Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the rise in irregular migration via the Western Balkan route through Serbia, including EU pressure on Serbia's visa regime and possible consequences for its visa-free arrangement. The government shares concern, reports Serbia's recent visa changes after EU diplomatic pressure, says it will monitor progress, and supports EU steps such as Frontex status negotiations and an action plan for the route.
The cabinet will closely monitor progress on this commitment and continue to press for progress.
Het kabinet zal de voortgang op deze toezegging nauwlettend monitoren en op voortgang blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het jaarverslag van de Europese Rekenkamer over 2021 en de dechargeprocedure

Rep. Van Wijngaarden (VVD) asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' 2021 annual report, including rising error rates in EU spending, risks from loans to third countries, and whether the Court receives all information it needs. The government answered that error rates remain too high (3.0% against a 2.0% tolerance), that it will push for tougher Council recommendations on discharge and may vote against them, and that it will raise transparency for the Court in general terms.
The cabinet will again this year push hard in the Council discussion for Council recommendations that sufficiently reflect the Court's conclusions.
Het kabinet zal zich ook dit jaar in de discussie in de Raad hard maken voor Raadsaanbevelingen die de conclusies van de ERK in voldoende mate reflecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Von der Leyen blijft zwijgen over vaccinonderhandelingen met Pfizer'

The MP asks whether the European Commission refuses to comply with the European Court of Auditors' information requests on the May 2021 Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine contract, and whether Dutch oversight powers are weaker than EU ones. The minister answers that the Court's report only notes missing documents on the preparatory negotiations, that the EU Treaty and Financial Regulation give the Court broad access powers comparable to the Dutch Algemene Rekenkamer, and sees no reason to tighten them.
From these provisions it follows that the European Court of Auditors has extensive powers to inspect all documents it considers necessary for carrying out its tasks.
Uit deze bepalingen volgt dat de Europese Rekenkamer uitgebreide bevoegdheden heeft tot inzage in alle documenten die zij voor de uitvoering van haar taken noodzakelijk acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Piri over het annuleren van Europride

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Piri asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would protest Serbia's cancellation of Europride and press for it to go ahead under police protection, and whether this should weigh in EU accession assessments. The minister agreed that freedom of assembly must be upheld and said the Netherlands has raised the issue bilaterally and with EU partners, with the Commission expected to address it in its progress report.

Since the reports on Europride, the Netherlands has consulted closely with civil society partners in Serbia, the EU and like-minded countries on possible options for action both publicly and behind the scenes.

Nederland heeft sinds de berichtgeving over Europride nauw overleg gevoerd met maatschappelijke partners in Servië, met de EU en met gelijkgezinde landen over mogelijke handelingsopties voor zowel voor als achter de schermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Mogelijke corruptie in Zwols Isala-ziekenhuis groter dan gedacht’

MPs Tielen and Van Wijngaarden asked about possible corruption at Isala hospital and the roles of internal and external supervisors, reporting channels, further integrity instruments, and the Court of Audit's view on fraud oversight. The minister explained the existing supervisory framework (supervisory boards, NZa, IGJ, Governance Code Zorg 2022), said she has no overview of whipblower-channel numbers, and pointed to a forthcoming letter on the transformation of medical specialist companies.

I do not have an overview of the number of care providers that have a confidential person as a reporting point for deviant behaviour or integrity concerns, nor of the number of reports that reach the external supervisor via such a reporting point.

Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal zorgaanbieders dat beschikt over een vertrouwenspersoon als meldpunt voor afwijkend gedrag of zorg over integriteit dan wel van het aantal meldingen dat via een meldpunt bij de externe toezichthouder terecht komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Hoe een zorgaanbieder heel makkelijk te veel zorg kan declareren'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about a news report on how care providers can easily over-declare care, asking how annual accounts are checked, how often the NZa acted on fraud signals, whether whistleblowing channels exist, whether a municipal escalation model with the Public Prosecution Service exists, and the status of removing the double-intent requirement from the Wmo 2015. The minister answered that the NZa uses annual accounts for risk detection and lists informal and formal interventions over five years, points to NZa and municipal reporting channels, denies a formal escalation model but describes ongoing cooperation with the OM/FP, and expects the Wmo amendment in spring 2023.
I expect to present this bill to your House in spring 2023.
Ik verwacht dit wetsvoorstel in het voorjaar van 2023 aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden  over bufferzones bij abortusklinieken

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Wijngaarden (VVD) asked whether a buffer zone around abortion clinics, banning demonstrations, would prevent intimidation of women by anti-abortion protesters, and what tools municipalities have. The minister said intimidation is unacceptable but demonstration rights must be protected, that local mayors decide enforcement and can impose conditions, and declined to send a list of clinic buffer zones, though he will consult municipalities and clinics.
It is primarily a local matter to give further substance to the exercise of the fundamental right to demonstrate
Het is primair een lokale aangelegenheid om nadere invulling te geven aan de uitoefening van het grondrecht om te demonstreren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Wijngaarden over de beschikbaarheid van 'Middel X'

MPs Tielen and Van Wijngaarden asked the Minister of Health about the availability of the suicide substance 'Middel X' after a police officer fell ill in an Arnhem home where it was found, and about the effectiveness of the 2018-2019 chemical sector code and any illegal market, and whether a 'proeftuin' for the Coöperatie Laatste Wil could be considered. The Minister said the risk to responders is very limited and the substances are not banned, that barrier-raising policy and the voluntary code are in place though effectiveness is hard to quantify, and that the 'proeftuin' request was declined given the demissionary cabinet and current policy.
Yes, I am aware of this.
Ja, hier ben ik bekend mee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden en Kuiken over de uitvoering van de Wmo 2015 voor patiënten met ALS

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Kuiken asked about municipal delays and inconsistency in Wmo 2015 provision of aids and support to ALS patients, including whether municipalities can be called to account and their view of the ALS protocol. The State Secretary acknowledged distressing cases and deferred to municipalities, pointing to existing agreements, a pending study and a commitment to talk with municipalities and the VNG where problems are signalled.
I am aware that distressing situations arise in individual cases, for example of ALS patients, where it takes a long time to organise support, and that is undesirable.
Ik ben ermee bekend dat zich schrijnende situaties voordoen in individuele situaties van bijvoorbeeld ALS-patiënten, waarin het lang duurt om de ondersteuning te organiseren en dat is onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Heinen over ‘Defensie-industrie vangt vaker bot bij banken die reputatieschade vrezen’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Heinen asked why banks refuse defence-industry firms accounts over reputational risk, whether the government will talk to banks and industry, whether firms can be exempted from ESG rules, and whether the EU has discussed clashes between sustainability and defence capacity. The minister says banks set their own client policy, the government will first meet the defence sector and then the Dutch Banking Association, has no data on closed accounts, will push for ambitious EU sustainability standards while noting the special position of defence, and reports EU discussion of the issue.
Enquiries with the NVB show that it does not have these figures at its disposal.
Navraag bij de NVB leert dat zij deze cijfers niet tot hun beschikking hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het artikel: “IGJ heeft niks meer aan mislukt ICT-systeem” van Skipr

An MP asks the Health Minister about the failed SPEC case-management ICT system at the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ), which cost over 35 million euros, including its budget consequences, causes, staff trust, and lessons learned. The minister answers in detail, citing an ABDTOPConsult evaluation, stating there are no further financial obligations, that errors occurred, and that governance has been reorganised with a programme director for IT.
To learn lessons from the situation that arose, the development and implementation of SPEC were thoroughly evaluated in 2021.
Om lessen te trekken uit de ontstane situatie zijn de ontwikkeling en implementatie van SPEC in 2021 grondig geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Mali expels Paris envoy over 'hostile and outrageous' French comments'

VVD MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about Mali's expulsion of France's envoy, the junta's postponed elections, and the effects on Dutch participation in MINUSMA and Takuba. The ministers answered that the junta is illegitimate, that Takuba will be withdrawn, and that the impact on Dutch missions and EU coordination is under close review.
The cabinet is also holding intensive consultations with partners in the UN and EU on the possible consequences of the deteriorating conditions in Mali for the UN mission MINUSMA.
Het kabinet voert daarnaast intensief overleg met partners in de VN en de EU over de mogelijke gevolgen van de verslechterende omstandigheden in Mali voor de VN-missie MINUSMA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Wijngaarden en Koerhuis over de actuele veiligheidsrisico’s voor Nederlanders in Oekraïne

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Infrastructure about security risks for Dutch nationals in Ukraine, including travel advice, evacuation preparations and airspace safety. The government answered that there is no reason yet to speak of a threatening situation, kept the current travel advice, said evacuation is not being organised, and pointed to existing EU and national airspace risk assessments.
That number need not be representative of the actual number of Dutch nationals in Ukraine, because there is no registration obligation for Dutch nationals abroad (due to privacy).
Dat getal hoeft niet per se representatief te zijn voor het daadwerkelijke aantal Nederlanders in Oekraïne, omdat er geen registratieplicht is voor Nederlanders in het buitenland (vanwege privacy).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het RTL4 nieuwsitem inzake de intimidatie van de advocaten van de nabestaanden van de MH17-zaak

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that lawyers for MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, possibly by Russia, including being followed to their homes. Minister Grapperhaus declined to discuss individual cases or investigations for security reasons, described general counter-interference cooperation, and said the NCTV protects those involved while noting no information currently warrants diplomatic action.
For security reasons, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Ik kan vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen uitspraken doen over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Minister Bijleveld en Admiraals Kramer en Tas uiten zorgen tijdens commando-overdracht'

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Rajkowski asked the Defence Minister about warnings on Russian submarine activity threatening undersea data cables, cable capacity, monitoring and protection measures, and naval capabilities. The minister answered in detail on the threat and cable routes but declined operational specifics, said no incidents had been reported, and noted the matter is handled through NATO and EU cooperation.
For operational reasons we cannot give a further explanation of this.
Om operationele redenen kunnen we hierop geen nadere toelichting geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen en Valstar over het bericht ‘Frankrijk ziet Taliban-banden bij gevluchte Afghanen’

Members Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen and Valstar asked the ministers whether evacuated Afghans with Taliban, Al Qaeda or IS ties could enter the Netherlands, how security screening was done before and after evacuation, and whether the Taliban can be treated as a terrorist organisation. The State Secretary answered that all asylum applicants are screened under standard procedures, that pre-evacuation screening was largely not possible given the time pressure, and that individuals can be excluded under article 1F or prosecuted, while the Taliban as an organisation is not on UN or EU terrorism lists.
For other persons who did not work directly for Dutch officials as part of an international military or police mission, such screening was in most cases not carried out by the Netherlands in advance.

Voor de andere personen die niet rechtstreeks voor (een) Nederlandse functionaris(sen) als onderdeel van een internationale militaire of politiemissie werkten is een dergelijke screening in de meeste gevallen niet vooraf door Nederland uitgevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Belhaj en Piri over het uit de vaart nemen van een marineschip door een ernstig tekort aan personeel

MPs asked the State Secretary why technical staff shortages forced the navy to take Johan de Wit and Van Speijk out of service, and how Defence plans to create specialist career paths to retain personnel. The government attributes the decommissioning to staff shortages and to redeploying crews to other ships, and sets out HR transition measures including specialist career paths that still need union agreement.
The temporary removal from service of Johan de Wit and Van Speijk is driven by two causes.
Het tijdelijk uit de vaart halen van Zr. Ms. Johan de Wit (JWIT) en Zr. Ms. Van Speijk (VSPK) wordt door twee oorzaken ingegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Boswijk over de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Boswijk asked about the Maritime Protection Act (Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij), including the use of Vessel Protection Detachments, piracy in the Gulf of Guinea, and ILT oversight. The government answered in detail, giving request statistics, budget figures, and a reasoned refusal to designate the Gulf of Guinea as a risk area, while promising an EU pilot evaluation and ongoing ILT-Defence arrangements.
Once the results of that are known, your House will be informed about them.
Zodra de resultaten daarvan bekend zijn, zal uw Kamer daarover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Boswijk en Stoffer over het munitiebudget

MPs Van Wijngaarden, Boswijk and Stoffer asked about a reported cut in the ammunition budget for training from EUR 140 million in 2021 to EUR 80 million in 2023, and its effects on readiness, missions and simulator training. The State Secretary confirmed a structural shortfall of EUR 60 million, partly covered by temporary increases, said cuts would reduce use of expensive munitions while keeping required training levels, and noted that deeper structural fixes depend on future budget room and a future cabinet decision.
It is up to a next cabinet to take a decision on this.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om hierover een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over de HCSS/Clingendael publicatie ‘Towards a Space Security Strategy, Action Points for Safeguarding Dutch Security and Prosperity in the Space Age’

An MP asks the Defence Minister about a HCSS/Clingendael report on Dutch space security, including situational awareness, EU alignment, a promised space strategy, the BRIK-II satellite, a Defence Space Security Centre and funding. The Minister says the Defence Space Agenda will address these points before summer 2021, defers decisions on capabilities and funding to the next cabinet, and gives limited detail on BRIK-II.
Before this summer I will send the House of Representatives the Defence Space Agenda.
Voor deze zomer stuur ik de Tweede Kamer de Defensie Ruimte Agenda toe.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, El Yassini en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Journalisten aangevallen bij kerkdiensten Urk en Krimpen: ‘Dit is een aantasting van de rechtsstaat''

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Security minister about attacks on journalists at church services on Urk and in Krimpen aan den IJssel, police and prosecution handling, PersVeilig complaint figures, the 200% sentencing uplift for violence against journalists, a team for threatened journalists, support for freelance journalists, and COVID-era church gatherings. The minister answered in detail, stating that suspects were processed with proces-verbaal, that the police and local tripartite were responsible for risk assessment, and that research on violence against journalists and taskforce options were underway.
In the first 3 months of 2021, journalists reported threats, assault and intimidation to the PersVeilig reporting point 73 times.
Journalisten hebben in de eerste 3 maanden van 2021 73 keer melding gemaakt van bedreiging, mishandeling en intimidatie bij (het meldpunt) PersVeilig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Leraar Khalid A. had meiden dansschool ‘volledig in de greep’: ‘Naar de top in ruil voor seks’'

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether a dance teacher who allegedly abused girls was able to act for so long, whether screening tools suffice to keep abusers out of sports and youth settings, and what the 15 million euro structural funding for sex-crime capacity has achieved. The government answered that it cannot comment on ongoing criminal investigations, relies on the VOG screening and the abuser register, sees no added value in a dedicated prosecutor for cross-database pattern searches, and reports about 90 new detectives phased in.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Weverling over het bericht 'Beschermenswaardige partijen: bescherming van het daderdier'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about dangerous fighting dogs, including unrestricted ownership, medical and police costs, shelters rehoming such dogs, breeding restrictions and the Amsterdam appeal court ruling on liability. Minister Schouten answered that existing criminal and municipal powers are sufficient, that breeding restrictions and a risk test exist or are being developed, and that rehoming is possible depending on behavioural testing.
Criminal law provisions apply that impose restrictions on keepers of dangerous dogs.
Er gelden strafrechtelijke voorschriften die beperkingen opleggen aan houders van gevaarlijke honden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Wijngaarden over het pleidooi voor effectieve preventie van seksueel geweld

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Wijngaarden asked the state secretary whether he is aware of Rutgers' plea for effective prevention of sexual violence, whether the promised letter on additional prevention steps will still come in January, and whether that letter will respond to the plea. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said Parliament will be informed in February about the interdepartmental approach including prevention, and that Rutgers will receive a separate written reply and an official-level meeting.
Your House will be informed in writing in February about the interdepartmental approach to sexual violence, including prevention of sexual violence.
Uw Kamer wordt in februari schriftelijk geïnformeerd over de interdepartementale aanpak van seksueel geweld, inclusief preventie van seksueel geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Wijngaarden over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad inzake het inreisverbod

MPs Becker and Van Wijngaarden asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Supreme Court ruling on entry bans, the use of criminal prosecution under article 197 Sr for illegal residents, detention and reception of those with bans, and the relation to unwanted-person declarations. The State Secretary answered that prosecutions have sharply declined pending a Court of Justice ruling, gave approximate figures (about 10 people detained), explained the return procedure and reception policy, and referred to earlier letters for further detail.
It is not possible to give a precise picture of how many foreigners reside unlawfully in the Netherlands and therefore also not how many of them have an entry ban.
Het is niet mogelijk een precies beeld te geven van hoeveel vreemdelingen onrechtmatig in Nederland verblijven en dus ook niet hoeveel van hen een inreisverbod hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Grapperhaus blokkeert benoeming van rechter in euthanasiecommissie‘

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that Minister Grapperhaus blocked the appointment of a judge to the euthanasia review committee, and whether this was a first, on what grounds, and what follow-up is planned. The ministers confirmed a prior non-appointment in 2007, declined to give the reasons citing privacy of candidates, said appeal lies only to the civil court, and refused to share the motivation with the House beyond the confidential letter to the committee chair.

Regarding the preparation and motivation of decisions on proposed candidate members, as usual, no substantive statements are made in the interest of protecting the privacy of those involved in appointment procedures.

Over de voorbereiding en motivering van beslissingen ten aanzien van voorgedragen kandidaat-leden worden, zoals gebruikelijk, in het belang van de bescherming van de privacy van de betrokkenen bij benoemingsprocedures geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Nederlandse sekteleider (58) verdacht van gijzeling en misbruik kinderen'

MPs Lodders and Van Wijngaarden asked about a report on a cult leader suspected of abuse and whether the tax authority can revoke the ANBI charity status of such organisations, including the Orde der Transformanten. The State Secretary answered that the status can be revoked via the existing integrity test or the new VOG requirement from 1 January 2021, that enforcement is risk-based, and that he will inform parliament in early 2021.

Following MP Lodders' question during Question Hour of 13 October about organisations offering homosexuality 'healing' therapies, I asked for a review of whether and what the Tax Authority can do regarding the ANBI status of such organisations and whether a legal amendment is needed.

Naar aanleiding van de vraag van het lid Lodders (VVD) tijdens het Vragenuur van 13 oktober jl. over organisaties die homogenezingstherapieën aanbieden, heb ik verzocht om nader te bezien of en wat de Belastingdienst kan doen met de ANBI-status van dergelijke organisaties en of daarvoor wetswijziging nodig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘The GRU's MH17 Disinformation Operations Part 1: The Bonanza Media Project’

MPs Koopmans and Van Wijngaarden asked the ministers about a Bellingcat article on GRU disinformation operations linked to MH17, including legal options, a possible espionage offence, and mandatory registration of foreign influence agents. The government called such foreign interference undesirable, said it is preparing a new espionage offence, and considered mandatory registration not clearly effective or proportionate, favouring awareness-raising instead.
The cabinet has established that an additional criminal offence is desirable and will examine how to give it shape and then start a legislative process.
Het kabinet heeft vastgesteld dat een aanvullende strafbaarstelling wenselijk is en zal onderzoeken op welke wijze daaraan vorm kan worden gegeven en vervolgens een wetstraject opstarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Woedeaanval terrorismeverdachte leidt tot 30.000 euro schade in gevangenis’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about a terror suspect's rampage causing about 30,000 euro damage at PI Vught, whether he should pay for it, incident counts, disciplinary sanctions, and whether complaints were filed against him and Mohammed Bouyeri. The minister confirmed the facts, said the suspect should bear the damage, gave incident and sanction figures, and said a complaint was filed against the suspect but not against Bouyeri given his limited role.
In the first eight months of 2020, 318 incidents took place within PI Vught that led to disciplinary sanctions.
In de eerste acht maanden van 2020 hebben binnen de PI Vught 318 incidenten plaatsgevonden die hebben geleid tot disciplinaire straffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Gent over Demonstratie tegen omstreden pedopartij

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Gent asked whether the Dutch party PVND, seen as a successor to the banned Martijn association, should be banned, whether it violates children's rights, and whether convicted offenders could be stripped of passive voting rights. The Minister of Justice answered that the OM is investigating and will not comment on ongoing inquiries, that deprivation of voting rights is only possible as a court-imposed sanction for serious offences against the state, and that a Political Parties Act is in preparation.
The Public Prosecution Service is conducting an investigation. No statements are made about ongoing investigations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) doet onderzoek. Over lopende onderzoeken worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Wijngaarden het bericht het bericht ‘Ik ben een schim geworden omdat het OM zo nodig die deal moest sluiten’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about a newspaper report in which the brother of a crown witness, an innocent person, complained of inadequate protection and a lack of insight into threat assessments. The Minister acknowledged repeated complaints, said threat analyses are classified and cannot be disclosed, admitted the murder of a relative was not foreseen and an internal evaluation led to improvements, and committed to further structural investment and a report before the budget debate.
Given the sensitivity of this information, these threat analyses have been classified at the state secret confidential level and higher.
Gezien de gevoeligheid van deze informatie zijn deze dreigingsanalyses gerubriceerd tot het niveau van staatsgeheim confidentieel en hoger
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Wijngaarden over de nieuwe veiligheidswet die de autoriteiten in Beijing opgelegd hebben aan Hong Kong

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about the Beijing-imposed national security law for Hong Kong, its effects on freedoms and judicial independence, and whether the extradition treaty with Hong Kong should be reconsidered. The government condemned the law's effects on autonomy and rule of law, and announced it would suspend the extradition treaty with Hong Kong as part of coordinated EU action.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Jonge meiden over feestjes bij hockeytrainers: ‘Megaveel drank en dan bed in lokken’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Rudmer Heerema asked about press reports of sexual misconduct by hockey coaches and what could keep such coaches out of sport, including data-sharing powers and a dedicated prosecutor. The minister answered that the government supports sports bodies' prevention efforts, screening tools such as the VOG and the disciplinary registry, and reporting campaigns, but declined to extend the football violence law or appoint a special prosecutor.
No. The Football Violence Measures Act grants powers to mayors, public prosecutors and criminal judges to prevent disturbances of public order.

Nee. De Wet Maatregelen bestrijding voetbalvandalisme en ernstige overlast kent bevoegdheden toe aan burgemeesters, officieren van justitie en strafrechters die zij kunnen inzetten ter voorkoming van verstoringen van de openbare orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Asscher, Van Otterloo, Van Ojik en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk met nieuwe wetgeving afspraken uit het uittredingsakkoord niet na dreigt te komen

Five MPs asked the government about the UK's planned Internal Market Bill, which would breach parts of the Withdrawal Agreement, and its risks for citizens' rights and Dutch nationals in the UK. The State Secretary answered that the government shares concerns, monitors citizens' rights implementation with the Commission, sees no current signs of further UK legislation undermining citizens' rights, and will consider information measures for Dutch nationals in the UK.

The government therefore monitors, together with the European Commission and in several ways, whether these rights are being honoured, including via the Joint Committee and the Dutch embassy in the UK.
Het kabinet monitort daarom samen met de Europese Commissie op verschillende manieren of deze rechten worden nagekomen, onder meer via het Gemengd Comité en via de Nederlandse ambassade in het VK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van Wijngaarden en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Verdachten zaak sushiketen Sumo krijgen geen straf vanwege inbreuk op hun privacy’

MPs asked the government about a court ruling that suspects in the Sumo sushi case received no sentence because their privacy was violated by a KRO-NCRV documentary filmed with the FIOD and the public prosecutor's cooperation, and about the prosecutor's role in the documentary's content and non-disclosure. The Minister of Justice answered that the prosecution has appealed, that the prosecutor had a media contract allowing review of footage, and that the revised prosecution guidelines of September 2020 aim to prevent similar cases.
As long as the case has not become final, I do not wish to anticipate the possible consequences of (part of) the judgment for other criminal cases of the OM.
Zolang de zaak niet onherroepelijk is geworden wil ik niet vooruitlopen op de mogelijke gevolgen van (een deel van) het vonnis voor andere strafzaken van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat een agent vervolging wil afdwingen van man die hem bedreigde met fysiek geweld

Members Van Wijngaarden and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked whether the Public Prosecution Service was right to drop a case where a police officer sought prosecution of a man who threatened him with violence, and about protection and reporting of violence against police. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the OM judged the threat did not qualify under the relevant offences, that agents are encouraged to report incidents, and that the bill extending the community-service prohibition is on track.
On this individual case, which is now before the judge, I cannot go into further detail.
Op deze individuele casus, die thans aan de rechter is voorgelegd, kan ik verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Haga over het bericht dat een man die de dochter van een columnist bedreigde een taakstraf van twintig uur kreeg opgelegd

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Haga asked whether a light community service sentence for threatening a columnist's daughter with rape and murder was acceptable and whether the OM's threat guideline should be tightened. Minister Grapperhaus answered that such threats are unacceptable, that sentencing is for the prosecutor and judge, and that the existing OM guideline and LOVS orientation points already allow higher sentences for aggravating factors, without committing to revise them.
Whether there is reason to impose a sentence in a particular case and, if so, which one, is determined by the public prosecutor or by the judge.
Of er in een bepaald geval aanleiding is om een straf op te leggen en zo ja, welke, wordt bepaald door de officier van justitie of door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Koopmans en Wiersma over het artikel ‘Marokkaanse Nederlanders bevrijd ons van de dubbele nationaliteit’

MPs from the VVD asked the government how it responds to Moroccan-Dutch citizens who want to renounce dual nationality, whether Morocco's diaspora institutions interfere in the Netherlands, and what practical help and EU position apply. The ministers answer that renunciation rights should be respected abroad, that foreign interference is handled under the 2018 unwanted-interference approach, and that the Moroccan and Turkish nationality rules are the responsibility of those states.
There can be no question of undesired influence on the individual lives of Dutch nationals and the choices they make.
Er kan geen sprake zijn van ongewenste beïnvloeding op de individuele levens van Nederlanders en de keuzes die zij maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht '“Zero tolerance” is needed across Europe as figures show it’s a world hub for hosting child sexual abuse material'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about an IWF report that 71% of child sexual abuse material found worldwide is hosted in the Netherlands, and about enforcement against webhosts that fail to remove it. The minister said the figures reflect reporting and crawler effects, outlined cooperation with EOKM and the EU, and said a bestuursrechtelijk enforcement bill is being prepared but cannot take effect before summer.
Once TU Delft has delivered its complete measurement in a report, I intend to send it to the House of Representatives, thereby making the names and performance of companies transparent.
Wanneer de TU Delft haar complete meting in een rapport heeft opgeleverd, ben ik voornemens deze aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden en daarmee namen en prestaties van bedrijven transparant te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Vuurwapens, explosieven en cocaïne: schoolkoepels slaan alarm over criminele leerlingen' en de uitzending van Jinek van 21 februari 2020

MPs Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked ministers about reports that school federations see rising serious incidents involving weapons and drugs, underreporting to police, and conflicting ministerial statements on filing criminal complaints. The government says there is no national incident registry, points to the Veiligheidsmonitor and existing police and municipal partnerships, stresses the importance of filing complaints for serious offences, and promises to discuss cooperation with partners and to publish the evaluation of the Wet veiligheid op school in summer 2020.
There is no national registration of the number of incidents that have occurred at schools.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van het aantal incidenten dat zich op scholen heeft voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Kuiken over het artikel ‘Burgemeesters roepen na gewelddadig weekeinde op tot messenverbod voor minderjarigen’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about mayors' calls for a knife ban for minors after violent incidents, including the effectiveness of the ban on certain knives, licence numbers, consultations with police and mayors, and whether the ban on carrying knives should be tightened. The Minister said effectiveness cannot be measured, reported seven knife-collector exemptions and three refusals, defended the existing general carrying prohibition, and promised to inform parliament of the consultation outcomes in spring.
As promised during the aforementioned question hour and in the letter of 3 February, I will inform your House of the outcomes in the spring.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het genoemde vragenuur en in de brief van 3 februari informeer ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Toorenburg over het artikel ‘Verdachte in ‘tattookillers’-zaak knipt enkelband door en vlucht’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a suspect who cut his ankle monitor and fled during a case, and whether conditional release is withheld in such cases. The minister said the prosecution does not hold data on the specific cases, that about 60 requests to revoke conditional release were filed in 2019 with 45 partly granted, and that the specific case is pending appeal and cannot be discussed in substance.
At the time of the assessment, the prosecution saw no serious objections on the basis of which it could be requested to refrain from conditional release.
Ten tijde van de beoordeling zag het OM geen ernstige bezwaren op grond waarvan verzocht kan worden om van een v.i. af te zien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Wijngaarden, Ploumen, Van Ojik, van der Graaf, Van der Staaij, van Nispen over het onderzoek van Levada Centrum onder de Russische bevolking naar de publieke opinie over Ned

MPs asked the government about a Levada Centre survey of Russian public opinion on the Netherlands and MH17, including willingness to pay compensation, access to facts, and whether Russians could follow the trial in Russian. The government said it was aware of the survey, that trial information is available online in English and via the Dutch embassy, and that the judiciary chose to livestream the trial in English; a Russian-language livestream of the first session was made by Current Time and the government is looking into Russian summaries.

Within the limits of the law, the judiciary, partly because of the broad and diverse international involvement, decided to set up a livestream so the MH17 trial can be followed worldwide and in English as well as Dutch.

Binnen de mogelijkheden van de wet heeft de Rechtspraak, mede vanwege de brede en diverse internationale betrokkenheid, besloten om een livestream in te richten waardoor het MH17-proces wereldwijd en naast het Nederlands, ook in het Engels te volgen is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Wiersma over het arrest van de Hoge Raad der Nederlanden, het artikel ‘Salafistische scholen leren kinderen zich af te keren van Nederland’ en ‘Invoer hallucinerende aya

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Wiersma asked the Minister of Justice about a Supreme Court ruling on drug import and religious freedom, and about Salafist mosque schools teaching children punishments such as stoning and execution for apostates and homosexuals. The Minister said the ruling does not automatically apply to other offences, that the government will not tolerate such teaching and is tackling it through a taskforce and an informal-education review, and that he cannot judge whether specific statements are criminal, while listing existing offences and recent penalty increases.
It is not my task to rule on the criminality of specific statements or conduct.
Het is niet mijn taak om uitspraak te doen over de strafbaarheid van concrete uitingen of gedragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Slechts één supersnelrechtszaak, ondanks meer incidenten jaarwisseling’

An MP asked why only one super-fast-track (supersnelrecht) case reached court this year despite more New Year's Eve incidents, and whether more such cases could be handled. The Minister answered that only evidentially simple cases suit the fast track, that victims generally value it but complete dossiers and victim claims sometimes call for ordinary procedure, and that the fast track is not an end in itself.
This means that more complex cases requiring additional investigation generally do not qualify for the super-fast-track procedure.
Dat betekent dat complexere zaken waarin aanvullend onderzoek nodig is in het algemeen niet in aanmerking komen voor supersnelrecht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Hogere straffen voor geweld, lagere straffen voor drugs’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether it is undesirable that serious drug offences and threats receive lower sentences, and whether maximum penalties should be raised. The minister declined to take a position on sentences imposed by judges, said the research does not show a clear trend, and saw no need to raise maximum penalties.
However, I do not consider it appropriate to express a view on the level of sentences imposed by judges.
Ik acht het echter niet opportuun om mij uit te spreken over de hoogte van door rechters opgelegde straffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over de uitzending van Pauw op 16 december 2019 en de tweet van Peter R. de Vries op 17 december 2019

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Pauw broadcast on the non-appearance of detained suspect Gökmen T. at his hearing, the handling of victim communication, the choice of courtroom, and Peter R. de Vries's tweet disputing the broadcast's account. The minister explained the existing legal framework, the planned mandatory-appearance bill, the prison intervention team deployment, and the court's courtroom and video arrangements, and committed to improved victim information for the next hearing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Dam, Groothuizen, Helder, Kuiken, Van Wijngaarden en Van den Berge over het boek ‘Moordsporen, op zoek naar de waarheid achter cold cases’

MPs from several parties asked the Justice Minister about the book 'Moordsporen' on unresolved cold cases, including the Larissa Dumont case, and whether an independent second-opinion facility should be set up. The minister acknowledged the importance of resolving doubts for relatives, pointed to police learning and ombudsman initiatives, defended the prosecutor's earlier conclusions, and described an ongoing second-opinion pilot and existing complaint routes.
If relatives have doubts about the conclusions of the death investigation after it has concluded, they can raise them with the public prosecutor.
Indien nabestaanden na het overlijdensonderzoek twijfels hebben over de conclusies daarvan, kunnen zij deze kenbaar maken aan de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van Dam en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Overheid sponsort eigen verzet’

MPs asked whether government-subsidised legal aid for environmental and other organisations suing the state, including squatter-type groups, is appropriate and whether the practice is being evaluated. The minister answered that subsidised legal aid can cover administrative cases, that stacking of procedures is possible but no business model is evident, that eligibility rules apply, and that the long-overdue evaluation of the reduced environmental-organisation contribution will be shared with parliament in the first half of 2020.
This evaluation, however, never took place and is now being carried out after all.
Deze evaluatie heeft evenwel nooit plaatsgevonden en wordt nu alsnog uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Tbs’ers uit frustratie ontsnapt’?

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of staff shortages and turnover in forensic care and their effect on safety and treatment of tbs patients. The minister acknowledged shortages, cited a 28.5 million euro package and a taskforce with a recruitment campaign, and gave no precise vacancy figures because most providers are private.
I have no insight into the precise extent of the staff shortages.
Ik heb geen zicht op de precieze omvang van de personeelstekorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Illegaal vlogt en feest op kosten gemeente’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether municipal subsidy money for illegal migrants (LVV programme) undermines national policy, and whether they should be made to leave rather than learn Dutch. The State Secretary answered that spending is a local matter, that LVV aims at durable solutions mostly meaning return, and that the convenant partners are in ongoing dialogue with Amsterdam.
It is not for me, as State Secretary for Justice and Security, to pass judgment on this.
Het is niet aan mij, als Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid, om hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Weverling over de artikelen ‘Asielzoekers uit veilige landen terroriseren Harderwijk’ en ‘Harderwijk is diefstallen door asielzoekers beu’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Weverling asked about press reports of crime by asylum seekers from safe countries in Harderwijk, their nationalities, unknown-destination departures, and returns. The State Secretary declined to address Harderwijk specifically, gave national figures showing nearly half of suspects were from Algeria and Morocco, and described efforts to improve returns, including conditional cooperation with origin countries.
Each year I inform the House about incidents through the incident overview in the Aliens Chain Report (RVK).
Jaarlijks informeer ik uw Kamer over incidenten door middel van het incidentenoverzicht in de Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen (RVK).
Antwoord op vragen van leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Protestmars in Beverwijk om geweld jongerenbende’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Van Wijngaarden asked the Justice Minister about the Pilotenbende, a group of 60 to 80 youths causing vandalism, threats and intimidation in Beverwijk, and about police and municipal capacity to tackle it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the municipality and police have used cameras, an assembly ban, area bans and prosecutions, that the problem is decreasing but not over, that the matter is a local responsibility, and that ministry-municipality consultation on further help is ongoing.

Although this is a local responsibility of the local triangle, consultation is already taking place between the Ministry of Justice and Security and the municipality of Beverwijk on help with the further approach.

Hoewel het hier om een lokale verantwoordelijkheid gaat van de lokale driehoek, vindt er reeds overleg plaats tussen het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de gemeente Beverwijk over hulp bij de verdere aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over de artikelen ‘Rechtsbijstandverlener tart advocatenregels’ en ‘Kleine bedrijven vinden de rechter te duur’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a rule by the Dutch Bar Association that bars advocates in employment from serving clients without legal expenses insurance, and about whether small businesses find legal costs too high. The Minister says access to justice must be affordable, that the Bar Association is responsible for reviewing its rules, and that she will inform parliament after the bar's review.
I expect the NOvA to critically review its rules when new forms of service delivery emerge.
Ik verwacht van de NOvA dat zij regels kritisch tegen het licht houdt op het moment dat nieuwe vormen van dienstverlening ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Toetsingscommissies euthanasie gaan meer naar de context kijken’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Tellegen asked about reports that euthanasia review committees will look more at context, and about a proposal to let the Supreme Court rule on euthanasia law questions directly. The government said it is examining allowing cassation in the interest of the law against RTE rulings, is studying ways to protect doctors from lengthy criminal proceedings, and that talks with stakeholders have already taken place, with a substantive letter promised this autumn.
Your House has been promised that this proposal will be examined.
Aan uw Kamer is toegezegd dat dit voorstel wordt onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Gedode Albanees Lato had eigen leger in Gelders dorp’

MPs Van Dam and Van Wijngaarden asked whether Festim Lato, shot dead in the Netherlands, had a private army, whether authorities ignored signals, and whether residents were endangered. The minister denied the private-army characterisation, said police monitored the address and seized weapons, and that no action was needed against a private army absent evidence of one.
I share the view that it would be an unacceptable situation if someone were to maintain an (armed) private army there.
Ik deel de mening dat het een onacceptabele situatie zou zijn indien iemand er een (bewapend) privéleger op zou nahouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Veel schade door ‘bitcoin-advertenties’ met nepuitspraken BN’ers’

MPs from the VVD asked ministers about misleading bitcoin advertisements using fake quotes from well-known Dutch people, the scale of resulting harm, whether police, prosecutors, the AFM and social media platforms can act, and what tools exist to identify advertisers and protect consumers and the persons whose names are misused. The government answered that the advertisers are unknown, reported about 1.7 million euro in reported damage, explained existing criminal, consumer-law and civil remedies, and said crypto-assets generally fall outside AFM supervision and no new national regulation is advised.
It is not known who or which organisations commissioned the placement of these misleading advertisements.
Het is niet bekend wie of welke organisaties opdrachtgever zijn van plaatsing van deze misleidende advertenties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Meer  migranten claimen slachtoffer van mensenhandel te zijn’

MPs Becker and Van Wijngaarden asked whether rising numbers of African migrants claiming to be trafficking victims undermine the trafficking regime and asylum procedures, and whether the law could be changed. The State Secretary confirmed a sharp rise in trafficking reports, especially from Nigerian Dublin claimants, said this overloads police and prosecution and that the Dublin claim lapses when a residence permit is granted, and said a package of measures would follow.
By letter of 28 June 2019 I informed your House about an integrated package of measures addressing the above problems.
Bij brief van 28 juni 2019 heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over een integraal pakket aan maatregelen die bovengenoemde problematiek adresseert.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Van Wijngaarden en Laan-Geselschap over de berichten ‘Tientallen jongeren met grensoverschrijdend gedrag worden niet behandeld’ en ‘Aanhoudingen in Rotterdam voor groepsverkrachtin

Three VVD MPs asked the Ministers for Legal Protection and Health about press reports on untreated youths with sexual boundary-crossing behaviour and group rape by minors in Rotterdam. The government answered that trends in juvenile sex offending are falling, that municipalities are responsible for youth care ordered by courts, and that financial shortfall does not exempt municipalities from their duty.
Under the Youth Act, municipalities are responsible for the provision of youth care. Financial shortage does not release municipalities from their youth care obligation.
Op grond van de Jeugdwet zijn gemeenten verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de jeugdhulp. Financiële krapte ontslaat gemeenten niet van hun jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Automobilisten hebben lak aan rode kruizen A16’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Remco Dijkstra asked about drivers ignoring red crosses on the A16, the legal basis for penalising them, and whether pilots and camera enforcement by road inspectors could be accelerated. The minister replied that ignoring red crosses is now criminal, that a bill would raise penalties, that enforcement staff and pilots are being expanded, and that camera enforcement on inspectors' vehicles was not pursued because of safety and role concerns.
Ignoring a red cross was transferred a few years ago from the administrative enforcement act for traffic rules to criminal law.
Het negeren van een rood kruis is een paar jaar geleden overgebracht van de Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften naar het strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laan-Geselschap en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Opgesloten terrorist moet kunnen verdienen’

MPs Van Laan-Geselschap and Van Wijngaarden asked why prison authorities would let frozen-asset terrorist detainees earn and receive money, and whether this undermines the sanctions regime. The minister replied that only a capped internal prison account (500 euro, one contact person) is exempt, other frozen accounts stay blocked, the sanctions rationale still holds, and sanctions beyond asset freezing (travel and contact bans, supervision, nationality deprivation) exist.

By making the exemption possible only for limited amounts on the internal prison current account intended for activities within the penal institution, the exemption does not detract from the risk reduction intended by the sanction measure.

Door de ontheffing alleen mogelijk te maken voor beperkte geldbedragen op de interne rekening courant die bestemd zijn voor activiteiten binnen de penitentiaire inrichting, doet de ontheffing geen afbreuk aan de risicoverkleining zoals bedoeld in de sanctiemaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Buitenweg, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht Boek over politieonderzoek Nicole van den Hurk moet worden aangepast

MPs asked about a court ruling that a book on the police investigation into Nicole van den Hurk must be amended to protect relatives' privacy, and about how the police and prosecution service handle media contracts and embedded journalists. The minister admits errors were made, says the relatives were informed late, outlines a revised media guideline and standard contract, and says a Slachtofferhulp study will report by end 2019.
Errors were made. In weighing the public interest in openness against the protection of the relatives' privacy, insufficient attention was paid to the latter.

Er zijn fouten gemaakt. Bij de afweging tussen het maatschappelijk belang van openheid aan de ene kant en de bescherming van de privacy van de nabestaanden aan de andere kant is onvoldoende oog geweest voor het laatste.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat meisjes met een migratie-achtergrond al in de basisschoolleeftijd worden ontvoerd en uitgehuwelijkt

MPs Becker, Rudmer Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked whether girls with a migration background are abducted and married off from primary school age, how many cases exist, how schools report them, and what legal and consular tools exist. The minister answered that no 2018 reports involved primary-school-age victims, gave case counts, pointed to existing reporting and court-intervention routes, and promised further steps in a June progress report.
Exact figures on the abandonment of minors abroad are currently not available, as figures on this specific subject cannot be derived from the current registration system.

Exacte cijfers over achterlating van minderjarigen in het buitenland, zijn momenteel niet beschikbaar aangezien cijfers over dit specifieke onderwerp niet te herleiden zijn uit het huidige registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Nijkerken-de Haan en Laan-Geselschap over ‘Politie Limburg wil DNA-onderzoeken onderbrengen bij een commercieel forensisch instituut’

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a plan by Limburg police and the prosecution to have DNA and digital trace examinations carried out by a commercial institute (TMFI) rather than the NFI, asking about capacity, delays, the expected acceleration, and data protection. The minister replied that the trial is still in its research phase, that such arrangements are already possible via the NFI's One Stop Shop, that effects can only be measured after about three years, and that private partners must meet NFI and GDPR privacy requirements.
It is unclear which traces the article refers to; the article does not distinguish between digital traces and DNA traces.
Het is onduidelijk op welke sporen in het artikel wordt gedoeld, het artikel maakt geen onderscheid tussen digitale sporen en DNA-sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Visser en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Letselschade-uitkering verkeersslachtoffer moet belastingvrij'

MPs from the VVD asked whether personal injury compensation for road accident victims should be exempt from the asset income surcharge that affects Wlz and Wmo co-payments, following a call by insurers and victim groups. The government answered that the surcharge applies in principle, that only compensation for non-material damage and claims fixed before 11 October 2010 are excluded under the hardship clause, and that it is consulting stakeholders with findings promised before summer.
I expect to be able to inform your House before the summer about the outcomes of these consultations.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer voor de zomer te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van deze overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht “Duitse privacywaakhond verbiedt datadelen WhatsApp”

An MP asked the State Secretary about a German privacy regulator's order to Facebook to stop processing WhatsApp users' data and whether it affects Dutch data sharing, and asked whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority had contacted its German counterpart. The government answered that it cannot comment on Dutch consequences, that Facebook has appealed the German order to the Hamburg court, and that the Dutch authority is in contact with EU counterparts and the Article 29 group sent a joint letter to WhatsApp.
No statements can be made about this.
Hierover kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over algemene voorwaarden van sportscholen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about gym terms and conditions and whether consumers can complain when a gym is not a member of the Fit!Vak trade association, which controls access to the Consumer Foundation's dispute committee. The minister answered that non-members can use the general dispute committee or the court (kantonrechter), that consumers can have unfair terms annulled, and that trade codes and keurmerken still create incentives and can influence judicial standards.
If the entrepreneur is not affiliated with one of the dispute committees, the consumer can appeal to the district court judge.
Indien de ondernemer niet is aangesloten bij één van de Geschillencommissies, kan de consument een beroep doen op de kantonrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat een Curaçaose loterij het ook goed doet in Nederland

MPs Bosman and Van Wijngaarden asked whether illegal sales of Curaçao lottery tickets in the Netherlands are undesirable, whether kansspelbelasting should be paid, and what enforcement exists and is used. The government agrees the sales are undesirable and that tax should be paid, describes administrative and criminal enforcement tools, says the Kansspelautoriteit so far used only informal measures such as warnings because cases were not large-scale, and says the minister will raise internet gambling oversight with Curaçao at the JVO.
The investigation by the Kansspelautoriteit led to intervention and to the ending of the violations.
Het onderzoek van de Kansspelautoriteit heeft geleid tot interventie en tot het beëindigen van de overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Oosenbrug over het bericht: Filmmakers naar de rechter: ‘Staat doet te weinig tegen piraterij’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that filmmakers were taking the state to court over insufficient action against piracy, including whether consumers should be warned and how internet providers and rights holders could cooperate. The minister answered that legal alternatives, information campaigns and private civil enforcement are the main tools, reported on a November 2015 seminar, and said he would convene follow-up talks between rights holders and internet providers.
I am willing to initiate follow-up consultations at my department within a reasonable time to bring the parties closer together.
Ik ben graag bereid binnen afzienbare tijd vervolgoverleg te entameren op mijn departement om partijen nader tot elkaar te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Harbers over het bericht ‘De enorme interesse voor vergunningen voor internetgokken in Nederland’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Harbers asked about the expected size of the online gambling market, the revenue impact of uniform gambling tax rates of 24% or 25%, expected channelling rates and enforcement options. The government estimated the 2014 market at about 232 million euros, reported a lower revenue estimate than previously assumed if uniform rates were adopted, and said full enforcement against illegal online operators is unrealistic, so successful initial channelling is crucial.
At my request, three trade associations of online gambling operators made a closer estimate of the size of the Dutch online gambling market in 2014.

Op mijn verzoek hebben drie brancheorganisaties van online kansspelaanbieders, Speel Verantwoord, European Gaming and Betting Association en Remote Gaming Association, een nadere inschatting gemaakt van de omvang van de Nederlandse markt voor online kansspelen in 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Aukje de Vries over het artikel “Eumedion vreest uitbuiting kleine aandeelhouders”

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Aukje de Vries asked whether the government sees risks in the concentration of control by majority shareholders at Dutch listed companies and whether minority shareholders should be better protected, following an Eumedion position paper. The minister disputes the doubling figure, finds it impossible to judge whether control has concentrated, sees existing Dutch company and securities law as adequate, and is cautious about new procedural rules while committing to consider the position paper and to evaluate the Wet bestuur en toezicht in 2016.

Dutch company law aims both to give entrepreneurs a legal infrastructure enabling them to fully pursue their activities and to give those involved in the company, including shareholders and creditors, sufficient protection against abuse of power.

Het Nederlandse vennootschapsrecht strekt er enerzijds toe om ondernemers een juridische infrastructuur te bieden die hen in staat stelt hun activiteiten ten volle te ontplooien en anderzijds om de bij de vennootschap betrokkenen, waaronder aandeelhouders en crediteuren, voldoende bescherming te bieden tegen (machts)misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Van Wijngaarden over "de beveiliging van SUWInet"

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Van Wijngaarden asked about security of SUWInet, which holds sensitive personal data, including whether burgomasters should be alerted, how citizens can check and restrict access, and whether debt collectors can access it. The State Secretary acknowledged risks identified in a privacy impact assessment, outlined an escalation protocol and audit duties for municipalities, and rejected direct SUWInet access for debt collectors while promising letters to municipalities and a progress update in October.
The escalation protocol, which I will send to you this autumn, contains a number of steps, with disconnecting an organisation from SUWInet as the ultimum remedium.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Heera Dijk over het bericht ‘Nederland moet zich uitspreken tegen grote militaire actie in Cariben

MPs Ceder and Heera Dijk asked the government how it responds to the US military operation 'Southern Spear' against alleged drug boats in the Caribbean, whether it will call for independent investigation, whether US use of Curaçao facilities played a role, and whether it will inform the House. The government says the Kingdom is not involved in the US national operation, stresses adherence to international law without judging the US self-defence claim, notes only unarmed surveillance flights are covered by the 2000 facilities treaty, and leaves independent investigation primarily to the US while referring to diplomatic channels.
The Kingdom is not involved in the national US deployment in international waters and international airspace.
Het Koninkrijk is niet betrokken bij de nationale inzet vanuit de VS in de internationale wateren en het internationale luchtruim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de lancering van de Discriminatietoets door de Staatscommissie tegen Discriminatie en Racisme

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the Discrimination Test for public service, its government role, funding, legal anchoring, monitoring, and implementation of earlier motions. The minister answered that the government will push adoption, funds it, has no plans yet to legislate, and will address monitoring and action in a forthcoming cabinet response.
I currently have no intention to legally anchor the discrimination test.
Ik heb nu geen voornemen om de discriminatietoets wettelijk te verankeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah, Kröger, Ceder en Grinwis over de oproep voor effectievere ondersteuning van mensen met hoge energiekosten via het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

MPs Lahlah, Kröger, Ceder and Grinwis asked about the G4 call to support high-energy-cost households via the Temporary Emergency Energy Fund (TNE) and whether a publicprivate route can be revived this winter. The State Secretary answers that private co-financing fell short, so the route is not responsible; instead €30 million goes via the Municipal Fund to existing local services, with no direct income support, citing legal and state-aid risks.
It has been established that it is not feasible to realise a public-private construction this coming winter.
Er is geconstateerd dat het niet haalbaar is om aankomende winter een publiek-private constructie te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘De stand van de Jeugdzorg 2025’ van de Jeugdautoriteit

An MP asks the state secretary about the Youth Authority's report on youth care, including whether young people with stress can be helped by non-youth-care support, the delayed national law defining youth-care scope, and the need for a societal debate on expectations. The secretary largely agrees the system needs narrowing and a broader societal conversation, points to a scope bill planned for consultation early 2026 and a letter before the 2 February 2026 committee debate, but does not give firm new commitments beyond existing reform agenda steps.
I want to put the bill out for consultation as soon as possible, with the aim of doing so early next year.
Ik wil het wetsvoorstel zo spoedig mogelijk in consultatie brengen, het streven is begin volgend jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over de publicatie 'Understanding Anti-Christian Hate Crimes and Addressing the Security Needs of Christian Communities'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the government how it responds to the OSCE/ODIHR publication on anti-Christian hate crimes, including monitoring, under-registration, and international advocacy. The government welcomed the report, said discrimination against Christians is a small share of complaints so no specific policy exists yet, and pointed to planned public communication on anti-discrimination reporting and ongoing diplomatic advocacy.
Because of the small number of reports, there is currently no specific policy to combat discrimination against Christians.
Vanwege het geringe aantal meldingen is er op dit moment geen specifiek beleid om discriminatie van christenen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘Behoeften en ondersteuning van mantelzorgers op Bonaire’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a report on carers' needs and support on Bonaire, showing overload, bureaucratic obstacles and lack of support. The State Secretary responded that local policy is primarily the Public Body's responsibility, that the Ministry has supported maatwerk provisions and a carers' support point, and that a possible intensification pilot could be discussed in the CKO.
Forming local policy for carers is therefore mainly the responsibility of the Public Body.
Het vormen van lokaal beleid voor mantelzorgers is dus hoofdzakelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller, Van Nispen en Ceder over het Nederlandse beleid inzake strafoverdracht en rechtsbescherming van gedetineerden in het buitenland en meer in het bijzonder de zaak van de heer Singh

MPs Sneller, Van Nispen and Ceder asked about the Dutch transfer-of-sentenced-persons policy and the case of Mr Singh, a detainee in the US with a court-ordered transfer request. The Minister (Staatssecretaris Rutte) defended the binding-requirement policy, said a cassation appeal was lodged, and rejected calls to reform the WOTS framework or move decisions to an independent judge.
Pending this cassation procedure, I will continue to work unabatedly to ensure compliance with the order pronounced by the court.
Ik zal mij, hangende deze cassatieprocedure, onverminderd blijven inzetten voor de naleving van het door het hof uitgesproken gebod.

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to the detention of Zion Church pastors in China and what steps it will take to raise the case with Chinese authorities. The minister called the reports worrying, said Dutch diplomatic channels raise religious freedom concerns in general but that the Zion Church case has not yet been raised specifically, and promised continued monitoring with partners.
The Netherlands will, together with our partners, closely follow the case and raise it with the Chinese authorities in contacts.
Nederland zal de zaak, samen met onze partners, nauwgezet blijven volgen en deze in contacten met de Chinese autoriteiten aan de orde stellen.

Christian Union MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about killings and abductions of Ethiopian Orthodox Church members in Arsi, Oromia, including the 190 killed since 2021 claim, the August 2024 attack, and who is responsible. The minister confirmed awareness, said a religious dimension is likely alongside ethnic and conflict factors, that perpetrators remain unidentified, and that the Netherlands urges the Ethiopian government to protect vulnerable groups in dialogue and EU/UN settings.
It is not possible for the cabinet to determine who the perpetrators were.
Het is voor het kabinet niet mogelijk vast te stellen wie de daders waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het artikel 'Pleegkinderen geslagen, aan oren getrokken en door hond gebeten'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers about the abuse of foster children in a family home in the north of the Netherlands, the failure of the guardianship agency to detect or act on it, and the position of parents after loss of parental authority. The government answered that it cannot yet judge the case pending inspection investigations, described the supervision framework for family homes, and pointed to a bill strengthening independent oversight of minors under guardianship.
That is why the bill 'Act to strengthen legal protection in youth care' assigns the Child Protection Board an annual evaluation of the wellbeing and safety of these children.

Daarom wordt in het wetsvoorstel «Wet ter versterking van de rechtsbescherming in de jeugdbescherming» de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming belast met een jaarlijkse evaluatie van het welzijn en de veiligheid van deze kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Lanschot, Piri, Van der Werf, Belhirch, Van der Burg, Ceder en Dassen  over een gat in de steun aan Oekraïne

MPs from several parties asked whether part of the 2026 military support budget for Ukraine was brought forward into 2025, leaving a gap in 2026, and how the government will prevent unwanted gaps. The Minister confirms that €3.1 billion for 2026 was partly accelerated into 2025, that planned 2026 cash outlays now stand at about €2.1 billion, and that support will continue with further burden-sharing efforts, without committing to a specific new safeguard.
Part of this support has been accelerated into cash expenditure in 2025.
Een deel van deze steun is versneld in 2025 tot kasuitgaven gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over beleid rond inclusiviteit op hogescholen

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the Minister of Education about whether institutions may rename or drop Christian holidays in the name of inclusivity, and about the government's role in such policy. The Minister replied that institutions are autonomous in designing inclusivity policy and calendars, that the government will keep naming official holidays, and that she will raise the topic in talks with institutions.
Because of this institutional autonomy, the Ministry of OCW has no policy on how universities of applied sciences and universities should name holidays.
Vanwege deze institutionele autonomie heeft het Ministerie van OCW geen beleid op hoe hbo- en wo-instellingen feestdagen moeten noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht "Kinderen in de klas hebben mannelijke rolmodellen nodig"'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the government about the low share of male teachers in primary education, the 30% male-student target set by teacher training programmes, how progress is monitored, and whether agreements on retaining male teachers should be made. The State Secretary answered that efforts to attract men are ongoing, that the target is evaluated annually within LOBO, and that no concrete retention agreements are currently planned because outflow is mainly retirement.
For that reason, I would not currently pursue concrete agreements on retaining male teachers.
Vandaar zou ik op dit moment niet inzetten op concrete afspraken over het behoud van mannelijke leraren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over aanvallen van Hamas op Palestijnen in Gaza

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reported Hamas executions and attacks on Palestinians in Gaza after the ceasefire, including claims about ambulances, clan appeals and protection of minorities. The minister said the government could not verify specific incidents, condemned misuse of civilian means, and pointed to the peace plan, Hamas disarmament and humanitarian and EU support as the way to protect civilians.
The cabinet cannot independently verify this specific incident.
Het kabinet kan dit specifieke incident niet eigenstandig verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht ‘Is er geen vervolging in Nederland?’ Yerani werd zondag ruw over de straat gesleurd wegens evangelieprediking

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the Justice Minister about a reported assault on an evangelist in Amsterdam, how widespread violence against street preachers is, and whether the government will act to protect them and engage municipalities. The minister condemned such violence, said police arrested a suspect, stated no data on attacks against street preachers are kept, and said there are no signals requiring a guidance document, noting police maintain public order under the mayor.
The police do not keep data on violence against specifically evangelists or street preachers.
Gegevens over geweld tegen specifiek evangelisten of straatpredikers houdt de politie niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Ceder over de kwestie van de Armeense genocide

MPs Ceder and Kahraman asked why the government still refers to 'the question' of the Armenian genocide despite a motion asking it to use the term genocide, and whether fear of Turkish reaction drives the stance. The minister replied that the government keeps the legal Genocide Convention definition, sees positive but precarious developments in the Armenia-Azerbaijan and Armenia-Turkey normalisation, and does not comment on other countries' motives.
As stated in the letter of last April, the cabinet maintains 'the question of the Armenian genocide'.
Zoals in de brief van afgelopen april vermeld staat, houdt het kabinet vast aan «de kwestie van de Armeense genocide».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'High Court rules state not giving Palestinian prisoners enough food'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a High Court ruling that the state is not giving Palestinian prisoners enough food, and Ben Gvir's refusal to accept it, and sought to know about prisoner deaths, legal rights, and whether Israel should be pressed and monitored. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised detention conditions bilaterally and multilaterally, cites UN figures of at least 75 deaths in detention, backs ICRC access, and will inform parliament if there is cause.
