The cabinet raises these concerns in bilateral contacts with the Israeli authorities.
Het kabinet brengt deze zorgen op in bilaterale contacten met de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over nieuwe berichten over aanvallen op christenen in West- en Centraal-Afrika

ChristenUnie MPs Ceder and Bikker asked the Foreign Minister about reported attacks on Christians in West and Central Africa, whether perpetrators are mainly Islamist groups, whether the government will press Nigeria on specific demands, and on the status of EU and parliamentary motions. The minister condemned the violence, said it affects both Christians and Muslims with different dynamics per country, reaffirmed religious freedom as a priority, and said no date is known for an EU special envoy and the motion follow-up will be reported later.
The cabinet will inform your House about this shortly.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hier binnenkort over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Ceder over het artikel “Syrische Druzen werden buitengerechtelijk geëxecuteerd’’

MPs Ceder and Kahraman asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports of extrajudicial executions of Druze in Suwayda, whether the interim Syrian government is responsible, whether sanctions lifting undermines motion Ceder, and how Syria's investigations and accountability efforts are being supported. The minister answered that the government awaits the findings of the Syrian and UN inquiries, supports international accountability mechanisms, and will act with sanctions if the interim government does not deliver.
It is important to establish what exactly happened in Suweida and who was responsible for this violence.
Belangrijk is dat wordt vastgesteld wat er precies is voorgevallen in Suweida en wie verantwoordelijk is geweest voor dit geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bezoek van de Indonesische president aan Nederland en mensenrechtenschendingen in West-Papoea

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister would meet the Indonesian president during his visit, whether the Netherlands bears a duty of care toward West Papua, and how Indonesia is pressed on human rights abuses there. The minister denied a meeting with the Prime Minister, described the human rights situation as worrying, and listed bilateral, EU and multilateral channels, while declining to say whether the King would raise the issue because such talks are confidential.
The Royal Couple received the president at Huis ten Bosch Palace; it is customary that conversations the Royal Couple holds at the Palace are confidential.
Het Koninklijk Paar heeft de president ontvangen op Paleis Huis ten Bosch; het is een goed gebruik dat de gesprekken die het Koninklijk Paar op het Paleis voert vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over ‘de berichtgeving dat een derde in Gaza al dagen geen eten heeft’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a third of people in Gaza were going days without food, including how much food is needed, causes of distribution failures, GHF and Hamas roles, and Israeli shooting at aid points. The minister answered at length, acknowledging famine conditions and blockade effects, stating the government has no reliable evidence of systematic Hamas aid theft, and largely declining to quantify or verify several claims while promising continued diplomatic pressure.
The cabinet has no reliable evidence for the allegation that Hamas systematically or on a large scale diverts humanitarian aid since 7 October 2023.
Het kabinet heeft geen betrouwbaar bewijs voor de aantijging dat Hamas zich systematisch of grootschalig schuldig maakt aan ontvreemding van humanitaire hulp sinds 7 oktober 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Ceder, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over dat Nederland moet meewerken aan overbrengen ambassadebewakers

Six MPs asked the ministers whether the Dutch state must help transport 42 Afghan embassy guards after a summary-judgment ruling that the state acted unlawfully by not evacuating them. The minister contests the ruling, says the guards were not state employees, has appealed on an urgent basis, and says the appeal court suspended enforcement pending its decision, so no further transport steps are being taken.
On 12 September the appeal court suspended the State's obligation to immediately implement the judgment until it has ruled on the appeal.
Het gerechtshof heeft op 12 september jl. de verplichting voor de Staat geschorst om per direct uitvoering te geven aan het vonnis totdat het hof in het hoger beroep over deze zaak heeft geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ceder over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof over het overplaatsen van de heer Singh

MP Ceder asked the Foreign and Justice ministers why the government had not yet sent the transfer request for Mr Singh after the court ruling, and how it had handled the earlier motion and WOTS procedure. The state secretary answered that the request was sent within the court's deadline, that the state will carry out the ruling, and that transfer under the WOTS policy was not the appropriate route due to insufficient ties to the Netherlands.
The request for transfer of sentence was sent to the American authorities within the time limit set by the Court of Appeal.
Het verzoek tot strafoverdracht is uitgestuurd naar de Amerikaanse autoriteiten binnen de door het Gerechtshof gestelde termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de belastingkwestie rond kerkelijke vastgoed in Jeruzalem

MP Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister about Jerusalem's municipal property tax claims on church-owned properties, the freezing of the Greek Orthodox Patriarchate's bank accounts, and reported enforced sales against Armenian Church property, asking about Dutch diplomatic action. Minister Van Weel answered that the Dutch embassy raised the bank freeze with the municipality urging negotiation, and that the government is concerned and raises religious freedom with Israel, but gave no concrete new commitment.
The cabinet has no knowledge of a report of an enforced sale of property belonging to the Armenian Apostolic Church.
Het kabinet heeft geen kennis van een bericht over een executieverkoop voor bezit van de Armeens-apostolische kerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Ceder over het bericht dat investeren in ontwikkelingssamenwerking gunstig is voor de Nederlandse economie

MPs Hirsch and Ceder asked the government about a study claiming Dutch aid boosts exports and jobs, whether cuts to development cooperation were properly assessed, and whether it will commission research on the broader costs and benefits. The Staatssecretaris called the econometric findings a reasonable but non-conclusive indication, said the cabinet sees no added value in a new study of the cuts, and gave no answer on commissioning research on wider effects beyond referring to an OECD report and a letter.
For the aforementioned reason, the cabinet sees no added value in a study of the broader societal costs and benefits of the recent cuts to development cooperation in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet ziet om voornoemde reden geen toegevoegde waarde van een onderzoek naar de brede maatschappelijke kosten en baten van de recente bezuinigingen op ontwikkelingssamenwerking in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de zaak Salimzade/staat

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration why the state appealed again after the court annulled the IND's decisions three times in the case of Iranian twin girls seeking a residence permit with their aunt, a Dutch citizen, and questions the IND's reasoning, including the claim that the children would burden schools. The Minister declines to discuss the individual case, which is pending before the Council of State, and explains in general terms how the IND weighs article 8 ECHR family life against state interests, giving great weight to the child's best interest, and that the state appeals only when it disagrees with the ruling or sees a wider interest.
I cannot go into individual cases, certainly not cases that are currently being handled by the Council of State.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken, zeker niet op zaken die op dit moment nog in behandeling zijn bij de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de veiligheidssituatie van christenen in Syrië

The MP Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the ministers about the safety of Christians in Syria, the return policy, and whether minority groups should get a risk profile. The government answered that it shares concern, that individual assessment remains the basis for asylum decisions, that no group-wide risk profile for Christians is justified by the current country report, and it described sanctions relief, support against IS, and an unchanged school curriculum for now.
However, an application by a Syrian Christian will always be assessed individually on the merits of the case, measured against the situation in the country of origin.
Een aanvraag van een Syrische christen zal echter altijd individueel beoordeeld worden aan de hand van de merites van de zaak, afgezet tegen de situatie in het herkomstgebied.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over de berichten 'Joodse studenten voelen zich onveilig en buitengesloten op UvA en VU: "De universiteit adviseerde me niet meer te komen"' en 'Antisemitisme drijft leerli

Christian Union MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the education minister how the government responds to reports that Jewish students feel unsafe at Dutch universities and that antisemitism drives pupils to Jewish schools, and what measures exist. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing measures (Strategy Against Antisemitism, guidance, planned security duty, monitoring plans) and said further steps would be considered after a task force reports in early 2026, while declining to register religion or monitor the handbook's use.
Institutions do not register religion for privacy reasons.
Instellingen registreren religie wegens privacy redenen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de berichtgeving - Sudan lijdt onder ongeziene hongersnood

MP Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister about reports of famine in Sudan, including steps to deliver food (such as airdrops), EU coordination, the scale of the crisis, conflict minerals, and French arms exports to Sudan. The minister answered that Dutch funding supports UN and NGO relief, that airdrops are not a real alternative to land transport, that the EU contact group is operational, and that the government checks arms licences for diversion risk while not commenting on the French inquiry.
The cabinet has confidence in the French arms export control policy. It is not for the cabinet to comment on the outcomes of the French investigation.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in het Franse wapenexportcontrolebeleid. Het is niet aan het kabinet om in te gaan op de uitkomsten van het Franse onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Israël richt bloedbad aan bij medische kliniek: ‘Doden vrouwen en kinderen gewetenloos’’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to a reported Israeli strike near a Gaza clinic, whether it has sought clarification or pushed for an independent investigation, how it ensures Israel takes precautions, and whether it trusts the EU-Israel humanitarian access agreement and will expand Dutch aid. The minister condemned the strike, said no contact was held on this specific incident, pointed to Israel's own investigation and the Dutch request to share outcomes, and described monitoring of the EU-Israel agreement and additional Dutch humanitarian funding.
The Israeli army has indicated that it is investigating the incident.
Het Israëlische leger heeft aangegeven het incident te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over een Israëlische raketinslag op de Holy Family Church in Gaza

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Israeli strike on the Holy Family Church in Gaza, the government's assessment, international humanitarian law, Christian minorities' access to aid, and press access to Gaza. The minister condemned the attack, said no information was received from Israeli authorities beyond a claimed technical error, and described existing diplomatic and multilateral efforts while giving no new concrete commitments.
The cabinet has not received any information from the Israeli authorities about this attack.
Het kabinet heeft geen informatie van de Israëlische autoriteiten over deze aanval ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de aanhoudende aanvallen op het dorp Taybeh op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about repeated settler attacks on the Christian village of Taybeh in the West Bank, including damage to a church, injuries, threats to clergy, the role of the Israeli army, and prosecution of perpetrators. The minister condemned the attacks, said Israel as occupying power is responsible for protecting the population, reported contact with local churches, but gave no concrete information on prosecutions and no new measures beyond existing diplomatic and EU sanctions efforts.
The cabinet does not have information to confirm the statement of the Greek Orthodox Patriarch of Jerusalem.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie om de uitspraak van de Grieks-orthodoxe patriarch van Jeruzalem te bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het artikel 'Uitslag proefprocedure: gemeente mag bij beslag op bijstand niet maandelijks afdragen'

An MP asks the government to respond to a court ruling that municipalities may not pay garnished welfare benefits monthly to bailiffs, and questions why monthly deductions are still used given the extra costs. The State Secretary declines to comment on the individual case, states that holiday allowance is normally paid annually, that municipalities must weigh interests carefully, and that the VNG guidance will be discussed and possibly revised.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to respond to a judicial ruling in an individual case.
Het past het kabinet niet om te reageren op een rechterlijk oordeel in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Radicalen vrijuit op universiteiten: gedragscodes blijken vooral papieren tijgers’

MPs Ceder and Martens-America asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how he views reports that university codes of conduct are toothless against intimidating radical behaviour, and what he will do about recurring intimidation and disruption on campuses. The Minister says institutions are responsible for enforcing their own rules and safety, that he is strengthening supervision through a planned statutory duty of care for safety and a review of complaint procedures, but gives no concrete new enforcement sanctions beyond existing instruments.
I expect institutions to take their responsibility for a safe learning and working environment for students and staff and to use the regular instruments available to them for this purpose.

Ik verwacht dat instellingen hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen in de zorg voor een veilige leer- en werkomgeving voor studenten en medewerkers en hierbij het reguliere instrumentarium inzetten dat zij hiervoor beschikbaar hebben
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over coalition of the willing inzake alternatief plan humanitaire situatie in Gaza

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about humanitarian access to Gaza, a coalition-of-the-willing distribution plan, airdrops, sea deliveries, Egypt's Rafah crossing, sanctions and the EU's role in ceasefire talks. The minister answered that the war must stop, that Israel must grant humanitarian access, that the Netherlands is joining airdrops and EU measures, and that Rafah remains closed despite pressure, while largely restating existing policy.
The war in Gaza must stop.
De oorlog in Gaza moet stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het afketsen van het staakt-het-vuren tussen Israël en Hamas

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister how the cabinet judges the collapse of Israel-Hamas ceasefire talks, who is responsible, the status of hostages and aid, and what role the Netherlands and EU can play. The minister answered that the cabinet urges a ceasefire, sees Hamas as bearing significant responsibility, pushes Israel to allow humanitarian access, and supports further EU sanctions while stating it cannot confirm some claims or details of the talks.
The cabinet cannot make exact statements about the positions of the parties during the negotiations.
Het kabinet kan geen exacte uitspraken doen over de opstelling van de partijen tijdens de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de gemaakte afspraken tussen EU en Israël t.a.v. humanitaire hulp in Gaza

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister about EU-Israel agreements on humanitarian aid to Gaza, including whether agreed aid routes and truck volumes were met and whether terms should be shared with parliament. The minister answered that Israel has not fulfilled the agreements, announced EU-level measures such as suspending the trade part of the Association Agreement, but declined to publish the detailed terms to protect diplomatic effectiveness.
The High Representative and EEAS, with a view to maximising the chance of swift and successful implementation of the EU-Israel agreements, did not make the specific details of the agreements public.

De Hoge Vertegenwoordiger en EDEO hebben, met oog op het zoveel mogelijk vergroten van de kans van slagen op spoedige en succesvolle implementatie van de afspraken tussen de EU en Israël, de specifieke details van de afspraken niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de brandbrief van hulporganisaties en gebrekkige voedseldistributie in Gaza

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Foreign Minister why food aid in Gaza is not reaching people, how many trucks are cleared, whether the GHF distribution is adequate, and whether independent investigation into hunger deaths will be demanded. The minister acknowledges serious aid obstacles, attributes the distribution failure mainly to Israeli military action, blockade and bureaucratic procedures, but declines to take a position on several questions, citing UN responsibility and lack of information.
The cabinet is not aware of details of correspondence between GHF and the UN and cannot make statements about it.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met details over correspondentie tussen GHF en de VN en kan hierover geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk, Eerdmans, Van der Burg en Ceder over de brief van omstreden VN-rapporteur Albanese aan Christenen voor Israël

MPs from SGP, JA21, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about a letter from UN Special Rapporteur Albanese to Christians for Israel, its mandate limits, and threats of criminal consequences. The minister answered that communicating with non-state actors falls within the mandate, that the government disagrees with her content, that vandalism and intimidation are condemned, and that the mandate is adequately defined and the letter was confidential practice.
The letter itself has not been made public.
De brief zelf is niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het gelijktrekken van de regels voor jeugdstrafzittingen binnen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden

An MP asks why juvenile criminal hearings for 16- and 17-year-olds are open to the public on the BES islands and in Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten while they are closed in the Netherlands, and whether this fits the Convention on the Rights of the Child. The State Secretary explains the historical origin of the open-hearing rule, notes that the Caribbean countries are autonomous, points to a pending WODC study with results expected in mid-2026, and defers any decision on a uniform norm until then.
To answer this question I want to take into account the outcomes of a study that the WODC recently started at my request into the functioning of juvenile criminal law on the BES islands.

Voor een antwoord op deze vraag wil ik de uitkomsten betrekken van een onderzoek dat het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoeks- en Datacentrum (WODC) onlangs op mijn verzoek is gestart naar de werking van het jeugdstrafrecht op de BES-eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Nederland zet voor het eerst 'gewortelde' kinderen uit sinds einde pardonregeling'

The ChristenUnie MP Ceder asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that children rooted in the Netherlands were deported for the first time since the end of the children's pardon, questioning the safety of Nigeria, the deportation of a mother with three children, child welfare and the effects of lengthy procedures. The Minister declines to comment on individual cases, states that the best interests of the child are weighed under article 8 ECHR and article 3 CRC, and says that rootedness is not a separate criterion and is not systematically recorded.
We cannot go into individual cases.
Wij kunnen niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Het uitbesteden van schuldhulpverlening kan burgers juist chaos opleveren: 'Na anderhalf jaar was geen enkele schuld afgelost''

MP Ceder asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about a Trouw report that outsourcing debt assistance to private firms causes delays and unequal access, including Nationale ombudsman concerns and possible malpractice. The State Secretary largely rejected the link between outsourcing and stagnation, said responsibility stays with municipalities, pointed to the basic service agreements, and saw no reason to increase budgets or commission comparative research.
The Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment does not keep data per municipality on how debt assistance is organised.
Het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid houdt geen gegevens bij per gemeente van hoe de schuldhulpverlening is ingericht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over de verjaring van kindermisbruik op de BES-eilanden

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked why serious sexual offences against minors can still become time-barred on the BES islands while they cannot in the European Netherlands, and whether the rules will be aligned. The government confirms the twelve-year limitation period on the islands, explains it stems from a policy of restraint in legislation for Caribbean Netherlands, and says the limitation rules will be reviewed alongside accepting the Istanbul Convention, with acceptance expected by 2027 at the earliest and possible inclusion in a justice omnibus bill.
It is being considered whether the limitation periods can be adjusted as quickly as possible by including them in the justice omnibus bill for the BES that is currently being prepared.

Bezien wordt of een aanpassing van de verjaringstermijnen zo snel mogelijk kan worden verwezenlijkt, door deze op te nemen in het verzamelwetsvoorstel Justitie voor de BES dat op dit moment wordt voorbereid.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid Ceder heeft gesteld over de uitspraak van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens: discriminatie vanwege medische redenen bij onder bewind gestelde klant

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that Coolblue Energie discriminated on medical grounds by demanding a deposit from a customer under guardianship for dementia. The State Secretary accepted the ruling's principle that discrimination on health grounds is impermissible, referred to the CRPD and the Wgbh/cz, but said he had no data on how often the CCBR register is consulted and could not judge whether the problem is structural.
I have no insight into how often the CCBR is consulted.
Ik heb geen zicht op hoe vaak het CCBR wordt geraadpleegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over het onderzoek ‘Met een schone lei beginnen. Onderzoek naar schulden bij slachtoffers van seksuele uitbuiting’ en het bericht ‘Slachtoffers uitbuiting blijven vaak met

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked about a study on debts of victims of sexual exploitation and whether victims of trafficking are actually compensated through criminal or civil proceedings and the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven. The Secretary of State answered that the Netherlands meets its Council of Europe obligations, cited figures on compensation measures and Schadefonds applications, acknowledged obstacles such as courts declaring victim claims inadmissible, and pointed to planned improvements and a forthcoming Meerjarenagenda Slachtofferbeleid.
The Judiciary has no information on the full amount awarded or how many applications were rejected.
De Rechtspraak heeft geen informatie over het volledige toegekende bedrag of hoeveel aanvragen zijn afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de uitvoering van de motie-Ceder (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 2948) en het ´Pay-for-Slay-programma´ van de Palestijnse Autoriteit

Dutch MPs Ceder asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funding conditions tied to the Pay-for-Slay payments to Palestinian Authority families were implemented under the Ceder motion, and about Abbas's reported statements and the shift of the program to another entity. The minister answered that the Commission withheld part of a tranche for insufficient reform progress, that a new needs-based system replaced the prior law, that the EU was not formally notified, and that the Netherlands condemns the statements and keeps urging reforms.
The EU has not been formally notified of this.
De EU is hierover niet formeel op de hoogte gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over de uitbreiding van militaire trainingsfaciliteiten op ’t Harde

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked how long permit procedures for expanding military training facilities take, whether this slows defence readiness, and how regulations, nature protection and noise concerns will be handled. The government acknowledges lengthy permit procedures and the tension with defence urgency, outlines short- and long-term steps such as accelerating existing permits, the NPRD programme and a planned bill, but gives no average processing time.
An average processing time for permit procedures for expanding Dutch military facilities cannot be given.
Een gemiddelde doorloopsnelheid van vergunningsprocedures voor uitbreiding van de Nederlandse militaire faciliteiten is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ceder over het bericht ‘De Raad voor de Kinderbescherming komt al jaren onvoorbereid naar de rechter in Den Haag, en geeft zwaarwegend advies’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming attends family court hearings in The Hague unprepared, without reading the case file, while giving weighty advice. The State Secretary explained the difference between the consult and advisory roles, acknowledged unclear arrangements that led to a revised procedure from 1 May 2025, and said several hundred cases were affected.
Since 1 May 2025 the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming receives the relevant documents before every hearing.
Sinds 1 mei 2025 ontvangt de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming voorafgaand aan iedere zitting de relevante stukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Boswijk en Kahraman over het bericht 'Nigeria: christenen in deelstaat Plateau keer op keer slachtoffer militante Fulani’s.'

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Foreign Minister about reported attacks on Christians in Nigeria's Plateau state by Fulani militants, including the government's response, the role of religion, EU and UN action, and the ECOWAS ruling against Kano blasphemy provisions. The minister answered that the violence stems from local land and resource conflicts, that the government is cautious about framing it by religion, and that it raises the issue bilaterally, in EU and UN settings, and through existing programmes, while committing only to a visit by the Human Rights Ambassador and noting the EU Special Envoy appointment is ongoing.
The cabinet does not know who instigated the violence or what exactly motivated them.
Het is bij het kabinet onbekend wie de aanstichters waren van het geweld en wat hen exact motiveerde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Christen (36) ter dood veroordeeld in Pakistan wegens godslastering: 'Koran geschonden''

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about a Pakistani death sentence for blasphemy against a Christian man, and whether the government would seek his release, attend the appeal, and push for reform of blasphemy laws. The minister condemned blasphemy laws as a violation of religious freedom, said the Netherlands is coordinating with EU partners and will attend the appeal if possible, and listed existing advocacy, though he gave no concrete new commitment on reform.
The Netherlands is jointly examining with EU member state representations and the EU delegation in Islamabad what the most constructive and effective approach to this matter is.
Nederland gaat met de vertegenwoordigingen van de EU-lidstaten en met de EU-delegatie in Islamabad gezamenlijk na wat de meest constructieve en effectieve benadering is voor deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het incasso- en invorderingsstelsel

Ceder (ChristenUnie) asks the State Secretaries about the debt collection system, including the VNG proposals, follow-up to earlier motions, the cost of government collection, and the Wet kwaliteit incassodienstverlening (WKI). The government says it is implementing measures such as a collective payment plan and a duty of care for bailiffs, promises further research and an evaluation, and reports on registrations and possible unregistered collectors.
I see a lot of overlap between the VNG's proposals and the cabinet's ambitions.
Ik zie veel overlap in de voorstellen van de VNG en de ambities van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het initiatief in Hardenberg waarbij asielzoekers een MDT-certificaat kunnen behalen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Hardenberg project in which asylum seekers could earn an MDT certificate, and whether the Labour Inspectorate's investigation and existing rules are proportionate. The minister explained the volunteer-work exemption and UWV procedures, said the inspection investigation is ongoing and it will not comment on it, and declined to contact the municipality directly.
The Labour Inspectorate does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
De Arbeidsinspectie doet geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Ceder over de toenemende invloed van Iraans gesteunde milities en de positie van minderheden op de Vlakte van Nineve, Irak

MPs Ceder and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about Iran-backed militias displacing Christian mayors on the Nineveh Plain in Iraq, sanctions on Rayan al-Kildani, and minority protection. The minister said the government is concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in EU channels when warranted, and declined to speculate on future sanctions targets.
The cabinet does not wish to speculate further on possible future sanctions targets.
Het kabinet wil verder niet speculeren over eventuele toekomstige doelwitten van sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport van Coptic Solidarity ‘Hidden Crimes, Public Deception’

An MP from the ChristianUnion asked the Foreign Minister how the government would respond to a Coptic Solidarity report on abductions, forced conversions and forced marriages of Coptic women and girls in Egypt, and what steps it would take with Egyptian authorities. The minister answered that the embassy is in contact with civil society, cites Egypt's National Human Rights Strategy and existing programmes against violence against women, and said he lacks data on Coptic deaths, while only in part committing to raise the issues in bilateral dialogue.
I do not have information on the number of Copts who have died in recent years as a result of specific attacks or revenge actions.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over aantallen Kopten die de afgelopen jaren zijn overleden als gevolg van specifieke aanslagen of wraakacties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de brandbrief die Amsterdamse kerken aan de burgemeester van Amsterdam stuurden in verband met het gebrek aan fysieke ruimte om hun diensten en activiteiten plaats te laten vinde

MP Ceder asked whether the government recognises the shortage of physical space for church services in Amsterdam, whether Article 6 of the Constitution guarantees such space, and whether the government will press municipalities, including Amsterdam and Rotterdam, to reserve space for religious communities. The minister answered that space allocation is a municipal matter, that Article 6 imposes no obligation to guarantee physical space, that the state can only intervene if freedom of religion is rendered illusory, and that existing guidance is sufficient, with no concrete new action committed.
Article 6 of the Constitution, however, does not impose on the government an obligation of result to make sufficient physical space available for holding religious services.
Artikel 6 van de Grondwet legt de overheid echter geen resultaatsverplichting op om voldoende fysieke ruimte beschikbaar te maken voor het houden van erediensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het artikel ‘Despair Haunts Ramadan for Palestinians Displaced in West Bank.’

An MP asked the government about displacement of Palestinians in the northern West Bank, Israeli military operations, the Palestinian Authority's role in Jenin, humanitarian aid and prospects for return. The government answered that it is concerned, calls on Israel to act within international law, notes the PA's primary security responsibility in Area A, and says Israel has stated displaced Palestinians may not return to certain camps for the coming year.
The cabinet calls on Israel to show restraint and to act within the framework of international law.
Het kabinet roept Israël op tot terughoudendheid en om te handelen binnen de kaders van het internationaal recht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over het Raad van State-advies ten aanzien van het amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. op het wetsvoorstel voor de verlenging van de transitieperiod

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Council of State's critical advice on the Joseph amendment, which would make non-transfer the default in the pension transition, and its consequences for members, implementation, social partners and courts. The minister answered that the amendment weakens intergenerational solidarity, risks compulsory participation, causes transition delays and legal conflict, conflicts with ILO conventions on collective bargaining, and that he considers it undesirable and will address this in the government's response.
From my administrative responsibility for compliance with the Pension Agreement, orderly legislation and predictability for implementation, I consider this undesirable.
Vanuit mijn bestuurlijke verantwoordelijkheid voor de naleving van afspraken uit het Pensioenakkoord, ordentelijke wetgeving en voorspelbaarheid voor de uitvoering acht ik dit niet gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk, en Haage over het bericht ‘Minister Van Hijum kraakt plan pensioenreferendum van zijn eigen partij: kritisch advies in concept-brief’

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a critical draft advisory note on a pension referendum amendment was real and why supporting documents had not been published. The minister confirmed awareness, said underlying departmental notes will be published with the cabinet response before the plenary debate, and explained that advice is withheld until a ministerial decision is made.
All underlying departmental notes from SZW and Finance used in decision-making will be made public at the same time as the cabinet response.
Alle onderliggende departementale nota's van SZW en van Financiën die zijn gebruikt bij de besluitvorming, zullen tegelijk met de kabinetsreactie openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Piri over het vervolg ten aanzien van de zaak van Tent of Nations

MPs Ceder and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations land case, delayed court rulings ordering removal of unlawful roads, and Palestinian protection in Area C. The minister confirmed the roads are unlawful, condemned COGAT's failure to enforce, said Netherlands raises the case regularly, and described the Oslo-based security division of powers while stating Israel's occupation-law duties remain.
COGAT has so far taken no action following these rulings, which I condemn.
COGAT heeft tot op heden geen actie ondernomen naar aanleiding van deze uitspraken, hetgeen ik afkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Dassen, Boswijk, Paternotte, Teunissen en Ceder over de aanhouding van de burgemeester van Istanbul

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the detention of Istanbul mayor Imamoglu and about a hundred others appears politically motivated, whether it should have consequences, and whether the Netherlands will raise it with Turkey and push for EU measures. The minister supports the EU statement calling for transparency and rule of law, says he raised concerns by phone with his Turkish counterpart and via the ambassador, and notes the EU has postponed thematic consultations with Turkey while it considers whether further measures are appropriate.
It is crucial that the legal process against mayor İmamoğlu and others takes place with transparency.
Het is cruciaal dat het juridische proces tegen burgemeester İmamoğlu en anderen in transparantie plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Dobbe en Boswijk over het bericht 'Goudkoorts blokkeert de weg naar vrede in Sudan'

MPs Ceder, Dobbe and Boswijk asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about gold trade fuelling the Sudan conflict, arms diversion, Russian involvement, EU sanctions and humanitarian response. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, points to existing EU conflict-minerals and forced-labour rules, the CSDDD and arms embargoes, and says it is pushing for EU engagement, a contact group and humanitarian exemptions, without committing to new concrete measures on gold imports.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to act in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises on responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht dat Nederlandse bedrijven ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder, Van der Burg, Kahraman, Vermeer, Boswijk en Eerdmans over christenvervolging in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the killing of 70 people in a church in the DR Congo, the role of the Special Envoy for Religion, EU terrorist listing of the ADF, foreign support for the ADF, and UN action. The minister condemned the attack, said the Envoy's involvement is not currently of added value, agreed to explore listing the ADF, and described Dutch and EU support for peace and UN human rights mechanisms.
I am willing to examine the possibilities of placing this group on the European terrorism sanctions list or the European ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctions list.
Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze groep op de Europese terrorisme-sanctielijst of de Europese ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctielijst te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de berichten ‘Oppermachtig Rwanda is in Congo vooral op zoek naar kostbare grondstoffen’ en 'EU speelt gevaarlijk dubbelspel met Rwanda in Congo'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the foreign and trade ministers about reports on Rwanda's role in eastern Congo, including the Rwandan army's control over M23, humanitarian aid for displaced people, sanctions, the ambassador's summoning, and the EU-Rwanda raw materials MoU. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares the UN view of Rwandan support to M23, has pressed Rwanda bilaterally and in the EU, backs sanctions and a suspension of the MoU, and funds humanitarian aid and responsible mineral supply chains.
The Netherlands shares the UN's view on Rwandan support to M23, as also shown in reports of the UN Group of Experts.
Nederland deelt de visie van de VN over de Rwandese steun aan M23, zoals ook aangetoond in rapporten van de VN Group of Experts .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de beantwoording van de prejudiciële vragen door de Hoge Raad over wat dient te worden verstaan onder ‘eerste aflossing’

An MP asks the State Secretaries of Justice and Social Affairs how the government will handle the Supreme Court's answers on what counts as a 'first repayment' in out-of-court debt arrangements, and how this affects debt assistance practice. The government acknowledges the ruling's likely impact, says Recofa guidelines may be revisited, and rejects an AMvB, citing judicial discretion and flexibility.
We will continue to monitor how this ruling develops in practice, for both an out-of-court debt arrangement and the statutory route.
Wij blijven monitoren hoe deze beantwoording zich in de praktijk verder ontwikkelt, voor zowel een buitengerechtelijke schuldregeling als het wettelijke traject.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op het lid Ceder over de acute medische situatie van Palestijnen in Gaza

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister about the medical crisis in Gaza, including the raid on Kamal Adwan hospital, aid access, starvation, and cold-related deaths. The minister answered at length, acknowledging severe impediments to aid and the collapse of the medical system, but said the government could not verify several claims and pointed to diplomatic pressure on Israel and the January 2025 ceasefire.
The cabinet cannot verify how much aid can be provided at which hospital at which time.
Het kabinet kan niet verifiëren hoeveel hulp op welk moment in welk ziekenhuis kan worden geboden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kahraman en Boswijk  over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2025 van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, Nieuw Sociaal Contract and CDA asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the Open Doors 2025 persecution ranking, covering Central Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa, Pakistan, Syria, Algeria and related issues. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, raises religious freedom bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, and commits to continued engagement, but declined to support an international UN inquiry into violence in Nigeria as unlikely to win broad support.
The cabinet currently considers it unlikely that there will be broad support for establishing a UN-mandated international commission of inquiry into religious violence in Nigeria.
Het kabinet acht het op dit moment onwaarschijnlijk dat er brede steun zal zijn voor het oprichten van een VN-gemandateerde internationale onderzoekscommissie voor religieus geweld in Nigeria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van den Burg, Teunissen, Ceder, Boswijk, Van der Lee en Kahraman over de acuut dreigende uitzetting van Oeigoeren in Thailand

Seven MPs asked the ministers about the imminent deportation of 48 Uyghurs held in Thailand to China and what the Netherlands was doing to prevent it. The Foreign Minister answered that the Netherlands has urged Thailand, bilaterally and within the EU, to respect non-refoulement and not deport the group, and is monitoring third-country resettlement options.
The Netherlands has made the urgent appeal to the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, both bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the 48 Uyghurs.

Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de 48 Oeigoeren niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de Nederlandse steun aan projecten in de Palestijnse gebieden

An MP asked why certain Dutch-funded reconciliation projects in the Palestinian territories are hidden or anonymised on the aid portal, and whether the documents will be published. The minister answered that anonymity protects participants in sensitive reconciliation work, that the government refuses to publish the withheld documents, and that financial oversight follows the usual contractual and reporting routine.
To enable the organisations concerned to carry out reconciliation projects, it has been decided not to make this information public.
Om de betreffende organisaties in staat te stellen om verzoeningsprojecten uit te voeren wordt ervoor gekozen om deze informatie niet openbaar te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over de memo in handen van RTL aangaande het ingediende amendement Joseph c.s. over een referendum over het invaren van pensioenfondsen

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the government would publish a leaked ministry memo on the budgetary cost of the NSC-backed Joseph amendment on a pension-fund referendum, and whether an MP had access to cabinet-internal documents. The minister confirmed the memo exists and attached it, denied it was a cabinet-internal document shared with the MP, and committed to publish the advice and appreciation of the amended amendment when the cabinet appreciation is issued.

As requested by the standing parliamentary committee on Social Affairs and Employment, the amended amendment will be accompanied by a cabinet appreciation, advice from the Council of State, and views from supervisors, the Tax Authority, pension administrators and social partners.

Zoals door de vaste Kamercommissie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid gevraagd, wordt het gewijzigde amendement voorzien van een kabinetsappreciatie, advies van de Raad van State, en zienswijzen van onder andere de toezichthouders, Belastingdienst, pensioenuitvoerders en sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder, Van Zanten, Eerdmans en Ellian over het weigeren van een Israëlische comedian door theaters in Amsterdam

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she views Amsterdam theatres declining to host Israeli comedian Yohay Sponder after threats and reactions, whether local police and municipal bodies were consulted, and what follow-up is planned. The minister condemns the intimidation, says cultural institutions must be free to programme, notes Boom Chicago did not follow the sector protocol, and reports ongoing talks with the alderman and Kunsten '92 to find an alternative venue.
It is intolerable that a cultural institution receives such reactions or is threatened to such an extent that a performance is cancelled.
Het is onverteerbaar dat een culturele instelling zodanige reacties krijgt of zodanig wordt bedreigd dat een voorstelling wordt geannuleerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder en Kahraman over het artikel 'Aramese christenen in Syrië vrezen voor hun bestaan en erfgoed: 'Massale uittocht moet worden voorkomen'' en 'Israël waarschuwt voor gevaren v

MPs Bikker, Ceder and Kahraman asked the Foreign Minister about reports on threats to Aramaic Christians in Syria, changes to Syrian school curricula, a curfew in Homs and Israeli warnings about the interim authorities. The minister replied that the situation is unclear, that the Netherlands raises minority protection and an inclusive transition in EU and regional fora, and that Nederland supports the UN evidence bank and the Commission of Inquiry, while stating that no concrete signs of specific minority danger exist and that the curriculum remains unchanged pending new commissions.
At follow-up contacts the cabinet will continue to stress the importance of a role in the political process for all population groups, including Christians.
Het kabinet zal bij vervolgcontacten het belang van een rol in het politieke proces voor alle bevolkingsgroepen, waaronder christenen, blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri , Ceder, Koekkoek en Podt over het bericht 'Faber beperkt inspraak van adviesorganen bij overhaaste wetgeving’

MPs asked why the Minister for Asylum and Migration shortened the consultation period for two asylum bills (two-status system and tighter family reunification) and why the emergency asylum bill was not sent to the Dutch Bar Association, and how this fits Dutch legislative drafting guidelines. The minister answered that urgency justified the accelerated process, that consultation was only with directly affected bodies such as the IND, the Council for the Judiciary and the Raad van State division, that the 'confidential' marking was an error, that no shortened consultation is planned for other migration bills, and that IND concerns about implementation will be taken into account.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Boomsma en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Asielzoekers met bekeringsverhaal krijgen minder vaak een verblijfsvergunning, zien advocaten'

MPs Ceder, Boomsma and Diederik van Dijk asked whether asylum claims based on conversion are now assessed more strictly after a 1 July 2024 change in the credibility framework, and how IND staff are trained and supported on Christianity and conversion. The minister denies that conversion claims are assessed more strictly, says documents now play a more prominent role, and refuses to provide statistics on conversion-based grant and refusal rates, citing lack of aggregated data.
The IND does not have this information because it does not record at an aggregated level what the asylum motive is for cases that are granted or refused.
De IND beschikt niet over deze informatie omdat niet op geaggregeerd niveau wordt bijgehouden wat het asielmotief is van zaken die worden ingewilligd en afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over het bericht 'Evangelist op station Maastricht met machtsvertoon staande gehouden: 'Intimiderende en dreigende sfeer''

ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers whether police intervention against evangelists singing at a Maastricht station piano, and NS house rules restricting evangelising folders, are compatible with freedom of religion, and whether they will talk to NS about this. The government answered that police acted on a nuisance report under local responsibility, that no restrictions were imposed and the group left voluntarily, that house rules and WP2000 obligations justify NS enforcement, and that it sees no reason to talk to NS now.
The police's conduct was based on knowledge of the local situation and under the responsibility of the competent authority.
Het optreden van de politie is op basis van de kennis van de lokale situatie en onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht 'Geboortezorg voor asielzoekers van 'onacceptabel' niveau, concluderen onderzoekers'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the ministers about a report finding worse birth outcomes (higher perinatal mortality and low birth weight) among asylum seekers, and about transport, transfers and medical handover for pregnant women in reception. The government acknowledges the disparities and the problems with emergency shelter, points to existing arrangements such as Musselkanaal and taxi transport, and promises further study of the report's recommendations without committing to new funding.
If so, do you consider this cause for serious concern and can you provide the House with a comprehensive response?
Zo ja, vindt u dit reden tot grote zorg en kunt u de Kamer van een uitgebreide reactie voorzien?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Ceder over het bericht ‘veel kinderen hebben spijt van aankopen in games’

MPs Krul (CDA) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government will respond to Unicef research showing many children regret in-game purchases such as loot boxes, whether a ban is needed, and why Belgium could ban them nationally but the Netherlands cannot. The minister answers that the findings are worrying, that the Netherlands is pushing for a loot box ban in the EU Digital Fairness Act (proposal expected late 2025 or early 2026) since EU maximum harmonisation blocks stricter national rules, that Dutch gambling law does not fit loot boxes, and that a national ban is not pursued in favour of EU action.
I do not want to anticipate national legislation, because I expect action to be taken at the European level.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op nationale wetgeving, omdat ik verwacht dat er op Europees niveau actie wordt ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman, Omtzigt, Ceder over de opmars van de HTS in Syrië

MPs Kahraman, Omtzigt and Ceder asked the ministers about HTS's rise in Syria, including foreign support, its terrorist listing, contacts, minority rights, sanctions, humanitarian aid and paths to peace. The minister answered that the government lacks information on who backs HTS, HTS is treated as terrorist via the UN/EU listing, no contacts exist, and many questions are deferred to the upcoming debate or ongoing EU reviews.
The cabinet does not have independent information with which these reports can be confirmed or denied.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie waarmee deze berichten bevestigd of ontkend kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over “het artikel Re-integratie (ex-)gedetineerde personen komt niet goed van de grond”

An MP asked the state secretaries about the Leiden study finding that debt support for detained and ex-detained persons is weak, and asked about regional debt-support coordination, benefit continuity, health insurance suspension and debt-restructuring credit during detention. The government answered that debt support is a municipal duty, that it is working on improving the detention plan and a workload measurement, that a regional debt-support model is being explored with a letter due before year end, and that several commitments will be reported in later letters.
Municipalities have the statutory duty to provide debt assistance to their residents, including when they are in detention.
Gemeenten hebben de wettelijke taak om schuldhulpverlening te bieden aan hun inwoners, ook wanneer deze in detentie verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Krul en Stoffer over het onderzoek ‘De herstelopdracht doorgelicht: Een verkenning naar de rechtmatigheid van herstelopdrachten in het funderend onderwijs’

MPs Ceder, Krul and Stoffer asked the Minister of Education about Professor Van Schoonhoven's study questioning whether Inspectorate remediation orders (herstelopdrachten) rest on legal grounds, and how the Inspectorate avoids overreach, distinguishes its supervisory from its stimulating role, justifies orders, and informs school boards of their rights. The Minister replies that the Inspectorate found its orders lawful, tied to statutory adequacy standards, will refine justification and frameworks, and will not withdraw any orders, while describing existing safeguards such as complaint procedures and board responses.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de opvanglocatie in de Expohal in Assen

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether asylum seekers staying beyond the agreed 20 days in the Expohal in Assen, including children and unaccompanied minors, is compatible with the planned reduction of asylum reception and with the agreements between Assen and COA. The minister answered that 90 of 473 residents exceeded the 20-day norm, that noodopvang is used due to shortage of regular places, and that COA is working to move children out and improve conditions, but gave no concrete binding guarantee on compliance with the agreement.
The stay in emergency reception locations must be as short as possible, therefore I am focusing on reducing pressure on the asylum system through measures that limit inflow.
Het verblijf op noodopvanglocaties dient zo kort mogelijk te zijn daarom zet ik met instroombeperkende maatregelen in op het verlichten van de druk op het asielsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de staande overeenkomst met UNRWA voor de periode 2023–2025

An MP asked the minister how much of the annual 19 million euro UNRWA contribution is legally binding, asked for the 2023-2025 agreement, and asked whether it contains termination conditions. The minister referred to earlier letters, confirmed the contract has termination and conditional clauses (use only for the agreed programme, no use contrary to Dutch foreign policy, parliamentary budget approval), and quoted clauses allowing the minister to stop transfers and claim repayment.

Subsequent instalments for 2024 and 2025 will be transferred upon receipt of a written request for payment in the first quarter of the calendar year; but will be subject to prior parliamentary approval of the overall budget of the Minister.

Subsequent instalments for 2024 and 2025 will be transferred upon receipt of a written request for payment in the first quarter of the calendar year; but will be subject to prior parliamentary approval of the overall budget of the Minister.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer en Krul over het schrappen van de subsidie op het godsdienstig onderwijs of levensbeschouwelijk vormingsonderwijs

MPs Ceder, Stoffer and Krul asked why the government plans to end the subsidy for religious and life-stance formation education and whether this conflicts with the statutory basis and with pupils' access to such education. The State Secretary answered that about 50,000 pupils receive it, that the subsidy ends from 2027 via a legislative proposal, and that schools' civic and worldview curriculum will cover the needs, but did not expect equal access and gave only partial answers on consultation with parents.
For the termination of the subsidy, a proposal for a legislative amendment will be made.
Voor de beëindiging van de subsidie wordt een voorstel tot wetswijziging gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Ceder en Patijn over het bericht 'Crisis UWV nog groter, ook missers bij mogelijk duizenden jonggehandicapten: 'Kommer en kwel''

MPs from CDA, D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the ministry knew earlier of problems at UWV affecting Wajong disability benefit assessments, and whether it would commission independent research, extend the Court of Audit request, and address WW and Ziektewet. The minister answered that Wajong quality measurements were discontinued from 2020 so quality cannot be verified, promised further investigations, a letter on remedies, and a check on WW and Ziektewet, but declined to commit to an Algemene Rekenkamer investigation until ongoing studies finish.
Unfortunately, quality measurements were scaled down from 2020 onward, and it is now insufficiently clear how the quality of Wajong assessments stands, because it is not traceable.
Helaas zijn de kwaliteitsmetingen vanaf 2020 afgeschaald en is het nu onvoldoende duidelijk hoe het is gesteld met de kwaliteit van de Wajong-beoordelingen, omdat dit niet navolgbaar is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport 'Bouwstenen voor het asielbeleid en het asielstelsel'

The MP asks how the government's report 'Bouwstenen voor het asielbeleid' was weighed in the coalition agreement and budget memorandum, and for a per-recommendation account. The minister says the report was one input among others, that recommendations are implemented only where included in the regeerprogramma, and that no overview per recommendation exists or can be produced in the time available.
There is no overview indicating per recommendation whether and to what extent the recommendations have been included in the coalition agreement or the subsequent government programme.
Er bestaat geen overzicht waarin per aanbeveling is aangegeven of en in welke mate de aanbevelingen een plaats hebben gekregen in het hoofdlijnenakkoord of het daarop gevolgde regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van Nispen en Ceder over het artikel 'The brutal truth behind Italy’s migrant reduction: beatings and rape by EU-funded forces in Tunisia'

MPs Koekkoek, Van Nispen and Ceder asked the government about a Guardian report on abuses by Tunisian coast guard forces funded through EU migration cooperation, including rape, beatings, EU financing, and EU monitoring. The government answered that it has raised concerns with the European Commission, that EU funds must not contribute to human rights violations, that it has no independently verified evidence of several alleged abuses, and that it will keep raising human rights in bilateral and EU contacts.
The Netherlands has conveyed these concerns to the European Commission.
Nederland heeft deze zorgen bij de Europese Commissie kenbaar gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Palmen, Ceder en White n.a.v. Beleidsreactie ACOI-rapport over de openbaarheid van de Bijlmervliegramp-stukken en het feit dat openbaarheid jaren op zich laat wachten door vertra

MPs Jansen, Palmen, Ceder and White asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Bijlmer air disaster archive remains largely closed years after the 2023 motion and why the government is commissioning external studies before acting on the ACOI recommendations. The minister defends the sequencing as driven by scarce expertise and procedure, outlines timelines and planned studies, and says access to the audio material was delayed by equipment and digitisation needs.
The aim is to have the study on recommendation 4 completed in the first quarter of 2025.
Het streven is het onderzoek naar aanbeveling 4 in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de uitspraken van de minister over de zaak ‘Mikael’ en het ingenomen standpunt

An MP asks the Minister for Asylum and Migration about her statements on the case of the Armenian child Mikael, whether she still has legal powers to intervene, and why the three-year-and-three-month residence rule was applied inconsistently. The Minister confirms she retains formal powers but says the discretionary power for hardship cases was limited to first procedures in 2019, declines to discuss individual cases, and states that children's interests are weighed under Article 8 ECHR.
As is known, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals bekend ga ik niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Ceder over het artikel ‘Roep om einde aan ‘incasso-industrie’ te maken: ‘Schuld van 50 euro kan nu oplopen tot 800 euro’’

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked whether maximum debt-collection costs and the debt-collection industry's profit margins are still reasonable, and how the government will respond to the Consumentenbond's proposals and the IBO on problematic debts. The State Secretary answered that the current cost rules are being examined in the IBO follow-up, that a Rijksincassovisie and a research on overheid claims are pending, and that a cabinet response to the IBO will follow this year, without committing to the Consumentenbond's specific proposals.

Given also the analyses from the IBO report, I intend to examine the funding system within the out-of-court collection phase more closely in the coming period, with particular attention to the cost escalation on small claims.

Gegeven ook de analyses uit het IBO rapport ben ik voornemens om de bekostigingssystematiek binnen de buitengerechtelijke incassofase de komende periode nader onder de loep te nemen, met bijzondere aandacht voor de kostenoploop bij kleine vorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk en Ceder over de interne communicatie en adviezen met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Asylum and Migration to send all internal communication and advice on the decision not to transfer Afghan guards to the Netherlands. The ministers respond that they partially meet the request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office.
We partially meet your request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office regarding the transfer of Afghan guards.

Wij komen gedeeltelijk tegemoet aan uw verzoek door de ambtelijke adviezen te verstrekken die zijn opgesteld sinds het aantreden van het nieuwe kabinet met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder over het bericht dat een Iraniër in Duitsland veroordeeld is voor brandstichting in opdracht van de Iraanse staat

MPs Ceder and Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister whether a German court ruling convicting an Iranian for arson on a synagogue on Iranian state orders could support listing the IRGC as a terrorist organisation, and whether the government would use it in its efforts. The minister said the EU Legal Service advice is confidential, that several member states support listing but there is no Council consensus, and that the Netherlands strongly supports listing and will use all available avenues.
The advice of the Legal Service of the Council of the European Union is confidential.
Het advies van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad van de Europese Unie is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Dure reclamecampagne blijft flop: nauwelijks ‘ouderlijk toezicht’ op Instagram

MP Ceder asks the government about reports that a costly campaign on parental supervision of Instagram use under 16 failed, and about legal obligations, enforcement by regulators, sanctions, and plans for legal age verification. The government answers that parental consent rules under the GDPR and the DSA apply, that enforcement rests with independent regulators (AP, ACM, European Commission), and that a statutory age-verification mandate for social media is not planned, while age verification is being explored for alcohol sales and BNPL services.
It is up to the independent regulators to determine whether social media companies meet the statutory requirements and whether in a given case they act unlawfully.

Het is uiteindelijk aan de onafhankelijke toezichthouders om vast te stellen of sociale mediabedrijven aan de in de wet- en regeling gestelde wettelijke eisen voldoen en in een voorliggend geval onrechtmatig handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Kahraman, Paternotte, Dobbe, Van Campen en Ceder over het vredesproces tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs asked the government about the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process, including the trilateral meeting in Washington, Azerbaijan's demand to amend Armenia's constitution, and what the Netherlands could do to speed up a deal. The minister said the government urges both sides toward a durable agreement based on mutual recognition of territorial integrity, declined to comment publicly on negotiating positions, and noted EUMA's de-escalating role and a mandate running to February 2025.
However, it is not in the interest of the negotiating parties to publicly address their negotiating positions in this answer.
Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelende partijen om in deze beantwoording publiekelijk in te gaan op de onderhandelingsposities van de partijen bij de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over arbeidsuitbuiting

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked ministers about the enforcement of labour exploitation, including prosecution figures, UWV's failure to revoke work permits in the Cornwall case, information sharing between ministries, housing tied to employment, inspectorate capacity and the scope of the criminal definition. The minister answered with figures on prosecutions, the legal limits on revoking permits, the new trafficking bill and the expansion of inspection capacity, while saying some earlier recommendations were not adopted.
On 25 April, the bill on modernising and extending the criminalisation of human trafficking was therefore submitted to the House of Representatives.
Op 25 april jl. is daarom het wetsvoorstel modernisering en uitbreiding strafbaarstelling mensenhandel bij de Tweede Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen lid Ceder over instandhouding en herbestemming kerkgebouwen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about preserving church buildings and their repurposing, including funding for restoration backlogs and whether the TRE programme will continue. The Minister answered that the programme runs to 2025, that a decision on its continuation will be communicated before summer 2025, and that a funding gap of €770 million for non-residential monuments cannot currently be met within existing budgets.
On the continuation I will inform your House before the summer of 2025.
Over het vervolg zal ik uw Kamer voor de zomer van 2025 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Ceder over de detentie en uitzetting van de familie Babayants

Two MPs (Piri and Ceder) asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the detention and planned deportation to Uzbekistan of the Babayants family, who have lived in the Netherlands for about ten years, including children born there, and whether this is consistent with children's rights and the best interests of the child. The Minister declined to discuss the individual case, said the best interests of the child are considered but not decisive, defended detention of families as a last resort in a family facility, and saw no reason to revise the policy.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het aanhoudende geweld tegen christenen in Nigeria

MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about kidnappings and killings of mostly Christians in Nigeria, whether religion is a driver versus land and water scarcity, the reliability of a report claiming 100,000 Christians were killed, and whether Nigeria will be raised at the UN Human Rights Council. The minister answered that violence stems from mixed causes including scarce resources and religion is not confirmed as root cause, could not yet verify the report's figures, and committed to raising religious freedom violations in Nigeria at the Human Rights Council later this year.
As a member of the Human Rights Council, the Netherlands intends to raise obstacles to freedom of religion or belief, including violence against believers in Nigeria, in the Council later this year.

Nederland is, als lid van de Mensenrechtenraad, voornemens om later dit jaar belemmeringen van de vrijheid van religie en geloofsovertuiging, waaronder geweld tegen gelovigen in Nigeria, aan de orde te stellen in de Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het artikel ‘In de schulden na een erfenis: ‘Ik kreeg dit ineens op mijn bord’’

MP Ceder asked about inheritance debts, the differing collection practices of national agencies (UWV, SVB), municipalities and the Tax Authority, the uptake of beneficiary acceptance, and whether beneficiary acceptance should be the default. The Staatssecretaris answered that agencies must recover undue benefits from heirs with maatwerk options and a debt-free minimum, that uniform policy will follow the pending IBO and civil enforcement reviews, and that default beneficiary acceptance was rejected as burdensome for most heirs.
A cabinet response to the IBO on problematic debts is still to follow.
Een kabinetsreactie op het IBO problematische schulden volgt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de dood van een Pakistaanse christen na een aanval door een gewelddadige menigte

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about the death of a Pakistani Christian after a mob attack over alleged blasphemy, including whether he was formally charged, how often Pakistan's minorities are attacked, how often the government raised minority protection, and whether Pakistan's GSP+ trade status should be questioned. The minister confirmed the death, said only a complaint was filed, pledged to raise the case with Pakistani authorities, and outlined bilateral, EU and UPR engagement but declined to reconsider GSP+ at this time.
The Netherlands will strongly advocate that abuse of blasphemy laws and related violence be discussed at the next meeting of this Sub-Group.
Nederland zal zich er sterk voor maken dat misbruik van blasfemiewetten en hiermee samenhangend geweld wordt besproken tijdens het volgende overleg van deze Sub-Group.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Dobbe over ontwikkelingen in Jemen

MPs Ceder and Dobbe asked the government about humanitarian needs in Yemen, stalled peace talks, follow-up on a motion to pursue war crimes investigations, and the abolition of the national arms export presumption of denial for Saudi Arabia and the UAE. The ministers answered that Nederland remains a substantial humanitarian donor with no additional funding planned, supports the UN envoy and multilateral efforts, could not secure support in the Human Rights Council for a war crimes investigation, and maintains strict arms export review under EU rules.
The Netherlands will continue to support the mandate of the UN envoy and to consistently draw attention to this forgotten conflict in multilateral settings.
Nederland blijft het mandaat van de VN gezant ondersteunen en in multilateraal verband voortdurend aandacht vragen voor dit vergeten conflict.
Antwoord op de leden Bamenga, Hirsch, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Ceder over het bericht ‘Nederlands bedrijf negeert ernstige schendingen in Saudi-Arabië’

Five MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Amnesty International briefing alleging that a Dutch company, with government support, contributed to human rights violations in Saudi Arabia linked to The Line project, and about IMVO due diligence, trade missions, the CSDDD and Amnesty's recommendations. The minister answered that the government takes such findings seriously, that due diligence is the companies' own responsibility, that the trade mission self-scans raised no reason for further inquiry, and that conditions for government support would be reinforced in practice without tightening the framework.
The cabinet takes the findings of civil society organisations, including Amnesty International, seriously.
Het kabinet neemt bevindingen van maatschappelijke organisatie waaronder Amnesty International serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de kwestie Tent of Nations en effectieve bescherming van Palestijnen

MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations land registration case and the effective protection of Palestinians in Area C, including delays, road closures, and access to police. The minister answered that the registration process remains unresolved despite a 2006 court ruling, that Israeli authorities have not clarified the delay, and that the Netherlands continues to press Israel on access, protection, and settlement policy.
The Netherlands will continue to press for reopening.
Nederland zal blijven aandringen op heropening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over marteling van Papoea’s door Indonesische militairen in West-Papoea

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of torture of Papuans by Indonesian soldiers, including a video-recorded incident, and about Indonesia's obligations, an independent investigation, and a UN High Commissioner visit. The minister confirmed awareness, noted that the army arrested 13 people over the filmed incident, said the Netherlands will keep raising Papua, and that it is not involved in UN visit talks.
The Indonesian army has no obligation to inform the public about internal investigations.
Het Indonesische leger heeft geen verplichting om het publiek te informeren over interne onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het afgelasten van concerten van het Jerusalem Quartet

An MP asked the State Secretary for Culture why the Concertgebouw cancelled Jerusalem Quartet concerts over safety concerns, and whether this threatens artistic freedom and was discussed with the sector. The State Secretary regretted the cancellation, said cultural institutions are responsible for their own programming and safety, reported no direct contact with the Concertgebouw beforehand, and committed to exploring with the sector how to prevent future cancellations.
