Using this case, I will explore with the sector how we can prevent a situation from arising again in which an organisation feels compelled to cancel an activity due to threats.

De komende tijd zal ik aan de hand van deze casus met de sector verkennen hoe we kunnen voorkomen dat zich opnieuw een situatie voordoet waarin een organisatie zich genoodzaakt ziet een activiteit te annuleren vanwege dreiging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Boon over de berichten 'Staatssecretaris: begrip voor uitstel concerten Israëlische groep' en 'Driehoek wist niets van het besluit over afgelastin

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary for culture how the government will ensure artists can perform safely regardless of origin, and why she showed understanding for Het Concertgebouw cancelling Jerusalem Quartet concerts without consulting the local security triangle. The answers say the cancellation was a security-based decision by the venue, that the state secretary understood it as an exception, that a general guidance document is being prepared with the sector, and that a concert date is being sought.
However, Het Concertgebouw itself made the decision to cancel this concert before advice had been given by the security triangle.
Het Concertgebouw heeft echter zelf de beslissing genomen om dit concert af te gelasten voordat er een advies vanuit de driehoek was gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Hirsch, Bamenga en Stoffer over toegenomen Nederlandse importen uit de Chinese provincie Xinjiang

MPs Ceder, Hirsch, Bamenga and Stoffer asked whether Dutch imports from Xinjiang rose, whether Oeigoeren forced labour is increasing, and how businesses, consumers and the EU forced-labour regulation and CSDDD address this. The minister could not verify the trade figures, said the government cannot confirm the Zenz findings, expects companies to apply OECD and UN guidance, and said enforcement of the forced-labour regulation will apply from around autumn 2027.
However, the government has no independent information position on the situation on the ground and therefore cannot confirm the specific conclusions of this research.
Het kabinet heeft echter geen eigenstandige informatiepositie over de situatie ter plaatse en kan de specifieke conclusies van dit onderzoek dus niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Synhaeve, Mohandis, Van Kent, Ceder en Koekkoek over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Den Haag dat de Nederlandse Staat en twee drinkwaterbedrijven onrechtmatig handelen door niet al het r

MPs asked the government to respond to a Hague Court of Appeal ruling that the State and two water companies acted unlawfully by not preventing children from losing access to drinking water, and about measures, a water fund and changes to disconnection rules. The minister answered that the companies will restore supply to occupied homes with children, that a study on child protection including a water fund will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the disconnection regulation will be reviewed.
The judgment calls for action in two areas.
Het arrest vraagt om actie op twee gebieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Stoffer over Turkse drone-aanslagen op christelijke leden van Noord-Syrische milities en berichten over Turkse betrokkenheid bij misdrijven in door Turkije bezette gebieden

MPs Ceder and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish drone strikes on Christian members of Northeast Syrian security forces and reports of abuses in Turkish-occupied areas, including whether the government would raise this with Turkey, NATO or the EU. The minister confirmed the strike, said Turkey invokes self-defence, and said the government raises proportionality and civilian protection bilaterally but sees no reason to raise it in NATO, while saying it cannot establish displacement figures or refugee flows.
The cabinet sees no reason to raise these operations within NATO either.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om deze operaties ook in NAVO-verband aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder en Tuinman over het artikel 'Rijksambtenaren Buitenlandse Zaken demonstreren tegen Nederlands Israëlbeleid'

MPs Stoffer, Ceder and Tuinman asked whether civil servants of the Foreign Ministry demonstrating for a ceasefire during lunch breaks, and their associated petition, conflict with government policy and the Civil Servants Act 2017. The minister answered that the demonstrations fall in the lunch break, that the call for a permanent ceasefire is not government policy, that civil servants have freedom of expression subject to Article 10 of the Act (assessed case by case by the employer), and that the ministry has held internal discussions and reminded staff of guidance.
Civil servants, like all other citizens, enjoy freedom of expression.
Ambtenaren kennen net als alle andere burgers de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de huisvesting van de YMCA-vakantiekampen

An MP asked the State Secretaries for Health and Interior whether they would act on the YMCA holiday camps' lost lease in Leusden, including mediating with the province and Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and seeking alternative premises. The State Secretary answered that the matter is local and regional, that the government will not take a role, and pointed to the municipality's stated willingness to help find a location.
It is therefore up to the locally and regionally involved parties to seek a solution.
Het ligt daarom op de weg van de lokaal en regionaal betrokken partijen om een oplossing te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Verbijstering over sluiting van het Auris College in Goes: 'Onze kinderen verzuipen op de reguliere school''

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the planned closure of three Auris College special secondary schools (Goes, Leiden, Rotterdam), parents' fears that their children will not thrive elsewhere, and the wider shift from special to regular education. The Minister answered that Auris decided independently after consultation, not for financial reasons, that the ministry is in contact with Auris and regional partnerships, and that individual placements and extra support are being arranged, but many questions on capacity, prognoses and risks were left open.
My officials will consult with Auris and the relevant partnerships in the coming period to see whether, and if so what, additional support and efforts are needed.
Mijn ambtenaren zullen de komende periode met Auris en de betrokken samenwerkingsverbanden in overleg treden om te zien of en zo ja welke extra ondersteuning en inspanningen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘NS verbiedt christelijke jongeren flyers uit te delen op Utrecht Centraal: ‘Dit is propaganda’’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked whether NS's ban on Christian youths handing out evangelism flyers at Utrecht Centraal, which NS called propaganda, restricts religious and expression freedom, and why pro-Palestine demonstrations there were not stopped. The minister replied that NS and ProRail may enforce station house rules requiring permission for distributing texts regardless of content, that the assessment belongs to NS and local authorities, and that he will not comment on their earlier decisions.
It is not for me to enter into the assessment that NS security and service staff made on site.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afweging die de veiligheid- en servicemedewerkers van NS ter plaatse hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Supermarkteigenaren verplaatsen tabaksverkoop naar eigen speciaalzaken in aanloop naar verbod

An MP asks whether supermarket owners are opening tobacco shops next to their stores to keep selling tobacco before the supermarket ban, whether the number of outlets is tracked, and what measures could curb new outlets. The state secretary answers that outlets are expected to fall to about 4,400 by 2024, that a registration duty is in preparation, that no additional measures against supermarkets are considered necessary, and that no further talks are planned.
In the field of discouraging tobacco use and combating gambling addiction, the cabinet has taken various measures that can count on broad public support.
Op het terrein van tabaksontmoediging en het tegengaan van kansspelverslaving heeft het kabinet verschillende maatregelen genomen die op breed maatschappelijk draagvlak kunnen rekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Ceder over uitingen van UNRWA medewerkers rond 7 oktober en de oorlog in Israël en Gaza

Questions from MPs Stoffer and Ceder asked about social media statements by UNRWA staff praising the 7 October attacks, whether the government condemns them, and whether Dutch funding should be suspended as in 2019. The minister condemned such statements, said Dutch additional funding is suspended pending two UN investigations, and explained UNRWA's unique mandate for Palestinian refugees.
Any additional Dutch funding to UNRWA is suspended until further notice.
Eventuele Nederlandse aanvullende financiering aan UNRWA is tot nader orde opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Boswijk, Kahraman en Ceder over het Open Doors rapport 2024 en het rapport 'Freedom of Thought' van het humanistisch verbond

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the Open Doors 2024 and Humanist Association 'Freedom of Thought' reports on religious persecution, including Christian persecution in Nigeria, the Sahel, China and Iraq, and whether policy or diplomacy should be tightened. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, cites existing diplomatic, multilateral and development programmes, and largely points to existing policy without committing to new measures.

The cabinet recognises trends mentioned in the Open Doors report, including an increase in religiously motivated violence in the Sahel and repression of people because of their religion or belief in countries such as Nicaragua, China and India.

Het kabinet herkent trends zoals genoemd in het Open Doors rapport, waaronder toename van religieus gemotiveerd geweld in de Sahelregio en onderdrukking van mensen vanwege hun religie of levensovertuiging in onder andere Nicaragua, China en India.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de inzet van Zr. Ms. Holland bij de hulpverlening aan de Gazastrook

An MP asks why the Netherlands is not acting on Israeli foreign minister Cohen's stated support for a maritime humanitarian corridor to Gaza, and why it does not itself contact Israel about deploying Zr. Ms. Holland. The government answers that full Israeli cooperation is not yet present, that land access is the priority, and that the ship will return to the Netherlands at the end of January while maritime options remain under review.
For now, this has not sufficiently crystallised in the international context.
Vooralsnog heeft zich dit in internationaal verband onvoldoende uitgekristalliseerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Ceder over de vervolging van een christelijke vrouw in Nigeria wegens vermeende godslastering en de brute moord op een christelijke studente door een groep islamitische medestudente

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of Rhoda Jatau in Nigeria for sharing a video condemning the killing of a Christian student, the death penalty risk, and impunity for the lynching. The minister reported that Jatau was released on bail in December 2023, that the case continues, that the Netherlands raises death penalty and religious freedom issues bilaterally and multilaterally, and that Nigerian justice is responsible for the investigation.
The Netherlands does not intervene in the legal proceedings of another country.
Nederland treedt niet in de rechtsgang in een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de mijnramp in Suriname

MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about the Surinamese government's rescue response to a mine shaft collapse in Brokopondo, whether Surinamese services have sufficient resources, and whether the Netherlands is in contact about possible assistance. The minister described the coordinated Surinamese response with French Guiana's help, expressed condolences, and said no Dutch aid request had been received.
In all contacts with the Surinamese government, including via the Dutch embassy in Paramaribo, the Netherlands has not received a request for assistance.
In alle contacten met de Surinaamse regering, ook via de Nederlandse ambassade in Paramaribo, heeft Nederland geen hulpverzoek ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het optreden van de Libische kustwacht tegen bootvluchtelingen

MP Ceder asked the ministers about the Libyan coast guard's ramming of a migrant rubber boat, EU support to that coast guard, monitoring, and accountability for abuses against migrants. The government answered that no deaths were registered, that it sees limited Commission tools to mitigate human rights risks, and that it keeps pressing for transparency and monitoring reports, though it has not stopped the EU support.
Due to the safety of the actors carrying out the monitoring, the Commission does not share written reports.
Vanwege de veiligheid van de actoren die de monitoring uitvoeren deelt de Commissie geen schriftelijke rapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Drost over de visumverlening aan en bezoek van Taliban-vertegenwoordiger Abdul Bari Omar aan Nederland

MPs Ceder and Drost asked how a Taliban representative received a Dutch visa to attend a WHO forum in the Netherlands, who invited him, and whether the minister would share the visa files and apologise to relatives of fallen Dutch soldiers. The minister answered that the WHO invited him, that the visa was assessed under the EU Visa Code and he was not on sanctions lists, that visa files cannot be shared, and that the government will review the visa process and invitation policy, while acknowledging he should not have received a visa.
No information is shared from individual visa application files.
Van individuele visumaanvraagdossiers wordt geen informatie gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Boswijk en Ceder over het rapport Vrijheid van Godsdienst Wereldwijd 2023 van Kerk in Nood

MPs Van der Staaij, Boswijk and Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about Kerk in Nood's 2023 religious freedom report, covering persecution of religious minorities, impunity, Nigeria, ICC follow-up, Sahel spread, India, Nicaragua, child marriage and Western cancel culture. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described diplomatic and programmatic responses, and noted that formal ICC investigation depends on the prosecutor's judgment, while declining to interfere with his prosecutorial policy.
The cabinet respects the independence of the Court and therefore refrains from interfering in the prosecution policy of the Court's prosecutor.
Zoals bekend, respecteert het kabinet de onafhankelijkheid van het Strafhof en om die reden onthoudt het kabinet zich van inmenging in het vervolgingsbeleid van de aanklager van het Strafhof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Van der Graaf over de aanval van Azerbeidzjan op de Armeense enclave Nagorno-Karabach

MPs Ceder and Van der Graaf asked the Foreign Minister how ethnic cleansing of Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh can be prevented, what the EU will do, whether the EU gas deal with Azerbaijan should continue, and whether sanctions remain ineffective. The minister answered that the government condemned the escalation, that a separate letter will address whether ethnic cleansing occurred, that the EU is considering support for Armenia and monitoring missions, that the gas deal is a diversification measure with limited share, and that sanctions remain under discussion with action if new violence threatens.
The cabinet will address this question in a separate letter, partly within the framework of the adopted motion by MP Ceder.
Het kabinet zal in een separate brief op deze vraag ingaan, mede in het kader van de aangenomen motie van het Lid Ceder
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over geweld tegen Palestijnse bewoners van de westelijke Jordaanoever

MP Ceder asks the Foreign Minister about reported killings and attacks on Palestinians in the West Bank by Israeli settlers, including alleged passivity or participation by Israeli soldiers, investigations, weapons distributed by the Israeli national security minister, seizure of crops, and what Netherlands can do. The minister condemns settler violence, says Israel has a duty to protect Palestinians and prevent such violence, notes Dutch lobbying and EU/UN statements, but states the government lacks full facts and that Dutch options for direct protection are limited.
The cabinet does not have all the facts of these cases.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over alle feiten van deze gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de antisemitische uitlatingen van de Palestijnse president Abbas

MP Ceder asks the Foreign Minister whether the government condemns antisemitic remarks by Palestinian President Abbas, whether it will challenge them, and whether Dutch support to the Palestinian Authority should be reconsidered. The minister answers that the Netherlands condemned the remarks in EU and bilateral channels, that it provides no direct budget support to the Palestinian Authority, and that it considers linking the remarks to aid counterproductive.
The cabinet condemns the antisemitic remarks of Palestinian President Abbas and has conveyed this disapproval both within the EU and bilaterally.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de antisemitische uitlatingen van de Palestijnse president Abbas en heeft deze afkeuring zowel in EU-verband als bilateraal overgebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de situatie in West-Papoea over de uitspraken van Alice Wairimu Nderitu, de Speciale Adviseur van de Secretaris-Generaal van de Verenigde Naties voor de Preventie van Genocide

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses the UN Special Adviser on Genocide Prevention's remarks on Papua, including arrests, land dispossession, foreign companies, the 1969 Act of Free Choice and a UN High Commissioner visit to Indonesia. The minister answered that the human rights situation is concerning and complex, that the government respects Indonesia's territorial integrity, that it will keep raising the issue and would still welcome a visit by the High Commissioner, but declined to comment on foreign companies and gave no concrete new commitments.
The Netherlands will continue to make efforts in this regard.
Nederland zal zich hiervoor blijven inspannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen en Ceder over het onderzoek Oxfam “From Development to Deterrence”

MPs Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen and Ceder asked whether EU development aid (ODA) under NDICI is being used for migration deterrence, citing an Oxfam report on Libyan and Tunisian coast guard funding and weak EU transparency. The minister says the Commission must check ODA eligibility and that the Netherlands will press for better reporting and human rights risk analysis, but gives no firm new commitments and says there is no misuse so far.

In the context of the mid-term evaluation of NDICI, the Netherlands has asked the Commission for insight into the calculation of migration-related expenditure and access to the markers used to attribute spending to NDICI's migration objective.

In het kader van de mid-term evaluatie van NDICI heeft Nederland de Commissie gevraagd om inzicht in berekening van migratie gerelateerde uitgaven en inzage in de markers die worden gebruikt om uitgaven aan de migratiedoelstelling van NDICI toe te rekenen.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Ceder over het gebruik van digitale technologie voor de repressie van religieuze minderheden en andersdenkenden in China en andere landen

MP Ceder asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands can keep raising China's human rights situation, why no export licences for cybersurveillance technology were granted in 2022, how the EU dual-use ad hoc licensing power is being implemented, how due diligence and forced-labour rules will be enforced, and about the latest on repression of Uyghurs and Christians. The minister answered that China concerns are raised bilaterally and multilaterally, that no such licences were requested in 2022, that the EU guidelines and national framework are delayed but in progress, that the Netherlands does not supervise due diligence until EU legislation applies, and that the situation remains very worrying.
Until that legislation is in force, the cabinet does not supervise the application of due diligence by companies.
Totdat die wetgeving van kracht is houdt het kabinet geen toezicht op de toepassing van gepaste zorgvuldigheid door bedrijven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk, Boswijk, Ceder, Belhaj, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Sylvana Simons, Dassen en Christine Teunissen over de evacuatie van lokale oud-medewerkers van de Nederlands

MPs from many parties asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the evacuation and resettlement of local former Afghan Security Guards and other local staff, including whether guards were excluded and why EUPOL staff were refused. The government answered that individual requests are assessed under the 2014 interpreter arrangement and special scheme, that criteria were not tightened, and that the resettlement project was folded into the ministries' standing organisations while the remaining group of about 100 people is still being pursued.
Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door het lid Ceder over de voortdurende blokkade van de Lachin-doorgang naar Nagorno-Karabach

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Azerbaijan's checkpoint and blockade of the Lachin corridor to Nagorno-Karabakh, contrary to the ICJ ruling, and what the Netherlands will do about it, including genocide prevention, UN fact-finding, prisoner repatriation and EU pressure. The minister acknowledges the checkpoint, says the Netherlands urges Azerbaijan to comply and supports EU mediation, but offers no new concrete measures, declines to share any independent investigation outcome, and refuses to disclose content of internal EU Foreign Affairs Council discussions.
Exchanges within the Council are confidential, therefore no further comment can be given on this.
Uitwisselingen binnen de Raad zijn vertrouwelijk, derhalve kan hier niet verder op worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Ceder over de aanhoudende berichtgeving over de zorgelijke omgang met migranten aan de Tunesische grens

MPs Drost and Ceder asked the Prime Minister about reports of deaths and mistreatment of migrants at the Tunisian borders, the EU-Tunisia migration deal, Dutch responsibility, and the human rights safeguards in the deal. The government answered that the events are hard to verify and worrying, that it supports monitoring and human rights in the deal, will raise concerns in dialogue with Tunisia, and will inform parliament once details of EU support are known.
The Netherlands, in contacts with Tunisia, works for humane reception and protection with respect for human rights.
Nederland zet zich in contacten met Tunesië in voor humane opvang en bescherming met respect voor mensenrechten.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers in de noodopvang en crisisnoodopvang

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security, in 23 numbered questions, about unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in emergency reception, including quality of care against the Opvangrichtlijn, disappearances, safety, healthcare, education and complaint handling. The State Secretary largely answered by pointing to the shortage of locations and staff, the Spreidingswet, ongoing measures and the inspections' findings, while declining a broad survey of staff and a large-scale discrimination investigation.
I see no reason to commission an additional survey on this.
Ik zie geen reden om daar een aanvullend onderzoek op te (laten) organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de toepassing van artikel 1F in het vreemdelingenbeleid

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how many residence permits refused under Article 1F of the Refugee Convention involved a finding that return would breach Article 3 ECHR, how many also carried an entry ban, what happens if courts lift such bans, whether prosecution is possible, and whether these persons should get a permit if no prosecution follows. The government answered with figures (321 cases, 88 with entry bans), explained the limited role of courts and the IND's revised procedure after the CJEU K and H.F. ruling, stated that criminal and immigration law are separate and that dismissal does not automatically entitle someone to a permit, and pointed to a narrow temporary-permit policy.
In principle it is not for the court to lift an entry ban.
Het is in principe niet aan de rechter om een inreisverbod op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over religie en buitenlands beleid

Lawmaker Ceder asked the Foreign and Justice ministers how the 2018 recommendations on religion and foreign policy were implemented, what role religion plays in peacebuilding in six countries, whether freedom of religion will be raised in bilateral dialogue, and how IND staff religious literacy is ensured. The minister replied that implementation is progressing (strategy days, training, a special envoy), outlined a JISRA programme in the named countries, committed to raising freedom of religion in bilateral contacts, and described IND training improvements.
Yes. Freedom of religion and belief is one of the priorities of the Netherlands' foreign human rights policy and is always raised where necessary
Ja. Vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging is een van de prioriteiten in het buitenlands mensenrechtenbeleid van Nederland en wordt waar nodig altijd te berde gebracht

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, De Roon, Klink, Eppink en Omtzigt over de bescherming van mensen die met de dood bedreigd worden door wetten tegen geloofsafvalligheid en godslastering

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands is doing to press states that retain the death penalty for apostasy and blasphemy, including via UN resolutions, UPR reviews, and an international campaign, and how it protects people threatened in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and in UN fora, made statements and visits, supports a moratorium in principle, and cited Dutch criminal law and support for ex-believers, but gave no concrete new commitments.
The Netherlands is against the death penalty in all cases and under all circumstances and therefore gives extensive attention to these resolutions and parliamentary motions.
Nederland is tegen de doodstraf in alle gevallen en onder alle omstandigheden en geeft daarom uitgebreid aandacht aan deze resoluties en Kamermoties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Vrouwen in gevangenis Nieuwersluis slachtoffer van seksuele misstanden'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of sexual abuse of female detainees by staff at Nieuwersluis prison, including when signals first arrived, why generic measures came late, supervision of male staff searching women, and whether similar problems exist in other institutions. The minister answered that signals were handled by the internal integrity bureau, that specific and DJI-wide measures have been taken and the Inspectorate's recommendations accepted, and that similar meldingen occur in men's prisons too.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport van de onafhankelijke Fact Finding Mission (FFM) van de Hoge Commissaris Voor de Rechten van de Mens van de Verenigde Naties, over de mensenrechtensituatie in Libië

An MP asked the government about the UN Fact-Finding Mission's findings on abuses against migrants in Libyan detention centres and about Dutch and EU support to the Libyan coast guard, including whether that support contributes to abuses and whether independent monitoring exists. The government answered that EU support (training, vehicles, equipment) aims to strengthen interception capacity, acknowledged the risks and limited instruments, pointed to third-party monitoring whose reports are not shared, and said IOM's registration system is not in use.
For the safety of the actors carrying out the monitoring and for the continuity of the monitoring, the EU does not share reports.
Omwille van de veiligheid van de actoren die de monitoring verrichten alsook voor de continuïteit van de monitoring deelt de EU geen rapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het onderzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer 'Betalingsregelingen bij uitvoeringsorganisaties van het Rijk

MP Ceder asks how the government views the Court of Audit finding that people with tailored payment arrangements may still fall into hardship because the subsistence minimum is insufficiently protected, and what will be done about it, including common norms, automatic insight into debts, and ways to reduce the effort required. The minister commits to working with agencies on protecting the subsistence minimum, exploring legal changes for shared debt visibility, and developing a government debt overview, while the Tax Authority says it cannot yet guarantee the minimum due to limited information on private debts.
I want to investigate whether it is possible to amend the laws and regulations on this point.
Ik wil onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om de wet- en regelgeving op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over gedwongen huisuitzettingen, de vernietiging van woningen en arrestatie van journalisten in Ethiopië

MP Ceder asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about forced evictions and demolition of homes around Addis Ababa, arrests of human rights council members and journalists, and entry restrictions for people from other regions. The minister confirmed awareness, said the scale is unclear, said the human rights council members were released on bail, and said the Netherlands would raise concerns or seek clarification through the EU or like-minded countries where possible.

The Netherlands is co-chair of the Media Freedom Coalition (MFC) and will, where possible and in good cooperation with other MFC members and/or like-minded countries, continue to ask for attention to press freedom and the safety of journalists in Ethiopia.

Nederland is medevoorzitter van de Media Freedom Coalition (MFC) en zal indien mogelijk en in goede samenwerking met andere leden van de MFC en/of gelijkgezinde landen aandacht blijven vragen voor het belang van persvrijheid en de veiligheid van journalisten in Ethiopië.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Piri over visumaanvragen van Surinamers

MPs Ceder and Piri asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about high refusal rates for short-stay visa applications from Surinamese applicants, capacity, processing times and communication. The minister answered that refusals stem mainly from insufficient information, doubts about return and weak ties to the country of origin, that refusal rates rose to 17.44% in 2022, and that processing capacity is being rebuilt with a target of 2019 production levels by Q2 2023.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs assesses every visa application in accordance with the rules of the EU Visa Code.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beoordeelt elke visumaanvraag conform de voorschriften van de EU-visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Ceder over sekse- en familie-gerelateerde aspecten rondom christenvervolging

Two MPs (SGP and ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the 2023 Open Doors gender report on Christian persecution, its pressure points, and how Dutch religious-freedom and human-rights efforts take it into account. The minister says the findings are serious, that Nederland raises rights violations bilaterally and multilaterally, and lists existing programmes such as Shelter City and Safety for Voices without committing to a new concrete step.
The Netherlands firmly stands for the human right to freedom of religion and belief.
Nederland staat pal voor het mensenrecht op vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Ceder en Podt over de uitspraken van de minister-president inzake NGO's

MPs Ceder and Podt asked the Prime Minister and the State Secretary of Justice and Security to explain and justify the Prime Minister's remarks distinguishing 'good and bad' NGOs at sea, and whether those remarks were unfounded. The State Secretary answered that the government values NGO rescue work, that national authorities (the Public Prosecution Service in the Netherlands) decide on criminal investigation, and that humanitarian motives can already be weighed under necessity defences, while giving no evidence that specific NGOs are involved in smuggling.
It is up to the national (investigative) authorities, if there is cause, to investigate this and, where necessary, to proceed to criminal prosecution.
Het is aan de nationale (opsporings)autoriteiten – als daartoe aanleiding is – hiernaar onderzoek te doen en zo nodig over te gaan tot strafrechtelijke vervolging.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over dilemma’s bij schuldhulpverleners om te kunnen handelen in het belang van cliënten als ontstaan effect van het recent aangenomen wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Wsnp

An MP asked about dilemmas for debt counsellors who, pending the entry into force of the amended Wsnp (debt rescheduling act), must weigh filing petitions now against a shorter 18-month term from 1 January 2024, and asked for a clear policy with the judiciary and other partners. The Minister acknowledges the problem, says the new rules apply on entry into force with no transitional law, and states that the government is consulting partners to bring the law into force as soon as possible.
That is why I am now consulting with practitioners to bring the new law into force as soon as possible.
Daarom ben ik nu in overleg met de praktijk om de nieuwe wet zo spoedig mogelijk in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de werking van de economische sancties in relatie tot noodhulp en wederopbouw in de door de aardbeving getroffen gebieden in Syrië

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether EU sanctions on Syria obstruct NGO relief, Syrian Red Crescent appeals, bank transfers to relatives, and heavy machinery imports for earthquake recovery. The minister replied that humanitarian goods and transfers are generally permitted, exemptions exist, the EU eased rules on 23 February, and the government is talking to banks and raising the issue with the Commission.
Humanitarian aid goods and activities are in principle not sanctioned.
Humanitaire hulpgoederen en -activiteiten zijn in principe niet gesanctioneerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Ceder over het voornemen van Vanuatu om het Internationaal Gerechtshof te vragen om een Advisory Opinion over de verantwoordelijkheden van staten op het gebied van klimaat

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would support Vanuatu's draft UN General Assembly resolution requesting an ICJ advisory opinion on state responsibility for climate change, and how it would use diplomacy to build support. The government answered that it intends to support and co-sponsor the resolution, that the resolution has broad support, and that no additional diplomatic effort is needed.

Given the Netherlands' ambitious national and international climate policy, the cabinet intends, like the UK, Japan, and nearly all EU countries, to support the resolution if it is put to a vote in the UN General Assembly.

Gelet op het ambitieuze nationale en internationale klimaatbeleid van Nederland is het kabinet voornemens om, net als het VK, Japan, en vrijwel alle EU landen, de resolutie te steunen als deze in stemming wordt gebracht in de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht dat Iran Nederlandse organisaties als het CIDI en Christenen voor Israël als terroristische organisaties heeft bestempeld

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether the Foreign Minister would summon the Iranian ambassador over Iran placing Dutch organisations CIDI and Christenen voor Israël on a terrorism list, what else could be done, how the threat to members is assessed, whether this is part of an antisemitic agenda, and whether the IRGC should be listed in the EU. The minister condemned the step, said security responsibility lies with organisations and is decentralised, framed the Iranian listing as a response to EU human rights sanctions, and said the IRGC cannot legally be listed by the EU at present while the government keeps pushing for it.
On specific threats, and the measures taken in response, I cannot make statements for security reasons.
Over specifieke dreigingen, alsmede de maatregelen die daartegen naar aanleiding daarvan worden genomen, kan ik vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Eppink, Van der Staaij, Van der Plas en Agnes Mulder over de ontmoeting tussen de minister-president en de Azerbeidzjaanse president Aliyev

MPs asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the January 2023 meeting with Azerbaijani President Aliyev in Davos, including gas deliveries, the Lachin corridor blockade, ECHR rulings and Armenian prisoners. The government answered that the meeting raised Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation and the Lachin blockade, that it did not address the ECHR interim measures or Armenian prisoners, and that it did not condemn Azerbaijan's occupation of Armenian territory, while promising continued calls for compliance.
During the conversation, the Prime Minister conveyed the Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation in Nagorno-Karabakh resulting from the de facto blockade of the Lachin corridor.
Tijdens het gesprek heeft de Minister-President de Nederlandse zorgen over de humanitaire situatie in Nagorno-Karabach als gevolg van de de facto blokkade van de Laçın-corridor overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de plaatsing van organisaties op terreurlijsten

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister whether organisations can be placed on terrorist lists by government decision rather than only by court rulings, and how the PKK listing and the IRGC listing relate to EU court judgments. The minister replied that listings can rest on national executive decisions as equivalents to judicial decisions, that EU court rulings did not find the PKK listing legally unsupported, and that under current EU law the IRGC cannot yet be listed, while the government keeps pressing for other measures.
Organisations cannot be placed on the EU terrorism list solely on the basis of court rulings.
Organisaties kunnen niet alleen op grond van rechterlijke uitspraken op de EU-terrorismelijst geplaatst worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Pouw-Verweij, Ceder en Van der Staaij over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2023

MPs from CDA, JA21, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the foreign minister about Open Doors' 2023 persecution-of-Christians ranking, Dutch initiatives on violence and impunity, Nigeria, Sahel mercenaries, China, North Korea and dual-use exports. The minister largely acknowledged the concerns, described existing programmes and dialogues, and said that prospects for change in North Korea are small and that dual-use risks are handled by export control and corporate due diligence.
I receive the same signals from the embassies that concern me.
Ik krijg vanuit de ambassades dezelfde signalen die mij zorgen baren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ceder over het bericht dat Nagorno-Karabach kampt met een tekort aan voedsel en medicijnen door wegblokkade.

MPs Mulder and Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about reports of food and medicine shortages in Nagorno-Karabakh caused by the blockade of the Lachin corridor, including humanitarian options, EU/US pressure on Azerbaijan, Russian peacekeepers' role and an EU monitoring mission. The minister answered that the ICRC delivers aid, a airlift is not feasible without Azerbaijani consent, Azerbaijan has not complied, and the government is pressing Azerbaijan and considering an EU monitoring mission.
The Netherlands will continue to press for this in the relevant EU bodies.
Nederland zal hierop blijven aandringen in relevante EU-gremia.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Ceder over de inzet van explosieve wapens in Jemen

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister about civilian harm from explosive weapons in Yemen, the ten incidents in a Mwatana/PAX report, whether Yemen, Saudi Arabia and the UAE should sign the explosive weapons political declaration, how to revive UN accountability investigations, and whether arms-supplying states should be pressed to stop deliveries. The minister said Nederland supports better IHL implementation and promotes the declaration, supports accountability through Dutch funding and the High Commissioner for Human Rights, and has raised concerns over arms transfers, but gave no concrete new commitment to restart UN investigations or halt arms supplies.
Nederland has called in various international fora for signing this declaration, and Yemen, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates were also present there.
Nederland heeft in verschillende internationale fora opgeroepen tot het ondertekenen van deze verklaring, daar waren Jemen, Saudi-Arabië en de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten ook bij aanwezig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het dalend aantal opvangplekken in asielzoekerscentra

Ceder (ChristenUnie) asks whether reception places for asylum seekers are falling by 1,250 despite the August asylum agreement, why, what is being done about expiring contracts and the agreement, whether the dispersal law can take effect on 1 January 2023, and for a breakdown per safety region. The Secretary of State answers that about 8,200 to 8,470 emergency crisis places exist, fluctuating as temporary locations open and close, that the Rijk reimburses costs, that a shortfall would be offset by COA capacity, that the dispersal bill is in consultation and depends on the Raad van State and parliament, and that each region targeted 450 places with about 8,400 available.

The municipalities within a safety region decide among themselves, in consultation with e.g. municipal councils, residents and location owners, where crisis emergency reception locations are realised and how long they remain open.

De gemeenten die in een veiligheidsregio liggen bepalen onderling en in afstemming met o.a. gemeenteraden, inwoners en locatie-eigenaren waar crisisnoodopvanglocaties worden gerealiseerd en hoelang deze open zijn.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de verder verslechterde situatie van minderjarige asielzoekers in het opvangcentrum in Ter Apel

MP Ceder asks the State Secretary why conditions for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers at Ter Apel have worsened since the Children's Ombudsman's April visit, including missing toothbrushes, blankets and beds, and whether hotel accommodation was considered. The State Secretary answers that inflow remains high with little outflow, that minors sometimes slept at the IND registration centre lacking facilities, that other emergency options were exhausted, and promises periodic progress reports but not within three weeks.
I cannot commit to this being within three weeks.
Ik kan u niet toezeggen dat dit binnen drie weken zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de voortdurend slechte situatie in het aanmeldcentrum Ter Apel en het weigeren en afslaan van hulp bij de opvangcrisis

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the persistently poor conditions at the Ter Apel registration centre and why offers of help from INLIA and volunteers were refused. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, listed concrete measures such as cleaning the sports hall, phased transfers and extended medical hours, and said cooperation with INLIA and other organisations is ongoing, while stating that coordination of volunteer aid is needed.
Immediately it will be examined whether asylum seekers transferred from Marnewaard to Ter Apel for identification and registration can be brought in phases.
Per direct zal worden onderzocht of asielzoekers die vanuit Marnewaard naar Ter Apel worden gebracht om het identificatie en registratie proces te doorlopen, gefaseerd kunnen worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj en Ceder over de voortgang overbrengingen Afghanistan

MPs Piri, Belhaj and Ceder asked the foreign and defence ministers about the progress of evacuations from Afghanistan, including whether an end date applies, how applications are assessed, and why former Dutch embassy guards were not evacuated. The minister answered that no end date has been set yet, that the criteria are applied as consistently as possible, and that the decision on the guards was made earlier and remains unchanged.
As promised during the debate of 31 March, the cabinet's intentions regarding a possible end date for the evacuation operation will be communicated to your House in advance.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het debat van 31 maart jl. zullen voornemens van het kabinet met betrekking tot een eventuele einddatum van de overbrengingsoperatie vooraf aan uw Kamer worden gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de berichtgeving omtrent arbeidsomstandigheden bagageafhandelaars Schiphol

An ChristenUnie MP asked ministers about reports that Schiphol baggage handlers exceeded occupational exposure limits for years while the Labour Inspectorate did not inspect them for about twelve years, and about how self-regulation and self-inspection tools work. The minister responded that the employer bears primary responsibility, that the inspectorate tests sector codes but not individual firms, that inspections are being carried out after recent media reports with results pending, and that the inspectorate's capacity allocation and the evaluation of self-regulation will be reviewed.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘Meedoen zonder beperkingen’ van de Nationale ombudsman

Christian Union MP Ceder asked the government to respond to the National Ombudsman's report on young people with disabilities and the Participation Act, including whether expectations of self-reliance are realistic and whether the law should be changed. Minister Schouten answered that a reply to the report will follow, cited measures such as the Breed Offensief bill, the planned raise of earnings thresholds and a 10% minimum wage increase, but rejected a structural system change for this group.
This cabinet's coalition agreement does not provide for a systemic change of the kind referred to in question 6.
In het Coalitieakkoord van dit kabinet is niet voorzien in een stelselverandering zoals bedoeld in vraag 6.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Veel financieel kwetsbare ouderen maken geen gebruik van inkomensvoorzieningen’ van de Nationale Ombudsman

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions how elderly people are informed about supplementary income schemes after reaching pension age, following a National Ombudsman report on non-take-up of benefits. The minister answered that the SVB and municipalities inform people, that proactive approaches and simpler application procedures and data exchange are being pursued, and that a legal basis for data sharing is planned.
Countering non-take-up has my priority and is part of the approach to money worries, poverty and debt.
Het tegengaan van niet-gebruik heeft mijn prioriteit en maakt deel uit van de aanpak van geldzorgen, armoede en schulden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over aanvallen op Armeens grondgebied en de deelname van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Azerbeidzjan aan een door de Azerbeidzjaanse regering georganiseerd bezoek aan de stad Sushi in

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about Azerbaijani attacks on Armenian territory and whether the Dutch ambassador in Baku joined a government-organised trip to Shusha in Nagorno-Karabakh, questioning Dutch support for OSCE Minsk Group mediation and calls for accountability. The minister said the Netherlands condemns the violence and backs EU mediation, that the ambassador joined the trip to observe the situation without endorsing it, and that the Netherlands opposes an independent investigation as counterproductive.
The cabinet has neither the capacity nor a presence on the ground to establish who started the fighting or who first violated the ceasefire.
Het kabinet heeft noch de capaciteit, noch de presentie ter plaatse, om vast te stellen wie de gevechten is begonnen, alsook wie het staakt-het-vuren als eerste schond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Sylvana Simons over de ernstige situatie in Suriname ten aanzien van ziekenhuiszorg

MPs Ceder and Sylvana Simons asked ministers about severe staff shortages in Surinamese hospitals, possible recruitment of Surinamese nurses by Dutch hospitals causing brain drain, and Dutch support for staffing, funding and training. The government answered that it supports Suriname via the Makandra programme, a seconded expert, about EUR 8 million from the Verdragsmiddelen for a Zorg Transitie Fonds, expert travel budgets via PUM, and an extended training agreement for Surinamese doctors, while stating it does not actively recruit non-EEA labour and that hospitals may hire under existing rules.
The cabinet, however, does not actively pursue labour migration from outside the EEA (except knowledge migration).
Het kabinet zet echter niet actief in op arbeidsmigratie van buiten de EER (met uitzondering van kennismigratie).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Van der Graaf over de noodsituatie in Pakistan wegens overstromingen

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the government knows of the flood emergency in Pakistan and whether it will provide emergency aid and involve local and civil society organisations. The minister confirmed awareness, pointed to over EUR 3.5 million via the Dutch Red Cross and Dutch Relief Alliance plus expert deployments and flexible funding to UN and Red Cross partners, and said local organisations are engaged in line with Grand Bargain commitments.
The Netherlands has already made emergency aid available for Pakistan.
Nederland heeft reeds noodhulp beschikbaar gesteld voor Pakistan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het rapport 'In Europa uitgebuit nergens beschermd', het bericht 'Nederland stuurt slachtoffers mensenhandel terug naar Italië ondanks risico op herhaalde uitbuiting'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a Salvation Army report on Nigerian trafficking victims, a report on returns of trafficking victims to Italy, and implementation of the Segers/Buitenweg motion. The State Secretary answered that the government relies on mutual trust among member states, that the B8/3 residence scheme was amended in 2019 with an evaluation due in 2023, and that the IND's multidisciplinary pilot had limited reach, while committing to further study and possible follow-up.
It is then up to the receiving member state to organise appropriate care.
Het is dan aan de ontvangende lidstaat om gepaste zorg te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Piri en Ceder over de toezeggingen die zijn gedaan aan de veiligheidsregio’s t.a.v. (extra) crisisnoodopvanglocaties voor asielzoekers

MPs Piri and Ceder asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the government's commitments to safety regions on medical care, staffing and registration at emergency reception locations for asylum seekers. The answers say medical care at some locations is not yet adequate, around 80 civil servants are assigned to specific locations with about 30 active, and registration is being intensified.
The cabinet is currently examining whether it is possible to organise care with other parties in the regions where this has not yet succeeded.
Momenteel onderzoekt het kabinet of het mogelijk is met andere partijen alsnog de zorg te organiseren in de regio's waar dat tot nu toe nog niet gelukt is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Brekelmans, Ceder en Slootweg over actuele problemen van Oekraïense ontheemden

MPs asked the state secretary and ministers about problems faced by Ukrainian displaced persons, including education, income, childcare, information and housing. The government answered that municipal education choices are acceptable, rejected a fully Ukrainian curriculum for children in the Netherlands, and described existing benefit, childcare and housing measures.
It is essential that children receive a full educational offer that suits their development.
Het is namelijk essentieel dat kinderen een volwaardig onderwijsaanbod krijgen dat past bij hun ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het Ceder en Bikker over het bericht ‘Curaçaos roulette’

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked about the Argos report on weak supervision of Curaçao's online gambling sector, its risks, Dutch involvement, and whether the Kingdom should intervene. The government acknowledged insufficient oversight, pointed to Kingdom package measures H.2 and H.19 for reform, and said licensing and enforcement fall under Curaçao's autonomy, with technical assistance offered.
The cabinet nonetheless recognises the statements made in the broadcast and endorses the finding that there is insufficient effective control and supervision of the online gambling sector in Curaçao.

Het kabinet herkent evenwel de uitlatingen die in de uitzending zijn gedaan en onderschrijft de constatering dat er onvoldoende effectieve controle en toezicht is op de online kansspelsector in Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de moordpartij op honderden Amhaarse burgers in Ethiopië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a massacre of hundreds of Amhara civilians in Oromia, Ethiopia, attributed to the OLA, and about EU contacts with TPLF and the stance on the conflict. The minister condemned the violence, said the EU and Netherlands support negotiations and an inclusive national dialogue, but gave no commitment to a formal EU condemnation.

I strongly condemn this act of violence and join the call of the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission for the Ethiopian government to do everything possible to prevent new attacks on civilians or outbreaks of violence.

Ik veroordeel deze gewelddaad ten zeerste, en sluit mij aan bij de oproep van de Ethiopische Mensenrechtencommissie (EHRC) aan de Ethiopische regering om al het mogelijke te doen om nieuwe aanvallen op burgers of uitbarstingen van geweld te voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Ceder over kritiek op het mandaat, de werkwijze en het eerste rapport van de onderzoekscommissie (COI) naar Israël en de Palestijnse gebieden binnen de VN-Mensen

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about criticism of the UN Human Rights Council's Commission of Inquiry on Israel and the Palestinian territories, including its mandate, its first report and Dutch voting behaviour. The minister replied that the Netherlands abstained in 2021 because the mandate was too broad and open-ended, supported a US-initiated joint statement criticising the mandate, and gave limited responses on the legal critiques, while declining to share answers before the 14 June debate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Kat  over het bericht ‘Weer minder mensen in de wettelijke schuldsanering’ van het CBS

MPs Ceder and Kat asked the government why the number of people admitted to the statutory debt restructuring regime (Wsnp) keeps falling and whether the entry threshold is too high, and whether it will consult municipalities and others. The minister answers that admission criteria are applied too strictly, points to a pending bill to loosen them, and says advice will be sought from practitioners, with a letter to parliament planned for September 2022.
It is not intended that people who would benefit from a Wsnp procedure remain in a municipal debt assistance procedure if it is clear that this offers no solution to their debt problem.

Het is niet de bedoeling dat mensen, die gebaat zijn bij een Wsnp-traject, in een gemeentelijk schuldhulpverleningstraject blijven indien duidelijk is dat dit geen oplossing biedt voor de schuldenproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Ceder en Van der Staaij over ‘digitale vervolging’ door in elk geval China en Rusland, en over de arrestatie van een 90-jarige priester door de Chinese autoriteiten

Two MPs (Ceder and Van der Staaij) asked the Foreign Minister about digital persecution by China and Russia, including surveillance of religious minorities, China's social credit system, export controls on surveillance technology, and the arrest of Cardinal Zen. The minister acknowledged the risks, described existing EU and Dutch export controls and corporate due diligence expectations, and said the Netherlands and EU are monitoring the Zen case closely and will raise it in the Foreign Affairs Council if needed.
The Netherlands and the EU are following the case closely.
Nederland en de EU volgen de zaak nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Kuiken en Den Haan over problemen met het notariaat op Saba en Sint Eustatius

MPs Ceder, Kuiken and Den Haan asked about the closure of the only notary office on Saba and Sint Eustatius from 1 July 2022, its consequences, the lack of a legal fallback, and plans for a durable solution. The minister said a temporary notary (waarnemer) is being recruited, that a longer-term extension of Bonaire notaries' work area is intended, and that individual cases will get tailored help, without a fixed timetable.
I am willing to take the necessary measures to ensure that residents of Saba and Sint Eustatius have sustainable access to notarial services.
Ik ben bereid om de noodzakelijke maatregelen te treffen om ervoor te zorgen dat de inwoners van Saba en Sint Eustatius duurzaam van toegang tot het notariaat zijn voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ceder en De Roon over het bezoek van de minister aan de Palestijnse ngo Al-Haq

MPs Van der Staaij, Ceder and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister why he met Palestinian NGO Al-Haq, which Israel has designated a terrorist organisation, and whether this sends a problematic signal, and about contacts with Israel and EU association council talks. The minister answered that the meeting was part of a dialogue with civil society, that Netherlands does not accept the unproven Israeli listings, that he was transparent about his discussions, and that Netherlands supports an EU association council with Israel but lacks EU-wide consensus.
I consider it important to be transparent about meetings such as those with Al-Haq and other civil society organisations, and the considerations underlying them.
Ik vind het belangrijk om transparant te zijn over ontmoetingen zoals met Al-Haq en andere maatschappelijke organisaties, en de afweging die daaraan ten grondslag liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Westerveld over seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de jeugdzorg

MPs Ceder and Westerveld asked the State Secretary and Minister about sexual boundary violations in youth care, including 414 reports reported by the Inspectorate, the role of victim protection, supervision and prosecution. The government acknowledges the problem as shocking, describes measures following the De Winter report, the AKJ advocacy system and IGJ supervision, and says it sees no structural gap in prosecution while admitting it cannot count prosecuted cases in youth care.

In addition, extra investment has been made in advocacy work (AKJ) to offer young people a listening ear; they will also more often explicitly ask about experiences of violence during their visits to institutions.
Daarnaast is extra geïnvesteerd in vertrouwenswerk (AKJ) om jongeren een luisterend oor te bieden; zij gaan tevens vaker expliciet vragen naar ervaringen van geweld bij hun bezoeken aan instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over bedreigingen aan het adres van de Russisch-Orthodoxe kerk in Nederland

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice Minister about threats against Russian Orthodox churches in the Netherlands and whether the government would engage with the communities and local authorities. The minister condemned the threats, said local authorities and police are responsible for security and protection, and visited a Russian Orthodox parish in Amsterdam.
It is therefore up to the local triangle to decide how threats are handled and how this is communicated to those involved.
Het is dan ook aan de lokale driehoek om te bepalen hoe met bedreigingen wordt omgegaan en hoe daarover met betrokkenen wordt gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de subsidiëring van een conferentie waar een NGO die gelieerd is aan terreurorganisatie PFLP aan deelneemt

MPs Ceder, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked whether the Foreign Ministry co-funded a May 2022 conference featuring Al-Haq director Shawan Jabarin, whom Israel links to the PFLP, and whether Dutch funds reach Al-Haq. The minister answered that the ministry's name was wrongly listed as a funder and corrected, that the government has received no evidence for Israel's designation and sees no reason to change policy, and that Nederland has only a limited, indirect relationship with Al-Haq as an implementing partner, while awaiting EU anti-fraud review.
The cabinet has so far received no evidence for Israel's qualifications of the six NGOs and has no reason to revise its policy towards these NGOs on the basis of the Israeli decision.

Het kabinet heeft tot op heden geen bewijs voor de Israëlische kwalificaties van de zes ngo’s ontvangen en heeft geen reden om het beleid ten aanzien van deze ngo’s, op basis van het Israëlische besluit, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Segers over de oproepen tot de doodstraf tegen een Nederlands Tweede Kamerlid door een Pakistaanse geestelijke

MPs Ceder and Segers asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to calls by a Pakistani cleric for the execution of MP Geert Wilders, including whether Pakistan has responded to Dutch mutual legal assistance requests and how the government handles threats from abroad. The minister says threats are unacceptable, the government has raised concern bilaterally with Pakistan, Pakistan has not responded to the 2018 legal assistance requests, and the government will keep working with Pakistan and the security services on the threat.
The cabinet is doing everything within its power to end these threats and mitigate the risks to Mr Wilders.
Het kabinet doet er alles aan wat in zijn macht ligt om een einde te maken aan deze bedreigingen en de risico’s ervan voor de heer Wilders te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het VN-Onderzoek naar oorlogsmisdaden in Jemen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the UN Group of Eminent Experts' mandate on war crimes in Yemen ended, whether Saudi lobbying was responsible, and whether the Netherlands would push to renew it. The minister confirmed the mandate lapsed for lack of a vote majority, acknowledged the value of such investigations, but said the Netherlands will not table a new initiative, instead funding local efforts and seeking other UN-mandated options.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs asked the government about human trafficking risks for Ukrainian refugees at the border, including unaccompanied children, and whether it would press for EU coordination and raise the issue in Council meetings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, has raised them in EU and UN contacts, and describes registration, monitoring and awareness measures in the Netherlands.
The cabinet generally shares UNHCR's concerns about signals of human traffickers in Europe exploiting vulnerable people, including unaccompanied children fleeing Ukraine.

Het kabinet deelt in algemene zin de zorgen van UNHCR over signalen van mensenhandelaren in Europa die misbruik maken van kwetsbare personen, inclusief alleenstaande kinderen die uit Oekraïne vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Oligarchen hebben vliegtuigen op Aruba’

MPs Ceder and Kuiken asked whether Russian oligarchs' private aircraft are registered in Aruba and how sanctions are coordinated across the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. The government answers that Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten enforce EU sanctions themselves, that frozen assets and a few aircraft and a ship were identified, and that six Aruban aircraft were restricted or removed from the register.

Regarding Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten, the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and of Infrastructure and Water Management, nor any other Dutch ministries, have legal powers to obtain insight into the nature and extent of Russian oligarchs' assets.

Met betrekking tot Curaçao, Aruba en Sint Maarten (de CAS) hebben het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken, Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat noch andere Nederlandse ministeries juridische bevoegdheden waarmee inzage verkregen kan worden in de aard en omvang van bezittingen van Russische oligarchen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bisschop, Van der Plas, Bikker, Ceder, Van den Berg, Tielen, Brekelmans en Podt over de toegang tot basiszorg voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MPs from several parties asked about access to basic healthcare for Ukrainian refugees, including GP, mental health, pharmacy, dental and maternity care, and about coordination with the LHV, InEen and GGD GHOR, medical evacuations, administrative burden, and interpreters. The government answered that Ukrainian displaced persons fall outside the asylum medical scheme, that JenV leads the organisation of access with insurers, that existing systems are being copied, and that it could not answer all questions before the plenary debate but sent a broader letter.
It has not been possible to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Het is niet gelukt om de vragen voor het plenaire debat te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘Zelfstandigen over de drempel’ van de Nationale Ombudsman

MPs asked the minister about the Ombudsman's report on uneven debt-relief access for self-employed people across municipalities, and whether national government should enforce minimum standards and prepare for a post-COVID inflow of indebted entrepreneurs. The minister acknowledges the unevenness, says municipalities are responsible for implementation while the national government sets the framework, and promises further talks with VNG and a response letter before summer recess.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for organising debt assistance for self-employed entrepreneurs.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijke voor de inrichting van de schuldhulpverlening aan zelfstandig ondernemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Ceder en De Roon over de brief  ‘Uitkomsten en kabinetsappreciatie extern onderzoek UAWC’

MPs asked the government to disclose the Proximities report on UAWC, defend its definition of the PFLP and the choice to treat Palestinian civil society organisations as PFLP-linked, and explain aid transparency and due diligence. The government declined to publish the report, citing a do-no-harm principle, said it does not share Proximities' broader definition, and promised further EU-level assessment and tightened due diligence.
The cabinet believes that publication of the report could cause disproportionate harm to the civil society organisations concerned.
Het kabinet meent dat openbaarmaking van het rapport de betreffende maatschappelijke organisaties onevenredige schade zou kunnen toebrengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ceder over het aantal doorplaatsingen van uit huis geplaatste kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Ceder asked about the frequency of re-placements of children taken out of their homes, what concrete steps followed the Het Vergeten Kind report and the StroomOp action plan, and whether targets were met. The State Secretary answered that re-placements are not registered nationally, that some targets such as the under-5% overplacement goal were not met though numbers fell, and that a plan for the future of closed youth care will be sent before summer.
The number of re-placements is not registered nationally.
Het aantal doorplaatsingen wordt niet landelijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij en Peters over het bericht dat enkele tientallen christenen in Noord-Korea standrechtelijk zijn geëxecuteerd

MPs Ceder, Van der Staaij and Peters asked the Foreign Minister about reports that dozens of Christians in North Korea were summarily executed, including whether the government can verify this, press for clarification, condemn it, and push for a new EU religious freedom envoy. Minister Hoekstra answered that Dutch information access is very limited, that the government raises human rights violations bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, supports the UN Special Rapporteur, expects an EU envoy appointment soon, and relies mainly on EU sanctions.
The Netherlands has no embassy in Pyongyang, there are currently no EU embassies open in Pyongyang, and the UN no longer has access to the country.
Nederland heeft geen ambassade in Pyongyang, er zijn momenteel geen EU ambassades meer open in Pyongyang en ook de VN heeft geen toegang meer tot het land.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink en Ceder over de berichten 'Steun projecten die kinderen een thuis bieden, geen tehuis: 'Het is tijd voor een nieuwe stap'' en 'Een kindertehuis is geen goed systeem – maar de situat

MPs Klink (VVD) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development how the government addresses orphanage tourism risks, including follow-up to the Ecorys study, possible ANBI status changes, regulation of volunteer trips, campaigns, dialogue with providers, and mandatory VOG checks for volunteers. The minister responded that the government discourages such trips through travel advice, is studying regulation and will inform parliament before the summer recess, leaves ANBI questions to the finance state secretary, and points to sector-led campaigns and dialogue.
The aim is to inform the House before the summer recess.
Inzet is om de Kamer voor het zomerreces te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Sociale media niet geschikt voor kinderen, concludeert Consumentenbond’

An MP asked the government about a Consumentenbond finding that social media platforms are unsuitable for children, including personalised advertising to minors and data privacy concerns. The state secretary responded that the AVG already protects children, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is responsible for enforcement, and that the government supports EU-level restrictions on profiling minors while proposing to promote the Dutch Code voor Kinderrechten Online and adjust national rules.
The cabinet wants to protect children more against inappropriate online advertising and child-directed marketing and give children the right not to be tracked and not to receive data profiles.
Het kabinet wil kinderen extra beschermen tegen niet-passende online reclame en kindermarketing en kinderen het recht geven om niet gevolgd te worden en geen dataprofielen te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs from ChristenUnie and PvdA asked the government about long border waits for Ukrainian refugees, humanitarian funding, reported discrimination against Roma at the Hungarian border and trafficking risks. The government answered that it finds long waits undesirable, is supporting neighbouring states via Frontex, EUAA and EU civil protection, increased humanitarian funding, and found no evidence of discrimination on the EU side while stating it monitors the situation closely.
The Netherlands intends to respond positively to this.
Nederland is voornemens hier positief op te reageren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ceder, Kuik, Eppink en De Roon over de vernietiging van Armeens cultureel en religieus erfgoed door Azerbeidzjan in relatie tot de uitspraak van het Internationaal Gerechts

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie, CDA, JA21 and PVV asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses Azerbaijan's destruction of Armenian cultural and religious heritage and its failure to comply with the ICJ's 2021 provisional measures, and what concrete steps it will take, including on EU aid and sanctions. The minister answered that the ICJ ruling is binding and that the Netherlands urges compliance and a UNESCO fact-finding mission, but declined to judge Azerbaijan's conduct, ruled out unilateral EU sanctions, and gave no firm new commitments.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that cultural and religious heritage is protected, as regularly emphasised in statements and conversations.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat cultureel en religieus erfgoed beschermd wordt, zoals regelmatig onderstreept in verklaringen en gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Grinwis en Ceder over het gebruik van eHerkenning

MPs Omtzigt, Grinwis and Ceder asked why the government keeps requiring eHerkenning for tax filing despite a Gelderland court ruling questioning its legal basis, and about refunds, penalties and a free public alternative.
