The State Secretary defends the legal basis, says the ruling does not affect other tax assessments, offers a limited compensation scheme, and refuses to provide a free public login or restore paper filing for now.
To clarify this, I will have an addendum published on the Tax Administration's website.
Om dit toe te lichten zal ik een naschrift laten publiceren op de website van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Westerveld over terugplaatsingen na uithuisplaatsingen

MPs Ceder and Westerveld asked the ministers how to reduce long out-of-home placements of children, what the government knows about returns home, and whether returns will be registered. The minister answers that reunification is a goal, lists measures and a WODC study, and says registration of returns will be explored with partners, but no reliable national figures on returns currently exist.
I am willing to improve registration on this point.
Ik ben bereid de registratie op dit punt te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Piri  en Kuzu over afwijzingen kort verblijf familieleden Syrische Nederlanders

MPs asked why Syrian visitors for family visits, even when they appear to meet the Visa Code conditions, are refused at a high rate (55% for Syrians overall, about 75% for family visits), and whether the Syrian war is treated as breaking ties to the home country. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that each application is assessed on its merits under the Visa Code, that refusals mostly reflect insufficient ties to the country of origin and doubts about timely return, and that Syrian nationals can only obtain a family visit visa if these concerns are resolved.
Every visa application is assessed on its own merits in accordance with the provisions of the Visa Code.
Alle visumaanvragen worden echter op hun eigen merites beoordeeld overeenkomstig de bepalingen van de Visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, Eppink en Omtzigt over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2022 van Open Doors

MPs Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, Eppink and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2022 Christian persecution ranking, covering Afghanistan, Nigeria, China, India, Algeria, digital surveillance exports, and religious freedom diplomacy. The minister answered that the trends are worrying, outlined existing diplomatic, UN, EU and export-control measures, and promised no new concrete action beyond continued engagement and a future subsidy policy framework.
The Netherlands, together with like-minded countries, raises publicly and behind the scenes at every suitable opportunity the importance of protecting human rights for everyone.

Nederland vraagt, samen met gelijkgezinde landen, zowel publiek als achter de schermen bij iedere gelegenheid die zich daarvoor leent aandacht voor het belang van het beschermen van mensenrechten voor iedereen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht ‘Medewerkers van GGD moeten weg na drie tijdelijke contracten’

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the ministers about reports that GGD staff on test and vaccination sites must leave after three temporary contracts, and whether covid financing could allow permanent contracts. The government answered that GGD organisations are responsible for their own personnel policy, that permanent contracts and redundancy procedures are possible, that VWS will finance certain extra costs under a cost-reimbursement scheme, and that talks will continue.
I have asked the GGDs whether they can quickly map the size of the group(s) of employees, as well as the financial implications that follow from this.
Ik heb aan de GGD’en gevraagd of zij op korte termijn de omvang van de groep(en) werknemers in kaart kunnen brengen, evenals de financiële implicaties die hieruit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Bikker, Ceder en Pouw-Verweij over het bericht 'Nederland grote abortussponsor'

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and JA21 asked whether the Netherlands funds over 250,000 abortion services per year in poorer countries, how many were actual abortions, and how oversight, reporting and SRGR budgets are handled. The minister says abortion services are not consistently defined or counted, so the figures cannot be verified, and that partners report under general indicators without a separate abortion-service requirement, though audits, evaluations and monitoring apply.
For these methodological reasons, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs decided to stop adding up and tracking the numbers of abortion services from 2017 onward.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft er om deze methodologische redenen voor gekozen om vanaf 2017 de aantallen abortusdiensten niet langer bij elkaar op te tellen en bij te houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Kröger, Piri en Ceder over het Fiche 'Voorstel voor een Raadsbesluit betreffende voorlopige noodmaatregelen ten behoeve van Letland, Litouwen en Polen'

Six MPs from D66, Volt, SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether emergency measures for Latvia, Lithuania and Poland under Article 78(3) TFEU are still necessary, legally grounded, time-limited and consistent with asylum and human rights safeguards, including the risk of pushbacks. The government answered that the Commission's assessment of an unprecedented influx from Belarus justifies the measures, that the measures are time-limited to six months, that they largely codify existing derogations, and that it will press these states on lawful border management while not withholding support for the proposal.
The government closely follows the situation at the borders with Belarus and considers the European Commission's assessment of the situation of great importance.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie aan de grenzen met Belarus nauwlettend en acht daarbij het oordeel van de Europese Commissie ten aanzien van de beoordeling van de situatie van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Koekkoek en Teunissen over het bericht over mogelijke push back van een groep van 27 vluchtelingen op het Griekse eiland Lesbos

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary about reports of a group of 27 refugees hiding on Lesbos to avoid alleged pushback, including claims of a pushback of a minor, unlawful strip searches of detained activists, Greek laws criminalising aid and restricting lawyers, and the status of an independent EU monitoring mechanism. The government answered that it awaits findings from Greek and EU investigations, supports an independent monitoring mechanism, notes the Commission is responsible for enforcement, and does not accept that pushbacks are normal practice.
In the absence of independent information, I await the results of such investigations.
Bij het ontbreken van eigenstandige informatie wacht ik de resultaten van dergelijke onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Ceder over het bericht 'Angstcultuur en machtsspelletjes en een verziekte sfeer bij afdeling van de IND: ‘die collega gaan wij afbranden’'

MPs Podt and Ceder asked the State Secretary about an NRC report on a toxic work climate and a whistleblower complaint at the IND, and whether top management intervened. The State Secretary answered that the IND investigated the signals, explained the internal reporting procedure and the role of the integrity committee, acknowledged shortcomings in caring for the complainant, and said internal protections are adequate and a culture scan is underway.
I regret that in this case the care for the complainant fell short in a number of respects.
Ik betreur dat in deze zaak in een aantal opzichten in de zorg voor de melder tekort is geschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de brief van 24 augustus 2021 (Kamerstuk 27062-124) inzake alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary why policy for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers was shaped by a single case, what the difference is between policy and working practice, and for the release of internal IND documents, an inventory and informational notices. The State Secretary answered that the practice was a generalised working method rather than formal policy, that the 'handvatten' document will be turned into a public work instruction, and that the inventory concerns individual casework and cannot be shared, though the related advice and most notices were released.
The inventory you requested concerns personal, individual casuistry. I therefore cannot share this inventory with the House.
De door u gevraagde inventarisatie betreft persoonsgebonden, individuele casuïstiek. Deze inventarisatie kan ik daarom niet met de Kamer delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder en Ellemeet over het rapport van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State over de Wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, in verband met het regelen van de aanmeldfase

Opposition MPs from D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Council of State's criticism of the new asylum pre-registration phase, which drops the first hearing and lacks safeguards such as legal aid and medical checks before the initial hearing. The State Secretary defended the change, saying safeguards are not needed for the brief initial questioning, that statements in pre-registration do not weigh against credibility, and that an evaluation will be published in mid-2022.
The cabinet is of the view that the brief questioning on asylum motives can be justified without yet meeting the safeguards named by the Council of State.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat de korte uitvraag van asielmotieven verantwoord kan zonder dat al aan de door de Afdeling genoemde waarborgen is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de zaak van een uit de Oekraïne afkomstig gezin dat geen paspoort kan krijgen

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about rejected asylum seekers, including a Ukrainian family from Crimea in Friesland, who cannot obtain a passport and are effectively stateless, and about when long residence of children should outweigh state interests. The State Secretary answered that such cases are assessed individually under the buitenschuldvergunning criteria and Article 8 ECHR, that a lack of travel documents does not automatically warrant a residence permit, and that no fixed period of residence settles the balance.
As you know, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet op individuele zaken ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over de toename in arbeidsuitbuiting

Christian Union MPs asked the ministers about the sharp rise in reported labour exploitation, why few cases reach prosecution, the dismissal of a case involving Filipino truck drivers, and protection for victims. The Secretary of State answered that most reports lack sufficient evidence, explained the prosecution and inspection process, said the high evidentiary burden limits prosecution, and promised implementation of the Aanjaagteam recommendations and a later review of article 273f, while noting the cabinet is caretaker.
However, a fully functioning cabinet and financial resources are needed for the decision-making on revising article 273f of the Criminal Code.
Voor de besluitvorming over herziening van artikel 273f Sr zijn echter een missionair kabinet en financiële middelen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Werf en Van der Plas over het bericht dat er nieuw beleid is voor gezinshereniging waar de Kamer niet over geïnformeerd is

MPs Ceder, Van der Werf and Van der Plas asked whether the IND had quietly changed family reunification rules for unaccompanied minors, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether the change is compatible with EU law. The State Secretary replied that the IND's practice was an interpretation of 'alleenstaand' rather than a policy change, that the change was dropped after an inventory, and that affected cases will be re-examined individually.
Question 10: Are you willing to reverse the introduced policy immediately? If not, why not?
Vraag 10 Bent u bereid om het ingevoerde beleid per direct terug te draaien? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Segers over het systematisch lekken vanuit het Catshuisoverleg

MPs Ceder and Segers asked the Prime Minister whether leaks from the Catshuis cabinet consultations are structural, who receives the documents, and what measures prevent them. The government acknowledges that plans leak with some regularity, says it does not know the motives or channels, and points to reminders of confidentiality while stating it will keep trying to prevent leaks.
I do not have information about the motives or causes of the leak, nor about how it occurs.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de motieven of oorzaken van het uitlekken, noch over de wijze waarop dit gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Van der Staaij over een luchtbrug voor vluchtelingen uit kwetsbare groepen uit Afghanistan

MPs Ceder and Van der Staaij asked whether the government would help vulnerable Afghan refugees (women in public roles, Afghan contractors, Christians) leave Kabul via a proposed airlift and admit some into the Dutch asylum procedure, and whether Christians' religion recorded in identity documents exposes them to greater risk. The minister replied that the Dutch evacuation ended on 26 August, that the government continues efforts to bring eligible people out and cooperates with regional countries and allies, and that it cannot yet assess the extra danger to Christians.
The cabinet will continue to actively make efforts to bring people who qualify out of Afghanistan or via neighbouring countries to the Netherlands in the coming period.
Het kabinet blijft zich actief inspannen om ook de komende periode mensen die daarvoor in aanmerking komen uit Afghanistan of via de buurlanden naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de manier waarop verder uitvoering gegeven wordt aan de motie-Belhaj en het beleid ten aanzien van Afghaanse vluchtelingen en ontheemden

An MP asks ministers how they assess which Afghan applicants fall under the Belhaj motion categories, what is being done with thousands of emails, whether those stranded in neighbouring countries can seek Dutch protection, and related questions on NGO lists, coalition burden-sharing, Croatia Dublin transfers and aid. The government answers that a special scheme for two groups is planned, the mailbox was closed with about 20,000 unique addresses sorted, the Vreemdelingencirculaire will be amended, and it cites Dutch engagement with allies and aid organisations.
All persons who sent a message to kabul@minbuza.nl will be informed of this by email.
Alle personen die een bericht hebben gestuurd naar kabul@minbuza.nl zullen hierover per e-mail worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden leden Bikker, Ceder en Segers aan over de Afghaanse heroïnehandel en de rol van Nederland

MPs Bikker, Ceder and Segers asked ministers about the Taliban's income from Afghan heroin trade and whether the Netherlands, as a Europe-wide transit hub, bears responsibility and can act. The government said the Netherlands plays an unintended role in the heroin market, that a causal link to Taliban financing is hard to establish, and that it is pursuing a joint EU and national approach through EMPACT, the drugs strategy and a security dialogue with Turkey.

Because of its infrastructure, its current role as a producing and transit country for drugs, and the role of Dutch criminals in the drug industry, the Netherlands unintentionally also plays a role in the European heroin market.

Nederland vervult vanwege haar infrastructuur, huidige rol als productie- en doorvoerland van drugs en de rol van Nederlandse criminelen in de drugsindustrie, ongewild ook een rol in de Europese heroïnemarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over uithuisplaatsing van kinderen van gedupeerden van de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many children of childcare-benefit scandal victims have been placed outside the home, for how long, and what help parents received. The minister answered that the number is not yet known, that placements are a last resort with safeguards, and that municipalities and the Herstel Toeslagen programme will offer support and reassess cases.
It is currently not known how many families of affected parents have had (or have) to deal with an out-of-home placement or return.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen van gedupeerde ouders te maken hebben (gehad) met een uithuisplaatsing of terugplaatsing.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri en Van der Werf over de grondhouding bij de beoordeling van asielzaken door de IND en de rol van taalexperts bij het beantwoorden van vragen over de identiteit

MPs Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri and Van der Werf asked the State Secretary about the IND's basic attitude toward asylum cases and the use of language experts in identity assessments, citing an internal 2009 discussion paper and a specific Burundi case. The State Secretary answered that the IND does not steer toward rejection, that language analyses are only supplementary indications, and that no independent investigation is needed given court review.
It has never been IND policy, either now or in the past, to primarily steer toward rejecting asylum applications.
Het is nimmer het beleid van IND geweest, in het heden noch het verleden, om primair te sturen op het afwijzen van asielaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Ceder, Segers en Van der Staaij over de situatie van Afghaanse christenen

Four MPs asked the government about the situation of Afghan Christians and converts under the Taliban, and whether asylum policy should be loosened. The government said the situation of religious minorities was already concerning, that information is limited, and that a moratorium on decisions and departures has been imposed with a new country report and further consultation with parliament promised.
After receiving the country report, the House will be further informed about the conclusions that can be drawn from it for the country-based asylum policy.
Na ontvangst van het ambtsbericht wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de conclusies die uit dat ambtsbericht kunnen worden getrokken voor het landgeboden asielbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Ellemeet over het onderzoek van het Europees Parlement naar Frontex

MPs Ceder and Ellemeet asked the State Secretary about the European Parliament's Frontex inquiry, which found Frontex was aware of alleged pushbacks but did not act, and about the role of director Leggeri and what should be done. The government acknowledged the failure of reporting and complaint mechanisms, called for better follow-up and strengthened Management Board steering, but declined to share Dutch Management Board statements and said no new investigation is needed.
The government's main conclusion from the FSWG report is that the existing reporting, complaints and monitoring mechanisms have not worked sufficiently.
Het kabinet trekt als voornaamste conclusie uit het FSWG-rapport dat de bestaande rapportage-, klachten- en monitoringsmechanismen onvoldoende hebben gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van den Berg en Kuik over de aanpak van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk

MPs asked about the government's approach to human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, including prosecutions, victim reporting, information sharing and whether the National Rapporteur's mandate should extend to the BES islands. The government answered that combating trafficking is largely a country matter, gave case and reporting figures for Caribbean Netherlands, declined to extend the National Rapporteur's mandate, and committed to raising the issue at the next Justice Ministers' meeting and evaluating the MoU in 2022.

Are you willing to come to the budget debate for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations with scenarios on how information gathering, information sharing, reception, investigation and prosecution of human trafficking in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom can be improved?

Bent u bereid voor de behandeling van de begroting Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties met scenario's te komen hoe de informatievergaring, informatiedeling, opvang, opsporing en vervolging op het gebied van mensenhandel in de Caribische delen van het Koninkrijk kan worden verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri en Simons over het rapport 'Onzichtbaar' van de Amsterdamse Ombudsman en het WODC-onderzoek naar mensen zonder rechtmatig verblijf

MPs asked the government about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's estimate that 4-6% of pupils in Amsterdam schools are undocumented, the national share, post-18 education and work prospects, economic costs, and return figures. The minister gave national percentages of students without a BSN, said the national share of undocumented children is likely lower, announced a study on newcomer funding, and declined further research on economic costs and returns, citing the legal framework.
It is not possible to state how many children staying unlawfully in the Netherlands receive national education.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel onrechtmatig in Nederland verblijvende kinderen landelijk onderwijs volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van Dijk, Piri en Van der Werf over de situatie van de door Nederland naar Bahrein uitgezette asielzoeker A.S.

MPs asked how the government monitors the detention of asylum seeker A.S. in Bahrain, whether he is isolated and mistreated, and what steps Netherlands and the EU take to secure his release. The minister says the embassy follows the case through regular human rights work, has raised concerns with Bahraini authorities, cannot confirm the reported conditions yet, and will continue to press for better detention conditions.
The Netherlands nevertheless follows A.S.'s case as part of the embassy in Kuwait's regular human rights work.
Nederland volgt evenwel de zaak van A.S. als onderdeel van het reguliere mensenrechtenwerk van de ambassade in Koeweit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kuik en Van Haga over de brief van 14 januari betreffende vrijwilligersreizen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development about orphanage tourism, development policy on orphan care, the UN Child Rights resolution, ANBI charity status rules, timelines for regulatory follow-up, and sector campaigns. The minister answered that orphan care is not a separate policy focus, that ANBI rules are neutral and offer no basis for extra checks, that further regulatory options will be decided in Q4 2021, and that the sector should self-organise with government in an information role.
Several ministries are currently examining which of the listed courses of action are realistic, desirable and feasible, and which concrete actions could be attached to them.
Er wordt momenteel met verschillende ministeries bezien welke van de genoemde handelingsperspectieven realistisch, wenselijk en haalbaar zijn en welke concrete acties hieraan verbonden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Werf en Piri over het terugsturen van Soedanese afgewezen asielzoekers naar Soedan

MPs from four parties asked the State Secretary about deportations of rejected Sudanese asylum seekers, including the use of language analysis, reports of ill-treatment after return, and possible contact with Sudanese intelligence officers at the embassy. The State Secretary defended the procedures as careful, said language analysis is only a supplementary indication, and maintained that there is no reason to believe returnees are targeted merely for returning.
A language analysis is only used as a supplementary instrument, namely when there is serious doubt about the stated country of origin.
Een taalanalyse wordt alleen als aanvullend instrument ingezet, namelijk wanneer er ernstige twijfel bij het gestelde land van herkomst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de gevolgen van de terugtrekking van de internationale troepen uit Afghanistan voor het beleid ten aanzien van Afghaanse asielzoekers

An MP asked whether rejected Afghan asylum seekers are still being returned amid the troop withdrawal, what happens to pending return cases, whether the country-of-origin report remains usable, and whether returns remain responsible. The State Secretary answered that a decision and departure moratorium has been imposed so no forced returns occur, that no forced returns to Afghanistan took place in 2021, and that the general country report will be brought forward for publication around end September with policy consequences to follow.
This means that no forced return of already rejected asylum seekers takes place.
Dit betekent dat er geen gedwongen terugkeer van reeds afgewezen asielzoekers plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Der Werf en Ceder over de ontstane situatie in Afghanistan.

MPs Van der Werf and Ceder asked whether a new Afghanistan country report would be published in October and whether it could be accelerated, whether a departure moratorium would be imposed, whether any removals to Afghanistan were planned, and whether Afghans were in immigration detention. The State Secretary referred to her letter of 11 August, which announced a decision and departure moratorium for Afghanistan and the timing of the next country report, and noted the questions crossed with that letter.
For the answers to these questions I would like to refer you to my letter of 11 August.
Voor de antwoorden op deze vragen verwijs ik u graag naar mijn brief van 11 augustus jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Bromet, Ceder en Kuzu over het beschermen van Afghanen die werkzaam waren voor Nederland tijdens de Afghanistanmissies

MPs from six parties asked the cabinet why it is not doing more to quickly bring Afghan interpreters and other former local staff who worked for Dutch missions to safety, including questions on the asylum process, document problems, non-interpreter staff, and a deportation moratorium. The ministers answered that additional staff were deployed, interpreters' remaining requirements were dropped, about 43 interpreters had arrived since June, non-interpreters are assessed individually and generously, and the moratorium's extension will be decided later.
The cabinet is taking all steps within its own power to bring the interpreters and their families to the Netherlands as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet onderneemt alle stappen die binnen het eigen vermogen liggen om de tolken en hun gezinnen op een zo kort mogelijke termijn naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Kuzu over ‘De Nederlandse militairen zijn weg uit Afghanistan, maar hun tolken lopen gevaar’

MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about Afghan interpreters and guards who worked for the Dutch mission still awaiting admission, including passport delays, EUPOL interpreters and exclusion of guards. The government gave detailed figures, explained passport and identity-verification obstacles, said it will consider guards case by case, and answered that each question would be addressed separately.
The cabinet makes maximum efforts to do what is possible if an applicant does not have a passport.
Het kabinet zet zich maximaal in om te doen wat mogelijk is indien een aanvrager niet over een paspoort beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Ceder over misbruik van Europese donorgelden door Palestijnse Ngo’s

MPs Stoffer and Ceder asked the minister whether Dutch and EU donor funds reach Palestinian NGOs linked to the PFLP, and what controls exist to prevent this. The minister says Dutch and EU funding is subject to risk analysis, audits and monitoring, that Israel's evidence so far is general and unsubstantiated, that OLAF has been asked to look, and that the UAWC contribution stays suspended pending a study to be sent after the summer recess.
The cabinet is awaiting the outcome of the EU request to OLAF.
wacht het kabinet het resultaat van het EU-verzoek aan OLAF af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Ceder over de vrijlating van het Pakistaanse echtpaar Shagufta en Shafqat

Two ChristianUnion MPs asked whether the released Pakistani Christian couple Shagufta Kausar and Shafqat Emmanuel face danger, whether the Netherlands will admit them as refugees, and what pressure is applied on Pakistan to repeal its blasphemy laws. The minister answered that the risk cannot be determined in advance, that asylum cannot be applied for at an embassy, and that the government raises the issue bilaterally and in EU channels while preferring quiet diplomacy.
It should be noted that the starting point of Dutch asylum policy is that a person can only apply for asylum in the Netherlands.
Hierbij dient aangetekend te worden dat het uitgangspunt van het Nederlandse asielbeleid is dat iemand enkel in Nederland asiel kan aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Rijk belemmert gemeenten in armoedebeleid' en het niet uitvoeren van de motie over dit onderwerp

An MP asked why the government has not implemented an adopted motion to raise the asset limit for local tax waiver to the Participatiewet level, and whether it will do so before 1 July 2021. The minister confirms non-implementation, citing the demissionary cabinet's reluctance, the different purposes of tax waivers and benefits, poverty-trap and tax-burden effects, and refuses to commit to a timeline, leaving the matter to a successor cabinet.
The cabinet has not yet implemented the broadly adopted motion, because the current demissionary cabinet does not consider it opportune to decide on this now.
Het kabinet heeft de breed aangenomen motie nog niet uitgevoerd, omdat het huidige demissionaire kabinet het niet opportuun acht om hier nu over te beslissen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu en Ceder over de noodsituatie van de Afghaanse tolken

MPs from five parties asked the Defence Minister how many Afghan interpreters and their families had arrived in the Netherlands in June 2021, how many remain in Afghanistan, and what is being done to speed up their transfer and protect them. The government answered with case counts (90 families arrived since 2014, 84 active applications in Afghanistan, 113 rejected), listed measures to accelerate processing, and said the embassy in Kabul will remain open if security allows.
For security reasons I cannot go into these measures.
Omwille van veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de samenwerking tussen de ministeries en religieuze actoren

The ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister how religious actors are considered in development cooperation, including their role in policy, programme analysis, staff knowledge and gender work. The minister answered that religious actors are treated as part of civil society, that cooperation is judged on effectiveness, and listed existing networks and embassy engagements.
Religious actors, such as religious institutions or individuals, are classed under civil society as in the policy framework Strengthening Civil Society and the Human Rights Policy.

Religieuze actoren, zoals religieuze instituties of individuen, worden geschaard onder het maatschappelijk middenveld zoals in het beleidskader Versterking Maatschappelijk Middenveld en het Mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite, Ceder, Bromet, Wassenberg en Simons over het bericht “heeft premier Jacobs een punt als zij zegt dat Nederland vals speelt”

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister about the Rijksministerraad decision of 23 April 2021 to release the fifth tranche of liquidity support to Sint Maarten and why the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations did not implement it. The Prime Minister answered that concerns about corporate governance at the airport led the State Secretary to resubmit the matter, which the council reversed on 28 May, and that no change to the council's rules of procedure is planned.
I see no reason to amend the rules of procedure of the council of ministers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het reglement van orde van de ministerraad te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Ceder over het bericht ‘Nieuwe deurwaarderswet brengt schuldenaars in problemen’

MPs Van Kent and Ceder asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the new attachment-free allowance rules (fictitious housing costs) leave debtors with too little to live on. The minister defended the fictitious housing-cost method as a deliberate choice, said adjustments to the Recofa calculation for the protected amount are being prepared, and promised an evaluation and external study.
The law contains a hardship clause.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Ceder over het bericht dat een groep bekeerlingen door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) als niet geloofwaardig wordt bestempeld

Two MPs (Bisschop, Ceder) asked whether the IND's assessment of converts' asylum claims, including the work of its Taskforce, amounts to injustice and whether staff expertise and safeguards are adequate. The State Secretary answered that individual cases are assessed carefully with existing safeguards (legal aid, appeal, specialist coordinators, training) and that the IND sees no injustice, while promising only talks on training and continued dialogue with the legal profession.
The asylum system has several safeguards to ensure that the foreign national is treated justly.
Het asielsysteem kent meerdere waarborgen om ervoor te zorgen dat de vreemdeling recht wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Koekkoek over de dreigende uitzetting van Davit en Nunë

MPs Ceder and Koekkoek asked the State Secretary about the threatened deportation of two Groningen-born children to Armenia, citing developmental risks, the child-rights convention, social networks, and the IND's handling of the children's stay and missed-whereabouts rules. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, maintained that the best interests of the child are weighed under Article 8 ECHR, and refused to change the criteria or commission new research.
As your House is aware, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over de oproep uit Suriname om hulp te bieden met vaccineren

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about Suriname's request for vaccination help amid a COVID-19 surge and the Indian export ban. The minister answered that Nederland has responded with oxygen containers, medical supplies, 90,000 AstraZeneca doses and a planned 500,000 to 750,000 doses, sent a special envoy, and donated EUR 70 million to COVAX.
The Netherlands has also committed that from week 25, provided supplies allow, vaccines will be delivered to Suriname.
Nederland heeft tevens toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over het aanbod van het Diaspora Medisch Team Nederland om steun aan het vaccinatieprogramma in Suriname te faciliteren

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about the Diaspora Medical Team's offer to support Suriname's vaccination programme, whether the minister had contacted Suriname's health minister, and whether vaccines would be supplied. The minister replied that talks with Suriname's health minister had taken place, that 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were sent with further deliveries promised from week 25, and that a coordinator was deployed to match Surinamese needs with Dutch medical staff offers.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has committed that from week 25, provided deliveries allow it, vaccines will be supplied to Suriname.
Verder heeft Nederland toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over burgergegevens bij het Inlichtingenbureau

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Inlichtingenbureau's data matching that generates 'samenloop' signals to municipalities on benefit fraud, including how signals arise, error rates, complaint routes and whether fraud control is disproportionate. The Minister answered that no risk models are used under the Participatiewet, that signals are data matches sent for municipal follow-up, that outcomes are not tracked centrally, and that complaint and correction routes exist.
It is up to the municipality to assess whether signals merit investigation and, through further inquiry, to establish whether unlawfulness actually exists.
Het is aan de gemeente om de onderzoekwaardigheid van signalen te beoordelen en om aan de hand van nader onderzoek vast te stellen of er daadwerkelijk sprake is van onrechtmatigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Leijten over het bericht 'Overheid heeft nog jaren nodig om «foute persoonsgegevens» op te ruimen'

MPs Ceder and Leijten asked the State Secretary of Interior about reports that the government needs years to clean up improperly used personal data in risk models, including use of nationality, ethnicity and birthplace, privacy impact assessments, proportionality, and timelines. The State Secretary answered that a DPIA check and inventory will be carried out across departments, that such data use is only allowed when objectively justified, that the operation may run until 2025, and that a first progress report will be sent before the budget debate.
As I wrote to your House in my letter of 8 April, we are starting with an inventory of data processing and a check on lawfulness.
Zoals ik uw Kamer schreef in mijn brief van 8 april, starten we met een inventarisatie van de gegevensverwerkingen en een toetsing op rechtmatigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Paternotte, Hagen, Boucke, Grinwis en Ceder over niet-EU-familieleden van expats, die geen toegang hebben tot Nederland

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked whether non-EU family members of expats and residents are barred from entering the Netherlands under the EU entry ban and Dutch flight bans, whether this breaches Article 8 ECHR, and whether exceptions can be made for Suriname and other regions. The government answered that family of Dutch residents with residence permits are exempt, that individual exceptions exist for urgent family reasons, that the flight bans were lifted on 1 June 2021, and that generic exceptions for first- and second-degree relatives were not desirable.
The cabinet notes that the right to private and family life in Article 8 ECHR does not constitute an absolute right of access to the Netherlands.
Daarbij merkt het kabinet op dat het in artikel 8 EVRM opgenomen recht op privé en familieleven geen absoluut recht tot toegang tot Nederland behelst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Ceder over vastlopende hersteloperatie toeslagenschandaal

MPs Grinwis and Ceder asked whether the childcare benefit scandal restitution operation is stalling, why rejection letters after the light check lack a objection clause, whether the Catshuisregeling compromises care, and about moratorium, dossier access, and compensation capacity. The State Secretary answered that the operation is not stalling despite high workload, that the letter was amended to include an objection reference, and that all parents get an integral assessment with the moratorium and dossier processes described.
As a result, the letter was amended and the full legal remedies reference was included.
Naar aanleiding hiervan is de brief aangepast en is de volledige rechtsmiddelverwijzing wel opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de mogelijkheid voor gemeenten om zelfstandig staatloosheid te onderzoeken en/of vast te stellen

An MP asked whether municipalities can independently investigate and establish statelessness and recode 'nationality unknown' to 'stateless' in the BRP, and whether they should be given guidance. The state secretary answered that municipalities have only a limited registration competence based on evident documents and refused a broader investigative duty, pointing instead to a forthcoming court-based statelessness determination procedure and declining to issue a guidance document.
This concerns a low-threshold procedure open to every person who claims to be stateless, regardless of their residence status.
Het betreft een laagdrempelige procedure die toegankelijk is voor elke persoon die stelt staatloos te zijn, ongeacht diens verblijfsstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Ceder, Jasper van Dijk en Piri over de dreigende uitzetting van Amsterdamse modelburgers Sofia en Najoua

MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the threatened deportation of two Amsterdam-raised young women, questioning whether the IND's decision, its appeal against the court ruling and the rules for residence under article 8 ECHR were consistent with the rights of children and the courts' findings. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, noted the IND has withdrawn the appeal and granted residence, and explained general routes and guidance for adults who grew up in the Netherlands without residence status.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases nor into the considerations underlying the decision to lodge an appeal.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken noch op overwegingen die ten grondslag liggen aan het instellen van Hoger Beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeets, Kuik, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Piri over het bericht ‘Tina en Jacob moeten weg!’

MPs from D66, CDA, SP, ChristenUnie and PvdA asked whether Armenian Syrians facing revocation of asylum status are treated unequally, and why some keep their permits while others lose them. The State Secretary answered that re-assessment is individual, that the IND does not register these figures, and that a 2021 court ruling concerned insufficient reasoning on equality, not discrimination.
The requested numerical data cannot be provided.
De gevraagde cijfermatige gegeven kunnen niet verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Ceder, Kuik en Koekkoek over de mogelijke uitzetting van Tina en Jacob

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Tina and Jacob, Syrian-Armenians, faced deportation to Armenia and whether their family ties and residence in the Netherlands should count. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case on privacy and confidentiality grounds, explained the IND's general approach to dual nationals and safe third countries, and noted that the IND had granted a residence permit.
As said, I cannot go into the individual case.
Zoals gezegd kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele zaak.

m: Motie van het lid Thijssen c.s. over het uitstellen van een beslissing over het verstrekken van een exportkredietverzekering aan TotalEnergies
Asks the government to postpone any decision on an export credit insurance for TotalEnergies' Mozambique LNG project until the reassessment outcomes are clear and discussed in the House.

requests the government to postpone a decision on granting an export credit insurance for TotalEnergies' LNG project in Mozambique until the outcomes of the reassessment process are clear and have been discussed in the House of Representatives

Raises spending on the three ODA policy articles by a total of 40 million euro through a cash shift funded by lowering the ODA buffers in 2027 and 2028.
Coverage is found in a cash shift between years by lowering the ODA buffer in 2027 by 20 million and lowering the ODA buffer in 2028 by 20 million.
Dekking wordt gevonden in een kasschuif tussen jaren door middel van het verlagen van de OS-buffer in 2027 met 20 miljoen en het verlagen van de OS-buffer in 2028 met 20 miljoen.

Met dit amendement beogen de indieners het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen te verhogen.
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 6 over het verhogen van het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen

Met dit amendement beogen de indieners het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen te verhogen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 74 over een verdeling op basis van inwoneraantal en sociaaleconomische status van de gemeente

Requires by statute that the distribution of asylum reception places be based on population and the SES-WOA socio-economic score, and that the minister consider that score in the distribution decision.
This amendment therefore establishes at statutory level that the distribution system must be based on population and socio-economic capacity.
Dit amendement legt daarom op wetsniveau vast dat de verdeelsystematiek gebaseerd moet zijn op inwoneraantal en op sociaaleconomische draagkracht.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 22 over een verdeling op basis van inwoneraantal en sociaaleconomische status van de gemeente
Amends the bill so that the distribution of reception places must be based in law on population and the CBS socio-economic score, limiting the government's discretion over the distribution system.
This amendment therefore establishes at statutory level that the distribution system must be based on population and socio-economic capacity.
Dit amendement legt daarom op wetsniveau vast dat de verdeelsystematiek gebaseerd moet zijn op inwoneraantal en op sociaaleconomische draagkracht.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van den Brink c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het verlengen van de fase van vrijwilligheid

Amends the asylum reception distribution bill to make the provincial allocation final by 1 February, extend the voluntary phase to 1 November, and postpone ministerial distribution decisions to 31 December.
By extending the phase in which reception facilities can be offered voluntarily, the chance that interadministrative supervision is needed is reduced.

Door de fase waarin op vrijwillige basis opvangfaciliteiten kunnen worden aangeboden te verlengen, wordt de kans op de inzet van interbestuurlijk toezicht voor het realiseren van opvangfaciliteiten verminderd.
Amendement van het lid Koekkoek c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 19 over het sterker verankeren van de mogelijkheid tot kleinschalige opvang
Amendment deletes the second sentence of article 2(3) so that locations below a minimum size can count as reception places for small-scale reception.
In article 2, third paragraph, the second sentence is deleted.
In artikel 2, derde lid, vervalt de tweede zin.
Amendement van het lid Koekkoek c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 30 over het sterker verankeren van de mogelijkheid tot kleinschalige opvang
Deletes a sentence in the bill so that minimum size requirements for reception locations no longer apply, strengthening small-scale reception.
In article 2, third paragraph, the second sentence is deleted.
In artikel 2, derde lid, vervalt de tweede zin.
Motie van het lid Piri c.s. over in de AMvB uitwerken dat volwaardige aanmeldcentra eerlijk worden verspreid
Asks the government to ensure, in the AMvB under the Wet gemeentelijke taak, that full asylum registration centres are distributed fairly across regions.

Asks the government to house asylum seekers as far as possible in the municipality or region where they will live after receiving asylum status.
requests the government to accommodate asylum seekers as much as possible in the municipality or region where they will be housed after receiving asylum status
verzoekt de regering om asielzoekers zo veel mogelijk op te vangen in de gemeente en/of regio waar zij na de verlening van de asielstatus gehuisvest worden
Motie van het lid Jasper van Dijk over onderzoeken hoe het onderscheid tussen kansarme en kansrijke asielzoekers kan worden vastgelegd in lagere regelgeving
Asks the government to study how the distinction between low- and high-prospect asylum seekers could be fixed in lower regulation, keeping low-prospect seekers with the national state.
requests the government to investigate how the distinction between low- and high-prospect asylum seekers can be laid down in lower regulations
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe het onderscheid tussen kansarme en kansrijke asielzoekers kan worden vastgelegd in lagere regelgeving

Adds to the bill that the distribution of asylum reception places between municipalities must be based on population size and the municipal SES-WOA socioeconomic score, narrowing the government's delegated discretion.
The distribution is based on the number of residents of the municipality concerned and on the socioeconomic status
De verdeling is gebaseerd op het aantal inwoners van de betreffende gemeente en op de Sociaaleconomische status
Amendement van het lid Koekkoek c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over kwaliteitskaders voor kwetsbare groepen

after 'must comply' is inserted ', taking particular account of the needs of vulnerable groups'
wordt na «moeten voldoen» ingevoegd «, waarbij in het bijzonder rekening wordt gehouden met de behoeften van kwetsbare groepen»
Amendement van de leden Koekkoek en Jasper van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het toevoegen van een voorhangbepaling

Replaces an earlier amendment by adding a clause requiring both chambers to receive draft general and ministerial regulations under the act, with a four-week waiting period and a veto by either chamber.
If one of the chambers of the States General decides not to agree with the draft, no proposal is made.
Indien een der Kamers der Staten-Generaal besluit niet in te stemmen met het ontwerp, wordt er geen voordracht gedaan.
Amendement van het lid Van den Brink c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het verlengen van de fase van vrijwilligheid

Amends the asylum shelter distribution law: earlier dates for provincial and municipal figures, a longer voluntary phase to 1 November, and postponing the minister's distribution decisions to 31 December, reducing use of interbestuurlijk toezicht.
This amendment enables the Minister to announce the distribution across all provinces and the indicative distribution per municipality before 1 February.
Dit amendement stelt de Minister in staat om de verdeling over alle provincies en de indicatieve verdeling per gemeente vóór 1 februari bekend te maken
Amendement van de leden Koekkoek en Jasper van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het sterker verankeren van de mogelijkheid tot kleinschalige opvang
Amendment deletes the second sentence of article 2(3) so that small-scale reception locations need not meet a minimum size to count as reception places.
In article 2, third paragraph, the second sentence is deleted.
In artikel 2, derde lid, vervalt de tweede zin.

Caps new reception facilities for asylum seekers at 300 places and applies the cap to existing larger facilities via ministerial rules, reducing central government discretion over siting.
Reception facilities have a maximum size of three hundred places.
Opvangvoorzieningen hebben een maximale omvang van driehonderd plaatsen.
Amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het schrappen van de financiële prikkels voor asielopvang
Deletes the financial incentives paid to municipalities for taking in asylum seekers.

Met dit amendement worden alle financiële prikkels voor gemeenten om asielzoekers op te vangen geschrapt.
Motie van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hammelburg over zich met gelijkgestemde staten inzetten voor een internationaal verdrag voor een verbod op volledig autonome wapensystemen
Asks the government to work with like-minded states for an international treaty banning fully autonomous weapon systems, outside the CCW if needed.
requests the government, with like-minded states and with high urgency, to work towards an international treaty banning fully autonomous weapon systems
verzoekt de regering zich, met gelijkgestemde staten en met hoge urgentie, in te zetten voor een internationaal verdrag voor een verbod op volledig autonome wapensystemen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 5 over middelen voor de aanpak van belastingontwijking
Shifts 200,000 euro within the development budget to intensify work on tax avoidance and illicit financial flows.

Daarom stelt indiener voor om € 200.000 euro uit artikel 1.3 te halen ten behoeve van de aanpak van belastingontwijking.

requests the government to consider the extent to which aid for repairing the damage can be increased

requests the government to map out how the Netherlands and the European Union can contribute more
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen op welke wijze Nederland en de Europese Unie een grotere inzet kunnen leveren
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over een onderzoek naar extra inzet voor humanitaire ontmijning in Cherson

requests the government to investigate whether extra effort can be made for humanitarian demining in the Kherson region
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of er extra inzet kan worden geleverd voor humanitaire ontmijning in de regio Cherson

Asks the government to elaborate alternative decision-making models in the OSCE, such as the consensus-minus-one model, to keep decisions possible.
requests the government to elaborate these options in order to keep decision-making within the OSCE possible
verzoekt de regering deze opties uit te werken teneinde besluitvorming binnen de OVSE mogelijk te houden

Motion asks the government to propose bilateral or EU measures if Israel keeps labelling seven Palestinian human rights organisations as terrorist.
requests the government to propose appropriate bilateral or EU-level measures
verzoekt de regering om bilateraal dan wel in EU-verband gepaste maatregelen voor te stellen
Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over zich binnen de VN inspannen om Iran te verwijderen uit de Commissie voor de Status van de Vrouw
Motion asking the government to work within the UN to remove Iran from the Commission on the Status of Women.
requests the government to work within the United Nations to remove Iran from the Commission on the Status of Women
verzoekt de regering zich binnen de Verenigde Naties in te spannen Iran te verwijderen uit de Commissie voor de Status van de Vrouw
Motie van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de stand van zaken rond nucleaire ontwapening en moderisering van kernwapens in Nederland
Asks the government to inform the Chamber about nuclear disarmament and the modernisation of nuclear weapons in the Netherlands, given possible deployment of new US weapons.
requests the government to inform the Chamber about the state of affairs regarding nuclear disarmament and the modernisation of nuclear weapons in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering de Kamer te informeren over de stand van zaken rond nucleaire ontwapening en over de modernisering van kernwapens in Nederland
Motie van de leden Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het bilateraal actieplan tussen Nederland en Marokko met de Kamer delen
Asks the government to share the bilateral action plan agreed with Morocco with the Chamber.
requests the government to share this action plan with the Chamber
verzoekt de regering dit actieplan met de Kamer te delen
Motie van het lid Jasper van Dijk over alle directe en indirecte wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne openbaar maken
Asks the government to publicly disclose all direct and indirect weapons deliveries to Ukraine, enhancing parliamentary transparency over defence decisions.
requests the government to make public all direct and indirect weapons deliveries to Ukraine
verzoekt de regering alle directe en indirecte wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne openbaar te maken

requests the government to explore the possibilities for a civilian victims fund

Motie van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de Kamer informeren over de stand van zaken rond nucleaire ontwapening en de modernisering van kernwapens in Nederland
Asks the government to inform the House about nuclear disarmament and the modernisation of nuclear weapons in the Netherlands.
requests the government to inform the House about the state of affairs regarding nuclear disarmament and the modernisation of nuclear weapons in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering de Kamer te informeren over de stand van zaken rond nucleaire ontwapening en over de modernisering van kernwapens in Nederland

Asks the government to impose a six-month moratorium on departures of Iranian asylum seekers.
requests the government to impose a six-month departure moratorium for Iranian asylum seekers

Asks the State Secretary to explore examples inside and outside the EU of gaining grip on migration and to elaborate a policy target figure and other measures.
asks the State Secretary to further explore other examples inside and outside the Union where more grip on migration has been achieved
verzoekt de Staatssecretaris zich nader te oriënteren op andere voorbeelden binnen en buiten de Unie waar meer grip op migratie is gekomen

Asks the government to draw up a plan to help asylum status holders find work by removing unnecessary obstacles.
requests the government to make a plan of action to find work for status holders
verzoekt de regering een plan van aanpak te maken om statushouders van werk te voorzien
Amendement van het lid Boswijk c.s. over ondersteuning van inloophuizen voor veteranen
Amends the Defence departmental budget to provide €150,000 in co-financing for veterans' drop-in houses, offset within the non-legally committed budget of article 9.

Met dit amendement wordt € 150.000 extra beschikbaar gesteld voor medefinanciering van veteranenontmoetingscentra
Amendement van het lid Boswijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 20 over ondersteuning van inloophuizen voor veteranen
Amendment shifting 150,000 euro within the defence budget to co-finance veterans' drop-in centres for 2023.
With this amendment 150,000 euro is made available for 2023 to provide support from Defence alongside other forms of funding.
Met dit amendement wordt voor 2023 € 150.000 beschikbaar gesteld om, naast andere vormen van financiering, ondersteuning te bieden vanuit Defensie.

requests the cabinet to specifically map the money flows from developing countries with which the Netherlands has a development relationship and whose elites channel money to tax havens

Motie van het lid Kuik c.s. over graan uit de graandeal naar landen laten verschepen die het zwaarst getroffen zijn

requests the Minister to commit more strongly, bilaterally and via multilateral organisations, to ship grain from the grain deal to the countries most severely affected,

Shifts 7 million euro within the development budget toward global health (Global Fund) funding.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de rol van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken rondom het WK mannenvoetbal in Qatar

MPs asked whether the Foreign Ministry blocked open criticism of host country Qatar for the 2022 World Cup, kept risks for LGBTIQ+ visitors out of Parliamentary letters, and what has been done for migrant workers. The government denies prioritising trade, says the process was a delicate balancing of interests, and outlines its constructive-critical dialogue, ILO-linked reforms, and planned follow-up.
The official tension could well have been mentioned.
Het ambtelijk spanningsveld had wel genoemd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dijk over de doorlevering van F-35-onderdelen naar Israël

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Israel used F-35s with 2,000-lb bombs in Gaza, whether F-35 parts flow via the European Regional Warehouse in Woensdrecht without case-by-case export review under general licence NL009, and why that licence was not suspended for Israel. The government said it lacks verified information on bomb types and Israeli F-35 use, maintains its decision not to intervene in the licence after an integrated foreign-policy and security assessment, and that the investigation into intervening in NL009 is not yet complete.
The government does not have verified information about the specific bombs Israel uses in its F-35 operations.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde informatie over de specifieke bommen die Israël gebruikt bij zijn F-35-inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over omstreden activiteiten van FMO in Nicaragua

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister about FMO's controversial investments in Nicaragua, including whether they rose to a record amount, how they compare with other donors, how the government supervises them, and whether FMO should show restraint given Nicaragua's human rights record and its severance of diplomatic relations. The minister denied the claimed increase (portfolio fell from EUR 171m to 161m), said oversight runs through agreed frameworks and dialogue with FMO without a formal tightening, and defended continued investment while noting room for improvement.
The cabinet remains in dialogue with FMO on these improvements, offers support where possible and calls FMO to account when it believes FMO is making insufficient progress.
Het kabinet blijft in gesprek met FMO over deze verbeteringen, biedt waar mogelijk ondersteuning en spreekt FMO aan wanneer het van mening is dat FMO onvoldoende voortgang boekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gang van zaken rond de Red Card Holder ten tijde van het bombardement op Hawija

MP Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about the Red Card Holder's role in the 2015 Hawija bombing, including whether the commander in Jordan held a dual role and whether the court-submitted documents would be sent to parliament. The minister explained the RCH's function and the 2020 tightening of its working method, but declined to comment on the dual-role documents because the case is before the court.
Since this case is currently before the court, I cannot make any statements on this at this time.
Aangezien deze zaak momenteel onder de rechter is kan ik hier op dit moment geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over kernwapens en de toetsingsconferentie TPNW

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the Netherlands should attend the second TPNW meeting of states parties as an observer, given Russia's withdrawal of ratification of the CTBT and Russian nuclear retaliation exercises, and which Western countries will attend. The Minister answered that the Netherlands can fulfil its bridging role without observer status, reiterated why it will not sign or support the TPNW, and listed Germany, Norway and Belgium as observers alongside Austria.
The Netherlands does not need to be an observer at the second meeting of the TPNW in order to continue fulfilling this bridging role.
Nederland hoeft geen waarnemer bij de tweede bijeenkomst van het TPNW te zijn, om deze brugfunctie te kunnen blijven vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Jasper van Dijk overintegriteitsproblemen bij de Defensie Bewaking en Beveiligingsorganisatie (DBBO)

An MP asked whether the Defence minister accepts that the investigation into an integrity complaint at DBBO-Zuid took too long and whether independent handling of such complaints is needed. The state secretary acknowledged the delay of over a year, said measures were taken to shorten it, but rejected an independent complaints body, arguing Defence must handle complaints itself.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over straffeloosheid van Israël

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's conduct in Gaza after 7 October 2023 amounts to war crimes, whether its self-defence is proportionate, and whether the Netherlands will support ICC investigations and humanitarian access, among other questions. The minister answered that the Netherlands calls for proportionality and humanitarian law compliance, that independent investigation is needed before judging specific acts, and that the Netherlands supports the ICC's investigation with additional funding.
Thorough and independent investigation will be necessary to bring the relevant facts to light.
Gedegen en onafhankelijk onderzoek zal nodig zijn om de relevante feiten boven water te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de levering van JSF-onderdelen aan Israël

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government would stop F-35 parts flowing through the European Regional Warehouse to Israel despite warnings of humanitarian law violations. The ministers answered that the government decided not to intervene in the general licence NL009, citing an integrated security assessment, that the F-35 deters regional threats, and alliance reliability, while no export licence test applies to these US-owned parts.
It was decided not to intervene in the operation of the General Licence NL009 regulation.
Er is besloten niet in te grijpen in de werking van de Regeling Algemene vergunning NL009.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over levering van munitie met verarmd uranium door de VS aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the US supply of depleted-uranium ammunition to Ukraine is acceptable given IAEA and UN concerns, and whether the Netherlands will oppose its use and raise it at the UN. The minister replied that the IAEA found no radiological danger to populations, that the Netherlands follows a precautionary approach by not using or supplying such ammunition, and that it discusses substitution of hazardous substances with partners without taking a new stance on the US supply.
Because of the scientific uncertainties about the effects of using weapons and ammunition with depleted uranium, the Netherlands indeed supports a precautionary approach.
Vanwege de wetenschappelijke onzekerheden over de gevolgen van het gebruik wapens en munitie met verarmd uranium, steunt Nederland inderdaad een voorzorgsbenadering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijke plaatsing van Amerikaanse kernwapens in Groot-Brittannië

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether US tactical nuclear weapons may be deployed in the UK, on what legal basis, whether this breaches the NPT and whether the government will urge the UK to refrain, and how it will prevent escalation. The government declined to comment on the bilateral UK-US matter, said the NPT articles do not govern relations between nuclear-weapon states, rejected the escalation framing, and reaffirmed Dutch commitment to disarmament.
The cabinet cannot comment on this; it is a bilateral matter between the United States and the United Kingdom.
Het kabinet kan hier geen commentaar op geven, het betreft een bilaterale kwestie tussen de Verenigde Staten en het Verenigd Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wijzigingen in het wapenexportbeleid

An SP MP asked the minister about a NRC op-ed on weak legal accountability of European arms makers, illegal arms flows, end-user certificates, the planned accession to the Franco-German-Spanish defence export control treaty, and scrapping the presumption of denial. The minister answered that the government shares concerns about illegal arms trade, points to existing export criteria, transparency tools and civil court access, but intends to join the treaty and proceed with the accession process.
The cabinet intends to accede to the treaty on export control in the defence domain.
Het kabinet is voornemens toe te treden tot het verdrag inzake exportcontrole in het defensiedomein
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het rapport van Human Rights Watch over mensenrechtenschendingen door de Saoedische grenswacht

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Human Rights Watch reports of Saudi border guards killing Ethiopian migrants, and whether it would launch international investigation or impose economic sanctions. The minister said the government raised the findings bilaterally with Saudi Arabia, supports the Saudi-announced investigation, and will keep pressing for it without committing to sanctions or a leading role in international inquiry.
The Netherlands raised this in bilateral contacts with Saudi Arabia following this report.
Nederland heeft dit naar aanleiding van dit rapport in bilaterale contacten met Saoedi-Arabië geuit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gebrekkige betrokkenheid bij de sanctiehandhaving

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the ministry failed to participate in sanctions enforcement talks after the invasion of Ukraine and whether oligarch assets were missed, and questioned the implementation of the Blok report recommendations. The minister denied the ministry was absent, said sanctions meetings were attended with delegations chosen per topic, reported that most of the 19 recommendations were realised with the rest pending legislative modernisation, and stated that coordination does not transfer responsibility from lead ministries.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over dubieuze investeringen in wapenbedrijven

An SP MP asked the minister whether pension funds and insurers investing in arms companies that supply high-risk countries conflicts with due diligence norms, and whether the minister would urge them to withdraw. The minister acknowledged the report, stated that the Netherlands applies strict export control, that financial institutions should apply OECD and UNGP due diligence, but declined to re-engage the funds or insurers, saying investment decisions are their own responsibility.
I therefore see no reason to now re-engage with these financial institutions about their investments in arms companies.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om nu opnieuw met deze financiële instellingen in gesprek te gaan over hun beleggingen in wapenbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de levering van F16’s aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether the decision to supply F-16s to Ukraine was taken on 20 August 2023 without first submitting it to parliament, given the caretaker cabinet, and how many aircraft and under what conditions. The government answered that it has only expressed the intention to supply F-16s, that delivery depends on training, infrastructure, US approval and EU export criteria, that numbers are not yet fixed, and that parliament will be informed later about the timeline.
Your House will be informed in due course about the envisaged timeline for delivery.
Uw Kamer wordt op termijn nader geïnformeerd over het beoogde tijdpad van levering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over clustermunitie

An SP MP asks the foreign minister whether the Netherlands attends the 2023 Cluster Munitions Convention meeting, whether it will condemn cluster munition use by all parties including Russia and Ukraine, and whether it will condemn supplies of cluster munitions to Ukraine by Turkey and the US. The minister says the Netherlands discourages all cluster munition use, places Ukraine's use in the context of Russian aggression, and states that non-parties are not bound by the convention's ban.
The Netherlands discouraged any use of cluster munitions in its opening statement.
Nederland heeft in de openingsverklaring ieder gebruik van clustermunitie ontmoedigd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk, Boswijk, Ceder, Belhaj, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Sylvana Simons, Dassen en Christine Teunissen over de evacuatie van lokale oud-medewerkers van de Nederlands

MPs from many parties asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the evacuation and resettlement of local former Afghan Security Guards and other local staff, including whether guards were excluded and why EUPOL staff were refused. The government answered that individual requests are assessed under the 2014 interpreter arrangement and special scheme, that criteria were not tightened, and that the resettlement project was folded into the ministries' standing organisations while the remaining group of about 100 people is still being pursued.
Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Baarle, Eerdmans en Omtzigt over de voordracht van Wopke Hoekstra als Eurocommissaris

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister how Wopke Hoekstra was nominated as Dutch European Commissioner, including the procedure, any candidate profile, whether parliament was informed, and whether his departure leaves the Foreign Ministry without political direction. The government replied that the nomination followed the standard Article 246 TFEU procedure after consultation within cabinet and with the Commission President, that no candidate profile was drawn up, that parliament was not informed beyond the standard procedure, and that ministerial responsibility for the Foreign Ministry is secured.
No. The procedure was followed in line with standing policy on earlier appointments, see the answers to questions 1 and 2.
Nee. De procedure is conform staand beleid van eerdere benoemingen gevolgd, zie de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Russische bedrijven die de oorlog financieren en tevens actief zijn in Europa

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister why Russian companies allegedly financing the war in Ukraine, including Novatek, Rusal and Pik Group, are not under EU sanctions, whether Dutch subsidiaries should be confiscated, and why such firms can still do business in Europe. The minister answered that these companies are not currently on EU sanctions lists, declined to comment on specific cases, said all options remain open, and explained that confiscation is only possible through a criminal conviction decided by a judge.
The cabinet cannot go into casuistry regarding specific companies.
Het kabinet kan verder niet ingaan op casuïstiek aangaande specifieke bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanpak van Russische oligarchen in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers why Russian oligarchs' Dutch assets, including VS Energy's operations, remain active and unconfiscated despite sanctions, and what the government is doing about confiscation and Ukrainian legal assistance requests. The minister replied that individual cases cannot be discussed, that confiscation is possible only through criminal-law titles, that legal assistance requests are assessed under treaties, and that Parliament will be updated after the summer.
The cabinet cannot go into individual case matters.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Sjoerdsma over sanctie-ontwijking door Iran

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Sjoerdsma asked about alleged Iranian sanctions evasion via Dutch trade shown in a Zembla broadcast, including whether the government investigated, whether a reported case was acted on, and whether enforcement is adequate.
