The ministers say they cannot comment on individual cases, that enforcement and investigation occur where indications exist, that sanctions on the IRGC are in place, and that existing enforcement structures are being strengthened with EU proposals shared with parliament.
The cabinet cannot make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de crisis in de asielopvang

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reception crisis for asylum seekers, including municipalities unwilling to extend reception places, the risk of a new shortage, ad hoc policy, and the Spreidingswet financial incentives. The State Secretary answered that a 19,000-place package is underway, a Wet gemeentelijke taak is being prepared and submitted, and additional measures are being monitored, though no full structural solution or timeline was given.
I agree that a lot of work still needs to be done to ensure that everyone with a legal entitlement is and remains assured of a reception place.
Ik onderschrijf dat nog veel werk verzet moet worden om ervoor te zorgen dat iedereen met een daartoe strekkend recht verzekerd is en blijft van een opvangplek.
Antwoord op vragen va de leden Jasper van Dijk en Teunissen over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie parlementen buitenspel wil zetten inzake het Mercosur verdrag

MPs Van Dijk and Teunissen asked whether the European Commission plans to split the EU-Mercosur agreement to bypass national parliaments and whether the government will insist national parliaments have the final say on full trade agreements. The minister rejects the premise: under the Lisbon Treaty the Council must approve signature and conclusion, usually with European Parliament consent, and the Commission has not yet decided the form of the agreement, with no decision expected before 2024; the government will take a position only once the full documents are submitted and will push in the EU for an integral association agreement.

As with any treaty, the cabinet will only determine a position on a possible agreement between the European Union and the Mercosur countries once all necessary documents are submitted by the Commission to the Council for decision-making.

Zoals bij ieder verdrag, zal het kabinet pas een positie bepalen ten aanzien van een mogelijk akkoord tussen de Europese Unie en de Mercosurlanden op het moment dat alle daartoe noodzakelijke stukken door de Commissie ter besluitvorming aan de Raad worden aangeboden.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Van der Graaf, Van der Lee, Klink, Jasper van Dijk en Thijssen over de situatie in Turkije en Syrië na de aardbevingen van 5/6 februari jl.

Members of parliament asked about access for international aid to Syria after the February 2023 earthquakes, the role of civil society in opposition areas, EU reconstruction funding, psychosocial and care needs, and aid worker safety. The minister answered that aid access to northwest Syria remains dependent on Turkey-based UN deliveries, that the EU is coordinating mid- to long-term support through existing channels, and that psychosocial support is integrated into programmes.

As promised during the committee debate on humanitarian aid after the earthquake in Turkey and Syria of 22 February, I asked the European Commission on behalf of the cabinet, ahead of the EU donor conference, to prepare a proposal for medium- and long-term aid and to coordinate its implementation.

Zoals toegezegd tijdens het commissiedebat Humanitaire Hulp na de aardbeving in Turkije en Syrië van 22 februari jl. heb ik voorafgaand aan de EU-donorconferentie namens het kabinet de Europese Commissie verzocht een voorstel te maken voor het leveren van middellange- en lange-termijnhulp en de implementatie hiervan te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Jasper van Dijk over betrokkenheid van de MIVD bij onderzoek naar vernieling van Nordstream 1 en Nordstream 2-pijpleidingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Defence whether the MIVD is involved in the investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline sabotage, who leads it, what information was found, whether a yacht and explosives were identified, and when foreign reports will be published. The minister declined to comment on the MIVD's knowledge, methods or sources, noted that the JSCU is a joint AIVD-MIVD unit rather than a separate service, and said the cabinet is awaiting the outcomes of the German, Danish and Swedish investigations.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on the knowledge level, working methods or sources of the General Intelligence and Security Service and the Military Intelligence and Security Service.

Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst en de Militaire Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de erkenning voor een zieke militair na het gebruik van PX-10

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Defence whether a sick soldier's recognition after PX-10 use shows a causal link and whether all PX-10-exposed personnel should be medically examined or supported by a damage fund. The State Secretary maintains there is no causal link under the 2011 RIVM findings, admits the pension was wrongly assessed under the pre-2011 framework without reversing it, and declines a medical re-examination or special fund.
I must note that the EenVandaag report you refer to repeats incorrect claims about the study.
Ik moet constateren dat er in het bericht van EenVandaag waar u naar verwijst onjuiste stellingen worden herhaald over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapens uit Estland die via een Nederlands bedrijf aan Oekraïne zouden zijn geleverd

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Defence whether a Dutch firm, ARLE, supplied anti-tank missiles from Estonia to Ukraine via a Czech company, whether the deal was registered with Dutch authorities, what profits were made, whether customs were aware or investigating, and how such arms trading will be prevented. The government declined to comment on individual cases, said high profit margins are plausible given demand, saw no reason to change export control policy, and noted that licences are required and breaches are punishable.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht dat geld voor ontwikkelingshulp in belastingparadijzen belandt

MPs Alkaya and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch development aid routed through PIDG, its Mauritius-based trust and the Guernsey-managed EAIF fund, could end up in tax havens, and how that fits Dutch anti-avoidance policy. Minister Schreinemacher answered that PIDG's trust is fiscally resident in the UK, that the fund manager was selected in 2016 under older tax rules, that PIDG now applies EDFI responsible tax principles, and that the ministry will explore a tax guideline and discuss a structure analysis with donors.
I am examining the possibilities for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Finance to draw up a guideline for this.
Ik ben aan het bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om vanuit het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Financiën een richtlijn hiervoor op te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een dubieuze promotiecampagne van de EU

MP Jasper van Dijk asks the Foreign Minister whether he finds the EU's 'You are EU' promotional campaign pathetic and ineffective, whether expanding EU powers should be a political debate rather than a campaign topic, and what the campaign costs. The minister replies that the Netherlands is not involved, the Commission controls its own communication and the Netherlands sees no reason to comment on it, that any expansion of EU powers requires treaty change under Article 48 TEU, and that the total campaign cost is EUR 34.5 million across 27 member states.
As a member state, the Netherlands is not involved in this campaign. The European Commission is responsible for its own communication.
Als lidstaat is Nederland niet betrokken bij deze campagne. De Europese Commissie gaat over haar eigen communicatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over buitensporig geweld op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the reported killings and alleged disproportionate force by Israeli forces in the West Bank (Jenin), requesting a position, measures under the 2020 Karabulut motion, and whether to suspend the EU association agreement with Israel. The minister answered that the government is concerned, urges de-escalation and proportionality, lacks independent information beyond UN confirmation, and rejects suspending the association agreement or boycotting Israel.
The Netherlands, however, does not have independent information on this.
Nederland beschikt echter niet over eigenstandige informatie hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mobilisatie in Rusland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about reports of a new Russian mobilisation and whether Russians fearing mobilisation should receive asylum protection or a suspension of decisions. The State Secretary answered that mobilisation was declared finished in October 2022 but incidental recruitment continues, that individual asylum assessments will proceed without a new moratorium, and that a new country report is due in spring.
This concerns a confidential source. It will not be made public.
Het betreft hier een vertrouwelijke bron. Deze wordt niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over import van uranium uit Rusland

An MP asked the government whether EU states import about 200 million euro of Russian uranium, whether Dutch nuclear operators still have Russian contacts, whether Dutch sanctions should cover uranium and Rosatom-linked firms, and what it would cost to stop such imports. The government answered that the Dutch import value is not dependent on Russian uranium, that no uranium was exported from Russia to the Netherlands since the invasion, that no EU-wide ban on uranium imports has sufficient support, and that it cannot comment on individual cases or negotiating positions.
The cabinet cannot address the negotiating position of individual member states.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op de onderhandelingspositie van individuele lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “Sponsoring van het EU-voorzitterschap door bedrijven”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether corporate sponsorship of the Swedish EU presidency, which opens the door to business funding, is acceptable and whether the Netherlands will ban such sponsorship during its own presidency. The minister answered that each presidency decides sponsorship autonomously, that the Council issued non-binding guidelines in 2021, that sponsorship is not in principle undesirable, and that the Dutch government values the guidelines and principles of impartiality and transparency.
Do you agree that safeguarding the integrity of European decision-making must take precedence over 'cutting the costs' of the EU presidency?
Deelt u de mening dat het waarborgen van de integriteit van Europese besluitvorming boven het «drukken van de kosten» van het EU-voorzitterschap moet worden gesteld?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de sterk toegenomen militaire uitgaven in de Europese Unie sinds de oorlog in Oekraïne en de hoge winsten voor de wapenindustrie

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the surge in EU military spending since the war in Ukraine, and the profits of the arms industry, are justified, including questions on the EU taxonomy, arms export policy and investment in nuclear weapons makers. The government defended higher defence spending as necessary for security and Ukraine support, rejected that the arms industry is the main beneficiary, said export policy is not being loosened, and said investment decisions are for companies and asset managers, though they are expected to follow OECD guidelines.
The cabinet is exploring options for better cooperation on this point and for aligning with the growing consensus on mutual recognition of licences.
Het kabinet onderzoekt mogelijkheden om op dit punt tot betere samenwerking te komen en om aan te sluiten bij de groeiende consensus over wederzijdse erkenning van vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over een klokkenluiderszaak bij de Centrale Organisatie Integriteit Defensie

MPs Omtzigt and Jasper van Dijk asked about the status, composition and method of the investigation into alleged misconduct at the defence integrity office COID, the earlier inventory study, and the treatment of two whistleblowers. The State Secretary answered that the probe restarted in February 2023 with a revised scope, names its members, declines to disclose the mandate or details about the whistleblowers for privacy reasons, and promises to report the results once completed.
Once the Commission has completed the investigation, I will inform your House of the results of this investigation.
Nadat de Commissie het onderzoek heeft voltooid, zal ik uw Kamer berichten over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Ceder over de inzet van explosieve wapens in Jemen

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister about civilian harm from explosive weapons in Yemen, the ten incidents in a Mwatana/PAX report, whether Yemen, Saudi Arabia and the UAE should sign the explosive weapons political declaration, how to revive UN accountability investigations, and whether arms-supplying states should be pressed to stop deliveries. The minister said Nederland supports better IHL implementation and promotes the declaration, supports accountability through Dutch funding and the High Commissioner for Human Rights, and has raised concerns over arms transfers, but gave no concrete new commitment to restart UN investigations or halt arms supplies.
Nederland has called in various international fora for signing this declaration, and Yemen, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates were also present there.
Nederland heeft in verschillende internationale fora opgeroepen tot het ondertekenen van deze verklaring, daar waren Jemen, Saudi-Arabië en de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten ook bij aanwezig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat bijna alle slachtoffers van het Essex-drama in Nederland zijn geweest

SP MPs asked whether the Essex lorry deaths victims had mostly been in the Netherlands, after a Myria report implied 38 of 39 victims were previously known there, and asked about Dutch handling of Vietnamese human trafficking and smuggling. The State Secretary answered that the passage was a misreading: fingerprint comparison found only two prior Dutch presences, the report was amended, the observation was not subject to the transit-prohibition given no concrete knowledge of smuggling, and no new investigation is planned.
This research showed that two of the 39 victims had been in the Netherlands before the tragedy.
Uit dit onderzoek is gebleken dat twee van de 39 slachtoffers voorafgaand aan het drama in Nederland zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de sluiting van een noodopvanglocatie in Horst aan de Maas

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the closure of an emergency asylum reception site in Horst aan de Maas, protests against it, the need for stable longer-term shelter and children's schooling, and whether he would intervene with the mayor. The state secretary confirmed awareness of protests, said closure is a municipal decision in consultation with the safety region, noted the COA is talking with the municipality about a transition, and announced a bill to encourage longer-term shelter, without committing to halt the closure.
Closing and opening crisis emergency shelter is a decision that falls to the local government, in consultation with the safety region.
Het sluiten en openen van crisisnoodopvang is een besluit dat de lokale overheid toekomt, in samenspraak met de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de documentaire 'Het laatste woord' en de straf die Jurriën in erbarmelijke omstandigheden uitzit in Tunesië

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked about the documentary 'Het laatste woord' and the harsh detention of a Dutch national, Jurriën, sentenced to 20 years in Tunisia. The minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the ministry provides consular assistance, has visited him 54 times, supported clemency requests, and cannot assess the legal proceedings abroad.
It is for the detainee and his lawyer to raise the aspects regarding the legal proceedings and legal remedies, and for the judge to then decide on them.
Het is aan de gedetineerde en zijn advocaat de aspecten ten aanzien van de rechtsgang en rechtsmiddelen aan de orde te stellen en aan de rechter hierover vervolgens te beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opstelling van Nederland tegenover Israël

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands abstained on a UN General Assembly resolution requesting an ICJ advisory opinion on Israel's occupation, whether the court's views are authoritative, and whether the Dutch chess federation's choice of an East Jerusalem hotel for a tournament was appropriate and had been discussed with the federation. The minister confirmed the abstention citing late drafting and wording concerns, affirmed the advisory opinion's authority, confirmed contact with the chess federation, and declined to condemn the venue, referring back to the earlier answer.
That is correct. The Netherlands abstained from voting on the resolution.
Dat klopt. Nederland heeft zich onthouden van stemming over de resolutie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese inmenging in Nederland

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen and Leijten asked about reports of Chinese 'police service stations' in the Netherlands, whether those staff can stay and be prosecuted, whether the AIVD knew, where the limits of foreign interference lie, what infrastructure Chinese state actors hold and how to prevent its use as leverage, and whether cruciale sectors should be under Dutch control. The government said the stations have been closed after diplomatic protests, that no evidence yet shows staff were sent from China, that investigation continues and prosecution is not ruled out, declined to comment on AIVD knowledge, pointed to its three-track anti-interference approach and a planned espionage bill, and described the Vifo screening law and a reinforced vital-infrastructure approach while citing partial Chinese ownership of Rotterdam container terminals.
Regarding the knowledge level, working methods or sources of the intelligence services, the AIVD, as you know, makes no public statements.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten doet de AIVD, zoals bij u bekend, in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het standpunt van het kabinet inzake mensenrechten en internationale sporttoernooien

MPs Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the government how it will respond to calls from KNVB and FNV to improve migrant worker rights in Qatar ahead of the World Cup, and how it intends to influence sports federations and FIFA on human rights and compensation. The ministers answered that constructive-critical diplomacy and dialogue with Qatar are the chosen approach, noting reforms but ongoing concerns, and largely pointed to sports federations, companies and the KNVB for further action while expressing openness to compensation and diplomatic support.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to operate in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de VN-richtlijnen voor bedrijfsleven en mensenrechten.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over spionage met gebruik van Pegasus- of vergelijkbare software

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government distinguishes security risks for ministers and senior officials, whether it will raise security measures against spyware such as Pegasus, and how it oversees use of intrusion software. The ministers answered that departments are responsible for their own digital security under the BIO framework, that intrusion software use is subject to legal safeguards and judicial, prosecutorial and intelligence oversight, and that they will not publish which software is used.
To protect means and methods, it is not possible to give public insight into which software the police use when carrying out this power.
Het is voor de afscherming van middelen en methodieken niet mogelijk om openbaar inzicht te geven in welke software de politie gebruikt bij de uitvoering van deze bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over investeringen in illegale nederzettingen

An SP MP asks the foreign minister about a report alleging Dutch banks, pension funds and asset managers invested EUR 12.5 billion in firms tied to Israeli settlements, and whether the government will press pension funds to withdraw. The minister says the government discourages economic activity that directly facilitates settlements, expects due diligence under IMVO, and has already held talks with pension funds, leaving divestment decisions to the funds themselves.
The cabinet does not itself keep track of such specific investments and leaves these figures to the authors of the report.
Het kabinet houdt dergelijke specifieke investeringen zelf niet bij en laat deze cijfers voor rekening van de opstellers van het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Wijngaarden over het nieuws dat alle ambtenaren in Brussel een grote loonsverhoging krijgen.

Two MPs asked the government about reports that EU civil servants in Brussels receive a 7 percent pay rise and whether this is defensible, including its budget impact. The minister explained the automatic salary method, said the Netherlands has objected and asked the Commission to study its sustainability, but gave no commitment to lower top salaries.
The cabinet believes it should be examined to what extent this method is sustainable in times of high inflation, as is currently the case.
Het kabinet vindt dat gekeken moet worden in hoeverre deze methode duurzaam is in het geval van hoge inflatieperioden, zoals nu het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Jasper van Dijk over een Europees programma ter ondersteuning van de evacuatie van bepaalde bijzonder kwetsbare personen uit Afghanistan

MPs Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Netherlands implemented the EU Council decision on evacuating vulnerable Afghans, how many were transferred, why others were not, and whether pending court-case applicants were checked for eligibility. Minister Hoekstra answered that 24 of a maximum 25 agreed journalists, human-rights defenders and judges and their core family were transferred, one more may follow, the national family definition was unchanged, and the government did not examine the EDEO list because it was compiled by the EDEO and not shared with it for privacy reasons.
The cabinet has not examined whether persons in the group belong to the category that would be eligible for the EDEO list.
Het kabinet heeft niet onderzocht of er personen tot de groep behoren die in aanmerking zouden komen voor de EDEO lijst.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van der Plas en Jasper van Dijk over het plan van de Europese Commissie om het Mercosur-verdrag geïmplementeerd te krijgen door nationale parlementen te omzeilen

MPs Teunissen, Van der Plas and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Commission is splitting the EU-Mercosur agreement to avoid national parliamentary ratification and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that talks with Mercosur continue without new developments, that the form of any agreement is not yet decided, and that national democratic procedures will apply once a proposal reaches the Council.

As the cabinet has repeatedly indicated, it will only take a position on the agreement with the Mercosur countries once the Commission has submitted the necessary decision-making documents to the Council.

Zoals herhaaldelijk door het kabinet aangegeven zal het kabinet pas een standpunt innemen over het akkoord met de Mercosur-landen wanneer de Commissie de benodigde documenten voor besluitvorming aan de Raad heeft aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er weer asielzoekers op het terrein voor Ter Apel hebben overnacht

An SP MP asks why asylum seekers again slept outside the Ter Apel reception centre, why shelter was not provided, and when emergency reception locations can close, and asks about Westerwolde municipality's agreements and inadequate medical care. The Staatssecretaris answers that about 30 people spent one night outside because no shelter was available at that late hour, that the government is working on alternatives and new municipal reception powers, and that it is willing to talk with Westerwolde, but does not foresee ending emergency reception soon.
I am willing to talk with the municipality of Westerwolde about the future of asylum reception.
Ik ben bereid om met de gemeente Westerwolde te spreken over de toekomst van de asielopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het voortbestaan van een onrechtmatige toestand van huwelijkse gevangenschap en de mogelijke verjaring

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the ongoing unlawful state of forced marriage (huwelijkse gevangenschap) can become time-barred, how many women sought legal aid or consular help, and what the government will do about funding, training and international cooperation. The minister answers that a pending bill makes the duty to cooperate in dissolving such a marriage legally enforceable and not subject to limitation, that the register cannot show how many cases were funded, that the fee point increase was raised to 19 points in 2022 but no further increase is planned, and that consular help is limited and the topic will be raised in EU and bilateral channels.
It can never, and therefore also not after a lapse of time, be required of anyone to remain bound in a religious or belief-based union that they do not wish to maintain.
Het kan nooit, en dus ook niet na verloop van tijd, van iemand worden gevergd dat hij blijft vastzitten in een religieuze of levensbeschouwelijke verbintenis die hij niet wenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mobilisatie in Rusland

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about Russian mobilisation, refugees fleeing it, Baltic border closures, and whether the departure and decision moratorium should be extended. Minister Hoekstra answered that IND assesses each asylum claim individually, the Netherlands backs a coordinated EU approach, and extending the moratorium is not ruled out while the situation is examined.
In the meantime, we are not taking irreversible steps in asylum and return procedures where a genuine appeal is made on grounds related to the mobilisation.
In de tussentijd nemen we geen onomkeerbare stappen in asiel- en terugkeerprocedures waarin een reëel beroep wordt gedaan op gronden gerelateerd aan de mobilisatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Kuzu, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Brekelmans, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons en Piri over het bericht dat waarnemers van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerkin

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about two Ukrainian OSCE staff members sentenced to over ten years by courts in the unrecognised Luhansk region, asking about their detention conditions, pressure on Russia, evacuation of local staff, and whether Turkey could help secure their release. The minister confirmed the sentences, said detention location is unknown, listed joint EU and OSCE calls for release, and said the OSCE Secretary General is working on their release.
At this time it is not known where the detainees are being held.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend waar de gevangenen worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj en Jasper van Dijk over de voortgang overbrenging uit Afghanistan

Three MPs asked whether the 1 November deadline for evacuations from Afghanistan applies only to people with passports who refused the offer, and whether people unable to travel through no fault of their own remain eligible. The minister confirmed both points: the deadline covers only passport holders who refused earlier, four of 28 such people did not respond, and those unable to travel for reasons beyond their control keep their eligibility with no deadline set.
For this group, no deadline has been set for the time being.
Voor deze groep is vooralsnog geen deadline gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over groeiende uitgaven van bedrijven voor de lobby in Brussel

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Corporate Europe Observatory report showing that the 50 largest corporate lobbying budgets in the EU rose from about 90 to 120 million euros since 2015, and about the imbalance with NGO lobbying and transparency of corporate lobbying. The minister replied that companies may decide freely how to lobby, that the EU transparency register and codes of conduct are the relevant rules, and that the Dutch Permanent Representation's contacts with stakeholders are a legitimate part of its work, without committing to new measures.
The cabinet is of the view that individual companies are free to decide whether and how they give substance to lobbying activities as part of business operations.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het individuele bedrijven vrij staat om te bepalen of en hoe zij invulling geven aan lobbyactiviteiten als onderdeel van de bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘onvolledig onderzoek naar het mortierongeval in Mali in 2016’

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister whether the Van der Veer inquiry into the 2016 Mali mortar accident was narrowed and whether the Belhaj motions were implemented, and whether new inquiry into individual negligence will be ordered. The Minister acknowledges the 2017 debate over the inquiry's wording and the Van der Veer inquiry's organisational focus, says the criminal case is still pending before the court, and commits to set up an independent commission to examine whether individual negligence can be established.
Therefore I am setting up an independent commission to investigate whether and how individual negligent and/or culpable conduct can be established and to follow up on this.
Daarom stel ik een onafhankelijke commissie in om te onderzoeken of en hoe eventueel individueel nalatig en/of verwijtbaar handelen kan worden vastgesteld en hier tevens opvolging aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opvangcrisis

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reception crisis at Ter Apel, the causes, the sudden designation of a reception centre in Albergen, and fair distribution of asylum seekers. The State Secretary acknowledges a severe shortage of reception places, describes the Albergen agreement with Tubbergen and the COA, and promises a bill on municipal reception duties, while not fully answering questions on causes and the process.
To respond to changing inflow, the national government, provinces, COA and VNG have made agreements in the Implementation Agenda for Flexibilising the Asylum Chain.
Om in te kunnen spelen op veranderende instroom hebben het rijk, de provincies, het COA en de VNG afspraken gemaakt in de Uitvoeringsagenda Flexibilisering Asielketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het PAX rapport betreffende foute investeringen van de ING en andere grote banken in de wapenindustrie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about a PAX report finding that major European banks, including ING, financed arms producers supplying states with high risk of using weapons against civilians, such as Saudi Arabia. The government answered that banks must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and UNGP, that exporters with valid licences operate within legal frameworks, and that it sees no reason to meet ING, while pointing to forthcoming due diligence legislation.

The government expects Dutch banks such as ING, in line with the OECD Guidelines and the UN Guiding Principles, to map risks to people and the environment in their value chain for their investments in the defence industry.

Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse banken zoals ING dat zij, conform de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's), voor hun investeringen in de defensie-industrie de risico's voor mens en milieu in hun waardeketen in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hammelburg over Nederlandse kennis over Australische oorlogsmisdaden in Uruzgan, Afghanistan

MPs Van Dijk and Hammelburg asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch personnel knew of possible Australian war crimes in Uruzgan as early as 2010, whether a special report exists, and what the status of earlier inventories and investigations is. The minister confirms awareness of the press report, says the alleged report cannot yet be confirmed, restates that the earlier inventory found no Dutch involvement, and states that a new Australian-linked investigation has been started.
Defence is still searching for a report that the reporter says was drawn up. The search has not yet been completed.
Defensie zoekt nog naar een rapport dat volgens de melder zou zijn opgemaakt. De zoekslag is nog niet voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de moord op een Palestijnse journaliste

The MP Jasper van Dijk asks the Foreign Minister how he views the Israeli army's conclusion that the killer of journalist Shireen Abu Akleh cannot be identified, whether independent investigation is still needed, and what more diplomacy could achieve. The minister responds that the Netherlands continues to press Israel for accountability and prosecution, notes Israel's forensic investigation under US oversight, and defends diplomatic dialogue as an effective instrument.
Together with like-minded partners, the Netherlands continues to press Israel for accountability and for the prosecution of those responsible for the death of Shireen Abu Akleh.
Samen met gelijkgezinde partners blijft Nederland bij Israël aandringen op verantwoording en op berechting van degenen die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de dood van Shireen Abu Akleh.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de komst van het energiebedrijf Gunvor naar Nederland met mogelijke betrokkenheid van Vladimir Poetin

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked whether President Putin has a stake in Gunvor, which plans a green hydrogen terminal in Rotterdam, and whether its establishment is acceptable given sanctions. The minister answered that no indications of Putin ownership were found, that Gunvor's ownership is held by Torbjorn Törnqvist, that existing screening and investment checks cover sanctions compliance, and that no measures against the plan are currently justified.
Based on the currently available information, there are no indications that this is the case.
Op basis van de thans beschikbare informatie zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat hiervan sprake is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat advocatenkantoor Houthoff nog steeds zaken doet met Russische klanten

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether law firm Houthoff still serves Russian clients despite sanctions, whether the Amsterdam dean (a partner at Nauta-Dutilh) can independently oversee it, what the investigation into Houthoff found, and when legal aid to Russian clients is exempt from sanctions. The minister answered that legal aid is permitted for non-sanctioned Russian clients, that aid necessary for litigation to a sanctioned party is exempt from the prohibition under a line still awaiting European Commission confirmation, that the dean's conflict of interest is addressed by a professional statute and planned reforms creating a national supervisory authority, and declined to detail the internal investigation citing confidentiality.
As I indicated in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, given the special position of the legal profession in our society, supervision of lawyers takes place independently of the government.

Antwoord 3 Zoals ik in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 6 heb aangeven vindt, gelet op de bijzondere positie van de advocatuur in onze samenleving, het toezicht op advocaten onafhankelijk van de overheid plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een onderzoek dat uitwijst dat de bedrijvenlobby het Europese IMVO voorstel heeft beïnvloed

An MP asked the minister about the CEO report 'Inside Job' claiming business lobbying through the EU Regulatory Scrutiny Board weakened the EU CSDDD proposal, and about Denmark's request for Dutch lobbying support, the ATR's role, and transparency of RSB contacts. The minister answered that the RSB is independent, that the Commission chose to proceed despite negative opinions, that the Netherlands backs EU transparency initiatives, and that a Dutch national due diligence bill with ATR and Council of State advice will follow.
The cabinet cannot assess to what extent business has or has not successfully lobbied the RSB, nor to what extent the RSB has been able to weigh the various interests.
Het kabinet kan niet beoordelen in hoeverre het bedrijfsleven al dan niet succesvol bij de RSB heeft gelobbyd, noch in hoeverre de RBS in staat is geweest verschillende belangen af te wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de trage uitvoering van sancties

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister why the implementation of sanctions against Russian-linked persons was delayed by over a month, and whether authorities acted too slowly. The minister answered that data sharing was legally blocked until an April amendment, that no violations were found, and that legislative and structural reforms to the sanctions regime are underway.
The cabinet does not recognise the picture that it acted slowly.
Het kabinet herkent zich niet in het beeld dat er traag is opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse bedrijven die actief zijn in Qatar vanwege het WK-voetbal

An SP MP asked the foreign trade and development minister about Dutch firms earning money from World Cup construction in Qatar, including worker exploitation, deaths, lack of due diligence and corporate transparency, and FIFA's liability. The minister answered that companies bear responsibility under OECD guidelines, that Dutch policy is to promote EU and national due diligence legislation and CSRD reporting from 2024, and that the causes of worker deaths could not be attributed clearly to World Cup works.
At EU level the cabinet promotes due diligence legislation and is implementing national due diligence legislation.
Het kabinet bevordert op EU-niveau IMVO-wetgeving en voert nationale IMVO-wetgeving in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over belemmering van de Russische wapenindustrie

An SP MP asked the Dutch ministers whether Russian arms-industry figures and firms were left off EU sanctions, whether Western electronics feeding Russian weapons were being curbed, and whether Dutch and EU arms and dual-use exports to Russia had been stopped. The government answered that the EU has listed major Russian defence firms and related persons, that no military exports to Russia have been licensed or made since 2014, and that no dual-use export licences have been granted since February 2022, while declining to comment on specific new sanction proposals and noting that a universal UN arms embargo is unlikely given Russia's veto.
The cabinet supports additional sanctions measures but does not comment on specific proposals for new sanctions.
Het kabinet is voorstander van aanvullende sanctiemaatregelen, maar doet geen uitlatingen over specifieke voorstellen voor nieuwe sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de situatie in Ter Apel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the crisis at the Ter Apel asylum reception centre and the municipality of Westerwolde's ten-point plan, including whether he agrees with it and what he will do, and whether the Red Cross withdrew because refugees had gone 12 hours without food or drink. The State Secretary acknowledged the situation is unacceptable, said it has been escalated to national crisis management, and answered each measure with reference to planned or existing steps, several of which are referred to earlier letters.

I can assure you that all efforts are aimed at achieving rapid results, first and foremost to resolve the acute shortages in asylum reception and remedy the pressing situation at the Ter Apel location.

Ik kan u verzekeren dat alle inzet erop is gericht om snelle resultaten te boeken, in de eerste plaats om de acute tekorten in de asielopvang op te lossen en de nijpende situatie op de locatie Ter Apel te verhelpen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de inform

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister-President and Foreign Affairs Minister what measures the ministry has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, on hardship-causing laws, prior inventories, the handling of new proposals, the baseline measurement for digital information management, the chat-message retention policy, and the number of FOI requests. The government answered that departments are conducting inventories of hardship-causing rules, outlined the methodology and timelines, described the retention rules for chat messages, and referred to attached overviews for FOI request data.
Question 2: Has this research, or have these studies, been shared with the House? If not, can you explain in detail why not and send the research to the House without delay?
Vraag 2 Is dit onderzoek of zijn deze onderzoeken met de Kamer gedeeld? Zo nee, kunt u uitgebreid motiveren waarom niet en kunt u het onderzoek onverwijld naar de Kamer sturen?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Defensie naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuisho

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister-President and Minister of Defence what measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of rules and the information management. The government answered that departments are conducting inventories of harsh legislation under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that the ministries' action plans and baseline measurements will be sent separately, and that the chat-message retention policy for ministers is being clarified.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, every ministry is carrying out an inventory of legislation and regulations that work harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het Ministerie van Financiën grote invloed had op hoogleraarsplek Erasmus Universiteit

SP MPs Kwint and Van Dijk asked whether the Ministry of Finance sponsored and influenced a tax-law professorship at Erasmus University, and about transparency and the funding of special chairs. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that Finance initiated the sponsorship arrangement, a selection procedure with a Finance representative on the committee was held, transparency should be improved, and he will consult the sector on the balance between regular and special professors.
I will send the Chamber the overview as soon as it is ready.
Ik zal de Kamer het overzicht doen toekomen zodra het gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het Kremlin aan de Zuidas

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether law firm Houthoff profited from work for sanctioned Russian state banks such as Sberbank, whether it should have done client due diligence, and whether prosecution, confiscation, and a legal framework for supervising lawyers are possible. The minister answered that the Amsterdam bar supervisor found no sanctions breach, declined to comment on the individual case, said prosecution depends on concrete signals, and said a legal framework for lawyer sanctions supervision is being prepared with an outline letter promised before the budget debates.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over gesponsorde hoogleraren

SP MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about externally funded endowed professorships at Dutch universities, including chairs financed by the Tax Authority and accounting firms that were not disclosed. The minister listed seven Finance-funded chairs, said the rules on private chairs are intended to guarantee independence, and promised an independent evaluation of the research integrity code while noting the Inspectorate has no legal basis to enforce on external funding.
As to the extent to which accounting firms have been open about matters, I cannot make a statement.
Over de mate waarin accountantskantoren openheid van zaken hebben gegeven kan ik geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Universiteit Leiden sponsoring hoogleraar door Belastingdienst verzweeg

MPs Kwint and Jasper van Dijk asked why Leiden University did not disclose that a professorship in tax law was funded by the Tax Authority, and what sanctions or transparency measures would follow. Minister Dijkgraaf acknowledged the lack of openness, said the university has adjusted its disclosures and is reviewing the case, but stated the ministry cannot impose sanctions and promised a letter to parliament on registration of side activities.
The ministry does not have the power to impose sanctions.
Het ministerie heeft niet de mogelijkheid sancties op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de schrijnende situatie van een Iraniër die met de dood wordt bedreigd

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the case of an Iranian asylum seeker threatened with death, including proof requirements for refugees, conversion claims, and whether his case should be reviewed as a hardship case. The State Secretary declines to discuss individual cases, explains the evidentiary and credibility rules and the conversion assessment framework, and refuses to refer the case to the IND for a hardship review.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijk buitenproportioneel gedrag van Nederlandse militairen in Uruzgan met burgerdoden tot gevolg

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service's closed investigation into Dutch soldiers' force in Uruzgan (2007) can now be answered, whether the material is public, whether force without positive identification was policy and in line with the ROE, how often it occurred, whether the ROE will change, and whether soldiers were warned by the regional command. The minister said the prosecutor will decide on publishing its material, that a decision on an own Defence investigation comes after summer, that warning shots without positive identification were within the ROE, that frequency cannot be determined, that the ROE are mission-specific and the ISAF ROE have lapsed, and that no documentation on the warnings could be found.
I will decide after the summer on whether Defence starts a possible own investigation.
Over het starten van een eventueel eigen onderzoek door Defensie neem ik na de zomer een besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de bescherming van Russische vluchtelingen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government should be more generous toward Russian asylum seekers, including conscientious objectors and deserters, given Russia's repression and the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, and whether it would impose a moratorium or designate them as a risk group. The State Secretary answered that Russian asylum policy is adequate and not strict: the existing country-specific policy covers activists, journalists, LHBT people and others, a six-month decision and departure moratorium was introduced for Russian male conscripts aged 18-27 who refuse or desert, and a new general country report is expected in early 2023.
For this reason it was decided to introduce a decision and departure moratorium for a period of six months after entry into force for Russian conscripts who refuse military service or desert.

Om deze reden is er besloten om een besluit- en vertrekmoratorium in te stellen voor een periode van zes maanden na inwerkingtreding voor Russische dienstplichtigen die dienstweigeren of die deserteren.
Antwoord op van het het lid Jasper van Dijk over het gebrekkige toezicht op Russische bedrijven

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign and Finance Ministers about weak oversight of Russian-linked companies, illegal trust services and sanctions enforcement capacity, citing a newspaper article and a 31-50% estimate of unlicensed trust providers. Minister Hoekstra replied that the government is aware of the issues, announced six measures and a trust-sector study, explained that DNB enforces mainly on signals, and said capacity is being reallocated pending new staff.
The outcome of the study will be communicated to the House as soon as possible after the summer.
Over de uitkomst van het onderzoek wordt uw Kamer na de zomer zo snel mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het ethisch profileren bij de IND bij 'erkend referenten'

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked why the IND's risk model for recognised sponsors (erkend referenten), which registered company board composition and reportedly profiled by origin, was stopped without public notice, whether other ministries were informed, and whether risk profiling by government should be halted. The government replied that the model had no consequences for decisions, that the board-composition indicator was never used in scoring but was wrongly registered, that it acknowledged an unheeded 2017 legal warning, and that it will inform the House before the summer recess on the results of the Motion#21 investigation into discriminatory risk models.
I regret that an internal memo from the IND's Legal Affairs department, which in 2017 advised stopping the risk model, was not acted on more quickly.
Ik betreur dat er niet sneller opvolging is gegeven aan een interne notitie van de afdeling Juridische Zaken van de IND, die in 2017 adviseerde met het risicomodel te stoppen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een dreigende Turkse invasie in Syrië

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a possible new Turkish military operation in northern Syria, Turkish plans to resettle Syrian refugees there, Turkey's democratic record, and whether Turkey still qualifies for NATO membership. The minister said the Netherlands shares US concern, urges de-escalation, holds that Syria does not yet meet standards for safe return, supports a Syrian-led political process under UNSCR 2254, raises human rights with Turkey, and sees NATO as the forum for discussing Turkish conduct.
The cabinet, including in talks with the Turkish authorities, stresses the importance of refraining from escalation in Syria to prevent further destabilisation.
Het kabinet onderstreept, ook in gesprekken met de Turkse autoriteiten, het belang van afzien van escalatie in Syrië om verdere destabilisering te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opvang van 1.000 Oekraïense vluchtelingen in Vlaardingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the planned temporary reception village for up to 1,000 Ukrainian refugees in Vlaardingen, including whether the government would sign the financial guarantee the municipality needed by 23 June 2022. The State Secretary confirmed the talks and shared interest, but said the revised financial proposal requires significant national guarantees and needs careful assessment before a decision.
The consultation will be continued aimed at giving a decision on Thursday.
Het overleg wordt voortgezet gericht op uitsluitsel op donderdag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het gebruik van hacksoftware, zoals Pegasus, in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked about Dutch use of hacking software such as Pegasus, including purchases, users, offences, targets, supplier screening, statistics, and the Wet CCIII evaluation. The government answered that police buy commercial intrusion software under judicial authorization, that operational details and expenditures cannot be disclosed for protection of methods, and that the Wet CCIII evaluation is delayed and expected after summer 2022.

Providing third parties with information on which specific software the police hold and use for this special investigative power entails unacceptable risks for the usability of those means and thereby for the investigative interest.

Het verstrekken van informatie aan derden over welke specifieke software de politie beschikt en gebruikt bij de inzet van deze bijzondere opsporingsbevoegdheid, brengt onaanvaardbare risico’s met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen en daarmee het opsporingsbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de situatie van Jezidi’s

An SP MP asked the government about conditions for Yazidis in Sinjar and Iraqi camps, including psychological care, reconstruction spending, and a dedicated resettlement programme for Yazidis like France, Germany and Canada. The minister acknowledged the gravity of the situation, described funding for psychosocial aid and UNDP reconstruction, but declined a special asylum programme since Dutch policy has no framework for such transfers, and explained UNHCR resettlement criteria.
The Netherlands has no policy framework for transferring people from their country of origin for asylum in the Netherlands, and therefore has no policy for transferring Yazidis.
Nederland kent geen beleidskader voor de overbrenging van mensen uit hun land van herkomst voor asiel in Nederland en heeft dus ook geen beleid voor de overbrenging van Jezidi’s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het besluit van het Israëlisch Hooggerechtshof dat de weg vrijmaakt voor gedwongen uitzetting van een grote groep Palestijnen uit Masafer Yatta

MPs Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands will condemn and act against an Israeli Supreme Court ruling enabling forced eviction of about 1,000 Palestinians from Masafer Yatta. The minister said the Netherlands respects Israeli judicial independence but is concerned, has urged Israel bilaterally and with EU partners not to act on the ruling, and will keep monitoring the case without announcing new concrete measures.
The Netherlands respects the independence of the judiciary in Israel, but is very concerned about the possible consequences of this ruling.
Nederland respecteert de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtspraak in Israël, maar is zeer bezorgd over de mogelijke gevolgen van deze uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de naturalisatie van pardonners en andere personen met een verblijfsvergunning

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the naturalisation of Ranov-permit holders (pardoned asylum seekers), including doubts about identity based on old language analyses, the handling of the motion on removing legal obstacles, the situation of the 2,097 asylum seekers under the 2003 one-off regulation, municipal advisory capacity, support for less self-reliant applicants, and naturalisation fees. The State Secretary reports about 3,250 Ranov applications with roughly 2,200 granted and about 50 refused, explains that 'gerede twijfel' requires an objective source, declines to map the 2,097-group, and defends the fee structure.
I believe the policy offers sufficient room to address this situation and I therefore do not intend to map what you requested.
Ik vind dat het beleid voldoende ruimte biedt om deze situatie te ondervangen en ben daarom niet voornemens het door u gevraagde in kaart te laten brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over het vervallen recht op toeslagen vanwege gegevens in de basisregistratie personen (BRP)

An MP asks why childcare and housing allowances are withdrawn and recovered when the IND registers code 98 (no lawful residence) in the BRP, even when people may not be definitively rejected, and whether affected people can contest this before recovery. The State Secretary replies that code 98 reflects current status not final rejection, that Toeslagen relies on IND's code and only checks doubtful cases, that the code is not a contestable decision but the underlying IND decision is, and that the government will report on hardship options in the summer.
Code 98 means that at the time of determination a citizen does not (or no longer) lawfully reside in the Netherlands; it does not mean the person has been finally rejected.
Code 98 betekent dat een burger op het moment van vaststelling niet (meer) rechtmatig in Nederland verblijft, dit betekent niet dat iemand uitgeprocedeerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu , Sylvana Simons en Sjoerdsma over straffeloosheid voor oorlogsmisdaden in Jemen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen after the UN Human Rights Council ended its war-crimes investigation, and whether Netherlands would push to resume an UN-mandated inquiry. The minister said the April ceasefire is holding, that Netherlands supports UN envoy efforts, but will not launch an initiative at the Council because the chance of success is very small, instead funding local accountability efforts.
The Netherlands will continue to emphasise the importance of combating impunity in international fora and in bilateral talks.
Ook zal Nederland het belang van het tegengaan van straffeloosheid in internationale fora en in bilaterale gesprekken blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de naleving van sancties tegen Russische oligarchen

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Finance Ministers about the enforcement of sanctions against Russian oligarchs, including a halted investigation, trust-sector oversight, reporting frequency and a sanctions coordinator. The minister declined to comment on individual investigations, pointed to existing and pending transparency and anti-money-laundering measures, and committed to further letters and the appointment of a coordinator's recommendations, without giving a timetable for a single contact point.
I cannot give a judgement on individual criminal investigations, as I do not have information about them.
Ik kan geen oordeel geven over individuele opsporingsonderzoeken, aangezien ik niet beschik over informatie daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over individuele ambtsberichten

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked about how Dutch individual intelligence reports (ambtsberichten) on Rwanda are produced, whether they can be verified, whether lawyers of genocide suspects get access, and the state of Rwanda's rule of law after Dutch aid ends. The government answered that the process uses vetted informants and independent sources, that courts can inspect underlying files confidentially, that ICJ monitoring of trials continues until final judgment, and that development aid is being phased out while human rights funding continues.

The competent court and/or the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State can obtain confidential access to the underlying documents to assess whether they support the conclusions of the individual intelligence report.

De bevoegde rechtbank en/of de Afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State kan op vertrouwelijke basis inzage krijgen in de achterliggende stukken om te bezien of die de conclusies van het individuele ambtsbericht kunnen dragen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het sturen van Pantserhouwitsers naar Oekraïne

An MP asked the Defence Minister why the government moved from announcing heavy equipment to specifying self-propelled howitzers for Ukraine, whether the howitzers are in the reserve and need modernisation, whether the army objects, what end-use conditions and agreements with Germany apply, and whether the aid escalates the conflict. The minister answered that the howitzers come from the logistic reserve, that five systems were assessed as acceptable after a weighing of readiness impact, that end-use declarations restrict use to self-defence, and that no MoU or rules of engagement were agreed with Germany.
Given the nature of the delivery and the cooperation with Germany, the cabinet decided to inform the House publicly in this case.
Vanwege de aard van de levering en de samenwerking met Duitsland heeft het kabinet in dit geval besloten de Kamer openbaar te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over het bericht van NOS van 6 april jl. waaruit blijk dat geen enkele universiteit de registratie van bijbanen van hoogleraren op orde heeft

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how universities can have unregistered side jobs of professors, and what will be done to keep registers accurate and public. The minister acknowledges the problem, says universities are responsible for registration, is talking with UNL about improvements including a possible central public register, and promises a letter to parliament this autumn.
I will send your House a letter this autumn on the state of affairs regarding the registration of side activities.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit najaar een brief sturen over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de registratie van nevenwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over een oud-bewindspersoon die lobbyt bij het ministerie

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked why a former minister working for a lobbying firm was given access to the Ministry of Defence, whether this creates conflict of interest, and whether a network-scan and cross-government checks on part-time lobbyists will be carried out. The government answered that access is limited to needed areas, that the secretary-general restricted his dealings with Defence for a two-year cooling-off period, that a whole-of-government integrity code and an organisation-level scan pilot are in progress, and that case-by-case assessment rules out a blanket check.
It is not the case that someone who has been politically active may under no circumstances have access to a ministry. That must be assessed on an individual case basis.
Het is niet zo dat iemand die politiek actief is geweest in geen geval toegang zou mogen hebben tot een ministerie. Dat dient per individueel geval beoordeeld te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Eppink en Jasper van Dijk over een lobbyregister voor hooggeplaatste militairen

MPs Eppink and Jasper van Dijk asked whether former senior officers lobbying for the defence industry is ethical and whether a transparency lobby register is needed for large defence investments. The State Secretary answered that former officers have freedom of work, that Defence bars former staff from acting as business contacts for two years, and that a lobby register is being pursued government-wide via the Dassen motion, with Defence to follow its outcome.
Defence will conform to the outcomes of the implementation of the Dassen motion.
Defensie zal zich conformeren aan de uitkomsten van de uitvoering van motie Dassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijk gebruik van Nederlands defensiematerieel door Egyptische speciale eenheden tegen Palestijnse burgers

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade whether Dutch defence equipment supplied to Egypt has been used against Palestinian civilians and whether the government knew of naval support to Egyptian units in Sinai. The ministers answered that no independently verified link has been established between licensed military goods and the incidents, that naval support is acknowledged but no concrete link to abuses is found, and that there is no basis to revoke the licence.
Information on the use of the licence is commercially confidential and under customs legislation may not be disclosed publicly.
Het gebruik van de vergunning betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die conform de douanewetgeving niet openbaar mag worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over dwangarbeid in relatie tot het WK voetbal in Qatar

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about forced labour linked to the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, including Amnesty's report, whether pressure on Qatar should increase, and whether a diplomatic boycott should be implemented. The minister answered that the government continues critical dialogue and engagement with Qatar, rejects a boycott in line with EU partners and human rights organisations, and will return to the 2021 boycott motion before the World Cup starts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Jasper van Dijk over door Nederland veroorzaakte doden, leed en schade in Hawija, Irak

MPs Simons and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister how the government would respond to a 2022 report finding far greater civilian harm from the 2015 Dutch airstrike on Hawija than previously assumed, including deaths, damaged buildings, and whether individual compensation and apologies would follow. The Minister acknowledged the harm was significant but unverifiable in full, pointed to the EUR 4.4 million community projects, declined individual compensation as the report does not change the assessment, and welcomed the report's recommendations on civilian harm mitigation, promising further talks.
The cabinet has on several occasions stated that it deeply regrets that civilian casualties occurred in Hawija on the night of 2 to 3 June 2015.
Het kabinet heeft bij meerdere gelegenheden aangegeven het ten zeerste te betreuren dat er in de nacht van 2 op 3 juni 2015 in Hawija burgerslachtoffers zijn gevallen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gebrekkige uitvoering van sancties

An SP MP asked why Dutch authorities have not seized real estate of Russians on the sanctions list and how the sanctions enforcement is organised. The government answers that sanctioned property is frozen rather than seized, that the Kadaster found no matches, and that a data team, a national sanctions coordinator and additional capacity are being set up.
Voor inbeslagname is een strafvorderlijke titel nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat voor de derde keer 500 miljoen euro wordt vrijgemaakt voor wapens aan Oekraïne via het Europees Vredesfonds

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about a third EU European Peace Facility tranche of 500 million euros for weapons to Ukraine, the transparency of such decisions, which weapons qualify, Dutch declarations, the budget ceiling in relation to a parliamentary motion, and conditions on use. The ministers answered that the Council approved the increase, that the Dutch parliament is informed through letters, that declarations so far total 36 million euros, that the 5.7 billion ceiling is maintained by spreading payments, and that end-use declarations restrict use to self-defence.
The cabinet has kept your House informed in writing in recent period about the support measures financed under the European Peace Facility.
Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer in de afgelopen periode schriftelijk op de hoogte gehouden over de steunmaatregelen die worden gefinancierd onder de Europese Vredesfaciliteit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat 30 miljard euro aan bezittingen van Russische oligarchen is bevroren door de Europese Freeze and Seize Taskforce

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the EU Freeze and Seize Taskforce, Dutch frozen assets, and reports on the King's villa in Greece, a Putin villa, and the yacht Scheherazade in Italy. The minister answered that detailed lists are not public, that the Dutch share is about 632.9 million euros, that Greece and Italy are cooperating, and that individual supervisory cases cannot be discussed.
The requested information is unfortunately not public.
De gevraagde informatie is helaas niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de aanwezigheid van Gazprom in Nederland

MPs from the SP asked the government about Gazprom's presence in the Netherlands, including its asset holdings via shell companies, Dutch investment ties with Russia, tax avoidance, tax rulings for state-owned firms, and frozen Russian assets. The State Secretary answered that sanctions freezes apply, the cabinet opposes facilitating Russian-linked shells and is banning certain trust services, tax secrecy limits detailed answers on individual taxpayers, and a rulings termination clause exists for sanctioned entities.
Under the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het toezicht op de naleving van de sancties tegen Rusland op de Zuidas

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether a 2019 Houthoff case breached Russia sanctions, who supervises sanctions compliance across four bodies, whether capacity is sufficient, and why only 14 administrative fines but no criminal action since 2015. The minister answered that law firms lack supervision and a statutory regulation is being prepared, that prosecution is for the OM, that additional capacity is being assessed, and that a national sanctions coordinator was appointed.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that criminal action was taken against violations of sectoral sanctions measures concerning the sanctioned flow of goods.
Het OM heeft aangegeven dat strafrechtelijk is opgetreden tegen overtreding van sectorale sanctiemaatregelen aangaande de gesanctioneerde goederenstroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over burn pits

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about burn pits in Afghanistan, including whether IRAS criticism of earlier measurements and literature was accepted, the status of a Belhaj motion, whether earlier claims of no exceedances were unfounded, and whether compensation should be offered to ill veterans. The government answered that the literature cannot support firm conclusions, that the motion is being implemented through measures such as masks and monitoring pilots, that earlier measurements showed no exceedances, and that compensation is assessed case by case through existing procedures.
Defence put equipment into use last year and started a pilot to monitor air quality in mission areas.
Defensie heeft vorig jaar apparatuur in gebruik genomen en is gestart met een pilot waarmee de luchtkwaliteit kan worden gemonitord in missiegebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlanders die naar Oekraïne gaan om te vechten

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether it is acceptable that Dutch nationals are recruited to fight in Ukraine, how vulnerable people are protected, and what action is taken against recruiters. The government answered that travel to fight is dangerous and strongly discouraged, but it cannot restrict the freedom of movement of Dutch citizens; recruitment for foreign military service is prosecutable under Article 205 of the Penal Code, while the government does not comment on individual cases.
The cabinet cannot go into individual cases.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over openheid over wapenleveringen aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister why the government now discloses less detail about military deliveries to Ukraine, whether this hinders public debate, and about vehicles, Patriot missiles, coordination and proportionality. The minister answered that transparency is weighed against operational security, that details will be shared with parliament confidentially, that Patriot deployment to Slovakia is planned, and that the EU Clearing House Cell coordinates support, while declining to publicly specify the items.

As also promised during the plenary debate on 10 March, this does not alter the fact that the cabinet wishes to account for its actions and will therefore keep parliament adequately informed, via a confidential annex.

Zoals ook toegezegd tijdens het plenaire debat op 10 maart jl. laat dit onverlet dat het kabinet verantwoording wil afleggen en daarom de Kamer adequaat zal blijven informeren, via een vertrouwelijke bijlage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over (burger)slachtoffers als gevolg van Nederlandse bijdrage aan bombardement

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about civilian casualties linked to Dutch contributions to US strikes, including Dutch PED support, monthly reporting on Dutch air operations against ISIS, and rules of engagement. The Minister answered that the data is largely published, that the Dutch PED cell was used 606 times with 20 cases of live targeting, that Dutch involvement in the US Freedom Sentinel operation is not something the government can comment on, and that rules of engagement applied were NATO's for RSM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de afhandeling schadevergoeding slachtoffers bombardement van Hawija

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about the lack of individual compensation for civilian victims of the 2015 Hawija bombing, the number of casualties, and a civil lawsuit by 11 victims. The minister answered that the Netherlands is responsible but not liable absent unlawful force, that collective projects (IOM and UNDP) were chosen instead of individual payments, and that the earlier reasoning still stands, while refusing to say precisely how many casualties there were and withholding detailed bombing locations for operational security.
Defence is currently considering whether it is possible to release more details. Your House will be informed about this.
Defensie beziet momenteel of het mogelijk is meer details vrij te geven. Uw Kamer zal daarover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Jasper van Dijk over een nieuw kritisch rapport over het EU-Mercosur handelsverdrag

MPs Teunissen and Jasper van Dijk asked the minister to respond to a critical Handel Anders! report on the EU-Mercosur trade agreement, including claims of a democratic deficit, consultation failures with indigenous peoples, the delayed sustainability impact assessment, and possible splitting of the deal. The minister replied that the government does not share several of the report's assumptions, describes the EU and national consultation and parliamentary involvement, acknowledges the late SIA while noting its partial use of recent data, and defends the trade policy against the report's proposals.
