Your House is regularly informed about the progress of negotiations on trade agreements, including through the regular progress report.
Uw Kamer wordt regelmatig geïnformeerd over de voortgang van onderhandelingen over handelsakkoorden, onder andere via de reguliere voortgangsrapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over “de ongekende invloed van Blackrock op de Europese klimaatplannen”

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the government about lobbying influence by BlackRock and financial-sector groups on EU sustainable finance and taxonomy rules, including BlackRock's role as a Commission adviser. The minister answered that lobbying must follow transparency rules, that the Ombudsman found no maladministration but urged stricter conflict-of-interest checks which the Commission has accepted, and that the government has no further information on BlackRock's budget or meetings.
The European Ombudsman concluded there was no maladministration because the European Commission had complied with the procurement rules.
7 De Ombudsman concludeerde dat er geen sprake was van wanbestuur omdat de Europese Commissie aan de aanbestedingsregels had voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het nieuws dat de Frontex baas een privévlucht boekte naar een meeting in Brussel

An SP MP asked the government about reports that the Frontex director booked an 8,500 euro private flight to a Brussels meeting, whether cheaper commercial flights were available, and what the government will do about wasteful spending and Frontex's wider credibility problems. The State Secretary answered that the government does not judge individual cases, that Frontex bears its own responsibility, that the Management Board is the body where the Netherlands can exert influence on budget execution, and that the government will keep raising the matter in EU channels.
It is not for the cabinet to pass judgement on individual casuistry and the specific considerations involved.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te vellen over individuele casuïstiek en de specifieke afwegingen daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de Argos-uitzending 'Drama bij evacuatie Kabul'

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about an Argos broadcast on chaotic evacuations from Kabul, including whether two sisters were on the evacuation list, why about a hundred people were removed from the list, and whether the ministry obstructs court access and appeal decisions. The government declined to discuss individual cases citing privacy, explained the removals as post-evacuation verification, and denied that appeals and court access are obstructed.
In line with the objectives of the GDPR, I will not address questions relating to specific individual cases.
In lijn met de doelstellingen van de AVG ga ik niet in op vragen die betrekking hebben op specifieke casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat universiteiten een maximum willen op het aantal internationale studenten vanwege overvolle collegezalen en overwerkte docenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that universities want a cap on international students due to overcrowded lecture halls and overworked staff, and whether funding per student creates a perverse incentive. The minister acknowledged signals of capacity limits, said there is currently no system-wide shortage, and deferred concrete measures and the Engelstalige programme questions to a forthcoming letter.
I refer you for this to the letter I promised during the committee debate on internationalisation and knowledge security on 9 February 2022, which I will shortly send to your House.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor graag naar de brief die ik heb toegezegd tijdens het commissiedebat internationalisering en kennisveiligheid op 9 februari 2022 en die ik binnenkort naar uw Kamer zal sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het weigeren van Europese Wob-aanvragen door de Europese Commissie over het Europees Herstelfonds

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the European Commission's refusal of Wob-style access requests for documents on talks over the EU Recovery Fund, and about the broader transparency of EU decision-making. The minister replied that it is not for the Dutch government to judge the Commission's application of the EU access regulation, that complainants can go to the EU Ombudsman or the General Court, and that the Netherlands pushes for modernisation of the regulation.
It is not for the cabinet to comment on whether the European Commission correctly applied Regulation EC 1049/2001 (the Eurowob).
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te treden in de vraag of de Europese Commissie verordening EG 1049/2001 (hierna: de Eurowob) correct heeft toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops en Agnes Mulder over de toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops and Mulder asked about the status of the EU's accession to the European Convention on Human Rights, the remaining legal and political objections, and when talks would resume. The minister replied that negotiations are progressing slowly through seven rounds since 2020, that several legal objections remain (partly resolved), the next round is scheduled for May 2022, and the Netherlands will actively push to speed up accession.
The Netherlands wishes to fulfil the treaty obligation for the EU's accession to the ECHR as quickly as possible.
Nederland wenst de verdragsrechtelijke verplichting tot toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM zo snel mogelijk te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Teunissen, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Simons en Dassen over het lot van de Afghaanse ambassadebewakers

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Afghan guards employed by an external contractor at the Dutch embassy in Kabul were not evacuated, when the Belhaj motion called for evacuating those who assisted the Dutch government, and whether the contractor was informed of the decision. The minister answered that the guards were not embassy employees and guarded other states' diplomatic missions, so they fell outside the evacuation criteria; he acknowledged the contractor received no timely written reply and that the lists and correspondence are shared only confidentially.
The request of 15 August and both reminders are shared with you on a confidential basis.
Het verzoek van 15 augustus en beide rappels worden op vertrouwelijke basis met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Minister samenwerkte met de bedrijfslobby tegen de aanpak van kinderarbeid en milieuschade

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she collaborated with the business lobby (VNO-NCW) against supply-chain due diligence rules on child labour and environmental harm, and whether her own past amendments to an EU report reflected lobby arguments. The Minister denied a formal lobbying alliance, said she had submitted 92 amendments on feasibility and legal certainty, abstained on the report, and committed to pursue Dutch and EU IMVO legislation in line with the coalition agreement.
Whether VNO-NCW was an ally to me in that regard is not for me to judge.
Of VNO-NCW daarbij aan mij een bondgenoot had, is niet aan mij om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ambassadeurs op de fraudelijst van de Belastingdienst

An MP asked why two ambassadors were on the Tax Authority's fraud list (FSV) and why they were not informed, under which GDPR exemption, and who they are and why they are listed. The State Secretary answered that the ambassadors will be informed like others unless an exemption applies, that the Tax Authority consulted the Foreign Ministry, and that the tax secrecy duty prevents him from identifying individuals or their tax position.
The ambassadors will, like other people registered in FSV, be informed, unless an exemption ground applies.
De ambassadeurs zullen net als andere mensen die in FSV stonden geregistreerd, worden geïnformeerd, tenzij er sprake is van een uitzonderingsgrond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Jasper van Dijk en Kuik over naturalisatieverzoeken RANOV-vergunninghouders en de Kamerbrief over diverse onderwerpen migratiebeleid van 7 juli 2021 en het WODC rapport “(N)ooit Nede

MPs Podt, Jasper van Dijk and Kuik asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why RANOV permit holders may still be asked for identity and nationality documents, how many naturalisation applications were filed and refused since the July 2021 policy change, and whether the Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg motion was properly implemented. The State Secretary answered that about 2,070 RANOV holders filed applications, around 690 were granted and fewer than 10 refused, that the documentary requirement is waived for RANOV holders with the possibility of submitting documents voluntarily, and that the motion is considered implemented.
Do you think you are implementing the adopted Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg motion in a way consistent with its spirit and intent?
Vraag 5 Vindt u dat u de aangenomen Kamermotie Van Dijk/Van Toorenburg 5 uitvoert op een manier die in lijn is met de geest en de bedoeling van de motie?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Jasper van Dijk over het besluit om financiering aan de Palestijnse organisatie UAWC stop te zetten

MPs Simons and Van Dijk asked why the government ended funding to the Palestinian organisation UAWC, whether the external Proximities report clears it of terrorism links, and why the government does not apply the same scrutiny to Israeli entities or the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The ministers answered that the decision rests on documented individual ties between UAWC staff and the PFLP, that the government will not revisit it, that no external study of Israeli firms is planned, and that suspension of the Association Agreement is not on the table.
The cabinet found that the individual ties, including within the UAWC board and the dual mandates with the PFLP, were widespread and covered the entire 2007–2021 research period.

Het kabinet heeft geconstateerd dat de individuele banden – zeker ook binnen het bestuur van UAWC en de daar geconstateerde dubbelmandaten met de PFLP – wijdverbreid waren en de gehele onderzoeksperiode 2007–2021 bestreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het nieuws dat supermarkten samen met FNV de misstanden in de Italiaanse tomatenteelt willen aanpakken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about supermarkets and FNV working to stop exploitation in Italian tomato farming, including the government's view on the CBL research findings, whether it is responsible for pressing Italy, and whether Italian products could be banned. The minister welcomed the industry initiative, said systemic risks lie largely outside Dutch influence, that Italy must enforce its own labour law, and that a ban is impossible under EU free movement of goods.
Calling Italy to account by the Dutch government is not an appropriate response.
Het aanspreken van Italië door de Nederlandse overheid is geen passende reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over politieke gevangenen in Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about political prisoners in Turkey, including the detention of Osman Kavala, reports of sick prisoners not receiving adequate care, and the case of Aysel Tuğluk. The minister answered that reliable figures are unavailable, that the Netherlands has raised Kavala's case in the Council of Europe and urged compliance with the European Court ruling, and that the embassy is monitoring Tuğluk's health without committing to specific intervention.
However, the cabinet cannot establish with certainty how many people are imprisoned for political reasons or what the trend is.
Het kabinet kan echter niet met zekerheid vaststellen hoeveel personen om politieke redenen vastzitten en wat hierbij de trend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Jasper van Dijk over een verplichte VOG om misbruikschandalen te voorkomen

MPs Van der Plas and Van Dijk asked whether a sector-specific VOG (certificate of conduct) should be made mandatory for humanitarian aid workers to prevent sexual abuse scandals. The minister said screening is a shared responsibility of organisations, that no specific sector request was received, and that she is open to further talks with aid organisations and COVOG on evaluating screening instruments.

I am open to a follow-up conversation with aid organisations to evaluate experiences with the various available personnel screening instruments and to arrive at an effective instrument as quickly as possible.

Ik sta open voor een vervolggesprek met hulporganisaties om de ervaringen met de verschillende beschikbare instrumenten voor screening van personeel te evalueren en zo snel mogelijk tot een effectief instrument te komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Piri  en Kuzu over afwijzingen kort verblijf familieleden Syrische Nederlanders

MPs asked why Syrian visitors for family visits, even when they appear to meet the Visa Code conditions, are refused at a high rate (55% for Syrians overall, about 75% for family visits), and whether the Syrian war is treated as breaking ties to the home country. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that each application is assessed on its merits under the Visa Code, that refusals mostly reflect insufficient ties to the country of origin and doubts about timely return, and that Syrian nationals can only obtain a family visit visa if these concerns are resolved.
Every visa application is assessed on its own merits in accordance with the provisions of the Visa Code.
Alle visumaanvragen worden echter op hun eigen merites beoordeeld overeenkomstig de bepalingen van de Visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gedwongen huisuitzettingen van Palestijnse families in Oost-Jeruzalem

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about forced evictions of Palestinian families in East Jerusalem, Israel's policy on demolitions, Dutch responses and possible measures against settlement business. The minister condemns the evictions as contrary to international law, says the Netherlands and EU raise the issue bilaterally, but declines to support a ban on trade with settlements, following EU policy.
The Netherlands fundamentally disagrees with the Israeli government on the evictions and demolitions in East Jerusalem.
Nederland verschilt op het punt van de uithuiszettingen en sloop in Oost-Jeruzalem fundamenteel van mening met de Israëlische regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het controleren en koppelen van data van onschuldige mensen

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked why no privacy impact assessment was carried out for police project Athene, which automatically linked data from asylum seekers' phones to criminal information, and whether similar projects exist and how the Council of State's advice on phone reading would be followed. The Minister answers that the police overlooked the need for a privacy test after the GDPR transition, the test was done in November 2021 and the project ended, no data was shared, and the government will clarify the legal basis for reading digital data carriers and has amended rules to meet the Council of State's advice.
As a result, the assessment only took place in November 2021, after which the project was ended.
Hierdoor heeft de toets pas plaatsgevonden in november 2021, waarna het project is beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over de ineffectiviteit van Europese bestedingen richting de Balkan betreffende de rechtsstaat

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how to respond to a European Court of Auditors report finding that EU spending of about 700 million euros on rule of law in Western Balkan candidate countries had little lasting effect, including inconsistent enforcement of conditionality and weak monitoring. The minister answered that the findings are concerning, that the government will push for stricter conditionality, better monitoring and a shift toward fundamental rule-of-law reform, and that the recommendations will be raised in EU forums.
The cabinet will strongly advocate that the EU in future focuses more on this fundamental strengthening of the rule of law, partly based on the ECA's recommendations.
Het kabinet zal zich er hard voor maken dat de EU zich in de toekomst meer richt op deze fundamentele versterking van de rechtsstaat, mede op basis van de aanbevelingen van de ERK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about arms deliveries to Ukraine, including transparency about Ukraine's request, the defensive/offensive distinction, and consistency with export criteria. The government answered that it cannot disclose Ukraine's specific needs, will inform parliament quickly if deliveries proceed above 2 million euro, and is welcoming toward supporting Ukraine's self-defence while still pursuing diplomacy.
Should the Netherlands decide to supply military goods to Ukraine, the cabinet is willing to inform the House of this in an expedited letter.
Mocht Nederland overgaan tot het leveren van militaire goederen aan Oekraïne dan is het kabinet graag bereid om de Kamer hierover versneld per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse investeringen in Qatar

An SP MP asked the government about ING's links via QNB to human rights abuses in Qatar, the government's oversight of Dutch firms and pension funds investing there, and the World Cup. Minister Schreinemacher answered that companies bear responsibility under the OECD guidelines, the government does not supervise compliance, and an official delegation decision will return later in 2022.
No, the cabinet currently does not supervise compliance with the OECD guidelines by Dutch companies.
Nee, het kabinet houdt momenteel geen toezicht op de naleving van de OESO-richtlijnen door Nederlandse bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over bericht ‘3 jaar cel voor WK-medewerker na steun aan arbeidsmigranten’

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister about a World Cup worker sentenced to three years in Qatar after supporting migrant workers, questioning the fairness of the trial, lack of embassy presence, and whether an official delegation should attend the World Cup. The minister says the embassy monitors the case with other actors, that the man has access to a lawyer, that consular aid is not possible since he is not Dutch, and that the World Cup delegation question will be revisited later in 2022.
The Dutch embassy in Doha cannot provide consular assistance in the Ibhais case because he is not a Dutch citizen.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Doha kan in de zaak-Ibhais geen consulaire bijstand verlenen omdat het hierbij niet gaat om een Nederlandse burger.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Kröger, Piri en Ceder over het Fiche 'Voorstel voor een Raadsbesluit betreffende voorlopige noodmaatregelen ten behoeve van Letland, Litouwen en Polen'

Six MPs from D66, Volt, SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether emergency measures for Latvia, Lithuania and Poland under Article 78(3) TFEU are still necessary, legally grounded, time-limited and consistent with asylum and human rights safeguards, including the risk of pushbacks. The government answered that the Commission's assessment of an unprecedented influx from Belarus justifies the measures, that the measures are time-limited to six months, that they largely codify existing derogations, and that it will press these states on lawful border management while not withholding support for the proposal.
The government closely follows the situation at the borders with Belarus and considers the European Commission's assessment of the situation of great importance.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie aan de grenzen met Belarus nauwlettend en acht daarbij het oordeel van de Europese Commissie ten aanzien van de beoordeling van de situatie van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de regering brieven met aanwijzingen aan gemeentes stuurde zonder wettelijke grondslag

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked whether letters the government sent to municipalities instructing them to create emergency asylum reception places, called 'aanwijzingen', had any legal basis, and whether they amounted to mere requests. The government answered that the letters had no basis in Dutch law, were not legally binding, were intended as urgent requests, and that it will no longer use the term 'aanwijzing' in this way, while refusing to share some correspondence yet and not answering the criminal-law questions.
The cabinet regrets this. Therefore the cabinet no longer wishes to use the term 'aanwijzing' in a situation like this in this way.
Het kabinet betreurt dat. Daarom wil het kabinet de term «aanwijzing» in een situatie zoals deze niet meer op deze wijze gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanwijzing aan gemeenten over de huisvesting van asielzoekers

An SP MP asked why the government designated five municipalities to host asylum seekers by letter instead of seeking voluntary cooperation, and on what legal basis. The State Secretary answered that the letters were urgent designations without legal basis or legal effect, justified by the risk of emergency tent shelters, and that such designations are a last resort.
It is not a designation in the legal sense, and the letters therefore have no public-law legal effect.
Het betreft geen aanwijzing in juridische zin en de brieven hebben dan ook geen publiekrechtelijk rechtsgevolg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij luchtaanvallen.

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister why answers to earlier questions on Dutch involvement in airstrikes took over four months, and asked about casualties, Dutch PED intelligence contributions to foreign airstrikes, and any refusals. The minister cited the Afghanistan crisis for the delay, said Dutch involvement in the disputed Iraq strike was not Dutch action and that no civilian-casualty concern was known, and declined to give counts of how often PED products contributed to strikes, citing the coalition's targeting process.
The cabinet can therefore only make statements about weapons deployment that the Netherlands itself carried out, since the Netherlands bears responsibility for those attacks.
Het kabinet kan daarom enkel uitspraken doen over wapeninzet die Nederland zelf heeft uitgevoerd, aangezien Nederland voor die aanvallen de verantwoordelijkheid draagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse verantwoordelijkheid voor burgerslachtoffers in de oorlog tegen IS

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands was responsible for specific coalition airstrikes against IS that the New York Times linked to civilian deaths, and whether it was responsible for any listed as non-credible. The minister confirmed four known cases of possible Dutch-linked civilian casualties, two investigated by CENTCOM and the Public Prosecution Service, and declined to say whether Dutch aircraft were involved in the non-credible list.
With regard to the category of non-credible reports, the ministry maintains its line that no statements are made about this.
Voor wat betreft de categorie « non-credible reports » handhaaft het ministerie de lijn dat hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een oproep van maatschappelijke organisaties om straffeloosheid in Jemen te bestrijden

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would pursue new UN investigation into war crimes in Yemen, challenge Saudi Arabia's role in ending the Group of Eminent Experts inquiry, and use Security Council or EU sanctions against those responsible for starvation tactics. The minister said the government keeps accountability high on the agenda through diplomacy and support for local initiatives, declined to pre-judge options under discussion with like-minded states, regretted the inquiry's end, and pointed to raising starvation at EU and UN meetings while describing sanctions as non-punitive tools.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to anticipate the outcome of these discussions.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om vooruit te lopen op de uitkomst van deze gesprekken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Jasper van Dijk en Teunissen over de onveilige situatie in Georgië voor asielzoekers met een LHBTI-achtergrond

MPs Kröger, Van Dijk and Teunissen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether Georgia remains unsafe for LHBTI asylum seekers and whether it should stop being treated as a safe country of origin for this group, including whether removals should be halted. The State Secretary replied that the designation of Georgia as a safe country of origin continues, with heightened attention for LHBTI cases, that no change in the situation is seen, and that no halt to removals is warranted, while declining to comment on individual cases.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Koekkoek en Teunissen over het bericht over mogelijke push back van een groep van 27 vluchtelingen op het Griekse eiland Lesbos

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary about reports of a group of 27 refugees hiding on Lesbos to avoid alleged pushback, including claims of a pushback of a minor, unlawful strip searches of detained activists, Greek laws criminalising aid and restricting lawyers, and the status of an independent EU monitoring mechanism. The government answered that it awaits findings from Greek and EU investigations, supports an independent monitoring mechanism, notes the Commission is responsible for enforcement, and does not accept that pushbacks are normal practice.
In the absence of independent information, I await the results of such investigations.
Bij het ontbreken van eigenstandige informatie wacht ik de resultaten van dergelijke onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de  antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het geweld in Chora in juni 2007

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about earlier answers on the 2007 fighting in Chora, Uruzgan, including artillery accuracy, civilian casualties, self-defence claims and the Dutch role. The Minister of Defence defended the troops' conduct, gave partial answers, withheld details citing ongoing legal proceedings and referred several questions to earlier answers or to NATO, Australia and other bodies.
On details that are still under discussion or assessment by the court in the legal case, no statements are made in the interest of the legal proceedings.
Over details die in de rechtszaak nog onderwerp zijn van discussie of van beoordeling door de rechter, worden in het belang van de rechtsgang geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij luchtaanvallen in Afghanistan

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands was involved in airstrikes in Afghanistan via drone intelligence, and asked about casualties, civilian harm, and parliamentary notification. The Minister answered that the drone article concerned Iraq and Inherent Resolve, that Dutch PED capacity also supported Resolute Support in Afghanistan from 2019 (already notified to parliament), and that this capacity has now ended.
However, this deployment did not concern Afghanistan and was likewise not carried out by the Netherlands.
Deze inzet betrof echter niet Afghanistan en werd evenmin uitgevoerd door Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opvangplekken bij het COA

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the decline and recent shortage of COA reception places, the waiting times for status holders, the lack of local support, and proposals for smaller, evenly spread shelters and reserve capacity. The State Secretary answered at length, explaining that places fluctuate with inflow and expiring municipal agreements, giving occupancy and processing figures, announcing temporary emergency shelters and reserve funding, but declining to commit to the SP's proposals.
I agree that it is undesirable for neighbours to rent or buy up premises to prevent asylum seekers or permit holders from moving in.
Ik ben het met u eens dat het onwenselijk is dat buurtbewoners panden huren of opkopen om zo te voorkomen dat er asielzoekers of vergunninghouders komen te wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Ter Apel overvol is

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about overcrowding at the Ter Apel asylum registration centre, including people sleeping in tents and on chairs, and why the surge was not foreseen and whether COA and the municipality have enough means to tackle nuisance. The State Secretary acknowledged the situation is unacceptable, described measures taken (extra provincial places, emergency locations, a 150,000 euro grant to Westerwolde, a toolbox against nuisance) and said the capacity shortage was not foreseen.
I deeply regret that. Together with the parties involved, I am doing everything to prevent this situation in the future.
Dat betreur ik zeer. Met de betrokken partijen doe ik er alles aan om deze situatie in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over statushouders die niet kunnen naturaliseren

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked why recognised refugees and their children who cannot obtain foreign documents cannot naturalise, and whether they should be exempted from the document requirement. The State Secretary replied that the document requirement applies in principle, that individual cases can be assessed case by case, and that she will not create a categorical exemption.
No, I am not willing to create a categorical exemption.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid een categoriale vrijstelling te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over de dreigende uitzetting van een Armeens gezin

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Hijink asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why an Armenian family, whose children were born and raised in the Netherlands and who appear to fall under the children's pardon, faces deportation, and whether the IND can correct the procedural error. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, stated that the Afsluitingsregeling conditions apply without requiring Dutch birth, rejected the claim of arbitrariness and the call for discretionary power, and said the case will not be reviewed again once proceedings are concluded.
As your House is aware, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat met levens van onschuldige kinderen wordt gespeeld

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a Yazidi family was being deported to Armenia despite family members being killed there, why asylum processing took over ten years, why threats carry little weight, whether deporting minors who have lived long in the Netherlands conflicts with Article 8 ECHR, and whether the case would be re-examined. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, explained the general asylum assessment, balancing and objection procedures, and noted that the IND is handling the lawyer's objection.
Because the article concerns an individual case, I cannot respond on the substance.
Omdat het artikel over een individuele zaak gaat kan ik niet op de inhoud reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de voortdurende overlast van asielzoekers in het openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about recurring violent incidents and threats by asylum seekers on public transport, including bus drivers' reluctance to check tickets, and whether the government will take responsibility and provide permanent security. The State Secretary said incidents are unacceptable and that police and carriers do not register nationality, promised to weigh nuisance in COA placement decisions, and pointed to a 1 million euro local measures scheme while stating a letter to parliament was sent.
The police and transport operators do not register by nationality or residence status.
De politie en vervoerders registreren niet op nationaliteit noch op verblijfsstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over een commandant die zijn bemanning niet wil laten testen

SP MPs asked whether a navy commander refusing to test crew with Covid-19 symptoms on Zr.Ms. Rotterdam was acceptable and what Defence policy is. The Minister says medical care aboard is the commander's responsibility, Defence follows government policy with exceptions for operational readiness, and crew were quarantined and tested only on return.
That is why Defence chooses, also because of the high vaccination rate, not to test routinely but to treat patients based on the actual clinical picture.
Daarom kiest Defensie ervoor om, ook vanwege de hoge vaccinatiegraad, niet standaard te testen, maar patiënten te behandelen op basis van het daadwerkelijke ziektebeeld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de lobby en vertragingen in zowel het Internationaal Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen (IMVO) op Europees niveau als de Wet Zorgplicht Kinderarbeid op nationaal ni

An MP asked how many meetings the Dutch Permanent Representation to the EU and the minister held with business and civil society on IMVO (due diligence) legislation, and why the Wet Zorgplicht Kinderarbeid was apparently postponed. The minister answered that exact counts cannot be given, described the types of contacts and consultations, and said the child labour law is not postponed but will be folded into broader EU IMVO legislation, with building blocks shared with parliament.
Furthermore, it is impracticable to quantify the number of conversations on IMVO, or other related topics, per stakeholder.
Het is verder ondoenlijk om het aantal gesprekken over IMVO, of andere gerelateerde onderwerpen, te kwantificeren per belanghebbende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verbod van zes Palestijnse niet-gouvernementele organisatiesd

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would object to Israel's designation of six Palestinian NGOs as terrorist organisations, whether it shares concerns about suppression of rights defenders, and whether Dutch-funded organisations would keep their funding. The minister answered that Israel has not yet shared the underlying evidence, that the Netherlands has requested it and is monitoring closely, and that funding to one organisation was suspended in 2020 pending an external review while indirect funding to two others continues.
The information underlying the six listings is not public.
De informatie die ten grondslag ligt aan de zes listings is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Jasper van Dijk over in Nederland geboren Molukkers die stateloos zijn

MPs Paulusma and Van Dijk asked about Dutch-born Moluccans who are stateless but hold Dutch travel documents under the Moluccans Position Act, including how many there are, how naturalisation works, and whether they should be actively informed about the option of Dutch nationality with voting rights. The state secretary answers that about 850 such people hold documents, at least 450 have obtained Dutch nationality over the years, and she is willing to discuss the matter with the Moluccan community while showing restraint in actively promoting nationality, since the Act was a deliberate choice.
I am of course willing to discuss this with representatives of the Moluccan community.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met vertegenwoordigers van de Molukse gemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de oefening Steadfast Noon

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about the NATO nuclear exercise Steadfast Noon: whether it was held, how transparency is handled, which countries take part, the status of New START, and whether Nuclear Sharing should end with the F-35 arrival at Volkel. The minister confirmed the exercise took place with Dutch participation, described transparency efforts, noted New START was extended to 2026, and maintained that the F-35 is meant to take over the nuclear role, declining to comment on other allies' policies.
The cabinet does not make statements about the nuclear weapons policy of other NATO allies.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over het kernwapenbeleid van andere NAVO-bondgenoten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over de situatie van Jezidische slachtoffers

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the Dutch government about the precarious situation of Yazidi victims of IS, including women with children from IS rapists, and whether the Netherlands should create an asylum programme like Germany, France and Canada. The government acknowledged likely genocide and described support programmes, explained that resettlement is UNHCR-led and that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission programme, and outlined revised asylum assessment practice for Yazidis; it did not answer the final question on timing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het verzoek van de ambassade in Kabul om militaire bijstand

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers why they rejected the Kabul embassy's request for military assistance, why it was omitted from the factual account, and why the request came only on 16 August. The ministers replied that no refusal occurred, that the embassy recommended a special forces protection team on 16 August which deployed on 17 August, and that the Taliban's rapid takeover surprised everyone.
There has been no question of rejecting a request for military assistance.
Van afwijzing van een verzoek tot militaire bijstand is geen sprake geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het ingrijpend wijzigen van asielbeleid zonder de Kamer daarover te informeren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the IND changed its family reunification practice for unaccompanied minors without informing parliament, and why the change would reduce children's ability to be reunited with family. The State Secretary replied that the IND's practice was an application of the concept of 'alleenstaand' rather than a policy change, that after an internal inventory she decided to abandon the generic approach and apply it only where a minor is evidently not alone, and that the internal notes and timeline would be provided as an annex.
I informed your House of this decision without delay.
Over dit besluit heb ik uw Kamer onverwijld geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vluchtelingen die vastzitten aan de grens tussen Polen en Wit-Rusland

An SP MP asked the government about migrants stranded at the Polish-Belarusian border, including reported deaths, lack of humanitarian access, and whether Dutch authorities would press Poland and Belarus. The minister answered that the government is concerned, cannot verify conditions due to the state of emergency and access restrictions, has urged Poland to allow humanitarian access and respect EU law, and is supporting EU sanctions and Commission action.
As your House is aware, the cabinet does not have independent information on exactly what is happening at the external borders.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend beschikt het kabinet niet over eigenstandige informatie over wat er aan de buitengrenzen precies gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Omtzigt over het aantal evacuaties vanuit de ambassade in Kaboel

MPs Van Dijk and Omtzigt asked whether the 'three' figure for evacuation exceptions from Kabul was used in government deliberations, and why the minutes of the inter-ministerial meetings are withheld. The minister says the figure was only an order-of-magnitude illustration relayed by phone, that cabinet minutes are confidential to protect the unity of cabinet policy, and that questions cannot be answered within 72 hours.

For this reason, information about the views within the cabinet is not made public, such as minutes of the (Council of) Ministers and preparation for sub-councils, other consultations of ministers and preliminary official deliberations.

Om deze reden wordt informatie over de opvattingen binnen het kabinet niet openbaar, zoals bijvoorbeeld verslagen van de (Rijks)ministerraad en voorbereiding voor onderraden, andere overleggen van bewindslieden en ambtelijke voorportalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het beleid ten aanzien van families van Afghaans-Nederlandse medewerkers

The MP asks whether the cabinet disagreed on applying the IND core-family rule to evacuate relatives of Afghan staff, whether the narrow definition should be widened for dependants, and how arbitrariness is prevented. The ministers answer that the cabinet jointly decided to apply the interpreter family rules to local embassy staff, that 47 dependent family members were admitted case by case as maatwerk rather than a policy change, and that the questions were answered as soon as possible.
This does not concern a policy change, but case-by-case tailoring applied to keep the entire staff working on the evacuation for as long as possible.
Dit betreft geen beleidswijziging, maar maatwerk dat is toegepast om zo lang als mogelijk met de gehele staf te kunnen doorgaan met (het voorbereiden van) de evacuatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de ambassadeur in Afghanistan maar drie van de zestig familieleden van het lokaal ambassadepersoneel mocht evacueren

An SP MP asked the Minister-President whether the ambassador in Kabul was told to evacuate only three of sixty family members of local embassy staff, and whether that figure was a government decision. The Foreign Affairs minister answered that three was an illustrative order of magnitude for 'very restrictive' exceptions communicated by phone, not an absolute cap, that the cabinet later allowed all requested family members to be evacuated, and that the figure was regrettable in how it was conveyed.
To illustrate the conclusion 'very restrictive', the number 3 was mentioned in the exchange as an order of magnitude, without being intended as an absolute number.
Om de conclusie «zeer restrictief» te illustreren is in de uitwisseling het getal 3 als orde van grootte genoemd, zonder dat dat als een absoluut aantal is bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het afwijzen van de asielaanvraag van MH17-getuigen

SP MPs asked why the IND rejected asylum applications from two witnesses in the MH17 case and whether they are adequately protected. The Secretary of State declined to discuss individual cases, explained that IND and witness-team assessments follow different frameworks, and said the OM handles relevance of witness testimony and protection.
I do not provide information about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de verslechterde situatie van vluchtelingen in Griekenland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the deteriorated situation of refugees in Greece, following two Council of State rulings that stopped returns of status holders to Greece. The State Secretary acknowledged the Council of State's conclusion that the interstate trust principle was insufficiently motivated, announced a fact-finding study, and said she would keep pressing the European Commission for solutions on integration support and burden-sharing.
The situation of status holders in Greece must be further examined and assessed by me.
De situatie van statushouders in Griekenland dient door mij nader te worden onderzocht en beoordeeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri en Van der Werf over de grondhouding bij de beoordeling van asielzaken door de IND en de rol van taalexperts bij het beantwoorden van vragen over de identiteit

MPs Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri and Van der Werf asked the State Secretary about the IND's basic attitude toward asylum cases and the use of language experts in identity assessments, citing an internal 2009 discussion paper and a specific Burundi case. The State Secretary answered that the IND does not steer toward rejection, that language analyses are only supplementary indications, and that no independent investigation is needed given court review.
It has never been IND policy, either now or in the past, to primarily steer toward rejecting asylum applications.
Het is nimmer het beleid van IND geweest, in het heden noch het verleden, om primair te sturen op het afwijzen van asielaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het Follow the Money artikel over Nordstream 2 en de Werkgroep Energie

MPs Van der Lee, Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about a Follow the Money report on the Dutch-Russian Energy Working Group, its restart, possible agreements linked to Nord Stream 2, and the protocol and sanctions implications. The minister replies that the working group made no agreements on specific projects such as Nord Stream 2, that the 2018 protocol has no formal status, and that the government keeps a neutral position on Nord Stream 2 as a commercial project.
There was (and is) no question of agreements on specific energy projects, such as Nord Stream 2.
Er was (en is) geen sprake van afspraken over specifieke energieprojecten, zoals Nord Stream 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het terugsturen van vluchtelingen naar Afghanistan

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the deteriorating situation in Afghanistan under the Taliban justifies humanitarian measures, asylum eligibility, and a halt to forced returns. The government answered that it is seriously concerned, outlined humanitarian funding, and announced a decision and departure moratorium for Afghan asylum seekers, with no forced returns to Afghanistan in 2021.
This means in principle that no decisions will be taken on pending and new asylum applications and that Afghan asylum seekers already rejected will not be returned to Afghanistan.
Dit betekent in beginsel dat er geen besluit wordt genomen op lopende en nieuwe asielaanvragen en dat reeds afgewezen Afghaanse asielzoekers niet zullen worden teruggestuurd naar Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een online informatiebijeenkomst over de mogelijke samenwerking tussen Elbit en Nederlandse bedrijven

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a planned online information meeting on cooperation between Israeli arms maker Elbit and Dutch firms, and whether the government would halt it given Palestinian civilian deaths and possible complicity in violations. The minister replied that the government saw no reason to suspend the meeting, and that any future exports would be subject to Dutch export controls that refuse licences where there is a clear risk of serious human rights violations.
The cabinet saw no reason to suspend this information meeting.
Het kabinet zag geen reden om deze informatiebijeenkomst op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen voor Nederland van het Pegasus-hack-schandaal

MPs Van Dijk asked whether the government knew of Pegasus spyware abuse against Dutch politicians, journalists, lawyers and human rights defenders, whether Dutch institutions use the software, and how it views the conviction of Moroccan journalist Omar Radi. The ministers said they were unaware of any list of Dutch targets, that Dutch agencies may use special powers under legal safeguards without disclosing details, that they cannot verify the basis of Radi's conviction, and that they find the surveillance unacceptable while pursuing export controls and cybersecurity norms.
In general, Dutch institutions are not permitted to hack into automated systems.
In het algemeen geldt dat het Nederlandse instellingen niet is toegestaan binnen te dringen in geautomatiseerde werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanhoudende incidenten op de bussen in en rondom Ter Apel

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about persistent incidents against bus drivers on lines in and around Ter Apel, and what steps were taken after a visit and driver letter. The State Secretary said overlap has fallen sharply, the shuttle bus will run fully this year, and that enforcement is a local responsibility, so no intervention is planned, though a one-million-euro specific grant is made available to municipalities.
The decision on security on the bus or placing security at a station does not fall under my responsibility.
De beslissing over beveiliging in de bus noch het plaatsen van beveiliging op een station vallen niet onder mijn bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over sociale rechten van personeel in Nederlandse Defensiewinkels in Duitsland

An MP asked the State Secretary about social rights of staff in Dutch Army Shops in Germany, including whether TVAL II contracts reduce AOW pension accrual and whether the shop staff would receive full AOW later. The minister answered that accrued insurance periods are not lost, that workers are insured in Germany under EU rules, that the Netherlands does not accept the claim of compensation, and that the shops no longer exist.
These temporary workers are not included in Defence's personnel administration; therefore it is also not known how many partners of Dutch military personnel stationed in Germany are involved.
Deze inhuurkrachten zijn niet opgenomen in de personeelsadministratie van Defensie; derhalve is ook niet bekend om hoeveel partners van in Duitsland gelegerde Nederlandse militairen het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijkheden om Hongarije aan te spreken op de anti-lhbti-wet

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister about options to pressure Hungary over its anti-LGBTI law and rule-of-law decline, including a legal scholars' report urging immediate use of the EU rule-of-law conditionality regulation. The minister answers that the Commission should first adopt guidelines and await the CJEU ruling, that the Commission has opened two infringement cases on LGBTI rights, and that the Netherlands will support action in the Article 7 procedure and bilateral channels.
The Netherlands will continue to call Hungary to account at EU level for compliance with the principles of the rule of law, democracy and fundamental rights within the Article 7 procedure.
Daarnaast zal Nederland Hongarije in EU-verband blijven aanspreken op naleving van de beginselen van rechtsstaat, democratie en grondrechten in het kader van de artikel 7-procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over de positie van Nederland als financiële draaischijf in de wapenindustrie

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch tax rules let major arms manufacturers route large sums through the Netherlands to avoid tax, and whether substance requirements and arms-export presumptions of denial should be tightened. The State Secretary of Finance acknowledged that the Dutch tax system has been used for avoidance structures, pointed to existing and planned anti-avoidance measures and a committee on conduit companies, but declined to comment on individual taxpayers and did not commit to tightening substance requirements.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot address the tax position of individual taxpayers.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de lobby en vertragingen in zowel het Internationaal Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen op Europees niveau als de Wet Zorgplicht Kinderarbeid op nationaal niveau

An SP MP asked the Minister of Foreign Trade about business lobbying against IMVO due diligence legislation at EU and national level, the balance of stakeholder consultations, and the delayed implementation of the Dutch Child Labour Due Diligence Act. The Minister denied concrete evidence of a change in VNO-NCW's position, said the EU route is preferred over the national child labour law, and gave no firm timeline for either.
The cabinet considers it necessary that Dutch diplomats in Brussels speak with various stakeholders to obtain as broad a picture as possible of interests relevant to decision-making.

Het kabinet acht het noodzakelijk dat de Nederlandse diplomaten in Brussel met verschillende stakeholders spreken om een zo breed mogelijk beeld te krijgen van belangen die relevant zijn voor besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een lading onderschepte munitie op vliegveld Beek

MP Van Dijk asked the government about a shipment of 500,000 pistol cartridges intercepted at Maastricht Aachen Airport in January 2021 that lacked Dutch permits. The government answered the facts of the seizure and consent, but declined to say whether any criminal investigation exists, citing the Justice Minister's policy.
As you know, the Minister of Justice and Security makes no statements on whether criminal investigations (against certain persons) are ongoing.
Zoals u weet, doet de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen uitspraken over de vraag of er strafrechtelijke onderzoeken (tegen bepaalde personen) lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri en Simons over het rapport 'Onzichtbaar' van de Amsterdamse Ombudsman en het WODC-onderzoek naar mensen zonder rechtmatig verblijf

MPs asked the government about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's estimate that 4-6% of pupils in Amsterdam schools are undocumented, the national share, post-18 education and work prospects, economic costs, and return figures. The minister gave national percentages of students without a BSN, said the national share of undocumented children is likely lower, announced a study on newcomer funding, and declined further research on economic costs and returns, citing the legal framework.
It is not possible to state how many children staying unlawfully in the Netherlands receive national education.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel onrechtmatig in Nederland verblijvende kinderen landelijk onderwijs volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de VS Turkije op een lijst heeft geplaatst van landen die betrokken zijn bij de inzet van Syrië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the US listing Turkey over child soldiers linked to the Sultan Murad Brigade, which the Netherlands had supported, and asked when the government knew, what materiel was supplied, and whether the external inquiry into the NLA programme examines child recruitment. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to publicly name or detail support to specific groups, and pointed to the inquiry's independent mandate without committing to add this aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van Dijk, Piri en Van der Werf over de situatie van de door Nederland naar Bahrein uitgezette asielzoeker A.S.

MPs asked how the government monitors the detention of asylum seeker A.S. in Bahrain, whether he is isolated and mistreated, and what steps Netherlands and the EU take to secure his release. The minister says the embassy follows the case through regular human rights work, has raised concerns with Bahraini authorities, cannot confirm the reported conditions yet, and will continue to press for better detention conditions.
The Netherlands nevertheless follows A.S.'s case as part of the embassy in Kuwait's regular human rights work.
Nederland volgt evenwel de zaak van A.S. als onderdeel van het reguliere mensenrechtenwerk van de ambassade in Koeweit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Werf en Piri over het terugsturen van Soedanese afgewezen asielzoekers naar Soedan

MPs from four parties asked the State Secretary about deportations of rejected Sudanese asylum seekers, including the use of language analysis, reports of ill-treatment after return, and possible contact with Sudanese intelligence officers at the embassy. The State Secretary defended the procedures as careful, said language analysis is only a supplementary indication, and maintained that there is no reason to believe returnees are targeted merely for returning.
A language analysis is only used as a supplementary instrument, namely when there is serious doubt about the stated country of origin.
Een taalanalyse wordt alleen als aanvullend instrument ingezet, namelijk wanneer er ernstige twijfel bij het gestelde land van herkomst is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Bromet, Ceder en Kuzu over het beschermen van Afghanen die werkzaam waren voor Nederland tijdens de Afghanistanmissies

MPs from six parties asked the cabinet why it is not doing more to quickly bring Afghan interpreters and other former local staff who worked for Dutch missions to safety, including questions on the asylum process, document problems, non-interpreter staff, and a deportation moratorium. The ministers answered that additional staff were deployed, interpreters' remaining requirements were dropped, about 43 interpreters had arrived since June, non-interpreters are assessed individually and generously, and the moratorium's extension will be decided later.
The cabinet is taking all steps within its own power to bring the interpreters and their families to the Netherlands as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet onderneemt alle stappen die binnen het eigen vermogen liggen om de tolken en hun gezinnen op een zo kort mogelijke termijn naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Kuzu over ‘De Nederlandse militairen zijn weg uit Afghanistan, maar hun tolken lopen gevaar’

MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers about Afghan interpreters and guards who worked for the Dutch mission still awaiting admission, including passport delays, EUPOL interpreters and exclusion of guards. The government gave detailed figures, explained passport and identity-verification obstacles, said it will consider guards case by case, and answered that each question would be addressed separately.
The cabinet makes maximum efforts to do what is possible if an applicant does not have a passport.
Het kabinet zet zich maximaal in om te doen wat mogelijk is indien een aanvrager niet over een paspoort beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de VS achter het voorstel staat om de patenten van de coronavaccins vrij te geven

MPs Hijink and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government supports the US position backing a waiver of COVID-19 vaccine patents, the EU's role as a blocker in the WTO, and whether Netherlands will back patent suspension. The minister answered that the government supports broad vaccine access, will press the European Commission to engage constructively in the WTO, but does not endorse the India/South Africa waiver as proposed and rejects several premises of the questions.

In line with the Piri et al. motion (Kamerstuk 35 663, no. 21), the cabinet will urge the European Commission to engage constructively within the WTO on proposals for temporary suspension of patents on COVID-19 vaccines.

In lijn met de motie Piri c.s. (Kamerstuk 35 663, nr. 21 ) zal het kabinet er bij de Europese Commissie op aandringen dat de EU constructief engageert binnen de WTO wat betreft voorstellen tot tijdelijke opschorting van patenten op coronavaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat asielkinderen dreigen te worden uitgezet ondanks de Afsluitingsregeling

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security why children who have lived long in the Netherlands risk deportation despite the Afsluitingsregeling, and questions the strictness of the availability criterion, the treatment of children born during or after asylum procedures, and unequal treatment of applicants. The State Secretary defends the criteria as a deliberate balance of responsibility, admits some applicants were rejected on the availability criterion, acknowledges an earlier lenient practice on M35-K forms was abandoned, and states that the scheme is now closed and no further claims can be made.
It is inherent in setting conditions and contra-indications that some people will not meet them, resulting in rejection of the application and an obligation to leave.
Het is inherent aan het stellen van voorwaarden en contra-indicaties dat er ook mensen niet voldoen, met een afwijzing van de aanvraag en een vertrekplicht tot gevolg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over falend schuldenbeleid van de Belastingdienst

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten (SP) asked why the Tax Administration offset benefit debts without applying the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) and how it will fix this and inform debtors. The State Secretary admits the practice was wrong, promises talks with the Ombudsman and LOSR, outlines plans to improve information and access to payment arrangements, and refers to an attached letter for details.
Given the purpose and intent of the Simplification of the Protected Minimum Act, I now conclude together with Toeslagen and the Tax Administration that this method should not have been applied.
Gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (Wet vBVV) concludeer ik nu met Toeslagen en de Belastingdienst dat deze werkwijze niet had mogen worden toegepast.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Van der Plas, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder en Eppink over het bericht dat Indonesië dreigt met 'uitroeiing' separatisten op Papoea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Indonesia threatened to 'eradicate' Papuan separatists, the killing of an intelligence officer, fears of disproportionate military violence and displacement, Papuans' political rights, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that Indonesia has security duties but concerns about military presence, civilian harm and rights restrictions are shared, and said the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue without intervening in foreign court cases.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indonesian authorities for a meaningful dialogue between all parties involved.
Nederland zal bij de Indonesische autoriteiten blijven aandringen op een betekenisvolle dialoog, tussen alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Kuzu en Ceder over de noodsituatie van de Afghaanse tolken

MPs from five parties asked the Defence Minister how many Afghan interpreters and their families had arrived in the Netherlands in June 2021, how many remain in Afghanistan, and what is being done to speed up their transfer and protect them. The government answered with case counts (90 families arrived since 2014, 84 active applications in Afghanistan, 113 rejected), listed measures to accelerate processing, and said the embassy in Kabul will remain open if security allows.
For security reasons I cannot go into these measures.
Omwille van veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over RANOV-vergunninghouders

An SP MP asked why the State Secretary has not yet implemented parliamentary motions to exempt RANOV permit holders from nationality requirements for naturalisation, why minors born after the pardon are excluded, and why a WODC study must be awaited first. The State Secretary answered that the policy change took effect on 1 June 2021, refers to a letter on migration policy for the policy response, explains existing rules for minors' naturalisation, and states that an up-to-date picture is needed before deciding.

As I have previously informed your House, in my view an up-to-date picture is necessary to reach a carefully considered decision, in which the wish of the House is also an essential part of this consideration.

Zoals ik uw Kamer eerder heb geïnformeerd is mijns inziens een actueel beeld noodzakelijk om tot een zorgvuldig afgewogen beslissing te komen, waarbij ook de wens van de Kamer een essentieel onderdeel is van deze afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over eerdere antwoorden over burgerdoden in Uruzgan

The SP MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers many questions about the use of force and civilian casualties during the June 2007 defence of Chora, Afghanistan, including rules of engagement, artillery accuracy, civilian warnings and investigations. The government answered that the Dutch troops acted lawfully under humanitarian law and self-defence, withheld some operational details and classified logs citing NATO rules and the ongoing court case, and rejected calls for an independent inquiry.
To avoid disrupting the legal proceedings, no statements can be made about certain details of the deployment in question while the matter is before the court.
Om de rechtsgang niet te verstoren, kunnen zo lang deze kwestie onder de rechter is geen uitspraken worden gedaan over enkele details van de inzet in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een onderzoek van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad naar aanleiding van het recente geweld in Gaza

MPs Jasper van Dijk asked why the Netherlands abstained on a UN Human Rights Council resolution to investigate the Gaza violence, and questioned impunity, aid and settlement expansion. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports independent investigation but abstained because the mandate was broad, permanent and overlapping with existing bodies, and set out aid contributions and opposition to settlements.

For these reasons the Netherlands, together with 13 other countries including France, Denmark, Italy and Poland, abstained from the vote and explained this during the Human Rights Council in an Explanation of Vote.

Nederland heeft zich vanwege deze redenen samen met 13 andere landen, waaronder Frankrijk, Denemarken, Italië en Polen onthouden van stemming en dit tijdens de Mensenrechtenraad toegelicht in een Explanation of Vote.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Alkaya over ‘het oliebedrijf Pluspetrol dat belasting ontwijkt in Nederland en het milieu vervuilt en mensenrechten schendt in Peru’

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked the minister about Pluspetrol, which allegedly avoids tax in the Netherlands, pollutes and violates human rights in Peru, and refused OECD National Contact Point mediation. The minister answered that tax matters of individual firms cannot be discussed, that the NCP has declared the complaint admissible while Pluspetrol declined mediation, and that the government is pursuing stronger IMVO due diligence legislation.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act, the cabinet cannot comment on the tax position of an individual company.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Libische kustwacht migranten op verzoek van Frontex onderschept

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether Frontex permits or orchestrates Libyan coast guard interceptions and returns of migrants in breach of international law, and about reported pushbacks and Frontex's response. The government answered that it follows the reports closely, that Frontex has explained its cooperation with the Libyan coast guard within SAR obligations, that internal and external investigations (Management Board, European Ombudsman, Parliament, OLAF) are ongoing, and that it will push for normalised disembarkation and safe ports.
In addition, the final report of the working group can be found on the Frontex website, and the Management Board has published conclusions following this report.
10 Daarnaast is het finale rapport van de werkgroep te vinden op de website van Frontex 11 en heeft de Management Board naar aanleiding van dit rapport conclusies gepubliceerd 12 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een Surinaams verzoek om hulp in de strijd tegen het coronavirus

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Suriname's request for COVID-19 help and why the Netherlands had not yet replied. The minister answered that oxygen containers and protective equipment were sent, 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were dispatched, and vaccine deliveries were promised from week 25 subject to supply.
On 9 June, the government sent 90,000 doses of AstraZeneca plus needles and syringes to Suriname.
Op 9 juni jl. heeft de regering 90.000 doses AstraZeneca plus naalden en spuiten naar Suriname gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht 'NS schrapt 341 banen; station zonder personeel wordt de norm'

SP MPs asked the government about news that NS would cut 341 station staff jobs, questioning whether this conflicts with its stated view that staff are essential and whether volunteers or temporary agency workers are displacing paid work. The minister and state secretary answered that NS decides its own staffing, cites falling counter sales and online ticketing, says safety is covered by camera monitoring and concession obligations, and commits only to help affected staff find other work within NS.
It is up to NS to determine where NS can deploy its personnel most effectively, taking into account the changing needs of travellers.
Het is aan NS om te bepalen waar NS haar personeel het meest effectief kan inzetten, waarbij NS rekening houdt met de veranderende behoefte van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over het duperen van bijstandontvangers met schulden

SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about benefit recipients with debts who were given too low a protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) because of errors in the new debt-collection system, asking about remedies, deputies' responsibilities, and fixes. The minister acknowledged the problems, explained they stem from implementation issues and gemeenten's vacation-allowance reporting, described repayment efforts via the KBvG, and committed to keeping the House informed and to exploring a permanent solution.
I will keep your House regularly informed of progress.
Ik zal uw Kamer regelmatig op de te hoogte houden van de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Piri, Van der Staaij en Jasper van Dijk over de dreigende executie van een Egyptische monnik

MPs from four parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she knew of Amnesty's appeal on the death sentence of Egyptian monk Wael Tawadros, whether torture-based confession and unfair trial could be confirmed, and whether she would press Egypt and the EU to stop the execution. The minister answered that she could not independently verify the allegations, noted rising executions in Egypt, and reported that Tawadros had already been executed on 9 May 2021, with Dutch and EU concern conveyed to Egyptian authorities at senior official level.
I therefore do not have independent information that confirms or refutes these reports, and can therefore give no further judgment on them.
Ik beschik derhalve niet over eigenstandige informatie die deze berichtgeving bevestigt dan wel ontkracht, en kan daar dan ook geen verder oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over uitleveringen en uitzettingen aan Rwanda

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about extraditions and expulsions to Rwanda, citing a critical Nederlands Juristenblad article on the country's human rights and fair-trial situation. The government replied that it sees no reason to change policy, points to ICJ monitoring of the 2016 extraditees' trials and to the lack of found due-process violations, and says it shares some NGO concerns while engaging Rwanda on them.
The cabinet sees no reason in this article to adopt different policy regarding extradition to Rwanda.
Het kabinet ziet in dit artikel geen reden om tot een ander beleid met betrekking tot uitlevering naar Rwanda te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het verlenen van een wapenexportvergunning voor Brazilië

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked whether a Dutch arms export licence for radar and C3 systems to the Brazilian navy (Thales, Tamandaré-class ships) was granted despite Brazil's Covid-19 crisis, human rights concerns and political turmoil in the military. Minister Kaag declined to give details on commercially confidential matters, said the licence was checked against the EU criteria with extra attention to human rights and regional stability, and saw no reason to reconsider it.
No statements can be made about the details of the application. That concerns commercially confidential information.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over de details van de aanvraag. Dat betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over de aanslagen in Mozambique en de rol van de Nederlandse overheid bij gaswinningsprojecten in deze regio

SP MPs asked why the Dutch government still provides export credit insurance for a Mozambique gas project amid jihadist violence and human rights concerns, and whether it will withdraw. The government answered that the insurance was granted under international standards, that the situation is being monitored, and that the abuses were committed by insurgents rather than the project, so it will continue to monitor and act within policy conditions.
The State and Atradius DSB are closely monitoring the situation and will act appropriately within the terms of the policies, depending on what the situation requires.
De Staat en Atradius DSB volgen de situatie nauwgezet en zullen op passende wijze handelen binnen de voorwaarden van de polissen en al naargelang waar de situatie om vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het ongevraagd uitkeren van een te hoog kindgebonden budget

Two SP MPs asked why the Tax Administration over-pays the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget) to migrant workers and why these people face large recoveries, and how many cases are known. The ministers answer that the system relies on BRN/BSN partner data which is often missing for partners abroad, describe partial fixes and planned improvements, and say they will review collection policy and make some changes but do not quantify harm or commit to individual redress.
It is not known in how many cases the Tax Administration wrongly assumes there is no partner.
Het is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen er door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onterecht wordt uitgegaan dat geen sprake is van een toeslagpartner.
