Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over etikettering van producten uit illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An SP MP asked the government about a fine imposed on a wine importer for mislabelling products from Israeli settlements, whether duties are correctly levied on them, and how much is imported from settlements. The minister confirmed the fine, explained that origin labelling is enforced by the NVWA and customs on the basis of EU rules, and said neither the government nor the Commission has figures on settlement trade.
Customs cannot provide information on individual declarations because of its duty of confidentiality under EU customs legislation.
De Douane kan vanwege haar geheimhoudingsplicht op basis van EU-douanewetgeving geen informatie verstrekken over individuele aangiften
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over een column van Rosanne Hertzberger in de NRC over de orthodox-Joodse school Cheider in Amsterdam

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked about alleged abuse at the Cheider school following a newspaper column, including corporal punishment, sexual abuse and a knife threat, and why the Inspectorate had not intervened. Minister Slob replied that recent inspections found no such incidents, that the school was under intensive supervision with sanctions imposed and suspended by a court, and that a bill to expand the Inspectorate's instruments is expected after the summer.
The inspectorate maintains intensive supervision of the school and has imposed two funding sanctions this school year on my behalf.
De inspectie houdt intensief toezicht op de school en heeft in dit schooljaar (2020/2021) namens mij twee bekostigingssancties opgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over discussie in kringen van officieren over de prioriteiten van de bestedingen van Defensie

SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about retired senior officers' doubts over Defence spending priorities, including the cost of nine extra F-35s, pooling with allies, and the Court of Audit's findings. The minister answered that the extra F-35s are necessary for constitutional tasks, that delivery is on schedule and the lifetime cost gap is acknowledged but no measures are taken yet, and that further choices are for a next cabinet.
The current operational target is to guard Dutch airspace 24 hours a day, seven days a week while simultaneously conducting one mission, one-off or long-term, with four aircraft.
De huidige inzetdoelstelling betreft 24 uur per dag, zeven dagen per week het Nederlandse luchtruim bewaken en tegelijkertijd met vier toestellen eenmalig of langdurig één missie uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de escalatie van geweld in Palestina en Israël

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about escalating violence in Israel and Palestine, Israeli evictions in East Jerusalem, the motion on sanctions over annexation, EU association agreement suspension, and the HRW report calling Israel's policy apartheid. The minister answered that the Netherlands urges de-escalation, opposes unilateral actions like evictions, supports continued dialogue and monitoring of annexation, rejects suspending the association agreement, is cautious about the term apartheid, and will respond carefully to the HRW report.
The cabinet is reticent about using characterisations such as "apartheid".
Het kabinet is terughoudend met het gebruiken van kwalificaties zoals «apartheid».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over anonieme bedreiging en intimidatie op huisadressen

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether anonymous intimidation at home addresses by groups such as Vizier op Links is punishable and how victims will be protected. The government said 51 reports and ten complaints have been filed, that the Public Prosecution Service is assessing whether criminal offences occurred, and pointed to local security measures and support for politicians.
The Public Prosecution Service is currently investigating whether the actions in question qualify as criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt momenteel of de betreffende handelingen zich kwalificeren als strafbare feiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij, Jasper van Dijk en Agnes Mulder over de veroordeling van een monnik in Turkije voor het geven van brood aan Koerdische bezoekers, in aanvulling op vragen van het li

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the conviction of a monk in Turkey for giving food to Kurdish visitors, the situation of Christian minorities, and whether EU-Turkey rapprochement and pre-accession aid should continue. The government answered that the Dutch embassy follows the case, that concerns about rule of law and religious freedom in Turkey are raised consistently, and that it has pressed for suspending pre-accession aid, though no Council support exists.
The Netherlands has serious concerns about human rights and the rule of law in Turkey and consistently raises these concerns.
Nederland heeft grote zorgen over de mensenrechten en de rechtsstaat in Turkije en stelt deze zorgen consequent aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht dat online discriminatie geen prioriteit heeft

SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether online discrimination deserves tackling, how many reports and prosecutions occurred in 2019–2020, how much police capacity is devoted to it, and whether platforms take enough responsibility. The minister agreed it deserves tackling, said no separate online figures exist, noted no dedicated police FTE, called for stronger platform action and promised a renewed approach to online discrimination before the summer recess.
No figures are available that show the number of criminal convictions for online discrimination or the number of expressions made inaccessible by providers and platforms.

Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar die inzicht geven in het aantal strafrechtelijke veroordelingen van online discriminatie dan wel het aantal uitingen dat door providers en platformen ontoegankelijk is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Italiaanse maffia vat probeert te krijgen op de miljarden uit het Corona Herstelfonds

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Italian mafia is targeting EU Recovery Fund money, and about oversight of the fund. The minister said the RRF has built-in control, audit and suspension mechanisms that the Commission assesses, that Italy is responsible for controls in the first instance, and that the Netherlands will not submit its plan before 30 April 2021 but a later date has no effect on its allocation.
It is necessary that fraud is prevented in all member states. The agreements made on the functioning of the RRF provide guarantees for this.
Het is noodzakelijk dat fraude wordt voorkomen in alle lidstaten. De gemaakte afspraken over de werking van de RRF bieden hier waarborgen voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over onveiligheid onder buschauffeurs rondom Ter Apel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about insecurity among bus drivers around Ter Apel, including a union survey and reduced enforcement staff. The State Secretary condemned the problem, said the responsibility for staffing and public order lies with the employer and local authorities, and listed measures taken, such as ketenmariniers, a toolbox, and a subsidy for boa's on the bus lines.
The decision on the number of boa's deployed is not mine and does not fall within my responsibility, but within the responsibility of the employer and the local triumvirate of authorities.
De beslissing over de inzet van het aantal boa's ligt niet bij mij en valt ook niet binnen mijn verantwoordelijkheid, maar binnen de verantwoordelijkheid van de werkgever en gezagsdriehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over één mondiaal minimumtarief voor winstbelasting

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked whether the US push for a global minimum corporate tax, the Yellen proposal, is a good tool against a race to the bottom, and what the government will do to avoid Dutch tax-haven reputation. The state secretary answered that Nederland supports the OECD Inclusive Framework Pillar 2 minimum tax and an agreement by mid-2021, distinguished it from the EU CCCTB, and pointed to existing anti-avoidance measures and commitment to promote the plan internationally.
The Netherlands will continue to work to reach agreements in the OECD Inclusive Framework by mid-2021.
Nederland zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten om halverwege 2021 tot afspraken te komen in het Inclusive Framework van de OESO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Ceder, Jasper van Dijk en Piri over de dreigende uitzetting van Amsterdamse modelburgers Sofia en Najoua

MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the threatened deportation of two Amsterdam-raised young women, questioning whether the IND's decision, its appeal against the court ruling and the rules for residence under article 8 ECHR were consistent with the rights of children and the courts' findings. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, noted the IND has withdrawn the appeal and granted residence, and explained general routes and guidance for adults who grew up in the Netherlands without residence status.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases nor into the considerations underlying the decision to lodge an appeal.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken noch op overwegingen die ten grondslag liggen aan het instellen van Hoger Beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de enorme schuld die de SVB een 80-jarige man heeft laten opbouwen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an 80-year-old man who was asked to repay nearly 5,000 euros after the SVB took a year to investigate a changed living situation, and whether similar cases exist. The minister explained that home visits were suspended during COVID, 14 comparable cases were identified and are being reassessed individually, and telephone investigations have since replaced home visits to prevent such delays.
In the case described in the Stentor, the assessment mistakenly did not follow the new work instructions.
In de casus zoals beschreven in de Stentor is de beoordeling abusievelijk niet conform de nieuwe werkinstructies verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland nog steeds een claimparadijs is voor buitenlandse bedrijven

MPs Alkaya and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked why the Netherlands remains a 'claim paradise' for foreign companies under investment treaties, why renegotiation has stalled, how many ISDS claims have been filed from the Netherlands, and whether investors should first exhaust domestic courts. Minister Kaag answered that renegotiations with six countries are slow due to COVID restrictions, reported 114 ISDS claims per UNCTAD without further monitoring, rejected mandatory exhaustion of domestic remedies, and committed to resuming renegotiations as soon as partners allow.
The cabinet does not have more information or more means to collect and report on ISDS claims than UNCTAD.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over meer informatie c.q. meer mogelijkheden om informatie te verzamelen en te rapporteren over ISDS claims dan de UNCTAD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de zorg dat Wajongers erop achteruitgaan

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether Wajong recipients are losing income under the new law despite the guarantee amount, and about delays and the union FNV's warnings. The minister says UWV is urgently analysing possible unintended causes of income loss, reports that about 10,000 of 20,000 delayed guarantee amounts are now set, and says extra staff is not the solution while migration conversations are postponed to the second half of 2021.
I am carrying out an urgent analysis with UWV into the reasons for income loss.
Ik voer samen met UWV met urgentie een analyse uit naar de redenen van inkomensverlies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat sekswerkers tijdens de lockdown met meer geweld te maken krijgen

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked why sex workers, many outside the income-support schemes during the lockdown, face more violence and financial distress and whether a special support measure and police assurances for victims are planned. The minister acknowledged the concern, explained which schemes (Tozo, WW, NOW, bijstand, TONK) may apply depending on employment status, said the police will not fine victims reporting crime, and promised to raise the signals with municipalities.
The cabinet has asked municipalities to apply the TONK generously.
Het kabinet heeft gemeenten verzocht de TONK ruimhartig toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeets, Kuik, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Piri over het bericht ‘Tina en Jacob moeten weg!’

MPs from D66, CDA, SP, ChristenUnie and PvdA asked whether Armenian Syrians facing revocation of asylum status are treated unequally, and why some keep their permits while others lose them. The State Secretary answered that re-assessment is individual, that the IND does not register these figures, and that a 2021 court ruling concerned insufficient reasoning on equality, not discrimination.
The requested numerical data cannot be provided.
De gevraagde cijfermatige gegeven kunnen niet verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Ceder, Kuik en Koekkoek over de mogelijke uitzetting van Tina en Jacob

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Tina and Jacob, Syrian-Armenians, faced deportation to Armenia and whether their family ties and residence in the Netherlands should count. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case on privacy and confidentiality grounds, explained the IND's general approach to dual nationals and safe third countries, and noted that the IND had granted a residence permit.
As said, I cannot go into the individual case.
Zoals gezegd kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over een radiouitzending over het Essexdrama waarbij 39 slachtoffers vielen

SP MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked about an Argos radio broadcast on the Essex tragedy, the police surveillance of two Vietnamese minors, the lawyer's exclusion, why no Dutch prosecutions followed, and alleged pressure on the EMM report. The state secretary defended the police and prosecution handling, said no concrete suspicion arose, gave limited figures on missing Vietnamese minors, and declined to order a new investigation.
It is generally not customary to inform a lawyer about the progress of a police investigation.
Het is in het algemeen niet gebruikelijk om een advocaat te informeren over de voortgang van een politioneel onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Jasper van Dijk over de zware omstandigheden op Lesbos en Kamp Moria 2.0

An MP asked the State Secretary about harsh conditions at Lesbos camps (Moria 2.0), including sanitation, lead contamination, winterization, and the age of unaccompanied minors. The government answered that Mavrovouni is better than Moria in most respects, that toilet ratios meet standards, that lead levels in living zones are within limits with precautionary measures, and it listed Dutch financial contributions.
The government is therefore not planning to join the call of the various organisations.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens om zich aan te sluiten bij de oproep van de verschillende organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over 'onveilige distributiecentra'

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that seven in ten distribution centres violated COVID and safety rules, and about enforcement, sanctions and worker safety. The minister acknowledged the concern, described Inspectorate SZW's inspections, enforcement tools and the temporary shutdown power, but declined to provide a list of individual violations and gave no exact figures for migrant workers infected at work.
I cannot make statements about individual companies or ongoing investigations, nor provide lists.
Over individuele bedrijven of lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen of lijsten aanleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over het niet uitvoeren van de motie over de naturalisatie van circa 10.000 pardonners (Ranov-vergunninghouders

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Van Toorenburg asked why the government has not implemented a motion to speed up naturalisation of about 10,000 Ranov permit holders, given earlier reports, and whether it will implement the motion immediately. The State Secretary answers that she knows the earlier reports but has commissioned additional research into the current group and its obstacles, with results expected in July 2021, which are relevant to how the motion will be implemented.

For this purpose I have commissioned additional research, in which I asked to map the current group of Ranov permit holders and the obstacles they currently experience in submitting a naturalisation application.

Hiervoor heb ik een aanvullend onderzoek ingesteld, waarbij ik gevraagd heb de actuele groep Ranov-vergunninghouders en de knelpunten die zij op dit moment ervaren voor het indienen van een naturalisatieverzoek in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat dak- en thuislozen in Breda gekort worden op hun uitkering omdat de 'financiële prikkel' ontbrak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Breda cut social assistance for homeless people to create a financial incentive to leave homelessness, and whether this is acceptable and whether it has helped anyone. The minister answered that municipalities may lower the assistance norm when housing costs are absent or low, that individual assessment applies, that scrutiny of Breda is for the municipal council rather than the national government, and that no national change is planned.
The municipal council is primarily responsible for monitoring the municipal executive in this matter, not the national government, which should not pass judgment on it.
Het is primair de gemeenteraad die de bevoegd- en verantwoordelijkheid heeft om het college van B&W in deze te controleren, en niet aan het Rijk om hier een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Groothuizen, Van Ojik en Jasper van Dijk over pushbacks van vluchtelingen door de Kroatische grensbewaking

MPs asked the State Secretary whether she knew of Danish Refugee Council and EenVandaag reports of pushbacks and violence by Croatian border guards, and whether she would raise them at EU Justice and Home Affairs Council, press the Commission, reconsider mutual trust in Croatia and address the damage to EU asylum policy. The State Secretary said the allegations are serious and must be investigated, that the subject was discussed at the January 2021 JHA Council and under Croatia's Schengen action plan, that the Commission is in dialogue with Croatia and is setting up an independent monitoring mechanism, and that mutual trust applies unless a court rules otherwise.
No court rulings have been made regarding Croatia that would mean the principle of mutual trust can no longer be assumed.
Over Kroatië zijn in dezen geen rechterlijke uitspraken gedaan die tot gevolg hebben dat niet langer kan worden uitgegaan van het interstatelijk vertrouwensbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het herleven van een studieschuld na afronding van een WSNP

SP MPs asked why people who exited a debt-restructuring (WSNP) procedure received letters demanding resumption of student loan repayments at amounts unaffordable on a modest income, and whether DUO would soften this. The minister explained repayment is frozen during the procedure, admitted the letters can be unexpected and too high before income-based assessment, and said DUO will now phone debtors first where income is unknown and clarify the letters.
After consultation with DUO, it has therefore been decided no longer to announce the resumption of collection solely by letter.
Na overleg met DUO is dan ook besloten om niet langer uitsluitend per brief aan te kondigen dat de inning wordt herstart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het SchuldenLabNL

MPs asked why the government appointed former finance minister Zalm, who is under OM investigation for money laundering, as chair of SchuldenLabNL, and whether private creditors would cooperate on debts of parents in the childcare benefits affair. The state secretary replied that SchuldenLabNL is an independent foundation the cabinet had no role in appointing its board, that the board is unpaid, and that talks with public and private creditors are ongoing to give affected parents a fresh start.
The cabinet has no involvement whatsoever in appointing Mr Zalm as chair or in appointing the other board members of SchuldenLabNL.
Het kabinet heeft geen enkele bemoeienis met het benoemen van de heer Zalm als voorzitter alsmede met de benoeming van andere leden van het bestuur van SchuldenlabNL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de afgebroken CAO-onderhandelingen bij de supermarkten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the record supermarket turnover in 2020 and early 2021 justifies a wage increase for supermarket staff, and whether the minister would appeal to employers and raise the minimum wage. The minister answered that wage bargaining in the supermarket CAO is for the social partners, declined to intervene or make a moral appeal, and said he does not intend to raise the statutory minimum wage in the remaining cabinet term.
It is up to the employers' and employees' organisations involved to negotiate the working conditions and conclude a collective agreement.
Het is aan de betrokken werkgevers(organisaties) en werknemersorganisaties om te onderhandelen over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en een cao af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het mislopen van noodsteun

An SP MP asks whether the government will provide a remedy for a startup hospitality entrepreneur excluded from COVID emergency support, and whether it will prevent forced closure. The government responds that a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will cover startups founded between October 2019 and July 2020, with separate subsidy and expanded loan facilities.
That is why the cabinet chose to introduce a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme as part of the recent expansion of the support and recovery package.
Daarom heeft het kabinet ervoor gekozen om bij de recente uitbreiding van het steun- en herstelpakket een nieuwe regeling Tegemoetkoming Starters te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het in één keer ontvangen van 54 aanmaningen van het CJIB

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked why a childcare-benefit affair victim received 54 reminder letters from the CJIB at once, and what the government will do to prevent this and stop collection of debts owed by victims. The State Secretary explains the letters were automatically generated per open case, the CJIB has taken measures to prevent bulk dispatch, and public creditors are being asked to pause collection of debts of victims while stating that fines from criminal convictions are excluded.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘het rücksichtslos afsluiten van energie in een seniorenwoning’

An SP MP asked why an energy network operator disconnected a pensioner's flat for six months without arranging a new connection or a settlement, and whether rules should be tightened. The minister answers that the disconnection followed the prescribed policy after repeated warnings and a court ruling, that the recent Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening amendment and a covenant will reduce disconnections, and sees no need for further talks with Stedin.
Disconnecting energy may therefore not simply be done.
Afsluiten van energie mag dan ook niet zomaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over overlastgevende asielzoekers in de omgeving van AZC Budel

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about nuisance by asylum seekers around the AZC Budel reception centre, including a police response failure, use of 'knokploegen', and renovation plans. The State Secretary answers that nuisance is unacceptable, that police capacity is a matter for the regional mayor and police chief, that a range of measures (ketenmariniers, Top-X list, htl placement, sober reception) is in place, and that the renovation does not increase places and the municipality and COA continue dialogue.
The regional mayor and the regional police chief are responsible for local police capacity.
De regioburgemeester en de regionale politiechef gaan over de lokale politiecapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "de rol van het Inlichtingenbureau bij de opsporing van bijstandsfraude"

An SP MP asked the government about the role, powers and democratic control of the private Inlichtingenbureau in detecting benefit fraud, including its legal status, complaint routes and data sharing. The minister answers that the bureau is an information intermediary without investigative powers, is accountable via its annual report, audit and the minister as principal, and that a decree amendment will make it jointly responsible for data processing with municipalities.
The IB itself has no investigative powers and is not further involved in enforcing against possible benefit fraud.
Zelf heeft het IB geen opsporingsbevoegdheid en het IB is niet verder betrokken bij de handhaving op mogelijke uitkeringsfraude.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Jasper van Dijk en Kuiken over de bureaucratie waarmee Ranov-vergunninghouders worden tegengewerkt bij het verkrijgen van het Nederlanderschap

MPs Van Ojik, Van Dijk and Kuiken asked why Ranov permit holders who have lived in the Netherlands for decades must meet a strict document requirement to naturalise, and whether the requirement should be dropped or Ranov permits converted to asylum permits. The State Secretary answers that individual exceptions are possible, that Ranov holders were found not to need protection and can be expected to obtain documents from their country of origin, and that a new WODC study will examine problems Ranov holders experience.

The policy ensures that, in the naturalisation procedure, the personal details and current possession of a foreign nationality are as far as possible known and demonstrated for foreigners with a regular right of residence.

Het beleid borgt dat in de naturalisatieprocedure zo goed als mogelijk de persoonsgegevens en het actueel bezit van de vreemde nationaliteit bekend en aangetoond zijn van vreemdelingen met een regulier verblijfrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gedeeltelijke sluiting van sociale werkvoorziening DZB in Leiden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the partial closure of Leiden's sheltered employment company DZB due to financial shortfalls, the reorganisation and works council involvement, and a motion on preventing sw-company closures. The State Secretary declined to judge the municipality's decisions, stating responsibility lies with municipalities, noting a 140 million euro COVID compensation for 2020, and that the appreciation of the initiative note would follow separately.
I have no view on the article, because responsibility for how the implementation of the Participation Act is organised is reserved for municipalities.
Ik heb geen oordeel over het artikel, omdat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de wijze waarop de uitvoering van de Participatiewet wordt vormgegeven is voorbehouden aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ZZP-ers die nog steeds geweerd worden bij schuldhulpverlening

An MP asked why some municipalities still exclude self-employed people (ZZP'ers) from debt assistance, whether this was reported to parliament, and how they can complain. The minister answers that the amended Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening from 1 January 2021 gives stronger rights, that refusals must be motivated in a decision subject to objection and appeal, and that support measures and campaigns are being used to push municipalities to act.
Access to help can only be refused with a reasoned decision.
Toegang tot hulp kan alleen met een gemotiveerde beschikking worden geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over het veel te snel aanmerken van bijstandsgerechtigden als fraudeur

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether a Wijdemeren benefit recipient was wrongly branded a fraudster and ordered to repay 7,000 euros plus a 50 percent fine for gifts of groceries from her mother, and whether the Participatiewet is too harsh and should be reformed. The state secretary declines to discuss the individual case, acknowledges concerns about hardship, promises general frameworks on gifts, a signalling team, round tables and a review of the fraud definition by summer 2021, while maintaining that the inlichtingenplicht must be enforced and that municipalities may waive repayment in urgent cases.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over "het gebruik van NOW in de eredivisie"

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Eredivisie clubs spending 74 million euros on transfers while receiving NOW wage subsidies was acceptable, and about the club aid package, adviser Klaas Dijkhof's role, and bonuses. The minister answered that the NOW uses a 20% revenue-loss threshold and group-level assessment, that transfer figures could not be verified because they are confidential, that further support is only a last resort after clubs exhaust their own options, and that bonuses are barred under NOW rules, with the minister referring the adviser question to Dijkhof himself.
Since this involves commercially sensitive information, it is not possible to verify the stated amounts.
Aangezien het hier bedrijfsgevoelige informatie betreft, is het niet mogelijk om de genoemde bedragen te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over arbeidsmigranten in verloederde huizen

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Interior about a landlord repeatedly linked to exploiting migrant workers and letting dilapidated housing, and about how municipalities and the government can prevent such landlords moving between municipalities. The Minister answered that enforcement lies mainly with municipalities, pointed to a regional pilot, knowledge sharing, planned tools such as a landlord permit and a blacklist review, and promised further letters including a government response to the migrant worker task force.
Enforcement of these abuses lies with the municipalities concerned themselves.
De handhaving van deze misstanden ligt bij de betrokken gemeenten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over geweld en agressie tegenover arbeidsmigranten en vakbondsmedewerkers

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a violent assault on a FNV union employee at a bungalow park housing migrant workers, whether the incident would be investigated, and how union and inspection access to such housing can be guaranteed. The minister condemned the violence, said the police handle the criminal complaint, stated that the Labour Inspectorate has access to migrant housing and can be threatened or refused access in isolated cases, and pointed to ongoing government programmes on migrant worker protection.
I cannot comment on this specific case. It is up to the police to investigate this matter following the complaint of assault.
Over dit specifieke geval kan ik geen uitspraken doen. Het is aan de politie om deze zaak, naar aanleiding van de aangifte van mishandeling, te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met naturalisatie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why long-term regular residents who lack identity or nationality documents, including those who regularised under the 2007 Ranov/general pardon scheme, cannot obtain naturalisation, and whether the document requirement should be dropped. The State Secretary explained that exceptions exist for 'good reasons' on a case-by-case basis, that embassies usually cannot issue birth certificates, and that the policy will not be changed, arguing that Ranov holders are generally not stateless.
A change in policy is not being considered.
Een aanpassing van het beleid wordt niet overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “vermeende bijstandsfraude”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about alleged welfare fraud, including a broadcast on a man left homeless after a conflict with the social services, how municipalities verify fraud, whether benefit cuts are disproportionate, and whether emails were lost. The State Secretary says municipalities must apply proportionality, the case is for the municipality and courts to judge, he will explore a legal definition of fraud and a prevention team, and he will review the enforcement system.
Supervision of municipalities as part of generic oversight is assigned to the provinces.
Het toezicht op gemeenten als onderdeel van het generiek toezicht is bij de provincies belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over voedselhulp in Nederland als gevolg van groeiende armoede

MPs Van Dijk and others asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about food aid for people excluded from food banks amid growing poverty, the Red Cross food aid, and structural measures such as abolishing the cost-sharer norm and raising the minimum wage. The government answered that municipalities bear primary responsibility, that a study on the cost-sharer norm has been sent and a review will follow, but that it does not plan to abolish the norm or sharply raise the minimum wage now.
The cabinet does not intend to abolish the cost-sharer norm.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens de kostendelersnorm af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra, Peters, Agnes Mulder, Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de betaalbaarheid van duurzaamheidsinvesteringen en de leningen die hiervoor moeten worden afgesloten

MPs asked the Minister how homeowners lacking funds for sustainability investments can be protected from being forced into loans, following a NIBUD study showing at least two million owners cannot afford them. The minister agreed that people without borrowing capacity should not be compelled to borrow, pointed to the energy-saving mortgage with income-based repayment and debt forgiveness, and promised to ask the Warmtefonds to monitor financial stress among vulnerable groups.
Daar ben ik het mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over schijnconstructies en wanpresterende uitzendbureaus

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about sham subcontracting schemes at Veka Shipyard and underpaid Romanian workers, the slow enforcement, weak remedies, and the role of employment agencies. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained existing liability and inspection tools, pointed to proposals under consideration and to ongoing exploration, but committed to no concrete new legal change now.
Under Article 3:305a of the Civil Code, trade unions have the possibility to bring a collective action on behalf of employees.
Op grond van artikel 3:305a BW hebben vakbonden de mogelijkheid om een collectieve actie in te zetten voor werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over het landgebonden asielbeleid ten aanzien van Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs Van Ojik, Voordewind and Jasper van Dijk asked whether escalating fighting in Nagorno-Karabach and neighbouring Armenian-Azerbaijani border areas warrants revising asylum return policy and the Armenia safe-country designation, and whether a return moratorium is needed. The State Secretary replied that the policy stands for now, citing the 10 November ceasefire and monitoring of the situation, with individual asylum assessments continuing and a possible new thematic country report if developments warrant it.
Depending on developments, a new (thematic) country report may be requested, which will address the security situation in Azerbaijan.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen kan een nieuw (thematisch) ambtsbericht worden opgevraagd, waarbij dan wordt ingegaan op de veiligheidssituatie in Azerbeidzjan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over vrachtwagenchauffeurs die hun cabine niet meer uitkomen

SP MPs asked whether truck drivers confined to their cabins during COVID measures lack humane conditions, such as access to toilets and showers, and what structural fix the government will provide. The State Secretary answered that employers must cover rest facilities, that the government relies on calls to petrol stations and rest areas to keep sanitary facilities open, and that talks with the sector are ongoing, without committing to a structural solution.
In addition, the Ministry of IenW keeps a close watch on industry organisations, so that any signals about the availability of sanitary facilities for drivers can be picked up in time.
Daarnaast houdt het Ministerie van IenW de vinger aan de pols bij brancheorganisaties, om eventuele signalen over de beschikbaarheid van sanitair voor chauffeurs tijdig op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een werkbezoek aan Park Droomgaard in Kaatsheuvel en hotel Friends in Waalwijk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about conditions for migrant workers at Park Droomgaard in Kaatsheuvel and Hotel Friends in Waalwijk, including excessive rent deductions, fines, bedbugs, a union visit being refused, and relocation to Venlo. The minister answered that rent deductions are capped under rules, that the housing is SNF-certified and monitored, that municipalities and the Labour Inspectorate handle the issues, that a visit is not desirable under COVID-19, and that the government will respond to the Roemer task force advice by mid-December.
The Labour Inspectorate is responsible for supervision and enforcement of the labour laws.
De Inspectie SZW is verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht en de handhaving van de arbeidswetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Jasper van Dijk over het aanpassen van de kostendelersnorm om dakloosheid te voorkomen

MPs Peters and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the government will amend the kostendelersnorm (co-tenant rule in the Participation Act) to prevent youth homelessness, citing Divosa's advice and the delayed research results. The State Secretary says the cabinet response and research are sent with the answers, agrees that temporary non-application of the norm for vulnerable young adults is sensible, and points to a broader exploration of alternatives.
Precisely for vulnerable young adults, the municipality can apply tailored measures by temporarily not applying the co-tenant rule, provided the stay is temporary until a permanent solution is found.

Juist voor kwetsbare jongvolwassenen kan de gemeente maatwerk toepassen door de kostendelersnorm tijdelijk niet toe te passen mits het gaat om tijdelijk verblijf tot een permanente oplossing is gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over tekorten bij sociale werkvoorzieningen

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary about deficits at sheltered workplaces (SW-bedrijven) such as Ergon and Wedeka, whether SW companies are financially failing nationwide, and what measures will prevent closures. The State Secretary declined to comment on individual companies, pointed to municipalities' responsibility and the Thermometer Wsw showing a peak deficit in 2020 expected to improve from 2025, and noted the temporary coronavirus compensation of 140 million euro.
I do not deal with the functioning and operation of individual social development companies.
Ik ga niet over het functioneren en de exploitatie van individuele sociale ontwikkelbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "een angstcultuur bij Sociaal Werkbedrijf Dethon"

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports of a climate of fear at sheltered employment firm Dethon, including transfers of critical staff, deductions of holiday days after sick leave, limited development opportunities, and the need for an ombudsman. The State Secretary answered that implementation is a municipal responsibility, that a voluntary consultative transfer policy applies, that his ministry found no holiday deductions, and that Dethon has an independent complaints committee and access to the Zeeland ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Jasper van Dijk en van Kent over cashen op kosten van de belastingbetaler

SP MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Rechtsbescherming about a case where a business owner allegedly used NOW wage subsidies, let a company go bankrupt, dismissed staff and profited, and whether bailiffs' market structure should be reversed. The minister replied that individual bankruptcies are for the courts and the independent curator and BFT supervisor, that UWV paid wages after the bankruptcy request and will recover via the curator, and that the government will not reverse market competition for bailiffs, though it will correct tariffs and ban price agreements that endanger independence.
It is not for me to judge bankruptcies in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over faillissement in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over bedrijven die handelen in kredietgegevens van personen zonder hen daarover te informeren

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether private credit-scoring firms may trade personal creditworthiness data without informing the individuals concerned, and whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority should be urged to investigate. The minister said the GDPR requires transparency toward data subjects, that firms are primarily responsible for compliance, and that the Authority is independent and is already investigating several credit bureaus, so it would not intervene in its priorities.
I wish to emphasise that these companies are primarily responsible for safeguarding personal data.
Ik hecht eraan te benadrukken dat deze bedrijven in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het waarborgen van persoonsgegevens
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "werken zonder loon"

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about unpaid work by welfare recipients, such as making face masks and participation placements that may displace regular jobs, and how such displacement and unfair competition are prevented and monitored. The State Secretary replies that municipalities have wide discretion, that the legal framework against displacement is clear and adequate, that complaints go to the municipality, the ACM or the courts, and that there is no evidence of fake re-integration trajectories, while declining to comment on a pending Supreme Court case and noting that displacement research is not yet feasible.
I do not consider it appropriate to anticipate the Supreme Court's ruling in the case on which the advocate-general has issued an opinion.
Ik acht het niet passend om vooruit te lopen op de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad in de zaak waarbij de advocaat-generaal een advies heeft geschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de financiering van Grieks wanbeleid op Lesbos

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister and the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands financed mismanagement on Lesbos, including a hospital container donated for a COVID-19 clinic that coincided with the closure of an MSF clinic, and the links with MotG and a Greek youth-care project. The minister denied any causal link between the donation and the MSF closure, said the location was a Greek decision, and described the Dutch-funded reception places for unaccompanied minors and the offer to take 50 minors and 50 families.

We have taken note of the article 'Hallucinant, Netherlands finances Greek mismanagement on Lesbos', but we do not endorse the claimed connection between the donation of the hospital container and the closure of the Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) clinic.

Wij hebben kennisgenomen van het artikel «Hallucinant, Nederland financiert Grieks wanbeleid op Lesbos», maar onderschrijven de gestelde samenhang tussen het schenken van de hospitainer en het sluiten van de kliniek van Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat minder dan 50 kinderen op Lesbos voldoen aan de eisen om opgehaald te worden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why fewer than 50 unaccompanied minors on Lesbos meet the criteria for transfer, and whether the criteria would be loosened and how many children would be taken in. The government answered that details of the group were not known when the offer was made, that several EU states are coordinating relocation, that the number of 100 is not meagre, and that it will inform parliament once the Dutch offer is worked out.
I will inform your House as soon as possible about the elaboration of the Dutch relocation offer.
Ik zal uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk informeren over de uitwerking van het Nederlandse herplaatsingsaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "de handelwijze van het UWV inzake terugbetalingen"

An SP MP asks the minister about UWV's handling of reclaiming benefits, including the six-week repayment deadline, gross-versus-net repayment, support for low-income debtors, and accessible help. The minister replies that the statutory six-week term cannot be changed, that gross repayment follows from tax rules and is mitigated by guidance and payment arrangements, and that UWV will consider continuing a proactive contact pilot.
When agreeing repayment arrangements, UWV always takes the debtor's financial position into account.
UWV houdt bij terugbetalingsregelingen altijd rekening met de financiële positie van de debiteur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over premieshoppen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that staffing agencies use posted-worker A1 certificates and third-country workers to cut labour and social-security costs (premium shopping). Minister Koolmees condemned premium shopping and abuse, described enforcement and EU-level measures, but gave no firm new commitments and said the EU coordination regulation negotiations are stalled.
I will inform the House if there is progress.
Ik informeer uw Kamer als er voortgang is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de familie S

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the S. family, Palestinian refugees who fled Gaza to Turkey, including their sick child and whether they could be resettled to the Netherlands. The government answered that resettlement only happens on UNHCR referral, that it cannot comment further on a court ruling under appeal, and it pointed to EU and bilateral support programmes in Turkey.
Pending this appeal, I cannot go further into this matter.
Hangende dit beroep kan ik niet verder op deze kwestie ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over illegale veelplegers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about illegal repeat offenders, including a Moroccan man with nearly 600 police contacts who has stayed in the Netherlands for fifty years without a residence permit, and whether failing return policy and reluctant countries of origin explain this. The State Secretary rejects that return policy has failed, acknowledges the need for improvement, explains the procedural and detention obstacles, describes EU-coordinated diplomatic and visa instruments, and says dialogue with Morocco is ongoing but was hampered by COVID-19.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases in public answers.
Zoals u weet ga ik in openbare beantwoording niet in op individuele zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over verontrustende berichtgeving met betrekking tot de As Soennah Moskee en de reactie van de burgemeester van Den Haag op het handhavingsverzoek van Femmes for

MPs Becker and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Justice Minister could take enforcement action against the As Soennah mosque after Femmes for Freedom's enforcement request, which the Hague mayor rejected and an appeal is pending. The minister answered that enforcement is for the mayor and the courts, that the anti-terrorism measures law does not apply, and that he will not intervene or revisit joint enforcement.
It is up to the mayor to assess such an enforcement request and decide on it after weighing all relevant facts and circumstances.
Het is aan de burgemeester om een dergelijk handhavingsverzoek te beoordelen en daarop, na afweging van alle relevante feiten en omstandigheden, een beslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over mogelijke fouten bij het dodelijk drama met Rik van de Rakt als slachtoffer

SP MPs asked whether information-sharing failures between COA, the municipality and care providers contributed to a fatal incident involving an asylum status holder, and whether the system should be investigated. The State Secretary said the criminal investigation is ongoing, that COA shared what legally could be shared, that medical data sharing is governed by consent rules, and that she is willing to review information sharing with partners and noted recent inspection reviews.
The criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘een werkgever en een uitzendbureau die hun werknemer in de steek lieten na een ernstig bedrijfsongeval’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an employer and temp agency that allegedly abandoned an injured migrant worker after a workplace accident, including delayed care, a missing report and a missing care pass. The state secretary said the Labour Inspectorate knows of the accident and is investigating, could not judge the specific case or give details while the investigation is ongoing, and pointed to the government's response to the migrant-worker task force recommendations.
The Labour Inspectorate does not make statements about an individual company and/or ongoing investigation.
Over een individueel bedrijf en/of lopend onderzoek doet de Inspectie SZW geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "het schrikbewind jegens bijstandsgerechtigden in de gemeente Enschede"

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether residents of Enschede who were harmed by alleged unlawful welfare practices (unlawful waiting periods, late advances, incorrect minimum-income calculations, reduced benefits, privacy breaches) should be compensated, and about other individual cases. The state secretary answers that municipal implementation is primarily the responsibility of the municipal council and the college, declines to judge individual cases, and points to objection, appeal, damages claims and complaint routes as remedies.
It is not for me to pass judgment on individual descriptions such as those in the broadcast you cite.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over individuele beschrijvingen zoals in de door u aangehaalde uitzending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de beperkte mogelijkheden om maatwerk te leveren bij de kostendelersnorm

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the sparing use of municipal discretion (maatwerk) under the cost-sharer norm in the Participation Act, its effect on homelessness and informal care, and whether the norm should be abolished. The State Secretary pointed to a Divosa handbook subsidy and an ongoing study by Significant APE, said the link to homelessness is not proven, referred to municipal responsibility for implementation, and declined to abolish the norm before the study's results.
The causal link between the cost-sharer norm and homelessness, however, has not been demonstrated.
Het oorzakelijk verband tussen de kostendelersnorm en dakloosheid is evenwel niet aangetoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het op dubieuze gronden afwijzen van een Tozo-uitkering

An MP asked why some sex workers in Alkmaar were refused Tozo benefits, including over stays abroad longer than 28 days, and whether municipalities' discretion creates arbitrariness. The minister replied that individual assessment applies, appeal to the independent court is open, the 4-week foreign stay rule of the Participatiewet applies, and that a toolkit has been provided to municipalities without changing their discretion.
When someone disagrees with a refusal, objection and possibly appeal to the independent administrative court are open.
Wanneer iemand het niet eens is met een afwijzing staan bezwaar en eventueel beroep bij de onafhankelijke bestuursrechter open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over "het verdringen van reguliere arbeid"

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Karabulut asked why the government's Participation Act factsheet gives no information on displacement testing, what 'other workplaces' include, and whether municipalities test for displacement of regular work, asking for figures, follow-up and measures. The state secretary answered that displacement testing is a municipal responsibility not monitored centrally, that no figures on detected displacement exist, that the existing legal framework is adequate, and that he opposes a statutory displacement test (Wet verdringingstoets).
Testing for displacement is a decentralised responsibility of municipalities, and no statistical information on it is collected centrally.
De toetsing op verdringing is een decentrale verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en daarover wordt (centraal) geen statistische informatie verzameld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over de Grieks-Nederlandse samenwerking ter verbetering van de situatie van alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers in Griekenland

MPs Groothuizen, Voordewind and Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary for progress on the Greek-Dutch initiative to set up reception places and a guardianship system for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in Greece, including timelines, partners, funding, obstacles and the role of NIDOS. The State Secretary answered that a MoU was signed on 18 June, a steering group met on 14 July, 48 reception places are being prepared with no fixed timetable, no funding has yet been transferred, and Greek authorities remain responsible.
On further progress I will continue to inform your House on a periodic basis.
Over de verdere voortgang zal ik uw Kamer op periodieke basis blijven informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over 11.000 mensen voor wie naturalisatie onmogelijk is

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security why about 11,000 former pardon-scheme (Ranov) residents cannot naturalise despite long legal stay, and questions strict identity and nationality document requirements, including for minors who turn adult. The State Secretary says eligibility conditions apply, documents are required in principle, no groups are excluded by the document rule, and declines to provide statistics on documentary hardship cases, citing capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de schuldsanering en een effectieve schuldenrechter

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister about debt relief, the accessibility of the Wsnp debt-discharge procedure, and a more effective debt judge. The Minister answered that the government is working with the State Secretary on better linking the voluntary and statutory debt tracks, and will inform Parliament in summer 2020 on concrete steps, while rejecting an external supervisory body and a maximum duration for voluntary debt assistance.
I am not in favour of a maximum term, but I am in favour of progress and transparency.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een maximumtermijn, maar wel van voortgang en transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat nog altijd één op de vijf reformatorische scholen het homohuwelijk moreel onacceptabel vindt

Two MPs asked the minister how rejecting homosexuality as contrary to God's word fits with a safe school climate for gay pupils, and whether the inspectorate has been asked to ensure this, and whether the planned sexual-diversity kerndoelen in the coalition agreement will still be realised this term. The minister replied that schools must take responsibility for a safe climate, that the inspectorate already supervises this and will intervene on signals of insecurity, and that the sexual-diversity goals will be reviewed alongside the integral curriculum revision from autumn 2020.
The inspectorate therefore already supervises this.
De inspectie houdt dus al toezicht hierop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over problemen voor sociale ondernemingen met de Tijdelijke Noodmaatregel voor Overbrugging Werkgelegenheid (NOW)

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk asked whether talks with Cedris stalled, whether social workplaces will get compensation, and whether the NOW wage subsidy should be opened to them. The State Secretary replied that the Wsw grant was raised by €90 million for compensation, that social enterprises are treated like other firms for revenue loss under the NOW, and that no further commitment to municipalities is given beyond referring to the earlier letter.
Social workplaces and social entrepreneurs are not treated differently from other companies and institutions in the scheme when assessing revenue loss for the NOW.
Sociale werkvoorzieningen en sociaal ondernemers worden in de regeling niet anders behandeld dan andere bedrijven en instellingen bij de beoordeling van het omzetverlies voor de NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over problemen voor sociale ondernemingen met de NOW

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether social workplaces and social entrepreneurs are disadvantaged under the NOW wage subsidy because subsidies count toward turnover, and whether a special compensation scheme is planned. The State Secretary replied that they are eligible, that subsidies must count toward turnover to avoid double financing, and that the government increased the Wsw contribution by 90 million euros for March to June 2020 while noting ongoing municipal financial pressure.
That I find undesirable and therefore I am not willing to do so.
Dat vind ik onwenselijk en daarom ben ik daartoe niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het bericht dat de Technische Unie de stakingsregels breekt

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a 50,000 euro advance payment from employers to the union AVV, which they say is not a member of the relevant social fund, breaches ILO Convention 98 and whether any supervision of such arrangements exists. The minister answered that cao parties may structure employer contributions freely within law, that whether this case breaches the ILO convention is not for him to judge, and described ILO and national supervisory mechanisms.
Whether there is a conflict with the ILO convention in this case, for example because a payment was made in advance, is not for me to assess.
Of in deze casus sprake is van strijdigheid met het ILO-verdrag, bijvoorbeeld omdat er een betaling vooraf is gedaan, is niet aan mij om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over de verplichte Marokkaanse nationaliteit

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether they would support Dutch-Moroccans seeking to renounce their compulsory Moroccan nationality, whether consular support and Moroccan consular influence in the Netherlands would be addressed, and whether they would negotiate with Morocco and EU partners. The government sympathised with the wish for choice in nationality, said it would raise the issue with Morocco, which pointed to its existing law, and said it would address undesirable foreign influence under its existing approach, without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet has understanding for this wish for freedom of choice.
Het kabinet heeft begrip voor deze wens tot keuzevrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Voordewind, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Ojik over het bericht dat Griekenland asielzoekers stiekem terugstuurt naar Turkije

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Netherlands views reports that Greece secretly returns asylum seekers to Turkey, whether this breaches the ECHR, and whether the government will press for independent investigation in EU and Council of Europe settings. The government says it has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greece denies them and temporarily suspended asylum applications from March to April 2020, and that it expects Greece and the EU to comply with the ECHR, leaving investigation to the Commission and to complaints by those affected.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the findings described in the article.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de in het artikel geschetste bevindingen te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Futselaar over arbeidsmigranten in een vleesfabriek in Groenlo die moesten doorwerken ondanks een corona-uitbraak

MPs Van Dijk and Futselaar (SP) asked whether meat-plant workers, mostly migrant workers, were forced to keep working during a COVID-19 outbreak at Vion Groenlo and why the plant closed late. The minister answered that the plant closed after a GGD sample showed over 20% infection, that closures are the responsibility of safety-region chairs, and that the labour inspectorate is inspecting slaughterhouses and enforcing workplace safety duties.
The labour inspectorate started on 8 June 2020 a project on slaughterhouse inspections for corona and will inspect a number of preselected slaughterhouses in the coming weeks.
De Inspectie SZW is op 8 juni 2020 gestart met het project «inspecties slachterijen – corona« en zal de komende weken een aantal voorgeselecteerde slachthuizen inspecteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Jasper van Dijk over onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat nog altijd één op de vijf reformatorische scholen het homohuwelijk moreel onacceptabel vindt

MPs Van den Hul and Van Dijk asked whether reformed schools that describe homosexuality as contrary to God's word, and state that sexuality belongs only in a man-woman marriage, will be held to the legal duties on safety and citizenship, and whether the 2009 motion against such staff declarations is respected. The ministers answered that schools' freedom is bounded by fundamental rights, that the Inspectorate monitors safety and will intervene, that the employment exception no longer allows discrimination on sexual orientation, and that the attainment targets on sexual diversity will be sharpened as part of curriculum reform.
It is up to the inspectorate to establish whether a school complies with these provisions and to intervene if it does not.
Het is aan de inspectie om vast te stellen of een school aan deze bepalingen voldoet en om in te grijpen als dat niet het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Kuiken over het optreden van de Griekse grenspolitie en de gewonden en de dood van een migrant

MPs Voordewind, Van Dijk and Kuiken asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Greek border police fired live rounds at migrants near the Turkish border on 4 March, leaving six wounded and one Pakistani man dead, and asked for investigations and clarification. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greek authorities deny using live fire, and that the government expects border actions to respect international law, pointing to existing complaint routes rather than committing to new action.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the situation at the Greek-Turkish border in early March and the reports about it.

Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de genoemde situatie begin maart aan de Grieks-Turkse grens en de berichten daaromtrent te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over oplopende armoede door corona

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about rising poverty and debt during the corona crisis, covering debt relief, youth benefits, collective special assistance, food banks, utility disconnections, evictions and rent increases. The State Secretary answers that existing measures, municipal debt assistance funding, a targeted rather than generic rent freeze and assurances on food banks and utilities are in place, while declining categorical benefits and giving limited data.
No figures are available on the number of disconnections, but as far as I am aware no companies in these sectors have failed to adapt their disconnection policy to the corona crisis.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal afsluitingen, maar voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen bedrijven in deze sectoren die hun afsluitbeleid niet hebben aangepast aan de coronacrisis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over vrouwenonderdrukking

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about oppression of women in marriages with migrants, including a case where a woman was killed shortly after arriving, and about isolation of partners of knowledge migrants. The government says such practices are unacceptable, points to the action agenda on harmful practices and the Rotterdam pilot, but declines a national study and says it cannot bar sponsors from bringing partners under EU family reunification rules.
Because every case of forced isolation is one too many, it has not been chosen to set up a national study into the extent of forced isolation of marriage migrants.
Omdat elk geval van gedwongen isolement er één te veel is, wordt er niet voor gekozen om een landelijk onderzoek in te stellen naar de omvang van gedwongen isolement van huwelijksmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat verhoging van het minimumloon weinig banen kost

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about a CPB update finding that raising the minimum wage costs fewer jobs than previously thought, and whether the government would reconsider its opposition to a substantial minimum wage increase. The ministers welcomed the study, said the job losses are smaller but still substantial when the benefit link is kept, and saw no reason to change their position or raise the minimum wage now.
At this moment I see no reason to revise the response to the initiative note and raise the minimum wage.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om de reactie op de initiatiefnota te herzien en het WML te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over onrust onder werknemers over arbeidsomstandigheden en behoud van baan

SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that employees are pressured, dismissed or made to work in unsafe conditions during the coronavirus crisis, and about employer obligations, sick leave rights, forced holiday, and NOW wage subsidy conditions. The government answered that such treatment is unacceptable, that employers must follow emergency rules and safety duties with enforcement by Inspectie SZW and police, and that NOW conditions and dismissal consequences apply, while declining to comment on individual cases and pointing to other bodies or existing rules.
I cannot judge individual reports, but in general I find it unacceptable that employees are pressured, dismissed or made to work in unsafe conditions in connection with the coronavirus.

Ik kan niet oordelen over individuele meldingen, maar in algemene zin vind ik het niet acceptabel dat werknemers in verband met het coronavirus onder druk worden gezet, ontslagen of onder onveilige arbeidsomstandigheden moeten werken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Groothuizen, Voordewind en Van Toorenburg over het voorstel om migranten op de Griekse eilanden vanwege corona over te brengen naar stilliggende cruisesc

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands would press the EU to evacuate migrants from overcrowded Greek island camps, such as Moria, to idle cruise ships to prevent a COVID-19 outbreak, and why Dutch relocation promises were not being kept. The government answered that the Greek authorities are primarily responsible, that transfers to the mainland are already ongoing, that the Netherlands is backing a Greek-Dutch programme for unaccompanied minors, and that cruise-ship accommodation was judged unnecessary and costly by Greece.
In principle it is for the Greek authorities to take adequate measures to address the COVID-19 situation.
Het is in beginsel aan de Griekse autoriteiten om adequate maatregelen te treffen om de COVID-19 situatie het hoofd te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een crowdfundingsactie voor Chun

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a crowdfunding campaign for Chun, an undocumented man with no residence status, and whether the government will grant him regular residence so he can live with dignity after sixteen years in limbo. The State Secretary acknowledged the public support, pointed to the buitenschuldbeleid (external-circumstances policy) as the available route, and declined to comment on the individual case.
As your House is aware, I cannot go into individual cases when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, kan ik in de beantwoording van Kamervragen niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het niet naleven van coronavoorschriften op vliegveld Eindhoven

Two SP MPs asked whether Eindhoven Airport charter flights carrying Eastern European workers were ignoring corona rules, whether this was an economic offence, and why the flights were not halted. The minister answered that the flights cannot be refused under EU free movement, that the airline and airport have taken measures such as multilingual information and extra staff, and that no economic offence applies.
There are no restrictions on air traffic from European member states, and therefore the flights to Eindhoven are not refused.
Er zijn geen beperkingen voor het vliegverkeer vanuit Europese lidstaten en daardoor worden de vluchten naar Eindhoven niet geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de positie van mensen met schulden in de coronacrisis

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about debt-related disconnections from telecom and utility services during the coronavirus crisis, forced evictions, collection of childhood school-book debts after age 18, and access to debt-restructuring schemes. The government answered that providers have agreed to be lenient and offered tailored solutions, that a sector-wide evictions moratorium applies, that parents are liable for children's debts, and that it will work on improving access to the Wsnp, with some items left for later updates.
No figures are available on the number of evictions in the past three months, but it is not likely that there have been many evictions.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal huisuitzettingen van de afgelopen drie maanden, maar het is niet waarschijnlijk dat er veel huisuitzettingen zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten met hun baan ook hun bed kwijt raken

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the ministers whether the government would prevent employers from evicting migrant workers who lose their jobs and charge excessive rent for housing. The minister answered that the NOW scheme encourages keeping staff employed, that housing charges are capped by law, that a task force on migrant worker protection has been set up, and that no data exists on how many workers lost housing.
There is currently no data available on the basis of which I can make concrete statements about the number of migrant workers affected by the crisis.
Er zijn echter op dit moment geen data beschikbaar op basis waarvan ik concrete uitspraken kan doen over de aantallen arbeidsmigranten die zijn getroffen door de crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek ‘Undercover bij Wehkamp’

MPs Peters and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act against Wehkamp's instalment-credit practices, including a 14% interest rate, lenient collection and a business model that resembles lending. The minister answered that the maximum credit fee will be temporarily cut to 10%, an external study on a structural cut is under way, and further measures will be assessed at the end of the year, while citing limited data on the direct effect of mail-order credit on debt problems.
To better protect consumers against the high costs of credit in this difficult period, I am temporarily lowering the maximum credit fee from 14 percent to 10 percent.
Om consumenten in deze lastige periode beter te beschermen tegen de hoge kosten van krediet, verlaag ik tijdelijk de maximale kredietvergoeding van 14 procent naar 10 procent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het verminderde recht op toeslagen als effect van de afbouw van de algemene heffingskorting

SP MPs asked why the phase-out of transferability of the general tax credit to the lower-earning partner pushes single-earner households above the minimum wage, causing loss of allowances and reduced net income, and why the Nationale ombudsman's 2016 concerns have not been resolved. The minister explains the cause of the case, sets out a range of solution directions that are rejected as too costly or disproportionate, and promises to explore options and inform parliament by end 2020.
The cabinet wants to explore options that ensure households with an income at the social minimum always receive the maximum allowance amount for the relevant allowances.
Het kabinet wil de mogelijkheden verkennen die ervoor zorgen dat huishoudens met een inkomen op het sociaal minimum altijd het maximale toeslagenbedrag aan de voor hen relevante toeslagen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘UWV-artsen weigeren afleggen ambtenareneed’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV medical assessors' objection to an oath of office that pledges not to harm the UWV's reputation, and whether it conflicts with the medical oath. The minister answered that the wording was revised to say the employee will do nothing with the aim of harming UWV's reputation, that the oath does not conflict with the medical oath or the public interest, and that he will not withdraw the oath.
The UWV did this based on various examples from municipalities and the oath for national civil servants.
Het UWV heeft dat op basis van verschillende voorbeelden van gemeenten en de eed voor Rijksambtenaren gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over falend terugkeerbeleid

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the failure of Dutch return policy, including countries refusing to cooperate with returns, the lack of sanctions, Morocco readmission, returns failing because migrants disappeared, and subsidised return training. The government answers that it weighs each country case by case, will inform parliament in spring, admits that in roughly 2,670 cases migrants disappeared after nationality confirmation, and commits to evaluating the return training subsidy.
In accordance with the Becker motion, the cabinet will inform your House in writing about this in the spring.
Conform de motie Becker zal het kabinet uw Kamer dit voorjaar hierover schriftelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het niet naleven van coronavoorschriften

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about police and municipalities not prioritising checks on overcrowded vans carrying migrant workers, and whether economic interests overrode safety rules. The minister said RIVM rules must be followed, that employers are responsible for safe transport, and that the government is consulting social partners and municipalities on practical solutions.

We are in discussion with social partners, municipalities, provinces and other parties to look at practical solutions to organise shared transport so that the chance of coronavirus infection is as small as possible.

We zijn in gesprek met sociale partners, gemeenten, provincies en andere betrokken partijen, om te kijken naar de praktische oplossingen die kunnen worden geboden om het gezamenlijk vervoer zo in te richten dat de kans op besmetting met het coronavirus zo klein mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over "het doorprocederen door de overheid"

Two SP MPs asked whether Enschede's municipality acted improperly by pursuing a benefit recovery to cover social investigation costs and monitoring bank spending to the euro, and whether this reflects a wider practice of prolonged litigation by government. The state secretary answered that it is a municipal case for the council to supervise, that no signals suggest a systemic practice, and that the government will share an interdepartmental plan to reduce unnecessary procedures with parliament before summer.
This concerns a case within an individual municipality. It is not for me or the Minister for Legal Protection to pass judgment on individual descriptions such as those in the article you cite.

Het betreft hier een casus binnen een individuele gemeente. Het is niet aan mij of de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming om een oordeel te vellen over individuele beschrijvingen zoals in het door u aangehaalde artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de dwangsom bij niet tijdig beslissen door de overheid

SP MPs asked whether the government should decide on time, whether the penalty-for-delay (dwangsom) regime still works as intended, why the Tax Administration has a different regime, and how much penalties were paid out in 2015-2019 per organisation. The minister agreed timely decisions matter, reported the regime has a preventive effect with some side effects, explained the Tax Administration's separate rules, and gave incomplete, non-uniform payment figures while noting the IND's sharp rise.
