It turned out that these figures are not kept everywhere or in a uniform way.
Gebleken is dat deze cijfers niet overal en niet uniform worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over stelende bewindvoerders

MPs Van Dijk and Peters asked the government about trustees (bewindvoerders) who embezzled clients' money in Limburg, including why intervention was slow, prosecution capacity, complaint handling, and whether a blacklist or regional lists should be created. The minister answered that courts dismissed the trustees, criminal proceedings are pending with the OM, quality requirements since 2014 are monitored by the judiciary, and that no blacklist is planned, while complaint routes and a white list are described.
The OM does not have this data because it is not registered by occupational group or profession of the suspect.
Het OM beschikt niet over deze gegevens omdat niet wordt geregistreerd op beroepsgroep of beroep van de verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over falende bewindvoerders

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about rogue court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) who allegedly defraud clients, and what the government will do about supervision and complaints. The minister answered that dismissal, liability and court supervision exist, that quality requirements and the Landelijk Kwaliteitsbureau are in place, and that stakeholders will explore mandatory training and the government will look into the motion on improving the system.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat uitzendbureau Fides arbeidsmigranten oproept zich niets aan te trekken van het coronavirus

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a staffing agency's social media posts urging Polish migrant workers to ignore coronavirus risks were acceptable and whether it would be contacted or referred to the labour inspectorate. The minister said the agency removed the posts after the sector association intervened, that the inspectorate can act on complaints, and that RIVM information is available in several languages.
Fides took immediate action on the signal and removed the post.
Fides heeft op grond van het signaal direct actie ondernomen en de uiting verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers about housing and safety of migrant workers during the coronavirus crisis, including infection risks, information provision, and evictions. The government answered that employers share responsibility, that information is distributed in several languages, that municipalities can close recreational sites with exemptions, and that agreements were made to prevent evictions.
No data are known to me on this.
Hierover zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe fraude met UWV-uitkeringen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported fraud with sickness benefits (ZW) and export unemployment benefits (WW) by migrant workers, including UWV home visits in Poland, the reliability of Polish doctors' certificates, enforcement figures, and intermediaries. The minister acknowledged fraud cannot be ruled out, disputed parts of the reporting, gave detailed enforcement statistics, released a withdrawn internal report, and noted ongoing risk audits and talks with Poland.
I am hereby sending the report to your House.
Het onderzoek stuur ik hierbij aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in armoede, voedselbanken en sociale werkvoorzieningen

An SP MP asked the Minister and State Secretary of Social Affairs about food banks, poverty, flex and zero-hour workers, debt enforcement, sheltered employment and migrant housing during the coronavirus crisis. The State Secretary answered that a temporary food bank fund of four million euros is provided, that income support schemes (NOW, Tozo) exist, that enforcement restraint is agreed with landlords and bodies, and that migrant housing is being addressed, mostly by referring to existing measures and further letters.
A one-off subsidy of four million euros is made available by the cabinet as a safety net for the calamity fund.
Er wordt eenmalig een subsidie van vier miljoen euro als vangnet voor het calamiteitenfonds beschikbaar gesteld door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de overheid al jaren weet van vermissingen van Vietnamese kinderen

MP Jasper van Dijk asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the government has known for years about disappearances of Vietnamese children from protected reception, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether earlier signals of trafficking were reported. The State Secretary answers that the phenomenon has long been known, that reports and two research studies were shared with the Chamber over time, that earlier statements were correct though indications of smuggling existed, and commits to measures set out in a letter of 23 March.
Do you acknowledge that the Chamber was not, or at least incompletely, informed?
Vraag 6 Erkent u dat de Kamer niet of tenminste onvolledig is geïnformeerd?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat “een aantal gemeenten grenzen stelt aan de komst van arbeidsmigranten”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about municipalities limiting the influx of labour migrants and their concerns about housing, liveability and displacement of local workers. The minister says municipalities have instruments to address problems, opposes quotas in favour of regional agreements, reports research finding little average displacement, and promises to respond to a related action plan and D66 proposal later.
Quotas on the number of labour migrants are not the way forward, in my view.
Quota aan aantallen arbeidsmigranten vind ik niet de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het groeiende tekort aan opvangplekken in de asielopvang

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the growing shortage of asylum reception places, including municipal reluctance, nuisance by some asylum seekers, IND backlogs, expiring reception contracts, and returns cooperation with Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia. The State Secretary answered that extra beds are urgently needed, that COA is preparing buffer capacity, that nuisance undermines local support, and that returns cooperation is being pursued, while listing 14 locations with contracts expiring in 2020-2021 without stating which will be renewed.
It is not possible at this time to indicate which will and which will not be extended, nor the reasons underlying this for the municipalities concerned.
Het is nu niet aan te geven welke wel en welke niet verlengd zullen worden, evenals welke redenen daaraan ten grondslag liggen voor de betreffende gemeentes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rechterlijke uitspraak over het Haga Lyceum

Rep. Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education whether the court ruling limiting government action against the Haga Lyceum is acceptable, whether article 23 of the Constitution hinders intervention, and whether antidemocratic education and board members should be easier to dismiss. The Minister declined to comment on the pending appeal, said the citizenship education law should be clarified, and pointed to sanction powers and two bills already submitted to parliament.
That an independent judge rules on the lawfulness of government action is a great good that we must cherish.
Dat een onafhankelijke rechter oordeelt over de rechtmatigheid van overheidshandelen is een groot goed, dat we moeten koesteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht "Deeltijdbaan met bijstand werkt niet"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that part-time work combined with social assistance is hard to make work, including the option to widen income disregards and to pay allowances monthly. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Simpel Switchen project, the planned calculation tool and the IBO Toeslagen review, and did not commit to new legislation or a set timetable.
That is why I am working with Divosa and municipalities in the Simpel Switchen project on solutions to make part-time work alongside supplementary social assistance less complex.

Daarom werk ik in het project Simpel Switchen in de Participatieketen samen met Divosa en gemeenten aan oplossingsrichtingen om deeltijdwerken met een aanvullende bijstandsuitkering minder complex te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat van 2,3 miljoen migranten onbekend is waar zij zich bevinden

An SP MP asked the ministers why the government cannot track the addresses of about 2.3 million non-resident migrants with a citizen service number, which hampers inspection and enforcement against exploitation. The minister replied that many of these registrations are not migrants at all (e.g. cross-border workers), that address verification requires other data, that a plan to improve registration is being prepared, and that a further letter will follow.
Not being able to access contact details of a migrant worker hinders the Inspectorate in carrying out its tasks, both in supervision and in investigation.
Het niet kunnen beschikken over contactgegevens van een arbeidsmigrant belemmert de Inspectie dus in haar taakuitvoering, zowel bij toezicht als opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het Oxfam rapport The EU Trust Fund for Africa

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked the minister about an Oxfam report arguing that EU Trust Fund for Africa aid is increasingly used to pressure countries into stopping migrants and that it violates aid principles and human rights. The minister rejects the claims of coercion and rights violations, says the EUTF is being evaluated and will inform the next budget, and acknowledges some useful recommendations.
In 2019 an external evaluation of the EUTF instrument was started. It is expected to be published mid-2020.
In 2019 is een externe evaluatie van het instrument EUTF gestart. Naar verwachting zal deze medio 2020 uitkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat asielzoekers niet welkom zijn in Ter Apel vanwege het Coronavirus

The Member of Parliament Jasper van Dijk asked whether new asylum seekers were being turned away from Ter Apel due to Covid-19, where they would be housed, why a second registration centre was not opened, whether return interviews were cancelled, and what measures protect staff and residents. The State Secretary confirmed that the asylum procedure for new arrivals was suspended and that an emergency shelter was being set up, ruled out a second centre, said return interviews only continue in exceptional cases, and described hygiene and cooperation measures with the GGD.
The decision taken is that for asylum seekers who newly register, the asylum procedure is suspended.
Het besluit dat is genomen is dat voor asielzoekers die zich nieuw aanmelden de asielprocedure wordt opgeschort.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over verontrustende berichtgeving met betrekking tot de As Soennah Moskee en de reactie van de burgemeester van Den Haag op het handhavingsverzoek van Femmes for

MPs Becker and Van Dijk asked about reports on the As Soennah mosque advocating female genital mutilation and violence against women, and about the Hague mayor's response to an enforcement request from Femmes for Freedom. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the prosecutor is pursuing incitement charges, that enforcement lies with the mayor in an ongoing procedure, that the TWBMT cannot be applied without terrorism-related conduct, and that the municipality is already in contact with the mosque.
It is therefore not for me to make statements about this now, nor about the existence of limits for the college of mayor and aldermen when it comes to enforcement.
Het is dan ook niet aan mij om hierover nu uitspraken te doen, noch over het bestaan van beperkingen voor het college van burgemeesters en wethouders als het gaat om handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een man die zijn arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering kwijtraakt vanwege een fysiotherapie behandeling

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a self-employed man whose disability insurer refused benefits after he did not disclose physiotherapy treatment on his health declaration, and about whether insurers should face an acceptance obligation and whether the government will act. The Minister defended the legal framework and insurers' disclosure rules, pointed to AFM findings of no structural misconduct, and said a government proposal on mandatory self-employed disability insurance would come before summer 2020.
I have taken note of this report.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van dit bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over overheidssteun aan de Grijze Wolven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he agrees that ten municipalities subsidise the Grijze Wolven-linked Turkish Federation and whether such funding should be stopped. The minister answered that subsidy is a municipal competence, that municipalities must apply their own criteria, and that the government will act through appropriate channels if democratic-legal boundaries are crossed.
Subsidy provision is an independent competence of municipalities. The cabinet in principle does not interfere in this.
Subsidieverstrekking is een eigenstandige bevoegdheid van gemeenten. Hierin mengt het kabinet zich in principe niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Chun; de man die niet bestaat

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the government responds to the case of Chun, a stateless man who cannot return to China nor obtain residence in the Netherlands, and whether the government will grant him a residence permit. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, confirmed that the buitenschuldbeleid (no-fault policy) exists for such situations, gave aggregate figures on applications and grants, and stated that international law does not oblige granting residence in such cases.
As your House is aware, I cannot go into individual cases when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, kan ik in de beantwoording van Kamervragen niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over angstcultuur en doorgeslagen flexwerk bij de gemeente Rotterdam

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a fear culture and excessive temporary agency work in Rotterdam's Work and Income unit, including non-renewal of agency contracts after a petition and alleged corruption. The minister answered that personnel policy is a municipal matter, that Rotterdam says it takes signals seriously and is in dialogue with council, and declined to take further action.
Personnel policy is a local matter for the municipality of Rotterdam.
Het personeelsbeleid betreft een lokale aangelegenheid van de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over "de toename van het aantal mensen met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering (WIA)"

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the rising inflow into the WIA disability benefit, including whether early-retirement schemes should be reinstated and why the number of disabled people is growing. The minister attributes the rise to a stronger labour market, the higher pension age and rising employment of older workers, says there is a shortage of occupational physicians, and declines to reinstate early-retirement schemes beyond the pension agreement.
The final quantitative figures on WIA benefits for 2019 are not yet known at this time.
De definitieve kwantitatieve cijfers over de WIA-uitkeringen voor 2019 zijn op dit moment nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “tientallen illegale slaapplekken van arbeidsmigranten".

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about 48 illegal sleeping places for migrant workers in a church parish house in The Hague, including fire-safety risks, minors housed there, and who is responsible. The minister answered that the municipality is investigating responsibilities, that the staffing agencies had no direct role in housing, that no exploitation was found, and that he will respond to the SP/ChristenUnie action plan in March.
The main focus of enforcement now lies with the municipality of The Hague.
Het zwaartepunt van de handhaving ligt nu bij de gemeente Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over het bericht dat de Technische Unie de stakingsregels breekt

MPs Van Dijk and Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a Technische Unie strike was being undermined by temporary staff, whether the Inspectorate was investigating, and about employers refusing talks with FNV and the allowance paid to AVV. The Minister answered that Waadi bans temporary replacement workers during strikes, the Inspectorate has begun an inspection whose details he cannot disclose, and that collective bargaining and courts, not the Minister, judge compliance.
I cannot provide further information about the timing and content of ongoing investigations.
Over de termijn en de inhoud van lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Futselaar  over medewerkers van Sandd die geen baan krijgen bij PostNL

Two SP MPs asked why most of Sandd's 16,000 staff lose their jobs when PostNL takes over, whether PostNL's job offers were adequate, and what is done for franchisee workers and those underpaid below minimum wage. The Secretary of State replies that PostNL made offers to all postal workers, that about 60% of interested postal workers accepted, that the civil courts handle franchisee contract disputes, and that the Inspectorate's fine concerned unverifiable hours.
It is not for me to intervene in individual contracts between Sandd and these franchisees.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in individuele contracten tussen Sandd en deze franchisenemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over zijn “ideeën” over Schengen en de herinvoering van grenscontroles

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister when Schengen's open borders become untenable, what alternatives he has in mind, what he discussed with Macron, and whether withholding these ideas undermines parliamentary control. The government replied that border controls are an ultimate measure not currently applicable, stressed strengthening external border protection and the common asylum system, said talks with France concern GEAS reform, and stated that parliament is informed via the annotated agenda and BNC-fiches.

As with all other European topics, your House is always informed in advance of Council meetings, in accordance with the applicable procedural agreements, about the intended cabinet position via the annotated agenda.

Net als voor alle andere Europese onderwerpen wordt uw Kamer, conform de geldende procedureafspraken, altijd voorafgaand aan bijeenkomsten in Raadskader geïnformeerd over het voorgenomen kabinetsstandpunt via de geannoteerde agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vrouwenbesnijdenis

An SP MP asked the health minister about female genital mutilation (FGM) in the Netherlands, including the effectiveness of measures, reporting duties, prevalence data, airport and border measures, international cooperation and curriculum changes. The minister answered that FGM is criminal and harmful, announced an action agenda on harmful practices, described existing prevention and reporting measures, and committed to further steps such as the action agenda and an FGM campaign element.
That is why I am, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, drawing up an action agenda on harmful practices.
Daarom stel ik, in samenwerking met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming, een actieagenda Schadelijke Praktijken op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Computer zegt nee. Hoe Saskia twintig jaar vastliep in het systeem'

MPs Alkaya and Van Dijk asked why a woman whose car was stolen in 1998 was pursued for 20 years by the CJIB and tax authorities over insurance and road tax fines, and how she would be helped. The minister answered that the RDW only deregistered the car in 2011, that registry rules were recently relaxed to allow backdating, that coordination has been taken on personally, and that a central reporting point for registry errors will be set up.
I have looked further into this situation, which is a very unpleasant one for the woman, which has now been going on for 20 years.
Ik heb me nader in deze situatie verdiept, waar sprake is van een zeer vervelende situatie voor mevrouw, die inmiddels al 20 jaar loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de aankoop van Maltese paspoorten door spionnen, fraudeurs, mensenhandelaren en belastingontduikers

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government shares concern that Maltese passports sold to investors have gone to suspected criminals and spies, and whether it will press Malta on its vetting. The government said it finds such passport sales undesirable, relies on Malta's due diligence checks, and will pursue dialogue at EU level once the Commission's expected 2020 report is published.
The government shares that concern and considers the so-called sale of passports, whereby a third-country national can also obtain EU citizenship, an undesirable form of naturalisation.
Het kabinet deelt die zorg en acht het zogenoemd verkopen van paspoorten, waardoor een derdelander ook het EU-burgerschap kan verkrijgen, een onwenselijke wijze van naturalisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het COA asielzoekers, die slachtoffer zijn van een zedendelict, afraadt aangifte te doen

MPs Kuiken and Van Dijk asked whether COA advised asylum seekers who were victims of sexual offences, including gay victims, against filing police reports, and how often such victims report. The State Secretary replied that COA encourages reporting, that it has no evidence of such advice beyond the media report, that no internal investigation exists, and that police and COA hold no central figures on this.
COA encourages residents to file police reports and provides support where needed.
Het COA stimuleert bewoners om aangifte te doen en biedt waar nodig ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een in Nederland geboren jongen van 19 die als illegaal in de gevangenis belandt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a Dutch-born 19-year-old was detained as an illegal resident and why no one prevented this, and whether he would be released and given Dutch nationality. The State Secretary declined to go into individual detail for privacy reasons, defended the court-reviewed detention and IND procedure, and said the IND is still assessing the new residence application.
When answering questions about individual cases from your House, I am, as is known, bound by rules on the privacy of the person concerned.
Ik ben bij de beantwoording van vragen over individuele zaken door uw Kamer, zoals bekend is, gebonden aan regels omtrent de privacy van een betrokkene
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Voordewind over het bericht dat vluchtelingen worden uitgehongerd in Libië

MPs Van Dijk and Voordewind asked whether refugees in Libya are being starved out of the UNHCR gathering centre in Tripoli, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledges the dire conditions, explains that UNHCR is shifting aid to urban centres and phasing out catering, and points to additional funding and existing resettlement and evacuation channels, without committing to new resettlement.
As the House has been informed on several occasions, the difficult conditions for refugees and migrants in Libya are a cause for concern.
Zoals vaker aan uw Kamer gemeld zijn de zware omstandigheden voor vluchtelingen en migranten in Libië zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk bericht 'Zet asielzoekers veilige landen apart'

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report that Ter Apel wants asylum seekers from safe countries housed separately, and about related concerns on shop theft, police presence, bus transport and schooling. The State Secretary says overlast from this group is a priority, points to a separate reception form and transfer to the Hoogeveen supervision location, notes the police station is being kept in Ter Apel, and says schooling is covered by existing rules.
The COA, together with the parties involved, is looking for a suitable location for the separate form of reception.
Het COA is samen met betrokken partijen op zoek naar een geschikte locatie voor de separate opvangvorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid werd geweigerd in Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the State Secretary for Justice and Security was refused a visit to Morocco, why, and what the government has done about it and about returns of Moroccan nationals. The government answered that the State Secretary was not refused, that a meeting is being planned, that relations are broad but returns have yielded few results, and that talks on returns continue.
In addition, work is underway to plan a meeting for the state secretary to visit her Moroccan counterpart.
Daarnaast wordt gewerkt aan het plannen van een afspraak voor een bezoek van de staatsecretaris aan haar Marokkaanse ambtgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een Afghaanse tolk die vreest voor zijn leven omdat hij Nederland dreigt te worden uitgezet

MPs asked whether Afghan interpreters who worked for Western forces, and who face Taliban threats, should receive categorical protection and whether the deportation of one such interpreter would breach non-refoulement. The government answered that the 2019 country report placed this group in a risk group where minor indications can suffice, that it has since adopted systematic persecution for interpreters of international missions following a motion, and that every application is assessed individually; it did not hold data on how many interpreters are in hiding or killed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Middeleeuwse toestanden in Heino

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about poor living conditions of migrant workers at a holiday park in Heino, including advice from staffing agencies not to register in the municipal registry, weak municipal control, the package-deal dependency, rent levels, SNF certification and permanent use of holiday homes. The minister acknowledged the seriousness of the problems, said housing complaints should first be resolved by landlord, agency and municipality, called non-registration undesirable, and promised an integrated approach to be reported by year end.
I am certainly of the view that abuses must be tackled.
Ik ben zeker van mening dat misstanden moeten worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de oproep dat veel meer jongerenwerkers nodig zijn in de strijd tegen drugsgeweld

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to calls for far more youth workers to keep young people out of drug-related violence and whether this fits the government's public statements, and when concrete plans and funding would follow. The minister answered that youth work is primarily a municipal responsibility, that a broader anti-subversion plan including youth work is being developed with municipalities, that 110 million euro was set aside for the start of the approach, and that further preventive measures will be communicated later, but declined to answer the questions in time for the scheduled debate.
Youth work and the deployment of youth workers is primarily a task of municipalities.
Jongerenwerk en de inzet van jongerenwerkers is primair een taak van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over data van werkzoekenden die massaal ontbreken bij een databank van het UWV

An SP MP asked the government about a UWV database of job seekers with disabilities, its failed candidate-finder tool, and a suppressed 2018 report. The minister defended the tool as part of a wider labour-market programme, declined to publish the internal report, and promised structural data-exchange improvements.
UWV sent the report to me in mid-September and also published it itself on its website on 1 October.
UWV heeft het rapport medio september jl. aan mij toegezonden en op 1 oktober jl. ook zelf gepubliceerd op haar website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat jonge kinderen betaald krijgen om reclame te maken

MPs Kwint and Van Dijk asked how child labour rules apply to children paid to advertise brands on YouTube and social media, and how enforcement and transparency of sponsored content work. The Secretary of State answered that child labour rules apply when children work under authority or under a contract, including payment in kind, that children up to 12 need an Inspectorate exemption, and that the Inspectorate handles reports that are directly fineable, with a review planned for 2020.
It is conceivable that young vloggers and influencers who talk about a product they have received enter the commercial sphere, so that the ban on child labour applies.

Het is denkbaar dat jonge vloggers en influencers die iets vertellen over een product dat ze hebben gekregen daarmee in de commerciële sfeer raken, waardoor het verbod op kinderarbeid van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er duizenden nieuwe opvangplekken nodig zijn voor asielzoekers

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary and Minister about reports that thousands of new asylum reception places were needed, questioning the earlier closure of reception centres, the absence of reserve capacity, waiting times and municipal responsibility. The government replied that capacity planning is under consultation with municipalities and provinces, that flexible reception forms are being developed, and that the IND is recruiting staff, while giving only partial data on waiting times and housing.
At this moment the IND is (still) not able to extract the waiting times from the systems.
Op dit moment is de IND (nog) niet in staat om de wachttijden uit de systemen te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het zonder waarschuwing incasseren van een openstaande toeslagschuld

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether it is normal that a missed payment within two weeks under a debt arrangement for a childcare-benefit debt triggers payment of the full outstanding amount, and how this fits with incasso policy. The state secretary answered that a reminder is sent first, that the procedure has applied since 2005, that about 212,000 cases were cancelled in 2018, and that personal payment arrangements remain available, while promising to reconsider policy on intent or gross negligence.
Only if that request is not met and no other response follows the payment reminder is the payment arrangement withdrawn, after which the citizen must pay the outstanding amount in one go.

Pas als niet aan dat verzoek wordt voldaan en op de betalingsherinnering evenmin een andere reactie is gevolgd, wordt de betalingsregeling ingetrokken waarna de burger gehouden is het openstaande bedrag in één keer te betalen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huurtoeslag en het minimumloon

Two SP MPs asked why the rent-subsidy (huurtoeslag) rent ceiling is lower for under-23s, how many young tenants miss out, and whether the age limit should be lowered to 18 and the youth minimum wage raised. The minister answered that the lower ceiling is deliberate to keep young people's housing affordable, that raising it would push up rents, and that no change is planned, while noting the government's stance on the youth minimum wage.
All things considered, there is currently no reason to lower the age limit of 23.
Alles overziend is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om de leeftijdsgrens van 23 jaar te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘deurwaarders die onterecht kosten in rekening brengen’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a disciplinary ruling that a bailiff firm (GGN) wrongly charged costs to around 34,000 debtors and whether the firm must repay them, and about the suitability of digital arbitration (e-Court) for such cases. The minister said that the civil court must decide on repayment and the ruling does not itself require active repayment, that parties should resolve whether debtors were harmed, and that e-Court can contribute if legal requirements are met.
That is for the civil judge to determine.
Dat is aan de burgerlijke rechter om vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kerstens over het bericht dat door Oost NL gesteunde Chinese spookbedrijven verdacht worden van uitbuiting van illegale werknemers

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked whether government-backed regional agency Oost NL supported Chinese companies suspected of exploiting illegal workers, and what action will be taken. The minister acknowledged serious labour-law violations found by the Inspectorate SZW, said Oost NL will pause expansion support and that municipalities decide on closures, and largely deflected responsibility to the companies, the inspectorate and municipalities.
Because this information is commercially confidential, RVO.nl does not disclose specific company information for tax schemes, guarantees, indirect financing arrangements and suretyships.

Vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie geldt voor fiscale regelingen, garantstellingen, indirecte financieringsregelingen en borgstellingen dat RVO.nl geen specifieke bedrijfsinformatie openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over uitbuiting van arbeidsmigranten

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the Minister of Social Affairs about exploitation of labour migrants, including whether Polish-registered firms bring non-EU workers to the Netherlands and whether cross-border posting rules should be tightened. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to the Wab, the Europese Arbeidsautoriteit and planned regulatory reviews, but said the free movement of services limits restrictions on work permits.
I share Mr Elzinga's view that avoiding taxes and social premiums, through sham constructions or otherwise, must be tackled.
Ik deel de mening van de heer Elzinga dat het ontwijken van belastingen en sociale premies – via schijnconstructies of anderszins – moet worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een Zwartboek naar aanleiding van erbarmelijke omstandigheden voor arbeidsmigranten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a FNV blackbook on poor housing for migrant workers in Ter Aar, including rent levels, landlord-employer dependence, and enforcement. The minister acknowledged the problems, said housing is mainly a municipal and regional responsibility, pointed to existing rules and the SNF certification route, and promised an integrated approach by year end.
How housing for migrant workers is best distributed within a region and in which forms it can be provided must be decided at regional and local level.
Hoe de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten binnen een regio het beste past qua verdeling en in welke woonvormen deze kan worden gerealiseerd, moet op regionaal en lokaal niveau worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de ‘Ontmanteling van sw-bedrijf Soweco’

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary about the planned dissolution of the Soweco sheltered workplace company, the lack of works council involvement, and whether six municipalities hold a veto, citing two adopted motions. The State Secretary replied that municipalities decide on the future role of these companies, jobs and support are said to continue, the works council will be involved in later stages, and a meeting with the municipalities is scheduled for 5 December.
It is up to the municipalities, which own the social development companies including Soweco, to decide what role these companies can play in the future.
Het is aan gemeenten, die de eigenaren zijn van de sociale ontwikkelbedrijven, waaronder Soweco, om te bepalen welke rol deze bedrijven in de toekomst kunnen spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Laatste aso AZC in Nederland sluit deuren'

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the closure of the last extra supervised reception location (EBTL) for troublesome asylum seekers, the safety of reception, union involvement, the number of safe-country asylum applicants, and the pilot's costs. The State Secretary answered that talks with the municipality of Hoogeveen on alternative reception are ongoing, that a WODC evaluation is expected soon, and gave cost and intake figures while declining to give a firm date or number of relocations yet.
As soon as I know the outcome of this, I will inform your House.
Zodra ik de uitkomst hiervan weet, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over leegloop en braindrain in Oost-Europa

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the Minister of Social Affairs about labour emigration and brain drain from Eastern Europe, citing a World Bank warning, and whether rich countries should refrain from recruiting workers and what the EU is doing about it. The minister acknowledged the World Bank's concerns but defended free movement as a fundamental right, said member states should improve conditions at home and that the EU has no coordinated response yet, promising to raise the issue within the European Semester.

At present there is no coordinated European effort in this area, but it is clear that if brain drain is seen as a serious problem in a growing number of member states, it must also be explored at European level how to address this challenge.

Op dit moment bestaat er geen gecoördineerde Europese inzet op dit gebied, maar duidelijk is wel dat als braindrain in een groeiend aantal lidstaten als een ernstig probleem wordt gezien, ook op Europees niveau verkend moet worden hoe aan deze uitdaging het hoofd geboden kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Breda willens en wetens in strijd met de wet voorwaarden verbindt aan het afgeven van een briefadres

An SP MP asked whether Breda imposes conditions on issuing a postal address (briefadres) contrary to the Personal Records Database Act, and whether the minister will act. The minister confirmed the law requires registration, said Breda deliberately keeps some homeless people registered as a way to monitor them, which is not permitted, and said the Rijksdienst and a letter to Breda have pointed out the violation.
I have had the Dutch Identity Data Agency contact the municipality of Breda.
Ik heb de Rijksdienst voor Identiteitsgegevens contact laten opnemen met de gemeente Breda.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Jasper van Dijk, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Bisschop over het bericht dat een medewerker bij de IND door zijn leidinggevende onder druk werd gezet om zijn eigen dossi

MPs asked whether internal IND emails showing a supervisor discussing 'constructions' around asylum decisions contradict the De Leeuw commission's finding of no directed instructions to break rules, and whether further investigation, contact with ministry officials, and a meeting with the whistleblower are warranted. The State Secretary replied that the emails were included in the commission's research, found no reason for further investigation or doubt about the report's reliability or independence, declined to discuss individual personnel matters citing privacy, and saw no reason to meet the whistleblower.
I therefore see no reason for additional investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor een aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Jasper van Dijk over de vermogenstoets voor kwijtschelding van lokale belastingen

MPs Van Raak and Van Dijk asked whether the asset limit for remission of local taxes should be raised to reduce debt problems and the poverty trap. The minister answered that the limits mirror national rules, acknowledged an earlier letter wrongly suggested a single figure, and declined to raise the limit because a higher threshold would worsen the poverty trap.
However, if the remission limit were raised to be closer to or equal to the social assistance norm, this would increase the poverty trap.
Echter, indien de kwijtscheldingsnorm zou worden opgehoogd om dichter of gelijk aan de bijstandsnorm te staan, zou dit de armoedeval vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Voordewind en Kuiken over het artikel ‘De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders’

MPs asked the government about shipowners' difficulties finding safe ports for rescued migrants in the Mediterranean, the suspension of EU naval mission Sophia, disembarkation platforms in North Africa, and Libya returns. The government agreed safe ports are needed, said a causal link to Sophia cannot be established, noted some North African ports have accepted rescued migrants, and pointed to ongoing EU negotiations and an informal JHA Council without a concrete mechanism.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de documentaire De schuldmachine

An MP asked the state secretary about the documentary De Schuldmachine, including debt traps, a young person's debt for school books, debt sales to collectors, toll-free health insurance penalties, and the role of debt advisers. The government answered that the Brede Schuldenaanpak is needed, pointed to measures on stacking of costs, a bill on collection quality, a study on buying back debts, and an evaluation of the health insurance defaulter scheme, while refusing to comment on individual cases.
I cannot make statements about specific cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake ‘een incassobureau dat zijn klanten uitknijpt’

An SP MP asked the government how a debt collection agency could operate for years squeezing small business clients, what enforcement the ACM and AFM had taken, and how to keep such agencies from using court resources. The Minister answered that collection must follow existing law, that individual cases are not for the Minister to address, that ACM and AFM lack competence over business-to-business conduct, and that a debt collection register bill is being prepared.

As I already indicated in answer to your parliamentary questions of 22 March 2019, which also addressed the functioning of a debt collection agency, it is not for me as Minister to address individual cases.

Zoals ik eerder al aangaf in antwoord op uw Kamervragen van 22 maart 2019, waar ook het functioneren van een incassobureau aan de orde kwam, is het evenwel niet aan mij als Minister om in te gaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Nederland nog niet akkoord met migrantendeal’

SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about reports that the Netherlands had not agreed to a Franco-German plan for rapid assessment and distribution of migrants arriving in Europe, and about alternatives such as regional reception facilities. The State Secretary referred to the informal JHA council report, saying the talks produced no temporary mechanism acceptable to the cabinet, and that it will keep pushing for shared responsibility including arrival states and a border procedure; she added there is no EU majority for externalised asylum procedures.
The cabinet will continue to press for a mechanism in which as large a group as possible, if not all member states, takes its responsibility, including the arrival states.
Het kabinet zal blijven aandringen op een mechanisme waarin een zo groot mogelijke groep, zo niet alle lidstaten, haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de sociale ontwrichting als gevolg van arbeidsmigratie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about social disruption from labour migration, including housing, exploitation, municipal burdens and registration of migrant workers. The minister acknowledged problems and pointed to enforcement, the Goed Verhuurderschap trajectory, registration studies and a planned action plan, while rejecting that migrants are mainly a cost.
The cabinet is examining ways to encourage labour migrants to register timely as residents in the Personal Records Database (BRP).
Het kabinet onderzoekt de mogelijkheden om te bevorderen dat arbeidsmigranten zich tijdig als ingezetene registreren in de Basisregistratie Personen (BRP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over de humanitaire noodsituatie waarin vluchtelingen in Libië verkeren

MPs asked the government about the humanitarian crisis facing migrants in Libyan detention centres near the conflict zone, including reports of an airstrike on the Tajoura centre, forced labour, and whether the Netherlands would evacuate migrants or offer asylum. The minister answered that the centres are unsafe, that Libya's GNA government agreed to close three centres including Tajoura, that Nederland supports IOM/UNHCR evacuations and ETM resettlement from Niger, but that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission route like Italy's and direct evacuation to the Netherlands is not possible.
The Netherlands has no admission on humanitarian grounds, unlike Italy. Direct evacuation from Libya to the Netherlands is therefore not among the possibilities.
Nederland kent geen toegang op humanitaire gronden, zoals Italië. Directe evacuatie vanuit Libië naar Nederland behoort dan ook niet tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitbuiting van arbeidsmigranten in Zeewolde

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported exploitation of migrant workers in Zeewolde, including housing conditions, wage deductions, and the role of inspectorates and private certification bodies. The minister acknowledged the problems, cited existing rules and inspection responsibilities, and promised further talks with stakeholders, but declined to confirm specific inspections and deferred some matters to municipalities.
The Labour Inspectorate does not comment on whether investigations are or will be conducted at specific companies.
De Inspectie SZW laat zich niet uit over de vraag of bij bepaalde bedrijven onderzoek is of wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over de gebrekkige aanpak van mensenhandel en arbeidsuitbuiting

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked why human trafficking and labour exploitation cases so rarely lead to convictions, whether the rules on what counts as exploitation should be clearer, and what steps follow the National Rapporteur's report. The government says it is exploring clearer criteria for the grey zone between bad employment practices and trafficking, will send a cabinet response before autumn, and declines to comment on individual cases such as the fatal accident involving Romanian workers.
I will not go into individual cases. The Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken. Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat over de vervolgingsbeslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verruiming van het zorgverlof voor ouders met ernstig zieke kinderen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the short care leave for parents of seriously ill children is too limited, whether the government should widen it, and whether it should study options abroad and free up budget. Minister Koolmees answered that employers and employees must handle such cases case by case, that the government will work with social partners on a guidance handbook for employers, and that he sees no financial room to expand leave now.
At this moment I see no financial possibilities to proceed to expanding leave possibilities.
Op dit moment zie ik geen (financiële) mogelijkheden om over te gaan tot uitbreiding van verlofmogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het programma Medialogica

An SP MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the Medialogica broadcast and earlier government cooperation with the programme Ontvoerd on child abduction cases, including an emergency passport, internal official doubts, and police information sharing. The minister defended the passport decision, acknowledged that police and prosecutors have contacted programme makers case by case, and announced a stricter police instruction and an ongoing investigation into a leaked arrest warrant.
Going forward, the June 2018 email from the Legal Affairs department has been developed into a more detailed instruction.
Naar de toekomst toe is het e-mailbericht van de afdeling Juridische Zaken uit juni 2018 uitgewerkt tot een nadere instructie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen, Van den Hul, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht ‘IND stuurt yezidi’s terug naar kampen in Noord-Irak, VN ongerust’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Iraqi Yezidis are being returned to camps in Northern Iraq despite UNHCR concern, and whether Kurdish camps can absorb them. The State Secretary answered that Yezidis from other parts of Iraq who fled to the Kurdistan Region and lived there long-term are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, so the vulnerable minority policy applies, and that the Kurdish shelter situation is not generally inadequate.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to give extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi’s
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over 1600 kinderen die verdwenen zijn uit asielopvang

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that 1,600 children disappeared from asylum reception, including whether those placed with Nidos and those leaving before registration are counted, and what protection and police action will follow. The state secretary said the figures are unverified and centrally unrecorded, pointed to pending analyses and an EMM study due in autumn, and noted police procedures and expanded trafficking investigation capacity.

On the basis of the data provided by COA and Nidos, no statement can be made about the number of unaccompanied minors who leave for an unknown destination before arriving in Ter Apel, because no central registration of this takes place.

Op basis van de verschafte gegevens van het COA en Nidos kan geen uitspraak gedaan worden over het aantal amv's dat nog vóór aankomst in Ter Apel vertrekt met onbekende bestemming, omdat hiervan geen centrale registratie plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vluchtelingenkinderen op straat door verkeerde registratie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about unaccompanied minors from Eritrea left on the street after age registration errors in Italy, and whether the IND's practice of treating them as adults when a shouw is inconclusive is sound. The State Secretary defended the practice under the interstate trust principle, said nothing forces people onto the street, and declined to include these cases in the study of minors who left with unknown destination.
If the inspection shows doubt about the claimed minority, the IND, on the basis of the interstate trust principle, accepts the age registered in another member state, even when this shows adulthood.

Als de schouw uitwijst dat er twijfel bestaat over de gestelde minderjarigheid, neemt de IND op grond van het interstatelijk vertrouwensbeginsel de in een andere lidstaat geregistreerde leeftijd aan, ook wanneer hieruit meerderjarigheid blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Stop verplichte zoekperiode voor bijstand'

An SP MP asked the state secretary about calls to abolish the mandatory four-week job-search period for welfare claimants, especially young people, and whether it pushes vulnerable youths out of view. The state secretary acknowledged the signal, pointed to municipal tools and partnerships to keep youths in view, and said a exemption for young people with work disabilities is being prepared in a bill expected in the second half of 2019.
In my letter of 23 May 2019 on the progress of the 'Breed Offensief' work, I addressed the possibility of this.
In mijn brief van 23 mei 2019 4 over de stand van zaken uitwerking «Breed Offensief» ben ik ingegaan op de mogelijkheid hiertoe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de onvoorspelbaarheid van het budget voor gebundelde uitkeringen voor gemeenten (BUIG-budget)

An SP MP asked why Sittard-Geleen's BUIG welfare budget fell by 2.7 million euro, whether the calculation is transparent and checkable, whether municipalities can predict budget changes earlier, and whether the system should be revised. The State Secretary attributed the drop to a lower budget share from the objective allocation model (including a new price component and annual updates of regional indicators), stated the model is not a black box and is verified by experts and the Auditdienst Rijk, but declined to change the system or move the publication date earlier than 1 October.
Every municipality receives a detailed, step-by-step calculation of the build-up of the amount to be received in the following year before 1 October.
Iedere gemeente ontvangt vóór 1 oktober een gedetailleerde, stap-voor-stap berekening van de opbouw van het te ontvangen bedrag in het volgende jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over beschut werk

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary about UWV work-assessment quality for sheltered work (beschut werk), including reports that employment-expert decisions often fail and whether an independent objection committee should be set up. The State Secretary answered that UWV has taken quality measures, that existing objection and appeal procedures under the Awb are sufficient, and that the report is already available to Parliament in confidence.
I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat marktwerking voor gerechtsdeurwaarders te ver is doorgeslagen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked whether market competition among bailiffs has gone too far, creating perverse incentives that undermine bailiffs' independence and whether government should encourage debt assistance and alternative procurement. The minister disagreed that competition has gone too far, said a commission is reviewing the tariff system, pointed to existing responsible-collection commitments, and said price will not be part of the CJIB tender competition.
I am awaiting the results of that investigation.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitbuiting van arbeidsmigranten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about exploitation of migrant workers, including Polish workers, the Labour Inspectorate's capacity and risk-based approach to complaints, temp agencies, housing and fines, and a complaints office. The minister answered that the Inspectorate is being expanded, that complaints are assessed on a risk basis, that the government will send a letter on the subject before the summer recess, and that most questions were answered with policy descriptions or responsibility assigned to municipalities.
I will send a letter before the summer recess in response to the NRC article.
Ik zal voor het zomerreces met een brief komen in reactie op het NRC-artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over achterblijvende lonen

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether wage increases have lagged inflation, whether the government will raise wages or the minimum wage, and whether it will reverse the VAT increase. The minister answered that wage growth is gradually rising, that the government sets no wage target and leaves wage policy to social partners, that a minimum wage rise is not desirable, and that the VAT shift is a deliberate choice.
The cabinet does not choose to raise the minimum wage because it is not the instrument to force higher wages.
Het kabinet kiest er niet voor om het minimumloon te verhogen omdat dit niet het instrument is om hogere lonen af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over arbeidsmigranten die een goudmijn zijn voor verhuurders

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked about reports that holiday bungalows in Ewijk are used to house migrant workers as a profitable model, the adequacy of oversight of exploitation and housing conditions, and what legal tools exist against exploitative landlords. The minister called such use undesirable in principle, said the Inspectorate SZW cannot judge exploitation from press reports, described lokal housing inspection and inter-agency cooperation, and pointed to pilots against bad landlords and forthcoming measures.
I cannot assess from the press reports whether there is exploitation or judge the specific housing conditions, partly because the expertise to assess this is assigned to other organisations.

Ik kan op basis van de berichtgeving niet beoordelen of er sprake is van uitbuiting of oordelen over de specifieke woonomstandigheden, mede omdat de expertise om te beoordelen of hier sprake van is bij andere organisaties is belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een onvoldoende voor het UWV

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister about a poor UWV quality assessment, why parliament was not informed earlier, whether internal reports would be shared, and whether errors in disability assessments would be corrected and affected people compensated. The minister acknowledged concerns about caseworker quality, said the impact on benefits could not be established, announced confidential inspection of the documents for parliament, and ruled out an independent appeal commission.
I will make the documents requested by newspaper Trouw under the Open Government Act available for confidential inspection by your House.
Ik zal de documenten die op grond van een beroep op de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur door dagblad Trouw zijn opgevraagd ter vertrouwelijke inzage leggen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over leegloop en braindrain door arbeidsmigratie binnen de EU

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about emigration and brain drain from EU countries caused by intra-EU labour mobility, and whether free movement should be regulated. The minister acknowledges concerns, defends free movement as a fundamental right while noting its downsides, points to recent EU labour rules and a stronger European Semester, and makes no commitment to a concrete legislative proposal.
I am in favour of free movement, but I consider it important that there are rules to address its negative consequences.
Ik ben voorstander van het vrij verkeer, maar vind het van belang dat er regels zijn om negatieve gevolgen ervan aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe onthullingen rond het Haga Lyceum

SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether reports about a Haga Lyceum linked to radical preachers, gender segregation, and possible terror financing were true, and whether the school should be closed or its board dismissed. The minister declined to comment on substance, citing the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation and the Bibob screening, while stating that intimidation of inspectors is unacceptable and that Article 23 must not block firm intervention.
In the interest of these ongoing investigations, I cannot go into this further.
In het belang van deze lopende onderzoeken kan ik hier verder niet op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Na twee jaar subsidiebaan weer kwijt: hoe schrijnend is dat?'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a news report on a man whose two-year participation job at the Amsterdam transport company GVB ended without a permanent contract, and whether the government would act to secure permanent jobs for former Wsw and Wajong clients. The State Secretary answered that the Participatiewet is implemented locally, so she would not intervene in the individual case, cited tracking data on employment rates among former Wsw and Wajong clients, and pointed to ongoing evaluation work.
The Participatiewet is implemented locally, so it is not appropriate to intervene in individual cases within local competences.
De Participatiewet wordt decentraal uitgevoerd en het past daarom niet om in individuele gevallen in lokale bevoegdheden te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over intimidatie door een incassobureau

MPs Van Dijk asked the government about intimidation by debt collection agency Hendriks Incasso, including threats of powers it lacks, and whether the ACM's warning-only response and the planned debt collection register would stop such firms. Minister Dekker answered that incasso practices must stay within the law, declined to judge the individual case, and said the register with sanctions is planned for mid-2021.
It is not for me as Minister to judge individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om te oordelen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over discriminatie op bestelling door verhuurmakelaars

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked the minister about landlord agents who agree to discriminate on request and charge illegal intermediary fees. The minister called the findings unacceptable, pointed to the Goed Verhuurderschap project, self-regulation, a research study and a Rotterdam pilot, and said prosecution is not feasible because willingness to discriminate is not yet actual discrimination.
I find these figures very disappointing and unacceptable.
Ik vind deze cijfers zeer teleurstellend en onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht "problemen met onbegrensde arbeidsmigratie”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about brain drain and population loss in lower-wage EU states caused by free movement of workers, and whether the Netherlands would introduce work permits for EU workers. The minister acknowledged downsides of labour mobility, pointed to EU-level convergence and the European Semester, and refused to introduce work permits for EU nationals as contrary to free movement.
Introducing work permits for workers from EU member states is contrary to the free movement of workers.
Het invoeren van tewerkstellingsvergunningen voor werknemers uit EU-lidstaten is in strijd met het vrij verkeer van werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de oplopende vaste lasten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about rising fixed housing and living costs, citing a Nibud report that more than half of household budgets go to fixed costs, and asked about government responsibility, the burden on tenants, and possible measures. The State Secretary attributes the rise mainly to price increases and a shift of taxes from labour to consumption, points to income tax cuts, the expanded rent allowance and a planned cap on social housing rent increases, and says households should monitor their spending.
The share of fixed costs has risen because both prices and taxes have gone up.
Het aandeel vaste lasten is gestegen doordat zowel de prijzen als de belastingen omhoog zijn gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdwenen Vietnamese kinderen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about Vietnamese unaccompanied minors disappearing from protected reception, including whether the government will investigate possible trafficking and act to prevent further disappearances. The State Secretary confirmed roughly 1,400 unaccompanied minors left reception since 2014 (about 40 Vietnamese from protected care), said disappearances cannot be fully prevented, and committed to an EMM phenomenon study and data analysis with results due in autumn 2019.
In addition, I am having an analysis carried out of data available within the migration chain on the disappearances of unaccompanied minors from reception facilities.
Daarnaast laat ik een analyse uitvoeren van binnen de migratieketen beschikbare gegevens over de verdwijningen van amv’s
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht dat de beantwoording van Kamervragen is afgestemd met het BKR

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about reports that the ministry coordinated its answers to earlier parliamentary questions with the credit registration bureau BKR, and whether this undermined trust in politics. The minister replied that consulting BKR was necessary to check the feasibility of the measures it was asked to take, that the ministry has no control over the independent BKR, and that the BKR has since published a balancing-of-interests guideline, free access to personal data, and dispute-committee rulings.
The picture painted in the report is not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat in het bericht wordt geschetst, herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het staken van reddingsacties op de Middellandse Zee

An SP MP asks the State Secretary why naval ships under EU operation Sophia were withdrawn, how rescue and smuggling interdiction are guaranteed, how the Libyan coast guard is monitored, whether the remaining ships carried helicopters and medical facilities, and whether Libyans have a right to asylum in Europe, along with questions on non-refoulement, detention centres and root causes of migration. The government answers that the remaining ships had helicopters and medical facilities, that asylum applications are assessed individually, that Libyan coast guard rescues do not amount to refoulement, and that it is pressing for registration systems and detention reform while pursuing an integrated migration agenda.
The cabinet is following developments closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Regeling die moet zorgen voor meer banen, houdt lonen laag’

An SP MP asked the government whether the LIV low-income wage subsidy keeps wages low and creates jobs, and asked for recipient lists and whether it should be abolished. The minister denied wage suppression signals, cited CPB expectations of about 7,000 extra full-time jobs, announced an evaluation by year-end, and refused to disclose individual company subsidy recipients as business-confidential.
Decisions under the Wtl wage-domain subsidy act are not public.
De beschikkingen op basis van de Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein (Wtl) zijn niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over een app die de invoering van de wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet kan versnellen

MPs Van Dijk and Peters asked whether an app from Stichting Financieel Paspoort could speed up the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet and whether people can use GDPR access rights to obtain the data needed. The state secretary answered that the app does not replace the implementation trajectory because it cannot cover partner and household data, that interim measures are planned, and that GDPR access alone does not suffice for the calculation.
The foundation's proposal is therefore not a full alternative to the implementation trajectory of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet, including accelerating it.
Het voorstel van de Stichting is dan ook geen volwaardig alternatief voor het – versnellen van – het implementatietraject van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Sociale dienst Achterhoek checkt zelfs ondergoed'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the Achterhoek social services body Laborijn searches homes, requires recipients to log showers and meals, and is intimidating, plus questions on privacy, gifts counted as income, external monitoring, client council protection and sanctions. The State Secretary said respectful treatment and proportionate enforcement are required, that the law protects privacy and allows checks, that Laborijn runs enforcement in-house, that municipalities are accountable to their councils rather than subject to national intervention, and that Laborijn's board announced an independent external investigation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over arbeidsmigranten in Gelderse schuren en stallen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about migrant workers housed in barns and stables in Gelderland, whether the government shares responsibility, whether municipal legal and financial tools are sufficient, and whether Labour Inspectorate capacity is adequate. The minister acknowledges the problem as unacceptable, points to the Wage Act housing deduction rules, local responsibility for housing, Good Landlordship tools, municipal enforcement budgets, and extra Inspectorate funding, and promises a letter before the summer recess.
I find it unacceptable that migrant workers are housed in barns and stables under poor conditions.
Ik vind het onaanvaardbaar dat arbeidsmigranten in schuren en stallen onder slechte omstandigheden worden gehuisvest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een visumplicht voor Albanezen

An SP MP asked the government about reintroducing a visa requirement for Albanian nationals, citing criminality, overstaying, asylum claims and irregular migration. The ministers answered that registered Albanian suspects are declining, that the visa requirement was lifted after Albania met the conditions, and that reintroduction would need broad EU support, so they will keep using cooperation and may revisit the emergency brake later.
In 2010 the visa requirement for citizens of Albanian nationality was abolished, after it was established that Albania meets the conditions for this.
In 2010 is de visumplicht voor burgers met de Albanese nationaliteit afgeschaft, nadat was vastgesteld dat Albanië voldoet aan de voorwaarden hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rechterlijke uitspraak over ‘onredelijk hoge boetes’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs how she responds to a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that fines imposed under the tightened 2013-2014 sanctions regime were evidently unreasonably high and must be reviewed, and whether all such fines will be reassessed ex officio and affected people informed or compensated. The State Secretary says she is studying the ruling, will send a fuller response with consequences for implementation before the summer recess, and will provide the number of fines imposed in the period later.
I will send my response to the ruling and explanation of the consequences for implementation to your House before the summer recess.
Mijn reactie op de uitspraak en uitleg over de gevolgen voor de uitvoering stuur ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een onderzoek van FNV naar onveiligheid en geweld in asielzoekerscentra

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an FNV study reporting serious aggression against COA asylum-centre staff, linking it to asylum seekers from safe countries, staffing, staff voice and a new facility for disruptive residents. State Secretary Harbers acknowledged the problem, said the government pursues return agreements with safe countries, pointed to existing measures and the EBTL pilot, promised to inform parliament after the Inspectorate's recommendations, and maintained that intensified measures are ongoing.
I have started working on the Inspectorate's recommendations and will inform your House about them soon.
Ik ben aan de slag gegaan met de aanbevelingen van de Inspectie en zal uw Kamer binnenkort hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huren in Hellevoetsluis

MPs Beckerman and Van Dijk (SP) asked about rising rents in Hellevoetsluis, housing conditions and possible exploitation of migrant workers, waiting times for social housing and data on migrant workers. Minister Ollongren answered that housing shortages drive up rents, that municipalities and the province are responsible for local supply, that exploitation questions fall to other bodies, and that updated migrant worker figures will follow later in the year.
I cannot judge from the reporting whether there is exploitation or assess the specific housing conditions, partly because the expertise to assess this lies with other organisations.

Ik kan op basis van de berichtgeving niet beoordelen of er sprake is van uitbuiting of oordelen over de specifieke woonomstandigheden, mede omdat de expertise om te beoordelen of hier sprake van is bij andere organisaties is belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vrouwenbesnijdenis

Rep. Van Dijk asked the government about a request to the Hague mayor to act against the As-Soennah mosque over alleged endorsement of female genital mutilation, whether reconstructive surgery after FGM should be covered by basic insurance, and the practice of hymen checks and hymen restoration. The minister replied that the enforcement decision lies with the mayor, that FGM is illegal and the government pursues an integrated chain approach, that reconstructive surgery cannot yet be added to basic insurance pending a Zorginstituut opinion, and that the government opposes hymen restoration done out of fear and will consult doctors and the NVOG.
The request to enforce is addressed to the mayor of The Hague.
Het verzoek tot handhaven is gericht aan de burgemeester van Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen va het lid Jasper van Dijk over spookburgers en gemeenten die een briefadres weigeren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Interior about municipalities refusing mail addresses (briefadres) to homeless and 'ghost' citizens, leaving them without access to insurance, benefits and passports. The government acknowledged the problem, said it was contacting municipalities and the Nationale ombudsman, and announced a legislative amendment to make municipalities register people at a mail address ex officio.

The Ministry of BZK organised and facilitated national workshops for municipalities in early 2017 and in September and October 2018 to draw attention to the topics in the circular on the BRP and mail addresses.
Zo heeft het Ministerie van BZK begin 2017, en in september en oktober 2018, landelijke workshops voor gemeenten georganiseerd en begeleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huiseigenaren die arbeidsmigranten in kamertjes proppen

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked ministers about homeowners housing migrant workers in overcrowded rooms, the shortage of adequate housing, Hilvarenbeek's housing target, and the government's role. The minister answers that housing is a regional and local responsibility, points to the SNF quality mark and a forthcoming guide for municipalities, but declines to give a count of migrant workers without adequate housing and offers no national lead role.
How housing for migrant workers is best distributed within a region and in which forms it can be provided must be determined at regional and local level.
Hoe de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten binnen een regio het beste past qua verdeling en in welke woonvormen deze kan worden gerealiseerd, moet op regionaal en lokaal niveau worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over twee jaar uitstel voor een wet die mensen met schulden moet helpen

An MP asks why the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (simplifying the garnishment-free amount act) is delayed by two years, how many people are harmed, and whether bank garnishment and household goods seizure rules will be modernised. The State Secretary attributes the delay to ICT and data-exchange challenges at UWV and the Tax Authority, states that the government is working on interim measures, and says the broader garnishment reform bill is with the Council of State before being submitted to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "armoede en achterblijvende lonen"

An SP MP asks the government about a Nibud report showing households on minimum income falling short for essential and social participation costs, especially large families, and about raising the minimum wage, wage growth and municipal poverty policy. The government answers that most households are covered by national schemes, points to child-benefit reforms and tax cuts already planned, rejects a 10% minimum wage increase on cost and employment grounds, and says it will study reallocating child-scheme funds and continue talks with municipalities.
In its response to the policy review, the cabinet indicated there is reason for further study of a possible reallocation of available financial resources within the child schemes.

In de reactie op de beleidsdoorlichting heeft het kabinet aangegeven dat er daarom aanleiding is voor nader onderzoek naar een mogelijke herallocatie van de beschikbare financiële middelen binnen de kindregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitzettingen naar Soedan

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the ongoing popular unrest in Sudan (about 40 dead, 1,000 detained) affects the safety assessment for deportations, why no new Sudan country report has been published since 2017, and whether a decision and departure moratorium is planned. The State Secretary answers that the situation is monitored and risk groups are already covered, that a new country report is expected around June 2019, and that no moratorium or suspension of removals is currently warranted.
At this moment I see no reason to introduce a decision and departure moratorium for Sudan.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om een besluit- en vertrekmoratorium in te stellen voor Soedan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitzendbureaus die aanzetten tot fraude met de werkloosheidsuitkering (WW-fraude)
