An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether staffing agencies were dismissing Polish migrant workers after 26 weeks to save pension costs and how UWV checks wrongful dismissal for WW benefits. The minister said such practices are undesirable, that UWV checks culpable unemployment on the contract and reasons given rather than how the employer refills the work, and that a broader evaluation of the agency regime including revolving-door constructions will follow.
I consider it undesirable if employers, purely for financial reasons, dismiss employees in order to then hire a new employee for the same work.
Ik vind het onwenselijk als werkgevers, louter om financiële redenen, werknemers ontslaan om vervolgens voor datzelfde werk een nieuwe werknemer aan te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de EU-missie EUCAP in Niger

An MP asks the government about the EU mission EUCAP Sahel Niger, the funding for alternative livelihoods for former smugglers in Agadez, and alleged police corruption shown in a VPRO documentary. The minister answers that the EU spent 31 million euros on the mission, of which the Netherlands contributes about 5% via the EU budget, and describes the PAIERA programme where 287 of 981 eligible applications were funded in a pilot, with 694 placed on a waiting list for a second phase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ICT-problemen bij UWV

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about claims on a podcast that UWV removed digital fraud-detection capabilities from the Polisadministratie, that UWV spent about 250 million euro on ICT in 2007, and whether earlier budget claims and spending were efficient. The minister denied that fraud-detection functions were removed, confirmed the 2007 ICT spending figure of 258 million, admitted ICT costs overran budget though not the total, and declined further investigation citing existing oversight reports.
I therefore see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor het doen van nader onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat sociale werkvoorziening ATEA te Breda verdwijnt en dat dit tot veel onrust leidt

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about reported unrest over the closure of the ATEA sheltered employment organisation in Breda, and whether Breda's failure to adopt the legally required client-participation ordinance under the Wsw invalidates its policy, plus related questions on beschut werk and other municipalities. The State Secretary says the municipality guarantees staff continuity, that the missing ordinance does not affect the lawfulness of policy, that the council is responsible for overseeing the executive, and that the evaluation of beschut werk will be concluded in autumn 2019.
It is up to the municipal council to check the executive on correct implementation.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad het college te controleren op een juiste uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gijs van Dijk over uitbuiting van Roemenen in Nederland

MPs Jasper and Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of labour exploitation of Romanian workers in the Netherlands, including complaint figures, the reasons victims do not report, estimates of the scale, food safety risks, and enforcement. The minister answered that exploitation is unacceptable, described the Inspectorate's handling of complaints and the extra funding and programmes to intensify enforcement, but gave no nationality-specific figures and no new prevalence estimate.
The estimates of the National Rapporteur are not broken down by nationality.
De schattingen van de Nationaal Rapporteur zijn niet uitgesplitst naar nationaliteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over een naar Bahrein uitgezette man

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked whether a rejected asylum seeker deported to Bahrain was arrested and possibly mistreated, why the IND did not weigh this risk, and whether deportations to Bahrain should be suspended with an independent investigation. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy, said the IND assesses each application on its merits and acknowledges worsening human rights, but refused a moratorium or investigation, while promising to monitor developments.
As your House is aware, in connection with the privacy of the person concerned I cannot make statements about individual cases and possible deportations.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken en eventuele uitzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over fouten bij keuring van zieke jongeren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a UWV internal study finding that in 2016 about one in five Wajong disability assessments carried a risk of incorrect decisions, low quality of labour expert reports, why the report was not sent to parliament, and access to appeal. The State Secretary disputed the 33% reading, said the report was not forwarded to him, declined to list all internal audits, rejected independence changes, and pointed to re-assessments and a 2019 Wajong evaluation.
The internal audit report in question was not submitted to me at the time for information.
Het bewuste interne onderzoeksrapport is destijds niet ter informatie aan mij aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het personeelstekort bij de IND

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the IND's frequent absence from court hearings, staff shortages, vacancies, and reliance on underpaid agency workers. The State Secretary answered that the IND attends about 80% of hearings, that absence does not automatically delay cases, and that recruitment of around 200 staff is underway, with agency practices said to comply with labour law.
In these cases a consideration was made not to attend the hearing, and a written position (statement of defence) from the IND was submitted before the hearing.
In deze gevallen is een afweging gemaakt om niet ter zitting aanwezig te zijn en is voor de zitting een schriftelijk standpunt (verweerschrift) van de IND ingestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de koopkrachtplaatjes van middeninkomens niet kloppen

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the purchasing-power projections for middle incomes are accurate, given claims that middle-income households gain little from economic recovery, and asked about income trends, wage growth and government action. The government rejects the criticism, says the projections are the best available estimates, and attributes weak income growth mainly to taxes, premiums and slow wage growth linked to productivity, while promising further study of productivity without committing to a concrete new step.
I do not share the view of Mr Castelein.
Ik deel de mening van de heer Castelein niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het bericht "Jongerenreis naar radicale prediker"

MPs Becker and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government knew of Milli Görüş youth trips to Turkey involving a radical preacher, and whether it would monitor, investigate or act on such trips and on the organisation's independence and funding. The minister answered that the government does not monitor organisations' trips or religious education, that intelligence matters cannot be disclosed, that Milli Görüş distanced itself from the preacher's statements, that a 2017 study found no proven Turkish control, and that municipalities did not know of the trips.
Social and religious organisations are free to organise foreign trips. The government does not supervise this.
Het staat maatschappelijke en religieuze organisaties vrij om buitenlandse reizen te organiseren. Hierop wordt door de overheid geen toezicht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de IND de eigen regels overtreedt bij het beoordelen van verblijfsvergunningen

An SP MP asked whether IND officials who handled initial decisions also handled objections against withdrawals of residence permits, potentially violating GALA rules and possibly forcing staff to sign under other names, and whether the IND has an independent supervisor. The Secretary of State acknowledged the rule, said an integrity investigation is underway, denied any deliberate decision to allow this, stated the IND has no separate supervisor but a ministerial ownership role and an internal whistleblower scheme, and gave no outcome yet.
As long as the investigation has not been concluded, the question of whether, why and to what extent this happened cannot yet be answered.
Zo lang het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond, kan de vraag of, waarom en in welke mate dit is gebeurd nog niet beantwoord worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met veiligelanders

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers from safe countries causing nuisance, including whether they could be held in closed reception centres and how to pressure countries to take back returnees. The State Secretary answered that a targeted approach with a range of measures is used, that closed reception is legally not possible, and that Extra Beveiligde Toezichtlocaties offer 100 places.
It is legally not possible to operate a closed reception location.
Het is juridisch niet mogelijk om een gesloten opvanglocatie te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er een schaderegeling komt voor ondernemers die te maken hebben met diefstal door asielzoekers uit veilige landen

An SP MP asks whether a compensation fund for shopkeepers hit by theft by asylum seekers from safe countries exists, why offenders cannot be billed directly, and who finances it. The Staatssecretaris says a dedicated fund is not warranted, that criminal law and existing schemes such as SODA should be used, and that SODA and COA are discussing how COA can support this.
There is therefore no immediate reason for a specific compensation fund set up for this purpose.
Voor een specifiek hiervoor in het leven geroepen schadefonds bestaat dan ook niet meteen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het opsporen van uitkeringsfraude van mensen met vermogen in het buitenland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about detecting benefit fraud by people holding assets abroad, including a Nieuwsuur report and alleged threats against fraud investigators in Turkey. The State Secretary said enforcement is complex abroad, that municipalities bear primary enforcement responsibility, that a handbook on investigations is being updated, and that asset-check agreements are being pursued in treaties, but gave no figures on success rates and withheld some data because municipalities choose their own methods.
The Ministry of SZW does not have the percentage of successful investigations per agency.
Het Ministerie van SZW beschikt niet over het percentage succesvolle opsporingen per instantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over armoede in Nederland en weken alleen gekookte rijst

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about poverty in the Netherlands, including a reported woman who lived for weeks on only boiled rice, and whether the anti-poverty policy has been effective. The State Secretary answers that poverty is a priority, cites CBS and Eurostat trends, and lists measures such as lowering taxes on work, the broader employment offensive, and funds for municipalities and anti-poverty organisations, plus a planned talk with the VNG about better reaching low-income workers.
I will continue to critically examine the current participation and poverty policy in order to further reduce the number of people living in poverty in the Netherlands.
Ik blijf kritisch kijken naar het huidige participatie- en armoedebeleid om het aantal mensen dat in Nederland in armoede leeft steeds verder terug te kunnen dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de toename van het aantal daklozen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about a wheelchair-using homeless woman refused at a Haarlem night shelter, the rising number of homeless people, waiting lists, and municipalities refusing postal addresses to homeless people. The State Secretary answers that the woman now has shelter, that CBS figures show homelessness rising to 2015 with a dip in 2016, that no national waiting-list data exist, and that the Ministry of BZK has pursued municipalities on postal-address refusals and will raise the issue with them.
Municipalities are legally responsible for providing good help and support.
Gemeenten zijn wettelijk verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van goede hulp en ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de hervestiging van zieke vluchtelingen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the resettlement of refugees with serious illnesses, including the medical sub-quota of 30 places, UNHCR funding shortfalls for cancer treatment in Lebanon, and EU donor and resettlement contributions. The government answered that medical need is one of several UNHCR vulnerability categories, that the medical sub-quota is increasingly irrelevant and under internal review, and that Nederland gives substantial but not sufficient humanitarian funding.
This sub-quota was set up because of the greater workload that these kinds of cases entail.
Dit sub quotum is ingesteld vanwege de grotere werkbelasting die dit soort zaken met zich meebrengt.
Antwoord op  vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Turkse weekendscholen

An MP asked the government whether Turkey is funding weekend schools in the Netherlands, how many subsidy applications exist, and whether the government will control lesson content and prevent foreign influence on children. The government answered that Turkey promised transparency and information sharing, that about 15 applications were reportedly made, and that informal weekend education cannot be banned because inspectors lack legal powers, though it opposes education that hinders integration or promotes anti-democratic views.
At present the cabinet does not have full insight into the nature and scope of informal education at weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen volledig zicht op de aard en omvang van het informeel onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak over de vluchtelingencrisis op Curaçao

SP MPs asked whether Curaçao requested Dutch help during the Venezuelan migrant crisis, what aid could be given, and whether returning migrants to Venezuela was part of the border-reopening deal. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao requested support, that the Netherlands provided expertise visits and a EUR 132,000 detention contribution pending a proposal, and that returns to Venezuela were not part of the agreement.
This is also not part of the agreement, which was published on the central government website following the Zembla FOI request.
Dit is ook geen onderdeel van het akkoord dat n.a.v. het WOB-verzoek van Zembla is gepubliceerd op de website van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Jasper van Dijk over "vingerscan-affaire in Spijkenisse"

MPs Renkema and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the illegal collection of welfare recipients' fingerprints in Spijkenisse, the reversal of sanctions, and the treatment of claimants as criminals were acceptable. The State Secretary called fingerprint scanning undesirable and contrary to privacy law, said the practice had ended and the AP was responsible for enforcement, and left sanction disputes to the courts.
Scanning and collecting fingerprints of welfare recipients to check their attendance at a work company is, in my view, undesirable and moreover contrary to the applicable privacy legislation.

Het scannen en verzamelen van vingerafdrukken van bijstandsgerechtigden ter controle van hun aanwezigheid bij een werkbedrijf acht ik onwenselijk en bovendien in strijd met de geldende privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gevaarlijke vluchtroutes in Griekenland

The SP MP asked the State Secretary about the deaths of 11 migrants on the Evros route from Turkey to Greece, whether the EU-Turkey deal caused the rise in crossings, and whether closing routes without legal alternatives pushes migrants into more dangerous routes, citing UNHCR. The government called the deaths tragic, denied a clear link to the EU-Turkey deal citing changing nationality mix and other factors, and pointed to resettlement expansion, a scholarship programme and migration cooperation as legal routes without committing to a concrete new action.
The cabinet does not consider it likely that this increase is a consequence of the EU-Turkey Statement.
Het kabinet acht het niet waarschijnlijk dat de betreffende toename een gevolg is van de EU-Turkije Verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over Albanese migranten die bij de gemeente Moerdijk in vrachtwagen klimmen

MPs Kuiken and Van Dijk asked about Albanian migrants climbing into trucks near Moerdijk bound for England, and about the mayor's plea for help. The State Secretary described the involved agencies, possible offences and removal procedures, said an inter-agency framework was being prepared, and promised to meet the mayor.
I will myself, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, enter into consultation with the mayor of Moerdijk.
Ik zal zelf eveneens, samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, in overleg treden met de burgemeester van Moerdijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de nieuwe ontslagwet slecht is voor werknemers

The SP MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the new dismissal law harms employees, citing an Inspectorate SZW report on UWV's business-economic dismissal review, including claims that employers replace dismissed staff with cheaper flex workers and supply false information. The minister rejects the claim that the law is bad for workers, notes that the Inspectorate's findings rest on perceptions that may differ from reality, and announces better information for employees on the re-employment condition and UWV follow-up.
UWV acts carefully by checking the information supplied by the employer for completeness and consistency.
Het UWV handelt zorgvuldig door de door de werkgever aangeleverde informatie te controleren op volledigheid en consistentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Onzekerheid heerst voor gehandicapte werknemers’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that workers with disabilities in the Participatiewet face insecure contracts, low share of permanent contracts (18%), sober employment conditions without a cao, missing pensions, and the role of municipalities and sheltered work. The State Secretary answered that the 18% figure relates only to the Participatiewet group in the jobs agreement, that 61% of hours for the whole target group are under permanent contracts, that employment conditions are a matter for social partners, and that the government will pursue a broad offensive including support for sheltered workplaces and the SER advice.
The central government has no role in this.
Het rijk heeft hierin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het intrekken van een Nederlands visum door Zweden

An SP MP asked the government about Sweden withdrawing a valid Dutch Schengen visa held by two Senegalese brothers who were detained in Sweden for six weeks, and whether the Netherlands could intervene. The government answered that Sweden acted independently under EU law, that the Netherlands cannot block such withdrawals or interfere in Swedish detention proceedings, and that new visa applications are assessed on their merits.
The Netherlands cannot and may not interfere in the legal proceedings of another country.
Nederland kan en mag zich niet mengen in de rechtsgang van een ander land.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat jongeren via moskee-organisatie Milli Görüs in Nederland op "trainingskamp' gaan naar een omstreden Turkse imam die de gewapende jihad steunt

An MP asked whether youths were taken by Milli Görüs to Turkey to be taught by a radical imam who supports armed jihad, and what the government would do about it. The minister said such trips are legal for civil society organisations, that the government will not propose measures to prevent foreign trips, and that financing of such trips is unknown.
Social and religious organisations are free to organise foreign trips.
Het staat maatschappelijke en religieuze organisaties vrij om buitenlandse reizen te organiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Van Ojik en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris in hoger beroep is gegaan in de zaak van Lili en Howick en daarmee het advies van de Raad voor kind

MPs asked why the State Secretary appealed the Lili and Howick ruling and disregarded Raad voor de Kinderbescherming conditions, and whether removal of supervised children without achieved goals is responsible. The State Secretary answered that asylum law under the CJEU M'Bodj judgment excludes these socio-economic circumstances from Article 3 ECHR, that the Raad van State ruled in his favour, that the children may now stay after events of 8 September 2018, and that the RvdK, IND and DT&V cooperate while each applies its own context.

The circumstances invoked in this case, namely that the goals formulated by the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming have not yet been achieved, cannot and may not, according to this case law of the Court of Justice, lead to asylum status.

De aangevoerde omstandigheden in deze zaak, erin gelegen dat de door de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming geformuleerde doelen nog niet zijn bereikt, kunnen en mogen volgens deze jurisprudentie van het Hof van Justitie niet leiden tot een asielstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het niet beschikbaar zijn van het loonkostenvoordeel voor mensen met een militair invaliditeitspensioen

An MP asked why people receiving a military disability pension (MIP) are excluded from the employer wage-cost subsidy and whether the rules will change. The minister answered that the MIP is compensation for invalidity rather than an incapacity benefit, so it does not qualify, and pointed to Defence's support arrangements and UWV expertise instead.
The MIP is financial compensation for invalidity and not an income provision for incapacity for work, like the WIA or WAMIL.
Het MIP betreft een financiële compensatie vanwege invaliditeit en is geen inkomensvoorziening vanwege arbeidsongeschiktheid, zoals de WIA of WAMIL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de volmacht en de Participatiewet

Two SP MPs asked whether a son holding a power of attorney for his incapacitated mother can lose his Participatiewet benefit merely by being deemed able to dispose of her assets, and what options exist to prevent this. The Secretary of State replied that a power of attorney does not affect benefit entitlement if the funds are used solely for the principal, that the benefit must be stopped only if the duty to disclose is breached, and that municipalities have been informed via a Gemeentenieuws notice.
A power of attorney and being reasonably able to dispose of funds has no effect on the right to benefits, provided the funds are used exclusively for the benefit of the authorised person.
Een volmacht en het redelijkerwijs over middelen kunnen beschikken heeft geen invloed op het recht op bijstand, mits de middelen uitsluitend ten behoeve van de gemachtigde worden aangewend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over uitzettingen naar Afghanistan

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, ChristenUnie and SP asked the State Secretary about deportations of Afghan families with minor children, the compatibility with children's rights, recognition rates across EU states, and the number of families in return procedures. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the deportation endangered the family, defended the policy change and the Afghan recognition rate, and said unaccompanied minors are not returned where no family or adequate care is available.
I do not share this conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht over nauwelijks gebruikte ebtl’s

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the low use of the extra supervision and guidance locations (EBTL) in Amsterdam and Hoogeveen, their costs, the placement criteria, and the treatment of minors and safe-country asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that the locations were in a startup pilot phase, promised a fuller report in autumn 2018 and a WODC evaluation by summer 2019, and gave cost estimates, but withheld or deferred several specifics such as overlast incident counts and outflow figures.
As promised in the committee debate of 14 December 2017, I will inform your House more extensively this autumn about the functioning of the EBTL.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO van 14 december 2017 3 , zal ik uw Kamer dit najaar uitgebreider informeren over het functioneren van de ebtl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen van arbeidsmigratie

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about housing shortages, employer-provided housing, wage deductions, registration and displacement effects of labour migration. The minister acknowledged the housing need, pointed to ongoing research and instruments, and said municipalities and employers bear responsibility, with EU free movement limiting language requirements and work permits.
It is up to municipalities, temp agencies, employers and housing providers to jointly take their responsibility and engage in discussion about quality housing for labour migrants.
Het is aan gemeenten, uitzendbureaus, werkgevers en huisvesters om gezamenlijk hun verantwoordelijkheid te pakken en het gesprek aan te gaan over kwalitatieve huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over de negatieve gevolgen van uitzetting naar Armenië voor de PTSS-klachten van Howick en Lili

MPs Van Ojik, Kuiken and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the IND adequately investigated the PTSD complaints of children Howick and Lili and their deportation to Armenia, and whether deportation should be halted pending new investigation. The Staatssecretaris declined to address individual medical circumstances, citing privacy of special personal data, and confirmed no irreversible steps had yet been taken.
As your House is aware, I do not go into individual and personal aspects in public answers to parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is ga ik in openbare beantwoording van Kamervragen niet in op individuele en persoonlijke aspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een vacaturesite die mogelijk discriminatie in de hand werkt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a job vacancy site allowing filtering on faith, appearance and political preference amounts to discrimination, and whether investigation and talks with the company are warranted. The state secretary condemned arbitrary filtering as contrary to government policy, noted that some distinctions are permitted under equal treatment law, said courts, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and the Public Prosecution Service decide on violations, and promised to study the impact of algorithmic matching as part of a broader inquiry.
I intend to conduct research into this to assess what the impact could be on discrimination and how to anticipate this in the future.
Ik ben voornemens hier onderzoek naar te doen om te bezien wat de impact kan zijn wat betreft discriminatie en hoe hier op geanticipeerd moet worden in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over de tweede tranche van de Turkijedeal

SP MPs asked the government about a second tranche of the EU-Turkey deal, including a reported 50 million euro Dutch contribution, whether the funds would fund border control, how their use would be reported, and whether Turkey had been challenged over reports of shootings at the Syrian border. The minister said the first 2 billion euro is funded from the EU budget with no national request yet, that FRIT projects target refugees' living conditions under Commission reporting and Dutch committee seat, and that the Commission could not confirm the shooting reports, though it monitors the situation.
As often exchanged with your House, projects are financed from the Facility for Refugees in Turkey (FRIT) to further improve the situation of refugees in Turkey and the communities hosting them.

Antwoord 4, 6 Zoals vaker met uw Kamer gewisseld 2 , worden vanuit de Faciliteit voor vluchtelingen in Turkije (FRIT) projecten gefinancierd om de situatie van vluchtelingen in Turkije en de gemeenschappen die hen opvangen verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bespioneren van uitkeringsgerechtigden

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reported surveillance, camera use, and intrusive questioning of welfare recipients by municipal social services, and about rules on cohabitation and cooperation with fraud investigations. The State Secretary declined to judge individual cases, said camera surveillance is no longer permitted after Central Raad van Beroep rulings, and announced an exploration of strengthening the legal basis for technical enforcement tools.
Currently I am exploring whether and how the legal basis for the use of technical tools in enforcement can be strengthened.
Momenteel verken ik of en zo ja, hoe de wettelijke grondslag voor de inzet van technische hulpmiddelen in de handhaving, kan worden verstevigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het lage-inkomensvoordeel

An SP MP asked the minister whether the low-wage allowance (LIV) discourages wage increases, whether it benefits large profitable firms such as Primark and Jumbo, and for transparency on recipients, including the share going to EU workers and to the quota register. The minister denied receiving signals that employers keep wages low for the LIV, declined a CPB study as premature, gave only sector-level LIV figures citing privacy, and promised a later analysis of overlap with the ET-regeling.
For privacy reasons, I do not consider it desirable to provide this kind of business-confidential information at employer level.
Ik acht het, vanuit privacy overwegingen, niet wenselijk om dit soort bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie op werkgeversniveau te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ernstige problemen na gezinshereniging van Eritrese vluchtelingen

An SP MP asked the ministers about serious problems (domestic violence, child abuse, health, integration) faced by Eritrean family reunification migrants and whether support, information and shelter are adequate. The government acknowledges the risks, points to existing guidance and Pharos research, promises to raise the issue with VNG, shelter and Veilig Thuis organisations, and says the residence permit type does not hinder seeking protection.

I will bring the Pharos exploration and the Argos article and broadcast to the attention of the VNG, the 35 centre municipalities for women's shelters, the women's shelter institutions and the national Veilig Thuis network.

Ik zal de verkenning van Pharos en het artikel en de uitzending van Argos onder de aandacht brengen van de VNG, de 35 centrumgemeenten vrouwenopvang, de vrouwenopvanginstellingen en het landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over uitbuiting van vrachtwagenchauffeurs

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Laçin asked ministers about exploitation of truck drivers, including enforcement of the 45-hour weekend rest, the adequacy of ILT enforcement and fines, sham constructions with foreign subsidiaries, and truckers' hotel accommodation. The minister denies that the Netherlands has become Europe's parking lot, says enforcement is risk-based and targeted, defends the current fine policy, and refers to ongoing EU mobility package negotiations.
I do not consider it opportune to change the current fining policy.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om het huidige boetebeleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat buitenlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs oververtegenwoordigd zijn bij ongelukken en pechgevallen

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether foreign truck drivers are overrepresented in accidents and breakdowns, and what the causes, costs and measures are. The minister answered that the data cannot establish the nationality-linked causes or costs, that most incidents are technical or tyre-related, and that the new road safety plan will address freight transport risks.
To further specify the causes of the involvement of foreign drivers, detailed information on all incidents is necessary.
Om de oorzaken van de betrokkenheid van buitenlandse chauffeurs nader te specificeren is gedetailleerde informatie van alle incidenten noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het tekortschietende toezicht op deurwaarders

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the four-person Bureau Financieel Toezicht can adequately supervise all bailiffs, and why investigations fell while bailiff offices under heightened supervision doubled. The minister replied that there is currently no enforcement shortfall, agreed to a 335,000 euro budget deficit for 2018, and will discuss funding for 2019 with the BFT and professional bodies in October.
I have agreed to a budget deficit for 2018 so that the BFT can carry out the proposed supervisory activities regarding bailiffs.
Ik heb ingestemd met een tekort op de begroting voor 2018 opdat het BFT uitvoering kan geven aan de voorgestelde toezichtactiviteiten ten aanzien van de gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten, Remco Dijkstra, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht 'Nederlands rijbewijs online te koop via Poolse website'

MPs from VVD and SP asked whether fake Dutch driving licences sold via a Polish website endanger road safety, how often forgeries are found and prosecuted, what is being done to take the site down, and whether employers check licences. The minister answered that forgeries are rare and prosecuted under existing law, that Poland lacks a legal basis to act against the site until a pending bill takes effect, and that the site's removal depends on Polish authorities.
The Polish Ministry said the relevant Polish authorities are aware of the site's activities, but without a legal expansion there is no basis to act against these practices.

Het Poolse Ministerie liet weten dat de relevante Poolse autoriteiten aandacht hebben voor de activiteiten van de bewuste site, maar dat zonder wettelijke verruiming er geen grond is voor optreden tegen deze praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat president Erdogan de Turkse Nederlanders per brief oproept om op zijn partij te stemmen

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether Erdogan's letter urging Turkish Dutch citizens to vote for his party was acceptable, how Turkish parties obtained voter data, and what the government would do about it. The minister said the letter is inappropriate as an implicit voting recommendation but legal, that voter lists were lawfully obtained from Turkish authorities, and that the government would raise the matter with Turkey if diaspora politics crossed legal limits.
The cabinet considers it inappropriate that Dutch citizens receive a letter from the Turkish president calling on them to vote in the Turkish parliamentary and presidential elections.
Het kabinet vindt het ongepast dat Nederlandse burgers een brief ontvangen van de Turkse president met een oproep om te gaan stemmen voor de Turkse parlements-en presidentsverkiezing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het niet uitvoeren van een motie over meervoudig gehandicapte kinderen

An SP MP asks why the 2016 Siderius motion, which asks for a Wajong benefit for severely multiply disabled pupils who leave special school at 18, has still not been implemented, and when it will be. The State Secretary says she is willing to implement it through a legal amendment removing the 'studying' exclusion, with a target entry into force of 1 January 2020, subject to feasibility.
I am therefore willing to implement the Siderius motion with the aim of preventing the right to a benefit from being a reason to stop education.
Ik ben dan ook bereid om uitvoering te geven aan de motie Siderius met het doel te voorkomen dat het recht op een uitkering reden is om te stoppen met onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het scheiden van immigrantenkinderen in de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the government would react to UN calls to end separating immigrant children from parents in the United States, summon the US ambassador, condemn the practice, and raise it with President Trump. The minister replied that concerns were conveyed diplomatically earlier, that a serious debate took place in the US, and that a presidential decree on 20 June stopped separating families.
The concerns that exist in Dutch society were earlier conveyed to the US through diplomatic channels.
De zorgen die in de Nederlandse samenleving bestaan zijn in een eerder stadium via diplomatieke weg aan de VS overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een chauffeur 34 uur onderweg was zonder fatsoenlijke pauze

The SP MPs Laçin and Van Dijk asked the ministers whether a Dutch truck driver who drove 34 hours without a proper break reflects a wider problem with tachograph tampering and enforcement, and who bears responsibility. The minister calls it unacceptable, describes ILT and ISZW risk-based enforcement and cross-border cooperation, says such a case was not previously encountered, and places primary responsibility on the employer and driver.
Exceeding driving and rest times occurs more often, but the ILT has not previously encountered a driver who was 34 hours on the road without a proper break.
Overschrijdingen van de rij- en rusttijden komen vaker voor, maar een chauffeur die 34 uur onderweg is zonder fatsoenlijke pauze, is de ILT nog niet eerder tegengekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over “Strijdigheid van bepalingen van de verordening Re-integratie en loonkostensubsidie van de gemeente Teylingen en andere ISD Bollenstreek-gemeenten met de Par

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether the Teylingen and other ISD Bollenstreek municipalities' rules limiting wage-cost subsidy hours conflict with the Participatiewet, and what supervisory options exist. The State Secretary confirmed the conflict, said the ISD will propose reversing the policy to municipal councils, and stated that interbestuurlijk toezicht measures are not needed for now.
It is therefore good that the ISD Bollenstreek will propose to the municipal councils, via the college of mayor and aldermen, to bring municipal policy back into line with the Participatiewet.
Het is daarom goed dat de ISD Bollenstreek via de colleges van B&W de gemeenteraden zal voorstellen het gemeentelijk beleid weer in overstemming met de Participatiewet te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een in Rotterdam werkzame imam in Engeland is veroordeeld voor kindermishandeling

Two MPs asked whether a Rotterdam imam convicted in England of child abuse was known to his mosque board, whether a VOG should be required for imams, whether he could obtain one, and about links to the Hijaz community. The government said the mosque board claims it was unaware, that VOG is an employer responsibility with a recommended VOG for child-related work, that a foreign conviction would appear in Dutch records and normally block a VOG, and that it cannot judge specific links but relies on the driesporen approach and transparency measures on foreign funding.
We do not go into individual cases.
Wij gaan niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over een geliquideerde man in Almere

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked whether the man liquidated in Almere in 2015 was a Iranian-convicted attacker who had received a residence permit under an alias, whether Iran contacted the Netherlands, and whether the MKO is considered terrorist. The government said no signals of a different identity were known during the asylum procedure, that some indications later emerged in the criminal investigation and were reported to ministers, that no reason was seen to further examine the identification process, and that no Iranian correspondence was found.
In this case no reason is seen to further investigate the identification and registration process.
Er wordt in deze casus geen aanleiding gezien om het I&R-proces verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over het uitsluiten van vrachtwagenchauffeurs van gelijk loon voor gelijk werk en de verkeersveiligheid op de Nederlandse wegen

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the EU Transport Committee's position excluding truck drivers from the posted workers directive and allowing longer driving-time flexibility threatens equal pay and road safety, and whether the Netherlands can still enforce posting rules. The minister answered that the exemption should be limited, that flexibilisation may endanger road safety, that the European Parliament had rejected the committee report as a negotiating basis, and that the Dutch enforcement position is unaffected.
The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has consistently pointed out that too much flexibilisation can endanger road safety.
De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat heeft steeds gewezen op het feit dat te veel flexibilisering de verkeersveiligheid in gevaar kan brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht "15 arbeidsmigranten in één eengezinswoning”

MP Van Dijk asked the Minister whether housing fifteen migrant workers in one family home was lawful, whether rules should be tightened, and whether the labour inspectorate has enough capacity against overcrowding, exploitation and displacement. The Minister said housing is primarily a municipal matter, pointed to municipal tools and complaint routes, noted additional inspectorate capacity to be clarified in Q3 2018, and said national rules may be tightened through the Goed verhuurderschap process.
Housing policy is primarily a local matter and municipalities have a duty to ensure suitable housing for all their residents.
Het woonbeleid is primair een lokale aangelegenheid en gemeenten hebben een taak om te zorgen voor geschikte huisvesting voor al hun inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over schuldenaars onder schrikbewind

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen (SP) asked about abuses by professional debt administrators (bewindvoerders), the lack of oversight, municipalities' ability to refer or assess them, liability for damages, and the market-law constraints on municipalities acting as administrators. The minister responded that existing court supervision, the ongoing evaluation of the 2013 reform, and the Wet markt en overheid apply, promising results of the evaluation around summer and largely pointing to the courts and the evaluation for answers.
I am awaiting the outcomes. These are expected around the summer and will be sent to your House as promised.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten af. Deze zijn rond de zomer te verwachten en worden zoals toegezegd aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “een Turks Festival in Arnhem dat een manifestatie is van de Turkse extreemrechtse Partij van de Nationalistische Beweging”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Turkish festival in Arnhem allegedly linked to the Grey Wolves and a singer with nationalist, hateful lyrics. The minister said the municipality monitors the event, the singer will not appear, police and prosecutors act on any criminal conduct, and the government will act if integration or the rule of law is undermined, without directly answering whether Grey Wolves displays are acceptable.
If there is any question of criminal offences in words or conduct, the police are alert to this and will act against it.
Indien er sprake is van strafbare feiten in woord of gedragingen, is de politie daar alert op en zal daar tegen worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over "een lagere WIA-uitkering door dagloonbesluit".

MPs Van Dijk and Van Kent asked whether the daily-wage rules (Dagloonbesluit) unfairly lower a WIA benefit compared with the Ziektewet, and whether the rules should be repaired. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, explained the reference-period and daily-wage calculation, and said there is no reason to change the rules.
There is no reason to change the daily-wage rules for the WIA.
Er is geen aanleiding om de dagloonregels voor de WIA te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘de afbraak van de sociale werkplaats’

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary about the dismantling of the sheltered employment system (sociale werkplaats), the slow rollout of sheltered jobs, the continuing efficiency cut per SW place, the Venlo municipality's practice, and the fate of people on the former Wsw waiting list. The State Secretary responded that existing Wsw rights are retained, banenafspraak and beschut werk numbers are rising, the efficiency cut was settled under the IBP, and municipalities are responsible for implementation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het aantal jonggehandicapten zonder uitkering snel stijgt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the rise in young disabled people with neither work nor benefits is caused by the Participation Act, and what municipalities and the government will do about it, including on the Wajong criteria and a legal right to support. The State Secretary disputed the causal link, pointed to positive employment figures and municipal support measures, and promised a further report and policy response in 2019.
This is not yet a report but an infographic analysing the position of Vso, Pro and Mbo-entry youths leaving education.
Het betreft hier nog geen rapport maar een infographic waarin de positie van Vso, Pro en Mbo-entree jongeren die het onderwijs verlaten, is geanalyseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een recordaantal mensen bij schuldhulpverlening

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the record number of people seeking debt assistance, the gap between households with problematic debts and those helped, the time to debt freedom after WSNP, and the sale of debts by ING to debt collectors. The State Secretary attributed the rise mainly to more people finding debt help, said there is no target for the share helped, gave a WSNP duration of just over three years, and declined to comment on ING's specific case while pointing to the broad debt approach and existing answers on debt sales.
I have no information about ING's specific situation. It is not for me to judge this case.
Over de specifieke situatie van ING heb ik geen informatie. Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over asielzoekers in Weert

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum seekers in Weert, including staffing shortages for minors, COA transparency, overlast-causing asylum seekers and their placement in the EBTL, and forced return. The State Secretary denied any staffing shortage for unaccompanied minors, said extra staff was added independently of media attention, and pointed to the migration agenda and letter on overlast for return measures.
There is no staffing shortage for the supervision of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers (amv) in Weert or in other amv reception locations.
Er is geen sprake van een personeelstekort voor de begeleiding van alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers (amv) in Weert of in andere amv-opvanglocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘het levenlanglerenkrediet voor Wajongers’

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a life-long learning credit that would stop Wajong benefits for disabled students, and asked for a faster fix so students can start in September 2018 without benefit cuts. The state secretary explained the credit affects Wajong2015 benefits but not oWajong, plans to correct it through the Verzamelwet SZW effective 1 January 2019, and declined to send a letter to all Wajongers as disproportionate.
I agree that it is desirable that Wajongers who want to start studying in September can use the planned changes as soon as possible.
Ik deel de mening dat het wenselijk is dat Wajongers die in september willen gaan studeren, zo snel mogelijk een beroep kunnen doen op de hiertoe voorgenomen wijzigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de lange wachttijd bij gezinshereniging

Dutch MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about long waiting times in family reunification for Eritrean asylum holders, including the use of indicative documents, DNA testing, appeal success rates, backlog in appeals and staffing. The State Secretary answered that the IND applies a framework based on plausible explanations for missing documents, that appeal grant rates rose from 14% to 27% after the new framework, that 49% of open appeal cases exceed the statutory deadline, and that extra staff are being deployed.
The IND does not record in how many cases hardship is accepted.
De IND registreert niet in hoeveel zaken bewijsnood wordt aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over "werken zonder loon in de vijf gemeenten in de Hoeksche Waard"

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether municipalities in the Hoeksche Waard may require welfare recipients to take part in unpaid work placements, whether this displaces paid jobs, and how the region performs on the jobs agreement and sheltered work. The State Secretary answered that the Dove trajectory is a work-experience step with supervision and a maximum of three months, not a tegenprestatie, that no unlawful coercion or underpayment is evident, that the municipality is responsible for preventing displacement within legal limits, and that the region is on track for its targets.
Based on the information from WIHW, I see no reason to assume that there is unlawful coercion or underpayment here.
Op basis van de informatie van WIHW zie ik geen reden om aan te nemen dat hier sprake is van ongeoorloofde dwang of onderbetaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de samenwerking tussen Italië en Libië

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about Italy coordinating and supporting the Libyan coast guard, and whether this makes the EU complicit in refoulement of migrants, including a legal case against Italy. The State Secretary answered that Italy has provided at least one ship, that there is coordination but no direct steering of the Libyan coast guard, that the EU supports human rights training and detention-centre improvements, and that the EU and Netherlands do not accept the complicity claim.
As far as is known, there is no question of Italy directing the Libyan coast guard.
Er is, voor zover bekend, geen sprake van aansturing door Italië van de Libische kustwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over slachtoffers van arbeidsuitbuiting

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about labour exploitation victims, temp agencies, the au pair scheme, the Asian catering covenant and Inspectorate capacity. The minister acknowledged the problem, described existing enforcement, self-regulation and information-sharing measures, and said he would inform parliament on Inspectorate capacity in Q3 2018.
The coalition agreement frees up an additional €50 million per year, rising gradually to 2021, to strengthen the enforcement chain under the Inspectorate Control Framework.
Het regeerakkoord maakt geleidelijk oplopend naar 2021 jaarlijks € 50 miljoen extra vrij voor versterking van de handhavingsketen conform het Inspectie Control Framework.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Arabische inmenging in moskee Rotterdam’

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports of Arab foreign influence over the Essalam mosque in Rotterdam, including the foreign funder's role and dismissal of Dutch staff, and about the status of a convenant and foreign-funding legislation. The minister replied that Rotterdam could not establish actual influence on the mosque's religious line, that the government is exploring ways to restrict undesirable foreign funding, and that the Chamber will be informed after summer 2018.
I share the urgency of this issue and your wish to have more instruments at hand to counter undesirable influence through foreign funding.
Ik onderschrijf de urgentie van deze problematiek en deel met u de wens om meer instrumenten voorhanden te hebben om onwenselijke beïnvloeding middels buitenlandse financiering tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Groothuizen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik en Kuiken over het rapport van Amnesty over de situatie van migranten in Libië

MPs from five parties asked the government about Amnesty's report on abuses against migrants in Libya, including how to close detention centres, EU/Dutch support to Libyan authorities, UNHCR access, IOM return programmes, and the Libyan coast guard. The government answered that it presses Libya for better conditions and closure of centres, notes four centres closed, defends continued support to stabilise Libya, and says it has urged monitoring improvements while lacking evidence of transponder non-compliance.
The ultimate goal is to close these detention centres and move to alternative reception and transit centres.
Het uiteindelijke doel is deze detentiecentra te sluiten en te komen tot alternatieve ontvangst- en transitcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over achterblijvende lonen in Europa

MPs Van Dijk and Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the divergence between productivity and wage growth in Europe and the Netherlands, the fall in disposable income since 2008, rising living costs, and whether the government will act on wages. The minister acknowledged the falling labour share, explained differences between disposable income measures showing rising household income since 2008, noted modest inflation, and said wage policy is for social partners while he will raise available wage room with them.
As promised to the House during the SZW budget debate, I am drawing the available wage room to the attention of social partners.
Zoals aan de Kamer toegezegd tijdens de Begrotingsbehandeling van SZW, breng ik de loonruimte onder de aandacht bij sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "de gevolgen van arbeidsmigratie"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about overcrowded housing for labour migrants, displacement, exploitation and whether permits or registration should be required. The minister answered that housing is a municipal matter, pointed to existing instruments, a forthcoming handreiking, enforcement funding, and said permits would conflict with EU free movement.
It is up to municipalities, temp agencies, employers and landlords to jointly take their responsibility and engage in discussion about quality housing for labour migrants.
Het is aan gemeenten, uitzendbureaus, werkgevers en huisvesters om gezamenlijk hun verantwoordelijkheid te pakken en het gesprek aan te gaan over kwalitatieve huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Waarom de strijd tegen het UWV je kapot kan maken - en hoe het anders kan’

SP MPs asked why UWV rarely uses mediation in objection cases, whether objection procedures can be made independent, and what will be done for a woman in a euthanasia procedure judged fit for work. The State Secretary answered that mediation is offered at objection stage but used only when both parties agree, that UWV's objection directorate is organisationally separate and independent, that an independent commission is unnecessary, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
I cannot go into an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over de bevindingen van de onderzoekscommissie Gezondheidsklachten Ter Apel

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Laçin asked whether the government would answer earlier questions on health complaints among COA staff at Ter Apel now that the investigative commission has reported, and whether it endorses its conclusions and what technical and psychosocial measures will follow. The Secretary of State endorses the commission's conclusions, reports that COA has begun cleaning, ventilation and lighting fixes with monitoring planned, and describes conversations with staff to restore trust.
I endorse the recommendations and conclusions of the investigative commission.
Ik onderschrijf de aanbevelingen en conclusies van de onderzoekscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht dat de EU meebetaalt aan dodelijke grensbewaking in Turkije

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked whether EU funds paid for armoured vehicles used in lethal border guarding in Turkey, how much Dutch money is involved, and whether non-refoulement is breached. The government answered that the IPA-funded surveillance project serves border security, that the vehicles are unarmed and restricted to surveillance by contract, that reports of killings could not be independently verified, and that Turkey's border management is understandable given the refugee burden.
However, there is currently insufficient support for suspension.
Voor opschorting bestaat momenteel echter onvoldoende draagvlak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Özdil over Jihadpreken in Nederlandse moskeeën

MPs Van Dijk and Özdil asked the minister about a reported jihad-themed sermon in a Diyanet mosque in Hoorn, its compatibility with integration, the role of Diyanet, and what the government would do about it. The minister said freedom of religion applies, no criminal offences were suspected, the local triangle had reviewed the sermon, the government does not decide sermon content absent criminal limits, and it wants ISN to operate independently of Turkey.
From the information I have received about the case in Hoorn, it appears there is no suspicion of criminal offences.
Uit de informatie die ik heb ontvangen over de zaak in Hoorn blijkt dat er géén sprake is van een verdenking van strafbare feiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over visueel gehandicapten die opeens een veel hogere bijdrage voor vervoer naar werk moeten betalen

An MP asked whether the state would soften the sharp jump in the employee contribution for work-commute transport for visually impaired workers once their income crosses a modal level, for example by phasing it in gradually. The state secretary declined, explaining that the contribution norm reflects average commuting costs and that UWV advises clients on cheaper alternatives instead.
Softening the income effects through a gradual increase of the employee contribution, as proposed, would mean introducing steps around the current generally customary norm.
Een verzachting van de inkomenseffecten via geleidelijke verhoging van de eigen bijdrage zoals voorgesteld, betekent dat stapjes rondom de huidige algemeen gebruikelijke norm worden geïntroduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Gehandicapten slachtoffer van ruziënde politiek en bedrijfsleven’

An SP MP asks the state secretary about Bollenstreek municipalities cutting wage-cost subsidies for disabled workers from 40 to 25.5 hours, questioning its legality, retroactivity, and the democratic legitimacy of the joint social service (ISD). The state secretary answers that hours are a matter for employer and employee, that municipalities cannot exclude subsidy-eligible persons, that the measure applies only to new contracts in 2018, and that the ISD acts under municipal ordinances, which he expects will be amended.
I will inform the aldermen of the municipalities concerned of my position.
Ik zal de wethouders van de betrokken gemeenten over mijn standpunt informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over misstanden met arbeidsmigranten bij distributiecentra van Albert Heijn

An MP from the SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported abuses against temporary migrant workers at Albert Heijn distribution centres, including work pressure, substandard and deducted housing, on-call standby without pay, and wage-scale issues. The minister answered that employers must ensure safe working conditions, that workers can file complaints with the Inspectie SZW, that housing deductions are capped by law, and that no enforcement action or new investigation was announced beyond existing complaint procedures.
I see no reason to have further research carried out into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hier nader onderzoek naar te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het tekortschietende toezicht op malafide bewindvoerders

SP MPs asked why supervision of malafide court-appointed financial administrators (bewindvoerders) is weak, whether the 2014 quality requirements and centralised quality control work, how information is shared among judges, and about municipalities taking over administration and a white list. The Minister answered that supervision applies to all professional administrators, that a broader evaluation is underway with results expected around summer 2018, that information sharing among judges is informal but feedback-based, and that he has reservations about an online blacklist while favouring cooperation among courts, municipalities and administrators.
Around the summer I will inform the House by letter about the evaluation.
Rond de zomer informeer ik uw Kamer bij brief over de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over E-Court

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about e-Court, a private digital arbitration body used for debt collection, including its procedures, consumer protection, judicial review of its awards, and debt-collector fees. The minister acknowledged concerns, said the Hoge Raad will be asked prejudicial questions via an upcoming test case, and announced a review of debt collection procedures, but largely deferred on specifics and did not commit to changing the rules.
It is important that clarity is provided on the scope of judicial review of e-Court's decisions by the court.
Het is van belang dat er uitsluitsel komt over de vraag naar de reikwijdte van de toetsing van uitspraken van e-Court door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de compensatieregeling voor zwangere ZZP’ers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the compensation for pregnant self-employed women (about 20,000 people, 5,600 euro each) is only paid in 2019, why it counts as income for allowances, and where the budget comes from. The minister answered that payment in 2019 avoids clawbacks of allowances, that the compensation is treated as income like the regular pregnancy benefit, and that any extra costs will be absorbed within the ministry's budget.
However, I have chosen to prevent the clawback of allowances as much as possible.
Ik heb hier echter voor gekozen om terugvordering van toeslagen zo veel mogelijk te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over tien jaar generaal pardon

An MP asked the State Secretary about children and adults who received residence permits under the 2007 RANOV amnesty and now struggle to obtain Dutch nationality because they cannot prove their nationality, including questions on fees, minors' self-representation and applicable exceptions. The State Secretary answered that no exception for proof of nationality will be made, that the burden of obtaining documents lies with the applicant, and that the requested figures cannot be generated from IND systems.
No, I am not willing to do so.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over kloksystemen op basis van vingerafdrukken

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked whether employers may require employees to give fingerprints for clock systems, whether unpaid hours for refusers is unlawful, and whether private collection of fingerprints is acceptable. The state secretary answered that under the GDPR and the UAVG, biometric fingerprint processing is allowed only for authentication or security purposes, that refusers must be offered an alternative, and that the Data Protection Authority and courts assess specific cases.
In any case, the regulation in the GDPR and UAVG precludes using an employee's fingerprints for purposes other than authentication and security purposes.
In ieder geval verzet de regeling in de AVG en UAVG zich tegen het gebruiken van vingerafdrukken van een werknemer voor andere doelen dan authenticatie en beveiligingsdoeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked whether police handling of Roma children used for theft is perpetuating their exploitation, and about investigative capacity, forced marriage and organised child trafficking. The state secretary answered that an internal police report will be shared with parliament though sensitive parts will be withheld, pointed to existing WODC research and ongoing intensification measures, and said further research would add little value.

Yes, I will send this to you soon. However, I will not make certain parts of the administrative signal public, because it concerns sensitive investigative information, criminal methods and other information that should not be made public.

Ja, ik zal u dit spoedig doen toekomen. Bepaalde delen van het bestuurlijk signaal zal ik echter niet openbaar maken, omdat het gevoelige (opsporings)informatie, criminele handelwijzen en andere niet openbaar te maken informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het uitzetten van mensen met een dubbele nationaliteit

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the treatment of asylum seekers holding dual Syrian-Armenian nationality, including why some are returned to Armenia years later, how many are affected, and whether living conditions there are poor. The State Secretary replied that dual nationals are assessed for safe return to their other country, that Armenian-Syrians who concealed Armenian nationality may have their status reviewed, that data on their numbers is not registered separately, and that conditions in Armenia are considered reasonable.
How many people this concerns is unknown, since this is not separately registered in the automated systems of the IND and the DT&V.
Om hoeveel personen het hierbij gaat is onbekend, aangezien dit in het geautomatiseerde systeem van de IND en in dat van de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek (DT&V) niet apart wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat illegalen in Nederland te lang worden opgesloten in detentiecentra

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that immigration detainees are held too long, about Amnesty International's reports, legal aid at first hearings, detention of persons who cooperate with return, the 18-month limit, detention conditions and the Zeist family facility. The State Secretary largely defended the current system as adequate and compliant with EU rules, and promised a fuller reaction in the upcoming debate on the return and immigration detention bill.
I am of the view that the legal protection of aliens in immigration detention is adequately safeguarded.
Ik ben van mening dat de rechtsbescherming van vreemdelingen in vreemdelingenbewaring adequaat is geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “schijnconstructies en het ontduiken van de CAO bij sociale werkvoorzieningen”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about disguised employment constructions in sheltered workshops (sociale werkvoorzieningen) that may circumvent the CAO, including whether he had misinformed parliament about Alescon and Werkzaak Rivierenland. The State Secretary said Alescon was the only known case, that SZW lacks an overview of similar constructions since implementation is decentralised to municipalities and social partners, and that he sees no reason for an independent investigation.
The Ministry of SZW does not currently have the requested overview.
Het Ministerie van SZW beschikt op dit moment niet over het gevraagde overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Amsterdam minima een korting op de energierekening wil geven

MPs Beckerman and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether he would use Amsterdam's plan for an energy-bill discount for low-income households as inspiration nationally, and how he views Belgium's social tariff. The minister answered that income support is better provided through general social policy, that energy pricing should not be used for income policy, and that a municipal discount could improperly cross national policy, leaving the council to prevent this.
This is in the first instance primarily a responsibility of the municipal council, as the controlling body, to prevent that cross-over.
Het betreft hier in eerste instantie primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenteraad – als controlerend orgaan-, om die doorkruising te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over compensatieregeling zwangere ZZP’ers

An MP asked the state secretary about a Facebook group of self-employed women waiting for a pregnancy compensation scheme, when the promised ministerial regulation would be published, why it was delayed, how the target group would be informed, and where funds were budgeted. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the delay due to feasibility checks and payment timing in 2019, announced publication in March 2018 with an application window to 1 October 2018, described UWV-led communication, and stated a 38 million euro reservation in the 2018 budget.
My aim is to publish the regulation in the Staatscourant in March and to have it take effect on 15 May 2018.
Mijn streven is om de regeling in maart te publiceren in de Staatscourant en in werking te laten treden op 15 mei 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de veranderde situatie in Turkije en vluchtelingen in Turkije

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the effect of the diplomatic freeze with Turkey on the EU-Turkey migrant deal, the Turkish offensive in Afrin, reports of Turkish border guards shooting Syrian refugees, and whether the EU itself should investigate rights abuses. The government answered that the freeze does not affect implementation, which the European Commission monitors, that border shootings are unacceptable but no instructions to shoot exist, and that Turkey itself bears responsibility for refugees while the Commission monitors the deal; it declined to draft a new country report for now.
It is therefore not for the European Union to provide guarantees on this.
Het is dan ook niet aan de Europese Unie om hier garanties op te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een vierjarige alleen wordt uitgezet naar Liberia

MP Jasper van Dijk asks the State Secretary whether the IND planned to deport a four-year-old alone to Liberia because her great-grandmother followed the wrong procedure, and what policy applies to deporting young children. The State Secretary replies that a residence permit has already been granted, explains the MVV requirement and the general return policy for minors, and states there was never a plan to send the child alone.
Contrary to what the report states, there has never been a plan to deport the minor alone to Liberia.
Anders dan weergegeven in het bericht is er geen sprake geweest van een plan om de minderjarige alleen naar Liberia uit te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over het bericht dat energiebedrijven experimenteren met prepaid energie

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked whether prepaid energy pilots that bypass disconnection protections are acceptable and whether the minister would ban them. The minister replied that the voluntary pilots are small, that existing disconnection rules still apply, that no ministerial permission was required, and that the ACM and a broader debt-relief approach will be relied on.
No permission was requested or obtained.
Er is geen toestemming gevraagd of gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Lacin over het bericht 'Chauffeurs moesten tijdens storm de weg op'

MPs Van Dijk and Lacin asked whether employers forced truck drivers onto the road during the January 2018 storm, whether sanctions, bans and fines should apply, and whether non-Dutch-speaking drivers were properly informed of the code red weather alert. The minister called the pressure unacceptable, said employers must inform drivers and that responsibility is shared, and promised to discuss measures with the transport sector and inform the House shortly, without committing to bans, fines or counting the affected drivers.
I immediately took the initiative to sit down with the transport and logistics sector to consider which measures could be taken in (expected) extreme weather conditions.
Ik heb meteen het initiatief genomen om met de transport- en logistieke sector om tafel te gaan om te bezien welke maatregelen bij (verwachte) extreme weersomstandigheden genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het ambtsbericht Afghanistan

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked why the November 2016 Afghanistan country report omitted UNHCR Eligibility Guidelines points on persecution risks for westernised returnees, supporters of the government, former KhAD/WAD staff and Christians, and when a new report would come. State Secretary Harbers replied that UNHCR guidelines are authoritative but not primarily fact-finding sources, that Christians are covered in the report, and that a new thematic report is expected in May with a policy assessment to follow.
The UNHCR Eligibility Guidelines were not primarily drafted as a source of factual country information.
De Eligibility Guidelines van de UNHCR zijn niet primair opgesteld als bron van feitelijke landeninformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat arbeidsbeperkten geen werk vinden

An SP MP asks the state secretary about reports that many people with work disabilities, including those on the former Wsw waiting list, have not found jobs, and questions the effectiveness of disability employment policy, Wajong cuts, loonkostensubsidie abolition and temporary contracts. The secretary disputes the framing, cites rising employment and support figures, and promises a memo on replacing loonkostensubsidie with loondispensatie and repairing the levenlanglerenkrediet effect.
I therefore intend to repair this unintended effect in the Verzamelwet SZW.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om dit onbedoelde effect in de Verzamelwet SZW te repareren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Privaat geld ingezet voor integratie vluchtelingen'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether using private investors (a Social Impact Bond) to fund refugee integration and reintegration into work, paid partly from the municipal welfare budget, is acceptable, and whether it is respectful and a proper public task. The minister answered that municipalities have wide policy freedom, that the Social Impact Bond payments are lawful from the Pw budget when paid only on actual welfare exits, and that participation is mandatory with possible benefit reduction.

It is permitted to finance this from the bundled Pw (formerly BUIG) benefit grant, because a surplus in the municipal benefits budget that is not used to pay benefits may be spent by municipalities at their own discretion.

Het is toegestaan dit te financieren vanuit de gebundelde uitkering Pw (voorheen BUIG) omdat een overschot op het gemeentelijke budget voor bijstandsuitkeringen dat niet is ingezet om uitkeringen te verstrekken door gemeenten naar eigen inzicht besteed mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "discriminatie door uitzendbureaus"

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the government whether it considers it unacceptable that employment agencies take part in discrimination, whether penalties and public naming of offending agencies are possible, and whether the Team Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie's powers should be extended. The state secretary condemns discrimination, points to the planned follow-up action plan and talks with the staffing sector, but defers the answers on penalties, naming, powers and enforcement to a letter to parliament.
I will answer questions 3 through 9 together in the letter that the House of Representatives has requested.
De vragen 3 t/m 9 zal ik in samenhang beantwoorden in de brief die de Tweede Kamer heeft gevraagd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, Groothuizen en Kuiken over de uitzettingen van afgewezen asielzoekers naar Soedan

Four MPs asked whether the Netherlands should investigate the fate of Sudanese asylum seekers deported to Sudan after Belgium opened an inquiry into alleged torture of deportees, whether Sudanese diplomats played a role in deportations, and whether they gather information on asylum seekers in the Netherlands. The Secretary of State refused to start an own investigation or pause deportations, arguing the Dutch situation differs from Belgium's and no concrete signal of irregularities was received, and denied knowledge of diplomats gathering information.

The investigation started by the Belgian government into statements from some Sudanese foreigners expelled by Belgium is for me no reason to conduct an independent investigation into deportation to Sudan or to suspend return to Sudan.
