Het onderzoek dat de Belgische regering is gestart naar de verklaring van enkele door België uitgezette Sudanese vreemdelingen vormt voor mij geen reden om een eigenstandig onderzoek te doen naar uitzetting naar Sudan dan wel om terugkeer naar Sudan op te schorten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over werken zonder loon door het UWV en verdringing van reguliere arbeidsplaatsen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about UWV-linked unpaid work trajectories, including a case where night porters at Fletcher Hotels were replaced by people in training placements at Reco-Security, and whether this displaces regular jobs. The minister answered that UWV does not test displacement for trial placements and orientation days, that the Reco-Security case concerns training internships with no unpaid workers via UWV, and that UWV has been asked to investigate compliance with the WW training rules and handles complaints centrally.

Following these questions from your House, I have asked the UWV to conduct further research into whether the trajectories of the named training institute comply with the rules applying to training during unemployment benefit.

Ik heb naar aanleiding van deze vragen van uw Kamer aan het UWV gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen of bij trajecten van het genoemde opleidingsinstituut is voldaan aan de regels die gelden voor scholing tijdens de WW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Incasso-oplichting blijft ongemoeid’

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked how debt collectors could wrongly charge debtors up to 500 euro in collection costs for years, and why the OM, curator and BFT had not acted. Minister Dekker answered that the BFT investigated, sought suspension and filed a disciplinary complaint, the chamber struck the bailiffs off in March 2017, and the OM is now handling a criminal complaint and will give extra attention to such cases in 2018.
The BFT did however intervene, as the answers below also show.
Het BFT heeft echter wel degelijk ingegrepen, zoals ook uit onderstaande antwoorden blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gijs van Dijk over het rekruteren van arbeidsgehandicapten voor sekswerk

MPs Jasper and Gijs van Dijk asked why 2016 questions about the website werkenmetwajong.nl, which recruits Wajong beneficiaries with disabilities for sex work, were never answered, and asked what was done to prevent abuse and where complaints can be filed. The State Secretary says the earlier questions were not answered by agreement with the MPs to avoid drawing more attention to the site, now answers them, and says he knows of no complaints, directing people to UWV and private complaint platforms.
My predecessor, in consultation with the questioners, decided not to answer the parliamentary questions.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft in overleg met de vragenstellers besloten de Kamervragen niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Jasper van Dijk over het afsluiten van gas, water en licht

Two SP MPs asked whether households failing to pay energy bills will be cut off less quickly now that suppliers must first refer them to debt assistance, and how that works, plus questions on water cut-offs, health risks and a similar water rule. The minister confirmed the referral duty, described the winter-period procedure, said a summer extension is planned, and committed to amending the water cut-off regulation with the VNG and Vewin.
I am willing to draw up a similar kind of regulation.
Ik ben bereid eenzelfde soort regeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "het Manifest Schuldvrij! en incassobureaus die te snel naar de rechter stappen"

An SP MP asked the government about the Schuldvrij! manifesto, the overuse of court debt collection by collection agencies, government fines and surcharges, and the Zweeds-style single-collector model. The Staatssecretaris answered that the government shares the concern and will pursue a broad debt approach, committing to a debt collection register, a 2018 review and an information letter in spring 2018, but largely restated existing policy and deferred several points.
The cabinet will get to work on elaborating the debt collection register announced in the coalition agreement.
Het kabinet gaat aan de slag met de uitwerking van het in het regeerakkoord aangekondigde incassoregister.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de woekerhandel in concertkaarten kan voortduren

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether the government would tackle large-scale secondary resale of concert tickets, including by Live Nation's platforms, and whether it would act against professional resale. The Staatssecretaris answered that resale is nuanced, that the ACM already has tools and has acted in specific cases, that talks with the sector will follow, and that any EU-level measures are preferable, without committing to new legislation yet.
As indicated in the answers to questions 3, 5 and 7, I first want to enter into discussion with the sector and then consider what may need to be done.
Zoals aangegeven in de antwoorden op de vragen 3, 5 en 7 wil ik nu eerst het gesprek met de sector aangaan en daarna bezien wat er eventueel moet gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht  "Minder loon in werkplaats nieuwe stijl’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that wages fall for workers in new-style sheltered workplaces, including the 130% minimum wage cap with pension for old Wsw workers, loon dispensation, Wajong cuts, and pension accrual. The State Secretary answers that employment terms are set by employers and social partners, that the Wsw was closed to new entrants in 2015, that a new wage supplement for loon dispensation will ensure people earn more than social minimum, and that municipalities are responsible for organising referral to work.
It is up to municipalities to decide how they organise the referral of people to work and what role the existing Sw companies play in this.
Het is aan gemeenten om te bepalen hoe zij de toeleiding van mensen naar werk organiseren en welke rol de bestaande Sw-bedrijven daarin hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over reddingsmissies op zee

Two SP MPs asked the government whether Libya is unsafe for refugees, whether EU support for the Libyan coast guard makes the EU complicit in returns, and about rescue NGOs, corruption and an alleged Italian intelligence infiltration of a Save the Children ship. The government agreed Libya is unsafe, said it works with UNHCR and IOM on conditions and voluntary return, defended EU training with vetting, said rescued persons fall under Libyan jurisdiction, and declined to comment on foreign investigations.
The Netherlands cannot provide information about foreign investigations.
Nederland kan geen informatie verstrekken over buitenlandse onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat gemeenten zich verzetten tegen het besluit om gehandicapten onder het minimumloon te laten werken

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary about reports that municipalities oppose the plan to let disabled workers earn below minimum wage, and whether this amounts to a 500 million euro cut, pensions, and lost motivation. The State Secretary denies a cut, says loonkostensubsidie will be replaced by loondispensatie with municipalities topping up income to minimum wage pro rata, applies only to new employment relations, and refuses to withdraw the plan while promising consultation.
I am not willing to withdraw this plan from the coalition agreement.
Ik ben niet bereid dit plan uit het Regeerakkoord in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de omstandigheden van vluchtelingen in Libië

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports of refugees being sold as slaves in Libya, EU support to the Libyan coast guard, detention conditions and voluntary return. The government answered that it is concerned, is pursuing an integrated EU approach with IOM and UNHCR, rejects that the EU returns refugees to Libya, and defends its training and monitoring of the Libyan coast guard.
The cabinet is affected by the recent harrowing images of de facto slave trade in Libya.
Het kabinet is getroffen door de recente schrijnende beelden van de facto slavenhandel in Libië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Kent en Lacin over werklozen die bij de NS met levensgevaarlijke chroomverf moesten werken

Three SP MPs asked the ministers about unemployed Tilburg workers exposed to chromium-6 paint in an NS-linked re-integration project, including whether authorities intervened, whether victims get compensation, and whether a damages fund should be set up. The government said the Tilburg municipality remains ultimately responsible, an independent RIVM investigation is underway with results expected August 2018, and it will decide on compensation after that, while also tightening REACH and exposure rules.
I would first like to await the results of this investigation; these are expected at the end of August 2018.
Ik wil graag eerst de resultaten van dit onderzoek afwachten; deze worden eind augustus 2018 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de misstanden bij de arbeidsomstandigheden en huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten in het Westland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alleged abuses by staffing agency Efficient at Work toward migrant workers in Westland, including weekly contracts, forced transport and insurance, pregnancy dismissal, poor housing and keurmerk oversight. The minister defended weekly contracts as lawful, said minimum-wage deductions are restricted and the municipality inspected the housing, and rejected a licensing system while noting private certification bodies take the signals seriously.
Whether there is an investigation, I make no statement.
Over of sprake is van een onderzoek doe ik geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het afwijzen van een uitkering aan zwaar zieke jonge mensen in hun laatste levensjaren

An SP MP asked why a seriously ill young woman with a progressive lung disease was refused a Wajong benefit and why there is no more humane approach to terminally ill people seeking benefits. The state secretary declined to comment on the individual case, explained the Wajong and WIA assessment rules, pointed to municipal support under the Participatiewet, and described the review and appeal procedures without agreeing to create a new independent commission.
I cannot go into an individual case, but I will explain the policy regarding the Wajong assessment.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus, maar zal wel het beleid ten aanzien van de Wajong beoordeling toelichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een ambtenaar van de gemeente Utrecht statushouders wierf voor zijn eigen taalschool

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that a Utrecht municipal official recruited refugees for his own language school, raising conflict of interest, school quality, certification oversight and the DUO loan system. The minister confirmed the case, called such conduct unacceptable if it occurred, described the school's suspension and the Blik op Werk certification and audit system, and said the government will revise the integration rules.
Bearing in mind that this concerns a vulnerable group of people, this conduct, if it is the case, is unacceptable.
Met in het achterhoofd dat het hier om een kwetsbare groep mensen gaat, is dit gedrag, indien dit aan de orde is, onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de verslechterende omstandigheden van asielzoekers op de Griekse eilanden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about deteriorating conditions for asylum seekers in Greek island hotspots, including overcrowding, lack of basic provisions, slow asylum procedures, vulnerability screening, winter shelter and the EU-Turkey deal's success. The State Secretary answered that Greece bears primary responsibility for reception, that the Commission monitors the situation, that EU funding has been provided, and that no additional Dutch measures or accelerated family reunification steps are deemed necessary.
Because Greece has no central registration system, no reliable figures are available for the data requested in questions 4, 6 and 7.
2 Doordat er geen centraal registratiesysteem in Griekenland 3 is, zijn er geen betrouwbare cijfers beschikbaar met betrekking tot de in de vragen 4, 6 en 7 gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat een schuldeiser een rekening niet volledig mag plukken

The MP asks whether creditors may empty bank accounts leaving no living allowance, whether a statutory rule for bank seizure is coming, and what is done about creditor and bailiff practice. The state secretary agrees a legal rule is needed, says a broader revision of seizure law is planned for consultation in 2018, and promises talks with the bailiffs' body and a Ministry of Finance study on a proactive living allowance.
I agree with the National Ombudsman that a statutory rule must come to prevent bank seizure from circumventing the rules on the protected minimum for wages or benefits.

Ik ben het met de Nationale ombudsman eens dat er een wettelijke regeling moet komen om te voorkomen dat de regeling inzake beslagvrije voet bij loon of uitkering door een bankbeslag wordt doorkruist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht inzake kansloze aangiftes bij mensenhandel

SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that a third of human trafficking complaints are dismissed within a month, whether this deters victims, the progress of a motion on combating trafficking, asylum versus trafficking residence procedures, IND's reliance on conviction, and steps to raise victims' willingness to report. The minister explained the new fast-track dismissal procedure piloted with police, prosecutors and IND, said data on residence grants cannot yet be broken down, and promised further consultation with partners and the National Rapporteur.
At present, however, no insight can be given into the number of grants made on the basis of a conviction, a criminal process lasting more than three years, or humanitarian circumstances.

Op dit moment kan echter geen inzicht worden gegeven in het aantal toekenningen dat heeft plaatsgevonden op basis van een veroordeling, een strafrechtelijk proces dat langer dan drie jaar in beslag heeft genomen, of op grond van humanitaire omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over incassobureaus die de rechtbank misbruiken om hun klanten te intimideren

SP MPs asked the Justice Minister about debt collectors such as Hoist and Direct Pay allegedly misusing the courts to intimidate debtors, including the adequacy of judicial oversight, the resale of debts, and AFM supervision. The minister said individual cases are for judges, promised a debt-collection register, a judicial vision paper due early 2018, and tighter AFM engagement, but declined to commit to banning debt resale.
I cannot go into individual cases that are submitted to the judge.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken die aan de rechter worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat honderden rijken uit Rusland en Oekraïne een Cypriotisch paspoort hebben kunnen kopen

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether Cyprus sold EU citizenship via its golden passport scheme to wealthy Russians and Ukrainians, including revenue, vetting, sanctions checks, money laundering and whether national parliaments can see recipients. The minister answered that Cyprus's individual naturalisation files are not visible, that the Netherlands does not act unless national law conflicts with international law, and that disclosure is a matter for member states.
No insight can be given into the individual naturalisation procedures actually followed.
Over de daadwerkelijk gevolgde individuele naturalisatieprocedures kan geen inzicht worden verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse truckers die niet meer naar Engeland rijden vanwege agressie door verstekelingen

MPs Gijs and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Dutch truckers have stopped driving to England because of violence by stowaways and what the government is doing about it. The minister says there is no general picture of companies halting England routes, cites ongoing EU-level cooperation, secure parking funding via CEF and joint anti-crime work with industry, and reports contact with transport associations.
According to the information currently available to me, there is no general picture of transport companies in the Netherlands no longer driving to England because of aggression by stowaways.

Volgens de mij op dit moment beschikbare informatie is er geen sprake van een algemeen beeld dat transportondernemingen in Nederland niet meer naar Engeland rijden vanwege agressie door verstekelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het gescheiden uitzetten van gezinnen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and others asked why a family was separated for deportation after nine years of proceedings, how the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek handles incomplete families, the weight of children's best interests and the role of Nidos. The Secretary of State declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, described general procedural accelerations and stated that separating families is permitted under procedure, refusing a temporary deportation stop.
For reasons of privacy and the safety of the young children in this case, I will not address the individual circumstances or the individual residence procedures.
Omwille van de privacy en de veiligheid van de jonge kinderen in deze zaak ga ik niet in op de individuele omstandigheden of de individuele verblijfsrechtelijke procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mensenhandel met het oogmerk van orgaanverwijdering

An MP asks the government about reports of migrants in Egypt, Libya and Niger being forced to give up organs, whether asylum seekers in the Netherlands reported such coercion and how that was investigated, and about police capacity and cooperation with transit countries. The State Secretary answers that no such cases of forced donation in the Netherlands are known, that signals of threatened organ removal were investigated but led to no prosecutions, and that cooperation with the region on smuggling and migrant rescue will be continued and expanded.
There are no known cases of asylum seekers in the Netherlands who stated during their asylum procedure that they had been forced to give up their organs.
Er zijn geen gevallen bekend van asielzoekers die in Nederland tijdens hun asielprocedure hebben verklaard dat zij onder dwang hun organen hebben moeten afstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat gezinshereniging voor Eritrese asielzoekers vrijwel onmogelijk is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the rejection rate for Eritrean family reunification applications (27% granted, versus 69% overall) and the handling of DNA tests and interviews indicate obstruction of family reunification. The State Secretary answered that rejections do not by themselves signal excessive hurdles, that policy is the same for all nationalities, that DNA tests are offered when identity is accepted or evidence distress is found, and that the IND relies on its Eritrea country report, which the ministry keeps improving.
The policy and implementing rules for family reunification applications are the same for all nationalities.
Het beleid en de uitvoeringsregels voor nareisaanvragen zijn voor alle nationaliteiten gelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het afsluiten van drinkwater

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether disconnecting a single mother and her three children from drinking water in Hoorn is acceptable, how often households were disconnected for water, gas and electricity, and what the government will do to prevent disconnections of vulnerable households and children. The minister acknowledged that disconnection is serious and must be avoided, announced a planned revision of the water disconnection regulation requiring a minimum water supply for four days, and otherwise defended the existing policy, declining to change the rules, to investigate the convenant, or to treat minors as vulnerable consumers.
I therefore see no reason to carry out the research you requested.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om het door u gevraagde onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdringing, werken zonder loon en de plaspas in Den Bosch

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about displacement of regular work, unpaid work and toilet-pass practices at Weener XL in Den Bosch, citing a Volkskrant article and a local party dossier. The government answered that the municipality is responsible, that no SW-indicated persons were dismissed, that the Inspectorate has no role in supervising individual municipalities, and that the municipality reports sanitary access is guaranteed.
It is not the task of the Inspectorate SZW to supervise individual municipalities regarding unfair competition.
Het is geen taak van de Inspectie SZW om toezicht te houden op individuele gemeenten inzake concurrentievervalsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de situatie op Lesbos

An SP MP asked the government about conditions in the Lesbos migrant camps, access rules, EU funding, monitoring of spending, relocation and the EU-Turkey deal. The minister answered that conditions need continued attention, access is controlled by Greek authorities, EU funds exceed 880 million euros, and that deals with third countries must meet European standards.

The European Commission monitors the situation closely, supported by the European Asylum Support Office (EASO), with the Greek authorities ultimately responsible for implementing asylum rules in line with European and international standards.

De Europese Commissie monitort de situatie dan ook nauwlettend, daarbij ondersteund door het Europees Ondersteuningsbureau voor asielzaken (EASO), waarbij de Griekse autoriteiten uiteindelijk verantwoordelijk zijn voor de uitvoering van de asielregelgeving conform Europese en internationale standaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over statushouders die klem komen te zitten tussen Participatiewet en de Wet inburgering 2013

An SP MP asked the minister about refugees (statushouders) being squeezed between the Participatiewet and the integration law, citing a KIS study, long workdays at a reintegration firm in Amstelveen, and whether municipalities are violating the spirit of the law. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible, that the matter is for the municipal council to supervise, that individual cases fall to municipalities, and committed to general cooperation agreements with VNG but no new national action.
First and foremost, it is for the municipal council to supervise the executive board.
Het is allereerst aan de gemeenteraad om het college te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het UWV gaat slecht om met 35-minners’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that UWV gives poor support to people assessed as less than 35% disabled, including whether they should receive job-search guidance and access to the no-risk policy. The minister answered that such people can receive support via other benefits or municipalities, that UWV provides tailored guidance without extending it to all 35-minners, and that further policy changes are left to a new cabinet.
I will not ask UWV to offer guidance to all 35-minners.
Ik ga UWV niet vragen aan alle 35-minners begeleiding aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat trauma’s bij vluchtelingen slecht worden opgemerkt

An SP MP asked the government whether refugee trauma is poorly recognised and what is done about it, including training of IND, COA and Vluchtelingenwerk staff, interpreter availability, funding of Psychiaters Zonder Grenzen and follow-up on a pilot of EMDR therapy for refugee children. The Minister answers that medical care is the responsibility of VWS, describes training and signalling procedures, says no specific trauma provision exists in integration courses, and reports a pilot with EMDR that was hampered by the location and is being extended.
Those trainings also pay attention to referral.
Ook bij die trainingen wordt aandacht besteed aan doorverwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Jasper van Dijk over over het bericht dat zelfstandigen door gemeenten van schuldhulp worden uitgesloten

MPs Hijink and Van Dijk asked whether municipalities exclude self-employed people from debt relief and whether this forces them to stop their businesses. The State Secretary answered that such exclusion is not allowed, that individual assessment is required, that the Bbz scheme is an alternative for some, and that she will raise the issue with the VNG.
Municipalities may not apply exclusion grounds within debt relief.
Gemeenten mogen geen uitsluitinggronden in het kader van de schuldhulpverlening hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over 'Werken bij de Wajong loont niet'

An SP MP asked why working on a Wajong or WAO benefit often does not pay, why Wajong recipients can keep far less of extra earnings than social assistance recipients, and whether the allowance could be raised. The Secretary of State answered that earnings rules differ by regime, that changing the Wajong earnings allowance requires legislation left to a future cabinet, that the Participatiewet experiment raises the allowance to 50 percent up to 199 euros, and that WAO recipients are protected from losing rights after five years.
Changing the earnings-supplement system requires legislation. I am leaving the decision on this to a future cabinet.
Voor het aanpassen van de loonaanvullingsystematiek is wetgeving nodig. Ik laat de besluitvorming hierover aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over sociale minima die er op achteruit gaan en dat veel meer Nederlanders in armoede leven dan we denken

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs and the Finance Minister why social minimum recipients fall behind, why homeless and indebted people are missing from poverty statistics, and whether CBS/SCP poverty measures are up to date. The government replies that CBS and SCP methods cannot fully capture homeless and indebted groups, that data updates are planned, and that a koopkracht package of 450 million euro protects benefit recipients in 2018.
The Cabinet has therefore taken measures to restore purchasing power for these groups.
Het Kabinet heeft daarom maatregelen genomen om de koopkracht voor deze groepen te repareren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘problemen met de Participatiewet’

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary about an Inspectorate report finding that many municipalities find parts of the Participatiewet unworkable, and about the severity of benefit sanctions, including full 100% benefit cuts. The State Secretary responded that municipalities should use their discretion and tailor sanctions, that about half of examined cases involved a full cut mostly for one month, and that the findings will be discussed with the VNG.
Implementation of the Participatiewet has been decentralised to the mayors and aldermen (colleges of B&W).
De uitvoering van de Participatiewet is gedecentraliseerd naar de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de arbeidsinkomensquote

The MPs Leijten and Van Dijk (SP) asked why the labour income share has not risen despite falling unemployment, why unused labour supply remains large, whether flexible work suppresses wages, whether profits drive investment, and why purchasing power lags growth. Minister Asscher answers that wage growth is expected to pick up in a tightening labour market, that wage policy is largely a matter for social partners, and that the links between profits, investment and the labour share are not clear-cut.
Wage formation takes place at three levels: at the level of the legislator, at the level of the social partners and at the level of individual employers and employees.
Loonvorming vindt plaats op drie niveaus: op het niveau van de wetgever, op het niveau van de sociale partners en op het niveau van de individuele werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over "pensioen en zware beroepen".

SP MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs whether the rising pension age is unattainable for heavy-work occupations and why incapacity inflow among metal workers has doubled, and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that social partners are primarily responsible for sustainable employability, pointed to prevention and retraining initiatives and ESF support, said a separate heavy-occupations scheme proved unworkable, and attributed the rise in WIA inflow mainly to former unemployed people falling sick after the 2014 crisis.
Social partners are primarily responsible for working longer.
Sociale partners zijn primair aan zet bij langer doorwerken van werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het artikel 'Helaas, geen nieuw huis dankzij BKR'

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether small debts or payment arrears leading to a negative BKR credit registration, and the BKR's handling of proportionality requests, deletion, retention periods, fees and transparency, are fair and whether the state should intervene. The Minister answered that the BKR is a private foundation, that a negative registration does not itself bar credit, that deletions are possible under proportionality rules, and that he expects a more pragmatic BKR approach by year-end while promising free access to personal data from May 2018 and publication of dispute rulings.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kooiman over ‘de toename van het aantal dakloze jongeren’

MPs Van Dijk and Kooiman asked why homeless young people rose from 8,000 to 12,000 in 2016, and whether the cost-sharing norm, psychiatric cuts, briefadres access and benefit rules contribute. The government acknowledges the rise, points to a pending Federatie Opvang report and a research project, defers responsibility to municipalities, and largely declines to commit to new legislative change.
Municipalities are responsible for tackling this target group and for making good policy to prevent people from becoming homeless.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de aanpak van deze doelgroep en het maken van goed beleid om te voorkomen dat mensen dakloos raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over ‘dat seksuele voorlichting op scholen niet voldoet’

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked the Minister of Education about reports that sex education in schools is inadequate, including inspectorate findings that many schools do nothing on sexual boundary-crossing behaviour, and whether schools can be compelled to meet core objectives and whether the duty should extend to upper secondary and vocational students. The government answered that schools have freedom in choosing methods, will improve information on intervention effectiveness, notes the inspectorate can impose sanctions for non-compliance, and says it will not extend the curriculum requirements beyond what is already in place.
If a school does not give effect to statutory requirements, the inspectorate will instruct the school to bring its education into line with them.
Als een school geen invulling geeft aan wettelijke eisen, zal de inspectie de school opdracht geven het onderwijs daar alsnog mee in overeenstemming te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de groei van het aantal mensen met problematische schulden

MPs asked the government about the growth in households with problematic debts, including residents of holiday parks, why most are not reached by debt assistance, the difficulty of obtaining a postal address, and whether government creditors impose excessive costs. The government says it is taking steps such as funding debt assistance, reforming enforcement costs and the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet), and promises to improve access but commits to few concrete new measures.
Creditors, both government creditors and private creditors, must behave properly.
Schuldeisers, zowel overheidsschuldeisers als (private) schuldeisers dienen zich behoorlijk te gedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over incassobureaus en de dubieuze handel in schulden

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the government about debt-collection agencies, the resale of private debts, unlawful collection costs and whether banks remain responsible for sold debts. The minister answered that existing consumer-protection and financial-supervision rules already apply, that a ban on resale is not the right fix, that cumulative collection-cost rules are being kept under review, and that banks stay responsible for outsourced collection, without committing to new legislation.
Charging unjustified costs may constitute an unfair commercial practice, which can be enforced under the Unfair Commercial Practices Enforcement Act.
Het in rekening brengen van onterechte kosten kan een oneerlijke handelspraktijk opleveren en hiertegen kan worden opgetreden op grond van de Wet handhaving oneerlijke handelspraktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over migratie via Niger

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked the government about migration through Niger, EU missions, funding, smuggling laws and prosecutions, economic alternatives for smugglers, and migrants abandoned in the desert. The minister answered in detail on each question, describing EUCAP and EU funding, Niger's laws and arrests, and economic alternatives, but gave no firm new commitments.
The Netherlands is urging the Red Cross and IOM to register that information better, so that left-behind family members can also be informed.
Nederland dringt er bij het Rode Kruis en de IOM op aan om die informatie beter te registreren, zodat ook achtergebleven familieleden geïnformeerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het falen van het kinderpardon

Dutch MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the expulsion of a mother without her children and the child-pardon (kinderpardon) rules, citing the best-interests-of-the-child principle and a motion calling for a more generous pardon. The State Secretary defended the expulsion as lawful under court rulings, said the children were found and are being supervised by Nidos, and refused to adopt a moratorium on expulsions pending a new cabinet.
The DT&V information system cannot establish how often a parent has been expelled and the children left behind during the past cabinet period.
Uit het informatiesysteem van de DT&V kan niet worden herleid hoe vaak het in de afgelopen kabinetsperiode is voorgekomen dat een ouder wordt uitgezet en de kinderen achterblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat werkenden een steeds kleiner deel van de koek krijgen

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act on reports that workers receive a shrinking share of market-sector income, including what it could do to raise the labour income share and whether public-sector pay could influence private wages. The minister replied that the labour income share is a wage-room indicator, that wage-setting is left to social partners and decentralised bargaining, and that the government gave no concrete new measures, leaving flex-contract and other choices to the next cabinet.
The main conclusion, however, was that wage policy requires tailoring and is therefore a matter for decentralised (collective agreement) parties.
Belangrijkste conclusie was echter dat loonbeleid maatwerk vereist en (dus) aan decentrale (cao-)partijen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdringing en het schaden van werknemersrechten door Flextensie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about Flextensie, a BV that places benefit recipients with employers while they keep their benefit, and whether this displaces regular workers and undermines labour rights and collective agreements. The State Secretary replied that the instrument is not an employment relationship, that municipalities are responsible for preventing displacement under the Participatiewet, that an inspection study and a research project are ongoing, and that no new measures beyond guidance to municipalities were announced.
The research is ongoing. It is expected to be completed after the summer, after which I will inform the House of the outcomes as soon as possible.
Het onderzoek loopt. Naar verwachting wordt het onderzoek na de zomer afgerond, waarna ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over belabberde arbeidsomstandigheden in het inburgeringsonderwijs

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about poor working conditions for civic integration teachers, precarious contracts since market liberalisation in 2007, lack of collective agreement coverage, poor facilities, and calls for Inspectorate oversight. Minister Asscher answered that employers must ensure safe conditions, that disputes should be handled internally with the Inspectorate SZW as last resort, that toezicht on lesson quality is being set up with the Inspectorate of Education involved, that changing the system is not on the agenda, and that he sees no reason to sign the petition.
I am working along several lines to improve this.
Ik werk langs verschillende lijnen om dit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het regime van Eritrea opnieuw een bijeenkomst in Nederland organiseert

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister about a Eritrean government-linked festival in Rijswijk, including attendance by Eritrea's foreign minister, possible propaganda use, and security measures. The minister answered that the cabinet has no objection to cultural festivals but felt uneasy about officials attending for political purposes, that the foreign minister was asked to stay away and did not come, and that public order is a local responsibility handled by the municipality.
The cabinet asked Minister Saleh to refrain from visiting the festival in Rijswijk.
Het kabinet heeft Minister Saleh verzocht om af te zien van een bezoek aan het festival in Rijswijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over het optreden van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM)

MPs Van Dijk and Hijink asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Consumer and Markets Authority (ACM) rarely acts against deception and fraud by firms, including a stalled enforcement request and a debt collector under scrutiny for four years, and whether the ACM should be given more teeth or replaced by a separate consumer authority. The minister answered that the ACM has adequate instruments and fines, that enforcement choices are its own, that the handling of one enforcement request was flawed, and that no new proposals or a separate authority are planned.
I cannot give any information about possible investigations concerning a specific company.
Over mogelijke onderzoeken betreffende een specifiek bedrijf kan ik geen mededeling doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Buitenweg en Jasper van Dijk over tralies bij de vluchtelingenopvang in de voormalige Bijlmerbajes

MPs asked whether the former Bijlmerbajes prison, used as a refugee shelter until December 2017, should have its bars removed given its detention character and the trauma of residents. The State Secretary answered that detention features were largely removed, the bars remain as external shading serving climate control, and COA sees no reason for further changes.
The bars now serve only as external shading and have not been removed, because they play an important role in climate control in the building.
De tralies dienen nu nog louter als externe zonwering en zijn niet verwijderd, omdat deze een belangrijke functie vervullen bij de klimaatbeheersing in het gebouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitzettingen van kinderen en jongvolwassenen naar Afghanistan in de demissionaire periode

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether child, young adult and vulnerable deportations to Afghanistan should be halted during the caretaker period, and how returnees are supported at Kabul airport. The State Secretary replied that the caretaker status gives no reason to stop existing policy, that returns follow careful procedures with individual assessment, and that voluntary return and reintegration support (IOM, ERIN Post Arrival Assistance) are available.
I see no reason in the caretaker status of the cabinet to stop implementing the existing policy.
Ik zie in de demissionaire status van het kabinet geen aanleiding om te stoppen met het effectueren van het bestaande beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over de uitzending van Tros Radar Extra over oudere werklozen die nauwelijks kans op een baan hebben

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers about a Tros Radar report on older unemployed people with very little chance of work, including low re-employment odds, income loss from short jobs, home-ownership and benefit rules, the job-search obligation, and basic income. The government said it is acting through the 50-plus action plan, that the re-employment chance is well above 3%, that asset rules allow municipal loans against a home, and that it is not pursuing basic income, while pointing to municipal experimentation powers.
The cabinet also considers unemployment among people over fifty to still be too high.
Het kabinet is eveneens van mening dat de werkloosheid onder vijftigplussers nog steeds te hoog is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het failliet van de banenafspraak

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the claimed failure of the disability jobs target (banenafspraak), including job counts, whether temporary placements and detachments count, and how to make these jobs permanent. The State Secretary reported that the 2016 private-sector target was exceeded while the public sector fell short, explained the counting rules, and said job durability will continue to be monitored, without committing to a specific new measure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat gezinshereniging voor Eritrese asielzoekers bijna onmogelijk is

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that family reunification for Eritrean asylum seekers has become nearly impossible, including long waiting times, documentation requirements and the IND's DNA/interview policy. The State Secretary answers largely by referring to earlier answers, gives average processing durations, states that the policy is careful rather than too strict, and denies a substantive change in grant rates.

The average duration between the grant of a provisional residence permit for family reunification (MVV) and the entry of a family member of a permit holder into the Netherlands cannot be generated from the IND systems.

De gemiddelde duur tussen de inwilliging van een machtiging tot voorlopig verblijf nareis (MVV) en de inreis van een familielid van een vergunninghouder in Nederland valt niet uit de IND-systemen te genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het idee om een EU-missie naar het zuiden van Libië te sturen

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister about a proposed EU mission to southern Libya, including its content, human rights safeguards and existing EU missions. The minister replied that Germany and Italy had only made a general call, no formal proposal exists yet, and that the government supports examining all options while stressing human rights and migrant protection in existing programmes.
Germany and Italy have not submitted a formal proposal.
Duitsland en Italië hebben geen formeel voorstel ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Oorlog op zee tegen redders vluchtelingen'

MPs Buitenweg and Van Dijk asked whether the Public Prosecution Service knows of Dutch participation in actions against migrant rescue operations in the Mediterranean and whether such actions could be criminal, and about a Libyan coastguard warning-shot incident. The minister answered that no signals of Dutch involvement were received, that prosecution depends on jurisdiction and the national law of the country where acts occur, and that the government will keep raising maritime coordination and human rights with Libya.
I have not received any signals from the Public Prosecution Service that Dutch nationals may be involved in such activities.
Ik heb geen signalen van het openbaar ministerie (OM) ontvangen dat er mogelijk Nederlanders betrokken zijn bij dergelijke activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over incassobureaus

An SP MP asked the government about debt-collection agencies using abusive practices (arbitrary fines, false threats of bailiffs), why the Nederlandse Incassocentrale had not been pursued by the OM or ACM, and whether payment arrangements should be offered before collection. The minister condemned these practices, said the ACM is enforcing in the sector and a criminal investigation is ongoing, but gave no details on specific companies and pointed to existing law and voluntary initiatives rather than new legislation.
The ACM cannot, under the law, make statements about whether it is investigating specifically named companies.
De ACM kan, op basis van de wet, geen mededelingen doen over of zij onderzoek doet naar specifiek genoemde bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de toename van het aantal afgewezen asielzoekers dat van de radar verdwijnt

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about the rise in rejected asylum seekers disappearing from view, the effect of cutting return support on Morocco and Algeria, and steps to secure forced returns. The government answers that departures without supervision cannot be equated with unlawful stay, that it prefers controlled return and is working with Morocco and Algeria, and that it wants more room for detention in EU rules.
By the nature of the matter, this cannot be ascertained.
Naar de aard van het vraagstuk is dit niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het terugsturen van kinderen naar Afghanistan

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why children are being deported to Afghanistan despite a deteriorating security situation, high detention numbers of Afghan children, low asylum approval rates, the Joint Way Forward agreement, and the treatment of Hazara minors. The State Secretary largely defended the policy, stating that individual assessments ensure safe return, that the travel advice is aimed at Dutch travellers, that no exceptional situation exists under the Qualification Directive, and that no change to the policy is planned.
I see no reason to immediately stop deporting vulnerable groups to Afghanistan.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om direct te stoppen met het uitzetten van kwetsbare groepen naar Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Albert Heijn op de vingers is getikt vanwege leeftijdsdiscriminatie

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Equal Treatment Commission finding that Albert Heijn discriminated on age in recruitment, and about enforcement, Inspectorate capacity and the youth minimum wage. The minister condemned discrimination, noted the Inspectorate has adequate powers and extra funding, and said the youth minimum wage is no licence to discriminate, while describing planned phased changes to the minimum wage.
The Labour Discrimination team at the Inspectorate SZW has sufficient powers.
Het team Arbeidsdiscriminatie bij de Inspectie SZW heeft voldoende bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Jasper van Dijk over de beoordeling van homoseksualiteit door de IND

MPs Buitenweg and Van Dijk asked whether the IND's assessment of asylum claims based on homosexuality is fair, given that questioning about the origins of feelings and taboo conditions in countries of origin may be inappropriate. The State Secretary defended the IND's working instructions as consistent with case law and said they already account for taboos, while declining to change them.
I see no reason to amend the working instruction and the method based on it.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de werkinstructie en de daarop gebaseerde werkwijze aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat tientallen medewerkers van het asielzoekerscentrum Ter Apel al maanden thuiszitten

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked why only parts of the former NAVO terrain at the Ter Apel asylum centre were remediated, whether soil was tested when the centre was built, and whether COA, IND and other bodies should be ordered to carry out medical research into sick staff. The State Secretary answered that earlier soil studies found no health-relevant contamination, that a recent survey found none either, that COA has set up an independent commission, and that no broader medical study is currently planned.
For now I see no reason to instruct all other bodies working in or around the asylum centre to carry out such a study.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen aanleiding om alle andere instanties die werkzaam zijn in of rondom het asielzoekerscentrum op te dragen een dergelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de dagvaarding van het sociaal werkbedrijf Alescon door FNV Overheid vanwege het inzetten van werknemers via een schijnconstructie

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary whether the social work company Alescon's use of an AwerC-Flex employment construction, which FNV Overheid has taken to court, breaches law and the collective agreement, and what the government will do. The State Secretary declined to judge the matter because it is before the court, gave factual clarifications on the corporate structure, employee numbers and contracts, and stated that the Participatiewet aims at a level playing field and that municipalities and social partners are responsible for oversight.
Since the case is before the court, it is not for me to pass judgment on it.
Aangezien de zaak onder de rechter is, is het niet aan mij hierover een oordeel te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Oost-Europese uitzendkrachten die worden ingezet bij sociale werkbedrijven

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about East European temporary agency workers deployed at sheltered workshops (sociale werkbedrijven), the Participatiewet, cao compliance, cost pressures and the funding demanded by municipalities. The State Secretary answers that the use of agency workers is incidental and exceptional, that she does not hold figures on it, that cao enforcement is primarily the responsibility of social partners, and that the extra 3 million euro is not new money but reallocated underspending.
I do not have these figures.
Over deze cijfers beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over de concentratiekampen voor homoseksuelen in Tsjetsjenië

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government how it responds to reports of concentration camps for gay men in Chechnya, including casualty figures, contacts with Russian authorities, Kremlin statements, asylum treatment of LGBTI refugees and Dutch leadership on LGBTI rights. The minister condemns the reports, describes Dutch diplomatic and multilateral efforts (EU, OSCE, Equal Rights Coalition, talks with Lavrov and the UN) and notes that LGBTI asylum seekers from Russia are treated as a risk group, while resettlement is a UNHCR decision.
Precise figures are not known, but various media and NGOs speak of 160 persons detained and at least 3 men who died during or after their detention.
Precieze cijfers zijn niet bekend maar verschillende media en ngo's spreken van 160 personen die gevangen zijn gezet en minimaal 3 mannen die tijdens of na hun gevangenschap zijn overleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat vluchtelingenkinderen in Griekenland geen andere uitweg zien dan seks voor geld

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how the government responds to reports that refugee children in Greece and the Balkans are sexually exploited, and what is being done about the Harvard and Save the Children reports. The State Secretary answered that primary responsibility lies with Greece, that Dutch standards are high, that Nederland is pressing other member states on relocation including unaccompanied minors, and described EMPACT cooperation, while noting no cooperation with Greece on trafficking.
It is therefore in the first instance up to the Greek government to respond to this.
Het is in eerste instantie dan ook aan de Griekse overheid om hierop te reageren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat Hongaarse vrachtwagenchauffeurs die voor een Nederlands transportbedrijf rijden niet betaald hoeven te worden volgens de Nederlandse cao

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether a Den Bosch appeals court ruling, that Hungarian truck drivers working for a Dutch transport firm need not be paid under the Dutch collective agreement, shows that the wage laws fail in court and whether the ruling opens the door to similar constructions, and what will be done to stop a race to the bottom. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, said equal pay for equal work remains the principle, pointed to existing laws and EU revisions, and said the case's specific facts allow no general conclusions while promising to await European Commission proposals.
As you know, I must be restrained in commenting on cases still under consideration; cassation can still be lodged against this ruling and the referring cantonal judge must still rule.

Zoals u weet moet ik terughoudend zijn uitspraken te doen over zaken die nog in behandeling zijn; tegen deze uitspraak kan nog cassatie worden ingesteld en ook moet de verwijzende kantonrechter nog uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een mogelijke Libiëdeal

MP Van Dijk asked whether an EU deal with Libya comparable to the Turkey deal is being pursued, and about EU funds for the Libyan coast guard, mistreatment of migrants, detention conditions and an Italian deal with militias in southern Libya. The State Secretary answered that there is no deal like the Turkey statement, that EU cooperation aims to strengthen migration management and improve reception conditions, and that monitoring of funds and Italian bilateral efforts will be followed, without new binding commitments.
Due to the complex situation in Libya, however, it is not always possible to adequately verify such signals.
Door de complexe situatie in Libië is het echter niet altijd mogelijk om dergelijke signalen adequaat te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het programma Ontvoerd

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether the ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice cooperated with the RTL programme Ontvoerd on child abduction, and raised concerns about child harm, due process and media interests. The state secretary answered that the Central Authority gave only general information in three meetings in 2012–2013, that the ministries were not involved in producing the programme, and that broadcasting and participation decisions rest with the broadcaster and parents.
As I indicated in answer to questions 1, 10 and 11, three meetings took place in 2012 and 2013 between officials of the Central Authority and the editorial team of RTL-Ontvoerd.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in antwoord op de vragen 1, 10 en 11 hebben in 2012 en 2013 drie gesprekken plaatsgevonden tussen ambtenaren van de Centrale autoriteit en de redactie van RTL-Ontvoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een schietincident in Irak in 2004

An MP asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service decided not to prosecute a Dutch soldier before all evidence on a 2004 Iraq shooting was gathered, whether it withheld statements, and how the minister views the claim that the OM misled the court. The minister declined substantive answers, citing a pending Article 12 Sv complaint procedure, judicial independence, privacy and investigative interests.
A procedure under Article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is currently ongoing on this matter.
Over deze aangelegenheid loopt momenteel een procedure ex artikel 12 Wetboek van strafvordering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over boetes voor migranten vanwege het niet tijdig slagen voor het inburgeringsexamen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about fines of up to €1,250 imposed on more than 500 refugees and spouse migrants who missed the three-year civic integration exam deadline, questioning course quality and whether debt was a fair sanction. The minister answered that fines are only imposed when the delay is culpable and cannot be excused, that quality oversight of courses is being tightened, and that changes to the system are for the incoming cabinet and the 2018 evaluation, while rejecting the MP's framing of the facts.
Integration participants who, according to DUO's records, culpably failed to meet the integration obligation receive a notice of the deadline overrun from DUO.
Inburgeraars die volgens de bij DUO bekende gegevens verwijtbaar niet aan de inburgeringsplicht hebben voldaan, krijgen een kennisgeving van de termijnoverschrijding van DUO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er generaties in Nederland geboren Molukkers stateloos zijn

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how Moluccans born in the Netherlands can hold a Dutch passport without Dutch nationality, what the status and disadvantages of the facilities passport are, how many people are affected, and whether they can be informed and given free naturalisation. The government explains that the Facilities Act treats this group as Dutch, that since 1991 holders can obtain a passport stating Dutch nationality, that 1,289 people are registered as treated as Dutch, that the third-generation rule and free option/naturalisation exist, and that it will ask municipalities to inform applicants but will not actively contact the group.

To this end, municipalities and other passport-issuing authorities will, where necessary, be told to inform applicants who are registered as being treated as Dutch of this fact and ask whether they want a passport showing that treatment.

Met het oog daarop zullen de gemeenten en de andere paspoortverstrekkende autoriteiten er, voor zover nodig, op worden gewezen dat zij aanvragers die blijkens de basisregistratie personen als Nederlander worden behandeld, van dit feit op de hoogte stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over 1 jaar Turkijedeal

An MP asked the State Secretary about the state of the EU-Turkey deal one year on, including the amount of the promised funds disbursed, the situation of refugees stuck in Greece, the use of EU funds for reception in Greece, and allegations of corruption raised by a whistleblower. The government answered that the deal has significantly reduced crossings and drownings, that EUR 777 million of the first EUR 3 billion tranche has been disbursed and the Netherlands has contributed EUR 93.9 million, and that it monitors fund use through the Commission, which handles any suspected irregularities via OLAF.
I am not aware of contacts the interviewed former official may have had with the President of the European Commission.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van contacten die de geïnterviewde oud-ambtenaar zou hebben gehad met de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Azmani, Jasper van Dijk, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken, Knops en Voordewind over het bericht “Onrust op ministeries over komst Eritrese partijfunctionaris”

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a planned Eritrean youth congress in the Netherlands, the planned speech by regime official Yemane Gebreab, and possible measures against regime-linked persons and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that the congress was banned by the Veldhoven mayor, that voluntariness of contacts with Eritrean authorities must remain the principle, that visa decisions are individual, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that a diaspora tax study is ongoing and will be reported in Q2 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commissioned an independent bureau to research the nature and extent of the Eritrean regime's diaspora tax.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een onafhankelijk bureau opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van de diasporabelasting van het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de campagne in Nederland voor het referendum in Turkije

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about the Turkish referendum campaign in the Netherlands, including bus transport aimed only at Yes or No voters, intimidation of campaigners and a journalist, and where the limit on foreign influence over Turkish Dutch citizens lies. The government answered that transport offers are not unusual and lawful, that intimidation is unacceptable and should be reported to police, that foreign interference is firmly opposed, and that the journalist's case is under police investigation.
The cabinet considers it undesirable that foreign governments openly or covertly try to influence the choices of Dutch citizens.
Het kabinet vindt het ongewenst dat buitenlandse overheden keuzes van Nederlandse burgers openlijk dan wel heimelijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de integratie van nieuwkomers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment and the State Secretary of Security and Justice about delays in integrating asylum seekers and recognised refugees, including whether language and integration training could start earlier. The Minister replied that the government is accelerating integration through earlier voorinburgering, better municipal matching, regional coordinators, and a cohort study, while acknowledging the 2015 backlog and emergency-shelter problems.
Newcomers who are allowed to stay must participate as quickly as possible.
Nieuwkomers die mogen blijven moeten zo snel mogelijk meedoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over promotiefraude aan de Tilburg University

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about alleged fraud by former dean Arie de Ruijter at Tilburg University, including payments to relatives' companies, the incentive effects of the promotion bonus, the quality of PhDs supervised, and his side jobs and salary. The minister answers that the Inspectorate investigated, the university reported the case to the prosecutor, the Hol committee found no scientific fraud, the promotion parameter is being capped, and that side-job and salary questions fall outside her ministry's remit.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education (IvhO) to conduct an investigation.
Ik heb de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (IvhO) gevraagd om onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over onrecht als gevolg van de invoering van het leenstelsel voor studenten

An SP MP asked the minister about child benefit ending for parents when minors start higher education, arguing it turns into a student debt and deters ambitious youths, and asked whether the loan system should be reversed. The minister replied that studiefinanciering replaces child benefit, that the change is not unequal or deterring, that the monitor shows 62% of students used the loan, and that the loan system will not be reversed.
It is not being considered to adjust the system.
Er wordt niet overwogen het systeem aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de klokkenluider van vliegbasis Eindhoven

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about a whistleblower at Eindhoven air base, including an entry in his medical file wrongly recorded as a psychological consult, the squadron commander's public statements, the handling of the OIO and IMG investigations, and whether the whistleblower still has legal protection. The Minister denied any falsification of the file, explained the IMG's reconstruction and its admitted dating assumptions, described the apology and data deletion, and confirmed the whistleblower remains protected by the whistleblower regulation.
There is no question of falsifying the medical file.
Van het vervalsen van het medisch dossier is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de indirecte bijdrage aan Bridge International Academies

MPs Van Bommel and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch development funds indirectly invested in Bridge International Academies, a low-cost private school operator, and whether this should be reclaimed given school closures and quality concerns. The minister confirmed about USD 1.51 million indirect investment via Novastar, refused to reclaim it, and argued that private education can complement weak public schooling while committing to monitor the Ugandan and Kenyan situations.
The cabinet sees no reason to reclaim this indirect support because the investment is a good complement to the deficient public education in these countries.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om deze indirecte steun terug te vorderen omdat de investering een goede aanvulling vormt op het gebrekkige publieke onderwijs in deze landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes en Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse verzekeraars die nog steeds investeren in wapenfabrikanten

MPs Sjoerdsma, Servaes and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch insurers' investments in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, which may be used in the Yemen conflict, fit export restrictions, the insurance sector's sustainable investment code and international responsible business standards, and what the government has done since 2015. Minister Ploumen answered that no EU sanctions apply to Saudi Arabia, that insurers themselves decide which companies to invest in, that a sector IMVO covenant is being negotiated, and that the insurers named were contacted.
Subject to these conditions, it is up to insurers themselves to decide which companies they invest in; the government in principle does not regulate this.
Met in achtneming van deze voorwaarden is het aan verzekeraars zelf om te bepalen in welke bedrijven zij investeren, de overheid reguleert dit in beginsel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over hogescholen en universiteiten die onrechtmatige studiekosten in rekening brengen bij studenten

The SP MP asks the Minister of Education why universities and universities of applied sciences still charge students unlawful study costs and what will be done to enforce the rules. The Minister answers that the Inspectorate will act if unlawful fees are found, has received the ISO inventory, and will discuss information provision with the sector associations.
Should it turn out that an institution indeed charges study costs unlawfully, the Inspectorate will hold the institution to account and take enforcement action where necessary.
Mocht blijken dat een instelling inderdaad onterecht studiekosten in rekening brengt, dan zal de inspectie de instelling daarop aanspreken en zo nodig handhavend optreden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Navigators Studentenvereniging Amsterdam op basis van de christelijke identiteit wordt geweerd door een leverancier van pinapparaten

MPs Bruins and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether refusing a card payment terminal to a Christian student association on religious grounds is lawful under the equal treatment act, and how it relates to that act. The minister answered that the equal treatment act generally prohibits religious distinctions in offering services, but whether unlawful discrimination occurred can only be determined through investigation, and the association could file a complaint with the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Whether unlawful distinction exists in the case in question can only be established on the basis of investigation.
Of er in het genoemde geval sprake is van verboden onderscheid kan alleen op basis van onderzoek worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een Brits bedrijf het IT-beveiligingsbedrijf dat Nederlandse staatsgeheimen beveiligt, heeft overgenomen

MPs Van Raak and Jasper van Dijk asked why the state relies on a private firm to secure state secrets, whether the UK takeover of Fox-IT endangers them, and why the NCTV and MIVD were not informed or able to block the deal. The ministers answered that the state needs specialised private expertise, that contractual and legal security requirements guard against unwanted access, that no notification duty existed and Dutch law offers no grounds to restrict such takeovers, and that the MIVD lacks power to block them.
Under the existing contractual arrangements with the company concerned, there was no obligation to inform the NCTV of a proposed takeover.
Op grond van de bestaande contractuele afspraken met het betreffende bedrijf bestond niet de verplichting om de NCTV op de hoogte te stellen van een voorgenomen overname.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak over stembureaus op MBO-scholen

MPs Van Dijk and Van Raak asked whether the government supports placing polling stations at MBO schools, universities of applied sciences and universities to increase youth turnout, and whether it will consult education bodies and the VNG before the 15 March election. Minister Plasterk agreed in principle that accessible polling locations help youth turnout, noted that most municipalities had already designated polling stations and printed passes, and said he will encourage municipalities to pay attention to school-based polling stations for the 2018 municipal elections.

However, I am willing to suggest to municipalities that they give extra attention to the possibility of setting up polling stations in educational institutions for the municipal elections of 21 March 2018.

Ik ben echter bereid om gemeenten in overweging te geven om voor de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen van 21 maart 2018 extra aandacht te besteden aan de mogelijkheid van het inrichten van stembureaus in onderwijsinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over wapenhandel met Turkije

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether the government would suspend arms exports to Turkey given Turkish airstrikes in Syria and Iraq, whether F-35 parts supplied from the Netherlands were acceptable, and whether they would raise the issue in the EU. The government answered that exports are assessed under the EU Common Position, that the F-35 parts are for a multinational production chain, that four Turkish export applications were refused last year, and that it opposes a unilateral embargo and sees no EU support for changing policy on Turkey.
The Netherlands applies the Common Position very strictly and will refuse an export application when it considers the proposed export not in line with the criteria of the Common Position.

Nederland is zeer strikt in de toepassing van het Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt en zal een vergunningaanvraag afwijzen wanneer het de voorgenomen uitvoer niet in overeenstemming acht met de criteria van het Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het handelsverdrag tussen de EU en Japan

An MP asked the trade minister about the stalled EU-Japan trade agreement, including whether it would include investor-state dispute settlement like CETA, data protection, and how the EU and Japan negotiations and CETA might be reset. The minister answered on each point: no agreement yet, the EU seeks the Investment Court System, market access for dairy and cars remains disputed, and the government pushes for more transparency and inclusion, including a new stakeholder council.
The cabinet advocates a reset of the negotiations. Trade agreements must become more sustainable, transparent and inclusive.
Het kabinet pleit voor een reset van de onderhandelingen. Handelsakkoorden moeten duurzamer, transparanter en inclusiever worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat mbo-scholen veel tijd kwijt zijn aan het wegwerken van taal- en rekenachterstanden bij hun studenten

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education about reports that MBO schools spend much time remedying students' language and arithmetic deficiencies, and whether holding pupils back is discouraged. The minister acknowledged the concern, stated that schools decide on retention themselves with alternatives like summer schools, promised a further analysis and possible additional measures, but did not have data on individual school lesson cancellations.
I do not have the data on lesson cancellations at individual schools.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens over lesuitval van individuele scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake hoge werkdruk en het lage salaris van leraren

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Education about high teacher workload, structural overtime, underfunding, and the failure to make teaching attractive, citing an AOb survey. The State Secretary disputes underfunding, points to ongoing measures to cut administrative burden and a planned letter on the motion about teaching hours, and argues workload is mainly a matter for teachers and their managers.
The solution to the experienced high workload is not simple and can only be limitedly influenced by national policy.
De oplossing voor de ervaren hoge werkdruk is niet eenvoudig en maar beperkt te beïnvloeden door landelijk beleid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de gevolgen van het handelsverdrag tussen de EU en Canada (CETA) en het handelsverdrag voor de handel in diensten (Trade in Services Agreement, TiSA)

Two SP MPs asked the Ministers of Foreign Trade and Finance about financial-sector risks, regulatory room, investor rights, TiSA services liberalisation and ILO standards under CETA and TiSA. The minister answered at length, largely defending the agreements, while committing to continued attention to ILO standards, a Broad Trade Consultation, and quarterly overviews of trade negotiations.
To increase transparency, the cabinet sends the House of Representatives a quarterly overview of all ongoing EU trade agreement negotiations with third countries.
Om de transparantie te vergroten stuurt het kabinet de Tweede Kamer elk kwartaal een overzicht van alle lopende onderhandelingen over handelsakkoorden van de EU met derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de klokkenluider van Vliegbasis Eindhoven

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that whistleblowers at Defence were pressured, whether the department erred in the Eindhoven air base case, whether the whistleblower met the Minister and consented to sharing the IMG report with parliament, and whether he risks consequences. The Minister said the whistleblower consented, the report was shared confidentially, and no consequences are expected, while maintaining that the case involved careless recording but no fraud.
The report contains not only confidential personal data of the whistleblower, which was the reason for confidential disclosure.
Daarnaast bevat dit IMG-rapport niet alleen vertrouwelijke persoonsgegevens van de klokkenluider, hetgeen reden is geweest voor de vertrouwelijke verstrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over megaclaims naar aanleiding van brandstofleveranties in Afghanistan

MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked the Defence Minister about reported NATO-Supreme Group fuel-supply claims in Afghanistan, including whether NATO faces a court case and how much Dutch money is involved, and about oversight and outsourcing. The minister declined to give details on the claims while the court case is pending, confirmed the Netherlands received fuel from Supreme, said control services are adequately equipped, and said Defence still has contracts with Supreme and outsources procurement for cost reasons.
As long as the case is still before the court, the government cannot go into detail on this.
Zolang de zaak nog voor de rechtbank dient, kan de regering hierover niet in detail treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de voorlopige toepassing en ratificatie van het Vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

An MP from the SP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about the provisional application and ratification of the EU-Canada CETA agreement, including which parts are excluded, whether the Council votes by qualified majority, the status of the interpretative declaration, and whether the government will publish texts and meet union demands. The Minister answered that the draft Council decision was published, provisional application excludes specified provisions, the declaration has legal and political value, and all texts will be made public.
Yes. The unrevised treaty text of CETA was already published in September 2014, and the legally-linguistically revised version was published immediately in February 2016.
Ja. De ongereviseerde verdragstekst van CETA is reeds in september 2014 openbaar gemaakt en ook de juridisch-linguïstisch gereviseerde versie is direct openbaar gemaakt in februari 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over claims met betrekking tot het reinigingsmiddel PX-10

An MP asked the Defence Minister why PX-10 victims were told their compensation claims might be time-barred, whether the government would clearly rule out limitation, and why Defence needs former staff to prove their employment. The minister answered that relative limitation (five years from October 2008) is applied case by case without automatic invocation, that absolute limitation (30 years) will not be invoked, and that validating old employment records is reasonable.
However, Defence will not automatically invoke the relative limitation period.
Echter, Defensie zal de relatieve verjaringstermijn niet automatisch inroepen.
