Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis, Jasper van Dijk en Verhoeven over geheime contracten en onzorgvuldige begeleiding van deelnemers bij RTL-programma's rond hulp-tv

MPs asked the state secretary about RTL reality-help programmes allegedly misleading vulnerable participants, binding them to secret contracts, and filming therapy under pressure, and whether the state has adequate legal tools and oversight. The state secretary said producers and broadcasters bear primary responsibility, the Mediawet 2008 contains no such rules and no new legislation is planned, RTL (under Luxembourg supervision) has promised to review its practices and media code, and medical questions were referred to the health minister.
I also see no reason to propose statutory rules for this.
Ik zie ook geen aanleiding om daar wettelijke regels voor te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het commerciële tv-programma "een nieuw begin"?

SP MPs asked the Health and Culture ministers about the commercial TV programme 'een nieuw begin', which allegedly pressed participants into unnecessary cosmetic and dental treatments, and whether clinics and the Inspectorate had acted. The minister called it a worrying signal, said patient consent and information duties apply, noted the Inspectorate had no complaints about the programme and was investigating CDC Tandzorg on unrelated complaints, and said RTL and producers bear responsibility and will be reviewed.
The Inspectorate cannot make any statements about the nature of the ongoing investigation.
Over de aard van het lopende onderzoek kan de Inspectie geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het mandaat van de VN-missie dubbelzinnig is

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether the UN MINUSMA mandate in Mali is ambiguous, since troops must be impartial while supporting state-building, and whether impartiality problems explain attacks on peacekeepers. The minister replied that the mandate is clear, centred on supporting the peace agreement, that the attacks are terrorist acts by non-signatory groups, and that the Rules of Engagement are clear, so no changes were planned.
The cabinet is of the view that the mandate of MINUSMA is clear.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat het mandaat van MINUSMA duidelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over jonge statushouders die gaan studeren

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the Minister about poor coordination between COA and municipalities that leaves student housing for young refugees underused, and about how the gaps in study guidance and information will be addressed. The Minister replied that municipalities are responsible for housing, that the Rijk has introduced early screening of refugees' education and work background, and that study guidance is a task of the educational institutions, with specialised support from UAF.
Municipalities are responsible for the housing of refugee status holders.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de huisvesting van statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Duisenberg over het bericht dat bestuurders van de Universiteit Utrecht opnieuw royaal hebben gedeclareerd

MPs Van Dijk and Duisenberg asked the minister whether Utrecht University board members' lavish declarations (luxury hotels, business-class flights) after stricter rules were introduced are acceptable, and whether the accountant's reports were acted on. The minister replied that the inspectorate will investigate the accountant's flagged shortcomings and the declarations deviating from the regulation, will report by spring 2017, and that new uniform declaration rules apply from 2017.

The inspectorate will carry out further investigation into the shortcomings and will therefore examine the declarations and allowances to Utrecht University board members that deviate from the declaration regulation.

De inspectie zal nader onderzoek doen naar de tekortkomingen en zal dan ook de declaraties en vergoedingen aan bestuurders van de Universiteit Utrecht in ogenschouw nemen die afwijken van het declaratiereglement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat promotiestudenten volgens arbeidsrechtsadvocaten een arbeidscontract kunnen eisen

MPs Van Meenen and Van Dijk asked whether PhD students can enforce an employment contract in court, as some labour lawyers claim, and what this means for the experiment with PhD education. The minister answered that the employment relationship depends on actual practice, that the universities shape this themselves, and that any case where a PhD student became an employee would be considered in the evaluation of the experiment.
If the court rules that there is no PhD student but an employee-PhD candidate, the rules applicable to employee-PhD candidates apply.
Als de rechter oordeelt dat geen sprake is van een promotiestudent, maar van een werknemer-promovendus, dan gelden de voor de werknemer-promovendus geldende regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Ten Broeke, Jasper van Dijk, Knops, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Grashoff en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Darfur

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report of possible chemical weapons use in Darfur, lack of humanitarian and UNAMID access to Jebel Marra, and whether Sudan should be asked to explain under the Chemical Weapons Convention and face inspection. The minister said the OPCW is examining the report, has requested more information from Sudan, and that Netherlands will press for accountability and raise the issue with EU and UN partners if use is confirmed.
The Netherlands asked the OPCW to act proactively and to actively inform the States Parties about the findings.
Nederland heeft de OPCW verzocht om proactief optreden en de Staten Partijen actief over de bevindingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over de gevolgen van de vrijhandelsverdragen met Canada (CETA) en de VS (TTIP) voor asbesthoudende producten

MPs Van Dijk and Smaling asked whether CETA and TTIP could let asbestos-containing products enter the EU market and whether the precautionary principle is weakened. The minister answered that REACH bans asbestos imports, that mutual recognition does not apply to asbestos, that inspection services have adequate powers, and that the precautionary principle is secured in CETA, while Dutch government asked the Commission for a binding declaration.
To clarify matters, the Netherlands has asked the European Commission to also include the precautionary principle for future safety and health measures in a legally binding declaration.

Ter verduidelijking heeft Nederland de Europese Commissie verzocht om het voorzorgsprincipe voor toekomstige veiligheids- en gezondheidsmaatregelen ook op te nemen in een juridisch bindende verklaring
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht dat een 'Gülenschool' in Amsterdam wordt beveiligd

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked about extra security at Gülen-linked schools in Amsterdam, possible foreign funding of schools, and whether political conflicts should stay out of schools. The state secretary said extra security was temporary and local, that inspection found no sign of external funding, and that schools should not become a political arena, while supporting schools and municipalities.
I am aware that at various schools security was present at the beginning of this school year.
Het is mij bekend dat op verschillende scholen aan het begin van dit schooljaar beveiliging aanwezig was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Jasper van Dijk en Grashoff inzake de gevolgen van het Turkse conflict voor Nederlandse scholen

MPs asked the State Secretary of Education about school withdrawals and intimidation of Turkish-Dutch pupils linked to the Erdogan-Gulen conflict, and about the role of municipalities and the financial effects on schools. The answers report about 600 pupils switching schools, signals of pressure from within the community, extra police attention, support from the School and Safety foundation, and that funding follows enrolment counts monitored by the Inspectorate.
I am therefore pleased with the great involvement of municipalities.
Ik ben daarom blij met de grote betrokkenheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake protest tegen het bestuur van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA)

MP Van Dijk asked the minister about protests against the joint UvA/HvA board, including calls for separation, the appointment procedure, and board-member combinations of roles. The minister rejected the claim that cooperation failed, noted the planned split is being discussed with the university community, and stated that the Raad van Toezicht chair remains in place after the UvA board resigned.
Before definitive steps are taken, the Executive Board rightly wishes first to discuss its line with the education community.
Voordat er definitieve stappen worden gezet wil het College van Bestuur terecht eerst haar lijn bespreken met de onderwijsgemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake de omstreden benoeming van de voorzitter van de Raad van Toezicht van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA)

An SP MP asked the Education Minister whether the reappointment of the Raad van Toezicht chair of the University of Amsterdam without consulting the works councils was lawful and why councils could not advise on the candidate's profile. The minister replied that the procedure followed the WHW, that the appointment was lawful per a Stibbe legal opinion, and that she will ensure councils get a chance to review profiles in future reappointments, and noted the board has since resigned and a new board was appointed.

In future reappointments of all members of the Raad van Toezicht of public universities, I will ensure that the works councils also get the chance to assess whether the profile on which they advised at the first term is still current.

Ik zal ik me er bij toekomstige herbenoemingen van alle leden van de Raad van Toezicht van de openbare universiteiten van vergewissen dat de medezeggenschap ook de kans heeft gekregen om te bezien of het profiel van de Raad van Toezicht waarover bij de eerste termijn is geadviseerd nog actueel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat meer dan de helft van de studies in het Engels wordt aangeboden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the report that over half of university programmes are taught in English, and whether this undermines Dutch as a scientific language and the WHW article 7.2 duty to teach in Dutch. The Minister answered that internationalisation justifies English-taught programmes, that the KNAW is conducting an exploration of language policy, and that she does not accept commercially driven English teaching but will await the KNAW report before further steps.
I do not accept that universities teach in English purely and solely for commercial reasons.
Ik accepteer niet dat universiteiten puur en alleen uit commerciële overwegingen onderwijs in het Engels geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes en Jasper van Dijk over een uitnodiging aan Saoedi-Arabië voor een Nederlandse wapenbeurs

MPs asked whether the Royal Netherlands Navy invited a Saudi delegation to the MAST 2016 defence fair, why the first question was not fully answered, and how an invitation squares with a strict arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia given the situation in Yemen and human rights. The government confirmed invitations went to 23 countries including Saudi Arabia, that no Saudi delegation attended (reason unknown), maintained its strict export licensing, and said it could not provide a central overview of past defence-fair invitations.
The Ministry of Defence does not keep a central registration of defence fairs.
Het Ministerie van Defensie voert geen centrale registratie van defensiebeurzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe onthullingen inzake de misstanden op vliegbasis Eindhoven

MPs Belhaj and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about new revelations of misconduct at Eindhoven air base, the scope and powers of the internal investigation, its timeline, and the status of the flares transport case. The minister declined to share the investigation's assignment details or findings before completion, promised to inform parliament of the outcome, and reported that prosecutors dropped the flares case without finding criminal offences.
Pending the investigation results, I will make no further statements on this.
In afwachting van de onderzoeksresultaten doe ik hier geen nadere uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de problemen met de JSF

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that F-35 software problems remain unresolved, the risks flagged by the US chief tester, schedule delays, cost overruns and the readiness of the aircraft. The minister acknowledged technical challenges and a roughly six-month software delay but said the Dutch budget ceiling is unchanged, the Dutch SDD contribution is capped with overruns borne by the US, and rejected the claim that acquisition is in doubt.
The US government has not yet released the memo in question.
De Amerikaanse overheid heeft het desbetreffende memo tot op heden niet vrijgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de voorlopige toepassing van het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

An SP MP asked the trade minister about the provisional application of the EU-Canada trade agreement CETA, including whether the government had objected in the trade committee, how it squares with a parliamentary motion, and whether investment court provisions and the whole agreement would be provisionally applied. The minister answered that the government took no position in Brussels until a 14 September debate, that CETA is a mixed agreement so national parliaments can weigh in on all of it, and that the government intends to oppose provisional application of the whole agreement.
Only after the debate with your House on 14 September will the cabinet establish a Dutch position on the provisional application of CETA and advocate it in Brussels.
Pas na het debat met uw Kamer op 14 september zal het kabinet een Nederlands standpunt vaststellen over de voorlopige toepassing van CETA en dit in Brussel uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de negatieve gevolgen van het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the ministers whether TTIP's tariff cuts on sugar, alcohol and tobacco would harm public health, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that tariff cuts may lower consumer prices, that public health policy space remains under TTIP, and that a full response will follow once Ecorys' final report is published.
Once the final report is published, the cabinet will give a comprehensive response.
Zodra het definitieve rapport is gepubliceerd, zal het kabinet een uitgebreide reactie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het hoge collegegeld voor een tweede studie

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education whether high institutional tuition fees for a second degree are unaffordable, why second-degree enrolment has fallen, and whether fees should be capped at the statutory rate. The Minister says the government enables students to pursue second degrees via financing schemes, that enrolment has stabilised since 2013, that institutions must be transparent on fee levels with a list of non-transparent institutions provided, and that she rejects equalising fees to the statutory rate, though she will press institutions on transparency and may consider maximum fees if they fall short.
I will seriously hold to account the institutions that have failed to comply and raise this again with the Vereniging Hogescholen and VSNU.
Ik zal de instellingen die in gebreke zijn gebleven daar ernstig op aanspreken en dit ook nogmaals aan de orde stellen bij de Vereniging Hogescholen en VSNU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk en Rog over het bericht dat er grote verschillen zijn in de financiële steun aan studenten met een beperking

MPs Bruins, Van Dijk and Rog asked the Minister of Education about reports of large differences in support for students with disabilities, including poor information provision and differences in municipal individual study allowances. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to information duties and a forthcoming letter to parliament, and said that municipal allowance differences reflect local policy freedom while deferring the allowance question to the state secretary of Social Affairs.
This autumn I will send a letter to the House in response to the motion by member Van Meenen et al.
Dit najaar stuur ik een brief aan de Kamer in reactie op de motie van het lid Van Meenen c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de onderhandelingen over het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) mislukt zijn

An SP MP asked the trade minister whether TTIP negotiations have effectively failed, whether ISDS/ICS investor protection and European standards are being conceded, and whether the government should abandon the deal. The minister answered that the US must make concessions, that the chapters are interlinked so no agreement exists yet, that European standards are not up for debate, and that the government still supports a balanced deal subject to SER criteria and parliamentary ratification.
The European Council, the European Parliament and the national parliaments will take a final decision, in accordance with the Treaty of Lisbon.
De Europese Raad, het Europees parlement en de nationale parlementen zullen een uiteindelijk besluit nemen, conform het Verdrag van Lissabon.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over de inzet van Europees ontwikkelingsgeld ten behoeve van buitenlandse krijgsmachten in Afrikaanse landen

MPs asked whether EU development funds would be used to finance foreign armies in African countries, including Sudan's, and whether this is acceptable. The government answered that the Commission proposal would only allow non-ODA funds under the IcSP in exceptional cases, that ODA cannot be used to strengthen foreign armies, that Sudanese army support is not on the table, and that the Netherlands will push to keep development money for development.
Your House will be further informed about this proposal in September via a BNC fiche.
Uw Kamer zal in september nader worden geïnformeerd over dit voorstel via een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over geldverspilling bij de Luchtmacht

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister about spending by the Air Force on its Innovation AIR programme, including paid speakers such as Stanley McChrystal, budgets, staffing and certificates. The minister defends the innovation cells and the speaker costs as serving military innovation and technical staff retention, and answers most questions with figures, though the claim that a toilet was placed in a lift is denied.
On the goals and results of AIR and the various other innovation initiatives, Defence is open and transparent.
Over de doelen en resultaten van AIR en de diverse andere innovatie-initiatieven is Defensie open en transparant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe misstanden op Vliegbasis Eindhoven

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether a new internal investigation into misconduct at Eindhoven Air Base (ten incidents, including alcohol abuse and fraud) was being carried out, who would conduct it, why it was not external, and whether earlier measures had been adequate, including whether disciplinary action had been taken and staff suspended. The Minister confirmed the base commander ordered an internal investigation by a commission of staff from outside the base with an outside retired colonel as chair, said it follows the internal investigation protocol, and declined to comment further on earlier measures or suspensions pending the results.
On the advice of the Royal Marechaussee, the commander of Eindhoven Air Base ordered an investigation into (financial) integrity violations at the air base.
Op advies van de Koninklijke Marechaussee heeft de commandant van de Vliegbasis Eindhoven een onderzoek gelast naar (financiële) integriteitschendingen op de vliegbasis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Thieme over het informeren van de Kamer over de ambities inzake TAFTA

MPs Van Dijk and Thieme asked why the government did not inform parliament about its ambitions for TAFTA/TTIP, including full liberalisation and the claim that failure was not an option. The minister replied that parliament was kept informed through regular letters and committee debates on the Dutch position, and that the Commission now proposes CETA as a mixed agreement, which meets the Dutch demand.
The House was informed of the Dutch position through the usual methods.
De Kamer is volgens de gebruikelijke methodes geïnformeerd over de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Mohandis over de toegankelijkheid van grote sportevenementen op televisie

MPs Van Dijk and Mohandis asked whether major sporting events such as Formula 1 should be available on free-to-air television and whether the events list should be widened, after Formula 1 moved to subscription broadcaster Ziggo Sport. The Secretary of State agrees such events should be accessible on free-to-air television if of significant national importance, but declines to amend the events list now, citing legal certainty and recent 2015 changes, and points to digital options.
At this moment, however, I do not wish to amend the events list.
Op dit moment wil ik de evenementenlijst echter niet aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen bij de Hogeschool Utrecht (HU)

An SP MP asked the Education Minister about governance problems at Hogeschool Utrecht, including a hostile work climate, centralisation, hired change managers, unusual bonuses and inspection of integrity. The minister answered that the institution's own and PwC investigations found no indications of irregularities, that the choices are the institution's responsibility, and that the Inspectorate is following up on rate-cap issues.
Because of the confidential nature of the investigations and the privacy-sensitive information in the reports, the reports were not made public.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van de onderzoeken en de privacy gevoelige informatie in de rapporten, zijn de rapporten niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk en Servaes over een Saoedische delegatie die op uitnodiging van de Koninklijke Marine een Nederlandse wapenbeurs bezoekt

MPs Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk and Servaes asked whether a Saudi delegation was invited by the Royal Netherlands Navy to the MAST arms fair, and how such an invitation fits with the motion on Saudi arms exports, the EU Parliament resolution and alleged humanitarian law violations in Yemen. The ministers replied that no Saudi delegation attended MAST 2016, and that the government maintains a very strict case-by-case arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia, with no export licences granted in 2016 so far.
No, no Saudi delegation was present at the Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Neen, er is geen Saoedische delegatie aanwezig geweest op de Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat twee apen geëuthanaseerd zullen worden na afloop van de dierproef

MPs Van Gerven and Jasper van Dijk asked whether two research monkeys at Radboud University face euthanasia after an animal experiment and whether they could be rehomed, and raised related questions on water restriction, rehoming costs and the rationale for ape research. The State Secretary replied that no decision has been taken, rehoming is for the licence holder to decide, the NCad advice and a Code of Practice on rehoming are being implemented, and funding for rehoming and alternatives is being arranged.
The decision on whether a former laboratory animal is eligible for rehoming or adoption is taken by the licence-holding institution.
De beslissing of een voormalig proefdier in aanmerking komt voor herplaatsing/adoptie wordt genomen door de vergunninghoudende instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Merkies over defensiebedrijven die via Nederland belasting ontwijken

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked whether large defence companies use Dutch holdings to avoid tax, how much corruption and holding data is tracked, and whether research into the sector's use of the Dutch tax climate is needed. The State Secretary answered that such data is not kept, corruption is addressed through EU and national anti-money-laundering and criminal rules, and that no specific sector-focused research is planned.
This data is not kept as such.
Deze gegevens worden niet als zodanig bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bedrijf Supreme Group dat Nederlandse troepen in Afghanistan heeft bevoorraad

SP MPs asked whether Defence knew of overcharging by Supreme Group, whether a whistleblower's report was acted on, and whether audits, repayment and legal action occurred. The minister confirmed the overcharging, said the whistleblower report was handled through audits and the matter was corrected, withheld amounts and audit reports as commercially confidential but offered confidential briefing, and said no civil or criminal action was taken since the company cooperated and repaid.
I am willing to inform you about the reports confidentially.
Ik ben bereid u op vertrouwelijke wijze over de rapporten te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de belangenverstrengeling van belastinghoogleraren

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked about the affiliations of tax professors with accountancy and law firms, conflicts of interest, lobbying influence on tax policy, and a register of side jobs. The government answered that such side jobs are acceptable under the Dutch research code, that transparency is required through university websites, that consultation and advice paragraphs are used, and that it sees no need for a national register.
It is the responsibility of civil servants, the cabinet and MPs to reach balanced judgments based on available information and by listening to the views of parties involved.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van ambtenaren, het kabinet en Kamerleden om op basis van beschikbare informatie en door te luisteren naar geluiden van betrokken partijen tot afgewogen oordelen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Jasper van Dijk over de productie van euromunten

MPs Merkies and Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Royal Dutch Mint's use of Poongsan roundels, a supplier also linked to cluster munitions, and about ministry oversight of state-owned enterprises. The State Secretary answered that the Mint raised the issue with the MDWG, that the ministry approves roundel orders and will block Poongsan purchases while it makes cluster munitions, and that the state will use the case as a general warning to other state holdings.

As promised in the General Consultation of 2 June on the KNM, the ministry will also in future ensure through the coin contract that no Poonsang roundels are purchased for producing Dutch euro coins as long as this company also makes cluster munitions.

Zoals toegezegd in Algemeen Overleg van 2 juni j.l. over KNM zal het ministerie ook in de toekomst via het muntcontract borgen dat er geen rondellen van Poonsang worden afgenomen voor de productie van Nederlandse euromunten zolang dit bedrijf ook clustermunitie maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Dijkgraaf, Jasper van Dijk, Bruins, De Roon en Grashoff over de voorlopige toepassing van het vrijhandelsverdrag met Canada (CETA)

MPs asked whether Netherlands had an effective veto over provisional application of the Ukraine association agreement and would have one over provisional application of CETA, and requested legal advice on provisional application. The minister confirmed unanimity applied for the association agreement, said CETA's voting rule depends on the legal basis not yet determined, and stated the government knows of no written legal advice received on provisional application.
Whether decision-making on signature and provisional application of CETA will be by unanimity or qualified majority depends on the legal basis.
Of besluitvorming over ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van CETA zal geschieden met unanimiteit of gekwalificeerde meerderheid is afhankelijk van de rechtsgrondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Bashir en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat driekwart van de studenten teveel huur betaalt

MPs Bashir and Van Dijk asked the Minister for Housing about an LSVb survey finding that 74% of students pay too much rent, and about enforcement, local rent-check teams and how the Rent Tribunal's rulings were communicated. The Minister replied that betaalbaarheid is on the platform's agenda and in the monitor, that municipalities decide on rent teams, that Rent Tribunal rulings were published in a public register, and that existing information and rent-check tools suffice, so no additional measures are planned.
I see no need to take additional measures for this target group.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om voor deze doelgroep aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jasper van Dijk over het geweld rondom het Agua Zarca project in Honduras en de vermeende betrokkenheid van de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsbank FMO

MPs Van Laar and Jasper van Dijk asked about violence around the Agua Zarca project in Honduras, alleged FMO involvement, and the investigation into the murder of activist Berta Cáceres. The minister said the government was shocked, FMO was withdrawing from the project, and it had urged Honduran authorities to accept IACHR involvement, while the fact-finding and broader accountability questions remain under review.
The government considers it crucial to have the facts clearly established and has therefore given relevant stakeholders the opportunity to share their views on the project.
Het kabinet vindt het cruciaal de feiten goed op een rij te hebben en heeft daarom betrokken stakeholders de mogelijkheid gegeven om hun visie op het project te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de investeringsbeschermingsverdragen tussen EU-lidstaten

An SP MP asked whether the Netherlands is seeking EU-wide support for ISDS arbitration so that European investors can bypass national courts, and why the government opposes terminating intra-EU BITs. The minister denied seeking ISDS, said the Netherlands is exploring orderly termination of intra-EU BITs with alternatives such as a permanent investment court, and gave no concrete commitment beyond continued analysis.
No, on the contrary. The article in NRC refers to a discussion on the future of bilateral investment protection agreements between EU member states.
Nee, integendeel. Het bewuste artikel in de NRC verwijst naar een discussie over de toekomst van bilaterale investeringsbeschermingsovereenkomsten tussen EU-lidstaten onderling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over slachtoffers van chroomverf

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Defence about chromium-6 paint victims at the former POMS site, including their long wait for the RIVM study, a survey showing 68 percent health complaints, medical data held by the CAOP reporting point, other hazardous substances such as depleted uranium, and whether individual work experiences are considered. The Minister answered that the RIVM study is ongoing and must be thorough, that most questions should be answered this year, that the health data can only be shared within privacy rules for the RIVM study, and that no separate investigation into other substances is planned.
Within the framework of privacy legislation, Defence can only make the data provided by (former) employees available for the RIVM study.
Defensie kan binnen de kaders van de privacywetgeving de gegevens die (oud-)medewerkers hebben gegeven alleen beschikbaar stellen voor het RIVM-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk, Dijkgraaf, Grashoff, De Roon, Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het handelsakkoord tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

Seven MPs asked the trade minister whether the Commission's plan to provisionally apply the EU-Canada CETA would be put to parliament, how the parliamentary reservation demanded by an earlier motion would be implemented, and whether CETA will be a mixed agreement. The minister answered that the Commissioner's commitment to consult the European Parliament is noted, that the government will formally register a parliamentary reservation in the Council once a proposal is tabled and inform the Tweede Kamer promptly, and that which parts would apply provisionally is not yet known.

If the Commission has submitted a proposal for a Council decision on signature and provisional application, the cabinet will formally implement the motion by stating in the Council that the Netherlands cannot agree to the proposal before it has been discussed with the House of Representatives.

Als de Commissie een voorstel heeft gedaan voor een Raadsbesluit voor ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing, zal het kabinet formeel uitvoering geven aan de motie door in de Raad kenbaar te maken dat Nederland niet kan instemmen met het voorstel voordat het voorstel is besproken met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het EU-Vietnam vrijhandelsverdrag

MPs Jasper van Dijk asked the minister about the labour, human rights and investment-court (ICS) implications of the EU-Vietnam free trade agreement, including its effects on Vietnamese industries and worker protections. The minister answered that impact studies show mixed economic effects, that existing ILO and EU mechanisms monitor labour rights, and that the ICS model mirrors the EU's TTIP proposal with safeguards for public policy.
The cabinet will soon respond to the SER advice.
Het kabinet zal spoedig een reactie op het SER-advies geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over TTIP Leaks

An SP MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade whether leaked TTIP documents show US business influence over EU decision-making, eroded standards and absent precautionary principle, and what the state of negotiations is on investment protection, regulatory cooperation, financial services and public debate. The minister rejects undue business influence, insists standards and the precautionary principle are preserved and regulatory policy space is protected, notes ongoing negotiations on investment court systems, and declines to share unpublished consolidated texts beyond the reading room.
Publication would harm the EU's negotiating position and therefore also the interests of the Netherlands.
Openbaarmaking schaadt de onderhandelingspositie van de EU en daarmee ook de belangen van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over corruptie bij de douane in de haven van Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Security and Justice about corruption among customs officers in the Port of Rotterdam, including whether the problem is structural, what measures are taken, and whether an independent inquiry will be held. The government denies a structural problem, describes preventive and disciplinary measures and new controls, says it cannot give a complete overview of smuggled goods, and declines an independent investigation, citing existing monitoring programmes.

The Customs service and the Public Prosecution Service do not have information to provide a complete overview of products (drugs, weapons) that entered in the past five years through bribery of customs personnel.

De Douane en het OM beschikken niet over informatie om een compleet overzicht te kunnen geven van producten (drugs, wapens) die de afgelopen vijf jaar via omkoping van douanepersoneel zijn binnengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gerommel met een rapport over de daling van het aantal studenten als gevolg van het leenstelsel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that a monitoring report on falling student intake under the loan system was delayed and reworked, and whether the government was concealing that lower-income and other disadvantaged groups show the largest drops. The minister answered almost every question by referring to the policy response accompanying the monitoring report sent to the Chamber on 18 April 2016, and said the report was consulted with sector and student organisations.
I refer you for my nuanced judgement on developments in enrolment in higher education to the policy response to the monitoring report that I sent to the House of Representatives on 18 April 2016.

Ik verwijs u voor mijn genuanceerde oordeel over de ontwikkelingen in de instroom in het hoger onderwijs naar de beleidsreactie bij de monitorrapportage die ik de Tweede Kamer op 18 april 2016 heb toegestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Jasper van Dijk over de productie van euromunten door een Zuid-Koreaans bedrijf dat ook betrokken is bij de productie van clustermunitie

MPs Merkies and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the state-owned Royal Dutch Mint (KNM) bought euro coin blanks from Poongsan, a Korean firm also linked to cluster munitions, and what the state as shareholder did about it. The Staatssecretaris answered that KNM ordered blanks in 2013 and 2015, that the state now asks KNM to stop ordering from Poongsan and will check this, and that the state will use the case as a general warning to other state holdings.
The state as shareholder will use this specific case as a general warning to the other state holdings that it is important to assess client and supplier relationships also on CSR aspects.

De staat als aandeelhouder zal deze specifieke casus gebruiken als algemene waarschuwing richting de andere staatsdeelnemingen dat het van belang is om klant- en leveranciersrelaties ook op MVO-aspecten te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Rog, Beertema en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht 'Leidse Greentower is in 2018 klaar

MPs asked the minister whether ROC Leiden's contribution to a bicycle parking garage near the Leiden square was capped, how it relates to earlier agreements on the square, and why the Chamber had not yet been informed. The minister answered that a 2014 agreement caps ROC Leiden's share at EUR 788,000 excluding VAT, with the municipality covering any excess, but that negotiations on the final amount are still ongoing and the Chamber will be informed once clarity exists.
At this moment the negotiations are still ongoing. As soon as I have clarity on this, I will inform you about it.
Op dit moment lopen de onderhandelingen nog. Zodra ik hier duidelijkheid over heb, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar, Jasper van Dijk, Van Veldhoven, Voordewind, Grashoff, Dijkgraaf, Thieme over het gebrek aan bescherming van Syrische kinderen

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about the lack of protection for Syrian children, including the petition and reports by UNICEF, Save the Children, War Child and World Vision, and what the Netherlands does on education, psychosocial aid and school protection. The minister answered that Dutch funding for education and psychosocial support in Syria and neighbouring countries is ongoing, that it supports the call to honour pledges, and that it will raise school protection and MHPSS at the EU and World Humanitarian Summit, but gave few figures on outcomes and no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands is working within international frameworks to ensure that the pledges are also honoured.
Nederland zet zich in internationaal verband in om ervoor te zorgen dat de toezeggingen ook worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gesjoemel met tickets in Nederland en België

An SP MP asked the Economics Minister about resale of concert tickets in NL and BE, including fraud, identity misuse, and cross-border evasion of Belgian resale ban. The government answered that resale is legal in NL, that ACM supervises transparency, prosecution is for the OM to decide, and it sees no reason for joint investigation.
The ACM does not make statements about individual cases.
De ACM doet geen mededelingen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk inzake de benoeming van  bestuurders aan de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA).

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the appointment procedure for new UvA executive board members, which excluded students and staff from real influence and leaked, and about the resignation of a board member linked to a dispute over splitting the UvA and HvA, and whether the supervisory board should explain this. The Minister replied that co-determination bodies were involved and agreed on the procedure and that the candidates' confidential process is acceptable, that the supervisory board decides jointly on the cooperation, and that she will not intervene in the dialogue between the works council and the supervisory board.
I have no intention of intervening in this conversation.
Ik heb geen intentie om in dit gesprek te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over landrechten

MPs Van Dijk and Smaling asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the murder of land-rights activist Berta Cáceres in Honduras, FMO's financing of the Agua Zarca dam, and Dutch land-rights policy. The Minister responded that the Netherlands has called for prosecution of the perpetrators, FMO has temporarily suspended financing pending investigation, and the government will sharpen land-rights policy and draft an action plan implementing the Smaling motion.
Pending the results of the investigation into local conditions at the Agua Zarca project, FMO has temporarily halted financing.
In afwachting van de resultaten van het onderzoek naar de lokale omstandigheden bij het Agua Zarca project heeft FMO de financiering tijdelijk stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Nieuw rapport: ‘Europese boeren kansloos door TTIP’

An SP MP asked the government about a report claiming TTIP would harm European farmers, including unfair competition from US livestock producers and pressure toward GMO feed and higher pesticide residue limits. The minister replied that the study's assumptions are unrealistic, that EU health, environment and animal welfare standards are not up for negotiation, and that the Netherlands is pursuing tariff exclusions for sensitive sectors while noting the EU does not plan to label products from animals fed GMO feed.

This assumption is not realistic given that the cabinet, the European Commission and the Council have repeatedly confirmed that European standards protecting human, plant, animal and environmental health are not up for discussion in TTIP.

Deze aanname is niet realistisch gezien het kabinet, de Europese Commissie en de Raad herhaaldelijk hebben bevestigd dat de Europese standaarden ter bescherming van mens, plant, dier en milieu door TTIP niet ter discussie staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rapport over import door IS van onderdelen voor de productie van IED’s (Improvised Explosive Devices- geïmproviseerde bommen)

Parliamentary member Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether the government shares concern about a report showing IS imports components for IEDs from many countries including the Netherlands, and what export controls could stop this. The ministers answer that most goods have civilian uses and are not export-controlled, that the Dutch-origin hydrogen peroxide was legally sold, and they point to new EU and national precursor rules and talks with other EU countries.

Therefore, within the National Counterterrorism Strategy and the Integrated Approach to Jihadism Action Programme, measures have been taken to limit the availability of raw materials for explosives and to oblige companies to report suspicious transactions.

Daarom zijn binnen de Nationale Contraterrorisme strategie en het Actieprogramma Integrale Aanpak Jihadisme maatregelen genomen om de beschikbaarheid van grondstoffen voor explosieven te beperken en bedrijven te verplichten om verdachte transacties te melden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over investeringsbescherming (Investor-State Dispute Settlement, ISDS) in het associatieakkoord met Oekraïne

MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether Article 89(2) of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, which mentions investment protection and investor-state dispute settlement, opens the door to ISDS and whether the passage would be dropped after the referendum. Minister Ploumen answered that the agreement contains no investor-state dispute mechanism, that ISDS is ruled out for the Netherlands, and that the cabinet will not anticipate the referendum outcome.
The Association Agreement with Ukraine contains no mechanism for the settlement of disputes between an investor and a state.
Het associatieakkoord met Oekraïne bevat geen mechanisme voor de beslechting van geschillen tussen een investeerder en een staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Jasper van Dijk inzake de marketingactiviteiten van scholen

MPs Siderius and Jasper van Dijk asked whether schools should hire marketing agencies and compete for pupils, and how much education funding goes to such activities. The State Secretary answered that transparency about schools is welcome, that no national data on marketing spending exists and no investigation is planned, and that regular funding is sufficient for the core teaching process.
Such an overview cannot be provided because this kind of information is not available at national level.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven aangezien dit soort informatie niet op landelijk niveau voorhanden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het wachtgeld voor de oud-burgemeester van Maastricht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the transition allowance of the former Maastricht mayor, its job-search obligations, holiday rules, sanctions and whether the scheme should be cut to match unemployment benefit rules. The Minister said the individual case is a municipal matter, explained the general rules and sanctions by analogy to the WW, and pointed to earlier reforms, rejecting further alignment because political office holders have a distinct legal position.
Moreover, for privacy reasons I in principle never provide information on the benefit entitlements of individual political office holders, even if I were to have such information.
Overigens geef ik uit privacyoverwegingen in beginsel nooit informatie over de uitkeringsrechten van individuele politieke ambtsdragers als ik daar al over zou beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de omstreden handelsverdragen met Canada (CETA) en de VS (TTIP)

An SP MP asks the trade minister about CETA and TTIP: whether member states are losing control, the German judges' objections, provisional application before parliamentary approval, ISDS/ICS arbitration risks (including the TransCanada Keystone claim), and regulatory chill. The minister rejects most concerns, says the investment court system is being adopted in CETA and TTIP, and commits to no new concrete action beyond continued parliamentary consultation.
The Netherlands does not comment on pending cases.
Nederland laat zich niet uit over lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake scholen die geld oppotten

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the education minister and state secretary about schools hoarding funds from the National Education Accord and Autumn Agreement, including whether a 3,000 young teachers target was met, and about lump-sum funding, university property risks and related motions. The government answered that schools received 891 million euro extra, with 406 million spent in 2013-2014, that employment targets are being verified via data due in 2016, and that inspectorate reports on university property will follow.
School boards were not asked to account for how the extra funds under the National Education Accord were spent.
Schoolbesturen zijn niet gevraagd om zich te verantwoorden over de besteding van de extra middelen in het kader van het Nationaal Onderwijsakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de berichten over het gebrek aan voortgang van de technologische en software ontwikkeling van de F-35

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of delays in the technological and software development of the F-35 (Block 3F), including test cuts, withheld weapons, costs, ALIS integration, and whether the Dutch aircraft will be operational by 2019 and within budget. The Minister acknowledged a likely delay to Block 3F software (expected end-2017), stated the Dutch IOC target of end-2021 is not under serious threat, promised further reporting in the progress reports, but gave no firm cost estimates and did not commit to a new parliamentary step beyond existing reports.
Defence informs the House about the progress of the programme with the progress reports in March and September.
Defensie informeert de Kamer over de voortgang van het programma met de voortgangsrapportages in maart en september.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Pieter Heerma, Verhoeven, Jasper van Dijk, Thieme en Kuzu over de behandeling van de Mediawet in de Eerste Kamer

MPs asked the State Secretary about appointments to the supervisory boards of the NOS and NTR and the NPO, including alleged political favouritism and whether a board chair's position at UWV made the appointment incompatible with the Mediawet. The State Secretary denied any legal incompatibility, said the NPO appointment followed an independent advisory committee, and refused to reverse it.
I regret the impression that has arisen and do not consider it consistent with the actual course of events.
Ik betreur het beeld dat is ontstaan en vind dat ook niet in overeenstemming met de feitelijke gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de uitspraak van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens dat Defensie discrimineert op grond van chronische ziekte

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister how she views a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that Defence discriminated against an applicant on grounds of chronic illness, and what she will do about it. The minister replied that medical basic requirements apply to all applicants, that Defence is talking with the person about options, and that the policy remains unchanged.
However, the policy remains unchanged. The medical basic requirements for military personnel apply to all applicants.
Het beleid blijft echter ongewijzigd. De medische basiseisen voor militairen gelden voor alle sollicitanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de informatiebijeenkomst PX-10

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about the PX-10 information meeting, the RIVM study, unpublished documents, the exposure scenarios, and whether PX-10 would be reintroduced and the study reopened. The minister defended the meeting and the RIVM study, promised to publish some documents under FOI, and declined to reopen the research.
The RIVM stands by the research and sees no reason to carry out the study again.
Het RIVM blijft achter het onderzoek staan en ziet geen aanleiding om het onderzoek opnieuw uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper Van Dijk over studieschuld als nieuwe restschuld en zieke werknemers als gevolg van schuld

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked whether student debt reduces mortgage capacity, can be concealed when applying for a mortgage, causes problem debts among workers, and whether sickness absence linked to financial problems will be investigated and addressed. The government answered that student loans are weighted lower than consumer credit in mortgage assessments, that lenders' duty of care and applicants' disclosure duty suffice, that repayment is income-contingent with debt forgiveness after 35 years, and that it will await TNO research results and develop a website for employers on financial problems.
To verify the amount of the student debt, and thus as proof, the former student can simply print an overview from mijnDUO.
Ter verificatie van de hoogte van de studieschuld en dus als bewijsstuk, kan de oud-student eenvoudigweg een overzicht vanuit mijnDUO uitdraaien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over export van militair materieel aan Saoedi-Arabië

SP MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Dutch arms export licences to Saudi Arabia breach EU and international law given the Yemen war and blockade, and whether Nederland will restrict such exports. The ministers acknowledge likely violations of international humanitarian law by the coalition, report four licences since March 2015 worth 2.8 million euro, and say they reject most military-related requests and will grant further licences only where no use in Yemen or rights abuses is conceivable.
Only when it is indisputably established that goods cannot be used in the fighting in Yemen or for human rights violations will a licence still be issued.
Alleen wanneer onomstotelijk vaststaat dat goederen niet kunnen worden ingezet in de strijd in Jemen of bij mensenrechtenschendingen zal nog een vergunning worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake de nieuwe eindtermen van het economieonderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about disagreement over macroeconomics specifications in the new economics exam syllabus, the progress of implementation, and whether the reform is necessary. The state secretary said the content dispute is not for the government to judge, that the domain H and I specifications are settled for the 2017 central exam, and that the CvTE is working on implementation.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on this type of substantive disagreement.
Het ligt niet in de rede dat ik me uitlaat over dit type inhoudelijke meningsverschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake gemeentelijke bezuinigingen op kunst en cultuur

MPs Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about municipal cuts to arts and culture, linked to cuts in the municipal fund, and whether this undermines national cultural investment and regional spread. The minister answered that municipalities are autonomous in setting cultural spending, that national investment of 18.6 million euros is planned for 2017-2020, and that she monitors the accessibility of cultural facilities without committing to new action.
Municipalities are autonomous in determining their own spending on culture.
Gemeenten zijn autonoom in het bepalen van hun eigen uitgaven aan cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over een docent die structureel wordt overbelast door het schoolbestuur

MPs Van Dijk and Siderius asked the State Secretary of Education about a teacher allegedly overloaded by her school board, including whether the board blocked her email and placed her on non-active status for discussing workload with colleagues. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case because it is before the courts, and gave general answers on workload, the collective agreement and national policy.
For the answers to questions 3 to 5, 7 and 9, I cannot go into this individual case because it is before the courts.
Voor het antwoord op de vragen 3 tot en met 5 en 7 en 9 geldt dat ik niet kan ingaan op dit individuele geval, omdat deze zaak onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jasper van Dijk inzake de inkomenspositie van popmuzikanten

MPs Van Dekken and Van Dijk asked the Minister about falling incomes of pop musicians, fees paid by subsidised pop venues, and royalties from streaming platforms. The Minister called the findings worrying, deferred advice from the Raad voor Cultuur, said fee-setting is the sector's responsibility while referring subsidy conditions to municipalities, and pointed to pending EU copyright work and a forthcoming pop policy letter.
I have asked the Raad voor Cultuur to advise me on how to deploy the EUR 2 million earmarked for improving artists' position on the labour market.
Ik heb de Raad voor Cultuur gevraagd mij te adviseren over de inzet van de € 2 miljoen euro
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het optreden van Nederlandse special forces in Afrika

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked about Dutch special forces training African militaries in counter-terrorism, the participation in Flintlock exercises since 2007, and a secret marine taskforce against piracy off Somalia that was not reported to parliament. The government answered that training takes place in secured military areas with negligible risk, lists Flintlock deployments year by year, and states that anti-piracy operations were reported via the article 100 procedure without naming this taskforce.
The name of the taskforce in question was not mentioned at the time.
De naam van onderhavige taskforce is destijds niet genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over dure kaartjes voor concerten

An SP MP asked ministers about very high resale prices for Adele concert tickets, Seatwave's booking fees, and links between primary seller Ticketmaster and resale site Seatwave, asking whether the government would intervene or investigate. The government answered that prices reflect scarcity and are free, that the matter has been referred to the ACM which enforces consumer and competition law, and that no separate investigation is needed.
The ACM is among other things authorised to supervise compliance with the Competition Act and consumer legislation.
De ACM is onder meer bevoegd om toezicht te houden op de naleving van de Mededingingswet en consumentenwetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat oliebedrijf Total de Oegandese staat aanklaagt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Total's investment-treaty arbitration against Uganda via a Dutch subsidiary, including treaty shopping, the disputed stamp duty, secrecy of production-sharing agreements and the effect on developing-country budgets. The minister said Dutch IBOs are available to firms with Dutch registration, that the use of IBOs by firms without substantial activity is undesirable and will be revised, and that the matter is for an arbitral tribunal, with transparency improvements promised for the IBO modernisation.
Attention deserves in this context the use of these treaties by Dutch investors that carry out no substantial business activities here.
Aandacht verdient in dit kader het gebruik van deze verdragen door Nederlandse investeerders die hier geen substantiële bedrijfsactiviteiten verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie klimaatvoorstellen zou blokkeren die handel en het TTIP hinderen

An SP MP asked the minister about a report that the European Commission was blocking climate proposals that hinder trade and TTIP, including a memo on instructing negotiators to oppose discussing trade in the UNFCCC and patent rights. The minister denied that all climate proposals are blocked, said climate and trade belong in their own fora with overlap handled politically, argued trade can benefit the environment, and said the Commission's stance needs no challenge.
The cabinet does not share the assumption in the report that the EU would block every climate proposal because of the TTIP negotiations.
Het kabinet deelt de veronderstelling in het bericht dat de EU ieder klimaatvoorstel zou blokkeren vanwege de TTIP-onderhandelingen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Van Dekken, Mei Li Vos en Jasper van Dijk over de economische positie van makers van reclamedeuntjes

MPs asked whether the economic position of jingle composers is weakened by a near-monopoly of a few advertising music firms and by practices of Buma/Stemra and broadcasters, and what the Auteurswet and Buma/Stemra could do about it. The government answered that competition law and the new author-contract law provide remedies, that complaints must come from the makers themselves, and that the law will be evaluated within five years.
Buma/Stemra is not a party to the agreement that composers and lyricists conclude with a client.
Buma/Stemra is geen partij bij de overeenkomst die componisten en tekstschrijvers sluiten met een opdrachtgever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hachchi over bijeenkomsten in het kader van het RIVM-onderzoek naar werken met chroom-VI

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Hachchi (D66) asked the Defence Minister about information meetings for former staff on the RIVM study into chromium-VI exposure, including frustration over criteria and attendance and the timeline. The minister defended the meetings and the study's independence and oversight, gave attendance figures, and promised fuller information in a late-January 2016 progress letter.
In the next progress letter, expected at the end of January 2016, I expect to be able to give you more substantive information about the study.
In de volgende standvanzakenbrief, die eind januari 2016 is voorzien, verwacht ik u meer inhoudelijke informatie over het onderzoek te kunnen verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut inzake het bericht 'Gülen runt nieuw lectoraat Inholland'

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked about reports that the Gülen movement runs a new lectorate at Inholland via the business association Hogiaf, and whether this is desirable and whether the school knew Hogiaf's background. The minister answered that Inholland guarantees the lectorate's independence, that the school will consider ending the cooperation if members actively promote Gülen ideology, and that the government has no overview of Gülen-linked organisations, with a parliamentary motion for further research pending.
The Dutch government does not have an overview of organisations operating under, or affiliated with, the Gülen movement.
De Nederlandse overheid beschikt niet over een overzicht van organisaties die opereren onder, of gelieerd zijn aan, de Gülen-beweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opening van een nevenvestiging van de RUG in China

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about the RUG's planned campus in Yantai, China, including costs, private financing, tuition, diploma rules, and medezeggenschap involvement. The Minister answered that the plan is still being developed, no business case has been approved, private funds only are allowed, and she will intervene if plans prove inadequate.
If I doubt the desirability of this initiative, or if it appears that the plans are insufficiently safeguarded in quality or financially, I will intervene.
Indien ik twijfel aan de wenselijkheid van dit initiatief, of wanneer het ernaar uit ziet dat de plannen kwalitatief of financieel onvoldoende geborgd zijn, zal ik ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht 'De kortingsregeling voor een studie aan de Open Universiteit'

The MPs asked whether Surinamese students living in Suriname are excluded from the Open Universiteit's collegegeld discount while Surinamese students in the Netherlands are eligible, and whether the discount should be extended to them. The minister denied the exclusion, explaining that since 2013 residence no longer matters for the statutory fee, so Surinamese students in Suriname can qualify, and she agreed that they should be able to.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Verhoeven inzake het bericht dat Sesamstraat verdwijnt van NPO1.

MPs Van Dijk and Verhoeven asked whether the removal of Sesamstraat from NPO1 to a themed channel is acceptable, given its educational role and the audience reach lost. The Secretary of State answered that the decision lies with the NPO under programmatic and editorial autonomy, that the morning broadcast remains on NPO 3, and that declined to discuss the decision with the NPO.
That editorial autonomy is explicitly guaranteed in the Mediawet (Media Act).
Die redactionele autonomie staat nadrukkelijk gegarandeerd in de Mediawet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over de plaatsing van nieuwe kernwapens in Duitsland

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign and Defence ministers about German nuclear-capable upgrades at Büchel, whether Dutch costs for Volkel were estimated, whether modernising B61 weapons conflicts with Global Zero and risks an arms race, and whether the Netherlands should drop modernisation now the JSF will not carry nuclear tasks. The government declined to speculate on Russian reactions, said NATO funds the WS-3 upgrades and gave no cost figures, rejected the view that modernisation conflicts with disarmament, and said it will keep the nuclear task debate open within NATO and not press for abandoning the B61 life-extension.
Under alliance agreements, no statements are made about the Netherlands' nuclear task.
Op grond van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken worden er geen mededelingen gedaan over de kernwapentaak van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake de chaotische invoering van de rekentoets

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education why the rekentoets (maths test) rules for secondary schools were published late and chaotically, leaving schools, pupils and parents uncertain about whether the test counts toward diplomas. The State Secretary answered that retroactive transitional rules would be published, that schools were advised on the worst-case scenario, and that clarity was given by letter, but declined to remove the test from the pass/fail rule for this school year.
With the letter of 22 October 2015 it was made clear in which cases the rekentoets counts toward the diploma.
Met de brief van 22 oktober 2015 is duidelijk gemaakt in welk geval de rekentoets meetelt voor het diploma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Jasper van Dijk inzake het artikel Moslimrector opnieuw onder vuur, nu om haattweets

MPs Duisenberg and Van Dijk asked whether the Inspectorate will visit the Islamic University of Rotterdam again and whether the rector's renewed controversial tweets breach his agreements with the minister. The minister confirmed the Inspectorate visit, said the rector's statements breach the agreements and undermine trust, and announced a bill allowing recognition to be withdrawn for discriminatory statements by board members.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapenexport naar Egypte

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about Dutch arms exports to Egypt, Egyptian navy involvement in the Yemen blockade, humanitarian impacts, and whether licences should be maintained. The ministers answered that the Yemen humanitarian situation is grave, that Egyptian ships are enforcing the UN arms embargo, that reports of bombing could not be confirmed, and that they see no reason to change the Egypt licensing policy.
The cabinet sees no reason to change the policy regarding Egypt on this point.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om het beleid ten aanzien van Egypte op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘dure reizen’ door de defensietop in de Telegraaf

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister how she views reports of high travel spending by the defence leadership, whether it is acceptable, and for overviews of flights and other declarations, and whether she will tighten travel policy. The minister answers that business-class travel is limited to specified ranks or operational necessity, provides aggregate flight and declaration figures, and says that business-class travel within Europe for senior staff has been restricted since 2010 with a proposal to unions this autumn, without detailed per-flight overviews.
Question 3: Can you provide an overview of all flights (and associated costs) made by the defence leadership in the past two years?
Vraag 3 Kunt u een overzicht geven van alle vliegreizen (en bijbehorende kosten) die in de afgelopen twee jaar gemaakt zijn door de defensietop?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapenexport naar Egypte

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Dutch export licence worth over 34 million euro for military equipment for the Egyptian navy, Egypt's role in the Yemen conflict and blockade, and whether the licence would be reconsidered. The ministers confirmed the licence, said they could not establish that Egyptian ships shelled targets in Yemen, acknowledged humanitarian concerns, and declined to reconsider the licence, citing the need to enforce the arms embargo and Egypt's legitimate security needs.
Based on the information gathered, the cabinet cannot conclude that Egyptian ships shelled targets in or off the coast of Yemen.
Op basis van de hieruit opgedane informatie kan het kabinet niet opmaken dat vanaf Egyptische schepen doelen in of voor de kust van Jemen zijn beschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het geschillenbeslechtingsmechanisme in het Vrijhandelsverdrag met Canada (CETA)

An SP MP asked the minister why the Commission will not modernise the ISDS arbitration clause in CETA while reforming it for TTIP, and about US subsidiaries in Canada, timing of legal scrubbing, and national parliamentary involvement. The minister largely referred to earlier answers, said only firms with substantial Canadian activity may use the protection, promised limited technical revisions before signature in the second half of 2016, and committed to parliamentary debate before signature.
As set out in parliamentary letter 31 985, no. 23, there will be a debate with your House on signature and provisional application of the agreement before the cabinet decides.
Zoals uiteen gezet in de Kamerbrief 31 985, nr. 23 zal er met uw Kamer worden gedebatteerd over ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van het akkoord voordat het kabinet hierover beslist.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Roemenië voelt TTIP nu al”

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade about Gabriel Resources' investment-arbitration claim against Romania (up to EUR 4 billion) after a gold-mine project was cancelled, and about treaty shopping, regulatory chill and ISDS in CETA and TTIP. The minister says investors may challenge state decisions via arbitration, denies that such claims cause regulatory chill, says the company's structure is unknown, and points to a proposed investment court and to excluding companies without substantial activity.
The cabinet does not prefer investment arbitration or an investment court over the regular legal route.
Het kabinet verkiest investeringsarbitrage of een investeringshof niet boven de reguliere rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gebrekkige transparantie rond het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP)

An SP MP asked the minister about limited transparency over the TTIP trade negotiations, including access for national parliamentarians to US and consolidated negotiating texts and the Brussels reading room. The minister replied that national parliamentarians should get access to consolidated texts, that transparency has increased, and that she pushes for it with the Commission, while declining to endorse the protest day.
The cabinet is of the view that national parliamentarians must be able to gain access to the consolidated negotiating texts.
Het kabinet is van mening dat nationale parlementariërs inzage moeten kunnen krijgen in de geconsolideerde onderhandelingsteksten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat éénvijfde van de oud-studenten wanbetaler is

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers whether one in five former students being in arrears on student loan repayment is worrying, what measures will prevent further debt, and whether enforcement and the draagkracht scheme work as intended. The minister answered that arrears are varied (many small), that the share has stayed around 20 percent, that new measures and stricter enforcement are being used, and that the government does not expect the new loan system to produce more defaulters, but no new concrete commitments beyond existing monitoring were given.
It is correct that 20.6 percent of former students with a repayment obligation have a payment arrear (as of 1 June 2015).
Het klopt dat 20,6 procent van de oud-studenten met een terugbetaalverplichting een betalingsachterstand heeft (stand per 1 juni 2015).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius inzake grote klassen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Siderius asked the state secretary about reports that pupils' classes are too large, the claimed link to worse performance, and whether a national 'Actieplan Kleine Klassen' should be made. The state secretary said class size is not a simple measure of quality, that the evidence on class size and performance is mixed, and that he will not create a national plan, instead encouraging schools to use their new flexibility.

No. A national 'Actieplan Kleine Klassen' suggests that all these different timetables with many different classes, teaching methods and subjects could (or should) be arranged centrally from 'The Hague'.

Nee. Een landelijk «Actieplan Kleine Klassen» suggereert dat al die verschillende lesroosters met veel verschillende klassen, verschillende werkvormen en veel verschillende vakken centraal, vanuit «Den Haag», geregeld zouden (kunnen) worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over denigrerende uitspraken over studenten

An SP MP asked the Education Minister to explain and justify her remarks about students choosing university boards, her views on board appointments and the Amsterdam Maagdenhuis protest. The minister replied that student and staff involvement in board appointments will be strengthened through the Versterking Bestuurskracht bill, while defending expertise-based selection and rejecting claims of arrogance.

I consider it important that teachers and students get a greater role in choosing those board members, which is why I am arranging in the Strengthening Governance bill that they have a say in the profile and appointment of board members.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat docenten en studenten bij de keuze van die bestuurders een grotere rol krijgen, daarom regel ik in wetsvoorstel Versterking Bestuurskracht dat zij inspraak krijgen in de profielschets en de benoeming van bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rapport van Stop Wapenhandel over wapenleveranties van het Nederlandse bedrijf Thales aan Myanmar

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Stop Wapenhandel report alleging Thales radar technology, licensed to Indian firm BEL, ended up in Myanmar's navy, and whether the Netherlands can block such re-export and enforce the Myanmar arms embargo. The government answered that licence and contract clauses require prior Dutch consent for re-sales, that it would refuse future licences to a breaching end-user, that the EU embargo covers listed goods regardless of age, and that it found no evidence of Dutch embargo violations.
It should be clear that the Dutch government will refuse a future licence application for this end-user.
Het mag duidelijk zijn dat de Nederlandse overheid een volgende vergunningaanvraag voor deze eindgebruiker zal weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het achterhouden van documenten over het Transatlantic Trade & Investment Partnership (TTIP)

An SP MP asked the trade minister why the Dutch parliament no longer receives TTIP negotiation documents and whether the EU's restricted reading room and US secrecy should be addressed. The minister answered that the Commission restricted the last round report after leaks, that the government opposes this, that parliament is informed via debates and letters, and that the government supports maximum transparency within normal confidentiality.
The government has spoken out against the current restriction on access to the latest negotiation report and, like other member states, has made this known to the Commission in various ways.

Het kabinet heeft zich uitgesproken tegen de huidige beperking in de toegang tot het laatste onderhandelingsverslag en heeft dit, evenals andere lidstaten, op diverse manieren kenbaar gemaakt aan de Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Merkies, Smaling en Van Bommel over het bericht “Afspraken VN-top stellen arme landen teleur”

MPs from the SP asked why no international tax body was created to combat tax avoidance, how much developing countries lose to profit shifting, and what the UN Addis Ababa conference means for aid and Dutch policy. The minister answered that BEPS and a compromise on the UN tax committee are the main routes, that loss estimates are unreliable, and that the outcome supports the SDGs without new pledges.
Owing to the lack of unambiguous data, it is currently impracticable to give a ratio between total development aid and the taxes developing countries lose through tax avoidance by multinationals.

Bij gebrek aan eenduidige gegevens is het thans ondoenlijk om een verhouding aan te geven tussen de totale ontwikkelingshulp en de belastingen die ontwikkelingslanden mislopen als gevolg van belastingontwijking door multinationals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Grashoff over de voorlichting van de Rijksoverheid over TTIP

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Grashoff asked the ministers whether government information on TTIP was misleading and how food safety, regulatory cooperation, MRLs and investor-state dispute settlement would be protected. The minister answered that regulatory cooperation does not allow lower EU standards, the regulatory cooperation body would be advisory only, and ISDS is being reformed toward a transparent, democratically supervised system.

As explained in a letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 1499), the European Commission confirms that this body may only have an advisory role, that European and national democratic procedures may therefore not be bypassed, and that all stakeholders must be able to contribute equally.

Zoals toegelicht in een Kamerbrief (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 1499 ), bevestigt de Europese Commissie dat deze instantie enkel een adviesrecht mag hebben, dat Europese en nationale democratische procedures daardoor niet doorkruist mogen worden
