Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland een ‘claimwalhalla’ is voor multinationals

An SP MP asked the minister whether the Netherlands is a 'claim paradise' for multinationals, questioning the CPB and UNCTAD studies on investment treaties, the lack of ISDS data, treaty shopping by letterbox firms, and the timeline for renegotiating Dutch BITs and TTIP safeguards. The minister rejected the claim, defended the investment treaty network, acknowledged that Dutch treaties allow letterbox firms without substance requirements and promised to examine substance requirements and treaty-shopping safeguards.
The Netherlands wants to revise this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over de hoge declaraties bij Hogeschool Windesheim in Zwolle

SP MPs asked the Minister of Education about very high expense claims by two Windesheim university of applied sciences board members and whether the board model and oversight by the supervisory board have failed. The Minister said existing expense rules and public disclosure apply, the Inspectorate is investigating claims across institutions, and rules may be tightened after its findings, while rejecting the claim that the board model has failed.
I have now instructed the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the expense claims of board members in higher education.
Inmiddels heb ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs opdracht gegeven het declaratiegedrag van bestuurders in het hoger onderwijs te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Jasper van Dijk over misstanden bij de verbetering van de veiligheid bij de luchtmacht

MPs Hachchi and Van Dijk asked whether the director of the Military Aviation Authority, who previously commanded Eindhoven air base where safety problems occurred, has a conflict of interest in overseeing air force safety, and whether disciplinary action or an independent specialist is warranted. The minister answered that the 2014 OVV report found no structural shortcomings, that the conflict concern was addressed by assigning certification of Eindhoven flight activities to the deputy director, and that no external specialist or disciplinary measures are planned.

Precisely to prevent the appearance of a conflict of interest, it was decided earlier this year to assign the certification assessment of flight activities at Eindhoven air base to the deputy director of the Military Aviation Authority (MLA).

Juist ter voorkoming van de schijn van belangenverstrengeling is eerder dit jaar besloten de beoordeling van de certificering van de vliegactiviteiten op vliegbasis Eindhoven op te dragen aan de plaatsvervangend directeur Militaire Luchtvaartautoriteit (MLA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht dat er grote onrust is onder schoonmakers van de Roeterseilandcampus (Universiteit van Amsterdam)

Two SP MPs asked ministers about reports of unrest among cleaning staff at the UvA Roeterseiland campus after a new contract with cleaning firm Hago, raising workload, intimidation, procurement quality and possible Arbowet violations. The minister says the UvA and the contractor are in constructive talks with staff, has added temporary cleaners and more time, sees no basis yet to judge Arbowet breaches, and says the Inspectorate would investigate any complaints received.
If the Inspectorate SZW receives complaints from the works council about violations of the Working Conditions Act, the Inspectorate SZW will investigate these complaints.
Als de Inspectie SZW klachten ontvangt van de OR vanwege overtredingen van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, dan zal de Inspectie SZW deze klachten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het conflict tussen Defensie en een veiligheidsofficier

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about a dispute between Defence and a former security officer, including the handling of a compensation offer, a 2001 rejection, and a request for an advance payment. The minister answered that the case is before the disciplinary court and that she cannot comment on this individual case because it is part of legal proceedings.
I cannot go into this individual case, which moreover is part of a legal procedure.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele casus, die bovendien onderdeel is van een juridische procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het groot manifest der Nederlandse taal

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Grand Manifesto against English-language instruction in higher education, the share of English-taught master's and bachelor's programmes, and how article 7.2 WHW is monitored and enforced. The minister acknowledged the importance of Dutch as a science language, defended English-taught programmes where justified, said the Inspectorate can investigate if needed, and promised to return on reflection with the sector.
I will consult with the VSNU and the VH on how that reflection can be stimulated.
Ik zal met de VSNU en de VH overleggen op welke wijze die reflectie kan worden gestimuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over beleggingen van verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen in de wapenhandel

MPs asked whether insurers and pension funds should stop investing in arms makers supplying controversial states, and about reported billions in such holdings, including APG's. The government answered that only cluster munitions are legally barred, that it promotes IMVO covenants, and that the banking and insurance sectors are pursuing sector-specific covenants.
For investments in cluster munitions there is a statutory ban; beyond that, there are no other binding legal restrictions on insurers and pension funds investing in companies.

Voor investeringen in clustermunitie geldt er een wettelijk verbod, verder zijn er geen andere dwingende wettelijke belemmeringen voor het investeren in bedrijven door verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Jasper van Dijk, Rog en Bisschop inzake de berekeningen van de VSNU dat het studievoorschot bij lange na geen 1 miljard euro oplevert en de komende tien jaar zelfs nauwelijks ext

MPs Schouten, Van Dijk, Rog and Bisschop asked the Minister of Education about VSNU calculations showing the student tuition-investment package yields far less than 1 billion euro and barely adds investment over ten years. The minister replied that up to 1 billion euro becomes available by 2026, that institutions will pre-invest 200 million euro yearly in 2015-2017, and that the investment will vary by institution, with details reported only at sector level.
I expect institutions to make the allocation of their pre-investments transparent and to discuss them well internally.
Ik verwacht van de instellingen dat zij de bestemming van de voorinvesteringen inzichtelijk maken en intern goed bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Rector Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam ziet Joods Armeens complot tegen Erdogan en AKP'

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about inflammatory statements by the rector of the Islamic University Rotterdam and what oversight bodies and the ministers would do. The minister says she has lost confidence in the rector, that the inspectorate's enhanced supervision continues, and that she will use a planned legal power to act once the bill takes effect, which is expected late this year.
At present I myself have no legal means to take further measures.
Zelf heb ik op dit moment geen juridische middelen om verdere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de governance gap op het gebied van bedrijfsgerelateerde mensenrechtenschendingen

SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Foreign Affairs about the global governance gap in preventing business-related human rights abuses, whether a binding Business and Human Rights Treaty would help, why the Netherlands joins TTIP talks but not the treaty talks, and the government's position and EU parameters for the IGWG. The ministers answered that the UN Guiding Principles and the national action plan are the preferred route, that the EU parameters for joining the IGWG have not been met, and that the Netherlands chairs the Council of Europe instrument negotiations.
The cabinet expects companies to respect in other countries the same human rights standards as in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven dat ze in het buitenland dezelfde mensenrechtenstandaarden eerbiedigen als in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de VS vasthouden aan een Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) met investeringsgeschillenbeslechting-sclausule (ISDS)

An SP MP asks the trade minister about reports that the US insists on retaining investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) in TTIP, rejecting the EU's proposed investment court, and about the consequences for negotiations and parliamentary approval. The minister replies that the Netherlands is pushing structural reforms (including a permanent court) with other member states, that the EU position is still being developed, that the Commission's proposals are in line with Dutch aims, and that US Trade Promotion Authority has been approved.
Once there is an EU position, negotiations with the Americans on this matter will be resumed.
Zodra er een EU positie is, zullen de onderhandelingen met de Amerikanen op dit gebied worden hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het meetellen van spelling en schrijfvaardigheid bij het examen Nederlands

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Education why spelling and writing no longer count in the Dutch centraal examen for havo and vwo after the reading-comprehension test was changed. The State Secretary acknowledged that the change had an unintended effect, said spelling should be assessed, and asked CvTE to reinstate spelling-based deductions for the 2016 exams, while stating that spelling is still assessed in the schoolexamen.
I want to emphasise that every pupil this year must still demonstrate that he or she has a good command of Dutch spelling.
Ik wil benadrukken dat elke leerling ook dit jaar wel degelijk moet bewijzen dat hij of zij de Nederlandse spelling goed beheerst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Smaling over het bericht ‘TTIP tast gezondheid EU aan’

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether TTIP would lower import tariffs on unhealthy US products, raising health costs and inequality, and whether the government's red lines on food safety hold. The minister replied that EU food safety standards remain fully in force, that tariffs are not linked to healthiness, that no list of affected products exists, and that the WRR food policy report is answered separately.
Such a list does not exist and is also not necessary.
Een dergelijk lijst is er niet en is ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht dat twee oud-bestuurders van de VU een gouden handdruk meekrijgen

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the minister whether severance payments of about two million euros to two former VU Amsterdam board members, including a salary continuation for former chair Smit, were acceptable and how exorbitant payouts could be stopped. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found the payments compliant with transitional law under the WNT, that a 2,125 euro overpayment was repaid, that a moral appeal was made, and that she has no legal basis to stop the payments.

Following this report and the amount of the severance arrangement stated in the 2013 annual report, I asked the Inspectorate to test the relevant severance arrangements of the two former board members against the WNT.

Naar aanleiding van dit bericht en de hoogte van de vertrekregeling zoals vermeld in het jaarverslag 2013 heb ik de Inspectie verzocht om de desbetreffende vertrekregelingen van de twee oud-bestuurders te toetsen aan de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semi publieke sector (WNT).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over studenten in vreemdelingendetentie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether students who occupied the Maagdenhuis and were held in immigration detention, some for up to nine months, were misused under immigration law and should be released. The state secretary answered that the students were released once their identity was confirmed, that the court awarded modest damages for unlawful detention but found no misuse of powers, and that police and officer training will be adjusted.
The court, however, did not rule that there was a misuse of powers.
De rechter heeft echter niet geoordeeld dat sprake is van misbruik van bevoegdheden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat EU-landen door het vrijhandelsakkoord tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) nieuwe wetten moeten toetsen op de impact die zij hebben op bedrijven

MP Jasper van Dijk asked whether EU-US TTIP would require new laws to be screened for impact on business, how this squares with his motion for a regulatory cooperation body with only advisory powers, and whether national parliaments keep full legislative freedom and a real say in ratification. Minister Ploumen answered that the regulatory cooperation body would only have an advisory role, that broad consultation including unions and consumer groups is planned, that parliaments keep full lawmaking power, and that the Netherlands treats TTIP as a mixed agreement requiring parliamentary approval before entry into force.
The regulatory body therefore only has an advisory power.
De regulerende instantie beschikt daarmee alleen over een adviesrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake het opheffen van NPO Radio 6

An SP MP asked the Secretary of State for Education, Culture and Science why the NPO plans to close NPO Radio 6 on 1 January 2016, challenging the efficiency rationale, audience figures, programming changes, and whether soul and jazz would be lost. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO decides programming and budget, that the decision awaits the concession policy plan due 15 June, and declined to intervene now.
It is up to the NPO to make programmatic considerations.
Het is aan de NPO om programmatische afwegingen te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Kritiek op aanpak radicalisering”

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government how it responds to criticism of its approach to radicalisation, the role of schools, the causes of radicalisation including discrimination, and whether schools can get specialist social workers. The government answered that schools play preventive, curative and repressive roles, describes existing support such as a hotline, training and the Stichting School en Veiligheid, rejects a dedicated social worker in every school as a matter of tailored support, and notes that research on causes is ongoing.
We have taken note of the criticism.
Wij hebben kennis genomen van de kritiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) en de komst van de "azijnkip"

An SP MP asks the trade minister whether the EU will admit peracetic acid washing of US chicken ('azijnkip') under TTIP, and how this relates to food safety, farmer competition, investor-state arbitration and regulatory cooperation. The minister replies that such applications follow EU procedures with EFSA risk assessment, that food standards will not be conceded, and that EU regulatory autonomy and the rule against lowering standards are preserved.
I have emphasised that no concessions will be made on European food standards.
Ik heb benadrukt dat er aan de Europese voedselstandaarden geen concessies zullen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over (financieel) wanbeleid van het College van Bestuur van de Universiteit van Amsterdam

An MP from the SP asked the Minister of Education about alleged financial mismanagement at the University of Amsterdam, including its listing on a US monitoring list, rising debt, low solvency, housing policy, and a blacklist of activist students sent to staff. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate monitors finances without seeing acute continuity risks, that works councils may request information, that the board has promised independent inquiries, and that the board's conduct is a matter for the Supervisory Board.
The Executive Board has given the works councils room to set up independent committees that investigate finances and housing, as well as governance and participation.

Antwoord 14 Het College van Bestuur van de UvA heeft de medezeggenschapsraden de ruimte gegeven om onafhankelijke commissies in te stellen die onderzoek doen naar financiën en huisvesting én bestuur en medezeggenschap bij de UvA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) voornemens is om extra te bezuinigen op het onderwijs

MPs Mohandis and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Education about the UvA's projected deficits of up to 83 million euros, possible education cuts, and derivatives losses that the inspectorate had not flagged. The minister answered that the UvA is drafting a future plan, that the inspectorate sees no acute continuity risk, that existing derivatives oversight is adequate, and that she has talked with the executive board and will keep monitoring.
I am of the opinion that the current financial supervision by the inspectorate regarding derivatives is adequate.
Ik ben van mening dat het huidige financieel toezicht door de inspectie met betrekking tot derivaten toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de groeiende roep om het aftreden van het College van Bestuur van de Universiteit van Amsterdam

MP Jasper van Dijk asks the minister about calls for the Executive Board of the University of Amsterdam to resign, the cost of the Maagdenhuis occupation, planned budget cuts tied to real estate, and whether students and staff have formal means to remove the board. The minister answers that the medezeggenschap rightly raised concerns leading to the chair's resignation, that the Raad van Toezicht holds the power to appoint and dismiss, and that the medezeggenschap's role is formally recognised, with the Versterking Bestuurskracht bill strengthening its say in appointments.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over leerlingen met ernstige vormen van dyslexie, die mogelijk geen gebruik kunnen maken van digitale woordenboeken tijdens het Centraal Schriftelijk Examen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Siderius asked why the College voor Toetsen en Examens refuses digital dictionaries for pupils with severe dyslexia in the central written exam, despite a non-binding ruling by the Human Rights Institute, and whether the pupil Iris can use one. The State Secretary defends the refusal: a digital dictionary lowers the vocabulary requirement, alternatives such as oral support are adequate, and no guarantee can be given for Iris.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de F-35 faalt bij luchtsteun

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that the F-35 underperforms in close air support compared with the A-10, and about related capability, weapons, night-flying and cost concerns. The minister answered that the F-35 follows a phased development (block 2B now, block 3F expected 2017), that the aircraft is multirole and not directly comparable to the A-10, and that the Dutch acquisition timeline is unaffected.
There are no consequences for the F-35 acquisition timeline.
Er zijn geen gevolgen voor het aanschaftraject van de F-35.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over hoge servicekosten voor toegangskaarten

MPs Van Dijk and Van Toorenburg asked the ministers whether excessive service fees added to concert and event tickets, including a claim of 56,000 euro per week for website maintenance and fees for printing one's own ticket, are acceptable, and whether a cap or all-in ticket should be introduced. The minister replied that pricing and fees are for market parties, that existing consumer-information and unfair-practice rules and the ACM's oversight are sufficient, and that a cap is undesirable.
Determining the height of the service fees is up to market parties.
Het bepalen van de hoogte van de servicekosten is aan marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over scholen voor voortgezet onderwijs die bewust beknibbelen op leraren

An SP MP asked the state secretary to respond to a BON study claiming schools underspend on teachers under the lump-sum funding system, and to explain rising support staff shares and the use of 150 and 650 million euro akkoord funds for teacher hiring. The state secretary rejects that lump-sum causes fewer teachers, says schools have autonomy and monitoring runs through sector agreements and the inspectorate, and declines to measure the effect of specific funds on teacher numbers.
It is not possible to indicate which euro was spent on what, or whether schools would have made different choices had they not received this money.
Het is niet mogelijk aan te geven welke euro precies waaraan is besteed en of scholen andere keuzes gemaakt hadden als ze dit geld niet ontvangen hadden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Jasper van Dijk over de resultaten van de economische missie naar Abu Dhabi en wapenhandel met Saoedi-Arabië

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Damen Shipyards naval contract with the UAE, whether it fell under Dutch arms-export criteria, the role of the Defence Minister at the Abu Dhabi fair, and why the Netherlands does not follow Sweden in halting arms trade with Saudi Arabia. The government answered that the contract dated from 2013, that export licences are assessed case by case against the EU Common Position criteria, that no credit guarantees or government-brokered contracts were involved at the fair, and that Sweden's decision concerned a memorandum rather than a trade halt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over containers met stenen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Van Bommel asked why ten containers returning Defence materiel from Afghanistan arrived at Volkel air base filled with stones. The minister answered that eleven containers were involved, that the seals were intact on arrival, that the military police (KMAR) could not establish how the goods were removed and has closed its investigation, so the materiel must be considered lost.
The KMAR has now closed the investigation. The materiel must therefore be considered lost.
Inmiddels heeft de KMAR het onderzoek gesloten. Het materieel moet daarom als verloren worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat bijna twee op de drie docenten in het voortgezet onderwijs getuige zijn van moslimdiscriminatie in de klas

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked about a report finding that 61% of secondary school teachers witnessed discrimination of Muslims in class, its rural-urban pattern, and whether more education on homosexuality and Islam is needed. The minister says discrimination is taken seriously, points to existing support tools (SLO, Centrum School en Veiligheid, teacher training efforts) and an ITS study on teacher needs, without committing to new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er recentelijk nog onveilig is gewerkt met chroom-6

MPs Hachchi and Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about reports that personnel at Volkel and Eindhoven air bases worked with chromium-6 unsafely in 2012 and 2014, and why the Chamber was not informed proactively. The Minister replied that exposure was below the limit value, that about a few dozen specialised staff work with chromium paint, that measures were taken, and that the Armed Forces occupational health service will report on an ongoing review, expected in April.

As I previously reported to you (see among others Chamber letter 34 000 X, no. 72 of 2 February), the Defence occupational health service is conducting research at the ten defence locations where chromium-containing paint is still used.

Zoals ik u eerder heb gemeld (zie onder meer Kamerbrief 34 000 X, nr. 72 van 2 februari jl.), voert de arbodienst van Defensie onderzoek uit op de tien defensielocaties waar nu nog met chroomhoudende verf wordt gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de “EUPE affaire”

The MP Van Dijk asks the minister whether EUPE was closed for poor quality, whether affected students were helped into replacement programmes and housing, and whether students' tuition (about 10,000 euro, frozen under a judicial seizure) should be refunded. The minister confirms the closure under the WHW, says only a limited number of students transferred, states that the refund is a matter between student and institution, and lists tightened rules on referent recognition, student conduct codes and accreditation as remedies.

The institution did not comply with what the law required regarding quality assurance, education, examinations and entry requirements, and providing the Minister with the necessary information about the institution.

De instelling voldeed niet aan hetgeen in de wet bepaald was omtrent de kwaliteitszorg, het onderwijs, de examens en de vooropleidingseisen en het verstrekken van de nodige inlichtingen aan de Minister omtrent de instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mogelijke bewapening van Nederlandse onbemande vliegtuigen (drones)

MP Jasper van Dijk asks whether the Netherlands is requesting a targeting component that would allow its planned US Reaper drones to be armed, whether Dutch personnel will train on drones and be kept out of US targeted killings, and why costs may rise by 50 million euro. The minister replies that the Reaper's standard configuration includes the MTS-B sensor, that the Dutch need is not for an armed platform, that training is only on sensor and piloting with no weapons involvement, and that cost information is still awaited with a later update promised.
Defence is still awaiting American information about the product and the price.
Defensie is nog in afwachting van Amerikaanse informatie over het product en de prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Jasper van Dijk over gebruik van chroomverf bij Defensie

MPs Hachchi and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister why chromium paint was still used unsafely in 2008, whether safe working can be guaranteed, and how staff are informed. The minister said Defence aims to work chromium-free, that new incidents cannot be fully excluded, that protective measures were tightened since 2001 and staff are trained, and that work is halted when precautions are missing.
Despite the tightening of regulations and adjustments to working methods, new incidents remain possible.
Ondanks de aanscherpingen van de regelgeving en aanpassingen van de werkwijze blijven nieuwe voorvallen mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over een op non-actief gestelde topambtenaar die toch bij de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) aan de slag ging

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked how a senior civil servant placed off duty at Defence could later work at the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa, whether this was a favour, and what the usual practice is. The minister replied that the official was never suspended or placed on non-active status but offered his post himself after IT restructuring, that the Defence Minister's investigation is awaited, and denied any favour or cover-up, while declining to give a full overview of reassignments.
I want to emphasise that in this case there is no question of an official who is or has been placed on non-active status.
Ik wil benadrukken dat er in dit geval geen sprake is van een ambtenaar die op non-actief is of wordt gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de bezetting van het Bungehuis van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the occupation of the Bungehuis (later Maagdenhuis) at the University of Amsterdam, the protesters' demands for democratic board elections, a new funding model and real input on faculty plans, and the board's refusal to negotiate without conditions. Minister Bussemaker replied that the occupation is primarily a matter between the UvA board and occupiers, that she supports dialogue, that governance and funding questions are discussed through existing bodies and reforms, and that a court-set fine was legitimate.
The occupation of the Bungehuis and now the Maagdenhuis and the negotiations about it are in principle a matter between the UvA board and the occupiers.
De bezetting van het Bungehuis en nu het Maagdenhuis en de onderhandelingen daarover zijn in principe een zaak tussen het bestuur van de UvA en de bezetters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over asbest in onderzeeboten

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about asbestos exposure among naval personnel and submarines, including missing registration of staff who worked with asbestos and a case of a sick former crew member. The minister answered that no operational exposure is indicated, that registration of exposed staff is kept in personnel files with a central overview promised for autumn 2015, and that the submarines are asbestos-safe though not asbestos-free.
My predecessors have informed you about this in the past.
Hierover hebben mijn ambtsvoorgangers u in het verleden geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Jasper vanDijk (SP) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de Nederlandse luchtaanval in Mali (ingezonden 23 januari 2015).

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about a Dutch Apache air strike in Mali near Tabankort, the protests in Kidal, casualties, the UN mandate, and the peace process. The ministers answered that the strike was defensive under the UN mandate, that casualties are not yet officially confirmed and are under investigation, and that the peace process continues.
How many dead and injured are to be regretted exactly has not yet been officially established. Research into this is still being conducted.
Hoeveel doden en gewonden er precies te betreuren zijn is nog niet officieel vastgesteld. Hiernaar wordt nog onderzoek verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ontwikkelingen rond het vrijhandelsakkoord tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP)

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about TTIP, covering the ratification process, labour rights, the Capaldo study on job losses, the stop-TTIP petition and ISDS arbitration. The minister answered that all parliaments must ratify a mixed agreement, that a labour clause protects social rules, that the Commission's ISDS consultation is being followed up, and that she opposes halting negotiations.
Once the negotiations are concluded, the European Council and the European Parliament will still have to approve the agreement.
Als de onderhandelingen zijn afgerond, zal de Europese Raad, het Europees parlement het akkoord nog moeten goedkeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nevenfuncties van hoogleraren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about professors' secondary (including commercial) positions, the transparency of disclosure, and conflicts of interest arising from endowed chairs and valorisation policy. The Minister answered that university-industry ties are welcome if transparent and academically independent, that VSNU reports nearly all professors now disclose their side activities, and that a national register is unnecessary since responsibility lies with professors and universities.
I do not detect that universities want to evade the desire for openness.
Ik bespeur niet dat universiteiten de wens tot openbaarheid willen ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanpak van topinkomens

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why university executives are exempt from the 2015 WNT pay cap, why the exemption was granted late, and whether all executives will comply. The minister says 2015 is a transition year for university boards because of their ties to university medical centres, a justification the minister partly refers to a joint letter from the Interior Minister and states that the cap applies to all other OCW institutions.
In 2015 I will apply the set maximums to all OCW institutions and, where necessary, take enforcement action.
In 2015 zal ik ten aanzien van alle OCW-instellingen de vastgestelde maxima toepassen en zo nodig handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Jasper Van Dijk over het plan van de UvA om te bezuinigen op de faculteit Geesteswetenschappen

MP Jasper Van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the University of Amsterdam's plans to cut the Humanities faculty, including possible job losses, property speculation, reduction of master's programmes, risks of diluted teaching, the closure of unique programmes, works council involvement and future student numbers. Minister Bussemaker answered that the UvA is still discussing its plans, that the university has assured her there is no property speculation, that the choice of programmes is for universities themselves, and that she will monitor the situation and talk with the UvA if problems arise.
I consider it important that the UvA conducts this discussion openly and carefully and takes the time for it.
Ik vind het van belang dat de UvA deze discussie open en zorgvuldig voert en daar de tijd voor neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over omstreden subsidies

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about alleged favouritism and questionable subsidies to Stichting Lezen & Schrijven, including its size, use of funds, communications staff, effectiveness and the reclaim of a subsidy from Stichting Vrienden van de Gaykrant. The minister rejected the allegations, cited an independent evaluation supporting the programme, and reported that the Gaykrant subsidy of EUR 206,833 is being fully reclaimed after the audit opinion was withdrawn.
I am reclaiming this entire amount.
Dit gehele bedrag vorder ik terug.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Scholen spelen privégegevens leerlingen door naar uitgevers”

MPs Rog, Voordewind and Van Dijk asked whether schools pass non-anonymised pupil data to publishers without parental consent, and why a 2014 privacy audit was not sent to parliament. The state secretary answered that consent is not required under the school's task-based legal ground, that pseudonymisation is being developed, and that the audit was withheld as a limited, policy-confirming exploration later published online.
The report was therefore not sent to your House.
Het rapport is daarom niet aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over de investeringsbescherming (ISDS) in het handelsverdrag tussen de VS en de EU (TTIP)

An SP MP asked the Dutch Minister for Foreign Trade about reports that EU Commissioner Timmermans would have a veto over investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) in TTIP, whether ISDS is effectively dropped, and whether TTIP should go to national parliaments as a mixed agreement. The minister answered that the Commission decides collegially, that the final ISDS position awaits a consultation analysis and EU institutional approval, and that the government supports improving ISDS and treating TTIP as a mixed agreement.
The Netherlands is committed to ensuring these improvements to the ISDS instrument are incorporated into TTIP.
Nederland zet erop in dat die verbeteringen in het ISDS-instrument in TTIP worden verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Smaling en Ouwehand over het bericht dat de EU ervan afziet om teerzandolie te labelen

MPs Jasper van Dijk, Smaling and Ouwehand asked whether the EU's dropping of a separate label for tar sands oil, its impact on climate ambitions, CETA and TTIP, and possible import bans or labelling are acceptable. The State Secretary answered that tar sands oil is still legally importable, that no import ban or consumer labelling is feasible given traceability limits, and that EU climate targets are not weakened.
I have no plans to exclude tar sands oil from the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen plannen om teerzandolie te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat Defensie jarenlang op de hoogte was van de gifverf, maar geen maatregelen nam

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether Defence knew for years about carcinogenic chromium-6 paint and failed to protect staff, including past inspections, a prosecution report and a 1990 medical inquiry. The minister answered that the RIVM investigation must first establish what happened and when, and gave timelines for ongoing GGD and RIVM studies without concluding on past knowledge.
With the ongoing RIVM investigation into the use of chromium-containing paint at Defence, more insight must be gained into what happened when.
Met het lopende onderzoek door het RIVM naar het gebruik van chroomhoudende verf bij Defensie, moet meer inzicht worden verkregen in wat wanneer is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over de tekortschietende financiering van Wageningen UR

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked whether the 2% cap on annual funding changes for Wageningen UR, set in 2001, disadvantages the institution compared with other universities, and whether the rule should be reconsidered. Minister Kamp answered that the cap avoids sharp budget fluctuations, that the rule will be included in a government review of funding for Economic Affairs and OCW education with results feeding into the 2016 budget, and that compliance with the top-income norm is monitored.

This arrangement will be included in the study the cabinet is starting into education funded by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and education funded by the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.

Onderhavige regeling wordt betrokken in het onderzoek dat het kabinet start naar onderwijs bekostigd door het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en het onderwijs bekostigd door het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over de gevolgen van het gebruik van het schoonmaakmiddel PX-10

An MP asked the Minister of Defence about the PX-10 cleaning agent, benzene exposure, RIVM findings, and whether Defence took health precautions and followed up a 2009 motion for former staff. The Minister answered that no historical measurements were found, that RIVM's methods are sound, and that the health risk was judged practically excluded, with former staff able to contact occupational health services.
No measurements from that period have been found.
Er zijn uit die periode geen metingen teruggevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over scholen die ouders verplichten tot aanschaf van een iPad

SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Education whether schools may require parents to buy iPads, which can cost up to 1,000 euro, and how the 'free' versus 'cost-free' distinction and school financing are handled. The State Secretary replied that schools may not compel purchase of tablets or laptops, that voluntary parental contributions are allowed with cost-free alternatives, and that the Inspectorate has received a stable number of complaints and ordered corrections at 17 schools.
I asked the Inspectorate whether it has received signals about schools where questions have arisen about parental contributions and school costs.
Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd of zij signalen hebben ontvangen over scholen waar vragen zijn gerezen over de ouderbijdrage en schoolkosten voor ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over “verwarring en onjuistheden in de investeringsbrief van OCW”

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Siderius (SP) asked the Education Minister about alleged errors and confusion in the OCW investment letter, including the claimed 500-euro professionalisation budget, the 1.2 billion investment figure, the effect of the wage freeze, and where Herfstakkoord money went. The Minister and State Secretary largely reject the criticism, state that the budget is at school level rather than personal, that the money is partly reallocated existing funds, and that school boards are monitored; they acknowledge the wording could have been clearer.
The wording about the personal budget in the letter could have better matched the wording in the collective agreement.
De formulering rondom het persoonlijk budget in de brief had beter kunnen aansluiten op de formulering in de cao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over omstandigheden voor militairen in Mali

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister about poor conditions for Dutch troops in Mali, including tents, broken toilets, extreme heat, equipment shortcomings and whether soldiers can safely complain. The minister answers that conditions are difficult but acceptable, that shelters and containers are being provided, that complaint channels and surveys exist, and declines an IMG inspection for now.
The IMG can, however, also carry out an investigation at the request of the unions.
De IMG kan echter ook op aanvraag van de bonden onderzoek verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het stopzetten van een succesvolle opleiding voor kwetsbare leerlingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about ROC Midden Nederland's plan to scrap a successful vocational programme for vulnerable learners, and whether the board ignored its works council and student council. The Minister replied that the college will not discontinue the programme but continue it as XL Entree in a broader bbl and bol form, with a cooperation agreement to be signed on 20 November and consultation of the works and student councils planned.
ROCMN has assured me that the elaboration will be submitted to both the works council and the student council.
ROCMN heeft mij verzekerd dat de uitwerking zal worden voorgelegd aan zowel de ondernemingsraad als de studentenraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdiensten voor bijbanen in publieke dienst

An MP asked the government about reports that former minister Uri Rosenthal received raised fees for his advisory council chairmanship and how much he earns from public-sector side jobs, and whether officials should earn no more than a minister. The government replied that the report was wrong, that the fee was actually lowered, that a calculation error in the published decision was corrected, and that the Remuneration Decree already caps combined fees at a minister's salary.
The internal checks on decisions sent to the Staatscourant have been tightened.
De interne controles op besluiten die naar de Staatscourant gaan, zijn verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over het bericht dat een bestuurder de scholenkoepel LMC heeft opgelicht

MPs Van Dijk and Siderius asked whether the EUR 460,000 embezzled by a former LMC school board chair will be recovered and whether schools will suffer financial harm, and how financial oversight in Dutch education is organized given recent fraud cases. The State Secretary answered that the board and supervisory board are pursuing maximum recovery but the final amount is unknown pending legal proceedings, that the existing financial oversight framework is adequate though fraud cannot always be prevented, and that individual investigations cannot be disclosed for reasons of investigation and privacy.
The content of cases cannot be disclosed in the interest of the investigation and the privacy of those involved.
Over de inhoud van zaken kan in het belang van het onderzoek en de privacy van de betrokkenen geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland inlichtingen over Toearegs verstrekt aan het Malinese leger

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Dutch intelligence supplied to Mali's army could help it attack Tuareg groups, and whether this undermines the UN mission and mediation. The government denied sharing intelligence with the Malian army, said Dutch-gathered intelligence goes to the UN mission (MINUSMA) and that sharing with Bamako is up to the UN, and described ongoing peace negotiations.
The Netherlands does not share intelligence with the Malian army, as the article claims.
Nederland deelt geen inlichtingen met het Malinese leger, zoals in het artikel wordt gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen c.s. over het bericht dat er zeer suggestieve vragen staan in de ‘Blikopener’-methode voor maatschappijleer op het VMBO

MPs asked whether the Blikopener social studies method for VMBO contains leading questions about Moroccan youth, headscarves and Islam, and reinforces gender stereotypes, and whether the method should be revised. The State Secretary answered that schools and teachers choose their own methods, that the content of methods is not for the government to judge, that there is no central quality control on methods beyond inspectorate oversight of coverage of attainment targets, and that the questions were not substantively addressed beyond referring back to the same general position.
It is not for me to assess the content of teaching methods or schools' choice of teaching methods.
Het is niet aan mij om de inhoud van lesmethodes of de keuze van scholen voor lesmethodes te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mbo-leerlingen die geweigerd worden op ROC’s

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Education whether MBO colleges refuse students under financial incentives, how many students are refused, and how the government will prevent this. The Minister denies that the funding system structurally rewards refusal, says refused students with unjustified grounds will be followed up by the Inspectorate, and commits to having the Ombudslijn MBO register all refusal reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Siderius en Van Gerven over sluikreclame op scholen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether food companies' so-called educational visits to schools (such as Ronald McDonald Shows and Blue Band lesson packs) amount to disguised advertising and should be banned. The Secretary of State answered that the Reclamecode voor Voedingsmiddelen permits such campaigns only with approval from a recognised authority, promised tightened rules by end 2014 and a letter in spring 2015, but rejected a statutory ban.
I expect the intended tightening to be in place by the end of this year. In spring 2015 I will inform you about this and give you my response.
Ik verwacht dat de beoogde aanscherpingen uiterlijk aan het einde van dit jaar tot stand zijn gekomen. In het voorjaar van 2015 zal ik u hierover informeren en u mijn reactie hierop geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de minister van mening blijft dat studiepunten afgepakt mogen worden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether her view that study credits may be taken away is consistent with the law and its legislative history, which he argued restrict credit expiry to exceptional, outdated-knowledge cases. The Minister maintained that Article 7.13(2)(k) WHW allows institutions to limit the validity of exams for study-progress reasons, citing a CBHO ruling, and that the wording of the law is decisive.
The text of the law is leading.
De tekst van de wet is leidend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Veel meer giftige verf bij Defensie”

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister how she views reports that toxic chromium-6 paint exposure occurred at many more Defence workplaces than the known POMS sites, why the Chamber was not informed, and whether all sites will be investigated. The minister replied that these findings were largely known since 1998 and 2001, that the results of the ongoing broad investigation must be awaited, and that the investigation is being extended to all Defence locations using CARC and chromium-containing paint.
Defence is collecting data and reports on CARC and chromium-containing paints found in the archive and elsewhere.
Defensie is bezig met het verzamelen van gegevens en rapporten over CARC en chroomhoudende verven die in het archief en elders zijn aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Reddingsbrigade een ongekend drukke tijd heeft

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about declining swimming ability among children, whether compulsory swimming lessons were abolished as a cause, whether the Zwem-ABC should be required, the decline of school swimming, and whether a new safety-net scheme should be reinstated. The minister answered that 94% of children still obtain at least one swimming diploma, that swimming skill is mainly parents' responsibility, that no evidence links the abolition to declining skills, and that no new safety-net scheme is planned.
I see no reason to do so.
Ik zie hier geen aanleiding toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over het alsnog doorvoeren van de bètafusie tussen de UvA en de VU

An MP asks the minister whether UvA and VU boards secretly agreed to cluster their science faculties despite the works council rejecting a merger, and whether works councils should have consent rights over such decisions. The minister denies a fusion agreement was made, says a working document was attached for information, acknowledges confusion caused, and states that instemmingsrecht over this subject is not legally required.
The fact that the executive board did submit its intended decision to the joint meeting for consent in this case, I view positively.
Het feit dat het CvB zijn voorgenomen besluit in dit geval wel ter instemming aan de gezamenlijke vergadering heeft voorgelegd, waardeer ik in dit verband positief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat steeds meer studenten problemen hebben met hun studieschuld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that more former students struggle to repay their study debt, the effect of the planned loan system (studievoorschot) on debt levels, and the UK and Scottish experience. The minister said the draagkracht scheme use rose from 7% to 9% due to recession and automatic assessment, that debt will rise under the reform but the reform is socially balanced with softened repayment terms, and that the effects will be monitored; she declined to comment on UK and Scottish policy as outside her responsibility.
I would therefore like to limit myself to answering the questions about that system.
Ik wil mij dan ook beperken tot de beantwoording van de vragen over dat stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Hogeschool Saxion wordt gekort op het budget omdat te weinig studenten op tijd afstuderen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the ministry set a 68% bachelor graduation target for Saxion, threatening budget cuts, and whether this creates a perverse incentive. The minister replied that Saxion itself chose the 68% target, that budget consequences apply to missed prestatieafspraken ambitions from 2017, and that a focus on graduation rate alone is not rewarding for institutions.
The article wrongly suggests that the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science determined that Saxion's bachelor graduation rate must be 68% in 2015.
In het artikel wordt ten onrechte gesuggereerd, dat het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap heeft bepaald dat het bachelor-rendement bij Hogeschool Saxion in 2015 68% moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat tientallen oud-medewerkers van Defensie ernstig ziek zijn geworden omdat zij zijn blootgesteld aan giftige stoffen

MPs Van Dijk and Ulenbelt asked whether Defence commissioned studies in 1999 and 2002 showing toxic chromium exposure at POMS depots that were kept secret, and what was known, when, about former staff falling ill. The minister replied that the studies were not concealed and staff were informed, and announced an internal historical inventory, an independent assessment and a GGD study, with liability to be decided after the findings.
Defence did not conceal the outcomes of the research at the POMS sites Vriezenveen and Brunssum.
Defensie heeft de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bij de POMS-sites Vriezenveen en Brunssum niet verzwegen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het bestuur van Hogeschool Inholland misstanden onder de pet houdt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about a report that the Inholland University board and Supervisory Board mishandled a student whistleblower's complaints, and whether an independent investigation would be ordered. The Minister acknowledged shortcomings in the institution's responsiveness, said the Supervisory Board ran the internal investigation under the institution's whistleblower rules, and refused to order or conduct an independent inquiry, pointing to internal complaint procedures and the College van Beroep.
I cannot prevent this matter from ending unsatisfactorily for one or more parties.
Ik kan niet voorkomen dat deze kwestie voor een of meer partijen onbevredigend afloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Mohandis inzake het bericht dat studenten van de Haagse Hogeschool tentamens vooraf kunnen inzien

MPs Van Dijk and Mohandis asked the Minister of Education about reports that students at the Haagse Hogeschool could view exams in advance, possibly for four years, and whether such fraud was being investigated and prevented. The Minister answered that an investigation found no evidence of exam fraud in the ICT courses, that seven students with prior knowledge of exams were expelled and reported, that the wider investigation continues, and that institutions themselves are responsible for preventing fraud.
This investigation is still ongoing and has been extended with the latest signal regarding fraud (July 2014).
Dit onderzoek loopt nog en is uitgebreid met het laatste signaal met betrekking tot fraude (juli 2014).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de gevolgen van het Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) en Trade in Services Agreement (TISA) voor financiële regulering

SP MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked about a leaked EU proposal on regulatory cooperation in financial services under TTIP and about the effects of TISA on financial regulation. Minister Ploumen answered that the EU aims only at institutional cooperation and consultation, not at weakening financial rules, and that TISA's financial provisions largely reaffirm existing GATS and standstill commitments.
Once enough parties have joined the TISA negotiations, I will also work to bring TISA under the WTO framework to safeguard the continuity of the global trading system.

Wanneer zich voldoende partijen bij de TISA-onderhandelingen hebben aangesloten, zal ik mij bovendien inzetten om TISA onder het raamwerk van de WTO te brengen om zo de continuïteit van het mondiale handelssysteem te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Eritreërs in Nederland onder grote druk staan van de Eritrese regering

Two SP MPs asked whether the government would back Eritrean residents pressured to pay a diaspora tax, enable anonymous reporting, investigate the tax, and close the Eritrean consulate. The government answered that the tax is not illegal per se if voluntary, that anonymous reporting is possible case by case, that the issue is being pursued at EU level, and that closing the embassy is not currently on the table.
To establish abuses, the public prosecution service and police depend substantially on reports and complaints from victims.
Om misstanden vast te kunnen stellen zijn het OM en politie in belangrijke mate afhankelijk van aangifte en melding door slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over het Oxfam-rapport Business Among Friends

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Merkies asked the State Secretary about the Oxfam report on corporate tax avoidance, the arm's length principle, transfer pricing improvements, and the role of developing countries in OECD standard-setting. The State Secretary answered that the arm's length principle works imperfectly but is not itself the cause of avoidance, that BEPS work targets profit shifting, and that developing countries are involved through dialogue and capacity building.
The Netherlands attaches importance to these action points and actively contributes to seeking improvements.
Nederland hecht belang aan deze actiepunten en draagt actief bij aan het zoeken naar verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Smaling over schaliegas in het vrijhandelsverdrag TTIP

Two SP MPs asked the minister about leaked TTIP texts that would deem energy exports automatically compliant with US export licence conditions, and whether this would boost imports of shale gas and tar sands oil, undermine renewable energy and reduce transparency. The minister answered that US export rules remain strict and that more imports are possible but unquantified, denied that EU climate regulation is being weakened, offered confidential briefings to parliament and said TTIP can support global energy governance.
As previously promised to your House, the House can, if desired, be confidentially informed before each new round and given confidential access to the EU negotiating documents.

Zoals eerder aan uw Kamer toegezegd, kan de Kamer – indien gewenst – voor elke nieuwe ronde vertrouwelijk worden geïnformeerd en vertrouwelijk inzage krijgen in de onderhandelingsdocumenten van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Amerikaanse militaire activiteiten in Mali

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reported US training of Malian commandos, US support to French forces, US drone use and funding for counterterrorism in the Sahel, and whether MINUSMA and EUTM are affected. The government said it had no information on the reported secret US training, that MINUSMA and EUTM do not train special counterterrorism units, declined to comment on other countries' operations, and promised only the usual biannual parliamentary reporting.
The cabinet does not make statements about such activities of other countries.
Over dergelijke activiteiten van andere landen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over segregatie in het onderwijs

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Karabulut asked the government about falling school segregation, the end of the twelve city pilots, the lack of structural municipality-school consultation, and parents' initiatives for mixed schools. The Secretary of State answered that segregation is declining, the pilots' effects were modest so they will not be continued (municipalities may continue on their own), and that the matter is a decentralised municipal responsibility, so the outcome was passed to the VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk, Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over het Moederdagrapport

MPs Van Dijk, Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Save the Children Mothers Day report on maternal and child mortality in fragile states, education in conflict countries, reproductive health, and the effects of reduced aid to transition countries. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports SRGR and education programmes in conflict settings, backs the Lucens Guidelines, and will shift some public health investment to the private sector in transition countries without a clear picture yet of who will fund it.
In the medium term, Dutch public investments in SRGR in the named countries will decrease.
Op middellange termijn zullen de Nederlandse publieke investeringen in SRGR in genoemde landen afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over zeggenschap van lidstaten bij het afsluiten van handelsverdragen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the trade minister whether the EU-Canada free trade agreement CETA and the planned TTIP should be ratified by member states as mixed agreements, and about an arbitration liability regulation adopted as a consent item. The minister answered that CETA should be a mixed agreement requiring national ratification, that the regulation was amended so the Commission cannot force member states' positions or settlements, and that an ISDS study will be completed before consent.
I am working to ensure that CETA becomes a mixed agreement, so that the Dutch parliament also gets the opportunity to consent to the agreement.
Ik zet mij ervoor in dat CETA een gemengd verdrag wordt, zodat ook het Nederlands parlement de mogelijkheid krijgt met het akkoord in te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat over het bericht dat ontwikkelingsbank FMO doorgaat met een omstreden stuwdamproject in Honduras

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister whether FMO should stop financing the contested Agua Zarca dam in Honduras after protests, a fatal incident, and allegations of harassment of local activists, and how FMO's standards and free, prior consent obligations were applied. The minister answered that FMO and DESA had consulted the communities, that DESA adjusted the design to avoid La Tejera, that the violence claims are hard to verify, and that FMO will continue to invest while using the embassy network more.
I have informed FMO that it should make greater use of the network of embassies, including local NGOs and local governments.
Ik heb aan FMO gemeld dat ze meer gebruik dient te maken van het netwerk van ambassades, waaronder lokale NGOs en lokale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat mbo-scholen onterecht schoolkosten in rekening blijven brengen

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Van Meenen (D66) asked the minister of Education about reports that vocational schools charge unlawful extra fees for mandatory activities, including a 600 euro trip, debt collection for voluntary contributions, and 70 complaints to JOB. The minister condemns it, says the inspectorate now checks school costs and will demand remedies, and restates the legal rule that only tuition may be mandatory and other contributions must be voluntary and clearly communicated.
Since September 2012, all regular inspections by the Inspectorate of Education examine school costs.
Sinds september 2012 wordt bij alle reguliere onderzoeken van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) naar schoolkosten gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over schadeclaims die via Nederland ingediend worden

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about investment treaty claims filed through Dutch shell companies, Indonesia's termination of its treaty with the Netherlands, and the risks of ISDS in TTIP. The minister replied that UNCTAD/CPB studies and an analysis of TTIP investor-state dispute settlement are underway, that Dutch treaties are being aligned with EU standards, and that consultations with partners may follow.
As already promised, your House will be informed of the outcomes of this study.
Zoals reeds toegezegd, wordt uw kamer geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de minister de Tweede Kamer verkeerd zou hebben geïnformeerd

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether her March 2014 letter misinformed parliament about universities invalidating exams to encourage timely graduation, and whether the WHW makes exams unlimited in validity. The minister rejected the claim of error, maintained that institutions may limit exam validity under art. 7.13(2)(k) WHW, and declined to issue a rectification.
There is therefore no question of an error, and I see no reason for a rectification.
Van een vergissing is dan ook geen sprake en daarom zie ik geen aanleiding voor een rectificatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat scholen niet klaar zijn voor passend onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a teachers' union survey showing schools are not ready for inclusive education (passend onderwijs), raising concerns about teacher information, class sizes, professionalisation funding and whether implementation should be postponed. The government answered that teachers need better information, that samenwerkingsverbanden are phasing in the reform, that special education remains, that professionalisation spending is controlled through school boards and works councils, and that there is no reason to postpone the 1 August start.
That is why I, together with the education organisations, have called on school board members and school leaders to enter into discussion with teachers and parents before 1 May.
Daarom heb ik samen met de onderwijsorganisaties schoolbestuurders en schoolleiders opgeroepen om voor 1 mei met leraren en ouders in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over de plannen rond ArtEZ en het functioneren van de Raad van Toezicht en het College van Bestuur

MPs Van Dijk and Gesthuizen asked about ArtEZ's plans to relocate or close programmes, the excessive pay of the interim chair of the Executive Board, a board member's business link with the interim chair's firm, and the Supervisory Board's functioning. The minister says the plans must improve quality, the Inspectorate is investigating the Wnt pay breach, the conflict of interest was checked and found acceptable, and governance matters are for the institution itself.
At the end of 2013 I informed ArtEZ that I regret that the remuneration of the interim chair of the Executive Board may exceed the norm.
Eind 2013 heb ik ArtEZ laten weten dat ik het betreur dat de bezoldiging van de interim-voorzitter van het College van Bestuur (CvB) de norm mogelijk overschrijdt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het aftreden van de regering in Mali

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the resignation of Mali's government, its effect on the northern reconciliation talks, and the impact of the UN mission MINUSMA. The minister explained the reshuffle as routine after elections, described the negotiations as slow, and said the mission's impact is growing but harder to make visible.
The cabinet has no data on increased prostitution in Mali.
Het kabinet zijn geen gegevens bekend over toegenomen prostitutie in Mali.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de berichten dat multinationals massaal belasting ontwijken in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies (SP) asked whether OECD tax reforms go far enough against profit shifting harming developing countries, and about transfer pricing losses in Africa and the Dutch role. Secretary Wiebes answered that the OECD rules already prevent profit shifting, that technical assistance to developing countries is supported, and that the Tax Authority's transfer pricing capacity has been expanded.
That all countries aim to be able to tax as large a share as reasonably possible of multinationals' profits is obvious.
Dat alle landen ernaar streven binnen het redelijke een zo groot mogelijk deel van de winst van multinationals te mogen belasten ligt voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak en Sjoerdsma (D66) over het bericht dat Nederlandse data mogelijk zijn gebruikt bij drone-aanvallen

MPs from SP and D66 asked whether Dutch intelligence from MIVD, shared for antipiracy operations off Somalia, may have been used for US drone targeted killings, and about the legal basis and data-sharing arrangements with the US. The government answered that it does not work with illegal targeted killings, cannot confirm or deny the specifics of partner use or the number of drone strikes, will not comment publicly on NSA or partner-service cooperation, and sees no indication that the shared intelligence was used in breach of international law.

If it were shown that a foreign partner demonstrably carries out illegal targeted killings for which Dutch information is also used, this will lead to a renewed assessment of whether such intelligence is shared with that partner.

Als zou blijken dat een buitenlandse partner aantoonbaar illegale targeted killings uitvoert, waarvoor ook Nederlandse informatie wordt gebruikt, zal dit leiden tot het opnieuw beoordelen van de vraag of dergelijke inlichtingen met die partner worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat opleidingen verpleging razend populair zijn

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked the government about the popularity of nursing degrees amid job losses in healthcare, the shortage of internship places, and whether numerus fixus admission limits are acceptable. The minister says intake is still growing, temporary solutions have been found for internships, a meeting with nursing schools is planned, and that restricted intake is acceptable as regional planning.

VWS and OCW are planning a meeting with the representatives of the HBO nursing programmes, in which among other things the situation regarding internship places for the coming academic year will be discussed.
VWS en OCW plannen een afspraak met de vertegenwoordiging van de hbo-verpleegkunde opleidingen, waarin onder meer de situatie rond de stageplaatsen voor het komende studiejaar aan de orde komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gedwongen verhuizing van de Ngöbe-stam vanwege de bouw van de Barro Blanco dam in Panama

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the minister about forced evictions of Ngöbe families for the Barro Blanco dam in Panama, a project financed partly by FMO, and whether the Ngöbe's free, prior and informed consent should be required before funding continues, plus questions on FMO transparency and human rights due diligence. The minister acknowledges communication failures by ASEP and says FMO has a complaints mechanism, but rejects suspending financing, says the state does not intervene in individual FMO investment decisions, and states FMO applies IFC and OECD standards.
I oversee that FMO complies with all relevant standards and I maintain close contact with the bank on this.
Ik zie er op toe dat FMO alle relevante standaarden naleeft en ik houd hierover nauw contact met de bank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de Huisjesmelker van het Jaar 2014

An SP MP asks the ministers about the 2014 Huisjesmelker van het Jaar award, the enforcement against landlords exploiting student tenants, a national rental permit scheme, fire and installation safety checks, and the student housing shortfall. Minister Blok responds that gemeenten already have enforcement tools, that a Woningwet amendment strengthening municipal enforcement is pending, that a national permit scheme is unnecessary, that safety oversight is for municipalities to decide, and that the 16,000-unit student housing target is on schedule and sufficient.
The cabinet is therefore committed to combating landlord exploitation, including by amending legislation and expanding municipalities' enforcement instruments.
Het kabinet zet zich dan ook in om huisjesmelkerij tegen te gaan, onder meer door wetgeving aan te passen en het handhavingsinstrumentarium van gemeenten uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over extra kosten voor studenten bovenop het collegegeld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about extra fees students must pay beyond tuition for activities needed to earn credits, and why this persists despite a legal prohibition. The Minister confirmed the rule that such costs are generally not allowed for compulsory activities, said institutions must offer free alternatives, and pointed to the ISO and Inspectorate for follow-up while stating that student complaint-channel information needs improvement.
I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to look into this.
Ik zal de Inspectie van het Onderwijs verzoeken hiernaar te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, De Caluwé, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Servaes over het bericht dat President Museveni de omstreden anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

MPs from several parties asked the government how it would respond to President Museveni signing Uganda's anti-homosexuality law and what measures it would take. The minister answered that the Netherlands suspended justice-sector aid and human-rights-conditioned support, pressed Uganda diplomatically, and would push the EU to condemn the law and withhold budget support, while promising to review support for LGBT groups.
Immediately after the law was signed, the cabinet suspended aid to the Ugandan government in the justice sector.
Meteen na het ondertekenen van de wet heeft het kabinet de hulp aan de Ugandese overheid in de justitiële sector opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het hoge collegegeld voor een tweede studie

An SP MP asked the education minister why universities charge up to 20,000 euro for a second degree, whether self-regulation has failed, whether that is a fair price in a crisis, and whether she will cap these fees as promised during the 2013 debate. The minister replied that fees vary widely, that she sees no reason to cap them, and that she will monitor fees, contact institutions with outliers, and examine how institutions inform students.
On the basis of this information, I see no reason to cap institutional tuition fees.
Op basis van deze informatie zie ik geen aanleiding het instellingscollegegeld te maximeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over spanningen tussen het Malinese regime en Bert Koenders (MINUSMA)

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Malian president was in conflict with Bert Koenders, head of the UN mission MINUSMA, and whether this endangered his position and the peace process. The minister said the reports rest on an anonymous source, that no tension is known to the government, that the reconciliation process is slow and stalled over disarmament demands, and that no steps are needed.
As far as the cabinet is aware, there is no such thing.
Voor zover het kabinet bekend, is hiervan geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gebrekkige medezeggenschap in het hoger onderwijs

An SP MP asks the Minister of Education whether the Utrecht University board bypassed the works council in revising master programmes, and whether the WHW was followed, whether a trend of sidelining councils exists, and how councils' rights will be protected. The Minister denies that the council was bypassed, sees no WHW violation, sees no trend, points to the 2014 governance evaluation and a student council monitor, and states the legal framework is in order, so no new legislation is planned.
The press release shows that the works council was not bypassed in the decision to revise the programme offering.
Uit het persbericht blijkt dat de medezeggenschap niet gepasseerd is bij de beslissing om het opleidingsaanbod te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met de JSF

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about a Pentagon test report describing serious problems with the F-35 software, reliability and possible delays, and whether this would change Dutch planning. The minister replied that the report contained no major new problems, that the delay of up to 13 months could be absorbed by Dutch timelines, and that no replanning was needed.
Defence closely follows developments. In the upcoming annual report I will inform you again about the status of the F-35 programme.
Defensie volgt de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend. In de komende jaarrapportage zal ik u opnieuw informeren over de stand van zaken van het F-35 programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de groeiende mondiale ongelijkheid

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Oxfam's report on growing global inequality, the WEF's view of inequality as a threat, and whether inequality should be a standalone post-2015 goal, plus measures against tax avoidance and resource revenue capture. The minister acknowledged inequality as a serious problem, described Dutch efforts on jobs, business climate and post-2015 targets, and said tax policy and resource revenue use are sovereign decisions of countries, with the Netherlands offering knowledge and advocacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de onrechtmatige benoeming van een lid van de Raad van Toezicht van de Hogeschool van Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the appointment of a Senate PvdA member to the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences supervisory board was unlawful under the institution's statutes, and what the Minister would do about it. The Minister said she had no role in appointing supervisory board members of such institutions, that the appointment was consistent with the WHW, that the statutes were amended, and that she saw no grounds for action.
I have no involvement in the appointment of a member of the supervisory board of a special institution, such as the HvA
Ik heb geen bemoeienis met de benoeming van een lid van de raad van toezicht van een bijzondere instelling, zoals de HvA
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de berichten dat er opnieuw sprake lijkt te zijn van grootschalige fraude door een wetenschapper

MPs asked the minister about reports of repeated plagiarism and self-citation by a researcher at the VU and what should be done about publication pressure and self-policing by universities. The minister said it is premature to call it fraud, that the VU is investigating, that the KNAW will advise on citation rules, and that the existing system of institutional self-correction works sufficiently.
I find it premature to speak of fraud.
Ik vind het voorbarig om te spreken van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het bericht dat scholen steeds minder vaak schoolzwemmen aanbieden

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the government about reports that municipalities are cutting funding for school swimming and that swimming diploma rates among children are falling. The state secretary answered that swimming skills are primarily the parents' responsibility, supported by schools and municipalities, that 94% of children obtain a diploma, and that no change to the division of responsibilities is warranted.
I see no reason to change the current division of responsibilities.
Zie ik geen aanleiding om de huidige verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Gerven over Munitiestortplaats Oosterschelde

SP MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about risks, oversight, and remediation options for the Oosterschelde munitions dump, following an EenVandaag report.
