The minister replied that TNO studies found spontaneous explosion practically nil and no proven environmental harm, that monitoring continues with added measures in 2014, and that remediation (estimated at €7 million in 2004) was not pursued because risks are low.
In 2014 the water quality above the former munitions dump will be measured monthly.
In 2014 zal de waterkwaliteit boven de voormalige munitiestortplaats maandelijks worden gemeten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de zogenaamd vrijwillige ouderbijdrage in het onderwijs

An MP asks whether voluntary parental contributions at Dutch primary schools, some very high, are being used for essential teaching and pressure parents, and whether limits should apply. The state secretary answers that contributions must be voluntary, are set with parent consent in the MR, that the inspectorate enforces the rules, and that no maximum will be introduced.
To obtain a picture of the current height of parental contributions, the education inspectorate will carry out such a study again in primary education.
Om een beeld te verkrijgen van de hoogte van de huidige ouderbijdragen, zal de inspectie van het onderwijs een dergelijk onderzoek in het primair onderwijs opnieuw uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Ulenbelt over investeringen in de kernwapenindustrie

MPs from the SP asked whether the government would discourage or ban investment by Dutch banks and pension funds in nuclear weapons producers, following an IKV Pax Christi report. The minister replied that financial institutions are responsible for their own investment policies, that the government will not amend the legal framework, and that no ban is being considered.
Pension funds and banks are primarily themselves responsible for their investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen en banken zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over grote klassen

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Education about large class sizes, citing a survey showing many secondary pupils find their classes too big, and asked who decides class size, whether budget cuts force larger classes, and whether the government will help make classes smaller. The secretary answered that class size is a school-level decision, that per-pupil funding has risen, that schools must weigh competing priorities, and that the government will not take over this responsibility, though good practices may be shared.
I am not inclined to place this responsibility with the national government.
Ik voel er niets voor deze verantwoordelijkheid bij de rijksoverheid te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Dijk over investeringsverdragen

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about investment treaties, including ISDS, regulatory chill, South Africa's termination of its bilateral investment treaty with the Netherlands, and the Ping An claim. The Minister replied that the Netherlands seeks a balance between investor protection and policy space, supports the right to regulate and OECD guidelines in EU treaties, sees little financial risk, and promised a study on ISDS risks.
I will inform the House of the results of this study.
Ik zal de Kamer over de resultaten van dit onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘de Superschool’

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the state secretary of Education about the proposed 'Superschool' for pupils aged 2 to 18, the admission rules for new schools, the handling of expelled pupils, the share of master-qualified teachers, and school management overhead. The state secretary welcomes the initiative's aims but says a judgement needs a project plan, that no new school is currently being founded, that existing expulsion provisions and teacher-qualification ambitions are in place, and that management overhead is low and capped by the WNT.
I can only form a judgement on the plan on the basis of a project plan and a closer study of it.
Een oordeel over het plan kan ik pas vellen op basis van een projectplan en nadere bestudering daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nevenfuncties van hoogleraren

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science about disclosure of professors' side jobs, citing high rates of side functions and commercial ties, and asked whether the disclosure code should be tightened. The minister replied that universities publish side functions on professor profile pages, that a sector check found near-complete compliance, and declined to tighten the code or restrict side jobs.
I therefore cannot send you such a report.
Ik kan u een dergelijke rapportage dus niet toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de crisis in de archeologie

An SP MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the crisis in commercial archaeology, job losses, budgets since 2003, municipal shortfalls in staff and policy, and whether a follow-up to the Odyssee pilot will be pursued. The Minister attributes the sector's trouble to the economic downturn, reports budgets and a pending employment study, says municipalities are primarily responsible and have more discretion, and points to Rijksdienst support programmes and the 'Oogst voor Malta' follow-up.
At this moment I do not have exact figures on employment.
Op dit moment heb ik geen exacte cijfers over de werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over steeds grotere klassen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about an AOb/ITS survey showing classes of over 28 pupils becoming more common, and pressed on class size, passend onderwijs and the Swedish research on smaller classes. The State Secretary answered that official representative data show only a slight rise in average group size, that large schools mostly form groups of 21-30 pupils, and that quality teachers and school-level judgement matter more than a fixed class-size cap, so no stepwise plan to smaller classes is planned.
Therefore I see no reason for a step-by-step plan towards smaller classes.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor een stappenplan naar kleinere klassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het leenstelsel ook voor de masterstudent met een jaar wordt uitgesteld

An SP MP asked the Education Minister about reports that the student loan system would also be postponed by a year for master's students, and about the consequences for institutions and the Education Agreement financing. The minister said she is not in favour of further postponement, that the master's loan bill is pending with a 1 September 2014 start, and that the 119 million euro figure is not directly tied to the loan system.
Unlike GroenLinks, I am for the time being not in favour of further postponement of the loan system.
Ik ben anders dan GroenLinks vooralsnog geen voorstander van verder uitstel van het leenstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis, Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat studenten van Inholland problemen ervaren bij het afronden van hun studie

MPs Mohandis, Van Dijk and Van Meenen asked whether Inholland's tightened graduation requirements are leaving students unable to finish, and what compensation is available. The minister answered that Inholland's extra support measures are adequate, that she does not expect large numbers to be stranded, and that students can seek support from the profileringsfonds or claim damages under general law.
I consider the measures taken by Hogeschool Inholland (see my answer to question 2 above) sufficient.
Ik acht de maatregelen die zijn getroffen door Hogeschool Inholland (zie hiervoor mijn antwoord op vraag 2 hierboven) voldoende.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met de JSF

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reported quality problems with the F-35 (JSF), including 363 findings by the US Inspector General, cost and delay effects, inefficient management, and a quality-escape clause in contracts. The minister answered that the findings concern quality management rather than design, that no delays or cost increases arise yet, that the JPO adopts most recommendations, and that Dutch contracts will include guarantees against payment for substandard quality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gevolgen van de cultuurbezuinigingen

An SP MP asked Minister Bussemaker about the effects of cultural budget cuts, including podium groups closing, job losses, more freelancers, reduced new productions, and rising marketisation. The minister said the Fonds Podiumkunsten made hard choices, sponsorship impact is still unclear, she sees no threat to continuity, and she does not see a process of marketisation and impoverishment.
I do not believe that a process of marketisation and impoverishment is underway.
Ik ben niet van mening dat er een proces van vermarkting en verschraling gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de dreigende vernietiging van de collectie van het Tropeninstituut

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the threatened destruction of most of the Tropeninstituut library collection is compatible with her earlier promise to keep the collection accessible, and what she will do to save it. The minister answered that the pre-1950 heritage part is protected and placed under Leiden University, that the post-1950 part is being rehoused in parts with other institutions, and that temporary storage is not a solution.
This amount is not known to me.
Dit bedrag is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mislukte fusie tussen de Universiteit van Amsterdam en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about the failed UvA-HvA 'fusion', its costs, whether the institutions can be split, and a planned VU-UvA merger. The Minister answered that the UvA-HvA arrangement is not a legal merger, that the institutions are autonomous, that splitting the shared board and facilities is legally possible, and that the evaluation is for the institutions to publish.
It is up to the institutions involved to decide whether to make such an evaluation public and when.
Het is aan de betrokken instellingen om een dergelijke evaluatie al dan niet openbaar te maken en te bepalen wanneer dat gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bereiken van de millenniumdoelen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she agrees that meeting the Millennium Development Goals requires spending 0.7% of GNI on ODA, whether she will press this at the UN, what Dutch ODA shares were for 2013-2015, and whether she will return to the 0.7% target. The minister answered that ODA is an important but modest contribution, that she supports modernising the ODA definition, that 2013 ODA was 0.67% with provisional 2014 and 2015 figures of 0.59% and 0.60%, and that she will report her view on ODA in the government response to the IBO report.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt, Jasper van Dijk en Bashir over misbruik van de Wet vermindering afdracht loonbelasting en premie voor de volksverzekeringen (WVA)

SP MPs asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs and the state secretary of Finance about firms and training institutions abusing the wage-tax reduction for education (AV onderwijs), including whether unqualified teachers and sham courses were used and whether the responsible parties would be punished. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found shortcomings at several institutions, that investigations continue at two, that the AV onderwijs is being abolished in favour of a new subsidy scheme, and that the Tax Service and FIOD can act, while declining to name firms or give tax-recovery estimates for confidentiality reasons.
Under the duty of confidentiality, no statements are ever made about individual taxpayers in tax matters.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht worden wat betreft fiscale aangelegenheden nimmer uitspraken gedaan over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht dat ontslag van leerkrachten dreigt op honderden basisscholen

MPs Smaling and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether a report that 80% of primary schools must dismiss teachers to stay solvent, with consequences for class sizes and individual attention, was accurate and whether budget cuts threaten education quality. The State Secretary replied that falling pupil numbers make fewer teachers necessary, that class sizes have not risen sharply, that the government is investing in teacher quality and that the Nationaal Onderwijsakkoord is being revived.
It cannot be determined in advance what the effect of fewer remedial teachers, gym teachers and music teachers will be on education quality.
Op voorhand kan niet worden bepaald wat het effect van minder «remedial teachers», gymleraren en muziekdocenten is op de kwaliteit van het onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de anti-homowet in Rusland

An SP MP asked whether the government condemns Russia's anti-gay propaganda law, what concrete action it takes, and whether it supports a boycott of the Sochi Olympics. The government calls the law discriminatory, says it raises concerns with Russia, will push for an EU position at the Foreign Affairs Council, and opposes a boycott while supporting athletes' freedom of expression.

In the autumn Foreign Affairs Council, which will prepare the EU-Russia Summit, the cabinet will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly and promote a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.

Het kabinet zal in de RBZ in het najaar, die de voorbereiding van de EU-Rusland Top ter hand zal nemen, de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen en bevorderen dat over de anti-homopropagandawet een gezamenlijk EU-standpunt zal worden ingenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Steve Jobsscholen

An MP asked the state secretary about the planned Steve Jobs schools, including whether minimum knowledge standards, teacher supervision and quality norms are met and whether the new model risks becoming a failed experiment. The state secretary answered that schools have pedagogical freedom within legal limits, that the inspectorate will apply extra supervision, that the schools must meet the same quality requirements, and that a possible AMvB on flexible instruction time is being explored.
The inspectorate will therefore carry out extra supervision of the Steve Jobs schools.
De inspectie zal dan ook extra toezicht houden op de Steve Jobsscholen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over FRAGO 242

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether FRAGO 242, a British order under MND-SE, was known to Dutch contingent command beyond the detachment commanders. The minister answered that archives and personnel were searched and no reference to FRAGO 242 was found.
FRAGO 242 or references to it were not found in this regard.
FRAGO 242 of verwijzingen hiernaar zijn hierbij niet aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Ypma over problemen met de ouderbijdrage in het onderwijs

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) and Ypma (PvdA) asked the state secretary about a news report on schools charging high parental contributions that deter poorer families, and about segregation. The state secretary answered that the contribution must be voluntary and that the inspectorate enforces this, but declined to cap contributions or to set a fixed enrolment date, leaving segregation to local authorities.
Where the inspectorate finds that schools do not comply with this statutory requirement, the inspectorate acts to enforce it.
Daar waar de inspectie constateert dat scholen zich niet aan deze wettelijke vereiste houden, treedt de inspectie handhavend op.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een kwart van vrouwelijke co-assistenten seksueel wordt geïntimideerd

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act on reports that a quarter of female medical trainees (co-assistenten) face sexual intimidation, and why few report it. The minister says such intimidation is unacceptable, points to hospital CAO rules, sector action plans and a planned NFU review, and says the data on other training tracks are not available.
We do not have this information.
Wij beschikken niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over thuisonderwijs via geheime constructies

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Smaling asked the state secretary about children receiving home schooling under secret arrangements, including whether contracts with parents impose confidentiality and whether the inspectorate approves them. The state secretary denied the secret-arrangement framing, said the individual handling plans are lawful maatwerk signed by the inspectorate, and pointed to a planned committee debate on truancy.
Agreements made are tailored work and not a blueprint for other pupils.
Gemaakte afspraken zijn maatwerk en geen blauwdruk voor andere leerlingen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over wapenleveranties aan Indonesië

Two SP MPs asked whether Vulcano 76mm naval gun ammunition, possibly used on frigates being supplied to Indonesia, is designed for ground targets and whether the Netherlands co-funds it, and whether this conflicts with the government's view on internal tensions. The minister answered that the Netherlands is not involved in developing that ammunition, that it contributed about EUR 6.2 million to a different Vulcano 127mm program, that the frigate supply was assessed against the eight export criteria, and that no known involvement of Indonesian navy equipment in repression has occurred since 1998.
These questions will be answered as soon as possible.
Deze vragen worden op de kortst mogelijke termijn beantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over FRAGO 242

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister whether the Guardian's claim that directive FRAGO 242 was circulated among coalition troops in Iraq is true, and about Dutch reporting rules, SFIR reports on violations of the laws of war, and US/UK command orders. The minister answered that Dutch detachment commanders were unaware of FRAGO 242, that Dutch rules on reporting suspected offences existed in internal regulations, and that the matter was otherwise handled through national procedures and earlier parliamentary reports.
The successive Dutch detachment commanders operating under the command of the British headquarters MND-SE were not aware of FRAGO 242.
De achtereenvolgende Nederlandse detachementscommandanten die opereerden onder het commando van het Britse hoofdkwartier MND-SE waren niet bekend met FRAGO 242.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut inzake scholen die allochtone leerlingen weigeren

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked about reports that schools refuse pupils of immigrant origin, and about a Forum study on admission barriers faced by migrant parents. The state secretary answered that the small-scale study cannot establish a clear pattern, that refusing pupils on ethnic grounds is unacceptable, and that desegregation is tackled locally, without a large-scale study.
Het tegengaan van segregatie is lokaal belegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Jasper van Dijk over de toekomst van de Tropenmuseum

MPs Monasch and Jasper van Dijk asked ministers whether the future of the Tropenmuseum is at risk, how the KIT budget cuts and 90 job losses affect it, and which ministry should fund it after 2013. The ministers answered that the KIT subsidy ended under earlier decisions, a transition grant of 15.3 million was given for 2013 with 7.5 million earmarked for the museum, the KIT is responsible for its own plans and cut allocation, and post-2013 funding talks with Amsterdam and the ministries are ongoing.
Responsibility for distributing the cuts across the different departments lies with the KIT.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de verdeling van de bezuinigingen over de verschillende afdelingen ligt bij het KIT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over de petitie "Burundi: Stop Silencing the Media!"

An MP asked the minister for a response to a petition against Burundi's new press law and whether the government condemns it as an attack on free expression. The minister agreed the law restricts press freedom, said the Netherlands and the EU have raised objections with Burundian authorities, and described ongoing diplomatic and legal support efforts.
The Netherlands is not leaving it at that.
Nederland laat het hier niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen Jasper van Dijk over scholen die steeds vaker bureaus inhuren voor examentrainingen

An SP MP asked whether it is problematic that about 160 Dutch secondary schools hire private agencies for exam training, which he sees as a sign that the state is failing in its responsibility for education. The state secretary replied that schools are responsible for exam preparation, that such extra training is their own decision, that the inspectorate does not supervise these agencies, and that no new measures are planned.
I am not in principle opposed to exam training as an extra supplement to standard practice at schools.
Ik ben op zich niet tegen examentrainingen als extra aanvulling op de staande praktijk bij de scholen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen bij de VU

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education about problems at the VU, including alleged over-marketisation of higher education, supervision failures, and tension between staff and the board. The Minister rejected the claim of systemic marketisation, said supervisory bodies need adequate time, promised further analysis via the Inspectorate and a letter on governance, and will report to parliament after the Inspectorate's conclusion around mid-July.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de betrokkenheid van hoge Amerikaanse militairen bij martelingen in Irak

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about a Guardian report linking senior US military figures to detainee torture in Iraq and about FRAGO 242, which allegedly limited coalition investigation of abuse. The minister answered that after June 2004 Iraqi authorities were responsible for investigating non-coalition conduct, that Dutch commanders did not know of the order, and that incidents had to be reported under Dutch rules.
The obligation to investigate crimes, including war crimes and human rights violations, lies with the authorities that exercise authority or jurisdiction in the area or over the suspects.

De verplichting tot het doen van onderzoek naar misdrijven, waaronder oorlogsmisdrijven en schendingen van de mensenrechten, ligt bij de autoriteiten die het gezag of jurisdictie uitoefenen in het gebied of over de verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen Jasper Van Dijk over mensenrechtenschendingen in Ethiopië

An SP MP asked the government about human rights violations in Ethiopia, including restrictions on civil society, forced resettlement of indigenous groups linked to donor-funded programmes, humanitarian access in the Ogaden, and land grabbing. The minister answered that the Netherlands monitors the situation, raises concerns bilaterally and in the EU, finds no convincing evidence of systematic forced displacement, and continues dialogue with Ethiopian authorities.
The Netherlands closely follows the human rights situation in Ethiopia, and the observations as stated in HRW's World Report 2013 are known to us.
Nederland volgt de mensenrechtensituatie in Ethiopië nauwlettend, en de observaties zoals die in het World Report 2013 van HRW zijn verwoord, zijn ons bekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat Iraanse studenten worden gediscrimineerd

MPs Van Dijk and Van Meenen asked whether Iranian students are excluded from some courses despite a Supreme Court ruling, and how the government will respond. The minister answers that the nuclear knowledge embargo implementation will be revised before summer, that 13 exemption requests were filed with 7 refused, and that she sees no reason to apologise or compensate.

We intend to work with the higher education institutions in the short term toward a comprehensive revision of the national implementation of the UN knowledge embargo, so as to address both the Supreme Court ruling and UN Security Council Resolution 1737.

Wij zijn voornemens om in overleg met de Hoger Onderwijs instellingen op korte termijn te komen tot een integrale herziening van de nationale uitwerking van het VN-kennisembargo, zodat tegemoet wordt gekomen aan zowel het arrest van de Hoge Raad als de VN-Veiligheidsraadsresolutie 1737.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over belastingontwijking in Zambia

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked the ministers whether a Dutch treaty with Zambia enables tax avoidance by a British sugar company, whether Zambia loses more to avoidance than it gains in aid, and whether the treaty should be renegotiated. The government said it lacks data on specific amounts, acknowledged the 5% dividend withholding rate under the 1977 treaty, and promised a review of treaties with developing countries with results expected in summer 2013.
We have no information on the amount of tax that may have been avoided in Zambia.
Over de omvang van de eventueel in Zambia ontweken belasting hebben wij geen informatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Jasper van Dijk over kinderen die noodgedwongen bij hun ouders moeten aankloppen ondanks een ontbrekende band of voogdij

SP MPs asked whether students who cannot ask a parent without custody or a parent who is absent or refuses to pay can qualify for the supplementary grant, and how many are affected. The minister explained the existing 'weigerachtige of onvindbare ouders' rule, saw no need for further research or a new solution, and noted the rule will be abolished under the coalition agreement, with a hardship clause under study.
It is not registered how many students with parents who have been removed or deprived of parental authority do not receive a supplementary grant based on parental income.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd hoeveel studenten met ouders die uit het gezag zijn ontheven of ontzet op basis van het inkomen van de ouders geen aanvullende beurs krijgen.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de toename van het aantal opleidingen met selectie aan de poort (ingezonden 31 januari 2013).

An MP asks the education minister whether the rise in higher-education programmes using selection at the gate (from 43 to 74), including capacity limits used as a back door to selection and joint capacity agreements among law faculties, is acceptable and in line with the coalition agreement. The minister replies that the increase is expected to be limited to programmes with more applicants than places, that selection is allowed only under objective grounds, that she will monitor for misuse and speak to institutions if needed, and that the law faculties' capacity agreements are not cartel formation.
Furthermore, I will closely monitor whether capacity limitation is nonetheless used to select improperly.
Verder zal ik scherp in de gaten houden of capaciteitsbeperking toch gebruikt wordt om oneigenlijk te selecteren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het delen van inlichtingen ten behoeve van drone aanvallen

SP MPs asked whether Dutch intelligence gathered in the region is shared with the United States and could be used for targeted drone killings, and whether Dutch officials risk prosecution. The minister confirmed awareness of a UK lawsuit, declined to say anything publicly about cooperation with foreign intelligence services, and stated that the UK case is not criminal prosecution.
No public statements can be made about cooperation with foreign intelligence and security services.
Over de samenwerking met buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een nieuwe bètafaculteit van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Vrije Universiteit (VU)

An SP MP asks the minister about a plan by the UvA and VU to merge their science faculties into one Amsterdam Faculty of Science, its governance, whether it falls under the merger test, whether staff and students are consulted, reduced bachelor programmes, and whether funds could go to a costly building project. The minister endorses the plan, says it is not a legal merger and so not subject to the merger test, says staff and students will be consulted via the works councils, and says the institutions alone are responsible for housing and spending.
The envisaged cooperation is not an administrative or institutional merger within the meaning of the law and therefore does not qualify for a merger test.
De beoogde samenwerking is geen bestuurlijke of instellingsfusie in de zin van de wet en komt daarom niet in aanmerking voor een fusietoets.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met tentamens bij de HvA (HvA)

An SP MP asks the education minister about exam mishaps at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences (HvA), including second-year students grading first-year exams and a cancelled MIC exam, and what consequences, investigation and legislative remedies follow. The minister regrets the incidents, outlines remedial test dates, internal investigation and planned procedural improvements, notes the Inspectorate will hold a governance meeting with the HvA, and says the bill on quality safeguards does not directly address these specific problems.
The Inspectorate will hold an administrative meeting with the HvA to also establish whether the institution is sufficiently "in control" in resolving these problems.
De Inspectie zal een bestuurlijk gesprek met de HvA voeren om ook vast te stellen of de hogeschool voldoende «in control» is bij het oplossen van deze problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat geen van de tien grootste levensmiddelenconcerns uitblinkt in milieu en mensvriendelijkheid

Two SP MPs asked the minister whether it is unacceptable that major food companies sell products linked to serious social and environmental harm, whether consumers are misled by CSR claims, and how transparency on land deals will be promoted. The minister answered that companies should improve along OECD guidelines, that CSR claims must be verifiable, and that the Netherlands supports transparency initiatives such as the Land Matrix and an EU working group, without committing to new binding measures.
The cabinet is of the view that we may ask companies to commit to realising that improvement.
Het kabinet is van mening dat we van bedrijven mogen vragen dat zij zich inzetten om die verbetering te realiseren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over steekpenningen bij een fregattendeal met Chili

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the government was involved in bribes paid in a 2004 frigate sale to Chile and about related Chilean prosecutions. The minister replied that Defence used no intermediaries, was not involved in the Chilean bribery, and that the Rijksrecherche handled a Chilean mutual legal assistance request but information could not be shared because it concerns an individual case, and the Public Prosecution Service would not say whether it would investigate De Schelde.
It is not possible to provide this information to the House of Representatives since it concerns an individual case.
Het is niet mogelijk om deze informatie aan de Tweede Kamer te verstrekken aangezien het een individuele zaak betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de vertrekkend bestuursvoorzitter van het Erasmus Medisch Centrum een zeer royale ontslagregeling heeft getroffen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about reports that the outgoing Erasmus MC board chair negotiated a generous severance package, including continued salary to 2015, a personal allowance, a mobile phone, laptop and first-class NS season ticket. The minister answered that the arrangement's basis under the CAO is incorrect since the chair was not covered by the CAO, that such a generous arrangement is too generous, but that the WNT cannot yet normalise professor pay.
In my view that is an incorrect reference.
Mijns inziens is dat een onterechte verwijzing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de cookiemuur van de Publieke Omroep niet rechtsgeldig is

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the government how it would respond to the CBP's criticism of the public broadcaster NPO's cookie wall, which denies access to sites for users who refuse tracking cookies, and what steps it would take. The state secretary said OPTA and the CBP are responsible for enforcement, that the government will consult the NPO within a month on alternatives, and that tracking cookies are not needed for basic site functions.
It is up to OPTA to judge the lawfulness of the NPO's conduct in light of the cookie provision.
Het is dus aan OPTA om een oordeel te vellen over de rechtmatigheid van de handelwijze van de NPO in het licht van de cookiebepaling.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over de Duitse weigering om wapens te vervoeren in verband met de Franse interventie in Mali

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that Germany would not transport weapons or ammunition supporting the French intervention in Mali, and about Dutch aircraft via the EATC. The minister answered that Germany does not transport such cargo, that the Netherlands places no restrictions on cargo, that the KDC-10 has not yet been deployed, and that Dutch aircraft are currently not used for flights to Mali pending a safety review, with the Chamber to be informed of any positive decision.
If a positive decision is taken, the Chamber will be informed further.
Bij positief besluit wordt de Kamer nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de waarde van een diploma naar aanleiding van een LOOT-programma

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked whether diplomas from LOOT elite-athlete programmes, with exemptions, carry the same value as regular diplomas, after a turnster was refused entry to a Saxion course because an exemption in economics left her deficient. The government answered that LOOT diplomas are full entry qualifications, that the refusal followed the course's own specific prerequisite, that the evaluation is due in summer 2013, and that no other similar cases are known.
Yes, that is correct. Pupils following an adapted programme in secondary education under the LOOT licence policy rule can obtain a full final diploma.

Leerlingen die een aangepast programma volgen op het middelbaar onderwijs in het kader van mijn Beleidsregel verstrekking Loot-licentie voortgezet onderwijs 1 , kunnen een volwaardig einddiploma verwerven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen van Amerikaanse drone aanvallen voor de burgerbevolking van Pakistan

MPs Van Bommel and Van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about civilian deaths and harms from US drone strikes in Pakistan, citing a Stanford/NYU report, and whether the US should compensate, be more transparent, or halt strikes. The minister answered that the US acknowledges some civilian deaths but gives no figures, that Dutch data on civilian deaths cannot be verified, that compensation and proportionality are matters for the US, and that no moratorium will be pursued, though more US transparency is welcomed.
I am in favour of greater openness about such strikes.
Ik ben voorstander van meer openheid over dergelijke aanvallen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de rechtmatigheid van en verantwoording over targeted killings

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government would share internal legal advice on US targeted killings, condemn such strikes as unlawful, and press the US for transparency and accountability on drone strikes. Minister Timmermans answered that the advice will be submitted to the CAVV, that prohibitions on attacks on protected persons and extrajudicial executions apply, that more openness from the US is welcomed, but that a judgement on specific strikes requires facts the government does not have.

I consider it useful to have the lawfulness and conditions for the use of armed drones further analysed and have decided to refer this question for advice to the Advisory Committee on Issues of Public International Law (CAVV).

Ik acht het nuttig om de rechtmatigheid en voorwaarden voor het gebruik van bewapende drones nader te laten analyseren en heb besloten om dit vraagstuk ter advisering aan de Commissie van Advies inzake Volkenrechtelijke Vraagstukken (CAVV) voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het door Red Bull gesponsorde onderzoek aan Universiteit Utrecht

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether Universiteit Utrecht's publication of positive results on an energy drink sponsored by Red Bull (300,000 euro) creates a conflict of interest, and what the KNAW will do about openness and sponsor influence. The state secretary replied that the KNAW has no direct role, that sponsored research is disclosed via declarations of interest, that the university ordered an integrity review, and that the government awaits the KNAW advice on trust and integrity before acting.
I am awaiting the KNAW recommendations in its advice on trust and integrity before acting on this.
Ik wacht hiervoor de aanbevelingen van de KNAW af in het advies over vertrouwen en integriteit.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het gebruik van cookies door de NPO

Two SP MPs asked whether agreements with the ministry oblige the NPO to obtain consent for cookies on its websites and to explain which functions require them, and whether cookie data is shared with third parties. The state secretary replied that the NPO uses functional, analytic, advertising and social media cookies, that consent is sought except for functional cookies, that data is anonymised and not passed to third parties, and that some social media trackers are controlled by those providers.
As promised at the Telecommunications General Consultation of 21 November, it is currently being examined whether, and under what conditions, analytic cookies can be regarded as necessary cookies.

Zoals bij het Algemeen Overleg Telecommunicatie van 21 november jongstleden is toegezegd wordt momenteel onderzocht of, en zo ja onder welke voorwaarden, analytische cookies kunnen worden beschouwd als noodzakelijk cookies
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen die ontstaan als de OV-studentenkaart wordt afgeschaft

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education whether abolishing the student OV travel card would reduce college attendance, harm education quality, raise student costs and deter study choices, and whether the government would investigate these effects. The minister replied that free travel ends in 2016 but students get discounts and a loan for remaining travel costs, that attendance matters, that the study-choice risk is overstated, and that details would follow in a forthcoming letter on the student finance proposals.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Maij over landroof in Mozambique

MPs Van Dijk and Maij asked the government about land grabbing linked to tree plantations in Niassa, Mozambique, the GSFF investment, ABP pension fund oversight, and possible monitoring mechanisms. The minister answered that the report captures real problems but is incomplete, that the new GSFF management has taken steps, and that ABP's oversight body discussed the investment, while the ministry will raise the report's recommendations in the next consultation.

The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will, as sector employer for the central government, raise the report's recommendations at the next meeting between the Verantwoordingsorgaan and the ABP board where responsible investment is discussed.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zal – als sectorwerkgever Rijk – de aanbevelingen in het rapport in het eerstvolgende overleg tussen het Verantwoordingsorgaan en het ABP-bestuur waar over verantwoord beleggen wordt gesproken, inbrengen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over “het bericht dat de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen schoonmakers uit het zicht wil houden”.

Two MPs asked ministers whether the University of Groningen's plan to have cleaners work only when no one is present, and sanctions against a cleaner, were acceptable under the Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag. The minister reports that the university, union and cleaning firms reached an agreement that keeps working hours, lifts sanctions and commits the university to sign the Code, but largely declines to take further action against the board.
I am pleased that the RUG, as client, together with the other partners, has reached this agreement.
Ik ben verheugd over het feit dat de RUG als opdrachtgever, samen met de andere partners, tot dit akkoord is gekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de bestuursvoorzitter van de Universiteit Leiden die met behoud van salaris met sabbatical gaat

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister whether a university board chair receiving about two million euros in salary during a 14-month paid sabbatical is acceptable, and what the government will do about such schemes. The minister said she needs more information from the university before judging, that she recovers amounts exceeding the WNT pay norm, and that the WNT is a sufficiently strong instrument.
As soon as I have received this information and have been able to form a judgment, I will inform you of my decision.
Zodra ik deze informatie heb ontvangen en ik mij een oordeel heb kunnen vormen, zal ik u informeren over mijn besluit.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over berichten dat volgens een VN ‘Group of Experts’ Rwanda en Oeganda directe militaire steun geven aan guerillastrijders in Congo en over de mensenrechtensitua

MPs Voordewind and Van Dijk asked about a UN Group of Experts finding that Rwanda and Uganda directly arm M23 rebels in Congo, about human rights in Congo and Rwanda, and whether Dutch aid to Rwanda's justice sector should end. The minister said the leaked report cannot yet be fully assessed, that Dutch aid remains suspended without linkage to the Amnesty findings, and that Rwanda's Security Council seat will sharpen scrutiny of its compliance with norms.
Since we have not been able to see the full final report, it is not yet possible to reach a considered judgment on the report or to consider new measures.

Aangezien wij geen kennis hebben kunnen nemen van het volledige eindrapport, is het op dit moment nog niet mogelijk om tot een afgewogen oordeel over het rapport te komen of om nieuwe maatregelen te overwegen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk inzake de mogelijke ondergang van het veteranenhuis in Veendam

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether the Veteranenhuis in Veendam, a veterans' meeting centre, faces closure from 1 January 2013 for lack of structural funding, and whether it could qualify for Veterans Fund support. The minister acknowledged the risk but said funding decisions rest with the independent Veteranenfonds and that Defence has no role, while stating that veterans' meeting centres are important in peer-level care.
It is up to the Veteranenfonds to assess whether the Veteranenhuis in Veendam qualifies for a grant.
Het is aan het Veteranenfonds te beoordelen of het Veteranenhuis in Veendam in aanmerking komt voor een vergoeding.
Antwoord vragen het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanslag op Denis Mukwege in Congo

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether the government would condemn the attack on Congolese gynaecologist and rights defender Denis Mukwege, visit him through the ambassador, and act against attacks on rights defenders in Congo. The minister answered that the attack was condemned, Mukwege and his family were moved to safety at EU expense, and the Netherlands will keep pressing Congolese authorities for better protection.
The Netherlands will continue, together with EU partners, to press the Congolese authorities for better protection of human rights defenders such as Dr Mukwege.
Nederland zal samen met EU-partners bij de Congolese autoriteiten blijven aandringen op betere bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers als Dr Mukwege.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper Van Dijk over de Navo oefening Steadfast Noon

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the NATO exercise Steadfast Noon, in which the Netherlands participates at Büchel air base, rehearses procedures for deploying tactical nuclear weapons, and whether Dutch participation conflicts with nuclear disarmament policy. The government declined to give details of the exercise citing international agreements, and argued that NATO remains a nuclear alliance while pursuing a world free of nuclear weapons step by step.
Based on international agreements, no statements are made on this matter.
Op basis van internationale afspraken worden hierover geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Jasper Van Dijk over de door de Financieringsmaatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden (FMO) gefinancierde Barro Blanco dam in Panama

An MP asked the state secretary about the FMO-financed Barro Blanco dam in Panama, including community opposition, conflicting information, disclosure policy and complaint mechanisms. The state secretary defended FMO's due diligence, said the shareholder state does not intervene in individual investments, deferred to a mediated round-table dialogue, and promised FMO would introduce a disclosure policy from January 2013 and examine a national complaints mechanism.
FMO will investigate how its disclosure policy can be shaped, taking into account the interests of its clients.
FMO gaat onderzoeken hoe haar openbaringsbeleid kan worden ingevuld, rekening houdend met de belangen van haar klanten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat NWO1) promotiestudenten financiert die voor Shell in India gaan werken

An MP asked whether NWO funding for PhD positions that largely go to Indian students who will then work for Shell is a good use of scarce research money. The government replied that Shell pays the PhD salaries, that NWO's contribution goes to open research programmes within the top-sector policy, and that no revision of NWO allocation criteria is needed.
Revising the criteria for the distribution of the NWO budget is not on the table.
Herziening van criteria voor verdeling van NWO-budget is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Reporter "Maxima's Microkrediet”

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about excessive interest rates in microcredit, subsidy amounts to microfinance, whether former non-profit recipients became commercial, and whether conditions should be attached to subsidies. The State Secretary called high-rate exploitation unacceptable, provided subsidy overviews and evaluation findings, and agreed quality and oversight must improve, but declined to attach rate conditions and pointed to sector initiatives.
The ministry will, among other things through co-financed organisations, continue to work on further professionalisation of the sector.
Het ministerie zal, o.a. via mede-gefinancierde organisaties, blijven inzetten op verdere professionalisering van de sector.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Japer van Dijk over straatkinderen in Oeganda

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs how the government views a Nieuwsuur report on a Ugandan child detention facility holding 350-500 children in poor conditions, and what the Netherlands will do about it, including its leverage over Uganda's justice sector and the treatment of minors. The State Secretary answered that the ambassador will visit the facility and raise findings with Ugandan authorities, that justice-sector dialogue and monitoring of agreed outputs (e.g. reduced pre-trial detention of minors) continue, and that no further consequences are decided yet.
The Dutch ambassador in Uganda will visit the institution shown in the report in the short term.
De Nederlandse ambassadeur in Oeganda zal op korte termijn een bezoek aan de in de reportage getoonde instelling brengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over de verplaatsing van het televisieprogramma Tegenlicht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the VPRO's Tegenlicht would be moved to late evening because of ratings, and whether ratings were being given too much weight at the public broadcaster. The minister replied that talks with the VPRO were ongoing, that quality and reach also count in programming, and that schedules are set by the NPO board together with the broadcasters.
Naturally, alongside ratings, quality and reach of programmes play a major role in programming.
Vanzelfsprekend spelen, naast kijkcijfers, juist ook de kwaliteit en het bereik van programma's een grote rol in de programmering.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Dijk inzake het bericht ‘MBO’s gokken met derivaten’

SP MPs asked the Education Minister whether MBO colleges speculated with housing funds through risky derivatives, whether this was responsible, whether the sector must pay for buy-outs, and whether governance and inspection oversight should be tightened. The minister said derivatives must be used risk-averse, that the Inspectorate is reviewing the financial picture and will report in autumn, and that action depends on those findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to critically assess the financial picture of all publicly funded MBO institutions.
Ik heb de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om het financiële cijferbeeld van alle publiek bekostigde mbo-instellingen kritisch te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen, Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het stopzetten van de behandeling van alle verblijfsaanvragen door Iraanse vreemdelingen

MPs asked whether the IND had stopped processing residence applications from Iranian students and nationals, and whether this amounted to discrimination. The minister answered that applications are decided, but students in restricted fields need a ministry exemption under UN resolution 1737 and EU regulation 267/2012, and that some applications for work were temporarily held before resuming processing.
It is a misunderstanding that the IND does not process applications from Iranian students.
Het is een misverstand dat de IND geen aanvragen van Iraanse studenten in behandeling neemt.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk inzake het NRC-bericht “Kritiek op bezuinigingen door het bestuur van de Vrije Universiteit”

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Education about the VU Amsterdam board's planned 33 million euro cutback, possible job losses, derivatives exposure and staff unrest. The State Secretary declined to judge the opinion piece, said the VU board is responsible for its own budget and personnel policy, pointed to a pending Inspectorate review of derivatives, and rejected reforming university governance.
I am awaiting the results of that investigation before deciding whether additional measures or amendments to the policy rule are necessary.
Ik wacht de resultaten van dat onderzoek af alvorens ik besluit of aanvullende maatregelen of aanpassingen van de beleidsregel noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dijk over de verkoop van voetbalrechten aan Rupert Murdoch

An SP MP asked the education, culture and science minister whether Murdoch's entry into Eredivisie rights would reduce open-channel match highlights and whether Studio Sport could disappear, and questioned the NOS's ability to pay higher prices. The minister said prices are set by the market, that the Mediawet and evenementenlijst already require highlights on the open channel with minimum durations and start times, and that an evaluation of the list is underway with results promised this autumn.
This autumn I will inform your House about this.
Dit najaar zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Smits inzake ‘gebrek aan burgerschap bij jongeren’

MPs Van Dijk and Smits asked the Minister of Education about a media report that Dutch pupils ranked low on civic knowledge and held extreme views on equal rights for migrants, and what would be done. The minister replied that the media analysis was selective, that Dutch pupils ranked 24th of 38 countries on civic knowledge, and that the Education Council's advice on civic education would be awaited, with the response left to the next cabinet.

In 2011 I asked the Education Council, partly in response to the Inspectorate's finding that citizenship in education needs more attention, to advise me on how schools can be supported in developing citizenship education.

In 2011 heb ik, mede naar aanleiding van de constatering van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs dat burgerschap in het onderwijs nadere aandacht behoeft, de Onderwijsraad gevraagd mij te adviseren over de vraag hoe scholen ondersteund kunnen worden
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijke bezuinigingen op de luchtmacht

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Defence Minister about reports that the F-16 fleet could shrink to 42 aircraft and Leeuwarden air base close due to budget cuts linked to the F-35 costs. The minister replied that the 42-aircraft option came from a technical consolidation document not included in the final coalition draft, that the 2011 policy letter reduces the fleet to 68 with both bases kept open, and that no further reduction or closure is planned, while defending continued F-35 participation.
Defence has no intention whatsoever of further reducing the number of F-16s or closing an air base.
Defensie heeft geen enkel voornemen voor een verdere vermindering van het aantal F-16»s of de sluiting van een vliegbasis.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Eijsink over de integriteitskwestie rond luitenant-kolonel Marcel de Haas

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister about the integrity dispute involving Lt-Col Marcel de Haas, including alleged structural problems in job allocation, calls for external personnel officers, a criminal investigation, and an external integrity oversight body. The minister replied that the commission's inquiry was thorough and partly substantiated the complaints, but rejected structural problems, criminal referral, and an external oversight body, citing existing appeal and reporting channels.
I do not share the view that there are structural problems in Defence's personnel policy, including in job allocation.
Ik deel de mening niet dat er bij Defensie sprake is van structurele problemen met het personeelsbeleid,ook niet bij de functietoewijzing.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over een EU-aanval op land in verband met de piraterijbestrijding (Atalanta)

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of an EU air attack on pirate logistics on Somalia's land and whether Dutch forces were involved, including a Lynx helicopter shot at near Somalia. The minister answered that the operation fell under the expanded Atalanta mandate, that no Dutch personnel were involved, that the Lynx was on a separate reconnaissance flight, and that no direct military contribution would be made before consulting parliament.
The Netherlands will not make a direct military contribution to such EU operations before the government has exchanged views with the House of Representatives on the matter.
Nederland zal geen directe bijdrage met militaire eenheden aan dergelijke EU-operaties leveren voordat de regering daarover met de Kamer van gedachten heeft gewisseld.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over de gebrekkige werking van de Code Goed Bestuur

An MP asked the state secretary about weak compliance with the HBO governance code, its lack of attention to education quality, board conflicts of interest, and sanctions for non-compliance. The state secretary acknowledged the shortcomings, said the sector must revise the code, and promised to designate a stronger code by general administrative order with a comply-or-explain duty, while stating no direct government sanctions were planned.
I am of the view that change must come quickly here.
Ik ben van oordeel dat hier snel verandering in moet komen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over de geringe belangstelling voor prestatiebeloning

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education about the low school interest in performance pay experiments and whether the plan should be withdrawn. The State Secretary answered that performance pay funding was reallocated under a new budgetary situation, the scheme is being withdrawn, and compensation will be paid to schools that applied; the other questions were declared no longer relevant.
Therefore, on 11 May 2012 I decided to withdraw the Regulation on performance pay in education in its entirety and in the short term.
Daarom heb ik op 11 mei 2012 besloten de Regeling prestatiebeloning in het onderwijs in z’n geheel en op korte termijn in te trekken.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over wapenhandel tussen Defensie en de heer Joep van den Nieuwenhuyzen

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether arms dealer Joep van den Nieuwenhuyzen was involved in selling surplus Dutch tanks abroad, whether he received a commission, whether the minister was aware of his involvement in fraudulent transactions, and whether it is acceptable for an arms dealer to play a key role in selling Dutch weapons. The minister denied any involvement by the ministry in using his services, said the ministry did not use his services, confirmed awareness of the fraud matters, and stated that surplus strategic materiel is in principle sold only via government-to-government arrangements, with sales to reputable companies possible if the final destination is known in advance.
The claim that Mr Van den Nieuwenhuyzen is involved in the sale of surplus Dutch tanks abroad is incorrect; the Ministry of Defence makes no use of his services in any way.

De bewering dat de heer Van den Nieuwenhuyzen is betrokken bij de verkoop van overtollige Nederlandse tanks aan het buitenland is onjuist; het ministerie van Defensie maakt op geen enkele wijze gebruik van zijn diensten.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over het reddingsplan van de scholen van het Amarantis schoolbestuur

An MP asked the Education Minister about the rescue plan for the Amarantis school board, including whether the full plan would be shared, job losses, a 10 million euro continuity guarantee funded from her ministry, delayed intervention, and an independent inquiry. The minister declined to share the plan as it does not yet exist, promised an independent inquiry and information within two weeks, and gave partial answers on the other points.
I will not share the full 'rescue plan' of the Amarantis Group with the House of Representatives, because it does not yet exist.
Het volledig «reddingsplan» van de Amarantis Groep deel ik niet met de Tweede Kamer, want het is er nog niet.
Antwoord vragen Jasper Van Dijk en Van Bommel over de verkoop van tanks aan Indonesië

SP MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether the cabinet approved a 200 million euro tank sale to Indonesia and an Egypt defence deal, how these fit human rights concerns and earlier parliamentary motions, and whether the minister misled parliament on timing. The ministers answered that a cabinet discussion took place with follow-up agreements referred to an earlier letter, no decision had been taken on Egypt, the Indonesia question was addressed in that letter, and they denied the allegations of strategic delay and ignored advice.
Given the cabinet's current caretaker status, we wish to weigh these matters with the utmost care before presenting them to your House.
Mede gezien de huidige demissionaire status van het kabinet willen wij deze aangelegenheden met de grootst mogelijke zorgvuldigheid wegen, alvorens ze aan uw Kamer voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over onbemande vliegtuigen (drones)

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Defence Minister about the KRO report on drones, whether General Atomics or other firms were already favoured for the MALE UAV procurement, whether the Reaper was pre-selected in breach of EU tendering rules, and whether armed drones and targeted killing were planned. The minister answered that no product, supplier or Dutch industry arrangement has been chosen yet, that the drones are for surveillance and reconnaissance and not armed, and that existing humanitarian law applies to unmanned systems.
On the results of the various phases of the DMP, including the acquisition strategy, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Over de resultaten van de verschillende fasen van het DMP, waaronder de verwervingsstrategie, zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en Jasper van Dijk, Peters over een volgende aanslag op het rijksmonument Sankt Ludwig in Vlodrop

Three MPs (Jansen, Van Dijk and Peters) asked whether the foundation Meru had again applied for demolition of the national monument Sankt Ludwig in Vlodrop, whether the municipality of Roerdalen had enforced repair, and whether the instruments were adequate. The state secretary confirmed the new permit application and said the municipality has used enforcement (an order under penalty, upheld by the Raad van State, with a deadline of 21 September 2012), that the minister has no power to force repair, and that no change in procedures is needed.
I have no legal means to enforce restoration.
Ik heb geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om herstel af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen Jasper van Dijk over "de school als vastgoedmagnaat", i.v.m. nieuwbouw door scholen

An SP MP asks the education minister whether a 100 million euro new-build project by Arcus College in Heerlen, amid vacancy in the city, is justified and how it can be prevented in future. The minister answers that the plans were made when the local property market was sound, that boards and the Inspectorate provide sufficient checks, and that the college's housing spending is below the sector benchmark, though the Inspectorate will examine staffing and temporary-staff arrangements.
Antwoord vragen Jasper Van Dijk over problemen in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs

An SP MP asks the education minister about problems in vocational education (mbo), including low student satisfaction with learning, assessment quality, unpaid optional fees, timetable gaps and placement-related dismissals. The minister acknowledges shortcomings, points to the inspectorate's monitoring, planned intensification and an action plan, and rejects the survey as unrepresentative.
The bill "Efficient learning routes/modernisation of funding", submitted to the House of Representatives, contains the measures that answer the bottlenecks revealed in the SP survey.

Het wetsvoorstel «Doelmatige leerwegen/modernisering bekostiging», aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer, bevat de maatregelen die een antwoord vormen op de knelpunten die in het SP-onderzoek naar voren komen.
Antwoord vragen Bosman, Jasper van Dijk en Eijsink over zelfdoding onder veteranen

MPs Bosman, Van Dijk and Eijsink asked the Defence minister whether suicide among veterans is tracked and whether a higher suicide rate among Balkan veterans is suspected. The minister answered that only CBS records causes of death without veteran status, that a RIVM study found no significant excess suicide among Balkan veterans, and that Defence is studying periodic CBS-based research and may include veteran suicide data in the Veteranennota from 2013.
Defence is studying whether it is possible to carry out periodic research into suicide among veterans based on CBS information.
Defensie bestudeert of het mogelijk is om aan de hand van de informatie van het CBS periodiek onderzoek uit te voeren naar zelfdoding bij veteranen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Peters over de ontslagvergoeding van een directielid van Buma/Stemra

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Peters (GroenLinks) asked whether the very high severance pay of a former Buma/Stemra legal director, paid from funds meant for artists, was acceptable, and whether the College van Toezicht or the minister could claw it back. Minister Teeven answered that the payment predates the supervision law and the salary norm, that there is no legal basis for clawback in this case, and that the forthcoming WNT and wetsvoorstel 31 766 will allow future recovery and salary caps.
This concerns an employment contract concluded some time ago, long before the Supervision of Collective Management Organisations Act came into force.
Het betreft hier een arbeidscontract dat geruime tijd geleden tot stand is gekomen, lang voordat de Wet toezicht collectieve beheersorganisaties in werking was getreden

Vragen van de leden Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Jasper VanDijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Ondernemende universiteit in zwaar weer» (ingezonden 26 oktober 2

MPs asked the state secretary about a newspaper report on alleged irregular spending, property losses and integrity gaps at TU Delft, and whether the ministry should act on PwC's withheld audit approval in 2007 and 2008. The state secretary said the Inspectorate validated TU Delft's commitments and sent improvement points, and that no sanctions were imposed because non-compliance with European tendering rules carries no state sanction policy.
On the basis of this consultation, the Inspectorate of Education further validated TU Delft's input.
Op basis van dit overleg heeft de Inspectie van het Onderwijs de inbreng van TU Delft nader gevalideerd.
Vragen van het lid Jasper vanDijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over belangenverstrengeling bij de TU Delft (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about conflict of interest at TU Delft, where a dean awarded about €750,000 in contracts to his wife, and what sanctions, code of conduct tightening, and disclosure of professors' side jobs would follow. The state secretary replied that an independent audit was done, the university has taken measures, the dean stepped down, and no central overview of side jobs is planned beyond the university's own publication.
Following this article, the TU Delft Executive Board, in consultation with the Inspectorate of Education, had an accountant carry out an independent fact-finding investigation.
Naar aanleiding van onder meer dit artikel heeft het College van Bestuur van TU Delft in overleg met de Inspectie van het Onderwijs een accountant een onafhankelijk feitenonderzoek laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Jasper van Dijk over het de verlaging van de prestatie-eisen van de F-35 Joint Strike Fighter

MPs Eijsink and Van Dijk asked whether the Defence Minister knew of a Pentagon proposal to lower F-35 performance requirements, whether this was discussed at the JROC and JPO, and whether a new candidate comparison for replacing the F-16 would follow. The minister confirmed prior information, said the 590 nautical mile range requirement was not lowered but the flight profile was adjusted to meet it, and ruled out a new candidate comparison.
Contrary to what the article suggests, during the JROC meeting the range performance requirement for the F-35A of 590 nautical miles was not lowered.
In tegenstelling tot wat het artikel suggereert, is tijdens de JROC-bijeenkomst de prestatie-eis over het vliegbereik van de F-35A van 590 zeemijlen niet verlaagd.
Antwoord vragen  Leden Eijsink, Hachchi en van Dijk over het bericht 'Defensie krijgt export-admiraal'

MPs Eijsink, Hachchi and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister what mandate the new 'export admiral' would have, whether this blurs independence and integrity given the role's links to defence industry exports, and how it relates to EL&I export promotion and export control. The minister answered that the vice-admiral mainly coordinates property, materiel disposal and supports exports without representing companies, that EL&I remains responsible for export licences, and that existing EL&I export consultations continue.
PCDS Nagtegaal will not act as a representative of companies, so conflict of interest does not arise.
PCDS Nagtegaal zal niet optreden als vertegenwoordiger van bedrijven, dus belangenverstrengeling is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over Pink Pearls

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a conflict between the organisation Pink Pearls and subsidised organisations, including a alleged defamation campaign, market exclusion, and whether the minister would mediate. The minister acknowledged the conflict, declined to intervene because the ministry is not a party and a court has already ruled, and said market exclusion is for the judge to assess.
The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science is not a party to this conflict, on which the District Court in Utrecht has already ruled.
Het ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap is geen partij bij dit conflict, waarover de Rechtbank in Utrecht al een uitspraak heeft gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang en Jasper Van Dijk over de betrokkenheid van Nederland bij mogelijke bombardementsmissies op land in Somalië

MPs Irrgang and Van Dijk asked whether the Netherlands was involved in contingency plans for beach bombardment missions against pirate and insurgent camps in Somalia, and whether this would exceed the mandate. The ministers answered that the Netherlands was not involved in any such plans, that piracy and terrorism were conflated in the press, and that Atalanta's mandate rests on UN resolutions; they promised to inform parliament once EU decisions on action with effect on land are completed.
As soon as the decision-making in EU context on action from the sea, with effect on land, is completed, your House will be informed about this.
Zodra de besluitvorming in EU-verband over optreden vanaf zee, met effect op land voltooid is, wordt uw kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over bouwfraude bij Rotterdamse scholen

An SP MP asked the education minister about alleged construction fraud at Rotterdam schools run by foundation BOOR, including whether the board can investigate itself, who can intervene in mismanagement, and whether the board should be suspended and the foundation scaled down. The minister awaits the prosecutor's findings, notes an independent external investigation has been commissioned, explains the board and municipal council intervention powers, and says she will return to the matter once the investigation concludes.
I am awaiting the conclusions of the ongoing investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik wacht de conclusies van het nog lopende onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie af.
Antwoord vragen Peters en Jasper Van Dijk over de optelsom van bezuinigingen op cultuur

MPs Peters and Van Dijk asked the state secretary for an aggregate picture of cultural budget cuts across national, provincial and municipal government, including effects on supply, attendance, employment, the Geefwet and the WWIK abolition. The secretary answered that the aggregate cannot yet be given because decisions are unfinished and data are not comparable, and that effects cannot reliably be predicted, though some figures (WWIK saving of 10 million, VAT rise of 90 million, transition costs up to 138 million) were provided.

Partly because decisions on cultural subsidies for 2013–2016 at national, municipal and provincial level are not yet concluded, it is not possible to state how much is cut in culture by national, provincial and municipal government together.

Mede omdat de besluitvorming over de cultuursubsidies voor de periode 2013–2016 bij zowel Rijk, gemeenten als provincies nog niet is afgerond, is het niet mogelijk aan te geven hoeveel er door Rijk, provincies en gemeenten gezamenlijk wordt bezuinigd op cultuur.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het terughalen van een Lynx-helikopter van Libië naar Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Defence Minister whether it is true that a Lynx helicopter stranded on the Libyan coast at Sirte will be brought back to the Netherlands and then dismantled, why this serves a national interest, and whether scrapping it in Libya would be cheaper. The minister confirmed the plan, citing national security and strategic defence material rules that Libya cannot meet, and gave an estimated additional cost of EUR 21,000 funded from the crisis operations budget.
Bringing back the helicopter is a national responsibility and serves a national security interest.
Het terughalen van de helikopter is een nationale verantwoordelijkheid en dient een nationaal veiligheidsbelang.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over ontslagen bij uitgeverij Wegener

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether they condone the planned loss of 300 to 350 jobs at publisher Wegener, whether regional news provision is important, and how they would support regional news. The ministers said job cuts are a private company decision, acknowledged the importance of news provision, and pointed to regional media centre cooperation and the Stimuleringsfonds voor de Pers as measures.
Although I regret the loss of employment, it is primarily up to Wegener to decide on this.
Hoewel ik het verlies aan werkgelegenheid betreur, is het primair aan Wegener om hierover een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink, Hachchi, Jasper van Dijk en El Fassed over het bericht ‘JSF duurder door uitstel aankopen VS’

MPs asked the Defence Minister whether and how the government was informed of the US Pentagon's decision to delay 179 F-35 deliveries over five years, and how information flow through the JSF Program Office had improved. The minister answered that the US notified the Netherlands in January 2012, that the JPO was not responsible for the US order schedule, that he had raised timely information with the JPO director, and that financial effects would be reported to the Chamber by 1 June 2012.

The Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO) is responsible for the development and future further development of the F-35, contract signing, ongoing production of the F-35 aircraft and preparation of maintenance.

Het Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO) is verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en toekomstige doorontwikkeling van de F-35, de contractsluiting, de lopende productie van de F-35 toestellen en de voorbereiding van de instandhouding.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Van Gerven over de berichten dat de Saxion Hogeschool de niet-geaccrediteerde opleiding tot CAM-therapeut blijft aanbieden

SP MPs asked whether Saxion Next still offers a non-accredited HBO CAM therapist programme and what happens to students and graduates. The state secretary answered that existing students may finish, that their diplomas are legally valid, that no new students were enrolled after accreditation lapsed, and that the website wording has been amended.
Saxion Next has acknowledged this and has since amended the text on the website.
Saxion Next heeft dit onderkend en heeft de tekst op de website inmiddels aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Çelik over financiële problemen bij een groot schoolbestuur

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Çelik asked the education minister about reported multi-million euro deficits, weak schools, dropout and board turmoil at Amarantis, a large Amsterdam school board with over 30,000 pupils. The minister answered that the situation is being examined by the board and supervised by the Inspectorate, gave dropout and weak-programme figures, stated that large boards do not inherently harm quality, and declined to pre-empt measures pending the board's plans.
I do not wish to anticipate any measures that may be taken.
Op eventueel te nemen maatregelen wil ik dan ook niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over het ontbreken van instemming bij experimenten met prestatiebeloning in het onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Education why pilot performance-pay experiments in schools went ahead without formal works-council consent, and whether such pilots are meaningful. The state secretary replied that the pilot schools consulted staff and works councils without formal signed consent, that the pilots were forerunners outside the formal scheme, and that experiments are needed to test whether performance pay works.

The Schools Participation Act (WMS) and the Works Councils Act (WOR) are clear on this: consent of the works council is required when adopting or changing policy on the award of salaries, allowances and gratuities to staff.

De Wet Medezeggenschap Scholen (WMS) en de Wet op de Ondernemingsraden (WOR) zijn hier duidelijk over: instemming van de MR/OR is noodzakelijk bij vaststelling of wijziging van het beleid met betrekking tot de toekenning van salarissen, toelagen en gratificaties aan het personeel.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat er fors bezuinigd wordt op het schoolmaatschappelijk werk

Two SP MPs asked whether reported large cuts to school social work, which reduce oversight of children with problems at home, would be reversed and whether municipalities cutting prevention conflicts with passend onderwijs and youth care reform. The state secretary answered that school social work is important but that municipalities and schools must decide themselves, that the government does not track cut amounts and will not investigate, and that prevention is a goal of the youth care reform.
I am not aware of how many municipalities are cutting back on school social work.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten bezuinigen op het schoolmaatschappelijk werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de dreigende sluiting van 17 musea

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether the reported possible closure of 17 museums, the impact on municipal museums and their collections, and the higher own-income requirement were acceptable given the 'spare heritage' commitment in the coalition agreement. The secretary answered that the closures cannot be predicted because subsidy procedures are still ongoing, that the heritage commitment applies to national policy, that he trusts municipalities and provinces to handle collections carefully, and that he sees no reason to revisit the own-income requirement, while consulting other governments on the museum system.
I see no reason to reconsider the measures taken.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de genomen maatregelen te heroverwegen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed, Verhoeven, Voordewind, Eijsink, Jasper van Dijk en Koppejan over het schip de Chariot dat naar verluidt munitie vervoerde met bestemming Syrië
