MPs from six parties asked the foreign minister whether Cyprus, Russia and EU partners would be pressed over the ship Chariot, reportedly carrying munitions to Syria in breach of the EU arms embargo, and whether prosecution or Europol/Interpol involvement was possible. The minister confirmed the transit violates the embargo, said Nederland raised it with Cyprus in the EU, would press Russia through the EU, and said primary responsibility for action lies with the flag state and Cyprus.
Primarily it is up to the flag state (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) or the port state (Cyprus) to take action where possible.
Het is primair aan de vlaggenstaat (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) of de havenstaat (Cyprus) om waar mogelijk actie te ondernemen.

Vragen van de leden Eijsink (PvdA), Hachchi (D66) en Jasper Van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over de uitspraken van admiraal Venlet over de Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

MPs Eijsink, Hachchi and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about admiral Venlet's statements that overlapping development, testing and production of the F-35 JSF was a miscalculation and that production must slow. The minister acknowledged the cost increases, shared the Pentagon's position, disclosed additional costs for the Dutch test aircraft, and said a Dutch decision on replacing the F-16 is left to a future cabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de TU Delft de studielast vermindert zodat studenten sneller afstuderen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether TU Delft's plan to reduce study load so students graduate faster reflects a perverse incentive from the government's focus on study efficiency, and how quality will be protected. State Secretary Zijlstra answered that the revision is part of agreed quality improvements, that funding is not tied to graduation rates, that accreditation safeguards quality, and that no new talks with the TUs are needed.
There is currently no reason to enter into consultation with the TUs again.
Er is nu geen aanleiding om weer met de TU’s in overleg te treden.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Smits over de steeds lager opgeleide mbo-docenten

MPs Van Dijk and Smits asked about reports that mbo teachers are increasingly under-qualified and whether the government will act on the rising share lacking teaching qualifications. The state secretary replied that the mbo teaching workforce is mixed, that 11% of teachers lack a qualification (mostly career changers given two years to qualify), and that no separate budget exists for qualifying unqualified teachers beyond general professionalisation funds.
The Cabinet therefore aims for all teachers working in mbo to be appointable and to obtain their qualification within two years, if not already obtained.
Het Kabinet streeft er daarom naar dat alle in het mbo werkzame leraren benoembaar zijn en binnen twee jaren hun bevoegdheid behalen, indien nog niet behaald.

Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smits (beiden SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over scholen die vooruitlopen op mogelijke wetgeving rondom het zogenaamde «passend onderwijs» (ingezonden 22

MPs Van Dijk and Smits asked the Minister of Education whether schools cutting jobs and raising class sizes ahead of approved 'passend onderwijs' legislation was acceptable, and questioned the cuts. The Minister replied that no financial necessity exists to cut jobs now, that the cuts follow standard legislative procedures, that schools are responsible for their own staffing, and that she will not postpone the measures.
There is currently, however, no financial need to cut jobs now as a result of the proposed measures.
Er is op dit moment echter geen financiële noodzaak om als gevolg van de voorgenomen maatregelen nu al banen te schrappen.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een docent aan de Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (VU) die tentamens heeft versimpeld om meer financiering binnen te

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Education whether a VU lecturer simplified exams to increase funding and how university funding creates incentives to lower standards. The state secretary answered that only four students received an extra resit in a politics programme after a curriculum change, that no deliberate exam simplification occurred, that funding does not depend on study points, and that performance agreements focus on quality, so no further investigation is planned.
I am therefore of the view that in this case there is no question of deliberately simplifying exams with the aim of getting more students to pass.
Ik ben dan ook van mening dat in dit geval geen sprake is van het opzettelijk versimpelen van tentamens met als doel meer studenten te laten slagen.

Vragen van de leden Eijsink en Dijksma (beiden PvdA), Hachchi (D66) en Jasper Van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Defensie over het stopzetten van de ontwikkeling van de F13

MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Defence about the cancellation of the F136 engine development for the Joint Strike Fighter, including the financial commitments of Dutch firms, expected orders, contacts with industry and the US Congress. The government regrets the decision, says the US financed the engine alone, reports about 7 million euro invested by Dutch firms and a revised order estimate of about 750 million dollars, and says it is pursuing a larger role for Dutch industry on the F135 engine.
The answer to questions 13, 14 and 15 addresses the possibly larger role of Dutch industry in producing the remaining engine, the F135 from Pratt & Whitney.
In het antwoord op de vragen 13, 14 en 15 wordt ingegaan op de mogelijk grotere rol van de Nederlandse industrie bij de productie van de overgebleven motor, de F135 van Pratt & Whitney.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de levering van F-16’s aan Indonesië in 1999 (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether Dutch companies' involvement in modernising Indonesian F-16s in 1999-2002 breached the EU arms embargo and Dutch export policy, and whether such mistakes can be ruled out. The government answers that the contract predated the embargo, the programme ran after it expired, no Dutch policy then excluded the Indonesian air force, and it does not see the matter as a serious error or misstep.
No. The Certificate of Final Acceptance states 6 August 1999 as the contract date.
Nee. Het «Certificate of Final Acceptance» vermeldt 6 augustus 1999 als contractdatum.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de klacht dat DUO automatisch leningen aan studenten verstrekt (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is reasonable that DUO automatically converts student grants into loans after the grant phase, forcing students to act to stop unwanted loans, and whether DUO's communication and complaint handling should be reviewed. The secretary rejected the criticism, arguing students retain control via 'Mijn DUO', were warned by mailing, and that DUO's service and complaint procedures meet agreed standards.
DUO's working method is permanently monitored. Accountability for this is given in the annual report.
De werkwijze van DUO wordt permanent gemonitord. Daarover wordt bij het jaarverslag verantwoording afgelegd.

Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk (SP) en Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de wetenschappelijke fraude van de heer Stapel (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

MPs asked the state secretary how the government views the Levelt Committee's recommendations on the Stapel research fraud, including a fraud confidant, five-year data retention, openness in research culture, pressure on researchers, the Independent Science declaration, and protection of affected researchers. The state secretary answered that the recommendations are directed at institutions, that the KNAW and VSNU are acting, that the code of conduct did not fail, and that trust cannot be replaced by bureaucracy.
The recommendations of the Levelt Committee are directed at the institutions concerned.
De aanbevelingen van de Commissie Levelt zijn gericht aan de betrokken instellingen.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over maatregelen waardoor minder studenten een masteropleiding gaan volgen (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about an ISO study finding that about twenty percent of students would not pursue a master's if the master's basic grant is abolished, and about the effects on access, debt and the knowledge-nation ambition. The secretary replies that the basic grant is not simply being abolished but replaced by a social loan scheme that keeps access guaranteed, that savings will be reinvested in quality, and that the study will be considered when the bill is debated.
I propose to take the ISO study into account when the aforementioned bill is considered.
Voor het overige stel ik voor om het ISO-onderzoek te betrekken bij de behandeling van het bovengenoemde wetsvoorstel.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over de reductie van geluidshinder door AWACS-vliegtuigen (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the 35% noise reduction from AWACS flights over the Netherlands by 1 January 2012 is on track, whether conditions should be set under the NATO flight regulation if not, and how noise is measured and whether results are public. The minister replied that NATO and Geilenkirchen base are taking measures to achieve the reduction, referred to a progress report, and attached a proposed noise-reduction validation procedure per a motion.
A proposed noise-reduction validation procedure has been attached to the AWACS progress report, following the Neppérus and Jansen motion.
Aan de Voortgangsrapportage AWACS is in bijlage een voorstel validatieprocedure geluidsreductie toegevoegd, in navolging van de motie Neppérus en Jansen

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Eijsink (beiden PvdA), Jasper van Dijk (SP), Hachchi (D66) en El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse inzet tijdens de Review Conferentie van de

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister how the Netherlands will act at the CCW Review Conference on cluster munitions, including whether a draft Protocol VI with a weaker standard than the CCM should be supported. The minister replied that the Netherlands will push for a protocol with the broadest scope, citing a total ban as the end goal, will promote universalisation of the CCM, and will consider a political declaration if no consensus is reached.
The Netherlands wants a Protocol VI with the broadest possible scope, explicitly including a total ban on cluster munitions as the final goal.
Nederland wil een Protocol VI met zo groot mogelijke reikwijdte, waarin een totaalverbod van clustermunitie expliciet als einddoel wordt opgenomen.

Vragen van het leden Eijsink (PvdA), Hachchi (D66), El Fassed (GL) en Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het massa-ontslag bij BAE systems als gevolg v

MPs asked the ministers about BAE Systems mass layoffs linked to delays and cost overruns in the JSF (F-35) programme and their effects on the Dutch aerospace industry. The government answered that production is ongoing, delays lower near-term output, and the business case will not be re-tendered until accounting checkpoints in 2020 and 2030, while promising no new information beyond existing reports.
I do not have information about the relationship mentioned in question 3, and I cannot make a comparison between the situation in the United Kingdom and that in the Netherlands.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de in vraag 3 genoemde relatie en ik kan geen vergelijking maken van de situatie in het Verenigd Koninkrijk met die in Nederland.

Vragen van het lid Van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de benoeming van een lid van de Raad van Toezicht van de Universiteit Utrecht (ingezonden 21 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the chair of the Utrecht University supervisory board resigned after three nominees were rejected, and why a party colleague was preferred for appointment, along with the criteria used and whether appointment reasoning should be public. The state secretary denies the nominee-profile objection, defends the criteria as unchanged, refuses to disclose reasoning or to motivate appointments to parliament, and says a new Amsterdam chair will be appointed by early next year.
No, this concerns a procedure that must in principle be confidential to prevent candidates from being damaged if an appointment does not go ahead.
Nee, het gaat hier om een procedure die ten principale vertrouwelijk moet zijn om te voorkomen dat kandidaten beschadigd worden indien een benoeming geen doorgang zou vinden.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gesponsord onderzoek (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about Wageningen University's sponsored research on milk and heart health, alleged industry influence, transparency of research funding and professors' side jobs. The government declined to judge scientific quality, pointed to existing integrity codes and the LOWI, said transparency is important and promised to ask institutions to keep side-job registers up to date.
I share the view that side functions should in principle be public.
Ik deel de opvatting dat nevenfuncties in principe openbaar moeten zijn.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over terugvorderingen vanwege te hoge salarissen voor bestuurders (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether the excessive salary of the TU Delft board chair was recovered, whether the recovery came from the institution or the person, and whether statutory tools exist to recover from individual board members, including for InHolland. The government answers that recovery was made from the institution's state grant, that the WNT bill will allow recovery from individual executives, and that the InHolland recovery and the prosecutor's inquiry are still pending.
Only after the WNT takes effect will I have legal options to recover remuneration exceeding the statutory norm from the executive concerned.
Pas na inwerkingtreding van de WNT heb ik juridische mogelijkheden om bezoldigingen – voor zover zij de wettelijke norm te boven gaan – terug te vorderen bij de betrokken bestuurder.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kamernood onder studenten (ingezonden 9 september

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the state secretary and minister about the shortage of student rooms, cited LSVb figures of a 30,000-room shortfall, and asked about Utrecht, other cities, office conversion and an action plan. The minister answered that an action plan and a monitor with Kences are being developed, that municipalities are responsible for adding housing, and that the Bouwbesluit 2012 will ease conversions of offices.
Vragen van het lid Van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de groei van het aantal buitenlandse studenten in het hoger onderwijs (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the growth of foreign students in Dutch higher education, the public funding per student, quality and accessibility risks, and university recruitment spending abroad. The government says growth is welcome but must not compromise quality, pledges a study of costs and benefits, and defends the Saudi Arabia and university advertising as legitimate.
I am currently having a study carried out into the societal costs and benefits of internationalisation of our higher education.
Momenteel laat ik een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de maatschappelijke kosten en baten van de internationalisering van ons hoger onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een fusie van de universiteiten Leiden, Delft en Rotterdam (ingezonden 26 juli 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Education about reported plans to merge the universities of Leiden, Delft and Rotterdam, including effects on governance, staff and student input, and whether a fusion test applies. The State Secretary says cooperation is for the institutions to pursue, that a legal change would be needed for a full merger which would be assessed case by case with strict conditions, and that the fusion test applies only once a real merger is legally possible.
For now I assume that the current legal frameworks offer sufficient room for cooperation between universities.
Vooralsnog ga ik ervan uit dat de huidige wettelijke kaders voldoende ruimte bieden voor samenwerking tussen universiteiten
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de verkoop van een deel van de collectie van het Wereldmuseum (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a Rotterdam museum's plan to sell part of its collection, including Africa objects, and whether this breaches the LAMO deaccession code and harms public trust. The state secretary said he shares no concern at this stage, relies on municipal responsibility and museum self-regulation, and noted that no concrete proposal has yet reached decision-making.

I trust that the Municipality of Rotterdam will take its responsibility toward donors and the public, take sensitive provenance issues into account, and work to preserve the Rotterdam collections for future generations.

Ik ga ervan uit dat de Gemeente Rotterdam zijn verantwoordelijkheid neemt jegens schenkers en publiek, rekening houdt met gevoelige herkomstvraagstukken en zich inzet voor het behoud van de Rotterdamse collecties.

Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Smits (beiden SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over tegenvallende resultaten van toetsen en de nadruk op rekenen en taal (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Education whether her emphasis on reading and arithmetic, following critics who argued it would crowd out other subjects and lead to teaching to the test, was sound. The minister rejected the claimed trade-off, said the Dutch approach differs from the US and England, and relied on school professionalism and inspectorate indicators rather than committing to new safeguards.
I trust the professionalism of schools and teachers to handle tests sensibly and not to focus education solely on achieving a good test score.
Ik vertrouw op de professionaliteit van scholen en leraren om op een verstandige manier met toetsen om te gaan en het onderwijs niet uitsluitend te richten op een goede score op een toets.

Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de problemen met zendmasten (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

MPs Van Dijk and Gesthuizen asked the ministers about the failures of the Hoogersmilde and Lopik broadcast masts, the fragmented private ownership, the lack of clear responsibility, whether masts should be publicly owned, and an investigation. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing, that masts are not in principle a public responsibility except for non-duplicable infrastructure, that existing emergency-broadcast arrangements suffice, and that a mediator has been appointed for Lopik.
The investigations into the cause of this serious situation resulting from the fires have not yet been completed.
De onderzoeken naar het ontstaan van deze ernstige situatie als gevolg van de branden zijn nog niet afgerond.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over problemen met kabelbedrijf Ziggo (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers about Ziggo cutting its analogue cable package from 30 to 25 channels, dropping CNN, BBC and others, and related complaints about forced digital migration, Caiway's analogue shutdown, Canal Digitaal regional channels, and calls for an independent complaints body. The ministers answered that the Mediawet permits these choices, that programme councils and the Commissariaat voor de Media handle disputes, that OPTA no longer regulates the TV market ex ante, and that the Consumentenautoriteit lacks competence, while promising to inform parliament after the recess about follow-up on cable distribution rules.

As I reported in my letter of 23 June to the House, I will inform the House after the summer recess what follow-up this cabinet gives to the proposed change of cable distribution rules in the Mediawet.

Zoals ik in een brief van 23 juni j.l. aan de Kamer heb gemeld, zal ik de Kamer na het zomerreces informeren welk vervolg dit kabinet geeft aan de voorgenomen wijziging van regels voor kabeldistributie in de Mediawet.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het uitbuiten van buitenlandse studenten (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Interior about landlord DUWO charging foreign students more for rooms, opaque service costs, a bedding and kitchen fee, a cushion deduction, missing smoke detectors, landlord entry without consent, and whether an investigation into exploitation of foreign students would be carried out. The minister largely defended DUWO's practices as cost-based and legal, pointed to tenants' right to a Huurcommissie review, and said the best remedy is more local student housing via an action plan to be drawn up in autumn with stakeholders.
Increasing the supply of student housing at local level is in my view the best means of countering possible abuses.
Het vergroten van het woningaanbod voor studenten op lokaal niveau is in mijn ogen het beste middel om eventuele misstanden tegen te gaan.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een mogelijke fusie tussen de Vrije Universiteit (VU) en Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) (ingezonden 27 mei 2011)

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Education about reports that the VU and UvA are considering a far-reaching alliance or merger, and whether it falls under the merger test and whether staff should be consulted. The state secretary answers that the cooperation is not a merger covered by the merger test, that it is for the institutions to explore, that staff involvement must follow existing rules, and declines to intervene.
No. The merger test concerns administrative and institutional mergers; such a merger is not being considered.
Nee. De fusietoets heeft betrekking op bestuurlijke en institutionele fusies; een dergelijke fusie wordt niet overwogen.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het verstrekken van een wapenexportvergunning aan een verdachte van drugshandel (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked whether an arms-export licence was granted in 2009 to a company owned by a man convicted of drug trafficking, and how licence applicants are screened for criminal background. The state secretary confirmed the licence and small deliveries, said no lists of persons facing prosecution are kept and that a conviction unrelated to strategic goods is not a ground for refusal, and declined to commit to BIBOB-style screening.
Standard screening for convictions for offences other than those related to strategic goods does not take place and is also of little use.
Een standaard screening op eventuele veroordelingen voor andere delicten dan in samenhang met strategische goederen vindt niet plaats en is ook weinig zinvol.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bouw door een Nederlandse werf van tankland

Two SP MPs asked whether a Dutch-linked shipyard in Cuba (DAMEX, a joint venture with Damen Shipyards) builds tank-landing-type ships for the Venezuelan navy with possible military use, and whether Dutch arms export policy applies. The state secretary answered that the ships are unarmed RoRo cargo vessels not classified as military, that the joint venture falls under Cuban law and outside Dutch arms export policy, and that the government shares concern only about military deliveries that threaten regional stability, which it does not see here.
These ships do not fall under Dutch arms export policy.
Deze schepen vallen niet onder het Nederlandse wapenexportbeleid.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een advertorial voor Hogeschool InHolland (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether a two-page advertorial by InHolland's chair was an inappropriate use of education budget given the institution's controversies, whether it was paid from institutional funds, and whether the state secretary would act on hogescholen's PR spending. The state secretary answered that institutions are responsible for their advertising, the EUR 20,000 cost came from InHolland's marketing budget, the state secretary sees no reason to intervene and does not hold an overview of advertising spend.
No, I do not have such an overview.
Nee, ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de topsalarissen bij Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary about top salaries at Buma/Stemra (over 200,000 euro for several board members), whether they should be capped, whether members have democratic means to act, and whether a spokesperson gag and oversight investigation are justified. The state secretary said the salary decision lies with the board and members, pointed to planned transparency and salary-normalisation rules in the pending Wet toezicht amendment, and said the College van Toezicht saw no reason to investigate for now.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse zaken over een schadeclaim (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about a damages claim of at least five million euro by a former MIVD informant in Uruzgan, including alleged Taliban contacts, weapons orders, a prevented attack, the death of a mullah and the suspension of MIVD staff. The minister replied that operational matters of the MIVD cannot be discussed publicly and offered a confidential briefing to the IVD committee, and that information from protected sources cannot be disclosed.
No public statements can be made about the operational matters of the MIVD. If requested, the IVD committee of your House can be informed.
In het openbaar kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over operationele aangelegenheden van de MIVD. Desgevraagd kan de commissie IVD van uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd.

Vragen van de leden Smits en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over ROC’s die leerlingen verplichten een extra bijdrage te betalen voor het volgen van een opleiding (ingezon

SP MPs asked the education minister about MBO colleges requiring students to pay extra voluntary contributions beyond tuition, including a Horizon College case where enrolment was blocked. The minister answered that enrolment cannot be made conditional on payments other than tuition, that required learning materials should not be charged, and that the inspectorate and MBO Raad will be asked to update guidance, with sanctions as a last resort.
Enrolment in a programme cannot be made conditional on financial contributions other than tuition fees (article 8.1.4 of the Adult and Vocational Education Act).
De inschrijving voor een opleiding kan niet afhankelijk gesteld worden van andere geldelijke bijdragen dan het les- of cursusgeld (artikel 8.1.4 van de Wet Educatie Beroepsonderwijs).
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de onafhankelijkheid van universiteitsbladen (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the Radboud University board censored the VOX student paper and whether that is compatible with editorial independence, and asked about communication-department costs and the state's role. The state secretary answered that the print paper remains independent, the online version is run by communications and now restricted, that universities are autonomous, and that he will keep urging respect for editorial independence without intervening.
University papers and their journalistic independence indeed fall under the responsibility of an institution.
Universiteitsbladen en hun journalistieke onafhankelijkheid vallen inderdaad onder de verantwoordelijkheid van een instelling.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Van Dijk en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de inzet Nederlandse militairen in Sahel-landen (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

SP MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs whether Dutch participation in the Flintlock exercises in the Sahel, linked to US counter-terrorism operations, was disclosed to parliament, why no artikel 100 procedure was used, and whether the operation militarises Sahel problems. The minister answered that Flintlock is a training exercise, not an operation, that parliament is not informed of such exercises, and that the programme does not militarise the region's political problems.
Since the Dutch military deployment concerns an exercise, the House of Representatives is not informed about it.
Aangezien de Nederlandse militaire inzet betrekking heeft op een oefening wordt de Kamer daarover niet geïnformeerd.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een proef aan de Erasmus Universiteit waarbij studenten in het eerste jaar honderd procent van de studiepunten moe

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the state secretary about an Erasmus University pilot requiring first-year students to earn all 60 credits, raising concerns about illness, teaching failures, compensation and quality. The state secretary supported the initiative to raise study efficiency, said illness is covered by personal circumstances rules with appeal routes, and said the pilot may be extended university-wide depending on initial results.
Against BSA decisions the student can appeal to the examination board, the Examinations Appeals Board and ultimately the Higher Education Appeals Tribunal.
Tegen BSA-beslissingen kan de student in beroep bij de examencommissie, de Commissie Beroep Examens en uiteindelijk de Commissie Beroep Hoger Onderwijs.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) en Timmermans en Eijsink (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse zaken en van Defensie over eventueel gebruik van munitie met verarmd uranium en clust

MPs from SP and PvdA asked the Foreign and Defence ministers how Dutch support for UN resolution 65/55 on depleted uranium translates into action, whether a moratorium is considered, whether the US, UK, Israel and Russia will be asked to release strike coordinates, whether depleted uranium or cluster munitions were used in Libya, and whether non-signatories will be urged to stop using cluster munitions. The government answered that it supports further health research and protective guidelines but sees no basis for a moratorium, will not repeat the request for coordinates, found no confirmed US depleted uranium use in Libya and uses none itself, and will urge non-signatories to join the cluster munitions convention.
The government takes note of such research with interest and appreciates the efforts undertaken in this area by international organisations and research institutions.
De regering neemt met belangstelling kennis van dergelijk onderzoek en waardeert de inspanningen die op dit gebied door internationale organisaties en onderzoeksinstellingen worden verricht.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over Nederlandse universiteiten die studenten werven in Saudi-Arabië (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch universities recruiting students in Saudi Arabia for paid contract education, a Dutch education attaché in Riyadh, and a numerus fixus conflict with Dutch students' access. The state secretary replied that contract education is cost-covering and does not displace Dutch students or public funds, that the attaché's costs are shared with the ministry as internationalisation policy, and that institutions are free to offer such education within those conditions.
This concerns contract education under the condition that it must be cost-covering and may not come at the expense of regular students and/or public funds.
Het gaat hier om contractonderwijs waarbij de voorwaarde geldt dat het kostendekkend moet zijn en niet ten koste mag gaan van reguliere studenten en/of publieke middelen.
Vragen van de leden Eijsink (PvdA) en Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over het bericht «Spijkers naar rechter om «psychiatrisering»» (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Eijsink and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Defence whether Defence-related psychiatric documents wrongly labelled Spijkers as suffering from a personality disorder and whether those responsible would be held accountable. The minister answered that the documents came from the former RBB, that the occupational physician's summary was judged not culpable enough for a sanction, and that the Central Appeals Tribunal found no psychiatrisation, so no further consequences or rehabilitation were announced.
The conduct of the occupational physician concerned was ultimately reviewed in 1994 by the highest body in healthcare, the Central Medical Disciplinary Board.
Het handelen van de betrokken bedrijfsarts is in 1994 uiteindelijk getoetst door de hoogste instantie in de gezondheidszorg, het Centraal Medisch Tuchtcollege.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham (D66), Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA), De Rouwe (CDA), Jasper van Dijk (SP), Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de boeten rond de bijve

MPs asked the state secretary about DUO's letters to about 20,000 students who exceeded the income limit for study grants in 2008, the switch to gross income, appeal options, repayment of OV-card costs and possible hardship relief. The state secretary said the number fits a rising trend, that appeals against DUO decisions are possible while the income figure itself must be contested with the tax authority, and that no hardship scheme is planned.
I see no possibilities to arrive at a hardship scheme for this group.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om voor deze groep tot een coulance-regeling te komen.
Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk (SP) en Eijsink (PvdA) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de JSF (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) and Eijsink (PvdA) asked the ministers of Defence and Economic Affairs about the reported loss of up to one billion euro for Dutch firms if the US cancels the F136 second engine for the F-35, whether this breaches agreements, and whether the Netherlands should cancel its test aircraft purchase. The government replied that the US Congress has not finalised the decision, that Dutch supplier orders were estimated at about $750 million per engine type, that cancelling F136 would not be contract breach, and that the second test aircraft purchase set in the coalition agreement will be communicated later.
If the F136 programme is indeed terminated, the ministry of EL&I will, together with the Dutch industry concerned, map out the consequences for orders and turnover expectations.
Indien het F136-programma inderdaad wordt beëindigd, zal het ministerie van EL&I samen met de betrokken Nederlandse industrie de gevolgen in kaart brengen voor de opdrachten en de omzetverwachting.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP) en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over wapenuitvoer naar Noord-Afrika en het Mid

MPs Van Bommel and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch arms exports to Libya occurred in 2008-2009, why the 2004 EU arms embargo was lifted, whether export criteria and embargoes should be tightened for Arab states, and whether Dutch firms should be discouraged from exhibiting at IDEX 2011. The minister answered that some licences (helicopter parts swap, night-vision devices) were granted but not actually executed, that the UN and EU imposed an embargo on Libya, and that new export applications to Bahrain, Yemen, Tunisia and Egypt are on hold.
For Libya, Syria and Iran, no arms export licences are being issued.
Voor Libië, Syrië en Iran geldt dat geen wapenexportvergunningen worden afgegeven.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen met kabelexploitanten (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Ziggo reducing its analogue channel package and whether foreign public broadcasters will remain available, and about the role of local programme councils and channel-selection rules. The Minister answers that pricing is not government's concern, cites OPTA and NMa powers and the Mediawet's advisory and dispute procedures, and promises a letter before summer on reforming the programme councils.
Before the summer I will inform the House what follow-up this cabinet gives to the proposed amendment to replace the programme council system with a modern form of consumer influence.

Voor de zomer zal ik de Kamer informeren welk vervolg dit kabinet geeft aan de voorgenomen wetswijziging om het systeem van programmaraden te vervangen door een eigentijdse variant van consumenteninvloed.
Vragen van de leden Eijsink (PvdA) en Jasper van Dijk (SP) over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep in de zaak Spijkers (23 december 2010) (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

MPs Eijsink and Jasper van Dijk asked the defence minister whether he knew of the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling in the Spijkers case, what action was taken, and whether the ministry contacted Mr Spijkers. The minister replied that the dismissal and benefit scheme were upheld but two considerations were revised because Defence had acted negligently, and that Defence paid compensation and contacted the FNV, Spijkers' union, with no further action taken.
Following the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling and the revised considerations, Defence contacted the FNV, which represents Mr Spijkers.
Naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep en de herziene overwegingen heeft Defensie contact opgenomen met de FNV, die de heer Spijkers bijstaat.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over wapenhandel naar Egypte (ingezonden 15 februar

SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Dutch arms exports to Egypt, including whether licences were granted for armoured vehicle parts, whether France and Germany suspended exports, whether YPR vehicles were used against protesters, and whether pending licences would be refused. The government confirmed a 2009 licence of about 1.2 million for YPR and M-113 parts, said it does not monitor end-use of goods delivered to foreign governments, and stated that one new licence was issued in 2011 with its export temporarily postponed at the company's request while remaining applications will be assessed case by case.
It is not usual to monitor goods supplied to another government.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om toezicht te houden op aan een andere overheid geleverde goederen.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen op bibliotheken (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary of Education, Culture and Science how he responds to reports that many public libraries may close due to municipal budget cuts, and whether the coalition pledge to spare libraries is meaningful. The state secretary replies that local cuts are not yet quantified, that libraries remain a municipal responsibility, that the national library budget will be spared as far as possible, and that he will raise the motion with the VNG at the next consultation.
I will raise this topic at the next administrative consultation with the VNG and inform the House about the outcomes.
Ik zal dit onderwerp bij het eerstvolgende bestuurlijk overleg met de VNG aan de orde stellen en de Kamer over de uitkomsten informeren.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) en Van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten (VS) niet bereid waren Nederland te helpen bij het bep

MPs asked whether the US refused to help the Netherlands reduce noise from AWACS aircraft at Geilenkirchen, whether the government misled parliament about engine replacement given US reluctance, why the minister of Environment lobbied for a flight simulator while Defence doubted it, and whether the NAPMO board was informed of a parliamentary motion. The minister declined to comment on alleged US internal assessments, but described the engine-replacement study, the simulator investment and the notification of the NAPMO board about the motion.
As set out in today's letter from the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, the cabinet cannot be expected to answer questions on the accuracy of the alleged American intelligence reports.

Antwoord 2 en 3 Zoals uiteengezet in de brief van heden van de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (kenmerk 2011–2000011311) mag van de zijde van het kabinet geen antwoord worden verwacht op vragen over de juistheid van de inhoud van de vermeende Amerikaanse ambtsberichten.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over studenten die moeten betalen voor hun eigen tentamen (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Education whether students must pay to view their own exam papers and whether he will end such practices. The state secretary said charging for viewing is wrong and that institutions do not ask for a payment to view exams, though a cost-covering fee may be charged for a copy and exams are not returned to students.
I consider it wrong if students were to have to pay to view exams.
Ik acht het onjuist indien studenten zouden moeten betalen voor het inzien van tentamens.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Defensie over Nederlandse opleidingscontracten voor huurlingenbedrijven

Two MPs asked the ministers about Dutch training contracts with US private military firms (Blackwater/Xe) and about security personnel at the Islamabad embassy. The government answered that Dutch police and KCT were trained by Terrorism Research Center at Blackwater facilities, that the costs were paid by the ministries involved, and that no further incidents or formal complaints occurred.
The Korps Commando Troepen trained 60 persons at the Blackwater training complex in North Carolina from 10 to 23 February 2005.
Het Korps Commando Troepen heeft van 10 t/m 23 februari 2005 met 60 personen getraind op het Blackwater trainingscomplex in North Carolina.
Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de minister van Defensie over gezondheidsklachten militair personeel in Uruzgan (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked the Defence Minister whether health complaints among soldiers in Uruzgan were linked to emissions from waste incinerators at Kamp Holland, and whether investigations would be shared. The minister answered that studies found only occasional elevated pollutant levels and no likely lasting health damage, promising to inform the House after measurements in Afghanistan are completed.
After the completion of the measurements in Afghanistan, I will inform the House about the Dutch research and the results of British and American studies.
Na de voltooiing van de metingen in Afghanistan zal ik de Kamer informeren over het Nederlandse onderzoek en de resultaten van Britse en Amerikaanse onderzoeken.

Vragen van de leden Eijsink (PvdA) en Van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie naar aanleiding van artikel «HAWK Personeel wist niet van gevaren. Afweer waar je kanker van krijgt. (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

MPs Eijsink and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister whether the safety distance for HAWK radar (ICWAR) was shortened, whether research into health risks for personnel is feasible, and asked for an instruction and manufacturer documents. The minister said safety distances were adjusted 1985–1998 while staying within NATO norms, no link to cancer was shown, research was deemed not feasible, and documents are not held by Defence but will be sent when available.
I will send the relevant parts of the documents to the House as soon as they are available.
Ik zal de relevante delen van de documenten naar de Kamer zenden zodra deze beschikbaar zijn.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen bij hogeschool INHolland (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked why the outgoing board chair of InHolland, a public university of applied sciences, would keep receiving salary until the end of 2010 and receive a severance payment, and whether that is a sober dismissal settlement. The state secretary answered that the contract was ended by mutual agreement with salary paid until 1 January 2011 and a severance afterwards, that the cost exceeds what the kantonrechter formula would give, and that he will reclaim the difference via a letter to the supervisory board.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over studenten van InHolland die via een truc een diploma kregen (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary about InHolland students who obtained diplomas through an alternative graduation track, including accepted substandard theses, pressure on staff, and whether the funding system creates perverse incentives. The state secretary condemns diploma fraud, cites the Leers commission and inspectorate findings, says no financial motive was found, and announces a reduced diploma component in funding from 2011 plus an inspectorate review of other institutions.
At 41 institutions the inspectorate is requesting additional information and will verify the information already available.
Bij 41 instellingen wordt door de inspectie aanvullende informatie opgevraagd en de reeds beschikbare informatie zal geverifieerd worden.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een HBO-docent die studenten zonder de vereiste kwaliteiten een diploma geeft (ingezonden 8 september 2010).

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the state secretary about a HBO lecturer who awarded diplomas to students lacking the required competences, and how such students could reach final stages and whether funding incentives and national exams would help. The state secretary regretted the case, said diplomas are governed by exam committees and accreditation rules, defended the funding model, and committed to an Inspectorate investigation of InHolland with a progress report by mid-January.

The Inspectorate will therefore give the most important parts of the improvement plan the highest attention and report to me on their progress, as far as assessable at that time, by mid-January at the latest.

De inspectie zal daarom de belangrijkste onderdelen van het verbeterplan de grootst mogelijk aandacht geven en mij over de voortgang daarvan voorzover op dat moment te beoordelen uiterlijk half januari rapporteren.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie en de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over het gebruik van een politie-escorte om op tijd te zijn voor intern overleg (ingezonden 28 se

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister about fifteen requests for police or Royal Marechaussee escort to avoid traffic jams, and whether an internal meeting justifies such escort. The minister answers that thirteen escorts were used in 2010, that the requests were needed to perform his duties, that the nature of a meeting does not indicate urgency, that escort costs about 300 euro per hour, and that ministers should be restrained in requesting escort.
Ministers should be restrained when requesting escort from the Marechaussee or the National Police Services Agency (KLPD).
Bewindspersonen dienen terughoudend te zijn bij het aanvragen van begeleiding door de marechaussee of het Korps Landelijke Politiediensten (KLPD).
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verdwijnen van kleinkunst en cabaret op Radio 2 (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Culture whether the move of kleinkunst and cabaret programmes from Radio 2 to Radio 5 Nostalgia was acceptable, and whether politics should intervene in broadcast scheduling. The state secretary replied that programming is the responsibility of the NPO and the broadcasters, that the programmes are moved rather than removed, and that the government will not intervene in programme decisions.
Cultural programming on the public broadcasters is a matter for the NPO.
De culturele programmering op de publieke zenders is een aangelegenheid van de NPO.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat JSF-bedrijven een korting van 245 miljoen euro van de overheid ontvangen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about a press report that JSF industry partners would receive a 245 million euro discount, and whether this breaks the promise that taxpayers would pay nothing. The minister rejected the press framing, explaining the sum combined four unrelated items and that the remaining 52.1 million was offset by cuts in the ministries' budgets, and declined to send the documents, pointing to prior parliamentary information and public WOB disclosure.
I do not recognise the presentation of the matter in the article in question.
Ik herken mij niet in de voorstelling van zaken in het desbetreffende artikel.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over dat jongeren vaak alcoholreclame in de bioscoop zien (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MPs Kooiman and Van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers of Health and Youth whether they would act against alcohol advertising in cinemas that reaches young audiences, and whether they would tighten self-regulation or make it statutory. The minister replied that talks with cinema operators and the alcohol industry body STIVA would come first, that self-regulation should be given a chance before any legal rules, and that a future cabinet could regulate by AMvB if needed.
I want to use this option first before considering statutory measures.
Ik wil deze mogelijkheid eerst benutten voordat ik wettelijke maatregelen overweeg.
Vragen van de leden Smits en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gesjoemel met de kwaliteit in het VO en het HBO (ingezonden 27 juli 2010).

Two MPs asked the state secretary about reports that secondary schools inflate exam grades and pressure teachers over pass rates, and that higher vocational schools hand out diplomas too easily. The state secretary answered that no concrete cases or signals were known, pointed to inspection safeguards and a planned inspection investigation into higher vocational diplomas, and gave an overall reply on the matter.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over het bericht dat militairen drugsgebruik aanwenden om uitzending te vermijden (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Defence Minister whether soldiers use drugs to avoid deployment to Afghanistan, how many have been dismissed for drug use, whether dismissals and refusals to deploy are investigated, why soldiers refuse missions, and how many have left the armed forces and used parental exemptions. The minister answered that the report lacks factual basis, cited steady dismissal figures of about 70 a year, saw no need for further investigation, and gave departure and exemption information.
The report lacks a factual basis.
Het bericht ontbeert een feitelijke grondslag.

Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Economische Zaken over een financiële bijdrage van de gemeente Papendrecht voor de komst van een fabriek van Stork Fokker (ingezonden 6 juli 20

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the municipality of Papendrecht's financial contribution, including land and hall lease constructions, to a Stork Fokker JSF parts factory constitutes state aid and whether the factory fits the JSF-testing motion. The minister answered that the municipality autonomously bid, self-assessed the state-aid rules as not applicable, and bears responsibility for its offer, with BZK only coordinating if a notification is needed.
The autonomy of Dutch subnational governments means they are themselves responsible for their offers and for correctly complying with the state-aid rules.
De autonomie van de Nederlandse decentrale overheden maakt dat zij zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor hun aanbiedingen en de correcte naleving van de staatssteunregels.

Vragen van de leden Eijsink (PvdA), Jasper van Dijk (SP) en El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Defensie over de blootstelling van militairen aan mangaan en andere schadelijke metalen in zand van zandstormen in on

MPs asked the defence minister about possible health effects of manganese and other metals in sandstorm dust on soldiers in Afghanistan and Iraq, and about traumatic brain injury findings. The minister said the metal risk is considered negligible based on measurements, that health complaints from metals have not been recorded, and that Defence will await the final US study and monitor dust exposure.
If the findings have consequences for the assessment of health risks for soldiers in the deployment area, an appraisal will be sent to the House of Representatives.
Als de bevindingen consequenties hebben voor de inschatting van gezondheidsrisico's voor militairen in het uitzendgebied zal een appreciatie naar de Tweede Kamer worden gestuurd.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over kritiek op de JSF in de VS (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the defence minister how he judged critical US voices on the JSF (F-35) fighter, whether opponents' concerns were accepted, whether supporters have vested interests, whether upgrading F-16s is preferable, and how far options to end participation in the JSF test phase had progressed. The minister said the critics' views were known since 2008 and that the F-35 was assessed as meeting Dutch requirements, rejected the vested-interest claim and an F-16 upgrade, and said options for ending participation would take some weeks.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over een onderzoek naar geluidsoverlast van de JSF (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether the government commissioned RIVM to validate the NLR report on JSF (F-35) noise, why this is pursued despite parliamentary motions to halt new JSF investments, and whether the EUR 50,000 could be better spent. The minister answered that the validation was commissioned by the province of Fryslân with Defence as co-client to resolve remaining uncertainties, and declined to ask the province to cancel it.
The Ministry of Defence is co-client of the study.
Het ministerie van Defensie is medeopdrachtgever van het onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de deelname van de staatssecretaris aan de Gay Pride (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether her participation in the Gay Pride boat is hypocritical given government support for schools being able to refuse gay teachers, and whether it signals a change of position. She answered that there is no tension with the balance in the equal treatment act between anti-discrimination and freedom of education, that joining the parade underlines active policy for social acceptance of homosexuality, and that she invited volunteers from various organisations to show the progress made.
There is no tension between joining the Gay Pride parade and accepting the balance set out in the General Equal Treatment Act between the prohibition of discrimination and freedom of education.

Er is geen spanning tussen het meevaren op de Gay Pride en het aanvaarden van de in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling vastgelegde balans tussen het verbod op discriminatie en de vrijheid van onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over fraude bij Hogeschool Windesheim (ingezonden 23 juni 2010).

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the state secretary for Education how the fraud of over 800,000 euro at Windesheim University of Applied Sciences happened, whether it relates to lumpsum funding, whether the supervisory board supervised finances adequately, and what measures will prevent such fraud and whether further cases are known. The state secretary said the fraud cannot yet be explained, awaits a forensic investigation commissioned by the board, refers to accountant controls and inspectorate procedures, and reported nine signals of fraud in 2009.
The Executive Board of Windesheim University of Applied Sciences immediately after the FIOD report commissioned an external firm to carry out a forensic investigation into the fraud in question.

Het College van Bestuur van Hogeschool Windesheim heeft direct na de melding van de FIOD aan een extern bureau de opdracht verstrekt om een forensisch onderzoek naar de onderhavige fraude te laten uitvoeren.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over een publicatieverbod van een tijdschrift over Srebrenica (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister why the Land Forces Command blocked a special Srebrenica issue of the NCO magazine De Onderofficier, whether the minister knew of it, and whether it conflicts with editorial freedom. The minister says the command, which publishes the magazine, gave binding guidance that a Srebrenica edition was not opportune, that the minister regrets it and it should not recur, and that the editors may still publish on the subject.
This should not have happened this way, and as far as I am concerned it will not happen again.
Dit had zo niet mogen gebeuren en wat mij betreft zal het niet nog eens gebeuren.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een hoger collegegeld voor een tweede studie (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

An SP MP asks the state secretary of Education whether higher tuition for a second degree, especially for teachers, is undesirable and inconsistent with teacher retraining and shortage policy, and asks about transparency and transition for current students. The state secretary defends the statutory and institutional tuition system, the teacher and healthcare exemption, and existing scholarships, and declines to change the policy.
No, I refer you for this to the debate on the bill strengthening governance.
Neen, ik verwijs u hiervoor naar de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel versterking besturing.

Vragen van de leden Smits en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarisvan Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over oud-studenten die moeten betalen voor de naamsverandering van de IB-groep naar DUO (ingezonden 22

MPs Smits and Jasper van Dijk asked the state secretary whether former students paying off study debts via bailiffs should be charged 74.54 euro because the IB-groep was renamed DUO, and whether they would act to stop this and inform debtors. The state secretary answered that debtors should not have to pay this charge, that bailiffs rarely pass on such costs under the formal procedure, and that debtors can file a complaint with DUO to be reimbursed.
It is not intended that debtors should have to pay the 74.54 euro that results from a service of process.
Het is niet de bedoeling dat debiteuren 74,54 euro moeten betalen, die van een betekening het gevolg is.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het inschakelen van tandartsassistenten die verdoven, wort

MPs Van Gerven and Jasper van Dijk asked whether dental assistants with short training perform invasive procedures such as anaesthesia, root canal treatment, drilling and filling, and about related dental-care oversight, capacity and quality issues. The minister said such delegation is lawful under strict conditions, that the Inspectorate may review its circular, and that the Inspectorate's oversight capacity and training capacity questions will be addressed in a forthcoming cabinet response.
I will therefore consult with the Inspectorate to examine whether its aforementioned circular needs tightening.
Om die reden zal ik in overleg met de Inspectie nagaan of haar voornoemde circulaire aanscherping behoeft.

Vragen van de leden Kraneveldt-van der Veen (PvdA) en Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het instandhouden dan wel bevorderen van openbaar onderwijs (ingezonden 12 mei 2010).

MPs asked whether it is undesirable that autonomous public-education boards may not promote public education after a Council of State ruling led to amended articles of association, and asked about a planned statutory amendment, its effect, and its timing. The minister confirmed the reported facts, explained that the ruling does not bar promotion per se but that new public schools can currently only be founded by the municipality, and said a planned amendment to allow boards to request new schools is in preparation, with its submission left to the new cabinet and no timeline given.
However, it is currently not possible for autonomous boards to submit a request to the municipality to establish a new public school.
Wel is het zo dat het op dit moment niet mogelijk is voor verzelfstandigde besturen om een verzoek in te dienen bij de gemeente tot het stichten van een nieuwe openbare school.

Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk (SP) en Besselink (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het advies van de VO-raad over de borg bij de gratis schoolboeken (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

Two MPs asked the state secretary whether she still stands by her statement that parents need not sign school cost agreements, and how she views required deposits for school books in distributors' terms and the VO-raad advice on them. The state secretary answered that schools, not distributors, are responsible for the deposit procedure, that supply must not depend on paying a deposit, and that the inspectorate will act on non-compliance, but mostly placed responsibility on parents and school participation councils.
However, the delivery of the school books may not be made dependent on paying a deposit.
De levering van de schoolboeken mag echter niet afhankelijk worden gesteld van het betalen van een borg.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een verschillende collegegeld voor dezelfde studie (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary whether Tilburg University may charge students who did not study there a higher institutional tuition fee than its own students for a second degree, and whether such differences are justified given accessibility concerns. The state secretary answers that the law allows institutions to differentiate institutional tuition, subject to equal-treatment law and reasoned decisions, and refers to the parliamentary debate on the governance reform for the rest.
Equal cases must be treated equally and unequal cases may be treated unequally.
Gelijke gevallen moeten gelijk en ongelijke gevallen kunnen ongelijk worden behandeld.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een miljoenenstrop bij de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Hogeschool van Amsterdam's EUR 300 million Amstelcampus real-estate project, including shops, housing and a car park, is an unacceptable use of teaching budget, and whether it is delayed, loses money, pays a EUR 17 million claim, and should be unwound through a merger with the University of Amsterdam. The state secretary answered that the institution's own board decides construction, that the project is on schedule with permits in place, that the institution is not a property developer, that no financial or educational problems have been established, and that no inspection or change to housing responsibilities is planned.
So far it has not become apparent to me that there are financial problems at the HvA or deficient education.
Vooralsnog is mij niet gebleken dat sprake is van financiële problemen bij de HvA of van tekortschietend onderwijs.

m: Motie van de leden Wörsdörfer en Voordewind over plannen gericht op kleinschalige transformatie
Asks the government to work with municipalities on how concrete plans for small-scale transformation of youth care can fit into regional visions.
requests the government, together with municipalities, to examine how concrete plans aimed at small-scale transformation can find a place in the regional visions to be formed
verzoekt de regering, om samen met gemeenten te bezien hoe concrete plannen gericht op kleinschalige transformatie een plek kunnen krijgen in de te vormen regiovisies
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over een onafhankelijke werkgroep voor integrale behandelingen bij eetstoornissencasuïstiek
Asks the government to set up an independent working group on integrated treatment for children with complex eating disorder cases.
requests the government, together with experts and regional expertise centres, to set up an independent working group
verzoekt de regering, samen met deskundigen en de regionale expertisecentra een onafhankelijke werkgroep in te stellen
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer c.s. over betere kennis en kunde van raadsleden over jeugdzorg
Asks the government, with the VNG and the councillors' association, to explore how councillors' knowledge for overseeing youth care can be improved.
requests the government to enter into discussion with the VNG and the Association of Councillors to explore how this knowledge and skill can be improved
verzoekt de regering, met de VNG en de Vereniging voor Raadsleden in gesprek te gaan om te bezien hoe deze kennis en kunde verbeterd kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer c.s. over een kader voor scherpere keuzes over wat onder jeugdhulp wordt verstaan
Asks the government with municipalities, parents, youth and professionals to develop a framework helping municipalities make sharper choices about what counts as youth care.
requests the government, together with municipalities, parents and young people and professionals, to arrive at a framework
verzoekt de regering, samen met de gemeenten, met ouders en jongeren en met professionals te komen tot een kader
Motie van het lid Peters c.s. over het regelen van regie op kleinschalige zorginitiatieven
Asks the government to arrange coordination (regie) over the shift from large-scale to small-scale youth care initiatives.
requests the government to arrange coordination of the good movement towards small-scale initiatives
verzoekt de regering, regie te regelen op de goede beweging richting kleinschalige initiatieven
Motie van de leden Wörsdörfer en Renkema over concrete verbeteringen en aanpassingen in de toekomstige begroting, jaarverslag en VWS-monitor
Asks the government for concrete improvements to the future VWS budget, annual report and monitor, plus a roadmap, to give parliament better insight into policy goals and results.
requests the government to come with concrete improvements and adjustments in the future budget, annual report and VWS monitor
verzoekt de regering, met concrete verbeteringen en aanpassingen in de toekomstige begroting, jaarverslag en VWS-monitor te komen
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer over de wettelijke verjaringstermijn tussen jeugdhulp en facturatie verkleinen
Asks the government to shorten the statutory limitation period between youth care provision and invoicing so municipalities get timelier cost information.
to shorten the statutory limitation period between youth care and claim and invoicing
de wettelijke verjaringstermijn tussen jeugdhulp en vordering en facturatie te verkleinen
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer over de rol van kleine ondernemingen bij het aanpakken van de schuldenproblematiek
Asks the government to consult MKB-Nederland on how small businesses can help prevent and address debts among customers and employees.
requests the government to engage with MKB-Nederland to see how entrepreneurs can best prevent debts
verzoekt de regering, om in gesprek te gaan met MKB-Nederland om te kijken op welke manier ondernemers het beste schulden kunnen voorkomen
Motie van de leden Wörsdörfer en Raemakers over ondersteuning van deelnemers aan een Wsnp-traject

Asks the government to investigate how Wsnp debt-settlement participants can be supported in managing their finances after completing the process, and whether a cost-benefit analysis for municipalities is possible.
requests the government to investigate how participants in a Wsnp process can be supported in learning to manage their bookkeeping well
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken op welke manier deelnemers aan een Wsnp-traject (kunnen) worden ondersteund om goed om te leren gaan met hun boekhouding
Motie van de leden Peters en Wörsdörfer over vereenvoudiging van de klacht- en beroepsprocedures
Asks the government to consult stakeholders and simplify the complaint and appeal procedures in the youth protection chain, reporting progress to the House every half year.

requests the government to consult interest groups, researchers and experience experts to achieve a strong simplification of the complaint and appeal procedures, and to report progress to the House every half year

verzoekt de regering, om in overleg te treden met belangenorganisaties, onderzoekers en ervaringsdeskundigen om te komen tot een sterke vereenvoudiging van de klacht- en beroepsprocedures, en de Kamer ieder halfjaar over de voortgang hiervan te rapporteren
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer over het zo veel mogelijk beperken van lokale en regionale verantwoordingseisen
Asks the government, in consultation with municipalities, to limit or streamline local and regional accountability requirements imposed on youth care providers.
requests the government, in consultation with municipalities, to limit as much as possible or streamline local and regional accountability requirements
verzoekt de regering, lokale en regionale verantwoordingseisen in overleg met gemeenten zo veel mogelijk te beperken dan wel te stroomlijnen
Motie van het lid Bergkamp c.s. over de aansluiting van de praktijkondersteuners op het SectorplanPlus
Asks the government to strengthen the connection of practice support staff and broader youth care to the SectorplanPlus training subsidy and report results to the House.
requests the government to strengthen the connection of practice support staff and broader youth care to the SectorplanPlus
verzoekt de regering, om de aansluiting van de praktijkondersteuners, alsmede de bredere jeugdzorg, op het SectorplanPlus te versterken
Motie van het lid Bergkamp c.s. over advies over de kansen en risico's van regionalisering in de zorg
Asks the government to have the Raad voor het Openbaar Bestuur advise on risks of regionalisation in health care, including reduced democratic control and the fit of region boundaries.
Motie van het lid Voordwind c.s. over het onafhankelijk van Rijk en gemeenten positioneren van de Jeugdautoriteit
Asks the government to position the Youth Authority (Jeugdautoriteit) independently of national government and municipalities, mainly to intervene in regions where youth care is failing.
requests the government to position the Youth Authority independently of national government and municipalities
verzoekt de regering, de Jeugdautoriteit onafhankelijk van Rijk en gemeenten te positioneren
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer over handhaven van de verruiming van de BMKB
Asks the government to keep the 2013 expansion of the BMKB business loan guarantee scheme in place until its 2021 evaluation.
requests the government to maintain the 2013 increase of the guarantee credit maximum from 1 million euro to 1.5 million euro
verzoekt de regering, de verruiming uit 2013 van het maximum van het borgstellingskrediet van 1 miljoen euro naar 1,5 miljoen euro
Motie van de leden Wörsdörfer en Sneller over onderzoek naar de praktijk van zekerheidstelling bij mkb-financiering
Asks the government to research collateral practice in SME financing, comparing with other EU member states.
requests the government to investigate the practice of collateral in SME financing
verzoekt de regering, om onderzoek te doen naar de praktijk van zekerheidstelling bij mkb-financiering
Amendement van het lid Wörsdörfer over het schrappen van de bepaling over het databankenrecht
Proposes deleting the provision that reserves database rights for the Chamber of Commerce in the Trade Register, as the question of such rights should be left to a court.
Therefore the proposal of the submitter to delete the provision on database rights.
Derhalve het voorstel van de indiener om de bepaling over databankenrecht te schrappen.
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer over herijking van het zekerhedenrecht
Asks the government to investigate how the Dutch security rights law can be revised so that SMEs obtain financing more easily.
requests the government to investigate how security rights can be recalibrated so that SME entrepreneurs qualify for financing more quickly
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe het zekerhedenrecht herijkt kan worden, zodat mkb-ondernemers sneller in aanmerking komen voor financiering
Amendement van de leden Amhaouch en Wörsdörfer ter vervanging van nr. 13 over 5 miljoen voor de sector HTSM
Shifts 5 million euro within the departmental budget from the innovation and sustainable entrepreneurship line and the Toekomstfonds to support innovation in the HTSM sector.
This amendment ensures that 5 million euro becomes available for the HTSM sector in 2019.
Dit amendement bewerkstelligt dat voor de sector HTSM in 2019 een bedrag van € 5 mln. beschikbaar komt
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer over de administratieve verplichtingen in kaart brengen
Asks the government, with implementing agencies, to map employers' administrative obligations and propose substantial simplifications.
requests the government, together with the relevant implementing agencies, to map the administrative obligations of employership
verzoekt de regering om, samen met de relevante uitvoeringsinstanties, de administratieve verplichtingen van het werkgeverschap in kaart te brengen
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer c.s. over de implementatie van de mkb-toets
Asks the government to present how the SME test (mkb-toets) can be implemented across all departments on a comply-or-explain basis.
requests the government to present, with the evaluation, how the SME test can be implemented
verzoekt de regering, direct bij de evaluatie te presenteren hoe de mkb-toets geïmplementeerd kan gaan worden
Amendement van de leden Amhaouch en Wörsdörfer over 5 miljoen voor de sector HTSM
Shifts €5 million within the departmental budget to fund international innovation for the HTSM sector in 2019, offsetting cuts to the PPS-toeslag.
This amendment ensures that €5 million becomes available for the HTSM sector in 2019 so that companies can innovate internationally in cooperation with knowledge institutions.
Dit amendement bewerkstelligt dat voor de sector HTSM in 2019 een bedrag van € 5 mln. beschikbaar komt zodat bedrijven internationaal kunnen innoveren in samenwerking met kennisinstellingen.
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer c.s. over de ongelijke rechtspositie van inschrijvers versus aanbestedende diensten
Asks the government to present research on the unequal legal position of tenderers versus contracting authorities, including private enforcement and a dedicated court for procurement cases.
requests the government to present the results of this research as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering, de resultaten van dit onderzoek zo snel als mogelijk te presenteren
Motie van het lid Wörsdörfer c.s. over het opleveren van de handreiking tenderkostenvergoeding
Asks the government to press for delivery of the tender-cost compensation guidance before the summer recess.
requests the government to press that the guidance be delivered in any case before the summer recess
verzoekt de regering, erop aan te dringen dat de handreiking in ieder geval nog voor het zomerreces wordt opgeleverd
Motie van de leden Van den Berg en Wörsdörfer over kaders voor vergoedingen in de Tenderkostenvergoeding
Asks the government to examine banning clauses that exclude tender cost compensation and to consider compensation frameworks for bidders when tenders are withdrawn late.
bidders must have the possibility to go to court for compensation
inschrijvers de mogelijkheid moeten hebben om naar de rechter te stappen voor een vergoeding
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over de Verwijsindex Risicojongeren

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Verwijsindex Risicojongeren (youth risk referral index), including whether the promised review covers parents' and children's perspectives, how misuse and stigmatisation are prevented, who checks correct use, and how families can see their registration.
