The State Secretary answered that the in-depth review is ongoing, will include youth and parent organisations, will report after the summer, and that municipalities and the Inspectie are responsible for oversight, with families informed of registrations and able to object.
After the summer I will inform the House of the outcomes of the in-depth study and my policy response to it.
Na de zomer zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het verdiepend onderzoek en mijn beleidsreactie hierop geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over mogelijke dubbele financiering van zorg vanwege samenloop Jeugdzorg en Wlz

An MP asked whether municipalities can check for a Wlz indication before providing youth care, to prevent double financing, and whether GDPR rules block such a check. The State Secretary answered that the Wlz register check cannot be used for youth care without a legal basis or parental consent, that double financing is undesirable but not known to be structural, and that no additional data exchange is deemed desirable.
I am aware of one incident in which there was double financing.
Er is mij één incident bekend, waarbij sprake is geweest van dubbele financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over toezeggingen om in gesprek te gaan met Bureau Krediet Registratie

The MP asks whether the promised talks with BKR on shortening the registration period, especially for corona-related cases, have taken place, and whether people who have restored their finances are wrongly denied credit. The minister says talks occurred at official level, but sees no reason to shorten the five-year retention period because it protects against over-indebtedness, and points to kredietverstrekkers' individual assessment and the Geschillencommissie for disputes.
Given its importance, I currently see no reason to request shortening of the registration period used by BKR.
Gelet op het belang hiervan zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding te vragen om verkorting van de door BKR gehanteerde registratietermijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over signalen over problematiek samenhangend met de overgang van statushouders van een AZC naar de gemeente

VVD MPs asked how status holders are transferred from asylum reception centres to municipalities, what factors guide placement, what funding and information municipalities receive, and whether their care needs and municipal difficulties are being addressed. The State Secretary explained the COA-to-municipality matching and information-sharing process, noted some information gaps and a review underway, and stated that funding and care needs are handled under the same criteria as other residents, with an Ombudsman investigation into unaccompanied minors pending.
Your House will be informed about this shortly.
Uw Kamer wordt hierover op korte termijn geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Wijngaarden over het pleidooi voor effectieve preventie van seksueel geweld

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Wijngaarden asked the state secretary whether he is aware of Rutgers' plea for effective prevention of sexual violence, whether the promised letter on additional prevention steps will still come in January, and whether that letter will respond to the plea. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said Parliament will be informed in February about the interdepartmental approach including prevention, and that Rutgers will receive a separate written reply and an official-level meeting.
Your House will be informed in writing in February about the interdepartmental approach to sexual violence, including prevention of sexual violence.
Uw Kamer wordt in februari schriftelijk geïnformeerd over de interdepartementale aanpak van seksueel geweld, inclusief preventie van seksueel geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het wetgevingsoverleg Jeugd van 23 november 2020

An MP asks whether COVID-19 is being used to frustrate custody visitation arrangements between parents and children, and what parents can do if access is restricted. The state secretary says visitation should continue except where someone has symptoms, points to NJi guidance and existing civil and criminal remedies, and says he will investigate reported signals with stakeholders.
The starting point is and remains that contact between child and parent, including during the coronavirus measures, continues.
Het uitgangspunt is en blijft dat omgang tussen kind en ouder, ook ten tijde van de coronamaatregelen, doorgang vindt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over antwoorden op vragen inzake de berichten ‘Tekorten aan jeugdzorgers steeds nijpender’ en ‘Sterke daling nieuwe werknemers in de jeugdzorg: ‘Zo gaat het kapot’

Two MPs (Wörsdörfer, VVD, and Westerveld, GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary for Health about staff shortages in youth care, the role of the national government, the Arbeidsmarktagenda, tariffs, professional participation, the convenant on stopping time-writing, and simplification of product codes. The State Secretary answered at length, describing ongoing joint programmes and a planned AMvB on reasonable tariffs, but gave mostly general commitments and set a 2022 target for the simplified product codes.
It is not possible to break down the data collected under the Labour Market Care and Welfare research programme by sub-sector.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gegevens die in het kader van het onderzoeksprogramma Arbeidsmarkt Zorg en Welzijn (AZW) worden verzameld uit te splitsen naar subbranches.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Hijink en en Wörsdörfer over wederom een datalek in de jeugdzorg

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health whether a new data leak at a youth care provider (Kenter/Jeugdriagg) could have been prevented given an earlier 2019 leak, and what steps have been taken on the earlier motions about securing youth care data, Z-CERT affiliation, penetration tests and ethical hacking rules. The State Secretary acknowledged the leak resulted from an old unclosed domain name, described the steps taken with branch organisations and Deloitte-run penetration tests, and said Z-CERT affiliation could start in early 2021 while stressing providers bear primary responsibility.
Through Z-CERT's risk-driven approach we will again examine the possibilities for affiliation.
Door de risico gestuurde aanpak van Z-CERT gaan we opnieuw de mogelijkheden voor aansluiting onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Duizenden kinderen worden uit huis geplaatst en dat kan zeer traumatisch zijn'

A VVD MP asked the ministers about reports that thousands of children are placed out of home in high-conflict (complex) divorces, covering terminology, triage, costs, registration, court procedures, and reporting quality. The state secretary answered largely by describing existing procedures, stating that cost and registration data on divorce-related cases are not available due to privacy rules, and committing to a policy response on equal parental care rights later in the year.
Due to privacy legislation, such data may not be used for another purpose, such as policy information.
Vanwege privacywetgeving mogen dergelijke gegevens niet worden gebruikt voor een ander doel, zoals beleidsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer naar aanleiding van het bericht dat broertjes en zusjes vaak niet samenblijven bij een uithuisplaatsing

An MP asked whether siblings are often separated in child protection placements and what the government will do about it. The minister answers that WODC research on separated placements is under way for completion in autumn 2021, that a broader Erasmus study on intervention effectiveness is expected in 2022/2023, and that the existing guideline already favours placing siblings together.
The WODC will conduct research this autumn into separated placements of brothers and sisters during out-of-home placement.
Het WODC gaat dit najaar onderzoek doen naar gescheiden plaatsingen van broers en zussen bij een uithuisplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Ouders klem door onterechte meldingen kindermishandeling’

An MP asked the Minister about reports that parents were pressured after unfounded child abuse reports, including whether a 2016 promise of trauma aid for 600 families was carried out and where support is available. The State Secretary says aftercare was studied, shared with stakeholders and is being worked on, offers case-specific support and complaint routes, and notes that drang is being reconsidered following advisory bodies' report.
The research shows that not all those involved need aftercare.
Uit het onderzoek blijkt dat niet alle betrokkenen behoefte hebben aan nazorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Tekort aan jeugdzorgers steeds nijpender'

Mr. Wörsdörfer (VVD) asked the minister about a report on a worsening shortage of youth care workers, including a reported 30% drop in inflow in Q1 2020, and about steps to reduce administrative burdens. The state secretary answered that the 30% figure covers only inflow from outside the sector without correcting for administrative mobility, that the true decline is about 13%, and outlined a covenant to stop time-recording and planned simplification of product codes by 2022.
I intend to lay down the simplification of product codes in a ministerial regulation, with a target date of 1 January 2022.
Ik ben voornemens om de vereenvoudiging van de productcodes vast te leggen in een ministeriele regeling, streefdatum is 1 januari 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Terreurverdachte werkte vlak voor arrestatie met kwetsbare jongeren’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked how a terror suspect convicted of a terrorism offence could work in three youth care institutions under a false identity, and about screening, information sharing and oversight of care staff. The minister answered that the screening failure cannot be fully reconstructed, that VOG responsibility lies with employers and staffing agencies, that the IGJ found no irregularities in recent visits, and that a criminal investigation and the WODC study will inform future screening policy.
Unfortunately, it can no longer be established why this went wrong at the staffing agency or at the three institutions in 2018.
Het is helaas niet meer na te gaan waarom dat bij het uitzendbureau of bij de drie instellingen in 2018 verkeerd is gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over ontvangen signalen over oneigenlijk gebruik van GIRFEC en de zogenoemde Kansencirkel

An MP asked the minister about parental fears that the Kansencirkel, derived from Scotland's GIRFEC, could be misused as a risk-assessment tool and lead to case files, and about oversight of this. The minister answered that central government will not spread GIRFEC, municipalities may experiment, the Kansencirkel is not meant as a risk tool, and the IGJ has received no reports of misuse, with complaints routed to the IGJ and AKJ.
I am not aware of any signals of improper use of the Kansencirkel or other elements of GIRFEC.
Er zijn mij geen signalen bekend van oneigenlijk gebruik van de Kansencirkel of andere elementen van GIRFEC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Raemakers over de consultatie van de Wet houdende wijziging van de Jeugdwet en enige andere wetten

MPs Wörsdörfer and Raemakers asked why the consultation on the Youth Act amendment bill started on 10 July 2020 when the minister had said he hoped to start it after the summer, and whether the consultation period of about eight weeks, overlapping holidays, gave municipalities enough time to respond. The minister answered that the aim had long been summer consultation, that the eight-week period accommodates all parties, and that he will not extend the period but will discuss the outcome with parliament this autumn.
I would like to discuss with your House this autumn how I intend to deal with the outcome of the consultation, and I therefore do not intend to extend the consultation period in general.
Ik wil graag dit najaar nog met uw Kamer bespreken hoe ik met de opbrengst uit de consultatie wil omgaan en ben daarom niet van plan om de consultatieperiode in zijn algemeenheid te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Aartsen en Van der Linde over het bericht 'AFM waarschuwt voor schulden bij leasen van een auto of wasmachine’

MPs asked the government about AFM warnings on debt risks from private leasing of cars and appliances, including its size, contract terms, consumer information, BKR registration and whether it should fall under AFM supervision. The minister answered that private lease is unregulated and growing, outlined existing self-regulation and information, and committed to talks with market parties and the AFM on possible measures.
I will ask the AFM and other relevant parties to provide more insight into, among other things, the growth of private lease, the causes of this growth and the risks for consumers.
Ik zal de AFM en andere relevante partijen vragen om meer inzicht te geven in onder andere de groei van private lease, de oorzaken van deze groei en de risico's voor consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Westerveld over het artikel ‘Jeugdzorgbedden weg in Oss en Boxtel, kan dat wel?’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Westerveld asked the minister about youth care beds closing in Oss and Boxtel, how waiting lists for specialist youth care are monitored regionally and nationally, and whether the inspectorate and providers can make waiting lists transparent. The minister answered that municipalities hold the youth care duty and that waiting-list problems must be addressed regionally, announcing binding inter-municipal cooperation and a regional approach, while declining a national overview and not committing to new agreements beyond existing regional commitments.
They hold the youth care duty and are responsible for sufficient suitable care provision.
Zij hebben de jeugdhulpplicht en zijn verantwoordelijk voor voldoende passend hulpaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht dat ‘Jeugdzorginstelling eist dat ouders video van uit huis halen dochtertje van internet verwijderen’

An MP asked about a youth care institution demanding that parents remove a video of their daughter from the internet, and about complaint routes, data on complaints, grounds for ending parental authority, mediation, and parents' right to criticise providers. The minister answered that complaints can go to the institution, its complaints committee, the National Ombudsman and professional tribunals, that the courts decide on ending parental authority and the privacy conflict, and that talks with certified institutions on a framework will be considered.
Such an overview is not available.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Westerveld over het manifest van Lijm de zorg

MPs Wörsdörfer (VVD) and Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Health about the Lijm de zorg manifesto on young people and parents who get stuck in the youth care system, including numbers, the number of contact points, and promised follow-up. The Minister acknowledged that some young people do not get timely help, reported about 100 complex youth cases in 2019, outlined new regional expert teams and specialist centres, and said a single clear overview and a referral route to VWS are being set up, while confirming the follow-up letter was already sent.
It is not known how many signals were received in 2017 and 2018.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel signalen er in 2017 en 2018 zijn binnengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over ontvangen signalen van het afsluiten van een zwijgcontract

An MP asked whether the government still supports banning gag contracts in healthcare and youth care, how many reports the inspectorate received, what action was taken, and when the bill goes to consultation. The minister confirmed the ban policy, reported few reports (8 confirmed of 55 in 2016-2017, 11 since, none confirmed), described a warning-based response, and said the bill will go to consultation shortly and to parliament after summer 2020.
The draft bill is nearly finished. The bill will very soon be put out for consultation.
Het ontwerp van het wetsvoorstel is bijna afgerond. Het wetsvoorstel wordt zeer binnenkort in consultatie gebracht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Inspectie: Veilig Thuis sloot zwijgcontract met ouders’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Veilig Thuis Utrecht imposed a confidentiality contract on a family and kept an unfounded Pediatric Condition Falsification suspicion on file, and about monitoring the family. Minister De Jonge answered that the IGJ found the amended settlement no longer contained confidentiality-contract features, that the disputed clause was dropped, that correction and deletion procedures exist, and that no further steps against Veilig Thuis Utrecht are needed.
It is not for me to judge the conduct of professionals in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over het handelen van professionals in individuele casuïstiek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Tielen over de brief getiteld ‘Kamervragen van het lid Van Kent (SP), het lid Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) en het lid Van Weyenberg (D66) over het bericht dat het concurrentiebeding

MPs Wörsdörfer and Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs how a planned study of non-compete clauses would weigh employer interests against employee freedom, including small innovative firms, and whether it could break down use by sector and function and assess their value qualitatively. The minister confirmed the study will cover both perspectives and possibly sector breakdowns, but said its concrete design was still under discussion with employer and employee organisations.
I have promised your House to examine not only whether more conditions can be attached to the non-compete clause, but also how extensive the problem surrounding the non-compete clause is.

Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd niet alleen te onderzoeken of er meer voorwaarden kunnen worden verbonden aan het concurrentiebeding, maar ook hoe omvangrijk de problematiek rondom het concurrentiebeding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot doorverwijzing bij het bellen van het nummer 1-1-3 naar het nummer 0900–0113

Rep. Wörsdörfer asked whether calling 1-1-3 with a recorded redirect to the suicide prevention line 0900-0113 could cause fatal delay, whether a direct connection is preferable, and about waiting times on 0900-0113. The State Secretary answered that 1-1-2 is the emergency number, that telecom providers implemented an audible redirect since November 2019 with a structural solution in progress, and that no concrete waiting-time signals were received, with a new monitoring system planned.

Following the General Consultation on suicide prevention of 17 October 2019, the telecom sector was asked without delay to implement an audible message with redirection to the number 0900-0113 in their networks.

In vervolg op het Algemeen Overleg suïcidepreventie van 17 oktober 2019, is de telecomsector per ommegaande verzocht om een auditieve melding met doorverwijzing naar het nummer 0900–0113 in hun netwerken te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Een klik verwijderd van je schuldeisers’

VVD MPs asked the state secretaries about schuldenwijzer.nl, a debt-overview site that currently shows only debts enforced by bailiffs, and why tax authority, municipal and water board debts are not yet included, plus the legal obstacles around citizen service numbers. The government answered that the site helps citizens gain insight, that expansion is in progress led by bailiffs and the Belastingdienst is working on its own portal, and that no concrete legal obstacle has been identified beyond what is still to be signalled by bailiffs.
The Ministry of SZW discusses progress with SNG and KBvG and whether and how government organisations can join.
Het Ministerie van SZW bespreekt met SNG en KBvG de voortgang en ook of en zo ja, hoe overheidsorganisaties kunnen aansluiten.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld en Wörstendörfer over ‘jeugdzorg wil actie tegen agressie’: ‘je bent gewaarschuwd ik maak je kapot’

MPs Wörstendörfer and Westerveld asked the government about rising aggression against youth care workers, sentencing, complaints handling, and privacy of professionals' data in the registry. The minister answered that aggression is widespread and measures are underway, that the OM applies a 200% aggravation for such offences, that complaints procedures are being evaluated, and that the registry data leak has been corrected.
I will talk with the sector, the police and the Public Prosecution Service to find out whether additional steps are needed.
Ik ga in gesprek met de branche, de politie en het OM te achterhalen of extra stappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Stichting tegen kindermishandeling gebruikte subsidie voor spirituele workshops'

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether ZonMw's EUR 16,000 advance to No Kidding for peer-expert workshops on child abuse was used appropriately, and whether subsidies should require scientific grounding and be clawed back. The minister said the advance fits the programme's goals, that subsidies are not automatically conditioned on scientific evidence, and that no clawback is planned.
It is not realistic to expect that relevant scientific evidence is available for all interventions from the pilots of such an action programme.
Het is niet realistisch om te verwachten dat relevante wetenschappelijke onderbouwing voorhanden is voor alle interventies uit de pilots van een dergelijk actieprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Veldman en Weverling over de berichten ‘Iedereen wil internet, niemand wil datacenters’ en 'Hoe Nederland zichzelf economisch in de voet schiet'

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary how the temporary building freeze on new data centres in Amsterdam and Haarlemmermeer fits with national digitalisation and spatial strategies, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary acknowledges the freeze is driven by energy demand and land shortages, points to a national data centre table and regional alternatives, and says the government is willing to play a facilitating role.
Yes, I am willing to play a facilitating role in this.
Ja ik ben bereid een faciliterende rol hierin te spelen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘VVD wil één loket voor vergunningen van strandtenthouders’

An MP asked the state secretary about proposals for a single permit counter for beach tent operators and the burden of multiple permits, documents and differing processing times. The state secretary answered that the WABO already allows bundled applications, that the Omgevingswet will further consolidate permits in one application via a single municipal counter from 2021, and that digital tools are being developed, while not committing to new cross-government consultation.
The Omgevingswet goes further and provides for a more extensive bundling of activities into a single environmental permit.
De Omgevingswet gaat verder en voorziet in een verdergaande bundeling van activiteiten in één omgevingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Familiedrama in Winschoten: 'Ze belde 113, maar dat nummer bestaat helemaal niet'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health why suicide-prevention callers cannot reach the helpline via 113 or must dial a longer 0900 number, and whether the line could be free and linked to 113. The State Secretary said 113 could be made available for suicide prevention in principle, but that this requires coordination with the Economic Affairs ministry (which controls number allocation), a plan of at least three months, and conditions over misdialling risks to emergency number 112.
As stated in today's letter to the House, the State Secretary for Economic Affairs has indicated willingness to make the number 1-1-3 available for help in the context of suicide prevention.
Zoals in de Kamerbrief van heden is opgenomen heeft de Staatssecretaris van EZK aangegeven bereid te zijn het nummer 1-1-3 beschikbaar te stellen voor hulp in het kader van suïcidepreventie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Haga over de antwoorden op de vragen over het bericht 'Chinese webgigant AliExpress in strijd met Europese regels'

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Haga asked how many imported products fail consumer and product safety rules, what ACM and NVWA have investigated and enforced against platforms like AliExpress, and how enforcement can be improved. The state secretary answered that no reliable percentage can be given because inspections are risk-based, described enforcement actions, new EU market surveillance rules, and planned consumer awareness campaigns, but declined to give exact counts of investigations or violations.
Because their investigations are targeted, it often turns out that there is a violation.
Omdat hun onderzoeken gericht worden uitgevoerd, blijkt daarom vaak dat er sprake is van een overtreding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Veldman over het bericht ‘Banken weigeren bedrijven die met blockchain in de weer zijn’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Veldman asked whether banks refuse accounts to blockchain companies after a newspaper report. The minister says no structural refusal signals exist, notes crypto-service firms may face higher AML risk, and promises talks with banks.
Nevertheless, I will enter into discussion with the banks on whether there is indeed a refusal of parties that do something with blockchain.
Desalniettemin zal ik met de banken in gesprek gaan of er inderdaad sprake is van het weigeren van partijen die iets met blockchain doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Laan-Geselschap en Worfsdorfer over het bericht ‘Deze nieuwe en gevaarlijke cyberaanval wordt gewoon met de post bezorgd’

Four VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about 'warshipping', a reported cyberattack using parcels to plant devices that breach local wifi networks, and how it could be detected, handled and countered. The government answered that it knows the technique but has no known cases in the Netherlands or abroad, that organisations can screen parcels, and that the NCTV and NCSC are aware of the risk and would advise if needed.
I am not aware of any cases in which warshipping has been detected in the Netherlands.
Er zijn mij geen gevallen bekend waarin «warshipping» is geconstateerd in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Ondernemers dupe van kwijtgeraakte pakketjes’

VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about entrepreneurs bearing costs of lost parcels and about data on lost-parcel volumes and complaints. The State Secretary answered that the government leaves the parcel market to competing carriers, does not hold the requested data, and that carriers are not legally required to record complaints.
I am addressing these questions together because the government does not have this information.
Ik behandel deze vragen tezamen omdat de overheid niet over deze informatie beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Wörsdörfer over de policy brief van het CPB over MKB-bankfinanciering

MPs Amhaouch and Wörsdörfer asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a CPB report finding that Dutch SMEs receive fewer bank loans and face higher rates than in other eurozone countries, and what the government will do. The State Secretary acknowledges the report, stresses that the causes are diverse and not firmly established, notes that many rejections are justified, points to existing guarantee and risk-capital instruments, and promises a policy letter in autumn 2019 rather than before the summer recess.
In autumn 2019 I will elaborate on my policy vision in a letter to the House.
In het najaar 2019 zal ik in een Kamerbrief mijn beleidsvisie nader toelichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over de International Association for Trusted Blockchain Applications

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the International Association for Trusted Blockchain Applications (INATBA), its expected role, Dutch membership, support for Dutch firms, regulatory sandboxes and blockchain in the digitalisation strategy. The State Secretary answered that the INATBA is still being set up, promised to support it where possible, described existing DNB/AFM sandbox programmes, and confirmed the digitalisation report contains no separate blockchain chapter.
Due to the confidentiality of supervision, the precise nature of the questions and experiments cannot be elaborated on.
Over de precieze aard van de vragen en experimenten kan in verband met vertrouwelijkheid van het toezicht niet uitgeweid worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Remco Dijkstra en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Transporteurs boos over dure Nederlandse tachokaart: ‘In buitenland veel goedkoper’

MPs asked why Dutch hauliers pay substantially higher prices for tachograph cards than in neighbouring countries and whether this disadvantages Dutch SMEs. The minister acknowledged price differences, said a benchmark study will be sent to parliament after the summer, and promised a revised, more transparent tariff scheme that may lower prices.
This study will be sent to your House after the summer.
Dit onderzoek zal na de zomer naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Dieven teisteren Nederlandse winkeliers: 1,8 miljard verlies'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the government was aware of reports of 1.8 billion euro in losses from shoplifting, what measures it was considering for small businesses, and for an appraisal of the VVD's earlier recommendations on shoplifting. The government confirmed the figures are broadly in line with earlier data, described existing public-private platforms and a new intelligence register on mobile gangs, and promised an appraisal of the recommendations from the Minister of Justice and Security by the end of summer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Tientallen kleine bedrijven failliet door hoge kosten crowdfunding'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Finance and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that small firms went bankrupt due to high crowdfunding costs, and whether existing rules protect SMEs from excessive interest rates. The minister answered that crowdfunding is a valuable financing option, that the government relies on self-regulation codes for business clients, and that the AFM oversees certain crowdfunding forms, with a possible national framework deferred to the pending EU regulation.
As indicated in the answer to question 3, the cabinet is relying on self-regulation to improve protection for small business clients.
Zoals in de beantwoording op vraag 3 is aangegeven, zet het kabinet wat betreft de verbetering van de bescherming voor kleinzakelijke klanten in op zelfregulering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Veldman en Wiersma over het aantrekken van personeel door startups

MPs Wörsdörfer, Veldman and Wiersma asked whether startups face barriers in recruiting foreign talent, including income requirements, the partner labour market access and BTW registration for foreign entrepreneurs. The government answered that a pilot residence scheme for essential startup staff with a lower salary threshold will be created, that partner labour market access is being arranged, and that foreign entrepreneurs do not need to register physically at the tax office.
It was chosen to create a separate residence scheme in the form of a pilot rather than to adjust the knowledge migrant scheme.
Er is gekozen voor een aparte verblijfsregeling in de vorm van een pilot en niet voor aanpassing van de kennismigrantenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Haga over het bericht 'Chinese webgigant AliExpress in strijd met Europese regels'

Two MPs asked whether AliExpress's terms breach Dutch and EU consumer rules, what the government will do to protect Dutch consumers buying from non-EU sellers, and why China strategy omitted this. The Secretary of State said enforcement lies with the ACM and courts, outlined EU cooperation, WTO e-commerce talks, product safety pledges, and an awareness campaign, and argued the share of purchases from Chinese webshops is still small.

It is up to the supervisory authority Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) and the courts to assess whether a company complies with the consumer rules in force in Europe and the Netherlands and, if not, which rules have been breached.

Het is aan de toezichthouder Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en de rechter om te beoordelen of een bedrijf zich aan de in Europa en Nederland geldende consumentenregels houdt en zo nee, welke regels zijn overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Schimmigheid klimaattafels baart MKB zorgen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the climate roundtables raise concerns among SMEs, and whether the energy transition is affordable, whether the government will consult SMEs about shifting the sustainable energy surcharge (ODE) to large industry, and whether SMEs can be supported in energy-saving measures. The minister answered that the government aims for an affordable transition, will show the effects of the ODE shift on SMEs before the bill this summer, and will assess the broader impact of the Klimaatakkoord on SMEs and inform the House in the second half of 2019.
Once this overview is ready it will be shared with MKB-Nederland and the House of Representatives.
Zodra dit overzicht gereed is zal het worden gedeeld met MKB-Nederland en de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘MKB-Nederland wil wettelijke betaaltermijn voor 'groot aan klein' naar 30 dagen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that SMEs wait up to 60 days for payment and whether the statutory maximum payment term should be cut to 30 days. The State Secretary said the evaluation of the payment-terms law will report by September and may lead to tighter rules, but declined to commit to amending the law now, citing average payment terms of about 40 days showing no clear trend.
I acknowledge there is a risk that emphasis on the 60-day outer limit causes attention to slacken on applying the desirable 30-day payment term.
Ik onderschrijf dat er een risico is dat nadruk op de uiterste grens van 60 dagen de aandacht laat verslappen voor het hanteren van de wenselijke betaaltermijn van 30 dagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Wörsdörfer over het bericht dat Europarlementariërs de Europese Commissie waarschuwen niet de plannen voor een nieuw ruimtevaartprogramma te blokkeren

MPs Veldman and Wörsdörfer asked whether the European Commission intended to withdraw the new EU space programme after a provisional deal had been reached, and what the consequences would be for the Dutch space sector and EU competitiveness. The State Secretary replied that the Commission has not withdrawn the programme, that Council, Parliament and Commission reached a partial agreement at first reading, and that open points such as budgets will be settled later in the MFF negotiations.
It is now clear that the European Commission has not withdrawn the space programme.
Inmiddels is duidelijk dat de Europese Commissie het ruimtevaartprogramma niet heeft teruggetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Wörsdörfer over ‘orange carpet’ initiatieven en barrières bij het aantrekken van startups en scale-ups naar Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about barriers to attracting foreign startups and scale-ups to the Netherlands and about 'orange carpet' initiatives. The state secretary answered that Dutch rankings are good, that some barriers exist (bank accounts, partner labour market access, waiting times), and listed existing and planned measures with commitments to inform parliament later in 2019.
Parliament will be informed further about this in the second half of 2019.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer in de tweede helft van 2019 nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Lodders over het bericht ‘Klokkenluiders kunnen bij misstanden aanbestedingen nergens terecht’

Two VVD MPs asked whether whistleblowers can report misconduct in public procurement, since the competition authority ACM can only act against firms under the cartel ban and not against government bodies or state companies. The state secretary answered that ACM can act against state companies acting as undertakings, that internal checks, the Huis voor Klokkenluiders and the FIOD/OM are the available routes, that no change to the rules is needed, and that research on legal protection in procurement is ongoing with results to parliament before summer.
I am of the view that it is not necessary to expand the current possibilities.
Ik ben van mening dat het niet nodig is om de huidige mogelijkheden uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Wörsdörfer over de financieringsmogelijkheden van het midden- en kleinbedrijf en de financieringsmonitor van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about SME financing difficulties, the CBS Financing Monitor, and possible policy responses. The State Secretary answered that SME financing is riskier, that Dutch figures are broadly in line with European surveys, and that the government is supporting schemes such as BMKB, Qredits and financing tables, with a CPB study and a Kamerbrief promised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Four Trends that Blockchain will Dominate in Emerging Tech in 2019’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Finance about blockchain developments, government funding, legal frameworks, regulatory sandboxes, bank account access for blockchain firms, a business complaints desk, and regulation abroad. The government answers that blockchain is still maturing, about 2.8 million euros is spent on blockchain research, several legal studies are underway, and it will examine EU financial rules and crypto regulation without finding clear domestic barriers so far.
A cabinet response to the report is expected before the summer recess.
Naar verwachting zal vóór het zomerreces een kabinetsreactie op het rapport volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Europa op grote achterstand in strijd om digitale hegemonie’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about a report claiming Europe lags behind in the platform economy, whether foreign platforms face weaker regulation, and what policy steps could help. The State Secretary largely reassured that the Netherlands performs well, pointed to existing EU and national enforcement, startup support and a consultation on competition policy, and gave other questions only general answers or referred to later letters.
However, I have no direct indications that the Dutch competitive position is under pressure from foreign platforms.
Ik heb echter nog geen directe aanwijzingen dat de Nederlandse concurrentiepositie onder druk staat door buitenlandse platforms.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht dat ondernemers schrikken van de Brexit

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that entrepreneurs are alarmed by Brexit, the number of Brexit information-point users, the share of unprepared firms, EORI registrations and additional outreach. The government answered that demand for Brexit information is rising, that a broad instrument mix exists, and that the campaign and stakeholder cooperation will be intensified.
Preparing for Brexit is ultimately the responsibility of the entrepreneur themselves; failing to start preparations in time is worrying.
Het voorbereiden op de Brexit is uiteindelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van de ondernemer zelf; het niet tijdig starten met de voorbereidingen is zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Lodders over de wachttijden voor ondernemers om zich in te schrijven in het handelsregister van de Kamer van Koophandel

Two MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretaries about waiting times of about three weeks for entrepreneurs to register at the Chamber of Commerce, including regional differences, the causes and VAT number delays. The government answered with regional waiting times of 4 to 14 days, measures taken to reduce them, and an explanation of VAT number timing, while stating it does not yet meet its 7-day target everywhere.
The KvK does not meet the target of a maximum waiting time of seven calendar days in all regions.
De KvK voldoet niet in alle regio’s aan de doelstelling van een maximale wachttijd van zeven kalenderdagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Spanish cities grapple with invasion of electric scooters’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Spanish cities struggling with electric scooters and whether similar initiatives, safety rules and experimentation room exist in the Netherlands. The minister replied that electric steps are currently classed as special mopeds with rules being reviewed by SWOV, RDW and the Safety Board, that municipalities cannot themselves admit vehicles to public roads, and that the Strategic Road Safety Plan will take these developments into account.
Municipalities cannot independently decide to admit vehicles to the public road.
Gemeenten kunnen niet zelfstandig besluiten om voertuigen toe te laten tot de openbare weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het onderzoek van de Consumentenbond dat veel winkels zich schuldig maken aan nepaanbiedingen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Consumentenbond study finding fake discounts in many shops, whether earlier findings were not addressed, and whether shops are unaware of the Unfair Commercial Practices Act. The State Secretary said there is no data on how often fake discounts occur, cannot confirm that shops failed to improve, and that the study cannot support general conclusions, while welcoming such research alongside ACM oversight.
I have no data on how often such fake discounts occur.
Ik heb geen gegevens over hoe vaak dergelijke nepaanbiedingen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Oosten over het tegengaan van winkeldiefstal

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Oosten asked about the scale of shop theft, use of collective shop bans, and whether filing a police report is required for civil settlements and information sharing. The minister said reliable damage figures cannot yet be given and a follow-up study is underway, that bans are used with few obstacles, that police are improving the reporting process, and that a report is needed for the standard civil charge but not for sharing information within the ban system.
A follow-up study is currently being carried out to answer whether it is possible to achieve proper registration and reliable data.
Op dit moment wordt een vervolgonderzoek uitgevoerd dat antwoord moet geven op de vraag of het mogelijk is tot een goede registratie en betrouwbare gegevens te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over betaaltermijnen aan mkb’ers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about longer payment terms for SMEs, whether the 2018 payment-term law is working, and whether an earlier evaluation, supplier-imposed conditions, EU comparisons and long-term risks will be examined. The State Secretary largely defended the current policy, declined to bring the evaluation forward, and said further investigation of contract conditions is uncertain.
No, I do not consider it useful to start an evaluation earlier than the planned date of mid-2019.
Nee, het starten van een evaluatie eerder dan het geplande tijdstip van medio 2019 acht ik niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het niet aansluiten Standaard Bedrijfsindeling (SBI) op economische activiteiten in de digitale economie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the Standard Industrial Classification (SBI) adequately captures the digital economy and whether it should be adapted, and whether other classifications have the same gap. The State Secretary agreed that a single SBI-based delineation of the internet economy is not possible, said he would consult Statistics Netherlands on international adjustment while noting this needs European consensus, and pointed to CBS monitoring and a digital transformation monitor.
Nevertheless, I will consult with CBS to explore the possibilities for internationally adapting the SBI so that it better reflects new developments in the digital economy.
Niettemin zal ik in overleg gaan met CBS om na te gaan wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de SBI internationaal aan te passen om nieuwe ontwikkelingen in de digitale economie beter te reflecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Koopmans over het bericht ‘Mkb kan uitzondering op nieuwe strenge privacywet wel vergeten’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about SME compliance costs and vague AVG rules, including the register obligation and data storage scope, and about the Data Protection Authority's enforcement approach. The government estimated compliance costs, pointed to existing guidance and brochures, said the register duty largely replaces the earlier notification duty, and described the AP's independent focus on education and proportionate enforcement.
The AP is an independent supervisor that makes its own supervisory choices.
De AP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf haar toezichtskeuzes maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Arno Rutte, Middendorp en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Agentschap Telecom slaat alarm over hackbare apparaten’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government shares the Agentschap Telecom's call to hurry a security mark for 'smart' connected devices, how it is progressing, and related questions on consumer visibility, ISP involvement, company-led certification and innovation. The government answers that it supports a European CE-type mark with mandatory minimum digital security requirements under the Radio Equipment Directive, that it has proposed this in Europe, and that it is working with ISPs and on EU cybersecurity certification.

Together with the European Commission, the cabinet is examining how to give effect to the aforementioned possibility of extending the current CE mark of the RED with minimum digital security requirements for wireless devices.

Met de Europese Commissie onderzoekt het kabinet hoe invulling te gegeven aan voornoemde mogelijkheid om het huidige CE-keurmerk van de RED uit te breiden met minimale eisen aan de digitale veiligheid van draadloze apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Koopmans over gebruik informatie uit het Handelsregister voor facebook-targeting

Two VVD MPs asked how Chamber of Commerce register data could be used for Facebook targeting, whether that is permitted, and whether the privacy of sole traders is affected. The Secretary of State said the register is public under the Handelsregisterwet, the KvK does not offer data for advertising purposes, privacy may be at stake, and talks with the Data Protection Authority are ongoing and confidential.
The talks between the KvK, the Data Protection Authority and EZK are still ongoing and take place in a confidential atmosphere.
De gesprekken tussen de KvK, de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens en EZK zijn nog gaande en vinden plaats in een vertrouwelijke sfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Veldman over de langere betalingstermijn aan Mkb'ers

MPs Wörsdörfer and Veldman asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about supermarkets paying suppliers later and whether SMEs are harmed by late payment, including government payment times. The state secretary answered that payment behaviour is improving, that no cases of SMEs in financial trouble from this trend are known, and that the government is monitoring payment times and has the 60-day payment law and the Betaalme.nu initiative in place.
The number of cases in which payment deviated from the 30 or 60 days is not available; these data are not on hand.
Het aantal gevallen waarbij er werd afgeweken van de 30 of 60 dagen is niet inzichtelijk, deze gegevens zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Kabinet zet koppositie ICT op het spel, waarschuwt Eelco Blok’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether they agreed with Eelco Blok's claim that the cabinet lacks a long-term ICT vision and risks Dutch digital leadership, and asked about spectrum auction timing and the national digitalisation strategy. The government disputed the claim, pointed to Dutch strengths and the coming Digitaliseringsstrategie, and confirmed that auction dates and the 3.5 GHz options would be sent to parliament before the relevant recesses.
To be able to lead in the coming years, the coalition agreement contains the necessary ambitions and actions regarding digitalisation.
Om de komende jaren voorop te kunnen lopen, bevat het regeerakkoord de nodige ambities en acties bevat als het gaat om digitalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Wörsdörfer over het btw-nummer van zzp’ers

VVD MPs Lodders and Wörsdörfer asked whether self-employed people working from home must publish their home address in the Chamber of Commerce register, how they are protected against identity fraud, and whether the VAT number containing the BSN can be avoided. The government answered that the register publicly shows home and business addresses for sole traders for traceability and legal certainty, that home addresses can be shielded on request, and that it is investigating options for VAT numbers without the BSN.
I have no indications that the public disclosure of this information in the trade register creates an increased risk of identity fraud.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de openbaarheid van deze gegevens in het handelsregister een vergroot risico op identiteitsfraude oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Wörsdorfer over het bericht  ‘Wirwar van gemeentelijke milieuzones groeit: automobilist kan Maastricht straks alleen nog met milieusticker in’

MPs Ziengs and Wörsdorfer asked about the growing patchwork of municipal environmental zones, including Maastricht's sticker system that affects motorists and entrepreneurs. The State Secretary agreed a uniform system is undesirable, deferred the balancing of interests to municipalities, and committed to a meeting with municipalities and the VNG and to uniform signage by 1 January 2020.
I have invited the new municipal executives and the VNG to sit down together on this matter.
Ik heb de nieuwe gemeentebestuurders en de VNG uitgenodigd om hierover om tafel te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Veldman over het omzeilen van de Wet markt en overheid

VVD MPs Wörsdörfer and Veldman asked whether a municipal loan to Focus Filmtheater, and the 'Horeca BV' structure that may let commercial hospitality bypass the Wet markt en overheid, creates unfair competition and what rules apply. The state secretary answered that state-aid and WMO rules apply, that enforcement lies primarily with the municipality, the Commission, courts and the ACM, and that subsidy conditions can address unfair competition, without committing to a new investigation or legislative change.
Whether there is state aid in the present situation is primarily for the municipality to assess.
Of er in onderhavige situatie sprake is van staatssteun, is in de eerste plaats aan de gemeente om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wörsdörfer over de verhaalspositie van het MKB bij onbetwiste geldvorderingen

MPs Van Oosten and Wörsdörfer asked whether Belgium's 2016 out-of-court debt collection procedure for undisputed claims between businesses should be introduced in the Netherlands to strengthen small and medium-sized firms' position. The minister answered that its added value is unclear, that rule-of-law safeguards and cost questions need study, and that a further exploration will follow once the Belgian law's effects are clearer.

The rule-of-law safeguard of out-of-court dispute resolution methods such as arbitration and binding advice lies, as a recently published report on this subject also showed, among other things in the fact that one must go to the judge for an enforceable title.

De rechtsstatelijke waarborging van buitengerechtelijke geschiloplossingsmethoden zoals arbitrage en bindend advies, is – zo bleek ook in een recentelijk gepubliceerd rapport over dit onderwerp – onder meer gelegen in het gegeven dat men voor een titel voor tenuitvoerlegging naar de rechter moet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het afzien van verdere deelname van IVBN aan de Retailagenda

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the consequences of the institutional investors' association IVBN and the private investors Vastgoed Belang no longer taking part in the next phase of the Retail Agenda, how transparency in the retail market will be improved, and how support for retail deals among local SMEs is secured. The State Secretary replies that talks with IVBN are underway, that Vastgoed Belang has signalled willingness to contribute again, that local retail deals are the responsibility of municipal councils and that a toolkit with support for stakeholder cooperation is provided.
Following IVBN's letter, the Director-General for Business and Innovation of my ministry and the chair of the Retail Agenda will talk with IVBN's board.
Naar aanleiding van de brief van IVBN gaan de Directeur-Generaal Bedrijfsleven en Innovatie van mijn ministerie en de voorzitter van de Retailagenda in gesprek met bestuurders van IVBN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over het op straat belanden van gevoelige gegevens van 1800 kwetsbare leerlingen

MPs Becker and Wörsdörfer asked the State Secretary for Education and the Interior Minister about leaked personal data of 1,800 vulnerable pupils via unanonymised municipal school-transport tenders, and about municipal privacy compliance, other risky tenders, pseudonymisation law and digital security standards. The government answered that municipalities are responsible for compliance and accountable to their councils, pointed to PIANOo and school-sector awareness measures, and said pseudonymisation targets digital learning tools rather than municipal tenders.
The municipalities are accountable to the municipal council for this.
De gemeenten zijn daarover verantwoording verschuldigd aan de gemeenteraad.

m: Motie van de leden Agema en Jansen over een kabinetsstandpunt over medisch-ethische kwesties rond technologische mogelijkheden
Asks the government to formulate a cabinet position on medical-ethical questions raised by technologies such as artificial intelligence.
requests the government to formulate a cabinet position on medical-ethical issues regarding technological possibilities such as artificial intelligence
verzoekt de regering, een kabinetsstandpunt te formuleren op medisch-ethische kwesties als het gaat om technologische mogelijkheden zoals artificiële intelligentie
Motie van het lid Ploumen c.s. over het continueren van de tweejaarlijkse screening op borstkanker
Asks the government to report to parliament before 1 March 2021 on how the two-yearly breast cancer screening interval can be maintained, including staffing solutions and additional funding.
requests the government to inform the House by 1 March 2021 how the two-year interval can be continued
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer voor 1 maart 2021 te berichten op welke wijze de termijn van twee jaar gecontinueerd kan worden
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over de borstkankerscreening tweejaarlijks blijven doen
Asks the government to continue biennial breast cancer screening.
requests the government to continue biennial breast cancer screening, and proceeds to the next item of business.
verzoekt de regering, de borstkankerscreening tweejaarlijks te blijven doen, en gaat over tot de orde van de dag.
Motie van het lid Westerveld c.s. over hulp aan sporters die te maken hebben gehad met psychische en fysieke mishandeling
Motion asking the government, in consultation with former gymnasts, to explore acute and adequate help and reimbursement for athletes who suffered psychological and physical abuse.
requests the government, in consultation with (former) gymnasts, to examine what is possible to provide acute and adequate help
verzoekt de regering, om in overleg met (oud-)turnsters te onderzoeken wat mogelijk is om te voorzien in acute en adequate hulp
Motie van het lid Westerveld c.s. over een schadefonds voor turnsters met klachten ten gevolge van psychische en fysieke mishandeling
Motion asks the government to propose a damage fund for former gymnasts with lasting harm from psychological and physical abuse.
requests the government, in its cabinet response to this research, also to make a proposal for a damage fund
verzoekt de regering, om in de kabinetsreactie op dit onderzoek ook een voorstel te doen voor een schadefonds
Amendement van de leden Jansen en Agema over het aanpassen van de verbodsbepalingen
Amendment relaxes alcohol sales prohibitions so shops such as hairdressers may serve one glass of low-alcohol drink without a social hygiene certificate.
serving one glass of low-alcohol drink to a customer by shopkeepers such as the bridal shop or hairdresser should remain possible without a required social hygiene knowledge certificate

het schenken van één glas zwak-alcoholhoudende drank aan een klant door winkeliers zoals de bruidszaak of de kapsalon mogelijk moet kunnen blijven zonder dat er een Verklaring kennis en inzicht sociale hygiëne nodig is
Amendement van het lid Jansen over opnemen mechanische ventilatie-eis
Adds a mandatory mechanical ventilation requirement for hospitality venues to the law, with a mayoral exemption for listed monuments.
With this amendment the mechanical ventilation requirement is therefore included in the law.
Met dit amendement wordt de mechanische ventilatie-eis dan ook in de wet opgenomen.
Amendement van het lid Jansen over het schrappen van het beperken van prijsacties
Amendment deletes the proposed ban on alcohol price promotions above 25% discount from the Alcohol Act.
This amendment deletes the proposed article 2a
Dit amendement schrapt het voorgestelde artikel 2a
Motie van het lid Jansen over uitstel van wetgeving rond e-sigaret tot onderzoek van het RIVM beschikbaar is
Asks the government to postpone the e-cigarette law amendment until the RIVM research on e-cigarette effects is finished.
postpone this legislative amendment until the research into the effects of the e-cigarette is completed
deze wetswijziging uit te stellen tot het onderzoek naar de effecten van de e-sigaret is afgerond
Amendement van de leden Jansen en Van Gerven over uitbreiding van het rookverbod naar kruidenrookproducten
Amends the Tobacco Act so the smoking ban also covers herbal smoking products, removing an exception.
By placing all products under the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act under the smoking ban, users can be prevented from switching to substitute harmful products.
Door alle producten uit de Tabaks- en rookwarenwet onder het rookverbod te plaatsen, kan worden voorkomen dat gebruikers vervangende schadelijke producten gaan gebruiken
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jansen t.v.v. nr. 19 over een verbod op winstuitkering met uitzonderingsmogelijkheid bij AMvB

Bans profit distribution for care providers subject to the profit ban, with a general administrative order exemption, and adds a four-week pre-consultation period before the AMvB is submitted to parliament.
The proposal for a general administrative order to be established under this Act is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.
De voordracht voor een krachtens deze wet vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jansen t.v.v. nr. 8 over het verbod op winstuitkering

Bans profit distribution in care: care providers may not outsource care to for-profit organisations, with a general administrative order allowing exemptions and a prior parliamentary submission requirement added.
By general administrative order, institutions and subcontractors may be designated to which the ban on profit distribution does not apply.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen instellingen en onderaannemers worden aangewezen waarop het verbod op winstuitkering niet van toepassing is.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de plannen voor nieuwe kerncentrales, kosteninschattingen en veiligheid Borssele

MP Teunissen (PvdD) asked the government about its plans for new nuclear plants, cost estimates versus other studies, and the safety implications of dropping the Borssele benchmark. The ministers defended nuclear power as a necessary part of a robust energy mix, acknowledged cost uncertainty pending TNO studies, and argued that dropping the benchmark does not reduce safety requirements, with no new MER needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het leveren van gebruikte visnetten aan Oekraïne

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked whether the government would support and remove regulatory obstacles to collecting and exporting used fishing nets to Ukraine for drone protection. The minister replied that defence does not fund civilian initiatives but is open to facilitating transport if Ukraine's defence ministry states a need, and that EU waste rules and extended producer responsibility cannot be unilaterally changed, though nets that reach end-of-waste status may be exported.
The Ministry of Defence is nevertheless open to examining how a contribution could be facilitated, for example for the transport of used fishing nets.
Het Ministerie van Defensie staat evenwel open voor het onderzoeken op welke manier wel een bijdrage gefaciliteerd kan worden, bijvoorbeeld voor het transport van gebruikte visnetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de betrokkenheid van multinationals bij omstreden fracking-operaties voor de productie van plastic verpakkingen

An MP asked the ministers about multinationals such as Unilever, Coca-Cola and Nestlé allegedly linked to fracking for plastic packaging feedstock in Texas, and about Dutch measures on fossil plastics, EU and global rules, transparency and a fracking ban. The government said it promotes recycled and bio-based plastic, points to EU packaging rules and the CSRD/CSDDD for transparency, maintains the ban on shale gas, and wants an ambitious global plastics treaty.
The cabinet is currently not considering additional national obligations.
Het kabinet overweegt op dit moment geen aanvullende nationale verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Stoffer naar aanleiding van het artikel in de Telegraaf ‘Recyclingsector in actie tegen extra plasticheffing: ’Kabinet zoekt geld, afvalsector wordt gepakt’’

MPs Pierik and Stoffer asked the government whether a planned plastic levy would fall on the waste and recycling sector, why recycling is struggling, and what the cost burden is. The State Secretary answered that the levy's design is still under review in spring budget decisions, that recyclers face high energy prices and EU rules, and gave tax-rate tables and Belgian and German comparisons, without committing to a final design.
The design of this is part of the spring budget decision-making. One cannot anticipate this.
De vormgeving hiervan is onderdeel van de voorjaarsbesluitvorming. Hier kan niet op worden vooruitgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Emiel van Dijk en Heutink over het bericht ‘OM vervolgt niemand na aangifte om mishandeling NS-conducteur’

MPs Van Dijk and Heutink asked why no one was prosecuted after a reported assault on an NS conductor, whether minor offences could be pursued, and what measures are being taken to curb violence on public transport. The State Secretary answered that the prosecutor found insufficient evidence, outlined existing measures (travel bans, bodycams, camera coverage, planned access to the driving-licence register for OV-boa's), and said NS is evaluating a broader rollout of bodycams.
It is not appropriate for me to pass judgment on a decision by the Public Prosecution Service in a specific investigation.
Het past mij niet om een oordeel te vellen over een beslissing van het OM in een specifiek onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Bamenga over het artikel op de website PITANE.BLUE van 19 januari 2025: ‘OV-NL: doel uitstootvrije bussen in 2030 onder druk door gebrek aan stroom’

MPs Rooderkerk and Bamenga asked the Minister and State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about mobility CO2 emissions, whether the 2030 restemissie target is reachable, funding, grid congestion delaying bus electrification, air quality and whether climate targets could be dropped. The State Secretary answered that the government is not on track, will consider alternative measures in spring, has no budget space yet, cites grid-congestion agreements and subsidies, and states it will only deviate from climate targets if alternative policy fails.
Therefore the cabinet is looking this spring at the possibilities for taking alternative measures, as also agreed in the coalition programme.
Daarom kijkt het kabinet dit voorjaar naar de mogelijkheden om alternatieve maatregelen te treffen, zoals ook afgesproken in het regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Piri over de erkenning van het recht op een gezonde leefomgeving in het Europese Verdrag van de Rechten van de Mens

MPs Gabriëls and Piri asked whether the Netherlands will support recognising a right to a healthy environment in the European Convention on Human Rights, given other EU states' constitutional recognition and UN resolutions. The minister replied that Dutch law already protects the environment through the Constitution, Omgevingswet and related statutes, that the Netherlands is still studying the Council of Europe's CDDH report, and that a national position will be sent to Parliament later.
Your House will be informed about this position in due course by letter to Parliament, in accordance with motion 32 735 no. 373.
Uw Kamer wordt t.z.t. over deze inzet geïnformeerd per Kamerbrief conform motie 32 735 nr. 373.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Bromet over de berichten dat Zeeuwse buffels te veel PFAS binnenkrijgen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked why the NVWA knew for two years that Zeeland water buffalo contained too much PFAS without informing the province or nature organisation, and what risks and remedies exist. The State Secretary answered that the owner was informed, no food safety risk existed since the meat was no longer sold, communication improvements and RIVM research are underway, but no direct action on the province's request was committed.

Because the buffalo were no longer slaughtered for human consumption and there was no food safety risk, there was no need to inform other parties such as the province of Zeeland and the nature organisation Het Zeeuwse Landschap.

Omdat de buffels hierna niet meer werden afgevoerd voor humane consumptie en er geen sprake was van een voedselveiligheidsrisico, bestond geen noodzaak andere partijen zoals de provincie Zeeland en natuurorganisatie Het Zeeuwse Landschap op de hoogte te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Kisteman over het bericht 'Statiegeld mogelijk omhoog naar €1 per fles'

Two VVD MPs asked whether a reported possible increase of the deposit on bottles to EUR 1 would burden consumers, harm the environment, dirty streets, and how collection could be improved. The state secretary answered that no increase has been decided yet, the ILT is still reviewing Verpact's studies, an evaluation of the deposit scheme is underway with results due spring 2025, and that ILT has ordered Verpact to create 5,400 extra return points.
At this moment there is not yet any intention to increase the deposit.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een voornemen tot verhoging van het statiegeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over het bericht 'Evangelist op station Maastricht met machtsvertoon staande gehouden: 'Intimiderende en dreigende sfeer''

ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers whether police intervention against evangelists singing at a Maastricht station piano, and NS house rules restricting evangelising folders, are compatible with freedom of religion, and whether they will talk to NS about this. The government answered that police acted on a nuisance report under local responsibility, that no restrictions were imposed and the group left voluntarily, that house rules and WP2000 obligations justify NS enforcement, and that it sees no reason to talk to NS now.
The police's conduct was based on knowledge of the local situation and under the responsibility of the competent authority.
Het optreden van de politie is op basis van de kennis van de lokale situatie en onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Verbazing over ‘nep-beveiligers’ tijdens pro-Palestina demonstratie’

Two SGP MPs asked whether a pro-Palestine demonstration in Leiden, where persons acting as self-appointed security (Protest Alliance Watch) allegedly enforced their own rules on station travellers, violated the ban on private armed-style organisations and whether NS station staff were adequately trained. The minister answered that the right to demonstrate applies within the law, that local authorities and police, not the minister, judge such conduct, that police did not observe forced removals, that NS conductors (boa's) have limited powers and no specific training is needed, and that a joint escalation framework is being drafted in response to a motion.
The judgment on whether specific concrete conduct constitutes a criminal offence is reserved for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the court.
Het oordeel of bepaald concreet handelen valt onder een strafrechtelijk delict is voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Gabriëls over de faillissementen van steeds meer koplopers in onze circulaire economie

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government what it had done after several Dutch circular plastics recyclers went bankrupt, what caused the failures, and how the government responded to cheap Chinese and virgin plastic. The state secretary answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined market causes and EU trade measures, and set out planned measures including a plastic levy from 2028, a recyclate norm from 2027 and EUR 267 million in subsidies.
The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but can confirm that the Ministry of KGG has had contact with a number of plastic recycling companies to explore options for support.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casus, maar wel bevestigen dat het Ministerie van KGG contact heeft gehad met een aantal plasticrecyclingbedrijven om mogelijkheden voor ondersteuning te bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Erkens, Vermeer en Grinwis over de overstap van de industrie naar groene waterstof en de raffinageroute

Four MPs asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth and the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the proposed 0.4 correction factor for the refinery route for green hydrogen, which they feared would undermine hydrogen investment and rely on uncertain market assumptions. The minister defended the correction factor as a balance between CO2 reduction, pump prices and hydrogen stimulation, acknowledged investment risks and committed to a study under a parliamentary motion on the refinery route's impact.

After the parliamentary questions were asked, the House adopted the motion by MPs Bontenbal and Vermeer calling for a study into how the refinery route should be designed to contribute maximally to the industry's sustainability goals.

Na het stellen van Kamervragen heeft de Kamer de motie van de leden Bontenbal en Vermeer aangenomen over een onderzoek naar hoe de raffinageroute eruit moet zien om maximaal bij te dragen aan de verduurzamingsdoelstellingen van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de gevolgen van asbestbranden

MPs Van Kent asked whether, after the government's earlier answer on asbestos fires, no party is now obliged to clear asbestos debris outside built plots, and whether a statutory duty is needed. The Secretary of State corrected his earlier answer, says the owner of the burned building must clear debris on neighbouring land (including undeveloped land), explains the Civil Code and environmental law basis, and concludes no new legislation is needed.
That answer relied too heavily on case law about responsibility for clearing drug waste.
In dat antwoord is te veel uitgegaan van de jurisprudentie over de verantwoordelijkheid voor het opruimen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Peter de Groot over de verdwijnende parkeerplaatsen in binnensteden

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether municipal removal of parking spaces in city centres such as Nijmegen harms car-dependent residents, whether a national overview of car-restrictive municipal measures exists, and whether national parking norms for new housing will be examined. The minister replied that parking and public space decisions are municipal responsibilities, that the ministry has no overview or oversight of parking norms, and that talks with municipalities on parking tariffs will be held.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het onderzoek van het Nibud, in opdracht van de Mobiliteitsalliantie

MP Postma asked the government about a Nibud study commissioned by the Mobiliteitsalliantie showing that low and middle incomes face transport poverty, and what measures will restore affordable mobility and how ETS-2 affects transport costs. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the study, gave no precise figure, pointed to past tariff measures, discount products and a planned Social Climate Fund, but did not commit to a specific new measure or timeline.
There is no precise figure to give on this.
Hierover is geen precies getal te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht «Gedrag van PVV-bewindslieden zet de verhoudingen op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat onder hoogspanning»

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister and State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported tensions with civil servants over their conduct, including a controversial remark on TV and lobbying by Schiphol and KLM. The Minister acknowledged the unease, said talks with the senior civil service had been held, stated that the State Secretary has distanced himself from the remark, and said the relationship is in good order.
From our conversations with the senior civil service we have gained insight into the discomfort that this and earlier events have caused in the department.
Uit onze gesprekken met de ambtelijke top hebben wij inzicht gekregen in het ongemak waartoe een en ander (uit het verleden) heeft geleid in het departement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over maatregelen die contraproductief werken voor het oplossen van de klimaatcrisis

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management about the CO2 impact of opening Lelystad Airport to commercial flights and of possibly reversing zero-emission zones, including whether the climate minister was consulted and what the timeline is. The government said the decision is still pending in 2025, that an updated environmental impact report will assess CO2 emissions and be submitted to parliament, and that the zero-emission zone reduction was estimated at 1 Mton CO2 per year from 2030.

Once there is clarity on a definitive planning of these products, the House will be informed about the decision-making steps. The role of parliament is (also) safeguarded through the pre-submission procedure.
Zodra er zicht is op een definitieve planning van deze producten wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de besluitvormingsstappen. De rol van het parlement is (ook) via de voorhangprocedure geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Buijsse over het verminderen van regeldruk in circulaire processen

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reducing regulatory burden and advancing the circular economy, including how circularity affects competitiveness, emissions and the definition of waste. The State Secretary answered that Dutch circular policy is being developed at EU level, that the national programme will be updated in September 2025, and that the definition of waste follows EU law.
A new ICER will be published in early 2025. Partly on that basis, I will send an updated NPCE to the House in September of that year.
Begin 2025 komt een nieuwe ICER uit. Mede op basis hiervan zal ik in september van dat jaar een geactualiseerd NPCE aan de Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over het bericht dat vertraging dreigt voor Tata Steel’s verduurzamingsplannen

MPs asked whether Tata Steel's delayed submission of the environmental impact report (MER) and the health effects report (GER) for its green steel plans could hold up permits, and whether parliament will see these documents before a Joint Letter of Intent is signed. The government says the company intends to submit everything in one go at year-end despite repeated warnings from the environmental service, that the GER methodology is still being developed, that negotiation details cannot be disclosed publicly, and that parliament will be briefed confidentially and may see the MER/GER if finalised before the JLoI.

Given the State's negotiating position and the possible market sensitivity of information on the negotiations, I cannot publicly address the conditions of the possible agreements between TSN and the State.

Gezien de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat en de mogelijke koersgevoeligheid van de informatie over de onderhandelingen, kan ik in het openbaar niet ingaan op de voorwaarden van de mogelijke afspraken tussen TSN en de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht ''Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is''
