An MP asked the State Secretary whether the government's climate policy suffices to meet the 2030 targets in mobility, and about the emission effects of the lower fuel excise, higher motorway speed, delayed zero-emission zones and road pricing. The State Secretary answered that the effects can only be assessed in the Klimaat- en Energieverkenning due 24 October, that additional policy will be considered in spring 2025 if needed, and that the fuel excise cut is not newly analysed.
From this it will become clear whether additional policy is needed to achieve the climate targets for mobility.
Hieruit zal blijken of aanvullend beleid nodig is om de klimaatdoelstellingen voor mobiliteit te behalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Michon-Derkzen over online video’s in treinen voor pornoplatforms

MPs Veltman and Michon-Derkzen asked the government about online videos of people masturbating on trains that are posted on porn platforms, and about enforcement against offenders and platform responsibility. The Secretary of State answered that existing criminal provisions can address the offenders, that NS handles preventive measures and reports on-the-spot cases to police, that platforms are bound by the DSA's notice-and-action duties, and that no new action is planned beyond existing measures.
Therefore I see no need to consult further.
Ik zie daarom ook geen noodzaak om nader in overleg te gaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over Het RIVM-onderzoek ter onderbouwing van het Europese PFAS restrictievoorstel en het bericht: Advies aangescherpt: speel niet in zeeschuim, maar strandganger weet van niets

An MP asks the ministers about the RIVM study underpinning the EU PFAS restriction proposal, whether municipalities and environmental services have legal grounds to curb PFAS emissions, revision obligations, the precedent of court rulings, and the late and narrow public advice on PFAS in sea foam. The government answers that the RIVM report is a building block for permit decisions, that existing duties of care and permit revision apply, that a guidance document is coming in autumn, and that the advice is unchanged with clarifications added on the website and app.

However, this report can be used as a building block to substantiate individual decisions on tightening permits or imposing tailor-made requirements to ultimately bring PFAS (and much of F-gas) emissions down to zero.

Wel kan dit rapport als bouwsteen worden gebruikt voor de onderbouwing van individuele besluiten over het aanscherpen van vergunningen of het opleggen van maatwerkvoorschriften om emissies van PFAS (en een groot deel van de F-gassen) uiteindelijk naar nul terug te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga  over de faillissementen in de plastic recyclingindustrie

MP Bamenga asked about plastic recycling bankruptcies, rising plastic incineration, CO2 effects, job losses, the EU plastic levy, the circular economy law, and support measures for recyclers. The government attributes the downturn to low virgin plastic prices and expects a temporary dip, pointing to planned EU and national measures, a 267 million euro subsidy package, and anti-dumping tools, while declining to provide job-loss figures and saying the data on incineration trends are unreliable.
The cabinet does not have this information.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de Kamerbrief van de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether a state secretary's letter distancing himself from a 'minder, minder' remark, while still personally standing by it, is consistent with cabinet unity and acceptable given a court ruling that the remark was punishable. The Prime Minister answers that the state secretary has retracted the remarks and will not repeat them, that personal views do not apply in office, and that the matter is closed.
Rightly, the letter states that these views in no way reflect cabinet policy.
Terecht wordt in de brief gesteld dat deze opvattingen op geen enkele manier het kabinetsbeleid reflecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Bamenga en Rooderkerk over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs from D66 asked the government to react to news that residents near heavy industry have higher healthcare costs, and about health data, pollution, legal enforcement of permits and the Tata Steel negotiations. The government answered that health depends on many factors so the link to industry is not direct, that no specific national data exists but further research (RIVM studies, a health impact method for permits under the Omgevingswet) is underway, and that enforcement tools lie with provinces and municipalities.
No, such insight specifically for residents of industry does not exist, and this possible link cannot simply be demonstrated, because it depends on many factors.
Nee, dergelijk inzicht speciaal voor omwonenden van de industrie bestaat niet en dit eventuele verband is ook niet zomaar aan te tonen, omdat het afhangt van veel factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gabriëls over het overnemen van de adviezen van de Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond als harde voorwaarde bij de onderhandelingen over de maatwerkafspraken

MPs Thijssen and Gabriëls asked how health of residents and workers is systematically included in the Tata Steel maatwerkafspraak negotiations, and whether the government's commitments go beyond the motion on adopting the Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond advice. The government answers that health is an integral part of the negotiation mandate, that a health paragraph will be included in the Joint Letter of Intent, that the health impact assessment (GER) is delayed and expected in 2025, and that most correspondence cannot be shared because it would harm the state's negotiating position.
Many of the documents and correspondence contain information that could harm the State's negotiating position.
Veel van de documenten en correspondentie bevatten informatie die de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat kunnen benadelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat zeeschuim onveilig is door vervuiling met PFAS

An SP MP asked the government about news that sea foam is unsafe due to PFAS pollution, including whether beach visitors were informed of tightened advice, what warnings were issued, and whether PFAS production should be halted and damages recovered from polluters. The minister replied that the advice is unchanged apart from clarifying wording, that no warning signs were placed, that producers cannot yet be identified, and that a full production stop is rejected in favour of a broad EU ban.
The advice on PFAS in sea foam is unchanged.
Het advies omtrent PFAS in zeeschuim is ongewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het bericht 'Wederom groot aantal geneesmiddelentekorten'

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reported drug shortages, when the government was informed, what measures were taken and planned, why no significant steps had been made on a strategic stockpile, and whether patients suffered complications. The minister acknowledges the long-running shortage problem, points to EU-level research, the national shortage reporting point and a stockpile being mapped, and states that most shortages are resolved without serious harm for patients.
I am therefore currently mapping how other European countries have organised their stockpile policy.
Ik breng daarom op dit moment in kaart op welke wijze andere Europese landen hun voorraadbeleid ingericht hebben.
Antwoord op vagen van het lid Jansen over tekorten van medische hulpmiddelen in de langdurige zorg

An MP asked the health minister about shortages of protective equipment and medical supplies in long-term care during the COVID-19 crisis, including gloves, aprons, masks and disinfectants, and whether staff were working unprotected. The minister answered by referring to a general COVID-19 update letter to parliament rather than answering each question directly.
The written questions from MP Jansen (PVV) to the Minister for Medical Care have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Jansen (PVV) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Van Aalst over het bericht dat hulpdiensten in de knel komen door de verlaging van de maximumsnelheid

Two MPs from the PVV asked the minister whether lowering the daytime speed limit to 100 km/h would lengthen emergency response times and endanger people in need, and whether the government would protect emergency services. The minister answered that the effects are expected to be small to negligible, that emergency services may still exceed the limit by up to 40 km/h, and that the effects will be monitored with the Kenniscentrum Voorrangsvoertuigen and adjusted if bottlenecks emerge.
The exact effects of the speed reduction between 06:00 and 19:00 on emergency service response times are currently not known.
De exacte effecten van de snelheidsverlaging tussen 06.00 en 19.00 uur op de aanrijtijden van de hulpdiensten zijn op dit moment niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht ‘Vindicat met 900 leden op wintersport naar Italië, ondanks coronavirus’

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports that student association Vindicat sent 900 members on a ski trip to northern Italy despite coronavirus, and asked whether this reflected incoherent policy and what measures would be taken on return. The minister answered that travel advice for the region changed only after the group left, that the advisories of RIVM and foreign affairs serve as the clear rules, and that GGD Groningen will coordinate the group's return with screening on arrival.
At the moment the Vindicat members departed, non-essential travel to this area was not yet being advised against.
Op het moment dat de leden van Vindicat vertrokken werden niet essentiële reizen naar dit gebied nog niet ontraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over de ontwikkelingen rondom het Coronavirus

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Medical Care about the spread, transmission, incubation period, mortality, origin and treatment of COVID-19, and about Chinese measures in Wuhan. The minister answered that the RIVM's current evidence is provisional, gave the RIVM estimates (2% mortality, 7-day incubation), and described Dutch containment measures without addressing the underlying policy choices in depth.
I am keeping a close eye on the situation.
Ik houd de situatie nauwlettend in de gaten.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Veltman over het bericht ‘Arriva: 92 procent van boetes voor zwartrijden van en naar azc Ter Apel niet betaald’

VVD MPs Veltman and Rajkowski asked the state secretary and the asylum minister about reports that 92 percent of fare-evasion fines near the Ter Apel asylum centre went unpaid, and whether identity checks, reentry bans and fine collection could be improved. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, describes identity-check procedures and fine processes, and says talks with carriers and COA are ongoing with the asylum minister committed to examining how fines can be recovered, though a concrete pilot was not committed to.
Fare evasion and not paying the fine undermine the system and contribute to the deterioration of public transport.
Zwartrijden en het niet betalen van de boete ondermijnen het systeem en dragen bij aan een verloedering van het openbaar vervoer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Veltman over de berichten ‘Perroncontroles 'overlasttrein' Zwolle - Emmen komen niet terug’ en ‘Staatssecretaris: snel oplossing voor mogelijk overslaan treinstation Maarheeze

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that perron checks on the Zwolle-Emmen line had stopped and that Maarheeze station might be skipped, and about safety, identification and enforcement against nuisance by asylum seekers on public transport. The minister answered that safety is a shared responsibility, that operators have replaced perron checks with on-board staff, that identification of offenders is limited because operators lack access to the basic register of foreigners, and that a structural solution for Maarheeze is still being negotiated.
The collection rate is commercially confidential information and cannot be shared for either company.
Het inningspercentage is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan voor beide bedrijven niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over de brand op een vrachtschip in de haven van Amsterdam

MPs Bamenga and Rooderkerk (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the cause of a May 2025 ship fire in the Amsterdam port, repeated fires, prevention measures, and health monitoring of residents. The minister answered that the cause is unknown and the matter is a local responsibility, cited general measures on battery waste and prevention by industry, and reported that GGD and the safety region issued advice to residents.
This concerns a local incident, which is handled by the local competent authority.
Het betreft een lokaal incident, dat door het lokaal bevoegd gezag behandeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over PFAS-lozingen Custom Powders

An MP asked the government about PFAS discharges by Custom Powders in Helmond, including the role of oversight, health effects, liability, costs and future prevention. The minister answered that the municipality will commission an independent investigation into its own oversight role, that PFOA effects are recognised but causality is not established, that liability lies with polluters through courts, and that structural measures (VTH reform, Routekaart, industry action agenda) are under way with further information promised before the summer recess.

The municipality of Helmond, as competent authority for the sewage discharges, has therefore announced an independent investigation into the role of the municipality and the environmental service, including licensing, supervision and enforcement.

De gemeente Helmond, als bevoegd gezag voor de rioollozingen, heeft daarom aangekondigd dat er een onafhankelijk onderzoek komt naar de rol van de gemeente en de milieudienst, inclusief vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kostić over milieu- en gezondheidsschade door industriële emissies

An MP asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about health and environmental damage from industrial emissions, cuts to clean air and noise policy, enforcement capacity, independent monitoring and conditions on negotiated agreements with polluting firms. The government responds that it takes the OVV findings seriously, points to ongoing measures such as the Industry and Residents action agenda, RIE implementation and studies due late 2025, but declines to commit to specific new funding or binding conditions for now, citing its demissionary status and pending studies.

At present, as part of the Industry and Residents Action Agenda, it is being mapped which improvements and innovations are possible regarding monitoring and controlling polluting emissions at companies.

Op dit moment wordt als onderdeel van de Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden in kaart gebracht welke verbeteringen en innovaties mogelijk zijn ten aanzien van het monitoren en controleren van verontreinigende emissies bij bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de PFAS-vervuiling door het bedrijf Custom Powders in Helmond

An MP asked how the government will respond to PFAS contamination by Custom Powders in Helmond, including unpermitted PFOA discharges, worker exposure, and whether Chemours should be held liable. The minister answered that municipal authority and courts determine liability, that employers are primarily responsible for worker safety, and that a separate exploration of a national PFAS ban will be sent.
Ultimately it is up to the court to determine whether there is legal liability and whether compensation must be awarded.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om vast te stellen of er sprake is van juridische aansprakelijkheid en of er schadevergoeding moet worden toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Hirsch over de verwerking van ingezamelde kleding door modeketens

MPs Gabriëls and Hirsch asked about Radar's finding that clothing collected by fashion chains is often exported to developing countries rather than reused or recycled, and about transparency, consumer information, enforcement and export rules. Minister Madlener answered that export data and transparency are limited, that the UPV Textiel reporting and enforcement are still being built out, and that the revised EU waste shipment regulation and waste framework directive will tighten export rules from 2027.
There is currently little transparency about what happens to the clothing after it has been collected.
Er is op dit moment weinig transparantie over wat er met de kleding gebeurt nadat het is ingezameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de NS-ticketautomaat op de veerhaven van ’t Horntje

An SP MP asked the minister whether NS may remove the ticket machine at the 't Horntje ferry port on Texel, citing ageing residents and tight transfers. The minister answers that NS is operationally responsible, usage is very low, one machine per station remains (Den Helder), and NS is consulting the Texel municipality on possibly keeping the machine temporarily.
The consideration regarding the ticket vending machines is an operational responsibility of NS.
De afweging met betrekking tot de kaartverkoopautomaten is een operationele verantwoordelijkheid van NS.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Stultiens over de berichtgeving waarin bedrijven in een manifest de regering oproepen met voortvarender beleid te komen ter stimulans van de circulaire economie

MPs Gabriëls and Stultiens asked why the circular economy is lagging despite the 2030 targets, following a business manifesto calling for faster government action. The state secretary acknowledged the urgency, pointed to an updated Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie due after the summer, and listed fiscal measures replacing the withdrawn polymer levy, while largely deferring concrete commitments.
The policy measures the cabinet will take will be included in the previously mentioned update of the NPCE.
De beleidsmaatregelen die het kabinet zal nemen zullen worden opgenomen in de eerder genoemde actualisatie van het NPCE.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het artikel waarin wordt bekendgemaakt dat buitenlandse ondernemers geen boete krijgen als zij met een vervuilend voertuig een zero-emissiezone inrijden

An MP asks the state secretary whether foreign vehicles entering zero-emission zones can avoid fines because they cannot be automatically enforced, and whether this justifies postponing the zones. The state secretary acknowledges the enforcement gap, says it is being addressed through bilateral agreements and manual checks by municipalities, and rejects postponement to 2029.
It is therefore being examined whether bilateral agreements can be made with the countries that account for the largest shares of foreign vehicles driving in Dutch cities.
Er wordt daarom onderzocht of er bilaterale afspraken gemaakt kunnen worden met de landen die de grootste aandelen buitenlandse voertuigen in de Nederlandse steden hebben rijden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent, Koekkoek en Kostić over de berichten dat milieutoezichthouders strengere regels wilden voor staalslakken

MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that environmental inspectors (ILT) wanted stricter rules for steel slag, why the ILT advice was not shared with parliament, and whether slag use as a building material is safe. The State Secretary answered that the ILT advice was tied to a permit application never filed, that a notification duty will replace the planned information duty (expected early 2026), and that use of LD slag as sand substitute in layers thicker than half a metre is being investigated, while ruling out generic classification of slag as waste.
The advice did not acquire formal status because no permit application was submitted.
Het advies heeft geen formele status gekregen vanwege het ontbreken van een aanvraag voor een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over Europese financiering voor de Nedersaksenlijn en de Lelylijn

JA21 MP Eerdmans asked why the government reallocated Lelylijn reserved funds despite a unanimous motion, and whether EU co-financing is at risk. The State Secretary answered that EU funding would only ever cover a limited share, that the funds were moved to the Nedersaksenlijn and other projects, and that the Masterplan Lelylijn continues, while declining to see a breach of trust with the Commission.
Last December the motion to keep the existing Lelylijn budget reserved and not use it for other purposes was adopted with support from the whole chamber; why did you not respect this motion?

Afgelopen december is de motie «het bestaande budget voor de Lelylijn gereserveerd houden en niet aanwenden voor andere doeleinden», kamerbreed aangenomen, waarom heeft u deze motie niet gerespecteerd?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het bericht dat werkzaamheden aan het spoor en het alternatieve vervoer, als gevolg daarvan, niet goed geregeld zijn

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that NS's information provision and replacement transport during rail works are poorly organised, and about NS's annual report claiming good information provision. The state secretary said NS meets its concession obligations, is implementing some of Rover's recommendations, will discuss earlier publication of works with NS, and will keep looking for improvements, without committing to a concrete new rule.

According to article 11 of the concession, in the event of a train service disruption NS must ensure 1) the shortest possible time for alternative travel options 2) with the shortest possible travel time extension, insofar as reasonably possible and necessary.

Volgens artikel 11 van de concessie dient NS in het geval van een treindienstverstoring te zorgen voor 1) een zo kort mogelijke termijn voor alternatieve reisopties 2) met een zo kort mogelijke omreistijd voor zover dit redelijkerwijs mogelijk en noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over de monitoring van zero-emissiezones

An MP asked the state secretary about the bimonthly monitoring of zero-emission zones, the impact on entrepreneurs and market traders, and whether municipalities may set local exemptions without national infrastructure. The state secretary answered that data covers only one month, no notable impact on deliveries was seen, consultations with industry bodies are ongoing, and local exemptions are a municipal choice that must use their own infrastructure.
The monitoring is based on one month of data, so it is not yet possible to determine the precise impact of the zero-emission zones.
De monitoring is gebaseerd op data van één maand, waardoor het nog niet mogelijk is de precieze impact van de zero-emissiezones vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht “Risico’s met bouwmateriaal vol gevaarlijke stoffen al jaren bekend, Rekenkamer kritisch”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary why warnings from the Court of Audit, the ILT and the Arnhem environmental service about risks of misapplied immobilisate (secondary building material with hazardous substances) were not heeded, and what steps would prevent pollution at a Zevenaar site and recover clean-up costs. The State Secretary answered that the concerns are taken seriously, citing planned mandatory washing of bottom ash, an information duty since 2024, a review of the quality guideline, and ILT enforcement, while stating that enforcement and cost recovery are for the local authority and polluter-pays case-by-case assessment.
I recognise the signals from the Court of Audit, ILT and ODRA and take them seriously.
Ik herken de signalen van de Algemene Rekenkamer, ILT en ODRA en neem deze serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over ‘intimidatie, agressie en geweld in het openbaar vervoer’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about intimidation, aggression and violence on public transport, including the prosecution gap after assaults on NS conductors, the Aanvalsplan motion, camera coverage and bodycams. The State Secretary answers that the government is intensifying measures such as bodycams, camera subsidies and access to the vehicle register for OV-boa's, but that many measures take time and some answers depend on other bodies.
I completely agree that there is no place for violence, intimidation and aggression in public transport and that this must be firmly opposed.
Ik ben het helemaal eens dat er in het openbaar vervoer geen plek is voor geweld, intimidatie en agressie en dat daar hard tegen moet worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de door het Ministerie van I&W uitgezette enquête over geur van veehouderijen

MP Van der Plas asked why a ministry-run survey on livestock odour uses leading questions, offers VVV vouchers as an incentive, and was distributed to residents in six municipalities, and whether it should be suspended. The State Secretary defended the survey as part of a standard participation process, said an external bureau designed it, that responses are weighted equally, and that the research will be reported in Q3 2025, but refused to suspend it.
I will therefore not suspend the survey.
Ik zal de enquête daarom niet opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over minder intercitystops in Weert, de intercityverbinding Eindhoven – Aken, en de algemene bereikbaarheid met en binnen Limburg

An MP asked the State Secretary about reduced intercity stops around Weert during PHS works and about the long-delayed Eindhoven–Aken intercity connection. The government says the works are necessary and that NS keeps regional connections, while the IC Aken depends on Eindhoven capacity works and cannot be realised before 2031 at the earliest, with a timeline to follow only once financing is clear.
A condition for drawing up a realistic timeline is that there is (prospect of) financing.
Voorwaarde om een realistisch tijdspad op te stellen is dat er (zicht op) financiering is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over Europese financiering voor de Nedersaksenlijn en de Lelylijn

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about possible EU funding (CEF, EIB, military mobility programmes) for the Nedersaksenlijn and Lelylijn rail projects and about a meeting with the EU transport commissioner. The State Secretary answered that EU funds cannot be pre-committed and are only an additional source, that CEF budgets are largely exhausted, that the post-2027 budget is uncertain, and that EIB loans do not solve the national budget problem.
The Commission has confirmed that the European Union cannot make advance commitments on possible funding prospects for specific infrastructure projects, including the Lelylijn and Nedersaksenlijn.

De Commissie heeft bevestigd dat vanuit de Europese Unie geen toezeggingen vooraf gedaan kunnen worden over mogelijke financieringskansen van concrete infrastructuurprojecten, ook niet voor de Lelylijn en Nedersaksenlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de beschikbaarheid van essentiële data met betrekking tot aardbevingen in Groningen

An SP MP asked whether KNMI data on Groningen earthquakes (catalogue, PGA/PGV values) had become outdated or harder to access after the seismic chain migrated to AWS, and how this affects residents and lawyers. The minister denied any reduction in availability, stated the data remain updated and accessible via KNMI platforms, pointed to the IMG taking new scientific insights into account, and committed to continued stakeholder consultation.
All data and products are unchanged available on AWS, in a renewed and more maintainable system that contributes to robust 24/7 availability.
Alle data en producten zijn op AWS onverminderd beschikbaar, in een vernieuwd en beter te onderhouden systeem dat bijdraagt aan een robuuste 24/7-beschikbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over gebrekkige handhaving van milieuregels in Noord- en Midden-Limburg

An MP asked the state secretary why Northern and Central Limburg lacks a full environmental enforcement service (omgevingsdienst) and whether the region will meet robustness criteria in time. The state secretary agreed this is undesirable, said responsibility lies with the municipalities and provinces as owners, and noted the region is not expected to be robust by 1 April 2026, with IenW monitoring and supporting the process.
The Ministry of IenW supports the steps the province is taking within the framework of IBT; this has also been stated in official contact between officials and the province of Limburg.
Het Ministerie van IenW ondersteunt de stappen die de provincie zet in het kader van IBT, dit is in ambtelijk contact tussen ambtenaren met de provincie Limburg ook benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent en Kostić over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how citizens, animals and the environment are protected against LD steel slag, which RIVM classifies as hazardous, and how regulation, enforcement and interbestuurlijk toezicht will be strengthened. The State Secretary answered that duty-of-care rules and enforcement apply, that several steps (information duty, updated circular, regulatory review) are underway, and that the risks are recognised, while stating that municipalities and provinces carry enforcement responsibility.
That is why steps have been taken and I am currently working, as part of the review of soil regulation, on
Daarom zijn er stappen ondernomen en ben ik op dit moment in het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving aan de slag met
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over Chemours

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and Volt asked the State Secretary about Chemours, its recent leak and past accidents, its lobbying in Europe against the PFAS ban, and the scientific claims used by industry. The State Secretary answered that supervision of the Seveso site is shared with inspection partners, that the leak caused no soil, water or drinking water effects, and that the PFAS restriction is under assessment by ECHA, with the government saying it would take a position once the Commission proposal exists.
I am not responsible for that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het uitvallen van de drielandentrein Luik-Maastricht-Aken

MP De Hoop asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about frequent cancellations of the Luik-Maastricht-Aachen cross-border train, including causes such as staff shortages, technical faults, infrastructure capacity and cross-border licensing rules. The State Secretary answers all 26 questions in substance, acknowledges the problems, describes improvement measures and says the government is in ongoing contact with partners, without committing to new formal sanctions.
Do you share the great concerns about continuity on this line? If not, why not?
Vraag 9 Deelt u de grote zorgen over de continuïteit op deze lijn? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Westerveld over de toegankelijkheid van het OV

MPs De Hoop and Westerveld asked the state secretaries about accessibility of public transport for people with disabilities, including lift and escalator outages, information provision and train design. The state secretary answered that full accessibility by 2030 is not feasible, that the 2040 target stands, and described ongoing measures with ProRail and operators, while committing to periodic reporting on lift functioning.
Achieving fully accessible public transport by 2030 is not feasible, but the sector has long been working to bring that goal closer.
Het verwezenlijken van volledig toegankelijk openbaar vervoer in 2030 is niet haalbaar, maar de sector spant zich al geruime tijd in om die doelstelling steeds dichter bij te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het nieuwsbericht ‘Mode-industrie maakt nog nauwelijks begin met verplicht recyclen’

An MP asked the State Secretary why textile recycling remains near 0.3% despite the extended producer responsibility (UPV) for textiles, whether producers and the Stichting UPV Textiel are doing enough, and whether the ILT will enforce compliance. The State Secretary answered that the targets took effect in 2025 to give producers time, reporting is due from 2026, the ILT will enforce from then, and it is too early to judge effectiveness; stricter measures are possible after the 2028 evaluation or the EU waste directive revision.
From 2026 the ILT can enforce whether these targets are met, based on the submitted reports.
Vanaf 2026 kan de ILT handhaven op het al dan niet behalen van deze doelstellingen op basis van de ingediende rapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over de procedure van de Europese Commissie over het hoofdrailnet

An MP asks the State Secretary about the European Commission's infringement procedure threatening legal action over the direct award of the main rail network concession to NS, including the Commission's reasons, the need for a market analysis, possible court outcomes and costs. The State Secretary answers that Nederland will respond to the reasoned opinion within two months, defends the direct award as grounded in market research, and says the financial consequences cannot yet be estimated.
The infringement procedure and the reasoned opinion that forms part of it are a confidential procedure.
De inbreukprocedure en het met redenen omkleed advies, dat daar een onderdeel van is, betreft een vertrouwelijke procedure.
Antwoord op vragen de leden White en Gabriëls over het circulaire economiebeleid in Caribisch Nederland

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about circular economy policy in the Caribbean Netherlands, the state of waste management and plastic pollution there, and whether extended producer responsibility should be extended to these islands. The State Secretary answered that the islands have no specific circular economy policy but have environmental plans and plastic bans, that the ministry supports waste policy there, and that extending producer responsibility is not supported without prior research, while committing to examine further measures with the islands.
I am willing to examine with those islands how the actions already in place to further reduce plastic pollution can be continued.
Ik ben bereid met die eilanden te onderzoeken hoe verdergegaan kan worden met de acties die al ingesteld zijn om de plasticvervuiling verder te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wingelaar en Gabriëls over strengere regels voor het gebruik van Beaumix

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports on Beaumix, a secondary building material, and calls for stricter rules, following RIVM and Court of Audit warnings. The State Secretary replied that the findings will be incorporated into the ongoing review of soil regulation, that Beaumix may continue to be used under current quality standards if applied correctly, that lab results from Stein may be considered if representative, and that Parliament will be informed in summer 2025.
Should research show that these quality requirements need to be tightened, I will of course take that into account in implementing the aforementioned motion.
Mocht uit onderzoek blijken dat deze kwaliteitseisen moeten worden aangescherpt, dan zal ik dat vanzelfsprekend meewegen in de uitvoering van bovengenoemde motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over windturbinegeluid

MP Vermeer (BBB) asks the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the wind turbine noise standard, the RIVM factsheet, health effects, sleep disturbance, the proposed 10% severe-annoyance norm, and a moratorium on turbines, with calls to stop turbines at night and withdraw permits. The state secretary defends the L den norm and the plan-MER, rejects the moratorium and permit withdrawal as the competence of local or provincial authorities, and promises no new measures beyond continued research.

No, there is no reason for this. The noise standards are, in line with WHO guideline values and the norms for other noise sources, expressed as the annual average noise measure L den, because it aligns with the annoyance relationships available from scientific research.

Nee, hiertoe is geen aanleiding. De geluidsnormen zijn, in lijn met de WHO-advieswaarden en met de normen voor andere geluidbronnen, uitgedrukt in de jaargemiddelde geluidmaat L den , omdat deze aansluit bij de uit wetenschappelijk onderzoek beschikbare hinderrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het vrijkomen van tetrafluorethyleen door een leidingbreuk bij Chemours

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a release of about 45 kg of tetrafluoroethylene gas at Chemours Dordrecht, its cause, health and environmental effects, worker health, prevention, criminal consequences and cleanup costs. The answers attribute the release to a ruptured safety disc at normal process conditions, judge risk to residents unlikely, say no worker was affected, and point to the provincial competent authority and DCMR for enforcement and cause analysis.
The breaking of a rupture disc must be seen as the direct cause of the incident. This does not yet provide insight into the underlying causes of the unusual occurrence.
Het doorbreken van een breekplaat moet gezien worden als de directe oorzaak van het incident. Hiermee is er nog geen inzicht in de onderliggende oorzaken van het ongewone voorval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Grinwis over het spoortraject Emmen-Rheine

MPs Vedder and Grinwis asked whether the government will ensure the cross-border Emmen-Rheine rail link can open by December 2026, given that German trains lack Dutch approval for the last 0.5 km into Coevorden and a simplified vehicle-authorisation procedure has not yet been confirmed. The Secretary of State says the ILT, an independent regulator, decides on authorisation, that the government is facilitating talks with ILT and EU bodies, and that it will keep the House informed, but declines to intervene in the regulator's decision.
The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) ultimately assesses and decides whether to grant a Dutch vehicle authorisation.
De Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) beoordeelt en besluit uiteindelijk over het al dan niet toekennen van een Nederlandse voertuigvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht dat vervuilende staalslakken worden geïmporteerd vanuit het buitenland

MP Gabriëls asked the State Secretary about reports that polluting steel slag is imported from abroad as waste and then used as a building material, including whether import should be restricted given health and environmental uncertainties. The State Secretary answered that import volumes are only indicative, that slag can be safely used under soil regulations regardless of waste status, and that the government will look at better safeguards in the soil regulation review but will not restrict imports.
No data can be obtained from waste monitoring for this.
Uit de monitoring van afvalstoffen zijn hiervoor geen gegevens te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White, Gabriëls en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Bewoners Bonaire geëvacueerd na grote brand bij de vuilstort’

MPs White, Gabriëls and Slagt-Tichelman asked about a large fire at the Selibon waste dump on Bonaire, its health and environmental effects, and the permit and oversight failures at the site. The government answered that the underground fire is not yet controlled, that the acting Kingdom Representative has taken over permitting and enforcement from the island authority due to neglect of duty, and that a waste plan and asbestos and biomedical waste measures are being prepared.

This led to a decision by the acting Kingdom Representative (on 15 November 2024) to step in for the island executive and make a number of decisions on permitting, supervision and enforcement at Selibon/Lagun.

Dit heeft geleid tot een besluit van de waarnemend Rijksvertegenwoordiger (op 15 november 2024) om indeplaats te treden van het bestuurscollege en daarmee te voorzien in een aantal beslissingen op het gebied van vergunningverlening, toezicht-, en handhaving (VTH) bij Selibon/Lagun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over het artikel 'Kankerverwekkend gas lekte weg bij Sabic’?

An MP asks the state secretary about reports of a butadiene leak at Sabic in Chemelot and whether the government's reassurances on health impacts and cumulative risks are credible. The state secretary answers that incidents were reported and handled by the province and regional environmental service, that limits were not exceeded, and that RIVM will run an exploratory health study expected next year.
The reporting system worked well in this case.
Het systeem van melden heeft in deze casus goed gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buijsse over het artikel 'Minder (gerecycled) plastic geproduceerd, zorgen over duurzaamheid'

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about the bankruptcies of Dutch plastic recycling firms, the sector's signals, the role of incinerators and chemical industry, and recyclate volumes in the plastics chain. The government acknowledged the problem, outlined a plastic levy from 2028, a circular plastics norm from 2027, EUR 267 million in subsidies, and said it would weigh effects in the Spring Memorandum 2025 without irreversible decisions in the meantime.
At the Spring Memorandum 2025, the effects of the circular plastics norm and the plastic levy will be weighed together, and no irreversible decisions will be taken until then.
Bij de Voorjaarsnota van 2025 zullen de effecten van de circulaireplasticnorm en de plastic heffing integraal worden gewogen en zullen tot die tijd geen onomkeerbare besluiten worden genomen.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Kostić, Wingelaar, Koekkoek, Gabriëls, Bamenga en Van Kent over het RTL Nieuws onderzoek 'Meer ziekmakende stoffen in de lucht bij 125 bedrijven door heel Nederland’

Six MPs asked the state secretary about an RTL Nieuws investigation showing rising emissions of hazardous substances (including PAK) at many industrial firms, and about the effectiveness of the ZZS minimisation duty, reporting errors at Tata Steel and the role of competent authorities. The state secretary answered that enforcement and assessment of emissions data is primarily the responsibility of competent authorities such as the provinces and environmental services, pointed to the Impulsprogramma Chemische Stoffen and the Actieagenda, promised to consult competent authorities and to ask RIVM and the Expertgroep for a reassessment, and declined to act on several requests because they fall under other bodies.
The competent authority may use all means available to it, including filing a criminal complaint; I do not interfere further in this.
Het bevoegde gezag kan gebruik maken van alle middelen die hen ter beschikking staan, waaronder het doen van aangifte, ik meng mij hier verder niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het bericht ‘Steden klaar met falend lachgasbeleid’

An MP asked the government about municipalities' complaints that the nitrous oxide ban has caused disposable canisters to end up in household waste, causing explosions and costs of around 150 million euros a year, and whether the state will compensate them. The government answered that the problem stems from illegal disposal and non-refillable canisters rather than the ban itself, rejected liability and compensation beyond a pilot, and said it will keep supporting municipalities with a toolkit, a 450,000 euro pilot and enforcement, without new regulation.
The State is not liable for the conduct of those who illegally dump the nitrous oxide canisters with residual waste or in public space.
De Staat is niet aansprakelijk voor het handelen van degenen die illegaal de lachgascilinders bij het restafval of in de openbare ruimte dumpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over stankoverlast door een kunstmestbedrijf in Amsterdam

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about odour and emission nuisance from fertilizer producer ICL Fertilizers in Amsterdam, including health impacts, outdated norms and monitoring gaps. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (the province of Noord-Holland), noted enforcement steps such as an order under penalty and additional measurements, and pointed to ongoing programmes and studies without committing to new binding measures.
The competent authority oversees this through licensing, supervision and enforcement.
Het bevoegd gezag ziet hierop toe door middel van vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger van Dijk en Pierik over het bericht 'Rijksadviseur Wouter Veldhuis is om: Lelylijn zonder Duitse connectie wél van belang.'

MPs Olger van Dijk and Pierik asked the State Secretary about a news report on the Lelylijn and Nedersaksenlijn rail projects, including whether further study should be done and how the projects can be financed. The State Secretary answered that both lines are priorities, that MIRT start conditions require about 75% financing not yet secured (roughly 7 billion euro for Lelylijn and 1.3 billion for Nedersaksenlijn), that financing options are still being studied, and that a final decision on next steps will be taken by the spring memorandum.
By the spring memorandum (April 2025) at the latest, the cabinet will take the definitive decision on the next steps for the Lelylijn.
Uiterlijk bij voorjaarsnota (april 2025) zal door het kabinet het definitieve besluit over de vervolgstappen voor de Lelylijn worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht 'Nieuwe Eurocity direct naar Brussel voor veel mensen te duur'

An MP asked the State Secretary why the new Eurocity Direct fare to Brussels is far higher than a comparable domestic trip, how this fits a motion asking for domestic-like treatment, why border crossings carry extra cost, and why OV-chipkaart check-in posts and some discount subscriptions do not extend across the Belgian border. The State Secretary answered that international operating costs justify the higher fare, that cross-border tariffs fall outside the concession, that check-in posts depend on bilateral agreements and technical complexity, and that the Eurocity Direct discounts end at Rotterdam Centraal.
However, the pricing of international train journeys falls outside the scope of the new concession (2025–2033).
De tarifering van internationale treinreizen valt echter buiten de reikwijdte van de nieuwe concessie (2025–2033).
Antwoord op van de leden Kostić, Van Kent, Gabriëls en Bamenga over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

MPs asked whether LD steel slag is a waste or a by-product usable as building material, citing a critical report from Stichting Natuurlijk Schoon Eerbeek, and asked about contamination risks, enforcement, financial incentives and possible suspension of use. The Minister rejected the report's conclusions, stated that the 2017 legal opinion is not a generic ruling, said use is permissible within regulatory frameworks, and announced a planned nationwide information obligation and review of soil regulation, while declining to suspend use or detail Tata Steel agreements.
As part of the review of soil regulation, I will examine to what extent it is desirable to tighten the regulations further.
In het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving zal ik bezien in hoeverre het wenselijk is de regelgeving nog verder aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over «Ongewenst en onacceptabel, maar we hebben geen keus, provincie woedend over treinloze maanden in 2029»

An MP asked the state secretary about the consequences of choosing the Zeeuwse Lijn as the ERTMS test section, which would mean about 3-4 months without passenger trains and later unreliability, and whether the decision was coordinated with Zeeland authorities. The state secretary answered that the choice was made after an analysis of candidate sections, that Zeeland's province agreed to a package of mitigation measures including replacement bus services, and that exact timing is not yet known.
The test section will be further developed over the coming years, in preparation for the period of track closure, together with other stakeholders in the region.
Het proefbaanvak zal de komende jaren – in voorbereiding op de periode van buitendienststelling- samen met andere belanghebbende partijen in de regio verder uitgewerkt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht «Vier maanden geen treinen tussen Goes en Vlissingen in 2029»

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about public concern over rail reliability in Zeeland, including the choice of Zeeland as the location for an ERTMS test section, communication with the province, and the impact on students. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, defended the stepwise ERTMS approach and the agreed mitigation package with the province, and committed to ongoing communication and replacement bus services, without giving a final date for the test section closure.
The exact timing of the track closure is not yet known at this moment.
Het exacte moment van de buitendienststelling is op dit moment nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Van den Hil over het bericht ««Ongewenst en onacceptabel, maar we hebben geen keus», provincie woedend over treinloze maanden in 2029»

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a trial stretch of the ERTMS rail signalling system on the Zeeuwse Lijn, which would leave the line without trains for months in 2029, and about the hindrance, replacement transport and communication for travellers. The State Secretary answered that the trial is needed to test the system safely, that the duration is unlikely to be shortened, and that the ministry, NS and ProRail will coordinate replacement transport, monitoring and communication with the province of Zeeland.
As a basis for this, agreements have been made between IenW and the Province of Zeeland on a package of measures for limiting hindrance and reliability.
Als basis hiervoor zijn er afspraken gemaakt over een maatregelpakket voor hinderbeperking en betrouwbaarheid tussen IenW en de Provincie Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht dat Eurostar mogelijk in de loop van 2025 de verbindingen tussen Nederland en Brussel/Parijs en Nederland en Londen opschort

The MP asks whether the planned rebuilding of Amsterdam Centraal, the HSL speed restrictions and capacity problems threaten the Eurostar links to London and Paris, and what the government will do. The State Secretary replies that direct secured Eurostar service to London is planned to resume in January, that the consequences for the timetable are still being assessed, that repairs to the HSL viaducts are targeted for 15 December with funding not yet secured, and that IenW, NS, ProRail and Eurostar remain in talks.
The ministry is therefore continuously in discussion to preserve and improve these connections for the Netherlands.
Het ministerie is daarom ook continu in gesprek om deze verbindingen voor Nederland te behouden en te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Supermarkt “rommelt” wéér met statiegeld, winkel ontkent’

An SP MP asked whether deposit refunds must always be paid in cash after a report that a supermarket refused cash refunds and whether the rules should be amended. The state secretary replied that the regulation requires refunds but not cash specifically, that Verpact must study refund methods by 1 November 2024, and that the deposit scheme will be evaluated and adjusted where needed.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management does not have such data.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat beschikt niet over dergelijke gegevens.
Antwoord op het lid Gabriëls over de certificering van bovengrondse tanks

An MP asked why the certification requirement for above-ground storage tanks was dropped in the Omgevingswet and Bal, and whether this increases environmental risks. The State Secretary replied that RIVM research shows these small tanks pose no external safety risk, that soil-protection rules still apply, and that certification would add no protection, so no reinstatement is planned.
RIVM research has shown that the storage tanks described above do not pose an external safety risk to the surroundings of the activity.
Uit RIVM-onderzoek is gebleken dat de hierboven omschreven opslagtanks geen risico voor externe veiligheid van de omgeving van de activiteit veroorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het media-optreden van de staatssecretaris

An MP asks the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether he distinguishes between his office and his private views after a media appearance with the remark 'minder, minder' (less, less), and whether he will clearly disown it. The government answers that there is no constitutional distinction between office and private person, that the views do not reflect cabinet policy, and that the state secretary has distanced himself from the remarks and will not repeat them.
Guiding this is that as State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management I have distanced myself from my remarks on Monday morning on WNL and have said I will not repeat them.
Leidend hierin is dat ik als Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat afstand heb genomen van mijn uitspraken maandagochtend jl. bij WNL en heb laten weten deze niet meer te herhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heutink over het bericht dat NS verwacht dat treinen in de tweede helft van het jaar vaker te laat komen

An MP asked the state secretary whether NS's expectation of more late trains in the second half of 2024 is acceptable and how the HRN concession performance standards will be enforced. The state secretary admitted performance is disappointing, said a formal assessment will follow the 2024 annual reports and that sanctions are possible if minimum values are missed, and pointed to the Betrouwbaar Beter programme.
Based on the concession agreements, a sanction can be imposed if the minimum values are not met.
Aan de hand van de concessieafspraken kan een sanctie worden opgelegd als niet aan de bodemwaarden wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht dat NS de prijzen van treinkaartjes en abonnementen komend jaar fors gaat verhogen

An MP asked the state secretary about the planned NS train fare increase, its effect on affordability and ridership, and the government's plans to improve public transport. The state secretary acknowledged the affordability concern, explained the increase as a consequence of rising costs and the expiry of one-off compensation, and promised a letter on fare scenarios and further policy later.
In response to the House's request, the cabinet is working on a letter on possible scenarios for NS fare increases.
In reactie op het verzoek van de Kamer werkt het kabinet aan een brief over mogelijke scenario's voor de tariefstijgingen van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over dat het advies met betrekking tot PFAS in zeeschuim is aangescherpt, maar strandgangers van niks weten

An MP asked why the advice to keep children and pets out of sea foam containing PFAS was only published on zwemwater.nl and not on beach signage, and asked about further PFAS measures. The minister replied that the advice was clarified rather than tightened, that the website and app reach about half a million visitors a year, and that beach signs are reserved for acute dangers, with no plans to add the advice to signage.
There is currently no reason for that.
Daar is op dit moment geen aanleiding voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat minder milieucontroles plaatsvinden door personeelstekorten bij omgevingsdiensten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that staff shortages at environmental services (omgevingsdiensten) mean fewer environmental inspections, asking about inspection backlogs, risks, recruitment and measures. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, said the government lacks exact per-service data on backlogs and that municipalities and provinces are responsible for capacity, and pointed to a recruitment campaign and a budget to repeat it.

I do not have information on the exact number of environmental inspections per environmental service that have been left undone or incompletely carried out due to understaffing or failure to meet their own quality requirements.

Ik beschik niet over informatie over het exacte aantal milieucontroles dat per omgevingsdienst is blijven liggen of onvolledig is uitgevoerd vanwege onderbezetting of het niet voldoen aan de eigen kwaliteitseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over dat er minder milieucontroles plaatsvinden vanwege personeelstekorten bij de omgevingsdiensten

An MP asked the State Secretary whether staff shortages at environmental services (omgevingsdiensten) are reducing inspections at major polluting firms, the harm this causes, and why the number of services is not being reduced as the Van Aartsen and Sorgdrager reviews advised. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortages, said inspection priorities lie with competent authorities, offered no data on reduced controls, and pointed to robustness criteria due by April 2026 and ongoing legislative work.
I do not have figures on the number of inspections, nor do I have insight into whether fewer inspections are carried out than would be the case with more staff.
Cijfers over aantallen controles heb ik niet, ook heb ik geen inzicht of er minder controles worden uitgevoerd dan wanneer er meer personeel zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de nieuwe snelheidsverlaging op de HSL

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the renewed speed reduction on the HSL caused by cracks and concrete damage in viaducts, covering causes, repair costs, liability, timelines, and the effects on rail timetables and the Intercity Direct surcharge. The state secretary answered that cause research by ProRail and TU Delft is ongoing, costs are not yet known, the state pays initially, and repairs and timetable impacts are still being studied, while NS keeps the surcharge and the track access fee unchanged.
At this moment research is still being carried out by ProRail, in cooperation with TU Delft, into the cause of the construction defects.
Op dit moment wordt nog onderzoek gedaan door ProRail, in samenwerking met de TU Delft, naar de oorzaak van de constructiefouten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over de toeslag op de hogesnelheidslijn (hierna: HSL) na de nieuwe, tijdelijke snelheidsverlagingen op de HSL

An MP asks why travellers still pay a supplementary fee on the high-speed line (HSL) Intercity Direct when trains now run at reduced speed, and whether the fee should be scrapped and refunded. The state secretary defends keeping the fee to spread passengers and avoid crowding, declines to re-open talks with NS, and reports the estimated financial effects of abolishing it as previously promised.
Even with this new, temporary speed reduction, the travel time between Schiphol and Rotterdam over the HSL remains shorter (about 20 minutes) than via the conventional railway.
Ook met deze nieuwe, tijdelijke snelheidsverlaging blijft de reistijd tussen Schiphol en Rotterdam over de HSL korter (ongeveer 20 minuten) dan via het conventionele spoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de problemen met communicatieapparatuur aan boord van bussen van Qbuzz

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about recurring failures of on-board communication and emergency systems in Qbuzz buses, including a June 2024 stoppage, and whether the IVU-box and payment system are linked. The State Secretary answered that the June incident was a data-processing fault unrelated to earlier ones, that the payment system is separate, and that the concession authority can enforce performance, with Qbuzz listing remedial measures but no commitment to report back to Parliament.
The OV-bureau Groningen-Drenthe can hold Qbuzz to account for this and can enforce performance under the concession.
Het OV-bureau Groningen-Drenthe kan Qbuzz hierop aanspreken en kan op basis van de concessie prestaties afdwingen.
Antwoord op van het lid Bamenga over ‘grote lasten onder dwangsom voor drankenproducenten als gevolg van niet behalen statiegeld doelstellingen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about five penalty orders (lasten onder dwangsom) imposed by the ILT on Verpact for missing deposit-return collection targets, the size of uncollected deposit funds, and related measures such as more return points, transparency on fund use, and possible inclusion of retailers. The State Secretary largely defended the independent enforcement process, confirmed the 2023 target was missed (74% against 90%), promised to press Verpact on return points and transparency, and committed to evaluating the deposit system this year, including linking return obligations to retail sales.

Given the ILT's independent position as supervisor and the ongoing enforcement procedure, a response to the penalty orders, or a judgement on Verpact's conduct in reaction to them, is not appropriate.

Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van de ILT als toezichthouder en het nu lopende handhavingstraject ligt een reactie op de lasten enerzijds, of een oordeel over het handelen in reactie daarop door Verpact anderzijds, niet voor de hand.

Daarom is het nodig in het wetsvoorstel te verduidelijken dat de beheerders van fondsen voor gemene rekening waarin uitsluitend pensioenfondsen participeren zijn vrijgesteld van de toepassing van de richtlijn.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger en Nijboer over de vergunningverlening locatie Schoonebeek van NAM

MPs Kröger and Nijboer asked whether a temporary carbon-filter installation permit for NAM at Schoonebeek signals a resumption of oil extraction and Twente water injection, and about decommissioning costs, e-boiler plans, state subsidies and grid use. The state secretary answered that the permit is only valid until 31 December 2023, that water injection in Twente will not resume under an agreement, and gave cost, subsidy and e-boiler details while noting some matters are NAM's responsibility.
Furthermore, I have agreed with NAM that water injection in Twente will not be resumed, and I will hold NAM to this agreement.
Daarnaast heb ik met de NAM afgesproken dat de waterinjectie in Twente niet zal worden hervat en ik zal de NAM houden aan deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over de extra belasting van woningcorporaties met betrekking tot schadevergoedingen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked why compensation paid to housing corporations for Groningen mining damage is taxed as corporate profit, and whether it should be exempted or compensated. The government replied that the compensation is fiscally neutral over time because associated repair costs offset it, that it sees no reason to defiscalise or compensate, and that the EUR 135 million subsidy, including EUR 750 per tenant, benefits tenants.
However, a compensation payment is fiscally neutral for housing corporations.
Een schadevergoeding pakt voor woningcorporaties echter fiscaal neutraal uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de winning van gas in Norg door NAM

An MP asks the government whether it will allow NAM to extract cushion gas from the Norg gas storage facility, citing supply security and local residents' concerns. The minister answers that NAM needs a permit approval from the minister, with advice from SodM, the Mijnraad, regional authorities and ACM on safety and supply security, and that residents' concerns will be addressed in a consultation process.
In doing so I will seek advice from, among others, the supervisory authority SodM, the Mijnraad and regional authorities.
Daarbij win ik advies in van onder andere toezichthouder SodM, de Mijnraad en regionale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het verpatsen van NAM

MP Nijboer asked whether Shell and ExxonMobil, shareholders of NAM, can be held liable for Groningen gas damage if NAM sells small fields or is split up, and what the government will do to prevent this. The Staatssecretaris answered that Groningen field and storage remain within NAM BV, that NAM is liable under civil law, that Shell and ExxonMobil provide guarantees under the Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen, and that a bill on definitive closure will follow with further information on security arrangements.

Under the Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen, Shell and ExxonMobil are obliged to provide replacement adequate security before the guarantees expire, for damage handling and reinforcement costs for the period after gas extraction ends.

Shell en ExxonMobil zijn op grond van het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen verplicht om voorafgaand aan het vervallen van de garanties (vervangende) passende zekerheden te stellen voor kosten met betrekking tot de schadeafhandeling en versterkingsoperatie voor de periode na de beëindiging van de gaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over mogelijke spionage via Chinese röntgencamera’s voor de douane

Two MPs asked whether Chinese X-ray scanners from Nuctech used by Dutch customs pose espionage risks, citing a Belgian ruling allowing exclusion of the supplier and US/Canadian warnings. The state secretary answered that Dutch procurement law does not allow excluding an EU-established supplier that meets requirements, that national security tools and stricter security requirements are applied, and that the government will explore reducing dependence on a single supplier and coordinate with European customs.
Under the Public Procurement Act 2012 it is not possible to exclude a supplier established in the European Union that meets the stated requirements and conditions.
Op basis van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 is het niet mogelijk om een (in de Europese Unie gevestigde) leverancier, die wel aan de gestelde eisen en voorwaarden voldoet, uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over niet toegestane huurstijgingen

The MP asks the minister whether rent increase clauses in private-sector leases may be unlawful under the EU unfair terms directive, and whether the government will analyse, quantify and remedy possibly excessive rents. The minister says the matter is for courts and parties to the contract, that he lacks data to analyse individual leases, and that he is monitoring developments and talking with tenant and landlord representatives, leaving redress to tenant organisations.
Rental contracts are a matter between landlord and tenant; they require no registration with a third body and are therefore known only to the landlord and tenant concerned.

Huurcontracten zijn een aangelegenheid van en tussen verhuurder en huurder; huurcontracten vereisen geen registratie bij een derde instantie en zijn dus alleen bekend bij de betreffende verhuurder en huurder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Huisbazen kunnen meer huur vragen door regels te omzeilen'

MP Nijboer asks whether the government will act on reports that landlords evade rent-regulation rules through group contracts and that property lawyers advise this without consequence. The minister replies that contract form does not avoid the WWS/WWSO point system, that group contracts are not banned but misuse is undesirable, and that the Wet betaalbare huur will strengthen tenants' position.
With the Affordable Rent Bill I am strengthening the position of tenants.
Met het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur versterk ik de positie van huurders.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Woningcorporatiebazen privé actief als vastgoedbelegger, sector scherpt integriteitscode aan’

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about reports that housing corporation executives privately rent out homes for profit, sometimes near corporation projects and with linked contractors, and how conflicts of interest can be prevented. The Minister called such conflicts undesirable, endorsed the sector's stricter governance code with a 'no, unless' rule on profit-driven rental, and said the regulator Aw sees no need for additional measures for now.
Conflicts of interest (or the appearance of them) must be prevented at all times.
Belangenverstrengeling (of de schijn daarvan) moet te allen tijde worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en De Hoop over ruim tweehonderd docenten die achter het net vissen bij hun aanvraag voor een Lerarenbeurs

Two PvdA MPs asked why over 200 teachers were refused Lerarenbeurs funding for 2023 and are forced to wait a year, given that similar shortfalls were fixed by budget top-ups in 2020. The ministers answer that the budget was insufficient, that rejected first-time applicants get priority in 2024, and that the government is pursuing a national professionalisation programme via the Growth Fund.
Teachers who applied for the first time this year and were rejected because the subsidy ceiling was reached will receive priority over teachers applying for the first time next year.

Leraren die dit jaar voor het eerst een aanvraag hebben gedaan en afgewezen zijn vanwege het bereiken van het subsidieplafond, krijgen komend jaar voorrang ten opzichte van leraren die dan voor het eerst aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Nijboer over de Amsterdamse voorrangsregeling op woningen voor docenten, die nog altijd onvoldoende merkbaar is voor onderwijspersoneel dat daar werkt

MPs Mohandis and Nijboer asked whether Amsterdam's priority housing scheme for teachers is effective given housing scarcity, what national rules hinder it, and how teacher shortages can be tackled. The government answered that 99 social and 29 mid-rent homes were allocated to teachers, that scarcity persists, that a law change lets municipalities allocate up to 50% of freed affordable rentals to vital professions, and that regional teacher-shortage convenants and wage measures are being pursued.
It is up to the municipalities to weigh the interests of the different groups of housing seekers carefully when making policy.
Het is aan de gemeenten om de belangen tussen de verschillende groepen woningzoekenden goed te wegen bij het maken van beleid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurders die na verhuizing naar een andere woningcorporatiewoning niet in aanmerking komen voor de huurverlaging op basis van de Wet huurverlaging voor huurders met een lager i

An MP asked why tenants who moved to another housing corporation dwelling after 1 March 2023 lose the right to the 2023 rent reduction, and what would be done for them. The minister confirmed that only sitting tenants on 1 March 2023 qualify, that people who moved are therefore excluded, and that the rent in the new dwelling is already passend for their income, while committing to no change.
Tenants who now switch corporation dwellings therefore do not meet the statutory requirements for the rent reduction.
Huurders die nu van woningcorporatiewoning wisselen voldoen daardoor niet aan de wettelijke vereisten voor de huurverlaging.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Nijboer over de handelspraktijken van de IM Academy

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the business practices of IM Academy, including whether its model amounts to a prohibited pyramid scheme, whether it is being investigated, and whether an AFM warning is enough to protect consumers. The minister answered that the regulators (Ksa, ACM, AFM) assess pyramid schemes case by case, that no enforcement against IM Academy in the Netherlands is known so far, that investigations cannot be disclosed, and pointed to consumer campaigns and the Acquisition Fraud Act as protection.
However, the supervisory authorities involved cannot share information about ongoing or possibly future investigations.
Betrokken toezichthouders kunnen echter geen informatie delen over lopende of eventueel te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurders die via de intermediaire verhuur niet in aanmerking komen voor de huurverlaging op basis van de Wet eenmalige huurverlaging 2023

Deputy Nijboer asked whether tenants renting corporation homes via care organisations (intermediary rental) are excluded from the one-off rent reduction under the 2023 law, and whether the minister would act to extend it to them. Minister De Jonge confirmed the exclusion, explained that care organisations fall outside the statutory income-check obligation and that tax data cannot be shared with them, said he sees no legal means to enforce it, and only encouraged corporations and care providers to make voluntary arrangements.
I currently have no insight into the extent to which housing corporations and care institutions make such agreements.
Ik heb op dit moment geen inzicht in de mate waarin woningcorporaties en zorginstellingen dergelijke afspraken maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over voortdurend nalatig onderhoud van Woonbron

MP Nijboer asked the minister about persistent neglected maintenance at Woonbron, including heating failures and mould in the Oostblok complex, and whether the minister would act. The minister said the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties reports agreements have been reached to fix the heating before the season, that tenants can use the Huurcommissie, courts or municipal enforcement, and that corporations must invest more in housing quality.
I take tenant complaints seriously, but ultimately it is up to the landlord to act.
Ik neem klachten van huurders serieus, maar het is uiteindelijk aan de verhuurder om iets te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het Nationaal Fonds Betaalbare Koopwoning

MP Nijboer asks why the planned Nationaal Fonds Betaalbare Koopwoningen targets starters at 1.5 to 2 times average income rather than the 1 to 2 times group proposed by OpMaat, and what the government will do for single starters earning too much for social rent but too little for the fund. Minister De Jonge replies that 1.5 to 2 times modal is the group most likely to use the fund given the price cap and discount, that lower-income starters are not excluded, and points to rent regulation and a municipal housing-permit bill as measures for middle incomes.
It is not a condition that future buyers must have at least 1.5 times modal as household income. It is not a lower limit.
Het is geen voorwaarde dat toekomstige kopers minimaal 1,5 modaal als huishoudinkomen moeten hebben. Het is geen ondergrens.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Nijboer en Van der Plas over de schadeafhandeling van het beleggingsproduct Sprintplan door Aegon

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister whether victims of Aegon's Sprintplan product are still uncompensated, whether settlement is too slow, and what compensation and timelines are appropriate. The minister answered that Aegon has paid out the 2021 settlement to those who accepted it, that one individual court case remains, and that a review of compensation procedures is underway, while declining to set a timeframe for Aegon and stressing the separation of civil and supervisory domains.
I expect Aegon to also act constructively towards consumers who did not accept the settlement proposal.
Ik verwacht van Aegon dat zij zich ook constructief opstelt ten opzichte van consumenten die het schikkingsvoorstel niet hebben geaccepteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de onduidelijkheid voor VvE’s om digitaal officiële vergaderingen te beleggen

An MP asked about uncertainty for VvEs (homeowners' associations) over holding digital meetings, the status of the consultation on the digital general meeting law, and debt-collection practices by state agencies that may breach subsistence minimums. The minister answered that the digital meeting law is pending, that agencies will improve communication and criteria for bespoke payment arrangements, and that a uniform subsistence norm and possible legislation are being explored.
I want to examine whether it is possible to safeguard the subsistence minimum based on the attachment-free amount or the free amount.
Ik wil onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om het bestaansminimum te borgen op basis van de beslagvrije voet of het vrij te laten bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerden van Triodos-certificaten

An MP asks the Finance Minister about Triodos Bank certificate holders unable to sell their holdings for years, including the capital structure, supervision by DNB and AFM, sales practices and possible duty-of-care breaches. The Minister acknowledges the problems and the uncertainty, but says the ministry lacks insight into individual cases, refers duty-of-care and compensation questions to civil courts, and points to existing supervision and the planned tradability via a trading platform.

The Ministry of Finance has no insight into individual cases, and I therefore cannot say how many of the people who invested in the Triodos Bank share certificates may have got into financial difficulties as a result.

Het Ministerie van Financiën heeft geen zicht op individuele gevallen en ik kan dus ook niet zeggen hoeveel van de mensen die belegd hebben in de certificaten van aandelen van Triodos Bank hierdoor mogelijk in de financiële problemen zijn komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboeren Van der Lee over private deelname in TenneT Duitsland na verkoop door de Nederlandse Staat
