MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked the ministers of Finance and Climate about possible private participation in the German TenneT grid after the Dutch state's sale, and about the risks to the energy transition. The ministers answered that the Dutch TenneT stays fully state-owned, that the sale is negotiated and not yet concluded, and that the government cannot guarantee the future ownership of German TenneT.
We will inform your House before the summer about the status of the negotiations.
Wij zullen uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de status van de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de Nederlandse invloed binnen Euronext

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether an agreement that the COO of Euronext would be Dutch, and that Euronext Amsterdam would hold board seats, was made at the 2014 licence stage, and whether Dutch influence over Euronext is adequate. The Minister replied that the 2014 agreement only concerned the initial board and a geographic balance requirement, that no Dutch national currently sits on the board, and that she intends to keep the existing arrangements.
As indicated in answer 1, no agreement was made about the second position within Euronext N.V.
Zoals bij vraag 1 aangegeven is er geen afspraak gemaakt over de tweede positie binnen Euronext N.V.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Nijboer over de registratie van fraudeurs door verzekeraars naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Nederlandse verzekeraars spelen voor aanklager en rechter tegelijk'

MPs Mutluer and Nijboer asked whether insurers may keep their own lists of fraudsters, how insured persons learn of their registration and can object, how often Kifid upheld complaints, whether insurers should report fraud to prosecutors rather than register it, and whether stronger rules are needed. Minister Kaag answers that insurers may register under the PIFI protocol approved by the Dutch data protection authority, that complaints are upheld in about 17-21% of cases, that reporting to prosecutors is decided case by case on proportionality, and that no stricter rules are needed.
Kifid does not have such (reliable) information on the number of complaints from data subjects for the years 2018, 2019 and 2020.
Kifid beschikt niet over dergelijke (betrouwbare) informatie over het aantal klachten van betrokkenen voor de jaren 2018, 2019 en 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van der Lee over de verhuizing van Ferrovial

MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance about Ferrovial's planned move of its top holding company to the Netherlands, including contacts with Dutch bodies, possible tax arrangements, and revenue effects. The State Secretary answered that the company gave no tax motives, that the Tax Authority cannot disclose a taxpayer's fiscal position, that no recent Tax Authority contact occurred, and that revenue effects cannot be reliably estimated.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act, however, it is not permitted to make information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer publicly known.
Op basis van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen is het echter niet toegestaan informatie over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige voor iedereen kenbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de ‘uitwringpraktijk’

MP Nijboer asks whether private equity buyouts load target companies with excessive debt, whether the Dutch ban on financial assistance should be reinstated for BVs, and whether this risks collapses and harm to workers and creditors. The minister answers that excesses are rare, that earnings-stripping and interest-deduction limits and director liability already apply, and that there is no need to reinstate the ban, promising no new measures.
I do not think companies should be separated from acquisition financing, other than what is already regulated in book 2 of the Civil Code.
Ik vind niet dat ondernemingen gescheiden zouden moeten worden van de aankoopfinanciering, anders dan nu al geregeld in boek 2 van het BW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Maatoug over het gevolg van een hogere instroom van jonge pensioendeelnemers voor het opbouwpercentage

MPs Nijboer and Maatoug asked whether an influx of young pension participants could lower the fiscal maximum accrual rate and pension premiums, and whether the fiscal limits should be changed. The minister answered that individual fiscal limits apply, that premiums need not fall, that no change to the law is needed, and listed the few pension schemes without a franchise.
No, that is not correct. For each participant in the pension scheme, the room for pension accrual must be determined separately.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Voor elke deelnemer aan de pensioenregeling dient afzonderlijk de ruimte voor pensioenopbouw te worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet halen van de doelen voor sociale huurwoningen

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the minister why the stock of social rental housing is shrinking and whether the 30% social rental target in all municipalities can be met. The minister answered that corporations will build 250,000 social rental homes by 2030, that less-than-target municipalities will be required to allocate 30% of new construction to social rent, and that sales and demolition are a necessary part of corporate operations, so no action to curb them is planned.
I furthermore want the social rental stock to be distributed more evenly among municipalities.
Ik wil bovendien dat de sociale huurvoorraad evenwichtiger verdeeld wordt tussen gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en De Hoop over het kamertekort voor studenten naar aanleiding van recente uitzendingen van Pointer en Spraakmakers

MPs Nijboer and De Hoop asked about the student housing shortage, loneliness among students, the lack of rent allowance for rooms versus studios, and the decline of non-self-contained rooms. The minister responded that the WWSO reform is a step but not sufficient, that a regional housing coordinator is in place, and that a new WWSO proposal is expected around summer 2023.
I aim to be able to present a new proposal for the WWSO to your House around the summer of 2023.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer rond de zomer van 2023 een nieuw voorstel voor het WWSO aan te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het salaris van de topman van Havenbedrijf Rotterdam

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the salary of the Port of Rotterdam Authority's chief executive, whether pay above the WNT norm should be capped in state holdings, and how this fits with strike-driven wage demands. The minister said the WNT does not apply to state holdings, pay is for the holding's board and shareholder oversight is limited, and declined to set a cap or commit to change.
It is up to the holdings themselves to structure their pay scales so that they can attract employees with the right knowledge and skills.
Het is aan de deelnemingen zelf om hun loongebouw zo in te richten dat zij werknemers met de juiste kennis en vaardigheden aan kunnen trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het illegaal in rekening brengen van screeningskosten aan huurders

An MP asked the housing minister about a Rotterdam letting agency charging prospective tenants about 75 euro for screening, which the MP argued violates the ban on double brokerage fees. The minister agreed such fees are unacceptable, explained tenants can reclaim them, and pointed to the Good Landlordship bill and municipal complaint points as the planned remedy.
I agree with you that brokers may not charge double brokerage fees to tenants, and I therefore disapprove of this conduct.
Ik ben het met u eens dat makelaars geen dubbele bemiddelingskosten bij huurders in rekening mogen brengen en keur dit gedrag dan ook af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Nijboer over het feit dat er nog altijd flitskredieten worden aangeboden in Nederland

MPs Grinwis and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether flash-credit providers such as saldodipje.nl, which impose penalties for missing guarantor documents that push costs above the legal maximum, are acceptable and whether the AFM can act against them. The minister said the 2020 flash-credit regulation caps such costs, a Rotterdam court ruling found insufficient evidence of a cap breach, and the government will review the rules when the revised EU consumer credit directive is transposed.
For that reason the Flash Credit Approach Regulation entered into force on 1 January 2020.
Daarom is op 1 januari 2020 de Regeling aanpak flitskrediet in werking getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over particuliere verhuurders van appartementencomplexen die de verlichting in algemene ruimten (deels) niet willen uitzetten om energie te besparen

An MP asks the housing minister about private landlords who keep common-area lighting on in apartment buildings, passing high energy costs to tenants who cannot control consumption, and asks about the impact and planned action. The minister answers that tenants can influence service charges via the WOHV consultation rules and courts, that the energy price cap excludes common areas, that no national data exists on the financial impact, and points to sustainability subsidies and performance agreements.
There is no national data on energy consumption in common areas and no insight into whether households fall into financial difficulties because of these extra energy costs.
Er is geen landelijke data voor energieverbruik in algemene ruimten en ook geen inzicht in of huishoudens door deze extra energiekosten in financiële problemen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over fraude met huurlabels

An MP asked the housing minister about widespread tenant overcharging in Groningen caused by incorrect energy labels, and whether such fraud should be criminalised and handled by municipalities. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to the Huurcommissie pilot, the goed verhuurderschap bill and a planned binding WWS, but rejected criminal law and said municipalities have no role in label quality control.
Tackling this problem through criminal law is not desirable in my view, because enforcement of rent levels would thereby become a task of the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het aanpakken van dit probleem via het strafrecht acht ik niet wenselijk, omdat handhaving op huurprijzen daarmee een taak wordt van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over conflicten tussen woningeigenaren en aannemers

The MP asked the minister whether the rise in disputes between homeowners and contractors is worrying, what homeowners can do against unreasonable cost increases, and whether he will act to protect them. The minister agreed the rise is worrying, advised careful contractor selection and written agreements, and pointed to the Wkb, which will require insurance disclosure and stricter post-completion liability, with monitoring and evaluation after three years.
From entry into force I will monitor the effects and evaluate after three years.
Vanaf inwerkingtreding zal ik de effecten monitoren en na drie jaar evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het ontwijken van de heffing in box 3 over vastgoed

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether holding real estate through a STAK (administration foundation) lets investors reduce box 3 tax compared with direct ownership, and whether that is fair. The State Secretary confirms the lower outcome stems from netting property against debts inside the STAK, says the structure is not intended for tax avoidance, and states the government is examining whether to counter it, possibly through legislation.
For that reason we are examining whether this construction is becoming more common and how it can best be combated, possibly with a legislative amendment.
Om die reden onderzoeken wij of deze constructie meer voorkomt en hoe deze het beste kan worden bestreden, al dan niet met behulp van een wetswijziging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de mogelijkheid voor VvE’s om digitaal vergaderingen te beleggen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked whether VvEs should be allowed to hold digital meetings permanently, and whether repeated extensions of the temporary COVID law create uncertainty and disadvantage less digitally skilled owners. The minister answers that a permanent digital-meeting option is desirable, that a Wet digitale algemene vergadering is in consultation, and that the COVID-based option will not be extended past 1 February 2023 unless circumstances change, with a machtiging-based safeguard for members.
I agree that in practice there appears to be a need to make digital meetings permanently possible.
Ik ben het met u eens, dat in de praktijk behoefte blijkt te bestaan aan het permanent mogelijk maken van digitaal vergaderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het aanbieden van verzekeringsproducten aan alleen hoger opgeleiden

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether insurers such as Promovendum may offer policies only to higher-educated people, whether this is lawful under acceptance duties and premium differentiation rules, and how this bears on social inequality and risk pooling. The minister answered that such differentiation is largely lawful outside basic health insurance, that she monitors developments closely with AFM and DNB, sees no need for new rules now, and will intervene if inequality grows.
I am therefore closely monitoring whether this effect occurs. If it does, I will act against it.
Ik houd dan ook nauwlettend in de gaten of dit effect zich voordoet. Als dat zo is, dan zal ik daar tegen optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale miljonairsvrijstelling

MP Nijboer asks the State Secretary of Finance about the wealth exemption (miljonairsvrijstelling) in article 3.95b of the income tax act, which lets holders of a lucrative interest move carried-interest-type gains from box 1 to the lower box 2 rate if at least 95% is distributed, and questions its rationale, the lack of data, the tax paid by holding companies, the time it costs the tax authority, and whether it should be abolished. The State Secretary defends the option as providing legal certainty and balanced tax burden, says no data are available on the revenue or claimed exemption, and states that the approach to opaque tax constructions will be communicated to parliament later.
No data are available on the tax levied on income from lucrative interests, as these are not separately recorded in income tax returns.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over de heffing over inkomsten uit lucratief belang, aangezien deze niet apart geregistreerd worden in de aangiften inkomstenbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een onbedoeld generaal pardon voor zwartspaarders

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a perceived unintended amnesty for undeclared 'black savers' after the Supreme Court's Christmas ruling on box 3 wealth tax, including lost revenue, navigation of assessment periods, fines and possible reform. The State Secretary answers that the ruling applies to open assessments, that the 12-year limitation period for foreign assets is justified, that fines and prosecution remain possible, that retroactive fine increases are legally impossible, and that the government will examine the limitation periods and fine basis and continues its anti-concealment programme.
It is not known how many black savers there are, how much or what kind of wealth they hold, or where it comes from.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel zwartspaarders er zijn en over hoeveel dan wel welk soort vermogen zij beschikken en wat de herkomst daarvan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het falen van het laten meewegen van de verstrekking van energiecertificaten in het woningwaarderingsstelsel (WWS)

An MP asks the minister about EU energy-label rules for rental housing and whether failure to hand over an energy certificate is sanctioned in the rent-points system (WWS), citing court rulings. The minister says the energy-label obligation is enforced by the ILT inspectorate rather than the WWS, that no legislative change is needed, and that the label copy will be made available to tenants via MijnOverheid.
The WWS is not a sanction on the energy label obligation.
Het WWS betreft geen sanctie op de energielabelplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over lozingen op de Waddenzee

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked about FrieslandCampina's discharges of nitrogen and phosphate into the Wadden Sea, the adequacy of its permit and supervision, and the lack of a water permit for the HoWa pipeline. The minister answered that the Omgevingsdienst Groningen judged the permit compliant, that supervision occurred annually, that a water permit was being processed by Rijkswaterstaat, and that no illegal discharge exists, though some questions were not answered in time.
There is no question of an illegal discharge via the HoWa pipeline by FrieslandCampina.
Er is geen sprake van een illegale lozing op de HoWa-leiding door FrieslandCampina.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Nijboer over schuldhulpverlening en het krijgen van een baan

MPs Kathmann and Nijboer asked whether people in debt assistance must have their wages paid to a trustee, whether this deters employers, and how to remove that barrier to work. The minister explained that wages go to a account in the debtor's own name managed by a trustee, that this need not stigmatise, and that the government promotes employer support for debt-stressed employees.
As explained, debt assistance and/or the payment of wages into a management account need not be an obstacle to finding work.
Zoals uitgelegd hoeft schuldhulpverlening en/of de uitbetaling van het loon op een beheerrekening geen drempel te zijn bij het vinden van werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Nijboer en Kröger over hoge energietarieven voor nieuwe klanten

MPs Thijssen, Nijboer and Kröger asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether it is acceptable that new customers pay up to three times more for energy than existing customers, and whether energy suppliers shift risks onto new customers or use postcode-based risk assessments. The minister acknowledged the unfairness, said the ACM is revising early-termination fee rules and suppliers will offer fixed contracts again in 2023, and referred to general income-support measures, while denying knowledge of postcode-based risk profiling.
I share the view that it is galling when people who have to move pay three times as much for energy as existing customers.
Ik deel de mening dat het wrang is als mensen die moeten verhuizen drie keer zo veel moeten betalen voor energie als bestaande klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet publiceren van kennisgroepstandpunten

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why tax authority expert-group (kennisgroep) positions are not published and made accessible, and whether this gives large firms an informational advantage over ordinary citizens. The State Secretary explained that these positions have the same status as formal policy, are generally published via policy decisions in the Staatscourant with some delay, and that a more accessible website for all positions will be published by 1 April 2023.
Once this website is shown to meet all conditions, all expert-group positions will be published via this website and thereby be accessible.
Zodra blijkt dat deze website voldoet aan alle randvoorwaarden, zullen alle kennisgroepstandpunten via deze website worden gepubliceerd en daarmee op een toegankelijke wijze raadpleegbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het weigeren van dhr. Van Roost (voormalig CEO Esso Nederland) om voor de parlementaire enquêtecommissie te verschijnen

An MP asked whether a former ExxonMobil executive refusing to appear before the Groningen gas parliamentary inquiry was morally objectionable, and whether government contact with ExxonMobil should be halted. The State Secretary agreed witnesses affecting Groningen should cooperate, noted no legal obligation exists for non-Dutch residents abroad, said he would personally contact ExxonMobil, and rejected halting contacts given its role as shareholder.
I note that where persons do not have Dutch nationality and live abroad, there is no obligation to cooperate under the Parliamentary Inquiry Act.
Ik merk daarbij op dat wanneer personen geen Nederlandse nationaliteit hebben en in het buitenland wonen, er op grond van de Wet op de parlementaire enquête geen verplichting tot medewerking bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ruimtelijke ordening in de gemeente Katwijk

MP Nijboer asks the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about the Valkenhorst development in Katwijk, including the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf's alleged obstruction of affordable housing, loss of green space, strained relations with the municipality, and whether it should be steered toward social goals rather than financial criteria. The minister denies obstruction, explains the dual financial and housing mandate, notes the 2020 agreement adding 600 affordable homes, and says a study on more affordable housing on state land is underway, while declining to commit to a change in the agency's mandate.
In response to the adopted Grinwis motion, my ministry has started a study into the possibilities of realising more affordable housing on state land.
Als reactie op de aangenomen motie Grinwis is mijn ministerie een onderzoek gestart naar de mogelijkheden om op rijksgronden meer betaalbare woningbouw te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Nijboer, Grinwis, Maatoug, Stoffer, Dassen en Inge van Dijk over de Uber-files en aanverwante zaken

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Uber Files, including Tax Authority conduct toward Uber, exchange-of-information handling, multilateral audits, the NFIA and APBI roles and the withheld Unilever bidbook. The Secretary answered largely by citing tax secrecy, promising an internal investigation with results expected in September, offering a confidential briefing, and declining to change rules or reveal individual cases.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, en Nijboer over het boren van een zoutput door Nedmag

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether the ministry allowed Nedmag to drill toward well VE-7 without a permit and before the required analysis, and why enforcement was refused. The state secretary answered that a permit was granted for the drilling under the environmental-permit procedure, that mining from VE-7 still requires a separate winning-plan change, and that SodM found no grounds for enforcement.
I also want to make a working visit to speak with residents and Nedmag.
Ik wil daarnaast ook op werkbezoek gaan om te spreken met inwoners en Nedmag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de opslag van aardgascondensaat in Roodeschool

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked about the State Supervision of Mines' advice to relocate the condensate loading station at Roodeschool and whether the current activities are permissible. The State Secretary acknowledged SodM's findings, said activities are halted until a gravel bed is repaired, prefers relocation, and promised to update the permit and report after the summer recess.
I have taken note of SodM's advice, in which it states that it currently assumes the activities permitted in 2004 at this location are not permittable.
Ik heb kennis genomen van het advies van SodM, waarin zij stelt dat zij er op dit moment van uitgaan dat de in 2004 vergunde activiteiten op deze locatie niet vergunbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gaswinning onder Unesco werelderfgoed

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about gas extraction plans near the Unesco World Heritage Koloniën van Weldadigheid and whether permits should be refused. The State Secretary said the impact assessment, including a heritage study, is ongoing, that extraction will only be allowed if no irreparable harm to the heritage is expected, and that permits would likely be refused if such harm or unsafe extraction were found.
Gas extraction will only be permitted here if careful research shows that no irreparable damage to the World Heritage site is to be expected from gas extraction.
Gaswinning zal hier uitsluitend worden toegestaan als uit zorgvuldig onderzoek blijkt dat door gaswinning geen onherstelbare schade aan het werelderfgoed te verwachten is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verre reizen naar pinautomaten

An MP asks the Finance Minister why the 5-km cash machine accessibility norm is not met in parts of the North, such as Oldambt, and whether the government will ensure enough ATMs in rural regions. The minister answers that the norm applies nationally, that Geldmaat sets placement policy and monitors rural gaps, and that DNB monitors compliance monthly under the Cash Convenant.
I consider it important that there is good access to cash and that Geldmaat, when placing its cash machines, maintains the five-kilometre norm and pursues a balanced distribution.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er een goede toegang is tot contant geld en dat Geldmaat bij het plaatsen van haar geldautomaten de vijfkilometernorm aanhoudt en een evenwichtige spreiding nastreeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘huurders die tegen de afspraak in op straat worden gezet’

MP Nijboer asks whether landlords may withdraw fixed-term leases without reasons despite promises to extend, whether tenants who invoke their rights face non-renewal, and whether the law should make permanent leases the norm again. Minister De Jonge answers that landlords need not extend fixed-term leases or give reasons, that oral promises are enforceable only if the tenant proves them in court, and that the government will extend the housing point system to more rentals and give municipalities tools against misuse of temporary contracts.
If oral agreements have been made between a tenant and landlord about extending a fixed-term lease, the landlord is bound to honour them.
Indien tussen een huurder en verhuurder mondeling afspraken zijn gemaakt over de verlenging van een huurovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd is de verhuurder gehouden om deze na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Thijssen en Piri over de gevolgen van de oorlog in Oekraïne voor gaslevering

Three PvdA MPs asked the minister about gas supply risks from the war in Ukraine, including scenarios for a halt in Russian gas, low storage levels, and the Groningen phase-out. The minister answered at length, referring to ENTSO-G outlooks, the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas, storage subsidies and earlier Kamerbrieven, while committing to share future analyses with the Kamer.
As soon as new ENTSO-G analyses are public, they will be shared with the Kamer.
Zodra er nieuwe analyses van ENTSO-G openbaar zijn, zullen die met de Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Staat diverse deals met vertrouwelingen van Poetin verzekerde

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether state-backed export insurance by Atradius covered deals with associates of Putin on US sanctions lists, and whether this undermined sanctions and why those persons were not on the EU list. The government answered that due diligence found no unacceptable risks, refused to share risk analyses or details of individual cases for commercial confidentiality, and said it follows EU, UN and Dutch sanctions rather than US ones.
Given commercial confidentiality, I cannot provide your House with more information on individual cases than is already known.
Gezien de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid, kan ik uw Kamer niet meer informatie geven over individuele zaken dan reeds bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Nijboer over "achterblijvende reiskostenvergoeding voor werknemers"

MPs Kathmann and Nijboer asked the government about rising commuting costs, the non-indexed tax-free travel allowance, and low employer reimbursement in low-wage sectors. The minister answered that the cost effects vary by worker, data on employer practices is incomplete, a study on modernising the allowance is due in 2022, and temporary fuel excise cuts and a planned future increase of the allowance are pointed to.
The Ministry of Finance is conducting research into modernising the travel allowance, and this research will be delivered in 2022.
Het Ministerie van Financiën doet onderzoek naar een modernisering van de reiskostenvergoeding, dat onderzoek zal in 2022 worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de problematiek rondom het Sprintplan van Aegon

An MP asked the Finance Minister about AEGON's Sprintplan investment-lease product and reports that AEGON offered victims a 750 euro settlement to waive all claims. The minister explained the product, said the settlement was agreed with Consumentenclaim and was for the affected participants to judge, and noted that affected participants can still go to court, to Kifid, or negotiate with AEGON.
I do not have an overview of cases in which the consumer's claim was wholly or partly granted and for what amount.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van zaken waarin de vordering van de consument geheel of gedeeltelijk is toegekend en voor welk bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de mogelijkheid tot BTW aangifte na overlijden en verlopen DIGID

An MP asked how a sole trader's VAT return can be filed after death when DigiD access lapses, and whether DigiD can be transferred to a relative. The State Secretary replied that heirs can authorise a person through the Tax Authority counter to file digitally, that DigiD sharing is not allowed, and listed support measures and planned simplifications.
The Tax Authority is currently investigating whether the authorisation can also be issued without a visit to the counter.
De Belastingdienst onderzoekt momenteel of het mogelijk is om de machtiging ook zonder bezoek aan de balie afgegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over regels in het Bouwbesluit 2012 die in de weg staan bij de opvang van Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the minister whether municipalities are uncertain about applying Bouwbesluit 2012 building rules to temporary crisis shelter for Ukrainian refugees, and what flexibility exists. The minister confirmed the uncertainty, pointed to equivalence provisions and a joint VNG guidance handbook, and said no further clarification or consultation commitment was made beyond existing cooperation.
Invoking equivalence, a municipality can always assess whether, in a given case, the functional requirement of the Bouwbesluit 2012 is met in a different way than the performance requirement.

Met een beroep op gelijkwaardigheid kan een gemeente altijd beoordelen of in een bepaald geval ook op een andere manier (dan de prestatie-eis) voldaan wordt aan de functionele eis die het Bouwbesluit 2012 stelt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Thijssen over de berichten ‘Studenten zien warmtekosten verdubbelen: ‘Het is mijn vakantiebudget’ en ‘Forse prijsverhoging voor huishoudens met ‘duurzame’ stadsverwarming: ‘We s

MPs Nijboer and Thijssen asked about reports of doubled heating costs for students and steep price rises on district heating, asking whether students should get the extra energy allowance, whether heat tariffs should be decoupled from gas prices, and whether tenants should be protected from passed-on costs. The minister answered that students are excluded from the categorical energy allowance in favour of individual assistance, that the new heat supply act will decouple tariffs from gas prices by late 2022, and that passing on higher energy costs is reasonable.
I am currently looking at how to submit this bill to the Council of State before the summer and then to the House of Representatives at the end of 2022.
Ik bekijk momenteel hoe ik dit wetsvoorstel voor de zomer aan kan bieden aan de Raad van State en daarna eind 2022 aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Kuiken, Nijboer en De Hoop over 50.000 opvangplekken voor vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

Opposition PvdA MPs asked how the government will support municipalities in securing and managing about 50,000 reception places for Ukrainian refugees, and about preparations for education, healthcare, housing, language lessons and work. The government answered that safety regions coordinate place creation with municipalities, a national reception programme is being prepared, and that housing, education and healthcare measures are being worked out, with further letters promised.
The cabinet considers it important that displaced persons from Ukraine residing in our country have the opportunity to learn the Dutch language
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat ontheemden uit Oekraïne die in ons land verblijven de mogelijkheid hebben om de Nederlandse taal te leren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en De Hoop over de schades aan huizen na werkzaamheden aan het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik

MPs Nijboer and De Hoop asked the minister about damage to around 400 homes caused by works on the Almelo-De Haandrik canal, including forced relocations, unacceptably long procedures, and who is responsible for the errors. The minister replied that the canal is a provincial waterway managed by Overijssel, that the ministry has no direct role, and that 288 damage claims have been granted compensation or subsidy so far.
The Almelo-De Haandrik canal is a provincial waterway. Its management is in the hands of the province of Overijssel.
Het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik is een provinciale vaarweg. Het beheer daarvan is in handen van de provincie Overijssel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Dexia nog altijd onder adequate schadevergoedingen voor de woekerpolisaffaire probeert uit te komen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that Dexia, in winding down its Duisenberg-scheme leasing cases, uses bailiff summonses with short deadlines, obstructs legal representation, pressures claimants into low settlements and may be unfit to run a financial institution. The minister answered that Dexia has been asked to act properly and respect client interests, that toezicht on individual cases lies with DNB and AFM, and that the minister shared the signals with them but cannot instruct them.
I may not give instructions to the AFM and DNB in a specific case.
Ik mag de AFM en DNB geen instructies geven in een specifiek geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over "aanhoudende briefjes van beleggers voor het opkopen van woningen"

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about investors using door-to-door notes and posing as a couple to buy homes, and whether NVM broker conduct rules and disciplinary law are enforced. The Minister acknowledges the practice may be misleading, points to a verbal improvement plan with brokers and a planned April 2022 review, and outlines tax and buyer-protection measures against investors.
If however the names are only used to win the seller's sympathy, and the house is not actually bought by them, that may be misleading.
Indien de namen echter enkel gebruikt worden om de sympathie van de verkoper te wekken, en de woning niet daadwerkelijk door hen wordt aangekocht, kan dat misleidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over gelijke gevallen die ongelijk worden behandeld

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked why homes in similar situations in Groningen (Ten Boer, Delfzijl, Ganzenerf) are treated differently under the earthquake-damage reinforcement and compensation rules, and whether the six-month decision period for joint reinforcement is justified. The state secretary answered that unexplained differences will be reviewed for a letter to parliament before summer, that the same six-month period applies to all owners, and that compensation and subsidy options exist for some cases, without committing to a specific change now.

As stated, I am looking at the differences that have arisen over the years in an integrated way and will inform the House of the options the cabinet sees to limit the unexplainable differences as much as possible.

Zoals benoemd, kijk ik integraal naar de verschillen die door de jaren heen zijn ontstaan en zal ik de Kamer berichten welke mogelijkheden het kabinet ziet om de onuitlegbare verschillen zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over servicekosten

MP Nijboer asked about the rules on service charges on top of the net rent, whether landlords advertise low net rents while charging high service costs, and why the cabinet plans to exclude service costs from the rent used for housing allowance, plus the minimum that may be charged. Minister De Jonge replied that service charges must be a reasonable reimbursement of actual costs, with tenants able to object to the rent commission or landlord, that he finds misleading advertising undesirable and will address it in the Goed verhuurderschap bill, and that he will not narrow the definition of service costs.
I find it undesirable when tenants are surprised by having to find that they actually have to pay much more for a rental home than initially indicated.
Ik vind het onwenselijk als huurders verrast worden doordat zij moeten vaststellen dat zijn in werkelijkheid totaal veel meer voor een huurwoning moeten betalen dan in eerste instantie is aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Nijboer, Thijssen en Kröger over de rode loper voor datacenter Zeewolde

MPs asked whether ministries actively courted Facebook/Meta for a Zeewolde data centre, gave it priority on the high-voltage grid, and whether the data centre's energy, heat and diesel backup impacts were addressed. The ministers answered that NFIA was approached by Meta, that the connection was legally permissible without priority, and that many questions on energy, heat and jobs are left to the municipality or are unknown, while promising a national data centre strategy later.
There is no question of "priority" for Meta's connection to the high-voltage grid.
Er is geen sprake van «voorrang» voor aansluiting van Meta op het hoogspanningsnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over de voorwaarden voor het ontvangen van huurtoeslag

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked whether rent allowance (huurtoeslag) can only be claimed from the first full calendar month of residence and why partial-month payment is not allowed, arguing this creates a barrier for tenants who may struggle with the first month's rent. Minister De Jonge replied that the rule applies to all income-dependent schemes for simplicity and administrability, that changes can be processed per month, and that landlords or payment arrangements can help, while declining to commit to a systemic change.
I do not consider it desirable to change the current system to one in which changes are processed immediately.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk om de huidige systematiek aan te passen naar een systeem waarbij wijzigingen per direct verwerkt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Nieuwste oplichterstruc: koophuis te huur aanbieden’

An MP asked the housing minister about fraudsters advertising for-sale homes as rentals, and what can be done about it, including platform responsibility. The minister confirmed the practice, pointed to the Goed Verhuurderschap bill and existing ACM enforcement, and said platforms should take their own measures.
Furthermore, I am working on further regulation of the rental process through the Goed Verhuurderschap bill.
Voorts werk ik aan een verdere regulering van het verhuurproces via het wetsvoorstel Goed Verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over nep sociale huurwoningen gebouwd door private partijen

Member Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Minister about concerns that commercial developers building social rental homes may let them drift to the free sector, the differing obligations between housing corporations and private parties, and how much municipalities can steer social rental construction. The Minister said the government is studying the issue, that municipalities can use zoning and allocation rules to secure social rental homes, and that a research report will be shared before summer 2022.
Municipalities can arrange this in the land-issuance agreement (where the municipality owns the land), in the anterior agreement and/or in local regulations.
Gemeenten kunnen dit regelen in de gronduitgifte overeenkomst (wanneer de gemeente grondeigenaar is), in de anterieure overeenkomst en/of in lokale verordeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de 10.000 euro subsidie voor verbetering/verduurzaming van woningen in het gaswinningsgebied

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why the 10,000 euro Groningen home-improvement subsidy ran out of budget, why applicants queued for hours, and whether this was fair. The State Secretary admitted the budget was underestimated, added 250 million euro, acknowledged the queuing and technical problems, and committed to further review and a policy letter.
I informed your House on 14 January 2022 by letter that the cabinet is allocating an additional 250 million euro for this scheme.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 14 januari 2022 per brief («Benutting budget woningverbeteringssubsidie») gemeld dat het kabinet 250 miljoen euro extra voor deze regeling uittrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het sluiten van kinderhartcentra

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the health minister why two rather than one children's heart centres are being closed, what criteria and financial motives lay behind the choice of Rotterdam and Utrecht, and whether more specialist care will be centralised. The minister answers that concentration in two intervention centres is needed to meet volume norms, staffing and succession problems, that financial considerations play no role, and that other care and emergency services remain available, promising a separate letter on the selection criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over wrakingsregels bij een hoorzitting van de huurcommissie

An MP asked why the recusal rules for rent tribunal hearings under the Uhw only allow challenges before the hearing starts, unlike court proceedings, and whether this is a gap. The minister confirmed the rule, explained it stems from the 1979 law mirroring older court rules, and said he will examine amending the law.
Yes. It is not a deliberate distinction, and therefore I intend to examine amending the law on this point.
Ja. Het gaat niet om een bewust onderscheid en daarom ben ik voornemens om een wijziging van de wet op dit punt te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Alkaya en Dassen over het bericht ‘Belasting besparen: zo doen Zuidas-partners dat’

MPs asked whether Zuidas partners' use of BV structures and DGA arrangements lets them pay less tax than employees, whether the Tax Authority's agreements on reasonable salaries are acceptable, and whether a 20-partner BV constructions should be banned. The State Secretary acknowledges a possible gap, describes the excessive-lending bill and the reasonable-salary rules, says new policy options are unnecessary, and states that ministers' business interests were disclosed under a motion.
The Tax Authority does not address individual cases because of its statutory duty of confidentiality.
De Belastingdienst gaat in verband met zijn wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over belemmeringen zzp’ers bij aanvraag coronasteunmaatregel

An MP asks why municipalities handle the simplified Bbz benefit for self-employed differently, whether the viability test and cost-sharing norm delay support, and why the Tozo was not reinstated. The minister answers that municipal variation is intended within legal bounds, that the simplified Bbz is temporary, that excessive information requests were addressed, and that the government will keep the Tozo closed and extend the simplified Bbz.
In those cases, the VNG was asked to contact the municipality concerned to communicate about this.
In die gevallen is de VNG gevraagd contact met de betreffende gemeente op te nemen om hierover te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over financiering van onderdak voor dak- en thuislozen uit coronagelden

An MP asked how much less municipalities receive for homeless shelter now that corona support is being phased out, whether funding affected street sleeping, and why it is not continued. The State Secretary replied that no phase-out has occurred, that the Covid cost-compensation scheme is extended to 31 December 2022, and that no exact data on street sleeping effects exist, while declining to provide extra funds this winter.
No exact data are available on this.
Hier zijn geen exacte gegevens over bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de schrijnende huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked the government about substandard housing of migrant workers, overcrowding linked to high rents, and enforcement by municipalities and employment agencies. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Goed Verhuurderschap bill, certification plans for employment agencies, housing funding and a coming Jaarrapportage, but gave mostly general commitments without new enforcement powers for the central government.
Municipalities will soon get an additional instrument with which they can act better against abuses.
Gemeenten krijgen straks een extra instrument in handen waarmee ze beter kunnen optreden tegen misstanden.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over het traject Delfzijl – Groningen n.a.v. het bericht ‘Boosheid over 'puinhoop' op spoor tussen Delfzijl en Groningen’ van de NOS

MPs Nijboer and De Hoop asked the state secretary about recurring train disruptions and overcrowding on the Delfzijl–Groningen line, including whether longer trains should be deployed during the pandemic and whether operator Arriva would be called to account. The state secretary said that regional transport responsibility lies with the province of Groningen, which regards the incidents as isolated, and that the province accepts the operator's explanation of force majeure.
Responsibility for regional public transport services lies primarily with the regional transport authorities and the operators.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het regionale OV-aanbod ligt primair bij de regionale OV-autoriteiten en de vervoerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de risico’s van CFD's

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the risks of CFDs, the apparent fraud and conflicts of interest in their sale, and why they are not banned. The minister explains the existing product-intervention rules, notes that a ban can only be imposed by European or national supervisors rather than by himself, and commits to pushing for consumer protection in the EU Retail Investment Strategy.
The Minister of Finance does not have a statutory power to adopt a product intervention measure to prohibit the marketing, distribution or sale of CFDs to non-professional clients in the Netherlands.

De Minister van Financiën beschikt niet over een wettelijke bevoegdheid om een productinterventiemaatregel vast te stellen teneinde het op de markt brengen, verspreiden of verkopen van CFD’s aan niet-professionele cliënten in Nederland te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Conflicten bij Deloitte en EY leggen bom onder verdienmodel Zuidas'

MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance about partner holding structures at Zuidas advisory firms, the tax burden of partners versus employees, governance and oversight of partners not in employment, and Tax Authority supervision. The State Secretary explained the box 1/2/3 and corporate tax treatment of direct and indirect partner participations, said the tax-secrecy rule prevents comment on individual cases, rejected the view that holding structures amount to tax avoidance, and pointed to existing accountancy oversight and planned reforms.
Based on the fiscal confidentiality obligation laid down in article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I furthermore cannot discuss the tax position of individual taxpayers.

Op grond van fiscale geheimhoudingplicht die is neergelegd in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik bovendien niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Is belasting betalen weer iets voor de dommen?'

MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked whether the 2021-2022 increase of the corporate tax low-rate bracket invites companies to split into multiple BVs to avoid tax, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answers that the effect is not yet known, the government will monitor fragmentation and report next year, and no legislative change is currently committed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over de activiteiten van NS-dochter Abellio in Noordrijn-Westfalen (NRW)

MPs De Hoop and Nijboer asked the government about NS subsidiary Abellio's losses and insolvency procedure in Germany, particularly the North Rhine-Westphalia contracts, and whether Dutch travellers and taxpayers would bear the costs. The minister explains the losses stem from external factors, that NS-backed restructuring keeps risk within the agreed framework, and that Abellio's NRW concessions will end on 31 January 2022 with emergency tenders.
With this solution NS stays within the risk framework ('Capital at Risk') that I agreed with your House for NS's foreign activities.
NS blijft met deze oplossing binnen het risicokader («Capital at Risk») dat ik met uw Kamer heb afgesproken voor de buitenlandse activiteiten van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de toepassing van de opkoopbescherming bij het ‘flippen’ van woningen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked whether flipping homes (buying, renovating and quickly reselling at a higher price) is undesirable, why the owner-occupancy protection does not cover flipping, and what the government will do about speculation in the housing market. Minister Ollongren answered that quick resale for profit is undesirable but not always harmful, that the protection targets rental-driven scarcity, that the raised 8% transfer tax on investors is an adequate deterrent, and that no outright ban is warranted on current data.
Banning quick resale of a home would be an additional restriction on property rights.
Het verbieden van het snel doorverkopen van een woning is een aanvullende beperking van het eigendomsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de voorgenomen structuurwijziging van de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM)

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about NAM's planned restructuring, including selling its small gas fields, effects on Groningen compensation and guarantees, supply security, jobs and union involvement. The Minister answers that the restructuring is an internal company matter needing no approval, that the Groningen field and storage obligations remain with NAM backed by Shell and ExxonMobil guarantees, and that any transfer of licences requires his consent under the Mining Act.
The structure of NAM is an internal business matter of NAM; my approval was not requested for it, and it is not necessary either.
De structuur van de NAM is een interne bedrijfsaangelegenheid van de NAM, mijn goedkeuring is daarvoor niet gevraagd, en ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over additionele middelen voor ontwikkelings- en investeringsmaatschappijen

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about recent additional capital for regional development companies (ROMs) and why the €150 million was split by regional GDP. The minister confirmed the top-up, explained the GDP-based allocation agreed with regional partners, and said use of the funds is monitored and reported at each ROM's shareholders' meeting.
These funds are intended solely for investments (equity) in and/or provision of debt to start-ups, scale-ups and the manufacturing industry without a banking relationship.
Deze middelen zijn enkel bedoeld voor investeringen (eigen vermogen) in en/of verstrekken van vreemd vermogen aan start-ups, scale-ups en de maakindustrie zonder bancaire relatie.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Nijboer over overlast gevende gevelreclame

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether landlords hanging advertising scaffolding sheets on their buildings, causing light and daylight nuisance for tenants (a Rotterdam case), is acceptable, what the national rules are, and what tenants can do. The minister answered that no specific national rules apply, that municipalities regulate such advertising through permits and bylaws, that landlords must prevent nuisance to tenants, and that tenants can seek remedies via the courts, the municipality, the Huurcommissie for rent reduction, and Het Juridisch Loket.
Apart from the specific case in Rotterdam, I am not aware of any signals from tenants experiencing nuisance from advertising on scaffolding sheets during facade renovation or maintenance.
Behalve over het betreffende geval in Rotterdam zijn mij geen signalen bekend van huurders die overlast ervaren van (reclame op) steigerdoeken tijdens gevelrenovatie of onderhoud aan de gevel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘oververhitte huurmarkt perfecte voedingsbodem voor oplichters’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about fake rental listings targeting desperate housing seekers, the lack of control over private rental, and police dismissing fraud reports. The minister condemned fraud, pointed to a forthcoming 'goed verhuurderschap' bill with a basic norm, a municipal area rental permit and a permit for migrant worker housing, and said it will go to the Raad van State soon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de plannen van het Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen om deel te willen nemen in een zonnepark

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether a hospital in Groningen (OZG) should take part in a solar park, given reports it would receive a EUR 20 million donation if the park is built. The government answered that the hospital does not invest in the park, is not dependent on the donation, and that hospitals should primarily provide care, though on-site renewables are acceptable; it declined to give a financial rescue guarantee and said oversight of insurers' duty of care is with the NZa.
It is not among the tasks of a hospital to be financially involved in a solar park to be developed on third-party land.
Het behoort niet tot de taken van een ziekenhuis om financieel betrokken te zijn bij een te ontwikkelen zonnepark op gronden van derden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden sociale huurwoningen in slechte staat en soms rijp voor de sloop’

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior about reports that tens of thousands of social rental homes are in poor condition, asking what the government will do, how corporations are supervised, the Huurcommissie waiting times, and whether an APK-style periodic inspection is warranted. The Minister acknowledges differences between corporations and points to prestatieafspraken, Aw supervision, Civil Code tenant rights and the Huurcommissie, but rejects a mandatory periodic inspection and automatic rent reductions, and largely disputes the data of specific corporations.
I am not in favour of a mandatory general periodic inspection for rental homes.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een verplichte algemene periodieke keuring voor huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bieden op huurwoningen

MP Nijboer asks the Minister of the Interior about rental platforms like Rebid where tenants bid against each other for homes, whether paid credits and bidding breach the ban on double intermediary fees, whether the ACM should be alerted, and whether this pushes rents up and should be regulated. The Minister says bidding is undesirable but lawful in the free rental sector, refers tenants to ACM ConsuWijzer and cites ACM fines on intermediaries, and says rent regulation and bidding are being tested in 'botsproeven' without committing to a concrete regulatory decision.
I still believe this phenomenon is undesirable, because tenants may take irresponsible risks in determining their rent.
Ik ben nog steeds van mening dat dit fenomeen onwenselijk is, doordat huurders wellicht onverantwoorde risico's nemen bij het bepalen van hun huur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het in Singaporese handen vallen van de High Tech Campus Eindhoven

MP Nijboer asks whether the sale of the High Tech Campus Eindhoven to a US asset manager with Singaporean state fund GIC behind it threatens Dutch knowledge infrastructure and national interests. The minister replies that the transaction is a private real estate deal outside existing investment screening rules, that no national security risk is identified, and that the government is examining whether additional safeguards are needed.

Regarding information security and national security risks from direct access to sites where sensitive technology is used or developed, my ministry is exploring whether additional measures are necessary.

Over de informatiebeveiliging en risico's voor de nationale veiligheid bij directe toegang tot de locaties waar sensitieve technologie gebruikt of ontwikkeld wordt, verkent mijn ministerie of aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de problemen bij het Chinese vastgoedconcern Evergrande

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about the problems at Chinese property developer Evergrande, including missed debt payments and exposure of Dutch banks and pension funds, and the consequences for China and the Dutch economy. The minister answered that direct Dutch exposure is limited, that uncertainty remains about China's economy, and that DNB and others monitor the situation.
Enquiries with DNB show that direct exposures of Dutch banks (and EU banks in general) to Evergrande are limited.
Navraag bij DNB wijst uit dat directe uitzettingen van Nederlandse banken (en EU-banken in het algemeen) op Evergrande beperkt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de nadelige gevolgen voor Groninger en Friese gemeenten van de herverdeling van het gemeentefonds

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the proposed redistribution of the municipal fund would cut funding for Groningen and Frisian municipalities, and how she would ensure fairness and avoid harming services. The answers were not included in this document; it only refers the questions to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 35 570 B, nr. 9), so the substance of the response cannot be coded.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Hoge leeftijd mag toegang tot krediet niet blokkeren?’

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks unilaterally tighten credit terms when customers reach an older age, and whether this amounts to age discrimination, asking for supervision and possible legal measures. The minister answers that banks may adjust terms on age-linked income changes if agreed in advance and customers are informed, that supervisors (AFM, DNB) oversee conduct and complaints go to Kifid or civil courts, and sees no need for legal measures.
I therefore ask banks to look together with the customer at what is still possible based on the individual situation.
Ik vraag banken dan ook om samen met de klant te kijken wat er wél mogelijk is op basis van de individuele situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Nijboer en Bromet over het oplopende tekort aan studentenwoningen

MPs Nijboer and Bromet asked the Minister why the student housing shortage of about 22,000 units is growing, whether the 50 million euro allocation is enough, and why a solution is only in sight by 2028. The minister acknowledges more is needed, promises to update the national action plan with stakeholders, but says structural solutions and any separate funding scheme for student housing must await a new cabinet.
As I indicated in the committee debate of 16 September, I am going to talk with the parties to update the National Student Housing Action Plan and increase the ambition.
Zoals ik in het Commissiedebat van 16 september jl. heb aangegeven ga ik met de partijen in gesprek om het Landelijk Actieplan Studentenhuisvesting te actualiseren en de ambitie te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer het artikel ‘Ambulances Noorden komen vaker te laat’

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the minister whether ambulances in the North of the Netherlands miss the 15-minute response norm, whether everyone is entitled to timely emergency care, and what will be done, with details on how often and where the norm was missed. The minister confirmed that response-time percentages fell in 2020 in most regions including the North, attributed this to COVID-19, said no signs of risk to access or quality were found, and pointed to existing action plans and earlier letters without listing individual incidents.
When an emergency department imposes a time-out, this signals to the ambulance service that the emergency department is very busy.
Wanneer een SEH een time-out instelt, is dit voor de ambulancedienst een signaal dat het erg druk is op de SEH
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over schatkistbankieren door zorginstellingen

An MP asks whether care institutions such as youth care providers can join voluntary treasury banking as education institutions can, and whether conditions could be relaxed to shield them from negative interest. The Minister answers that care institutions generally are not statutory-task legal persons and that legal form, care commissioning structure and EU state aid rules preclude participation, so no broader conditions are planned.
Given these criteria and national and European regulations, we also see no possibilities to further broaden the conditions for treasury banking.
Gegeven deze criteria en nationale en Europese regelgeving zien wij ook geen mogelijkheden om de voorwaarden voor het schatkistbankieren verder te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het bericht dat er mogelijk tientallen miljoenen publieke gelden voor coronatesten naar bedrijven in belastingparadijzen zouden zijn gevloeid

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and finance ministers whether public funds for COVID tests reached tax-haven companies, and whether the ministry had acted on information from two entrepreneurs. Minister De Jonge replied that there was no evidence of misuse, that invoices are checked and that the ministry did not investigate because no factual proof was provided.
This conversation gave no reason to investigate whether public money had leaked away, because no factual evidence was presented in the conversation.
Dit gesprek heeft geen aanleiding gegeven om te onderzoeken of publiek geld is weggevloeid, omdat in het gesprek geen feitelijk bewijs is overlegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over mensen die vermorzeld worden door de Belastingdienst

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about people crushed by the Tax Authority, including harsh collection practices, stacked penalties, legislation-caused hardship, IND-related problems and access to legal aid. The State Secretary responds that the Stella team is reviewing 25 cases with 11 contacted so far, that improvements to collection strategy and legal protection are underway, and that individual tax matters cannot be discussed due to confidentiality.
Because of the fiscal confidentiality obligation, I cannot go into the personal situations of the people named in the article.
Antwoord 8 Ik kan omwille van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht 7 niet in gaan op de persoonlijke situaties van de mensen genoemd in het artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de subsidie Verduurzaming en Verbetering voor gedupeerden in Groningen, die binnen 5 dagen op is

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked why the 2021 budget for the Groningen home-improvement subsidy ran out within five days and whether all eligible owners can be reached, including the number of eligible homes and the regimes in place. The ministers answer that the subsidy is phased over three years by design, that no legal entitlement exists, and that they will raise the ceiling via a Staatscourant amendment if needed, though they do not commit to extra funding now.
This year €75 million was available, for which more than 8,100 owners submitted an application.
Dit jaar was € 75 mln. beschikbaar, waar door meer dan 8.100 eigenaren een aanvraag hebben ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de fotografie-aanbesteding Rijksoverheid

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked about the upcoming central government photography tender, its status, and whether it would keep freelance photographers' rates from being pressured and give them a fairer chance to compete, as the Vos/Mulder motion requested. The Prime Minister answered that the tender is in preparation with a pre-announcement published, that a single agency will select a pool of photographers under a framework with fixed hourly rates, and that the design is intended to respect the motion's intent.
In my judgement, the new design does justice to the spirit of the Vos/Mulder motion.
Met de nieuwe opzet wordt naar mijn oordeel recht gedaan aan de geest van de motie Vos/Mulder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over Temper

Two PvdA MPs asked why the Inspectorate SZW treats Temper as a temporary-work agency while the Tax Authority treats it as a client, and whether the Tax Authority's position undermines the Inspectorate and leaves vulnerable workers unprotected. The minister answered that the two bodies have different purposes and methods, that individual cases and inspection reports cannot be disclosed, and that workers can bring civil claims or register-based enforcement remains available.
I cannot make any statements about individual cases and investigations of the Inspectorate SZW.
Over individuele zaken en onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW kan ik geen mededelingen doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over banksaldi van overleden dierbaren

An MP asks the Finance Minister about bank practices when releasing deceased relatives' account balances, including inconsistent requirements, mandatory verification via a certificate of inheritance even for small sums, and tying payout to opening an ING account. The minister acknowledges the burden, notes banks set their own policy within reasonableness limits, points to a 2012 NVB form and ongoing industry talks, and says ING is evaluating its practice.
However, I believe this must not come at the expense of people who need or are compelled to handle their banking matters in person.
Ik vind echter dat dit niet ten koste mag gaan van mensen die behoefte hebben of genoodzaakt zijn om hun bankzaken fysiek te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over misstanden bij bouwtechnische keuringen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about abuses in building inspections for house purchases, including inspectors hired by sellers understating defects, lead fees paid by inspectors to estate agents, and weak quality and liability rules. The Minister acknowledges concerns and urges sector professionalisation and transparency, but rules out mandatory inspections or a system overhaul for now, while promising continued dialogue with the sector and possible further measures if progress is insufficient.
If insufficient progress is made, I do not rule out additional measures.
Als er onvoldoende progressie wordt gemaakt sluit ik aanvullende maatregelen niet uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de kosten van taxaties

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the lack of agreement between banks and the valuation sector on hybrid property valuations, their costs, and whether the cheaper desktop valuation for small changes will remain the norm. The minister answered that two competing hybrid products will be available after 30 June, that costs are not yet known and will be monitored, and that the regulator NRVT and the ECB/DNB will assess compliance with EBA guidelines without the minister commenting on that.
It is not for me to assess whether the developed valuation products comply with the EBA guidelines.
