Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of de ontwikkelde taxatieproducten voldoen aan de richtsnoeren van de EBA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over kapotte bruggen in Groningen

MPs De Hoop and Nijboer asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about damaged bridges in Groningen, including causes of ship collisions, a history of incidents, and repair timelines. The minister gave substantive answers on incident causes, planned safety measures, and rebuilding timelines, but declined to state causes pending a police investigation and deferred some timing questions to ongoing procedures and regional consultations.
I cannot yet make statements about the cause of the collision pending the ongoing police investigation.
Over de oorzaak van de aanvaring kan ik nog geen uitspraken doen in afwachting van het lopende politieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het onterecht aanmerken van mensen als fraudeur

MP Nijboer asks why about 60,000 people received letters after being registered in the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), on what grounds they were registered, and how unjust consequences will be investigated. The State Secretaries answer that FSV was used for varied purposes, that its origins are often not traceable, that people will receive letters explaining registration where possible, and that a PwC study of effects will be completed around September 2021.
To carry out this work well, it is important to be able to assess whether the return or application is in all likelihood correct and complete.
Om dit werk goed uit te kunnen voeren, is het belangrijk om te kunnen beoordelen of de aangifte of aanvraag naar alle waarschijnlijkheid juist en volledig is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat ABN AMRO kosten in rekening gaat brengen voor opname van contant geld

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO's plan to charge fees for large cash withdrawals (above EUR 12,000 a year) is acceptable, and whether banks should be barred from charging for cash withdrawals of their own customers' money. The minister answered that the fee is ABN AMRO's own decision, that a DNB-commissioned study on cash infrastructure is pending, and that concrete measures will be decided only after its results, without committing to a ban.
A study commissioned by De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) is currently underway into what the cash infrastructure should look like in the future and what its costs would be.
Momenteel loopt er in opdracht van De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) een onderzoek naar hoe de infrastructuur voor contant geld er in de toekomst uit moet zien en wat de kosten hiervan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de bouw en verkoop van sociale huurwoningen

Labour MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about the supply of social rental housing, commercial developers' deals that release social units after a time, subsidy conditions, tenant consent for sales and rent protection. The Minister replied that a 150,000-unit social rental commitment is in place, that municipalities and housing corporations decide locally on sales, that tenant contracts remain intact after sale, and that existing rules already regulate sales and rents.
I have no insight into the extent to which municipalities also make agreements with commercial parties on the construction of rental housing for the regulated segment.
Ik heb geen zicht op in hoeverre gemeenten ook afspraken maken met commerciële partijen over de bouw van huurwoningen voor het gereguleerde segment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het artikel 'Tozo-uitkering is halve sigaar uit eigen doos'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the State Secretary of Finance about how child maintenance is treated as income under the Participatiewet and tax law, the legal basis for Belastingdienst tax assessments on Tozo benefits paid to partners, and whether those assessments should be scrapped. The minister defended the current treatment, said the Tozo is a household benefit with a legal basis for the tax assessments, and declined to offer a general solution, citing the lack of a legal basis for waiving the assessments.
There is no legal basis for waiving that levy.
Voor het achterwege laten van die heffing bestaat geen wettelijke basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over negatieve rentes voor particulieren

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about negative interest rates on private savings after ING announced charging negative rates on balances above 100,000 euro, asking about trust, alternatives for savers, reasonable thresholds, a statutory ban and effects on schools, hospitals and non-profits. The minister answered that no negative rate is currently charged to ordinary savers, that DNB advised against a legal ban on balance thresholds for economic and monetary policy reasons, and that he is reluctant to engage banks on pricing given competition rules.
Should those options in future be significantly restricted, I will take up the subject again and consider legislation where appropriate.
Mochten die mogelijkheden in de toekomst significant worden beperkt, dan neem ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand en overweeg ik indien opportuun ook wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over problemen bij de registratie van zendamateurs

An MP asked whether over 1,000 amateur radio registrations had been wrongly withdrawn by the Agentschap Telecom, leaving many operators without a valid licence. The State Secretary answered that no registrations were withdrawn; a database clean-up and an automated script caused a false impression, and the agency has since clarified the situation.
However, this was not the case.
Dit was echter niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de situatie bij de Volksbank

The MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister about governance problems at the state-owned Volksbank, including a supervisory report on board dynamics, the minister's knowledge of it, his passive stance, and delays in NLFI's progress reports. The minister answers that the report was confidential and not shared with him or NLFI, that board and supervisory board changes are underway, and that a new NLFI report is expected around summer.
Supervisory authority reports are confidential under supervision.
Rapportages van de toezichthouder zijn toezichtsvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over aanhoudende problemen met loden leidingen

MP Nijboer asked the Interior Minister about slow progress in finding and replacing lead pipes, the duty of landlords to disclose them, a possible lease clause, health risks to children, and whether a ban is planned. The minister answered that owners are responsible for removal, that gemeenten were asked to act, that a disclosure clause is being studied and progress will be reported annually, and that a ban will be considered if progress is insufficient.
The letter of 2 July 2020 on lead-in-drinking-water actions committed to reporting to the House annually, in a joint letter, on developments and progress in remediation.
In de brief van 2 juli 2020 over acties lood in drinkwater is toegezegd dat de Kamer jaarlijks per gezamenlijke brief wordt gerapporteerd over de ontwikkelingen en de voortgang van saneringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over Gronings restaurant met eigen bezorgdienst krijgt minder steun

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether restaurants delivering their own food receive less TVL support than restaurants using delivery platforms, and whether this is unfair. The State Secretary answered that TVL uses gross turnover, that the outcome depends on contract terms and can go either way, that RVO does not track such cases, and that the scheme already moves with each business's turnover loss, so no change is planned.
For the TVL it does not matter whether you use an own or an external delivery service.
Voor de TVL maakt het niet uit of je gebruik maakt van een eigen of een externe bezorgdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurdersbelangenorganisaties

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how tenant organisations are regulated, whether it is desirable that housing corporations can agree sales with tenant organisations that do not represent the affected tenants, and how individual tenants can have a say in sales. The minister explained the representativeness rules under the Overlegwet and Woningwet, that Woonzorg Nederland now agreed to recognise the local tenant association and give it advisory rights, and that individual tenants have no veto over sales but keep their rental rights.
I do not consider it desirable that housing corporations can make agreements with tenant organisations about the sale of homes while the tenants concerned are not represented.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat woningcorporaties afspraken kunnen maken met huurdersorganisaties over de verkoop van woningen, terwijl de betrokken huurders niet worden vertegenwoordigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ABN Amro, dat klanten teveel rente liet betalen over hun doorlopend krediet

MPs Nijboer asked the Finance Minister how ABN Amro could keep variable interest on a credit line out of step with market rates, after a Kifid appeals ruling, and what consumers, the bank, and the minister would do about compensation, a possible law change, and wider investigation. The minister answered that no specific rules govern how banks set variable rates beyond disclosure duties, that the ruling obliges ABN Amro to recalculate and refund, that compensation and the bank's conduct are matters for the bank, Kifid and courts, and that he will monitor developments and talk with lenders.
The consequence of this ruling is that the credit provider must recalculate for the consumer concerned how much interest was owed on his or her revolving credit.
Het gevolg van deze uitspraak is dat de kredietverstrekker voor de betrokken consument opnieuw moet berekenen hoeveel rente verschuldigd was over zijn of haar doorlopend krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over slapende rekeningen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about dormant bank accounts, including the seven-year record-keeping rule, the twenty-year limitation period after which funds may fall to banks or the State, and whether banks should trace owners and return funds. The minister replied that existing rules suffice, that the seven-year retention period does not apply to dormant accounts, that funds are paid out on proof of ownership, and that a covenant on unclaimed estates with the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is nearing completion.
There is no central administration of banks' efforts regarding dormant accounts.
Er bestaat geen centrale administratie van de inspanningen van banken ten aanzien van slapende rekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over ‘de compensatie van Shell en Exxon voor het verlagen van de gaswinning’

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether Shell and ExxonMobil received at least 1.5 billion euros in compensation for the Groningen gas closure, and pressed on the NAM's payments for damage and reinforcement costs, the stuwmeer scheme, the Norg storage dispute and possible taxation of the oil companies. The minister denied the 1.5 billion figure, said the profit-split change was about 1.3 billion for 2018-2023 but much lower in practice, and explained the cost recovery from NAM and the ongoing arbitration, while declining to disclose commercially confidential information and promising to inform parliament on a levy.
All agreements with Shell, ExxonMobil or the NAM are public, except for commercially confidential information.
Alle overeenkomsten met Shell, ExxonMobil of de NAM zijn, behoudens bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie, openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over voorkennis bij het bieden op woningen

MP Nijboer asks the Minister of the Interior about insider information and non-transparent bidding in the housing market, including lottery practices for new-build homes. The minister calls such practices unacceptable, points to industry codes and complaint routes, promises talks with brokers and transparency measures, but declines to ask the ACM for an investigation or to commission a study of the Norwegian bidding model.
I will discuss with property developers the methods used in allocating new-build homes.
Ik ga met de projectontwikkelaars in gesprek over de methoden die worden gehanteerd bij de toewijzing van nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de lange wachttijden in de ggz in Groningen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health why mental health waiting times in Groningen exceed the 14-week norm, what has been done over four years, and what new steps will be taken. The State Secretary confirmed the specialised mental health waits exceed the norm, described measures such as regional taskforces, transfer mechanisms and a regional enforcement power, and said the problem is too complex for a quick fix.
I am in discussions with regions where the problem is greatest.
Ik ben in gesprek met regio's waar de problematiek het grootst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat nog altijd flitskredieten tegen torenhoge kosten worden aangeboden

An MP asks the Finance Minister about flash-credit firm Ferratum charging fees above the legal 10% maximum, asking why the AFM has not acted, whether this is criminal, and about municipal credit banks. The minister replies that the maximum applies to all fees including guarantee costs, the AFM is bound by secrecy and must decide itself on enforcement, criminal prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and EU rules limit national action on cross-border online lenders.
The AFM cannot provide information about individual parties and is bound by the statutory duty of confidentiality.
De AFM kan geen informatie over individuele partijen verstrekken en is gebonden aan de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over steun aan buurt- en dorpshuizen voor het jaar 2021

MP Nijboer asked whether the government would extend compensation for neighbourhood and village houses for 2021 and whether municipal finance pressures threaten their closure. The minister said TVL support continues through Q2 2021 with higher minimum subsidies, that no additional support is planned for now, and that municipal finance questions are for a future cabinet.
The cabinet is currently not planning to take additional support measures beyond the existing TVL compensation and the extra TVL measures from April 2021.

het kabinet is vooralsnog niet voornemens om naast de compenserende maatregelen via de huidige TVL regeling en de extra compenserende maatregelen van de TVL regeling per april 2021, aanvullende ondersteuningsmaatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het deltaplan aanpak funderingsschade

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the Deltaplan on foundation damage, including the claim that a million homes face risk, the role of groundwater management, how owners with unaffordable repair costs are helped, and whether the Rijk should take a stronger coordinating role. The Minister disputes the scale of the claim (at most 80,000 homes in the relevant damage bracket), explains the division of groundwater responsibilities among provinces, water boards and municipalities, points to the Fonds Duurzaam Funderingsherstel, and says that any new ministry question is for formation talks.

I am of course willing to hold talks with the coalition of the Deltaplan aanpak funderingsschade, together with the other responsible departments and co-governments, to see how we can jointly prevent foundation problems and solve current ones.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid om samen met de andere verantwoordelijke departementen en medeoverheden het gesprek te voeren met de coalitie van het Deltaplan aanpak funderingsschade
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de invloed van de negatieve rente op zorg- en onderwijsinstellingen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about negative interest rates costing care and education institutions money and whether public funds could be shifted to the state treasury. The minister said there is no data on care institutions' negative-rate costs, that banks set their own rates, and that education institutions can voluntarily bank with the treasury, while refusing to open talks with banks on pricing.
There is no insight into the costs that care institutions in the Netherlands incur from negative interest.
Er is geen inzicht in de kosten die zorginstellingen in Nederland kwijt zijn aan negatieve rente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over toezicht op grondspeculanten

An MP asked ministers about oversight of land speculators, notaries' duties, AFM supervision and fragmentation of land ownership after reports of disputes over dubious land deals. The government answered that existing consumer law, notarial duties and AFM rules apply, that no new oversight is needed, and that the Wet beleggingsobjecten decision is left to the next cabinet.

From the statutory framework and the professional body's regulations in general, and from the disciplinary procedure in particular, it cannot be inferred that the role of notaries (in general) in pointing out risks in land transactions needs improvement.

Uit de wettelijke regeling en de verordeningen van de beroepsorganisatie in het algemeen en uit de tuchtprocedure in het bijzonder valt dan ook niet te herleiden dat de rol van notarissen (in het algemeen) bij het wijzen op risico's bij grondtransacties verbetering behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Kerstens en Kuiken over zorgcowboys die gemeenten op kosten jagen

MPs Nijboer, Kerstens and Kuiken asked about 'zorgcowboys' moving clients across the country to the detriment of municipalities, municipal financial strain in youth care, benefits and shelter, and whether this causes social rental housing construction problems and gatekeeping of care. Minister De Jonge answered that no signals of such practices were received, pointed to COVID compensation, extra youth-care funds and the planned residence-principle reforms, and largely deferred the structural funding question to a future cabinet.
Decision-making on a structural solution in terms of adjusting the system from 2022 and the required budget will be left to a next cabinet.
Besluitvorming over een structurele oplossing in termen van aanpassing in het stelsel vanaf 2022 en benodigd budget, zal aan een volgend kabinet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ‘’het gebrek aan voortgang in Groningen’’

MP Nijboer asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about delays in the Groningen earthquake-damage handling, reinforcement operation and the rollout of fibre internet in Siddeburen, and what will be done to restore residents' trust. The Minister acknowledges delays, cites improvements at the IMG damage-handling body and the fibre contractor's revised timeline, and agrees residents must benefit quickly from economic measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over woningeigenaren die huren bij een woningcorporatie

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about social tenants who own several homes, including a Súdwest-Fryslân tenant owning 59 properties, and whether ownership should be checked before allocating social housing. The minister said the Kadaster found 1055 social tenants also owning two or more homes, that such situations are undesirable, that corporations can include clauses in leases and terminate contracts, and that further research is planned.
Research by the Kadaster found that 1055 people rent a home from a housing corporation while also owning two or more owner-occupied homes.
Uit onderzoek van het Kadaster is naar voren gekomen dat 1055 personen een woning bij een woningcorporatie huren en tegelijk twee of meer koopwoningen in eigendom hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de Friese bodem niet meer terugveert na ondergrondse zoutwinning

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that the Frisian soil no longer rebounds after underground salt extraction, asking about permit conditions, subsidence effects, compensation, water management and whether extraction should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the permit caps subsidence at 30 cm above the caverns and 35 cm across the area, that residual rebound is not a permit criterion, that damage claims go to the mining company and the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, and that there is no reason to reconsider extraction.
I do not want residents to be left with damage caused by ground movement from mining.
Ik wil niet dat bewoners blijven zitten met schade ten gevolge van bodembeweging door mijnbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aangenomen resolutie van het Europees Parlement op 21 januari 2021 over de herziening van de EU-lijst van belastingparadijzen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about EP resolution on the EU tax haven blacklist, including whether the Cayman Islands were delisted and whether zero-tax countries should be automatically listed. The State Secretary confirms the Cayman Islands met the criteria, supports stricter criteria such as automatic listing for zero corporate tax, promises more transparency of the Code of Conduct Group, and says the Commission will evaluate defensive measures in 2022.
The Netherlands has long been in favour of promoting greater transparency of the Code of Conduct Group.
Nederland is al een tijd voorstander van het bevorderen van meer transparantie van de Gedragscodegroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers in Groningen en Fryslân die knel komen te zitten

MPs Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked whether start-up businesses hit by COVID-19 measures, such as hairdressers and hospitality firms without a reference turnover, are adequately compensated and whether the schemes could be changed. The State Secretary replied that a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will cover start-ups' fixed costs, that monthly turnover calculations are not feasible, and that fully closed sectors get up to 85% fixed-cost subsidy.
With the new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme, the cabinet wants to give these entrepreneurs a reasonable subsidy for their fixed costs.
Met de nieuwe regeling Tegemoetkoming Starters wil het kabinet deze ondernemers een redelijke subsidie bieden voor hun vaste lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het bericht ‘Ruzie tussen Nederland en Frankrijk bedreigt banen in Roden’

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of a dispute with France over Photonis and the threat to jobs in Roden, and what the government would do to protect them and prevent the company falling into the wrong hands. The minister denied a dispute, said the Netherlands is in close contact with France, expressed a preference for a sale by the current owner, and gave general commitments to protect jobs and R&D without concrete new steps.
The cabinet has no indication that an undesirable takeover of the company is currently at issue.
Het kabinet heeft geen indicatie dat een onwenselijke overname van het bedrijf op dit moment aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat gebrekkige gegevensuitwisseling belastingontwijking in de hand werkt

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that poor cross-border tax data exchange enables tax avoidance, including which data is exchanged, its quality, and the possibility of public country-by-country reporting. The State Secretary answered in detail on the DAC framework, data quality issues, and planned DAC7/DAC8 improvements, while stating the government supports public country-by-country reporting only through international agreement.
Making country-by-country reports by multinationals public, for example by including them as an annex to the annual accounts, can be an effective means of promoting fiscal transparency.
Het publiek maken van landenrapporten door multinationals, bijvoorbeeld door deze als bijlage op te nemen bij de jaarrekening, kan een effectief middel zijn om fiscale transparantie te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het groeiende aanbod van verhuurhypotheken

An MP asks the ministers about the growing supply of buy-to-let mortgages and their effects on starters and house prices. The minister answers that there are about 15 providers, that the government sees no problem with more providers but requires responsible lending, that it differentiated transfer tax to favour starters, and that it will introduce purchase protection and cap rent increases, while rejecting a numeric threshold for treating landlords as entrepreneurs.
In addition, I will cap the annual rent increase in the free sector, so that tenants in the free sector are also protected against unexpected excessive rent increases.
Daarnaast zal ik de jaarlijkse huurprijsstijging in de vrije sector maximeren, waardoor ook de huurders in de vrije sector worden beschermd tegen onverwachte excessieve huurverhogingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over beslaglegging op compensatie door de Belastingdienst

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked whether debt-relief trustees can seize compensation paid to childcare-benefit scandal victims after a WSNP debt-rescheduling period ends, and whether a seizure ban will be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledged the undesirable effect, said talks with public and private creditors are ongoing, committed to public creditors waiving claims, and promised certificates clearing victims of past fraud or intent labels.
That is why I am in talks with creditors and other parties to reach a solution that does justice to the various interests.
Daarom ben ik in gesprek met schuldeisers en betrokken partijen om te komen tot een oplossing die recht doet aan de verschillende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het achterblijven van de bouwambitie in Almere

Labour MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior why Almere's housing ambition lags behind the 60,000-home target agreed with the national government, and what consequences and steps follow. The minister replied that the agreements remain in force, that about 12,000 homes have been built since 2010, that a 25,000-home plan for 2020-2030 is a substantial acceleration, and that further steps are being explored in ongoing MIRT and regional processes.
Currently a programme is being developed in Almere to realise this acceleration task.
Momenteel wordt in Almere gewerkt aan een programma om deze versnellingsopgave te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Agnes Mulder, Sienot, Bromet, Nijboer en Dik-Faber over het rekenmodel waardedalingsregeling dat gedupeerden benadeelt

MPs asked whether the IMG's depreciation model disadvantages the hardest-hit Groningen homes and whether the minister would intervene to apply an individual-level alternative proposed by De Kam and Blanken. The minister replied that the IMG independently sets its own method under the Tijdelijke wet Groningen, that it chose the variant giving the highest average outcomes, and that intervening would undermine its independence, though objections and appeals remain available.
It is not for me but for the IMG to determine, within the legal framework, which method it uses to handle all types of damage, including depreciation damage.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan het IMG om binnen de wettelijke kaders te bepalen welke werkwijze zij hanteert voor de afhandeling van alle schadevormen, waaronder schade door waardedaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de sociale woningbouw in Noord-Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about housing corporations' warning on social housing in Northern Netherlands, including support for replacing homes and liveability investments in sparsely populated areas. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing schemes (RVV, Woningbouwimpuls, Volkshuisvestingsfonds) and planned legislative changes, while leaving structural solutions to the next cabinet.
It is up to the next cabinet to make choices about structural solutions for the imbalance between the resources and tasks of corporations.
Het is aan het volgende kabinet om keuzes te maken over structurele oplossingsrichtingen voor de disbalans tussen de middelen en opgaven van corporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over constructies om huurprijsregulering te ontduiken bij Kamerverhuur

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the legal construction of 'contractuele medehuur' (contractual co-tenancy) is used to evade rent regulation in room rentals, and what protections tenants have, including whether municipalities could require individual contracts. The minister answered that such practices are undesirable, that she is examining legal instruments for municipalities such as a landlord licence, and that the decision is left to the next cabinet.
I want to further map out which legal changes are needed to give municipalities more instruments to prevent these constructions and what the possible consequences of this would be.
Ik wil verder in beeld brengen welke wettelijke wijzigingen nodig zijn om gemeenten meer instrumenten te bieden om deze constructies te voorkomen en wat de mogelijke consequenties hiervan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de dividenduitkering van een Finse bankragen

An MP asks the Finance Minister about a Finnish bank paying out 59% of its 2019 profit as dividend despite ECB and Finnish supervisor recommendations against dividends during COVID-19, and whether such recommendations can be made binding. The minister says the ECB advice is not legally enforceable but supervisors expect compliance, that supervisors can already impose individual dividend bans, and that he has no signals of Dutch banks defying the recommendations.
This concerns an ECB recommendation with an urgent advice to the banking sector. Supervisors expect institutions to follow the advice, but this is not legally enforceable.
Het betreft een aanbeveling van de ECB met een dringend advies aan de bankensector. Toezichthouders verwachten dat instellingen het advies volgen, maar dit is niet juridisch afdwingbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de verder verslechterde financiële positie van jeugdzorginstelling Elker

Kuiken and Nijboer (PvdA) asked the state secretary about Elker's deteriorating finances, possible dismissals amid high sickness absence, and whether the ministry would intervene to prevent bankruptcy. The secretary answered that providers and municipalities are responsible, that continuity of care is paramount, and that the Jeugdautoriteit and municipalities are in talks, with emergency liquidity support available only under strict conditions.
In extreme cases, youth care providers can apply for temporary liquidity support under the subsidy scheme 'Continuity of crucial youth care'.
In uiterste gevallen kunnen jeugdzorgaanbieders een aanvraag indienen voor tijdelijke liquiditeitssteun op basis van de subsidieregeling «Continuïteit cruciale jeugdzorg».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het drama voor de huizenkopers in Helmond

MP Nijboer asks the Minister of Interior about the Helmond housing project where buyers face unfinished homes after developer Earth & Eternity and contractor Gemert Bouw dispute payment, and about the Betaal Garant guarantee fund and how buyers can be protected. The minister answers that the municipality is supporting buyers, that court proceedings against the fund's director are pending, that existing market guarantee schemes and the Wet kwaliteitsborging information duty are relied on, and that a national guarantee fund is not considered necessary.
Court proceedings against the director of Betaal Garant Nederland are currently ongoing.
Momenteel loopt een gerechtelijke procedure tegen de bestuurder van Betaal Garant Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Ommelander Ziekenhuis in zwaar weer: 'ingrijpende maatregelen' dreigen’

MPs Ploumen and Nijboer asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that the Ommelander Ziekenhuis in Scheemda faces financial trouble and drastic measures, and about accessibility of care in the region. The Minister replied that there is no acute financial crisis, that the hospital's strategy is being adjusted with insurers and other financiers, that the NZa sees no current risk to the duty of care, and that the matter is primarily for the hospital and insurers to resolve.
It is primarily up to OZG and the health insurers and other financiers to now hold the discussion together.
Het is primair aan OZG en de zorgverzekeraars en andere financiers om nu samen het gesprek te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over georganiseerde criminaliteit in de Noordelijke zeehavens

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether organised crime is shifting to the Northern seaports due to weak oversight and information positions, and what will be done to improve this. The Minister replied that the study confirmed the information position is inadequate, that the extent of organised crime there is still unclear, and listed initiatives such as information-sharing agreements, training, and specialised investigation teams.
The research showed that the extent to which organised, undermining crime occurs in the Northern seaports is still insufficiently clear.
Het onderzoek heeft uitgewezen dat de mate waarin georganiseerde, ondermijnende criminaliteit in de Noordelijke zeehavens voorkomt nog onvoldoende duidelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Ploumen over mijn eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen over een zinkgat in Kerkrade

MPs Beckerman, Nijboer and Ploumen pressed the minister on who is liable for damage from a sinkhole in Kerkrade, whether the Waarborgfonds Mijnbouwschade had been contacted, whether residents were informed of risks, whether 12 people lived in the adjacent building, and what lessons were learned. The minister answered that the Waarborgfonds is liable for mining damage to private persons, that no structural damage to homes has been found, that the municipality handles communication, that the adjacent building was unoccupied apart from a foundation's use, and that lessons will be discussed after remediation finishes in June 2021.
Some time after the shaft is tapped, remediation of the shaft begins.
Vervolgens wordt enige tijd na het aanboren van de schacht de sanering aangevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de bestaande mogelijkheden om de overwaarde op een huis uit te laten betalen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about products that let homeowners cash out home equity, the AFM's oversight of them, and whether mandatory repayment rules push people to build equity. The minister answered that no total count exists, that the AFM supervises these products (with some sale-and-lease-back constructions falling under ACM), and that equity can arise from repayment, price rises or savings, with the government emphasising good advice and clear conditions.
Therefore there is no overall picture of the number of homeowners who annually use these financial products for that reason.
Daarom is er geen totaaloverzicht van het aantal huiseigenaren dat jaarlijks om die reden gebruikmaakt van deze financiële producten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over Vestia en de huurverlaging

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior about Vestia's rent policy, its WSW sanitation constraints, the Social Rent Accord rent cut, and the transfer tax increase for housing corporations. The minister answered that Vestia may freeze or lower rents within the sanitation framework, that a mandatory rent reduction applies to Vestia tenants from 1 January 2021, and that a structural solution will be reported before year-end, while declining to offer specific compensation.
As promised in the committee meeting of 9 November 2020, I will inform the House before the end of the year about the steps I am taking to ensure a solution is on the table next year.

Zoals toegezegd in het WGO Wonen en Ruimte van 9 november 2020, informeer ik uw Kamer voor het einde van het jaar over de stappen die ik neem om te zorgen dat er volgend jaar een oplossing op tafel komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over herindelingsverkiezing Eemsdelta

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked why proxy votes, postal and early voting were not made possible for the Eemsdelta by-election in time, and what further measures could be taken. The minister answered that the Covid-19 election law provides a basis, that increasing proxy votes from two to three was dropped in consultation with municipalities as unworkable in time, and that postal and early voting are planned only for the March 2021 national election.
In the evaluation I will pay attention to the number of proxy votes cast.
In de evaluatie zal ik aandacht schenken aan het aantal uitgebrachte volmachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de huurtoeslag en de uitwerking van het Sociaal Huurakkoord

An MP asked about implementing the Social Rental Agreement (Sociaal Huurakkoord), commercial landlords' obligations, and the reinstatement of rent allowance (huurtoeslag) for a case where the rent exceeded the threshold. The minister answered that the measures are being legislated or are in progress, outlined the rules on reinstated entitlement and a new hardship clause, and declined to take a position requiring commercial landlords to cut rents.
Expected later this year to inform the House of Representatives about possible adjustments to rental policy and regulations.
Naar verwachting later dit jaar informatie aan de Tweede Kamer over eventuele aanpassingen in huurbeleid- en regelgeving
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over 1 miljoen verzakkende huizen door bodemdaling

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Interior and of Infrastructure about the risk that up to a million homes sink due to land subsidence, the costs, who bears them, and what policy exists. The government answered that owners bear foundation repair costs, that municipalities and water boards manage groundwater with limited ability to prevent further sinking, and listed existing funding and support programmes without committing to new measures.
Enquiries with the provincial, water board and municipal associations show that it is not possible to provide this overview in full detail within the set deadline.
Uit navraag bij de koepels van provincies, waterschappen en gemeenten blijkt dat het niet mogelijk is om dit overzicht op de gestelde termijn «en detail» te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de kosten van WOZ-bezwaren voor gemeenten

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether no-cure-no-pay agencies profit from WOZ property-valuation objections while citizens gain little, and about the costs to municipalities. The minister says a WODC study is expected by end 2020, cites over EUR 12 million in cost reimbursements paid by municipalities in 2019, and states that objection procedures are already easy for citizens, with no further access measures planned for now.
The WODC study is expected to be delivered by the end of 2020.
Het onderzoek van het WODC wordt naar verwachting voor het eind van 2020 opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over aanpassing van de rente door hypotheekverstrekkers na wijziging van de WOZ-waarde

An MP asked whether mortgage lenders should actively inform borrowers when a rise in WOZ property value makes them eligible for a lower interest rate. The minister explained that lenders adjust risk surcharges based on loan-to-value, that borrowers may need to provide proof of higher value, and that lenders should inform clients, but declined to impose a specific new obligation, pointing to AFM supervision and sector initiatives.
I find it desirable that mortgage lenders actively lower the interest rate within the fixed-rate period when the debt decreases.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat hypotheekverstrekkers binnen de rentevastperiode de rente actief verlagen wanneer de schuld afneemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het bericht 'Miljarden vliegen weg bij Tata'

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the ministers whether reports that billions of euros flowed from Tata Steel Netherlands to its Indian parent show unpaid corporate tax, mismanagement, or threats to investment. Minister Wiebes answered that tax secrecy (art. 67 AWR) prevents comment on an individual taxpayer, that the Tax Authority supervises on a risk basis, that he sees no grounds for intervention, and that Tata Steel's investment plans are sound, while rejecting new rules restricting profit transfers.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Moorlag over de slechte toegankelijkheid van huisartsenspoedzorg in Noordoost-Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about the reduction of night-time GP emergency car visits in Noordoost-Groningen, the loss of the Delfzijl post, and the erosion of acute care in the region. The minister replied that GPs and insurers are responsible for 24-hour care, that the inspectorate found no patient-safety breach so far, that a draft AMvB on acute care would require careful process if closures were decided, and that no signals of unacceptable care had been received.
I have currently received no signals from the relevant supervisory bodies that the quality or availability of care is at stake.
Ik heb op dit moment geen signalen ontvangen van de betreffende toezichthouders dat kwaliteit of beschikbaarheid van zorg in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Smeulders en Nijboer over huisuitzettingen in de tweede coronagolf

MPs Beckerman, Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior about evictions of antikraak residents during the second COVID wave, a possible ban on evictions, a rehousing guarantee, and renewed agreements with landlords. The Minister said a general eviction ban is not desirable, that courts should weigh individual cases, that a case was resolved by alternative housing, and that the earlier agreements remain in force with some landlord associations and municipalities.
A general ban on evictions is not considered desirable by the cabinet.
Een algeheel verbod op huisuitzettingen acht het kabinet niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Ploumen over een sinkhole in Kerkrade

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a sinkhole in Kerkrade caused by sanitising an old mine shaft, covering instability, funding, liability, resident information, lessons learned and damage to neighbouring homes. The minister answered that the shaft is being sanitised, funded through a 12 million euro package, that damage claims go to the Waarborgfonds Mijnbouwschade, and that the municipality is monitoring nearby homes, with a follow-up consultation planned.
After the remediation, this historic shaft will be stabilised and safe.
Na de sanering is deze historische schacht gestabiliseerd en veilig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over mensen die in de problemen komen door hun belastingadviseur

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about taxpayers harmed by malicious tax advisers, including the number of advisers and victims, the misuse of DigiD and beconnummers, liability, disciplinary law and competence requirements. The government answered that the Tax Authority lacks an overview of victims, described enforcement against facilitators, rejected mandatory disciplinary law, competence requirements and VOG, and promised to examine whether existing instruments are adequate.
I am therefore willing to examine whether the existing instruments to act against malicious tax advisers are adequate and sufficiently used.
Ik ben dan ook bereid om te onderzoeken of het bestaande instrumentarium om op te treden tegen malafide belastingadviseurs toereikend is en voldoende wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over vriendjespolitiek bij het toewijzen van nieuwbouwwoningen

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether developers allocate new-build homes to friends and family and to people based on discrimination, and what measures the government will take. The minister answers that anti-discrimination rules apply, that the extent of discrimination is unclear so the government will investigate it, and that it sees no reason for measures against favouritism, while outlining future steps on affordable ownership and municipal allocation powers.
At present it is unclear to what extent discrimination occurs in the allocation of new-build homes.
Op dit moment is het onduidelijk in welke mate discriminatie voorkomt bij het toewijzen van nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp Van Eijs, Beckerman, Laan-Geselschap, Dik-Faber, Nijboer Geluk-Poortvliet en Terpstra over de noodzaak tot investeren in wonen voor senioren

MPs from several parties asked whether a 80,000-unit shortage of senior housing exists, what the government is doing with the taskforce on housing and care, and whether municipalities should be obliged to build senior homes. The minister answered that the shortage figure's source is unclear, that a senior housing monitor will be sent by year-end, that no binding national targets will be imposed, and that the government is supporting local action through taskforces, agreements and subsidy schemes.
Even after inquiry, it is not clear to us what the source of this figure is.
Het is ons, ook na navraag, niet duidelijk wat de bron is van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verhuurders die huurders dwingen een dure parkeerplaats te huren

An MP asked the Minister whether landlords may force tenants to rent a parking space with social housing, and whether this should be banned. The Minister answered that bundled parking rent is in principle lawful, that courts usually find it reasonable but may annul it if it gives the landlord an unreasonable advantage, and that she will investigate a possible ban and report in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de bewoonbaarheid van verhitte woningen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether overheated homes can count as a defect the landlord must fix, whether landlords can be forced to cool them, and what is done for vulnerable residents and climate adaptation. The minister said there are no legal temperature norms for existing homes, so courts or the Huurcommissie decide case by case, while new homes get an overheating standard from 2021 and several climate adaptation programmes are underway.
Where indoor temperatures are concerned, there are no statutory norms for existing homes.
Waar het gaat om binnentemperaturen bestaan er voor bestaande woningen geen wettelijke normen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de Huurcommissie

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about long processing times at the Rent Commission (Huurcommissie), the share of tenants winning cases, and whether landlords can raise rents while disputes are pending. The Minister gave statutory deadlines, case volumes and win rates, attributed delays to a 2018 inflow surge and COVID-19 hearing suspensions, and announced capacity measures and an action plan to be sent to Parliament.
For the Commission's rulings, a statutory deadline of four months applies after the four-week fee payment period has expired.
Voor het doen van commissie-uitspraken geldt een wettelijke termijn van vier maanden na het verstrijken van de legesbetalingstermijn van vier weken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Nijboer over vermogen van het Wit-Russische regime bij Nederlandse brievenbusfirma’s

MPs Ploumen and Nijboer asked whether the Belarusian Lukashenko regime holds assets in Dutch letterbox companies, whether such assets should be frozen and how to prevent them. The minister answered that the government is unaware of such assets, that individual cases cannot be commented on absent sanctions, and that EU sanctions, client due diligence and tighter trust office rules are the instruments, while national unilateral measures are not possible under current law.
I cannot make statements about individual cases as long as no sanctions apply to those persons or regimes.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik geen uitspraken doen, zolang er geen sprake is van sancties die van toepassing zijn op die personen of regimes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de werkwijze van taxateurs

An MP asks the Interior and Finance Ministers about the independence and quality of mortgage valuations (taxaties), the DNB finding of systematic overvaluation, EU rules on model-based valuation, and costs to consumers. The minister acknowledges quality and independence concerns, points to a working group, sector self-regulation and new hybrid valuation options, but does not commit to a regulatory fix beyond further reporting later in the year.
I will inform you further about the outcomes of this process later this year.
Over de uitkomsten van dit traject zal ik u later dit jaar nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de grote opgave voor Vestia

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the Vestia housing corporation, its divestment of stock to regional corporations, shortfalls in investment capacity in the Haaglanden region, and the impact on tenants including rent reductions under the Social Rental Agreement. The Minister acknowledges the regional shortfall and the transfer effects, but defends Vestia's sanering plan and declines to force rent cuts or compensate Vestia, pointing to ongoing regional talks and a regional regisseur.
I see no need or possibility to specifically enforce rent reductions at Vestia and compensate the corporation for them.
Ik zie geen noodzaak en mogelijkheid om specifiek bij Vestia huurverlaging af te dwingen en de corporatie daarvoor te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Ploumen over een wegverzakking in Kerkrade

Two MPs asked about a road collapse in Kerkrade caused by a historic mine shaft, including how it happened, safety measures, and compensation. The minister answered that the shaft is being located and sealed under an existing programme, that a worker was injured when a drilling rig slid into the collapse, and that residents' financial damage will be settled between authorities.
With the municipality of Kerkrade it has been agreed to consult the parties involved after the sealing of shaft DOM-37 on whether this event gives cause for adjustments to the programme.
Met de gemeente Kerkrade is afgesproken om na de sanering van de DOM-37-schacht met de betrokken partijen te overleggen of deze gebeurtenis aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verhuurwebsites die illegale kosten rekenen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about rental websites that mislead consumers and charge prohibited intermediary fees to tenants. The minister answered that such practices are prohibited, pointed tenants to reclaim unlawful fees and report misleading practices to the consumer authority ACM, which can investigate systematic violations.
Tenants can reclaim wrongly charged intermediary fees from rental agents.
Huurders kunnen ten onrechte in rekening gebrachte bemiddelingskosten van verhuurbemiddelaars terugvorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over wooncoöperaties

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about housing cooperatives abroad (Germany, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland), including their legal form, funding, tenant participation and whether Sweden's public housing complies with EU law, and asked what lessons can be learned. The Minister answered that the information requires external research, which will be sent to parliament with a letter, and gave a short account of Sweden's system.
I will commission such research, while noting, as in my earlier answer, that a comparison is subject to limitations.
Ik zal een dergelijk onderzoek laten doen, waarbij ik net als in mijn eerdere beantwoording aanteken dat een vergelijking aan beperkingen onderhevig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de verergering van de situatie in Groningen

Labour MP Nijboer asked about slow progress on house reinforcement in Groningen, inspection reports not being shared, delays and uncertainty for residents, foundation research and compensation disputes, and why these problems persist compared with the speed of the COVID response. The minister answers that inspection reports are available on request, that prioritisation and capacity limits cause delays, that a few specific cases will be discussed or have advice sent, and that a versnellingspakket is intended to speed up reinforcement.
Residents can ask their assigned NCG resident supporter or the municipality's area director whether and when their address is included in the municipal action plans.
Bewoners kunnen bij de hun toegewezen bewonersbegeleider van NCG of gebiedsregisseur van de eigen gemeente informeren of en wanneer hun adres is opgenomen in de gemeentelijke plannen van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Terpstra over de terugkeer van het ministerie van VROM

MPs Nijboer and Terpstra asked whether the government would restore a separate Minister for Housing, Spatial Planning and Environment (VROM), prepare for it, and re-establish a Rijksplanologische Dienst. Minister Ollongren answered that a ministerial portfolio is a political choice for the next cabinet formation, that housing and spatial tasks are handled integrally, and that re-creating a planning service is not considered appropriate.
Whether the next cabinet should have a Minister for Housing, Spatial Planning and Environment is a political choice and consideration for the parties involved in a future cabinet formation.

Of er in het volgend kabinet een Minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer moet komen, is een politieke keuze en afweging die aan politieke partijen betrokken bij een volgende kabinetsformatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over loodvergiftging van kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of childhood lead poisoning in the Netherlands, its causes, the role of lead pipes, and whether a binding ban on lead pipes and a timeline for safe tap water would be introduced. The minister disputed the 7,600 figure, said recent Dutch measurements show a declining trend, referred to the Gezondheidsraad advice and the July 2020 letter, and said a pipe ban would be reconsidered depending on the annual sanitation progress report.
Until the pipes are replaced, the Health Council advises residents to use bottled water for pregnant women, bottle-fed infants and young children up to about seven years old.
Zolang de leidingen niet zijn vervangen adviseert de Gezondheidsraad aan bewoners om voor zwangeren, flesgevoede kinderen en jonge kinderen tot een jaar of zeven flessenwater te gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huisbazen die weigeren loden leidingen te vervangen

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether landlords refusing to replace lead pipes should be held to account, whether tenants must go to court to enforce safe water, and whether a lead-pipe ban and warnings will follow. The minister says landlords are responsible and tenants can use the Huurcommissie or courts, that a lead-pipe ban was not chosen for now but will be reconsidered after annual monitoring, and that municipalities and GGDs will be encouraged to act.
If the landlord refuses to take measures, the tenant can bring the matter before the Huurcommissie or, if necessary, the court.
Indien de verhuurder weigert maatregelen te nemen kan de huurder zijn zaak voorleggen aan de Huurcommissie of zo nodig de rechter
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over wooncoöperaties

An MP asks the minister about housing cooperatives: their number, their potential to deliver affordable housing, obstacles they face, and whether government will support pilots, a revolving fund and foreign models. The minister answers that the cooperative sector is small, that a full overview is not available, that a financing study and pilots via Platform31 are underway, and that she will inform parliament after the summer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers die tussen wal en schip vallen bij het aanvragen van de NOW-regeling

MPs asked whether entrepreneurs who changed legal form, took over a business or started in early 2020 fall through the cracks of the NOW wage-subsidy scheme, and whether affected firms can be compensated and included in a second package. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the scheme cannot be adapted to every case, refuses to quantify affected firms, and declines to extend eligibility to businesses without a full reference month of turnover.
I am aware of the problem of businesses that had not yet generated a full month of turnover before March.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de problematiek van bedrijven die voor maart nog geen hele maand omzet hebben gedraaid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over gemeenten die in geldnood dreigen te komen

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether municipalities face financial distress from COVID-19 revenue losses and how they could absorb it, and whether the government would help. State Secretary Knops replied that compensation measures were agreed with local governments, no liquidity problems are known, a regiegroep is assessing the costs, and the accres is frozen for 2020-2021.
The number of municipalities under preventive enhanced supervision in 2020 is still limited and does not deviate strongly from the figures of the past ten years.
Het aantal gemeenten dat in 2020 onder verscherpt toezicht staat (preventief) is nog beperkt en wijkt niet sterk af van de aantallen van de afgelopen tien jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het ontbreken van overeenstemming tussen winkeliers en vastgoedeigenaren

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked whether landlords and retail tenants are reaching rent-relief agreements, whether the Steunakkoord agreements are binding and could be declared generally binding, and whether legislation is needed. The State Secretary replied that most tenants and landlords have made case-by-case agreements, that a legal basis for generally binding private agreements does not exist, and that no legislative proposal is planned.
To declare private agreements generally binding, a legal basis is required. That does not currently exist.
Om private afspraken algemeen verbindend te verklaren, is een wettelijke grondslag nodig. Die bestaat nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de plannen van Leeuwarden en Groningen voor meer betaalbare woningen

An MP asked about investor purchases of homes in Groningen and Leeuwarden, the risk to affordability, and calls for a residence requirement and rent regulation. The minister confirmed rising investor purchases, announced an opkoopbescherming (purchase protection) for municipalities, a rent-increase cap and transparency measures, but rejected experiments with extending the points system to mid-rent housing.
I will introduce the purchase protection for a period of three years and then evaluate it.
Ik zal de opkoopbescherming invoeren voor een periode van drie jaar en vervolgens evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Smeulders en Beckerman over het tijdelijk bevriezen van huurprijzen

MPs Nijboer, Smeulders and Beckerman asked how the minister will implement the Senate motion to temporarily freeze rents in both the free and social sectors, and whether housing corporations should be compensated for lost rent. The minister answered that a general freeze is not proportionate or timely, relies on case-by-case maatwerk, a complaints desk at the Huurcommissie, monitoring, and a decision in August, and will table a separate bill on temporary rent reductions.
Capping or generally postponing the rent increases customarily applied on 1 July does not reflect proper governance, for two reasons.
Het nu maximeren of generiek uitstellen van de huurverhogingen die gebruikelijk plaats vindt op 1 juli getuigt niet van behoorlijk bestuur, vanwege twee redenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale straf voor woningcorporaties

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of the Interior whether the corporate tax treatment of housing corporations (depreciation limits, ban on write-downs, earningsstripping under ATAD1, reserves) unfairly penalises them compared with commercial landlords and restricts their investment capacity. The government answers that equal treatment requires no special regime, that the rules apply generically, that corporations cannot be carved out under ATAD1, and that the investment capacity and withholding of a broader review will be sent to parliament before summer.
The cabinet is examining whether housing corporations will also have sufficient room for the necessary investments in the medium and long term.
Het kabinet onderzoekt of woningcorporaties ook op middellange en lange termijn voldoende ruimte hebben voor de benodigde investeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de evaluatie van de verhuurderheffing

An MP asks the government about the rental levy (verhuurderheffing) on housing corporations, whether it has halved social rental construction, and whether it should be lowered to stimulate building affordable homes. The minister disputes that the levy alone caused the investment drop, notes corporations have investment room, and points to a planned study under the Ronnes motion and measures to keep building.
Before the summer I will send the results of this to the House.
Voor de zomer zal ik de resultaten hiervan aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de definitieve sluiting van Het Poortje

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the government about the definitive closure of Het Poortje youth institution in Groningen, including a claimed EUR 3.5 million deficit, dismissals, and whether youth care in Groningen and Drenthe remains adequate. Minister De Jonge answered that Elker will close its Groningen Jeugdzorg Plus location but continue closed youth care in smaller settings without forced dismissals, that regions are satisfied with places, and that no emergency plan is needed.
Elker Jeugdhulp & onderwijs has informed me that it will organise closed youth care differently.
Elker Jeugdhulp & onderwijs heeft mij gemeld dat zij de gesloten jeugdhulp anders gaan organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Nijboer en Sneller over het uitblijven van resultaten na de aankoop van aandelen van Air France – KLM

MPs asked the Finance Minister about the state's stake in Air France-KLM, IATA board seats, the Franse pilot agreements and KLM dividend policy. The minister answered that IATA matters are for airlines, that the Franco-Dutch talks are ongoing without interim detail, and that KLM's dividend is decided by its supervisory board and priority shareholders.
Besides the fact that Air France-KLM is a listed company, it is also not constructive to share interim information about these talks.
Naast het feit dat Air France-KLM een beursgenoteerde onderneming is, is het ook niet constructief om tussentijds iets te delen over deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over veelvuldig discriminerende makelaars en verhuurders

MP Nijboer asked whether the government finds it unacceptable that agents and landlords discriminate against housing seekers, whether offenders will be prosecuted, and whether licensing for agents and landlords will be introduced. The Minister replied that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide and no complaint is known, that awareness-based and screening measures plus a new study are underway, and that a quality mark and landlord licensing are being piloted without firm dates.
It is not for me but for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether a criminal offence has occurred and to decide whether to prosecute.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of sprake is van een strafbaar feit en te beslissen of tot strafrechtelijke vervolging wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de Regeling Vermindering Verhuurderheffing (RVV) nieuwbouw 2020

An MP asked how much of the €1 billion nieuwbouw heffingsvermindering budget was already claimed, whether the scheme should be expanded, and whether the rental levy should be cut structurally instead of through targeted schemes. The minister replied that applications already exceed the budget, the scheme will be closed from 1 July 2020 while pending applications are honoured, and that a targeted scheme was chosen over a generic levy cut for reasons of focus, while acknowledging a generic cut would be simpler.
Because of the many applications, I have had to decide to close the application option for the nieuwbouw levy reduction as of 1 July.
Vanwege de vele aanvragen heb ik moeten besluiten om per 1 juli de aanvraagmogelijkheid van de heffingsvermindering voor nieuwbouw te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over de glasplaten in het rijkskantoor Rijnstraat 8

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior about dangerous glass panels at the Rijnstraat 8 government building in The Hague, including whether staff and passers-by are safe and why the panels have not all been replaced. The State Secretary replied that a temporary management plan keeps people safe, that TNO found nickel-sulphide inclusions likely caused breakages but no full explanation, and that a decision on permanent replacement will follow on 2 June 2020 with the contractor PoortCentraal held to account.
I have held PoortCentraal to account for its contractual responsibility for a safe and undisturbed building, without additional management measures.
Ik heb PoortCentraal aangesproken op haar contractuele verantwoordelijkheid voor een veilig en ongestoord te gebruiken gebouw, zonder aanvullende beheersmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over de voorwaarden voor steun aan bedrijven

MPs Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether Booking.com's dividends and share buybacks should bar it from state support, whether NOW wage subsidies allow dismissals, what conditions apply to support, and whether it uses tax schemes. The state secretary answered that companies are responsible for their dividends, that support will generally exclude dividends, bonuses and buybacks, and that tax secrecy prevents comment on Booking.com's tax position, while promising further anti-avoidance work.
Due to the statutory tax secrecy obligation, the cabinet cannot make statements about the tax position of an individual taxpayer such as Booking.com.
Door de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige als Booking.com.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanstaande evaluatie Wet doorstroming huurmarkt

An MP asks the minister about reports of rising insecurity among tenants caused by temporary rental contracts, the number of such contracts, their renewal, the absence of a registration duty, and protection against exploitative landlords. The minister answers with CBS monitor figures, notes that temporary contracts are not renewable as a chain, pledges an evaluation of the law before 1 July 2021, and commits to developing a Goed Verhuurderschap approach.
I do not have figures on these cases and cannot say whether, or to what extent, this occurs.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over deze gevallen en ik kan niet zeggen of, en zo ja in welke mate, dit gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de gevolgen van de Kraanwatercrisis voor de Volksgezondheid

An MP from the Labour party asked the minister about lead contamination in tap water in Amsterdam schools and housing, the health risks, compensation, replacement of lead pipes and the standards used. The minister answered that action plans are under way, that landlords must remedy defects and can face rent reductions, and that a report to parliament will follow.

In the cabinet response to the Health Council's advice, the Minister of I&W, on behalf of the Minister for Medical Care and Sport and myself, announced a large number of actions to tackle the lead problem.

In de kabinetsreactie 2 op het advies van de Gezondheidsraad heeft de Minister van I&W, mede namens de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport en mijzelf een groot aantal acties aangekondigd om de loodproblematiek aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden van Van Raan, Alkaya, Van den Hul, Nijboer, Diks en Snels over schending van de OESO-richtlijnen door Pluspetrol

MPs asked the government about an OECD guidelines complaint against Pluspetrol over pollution and indigenous rights in the Peruvian Amazon, the Dutch oil and gas sector's responsible business conduct plan, Tax Authority transparency requirements on financial flows to low-tax jurisdictions, and binding due diligence legislation. The government acknowledged the concerns, said the sector had not published the promised plan and it would reach out again, and described existing tax transparency measures and a study on enforceable due diligence instruments.
The oil and gas sector has not published an action plan. The cabinet cannot establish whether any improvement has taken place.
De olie- en gassector heeft geen plan van aanpak gepubliceerd. Het kabinet kan niet vaststellen of er verbetering heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over 65 miljard euro aan schade door verzakkende huizen

An MP asked the ministers about reported 65 billion euro in damage from sinking houses, cost drivers, owner obligations, financing options, and whether the government is responsible for groundwater levels. The minister answered that costs depend on foundation area, that owners are responsible for their own foundations with some municipal and national support, that the 65 billion figure rests on uncertain assumptions, and that the government is monitoring the problem and informing municipalities.
Almost all factors involved in foundation problems are uncertain.
Bijna alle factoren die een rol spelen bij funderingsproblematiek zijn onzeker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul, Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about measures during the coronavirus crisis across care, education, housing, debt, and the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, while giving substantive answers on mantelzorg communication, eviction restrictions, and utility disconnection protections.
Because there may be obvious reasons for eviction, such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance, the cabinet is not willing to impose a moratorium.
Omdat er evidente redenen kunnen zijn om tot huisuitzetting over te gaan, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast, is het kabinet niet bereid om tot een moratorium over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over Rijkssteun bij overname van Vestia-woningen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked whether the national government would waive transfer tax so that social rental homes held by Vestia could be sold to other housing corporations rather than investors, and what the consequences would be if no sale succeeded. The minister said a sale to non-corporations is not currently on the table, that a new transfer-tax exemption for corporations cannot be reintroduced, and that options within existing exemptions will be explored and reported before summer 2020.

If there is no room within the existing exemptions for a transfer tax exemption, I will examine policy alternatives outside the sphere of transfer tax and inform your House of the outcome around the summer.

Ingeval binnen de bestaande vrijstellingen geen ruimte bestaat voor een vrijstelling van overdrachtsbelasting, dan zal ik beleidsalternatieven buiten de sfeer van de overdrachtsbelasting onderzoeken en rond de zomer aan uw Kamer over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Van der Graaf en Van Nispen over de totstandkoming van de Wet homologatie onderhands akkoord

MPs Nijboer, Van der Graaf and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection how the WHOA bill was prepared, including which documents, consultation inputs and outside-party texts can be shared, and whether ministry contacts with third parties over amendments were improper. The minister answered that the bill's history and consultation reactions are largely available, that outside texts were used through a standard process, and that premature communication about draft amendments with the coalition and Finance occurred due to miscommunication.
This happened as a result of a miscommunication.
Dit gebeurde als gevolg van een miscommunicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale straf voor woningcorporaties

Parliamentary questions from MP Nijboer asked whether the tax treatment of housing corporations (depreciation limits, the ATAD earnings-stripping rule and the lack of a state-aid-compatible exemption) punishes investment in social housing. The State Secretary answered that corporations are taxed like other companies, that they have sufficient funds for now, that the sector's financial capacity will be examined in a study following the Ronnes motion, and that no exemption from the earnings-stripping rule is possible.
Because of their activities under the Services of General Economic Interest (DAEB) assigned to them, housing corporations receive a number of support measures (compensations).
Vanwege hun activiteiten in het kader van de aan hen opgedragen Dienst van Algemeen Economisch Belang (DAEB) ontvangen woningcorporaties een aantal steunmaatregelen (compensaties).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over ‘de economische gevolgen van het coronavirus’

MPs from the PvdA asked the government about the economic effects of the coronavirus, including supply and demand shocks, short-time work, public investment, support for small businesses, and comparisons with Germany and Italy. The government answered that it is monitoring the situation, has announced a noodpakket of support measures (NOW wage subsidy, BMKB loan guarantees, tax deferrals, self-employed support), says a robust forecast is not yet possible, and defers further details to a CPB scenario publication.
The cabinet of course closely monitors economic developments.
Het kabinet houdt de economische ontwikkelingen vanzelfsprekend nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over onbegrijpelijk hoge rekeningen bij blokverwarming

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked about very high bills for communal (block) heating, the Warmtewet's coverage of owner-occupiers and VvE members, the cost of checking heat meters, and how residents can challenge high bills. The minister answered that VvE-supplied heat is now excluded from the Warmtewet, that VvE members have rights under Book 5 BW and access to civil courts, and that the procedure is reasonable.
It is therefore not necessary to open the route to a complaints committee for this.
Het is dus niet nodig om hiervoor de weg naar een geschillencommissie open te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het gebruik van warmtenetten

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the ministers why district heating costs differ from gas heating, what legal and technical barriers exist to disconnecting from heat networks, and related questions on tariff linkage, fixed versus variable costs, and temperature-based pricing. The minister replied that maximum heat tariffs are based on the gas reference so costs are on average equal, that disconnection is governed by the Warmtewet and civil law with some exceptions, and that tariff regulation is being reformed.
In my progress letter on Heat Act 2 I concluded that the current tariff system based on a gas reference is not sustainable in the long term.
In mijn voortgangsbrief over Warmtewet 2 heb ik geconcludeerd dat de huidige tariefsystematiek op basis van een gasreferentie op de lange termijn niet houdbaar is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verhuurders die weigeren gevaarlijk loden leidingen te vervangen

An MP asked the minister about landlords who refuse to replace dangerous lead pipes in rented homes, and why housing corporations still have lead pipes despite a 2005 sanitation commitment. The minister said landlords must act, outlined tenants' remedies through the rent tribunal and courts, noted that a corporation has started replacing pipes, and promised to examine a ban on lead pipes in existing buildings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de Kraanwatercrisis door loden leidingen

MP Nijboer asked the minister whether a urgent investigation into lead pipes in all public buildings, prioritising childcare, schools and hospitals, would be ordered, and what protection tenants and buyers would get given landlords' refusal to replace lead pipes. The minister said municipalities and GGDs should check and replace lead pipes, that tenants and buyers have their own responsibility to investigate, and that a notification duty and a ban on lead pipes in existing buildings are being examined.
I consider it important that for all buildings and dwellings built before 1960 it is established whether lead pipes are still present.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat van alle gebouwen en woningen met een bouwjaar voor 1960 wordt vastgesteld of er nog loden leidingen aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het stoppen met zoutwinning in de Waddenzee

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the advisory committee found the baseline measurements for salt mining in the Wadden Sea insufficient for monitoring, and whether all preparatory activities should stop given the World Heritage status. Minister Wiebes confirmed the committee's finding, rejected stopping preparatory work, and said the revised baseline would be submitted to the audit committee, with no mining allowed until monitoring is in order.
I currently see no reason for further measures.
Ik zie nu geen aanleiding voor verdere maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht dat 23 ouderen hun huis kwijtraken door een commerciële overname

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked about 23 elderly residents losing their homes after a commercial takeover of their care-housing provider, including the inspectorate's assessment of the building and the legality of the tenant stopping rent payments.
