The minister said the inspectorate found the building unfit for 24-hour care, that the courts found stopping rent unjustified, and that residents were relocated, compensated for moving, and given tenancy protections, while declining to judge the complex dispute in detail.
I am therefore reticent in my judgement because I do not wish to intervene in the court's assessment and do not know all the details.
Dit maakt dat ik terughoudend ben in mijn oordeel omdat ik niet wil treden in de beoordeling van de rechter en niet alle details ken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de financiële positie van woningcorporaties hun publieke taak bedreigt

MP Nijboer asks whether the 22% fall in housing corporations' net cash flow, driven by the landlord levy and corporate tax, threatens their public housing task and new-build investment. The minister acknowledges the decline but argues financial ratios remain sufficient, cites about 29 billion euro of additional investment room, and promises research on the motion Ronnes before summer.
Before the summer, the House can expect the results of this research.
Voor de zomer kan de Kamer de resultaten van dit onderzoek verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de harde aanpak van eigen ambtenaren bij de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the state secretary about the Tax Authority's appeal against a court ruling that overturned the dismissal of an employee, and about the broader climate of fear and open culture within the Belastingdienst. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases but acknowledged concerns about openness and announced a leadership and culture programme, dialogue sessions and an external culture study by Deloitte.
I cannot, however, make statements about individual employees or taxpayers, both in my role as employer and in terms of tax matters given the tax confidentiality obligation.
Ik kan echter geen uitspraken doen over individuele medewerkers of belastingplichtigen, zowel vanuit de rol van werkgever als vanuit de fiscaliteit in verband met de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerde huizenkopers in Brielle

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about home buyers in Brielle left unprotected after the failed builder guarantee firm Betaal Garant Nederland, covering municipal help, the bankruptcy curator's claims, consumer information duties under the Wkb, criminal prosecution of its director, and DNB's supervisory response. The Minister answered that the municipality of Brielle is providing support, that the Wkb information duty is being examined, and that DNB handles signals under confidentiality limits, without committing to a mandatory guarantee.
Because of supervisory confidentiality, DNB can only address its handling of signals in general terms.
DNB kan vanwege de toezichtvertrouwelijkheid alleen ingaan op de aanpak van signalen in het algemeen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verzekering van zonnepanelen

PvdA MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether high insurance premiums are hindering solar panel installation, whether the government should intervene if private parties do not solve the insurance problem, and what rules govern fire safety and location choice. Minister Wiebes answered that the effect of premiums is unknown but likely small, that talks with insurers are constructive so no larger government role is planned, that fire safety rules exist and a standards review has started, and that the government supports prioritising rooftops in regional planning.
I have no information on the extent to which the level of insurance premiums hinders the installation of solar panels.
Ik heb geen informatie over in hoeverre de hoogte van verzekeringspremies belemmerend werkt op de aanleg van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de gedwongen huisuitzetting van een familie in Elst

An MP asks the housing minister whether the municipality of Overbetuwe should postpone the forced eviction of a family from an unauthorised dwelling in Elst, given a judge's suggestion to wait for a pending zoning decision, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answers that the municipality is legally bound to enforce, that legalisation is blocked by planning constraints, and that intervening is not appropriate given the municipality's powers and the family's pending legal remedies.

Given the municipality's powers, the outcome of the various legal proceedings and the family's remaining legal remedies against the enforcement order, it does not befit me to intervene in this situation.

Gelet op de bevoegdheden van de gemeente, de geschetste uitkomst van diverse juridische procedures en de nog openstaande rechtsmiddelen van de familie om tegen de last onder bestuursdwang in verweer te komen, past het mij niet in deze situatie te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de vertraging van de wet Versterken

An MP asked why the Versterken (reinforcement) bill for Groningen earthquake-damaged homes was delayed, including the short two-week internet consultation and when it would reach the Council of State. The minister replied that the bill was put to consultation on 6 November, the short period was chosen to speed things up after prior consultation with stakeholders, the bill is expected to go to the Council of State that month, and the timetable depends on close coordination with the region.
The aim is to submit the bill to the Council of State for advice this month.
Het streven is om het wetsvoorstel nog deze maand ter advisering voor te leggen aan de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het schimmeldrama in aardbevingsgebied

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked about mould and damp in social rental homes in the Groningen earthquake area, including Woongroep Marenland's four years of neglected maintenance, timelines for repairs, compensation for tenants, and corporations' communication. The minister apologised via the corporation, outlined planned repairs and a national approach to damp and mould, but offered no direct compensation and pointed tenants to the rent tribunal.
four years of uncertainty and living in a home with mould is not acceptable
vier jaar onzekerheid en leven in een woning met schimmel is niet acceptabel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over Vestia

An MP asked the housing minister about Vestia's financial shortfall and poor housing conditions in Bergeijk, including whether Vestia can renovate and whether tenant interests are protected in a planned sale. The minister answered that maintenance is the corporation's duty, that tenant rights to maintenance and renovation are set out in law, and that a regional transfer process and sector investment study are underway, with reports expected in 2020.
Projects concerning renovations and major maintenance involve individual cases handled by local stakeholders, which I as Minister do not get involved in.
Projecten ten aanzien van renovaties en groot onderhoud betreffen individuele casuïstiek onder de zorg van lokale stakeholders, waar ik als Minister niet in treedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de implementatie van de Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about press reports suggesting the Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen is misunderstood, the municipal role under it, whether municipalities need a preventive risk analysis, who is responsible for checking compliance, and progress on an motion on approved technical solutions. The Minister rejects the misunderstanding claim, explains the division of responsibilities between builder, quality assurer, the toelatingsorganisatie and municipalities, and reports on stakeholder talks about Erkende Technische Toepassingen.
On the basis of this file the municipality can assess the extent to which all statutory requirements have been met.
De gemeente kan op basis van dit dossier beoordelen in hoeverre aan alle wettelijke vereisten is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het schaarstecriterium in de Huisvestingswet

An MP asks the housing minister about court rulings annulling the scarcity criterion underpinning municipal housing ordinances in Rotterdam and Eindhoven, about investor buy-to-let practices, and about what municipalities can do to regulate conversions and tenant protection. The minister defends the scarcity basis as requiring sound justification, says the rulings concern outdated local justifications, notes Rotterdam has adopted a new ordinance and an appeal is pending, and promises the Huisvestingswet evaluation before summer recess.
An appeal has been lodged against the Rotterdam district court ruling of 13 March 2019.
Tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Rotterdam van 13 maart 2019 is hoger beroep ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat 23 ouderen hun huis kwijtraken vanwege een commerciële overname

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked the ministers of Health and Interior about reports that 23 elderly residents of De Keizershof must leave after a commercial takeover, and whether this is acceptable, legally sound, and comparable to the Careyn case. The minister answered that the building was never a care location, the care provider and property owner disputed who pays for adaptations, the rent stopped and the lease was dissolved by court, and that the ministers have contacted the parties to help residents find new housing, committing to no formal structural change.
I find it very unfortunate that these elderly residents have ended up in this situation.
Ik vind het heel vervelend dat deze ouderen in deze situatie terecht zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘KLM moet krimpen ten faveure van Franse piloten’

MPs Nijboer and Paternotte asked the Finance Minister whether a production-balance agreement between Air France, KLM and pilot unions forces KLM to shrink, whether the state as shareholder was informed, and how it will use its stake to prevent agreements against Dutch interests. The minister answered that the agreement is an operational matter for company management, the state has no formal role as shareholder, but it discusses the issue with KLM and will protect the Dutch public interest through its board representation.
Agreements on operational activities, however, are the responsibility of the company's executive management.
Afspraken over de operationele activiteiten zijn echter een verantwoordelijkheid van het uitvoerend bestuur van de onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over discriminatie op de woningmarkt

Two MPs asked the government about ongoing discrimination against housing seekers on the Utrecht housing market, including licensing for estate agents, fines, and ACM or Public Prosecution action. The minister said the problem is not surprising, outlined an approach of awareness, mystery-guest testing and local pilots, but declined new fines or a licensing law for now.
I have no intention of amending the law on this point.
Ik heb geen voornemen de wet op dit onderdeel aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over kredietwaardigheidsonderzoeken

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about creditworthiness checks by credit bureaus, including use of postcode and age data, transparency, and redress. The minister answered that existing GDPR rules and the AP and NVH complaint routes apply, that the government will seek EU-level safeguards for algorithmic decisions, and that no new national rules are announced.
These third parties may only provide this data if a valid legal basis exists, with the necessity of the processing motivated and demonstrated.
Deze derden mogen deze gegevens alleen verstrekken indien hiertoe een geldige grondslag bestaat waarbij de noodzaak van de verwerking wordt gemotiveerd en aangetoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over antikraak-cowboys die weerloze huurders uitbuiten

MP Nijboer asked the minister about anti-squat agencies exploiting vulnerable tenants, including their rights, the Keurmerk Leegstandbeheer complaints committee, rental rules, contract terms and municipal alternatives. The minister replied that the sector has been professionalised through the certification scheme, its complaints committee and a trade association, that residents can go to court or to the committee for a EUR 25 fee, and that temporary rental is preferred.
If an anti-squat resident believes their rights are being violated, they can ask the court for a judgment.
Indien een anti-kraakbewoner van mening is dat zijn of haar rechten worden geschonden, kan een oordeel worden gevraagd aan de rechtbank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de onaangekondigde korting van 3 miljoen op de begroting van Emmen

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked why Emmen was not informed in time of a surprise cut of about 3 million euro to its social assistance budget, and whether the change in allocation key is justified. The state secretary replied that the budget shift reflects annual model updates and labour market changes, that no improper administration occurred, that the municipality can use the safety-net scheme if a shortfall arises, and that no reason to revise the budget is seen.
Of course, the ministry is willing to explain the budget change.
Uiteraard is het ministerie bereid om de budgetmutatie toe te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de aangekondigde ontslagen bij Tata steel

An MP asked the economics minister whether the announced Tata Steel layoffs stem from global overcapacity, the aborted Thyssenkrupp merger, EU anti-dumping policy, and whether the EU should have conditioned merger approval on greener steel, and if consolidation is needed. The minister answered that overcapacity and auto demand are causes, that EU trade defence measures are effective but unilateral restrictions are not a long-term solution, that merger review rules do not normally allow green conditions, and that consolidation is primarily a matter for market parties.
It is primarily up to market parties themselves to decide whether they want to consolidate and to look for suitable partner(s).
Het is primair aan marktpartijen zelf om te bepalen of zij willen consolideren en daarvoor geschikte partner(s) te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het verzekeren van zonnepanelen tegen hagelschade

PvdA MPs asked whether insurers dropping cover for invisible hail damage to solar panels leaves homeowners unprotected, and what the government will do about it. The Minister of Finance answered that some insurers have excluded this risk in their terms, that the share of uninsured owners is unknown, and that the matter is primarily for insurers and the market, with no concrete government action committed.
I consider this primarily a matter between insurers, market parties and owners of solar panels.
Ik beschouw dit primair als een zaak tussen verzekeraars, marktpartijen en eigenaren van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerde huizenkopers in Brielle

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior whether home buyers in Brielle can rely on the guarantee insurer, how they can enforce claims, whether they are adequately informed, and whether a national construction guarantee fund should be created. The Minister explained supervision by DNB and the bankruptcy-claim route, pointed to the upcoming Wet kwaliteitsborging for better information, and declined to set up a mandatory national fund.
Given the duty of confidentiality, DNB does not give insight into possible steps in specific cases while the investigation lasts.
Gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht geeft DNB zolang het onderzoek duurt geen inzicht in mogelijke stappen in specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verhuurders die woningen verhuren aan de hoogste bieder

An MP asked the housing minister about landlords renting homes to the highest bidder and whether this is allowed, whether it exploits housing shortages, and whether rent protection should be extended. The minister referred to earlier answers, said no other cases are known, and pointed to planned housing policy and income-limit changes for social rentals.

As announced in my letter 'State of the Housing Market and overview of measures' of 7 November 2019, I want to safeguard the accessibility, affordability and quality of housing for people with middle incomes or starters on the housing market.

Zoals aangekondigd in mijn brief «Staat van de Woningmarkt en overzicht van maatregelen» van 7 november 2019 wil ik de toegankelijkheid, de betaalbaarheid en kwaliteit van het wonen voor mensen met een middeninkomen of starters op de woningmarkt borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de rechten van consumenten bij fusies en overnames in de financiële sector

An MP asks the Finance Minister what rights consumers have when banks or insurers merge, are taken over, or transfer portfolios, including deposit guarantee, switching costs, poor service and tax consequences. The minister describes existing safeguards (DNB approval, policyholder objection rights, deposit guarantee notice and withdrawal rights, tax-neutral transfers) and declines to commission a new study, while promising continued dialogue with stakeholders.
A further study into strengthening consumer rights in mergers and takeovers is therefore not necessary at this time in my view.
Nader onderzoek naar het versterken van de rechten van consumenten bij fusies en overnames acht ik om die reden op dit moment dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Nijboer over “de uitzending van Radar over ANW-hiaatverzekeringen”

MPs Slootweg and Nijboer asked about a Radar broadcast on ANW survivor-gap insurance that ABN AMRO stopped paying at age 65 despite policy terms tying payments to the AOW age, and about how widespread this is, how UPO and Mijn Pensioenoverzicht display the AOW change, and how to enforce compliance. The minister said ABN AMRO corrected the case and reviewed similar cases, that sector data on policy numbers is insufficient, that supervision by DNB and AFM is risk-based and will act on structural signals, and that complaints go through internal procedures and alternative dispute bodies, while calling on insurers to explain payment durations clearly.
This led ABN AMRO Levensverzekering to acknowledge that this woman was not correctly informed and ABN AMRO Levensverzekeringen has remedied this.
Dit heeft ertoe geleid dat ABN AMRO Levensverzekering heeft erkend dat deze mevrouw niet correct is voorgelicht en ABN AMRO Levensverzekeringen dit heeft hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over financiële overschotten op de Najaarsnota

Two PvdA MPs asked why a fiscal surplus of nearly 14 billion euros in mid-2019 coexists with shortages in police, healthcare and education, and whether part of it will be spent on those sectors or underspending moved to later years. The Finance Minister replied that the 2019 surplus is largely incidental, that the government has added billions structurally to these sectors, that some underspending will go to priorities such as education and undermining crime, and that underspent investment budgets were shifted to 2022-2024 via a ceiling correction.
The cabinet has now decided to spend part of the 2019 underspending on social priorities such as education, undermining crime, the nitrogen problem, legal aid, and safety and protection.

Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om een deel van de onderuitputting van 2019 uit te geven aan maatschappelijke prioriteiten als onderwijs, ondermijning, de stikstofproblematiek, de rechtsbijstand en veiligheid en beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Een derde kinderen leeft in ongezond huis’

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior about a report finding that a third of children live in unhealthy homes, including whether landlords should be obliged to keep homes healthy, whether building rules will change, and why tenants report more mould. The Minister acknowledged the concern, described the existing landlord-tenant division of repair duties and tenant remedies (rent reduction, court orders, municipal enforcement), pointed to existing health rules in the Building Decree, and promised a faster local mould approach and more information on healthy living.
I want to accelerate the approach and I am focusing on the local approach in those G4 and G40 municipalities where tenants say mould occurs most often.
Ik wil een versnelling in de aanpak en richt mij daarbij op de lokale aanpak in die G4 en G40 gemeenten waar vocht en schimmel volgens huurders het vaakst voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘McKinsey: kaalslag dreigt onder banken bij nieuwe crisis’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a McKinsey report warning of bank consolidation and weakness in Western Europe, and whether Dutch banks are prepared for a new crisis and whether buffers should be raised. The minister disputed the framing, said Dutch banks are better prepared through higher capital and leverage requirements, and said consolidation is primarily a matter for banks, with supervisors able to act on concrete risks.

It is first and foremost up to the banks themselves to explore for their own organisations the pros and cons and the possibilities for mergers and acquisitions, and to weigh opportunities against risks.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan banken zelf om voor hun eigen organisaties de voor- en nadelen en de mogelijkheden voor fusies en overnames te verkennen en kansen en risico’s tegen elkaar af te wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over vervuild drinkwater door loden waterleidingen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether lead water pipes in homes, which can harm unborn and young children, will be replaced, and what measures and cost coverage are planned. The minister answered that numbers are unknown, that owners are responsible for removal, that a mandatory disclosure at rental or purchase and information campaigns are being considered, and that a ban on renting such homes is not needed because the Huurcommissie and courts can enforce repair.
I will also look at how an active disclosure of possible lead pipes when entering a rental or purchase agreement can be made mandatory.
Ik ga ook kijken hoe een actieve melding over de eventuele aanwezigheid van loden leidingen bij het aangaan van een huur- of koopovereenkomst verplicht gesteld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het versterken van woningen in Groningen

MP Nijboer asks why residents of Loppersum were promised reinforcement of their homes that has not been carried out, why the HRA risk model yields so few high-risk addresses, and how many acute unsafe situations have occurred. The minister answers that no binding promise was made, that a sample check of normal-risk addresses is ongoing, that the scope remains about 26,000 addresses, and that acute unsafe situation reports are handled within 48 hours.
Once there is clarity on what this will mean for the actual reinforcement, the cabinet will inform the residents and your House.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over wat dit voor de daadwerkelijke versterking zal gaan betekenen, zal het kabinet de bewoners en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het toenemend aantal economisch daklozen in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the rising number of economically homeless people in the Netherlands, whether the state will act, and whether the state is failing its constitutional duty to provide housing. The minister answered that the number is not tracked, cited a CBS figure of 39,300 homeless in 2018, pointed to existing housing measures and municipal responsibility, and said a plan to reduce homelessness would come in autumn.
The number of economically homeless people in the Netherlands is not tracked.
Het aantal economisch daklozen in Nederland wordt niet in kaart gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over de verdubbeling van het aantal daklozen

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about the reported doubling of the number of homeless people in the Netherlands, including the state's duty to provide housing, the causes, the adequacy of social assistance, shelter capacity and broader societal effects. The state secretary answered that housing and health are constitutional social rights shared with municipalities and housing corporations, that the government will present an additional plan this autumn, and that CBS research on the rise is pending.
That is why the Cabinet, together with other (local) parties, will come this autumn with an additional plan to significantly reduce the number of homeless people in the coming years.
Daarom komt het Kabinet dit najaar samen met andere (lokale) partijen met een aanvullend plan om het aantal dak- en thuislozen de komende jaren fors terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over beleggers die het onmogelijk maken voor starters om een huis te kopen

MPs Asscher and Nijboer asked whether investors pushing up house prices make it impossible for first-time buyers to buy, and what the government will do about buy-to-let investors, owner-occupancy obligations and rent increases. The minister answered that a price effect is suggested but causality is not shown, that the government is exploring a differentiated transfer tax and box 3 changes, and that rent measures will be decided later in the autumn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerde huizenkopers in Brielle

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about home buyers in Brielle who face costs of construction defects after the builder went bankrupt, and asked what rights, remedies and guarantee schemes exist. The minister said the municipality supports buyers with an interest-free loan and urges collective action, outlined existing rights and guarantees, and said the upcoming Wet kwaliteitsborging will strengthen consumer protection, while stating that no separate guarantee fund is planned.
Precise figures are not known to me because I am not a party involved in this.
Precieze aantallen zijn mij niet bekend omdat ik hierbij geen betrokken partij ben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het onterecht stoppen van huurtoeslag aan statushouders

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked why housing allowance is stopped and reclaimed for statushouder families when a baby is born, and asked for compensation and a fix. The government answers that the allowance is restored retroactively once the child's residence permit is granted, that the problem stems from legal eligibility requirements rather than automatic database linking, and promises to examine options with other ministers and report in spring 2020.
Even in the case of an initially late application for a residence permit, there is ultimately no loss of housing allowance.
Zelfs bij een in eerste instantie te late aanvraag van een verblijfstitel is er dus uiteindelijk geen verlies aan huurtoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het artikel 'Minister Wiebes over compensatie NAM: "Voelt heel verkeerd, maar moet wel"'

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister why a provisional 90 million euro payment to Shell and ExxonMobil over Groningen gas production cuts is justified, on what legal basis, and why these companies should be compensated given harm to Groningers. The minister answers that the payment secures gas storage at Norg for an accelerated Groningen phase-out, that the amount is not final, that legal advice was taken but offered only in a confidential briefing, and that he will keep the House informed.
I am willing to inform the House further in a confidential briefing.
Ik ben graag bereid om uw Kamer nader te informeren in een vertrouwelijke briefing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de stijgende kosten van taxaties

An MP asked the Interior and Finance Ministers whether draft EBA guidelines requiring physical appraisals, and rising appraisal costs, are acceptable given house prices. The Minister answered that quality appraisals matter, that model valuations (about 30 euro versus 400-500 euro for physical ones) are a good alternative when used responsibly, and that it is too early to judge consumer cost effects.
I previously informed the House that I see model-based valuation, when used responsibly, as a good alternative to a physical appraisal.
Ik heb eerder aan uw Kamer gemeld dat ik modelmatig waarderen bij verantwoord gebruik zie als een goed alternatief voor een fysieke taxatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de stijgende lasten voor woningcorporaties

An MP asked the Interior and Finance ministers whether the rising levy on housing associations (verhuurderheffing) and the ATAD tax rules are shrinking their investment capacity and new affordable construction, and whether the government will compensate them. The minister answered that the levy rise is mainly from WOZ-value growth and an earlier higher revenue estimate, that the 100 million euro rate cut offsets the burden, that associations' planned investments have risen, and that a 100 million euro annual reduction for building in shortage areas was announced.
There is no reason to assume that the lower new-build figures were caused by a shortage of investment capacity in the short and medium term as a result of the landlord levy.
Er is geen reden om aan te nemen dat de lagere nieuwbouwcijfers zijn ingegeven door een tekort aan investeringskracht op de korte en middellange termijn als gevolg van de verhuurderheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het afbranden van monument Haarendael

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about a fire that destroyed the listed Haarendael estate, including its cause, whether the owner failed to protect it, and whether long-term neglect of maintenance is acceptable. The minister answered that the cause is still under investigation, that the owner had no effective protective measures and the building was left vacant, and that she agrees long-term neglect of monuments is undesirable and promotes regular maintenance.
Technical investigation into the cause of the fire is still being carried out.
Technisch onderzoek naar de oorzaak van de brand wordt nog uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de race naar de bodem van beveiligers op Schiphol

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether Schiphol's security tender, split among seven companies and excluding the sector CAO, risks a race to the bottom on security guards' pay and whether the state as shareholder should intervene. The minister replied that Schiphol's management is responsible for operations and labour conditions, that he will not pressure Schiphol, and gave Schiphol's reasons for multiple contractors and quality-based awarding.
It is not for me to call Schiphol to account on this.
Het is niet aan mij om Schiphol hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevaarlijke situatie na spontaan springen van ramen bij ministeries Rijnstraat 8

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked about window breakages at the Rijnstraat 8 government building, the safety risks, costs, and whether the building is fit for purpose. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies with the contractor PoortCentraal, that wind-speed closures and inspections were introduced, that a root-cause study is pending, and that costs to the state are about 600,000 euro.
Your House has not been separately informed.
Uw Kamer is niet separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verboden bemiddelingskosten die Utrechtse pandjesbazen reken

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior why Utrecht rental intermediaries keep charging prohibited brokerage fees, whether fines should apply to repeat offending landlords, and what legal barriers prevent municipalities from introducing landlord licensing. The minister says the ban is clear, cooperates with the ACM against malicious intermediaries without guaranteeing an end to such fees, points to Groningen's existing municipal powers, and commits to report on a motion on licensing risks this autumn.
However, I cannot guarantee that intermediaries will never again charge unjustified brokerage fees.
Ik kan echter niet garanderen dat bemiddelaars nooit meer onterechte bemiddelingskosten in rekening (blijven) brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over negatieve rentes voor particulieren

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether he is concerned that Dutch banks might impose negative interest rates on savings accounts, whether this would harm trust and access to bank accounts, what risks cash hoarding and a run on cash would pose, how this fits with cash payment limits, which banks are considering it, whether a legal ban is possible, and whether he will coordinate with Germany and EU finance ministers. The minister replies that negative rates on household deposits are not currently applied, that a hard ban is a far-reaching market intervention with drawbacks, that he will monitor developments and talk to banks, that the box 3 regime will be adjusted, and that he will raise the issue with European counterparts if Germany's legal study produces results.
A hard ban on negative interest rates is, however, a very far-reaching intervention in the market, which also has drawbacks.
Een hard verbod op negatieve rente is echter een zeer forse ingreep in de markt, die ook nadelen kent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerde huurders in Honselersdijk

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about tenants of Vestia in Honselersdijk affected by renovation works, including communication, temporary housing, permits, safety and compensation. The minister explained the tenants' rights and duties under tenancy law and the Overlegwet, declined to act on the ongoing case, and pointed to the Huurcommissie and courts for rent reduction.
It therefore does not fit my role as system steward to address the municipality of Westland or Vestia about an ongoing case concerning the treatment of tenants.
Het past derhalve niet in mijn rol van stelselverantwoordelijke om de gemeente Westland of Vestia aan te spreken op een lopende zaak omtrent de behandeling van huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de mogelijkheden tot verruiming van de inkomensgrens voor sociale huur

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the Dutch government itself proposed the EUR 33,000 income limit for social rental housing, and whether the income limit could be raised or the single-person limit lowered in line with EU state-aid rules. The minister answered that the Netherlands could propose but the Commission had to approve, that the EUR 33,000 cap was agreed with the Commission in 2009, and announced plans for a bill raising the limit for larger households and lowering it for single-person households.
This measure was discussed with the EC and agreed in consultation with your House.
Deze maatregel is met de EC besproken en in overleg met uw Kamer overeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat kleine gasvelden in Noord-Nederland versneld worden leeggehaald

An MP asked the minister whether small Northern Dutch gas fields are being depleted faster than agreed, whether old wells are being reused, and what the risks are, given the Groningen earthquake experience. The minister denied faster extraction, said SodM supervises compliance with production plans and permits, dismissed claims of greater seismic risk, and declined to halt extraction.
No, the assumption that the small gas fields are being depleted faster and that more is being extracted than agreed is incorrect.
Nee, de veronderstelling dat de kleine gasvelden sneller worden leeggehaald en dat er meer wordt gewonnen dan afgesproken, klopt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over extra kapitaal voor TenneT voor investeringen in het Duitse netwerk

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether TenneT's raised investment outlook of 35 billion euro, of which 23 billion is for the German grid, and talks with German parties or a stock listing, were correct, and whether the state should take a stance. The minister confirmed the figures, said capital needs arise from the energy transition and German obligations, and said the government will explore options such as a state capital injection, partial sale or cooperation with Germany while ruling out a stock listing as unlikely.
Guided by the above conditions and objectives, the cabinet will over the coming months develop various options for the capital requirement and examine whether these options are feasible in practice.

Met als leidraad de bovenstaande randvoorwaarden en doelstellingen zal het kabinet de komende maanden verschillende opties voor de kapitaalbehoefte uitwerken en onderzoeken of deze opties in de praktijk ook realiseerbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over huurverhogingen in aardbevingsgebied 2.0

Two MPs asked whether a housing corporation's rent increases for tenants in a Groningen earthquake-risk complex, which was flagged as elevated risk, were justified, and what tenants could do. The minister answered that the increase was regular, that reinforcement assessments are handled by the National Coordinator Groningen, that tenants can object to the Rent Tribunal, and that she is not party to the dispute and will not reverse it.
I am not a party to this matter and it is not for me to reverse the rent increase.
Ik ben geen partij in deze kwestie en het is niet aan mij om de huurverhoging ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de lijst met onveilige gebouwen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Groningen list of unsafe buildings accounts for renovations and whether the Hazard and Risk Assessment model is reliable, given that it relies on assumptions and is run by the NAM. The minister acknowledges renovations are included, defends the HRA as an internationally recognised prioritisation tool verified by SodM, TNO and the Raad van State, and promises public management of the model and a TNO verification tool.
However, I consider it important that the HRA model comes under public management as soon as possible.
Wel acht ik het van belang dat het HRA model zo snel mogelijk in publiek beheer komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over mijnbouwactiviteiten in het waddengebied

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the government shares concerns about mining in the Wadden Sea World Heritage area, whether UNESCO's letter signals concern, and whether a moratorium on new mining is needed. Minister Wiebes replied that strict conditions, monitoring and an independent audit committee apply, that UNESCO's letter is a standard procedural request, and that no moratorium is considered necessary.
Nederland expects to send the reply letter to UNESCO in September 2019. The Minister of LNV will inform your House about this.
Naar verwachting zal Nederland de antwoordbrief aan UNESCO in september 2019 versturen. Uw Kamer zal hierover door de Minister van LNV worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over brandveiligheid in seniorenwoningen

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about fire safety in senior housing complexes after a news report on evacuation risks, asking about past signals, measures on smoke spread and escape route length, and whether existing rules fall short. The minister answered that stricter fire safety requirements for residential buildings are planned, with TNO research and a draft amendment to the Besluit bouwwerken leefomgeving to follow, and that municipalities can already impose new-build standards on existing complexes but the minister is still considering how to encourage this.
In this letter I report that I intend to tighten the fire safety requirements for residential buildings.
Ik meld in deze brief dat ik voornemens ben om de brandveiligheidseisen voor woongebouwen aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over een onderzoek naar de veiligheid van constructies in publieke gebouwen

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked whether public buildings are regularly checked for structural safety, why wind loads are not studied, and how the findings of the 2016 football stadium safety audit were followed up. The minister replied that building owners and municipalities are responsible, that no mandatory periodic inspection exists, that targeted inspection duties are used for specific building types, and that the stadium audit was discussed with clubs and municipalities without new specific standards.
At this moment it is still unclear what caused the collapse of the roof of the AZ stadium.
Op dit moment is nog onduidelijk wat de oorzaak is geweest van het instorten van het dak van het AZ-stadion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Uber een belastingvoordeel van miljarden heeft gecreëerd in Nederland

MPs Nijboer (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Uber created a multi-billion-euro tax deduction in the Netherlands by moving intellectual property from Bermuda, and whether the tax ruling and the relocation were lawful and fair. The State Secretary answered that under the general confidentiality rule of Article 67 AWR he cannot discuss the position of an individual taxpayer, explained the general rules, and listed existing anti-avoidance measures and a commission on multinational taxation.
Under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR) I cannot go into the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de libra

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about Facebook's planned Libra digital currency, including its workings, which supervisors apply, data use, consumer protection, systemic risks and whether an analysis would be sent by September 2019. Minister Hoekstra answered that little is known yet, that supervisors will be consulted and DNB is studying digital central bank money, but he cannot promise a September analysis.
I therefore cannot promise to inform the House further about Libra by September.
Ik kan u daarom niet toezeggen om voor september de Kamer verder te informeren over de Libra.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over de grote klappen voor de werkgelegenheid in Groningen

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the ministers about reported job losses in Groningen (about 180 jobs at the RUG) and healthcare access caused by the revised higher-education funding model. The minister answered that there is no forced internal reallocation, that RUG funding changes are small (0.0% in 2020-2021, -1.1% in 2022, -0.9% in 2023), that healthcare access is unaffected, and that the government is committed to Groningen's employment and liveability.
It is the responsibility of the institution's board to allocate the government contribution internally.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de instelling om de rijksbijdrage intern te verdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de middenklasse die geen huis meer kan kopen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the middle-income group can still afford a home, the consequences of housing scarcity, and measures to stabilise rents and prices. The Minister denied that middle-income housing costs have risen (WoOn2018 shows stable quotes), acknowledged regional shortages, and listed building targets, allocation measures and promised follow-up letters and studies.
I will examine together with municipalities and market parties whether there is room to better target the design of the emergency lever toward the problems experienced.
Ik zal samen met gemeenten en marktpartijen onderzoeken of er ruimte is om de uitwerking van de noodknop nog beter te richten op de ervaren problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Nijboer over het sluiten van bankrekeningen van Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen

MPs Ploumen and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether banks are increasingly closing accounts of Dutch citizens living abroad, why, and whether additional rules apply. The minister confirmed the trend, said banks set their own client strategy and risk profile within existing law, and committed to consulting banks on access to services for Dutch citizens abroad.
I will consult with banks to discuss developments regarding access for Dutch citizens abroad to banking services.
Ik zal in overleg treden met banken om te spreken over de ontwikkelingen rond de toegang van Nederlanders in het buitenland tot dienstverlening van banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over mogelijkheden tot verruiming van de inkomensgrenzen voor sociale huur

An MP asks whether income limits for social housing should be widened, how many people fall between social and private rental, and how other EU states define social housing targets under EU state-aid rules. The minister answers that the EU Commission only checks for manifest errors, that the Dutch income limit was agreed with Brussels, and that a differentiated income limit is being explored while the government commits to a broader housing package and a later overview of other member states.
On how these member states have shaped this demarcation, I will inform you further.
Over de wijze hoe deze lidstaten deze afbakening hebben vormgegeven zal ik u nader informeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Van den Hul over Nederlandse verzekeraars die meer kunnen doen om medicijnen betaalbaar te maken

Three PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch insurers such as Aegon and Allianz, which invest heavily in pharmaceutical firms, should press those firms on medicine prices, tax payment and the Access to Medicine Index investor pledge. The minister answered that insurers are responsible for their own investment policy, pointed to existing IMVO covenant commitments and the OECD guidelines, encouraged signing the pledge, and saw no reason for further measures on transparency.
Institutional investors, including insurers, are responsible for their own investment policy and decide themselves in which companies to invest.
Institutionele beleggers, waaronder verzekeraars, zijn verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen beleggingsbeleid en bepalen zelf in welke bedrijven belegd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat ING betaalgegevens gebruikt voor persoonlijke reclame

An MP asked the Finance Minister about ING's plan to use payment transaction data for personalised advertising, whether this complies with the GDPR and PSD2, and whether opt-out defaults are acceptable. The minister answered that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is the competent supervisor and has already requested justification from ING, referred to its published guidance, and declined to give substantive views on the bank's balancing or on opt-in defaults.
It is therefore not for me, but in the first instance for the AP (and ultimately possibly the judge), to determine whether ING's practice complies with privacy legislation.
Het is dan ook niet aan mij, maar in eerste instantie aan de AP (en uiteindelijk eventueel de rechter) om te bepalen of de werkwijze van ING in overeenstemming is met de privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Mitros bouwafspraken niet nakomt

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Mitros, a housing corporation, should halt sales of social rental homes after failing to meet agreed construction targets, and why its sale prices and conditions are above WOZ value. The minister replied that local parties set performance agreements and judge their implementation, that sales rules apply (offer first to sitting tenants for regulated homes), and that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties checks compliance.
It is a matter for those parties how they assess the implementation of mutually agreed performance agreements.
Het is een aangelegenheid van die partijen hoe zij de uitvoering van onderling gemaakte prestatieafspraken beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over de belastbaarheid van de premiebijdrage aan Gemeentepolis

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked whether the Tax Authority's plan to tax the part of the municipal Gemeentepolis premium covering the statutory deductible is legally justified and whether it is undesirable. The government replied that, after consultation between departments, taxing that part will not arise, and the social affairs ministry will inform municipalities.
After consultation between the departments concerned, it has been established that taxing the said part of the municipal contribution will not arise.
Na overleg tussen de betrokken departementen is vastgesteld dat het belasten van voornoemd deel van de gemeentelijke bijdrage niet aan de orde zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over afschaffing van het 500 euro biljet

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the 500-euro note, which is rarely used for payments but common in criminal money flows, should be abolished, and about its circulation outside the eurozone. The minister answers that the government will push via DNB for an end date at the ECB and raise acceptance limits in the MOB, noting that the ECB stopped issuing the note in 2019 and that its legal tender status is set in EU law.
As also announced in the anti-money-laundering action plan sent to the House today, Minister Grapperhaus and I will work to abolish the 500-euro note.
Zoals ook aangekondigd in het plan van aanpak witwassen dat vandaag naar de Tweede Kamer is verzonden, gaan Minister Grapperhaus en ik ons inzetten voor het afschaffen van het 500 eurobiljet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Beleggers kopen Groningen op’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about reports that investors are buying up Groningen, squeezing starters and social renters, and proposes measures such as higher transfer tax for investors and rent caps. The Minister acknowledges housing shortages and the rise of private rentals, promises further research on investor price effects, a 'noodknop' for middle-segment rents, and a review of transfer tax differentiation, but rejects the proposed rent freeze and cap as impractical.
Before the summer I will inform the House about the further elaboration of the emergency button.
Voor de zomer informeer ik uw Kamer over de verdere uitwerking van de noodknop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Mitroshuurders vrezen extreme huurverhoging'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that Mitros tenants fear extreme rent increases after 21 social rental homes in Utrecht were sold to a commercial buyer, and about the adequacy of tenant information, the Autoriteit woningcorporaties' approval, and local agreements. The minister answered that the Aw approved the sale under the legal procedure after positive opinions from the municipality and tenant organisation, that tenants were informed in time, and that housing allocation and distribution are a matter for local parties.
The Aw states that both the municipality of Utrecht and the tenant organisation gave a positive opinion on the proposed sales.
De Aw geeft aan dat zowel de gemeente Utrecht als de huurdersorganisatie een positieve zienswijze op de voorgenomen verkopen hebben gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat woningcorporaties hoge tarieven rekenen voor inschrijvingen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about housing corporations charging high registration fees for social rental housing, and whether waiting-time portability and a national search system could help. The minister acknowledged rising waiting times, defended registration fees as cost recovery, provided a fee table per region, and said that portability and a unified system are for corporations and municipalities to pursue, with the government supporting exploration.
I do not have information on waiting times per housing corporation.
Ik beschik niet over informatie van wachttijden per corporatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over te dure huurwoningen voor zorgcliënten in Zwolle

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked whether the government knows of care clients forced to move because their rent is too high for their income in Zwolle, and whether rent for care housing is monitored. The minister replied that she had no such signals, explained the tenancy protection rules for care housing, said rent is not monitored against client income, and will await the municipality's study before considering further steps.
No, rent is not supervised in relation to the income of tenants (who may also be care clients).
Nee, op huurprijzen wordt geen toezicht gehouden in relatie tot het inkomen van huurders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Huurders betalen hoge prijs in overspannen vrije sector’

An MP asks whether landlords in the liberalised rental sector exploit scarcity through neglected maintenance, high rents and service charges, and whether tenants should get Huurcommissie access and better protection. The minister says landlords may not charge maintenance costs, describes Goed Verhuurderschap and woondeals, and says the Huurcommissie advice route is being promoted but full access for liberalised tenants is not granted.

Regarding rent protection there is a distinction. Whereas for regulated tenancies all procedures under the Rent Price Implementation Act are possible before the Huurcommissie, this is not the case for liberalised tenancies.

Ten aanzien van de huurprijsbescherming is er wel een onderscheid. Daar waar bij de gereguleerde huurovereenkomsten alle procedures op basis van de Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte bij de Huurcommissie mogelijk zijn, is dit bij de geliberaliseerde huurovereenkomsten niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Nu al record aan woningbeleggingen in 2019'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a report that housing investment reached a record in 2019, including the rising share of international investors, their effect on prices and affordability, and why housing corporations invest less in new construction. The minister acknowledged the trend, noted risks from excessive rents, said she is developing an emergency brake on excessive rents and studying price effects, and outlined measures such as simplified market testing and differentiated income limits for corporation housing.
I am therefore working hard to counter investors who behave excessively.
Ik werk er dan ook hard aan om de beleggers die zich excessief gedragen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over het bericht dat de doorstroming vanuit de vrouwenopvang naar huurwoningen problematisch verloopt

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked about reports that women leaving shelters struggle to move into rental housing, and about the Ombudsman's findings on shelter bottlenecks and clawed-back rent allowance. The Minister acknowledges local housing shortages, points to existing priority rules for shelter residents and to ongoing working groups and a commitment to inform parliament, while stating there is no national picture of shelter place shortages and that municipalities are responsible.
There is no national picture of the (possible) shortages of shelter places in women's shelters.
Er is geen landelijk beeld van de (eventuele) tekorten aan opvangplekken in de vrouwenopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over blazers van ESD

MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring 'blazers' (emission flares) at the ESD factory in Groningen, including carcinogenic particle emissions, public health risks, unclear public information, and what will be done to reduce blazers and stop illegal emissions. The government answered that the province of Groningen, as competent authority, is responsible for enforcement, that health risks from SiC fibres are still under investigation, that a dwangsom (penalty) was imposed for SiC emissions, and that communication was handled by the Veiligheidsregio and municipality.
In this case, the province of Groningen is responsible for enforcement as the competent authority.
In dit geval is de provincie Groningen als bevoegd gezag verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat gemeenten bouwplannen frustreren

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are frustrating housing construction, whether a shortage of building officials explains lagging output, and what measures will reach the 75,000 homes per year target and protect affordable rental housing. The minister acknowledged capacity constraints at municipalities, pointed to the expert team and Crisis- and herstelwet, said 2018 output came close to the target, and promised to inform parliament before summer about an emergency measure on excessive rent increases.
That is why I am working on developing an emergency measure to curb excessive rent increases. I will inform you about this before the summer.
Daarom ben ik bezig met de uitwerking van de noodknop om excessieve huurstijgingen tegen te gaan. Hierover zal ik u voor de zomer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over blazers van ESD

MPs asked about a RIVM advice on silicon carbide fibres and emissions from ESD-SIC near Farsum, and whether a risk limit for air will be set quickly. The state secretary confirmed SiC fibres should be treated as carcinogenic (ZZS), said the company and province must minimise emissions, and explained that RIVM found too little data for an air limit, so amphibole asbestos is used as a worst-case screening value, with a full standard depending on further information and a timeline not given.
RIVM indicated in its advice that there is currently too little data to derive an MTR for SiC fibres.
Het RIVM heeft in haar advies aangegeven dat er op dit moment te weinig gegevens zijn om een MTR voor SiC-vezels af te kunnen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de jeugdzorginstelling Elker – het Poortje

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the minister about budget cuts and job losses at youth care provider Elker – het Poortje in Groningen and Drenthe, and the risks for suicidal and vulnerable youths. The minister answered that a mediation process is ongoing under the support team OZJ, that municipalities hold the youth care duty, and that the Jeugdautoriteit and a dispute committee exist, with a 20 million euro liquidity facility, but gave no concrete rescue plan or contingency document.
Municipalities are responsible for youth care and have a youth care duty.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp en hebben een jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de brandbrief van de Raad van Toezicht van jeugdzorginstelling Elker – het Poortje

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the minister about the board of Elker – het Poortje's warning that youth care institutions can no longer provide good care, and about financial shortfalls and lack of coordination in the youth care transition. The minister acknowledged the signals, pointed to a mediation track with regional bodies, extra municipal funding and the Jeugdautoriteit, but did not commit to a new concrete intervention beyond monitoring.
It is a worrying signal and it has my explicit attention.
Het is een zorgelijk signaal en het heeft nadrukkelijk mijn aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over betere samenwerking tussen banken in de strijd tegen witwassen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about bank customer due diligence against money laundering, whether banks must check prior banks for new clients, and whether they may share information on suspected launderers, plus the idea of a blacklist for convicted launderers. The minister explained the Wwft duties, said banks may share limited transaction information but not account or mortgage data, and said a review of data sharing and a register of high-risk clients is underway, with results in a plan of action.

I am examining not only the legal (im)possibilities and the added value for the effectiveness of customer due diligence and transaction monitoring, but also the proportionality and desirability of the information exchange.

Ik onderzoek niet alleen de juridische (on)mogelijkheden en de toegevoegde waarde voor de effectiviteit van het cliëntenonderzoek en de transactiemonitoring, maar ook de proportionaliteit en wenselijkheid van de informatie-uitwisseling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de nieuwe versterkingsaanpak

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the new reinforcement approach for earthquake-damaged buildings in Groningen, including governance, the role of NAM and CVW, and resident influence. The Minister defended the Besluit versterken gebouwen Groningen, stating the owner keeps the final say, municipalities gain material client role, and NAM is removed from steering, while acknowledging ongoing concerns and committing to monitor and possibly amend the rules.
The decision gives substance to the joint agreements of the central government and regional authorities on carrying out the reinforcement, and thereby provides clarity to the people of Groningen.
Het besluit geeft invulling aan de gezamenlijke afspraken van het Rijk en regionale overheden voor de uitvoering van de versterking en daarmee duidelijkheid aan de Groningers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Smeulders over gevolgen van de saneringsopdracht van corporatie Vestia voor huurders in Bergeijk

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about negative effects of Vestia's remediation plan on tenants in Bergeijk, including maintenance backlogs, poor communication, reduction of social rental stock, and the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties' approval of commercial-branch separation. The Minister answered that operational maintenance is the corporation's responsibility with complaints to the Huurcommissie, that monitoring by WSW and the Aw finds no large-scale backlog, that sale of Vestia homes must be at market value, that a bestuurlijk regisseur has been appointed with advice expected mid-2019, and that financial recovery is weighed alongside housing interests.
The operational activities of a housing corporation fall under the responsibility of the corporation itself.
De operationele activiteiten van een corporatie vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de corporatie zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurprijzen die de pan uit rijzen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the minister whether she would freeze or cap rent increases in the free rental sector after reports of sharp rises, and why earlier amendments were rejected. The minister agreed rents are a concern but said freezing existing contracts is unworkable and that she is developing a targeted 'noodknop' for the middle-rent segment, to be presented before summer.
I am working on developing the emergency button to tackle excesses and am focusing on the middle-rent segment.
Ik ben bezig met de uitwerking van de noodknop om excessen aan te pakken en richt mij daarop op het middenhuursegment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het Scandinavische duale stelsel voor het belasten van directeur-grootaandeelhouders (dga’s)

Labour MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Scandinavian dual income tax model for owner-managers (DGA), including whether a fixed return on capital would be simpler and fairer and whether the model could be studied for the Netherlands. The State Secretary explained how dual taxation works, noted that the DGA has incentives to set the salary low and to defer tax, and committed to studying the Scandinavian approach in the tax-reform building-blocks trajectory due early 2020.
The research should ultimately lead to policy options within the current system, but reforms that go beyond the current box structure will also be examined.
Het onderzoek moet uiteindelijke leiden tot beleidsopties binnen het huidige stelsel, maar er zal ook gekeken worden naar hervormingen die de huidige boxenstructuur overstijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over drempels bij het gebruik van de blijverslening

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked why the Blijverslening, a municipal loan for home adaptations for older residents, has been granted only 75 times since 2015, and what conditions and awareness exist. The minister confirmed the figure, attributed low uptake to limited awareness and reluctance to plan future housing needs, and said municipalities decide whether to offer the loan and on what terms, promising continued support and awareness campaigns without a new binding step.
It is up to municipalities and provinces themselves to determine to what extent the set conditions sufficiently match local needs and policy objectives.
Het is aan gemeenten en provincies zelf om te bepalen in hoeverre de gestelde voorwaarden voldoende aansluiten op de lokale behoefte en beleidsdoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Spaargeld in de zak van de bank: ‘Ik voel mij zwaar belazerd door ABN AMRO’’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Radar report on ABN AMRO's Meegroeihypotheek, where a customer's savings could be lost on death and the risk was not disclosed, and asked whether consumers are adequately informed and whether the AFM should investigate. The minister said the product is no longer sold by ABN AMRO, pointed to the complaints route via Kifid and courts, noted the AFM sets its own priorities, and saw no reason for further action.

On a risk-oriented basis, for example based on consumer complaints or advertising by mortgage providers and insurers, the Netherlands Authority for the Financial Markets as an independent supervisor determines its own supervisory priorities.

Op basis van een risicogeoriënteerde inzet, bijvoorbeeld op basis van meldingen van consumenten of reclame-uitingen van hypotheekaanbieders en verzekeraars, bepaalt de Autoriteit Financiële Markten als onafhankelijk toezichthouder haar eigen toezichtprioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over hinderlijke regelgeving voor de uitrol van zonnepanelen door woningbouwcorporaties

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Woningwet rules that restrict housing corporations from installing solar panels and feeding surplus energy into the grid hinder sustainability goals, and whether corporations should get SDE+ subsidy. The minister confirmed the current limits, said corporations are eligible for SDE+ if they meet conditions, and committed to amend the Woningwet after the evaluation to allow more sustainability measures.
I intend to include these adjustments in the legislative amendments following the evaluation of the revised Housing Act.
Ik ben voornemens om deze aanpassingen mee te nemen in de wetswijzigingen naar aanleiding van de evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet opnemen van een bouwtechnische keuring in het koopcontract

An MP asked why a building inspection clause was absent from most home purchase contracts despite a standard model clause introduced in 2018, and whether buyers are discouraged from inspections in the overheated housing market. The minister replied that the model clause makes disclosure mandatory but not inspection itself, that research found no evidence buyers forgo inspections under market pressure, and that no further measures are planned.
That research showed no evidence that buyers in a tight housing market more often forgo a contingency clause in the purchase contract.
Daaruit is niet gebleken dat kopers in een gespannen woningmarkt vaker afzien van een voorbehoud in het koopcontract.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Nijboer en Ronnes over de huurcommissie

MPs Smeulders, Nijboer and Ronnes asked the Minister of the Interior about the Huurcommissie's backlog, including its budget, causes of longer processing times, regional complaint volumes, staffing, and when the backlog will be cleared. The minister answered that about EUR 4 million is reserved for 2019 and staffing is being expanded by about 10 FTE, that the 7,500-case target for 2019 carries risks, and that the backlog is expected to be cleared only in the course of 2021.
The Huurcommissie and I consider it important to clear the increased workload as quickly as possible and to normalise processing times.
De Huurcommissie en ik vinden het belangrijk om de toegenomen werkvoorraad zo snel mogelijk in te halen en de doorlooptijden te normaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Ploumen en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Westerveld hoopt op snelle publicatie van RIVM rapport’

MPs Moorlag, Ploumen and Nijboer asked about a news report on Westerveld hoping for quick publication of a RIVM report on pesticide exposure, when it was completed, and what legal tools municipalities have to protect residents from pesticide exposure via zoning. The minister answered that the RIVM reports were sent to the House on 10 April, and that municipalities can use zoning plans and the precautionary principle to set buffer zones, with about 50 metres a commonly accepted rule of thumb, while the exposure study shows no unacceptable risk at that distance.
Yes, this is possible and is already happening.
Ja, dit kan en vindt ook al plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat zeker 1 miljoen huizen in Nederland dreigen te verzakken

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the ministry knows about foundation subsidence threatening up to one million homes, how many reports it has received, and what it will do about groundwater levels, affected municipalities, and homeowners' financial support. The minister answered that the ministry is aware, that owners are primarily responsible with a shared loan fund for those unable to pay, that a broader survey of affected municipalities will be considered and reported to parliament, and that a public-private viewer helps buyers identify risk.
I will look into how this can be given shape and inform your House of the outcomes.
Ik zal bezien op welke wijze dit vorm kan worden gegeven en uw Kamer over de uitkomsten hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Moorlag en Nijboer over meer banen in Oost-Groningen

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers whether the Opiumwet's ban on industrial use of hemp tops, which blocks CBD extraction at HempFlax in Oost-Groningen, should be relaxed to create jobs, and how Germany regulates this. The minister answered that the law only exempts fibre hemp for fibre or seed, that the juridical options are still being explored, and that talks with the businesses will follow.
At this moment I am exploring the legal possibilities.
Op dit moment ben ik de juridische mogelijkheden aan het verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het blijven zitten met restschulden na overlijden

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister whether banks sold spaargroeihypotheken with life-risk insurance under which part of the savings can fall to the bank on early death, whether consumers were properly informed, whether the AFM reviewed these products, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answers that the product was sold 2004-2010, that the AFM received no prior complaints and PARP rules only came into force in 2013, that ABN-AMRO has contacted customers with options, and that no further action with banks is planned.
As far as I am aware, such a product was offered by several lenders, but I have no overview of which lenders these were.
Voor zover mij bekend werd een dergelijk product door verschillende kredietverstrekkers aangeboden, maar ik heb geen overzicht van welke kredietverstrekkers dit betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat 70 procent van de huurbemiddelaars illegale bemiddelingskosten rekent

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares concern that 70 percent of rental agents charge illegal intermediary fees, what action will be taken, whether tenants can recover fees, and whether a Groningen-style landlord licence should be introduced nationally. The minister answers that ACM will enforce more strictly, that tenants can reclaim fees via ConsuWijzer and other guidance, and that a national landlord licence is disproportionate while the Groningen pilot is monitored.
I am therefore pleased with the announcement by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) that it will act more intensively against rental agents who charge tenants unjustified costs.
Ik ben dan ook verheugd over de aankondiging 2 van de Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM), die intensiever op gaat treden tegen huurbemiddelaars die onterechte kosten in rekening brengen aan huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over misbruik van crowdfundkanalen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about misuse of crowdfunding platforms, including platform obligations to identify users, AFM supervision, fee transparency, victim remedies and police capacity. The government said the scale is unknown, platforms must follow civil and consumer law without new legislation, reward and donation crowdfunding fall under ACM rather than AFM, and victims can report to police and that investigative capacity is sufficient.
The scale of misuse of crowdfunding campaigns is not known.
De schaal van het misbruik van crowdfundingacties is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over klachten van bewoners van de Lijnbaanflat in Rotterdam over een ingrijpende renovatie

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about residents of the Lijnbaanflat in Rotterdam complaining of extreme nuisance from a major renovation, the rules for remaining in homes during works, compensation, tenants' right to temporary housing, the reported Vestia media ban, and whether tenant rights should be strengthened for upcoming sustainability works. The minister answered that existing Civil Code and Overlegwet rules are sufficient, that tenants can go to court for compensation or stopping works, that Vestia denies imposing a media ban (which only a court can impose), and that the cabinet will discuss tenant protection in the Klimaatakkoord follow-up.

The cabinet will also discuss with parties such as Aedes, the Woonbond and the VNG, as part of the follow-up to the Klimaatakkoord, how the position and quiet enjoyment of tenants during sustainability works can be sufficiently safeguarded.

Het kabinet zal de uitwerking van nieuwe maatregelen op grond van het Klimaatakkoord met partijen zoals Aedes, de Woonbond en de VNG ook bespreken hoe de positie en woongenot van huurders bij verduurzamingswerkzaamheden in voldoende mate geborgd kan blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Ronnes en Smeulders over het bericht 'Huurcommissie kan stroom aan klachten niet aan'

MPs asked why complaints to the Huurcommissie (rent tribunal) surged to about 10,000 in 2018, how long cases take, and what the effect of the modernisation bill and long waits is. The minister attributes the rise to no single cause, says durations range from two months to a year, and says she cannot say how many disputes moved to the courts.
The Huurcommissie does not receive data on court proceedings before the judge.
De Huurcommissie ontvangt geen gegevens over gerechtelijke procedures bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber, Agnes Mulder, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Stress door gasellende in bevingsgebied neemt toe’

MPs asked the minister about reports that gas-extraction stress in the Groningen earthquake area is rising, the need for psychological care funding, and NAM liability for immaterial damage. The minister acknowledged the mental health problem, pointed to ending gas extraction, independent damage and reinforcement processes, regional support programmes, and said he will await the outcome of pending court proceedings on immaterial damage.
I am awaiting the outcome of the court proceedings.
Ik wacht de uitkomst van de gerechtelijke procedures af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het opkopen van Zeeuwse woningen voor vakantieverhuur

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether holiday-rental buy-to-let in Zeeland coastal villages (Cadzand, Groede, Breskens) harms liveability, drives up house prices and displaces local residents, and what the government will do about commercial rental in breach of local rules. The Minister answered that municipalities can set and enforce rules on holiday rental, that she encourages them to use existing powers, pointed to a handreiking and a planned one-time registration obligation, but attributed price rises to many factors and left most concrete choices to municipalities.
I encourage municipalities to make use of these possibilities.
Ik moedig gemeenten aan om gebruik te maken van deze mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels, Sneller, Bruins en Nijboer over de ING-witwasaffaire

Four MPs asked the Finance Minister whether his ministry suggested wording to DNB on its letter about the ING money-laundering case, whether it steered answers, and how ministerial responsibility for DNB is exercised. The minister answered that his officials only asked clarifying questions, that DNB decides its own wording, that he holds only system responsibility for DNB, and that he was first informed of the case on 31 August 2018.
DNB is independent in carrying out the tasks assigned to it as an independent administrative body: it judges individual cases autonomously and is not subordinate to the Minister of Finance.

DNB is onafhankelijk in de uitvoering van de taken die haar als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan zijn opgedragen: zij oordeelt zelfstandig over individuele gevallen en is niet ondergeschikt aan de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Snels en Nijboer over ING als huisbankier van de Staat

MPs Bruins, Snels and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister when he learned of legal options to terminate state contracts with ING after the money-laundering settlement, why the September letter did not explain them, and when the Chamber would be informed. The minister answered that legal options were mapped from September 2018, advice was finalised in late September, the Chamber received the analysis in earlier answers, and a further letter on additional exclusion and termination grounds was sent with this answer.

Simultaneously with answering these questions, I am informing your Chamber by letter about the possibilities of including additional exclusion grounds in new tender procedures for payment services and about additional termination grounds in contracts.

Gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze vragen informeer ik uw Kamer per brief over de mogelijkheden voor het opnemen van aanvullende uitsluitingsgronden bij nieuwe aanbestedingsprocedures betalingsverkeer en over aanvullende opzeggingsgronden in overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het discrimineren door banken van klanten met een spaarhypotheek
