An MP asked whether banks such as ING and Rabobank unfairly charge a rate surcharge to customers renewing an expiring savings mortgage, how much tax deduction is involved, and what the government will do to make banks prioritise customer interests. The Minister of Finance answered that rate differences between mortgage types are permitted, that the surcharge reflects higher interest and refinancing risk and is treated as ordinary deductible interest, that the amount of deduction involved is unknown, and that the sector should itself show more regard for customers.
I am of the view that it is primarily up to the sector to show that they have more regard for the interests of the customer.
Ik ben van mening dat het primair aan de sector is om te laten zien dat zij meer oog hebben voor het belang van de klant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over fraude met bankrekeningnummers

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about direct debit fraud, including how often it occurs, how it can be prevented, how victims can recover money, and whether payment descriptions can be made clearer. The minister answered that fraud losses are small (EUR 89,000 in 2018), that banks and creditors bear control duties and customers have refund rights, and that the market and the consultation body MOB are sufficient to improve transaction clarity.
The MOB discussed this topic at its autumn meeting.
Het MOB heeft dit onderwerp besproken in haar najaarsvergadering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het beoordelen van woningen in Groningen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the figures in an internal memo on assessment capacity for Groningen earthquake-reinforcement homes differed from the January letter suggesting nearly 3,000 assessments in the first half of 2019, and whether residents would have clarity by then. The Minister replied that the January letter did not intend to suggest 3,000 assessments in that period, that capacity constraints and regional planning were involved, and that the government aims for 4,000 assessments per year from 2020 with an acceleration plan, while promising to inform the House of significant setbacks.
In that context, the national government and the regions acknowledged that undesirable waiting times arise for residents because intake capacity is greater than assessment capacity.
Daarbij is door Rijk en Regio onderkend dat ongewenste wachttijd voor bewoners ontstaat, omdat de opnamecapaciteit groter is dan de beoordelingscapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de afwijkende metingen bij de versnellingsmeters van KNMI

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked why the KNMI kept quiet for months about deviating accelerometer readings in Groningen, what the errors mean for the HRA model, damage assessment and public trust, and whether the measurement network will be expanded. The ministers say the errors were reported late, that KNMI's hazard maps are not affected, that an evaluation, a working group and an audit are underway, and that they cannot answer by 5 March.
We regret that the KNMI did not report the identified deviations in a timely manner.
Wij betreuren het dat het KNMI niet tijdig een melding heeft gemaakt van de geconstateerde afwijkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over medewerkers van ABN AMRO die de bonuswet omzeilen

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO staff holding private-equity participations via ABN AMRO Participaties, apparently circumventing bonus rules, and asked about payouts, risk, and carried-interest-like status. The minister answered that the fund had been spun off, that individual payouts are confidential, and that tax qualification is for the tax inspector.
Information on the investment and payout per person cannot be provided due to the personal confidential nature of this information.
Informatie over de inleg en uitkering per persoon kan niet gegeven worden in verband met het persoonsvertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale behandeling van woningen als beleggingsobject

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary of Finance how homes held as investments are taxed in box 3, box 1 and box 2, with worked examples, and whether the treatment should be made less attractive. The State Secretary answered that box 3 uses a forfaitary return on the WOZ value, that the tax cannot be attributed to a single asset, that a study on rental income taxation is underway, and that a higher transfer tax for additional homes is not an efficient option.
The aim is not to make investing in homes less attractive for tax purposes, but to map out options that can contribute to a better tax system.
Het doel daarvan is niet om het beleggen in woningen fiscaal minder aantrekkelijk te maken, maar om varianten in beeld te brengen die kunnen bijdragen aan een beter belastingstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over fraude met inkomensverklaringen door wanhopige woningzoekenden

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporations' fraud with fake income declarations by desperate applicants is acceptable, whether the money is recovered, whether fraudsters are prosecuted, and what action is taken. The minister says prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, notes no national fraud figures are kept, and announces a digital income-verification pilot with corporations, the Tax Office and Aedes.
No national figures are kept on the number of deregistrations by housing corporations due to fraud.
Over het aantal uitschrijvingen bij woningcorporaties vanwege fraude worden geen landelijke cijfers bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het plegen van identiteitsfraude

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked how easy it still is to commit identity fraud, how banks verify identity when opening accounts and granting credit, and whether remote and outsourced checks are adequately supervised. The minister explained the Wwft verification rules, DNB's supervision and the fraud-prevention initiatives, but gave no commitment to new measures.
DNB supervises banks' compliance with the Wwft and has named preventing institutions' involvement in financial-economic crime as a priority of its supervision.

De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Wwft door banken, en heeft het voorkomen van betrokkenheid van instellingen bij financieel-economische criminaliteit benoemd als speerpunt van haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over privacyregels die gelden voor de Belastingdienst

Nijboer (PvdA) asked how far the Belastingdienst may use third-party sources, including doctors, to verify tax deductions and whether medical confidentiality and privacy are protected. The State Secretary answered that inspectors may request information from taxpayers and administrative obligors such as doctors, that doctors may invoke their duty of confidentiality, and declined to promise that inspectors would never approach doctors independently or that doctors need never inform patients on such requests.
Nee, dit kan ik niet toezeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de aardbeving in het zoutwinningsgebied bij Veendam

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the government is studying the effects of a 1.3 magnitude quake near Veendam on salt caverns, whether gas-induced quakes could cause collapse or leakage, whether salt mining should be reconsidered, and whether the precautionary principle requires ending salt mining. Minister Wiebes answered that such a small quake is not expected to harm the caverns, that risks were assessed by SodM and TNO, that licences need not be reconsidered now, and that new knowledge would lead to additional conditions where warranted.

If new insights arise about the risks of salt mining, I will examine whether this gives reason to impose additional conditions on mining plans, and SodM will supervise whether the companies concerned take adequate measures.

Als nieuwe inzichten ontstaan over de risico's van zoutwinning, dan zal ik bezien of dit aanleiding geeft tot het stellen van aanvullende voorwaarden voor winningsplannen en zal SodM toezien op het nemen van adequate maatregelen door de betreffende bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over bancaire investeringen in fossiele energie

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked whether banks should speed up green investment, how the government monitors fossil versus renewable financing, and whether a complaint was filed with the OECD National Contact Point over bank human rights concerns in oil and gas. The minister said DNB monitors financial sector exposure to CO2-intensive sectors, the sector committed to measuring and reporting CO2 emissions from 2020, no OECD complaint has been filed, and an oil and gas value chain analysis under the banking IMVO covenant is in preparation.
No, following the Eerlijke Bankwijzer research no complaint has been filed with the National Contact Point (NCP) for the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Nee, er is naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van de Eerlijke Bankwijzer geen klacht ingediend bij het Nationaal Contact Punt (NCP) voor de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Leraren vinden moeilijk een woning op plekken waar werk is'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Ministers of Interior and Education whether teachers can realistically find affordable homes in big cities, and what the government will do about it. The minister says housing supply is a municipal responsibility, describes existing national and municipal instruments and initiatives, and states the government is stimulating housing construction without committing to specific new measures for middle-income teachers.
Data on the size of the shortage in these cities is not available to central government.
De gegevens over de omvang van het tekort in deze steden zijn niet bij het Rijk beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘The illusion of UK bank capital strength’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about an article claiming UK banks, including RBS, have excess capital, and about low leverage ratios, and asks for Dutch bank capital figures, rules on capital distributions, and whether the minimum leverage ratio should be raised to 10%. The minister answers with the EBA-based figures and explains the strict conditions on dividends and buybacks, while stating that Dutch leverage requirements are set at EU level and that stricter EU measures are being pursued.
I think it is sensible for banks to hold high buffers.
Ik vind het verstandig dat banken hoge buffers aanhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van der Lee en Nijboer over woningen die eerst versterkt zouden worden, maar nu veilig blijken te zijn volgens het HRA-model

MPs Beckerman, Van der Lee and Nijboer asked the minister why Groningen homes in batches 1581 and 1588, promised reinforcement under earlier motions, now appear safe under the HRA model, and how residents keep control over their homes. The minister says reinforcement continues for batch 1588, that batch 1581 is handled via prepared advice with owner choice, declines to comment on individual cases, and stresses owners have the final say while admitting uncertainty remains.
It does not befit me as Minister to publicly exchange views on an individual case.
Het past mij als Minister niet om in het openbaar van gedachten te wisselen over een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanpak van de problemen met aardbevingen in Groningen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Groningen earthquake response: the Gasberaad secretary's criticism that the government is ignoring the human side, slow damage settlement (up to 15 months), and the fate of the Meerjarenprogramma after Alders left. The minister says the gas extraction phase-out addresses the cause, that damage handling has moved into public hands, that the new reinforcement approach is based on Mijnraad advice, and that he will keep meeting regional representatives.
A processing time of 15 months is not acceptable to me.
Een doorlooptijd van 15 maanden vind ik niet acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ABN AMRO-medewerkers die de bonuswet omzeilen

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO employees were circumventing the bonus law through participations in its private-equity arm AAP, and asked for disclosure of profits, dividends, and individual stakes. The minister answered that individual data cannot be given for confidentiality reasons, that AAP profits are not yet determined, and that the arrangement is not a prohibited variable pay but DNB and AFM will act if circumvention is found.
Information on the investment and payout per person cannot be provided because of the personal confidential nature of this information.
Informatie over de inleg en uitkering per persoon kan niet gegeven worden in verband met het persoonsvertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Bodem zakt meer dan verwacht door droogte’

Two MPs asked the ministers about a report that Dutch soil is subsiding faster than expected because of drought, its causes, the expected costs, and who is liable for damage. The minister answered that drought and groundwater management cause the subsidence, that owners bear their own responsibility, that municipalities and water boards have a duty to weigh interests, and that insurers' coverage depends on policy terms.
If the damage is caused by unlawful action by the government, the injured party can hold the relevant government body liable through civil law.
Als de schade wordt veroorzaakt door onrechtmatig handelen door de overheid, dan kan de benadeelde het betreffende overheidsorgaan aansprakelijk stellen via de civielrechtelijke weg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over woningcorporaties die het moeilijk wordt gemaakt om te verduurzamen

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked whether the minister agrees with the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties' rejection of Groninger Huis joining a solar park, and how sustainability goals can be met if such initiatives are blocked. The minister declined to comment on the individual case (under court review), said the Woningwet's proximity rule is assessed case by case, and promised an evaluation of the Woningwet in early 2019 that will examine obstacles to housing-corporation sustainability.
As legislator, it is not for BZK to respond to individual cases.
Als wetgever is het niet aan BZK om te reageren op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over het vastlopen van de versterking in Groningen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the minister about reported criticism of the Groningen reinforcement operation, including claims of delay tactics, staff distrust, the HRA model, financing of home inspections and inequality between municipalities. The minister denied deliberate delay, said the HRA model is only used for risk prioritisation, confirmed NAM will cover reinforcement costs, and said some schemes will be reviewed while no concrete timetable was promised.
The implementation of the reinforcement cannot, however, wait for this.
Dit uitvoering van de versterking kan hier echter niet op wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet handhaven van het woningwaarderingsstelsel

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about widespread non-compliance with the rent-scoring system, landlord intimidation, rent-policing, registers of bad landlords, higher fines, and faster tribunal procedures. The Minister said high rents are not illegal under contractual freedom, pointed to information campaigns, the Huurcommissie tools, new landlord fees and the Goed Verhuurderschap measures, and explained that short procedures are rarely suitable but that the 2019 reform gives enough options for faster cases.
The Huurcommissie is also currently examining the possibilities to make the register of rulings more searchable.
Ook onderzoekt de Huurcommissie momenteel de mogelijkheden om de doorzoekbaarheid van het register van uitspraken te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de versterking van huizen in Meedhuizen

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the news that many houses in Meedhuizen must be strengthened under the new prioritisation model, questioning its reliability, how residents were informed, and the poor communication with the local mayor. The minister answered that the HRA model is a high-quality, science-based tool used only to prioritise high-risk homes, that residents were informed by letter and a meeting, and that a second meeting is planned for January, with individual measures decided after on-site inspection.
The HRA model is regarded by both the Mijnraad and SodM as a high-quality model, based on the best scientific knowledge currently available.
Het HRA-model wordt door zowel de Mijnraad als het SodM gezien als een hoogstaand model, gebaseerd op de beste wetenschappelijke kennis die er op dit moment is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een olievlek bij Farmsum

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an oil spill of toxic gas condensate from the NAM tank park in Delfzijl into a sewer and waterway at Farmsum, including what happened, whether the State Supervision of Mines was notified, health risks, recurrence and cost recovery. The minister answered in detail on the cause, the notification timeline, measured benzene levels, the imposition of enhanced supervision with extra safety measures, and that all damage will be recovered from the NAM.
To prevent such incidents from happening again, SodM has placed the tank park under enhanced supervision.
Om te voorkomen dat dit soort incidenten zich nogmaals voordoen, heeft SodM het tankenpark onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de overslaginstallatie van het bedrijf Noordgastransport in Roodeschool

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the minister to relocate the gas condensate transshipment facility out of the centre of Roodeschool, citing livability and fairness for Groningen. The minister agreed the facility is undesirable there and offered renewed talks, but said the operator holds valid permits, the risks do not justify forced relocation, and no compensation from gas revenues will be earmarked.
I am willing to re-engage in talks with the company and the municipality about an alternative.
Ik ben bereid opnieuw het gesprek met het bedrijf en de gemeente aan te gaan over een alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Nijboer over de grootste belastingfraude in de Europese geschiedenis

MPs Snels and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about the CumEx dividend tax fraud, including prosecutions, bank involvement, the Belastingdienst's systems and whether Dutch dividend stripping continues. The government answered that it cannot judge the Dutch share or the scale abroad, referred to an ongoing OM investigation, said the Belastingdienst does not systematically track fines, and outlined limits on enforcement due to the heavy burden of proof, with a commitment to inventory dividend stripping practices.
As the cover letter shows, situations of dividend stripping also occur in the Netherlands.
Zoals blijkt uit de aanbiedingsbrief doen zich in Nederland ook situaties van dividendstripping voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Nijboer over het definitieve energielabel voor woningen

MPs Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the reliability of home energy labels, the oversight of certified assessors, liability for incorrect labels, and the energy-label system's performance. The minister answered that the government registers rather than issues labels, cited inspection results and fines, acknowledged the need for better communication and a review of the simplified label, and promised further steps.
The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport carries out random checks on the files handled by certified experts.
De Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport voert steekproefsgewijs controles uit op de dossiers die door de erkend deskundigen zijn behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Nijboer over gesjoemel met energielabels en energie-indexen

MPs Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about alleged manipulation of energy indices in Groningen rental housing, how tenants can recover overpayments, how certifiers are checked and sanctioned, and whether action will be taken. The minister acknowledged the article, explained the rent-points effect (often limited in practice), said only suspected cases by one certificate holder are known, pointed tenants to the Huurcommissie and courts, outlined a suspension and withdrawal process for certificate holders, and saw no need for further measures.
Given the options tenants have with the Rent Tribunal and the courts in cases of fraud and manipulation, I currently see insufficient reason for additional measures.
Gezien de mogelijkheden van huurders bij de Huurcommissie en de rechter in gevallen van fraude en sjoemelen, zie ik op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding voor aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer en Snels over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

MPs Bruins, Nijboer and Snels asked the Finance Minister whether ING, the state's house bank, remained eligible in tender procedures after a recent OM transaction under article 74 of the Criminal Code, and whether this should affect future tenders. The minister answered that the transaction is not a final conviction, so no mandatory exclusion ground applies, ING may still bid, and stricter anti-money-laundering criteria will be considered in upcoming tenders, including the credit card contract and a planned reassessment before any 2020 extension.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Nijboer over het contact met en advies van de Europese Commissie aangaande de vraag of woningbouwcorporaties onder de werking van de antibelastingontwijkingsrichtlijn ATAD1 vall

MPs Leijten and Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance for an overview of all contacts with the European Commission on whether housing associations fall under ATAD1, how the government lobbied for an exemption and the budgetary consequences, and for the advice and the government's request to be sent to the House. The State Secretary referred to a letter of 12 November 2018 for the correspondence, stated that an exemption would carry real state-aid risks, and gave a budgetary loss table (EUR 102m in 2019 rising to 193m in 2021, structural 353m).
For answering these questions I refer to my letter of 12 November.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief van 12 november jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Ploumen over het bericht dat Nederland farmaceuten helpt om belasting te ontwijken

MPs Nijboer and Ploumen asked the government about reports that the Netherlands helps pharmaceutical companies avoid tax, including undisclosed arrangements, transparency, and effects on developing countries. The State Secretary of Finance answered that individual tax affairs cannot be discussed under article 67 AWR, and listed general anti-avoidance measures, the position on country-by-country reporting, and EU work on pharmaceutical patent protection.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual companies.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de deal met Shell en Exxon

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the 2018 Shell/ExxonMobil deal on Groningen gas, including whether NAM could fail its obligations and how Shell's public guarantee statements square with the deal and its financial figures. The Minister confirmed that the risk exists, said the guarantees are legally binding under the tripartite agreement, and defended the adjusted financial terms as part of a balanced package, while disputing the press calculations.
The Agreement on Main Lines is a tripartite agreement between the State, Shell and ExxonMobil.
Het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen is een tripartiete overeenkomst tussen de Staat, Shell en ExxonMobil.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over energiecoöperaties

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked how the Wft applies to small energy cooperatives, including thresholds for membership, capital and transferability, and whether a licensing requirement exists. The government answered that cooperatives mostly qualify as businesses rather than investing, that prospectus rules apply only above a €5 million threshold with exemptions below it, and that it does not intend to burden small initiatives with unreasonable bureaucracy.
Small-scale citizen initiatives to generate sustainable energy are welcomed.
Kleinschalige initiatieven van bewoners om duurzame energie op te wekken worden toegejuicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over Nederlandse investeerders die amper geld steken in start-ups van vrouwen

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the very low share of venture capital going to women-led start-ups is simply accepted as part of the free market, what levers exist, and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that this is not accepted as a given, that institutional investors play a limited role, and that a round-table with stakeholders will be organised before deciding on further measures.
I will consider this after the round-table discussion, where I hope to gain more insight into why female-led start-ups obtain so little capital and the options available to address it.

Dit zal ik na het rondetafelgesprek bezien, waar ik hopelijk meer inzicht zal opdoen over de redenen waarom vrouwelijke start-ups zo weinig kapitaal verkrijgen en de mogelijkheden die er zijn om hier wat aan te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over illegale boetes door huisbazen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked whether a Nijmegen landlord may impose fines of 50 to 100 euro for misplaced bicycles or forgotten keys, and whether this is common and how the government will act against abuse of tenants' dependent position. The minister answers that fines are permitted if agreed in the lease and reasonable, that a landlord may only charge a cost-based reimbursement absent such terms, that unlawful brokerage fees are banned, and that she is working to improve enforcement as requested in a motion.
Landlords are permitted to include penalty clauses in their lease contracts or general terms for cases where the tenant does not comply with certain agreements on house rules.

Het is verhuurders toegestaan om in hun huurcontracten dan wel in de algemene voorwaarden bij de huurcontracten boetebepalingen op te nemen voor gevallen de huurder bepaalde afspraken omtrent «huisregels» niet nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over woningen van Vestia aan de Trekweg te Den Haag

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she would engage housing corporation Vestia to fix structural maintenance failures in Trekweg and Stuwstraat homes in The Hague, and whether she would force action and address poor complaint handling. The Minister answered that maintenance is a core task of corporations, that Vestia's remediation plan covers it, and listed existing tenant routes (complaints, Huurcommissie, municipal orders, court injunctions) while noting a complaints line, weekly surgery and an upcoming visit by the alderman and a Vestia board member.
Tenants must be able to assume at all times that their home is maintained in a decent way.
Huurders moeten er te allen tijde vanuit kunnen gaan dat hun woning op een degelijke manier onderhouden wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat een investeerder zeker tien keer witwaspraktijken had aangekaart bij ING, waar vervolgens niets mee werd gedaan

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether ING ignored a financier's repeated reports of money laundering, whether the gatekeeper system worked given that both the bank and a trust office failed, and what would be done to protect whistleblowers and review bank compliance. The minister answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined Wwft duties and DNB supervision, pointed to tightened rules and the pending trust office bill, noted whistleblower protection under the fourth anti-money-laundering directive, and said investigating individual banks' procedures is for the supervisor DNB.
Supervision of banks' compliance with these statutory obligations is carried out by De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het toezicht op de uitvoering van deze wettelijke verplichtingen door banken wordt uitgevoerd door De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over signalen dat mensen lang niet kunnen verhuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether older people wanting to downsize are stuck for many years due to scarce affordable housing, and how common this is. The minister said such waits are undesirable, cited RIGO and WoON data showing long registration times varying by region, and pointed to the Actielijn Wonen en Zorg and NHG changes as measures to improve downsizing.
I consider it undesirable if people cannot move to a home that suits their housing wishes.
Ik vind het onwenselijk als mensen niet kunnen verhuizen naar een woning die past bij hun woonwens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht dat er ook bevingen bij zoutwinning kunnen ontstaan

MPs Beckerman (SP) and Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about KNMI findings that salt mining can cause tremors near Groningen, the risk of a salt cavern near Winschoten, the advice to halt new wells in Veendam, damage compensation liability, and whether salt mining should be phased out. The minister denied the problems are more serious than thought, said the Winschoten cavern is stable but monitored, said the Veendam expansion requires an amended mining plan by 1 January 2019, and committed to follow SodM recommendations.
Individuals who believe they have suffered damage can, after the mining company has rejected the claim, appeal to the Technical Committee on Soil Movement (Tcbb).
Particulieren die menen schade te hebben kunnen, nadat deze claim is afgewezen door het desbetreffende mijnbouwbedrijf, een beroep doen op de Tcbb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer en Snels over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

MPs Bruins, Nijboer and Snels asked the Finance Minister how ING's admission of structural anti-money-laundering violations fits with its role as the state's house bank, whether it meets the sustainability criteria, whether contracts can be terminated, and whether evaluation moments exist. The minister replied that the tenders were carefully drafted, ING still meets the criteria, the contract allows termination for specified breaches, and periodic review occurs, while stating a transaction under the Criminal Code offers no basis for terminating the contract.
The requirements and wishes in the tender were at the time carefully and adequately formulated.
De eisen en wensen in de aanbesteding zijn destijds zorgvuldig en adequaat geformuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Wiebes over incomplete lijst onveilige woningen: 'Het valt mij ook tegen''

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why no complete list of unsafe buildings in the Groningen earthquake area exists yet, how the figure of about 1,500 was established, whether residents can get free inspections, and when they will have certainty. The minister replies that about 1,500 buildings were identified via modelling and checked, that priority goes to careful communication over speed, and that the NCG will deliver a plan of action shortly, after which residents will be informed.
The NCG expects to be able to deliver the plan of action in the short term, after which I will send it to your House.
De NCG verwacht het plan van aanpak op korte termijn te kunnen opleveren, waarna ik dit aan uw Kamer zal aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over Groningse basisschoolleraren die hun leerlingen vaker onderschatten dan hun collega’s in rest van Nederland

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked why Groningen primary teachers give lower secondary school advice more often than elsewhere in the Netherlands, and what this means for pupils' opportunities, while also raising the role of parental pressure, school-level agreements and the research of Bosker. The minister confirmed more Groningen advice is revised downward, said no research has yet explained the gap, pointed to Drenthe research and an Inspectorate game, and promised to return to the topic in the 2018 results report and the final evaluation of the eindtoets law.

No substantiated statements can be made about the province of Groningen, since no research has yet been conducted in that province into the cause of the difference between school advice and test advice.

Er kunnen over de provincie Groningen geen onderbouwde uitspraken worden gedaan, aangezien er in die provincie nog geen onderzoek gedaan is naar de oorzaak van het verschil in schooladvies en toetsadvies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de besluitvorming rondom het beloningsbeleid bij bedrijven met een Stichting Administratiekantoor

An MP asked whether the Stichting Administratiekantoor (STAK) vote was decisive in approving higher executive pay at Van Lanschot Kempen, and whether its use of voting rights for pay matters is consistent with the Corporate Governance Code and the law. The minister answered that the STAK's votes could not be shown to be decisive, that the STAK's governance meets the Code, that the law gives voting rights to the shareholder, and that the government is consulting on tighter pay rules.
It is not known how the certificate holders who did not use their power to vote by proxy would have voted had they invoked that power.
Het is niet bekend hoe de certificaathouders die geen gebruik hebben gemaakt van hun bevoegdheid om door middel van een volmacht hun stem uit te brengen zouden hebben gestemd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting nog meer gaat kosten dan eerder werd aangenomen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why abolishing the dividend tax now costs more than the 1.4 billion euro previously assumed, and urged redirecting the money to public services; the government answered that the cost is now estimated at 1.9 billion euro structurally due to higher revenue realisations and recalculation, that additional purchasing-power measures were taken for low incomes, that the advice documents were partly published, and that it will not reconsider the measure. The reply gives the cost figures and says cabinet's reasons for the policy are growth and retaining headquarters.
The cabinet, ahead of the debate with your House on 25 April 2018, disclosed in a letter of 24 April 2018 documents relating to the abolition of the dividend tax.
Het kabinet heeft – in aanloop naar het debat met uw Kamer op 25 april 2018 – bij brief van 24 april 2018 stukken geopenbaard die betrekking hebben op de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Britse beleggers zitten niet te wachten op afschaffen dividendbelasting'

MP Nijboer asked the government about a press report that British investors are not keen on abolishing the Dutch dividend tax, and about who bears the cost and revenue effects. The State Secretary answered that no foreign investors asked for abolition, that exact investor breakdowns are unavailable, and that the government will proceed with abolition to keep headquarters in the Netherlands.
Who these portfolio shareholders are is often also unknown to listed companies.
Wie deze portfolioaandeelhouders zijn is veelal ook voor beursgenoteerde bedrijven onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gerepareerde scheuren die niet bestand zijn tegen nieuwe bevingen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether repaired cracks from earthquakes in Groningen fail under new tremors, how often this occurs, whether repair methods were effective, and why the TNO research was not published immediately. The minister confirmed repaired damage can recur, cited 39 of 476 repaired cracks reappearing after one quake, pointed to the gas production phase-out and a forthcoming law on public damage handling, and said NAM commissioned the research and published it.
As Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, I had no role in the client-contractor relationship between NAM and TNO.
Ik had als Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat geen rol in de opdrachtgever-opdrachtnemersrelatie tussen NAM en TNO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het bericht 'ING treft miljoenenschikking met OM in witwaszaken' (Herdruk)

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about ING's record 775 million euro settlement with the Public Prosecution Service over money laundering, including how the amount was set, why prosecution was avoided, and whether individuals and the bank's leadership face consequences. The ministers answered that the settlement combined a 665 million fine with 100 million in disgorgement, that the OM chose a transaction for its enforceable compliance measures under DNB supervision, and that individual criminal liability could not be established, while the bank's supervisory board has announced personnel consequences at board level.
The OM therefore attributes the criminal offences to the organisation as a whole.
Het OM rekent de strafbare feiten dan ook toe aan de organisatie als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Amsterdam boos: 'Kabinet lokt foute vastgoedbeleggers'”

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior why the government promotes Dutch rental housing to foreign investors, whether social rental homes should be liberalised and sold to foreign investors, and why pension funds rather than housing corporations are targeted. The minister answers that the campaign informs investors about the housing market, that corporations may sell or liberalise stock under sale rules involving tenants, municipalities and a possible independent committee, and that foreign investment is under 5 percent and supports housing finance.
For the potentially liberalisable homes the offer sequence does not apply. However, for these homes a municipal opinion is also mandatory.
Voor de potentieel te liberaliseren woningen geldt de aanbiedingsvolgorde niet. Wel geldt dat voor deze woningen ook een zienswijze van de gemeente verplicht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het massaal vragen van teveel huur voor studentenkamers

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about a student-union report finding that about 70 percent of students pay rent above the legal maximum, and whether the rent-protection system works, and urges penalties, blacklisting of landlords and action against double brokerage fees. The minister refers to a letter on the representativeness and reform, says she will monitor affordability via a national student housing monitor, is willing to talk to housing corporations with concrete signals, plans higher fees for repeat-offending landlords and good-landlordship talks with the sector, and notes municipalities can intervene on overcrowding and safety.

In cases of overcrowding, poor fire safety, unlawful subdivision and the like, the municipality can intervene under administrative law based on the Housing Act, the zoning plan or the Building Decree.

Bij overbewoning, slechte brandveiligheid, ongeoorloofde verkamering en dergelijke kan de gemeente bestuursrechtelijk ingrijpen op grond van de huisvestingswet, het bestemmingsplan of het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de deal met Shell en Exxon

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Groningen gas deal with Shell and ExxonMobil, including the 2035 end date for liability, the legal strength of a feared 70 billion euro compensation claim, the role of the Finance Minister, and whether the government was outmaneuvered by the companies. The Minister answered that liability remains without time limit, that the claim risk was assessed internally with the Landsadvocaat advising, that the indicative loss is 1.65 billion euro through 2022, and that the Finance Ministry was involved, while promising a confidential technical briefing.
I will provide your House with more clarity on the commercially confidential elements of the Principal Agreement during the confidential technical briefing.
Ik zal uw Kamer meer duidelijkheid verschaffen over de bedrijfsvertrouwelijke elementen van het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen tijdens de vertrouwelijke technische briefing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Rijke huurder krijgt geld terug’

MP Nijboer asked the ministers about a report that the Tax Authority wrongly supplied tenants' income data to landlords before 2016, and whether rent increases based on that data must be reversed or compensated. The minister answered that the legal basis dates from 2013, that the Finance Minister is appealing a court ruling on the pre-2016 data, that she does not consider the Council of State ruling to invalidate those rent increases, and that individual civil cases are pending.

I am of the view that the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State does not mean that it must be concluded that the income-dependent (higher) rent increases of 2013 through 2015 were not validly agreed.

Ik ben van mening dat de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State niet tot gevolg heeft dat geconcludeerd moet worden dat de inkomensafhankelijke (hogere) huurverhogingen van de jaren 2013 tot en met 2015 niet rechtsgeldig overeengekomen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag  en Nijboer over de risico's bij zoutwinning

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about risks from salt mining, including long-term cavern instability, sinkholes in Twente, a Heiligerlee cavern, and leakage at Veendam, citing an SodM report. The minister acknowledges long-term risks need more attention, describes monitoring and remediation plans with AkzoNobel and Nedmag, and promises further information on a single damage desk and reports.
SodM has given supervision of the salt sector greater priority.
SodM heeft het toezicht op de zoutsector meer prioriteit gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de zoutwinning in de gemeente Midden-Groningen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about salt mining by Nedmag in Midden-Groningen, including alleged drilling against the permit, a leak incident, accelerated subsidence and damage risks, and a claims desk for mining damage. The Minister says no drilling is currently taking place, the objection will be handled by SodM, the leak investigation is ongoing, and that the Tcbb advice on a claims desk will be implemented with a further letter to parliament.
SodM will handle the objection according to the procedure within the set time limit.
SodM zal het bezwaar behandelen volgens de procedure binnen de daarvoor vaststelde termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat hypotheekverstrekkers nog altijd te hoge boeterente berekenen

Member Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister why mortgage lenders still overcharge early-repayment penalties, after the AFM found errors at nine of fifteen lenders, and what consumers can do and how compliance can be enforced. The minister acknowledged the errors and disappointing compliance, said banks promised to compensate affected customers, and noted that the AFM is monitoring and considering enforcement measures, leaving the timing of fines to the AFM.
It is up to the AFM as an independent supervisor to decide whether and when these follow-up steps are taken.
Het is aan de AFM als onafhankelijk toezichthouder om te bepalen of en wanneer deze vervolgstappen worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht op de website van de belastingdienst getiteld 'Wat betekent de vergoeding voor aardbevingsschade voor mijn toeslagen?'

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether compensation for Groningen earthquake damage should reduce childcare and child benefit allowances, and whether recipients face double harm and other benefit effects. The minister answered that compensation should leave people no worse off, that only a very limited group is affected through box 3 income, that such effects count as consequential damage claimable at the TCMG, and that no specific fiscal regulation is planned.
I am asking the TCMG to actively inform about this and am looking with them at how this can best be arranged in practice.
Ik vraag de TCMG hier actief over te informeren en kijk met hen hoe dit uitvoeringstechnisch het beste kan worden geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over internationale energiebedrijven die Nederland gebruiken om miljoen te eisen

Dutch MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether international energy investors use the Energy Charter Treaty to claim compensation from states over energy policy, and whether Dutch shell companies are used for such claims. The government answered that investors can bring arbitration under the treaty for unlawful state conduct, that Nederland has never been sued, and that it will work to amend the treaty to stop shell-company claims.
The cabinet is therefore committed to amending the Energy Charter Treaty on this point.
Het kabinet zet zich dan ook in om het Energiehandvestverdrag op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer, Snels, Van Weyenberg, Omtzigt, Lodders en Leijten over een nieuw datalek bij Mossack Fonseca

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a new Mossack Fonseca data leak, how the Tax Authority will use the data, the yield and cost of Panama Papers work, the promised business case on strengthening its information position, and staffing outflow. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said analysis will start once the data is public, and stated that costs and yields cannot be separately tracked or directly linked, promising a broader assessment and information to parliament on Prinsjesdag 2018.

I will inform the House on Prinsjesdag 2018 to what extent additional investment in strengthening the Tax Authority's information position and enforcement capacity could benefit tax revenues and its enforcement strategy.

Ik informeer uw Kamer op Prinsjesdag 2018 in hoeverre een extra investering op het terrein van de versterking van de informatiepositie en de opsporingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst de belastingopbrengsten en ook de handhavingstrategie van de Belastingdienst ten goede kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ‘de NAM die weigert op te draaien voor de versterkingskosten’

An MP asks the minister why NAM refused to pay for Groningen reinforcement costs, whether NAM sought to suspend reinforcement of unsafe homes, why it still has influence over safety decisions, and whether the Algemene Rekenkamer should advise before signing a Akkoord op hoofdlijnen. The minister denies NAM raised costs as a reason, says NAM sought consultation over pace and safety, promises independent organisation of the reinforcement operation, and offers a confidential briefing on the agreement.
I want to offer your House maximum transparency, and have therefore sent the Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen, cleansed of commercially sensitive information, to the House
Ik wil uw Kamer maximale transparantie bieden, en heb daarom het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen, geschoond van bedrijfsgevoelige informatie, naar de Kamer gestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen dat de Staat heeft gesloten met Shell en ExxonMobil

An MP asks why the Groningen gas settlement with Shell and ExxonMobil was not submitted to parliament in advance, why NAM's liability and the confidentiality of the deal were handled as they were, and how costs, dividends and the Groningen compensation fund are divided. Minister Wiebes answers that the agreement was lawful without prior parliamentary approval, that NAM remains liable through the Staat-run fund, and gives partial figures while deferring the year-by-year breakdown to later.
Now that the negotiations are concluded, you can debate the agreement with me and use parliament's budgetary powers to check its financial consequences.
Nu de onderhandelingen zijn afgerond kunt met mij in debat gaan over het akkoord en aan de hand van het parlementaire budgetrecht de financiële gevolgen hiervan controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de dekking van de verminderde gasopbrengsten

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the cabinet had already found cover for a 1.1 billion euro shortfall in gas revenue and why this was not disclosed in the Spring Memorandum. The minister confirmed the interview quote, said the cover for later years will be shared on Prinsjesdag under the regular budget process, and declined to give details now.
As is customary, the multi-year budgetary cover for the gas decision will be communicated on Prinsjesdag through the Miljoenennota and the associated departmental draft budgets.
Zoals gebruikelijk wordt de meerjarige budgettaire dekking van het gasbesluit op Prinsjesdag via de Miljoenennota en de bijbehorende departementale ontwerpbegrotingen gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Utrecht stemt in met verkoop monumentale woningen door Stadsherstel Midden Nederland’ (Herdruk)

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the sale of monumental housing by Stadsherstel Midden Nederland in Utrecht, including conditions, DAEB status, loss of social rental stock and tenant protection. The minister answered that local conditions bind the sale (no sale for 10 years, rent segments set), that the Housing Act does not require such sales, that tenants keep their contracts, and that the sale is a local judgment.
The decision whether the housing corporation will sell specific monumental dwellings is made by the corporation in consultation with local parties.
De afweging of de woningcorporatie specifieke monumentale woningen zal verkopen wordt door de corporatie gemaakt in afstemming met lokale partijen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de ongevallenverzekering voor Deliveroo bezorgers

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether Deliveroo's free accident insurance for couriers signals employer status and disguised self-employment, whether the Tax Authority will enforce, and whether clarity is needed to prevent a race to the bottom. The minister answered that employer status is for courts to decide case by case, that tax confidentiality bars comments on individuals, that the government will tackle disguised self-employment through new rules, and that enforcement against the most serious bad-faith cases continues, with a broader scope from 1 July 2018.
No statements can be made about individual taxpayers under article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over individuele belastingplichtigen kunnen op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Streep door 2500 studentenwoningen na ‘verraad’ ministerie’

An MP asked whether the national ministries had co-developed and then rejected a plan for 2,500 student dwellings at Uilenstede near Schiphol despite safety and health concerns, and whether the state was a reliable partner. The ministers answered that the plan was assessed under the airport zoning rules, the inspectorate refused the exemption on external safety and noise grounds, and the local objection is pending.
Because of the appeal to special circumstances, and recognising that this is a complex task, the ILT made a broader balancing of interests.
Vanwege het beroep op bijzondere omstandigheden, en het besef dat het een complexe opgave betreft, heeft de ILT een bredere belangenafweging gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verdringing en verrijking door zonneparken

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about solar parks displacing farmland, land-price effects, overcompensation of landowners, and whether state-owned land should be used. The minister acknowledged land-use pressure, placed primary responsibility on municipalities and provinces, promised to address efficient land use in the Climate Agreement and National Environmental Vision, and deferred the compensation questions to market parties and an interdepartmental policy review.
In this context I consider it important that we handle agricultural land carefully in the Netherlands and that this is taken into account in spatial considerations for placing solar panels.
Ik vind het in dit kader van belang dat we in Nederland zorgvuldig omgaan met landbouwgronden en dat dat wordt betrokken bij de ruimtelijke afwegingen voor de plaatsing van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale behandeling van compensatie van schade door aardbevingen

MP Nijboer asks the State Secretary of Finance whether it is fair that Groningen earthquake damage compensation, which is uncertain in existence and amount, is subject to box 3 wealth tax, and asks for a specific tax decision to relieve affected residents. The State Secretary replies that a compensation claim only enters the box 3 base once entitlement is established, that the TCMG pays within two weeks of decision so the tax-before-payment problem rarely arises, that most sums are under EUR 10,000, and that he will not adopt a specific tax decision but will explore with the Economic Affairs ministry how to remove uncertainty.
together with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate it will be explored how these uncertainties can be further removed
zal samen met het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat worden verkend hoe deze onzekerheden verder kunnen worden weggenomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘ABN Amro wil klantdata gebruiken voor advertenties’

Opposition MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about reports that ABN Amro wants to use customer data from its budgeting app for personalised advertising, including rules on consent, what ads would be shown, and whether this is undesirable. The minister answered that GDPR consent is required for third-party ads, that the bank proposes only its own product suggestions for now, and that he sees no reason to adopt a proposed ban on sharing utility-derived bank data.
If the bank also wants to use the customer's data for direct marketing in the form of sending personalised advertisements from third parties, separate consent from the customer is required.

Als de bank de gegevens van de klant ook wil gebruiken voor direct marketing in de vorm van het sturen van gepersonaliseerde advertenties van derden dan is daarvoor afzonderlijk toestemming nodig van de klant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het budgetrecht van de Kamer ten aanzien van een nieuwe deal met Shell en Exxon

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why the cabinet refuses prior parliamentary approval of the Shell and Exxon Groningen gas deal, despite a motion, and how this fits parliament's budget power and the ministers' competence to bind the state. The minister replied that prior publication would endanger negotiations, that Article 4.6 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 allows ministers to conclude agreements without prior consultation, and that parliament will be informed once a framework agreement is reached, but the cabinet will not seek prior approval.
For these reasons, the cabinet will immediately inform the House of Representatives once a framework agreement with Shell and Exxon has been concluded.
Om die redenen zal het kabinet de Tweede Kamer terstond informeren op het moment dat een akkoord op hoofdlijnen is afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over versterkingsproblemen in Groningen

Nijboer (PvdA) asks why one side of a street in Overschild is being reinforced against earthquakes while the other side is not, and why residents remain uncertain while the government pauses reinforcement decisions. Minister Wiebes replies that reinforcement continues for homes already advised or under way, that a pause on new decisions lasts until expert advice (Mijnraad) is available before summer, and that the region suspended consultation over this pause.
In the intervening weeks, therefore, no new reinforcement advice will be issued to residents and no new decisions will be taken on how homes not yet in the implementation phase are reinforced.

In de tussenliggende weken worden daarom geen nieuwe versterkingsadviezen uitgebracht aan bewoners en worden geen nieuwe besluiten genomen over de wijze van versterking van woningen die nog niet in de uitvoeringsfase zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over de afhandeling van oude schades door de NAM

MPs Beckerman, Nijboer and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that NAM handles old Groningen damage claims carelessly, including forgotten files and delays after court rulings. The Minister says NAM must process claims carefully and promptly, reports that over half of old claims are resolved, and points to an independent survey and the Onafhankelijke raadsman and Arbiter Bodembeweging as routes for complaints.
In principle I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga in beginsel niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Arno Rutte en Beckerman over het gijzelen van een huurster in Groningen

Three MPs asked the ministers about a Groningen landlord who allegedly locked a tenant in her room by screwing the door shut, and whether such practices occur more widely. The minister declined to comment on the specific case pending investigation, called such confinement unacceptable, outlined planned action against bad landlords including sector agreements and possible legal changes, and noted that exact figures on such offences are not registered.
As long as not all the facts are known, I refrain from commenting on this specific case.
Zolang niet alle feiten bekend zijn onthoud ik mij van een reactie over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over documentatieverplichtingen voor huurwoningen met een huur rondom de liberalisatiegrens

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Minister of Interior whether landlords may obtain tenants' income data for income-dependent rent increases when rents are above the liberalisation threshold, what protects tenants' privacy, and whether the rent tribunal could play a role. The Minister explained that landlords of regulated tenancies may request household declarations from the Tax Authority regardless of the threshold as long as the maximum rent is not exceeded, that the Tax Authority will act on complaints and may refuse repeat offenders, and that the rent tribunal has no role in this but handles rent-increase disputes.

Landlords may propose an income-dependent rent increase for all regulated tenancies, including dwellings whose current rent is around or above the current liberalisation threshold, as long as they do not exceed the dwelling's maximum rent limit.

Verhuurders mogen voor alle met een gereguleerde huurcontract verhuurde woningen, dus ook voor woningen waarvan de huidige huurprijs rond of boven de huidige liberalisatiegrens (€ 710,68 p.m.) ligt, een inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging voorstellen zolang zij daarmee de maximale huurprijsgrens van de woning niet overschrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van Tongeren en Nijboer over de afhandeling van oude schades

MPs Beckerman, Van Tongeren and Nijboer asked the minister whether NAM's handling of old Groningen earthquake damage claims is truly successful, raising concerns about low offers, inspections, the six-week arbiter deadline, the waardevermeerdering scheme, independent research, complaints channels and enforcement of arbiter rulings. The minister replied that acceptance rates are encouraging but success is not yet certain, pointed to an independent study and a SNN scheme for the former buitengebied, and said he cannot impose a deadline on NAM but will press it to act on arbiter rulings.
In addition, an independent investigation into the handling of old damage reports has been started. I will inform your House of the outcomes of this investigation.
Daarnaast is een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de afhandeling van oude schademeldingen gestart. Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over hogere beloningen aan de top van Van Lanschot

An MP asks the Finance Minister about proposed large pay rises for the top of Van Lanschot Kempen, including a rise in share-based fixed pay and pension contributions, whether this circumvents the bonus rules, and whether shareholders should vote against. The minister calls the proposed increase remarkable and very large, says the supervisory board and shareholders are responsible for pay decisions, and announces he will work with the sector on tightening the Banking Code and is considering legal measures on financial-sector pay.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verduurzaming van woningen

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether builders place marginal solar panels merely to meet energy norms, and whether the minister would engage the sector, municipalities, or change building rules to improve rooftop solar use. The minister said builders comply legally with permits and contracts, pointed to forthcoming BENG nearly-zero-energy requirements as the solution, and declined to add specific rules or start talks with the sector.
I will therefore not include specific requirements in the building regulations.
Ik zal daarom geen specifieke eisen opnemen in de bouwregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over foute overboekingen bij ING

Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about duplicate debits at ING, whether such errors are becoming more frequent, their cause, customer compensation, comparisons across banks, outage statistics, and ING's executive pay proposal. The minister answered that the duplicate debits were a human error during a system change, corrected within hours with manual adjustments, that no statistics on such errors are kept, and that the remuneration decision rests with ING's supervisory board and shareholders.
The supervisory board and, by extension, the shareholders are responsible for the remuneration policy and remuneration of executives of financial companies.
De raad van commissarissen en in het verlengde daarvan de aandeelhouders zijn verantwoordelijk voor het beloningsbeleid en beloningen van bestuurders van financiële ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het ANBO-onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat honderdduizenden ouderen met een aflossingsvrije hypotheek in de problemen komen

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about an ANBO study suggesting hundreds of thousands of older people with interest-only mortgages face difficulties at loan maturity, including whether banks refuse renewals, whether the rules are too restrictive, and whether equity release options should be expanded. The minister replied that DNB and the AFM are monitoring the risk, banks are identifying vulnerable clients, a government reaction will follow before summer, and no clear evidence of refusals or overly restrictive AFM rules has been found.
I have no signals that lenders are unwilling to offer their existing customers a new mortgage at the end of the term.
Ik heb geen signalen dat kredietverstrekkers niet bereid zijn om hun bestaande klanten aan het einde van de looptijd een nieuwe hypotheek aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de overval op Rabobank en of banken niet behoren te weten of er crimineel geld in kluisjes wordt opgeborgen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a large robbery of safe-deposit boxes at a Rabobank branch and whether banks should know what is stored in their boxes given possible money laundering. The minister declined to discuss the ongoing criminal case, explained the Wwft anti-money-laundering duties and DNB supervision, and said he will review with DNB whether the rules need tightening.
In consultation with DNB I will examine to what extent it is necessary to pay further attention to the application of the existing rules in the Netherlands
In overleg met DNB zal ik bezien in hoeverre het noodzakelijk is nadere aandacht te besteden aan de toepassing van de bestaande regels in Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Zelfs solide DNB belegt nu riskanter’

MPs Nijboer asked whether DNB's shift into corporate bonds, including high-yield funds, raises risk, whether ESG standards are weaker, and whether the State pressured DNB to protect the dividend. The minister answered that the bond stake is about 1 billion of 18.5 billion euros, diversification keeps portfolio risk stable, ESG requirements are comparable to equities, and the State had no role in investment decisions beyond the agreed internal guidelines.
Because of the independence of the central bank, the State is not involved in the implementation of DNB's investment policy.
Vanwege de onafhankelijkheid van de centrale bank is de Staat niet betrokken bij de uitvoering van het beleggingsbeleid van DNB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de nieuwe spoorbrug bij Weener

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about delays to the Friesenbrücke rail bridge at Weener, including whether repairs could last until 2030 and what the cross-border travel burden is. The state secretary replied that German partners report the project is on schedule for 2024, that the Dutch side keeps pressing for speedy repair at official level, that about 255,000 cross-border travellers are affected by a bus substitute adding roughly 20 minutes, and that delays stem from German planning procedures.
In various high-level official contacts, the German partners are urged to speed up the repair.
In diverse hoogambtelijke contacten wordt richting de Duitse partners aangedrongen op spoedig herstel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Van Engelshoven stelt 17 miljoen euro beschikbaar voor Gronings erfgoed’

MPs asked whether the government will extend subsidies for mining-damaged national monuments in Groningen to monuments outside the ten earthquake municipalities, and about complaints that NAM damage offers ignore monumental value. The minister answered that monuments outside those municipalities are not eligible for the earthquake-specific subsidies but can use other schemes, and that expert damage assessment remains a principle in the TCMG process.
It is correct that these national monuments are not eligible for the relevant subsidy schemes.
Het klopt dat deze rijksmonumenten niet in aanmerking komen voor de betreffende subsidieregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether ING's proposed pay rise for its CEO fits government views on restrained pay, whether ING still meets standards of social propriety, whether corporate social responsibility and pay played a role in awarding ING the state's banking contract, under what conditions that contract can be terminated, and whether the government would reconsider the contract if the raise went ahead. The minister called the proposal excessive, said pay is the responsibility of ING's supervisory board and shareholders, explained the tender criteria and termination conditions, and noted that ING's board withdrew the proposal; he could not rule out a contract change under the procurement rules.
In my view, the supervisory board's proposal was excessive and thereby undermined the process of restoring trust in the financial sector.
Het voorstel van de raad van commissarissen van ING was – in mijn ogen – buitensporig en deed daardoor afbreuk aan het proces van herwinnen van het vertrouwen in de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het bericht dat de Noorse gevangenen verdwijnen uit Veenhuizen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection what the government will do to keep Norgerhaven prison open after Norway stopped leasing it, and how job security and the regional prison policy in the regulation will be handled. The Minister answered that the decision is still being weighed against total detention capacity, that a vision on prisons will be sent before the summer recess, and that a personnel convenant on job security was signed.
Although I want to dispel this uncertainty as quickly as possible, I cannot yet provide clarity on the precise consequences of this decision for the capacity of Norgerhaven.
Hoewel ik deze onrust zo snel mogelijk wil wegnemen, kan ik op dit moment nog geen duidelijkheid verschaffen over de precieze gevolgen van deze beslissing voor de capaciteit van Norgerhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over dat de fiscus zelden antwoord geeft op zzp vragen

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked why the tax authority rarely answers freelancer (zzp) questions on sham self-employment, as the Bovib claimed 85% go unanswered. The State Secretary replied that the Tax Authority does not track questions per association, that approved model agreements give legal certainty, and that of 8,026 model-agreement requests, 1,808 were approved and 2,810 rejected, with 3,207 closed for non-response.
It is not always simple to give a judgment (self-employed or sham self-employed) based on the information available in an agreement.
Het is niet eenvoudig om altijd aan de hand van de in een overeenkomst beschikbare informatie een oordeel (zelfstandige/schijnzelfstandige) te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over de gevolgen voor bewoners tijdens renovaties

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the minister about tenant rights and living conditions during housing renovations, including temporary housing, compensation for damage, nuisance duration, asbestos, toilet facilities, and tenant participation. The minister answered that tenants have legal rights to compensation and temporary housing where relocation is objectively necessary, that disputes can go to court, and that existing rules suffice, while encouraging agreements between landlords and tenants.
There is therefore an independent procedure for disputes over temporary replacement housing during renovation work.
Er bestaat dus een onafhankelijke procedure voor geschillen over tijdelijke vervangende woon- of verblijfruimte tijdens renovatiewerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over onvoorziene fiscale gevolgen van de bevingsschade

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether unclear tax treatment of Groningen earthquake damage compensation, including immaterial damage and house value loss, creates uncertainty and how it is taxed for individuals and businesses. The government answered that such compensation is generally not taxable income for private persons, may count in Box 3 wealth depending on use, explained business relocation rules, and promised a publication on the Tax Administration website.
The intention is to include on the Tax Administration website a publication setting out the tax treatment of the compensation schemes.
Het voornemen is om op de website van de Belastingdienst een publicatie op te nemen waarin de fiscale behandeling van de compensatieregelingen is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Ex-staatsbedrijf ASR gooit salarissen aan de top met tonnen omhoog'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about ASR's sharp executive pay rise shortly after the state sold its last shares, including whether the government will act against it and whether bonuses return. The minister says the state is no longer a shareholder, the supervisory board and new shareholders must judge pay, he will send a letter on ING pay and sector accountability measures, and no pay commitments were made after full privatisation.
Because I am no longer a shareholder, I do not decide on the level of pay of the ASR management board.
Omdat ik geen aandeelhouder meer ben, ga ik niet over de hoogte van de beloning van de raad van bestuur van a.s.r.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de omvang en de beloning van de directie van NWB Bank

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the expansion of the NWB Bank executive board to three people, its pay levels, the pay norms and whether it is proportionate to the bank's size and risk profile. The minister answered that the board has been three-member since 1993 apart from 2008-2011, listed 2016 pay figures, and said the pay policy follows the state-participation framework and was revised in 2015 with shareholder approval.
NWB Bank will publish its 2017 annual report on 19 April 2018, in which the board's 2017 remuneration can be consulted.
De NWB Bank zal op 19 april 2018 haar jaarverslag 2017 publiceren waarin de beloning van de directie in 2017 te raadplegen zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Dreigend huisartsentekort in Oost-Groningen: Reden om je zorgen te maken’

MPs Dijksma and Nijboer asked the Minister about reports of a looming GP shortage in East Groningen, including ways to make setting up a practice more attractive, reducing administrative burden, contact with insurer Menzis and local partners, and other regions at risk. The Minister said the problem is regional and complex, pointed to a planned study with the LHV, administrative burden measures and a planned programme, and offered continued contact with local parties.
I am willing to stay in continuous contact with these parties about the bottlenecks they experience and the solutions they apply in practice.
Ik ben bereid doorlopend contact te houden met deze partijen over de ervaren knelpunten en de oplossingen hiervoor die zij in de praktijk toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Ronnes en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Peking pleegt coup bij verzekeringsreus Anbang’

MPs Ronnes (CDA) and Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about reports of a Chinese state takeover of Anbang, the owner of Dutch insurer Vivat, and what this means for Dutch supervision, capitalisation, possible capital outflows, state aid and policyholder protection. The minister answered that DNB supervises Vivat under Dutch law, that Vivat has repaid loans to Anbang and may not lend to or guarantee its shareholder without DNB consent, and that policyholders face no consequence, though he had no information beyond the media on the Chinese intervention.
I have no further information on the intervention by the Chinese insurance supervisor CIRC at Anbang beyond what is known from the media.
Ik heb geen nadere informatie over de interventie van de Chinese toezichthouder op de verzekeringssector CIRC bij Anbang dan in de media bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over legionella in een wooncomplex is Amsterdam Zuidoost

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of the Interior about Legionella contamination in a housing complex in Amsterdam Zuidoost, its health risks, the timing of disinfection, and temporary sanitation for residents. The Minister replied that the housing corporation Rochdale had installed legionella filter showerheads, disinfection was scheduled for 29 March with temporary toilets provided, and no further action by the government was currently warranted.
The GG&GD saw no reason for further action on its part.
De GG&GD zag geen reden voor verdere actie van haar kant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het versoepelen van de bonuswetgeving voor flitshandelaren

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the AFM may decline to enforce the bonus cap for flash traders and whether this undermines parliament's legislation. The minister explained the AFM's non-enforcement until end-2019 as a justified exception to the duty to enforce, while stating the proposal only continues an existing exemption and that he will not take irreversible steps pending a parliamentary motion.
The AFM has therefore decided not to enforce compliance with the bonus cap until and including 31 December 2019.
De AFM heeft daarom besloten naleving van het bonusplafond niet te handhaven tot en met 31 december 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Geldspoor miljardenfraude met cryptomunten leidt naar ING’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports linking ING to Tether, the crypto-related firm allegedly involved in large-scale fraud, including why banks ended relations, bank due diligence duties, consumer protection and international enforcement. The minister answered that DNB and the AFM supervise banks' compliance and that DNB cannot comment on ING's case due to confidentiality, while committing to consult credit card companies and to bring crypto exchanges within a regulatory framework.
DNB cannot make statements about that, given its statutory duty of confidentiality.
DNB kan daar, met het oog op haar wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht, geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het bericht 'Gasloos vergt nieuwe regelgeving'

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether existing regulation hinders municipalities in the energy transition, whether the Omgevingswet delay and the Motion Vos-Van Veldhoven on CO2-neutral land-use strategies are being acted on, and whether the Bro and Bouwbesluit should be amended. The minister answers that legislation will be adapted (Wet voortgang energietransitie, Warmtewet, Bouwbesluit change), that municipalities can already act via the Chw experiment, but declines to amend the Bro or Bouwbesluit in the proposed way.
I therefore currently see insufficient possibilities to amend the Bro in the proposed way.
Ik zie op dit moment dan ook niet voldoende mogelijkheden om het Bro op de voorgestelde wijze aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over de houding van de NAM bij een arbitragezaak

MPs asked the minister whether he still trusts NAM to handle Groningen damage claims fairly after NAM refused fresh damage photos and sought a counter-expertise in an arbitration case already assessed at tens of thousands of euros. The minister replied that he and the Groningen Commissioner of the King monitor NAM's handling of old claims closely and trust the independent Arbiter Bodembeweging, to which NAM has committed.
For individual damage cases in procedure before the Arbiter Bodembeweging, I have confidence in the working method and independent judgment of the Arbiter.
Voor individuele schadezaken die in procedure zijn bij de Arbiter Bodembeweging geldt dat ik vertrouwen heb in de werkwijze en het onafhankelijke oordeel van de Arbiter.
