Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Fiscus negeerde Europees verbod op afspraken’

Member Nijboer (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a press report claiming the tax authority ignored a European ban on rulings, and about how concern financing structures and their tax treatment evolved. The State Secretary answered that the headline was incorrect and corrected, explained the shift from the CFA regime and the evolving transfer pricing view, and said he is committed to fighting tax avoidance.
I have made the fight against tax evasion and tax avoidance a priority of my policy.
Daarom heb ik de strijd tegen belastingontduiking en belastingontwijking tot een speerpunt van mijn beleid gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanhoudende DDoS-aanvallen op Nederlandse banken en de Belastingdienst

MPs asked the Finance ministers about recent DDoS attacks on Dutch banks and the Tax Authority, including whether data was leaked, how perpetrators are investigated, what measures banks take, whether DNB supervises payment availability, and what the government will do to keep access to money and tax filing secure. The government answered that the attacks caused temporary outages but no data breach or direct financial loss, described a suspect arrested, listed existing protective measures and DNB supervision, and said vigilance will be maintained.
There is no danger to the personal data of customers and/or taxpayers or to the security of their data and money, and there has been no data breach.
Er is geen gevaar voor de persoonsgegevens van klanten en/of belastingplichtigen of voor de veiligheid van hun gegevens en geld, en er is geen sprake geweest van een datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de positie van woongroepen voor ouderen

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior about the position of senior co-housing groups, including whether housing corporations selling such properties should be required to protect their continuity and whether the government will act on this. The Minister acknowledged their social value but said existing local agreement and consultation rules are sufficient and declined a national role, while promising no concrete new action.
At present I see no role for the national government to steer in such local matters.
Daarbij zie ik op dit moment geen rol voor de rijksoverheid om in dergelijke lokale aangelegenheden sturend op te treden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over bouwvertragingen in Bedum

An MP asked the minister about construction delays in Bedum caused by disputes with NAM over the extra costs of earthquake-resistant building, and whether NAM should be replaced by public steering. The minister said a new-build scheme with compensation for reasonable extra costs exists, that the developer's own concept falls outside it, and that no overview of delays is available since municipalities supervise construction.
The realisation of new-build projects and the application of building regulations take place under the supervision of the individual responsible municipalities.
Antwoord 6, 7 De realisatie van nieuwbouwprojecten en de toepassing van bouwregelgeving vindt plaats onder toezicht van de afzonderlijke verantwoordelijke gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over piratenzenders

MPs Nijboer and Van den Hul asked about unlicensed pirate radio stations, rising fines, and whether the hobby could be tolerated or recognised as cultural heritage. The government defended enforcement by Agentschap Telecom on grounds of spectrum scarcity, safety and environmental harm, pointed to legal alternatives, and declined to endorse the heritage call.
The fining policy is aimed at stopping illegal activities or sharply reducing them.
Het boetebeleid is erop gericht om illegale activiteiten te doen stoppen dan wel sterk te doen verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de zorgen van bewoners van de Kustwegflats in Delfzijl

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about residents' concerns over earthquake safety and poor information in three Kustweg flats in Delfzijl, including whether the flats are safe and whether residents can see inspection reports. The minister says the Dijkzicht flat was assessed in 2015 with no acute danger but non-structural parts need securing, that the owner corporation Acantus has informed residents, and that the other two flats are still to be assessed pending NCG research.
Reinforcement advice is always shared with the owner of the home.
Versterkingsadviezen worden altijd gedeeld met de eigenaar van de woning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Lijst taksparadijzen halveert’

An MP from the PvdA asked the Finance Ministry why several jurisdictions were removed from the EU blacklist of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions, why the grey list is not public, and what sanctions are planned for listed countries. The State Secretary referred to the Ecofin report for the delisting reasons, said the grey list is publicly available only in the Council conclusions and that Nederland wants more transparency, and described the agreed mix of fiscal and non-fiscal countermeasures while promising a separate letter on the wider approach.
I refer you for an answer to these questions to the report of the Ecofin Council of 23 January.
Ik verwijs voor een antwoord op deze vragen naar het verslag van de Ecofinraad van 23 januari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Waar zijn de miljoenen voor de gezonde Veenkoloniën gebleven?’

MPs Dijksma and Nijboer asked the state secretary where the ten million euros for health measures in the Veenkoloniën went, whether bureaucracy hindered spending, and what health goals were set. The state secretary replied that EUR 3.5 million of the EUR 10 million has been spent on regional projects under the Kans voor de Veenkoloniën programme, that no signals of bureaucratic obstruction were received, and that results are too early to assess.
Currently EUR 3.5 million of the reserved EUR 10 million has been spent.
Er is momenteel € 3,5 miljoen van de gereserveerde € 10 miljoen besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Van Tongeren en Beckerman over de NAM-uitspraken en technische mogelijkheden voor het verminderen van gaswinning

MPs Nijboer, Van Tongeren and Beckerman asked the minister about NAM's claim that no additional safety measures were needed after a tremor, that the code red was wrongly issued, and about options to reduce Groningen gas extraction and exports of low-calorific gas. The minister defended SodM's assessment that the earthquake fit expected patterns, and outlined short-term limits and longer-term options to reduce gas demand, while declining to direct NAM's communications.
However, I do not decide on the way NAM presents its figures, reports and letters.
Ik ga echter niet over de wijze waarop NAM zijn cijfers, rapporten en brieven presenteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurders in Groningen die in de steek worden gelaten

MP Nijboer asks whether it is acceptable that Groningen housing corporations and tenants face prolonged uncertainty over earthquake reinforcement procedures and standards, and whether the government will provide clarity and hold corporations accountable for neglected maintenance. Minister Ollongren answers that clarity is a priority, that the norm changes only when NEN makes significant improvements, that tenants can pressure corporations through existing channels, and that she is in talks with corporations, though the minister's role on specific maintenance complaints is limited to setting the framework.
The central government is therefore making every effort to remove the resulting uncertainties, for housing corporations and other stakeholders, as quickly as possible.
Het Rijk spant zich dan ook in om de ontstane onduidelijkheden, voor woningcorporaties en andere betrokkenen, zo snel mogelijk weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het bericht dat een huiseigenaar alleen wil verhuren aan ‘mensen van Nederlandse afkomst'

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether a landlord refusing to rent to people not of Dutch origin is discrimination, what victims can do, and what measures will prevent it, including whether estate agents should refuse such requests and whether the sector will be engaged. The minister answered that discrimination is prohibited, pointed to the Equal Treatment Act, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and local anti-discrimination services, noted the brokerage associations' codes of conduct, and said the issue will be raised in upcoming consultations with the sector.

In the upcoming consultations with the brokerage associations and the umbrella organisations of private landlords I will discuss whether enough attention is being paid in practice to preventing discrimination.

In de eerstvolgende overleggen met de brancheverenigingen voor makelaars en de koepelorganisaties van particuliere verhuurders zal ik in gesprek gaan over of er in de praktijk voldoende aandacht is om discriminatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over contourenlijnen in het aardbevingsgebied

Nijboer and Beckerman asked whether the administrative contour lines should still determine damage assessment and reinforcement of homes in the Groningen earthquake area, and why different building norms apply outside the contour. Minister Wiebes answered that NAM is liable regardless of location, a new damage protocol without NAM's role is being negotiated, the NPR applies inside the area while outside it additional norms add no value, and he declined to comment on an individual court case.
Intensive consultation is currently taking place among all parties on a new damage protocol in which NAM no longer plays a role in assessing damage reports.
Op dit moment vindt intensief overleg plaats tussen alle betrokken partijen over een nieuw schadeprotocol, waarin NAM geen rol meer speelt in de beoordeling van schademeldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over het bericht “Echtpaar kraakt droomhuis om sloop te voorkomen”

MPs asked the minister about a couple who squatted a characteristic farmhouse in Middelstum to prevent its demolition by NAM, and whether NAM's demand that they leave within two days was acceptable. The minister said the couple left for safety reasons, that the future of the building is separate, that heritage preservation is a key principle and NAM has pledged to work toward keeping the house, and that a state housing company will be set up to manage acquired property.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aardbeving in ‘t Zandt

An MP asked the Economic Affairs Minister about a 3.4 magnitude earthquake near Zeerijp, the number of new damage reports, whether listed heritage buildings could be demolished faster by NAM, where damage can be reported, and acceptable timelines for repair. The minister confirmed the quake, reported about 2,900 new damage reports, rejected faster demolition, described reporting channels, and said a new damage protocol is the top priority without giving a firm date.
Accelerating demolition is however not in line with the principle in damage repair and reinforcement that characteristic and landmark buildings should be preserved as far as possible.
Het versneld overgaan tot sloop is echter niet in lijn met het uitgangspunt bij schadeherstel en versterking dat karakteristieke en beeldbepalende gebouwen zoveel mogelijk behouden dienen te blijven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Nijboer over de waarschuwing van AFM voor digitale beursgangen (ICO’s)

MPs Paternotte and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about the AFM warning on ICOs, including whether the regulator can do more than warn, how ICOs work, which rules apply, and how investors are warned. The minister answered that the warnings are appropriate, that many ICOs fall outside financial supervision law, that consultation with AFM and DNB took place, and that he sees no need for further measures beyond existing warnings.
The supervisory authorities informed me in advance about the publication of these warnings.
De toezichthouders hebben mij van tevoren geïnformeerd over de publicatie van deze waarschuwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over beschimmelde huizen in Bedum en Groningen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about long-term residents in mouldy, poorly ventilated social rental homes in Bedum and Groningen, and how long this is acceptable. The minister answered that landlords are responsible for repairs, pointed tenants to the complaints committee, Huurcommissie, courts and building supervision, and said the corporations are acting with tenants, without intervening in the individual case.

In general terms the Minister's role is to set the framework, and it is not appropriate to intervene in such a case in advance, given the various legal options and obligations that exist to remedy the problem.

In algemene zin is de rol van de Minister kaderstellend en past het op voorhand niet om te interveniëren in een dergelijke casus, gelet op de diverse wettelijke mogelijkheden en verplichtingen die er zijn om de problematiek te verhelpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat overwaarde moeilijk te gelde te maken is

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that home equity is hard to access for older homeowners with low incomes, including whether they must move, why few providers offer equity-release mortgages, and the effect of phasing out the Hillen scheme. The minister answered that equity can be released through interest-only mortgages, individual affordability assessments and other options, that competition is sufficient though equity-release providers are few, and that the Hillen phase-out is unlikely to force sales.
I consider it important that seniors have sufficient options to release equity from their homes.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat senioren voldoende mogelijkheden hebben om overwaarde vrij te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gevolgen van gaswinning in Drenthe

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Drenthe residents affected by gas extraction and storage damage have the same rights and damage protocol as Groningen residents, and how NAM's handling of claims and the planned compensation fund are progressing. The minister says all Dutch citizens have the same civil-law right to compensation, that the Tcbb was asked to advise on a uniform protocol and an independent claims body before year-end, and that the Groningen protocol is stalled pending agreement on a new one with NAM stepping back.

I have asked the Technical Committee on Soil Movement (Tcbb) to explore the option of setting up an identical damage protocol for the rest of the Netherlands for damage caused by mining, handled by an independent body.

Ik heb de Technische commissie bodembeweging (Tcbb) gevraagd om de optie te verkennen om voor de rest van Nederland een gelijkluidend schadeprotocol in te richten voor schade veroorzaakt door mijnbouw met een onafhankelijk orgaan dat de schade afhandelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat niet alle rulings worden uitgewisseld

MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority is failing to exchange all tax rulings with international partners, as required, and how many rulings have been exchanged. The State Secretary denies any intent to withhold information, explains that about 4,000 relevant rulings were identified through file review, says a letter on the status will follow in early 2018, and points to EU and OECD peer-review enforcement mechanisms.
I will inform the House by letter in early 2018 about the status of the exchange of ruling information within the EU and OECD.
Ik zal uw Kamer begin 2018 door middel van een brief informeren over de stand van zaken ten aanzien van de rulinguitwisseling in EU- en OESO-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht dat de export van Gronings gas verder stijgt

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether rising exports of Groningen gas were undesirable, whether they conflict with the Chamber's wish to end export contracts early, and for export forecasts and full disclosure of export contracts. The minister replied that export volumes follow physical demand abroad, that no new export contracts have been signed since 2014, and that forecasts fall to zero by 2030, but declined full disclosure of the contracts as commercially confidential.
Since these contracts are concluded between private parties and also contain commercially confidential information, I do not intend to make them public.
Aangezien deze contracten zijn gesloten tussen private partijen en daarnaast ook bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie bevatten, ben ik niet voornemens deze openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurtoeslag in familiesituaties

An MP asked whether parents renting a home to their child in order to claim housing benefit (huurtoeslag) is acceptable and how it could be prevented. The minister said the rules allow family landlords, that the Tax Administration monitors rent levels, and that a family-specific ban would violate equal treatment, so no rule change is planned.
However, I see no feasible options to adjust the housing benefit scheme so that such a construction within the legal framework is made impossible specifically for family situations.
Ik zie echter geen uitvoerbare mogelijkheden de huurtoeslagregeling zo aan te passen dat een constructie binnen de wettelijke kaders specifiek voor familiesituaties onmogelijk wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de consument nog steeds ten onrechte kosten betaalt aan verhuurmakelaars

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether letting agents still charge tenants illegal intermediary fees, why enforcement is lacking, and what tenants can do. The minister confirmed the legal ban, said tenants can reclaim fees within five years, and noted the ACM supervises compliance and has acted against agents in the past.
I do not have figures on the number of intermediaries who wrongly charge, whether or not disguised, intermediary fees.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van de aantallen bemiddelaars die ten onrechte al dan niet verkapte bemiddelingskosten in rekening brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het gemak waarmee men als belastingconsulent aangemerkt kan worden

Nijboer asked whether obtaining a tax-consultant registration number (becon) from the Tax Authority is easy, whether it implies reliability, and whether consultants can file returns and claim allowances without authorisation, and what data and safeguards apply. Staatssecretaris Snel answered that the becon is only a registration number that signals nothing about quality, that authorisation is needed for some actions, that data rules apply, and that action is taken against lookalike commercial websites, while declining to add minimum quality or background-check requirements.
The becon number indeed says nothing about the reliability or expertise of a tax consultant or administration office.
Het beconnummer zegt inderdaad niets over de betrouwbaarheid of deskundigheid van een belastingconsulent of administratiekantoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over pesticide die schadelijk zijn voor baby’s

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether a Nature study linking pesticide exposure to premature births and birth defects applies to the Netherlands, and whether Dutch research and protective measures are planned. The minister answered that she had taken note of the study and referred all substantive questions to a separate letter on the status of research into pesticide effects on residents near agricultural fields.
I refer you to my letter on the status of research into the effects of crop protection products on residents living near agricultural fields.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn brief met onderwerp: Stand van zaken van het onderzoek naar de gevolgen van het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen voor omwonenden van agrarische percelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over onderhoud van huurhuizen in Groningen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked about housing corporations in Groningen halting maintenance on rental homes, the use of foam insulation on roofs, and tenants being left to live in unsafe, poorly maintained homes during the earthquake-reinforcement operation. The ministers answered that tenants can raise maintenance with corporations, the Huurcommissie, the municipality, or the kantonrechter, that the government acknowledges delays and will consult the region on reinforcement and sustainability.
Tenants can also turn to the municipality if deferred maintenance leads to insufficient structural quality.
Ook kunnen huurders zich tot de gemeente wenden als achterstallig onderhoud ertoe leidt dat de bouwtechnische kwaliteit onvoldoende lijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het mogelijke baanverlies bij Tata Steel

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about job losses and the independence of Tata Steel Nederland after its planned merger with ThyssenKrupp, including whether the merger should be blocked if it involves forced layoffs. The minister said the government supported a strong IJmuiden position and would monitor developments closely, but would not block the merger, relying on a workforce pact and natural attrition to limit layoffs.
Banning the merger is not on the table, but I will bring Dutch interests to the attention of the Tata Group management where necessary.
De fusie verbieden is niet aan de orde, maar ik zal waar nodig de Nederlandse belangen onder de aandacht brengen van de directie van Tata Group.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting

Asscher and Nijboer asked the Prime Minister whether Shell, Akzo Nobel, Unilever and Philips lobbied for abolishing the dividend tax, how the formation archive was handled, and what the effects on SMEs, housing corporations and the investment climate would be. The government answered that it talks regularly with business, that the contacts are confidential, that the formation archive contains only the listed documents, and that the effects of abolition are uncertain and not quantified in detail.
My interlocutors must be able to rely on our conversations being in principle confidential.
Mijn gesprekspartners moeten erop kunnen rekenen dat onze gesprekken in beginsel vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het faillissement van Aldel

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the bankruptcy of aluminium producer Aldel, including job protection, subsidies, regional investment funds and private equity practices. The minister said the government generally does not intervene in individual firms, pointed to UWV support for workers and the expected takeover by York Capital, and declined to comment on Klesch's investment and tax choices.
I do not have broad insight into the choices and underlying motives regarding Klesch Group's investments, nor into the use of fiscal and legal options involved with those investments.

Ik heb geen breed inzicht in de keuzes en achterliggende motieven ten aanzien van de investeringen van Klesch Group, noch in het gebruik van fiscale en juridische mogelijkheden die met die investeringen gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over schade door zoutwinning en gaswinning bij Veendam, Muntendam, Hoogezand, Tripscompagnie en Borgercompagnie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about compensation for damage from salt and gas extraction in several villages near Veendam and Hoogezand, and about oversight of cumulative subsidence. The minister answered that subsidence-related damage is not expected, that the Tcbb independently reviews claims, that SodM supervises cumulative subsidence limits, and that a national damage protocol is being explored with advice due in December 2017.
I have asked the Tcbb to explore the option of establishing a uniform damage protocol for the whole of the Netherlands for damage caused by mining, with an independent body handling the damage.

Ik heb de Tcbb gevraagd om de optie te verkennen om voor heel Nederland een gelijkluidend schadeprotocol in te richten voor schade veroorzaakt door mijnbouw met een onafhankelijk orgaan dat de schade afhandelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over zogenaamd ‘Slimme deals van farmaceuten’

An MP asked the health minister whether the US pharmaceutical firm Allergan's transfer of Restasis patents to a Native American tribe, which blocks patent challenges, is unethical and what the government will do about it. The minister explained the US mechanism, said the case has not been tested in court, and stated it is not possible in the Netherlands, so no action is needed.
I therefore see no need or opportunity to act against this.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak en gelegenheid om hiertegen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over drempels bij het gebruik van de blijverslening

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether the blijverslening (a municipal-backed loan for home adaptations for seniors) is excluding people with only a small AOW or pension who have home equity, and how many municipalities use the scheme. The minister answered that loan limits are set by income norms and that 59 municipalities offer the loan, and that the SVn is developing a new product for low-income seniors expected in mid-2018.
This product is expected to be offered to municipalities around mid-2018.
Dit product zal naar verwachting medio 2018 aangeboden worden aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de winst die op de handel in geneesmiddelen wordt gemaakt

An MP asked the health minister about Advent's alleged extraction of half a billion euros and a 61 million dollar loan from pharmaceutical wholesaler Mediq, the resulting drop in solvency, and risks to medicine supply. The minister replied that the wholesale and pharmacy businesses were sold before the payout, that Mediq no longer plays a role in medicine supply, that supply continuity was never at risk, and that private profit-making is a matter for company law.
There is therefore in fact no payout to Advent that was extracted from a pharmaceutical wholesaler.
Er is daarom feitelijk geen sprake van een uitkering aan Advent die is onttrokken aan een farmaceutische groothandel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het beëindigen van de collectieve zorgverzekering voor minima door zorgverzekeraar Zilveren Kruis

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked whether Zilveren Kruis ending its collective health insurance contracts for low-income people in three municipalities undermines solidarity and whether the government will intervene. The state secretary answered that contracts are extended one year where no alternative exists, that insurers must accept everyone but need not offer collectives, that municipalities choose their own instruments, and that VWS is not a party to negotiations but has spoken with the insurer.
Health insurers have the social duty to insure all Dutch residents, but not the obligation to accept everyone for all collectives.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben de maatschappelijke taak om alle Nederlanders te verzekeren, maar niet de verplichting om iedereen voor alle collectiviteiten te accepteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over monumenten in het aardbevingsgebied

An MP asked the ministers whether the NAM has bought listed farmhouses and other heritage buildings in the Groningen earthquake area, what will happen to them, and how unlisted characteristic buildings are protected from demolition. The minister answered that NAM owns eight listed monuments plus 74 objects in total, that municipalities are still inventorying characteristic buildings, and that protection runs through zoning plans and a heritage programme, without committing to new state powers.
At this moment it is not known whether this portfolio also contains characteristic and/or defining buildings.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend of zich in deze portefeuille ook beeldbepalende en/of karakteristieke gebouwen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de afhankelijkheid van farmaceutische bedrijven

An MP asked the health minister about pharmaceutical companies' influence on paediatric prescribing, including deals linking drug purchases to research funding, conflicts of interest and a growth-hormone director's dual role. The minister said the IGZ will assess the case as a complaint and await the supervisors' findings, pointed to existing rules on gifts, advertising and governance, and said transparency has been increased since 2012.
The IGZ has committed to treating this case as a report and will assess it, request further information and investigate further if necessary.
De IGZ heeft mij toegezegd deze casus als melding te behandelen en zal deze beoordelen, nader informatie opvragen en zo nodig verder onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over websites als zorgtoeslag.nl en mijntheorieaanvragen.nl

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about commercial intermediary websites such as zorgtoeslag.nl and mijntheorieaanvragen.nl that resemble government sites and charge more than official services. The government answered that such intermediaries are not prohibited if they are not misleading, that legal instruments exist against deceptive sites, and that the Tax Office and CBR send warning letters and can take legal action.
When commercial websites look too much like government websites, action is taken against the sites concerned.
Als commerciële websites teveel lijken op overheidswebsites wordt actie ondernomen richting de desbetreffende sites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over een buitensporige ontslagvergoeding voor een ziekenhuisdirecteur en beloningen van medisch specialisten in het Noorden

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked about a severance payment of over a quarter million euros to a hospital department head at Nij Smellinghe, whether the WNT pay cap allows buying out waiting-benefit entitlements, and why medical specialists in the north earn above the Balkende norm. The minister answered that the individual severance cases fall to the accountant and the WNT supervisor (CIBG), that no change to the WNT is planned, and that medical specialists were removed from the WNT's scope from 1 July 2017, so their pay is no longer published.
A severance payment to a non-top official is not capped under the WNT, because the WNT only caps the pay and severance of top officials.
Een ontslagvergoeding aan een niet-topfunctionaris wordt niet genormeerd in het kader van de WNT, omdat de WNT alleen de bezoldiging en ontslagvergoedingen van topfunctionarissen normeert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Accountants moeten sneller hervormen”

Labour MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister about criticism by Everts that audit firms implement promised quality improvements too slowly, that their business model fails to serve the public interest, and that team composition hampers audit quality. The minister replies by referring to the AFM report on quality at audit firms (Kamerstuk 34 677, nr. 7), without answering the questions in substance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de rol van een ondernemingsraad na een doorstart bij faillissement

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice Minister whether a Supreme Court ruling extends works council advisory rights to bankruptcy sales and going-concern takeovers, and whether it requires advice before a doorstart and helps prevent abusive dismissals. The minister confirmed the ruling applies WOR advisory rights to continuation or doorstart of bankrupt businesses where jobs may be preserved, but not to liquidation by the curator, and said the topic will be addressed in the faillissementsrecht reform programme with a fuller update due in September.
I will inform you further on this subject in mid-September, in the next progress letter on the bankruptcy law renewal programme.
Ik zal u medio september, in de volgende voortgangsbrief van het programma herijking faillissementsrecht, nader over dit onderwerp informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de matige loongroei en flexibilisering

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked the Minister of Social Affairs about moderate wage growth, whether labour market flexibilisation explains it, and whether research and action on flexibility, pensions and insurance for self-employed workers are warranted. The minister said wage growth is moderate mainly because of unused labour supply and that there is no one-to-one proof linking flexibility to wages, and promised to consult the CPB and DNB on whether additional research is needed.
I will discuss this with the CPB and DNB and examine whether additional research is needed.
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met het CPB en DNB en bezien of aanvullend onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over vrouwen in blijf-van-mijn-lijfhuizen die verstrikt raken in bureaucratische regelgeving

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the state secretary whether women fleeing domestic violence get stuck in bureaucratic rules, such as signing forms, needing a partner's consent for children's help, the briefadres, the kostendelersnorm, urgentie and independent client support. The state secretary responded that he is grateful for the Ombudsman's report and will prepare a policy response with relevant parties, to be sent in the GIA progress report, without answering the specific questions on substance.
The report of the National Ombudsman provides important starting points for further improvement.
Het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman biedt belangrijke aanknopingspunten voor verdere verbetering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Oplichtersnetwerk roofde ongestoord tientallen miljoenen”

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers how a network defrauding private investors through investment schemes could operate undetected for years, what victims can recover, and whether the AFM and prosecution have enough resources. The minister answered that prosecution and AFM action were taken in specific cases (Centurion, Hollandsche Wind), that the AFM's powers over exempt offerings are limited, and that enforcement and prevention are adequate, with planned tightening of the exemption threshold.
I cannot provide information on the number of victims and the amount of damage per individual case.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over het aantal gedupeerden en de omvang van de schade per individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over OneCoin en OneLife

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about OneLife and OneCoin, a multi-level marketing scheme suspected of being a pyramid game, and whether authorities are investigating it. The Finance Minister answered that virtual currencies fall outside supervision, that the assessment is for regulators, prosecutors and courts, and declined to give participant numbers or confirm ongoing Dutch investigations.
No statements are made about any ongoing investigations in the Netherlands.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken in Nederland worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het artikel “Het kostte veel meer tijd dan ik dacht”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a pilot for a new permanent education model for accountants, including whether courses like Spanish or articulation can count, and whether dropping minimum hours weakens the system and how the NBA fulfils its public-interest role. The minister said the pilot is positive but not yet evaluated, that the NBA must supervise compliance, and that enforcement via a regulation and disciplinary action will be introduced with the new model.
The NBA board has not yet carried out a final evaluation of the whole pilot because it is still running, so no definitive decision has been taken on whether to introduce the new model.

Het bestuur van de NBA heeft echter nog geen eindevaluatie over de totale pilot gedaan omdat deze nog loopt en daarom ook nog geen definitieve beslissing genomen over de wenselijkheid om het nieuwe model in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Groningen nog 400 zwaardere aardbevingen te wachten staat

MP Nijboer asked the minister about a report predicting 400 more severe earthquakes for Groningen and whether the damage would be overwhelming. The minister replied that the Hagoort method is a simplified version of NAM's assessment, its outcomes fall within NAM's range, and that a NAM damage methodology report is due by 1 November 2017, after which further policy will be decided.
Depending on these outcomes, I will determine whether additional policy is needed and, if so, how this will be shaped.
Afhankelijk van deze uitkomsten bepaal ik of er aanvullend beleid nodig is en zo ja, hoe dit wordt vorm gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over ernstige gezondheidsklachten bij medewerkers van het AZC in Ter Apel

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the State Secretary and Health Minister about health complaints among COA staff at the Ter Apel asylum centre, including calls for deeper investigation and doubts about soil research. The State Secretary answered that 17 staff are currently on sick leave, that an independent commission of external experts has been set up to investigate the causes, and that soil studies found no contamination capable of causing the complaints.
The COA board has decided to set up an independent investigation committee with external experts.
Het bestuur van het COA heeft besloten tot het instellen van een onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie met externe deskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de uitzending van Radar over te hoog berekende boeterente

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Radar broadcast alleging banks miscalculate early-repayment penalties on mortgages, and whether banks apply the AFM guideline and disclose the data needed for customers to check it. The minister answered that the MCD rules and AFM guideline are in force, banks committed to follow the guideline and compensate customers, and the AFM will examine compliance in Q4 2017 with enforcement possible.
The AFM will investigate in the fourth quarter of this year whether lenders indeed adhere to the new standards.
De AFM zal in het vierde kwartaal van dit jaar onderzoeken of kredietverstrekkers zich inderdaad houden aan de nieuwe normen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het voortbestaan van de Kindertelefoon

An MP asked the state secretary about the future of the Kindertelefoon and AKJ after the transitional funding from 388 municipalities expires, and whether their tasks should be organised nationally. The state secretary agreed the services should be national, concluded the state will take responsibility from 2018 through a fund withdrawal from the municipal fund, and promised to legislate as soon as possible.
Therefore in 2018 I will ensure the continuity of the Kindertelefoon, AKJ and Sensoor.
Daarom zal ik in 2018 zorg dragen voor continuïteit van de Kindertelefoon, AKJ en Sensoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Ons land ‘witwasrisico’”

The MP Nijboer asked the ministers of Finance and Justice about a Transparency International report finding that the Netherlands still lags on beneficial ownership transparency and whether they would adopt its recommendations, plus questions on bank and trust-office client screening, foreign trusts, UBO registration, and a ban on dealing with shell companies. The government answered that most recommendations are already covered by pending legislation and EU negotiations, declined to commit to some (e.g. public access to the shareholder register, extending UBO registration to foreign entities), and noted existing supervision and sanctions.
The draft bill aims to fully align Dutch rules on bearer shares with FATF international standards.
Het concept-wetsvoorstel beoogt de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving met betrekking tot aandelen aan toonder volledig in lijn te brengen met de internationale standaarden van FATF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de schadeafhandeling in Groningen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the handling of earthquake damage claims in Groningen, including halted repairs, the closing of the old claims procedure, slow or inadequate settlements in specific villages, the NAM's 1,500 euro offer, and an independent damage commission. The minister mostly answers that individual cases cannot be discussed publicly, that a new procedure starts on 1 July 2017, and that details of the new independent commission are not yet settled.
It does not befit me as Minister to publicly exchange views with the House of Representatives on the details of individual damage cases.
Het past mij als Minister niet om in het openbaar met de Tweede Kamer van gedachten te wisselen over de details van individuele schadegevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Jan Vos over het initiatief van de Stichting Meent van der Sluis voor de oprichting van Het Andere Monument

Three MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a proposed monument ('Het Andere Monument') for victims of Groningen gas-extraction earthquake damage, including municipal land availability and funding for a youth work-learning project. The minister confirmed awareness, expressed appreciation, noted the National Coordinator Groningen mediated, and said the Social Affairs minister would explore a work-learning route.
The Minister of SZW will explore the possibilities for a work-learning project and will contact the foundation about it.
De Minister van SZW zal de mogelijkheden voor een leer-werktraject onderzoeken en daarover in contact treden met de stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Aandeleninkoop optie voor ABN Amro”

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO seeking shareholder authorisation to buy back shares, whether this concerns NLFI shares, the bank's capital buffers, and what the government will do to prevent buffers from being lowered. The minister answered that the authorisation is a standard, capped (10%) buy-back mandate that still requires prior supervisor approval, that capital is currently well above requirements, and that DNB supervises buffers while the government pursues a 4% leverage ratio.
In addition, prior approval from the supervisor must always be obtained before shares are actually bought in practice.
Daarnaast dient altijd voorafgaande toestemming van de toezichthouder te worden verkregen voordat in de praktijk aandelen zouden worden ingekocht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gokcriminelen in het betaald voetbal

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about illegal gambling syndicates influencing Dutch professional football, including a press report on a footballer drawn into gambling and the status of the Feniks investigation. The minister answered that the Feniks investigation is complete, no players or officials are suspected of match-fixing in a related case, and the KNVB has taken prevention measures.
The criminal investigation Feniks has been concluded.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek Feniks is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het testen van medicijnen

An MP asks the Health Minister about pharmaceutical companies testing drugs in poor countries, including ethics and oversight of such trials, available sanctions, and reports of pressure on critics. The State Secretary says ethics is a national competence, describes EU GCP-based inspections that can lead to refusal or suspension of licences, and says he has no insight into pressure on critics though finds it unacceptable.
Ethics is par excellence a national competence, not culturally transferable, and the EU Treaties also establish this as such.
Ethiek is bij uitstek een nationale bevoegdheid en niet cultureel overdraagbaar en in de Verdragen van de Europese Unie is dit ook als zodanig vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het bedrijf moet blijven. FNV voert actie: Ziegler aan de ketting’ van RTV-Noord

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked about the planned relocation of part of Ziegler's fire-engine production from Winschoten to Croatia, its effect on fire-service readiness, union negotiations, jobs and procurement criteria. The minister answered that fire-service procurement and negotiations are matters for the safety regions and employers and unions, that no signals of reduced readiness exist, that about twenty of roughly 75 jobs are affected, and that general employment policy and UWV support apply.
Negotiations over whether to relocate business activities are a matter for employers and employees.
Onderhandelingen over het al dan niet verplaatsen van bedrijfsactiviteiten zijn een zaak van werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht «Omstreden belastingdeals tussen fiscus en multinationals openbaar»

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports on controversial tax arrangements between the tax authority and multinationals, why an analysis of common rulings was not sent to parliament, whether risky arrangements will stop, and what effect this has on Dutch reputation. The answer refers the MP to an earlier letter on the same subject rather than answering the questions on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de uitzending van Argos over flitskredieten

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a broadcast on flash-credit lender Ferratum, which offers loans from the UK at very high rates, and how Dutch consumers are protected. The minister said the AFM's powers over foreign online lenders are limited under the country-of-origin principle, and announced that flash credit will be designated under the advertising ban so the AFM can act, with monitoring of effectiveness.
The power to designate financial products is assigned to the AFM so that the supervisor can intervene quickly if necessary.
De bevoegdheid tot aanwijzing van financiële producten wordt neergelegd bij de AFM zodat, indien nodig, snel kan worden ingegrepen door de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘boeterente aan banden’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that mortgage lenders still charge excessive early-repayment penalties, and whether affected consumers are compensated. The minister said lenders will compensate post-14 July 2016 overpayments under AFM guidance, that pre-July 2016 cases must go to Kifid or courts, and that the AFM will investigate compliance.
The AFM will investigate in the second half of this year compliance with the rules on early repayment costs and will enforce if providers violate the law.
De AFM gaat in de tweede helft van dit jaar onderzoek doen naar de naleving van de regels over de kosten bij vervroegde aflossing en treedt handhavend op als aanbieders de wet overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over de aankoop van een huis zonder financieringsvoorbehoud of bouwtechnische keuring

MPs Nijboer and De Vries asked whether buyers are increasingly dropping financing and building-inspection conditions to compete for homes, and what risks and remedies exist. Minister Plasterk answered that such conditions are advisable, that data is limited, that brokers should advise against risky bids, and that the government will research the scale of the problem before considering further steps.
The cabinet will therefore conduct research into the scale of this problem and will consider follow-up steps based on the outcomes.
Het kabinet gaat daarom onderzoek verrichten naar de omvang van deze problematiek en zal aan de hand van de uitkomsten vervolgstappen overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Onderzoek witwas via geldautomaat’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports of money laundering through cash machines run by shopkeepers, including opaque exchange margins and whether YourCash is supervised. The minister answered that such machines need no licence under the Wft, DNB supervises euro note recirculation rules and bank clients, and the issue would be shared through the FEC without committing to a new investigation.
The exact exchange margins applied are not known to me. In principle, no supervision is exercised over exchange margins or choice menus.
De exacte wisselmarges die worden gehanteerd zijn mij niet bekend. Op wisselmarges of keuzemenu's wordt in beginsel geen toezicht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Bank is voortaan vaag over kapitaaleis'

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB asked banks not to disclose their total capital requirement, how the legal minimum differs from the guidance buffer, and whether supervisors can enforce extra capital and whether guidance should be enforceable or mandatorily published. The minister denied that the ECB asked banks to withhold guidance, explained that guidance is advisory unless converted into a hard Pillar 2 requirement, and said Dutch authorities will raise publication and communication issues in EU negotiations.
The ECB, however, did not ask the banks not to disclose the guidance.
De ECB heeft de banken echter niet verzocht om de guidance niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Yücel en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Armsten opgelicht’

MPs Recourt, Yücel and Nijboer asked the ministers about reports that bailiffs at BSR charged duplicate costs to vulnerable debtors, and what oversight, compensation and action would follow. The minister declined to prejudge the pending tuchtrecht case, said BFT oversight is risk-based and sufficient for now, that creditors should be compensated as far as possible via the bankruptcy estate, and that ACM and AFM are acting against malafide collection agencies.
It does not befit me to anticipate a case that is still before the court.
Het past mij niet vooruit te lopen op een zaak die nog onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over rentemiddelen bij Finqus

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Finqus, the successor name of the bankrupt DSB, should offer its mortgage customers interest-rate averaging and whether the minister would engage the curators to make it do so, given the bank's profits and remaining customers. The minister replied that Finqus has decided not to prioritise rate averaging, that the minister will only encourage it to offer the option, and that creditor repayment and the bank's results are reported by the curators.
Because I consider it important that the provider puts the customer first, I will draw Finqus's attention to the desirability of offering rate averaging.
Omdat ik het belangrijk vind dat de aanbieder de klant centraal zet, zal ik Finqus attenderen op de wenselijkheid om rentemiddeling aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Swapgeld duurt even'

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether waiting times of up to 1.5 years for swap compensation at Rabobank and other banks are acceptable, and whether the government will ensure all victims receive a reassessment in 2017. The minister answered that the pilot phase was extended for careful implementation, that Rabobank may need into 2018 while other banks expect to finish in 2017, and that the AFM supervises the process and banks are expected to offer redress to all clients by year end.
The AFM supervises the proper application of the recovery framework by banks.
De AFM houdt toezicht op de goede toepassing van het herstelkader door banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de versterkingsoperatie die nu ineens tien jaar kan gaan duren

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked why the Groningen reinforcement operation now may take ten years instead of five, whether residents are left in uncertainty too long, how many homes must be reinforced, and why the new compensation scheme took a year. The minister replied that the approach has the support of all administrative parties, that a block-by-block inspection-then-reinforcement method is used with work starting in Q4 2017, and that the total scope and resident displacement cannot yet be determined, deferring to ongoing inspections.
No statement can currently be made about the scope of the total reinforcement task.
Over de omvang van de totale versterkingsopgave is op dit moment geen uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Cegerek over het bericht 'Drie Chinezen blijven over in strijd om Attero'

MPs Nijboer and Cegerek asked about the 2013 sale of waste processor Attero to private equity firm Waterland, including dividends, environmental aftercare obligations and whether the sale price was too low. The state secretary answered that competition supervision applies as for any concentration, environmental aftercare is handled by the provinces, the sale was a decentralised decision, and a Zuidelijke Rekenkamer inquiry is due in May 2017.
The agreements form part of the confidential sale agreement.
De afspraken zijn onderdeel van de vertrouwelijke verkoopovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de positie van de aandeelhouder bij faillissementen

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about shareholders' position in bankruptcies, including debt-financing of firms, shareholder-creditors, pre-pack sales and carve-outs for suppliers. The government answered that the issues will be examined within the WCO I-III reform programme and a consultation draft is planned for summer 2017, while declining to assess specific cases.
It is not for us (as Ministers of Finance and Justice) to assess specific practical situations and to state whether employees or creditors may have been harmed.

Het is niet aan ons (als Ministers van Financiën en Veiligheid en Justitie) om specifieke praktijksituaties te beoordelen en ons uit te spreken over de vraag of werknemers of schuldeisers daarbij mogelijk zijn benadeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Nijboer over het klimaatbeleid van banken

MPs Jan Vos and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about poor climate scores of Dutch banks, their climate commitments, supervision and standards for non-financial reporting. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said banks should be more transparent and do more, and pointed to existing platforms and EU rules, committing to support international standards and to an accountant audit of non-financial information.
Unambiguous and enforceable international standards for presenting non-financial information, without too much discretion, would be an important step forward.
Eenduidige en afdwingbare internationale standaarden voor de weergave van niet-financiële informatie, zonder te veel vrijheidsgraden, zouden een belangrijke stap voorwaarts zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het niet oplossen van schade door de NAM in Termunterzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about NAM's refusal to resolve damage to a house in Termunterzijl, including whether it is linked to gas extraction, the family's forced relocation on NAM's advice, and reversal of the burden of proof. The minister declined to go into substance because of pending litigation against NAM and the State, noted rising non-earthquake damage reports, and said the burden-of-proof bill is pending in the Senate with entry into force expected before year-end.

A court case concerning this file is pending before the Northern Netherlands District Court, in which NAM and the State are defendants. Against that background I will not go into the substance of this file.
Over dit dossier is een procedure aanhangig bij de rechtbank Noord-Nederland, waarin NAM en de Staat zijn gedaagd. Tegen die achtergrond ga ik niet inhoudelijk in op dit dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het KNMI, dat aardbevingen niet goed zou registreren

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the KNMI misrepresents Groningen earthquakes by naming quakes after the nearest village, so that eleven quakes are attributed to Garmerwolde rather than Groningen city, and whether this distorts regional spread and should be corrected. The minister answered that the KNMI never claimed only one quake hit Groningen city, that the naming procedure was changed on 1 December 2016 to use municipal boundaries, and that the regional picture is unaffected since analyses use coordinates.
On 1 December 2016 the KNMI retroactively introduced a new naming procedure that looks at the distance between the epicentre and a municipal boundary.
Op 1 december 2016 heeft het KNMI met terugwerkende kracht een nieuwe naamgevingsprocedure geïntroduceerd waarbij wordt gekeken naar de afstand tussen het epicentrum en een gemeentegrens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘ABN Amro-adviseurs in de fout met hypotheken’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ABN AMRO advisers copied client signatures to close mortgage files without clients' knowledge, and about disciplinary consequences, supervisory policy and adviser pay. The minister confirmed the supervisors were notified and an internal investigation started, called the director's remark on client harm unfortunate, said the bankers' oath disciplinary regime may apply depending on timing, and described the bank's pay structure and the commission ban.
Because of their duty of confidentiality, the supervisors make no further statements about their role in this investigation.
De toezichthouders doen vanwege hun geheimhoudingsplicht geen verdere mededelingen over hun rol bij dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de bemoeienis van NAM met bouwprojecten in Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the minister whether NAM's involvement in new-build projects in Groningen, including the absence of a new-build scheme in the multi-year programme, causes delays and should be curbed. The minister answered that the NPR 9998 standard is being made legally binding, that a revised new-build scheme will be proposed by year end, and that the NCG is discussing NAM's role with NAM and municipalities, without committing to stop NAM's involvement.
The draft multi-year programme 2017–2021 provides that a revised scheme must be established, agreed with the administrative and societal steering committee.
In het concept Meerjarenprogramma Aardbevingsbestendig en Kansrijk Groningen 2017–2021 is opgenomen dat een herijkte regeling tot stand dient te komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Fiscus legt ABN Amro forse naheffing op’

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about reports that the tax authority imposed a EUR 142 million additional assessment on ABN AMRO over two structured finance entities kept off its balance sheet, and about cum/ex dividend tax practices under German investigation. Minister Dijsselbloem declined to discuss the individual case citing tax secrecy, said the consolidation question is for the accountant and separate from tax liability, and stated that tax assessments are not negotiable though contact with the tax authority exists.
The Tax Authority is bound by a tax secrecy obligation. Therefore I cannot make any statements about actions the Tax Authority does or does not take regarding individual taxpayers.

De Belastingdienst kent een fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht. Derhalve kan ik geen mededelingen doen over de handelingen die de Belastingdienst al dan niet uitvoert ten aanzien van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Overname levert NXP-topman 391 miljoen op’

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Minister of Finance about reports that the NXP executive would receive about 391 million euros from the takeover, questioning the pay level, short-termism, pay ratios, possible repayment of about 50 million euros in subsidies, variable pay limits, and whether the Tang-Irrgang conflict-of-interest rules apply. The government replied that it has no opinion on the amount, points to existing corporate governance code rules and pending EU and Dutch legislation on pay transparency, explains that NXP received 96 million euros in innovation subsidies with no grounds for repayment, notes financial-sector pay rules differ from other sectors, and states the conflict-of-interest provision in Article 2:129a BW bars executive directors from deciding on their own pay.
Reclaiming the subsidy is therefore not an issue.
Terugvordering van subsidie is daarom niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Creditcardbedrijf van ABN gaf klanten te veel krediet’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ABN AMRO subsidiary ICS extended excessive credit to card customers for at least five years, charging up to 14% interest. The minister confirmed the AFM's investigation, stated that breaching a bank's own norms does not automatically breach the statutory duty of care, noted that ICS is preparing customer compensation, and said the AFM supervises creditcard providers risk-based and will focus on whether credit matches customer needs.
On that basis the AFM started a formal investigation, since the earlier irregularities and the reported incidents together point to serious violations.
Daarop is de AFM een formeel onderzoek gestart, aangezien de eerdere onregelmatigheden en de melding van incidenten tezamen duiden op ernstige overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de berichten ‘Curator stapt vaker de ring in’ en ‘Pandrechten leiden tot meer rechtszaken bij faillissement’

Two MPs asked whether creditors, especially banks holding pledges, are unfairly privileged in bankruptcy, whether curators are pressured, and whether shareholders misuse bankruptcy to take over assets and shed staff. The minister answered that pledge holders have legitimate priority under existing law, that worker protections exist via UWV, that curators have a central role in any doorstart, and that the issues will be addressed in the forthcoming WCO III bill after consultation with interest groups.
Within the bankruptcy law review programme, work is underway on a proposal for the Business Continuity Act III (WCO III).
Binnen het programma herijking faillissementsrecht wordt gewerkt aan een voorstel voor de wet continuïteit ondernemingen III (de WCO III).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Van Dekken en Nijboer over Het bericht 'Lijmklassieker blijft een succes' en de problemen met de Europese regelgeving

Three PvdA MPs asked the government whether new EU limits on lead migration in children's toys and paints, which they claimed make paint production impossible, are justified and whether the government has acted on such regulation. The Minister of Health answered that the limit is a migration limit that is 340 times stricter than the drinking water standard, that production is not made impossible, that no cases of EU rules burdening entrepreneurs are known, and that no action has been taken because there is no reason to.
No. The limit value for migration of lead in this type of toy is currently 3.4 mg/kg.
Nee. De grenswaarde voor migratie van lood in dit type speelgoed is op dit moment 3,4 mg/kg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Yücel over het terugtreden van de enige vrouw in de RvB van ABN AMRO

MPs Nijboer and Yücel asked the government about the departure of the only woman on ABN AMRO's management board, the gender diversity shortfall in the financial sector, and what the state as shareholder will do to reach the 30 percent target. The minister answered that the state will press ABN AMRO to nominate a woman, has asked NLFI to discuss diversity measures, and points to the reinstated statutory target and monitoring in 2019.
If a board does not meet the target, I as shareholder request that the company make an effort to nominate a woman.
Indien een raad niet voldoet aan het streefcijfer, vraag ik als aandeelhouder een inspanningsverplichting van de onderneming om een vrouw voor te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Nijboer over hulp bij pinnen voor mensen met een beperking

MPs Volp and Nijboer asked whether ING's new security policy, which requires a companion when a customer with a disability withdraws cash, conflicts with the Dutch disability equality law and the UN Convention. The State Secretary answered that banks set their own security rules, that the Wgbh/cz obliges providers to make effective adjustments with the College voor de Rechten van de Mens judging specific cases, and that the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer will discuss accessibility.
The College voor de Rechten van de Mens can investigate whether there is prohibited discrimination and whether article 2 has been violated.
Het College voor de Rechten van de Mens kan onderzoeken of er sprake is van verboden onderscheid en of er in strijd met artikel 2 is gehandeld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de invloed van NAM op bouwprojecten  in Groningen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM is interfering in new construction projects in Groningen, causing delays and overreaching on design and location, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister acknowledges the NAM compensation schemes and that the Boterdiep parking-garage project was delayed, says an exception was made after mediation by the National Coordinator Groningen, and states that delay is undesirable and that the NCG is working to revise the scheme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over de beloningen bij de Bank Nederlandse Gemeenten

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Finance Minister about the high pay of BNG Bank's board chair, the 2009 pay policy, and whether semi-public banks should pay less. The minister said the 2009 policy applies only to newly appointed board members, that a new policy cutting the maximum to EUR 301,000 was adopted on 5 October 2016, and that state holdings are private companies whose pay must reflect specialist labour markets.
For the level of pay of the chair and other members of the board of BNG Bank, I refer you to the public annual reports of BNG Bank.
Voor de hoogte van de beloning van de voorzitter en overige leden van de rvb van BNG Bank verwijs ik u naar de openbare jaarverslagen van BNG Bank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Koers Deutsche Bank fors onderuit na weigering miljardenschikking met Amerikaanse justitie’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that Deutsche Bank faced a multi-billion settlement demand from US justice over RMBS sales, and whether this threatens its capital position and Dutch banks. The minister answered that the settlement is a matter for US authorities, that Deutsche Bank meets minimum capital requirements though faces structural challenges, and that the government sees no direct threat to Dutch banks while stressing the importance of strict supervision.
It is up to the American authorities to reach arrangements with banks that in their jurisdiction are reported to have carried out activities that did not comply with the applicable rules.
Het is aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten om regelingen te treffen met banken die in hun jurisdictie activiteiten zouden hebben ontplooid die niet strookten met de toepasselijke regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de berichten 'Europa botst met VS over zwaardere regels voor banken,' en 'Niet vreemd dat het wringt tussen Europa en VS'

The MP asks whether the Dutch government will push for stricter Basel bank capital rules and a higher leverage ratio, given US-EU disagreement and DNB's stance against a significant rise in capital requirements. The Minister answers that Basel reforms aim to improve internal-model risk weights rather than broadly raise capital, that Netherlands will seek a leverage ratio of at least 4%, and that EU deviations from Basel (e.g. sovereign bond treatment) will be addressed later, without committing to a specific new DNB intervention.
The aim of these reforms is not to further substantially raise capital requirements across the board.
Het doel van deze hervormingen is niet om over de hele linie de kapitaaleisen verder fors te laten stijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Nijboer over het bericht ‘België verbiedt cfd's en binaire opties voor particulieren’

MPs Ronnes and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether Belgium's ban on marketing CFDs and binary options to consumers applies to EU-passported firms, how many complaints the Netherlands has received, and whether the Netherlands will follow suit. The minister confirmed the Belgian rule covers cross-border firms, reported about 50 complaints since 2014, and committed to work with the AFM on a comparable advertising ban for the Netherlands ahead of MiFID II.
I consider it appropriate to introduce in the Netherlands a ban comparable to the Belgian or French situation.
Ik acht het opportuun om een met de Belgische of Franse situatie vergelijkbaar verbod ook in Nederland te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat banken maar beperkt inzetten op rechten van werknemers in hun relaties met grote bedrijven

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a report finding that major Dutch banks do too little to promote workers' rights among large corporate clients, and whether they meet OECD guidelines. The minister acknowledged mixed results, endorsed the report's call for more active banking engagement, and pointed to the IMVO covenant and ongoing dialogue, without committing to new binding measures.
My ministry is in dialogue with the banks in various places and ways on corporate social responsibility.
Mijn ministerie is op verschillende plekken en manieren met de banken in dialoog over maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de NAM die niet meer wil samenwerken met een onafhankelijk contra-expertisebureau

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM may end cooperation with the independent counter-expertise firm Vergnes Expertise, and whether this undermines residents' trust and calls for moving damage assessment to the NCG. The minister answered that NAM stopped reimbursing new Vergnes counter-expertises after failed quality improvement talks, that NAM may terminate such private contracts without NCG consent, and that the NCG will take a supervisory role over the CVW.
It is important that experts deliver quality and that residents are adequately helped.
Het is van belang dat experts kwaliteit leveren en dat bewoners adequaat worden geholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over ‘de Groninger Bodembeweging en het Groninger Gasberaad, die niet meer praten met Nationaal Coördinator Groningen’

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about Groningen residents' refusal to talk with the National Coordinator Groningen over the NAM damage protocol, including the rise in rejected c-damage claims, NAM's and CVW's influence, and the damage contour line. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to ongoing audits and research due in early 2017, and agreed to individually assess claims without a contour line, though he declined to give the NCG the power to set the protocol itself.
The damage protocol, established by NAM, is intended to achieve rapid and low-threshold handling of damage claims by the CVW.
Het schadeprotocol, dat is vastgesteld door NAM, is bedoeld om tot snelle en laagdrempelige afhandeling te komen van schadeclaims door het CVW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het validatieonderzoek van de TU Delft

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a TU Delft validation study finding that NAM's Arcadis-based damage contour around the Groningen gas field is not tenable, and whether NAM and the CVW will drop it and compensate damage outside it. The minister agreed the contour is not tenable, said NAM and CVW accept that all reported damage must be assessed individually via a pilot overseen by an independent steering committee, and said a supervisory role for the NCG on the CVW will be detailed later.
Based on the results of the TU Delft study, the NCG concludes that the damage contour set by NAM is not tenable and all reported damage must be individually assessed.

Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de TU Delft concludeert de NCG dat de door NAM vastgestelde schadecontourlijn niet houdbaar is en alle aangemelde schade alsnog individueel moet worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Bankiers schikken Euribor-fraude' en het bericht Tuchtrecht banken werkt niet'

An MP asked the Minister of Finance whether the Dutch Securities Institute's light fines (750 to 3,000 euro) for Rabobank bankers in the LIBOR/EURIBOR scandal and the low number of royements show that self-regulatory discipline in banking fails. The minister defended the self-regulatory disciplinary system as serving different functions from criminal law, noted the new benchmark-manipulation rules and AFM powers, and declined to comment on the tribunal's independent judgments while promising no new structural change.
For the handling of the case by the DSI Disciplinary Committee and the DSI Appeals Committee, I refer to the answer to question 5.
Voor de behandeling van de zaak door de Tuchtcommissie DSI en de Commissie van Beroep DSI verwijs ik naar de beantwoording van vraag 5.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Spaarpolis verzekeraar ongedekt’

Nijboer asked whether mortgage savings products backed by insurers are really savings, and why deposit guarantee (DGS) protection applies to bank savings mortgages but not insurer-based ones. The minister explained that only deposits fall under the DGS, that insurer-based savings mortgages are not deposits and so are excluded, and that he sees no reason to assume consumers are confused about the difference.
Only deposits are eligible for protection under the deposit guarantee scheme (DGS).
Alleen deposito’s komen voor bescherming door het depositogarantiestelsel (DGS) in aanmerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over schade aan huurwoningen door gaswinning

MPs asked why housing corporation Woongroep Marenland refuses to repair gas-extraction damage to tenants' homes in Appingedam and what the minister and the NCG will do about it. The minister declined to comment on an individual case, citing a pending court dispute, but reported that the damage was repaired under NAM supervision and during an NCG inspection, and agreed tenants must be taken seriously.
As a rule I do not go into individual cases. There is a conflict between a tenant and a housing corporation involving a pending court ruling.
In de regel ga ik niet in op een individuele casus. Er is hier sprake van een conflict tussen een huurder en een woningcorporatie waarbij een gerechtelijke uitspraak aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over grote persoonlijke problemen bij doorlopende kredieten

An MP asked the Finance Minister about consumers trapped in long-running revolving credit from Interbank, including whether they were properly informed, how many are affected, whether lenders may refuse to refinance, and whether variable rate increases are permitted. The minister answered that such 'locked-up' situations arise from combined circumstances, that the AFM has required lenders to review portfolios and restructure credits, and that the minister expects providers to offer suitable solutions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Nijboer over het bericht “Nog geen uitspraken vanwege schending bankierseed”

MPs Mei Li Vos and Nijboer asked why the banker's oath disciplinary Tuchtcommissie had issued no rulings a year after its introduction, why 43 of 57 complaints were rejected by the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken, and how franchisees denied access to their credit files and loan information could be protected. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the first year was a transitional period without retroactive effect, that rejected complaints were civil disputes for Kifid or the courts, that six complaints are pending with first rulings expected late 2016, and that DNB and AFM are investigating how banks implement the oath.
An adequate procedure at the Stichting Tuchtrecht Banken appears to be assured.
Een adequate procesgang bij de stichting Tuchtrecht Banken lijkt geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Oud-bankier Dirk Scheringa maakt comeback via lege beurshuls’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the reverse listing of CS Factoring via the listed shell company Lavide, and its possible exemption from the prospectus requirement, is desirable and adequately informs investors. The Minister answered that the AFM assesses case by case whether the conversion exemption applies and whether investors are adequately informed, and that the AFM will ensure this.
It is up to the AFM to assess case by case whether the exception applies.
Het is aan de AFM om van geval tot geval te beoordelen of de uitzondering van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Van slachtoffer naar schuldige”

An MP (Nijboer, PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about reports that victims of bank card fraud are often left uncompensated, questioning whether banks refuse payment too readily on grounds of gross negligence and whether the Kifid complaints body applies the law correctly. The minister answered that banks almost always compensate victims, that the burden of proof of gross negligence lies with the bank, and that new PSD2 rules will reduce the customer's liability and set a one-business-day refund period.
I do not have figures showing what share of the fraud losses from debit and credit card fraud banks have compensated to victims.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers die inzichtelijk maken welk deel van de opgetreden fraudeschade als gevolg van betaalpas- en creditcardfraude de banken aan de gedupeerden hebben vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ontwikkelingen aangaande kredietunies in Nederland

MPs Nijboer asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the role of credit unions in SME lending, subsidy targeting, unregulated bodies calling themselves credit unions, banks acting as intermediaries, and regional or sectoral focus. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that credit unions are small, that subsidies are not split by model, that AFM oversees crowdfunding intermediaries using the name, and that banks' conditions are case-specific without committing to new action.
