There is no reason to prohibit these initiatives from calling themselves a credit union.
Er is geen reden om deze initiatieven te verbieden om zich kredietunie te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht dat de alternatieve arbeidsinkomensquote momenteel relatief laag is

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the government about DNB's finding that the alternative labour income share is currently low, its historical position, the role of self-employment, and whether wages lag productivity. Minister Asscher answered that the measures differ mainly due to bank mortgage profits and self-employed income treatment, that a longer series and a common method are needed, and that wage-setting is for social partners, while the government will keep urging them to use available wage room.

I therefore follow with interest the hearing on wage developments and the labour income share to be held after the recess at the initiative of MP Voortman, and I invite the parties involved to agree on a uniform method for presenting the labour income share.

Ik volg dan ook met interesse de hoorzitting over de ontwikkeling van de lonen en het AIQ die op initiatief van het lid Voortman zal plaatsvinden na het reces, en nodig de betrokken partijen uit om met een uniforme methode te komen om de AIQ te presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Nieuwe tegenvaller Staat bij verkoop Vivat’

The MP asks the Finance Minister about reports of a new setback for the State in the sale of Vivat, including a pension agreement and the repayment of subordinated loans. The Minister confirms the pension indexation settlement (EUR 117.5 million in total, of which SRH owes EUR 81.7 million to Vivat), describes the loan repayment and the liability cap of EUR 150 million, but gives no clear answer on the supervisory role.
What role has the supervisor played in this?
Wat is de rol van de toezichthouder geweest in deze?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Schikking over derivaten stuit op onwil banken’

An MP from the PvdA asks the Finance Minister about reports that banks resist a commission's proposal to settle interest-rate derivative mis-selling claims collectively, including the reported settlement amounts, whether banks will cooperate, and the role of the AFM. The minister replies that independent experts are drawing up a uniform redress framework, that concrete figures were not shared with him, that banks are still in talks and have committed to the process, and that the AFM lacks legal power to enforce redress.
Concrete proposals have not been shared with me.
Concrete voorstellen zijn niet met mij gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het wel produceren van rapporten maar niet repareren van de schade

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM and the Centrum Veilig Wonen produce costly reports without repairing gas-damage, including claims of 25,000 euro in reports, that these exceed the actual damage, and that they rarely call back. The minister declined to discuss the individual case in detail, said agreement had been reached so repairs can start, noted the CVW is improving its communication, and said handling speed depends on repair complexity.
It does not befit me as Minister to go into the details of an individual damage case at length.
Het past mij als Minister niet om uitgebreid in te gaan op de details van een individueel schadegeval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over schadetaxaties door het Groninger Taxatie Bureau

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about allegations that the Groninger Taxatie Bureau, acting for the Centrum Veilig Wonen, routinely rejects earthquake damage claims, makes counter-expertise dependent on NAM-set limits and underreports damage, and whether NAM and CVW prioritise keeping compensation costs low. The minister denied these allegations, stating that experts follow the NAM protocol and Handboek Aardbevingsschade, that residents may choose a counter-expert and the Arbiter Aardbevingsschade, and that he has no signals of a gap between management and the workfloor.
No. The resident is free to choose their own counter-expert, who is paid by the CVW at a set hourly rate.
Nee. De bewoner is vrij om zelf een contra-expert te kiezen die wordt betaald door het CVW volgens een vastgesteld uurtarief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht "DNB zet deur op kier voor eigen koers bankenbuffer"

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports that DNB may ease bank capital buffer requirements if mortgage risk weights rise under Basel reforms. The minister replies that the Basel trajectories are still pending, that he sees no automatic link between systemic buffers and those reforms, and that capital requirements will remain firm.
I therefore see no direct or automatic link between the level of the systemic buffers and the reforms being worked on in the Basel Committee.
Ik zie daarom geen directe of automatische relatie tussen de (hoogte van de) systeembuffers en de hervormingen waar in het Bazelse Comité aan wordt gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Chinese muur’ vertoont gat'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch rules separating audit and advisory work for listed companies are circumvented when foreign affiliates of Dutch audit firms advise audit clients' foreign subsidiaries, and whether the rules should be reconsidered. The minister answered that Dutch law covers only Dutch-linked advice, that foreign affiliates' advice to foreign subsidiaries is not covered and not circumvention, and that EU Regulation 537/2014 from 17 June 2016 will ban such services for EU-based affiliates, so auditor independence is sufficiently safeguarded.
With the entry into force of the aforementioned regulation on 17 June 2016, additional rules will apply to foreign network members of audit firms that provide advisory services.

Met de inwerkingtreding van voornoemde verordening met ingang van 17 juni 2016 zullen aanvullende regels van toepassing worden voor buitenlandse netwerkonderdelen van accountantsorganisaties die adviesdiensten verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over gezondheidsklachten als gevolg van meervoudige mijnbouwschade

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about health complaints linked to repeated gas-extraction damage in Groningen, the RUG Gronings Perspectief findings, and how policy would respond. The minister confirmed the interim findings, said the NCG already prioritises relieving affected residents and will use the results to improve procedures, and declined to speculate on the study's final conclusions about underlying causes.
In response to this report, the NCG has already indicated that the results will be used to improve the damage protocol and the working method of the Centre for Safe Living (CVW) in that respect.
In reactie op dit rapport heeft de NCG reeds laten weten dat de resultaten zullen worden benut om het schadeprotocol en de werkwijze van het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW) in dat opzicht te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de waardedalingsregeling

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Groningen value-decline compensation scheme applies in some municipalities but not Oldambt, whether value-increase rules also exclude Oldambt, and about the status of a motion for a similar scheme. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the value-increase scheme now covers all earthquake damage above 1,000 euro, said the motion will be considered in the spring memorandum, and justified the value-decline geographic boundary by a CBS study of housing-market functioning.
The cabinet will take this motion into account in the decision-making for the spring memorandum and will then inform the House of Representatives about it.
Het kabinet betrekt deze motie bij de besluitvorming in het kader van de voorjaarsnota en zal uw Kamer hierover vervolgens informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de renteopslagen die banken in rekening brengen aan huiseigenaren bij het toepassen van rentemiddeling van 29 maart 2016

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether early-repayment penalty interest on mortgages, including rate-averaging charges, may include opaque surcharges and whether components and calculation must be transparent. The minister answered that penalties must reflect the lender's actual financial loss, that transparency is required, and that the AFM will oversee compliance under the Mortgage Credit Directive and may issue further rules if needed.
The customer's interest must be central when calculating the penalty interest.
Het belang van de klant moet bij de berekening van de boeterente centraal staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Jacobi en Nijboer over afvalwater van NAM in de Waddenzee

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about media reports that NAM would discharge treated production water into the Wadden Sea via the Eems, and why NAM does not simply choose the purification-and-discharge option. The minister replied that the re-injection alternatives are still under evaluation with a decision expected in December 2016, that composition monitoring classifies the injection water as non-hazardous, and that he does not recognise the portrayal of NAM as cost-evading.
The supervisory committee's task is to check whether the research process is transparent and that the questions and concerns in the region are taken into account in the study.
De begeleidingscommissie heeft als taak om te controleren of het onderzoeksproces transparant verloopt, en dat de vragen en zorgen die leven in de regio worden meegenomen in het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Sparen buiten eigen land blijft risicovol’

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about savings held at foreign banks through Dutch intermediaries, including the risks, deposit guarantee coverage, and possible malicious intermediaries. The minister answered that intermediaries must be licensed and disclose risks under AFM rules, that DNB and AFM supervise compliance, and that the revised EU deposit guarantee directive reduces the chance the state must step in.
There are no reports identifying how much savings, in volume and number, reaches foreign banks via intermediaries active in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen rapportages die identificeren hoeveel spaargeld, zowel qua omvang als aantal, via bemiddelaars actief in Nederland bij buitenlandse banken terecht komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de afhandeling van meldingen van aardbevingsschade door het Centrum voor Veilig Wonen (CVW) buiten de contour

Three PvdA MPs asked why claims for earthquake damage outside the damage contour are not being processed by CVW while a validation study is pending, and whether registration and provisional payments could proceed now. The minister replied that NAM's Arcadis study finds such damage negligible, that an independent validation is due around summer and the minister will inform parliament then, and that NAM will visit all reporters but wants the validation results first; a judgement now would almost certainly mean rejection.
I will inform your House at that moment.
Ik zal uw Kamer op dat moment informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Nijboer en Groot over het bericht dat de heer Meerstadt per direct opstapt als commissaris bij ABN AMRO

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked the Finance Minister about the sudden resignation of ABN AMRO supervisory board member Meerstadt after Panama Papers reports, and whether undisclosed offshore interests should be disclosed and checked in suitability tests. The minister answered that the resignation was unplanned, Meerstadt denies involvement, disclosure rules apply, and tax authorities will use the Panama Papers information, but declined to assess whether further information can be provided.
The Tax Authority will use the information from the Panama Papers to detect possible tax fraud.
De Belastingdienst zal de informatie uit de Panama Papers gebruiken om eventuele belastingfraude op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de afschaffing van de contourenregeling

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he welcomed NAM director Schotman's call to abandon the contour map (contourenkaart) for gas-extraction damage, and how this fits with the proposed evidentiary presumption law that still relies on the earthquake contour. The minister answered that NAM must compensate damage regardless of location, that the map plays no role, and that the presumption is limited to the Groningen field effect area because a broader presumption would be disproportionate.
The bill aims to strengthen the evidentiary position of those harmed, without leading to a disproportionate situation.
Het wetsvoorstel beoogt de bewijspositie van benadeelden te versterken, zonder tot een onevenredige situatie te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat DNB zich verzet tegen hogere kapitaalbuffers voor banken

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether he agrees that bank capital buffers should be raised further, whether DNB's opposition to this in international fora is inappropriate, and about DNB's views on internal models and Basel Committee proposals. The minister answers that buffers have already been raised and further steps are needed, defends the internal-model reforms and the Basel process, and declines to confront DNB on its lobbying while setting out the Basel agenda in a separate letter.
Yes. Have you taken note of the report 'DNB does not give up fight against buffers'?
Vraag 1 Hebt u kennisgenomen van het bericht «DNB geeft strijd tegen buffers niet op»?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over de aankondiging van ING om te stoppen met het aanbieden van hypotheken voor woonboten

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether ING's decision to stop offering mortgages for houseboats, leaving only Rabobank, would harm buyers and owners and what would be done about it. The minister confirmed the decision, said existing customers are unaffected, and said the market is complex and new entrants may appear, with consultation of the Dutch banking association planned.
Consultation will be held with the Dutch Banking Association and they will be asked whether they have ideas on how more providers of houseboat mortgages can enter the market.

Er zal overleg worden gevoerd met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en worden gevraagd of zij ideeën hebben over hoe ervoor kan worden gezorgd dat er meer aanbieders van woonboothypotheken op de markt kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over banken die niet meewerken aan het oversluiten van een hypotheek waardoor klanten niet van de lage rente kunnen profiteren

MPs Nijboer and Albert de Vries asked the Finance Minister about banks that refuse to help mortgage holders refinance to benefit from low rates, including those with pension or benefit income, and whether banks should be obliged to accept such clients. The minister answered that refinancing can be in the client's interest but depends on individual factors, rejected a duty to accept all refinancing requests as harmful to competition, and described voluntary measures such as rate smoothing and a banking trust monitor, while the AFM had no concrete signals of advisers misinforming clients.
I would therefore not want to advocate that credit providers be obliged to accept a client who wants to refinance their mortgage.
Ik zou er dan ook niet voor willen pleiten dat kredietverstrekkers verplicht een klant moeten accepteren die zijn hypotheek wil oversluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een reclame-event voor accountants dat meetelt als PE-activiteit

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a paid sales event for accountants that carried 5 PE (continuing education) points should be allowed, and whether the NBA should be held to account and the PE system tightened. The minister said the NBA is responsible for PE accreditation, has already reviewed and concluded no PE points could be awarded to this event, and pointed to a planned PE system reform with knowledge tests and a 2016 pilot.
The NBA has the possibility to nevertheless reject individual PE activities.
De NBA heeft de mogelijkheid om individuele PE-activiteiten desalniettemin af te keuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over een snel stijgend aantal beschadigingen aan boerderijen en drainagesystemen door bodemdaling in Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why NAM and the Commissie Bodemdaling dismiss rising damage to farms and drainage systems from subsidence in Groningen as mere settlement damage, whether NAM will pay, and when the Grontmij study is due. The Minister confirmed complaints have risen, explained that the official studies find uniform subsidence with no absolute effect on water levels, noted NAM must pay damage caused by gas extraction, gave a spring 2016 timeline for the study, and pointed to a case-manager arrangement while negotiating with NAM.
Yes, I am aware that the number of damage reports has increased.
Ja, het is mij bekend dat het aantal meldingen van schade is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een Spaans onderzoek naar fraude bij een dochteronderneming van Propertize

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Spanish investigation into fraud at Propertize's Spanish subsidiary PDU, whether Propertize's control of PDU was reported late, and what this means for the planned sale. The minister said the OM was unaware of any Spanish investigation or request, explained the historical consolidation and disclosure of PDU, and said the matter does not affect the sale because it contains no new facts.
The OM has informed me that it is not aware of a Spanish investigation into Propertize or of a request for legal assistance from Spain to the Netherlands in this matter.
Het OM heeft mij te kennen gegeven niet bekend te zijn met een Spaans onderzoek naar Propertize dan wel met een rechtshulpverzoek van Spanje aan Nederland in deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de onderlinge samenwerkingsovereenkomst tussen de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) en het Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW)

Opposition MPs asked the minister whether the cooperation agreement between NAM and the Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW) is public, whether CVW is independent of NAM, and how contra-expertise hours are allocated. The minister said the agreement is private and not public, but was reviewed by the Commission of Toezicht, which found CVW independent and the relationship critical but sound, and promised to amend the damage protocol on contra-expertise.
This agreement is not public, but it has been reviewed by the Supervisory Committee on the Centrum Veilig Wonen, set up by me, in order to assess the working relationship between NAM and CVW.
Deze overeenkomst is niet openbaar, maar wel ingezien door de door mij ingestelde Commissie van Toezicht op het Centrum Veilig Wonen om de werkverhouding tussen NAM en CVW te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over massale schade door gaswinning bij Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about widespread gas-extraction damage in villages near Delfzijl and whether he would press the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen for a fast investigation and speedy settlement. The minister confirmed the reports, said an investigation into the causes of high damage rates at the edges of the earthquake area starts in the first quarter of 2016, and promised attention to speedy, careful settlement of damage claims.

The National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) will start an investigation in the first quarter of this year into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over de gelijke behandeling van aardbevingsschade in alle gemeenten

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether earthquake damage in Oldambt villages such as Nieuwolda, 't Waar and Nieuw-Scheemda mirrors the situation in Delfzijl, and asked the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen to extend its investigation to the whole area. Minister Kamp answered that the NCG will start in early 2016 an investigation into causes of high damage percentages at the edges of the earthquake area, including the municipalities named.

The Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) will start in the first quarter of this year an investigation into the causes of the high percentages of damage cases located at the edges of the earthquake area.

De Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) start in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar met een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de hoge percentages schadegevallen die gelokaliseerd zijn aan de randen van het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij, Kerstens en Nijboer over de oud -eigenaar Sun Capital die mogelijk betrokken is bij een doorstart van V&D

MPs Vermeij, Kerstens and Nijboer asked about former owner Sun Capital's possible role in a V&D going-concern restart after bankruptcy, and whether bankruptcy was misused against staff and creditors. Minister Asscher answered that the court and curators are responsible, that the curators' report will show Sun Capital's role, and that research into works council positions in takeovers will be completed before summer.
It is not for me to make statements about the background to this bankruptcy and the financial situation of the company.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de achtergronden bij dit faillissement en de financiële situatie van de onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het aardbevingsbestendig maken van de chemiesector in Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked why the Groningen National Coordinator's programme lacks a concrete plan for making Delfzijl's chemical sector earthquake-resistant, when it will come and when binding standards will exist. The minister answered that an industry table chaired by the coordinator will develop a joint approach expected in Q1 2016, that a Deltares/TNO guideline exists while standards are still under discussion, and that much of the research lies with industry itself.
Companies and competent authorities will jointly develop, via the so-called Industry Table, a comprehensive approach linking existing and planned methods and studies.
Bedrijven en bevoegde instanties zullen via de zogenaamde Industrietafel samen een sluitende aanpak ontwikkelen, die bestaande en voorgenomen methodieken en onderzoeken verbindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over een verschuiving van de aardbevingen naar de randen van het gaswinningsgebied

MPs asked whether earthquakes are shifting to the edges of the Groningen gas field after production cuts at Loppersum, and whether closure sequencing could worsen the situation and be included in the gas-extraction decision. The minister answered that faults do not move, that quakes in the edge areas follow local pressure decline and production, and that NAM has been asked to optimise production allocation across the field, with SodM supervising the work.

In line with SodM's advice of 1 December 2015, I have asked NAM what the optimal production distribution across the entire field (including the Loppersum area) is, in order to further reduce the risk now and in the future.

Conform het advies van SodM van 1 december 2015 heb ik NAM gevraagd wat de optimale productieverdeling over het gehele veld (inclusief het Loppersumgebied) is, om het risico nu en in de toekomst verder te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Van Dekken, Nijboer over de stremming van het treinverkeer tussen Bad Nieuweschans en Leer

MPs asked the State Secretary about the closure of the rail bridge between Bad Nieuweschans and Leer, its duration, passenger and freight impacts, alternatives, and consequences for the Groningen–Bremen rail project's national funding and EU grant. The State Secretary answered that replacement may take 3 to 5 years, will write to the German counterpart, provides replacement buses, and says funding conditions and the EU study budget are still being assessed.
In the short term I will send my German counterpart a letter drawing attention to the current disruption.
Op korte termijn zal ik mijn Duitse ambtscollega een brief sturen, waarin ik aandacht zal vragen voor de huidige hinder
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een nieuwe, tweede corruptiezaak bij Propertize

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a second corruption case at Propertize (ex-SNS Property Finance), the scope of prior DNB instructions, integrity measures taken, and whether integrity problems caused SNS's failure. The minister confirmed the criminal case and its suspects but declined to give the year or other details, citing prosecution interests, said no information is given on other investigations, described the DNB instruction and Propertize's integrity measures, and refused to comment on the integrity question while the case is before the court.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that, given investigation and prosecution interests, it cannot provide any information on this.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij medegedeeld dat het, gelet op de opsporings- en vervolgingsbelangen, hierover geen mededelingen kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken over de onafhankelijkheid van het Centrum Veilig Wonen

MPs Jan Vos, Nijboer and Van Dekken asked the minister whether the Centrum Veilig Wonen (CVW), which handles earthquake damage claims for NAM, is truly independent of NAM, and raised concerns about the oversight commission, the damage assessment process, pressure towards demolition, the Handboek Aardbevingsschade and the reversal of the burden of proof. The minister replied that NAM remains legally liable, that CVW is operated at arm's length under a tender, that the oversight chair is independent, that damage assessments and contra-expertise are handled properly, and that a bill on a statutory presumption of causation will be submitted after Council of State advice.
I have asked the Council of State for urgent advice on the bill concerning the statutory presumption of evidence.
Ik heb de Raad van State gevraagd om spoedadvies over het wetsvoorstel omtrent het wettelijk bewijsvermoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Monasch over de ondoorzichtige kostenstructuur die banken hanteren bij valutatransacties voor het MKB

MPs Nijboer and Monasch asked the Finance Minister whether banks' cost structures for foreign currency transactions for SMEs are opaque and whether margins reach hundreds of percent. The minister answered that banks say they are transparent and charge fair prices, that the minister has no view of their margins, and that SME clients should compare offers across providers.
I have no insight into the profit margins of banks on foreign currency transactions for SMEs.
Ik heb geen zicht op de winstmarges van banken op valutatransacties voor het MKB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat banken niets willen doen om verkeerde overboekingen te voorkomen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks refuse to act on wrong transfers caused by incorrect IBAN entry and do no name-number checks. The minister answered that customers bear primary responsibility for checking IBANs, banks must help recover misdirected funds (about 80% recovered), and an industry study is planned with the Consumentenbond continuing talks.
If a transfer nevertheless goes to a different number than the customer intended, I am of the view that banks must assist their customers in recovering the amount concerned.
Indien het toch een overboeking plaatsvindt naar een ander nummer dan de klant beoogde, dan ben ik van mening dat banken hun klanten moeten bijstaan bij het terughalen van het betrokken bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over witwasdossiers die blijven liggen bij de Financial Intelligence Unit

Two PvdA MPs asked why suspicious-transaction reports from the Financial Intelligence Unit seem to go unused in money-laundering cases, and whether the number of prosecutor requests has fallen. The minister answered that such reports are useful intelligence but are not separately tracked in criminal files, that cooperation and new registration agreements are being improved, and that money laundering is prosecuted alongside confiscation.
The Public Prosecution Service does not record on the basis of what type of information a criminal case was started.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) registreert niet op grond van welke soort informatie een strafzaak is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘NAM mag druk onder Langelo opvoeren, ondanks kans op zwaardere bevingen’

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's plan to increase gas storage at Norg despite the risk of stronger earthquakes, and why residents were not informed. The minister said the storage expansion approval dates from June 2014, the August 2015 change only lifts a compartment-level pressure restriction, municipalities and province were informed but residents were not, and seismic risk remains very limited according to SodM and TNO, with a monitoring network planned.
The residents were not separately informed.
De omwonenden zijn niet separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Geef premie van 4000 euro aan alle inwoners aardbevingsgebied’

MPs asked whether all residents of the Groningen earthquake area should receive a 4,000 euro premium, as proposed by the Groninger Bodem Beweging, and whether this was promised in the earlier administrative agreement. The minister said no such promise exists, that the waardevermeerdering scheme covers only homeowners, and that the National Coordinator is reviewing all schemes, with the current scheme reopened retroactively for damage cases outside the 11 municipalities.
The administrative agreement 'Trust in Recovery and Recovery of Trust' provides that homeowners will be offered a value-increasing package.
In het bestuursakkoord «Vertrouwen op Herstel en Herstel van Vertrouwen» is afgesproken dat aan woningeigenaren een waardeverhogend pakket beschikbaar wordt gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de toegenomen volatiliteit op financiële markten en de risico’s voor de financiële stabiliteit

An MP asked the Finance Minister about rising market volatility, financial stability risks from China, US monetary tightening, shadow banks and investment funds, interbank exposures and Dutch problem loans. The minister answered that Dutch bank problem loans are low (2.9%), that DNB is studying shadow banks with a publication due by early next year, and that supervisors have existing tools for interbank exposures and problem-loan resolution.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Jan Vos over fossiele reserves die mogelijk zullen worden afgeschreven

MPs Nijboer and Jan Vos asked the Finance and Infrastructure and Environment ministers about 'stranded assets' from fossil fuel reserves, the Citigroup valuation, DNB and FSB work on climate risk, annual reporting of climate risk and Chevron dividends. The government answered that a Paris agreement's effects are premature to judge, that the carbon bubble concept is still debated, and promised to inform parliament on FSB results and to ask DNB for a broad climate-risk analysis by early next year.

During the AFB of 1 October it was also promised that DNB will be asked to look broadly at the risks of climate change for the financial sector in light of a recent speech by Mark Carney and the FSB's plans.

is tevens toegezegd dat DNB verzocht zal worden om in het licht van een recente speech van Mark Carney 5 en de plannen van de FSB, in brede zin te kijken naar de risico’s van klimaatverandering voor de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de beslissing van Deloitte om niet van account te wisselen

The MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Finance why Deloitte chose not to rotate its external auditor after more than ten years, and whether the selection committee, including the CFO and head of Finance, was independent enough. The Minister called the reported decision a poor fit with sector integrity goals, noted that Deloitte reversed it and will start a new selection, and pointed to forthcoming statutory safeguards such as a mandatory internal supervisory body, rotation rules and transparency on partner remuneration.
The AFM will report on compliance and enforce the statutory requirements.
De AFM zal over de naleving rapporteren en op de wettelijke eisen handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de rol van banken bij faillissementen

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about banks' role in the Imtech bankruptcy, including criticised information provision, pre-pack procedures, account blocking and protection of stakeholders. The Minister of Justice answered in general terms, declining to assess the specific case, and pointed to the Wet continuïteit ondernemingen I and related faillissementsrecht reforms as remedies.
To avoid misunderstanding, I note that in answering these questions I make no findings about the factual course of events surrounding the Imtech bankruptcy.

Ter voorkoming van misverstanden merk ik op dat ik bij de beantwoording van de hier aan de orde zijnde vragen geen vaststellingen doe over de feitelijke gang van zaken rond het faillissement van Imtech.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over het AFM-onderzoek naar de dienstverlening van hypotheekaanbieders bij betalingsproblemen met hypotheken

MPs Nijboer and Albert de Vries asked about an AFM study finding that mortgage lenders must improve their service to borrowers with payment problems, including which lenders must improve, the safeguarding of borrower interests and fees, and the timing of a follow-up study. The minister answered that most lenders still need improvements, the AFM will monitor progress and decide on follow-up research, and the EU mortgage directive will limit charges to actual damages.
Which lender falls into which category is not disclosed because this is supervisory-confidential information.
Welke aanbieder in welke categorie valt wordt niet bekend gemaakt omdat dit toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de mogelijke betrokkenheid van Nederlandse banken bij valutafraude

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks are implicated in currency fraud, whether regulators are investigating, whether staff were dismissed or prosecuted, and what the capital risks and progress on reforms are. The minister answered that he lacks further information on settlements, that AFM and DNB are investigating and will report this year, that dismissals are a matter for firms, that benchmark manipulation is now prohibited and prosecutable, and that he sees no capital risk.
The AFM and DNB are currently investigating the involvement of Dutch financial institutions in currency trading and benchmarks; this investigation is expected to be completed this year.
De AFM en DNB doen op dit moment onderzoek naar betrokkenheid van Nederlandse financiële instellingen bij valutahandel en -benchmarks; dit onderzoek zal naar verwachting dit jaar worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jans Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de toepassing van fracking bij gaswinning in Saaksum

MPs Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about NAM's plan to use fracking to recover remaining gas near Saaksum, the risks, alternatives and consultation with local authorities. The minister answered that fracking here is a routine, safety-checked stimulation within the existing plan, that SodM reviews the risk documents before work starts, that no alternative exists for this rock type, and that NAM has consulted local authorities, but declined to ask NAM to refrain.
However, regarding the upcoming work, I see no reason and no possibility to ask NAM not to carry it out.
Ten aanzien van de aanstaande werkzaamheden zie ik echter geen reden en geen mogelijkheid om NAM te verzoeken deze niet uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de bestuursvoorzitter van Vivat anderhalve maand na de overname door Anbang vertrekt

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about the departure of Vivat's CEO shortly after the takeover by Anbang, including effects on governance, policyholders, DNB approval and the capital injection. The minister answered that Vivat's governance is now a matter for the company, its supervisory board and the shareholder, that DNB approved the takeover under confidentiality rules, and that the EUR 1.35 billion capital injection is due by 26 October 2015 with DNB enforcement tools available if conditions are not met.
DNB is bound by a statutory duty of confidentiality under article 1:89 of the Financial Supervision Act.
DNB heeft op grond van artikel 1:89 van de Wet op het financieel toezicht een geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht over een ingestorte boerderij in Bedum

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs what steps had been taken in the Bedum farmhouse collapse case, why the counter-expertise took so long, and whether NAM's lack of communication and support for residents was adequate. The minister declined to comment on the individual case in detail, described the procedural steps and the municipality's coordinating role, acknowledged that long silences are undesirable, and asked the National Coordinator Groningen to examine the adequacy of support for residents.
In general I am reluctant to respond to individual cases.
Ten algemene ben ik terughoudend met het reageren op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over het artikel «Pension Funds Can Only Guess at Private Equity’s Cost»

MPs Nijboer and Vermeij asked the Finance Minister and the Social Affairs State Secretary about pension fund private equity costs, including whether fees and profit-sharing are lawful and whether pension funds can see their costs. The government answered that fee levels are negotiated contractually, that it cannot assess whether the costs are lawful, that existing reporting rules are sufficient for now, and that it will push for more cost transparency internationally through the AIFMD evaluation.

It is not clear to the cabinet what the pension funds named in the article agreed with the private equity funds concerning the allocation, level and reporting of the various costs, and how this relates to the costs actually charged.

Het is voor het kabinet niet inzichtelijk wat de onderzochte pensioenfondsen die in het artikel worden genoemd met de betreffende private equityfondsen hebben afgesproken over de allocatie, hoogte en rapportage van de verschillende kosten en hoe dit zich verhoudt tot de daadwerkelijk in rekening gebrachte kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Koolmees over rentemiddeling waardoor hypotheekbezitters kunnen profiteren van een lagere hypotheekrente

MPs Nijboer and Koolmees asked whether banks should offer 'rentemiddeling' (averaging a fixed mortgage rate with market rates to spread the early-repayment penalty) so homeowners can benefit from lower rates, and whether the penalty calculation can be made transparent. The minister said six banks offer it, that it depends on individual circumstances, that he will ask the sector by letter to offer it, and that the penalty calculation will be further regulated under the Mortgage Credit Directive in 2016.
I will ask the sector, by letter, to offer rentemiddeling as an option, whereby in individual situations it must be considered whether rentemiddeling is in the customer's interest.
Ik zal de sector, middels een brief, verzoeken om rentemiddeling als optie aan te bieden, waarbij in individuele situaties moet worden bezien of rentemiddeling in het belang is van de klant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Cegerek over dubieuze transacties van investeringsfonds Waterland

MPs Nijboer and Cegerek asked whether private equity fund Waterland extracted more cash from Attero than it invested, whether this weakened the firm's landfill aftercare provisions and ability to pay future remediation costs, and what it means for staff. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that excess distributions are not per se improper, pointed to existing private equity asset-stripping rules and corporate law, said aftercare reserves and financial guarantees remain legally required, and said Waterland describes Attero as financially healthy while the staff impact cannot be assessed.
Dutch company law provides that the profit of a private or public limited company belongs to the shareholders, and sets limits on distributability.
Het Nederlandse vennootschapsrecht bepaalt dat de winst van een besloten of naamloze vennootschap toekomt aan de aandeelhouders, en stelt grenzen aan uitkeerbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het beperkte inzicht van afschriften van betaalrekeningen

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister whether banks should guarantee free access to account statements for several years, given that some banks restrict online viewing of statements to 15 months and cause problems for tax and benefit claims. The minister answers that no rules require a minimum period, that the big banks offer 5 to 10 years of digital history, and that the Overstapservice evaluation will examine problems when switching banks.
For this reason I see no urgent need to engage in further discussion on this at the present time.
Ik zie om deze reden geen dringende noodzaak om hierover op dit moment nader in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘CdK haalt ongemeen fel uit naar de NAM’

PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Groningen Commissioner of the King criticised NAM's slow handling of complex earthquake damage claims, including a case in Nieuwolda where work stopped despite safety concerns. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to the damage protocol, the transfer of new claims to the Centrum Veilig Wonen, and agreements with NAM to finish complex cases by year-end.
As Minister, it is not appropriate for me to respond to individual cases.
Als Minister past het mij niet om op individuele gevallen te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de waardedaling van woningen door aardbevingen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a VU study finding house values drop 1.2 to 1.9 percent per earthquake above 2.2 on the Richter scale, and about the adequacy of the compensation scheme and its trust and complexity. The minister disputes the VU finding based on Ortec Finance studies, describes the compensation scheme and planned market measures, and promises to pass the findings to the National Coordinator Groningen.
I will bring the outcomes of this study and of the study commissioned by the Dialogue Table to the attention of the National Coordinator Groningen.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en het onderzoek dat gedaan wordt in opdracht van de Dialoogtafel onder de aandacht brengen van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het herstel van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM and CVW control contractor choice for earthquake damage repair in Groningen, and how the government responds to criticism of CVW's expert assessments and WOZ valuations. The minister answered that residents can choose among three options including their own contractor, that the procedure protects choice and counter-expertise, and that WOZ valuation is a municipal responsibility.
The Supervisory Committee of CVW oversees the proper execution of CVW's work.
De Commissie van Toezicht van CVW ziet toe op een gedegen uitvoering van de werkzaamheden door CVW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de impact van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about earthquake damage in Groningen, including whether induced quakes are comparable in impact to Southern European quakes and the safety of primary schools such as CBS De Regenboog in Bedum. The minister replied that induced quakes have a different impact than natural ones, that shake-maps will be published after the new seismic network is operational in summer 2015, and that school buildings are being inspected and reinforced by NAM, with a final report on the Bedum school expected in a few weeks.
Yes. With the new seismological network in Groningen, currently being built, it will become possible to make ground acceleration visible directly after an earthquake in the form of shake-maps.

Ja. Met het nieuwe seismologische netwerk in Groningen, dat op dit moment wordt opgebouwd, wordt het mogelijk om ook de grondversnelling direct na de beving inzichtelijk te maken in de vorm van «shake-maps».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over de aardbevingsbestendigheid van het Chemiepark in Delfzijl

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the minister about a 2015 letter from Delfzijl's mayor on earthquake resistance of the Delfzijl chemical park, whether a study was promised in 2013, and whether research has been done and the municipality will be informed. The minister confirms the letter and a working group with a methodology by Deltares and TNO, but says the research is run by individual companies, funded by NAM, takes up to two years, and results will only be shared through the regular permitting process with the municipalities.
I will ask the National Coordinator Groningen to discuss with the parties involved whether, and if so how, the research process can be accelerated.
Ik zal de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen vragen om met de betrokken partijen te bespreken of, en zo ja, hoe het onderzoeksproces versneld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de hoge en sterk uiteenlopende kosten van vermogensbeheer

An MP asked the Finance Minister about high and widely varying asset management fees and what should be done about them. The minister answered that fees are set freely by managers, that a cap is too drastic, and that a comparative cost measure has been in place since 1 January 2015, with further EU rules (MiFID II, PRIIPs) planned.
Setting a maximum on market prices is generally too drastic a measure.
Het stellen van een maximum aan marktprijzen is over het algemeen een te ingrijpende maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Nijboer, Van Dekken en Albert de Vries over vestigingsplaatsen voor een kerncentrale

Three PvdA MPs asked whether earthquake risk in Groningen makes the Eemshaven unsuitable as a nuclear plant site and whether it should be dropped from the SEV III energy structure plan. The minister answered that the risk is premature grounds to exclude the site, that Eemshaven remains a safeguarded location, and that it will be reviewed in the second SEV III evaluation in 2016.
This will be considered at the second evaluation of SEV III, in 2016.
Dit zal worden bezien bij de tweede evaluatie van het SEV III, in 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de regels met betrekking tot de meldplicht van accountants

Two MPs asked whether an Accountantskamer ruling narrows accountants' confidentiality duty when they suspect large tax fraud, and whether it conflicts with earlier rulings and with the Wwft reporting duty. The minister answered that the ruling reflects existing rules, that no conflict exists, and that no new legislation is needed.
No. The existing laws and regulations offer sufficient starting points for the accountants' duty to report fraud.
Nee. De bestaande wet- en regelgeving biedt voldoende aanknopingspunten voor de meldplicht van accountants bij fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het wegnemen van belemmeringen om over de grens te werken

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs how the motion on mapping the fiscal and social security consequences for cross-border workers is implemented, what information is available to residents of the border region, and whether regional initiatives such as a helpdesk for working in Germany will be supported. The minister points to the grensinfo.nl website, the Belastingtelefoon and the cross-border tax team, Benelux information portals, and periodic cabinet reporting to parliament, and says the cabinet will consult VNG on whether a border counter is needed.
You will be further informed about the outcome of this consultation.
U wordt over de uitkomst van dit overleg nog nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de handel in ‘contracts for difference’

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about contracts for difference (CfDs), including their risks, whether investors are adequately informed, which providers operate and under what supervision, possible protective measures, expected returns, and whether CfD trading resembles gambling. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that CfDs are suited mainly to professional investors, that the AFM found providers gave insufficient information and that some foreign providers breach EU rules, and that MiFID revision from 2017 and AFM enforcement powers will strengthen protection.
The AFM finds that a number of providers insufficiently comply with the applicable European rules. The AFM considers this situation worrying and will raise it at European level.
De AFM constateert dat een aantal aanbieders de geldende Europese regels onvoldoende naleeft. De AFM vindt deze situatie zorgwekkend en zal dit in Europees verband aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Dit kan echt niet’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Groninger residents' case where a family with two children allegedly had been waiting two years in a replacement home, and whether NAM could reopen a valuation despite earlier commitments, and whether such cases belong before the Commission for Exceptional Cases. The minister said the family was not in a replacement home for two years but in its own home, that a temporary home became available in December, that NAM has offered options, and that individual cases are not shared for privacy reasons, while referring to the handover of claims to the CVW and the role of the ombudsman-type raadsman.
Furthermore, as Minister of Economic Affairs I want to be restrained in sharing information about individual cases, for privacy reasons.
Verder wil ik als Minister van Economische Zaken terughoudend zijn met het delen van informatie over individuele gevallen, omwille van de privacy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Oosenbrug over het artikel ‘Beveiligingslek banken maakte phishing mogelijk’

MPs Nijboer and Oosenbrug asked whether a web security flaw in major Dutch banks enabling phishing was known, whether victims would be fully compensated, and whether banks invest enough and share vulnerabilities. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that banks follow a responsible disclosure policy, that DNB has tightened IT-risk requirements, that banks say they know of no attacks exploiting the flaw, and that liability for victims applies unless gross negligence is involved.
Given the development of cyber threats, DNB has tightened the requirements it imposes on supervised institutions regarding the analysis and control of IT risks from this year onward.
Gezien de ontwikkeling van cyberdreigingen heeft DNB de eisen die zij stelt aan onder toezicht staande instellingen wat betreft de analyse en beheersing van IT-risico's vanaf dit jaar verzwaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de gestegen inkomens van accountants

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister whether rising partner incomes at Big 4 audit firms are acceptable given the sector's quality problems, its own pledges to invest in quality, and the reduced partner involvement in audits. The minister replies that audit firms are private bodies setting their own pay, points to NBA measures (claw-back, capped variable pay, partner-hours reporting) and says the AFM will supervise implementation, while noting the reported pay covers the prior financial year before the measures took effect.
The Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) will closely monitor both the progress of implementing the measures and the quality of the statutory audit.
De Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) zal nauwgezet toezien op zowel de voortgang van de implementatie van de maatregelen als de kwaliteit van de wettelijke controle.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over renteverhogingen door banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether banks should limit variable-rate increases, tie them to objective criteria and benchmarks, and whether such rules should be legally anchored, including for business credit. The minister said banks are not obliged to link rates one-to-one to benchmarks, pledged to work for clearer communication of rate components to consumers and businesses, and would consider legal anchoring only if needed.
I will work to ensure that credit providers clearly inform both consumers and entrepreneurs about the components of the variable interest rate.
Ik zal mij ervoor inzetten dat kredietaanbieders zowel consumenten als ondernemers duidelijk informeren over de componenten waaruit de variabele rente is opgebouwd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de kosten van beleggingsfondsen

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether fund management fees, the stacking of funds and high investment costs undermine investors' interests and whether costs are transparent enough. The Minister replied that the advisor commission ban protects investors, that fund management fees are standard practice, and that clearer cost disclosure will come via Dutch bank commitments and EU rules (MiFID II, PRIIPS) with Europe-level advocacy.
In my view, information on investment costs can be more complete and transparent.
Informatie over kosten van beleggen kunnen mijns inziens vollediger en inzichtelijker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over fouten van banken bij het omzetten van adresboeken van klanten

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether banks made errors converting customers' address-book account numbers to IBAN and who is liable when money goes to a wrong account. The minister answered that the IBAN check digit prevents most errors, that account holders share responsibility, that banks are jointly liable for incorrectly executed transfers, and that wrong transfers should fall markedly after the August 2014 switch to IBAN.
If payments are however executed incorrectly through the bank's doing, the bank is jointly liable towards its customers and responsible for refunding the amount of the incorrectly executed payment.

Als betalingen echter door toedoen van de bank foutief worden uitgevoerd, is deze mede aansprakelijk richting haar klanten en verantwoordelijk voor terugboeking van het bedrag van de foutief uitgevoerde betaling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het sluiten van de metaalafdeling van Synergon

MPs Kerstens, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the State Secretary about the closure of Synergon's metal department, the failed takeover talks, the long uncertainty for staff and possible support for an external investigation. The State Secretary said responsibility for the Wsw lies with the municipalities, so she cannot comment on the company's operations, but pointed to a sector-wide Cedris programme, a provincial independent inquiry and regional funding.
Responsibility for implementing the Wsw is assigned to the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van de Wsw is belegd bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Nijboer, Yücel en Hamer over fraude met kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Nijboer, Yücel and Hamer asked the State Secretary of Finance about a childcare benefit fraud case, parents facing large repayments and eviction, and whether the Tax Authority recovers from fraudulent providers. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases citing confidentiality, explained that parents are liable for repayment and can appeal, outlined recovery practices, and said the motion on reducing repayments will be addressed in the next half-year report.
Because of the duty of confidentiality, I cannot discuss individual cases in public.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet in de openbaarheid op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de gevolgen voor klanten van hogere kapitaaleisen voor banken

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch banks pass higher capital costs on to customers more than banks elsewhere, citing a Vallstein report, and whether banks should instead raise buffers through cost cuts, dividend retention and new capital. The minister disputes the report's methodology and its benchmark of 10% return on equity, notes Dutch banks are already well capitalised, says supervisors can restrict payouts, and points to measures on banking competition and regulatory barriers.
I do not share this premise, because shareholders in better capitalised banks can accept lower returns as the risks also decrease accordingly.
Ik deel dit uitgangspunt niet, omdat aandeelhouders in beter gekapitaliseerde banken genoegen kunnen nemen met lagere rendementen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht dat er een aardbeving heeft plaatsgevonden bij Froombosch

MPs Jan Vos, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about two earthquakes near Froombosch, the historical frequency and magnitude of quakes there, whether seismicity has risen since the Loppersum well closures, and whether damage claims are being handled quickly. The minister confirmed the reports, listed seven earlier quakes above magnitude 1.5, said recent quakes show no change in seismicity, and reported about 400 related damage claims with most light cases resolved within three months.
Contact has already been made with 75% of residents, and appointments for a visit by the damage expert have been made with half of them.
Er is inmiddels met 75% van de bewoners contact geweest en met de helft zijn afspraken gemaakt voor een bezoek van de schade expert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het krantenbericht “G20 komt met eigen reddingsfonds banken”

Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about press reports of a G20 bank rescue fund and the planned GLAC/TLAC bail-in capacity for global systemically important banks, including its relation to EU rules and which Dutch and European banks are covered. Dijsselbloem answered that the G20 is not creating a rescue fund but negotiating minimum total loss-absorbing capacity via the FSB, that TLAC is complementary to the EU MREL, that only ING among Dutch banks qualifies, and that the Netherlands supports an ambitious standard to be decided at the Brisbane summit.
I will inform the House in due course about the outcomes of this.
Ik zal de Kamer te zijner tijd verder over de uitkomsten hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het aankomende rouleren van stemrechten binnen de ECB

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the ECB's planned move to six-weekly monetary meetings, the publication of minutes, and the rotation of voting rights when Lithuania joins the euro in 2015, including effects on Dutch influence. The minister answers that rotation starts on 1 January 2015 under the Treaty, that meeting frequency does not change the rotation, that no date for the Dutch president's voting gap is yet published, and that a treaty change is not necessary.
No. The ECB has not yet published a decision on this.
Nee. De ECB heeft hier nog geen besluit over gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Barclays wordt beticht van misleiding van institutionele beleggers

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch institutional investors such as pension funds were harmed by reports that Barclays misled institutional investors through its dark pool, and whether dark pools exist in the Netherlands and how they are supervised. The minister replied that no signals of harm to Dutch investors had reached him, that no dark pools currently operate in the Netherlands, that AFM would supervise such venues if they existed, and described the new EU MiFID/MiFIR rules tightening dark pool trading.
At present, no dark pools are operated in the Netherlands.
Op dit moment worden er geen dark pools in Nederland geëxploiteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de Portugese overheid de Banco Espírito Santo (BES) redt

The MP asks the Finance Minister about the Portuguese state rescue of Banco Espírito Santo, including the supervisor's past actions, fraud, burden-sharing with private parties, debt effects, contagion risk and Dutch exposure. The minister answers mostly by cross-reference, describes the Portuguese central bank's supervisory steps, and says the operation does not change Portugal's debt and that Dutch risk runs only indirectly via EFSF, EFSM and IMF.
The Portuguese Central Bank found irregularities in the accounts of the parent company of Espírito Santo International (ESI) in an audit in 2013.
Meer specifiek heeft de Portugese Centrale Bank in een audit in 2013 onregelmatigheden in de rekeningen van het moederbedrijf van Espírito Santo International (ESI) geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de beloningen bij vermogensbeheerders

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister whether he agrees with the AFM that asset managers should charge hourly rather than a percentage of assets, and whether such a fee is fairer and more transparent. The minister answers that fees must serve the client's interest, that the AFM does not require hourly pay but questions flat percentage fees, and that it is too early to draw conclusions on fee models.
In my view it is still too early to draw conclusions regarding the different forms of remuneration.
Het is mijn inziens nog te vroeg om conclusies te trekken ten aanzien van de verschillende vormen van beloning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over de verhoging van het vaste salaris van de ABN AMRO top

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked whether ABN AMRO's 20% fixed-salary increase for its senior management, and its cost-to-income ratio, are acceptable given the minister's call for bank pay moderation. The minister replied that the salary rise is the bank's own responsibility, that the executive board decided without prior notice to him or NLFI, that pay can be lowered but wage setting belongs to employers and employees, and that Dutch personnel costs and cost-to-income ratios are high relative to the EU average.
As a shareholder, I am concerned with the remuneration policy of the executive board, not with the remuneration policy of senior management.
Als aandeelhouder ga ik over het beloningsbeleid van de RvB en niet over het beloningsbeleid van het senior management.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over de fors gestegen lonen van bankiers

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Finance Minister why bank staff pay rose sharply, whether bonus caps are circumvented by higher fixed salaries, and whether talent-retention arguments justify this. The minister said pay setting is for employers and employees, that the bill targets variable pay rather than fixed pay, and that the talent argument is overstated, while giving limited data on how banks compensated staff.
Wage formation, however, is reserved for employers and employees. The government in principle plays no role in this.
De loonvorming is echter voorbehouden aan werkgevers en werknemers. De overheid speelt daar in beginsel geen rol bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van Laar over het rapport van Oxfam Novib over belastingontwijking door bedrijven

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about an Oxfam Novib report on corporate tax avoidance and its effect on developing countries' revenues, and about Dutch efforts on the OECD BEPS project and country-by-country reporting. The government answered that the 100% revenue claim anticipates a forthcoming study, pointed to Dutch treaty and technical assistance efforts, said developing countries are being involved in BEPS, and described EU country-by-country reporting rules with an evaluation due in 2018.
Without knowledge of that report, the question posed cannot be answered.
Zonder kennis van dat rapport is de gestelde vraag niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Hamer over de berichten 'Aardschokken ook een kans' en 'Laat het werk niet weglopen'

MPs Van Dekken, Nijboer and Hamer asked about reports that small Groningen builders are losing repair work to large firms, the labour needed for earthquake-damage repair, and the new facilities company 'Groningen versterkt'. Minister Kamp answered that homeowners freely choose contractors, expects a positive economic impulse, notes labour estimates vary pending the executing organisation, and cannot yet assess the initiative because the framework is not yet set.
However, I cannot currently confirm that these numbers of construction workers are needed.
Ik kan echter op dit moment niet bevestigen dat deze aantallen bouwvakkers nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Onduidelijkheid over ingestorte boerderij Bedum’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the collapse of a barn in Bedum, the evacuation of residents, why NAM and the municipality would not explain the cause, and how information on earthquake damage in the area is provided. The minister answered that the municipality commissioned an independent investigation into the cause, that residents were advised to leave on fire brigade advice, that several earlier evacuations were due to combined factors, and that information is shared via official consultations, the Dialoogtafel and NAM communications.
Because there was no clarity about the causes of the collapse at that time, the letter and press release did not go into possible causes, also to prevent speculation.
Omdat er toen geen duidelijkheid was over de oorzaken van de instorting is – ook om speculatie te voorkomen – in de brief en het persbericht niet nader ingegaan op mogelijke oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hamer en Nijboer over de berichten ‘Mobiliteitscentrum schiet tekort’ en ‘Er zijn juist heel heldere afspraken gemaakt’

MPs Van Dekken, Hamer and Nijboer asked about former Aldel workers at the Delfzijl mobility centre who complain about limited training options, UWV rules, sanctions, age discrimination and sick workers' access to the training fund. The minister answers that training is tailored, the EUR 2,500 cap was agreed as an average, 70 of 340 candidates have found work, and the government sees no evidence of targeted exclusion.
It was agreed that the amount of EUR 2,500 is used as an average available amount for training per candidate rather than as a maximum amount.
Hierbij is afgesproken dat het bedrag van € 2.500 als een gemiddeld beschikbaar bedrag voor scholing per kandidaat wordt gehanteerd in plaats van als maximum bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Groot over het alarmerende bericht dat de integriteit van trustkantoren in het geding is

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked the Finance Minister about DNB findings that trust offices take unacceptable risks with Dutch limited partnerships (cv-structures), lack separation of functions and source-of-funds checks. The minister agrees the findings are worrying, points to new integrity rules (RibWtt 2014) effective 2015, and says tax avoidance via these structures falls outside last year's measures and is being addressed internationally.
Soon I will publish the new Regulation on Integrity of Business Operations under the Trust Offices Supervision Act (RibWtt 2014).
Binnenkort zal ik de nieuwe Regeling Integere Bedrijfsvoering Wet toezicht trustkantoren (RibWtt 2014) publiceren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de voorlichting van banken aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf (MKB) over de risico’s van derivaten zoals renteswaps naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van de rechtbank in Den Bosch

An MP asks the Finance Minister how banks inform SMEs about the risks of interest rate swaps, following a court ruling on a bank's duty of care, and whether execution-only sales should be allowed. The minister says banks must inform clients under existing MiFID/Wft rules, that the AFM found shortcomings and banks have committed to improvements, and that the AFM will review past sales and report.
The AFM will continue to closely monitor these developments.
De AFM blijft deze ontwikkelingen nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het bericht ‘gaswinning zorgt opnieuw voor een conflict tussen provincie en het Rijk’

MPs Jacobi, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether the national government requires water boards to pay half the cost of strengthening dikes in Groningen because of gas-field economic interests, and how the government will limit gas-extraction harm and fund dike reinforcement. The minister denies any such demand, describes the standard 50/40/10 cost split under the flood protection programme and a separate 100 million euro fund for earthquake-proofing vital infrastructure, and says talks with water boards are ongoing.

There is, however, no requirement from the central government that the water board pay half the costs of dikes that receive a stricter standard because of the economic importance of the gas locations and therefore need to be strengthened.

Er is echter geen sprake van een eis van het Rijk dat het waterschap de helft van de kosten betaalt voor dijken die vanwege het economisch belang van de gaslocaties een strengere norm krijgen en daardoor versterkt zouden moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over KPMG en de mogelijke fraude bij de nieuwbouw van het hoofdkantoor

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about alleged tax-return fraud by a KPMG-linked joint venture building KPMG's headquarters, and whether accountancy fraud is structural and calls for stricter rules. The minister declined to give details while the criminal investigation is ongoing, pointed to AFM supervision and recent reforms, and said the sector must change its culture.
Given that the criminal investigation is still ongoing, no further information can be provided on this matter.
Gelet op het feit dat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog gaande is, kunnen daarover geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Nijboer en van Dekken Milieu over overlast vanwege laagfrequent geluid

MPs Cegerek, Nijboer and van Dekken asked the State Secretary about residents' complaints of low-frequency noise near the NAM gas storage site at Grijpskerk, Zuidhorn. The government answered that studies found no clear cause for the complaints, so no basis remains for targeting a specific source, and it informed the Zuidhorn mayor accordingly.
In this specific case, research has not identified a clear cause for the complaints.
In dit specifieke geval is uit onderzoek geen duidelijke oorzaak voor de klachten naar voren gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanpak van flitshandel

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether high-frequency traders gain unfair advantages, distort prices, and whether research or regulation is needed. The minister answers that MiFID II and AFM supervision ensure a level playing field, that flash trading is not possible in Europe, and that ESMA is the appropriate body to study HFT further.
It is important that everyone has access to trading in financial instruments on regulated trading platforms under equal conditions.
Het is belangrijk dat iedereen onder gelijke voorwaarden toegang heeft tot de handel in financiële instrumenten op gereguleerde handelsplatformen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de verwerkingstermijn van betaaltransacties op weekenden en feestdagen

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Target2 closure on weekends and holidays, which delays card payment crediting, could be shortened, and whether banks could compensate merchants and assess damages and systemic risks. The Minister answered that Target2 cannot be extended to 365 days in the short term, that the matter is being studied with DNB via the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer with a report due in May, and that damages are unknown while banks do not compensate overdraft costs.
The consequences of the longer processing times for interest received and paid are not known.
De gevolgen van de langere verwerkingstijden voor te ontvangen en betalen rente zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Nijboer over het bevriezen van Oekraïense tegoeden en het voorkomen van belastingontwijking via Nederland door de Oekraïense elite

MPs Servaes and Nijboer asked about the amount of Ukrainian assets frozen in the Netherlands and how the FIU reported only one suspicious transaction linked to Ukraine, and whether the government would investigate how the assets came to the Netherlands and improve supervision. The minister declined to give amounts or breakdowns citing secrecy rules, explained the separate legal procedures for freezing and reporting, and committed to examine the cases and feed the results into an anti-money-laundering policy monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over problemen met foute overschrijvingen met IBAN

An MP asked the Finance Minister about wrongly directed bank transfers under IBAN, including the lack of name checks and how to recover misdirected payments. The minister answered that IBAN's built-in check digit prevents most typing errors, that the misdirected-payment problem mainly arises during the dual period with converted old Postbank accounts, and that no bank duty of care exists for transfers, so the government sees no need to put the issue on the agenda of the next MOB meeting.
The use of IBAN is not the cause of incorrect transfers, but precisely a solution to them.
Het gebruik van het IBAN is niet de oorzaak van onjuiste overboekingen, maar juist een oplossing hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de voortgang van het internationale onderzoek naar de prijsmanipulatie op de internationale valutamarkten

MP Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about the progress of international investigations into manipulation of currency benchmarks, Dutch banks' involvement, the Fideres report, enforcement under the new EU market abuse rules, and benchmark design. The Minister answered that DNB and AFM are investigating Dutch banks' benchmark risks, that the Fideres report is not public, that new sanctions and national legislation are coming, and that benchmark design principles are being pursued.
On the possible involvement of Dutch banks I cannot make any statements at this time because the investigation by DNB and AFM is still ongoing.
Over de eventuele betrokkenheid van Nederlandse banken kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen omdat het onderzoek door DNB en AFM nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Nederlandse bedrijven voor een miljard in het krijt staan bij de fiscus

MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that Dutch businesses owe the tax authority about one billion euros, including whether the tax authority is losing money through the payment deferral scheme, whether arrears are still tracked, whether collateral is required, and whether the tax authority acts too passively in bankruptcies. The State Secretary disputed the one-billion figure, stated that deferred amounts are recovered later and that losses from bankruptcy fell, provided the 2011-2013 arrears figures, and rejected the need to change the approach.
I do not recognise this picture. First, it is not clear what the 1 billion euro amount is based on.
Ik herken dit beeld niet. Ten eerste is niet duidelijk waar het bedrag van € 1 miljard op is gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over Chinese schaduwbanken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Chinese shadow banking and its risks to the world economy, its growth in China, the Netherlands and the EU, and whether regulation is being circumvented. The minister acknowledged the risks, gave growth figures and said he sees no current signs of regulatory evasion, while promising a separate letter on shadow banking regulation once international proposals are clearer.
As soon as there is more clarity on this, I will inform the House in a separate letter on this theme.
Zodra hier meer duidelijkheid over is, zal ik de Kamer middels een aparte brief nader informeren over dit thema.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de onvoldoende voor de BelastingTelefoon

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Consumentenbond's failing grade for the Tax Phone service and whether callers get correct information. The State Secretary answered that 86% of tax-substance questions were answered correctly in 2012 and 2013 per external mystery calls, that the Tax Phone will be strengthened for complex questions, and that tax advice questions will no longer be answered.
The Tax Administration will discuss the outcomes and research methods with the Consumentenbond.
De Belastingdienst gaat met de Consumentenbond in gesprek over de uitkomsten en onderzoeksmethoden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Bouwmeester over de transparantie van de lobbypraktijken van Nederlandse banken

MPs Nijboer and Bouwmeester asked whether the government would adopt SOMO's recommendations on transparency of Dutch banks' lobbying, including a 'lobby paragraph' in each bill, and whether similar transparency should apply to business generally. The minister replied that banks should implement recommendations themselves, that the government supports transparent accountability of stakeholder influence, and that consultation reports already function as such a lobby paragraph.
The cabinet therefore endorses the importance of transparent accountability for the influence of stakeholders on the policy process.
