Het kabinet onderschrijft derhalve het belang van transparante verantwoording over die invloed van belanghebbenden op het beleidsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over KPMG en de steekpenningenaffaire van Ballast Nedam

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about KPMG's role in the Ballast Nedam bribery affair, the AFM's handling of it, and accountant oversight. The minister answered that the AFM helped arrange a gradual handover of the 2012 audit, that the criminal investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, and that existing rules already cover integrity and fraud signalling, with a response to a pending motion promised.
To avoid harming this ongoing investigation, I cannot answer the specific questions you ask at this time.
Om dit nog lopende onderzoek niet te schaden kan ik de specifieke vragen die u stelt nu niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over storingen en fraude bij online bankieren

An MP asked the Finance Minister about online banking outages, fraud losses, bank compensation practices, the ECB security recommendations and the burden of proof on consumers under civil code rules. The Minister answered that no fixed availability norm exists, that DNB monitors resilience, that banks are working toward ECB recommendations, and that liability for gross negligence is for courts to decide.
I do not have the percentage of fraud cases in which the bank compensated the damage, nor the percentage of cases still ongoing.
Ik beschik niet over het percentage van fraudegevallen waarbij de bank de schade heeft gecompenseerd en een percentage van welke zaken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Oosenbrug over de gevoeligheid voor cyberaanvallen van Nederlandse banken

MPs Nijboer and Oosenbrug asked about cyberattack vulnerability of Dutch banks, outages in online payments, the costs involved, reporting duties and information sharing. The minister answered that banks must report incidents to DNB under the Wft, that DNB supervises security and payment robustness, that a security-breach reporting duty to the NCSC is in consultation, and that information sharing via the NCSC is important.
The average outage duration is not known to me.
De gemiddelde storingsduur is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de financiële fragmentatie van het bankenlandschap in Europa

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that German supervisors restrict Dutch banks from funding Dutch loans with German deposits, and about the effects on interest rates and the banking union. The Minister said no general ban exists under CRD-IV, that national supervisors can restrict intragroup liquidity transfers, and that the banking union should reduce fragmentation.
I am not aware of a general ban imposed by the German supervisor on Dutch banks using German deposits to fund loans in the Netherlands.
Ik ben niet bekend met een algeheel verbod voor Nederlandse banken van de Duitse toezichthouder om Duitse deposito’s te gebruiken voor het uitzetten van leningen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de uniforme veiligheidsregels voor online bankieren

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the uniform security rules for online banking agreed between the Dutch Banking Association and the Consumentenbond, including their legal status, whether they shift liability onto customers, and phishing losses. The minister replied that the rules are voluntary agreements that do not alter the statutory burden of proof on banks, that courts decide on gross negligence, and that banks decide on any voluntary compensation.
From articles 7:524 and 7:529 of the Civil Code it follows that the burden of proof for intentional conduct or gross negligence of the consumer rests with the bank.
Uit de artikelen 7:524 en 7:529 BW volgt dat de bewijslast voor opzettelijk handelen of grove nalatigheid van de consument op de bank rust.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer inzake het gebruik van en toezicht op nieuwe digitale betaalmiddelen zoals de Bitcoin

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether financial supervision of digital currencies such as Bitcoin is adequate, whether e-money definitions should change, and how money laundering risks are limited. The minister replies that Bitcoin falls outside financial supervision, sees no need for legislative change now, warns consumers of the risks, and says regulators will monitor developments and act if needed.
For now there does not appear to be a need to amend the law on this.
Vooralsnog lijkt er geen noodzaak te bestaan de wet hierop aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer naar aanleiding van berichten in de media dat Oostenrijk en Luxemburg hun bankgeheim willen behouden

MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Austria and Luxembourg's wish to keep bank secrecy hampers the fight against tax evasion and money laundering, and what options exist to force them to lift it. The State Secretary answered that the question is no longer whether bank secrecy will be abolished but when, pointing to OECD, FATCA and EU initiatives on automatic information exchange and to Nederland's negotiating position at the December European Council.
The question is no longer whether bank secrecy will be abolished but when.
De vraag is niet meer of het bankgeheim zal worden afgeschaft maar wanneer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de stevige kritiek van de ESMA op kredietbeoordelaars

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about ESMA's criticism of credit rating agencies on independence, conflicts of interest, leaked sovereign ratings, delayed publication and resourcing, and its implications for ratings' quality, bank capital rules, competition and enforcement. The minister acknowledged the findings as serious, said ESMA will keep monitoring and that EU rules may be tightened later, while deferring to ESMA on compliance and noting limited direct reliance of Dutch banks on external ratings.
It is therefore important that ESMA continues to monitor progress to ensure that credit rating agencies address the identified points.
Het is daarom van belang dat ESMA de voortgang blijft volgen om er zeker van te zijn dat kredietbeoordelaars de gesignaleerde punten oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Groot over het bericht dat de Rabobank heeft aangekondigd de Liborboete in mindering te brengen op de nettowinst van de bank

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked whether Rabobank may deduct a Libor fine from its taxable profit, and how that squares with the rule that fines are non-deductible. The State Secretary declined to discuss an individual taxpayer, explained that foreign fines are in principle deductible unlike Dutch fines, and said he is considering proposing that foreign fines also be non-deductible in a letter to parliament.
I am therefore considering proposing that foreign fines also no longer be allowed as a deduction.
Ik overweeg daarom voor te stellen ook buitenlandse boetes niet langer in aftrek toe te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Maij inzake de uitspraken van de president van de Europese Centrale Bank over het ontzien van junior obligatiehouders

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB president's letter urging that junior bondholders be spared losses in bank rescues conflicts with Dutch aims to push risks onto banks and markets, and whether the bail-in agreement, stress test and state aid exception would be weakened. The minister answered that he supports the Commission's state aid rules, that the BRRD bail-in agreement is unaffected, and that the exception would apply only in very exceptional circumstances.
I attach great importance to sparing taxpayers from the costs of problems at banks.
Ik hecht grote waarde aan het ontzien van de belastingbetaler van de kosten van problemen bij banken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de dienstverlening van banken aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf (MKB) bij het afsluiten van rentederivaten

Parliamentary questions from MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about the AFM finding that banks serving SME clients insufficiently inform them on interest rate derivatives, whether banks circumvent the duty of care, compensation for harmed firms, bank liability, and access to the Kifid complaints body. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the AFM will conduct follow-up research and monitor bank improvements, declined to commission damage assessment for now, deferred liability to civil courts, and saw no current need to widen Kifid access.
The AFM will follow up on this exploration.
De AFM zal aan deze verkenning een vervolg geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de creatieve wijze van kapitaalversterking door Spaanse en Italiaanse banken

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about Spanish and Italian banks seeking accounting relief, such as converting deferred tax assets into tax credits and revaluing Bank of Italy shares, and how buffer manipulation and state aid rules would be policed. The minister answered that supervisors have enforcement powers, that tax credits can count as core capital under CRD-IV while profit-dependent deferred tax assets cannot, that the ECB and EBA will oversee the matter, and that the Commission would assess any state aid or fiscal impact.
I do not have sufficient information to assess whether a possible revaluation of this share would be in line with the CRD-IV agreements, partly because there is no concrete proposal.

Ik beschik niet over voldoende informatie om in te schatten of een eventuele herwaardering van dit aandeel in lijn zou zijn met de afspraken van CRD-IV, mede vanwege het ontbreken van een concreet voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de verbetering van het toezicht op belangrijke financiële benchmarks

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reforming the setting of financial benchmarks such as LIBOR, EURIBOR and ISDAfix after manipulation reports, including whether IOSCO principles, EU regulation, Dutch participation, ESMA supervision and mandatory panel participation are supported. The minister supports the international principles and proportionate EU regulation, notes that the AFM's powers over benchmark manipulation will expand under the new market abuse regulation, and gives estimates of contract values while declining to quantify the impact of a one basis point deviation.
With the new Market Abuse Regulation, manipulation of benchmarks will be brought within the scope of the market abuse rules.
Met de nieuwe Verordening marktmisbruik zal manipulatie van benchmarks wel onder de reikwijdte van de regels ter voorkoming van marktmisbruik worden gebracht.

Vragen van het lid Nijboer (PvdA) aan de Minister van Financiën over de verstrekking van kredieten aan financieel adviseurs door verzekeraars en het ontwijken van het provisieverbod (ingezonden 5 augustus 2013).

An MP asks the Finance Minister about insurers granting discount credit to financial advisers, whether this undermines the provisieverbod (commission ban), and about possible circumvention such as service subscriptions and double charging. The minister says the ban safeguards impartiality, that he lacks data on how many advisers hold such credits, will restrict premium collection in a draft amendment, and that the AFM is investigating misconduct.
I have no information on how many financial advisers have a discount credit outstanding with an insurer.
Over hoeveel financieel adviseurs een kortingskrediet hebben lopen bij een verzekeraar heb ik geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van Laar over de boekhouding van het Rijk

MPs Nijboer and Van Laar asked the Finance Minister about press reports that ministries spent 472 million euros unlawfully and about the accountability of central government spending. The minister answered that 0.20% of 2012 spending (about 470 million euros, of which roughly 60% was uncertain rather than wrong) was unlawful, within the 1% tolerance, and pointed to Court of Audit reports, the 2013 accountability debate and ministers' commitments.
The unlawfulness rate of central government spending in 2012 (0.20%: about 470 million euros) remained well within the 1% tolerance limit.
Het onrechtmatigheidspercentage van de rijksuitgaven in 2012 (0,20%: circa € 470 miljoen) bleef daarmee ruim binnen de tolerantiegrens van 1%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de dreigende sluiting van de sociale werkplaats in Groningen

MPs Kerstens, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether the Secretary of State was aware of reports on the threatened closure of the Groningen sheltered workshop, whether she agreed with the term 'sterfhuisconstructie', and whether a regional-differences motion would be implemented. The Secretary answered yes to awareness, explained that the Participatiewet closes Wsw inflow from 2015 without the state closing workshops, and confirmed regional factors will be weighed in the new budget distribution.
The central government is not closing any sw-bedrijven.
Het Rijk sluit daarbij geen sw-bedrijven.
Vragen van het lid Nijboer(PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over mogelijke prijsmanipulatie op de internationale valutamarkten (ingezonden 17 juni 2013).

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about possible price manipulation on international currency markets, the 'wild west' characterisation, dark pools, MiFID II treatment, and benchmark manipulation such as WM/Reuters and LIBOR. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that spot FX is outside MiFID but FX derivatives are covered, that the government supports EU and IOSCO benchmark principles and will regulate benchmarks proportionately, and that the forthcoming market abuse regulation will bring benchmark manipulation within enforcement reach.
Given the widespread use of benchmarks in financial instruments and contracts, it is important that benchmarks are set in an honest and transparent manner.
Gezien het wijdverbreide gebruik van benchmarks in financiële instrumenten en contracten is het belangrijk dat benchmarks op een integere en transparante wijze tot stand komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over aanpassing van stemrechten binnen de ECB-Raadsvergaderingen

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether he supports the rotation system for voting rights in the ECB Governing Council once a further country joins the euro, and whether it endangers balanced monetary policy. The minister answered that the system respects equal treatment and transparency, that Netherlands stays in the first group for the foreseeable future, and that the rotation start is not yet determined.
This random start has not yet been assigned, so an overview of the rotation cannot yet be drawn up.
Deze willekeurige start is nog niet toegewezen, een overzicht van de roulatie kan zodoende nog niet worden opgesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over bonussen bij Robeco

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Robeco transaction bonus approved by DNB despite apparently conflicting with the remuneration rules, and whether it could be blocked or clawed back. The minister said DNB granted a one-time exemption with added conditions, that the payment had not yet occurred and clawback is possible, and that he will consult on a bill capping financial sector bonuses after the summer recess.
I have asked DNB for an explanation regarding the considerations behind approving the transaction bonuses.
Ik heb DNB om uitleg gevraagd met betrekking tot de overwegingen bij het goedkeuren van de transactiebonussen.

Vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het afschaffen van het 500-eurobiljet en de oprichting van een Europees Openbaar Ministerie (Ingezond

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Finance and Justice ministers about abolishing the 500-euro banknote, the AIV advice on crime and corruption, a European Public Prosecutor, financial crime investigation capacity, and FATF implementation. The government declined to back abolition, noted that only the ECB can decide on it, committed to drawing DNB's attention to the note, and said it opposes a European Public Prosecutor for now while expanding financial investigation capacity.
The Minister of Finance asked DNB to give special attention to the 500-euro banknote in future research into the use of euro banknotes.
De Minister van Financiën heeft DNB verzocht in toekomstige onderzoeken naar het gebruik van eurobiljetten speciale aandacht te geven aan het 500-eurobiljet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Koolmees over de ongewogen kapitaalratio

MPs Nijboer and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister about risk-weighted capital ratios, the non-risk-weighted leverage ratio, and related Basel III and CRD IV timing and accounting issues. The minister answered that internal models allow useful flexibility but create variation and risks, that the EU and Basel are studying the variation, that the leverage ratio should complement risk-weighted requirements, and that a binding minimum will come later (2018).

For this reason, both the European Banking Authority (EBA) and the Basel Committee have for some time been researching the causes of differences in RWA and policy options to limit undesirable differences.

Daarom doen zowel de Europese Bankenautoriteit (EBA) als het Bazels Comité op dit moment al enige tijd onderzoek naar de oorzaken van verschillen in RWA en beleidsopties om ongewenste verschillen te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanpak van de woekerpolisaffaire

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the handling of the 'woekerpolis' affair: whether insurers are restoring trust, how many policies have negative value, what compensation is offered, and how the Oosting commission for hardship cases works. The minister answered that insurers must actively reach out to affected customers, the AFM will monitor aftercare with results in early 2014, and the hardship commission is expected to see little use.
I will inform the House of these results.
Ik zal uw Kamer over deze resultaten informeren.
Antwoord vragen Nijboer over misstanden met uitvaartverzekeringen

MP Nijboer asks the finance minister about misconduct in funeral insurance, including possible double payment for advice, opaque cost structures, AFM warnings since 2008, and over-insurance. The minister says the AFM has been alerted and will decide on enforcement, a standardised service document will improve cost comparison from 1 July, the AFM is investigating intermediaries and has considered formal measures, and it monitors consumer information without further targeted investigation.
I have alerted the AFM to the possibility that consumers are paying twice for advice.
Ik heb de AFM erop geattendeerd dat er mogelijk sprake is van dubbel betalen voor advies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de opkomst van de Bitcoin als digitale betaaleenheid

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about the rise of Bitcoin as a digital currency, its risks, its use for money laundering, and its tax treatment. The minister answered that Bitcoin falls outside financial supervision and poses no current systemic risk, that the FIOD monitors possible criminal use, and that Bitcoin gains are taxable income.
Its use is not subject to any form of government financial supervision, and the deposit guarantee scheme does not apply to Bitcoin.
Het gebruik ervan is niet onderworpen aan enige vorm van financieel toezicht van overheidswege en ook het depositogarantiestelsel is niet van toepassing op Bitcoin.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over beperking flitshandel

MP Nijboer asks the Finance Minister about high-frequency trading, EBS dropping first-come-first-served order handling, and fake Twitter news moving markets, and whether the government will consult exchanges to curb flash trading. The minister answers that EBS's plans are unclear, that MiFID II will address algorithmic trading risks, that misleading information is covered by market manipulation rules, and that consulting exchanges is not opportune because EBS is an unregulated FX platform.
The precise plans of EBS are not known.
De precieze plannen van EBS zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over schoon schip maken bij SNS

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the status of SNS Reaal's internal integrity investigation, including FIOD suspicions of conflicts of interest at SNS Property Finance and reports that suspects remained supervisory board members. The minister answered that the investigation is ongoing with external help, 17 persons are no longer active, a former director was reported, and the two suspects' supervisory mandates have been ended, while stating he has asked management to keep him informed.
Since the investigation is not yet concluded, no specific statements can be made about it at this time.
Aangezien het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond kunnen hier nu nog geen specifieke mededelingen over worden gedaan

Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de mogelijkheid voor financieel dienstverleners om adviezen van het Klachteninstituut financiële dienstverlening (Kifid) als niet-bindend te aanvaarden

MPs Nijboer and Mei Li Vos asked the Finance Minister about reports that financial firms can opt out of binding Kifid complaint rulings, and whether the list of non-binding firms and the scope of Kifid access should change. The minister answered that binding force cannot be enshrined in law under the Constitution, announced that Kifid will limit withdrawal of binding acceptance to new contracts, and said he is willing to examine extending access to small businesses.
Kifid plans to amend its rules so that withdrawal of acceptance of the binding force of its rulings applies only to contractual relationships entered into after that date.

Het Kifid is van plan haar reglementen zo aan te passen dat een intrekking van de aanvaarding van de bindendheid van haar uitspraken alleen geldt voor contractuele verhoudingen die na deze datum zijn aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over het nieuwe voorstel van de Europese Commissie voor een financiële transactiebelasting

MPs Nijboer and Vermeij asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the Commission's new financial transaction tax proposal, including its effect on Dutch pension funds, extraterritorial reach, a de minimis exemption, next steps, and compensation for non-participating states. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the Netherlands will not join the enhanced cooperation yet because pension funds are still taxed, that the impact cannot yet be reliably calculated, and that compensation is not provided but will be raised in negotiations.
Therefore the Netherlands will for now not join the enhanced cooperation.
Nederland zal daarom op dit moment niet toetreden tot de nauwere samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over witwassen via prepaid- en cadeaukaarten

An MP asked the Finance Minister about money laundering through prepaid and gift cards, including the FATF estimate for the Netherlands, reporting obligations, card limits and customs controls on cross-border movement. The minister answered that prepaid cards fall under the anti-money-laundering law with reporting duties supervised by DNB, that no statutory limits exist but gift cards in practice carry small balances, and that customs lacks powers over prepaid cards, which will be examined.
Thus the EGI is exempt that issues electronic money usable only within its own premises, within a limited network of service providers or for a limited range of goods and services.

Zo is de EGI uitgezonderd die elektronisch geld uitgeeft waarmee alleen kan worden betaald binnen de eigen bedrijfsgebouwen, binnen een beperkt netwerk van dienstverleners of voor een beperkte reeks van goederen en diensten.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Nijboer over grote winstmarges voor banken op hypotheken

MPs Monasch and Nijboer asked about reports that Dutch banks' mortgage profit margins rose between January 2012 and January 2013 despite small rate cuts, and about the size of the extra margin and its effect on borrowers and the housing market. The minister confirmed margins have risen since 2011 per an ACM study, but said the absolute size is uncertain and gave an estimated increase of 0.24 to 0.74 percentage points, with ACM promising further research into competition in the mortgage market.
The ACM has indicated it will conduct further research this year into possibilities for improving market competition in the banking sector, including the mortgage market.
De ACM heeft aangegeven nog dit jaar nader onderzoek te zullen verrichten naar mogelijkheden voor verbeteringen van de marktwerking in de bancaire sector, waaronder de hypotheekmarkt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ernstige tekortkomingen bij externe accountantscontroles en de weigering van de grote vier accountantskantoren om de wet over scheiding van advies- en controlepraktijk na te le

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the finance minister about the AFM's findings that Big 4 audit firms signed new advisory contracts with audit clients just before the transitional period of the audit-advisory separation law, and that most audits at nine firms showed serious deficiencies. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the firms acted against the spirit of the law, that the AFM has enforcement tools it is using, and that the existing enforcement framework is adequate.
The existing enforcement instruments seem to me sufficiently adequate.
Het bestaande handhavingsinstrumentarium lijkt mij voldoende adequaat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over het criminele gebruik van het 500 eurobiljet

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about criminal use of the 500-euro note, the reasons for differing 500-note shares across euro countries, reporting thresholds for cash transactions, foreign high-denomination note policies, and whether DNB or the ECB should be asked to investigate further. The minister answered that the ECB holds exclusive competence over banknotes, outlined the ECB's findings and sanctions under the Wwft, and agreed to ask DNB and the ECB to give special attention to the 500-euro note in future research without prejudging outcomes.
I am willing to ask DNB and the ECB to give special attention to the role of the €500 note in future research on euro banknote use.
Ik ben bereid DNB en ECB te verzoeken speciale aandacht te geven aan de rol van specifiek het € 500-biljet in toekomstige onderzoeken naar het gebruik van eurobiljetten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de digitale poliskluis

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the industry's proposed digital insurance 'policy vault' and its privacy implications, including the use of the citizen service number. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that a digital overview can help curb over- and under-insurance, pointed to the BSN-based pension register as precedent, and described ongoing feasibility work and new adviser competence rules.
The Association of Insurers regards the use of the BSN, DigiD and/or access to the GBA as an important success factor for the policy vault.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars geeft aan het gebruik van BSN, DigiD en/of toegang tot GBA als een belangrijke succesfactor voor de poliskluis te zien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Nijboer over het belastingvoordeel dat gepaard gaat met het aanbieden van hypotheken onder marktrentes

MPs Groot and Nijboer asked the state secretary of Finance whether employee mortgage discounts below market rate should be taxed at market value rather than the 3% norm rate, and about the revenue loss. The state secretary confirmed the tax treatment rules, said the norm rate is applied in practice, and stated there is no budgetary loss; the rule will be reviewed in light of planned mortgage interest deduction limits.
In light of the upcoming restrictions on mortgage interest deduction, as foreseen in the VVD/PvdA coalition agreement, this arrangement will still be reviewed.
In het licht van de aanstaande beperkingen van de hypotheekrenteaftrek, zoals voorzien in het Regeerakkoord VVD/PvdA, zal deze regeling nog worden bezien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over het onderzoek van de FIOD naar mogelijke belangenverstrengeling in de top van SNS Property Finance

PvdA MP Nijboer asked the ministers of Finance about a FIOD investigation into possible conflicts of interest at SNS Property Finance, including the basis for suspicion, links to its losses and nationalisation, contact with SNS Reaal's new board, and liability and bonus claw-back for staff. The minister declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation, said the board was monitoring integrity signals, and noted employers can hold staff financially liable for fraud.
I make no statements regarding ongoing criminal investigations.
Ik doe geen mededelingen met betrekking tot lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over de uitspraken van eurocommissaris Semeta over een financiële sectorbelasting en de positie van pensioenfondsen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Commissioner Semeta's statements that a new financial transaction tax would not exempt pension funds conflict with the Dutch coalition conditions for joining enhanced cooperation on the tax. The minister replied that the Commission proposal does not meet the coalition conditions, so the Netherlands will not join for now, and that it will keep lobbying in the Ecofin Council and inform parliament via a BNC fiche.
This proposal does not meet the conditions of the coalition agreement.
Dit voorstel voldoet niet aan de voorwaarden van het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de rol van het €500 biljet in de geldsmokkel, witwascircuit, drugs- en overige criminaliteit

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the role of the 500-euro note in money smuggling, money laundering and crime, and whether it should be withdrawn. The minister replied that the ECB decides denominations, that Dutch use of the note is limited, and that existing reporting duties and EU cash controls are adequate, so he will not push for withdrawal.
All things considered, I do not intend to advocate at DNB and the ECB for withdrawing the 500-euro note from circulation.
Alles overwegende ben ik niet voornemens om bij DNB en de ECB het uit het betalingsverkeer halen van het biljet van 500 euro te bepleiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de kosten verbonden aan creditcardbetalingen

MPs Nijboer and Mei Li Vos asked about the high cost of credit card payments for retailers, whether card companies may charge above cost, whether the EU consumer rights directive will curb fees, whether Dutch action should not await EU payment services rules, and whether the regulators should investigate. The minister answered that retailers negotiate with their payment provider, that no action is warranted now, that the directive limits surcharges to actual costs, and that the competition authority NMa is independent and may start its own investigation.
I currently see no reason to take action in this area.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om actie op dit vlak te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de hoge betalingskosten voor verkopende partijen bij PayPal

Two MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about high PayPal fees charged to sellers, whether a legal cap applies, and whether the EU consumer rights directive or a regulator investigation would change this. The minister answered that no legal maximum exists, that consumers are protected from excessive surcharges by the directive, and that the competition authority NMa is independent and has been informed of the concerns.
The NMa is an independent regulator, so it is not for me to ask it to investigate certain markets.
De NMa is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder, het is dan ook niet aan mij om haar te verzoeken onderzoek te doen naar bepaalde markten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet uitkeren van het premieoverschot door enkele overlijdensrisico-verzekeraars bij het voortijdig stopzetten van de verzekering

MP Nijboer asked whether life-risk insurers must pay out the premium surplus or offer a paid-up policy when a policy is cancelled early, and asked for AFM attention and an inventory of such products. The minister answered that the Civil Code obliges surrender or paid-up continuation only in some cases, that the AFM was alerted and can enforce the client-interest norm, and that an inventory was not opportune, while consultation with the insurers' association had already taken place.
I drew the AFM's attention to the legal framework it was already aware of and asked it to pay attention to possible non-compliance with the rules by insurers.
Ik heb de AFM geattendeerd op het wettelijk kader waarmee zij bekend was en daarbij aandacht gevraagd voor de eventuele niet-naleving van de regels door verzekeraars.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Nijboer en Van Dekken inzake de stroomtarieven van aluminiumproducent Aldel

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the electricity tariffs facing aluminium producer Aldel, a German grid-cost exemption for large consumers, and unfair European competition. The minister replied that a Dutch equivalent of the German rule is being studied within the STROOM legislative agenda, that the Commission's state-aid view is awaited, and that a concrete compensation scheme is under consideration.
Because of the redistribution effects, it is important to consider any large-consumer scheme in an integrated way within the broader revision of tariff regulation under the STROOM legislative agenda.

Vanwege de herverdelingseffecten is het van belang een eventuele grootverbruikerregeling integraal te bezien binnen de bredere herziening van de tariefregulering die plaatsvindt binnen de wetgevingsagenda STROOM.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de vergoeding van schade bij fraude bij internetbankieren

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether banks bear primary responsibility for internet-banking fraud losses, why compensation standards differ between banks, and whether the reverse burden of proof of the US system should be introduced. The minister answered that the legal framework (Payment Services Directive, BW) assigns the burden of proof to banks and that remaining differences in goodwill policy will be discussed in the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer, while rejecting new legislation for now.
I assume you are referring to the US Electronic Fund Transfer Act and Regulation E.
Ik ga ervan uit dat u doelt op de Amerikaanse Electronic Fund Transfer Act en Regulation E
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over kritiek van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) op de wirwar aan beleggingskosten

Rep. Nijboer asked the finance minister whether he shared the AFM's criticism that investment service costs are complex and unclear, and whether he would support a comparable total cost of ownership and legal measures if needed. The minister agreed costs are hard for consumers to grasp, supported the AFM's TCO approach as a transparency tool, and said he would take legal measures if necessary while awaiting the consultation outcome.
I am willing to take legal measures, if necessary.
Ik ben bereid om, indien nodig, wettelijke maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over de uitspraken van ING bestuursvoorzitter Hommen over het in het regeerakkoord opgenomen bonusplafond van twintig procent

MP Nijboer asked the finance minister about ING CEO Hommen's remarks that a 20% bonus cap would hurt international competitiveness, and whether the cap should be legislated urgently. The minister agreed bonuses contributed to the crisis, welcomed ING's removal of variable pay for CAO staff, and said a 20% cap would not hurt recruitment for most roles, promising more detail in early 2013 without committing to an immediate bill.
I expect to be able to inform you further in early 2013 about how I will give effect to the measure in an effective way.
Ik verwacht u begin 2013 nader te kunnen informeren over de manier waarop ik de maatregel op een effectieve wijze vorm zal geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer over vergoeding schade bij fraude internetbankieren

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about liability for losses from internet banking fraud, including whether banks are shifting liability to customers through security conditions. The minister replied that liability is limited to 150 euro for non-compliance with bank security rules, with full liability only for intent or gross negligence, that banks have been generous but are becoming stricter, and that disputes can go to KiFiD or the courts.
Consumers are liable where there is intent or gross negligence.
Consumenten zijn aansprakelijk als sprake is van opzet of grove nalatigheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Monasch over het bericht dat de hypotheekrentes in Nederland in internationaal perspectief zeer hoog zijn

MPs Nijboer and Monasch asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch mortgage margins are too high by international standards, whether the mortgage market is uncompetitive, and whether the price-leadership ban is to blame. The minister said DNB attributes much of the gap to higher bank funding costs, that the NMa found margins had returned to pre-crisis levels in 2011, and that ING's price-leadership ban was lifted and NN Bank will enter the market, with the NMa continuing to monitor.
Because margins may have risen since then, given changed competitive conditions after several parties recently left the Dutch market, I welcome the NMa closely monitoring the mortgage market.

Omdat de marges sindsdien kunnen zijn gestegen, mede gegeven de gewijzigde concurrentieverhoudingen ten gevolge van het feit dat recentelijk een aantal partijen de Nederlandse markt hebben verlaten, juich ik toe dat de NMa de hypotheekmarkt scherp monitort.
Antwoord vragen Nijboer en Vos over de hoge additionele kosten bij het gebruik van een creditcard voor betalingen en specifiek voor boekingen bij vliegtuigmaatschappijen

MPs Nijboer and Vos asked about high credit-card surcharges on payments, especially airline bookings, and whether UK-style rules should apply in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the EU consumer rights directive caps surcharges at actual costs, including for passenger transport, that a Dutch implementing bill is expected soon, and that the Payment Services Directive revision will be pursued, while consumer-authority enforcement on hidden fees is noted.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Nijboer inzake onnodig duur ‘rood staan’ op betaalrekeningen

An MP asks the Finance Minister why people go into overdraft while holding savings, which banks charge high overdraft rates, and whether the maximum credit charge should be lowered. The minister answers that existing consumer-credit rules and AFM monitoring apply, promises a study on lowering the overdraft ceiling in 2013, and says he will discuss avoiding long overdrafts with the sector.
I will start a study into the effects of the maximum credit charge on overdrafts, the possibilities of moving to a lower ceiling, and the justification for this ceiling.

In aanvulling op deze maatregelen zal ik een onderzoek starten naar de effecten van de maximum kredietvergoeding op roodstanden, naar de mogelijkheden om naar een lager plafond te gaan en naar de onderbouwing van dit plafond.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Nijboer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers voor Wonen en Rijksdienst en van Financiën over de striktere regels omtrent de Nationale Hypotheek Garantie bij oversluiten van een hypotheek (ingezon

MPs Monasch and Nijboer asked the ministers whether stricter NHG rules requiring annuity or linear repayment when remortgaging would apply to all existing NHG mortgages, and why. The minister answered that the rule was unintended, asked the WEW to amend it so existing savings and interest-only NHG mortgages can move to a new home without mandatory repayment change, and the WEW agreed to do so.

I have therefore asked the WEW to adjust the rules so that existing savings and/or interest-only mortgages with National Mortgage Guarantee can be carried over to a next home without owners being required to repay annuity-style.
Ik heb daarom het WEW verzocht de regels zodanig aan te passen dat bestaande spaar- en/of aflossingsvrije hypotheken met Nationale Hypotheek Garantie meegenomen kunnen worden naar een volgende woning

m: Motie van de leden Siderius en Jasper van Dijk over volwaardig instemmingsrecht van de medezeggenschap over een campus van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen in China
Asks the government to give the works council full consent rights over all decisions on setting up a Groningen university campus in China.
requests the government to give full consent rights to the works council on all decision-making moments
verzoekt de regering, volwaardig instemmingsrecht te geven aan de medezeggenschap inzake alle besluitvormingsmomenten
Motie van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over een pilot om de rijksbijdrage rechtstreeks aan de schoolvestiging uit te keren
Asks the government to organise a pilot in which the national school funding is paid directly to individual school locations rather than to school boards.
requests the government to organise a pilot in which the national contribution is paid directly to the school location
verzoekt de regering, een pilot te organiseren waarin de rijksbijdrage rechtstreeks aan de schoolvestiging wordt uitgekeerd
Motie van het lid Siderius over uniforme formulieren, toelaatbaarheidsverklaringen en procedures
Asks the government to design uniform forms, admission declarations and procedures for all special-education cooperation bodies by 1 January 2017.
requests the government to design uniform forms, admission declarations and procedures for all cooperation bodies
verzoekt de regering, uniforme formulieren, toelaatbaarheidsverklaringen en procedures voor alle samenwerkingsverbanden te ontwerpen
Motie van het lid Siderius over structureel compenseren van scholen
Asks the government to structurally compensate schools for the 3 million euro in extra administrative costs from the development-perspective law.
requests the government to structurally compensate schools for the extra administrative costs of 3 million euros
verzoekt de regering, scholen structureel te compenseren voor de extra administratielasten van 3 miljoen euro
Motie van het lid Siderius over cluster 3-leerlingen met een Wajong-uitkering
Asks the government to create a benefit entitlement for adult cluster 3 students under Wajong instead of commissioning research.
not to conduct research but to make a provision
geen onderzoek in te stellen, maar een voorziening te treffen
Amendement van het lid Ypma c.s. over medezeggenschap voor ouders van leerlingen met een ondersteuningsarrangement
Amendment gives parents of pupils supported by specialist institutions for clusters 1 and 2 a seat on the institution's participation council.
Motie van het lid Siderius over een eenvoudige registratie van het aantal geweigerde studenten
Asks the government to set up a simple registration system recording how many applicants mbo institutions refuse and why.
to set up a simple registration system for mbo institutions
een eenvoudig registratiesysteem in te richten voor mbo-instellingen
Amendement van het lid Siderius over diversiteitsbeleid in het bestuursverslag
Requires companies to report in their board report on diversity policy, including measures against discrimination and unequal treatment.
The board report must also include a section on the diversity policy pursued by the legal entity
In het bestuursverslag wordt tevens een paragraaf opgenomen over het door de rechtspersoon gevoerde diversiteitsbeleid
Motie van het lid Rog c.s. over per direct staken van het experiment met de onderbouwtoets
Asks the government to immediately stop the experiment with an interim diagnostic test and redirect the funds to formative feedback culture in education.
requests the government to stop the experiment with the onderbouwtoets immediately and invest the freed funds in strengthening a formative feedback culture in education
verzoekt de regering, het experiment met de onderbouwtoets per direct te staken en de vrijkomende middelen te investeren in het versterken van een formatieve feedbackcultuur in het onderwijs
Amendement van het lid Siderius waarmee de voorkeursbehandeling bij lotingen van studenten die zich voor 1 april hebben aangemeld vervalt
Removes the rule giving earlier applicants (before 1 April) priority in lotteries for vocational education (mbo) programmes.
the last sentence of article 8.1.1c, fifth paragraph, is deleted.
vervalt in artikel 8.1.1c, vijfde lid, de laatste volzin.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Meenen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 7 waarmee de invoering van het bindend studieadvies uit het wetsvoorstel wordt geschrapt
Amends the education bill to delete the introduction of a binding study advice (bindend studieadvies) in vocational education.
This amendment provides that the introduction of the binding study advice in vocational education is deleted.
Dit amendement regelt dat de invoering van het bindend studieadvies in het mbo wordt geschrapt.
Motie van de leden Siderius en Jasper Van Dijk over daadwerkelijke besteding van onderwijsgeld in de klas
Asks the government to ensure at least half of the 485 million euro held by school boards is actually spent in classrooms this year and to inform the Chamber.
requests the government to aim for at least half of the 485 million euro to be actually spent in the classroom this year
verzoekt de regering, ernaar te streven dat ten minste de helft van de 485 miljoen euro nog dit jaar daadwerkelijk in de klas wordt besteed
Motie van het lid Ulenbelt c.s. over een uitzondering in de regeling voor kinderopvangtoeslag
Asks the government to create an exception in childcare allowance rules so families where a partner is long-term unable to work or care due to illness can still receive it, and to inform the Chamber.
requests the government to make an exception in the childcare allowance scheme
verzoekt de regering, een uitzondering te maken in de regeling voor kinderopvangtoeslag
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Siderius ter vervanging van nr. 16 waarmee een fonds voor thuiszitters wordt opgericht
Amendment shifts budget within the education budget to create a fund of 63 million for children not attending school.
This amendment establishes a fund of 63 million for pupils who do not attend education and stay at home.
Dit amendement regelt een fonds van 63 miljoen voor leerlingen die geen onderwijs volgen en thuis zitten.
Motie van het lid Siderius over inkomensafhankelijk maken van de kinderbijslagen op de BES-eilanden
Asks the government to make the child benefit scheme for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba income-dependent.
requests the government to make the child benefit scheme for the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba income-dependent
verzoekt de regering, de regeling voor kinderbijslag voor de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint-Eustatius en Saba inkomensafhankelijk te maken
Motie van het lid Siderius over automatisch aanvragen van kinderbijslag op de BES-eilanden
Asks the government to arrange child benefit for the BES islands so that registration in the population register automatically triggers an application.
to shape it so that when children are registered in the population administration, child benefit is automatically applied for
zo vorm te geven dat bij inschrijvingen van kinderen in de bevolkingsadministratie automatisch kinderbijslag wordt aangevraagd
Motie van het lid Siderius over altijd kunnen overstappen naar een ander profiel in het vmbo
Asks the government to make it possible for vmbo pupils to switch to another profile at any school and at any time.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het artikel "Amsterdamse Kinderombudsman hekelt regeloerwoud in mbo"

MPs Siderius (SP) asked the Minister of Education about the Amsterdam Children's Ombudsman's findings that mbo vocational colleges have complex complaint procedures that leave students stuck, including cases of a chronically ill student charged tuition and a pregnant student unilaterally deregistered. The Minister disputes that the findings apply nationally, points to existing complaint-law reforms and the Inspectorate's enforcement powers, and says no nationwide scale-up is needed.
The Amsterdam Children's Ombudsman's research specifically concerns the complaint procedures of the mbo institutions ROC van Amsterdam and ROC TOP.
Het onderzoek van de Amsterdamse Kinderombudsman gaat specifiek over de klachtenprocedures van de mbo-instellingen ROC van Amsterdam en ROC TOP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over dubbele kinderbijslag voor uitwonende minderjarige leerlingen die een beroepsopleiding volgen die op weinig plekken in Nederland wordt aangeboden

An SP MP asked whether the list of rare vocational courses qualifying for double child benefit for students living away from home for education should be widened, including Media Management and Music Industry Professional. The minister replied that the under-10-institutions criterion is applied as set, that the lists are updated annually, that the two courses were excluded for 2016-2017 because they had more than 10 institutions in 2015, and that hardship cases are handled by the SVB.

The courses Media Management and Music Industry Professional are not included in the annex to the Regulation on double child benefit for educational reasons for the 2016-2017 school year because on 1 October 2015 these courses had participants enrolled at 10 institutions.

De opleidingen Media Management en Music Industry Professional zijn niet opgenomen in de bijlage bij de Regeling dubbele kinderbijslag om onderwijsredenen voor het schooljaar 2016–2017 omdat voor deze opleidingen op 1 oktober 2015 op 10 instellingen deelnemers stonden ingeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over conciërges en klassenassistenten

An SP MP asked how many concierges and classroom assistants were hired since 2015 with the structural 50 million euro from the 2014 budget agreement, and requested yearly headcounts from 2010 to 2014. The State Secretary replied that the funds went into the lump sum so hiring cannot be traced, but DUO staff data show a rise in support staff from 2014 to 2015 and provides figures for 2010-2015.
As a result, it is not possible to state how many concierges and classroom assistants have been hired with this money.
Daardoor is het niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel conciërges en klassenassistenten met dit geld zijn aangesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het bericht dat scholieren vaak ziek thuis zitten

An SP MP asked the education state secretary about reports that many pupils stay home sick, whether passend onderwijs has failed, and whether the M@ZL programme should be rolled out nationally. The state secretary said there is no national data on pupil sickness absence, that M@ZL halved absence in West Brabant, and that the NCJ is exploring wider rollout while regions decide themselves.
No, I cannot give you figures on this.
Nee, ik kan u hierover geen cijfers geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de stand van zaken bij het Bureau Kwaliteit Kinderopvang

An SP MP asked the minister about the status of quality assurance of BKK-approved language and interaction training for childcare staff, whether its effectiveness has been scientifically proven, and what improvements BKK has made since 2014 and how the minister supervises them. The minister answered that monitoring is ongoing, that effects are well-founded but not yet independently studied, that an independent effectiveness study is planned for autumn with results promised in spring 2017, and that the ministry follows progress through regular consultation.
I intend to commission an independent study this autumn into the effects of the training courses.
Ik ben voornemens om dit najaar een onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de effecten van de trainingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de positie van de landelijke ouderorganisatie Ouders & Onderwijs

An SP MP asked the education state secretary whether the state-funded parents' organisation Ouders & Onderwijs adequately represents parents, how its 1 million euro budget, director's spending and grant discretion are controlled, and whether its evaluation should be brought forward. The state secretary defended the organisation as fulfilling a parliamentary motion, pointed to an evaluation in 2017 covering governance and representation, detailed the 2015 expenditure, and declined to bring the evaluation forward.
I want to first give the organisation the opportunity to take shape before I evaluate.
Ik wil de organisatie eerst de kans geven vorm te krijgen, alvorens ik ga evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over examens in het speciaal onderwijs

MP Siderius asked whether students with autism in special secondary education must take the oral college exam, whether their test grades count toward the final exam grade, and whether the oral exam can be taken in writing. The State Secretary answered that schools choose among exam modalities; under the state exam the college exam (oral, possibly partly written, adaptable with CvTE approval) determines half the final grade, and schools with an exam licence can count test results while written alternatives are possible.
A written exam instead of an oral exam is among the possibilities.
Een schriftelijk examen in plaats van een mondeling examen behoort tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over flexibele bekostiging van de kinderopvang

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether childcare billing must follow fixed time units, whether overbilling for partly used sessions is tracked, and whether per-hour or per-half-hour billing would save childcare allowance. The minister replied that contract freedom governs billing units, that no data exist on allowance paid for unused hours, and that he sees no need for new measures on flexible billing.
It is not known how much childcare allowance is paid for hours that are billed to the parent but when the child is not at the childcare.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel kinderopvangtoeslag wordt uitgekeerd voor uren die wel in rekening worden gebracht aan de ouder, maar waarbij het kind niet op de opvang is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de aanhoudende problemen met het leerlingenvervoer in De Fryske Marren

The State Secretary answered that the municipality is responsible, that data should not have been shared and an apology was given, and that complaints can be lodged with the municipality, while declining to inspect stop conditions and committing to no new action.
School transport is a responsibility of the municipalities.
Het leerlingenvervoer is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het opheffen van de Groep in School (GIS) op basisschool de Torteltuin in Almere

An SP MP asked whether closing the Groep in School at de Torteltuin in Almere without an equivalent alternative, on financial grounds and without parental involvement, was acceptable under passend onderwijs. The State Secretary replied that school boards in the SWV are responsible for a dekkend aanbod, that alternatives were offered to all pupils, that parents were informed and consulted, and that no extra measures or investigation are needed.
As stated in the answer to question 1, it is the responsibility of the schools within a collaborative partnership to organise a comprehensive range of support provision.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 1 staat, is het de verantwoordelijkheid van de scholen binnen een samenwerkingsverband om een dekkend aanbod aan ondersteuningsvoorzieningen te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de werkwijze van het interventieteam Onderwijs en Zorg

An MP asked the state secretary about the criteria, procedures and powers of the Interventieteam Onderwijs en Zorg, which handles children who stay home long-term. The government answered that the team has no extra powers or override authority, works case by case with parental consent, and that remaining cases are still in progress.
The intervention team has no override authority.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat stapeling van diploma’s in het MBO belemmerd worden door verplichte keuzedelen

An SP MP asked whether requiring three elective modules (keuzedelen) in one year for bbl students moving from MBO level 2 to level 3 obstructs diploma stacking, and whether exemptions or a per-year quota could be introduced. The minister answered that the rules apply equally to bbl and bol, that institutions can grant exemptions and set programme structure, that transitional arrangements give enough time, and that she could not yet give enrolment numbers.
I cannot do that at this moment. Not all enrolments for the 2016–2017 school year are known yet.
Dat kan ik op dit moment niet. Nog niet alle inschrijvingen voor het schooljaar 2016–2017 zijn bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat een leerling vanwege haar beperking niet mee op schoolkamp mocht

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether it is acceptable that a pupil with a disability was excluded from a school camp, and what the school and government will do about it. The State Secretary said exclusion is not desirable, declined to judge the individual case, contacted the school, which will look at better support for activities outside class, and pointed to existing anti-discrimination law and the UN disability convention.
Ik heb contact gelegd met de school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Bashir over het feit dat ouderparen waarvan één partner ernstig ziek is fiscaal ongelijk behandeld worden

MPs Siderius and Bashir (SP) asked whether couples where one partner is seriously ill are unfairly treated by the tax system compared with single parents, given lower child benefit and a higher tax burden, and whether they will be compensated. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the comparison is partial, that income support for the chronically ill runs through other schemes and municipal SMI, that the combination credit is a participation tool not meant for income support, and that the SMI policy will be reviewed with a vision letter this autumn.
There is no question of exclusion from income support for couples in which one partner is seriously ill.
Er is geen sprake van uitsluiting van inkomensondersteuning voor ouderparen waarvan één partner ernstig ziek is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat de kinderopvang een eigen kredietunie gaat starten

Opposition MP Siderius asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government regrets that childcare providers can no longer obtain bank finance and must turn to a credit union or EU subsidies, and whether government childcare allowance policy caused this. The minister answered that the sector is private, that the government supports credit unions in principle, and that bank tightening stems from general SME credit conditions, while noting recent childcare funding increases and refusing to contribute to the credit union's start-up costs.
I see this as a natural movement in a market sector, in which supply and demand move towards each other.
Ik zie dit als een natuurlijke beweging in een marktsector, waarbij vraag en aanbod naar elkaar toe groeien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de toegang van leerlingen met een beperking uit het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs tot de REA topklas in Leiden

An SP MP asked the minister whether it is desirable that vso graduates with vmbo-tl diplomas can no longer enter the REA topklas at ROC Leiden due to cuts, and about the consequences for their schooling, plus questions on passend onderwijs gaps in mbo. The minister answered that support is the responsibility of mbo institutions and regional partners, that no decision has yet been taken on the REA topklas, that no shortfall in funding is seen, and that monitoring of passend onderwijs will continue.
As I already indicated, I find it important that students receive appropriate support to successfully complete a mbo programme.
Zoals ik al aangaf vind ik het belangrijk dat studenten passende ondersteuning krijgen om succesvol een mbo-opleiding af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de toekenning van kinderopvangtoeslag voor vierjarige kinderen met een beperking die een wenprogramma doorlopen

An SP MP asked whether children with disabilities starting a transition ('wen') programme at age four are registered as school pupils, which cuts off daycare allowance, and whether this discourages parents from working. The minister answers that the rules are clear, that BSO allowance applies once a child attends primary school, and that municipalities can provide supplementary support through social medical indication, so no structural change is planned.
Where necessary, an additional provision can be made for children with a disability via the municipality.
Daar waar nodig kan er voor kinderen met een beperking een aanvullende voorziening worden getroffen via de gemeente
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over het bericht dat de GGD Hart voor Brabant de screening van spraak- en taalontwikkeling van 5-jarigen stop zet

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked whether the GGD Hart voor Brabant stopping logopedic screening of 5-year-olds weakens early detection of speech and language disorders, and what the government will do. The state secretary replied that the GGD has reorganised rather than abandoned the task, that youth health care (JGZ) is responsible under municipal law, and that no intervention or new investigation is planned.
I see no reason to call the GGD Hart voor Brabant and the associated municipalities to order.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de GGD Hart voor Brabant en de bijbehorende gemeenten tot de orde te roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de sluiting van het Expertisecentrum Onderwijs Noord-Kennemerland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about the closure of the Expertisecentrum Onderwijs in Noord-Kennemerland, which would move pupils with special needs to regular vmbo schools, and whether every region should keep an OPDC. The State Secretary answered that the samenwerkingsverband is competent to make this policy choice, that support and staff expertise will be secured through redeployment and the TOM rebound facility, and that there is no wave of OPDC closures.
The samenwerkingsverband is also competent to do so.
Het samenwerkingsverband is daartoe ook bevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de diagnose en behandeling van dyscalculie bij kinderen op de basisschool

An MP asked why dyslexia diagnosis and treatment for primary school children fall under the Youth Act while dyscalculia does not, and whether dyscalculia care should get the same status. The government answered that this was a deliberate choice, since only severe isolated dyslexia had been in the basic health insurance package based on a CVZ assessment, and no comparable justification exists for dyscalculia, while schools must provide support regardless of diagnosis.
Yes, this was a deliberate choice.
Ja, dit is een bewuste keuze geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de problemen in de uitbesteding van leerlingen door scholen voor het voortgezet onderwijs (vo-scholen) aan het voortgezet algemeen volwassen onderwijs

MP Siderius asked the minister about vo schools refusing to outsource pupils to adult secondary education (vavo) based on grade thresholds or age, and about related problems with vmbo-havo transfer rules. The minister answered that outsourcing is not an enforceable right, that vo schools remain primarily responsible for minors, and that no statutory change to the transfer code is currently planned, with monitoring results to follow later.
Outsourcing a vo pupil to a vavo institution is not a right a pupil can invoke at all times.
Het uitbesteden van een vo-leerling aan een vavo-instelling is geen recht waarop een leerling zich te allen tijde kan beroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten inzake ouders die zich door scholen onder druk gezet voelen om hun kind te medicaliseren tegen ADHD

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries whether schools pressure parents to medicate children for ADHD without diagnosis, and whether funding cuts, class sizes, waiting lists and costs drive medicalisation. The government answers that schools cannot prescribe medication, that a plan of action against medicalisation is underway with expert meetings planned for autumn 2016, that prescriptions fell in 2015, and that several questions are for further research or the next progress report.
Schools cannot prescribe medication; this is reserved for care professionals.
Scholen kunnen geen medicatie voorschrijven, dit is voorbehouden aan zorgprofessionals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "de gemeente Rotterdam die kinderopvangaanbieders zelf de hoogte van de ouderbijdrage laat vaststellen"

The MP asked whether Rotterdam letting childcare providers set and collect parental contributions raises privacy, fraud and proportionality concerns. The minister answered that setting parental fees for children without childcare benefit is a municipal responsibility, that the Rijk handles the childcare allowance and that the new funding system does not give providers access to parents' income data, and promised a study on municipal practices around summer.
It is up to municipalities to decide how the parental contribution is set for children without entitlement to the childcare allowance.
Het is aan gemeenten om te bepalen hoe de ouderbijdrage wordt vastgesteld voor kinderen zonder recht op kinderopvangtoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de verplichte ouderbijdrage voor onderwijs aan hoogbegaafden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether mandatory parental contributions of about €1,145 to €1,200 for Leonardo education for gifted pupils are acceptable, and how this fits with inclusive education and the excellence programme. The State Secretary answered that education for gifted pupils should be free and accessible, that schools and support partnerships must provide suitable provision, and that the Plan van Aanpak Toptalenten requires no parental contribution, but did not address the number of schools or costs and gave no commitment to ban the contribution by law.
I am of the view that education for gifted pupils, like for other pupils, must be freely accessible and free of charge.
Ik ben van mening dat het onderwijs voor hoogbegaafde leerlingen net als voor andere leerlingen vrij toegankelijk en kosteloos moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de subsidie aan Ouders & Onderwijs en het salaris van de directeur

An MP asked the State Secretary about the EUR 1.15 million subsidy to Ouders & Onderwijs, the director's salary, unspent funds, reserves and the foundation's form, transparency and representation of parents. The State Secretary answered that the hourly rates and salary fall within rijksbrede norms and the WNT maximum, that financial reporting for 2015 is not yet received, and that the structure will be evaluated in 2017.
I am willing to do so. However, I have not yet received the financial accountability for the year 2015.
Daar ben ik toe bereid. De financiële verantwoording over het jaar 2015 heb ik echter nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de prestatiedruk bij kleuters

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether pressure on kindergarten children and the use of prescribed kleutermethodes is harmful, and whether teachers' expertise is being undermined. The State Secretary answered that the signals do not warrant new action, that schools choose their own methods, and that the inspectorate's communication on the matter is being improved.
I see no reason to take measures on this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hier maatregelen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat stagiairs de dupe zijn van failliete winkelketens

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether vocational students (mbo) whose work placements were at bankrupt retail chains risk failing to graduate, and what support and coulance would be offered. The minister answered that roughly 600 students were affected, that nearly all have since been placed, that SBB supports the search for new placements, and that no further binding measures towards employers are currently seen as necessary.
A breakdown of the number of students per bankrupt retail chain cannot be given, because the number of available and lapsed placements changes very dynamically.
Een specificatie van het aantal studenten per failliete winkelketen is niet te geven, omdat het aantal beschikbare en vervallen bpv-plaatsen erg dynamisch is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het inzetten van de subsidieregeling praktijkleren voor de meest kwetsbare leerlingen

An MP asks why the practical-learning subsidy scheme excludes pupils in vso and praktijkonderwijs, whether it should be extended to them, and why pro pupils are not automatically in the disability employment register. The Minister confirms the exclusion, says she is willing to examine extending the scheme to vso, pro and vmbo entry programmes, and explains that pro pupils generally have better job prospects so they are not automatically registered.
I am therefore willing to examine whether it is desirable to extend the scheme to other groups.
Ik ben daarom bereid te onderzoeken of het wenselijk is de regeling uit te breiden naar andere groepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het weigeren van leerlingen bij een mytylschool vanwege het passend onderwijs

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education about a Haarlem special school refusing pupils due to bureaucracy under passend onderwijs, and about administrative burden at regional partnerships. The State Secretary answers that refusing pupils would breach the duty of care, that the Inspectorate found no refusals, and that a national form is not desired, while announcing measures to reduce bureaucracy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake fraude bij de tussentijdse Cito-toetsen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Education about repeated cheating with Cito interim tests, including a school location director who had students redo wrong questions to inflate results, and about tests still sold on Marktplaats. The State Secretary condemns the cheating, notes the school suspended the director and the Inspectorate was informed, says Cito sends letters and pursues illegal copies, and states the government will monitor implementation through a multi-year evaluation.
I see it as the government's responsibility to closely monitor how the implementation of the renewed legislation proceeds.
Ik zie het als verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid om goed te volgen hoe uitvoering van de vernieuwde wetgeving loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Jasper van Dijk inzake de marketingactiviteiten van scholen

MPs Siderius and Jasper van Dijk asked whether schools should hire marketing agencies and compete for pupils, and how much education funding goes to such activities. The State Secretary answered that transparency about schools is welcome, that no national data on marketing spending exists and no investigation is planned, and that regular funding is sufficient for the core teaching process.
Such an overview cannot be provided because this kind of information is not available at national level.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven aangezien dit soort informatie niet op landelijk niveau voorhanden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Siderius over het bericht dat de werkgelegenheid in welzijn, jeugdzorg en kinderopvang fors afneemt

MPs Kooiman and Siderius asked the ministers about a projected fall in employment in youth care, welfare and childcare, its effects on care quality, waiting lists, costs of unemployment benefits and support for affected workers. The government answered that the outlook is uncertain, that waiting lists cannot be tracked nationally because municipalities organise access differently, that childcare employment is expected to recover, and that sector plans and extra funding support retraining.
It is not possible to establish nationally in a uniform way the size of the waiting lists because municipalities have organised access to youth care differently.
Het is niet mogelijk om landelijk op eenduidige wijze vast te stellen wat de omvang van de wachtlijsten is omdat gemeenten de toegang tot de jeugdhulp verschillend georganiseerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het schenden van de hoorplicht bij bezwaarprocedures inzake kinderopvangtoeslag

An SP MP asked the government to respond to two court rulings finding that the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen repeatedly violated the duty to hear taxpayers in childcare benefit objection procedures, and asked whether this discouraged objectors and whether an investigation and compensation would follow. The Staatssecretaris accepted the rulings as guidance, said there was no active discouragement and no need for an investigation, but committed to adjusting the procedure in similar cases; he also said the Belastingdienst does not record how often hearings were held or not held.
If the judge finds that the duty to hear has been violated, he can refer the case back and compensate the court fees and/or costs of proceedings.
Constateert de rechter dat de hoorplicht is geschonden, dan kan hij de zaak terugwijzen en het griffierecht en/of de proceskosten vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Pieter Heerma over de voortslepende zaak rondom de voormalige kinderopvang de Parel

MPs Siderius and Heerma asked whether the childcare benefit system's past vulnerability to fraud, the reliance on recommendations from schools and municipalities, the unpaid parental contributions, enforcement and recovery, and the hardship faced by parents affected by the De Parel case justified changes or relief. The State Secretary replied that the 2011 DigiD loophole was closed, that parents remain responsible for their applications, that recovery follows legal obligations with objections and payment arrangements available, and that he cannot discuss individual cases or the municipal costs of hardship.
Because of the duty of confidentiality, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan niet ingegaan worden op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de aanbevelingen van de commissie Gunning

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the implementation of the Gunning commission's recommendations on childcare safety, including governance, complaint handling in inspections, the definition of quality, and public disclosure of quality data. The minister said an evaluation of the recommendations will be commissioned, that the sector's governance code exists and financial oversight is being reviewed, that complaint-handling figures are not available, and that quality ratings are not yet given, with the new inspection framework under development.
Precise figures on how often GGD inspectors have taken note of complaint handling during inspections are not known.
Precieze cijfers over hoe vaak GGD inspecteurs kennis hebben genomen van de behandeling van klachten bij het afnemen van inspecties zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Siderius en Gesthuizen inzake de problemen rond de huisvesting van de Internationale Schakelklas (ISK)

MPs Siderius and Gesthuizen asked the state secretaries about problems finding adequate school housing for asylum-seeker children in the International Transition Class, and about funding and a possible national contribution. The government answered that municipalities are responsible for school housing, acknowledged difficulties in some cases, said a national scheme for secondary education is being explored, and is in talks with affected municipalities and school boards.

For secondary education, the possibility is being examined of quickly designing a scheme, modelled on the OHBA scheme for primary education with standard amounts, that addresses school housing problems in municipalities.
Voor het voortgezet onderwijs wordt de mogelijkheid onderzocht om op korte termijn een regeling te ontwerpen, die naar analogie aan de OHBA-regeling voor het primair onderwijs met normbedragen werkt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de toegang tot de entreeopleiding

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether vmbo graduates who are not yet socially-emotionally ready should be allowed into entry-level (mbo-1) programmes, and why the former route was closed. The minister replied that vmbo graduates are cognitively able to start at mbo level 2, that support for students with social-emotional problems is funded through existing schemes, and that entry-level programmes are reserved for students lacking level-2 prerequisites.
Students with a vmbo diploma do not belong in an entry-level programme, given the capabilities shown by their prior education.
Leerlingen met een vmbo-diploma horen niet thuis in een entreeopleiding, vanwege de uit hun vooropleiding gebleken capaciteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht betreffende het aanbestedingscircus bij het leerlingenvervoer

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Education about the tendering of school transport, including price-versus-quality concerns, reduced travel times, cost trends, privacy breaches from publishing pupil data on TenderNed, and calls for a national base rate. The State Secretary replies that responsibility lies with municipalities within legal frameworks, admits the privacy publication was wrong and had the data removed, but rejects a national tariff and new measures.
I deeply regret this. Publishing such privacy-sensitive information is absolutely unacceptable.
Ik betreur dit ten zeerste. Het publiceren van dergelijke privacygevoelige informatie kan absoluut niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de top van TSN Thuiszorg zich achter de schermen ontdaan heeft van aansprakelijkheid bij faillissement

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that TSN Thuiszorg's parent company ADG secretly shed liability for a bankruptcy, shifting risks to staff and creditors, including a renamed entity and withdrawn guarantee. The State Secretary largely confirmed the facts from commercial register documents, said he cannot judge intent or legal compliance (a matter for the courts), called such conduct morally reprehensible if intended, and pointed to existing law and corporate responsibility.
I do not know what the intention of the parent company ADG dienstengroep SE was
Ik weet niet wat de bedoeling van het moederbedrijf ADG dienstengroep SE is geweest
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius, Rog en Van Meenen inzake de sluiting van het doveninternaat in Haren
