MPs Siderius, Rog and Van Meenen asked the state secretary about closing the boarding school for deaf pupils in Haren, arguing it would destroy capital and expertise and that clustered classes are not a realistic alternative. The state secretary replied that alternatives in regular education are being explored with the VO-raad and Siméa, that boarding costs were never structurally funded and will be phased out for new pupils from August 2017, and that the Guyotschool need not close.
The boarding school is not needed if appropriate education can be offered nearby for these pupils within regular or special secondary education.
Het internaat is niet nodig, als er thuisnabij ook voor deze leerlingen binnen het regulier of binnen het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs passend onderwijs kan worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake wijzigingen in de toegestane hulpmiddelen bij de centrale examens VO in 2016

An MP asks the State Secretary why spell-checker use was removed for pupils with dyslexia during the 2016 central exam year, and whether this is consistent with earlier guidance and equal treatment law. The State Secretary says the independent exam body CvTE made the decision for equal exam conditions, that he has asked CvTE to reconsider for pupils with spelling disabilities, but that he has no power to reverse the decision himself.
Since this concerns a statutory task of the CvTE as an independent administrative body, I cannot intervene in this decision.
Aangezien het hier een wettelijke taak van het CvTE als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan betreft kan ik niet in dit besluit treden.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Siderius inzake kleine klassen in het basisonderwijs

An MP asked the state secretary to provide the group-size charts from a letter on primary school class sizes in tabular form. The government answered yes and supplied tables for the average group size and the distributions of group sizes and schools.
Question 1: Can you send the graphs from the letter on group size in primary education (figures 1, 2 and 3) to the House in table form?
Vraag 1 Kunt u de grafieken uit de brief over groepsgrootte in het basisonderwijs (figuur 1, 2 en 3) in tabelvorm aan de Kamer doen toekomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over de onderhandelingen van zeven Westfriese gemeenten over de thuiszorg

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether thuiszorg provider Zorgkompas made national agreements not to take over TSN Thuiszorg staff in a bankruptcy, whether this amounts to a cartel, and how staff rights and conditions would be protected, including via municipal contracts and compensation. The state secretary replied that no national agreements exist, that providers set their own personnel policy within the law, that talks on a possible takeover are ongoing, and that he refers to earlier letters on fair employment conditions and the 2015 care agreement, without committing to new measures such as compensation.

Based on the information Zorgkompas provided to me, I can inform you that Zorgkompas has made no national agreements about whether or not to take on TSN Thuiszorg staff after a bankruptcy of TSN Thuiszorg.

Op grond van de door Zorgkompas aan mij verstrekte informatie kan ik u melden dat Zorgkompas geen landelijke afspraken heeft gemaakt over het al dan niet in dienst treden van medewerkers van TSN Thuiszorg na een faillissement van TSN Thuiszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over een docent die structureel wordt overbelast door het schoolbestuur

MPs Van Dijk and Siderius asked the State Secretary of Education about a teacher allegedly overloaded by her school board, including whether the board blocked her email and placed her on non-active status for discussing workload with colleagues. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case because it is before the courts, and gave general answers on workload, the collective agreement and national policy.
For the answers to questions 3 to 5, 7 and 9, I cannot go into this individual case because it is before the courts.
Voor het antwoord op de vragen 3 tot en met 5 en 7 en 9 geldt dat ik niet kan ingaan op dit individuele geval, omdat deze zaak onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de hoge werkdruk in het basisonderwijs

An SP MP asks the state secretary for education about high workload in primary schools, teachers' burnout and 'survival mode', the effects of accountability and inspection, measurability of results, 'phantom rules', and the impact of passend onderwijs. The state secretary acknowledges the concern, points to the Nationaal Onderwijs Akkoord, a regeldruk agenda and a registration complaints desk, and rejects the claim that policy has fostered distrust, while stating that workload has multiple causes and needs school-level solutions.
High workload can lead to more sick leave, a greater chance of burn-out complaints and less job satisfaction.
Een hoge werkdruk kan leiden tot meer ziekteverzuim, een grotere kans op burn-out klachten en minder werkplezier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de bovenwettelijke ouderbijdragen van de Groningse Schoolvereniging

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about voluntary parental contributions at a Groningen school association, including whether schools may withhold information about parents' rights, whether the contribution can be split by use, and whether internationally oriented education can be charged extra. The State Secretary answered that schools must state the voluntary nature of contributions, that parental consent via the works council is required, that the Inspectorate can enforce, and that no separation of pupils by ability to pay is allowed.
The Inspectorate will examine the cited case further.
De inspectie zal de genoemde casus nader bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake arme scholen die online campagnes organiseren om geld in te zamelen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether it is acceptable that schools must raise money through crowdfunding for basics like playground renovation and tablets, and whether this creates inequality between schools. The State Secretary answered that regular government funding is sufficient for statutory tasks, that schools may seek extra funding such as crowdfunding under a sponsorship covenant, and that no inequality arises.
The government is responsible for the regular funding that enables schools to provide good quality education and meet their statutory obligations.
De overheid is verantwoordelijk voor de reguliere bekostiging waarmee scholen in staat worden om kwalitatief goed onderwijs te geven en aan hun wettelijke verplichtingen te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de gevolgen van de prijsstijging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) voor de kinderopvangbranche

An SP MP asked the minister about the financial impact of the VOG price rise on the childcare sector, whether a 38 percent increase is excessive given budget cuts, what measures prevent extra childcare funds flowing back to the state via fees, and whether the VOG will be made free or supported. The minister estimates the extra sector cost at about 0.6 million euro per year (falling to 0.4 million after the personal register is introduced), says the rise is sizeable but limited for the sector, sees no reason for measures or free VOGs, and commits to no action.
As answered in response to the first question.
Zoals bij de eerste vraag is geantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over het bericht dat toezichthouders van Patyna het eigen salaris fors verhogen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary for health whether it is acceptable that supervisory board members of Patyna raised their own pay while home-care staff are asked to give up salary, and asked for an overview of similar cases and for the quality criteria for supervisors. The state secretary answered that pay limits are set by the WNT and that setting a fitting fee is for the supervisors themselves, that Patyna has since reversed the increase and will review pay with its works and client councils, that data for 2015 are not yet available, and that an accreditation track for supervisors is being discussed with the NVTZ.
Within the limits set by the law, in particular the WNT, it is up to the supervisors to determine what constitutes an appropriate remuneration.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet, in het bijzonder de WNT, stelt is het aan de toezichthouders om te bepalen wat een passende beloning is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut inzake de sluiting van leerwerkbedrijven

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked why the Werkartaal social-firm training provider for vulnerable youth and others is closing, whether the Participatiewet cuts are harming vulnerable groups, and what the government will do to preserve such pathways. The minister answers that the closure stems from lack of participants and falling employer demand, that the government cannot support individual private work-learning companies, and that gemeenten and other providers can take over.
The Ministry of OCW therefore cannot take measures to support an individual work-learning company that is in financial distress.
Het Ministerie van OCW kan dan ook geen maatregelen nemen om een individueel leerwerkbedrijf dat in financiële nood verkeert te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de huisvesting van twee mbo-instellingen in Purmerend

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the reasons for two Purmerend vocational colleges building a new EUR 14.5 million campus instead of using the existing Spinnekop building, the guarantee for a loan, and whether central oversight or a financial approval test should be introduced. The Minister answered that institutions are responsible for their own housing, that the WEB does not require prior approval of such investments, that the Spinnekop does not meet joint-housing requirements, that no guarantee could be given for an extra loan, and that she will not introduce a mandatory financial approval test but will encourage peer review and knowledge sharing.
Vocational education institutions are themselves responsible for their housing.
Mbo-instellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de hoge registratiekosten voor de verplichte geschillencommissie in de kinderopvang en het 'klachtengeld' dat betaald moet worden

An SP MP asked the minister about high registration costs for the new mandatory childcare dispute commission and a 25 euro complaint fee for parents, asking whether this creates barriers. The minister said membership replaces the old complaints obligation, fees are based on registered childcare places and set by the sector, the 25 euro fee is refundable if the complainant wins, and the free Klachtenloket remains available.
It has been agreed that the level of membership contributions will remain an important point of attention for the steering group in 2016 and will be monitored.
Afgesproken is dat de hoogte van de aansluitbijdragen ook in 2016 een belangrijk aandachtspunt zal zijn voor de Stuurgroep Geschillencommissie Kinderopvang en dat dit gemonitord zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over het bericht dat in Enschede een zorggroep een loonoffer vraagt van duizend personeelsleden

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about care group Manna in Enschede requesting a voluntary wage sacrifice from about a thousand staff to cover a 2015 deficit, and how this relates to a court ruling that financial problems may not be shifted onto employees. The state secretary called the request remarkable but said institutions set their own personnel policy within legal and collective agreement frameworks, that the cases differ, and that no information is held on other organisations; he pointed to a new joint approach with unions and VNG for long-term care.
However, institutions determine their own vision, conduct and personnel policy.
Instellingen bepalen echter hun eigen visie, handelen en personeelbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake tegenstrijdige berichten over de 'Class for the Gifted' van het Aloysius College

The MP Siderius asked the State Secretary of Education about contradictory reports on whether the Aloysius College's Class for the Gifted for grade 7 and 8 pupils would continue, and what measures would keep it. The State Secretary replied that Zandvliet College intended a programme but attracted too few pupils, that a new Zandvliet offer starting April 2016 is separate from the Aloysius programme, that a gap arose, and that the interim board committed to restoring an offer from January 2016.
Therefore he has promised me to do everything possible to have an offer again from January 2016 for the gifted pupils of grades 7 and 8 of primary education.
Daarom heeft hij mij toegezegd alles in het werk te stellen om vanaf januari 2016 weer een aanbod te hebben voor de hoogbegaafde leerlingen van groep 7 en 8 basisonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over Noorse investeerders die oprukken in de Nederlandse kinderopvang

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is desirable that a Norwegian investor (Norlandia Care Group) expands in Dutch childcare, profiting from state-funded childcare allowances, and whether such foreign takeovers, scale growth and profit transfers abroad should be restricted. The minister answered that private investment is welcome as it expands choice for parents, that he has no insight into private companies' operations or profit use, and that childcare quality and compliance with rules matter most.
I have no insight into the business operations of private companies.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de bedrijfsvoering van private ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de gevolgen van het verdwijnen van 1.800 vrijwilligers uit het peuterspeelzaalwerk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the consequences of about 1,800 volunteers leaving childcare playgroups, including costs, funding cuts, rural impacts, free childcare hours and the role of volunteers. The minister answered that the playgroup organisational form is for organisations to decide, that the 2018 harmonisation with childcare stands, that municipalities will not receive extra money for rural staffing, and that a concrete follow-up on the 60 million development entitlement will come in spring 2016.
I will inform you further on the elaboration and the consultation with the VNG no later than spring 2016.
Ik zal u nader informeren over de verdere invulling en het overleg met de VNG uiterlijk in het voorjaar van 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de problemen bij de overname van de afdeling Gifted Education van het Aloysius College door het Zandvliet College en het Rijswijks Lyceum

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about problems placing the gifted-education pupils of the closing Aloysius College in other Hague schools, including whether Zandvliet College can accommodate them and whether a transfer plan exists. The State Secretary answered that about 90 percent of pupils, including gifted pupils, were placed at their first-choice school, that schools must offer suitable education, and that he sees no need for extra funding for a new school.
I consider this a positive result.
Ik beschouw dit als een positief resultaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat vrouwen nog steeds minder verdienen dan mannen

MPs Karabulut and Siderius asked the ministers how they react to reports that women still earn less than men for equal work, why women over 35 earn less, what the pay gaps are, what agreements exist with social partners, and what role the government sees for itself. The ministers answer that pay discrimination is unacceptable, that much of the gap stems from different labour-market positions, cite CBS findings and ongoing actions and studies, and promise further updates in early 2016.
Nowadays it is not explainable that it still occurs that women earn less than men for equivalent work.
Het is heden ten dage niet uit te leggen dat het nog altijd voorkomt dat vrouwen minder verdienen dan mannen voor gelijkwaardig werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "toeslagpartners van ernstig zieke mensen die geen kinderopvangtoeslag ontvangen"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether parents of seriously ill partners who receive no childcare allowance should be able to get childcare support, and about numbers and compensation. The minister said municipalities handle this through social-medical indication (SMI) with discretionary case-by-case support, reported about 3,300 SMI grants in 2012, saw no legal inequality problem, and will review SMI in 2016 without changing national rules or compensating affected families.
I have no figures available on the number of partners who, due to illness, are no longer able to participate in work and for whom the other parent is not entitled to childcare allowance.
Ik heb geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal toeslagpartners die vanwege ziekte – langdurig of in het geheel – niet meer in staat zijn om deel te nemen aan het arbeidsproces
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over problemen met de bekostiging van het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs aan leerlingen ouder dan 18 jaar

Siderius (SP) asked whether it is acceptable that severely learning-disabled pupils in special secondary education lose schooling after age 18 due to funding problems under passend onderwijs, and how the government will guarantee schooling until age 20 as the WEC allows. The State Secretary replied that schools remain funded for every enrolled pupil regardless of age, that the decision to stay or leave is individual and made with parents, and that the inspectorate can act against unlawful expulsions, though no specific study is planned and the motion Ypma guarantee is said to be already met by existing law.
If schools wrongly remove pupils after eighteen and thereby evade their duty of care, the inspectorate can act against this.
Indien scholen onterecht leerlingen na achttien jaar verwijderen en daardoor zich aan hun zorgplicht onttrekken kan de inspectie daar tegen optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake verplichte overblijfkosten op scholen met een continurooster

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether schools with a continuous timetable are transparent that lunch-supervision costs are voluntary, whether such costs may be made compulsory, and whether the voluntary parental contribution should be capped. The State Secretary answered that schools must state the voluntary nature of contributions in their school guides (94 percent reportedly do), that compulsory lunch costs are undesirable, and that no cap is planned because schools set activities individually.
Schools must at all times be clear about the voluntary nature of the parental contribution.
Scholen moeten te allen tijde duidelijk zijn over het vrijwillige karakter van de ouderbijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Kooiman betreffende de problemen die kinderen ondervinden met het volgen van onderwijs na een plaatsing in een residentiële jeugdzorgvoorziening

MPs Siderius and Kooiman asked why pupils placed in residential youth care often cannot return to their home school, whether schools tied to nationally operating care institutions bear the school duty of care, and how onderwijs and care placements can be better aligned. The State Secretary says the receiving school has the duty of care, outlines transition rules and a Variawet exemption for short stays, rejects per-place funding, and promises a separate letter on education outside school premises.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over camerabeelden die in het kader van het vier-ogen-principe in de kinderopvang door iedereen ingezien kunnen worden

MP Siderius asks whether unsecured internet cameras in childcare groups, viewable worldwide, are acceptable, who has viewed the footage, and what measures will be taken on camera use, privacy and procedures. Minister Asscher says such viewing is undesirable and must be prevented through secured connections, refers to the sector body's guidance, but declines to take further measures or hold data on viewers.
No, I have no data on this.
Nee, ik heb hierover geen gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Gesthuizen inzake onderwijs aan meerderjarige vreemdelingen

MPs Siderius and Gesthuizen asked whether the government's rules denying adult foreigners without a residence permit the ability to start or switch education are desirable, and whether they conflict with the European Convention on Human Rights. The minister answered that residence-permit applicants and those with lawful stay can enrol, that unlawfully staying adults may only finish courses already begun under the Koppelingswet's aims, and that no legislative change is planned.
The cabinet sees no need to take further measures.
Het kabinet ziet geen noodzaak om verdere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over een samenwerkingsverband dat weigert passende expertise op school in te zetten en ouders de benodigde expertise zelf laat betalen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education about a special education partnership (SPPOH) that refuses to use outside expertise for a pupil with epilepsy and requires parents to pay for external support themselves. The State Secretary answered that parents should not have to pay for school support, that the inspectorate will act if this happens, and that the partnership has the right to prioritise its own staff and to shorten the procedure, but did not disclose details of the individual case.
If that does happen, the inspectorate will hold those schools and partnerships to account and ask them to reverse it.
Als dat wel gebeurt, zal de inspectie die scholen en samenwerkingsverbanden daarop aanspreken en verzoeken dat terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over knelpunten in de inkomensvoorziening voor jongeren met opgeschorte Wajong-2015

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked whether severely multiply disabled young people over 18 can continue learning and what support exists after the Wajong-2015 study allowance ended. The government replied that vso attendance is possible until age 20 with exemptions, that gemeenten may grant studietoeslag or bijzondere bijstand, and that it has no insight into how many municipalities provide bijzondere bijstand to this group.
I have no insight into the extent to which municipalities provide individual special assistance to severely multiply disabled young people aged 18 and over without labour market prospects.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de mate waarin gemeenten individuele bijzondere bijstand verstrekken aan meervoudig gehandicapte jongeren van 18 jaar en ouder zonder arbeidsmarktperspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de sluiting van een school voor speciaal onderwijs 'de Ambelt' door de invoering van het passend onderwijs.

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about the closure of special school De Ambelt due to passend onderwijs, questioning the loss of places, staff and expertise and the effects on pupils. The State Secretary answered that the closure is a regional decision driven by verevening and that pupils will get support elsewhere, while largely rejecting the claims and stating that passend onderwijs is not failing.
I distance myself from what is insinuated in the question.
Ik neem afstand van wat in de vraag wordt geïnsinueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over problemen met het passend onderwijs op het mbo

An SP MP asked the minister about problems with passend onderwijs in mbo, including a student removed after four weeks, budget dilution for students needing support, and exam flexibility. The minister said implementation is not causing major problems, that the budget is unchanged, and that individual cases should be resolved between institution and student, offering a study on exam flexibility.
This data is not known. Mbo institutions are themselves responsible for the support they provide within the framework of passend onderwijs.
Deze gegevens zijn niet bekend. Mbo-instellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de ondersteuning die ze bieden in het kader van passend onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de entreetoets die steeds meer gebruikt wordt als basis voor schooladviezen

An SP MP asked whether using the group 7 entreetoets as an early basis for school advice is undesirable, whether Cito tests remain reliable, and what the government will do about test-driven advice. The State Secretary replied that schools own their advice and decide how test results are weighed, that no legal limits apply to the entreetoets' use, and that he sees no reason for new steps or measures.
It is up to their professional judgement to determine how test data are weighed in this.
Het is aan hun professionele oordeel om te bepalen hoe toetsgegevens hierin meewegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de zorgelijke situatie op school voor het speciaal onderwijs 'de Parachute’

An SP MP asks whether pupils who left special school 'de Parachute' and now receive partial schooling at a care farm are left at home because the regional partnership, inspectorate and municipality take no responsibility for a new placement, and criticises the inspectorate and truancy officer. The Secretary of State says children should not be left without schooling, that most pupils now have a solution, that the partnership and school must act, and that the school remains under intensified inspection with a review planned for January 2016.
The Inspectorate of Education will keep a close watch in the coming period to ensure that a suitable solution is found for all children as quickly as possible.
De inspectie houdt komende periode vinger aan de pols om ervoor te zorgen dat zo snel mogelijk voor alle kinderen een passende oplossing komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius inzake grote klassen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Siderius asked the state secretary about reports that pupils' classes are too large, the claimed link to worse performance, and whether a national 'Actieplan Kleine Klassen' should be made. The state secretary said class size is not a simple measure of quality, that the evidence on class size and performance is mixed, and that he will not create a national plan, instead encouraging schools to use their new flexibility.

No. A national 'Actieplan Kleine Klassen' suggests that all these different timetables with many different classes, teaching methods and subjects could (or should) be arranged centrally from 'The Hague'.

Nee. Een landelijk «Actieplan Kleine Klassen» suggereert dat al die verschillende lesroosters met veel verschillende klassen, verschillende werkvormen en veel verschillende vakken centraal, vanuit «Den Haag», geregeld zouden (kunnen) worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over onbereikbaar zijn van duur MBO voor kinderen van minima

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about reports that expensive MBO vocational education is out of reach for children of low-income families, with some schools redirecting pupils who cannot pay to other options or to Leergeld foundations. The minister says the situation is unwelcome, that schools may require only tuition and not other fees, that the inspectorate monitors school-cost policy, and that she will ask the MBO Raad to promote instalment payment schemes and report back to parliament.
I will inform your House of this in writing.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover schriftelijke informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over ouders die steeds vaker financiële hulp nodig hebben om de kosten voor school en sport te dekken

An SP MP asked why 68,619 children depend on charity such as Stichting Leergeld to cover school and sport costs, and whether voluntary parental contributions should be capped or reported. The State Secretary answered that schools must offer free alternatives for compulsory activities, that voluntary contributions are the shared responsibility of schools and parents monitored by the inspectorate, and that no cap or national reporting is planned.
From school year 2012/2013 supervision of compliance with school costs and voluntary parental contributions has been included in the inspectorate's regular supervision.
Vanaf het schooljaar 2012/2013 is het toezicht op de naleving van de schoolkosten en vrijwillige ouderbijdrage in het reguliere toezicht van de inspectie opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het trage internet op basisscholen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education why slow internet at primary schools could deprive 900,000 pupils of modern education, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary says the Doorbraakproject Onderwijs en ICT and partners will ensure schools get adequate connections by 2017, with a broadband guide and purchasing support, but explicitly states the central government will not finance fast internet for all schools.
However, this does not mean that the central government will finance fast internet for all primary schools.
Dat betekent echter niet dat de rijksoverheid snel internet voor alle basisscholen gaat financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de mogelijkheid van leerlingenvervoer naar de buitenschoolse opvang

An SP MP asked whether municipalities should be made to provide adapted transport from special schools to after-school care for children with disabilities, since parents may be forced to stop working. The State Secretary answered that the arrangement covers home-school transport only, that after-school transport is the parents' responsibility, and that existing hardship clauses already allow flexibility without new legislation.
I am of the view that not every situation should be resolved through regulation.
Ik ben van mening dat niet elke situatie via regelgeving moet worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over "de (h)erkenning van endometriose"

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked whether endometriosis is grounds for UWV to refuse sickness benefit or disability assessment, and why Netherlands has not formally recognised it as an illness. The government answered that a diagnosis alone does not determine entitlement; the insurance physician assesses functional limitations, guided by an international ESHRE guideline, and that recognising diseases is the task of professional bodies, not the state.
Recognising illnesses is not a government task.
Het erkennen van ziekten is geen overheidstaak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over ‘onduidelijkheden over de hoogte van de mobiliteitsbonus en het doelgroepenregister voor schoolverlaters van het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs, praktijkonderwijs

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether schools hesitate to register school-leavers for the target-group register because the mobility bonus is cut from 2016, and whether a school-leaver who has earned the minimum wage can still be on the register. The state secretary answered that UWV has received registrations, that a planned amendment will equalise the bonus at 2,000 euro for the whole target group, and that the register rule cannot be applied retroactively in the described case.
Partly in response to the question from these SP members, I intend to actively inform parties in the field in the short term.
Mede naar aanleiding van de vraag die deze leden van de SP hebben gesteld, ben ik van plan om partijen in het veld op korte termijn actief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake scholen in het voortgezet onderwijs die enkelvoudige schooladviezen verplicht stellen

An SP MP asked why some secondary schools require single school advice from primary schools, whether this is a side effect of inspectorate accountability pressure, and what will be done to stop it. The State Secretary replied that the arrangements are voluntary agreements under the Friese Plaatsingswijzer, not unilateral requirements, that broad advice may be better for some pupils, that the Inspectorate has no signals of unilateral imposition, and that schools will be reminded via the VO-raad and newsletters to align admission policy with regulations.
There is therefore no question here of secondary schools imposing single advice on primary schools.
Er is hier dan ook geen sprake van een verplichtstelling van enkelvoudige adviezen door het voortgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het leerlingenvervoer in De Fryske Marren

An SP MP asked whether the municipality of De Fryske Marren may replace individual school transport for pupils with disabilities or behavioural problems with group pick-up points, and whether it treats parents' objections fairly. The Secretary of State answered that the municipality still provides adapted transport for those pupils as legally required, that objections were handled before the school year, and that no measures are needed.
For the pupils who are designated for this, adapted transport is still provided.
Voor de leerlingen die daarop zijn aangewezen wordt nog steeds aangepast vervoer toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over de hoge declaraties bij Hogeschool Windesheim in Zwolle

SP MPs asked the Minister of Education about very high expense claims by two Windesheim university of applied sciences board members and whether the board model and oversight by the supervisory board have failed. The Minister said existing expense rules and public disclosure apply, the Inspectorate is investigating claims across institutions, and rules may be tightened after its findings, while rejecting the claim that the board model has failed.
I have now instructed the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the expense claims of board members in higher education.
Inmiddels heb ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs opdracht gegeven het declaratiegedrag van bestuurders in het hoger onderwijs te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake onvoldoende bekostiging om het onderwijs en de zorg voor leerlingen met een ernstige meervoudige beperking (cluster 3) te garanderen

The SP MP Siderius asked whether funding cuts by special-education partnerships were pushing students with severe multiple disabilities (cluster 3) into lower funding categories, leaving schools unable to secure nursing care, and whether a separate funding regime and a refusal to exempt these pupils from inclusive education were warranted. The State Secretary answered that partnerships set their own criteria, that the new special funding scheme and simplified procedure are meant to keep category 3 funding for these pupils, that schools' nursing care can come from care budgets, and that no change to inclusive education is planned.
It is therefore explicitly not the intention that partnerships lower the funding of emb pupils to category 2.
Het is dan ook nadrukkelijk niet de bedoeling dat samenwerkingsverbanden de bekostiging van emb-leerlingen verlagen naar categorie 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de bestuurlijke chaos bij Stichting Mozon

An MP from the SP asked the State Secretary of Education about governance chaos at Stichting Mozon, including the suspension of a school director, conflicts over the board and supervisory board, petition handling, and the case for works council consent rights. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate is investigating the Venlo school, defended the current board model with checks and balances, and pointed to the Wet Versterking bestuurskracht bill and a possible review of budget consent rights by summer 2016.
The quality investigation is currently in the hearing and counter-hearing phase.
Het kwaliteitsonderzoek bevindt zich momenteel in de fase van hoor en wederhoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de gemeente Kampen die weigert passend vervoer te regelen voor leerlingen met een beperking

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether the municipality of Kampen, by no longer providing adapted transport to special primary school pupils and paying only public transport fares, complies with its legal duty to provide suitable pupil transport. The State Secretary replies that Kampen applies its ordinance with an individual assessment per pupil, that compliance is ultimately for the courts to judge, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
Whether the municipality applies the law correctly, as answered at question 7, is a task for the judge.
Of de gemeente de wet goed toepast is, zoals beantwoord bij vraag 7, een taak van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de gemeente Heerhugowaard die stopt met het organiseren van aangepast vervoer voor leerlingen naar het speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked the state secretary whether Heerhugowaard's refusal to organise adapted transport for special-education pupils, leaving only public-transport allowances and parental escort duties, complies with the legal duty and whether ministerial action is planned. The secretary replied that the municipality has not been shown to refuse adapted transport, that case-by-case assessment is lawful, that no signals of the alleged harms were received, and that objections go through the normal appeal route, so no measures are planned.
I cannot infer from the information available to me that the municipality of Heerhugowaard refuses to organise appropriate adapted pupil transport for pupils of special primary education.
Ik kan uit de mij beschikbare informatie niet afleiden dat de gemeente Heerhugowaard weigert om passend aangepast leerlingenvervoer te organiseren voor leerlingen van het speciaal basisonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake sponsoring van een school voor 3 ton door een commercieel bedrijf

An SP MP asks whether a Rotterdam secondary school accepting a 300,000 euro gift from a software company, amid budget cuts, is acceptable and whether this threatens the independence of education and creates inequality. The state secretary replies that schools have sufficient funding, that the gift is a donation without counter-performance covered by the sponsorship convenant, and that no overview of sponsorship is held.
I do not have an overview of sponsorship of schools in primary and secondary education in 2013 and 2014.
Ik ben niet in het bezit van een overzicht van de sponsoring van scholen in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs in 2013 en 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de gevolgen van de sluiting van orthopedische didactische centra (opdc's) voor leerlingen met een zorgbehoefte

An MP asked the state secretary about the closure of an orthopedic didactic centre (OPDC) and the refusal of a pupil by a vmbo school based solely on a school file, asking whether schools may refuse pupils on file alone and how the duty of care under inclusive education is enforced. The state secretary answered that schools must first examine whether they can provide the support themselves, that the inspectorate supervises compliance, that the case was resolved by the regional partnership, and that the state secretary is not directly responsible for finding places but monitors through the inspectorate.
A school must always first examine, for a pupil who needs extra support, whether it can offer that support itself.
Een school moet bij een leerling die extra ondersteuning nodig heeft altijd eerst bekijken of zij deze ondersteuning zelf kan bieden.

Vragen van het lid Siderius (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verplicht aanleveren van groepsinformatie over dyslexie uit het leerlingvolgsysteem aan externe bureaus (ingezonden 2

An SP MP asked whether external dyslexia bureaus may require schools to supply group-level data from the pupil tracking system before helping individual pupils, and whether this is lawful and acceptable. The State Secretary replied that it is not desirable and does not happen in practice, that the requirement appeared in an error in an institute newsletter which was corrected, and that no further measures are needed.
I assume this was a one-off mistake, which was corrected in good time by the professional group itself.
Ik ga ervan uit dat dit een éénmalige misser is, die tijdig door de beroepsgroep zelf is gecorrigeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake onbehoorlijk bestuur binnen de Stichting Roobol en het niet publiek maken van een onderzoeksrapport

The SP MP Siderius asked the state secretary about governance failures at Stichting Roobol, including the non-publication of an independent investigation report and the composition of its supervisory board. The secretary answered that procedural errors were made but no structural problem found, that the report is kept confidential by the supervisory board, and that the government will strengthen medezeggenschap (works council) rights through a bill.
The supervisory board chooses to keep the Van den Hoek report confidential because it contains sensitive personal information about the former chair of the executive board.
De raad van toezicht kiest ervoor het rapport Van den Hoek vertrouwelijk te houden omdat het gevoelige persoonlijke informatie bevat over de afgetreden voorzitter van het college van bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over een directeur die twee schoolbesturen leidt en voor 66 uur per week wordt uitbetaald

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a school director leading two separate primary school boards and paid for 66 hours a week (1.65 fte), questioning legality, pay norms, employee protection, works council rights and whether such dual roles exist elsewhere. The state secretary called this undesirable, said the parties are seeking a solution and that the case will be monitored, noted the cao caps the contract at 100 percent of a norm position, said pay falls within the WNT norm, explained the works council dispute mechanisms, and could not say how many such dual directors exist because the data does not allow it.

I do not consider it desirable that a full-time school board member, regardless of the number of hours he works, leads two independent school boards, partly because a board member must be alert to conflicting interests.

Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat een fulltime schoolbestuurder, ongeacht het aantal uren dat hij werkt, leiding geeft aan twee zelfstandige schoolbesturen, mede omdat een bestuurder alert moet zijn op conflicterende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat het toelatingsbeleid in Amsterdam scholen weer zwart maakt

Two SP MPs asked how the government responds to reports that Amsterdam admission policy is re-segregating schools, and about funding for parent initiatives to mix schools. The State Secretary answered that schools' quality matters, that existing disadvantage measures apply, that school mixing by ethnicity is not desired at national level, and that the only role for municipalities is the statutory annual consultation on segregation.
I see no further role for the national government.
Ik zie geen verdere taak weggelegd voor de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het fysiek ingrijpen en fixeren van leerlingen op de school voor speciaal onderwijs De Parachute in Zoetermeer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education about the physical restraint of pupils at special school De Parachute in Zoetermeer, its very weak inspection rating, and pupils being placed at a farm receiving only half an hour of education daily. The State Secretary confirmed the school is under intensified inspection supervision, said the farm arrangement does not meet legal education requirements and must end by 1 August 2015, and described the inspectorate's follow-up monitoring while declining to discuss individual cases.
It is not for me to go into individual cases and privacy-sensitive information about pupils in the House.
Het is niet aan mij om in de Kamer in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek en privacygevoelige gegevens van leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Ulenbelt over ongelukken in praktijklokalen op vmbo-scholen

MPs Siderius and Ulenbelt asked why safe machine use in vmbo practical rooms remained non-compliant in 64% of inspections since 2009, what measures were taken, how many pupils and teachers were harmed, how many fines and closures occurred, and whether unsafe rooms would be closed directly. The minister answered that schools bear primary responsibility, listed sector support measures, reported fines (6 in vmbo, 2010-2014), and said inspections show schools improving, so immediate closure was not planned.
According to the Inspectorate, schools that did not have health and safety in order are now on the right track in improving safety.
Volgens de Inspectie zijn de scholen die de gezondheid en veiligheid niet op orde hadden inmiddels op de goede weg bij het verbeteren van de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake eerder onderzoek op taal- en spraakproblemen bij kinderen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the decline of GGD logopedic screening in primary schools, its effects on children with speech problems, and the cost-benefit of speech therapy. The government answered that screening is not mandatory for all pupils under the basic youth health care package, that schools and parents refer when needed, that no data exist on the number of affected pupils, and that a new guideline is being developed.
There is no data known on the number of pupils with speech problems in regular primary education.
Er zijn geen gegevens bekend over het aantal leerlingen met spraakproblemen in het reguliere basisonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over thuiszittende, autistische kinderen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about autistic children staying at home because regular schools cannot meet their needs and special school waiting lists are long, and asked for waiting-list figures and budget details. The state secretary said that schools and partnerships are responsible for providing suitable provision and that the Inspectorate supervises them, but that waiting-list and budget data are not kept nationally and only partly answered the questions.
Data on possible waiting lists are not kept nationally.
Gegevens over eventuele wachtlijsten worden niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het voortbestaan van het speciaal basisonderwijs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether passend onderwijs threatens the survival of speciaal basisonderwijs (sbo), and what the government will do about it, including the lack of expertise and funding in regular schools. The State Secretary replied that the regions decide placements, the sbo decline predates passend onderwijs, no sbo schools have closed since its introduction, and no extra measures are planned, citing existing funding.
I therefore will not take any additional measures regarding the sbo.
Ik ga dan ook geen extra maatregelen nemen ten aanzien van het sbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het Adelbert College dat een moeder heeft laten aanhouden door de politie vanwege onenigheid over passend onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a school that had a mother of a chronically ill pupil arrested by police over a dispute on special education, and about suspension, the school's duty of care, parental involvement and the availability of kort geding data. The state secretary said police intervention was undesirable but understandable in escalated conflicts, that the school met procedural requirements, and that the individual case and the placement decision are for the school, the partnership and the complaints committee; data on kort geding cases was not available and the answer was late.
It is not for me to assess the substance of a decision to suspend or remove a pupil.
Het is niet aan mij om een besluit tot schorsing of verwijdering inhoudelijk te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake emotionele schade die kinderen oplopen omdat zij te laat worden doorverwezen naar het speciaal onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about children suffering emotional harm from late referral to special education under passend onderwijs, including financial incentives, crisis-situation placements, costs to schools, regional equalisation and enrolment figures. The state secretary answered that referral decisions rest on the needs of the child and on appeal rights, denied a rise in crisis placements, and provided cost tables and enrolment data while stating no new grounds to revise equalisation.

If the collaborative partnership does not issue an admission declaration and parents and/or the regular school believe special education is the best solution, they can object to the partnership's decision.

Geeft het samenwerkingsverband geen toelaatbaarheidsverklaring af en zijn ouders en/of de reguliere school van mening dat speciaal onderwijs de beste oplossing is, dan kunnen zij tegen het besluit van het samenwerkingsverband bezwaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de aanhoudende onzekerheid voor kinderen met een meervoudige beperking en de intensieve zorg in de klas

An SP MP asked the state secretaries of Education and of Health about persistent uncertainty for children with multiple disabilities who need intensive care in class, including funding of medical care at school, whether Wlz-funded care should be earmarked, and the reported letters from schools to parents. The government replied that funding and care rights are adequate, that earmarking is neither necessary nor desirable, that a national application procedure and a joint working agenda are being pursued, and that it will keep monitoring implementation.
As State Secretary Van Rijn indicated in the general consultation on 25 March, earmarking part of the Wlz indication for possible participation in education is neither necessary nor desirable.

Zoals de Staatssecretaris Van Rijn in het algemeen overleg op 25 maart heeft aangegeven, is het oormerken van een deel van de Wlz-indicatie voor een mogelijke deelname aan onderwijs niet nodig en niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over de toekomst van leerlingen die het praktijkonderwijs succesvol hebben doorlopen

MPs Siderius and Karabulut (SP) asked about the prospects of praktijkonderwijs (practical education) leavers, including barriers from language and maths requirements, the Participatiewet, sheltered work and dagbesteding, and whether the government will monitor and support school-leavers. The State Secretary answers that most leavers find work or continue training, that municipalities are now responsible for support, and that additional measures and monitoring are planned, without accepting parliamentary demands for extended follow-up or compensation for reduced ESF funds.
The cabinet does not expect a negative effect of the Participatiewet on the successful outflow of praktijkonderwijs pupils.
Het kabinet verwacht geen negatief effect van de Participatiewet op de succesvolle uitstroom van leerlingen uit het pro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de mogelijkheid tot het geven van dubbele schooladviezen bij het doorstromen van het primair onderwijs naar het voortgezet onderwijs

MP Siderius asked whether it is desirable that a regional school consultation body in four municipalities requires primary schools to give only single school recommendations, ruling out combined advice, and what the government will do about it. The Staatssecretaris said he does not find this desirable, but that schools have room under current rules to make such agreements, so the arrangement is not directly unlawful; the inspectorate will raise the point with the regional body.
However, I have to establish that such agreements are not directly in conflict with the laws and regulations.
Ik moet echter vaststellen dat dergelijke afspraken niet direct strijdig zijn met de wet- en regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over leerlingen met ernstige vormen van dyslexie, die mogelijk geen gebruik kunnen maken van digitale woordenboeken tijdens het Centraal Schriftelijk Examen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Siderius asked why the College voor Toetsen en Examens refuses digital dictionaries for pupils with severe dyslexia in the central written exam, despite a non-binding ruling by the Human Rights Institute, and whether the pupil Iris can use one. The State Secretary defends the refusal: a digital dictionary lowers the vocabulary requirement, alternatives such as oral support are adequate, and no guarantee can be given for Iris.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over passend onderwijs voor leerlingen met diabetes

An SP MP asked the state secretary for education what became of promised early-2015 measures on diabetes care in schools: a factsheet, an improved medical-procedures protocol and good-practice examples. The state secretary replied that the factsheet will soon be published digitally, the protocol revision is still underway with sector and patient organisations, and a legal exploration will be reported in the next progress report before the summer recess.
The factsheet on diabetes care in primary education will soon be made available digitally.
De factsheet diabeteszorg in het basisonderwijs wordt binnenkort digitaal beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de autistische Rebecca, die graag naar school wil, maar al 18 maanden thuis zit

An MP asked the state secretaries about a 15-year-old autistic girl kept at home for 18 months, the lack of a joined-up school and youth-care system, and related waiting lists and gaps in responsibility. The government says a suitable school placement has recently been found, cites privacy limits on details, and points to municipal responsibility and existing cooperation support without committing to new national measures.
I cannot go into all the details of this matter, because this concerns privacy-sensitive information.
Ik kan niet op alle details van deze kwestie ingaan, omdat dit privacygevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Siderius over de financiële en sociale gevolgen van de wet hervorming kindregelingen voor de kinderalimentatie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Social Affairs and Finance about the financial and social effects of the Wet hervorming kindregelingen on child maintenance, including whether recipients lose out and whether the scheme leads to conflicts and a flood of maintenance cases. The minister answers that most recipients gain, that effects depend on individual cases, that the Raad voor de rechtspraak expects some extra change requests, and that no compensation is planned.
The exact consequences for child maintenance depend heavily on the facts and circumstances of a specific case.
De exacte gevolgen voor kinderalimentatie zijn sterk afhankelijk van de feiten en omstandigheden in een specifiek geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de toelaatbaarheidsverklaringen voor het speciaal onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about special education admission certificates (toelaatbaarheidsverklaringen): whether schools should decide without knowing pupils, whether a uniform form and earlier applications were appropriate, and whether the vso should fall under the secondary-education collective agreement. The state secretary defended the current division of responsibilities, said the uniform form applies only to severely multiply disabled pupils, rejected national admission criteria, and announced a planned unbundling of special and vso with a progress report before the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de sluiting van speciale school 't Nyrees in Almelo

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about the planned closure of the special school 't Nyrees in Almelo, its effects on pupils and staff, and the lack of a social plan. The State Secretary answered that the decision belongs to the samenwerkingsverband (school board consortium), which is currently considering a successor arrangement, and that the parents' council has consent rights over the support plan.
It is the responsibility of the samenwerkingsverband and the schools where these pupils are enrolled to ensure an appropriate offer.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het samenwerkingsverband en de scholen waar deze leerlingen ingeschreven zijn om te zorgen voor een passend aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het aanstellen van conciërges en klassenassistenten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education how many concierges and classroom assistants had been hired since 1 January 2015 with the structural 50 million euro, how staffing changed in 2010-2014, and how many extra hours teachers gained. The State Secretary answered that the funds only became available early 2015, no staffing targets were agreed with sector organisations, staffing figures for 2015 come only in 2016, historical figures show a decline due to falling pupil numbers, and the extra teaching hours cannot be stated.
I can provide you with figures on the total number of education support staff and support and management staff (OOP/OBP) hired.
Ik kan u wel cijfers verstrekken over het totaal aangesteld onderwijsondersteunend personeel en ondersteunend en beheerspersoneel (OOP/OBP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de gewichtenregeling in het basisonderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether children whose parents only completed MBO level 1 receive no weighting in the primary-school weighting scheme and whether this is fair compared with vmbo. The State Secretary confirmed the rules, said no data exist on how many parents report MBO-1, and promised to report on possible revision of the scheme later in the year.
Schools administer the parents' education data for implementing the weighting scheme. OCW has no insight into this data.
Scholen administreren voor de uitvoering van de gewichtenregeling de opleidingsgegevens van de ouders. OCW heeft geen inzicht in deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de verplichte herbestedingsregels voor de ambulante begeleiding binnen het zogenaamde passend onderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether unclear rules on mandatory reallocation of ambulatory support budgets from special schools to regional cooperation bodies are causing confusion, whether agreements are being kept, and about the financial and staffing consequences. The State Secretary answered that information is provided via letters, factsheets and an advisory committee, that the agreements are in law and the Inspectorate can intervene if they are not kept, and that some cooperation bodies are opting out while exact amounts for some budgets cannot be given.
If signals show that this is not happening, that is reason for the Inspectorate of Education to start a conversation about it.
Indien uit signalen blijkt dat dit niet gebeurt, is dat reden voor de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) om daarover het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het in stand houden van regulier onderwijs met specifieke locaties voor zorgleerlingen in het passend onderwijs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about the threatened continuation of special-needs locations within regular schools, including the Jorisschool in Nijmegen and a Rotterdam closure, the wider impact of passend onderwijs on funding, bureaucracy, care procurement and cluster 3 financing. The State Secretary replied that closure of the Jorisschool is not currently on the table, that responsibility for a covering support structure lies with the samenwerkingsverband and school boards, and that no national measures to sustain such facilities or change funding by location are planned.
Incidentally, responsibility for a comprehensive support structure lies with the samenwerkingsverband passend onderwijs.
Overigens ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor een dekkende ondersteuningsstructuur bij het samenwerkingsverband passend onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat Utrecht al 600 klachten heeft ontvangen over de thuiszorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that Utrecht received 600 complaints over home-care cuts, the 'Schoon huis' collective provision, reduced hours after file reviews, and whether this fits the Wmo 2015. The state secretary said the complaints are objections under the Awb, that the VNG and he are promoting careful procedures, that the courts will rule on the disputed cases, that huishoudelijke hulp is judged by outcome, and that he lacks the requested overview of objections per municipality.
I do not have the requested overview and for that reason cannot comply with your request.
Ik beschik niet over het gevraagde overzicht en kan om die reden niet aan uw verzoek voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "een overgangsregeling voor de couveuseregeling bij vroeggeboorte"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether mothers of premature babies born in December 2014, still hospitalised, should get a transitional arrangement for the extended maternity leave for hospitalised infants that takes effect 1 January 2015. The minister answered that about 250 cases per month are expected, refused a transitional arrangement to avoid abrupt effects on employers and UWV, and estimated its cost at about 250,000 euro.
I am therefore not willing to make a transitional arrangement or provision.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid om een overgangsregeling of voorziening te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het faillissement van Pantein/Vivent

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of home-care provider Pantein/Vivent, including the role of budget cuts, the transfer of staff to ZuidZorg, executive pay and the stille bewindvoering period. The State Secretary largely declined to comment on the causes and finances of the bankruptcy, pointing to the court and curator, and said municipalities are responsible for continuity of care while promising ongoing monitoring.
It is not for me to make statements about the background to this bankruptcy and the financial situation of the organisation.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de achtergronden bij dit faillissement en de financiële situatie van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de klachten van 24000 mensen in Gelderland en Overijssel over de veranderingen in de zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a regional survey in which nearly 24,000 people in Gelderland and Overijssel voiced worries about cuts, care quality, affordability and mantelzorg burdens under the Wmo and Wlz reforms. The State Secretary answered that the survey predates the changes, that the government will monitor experiences and report in April, and that municipalities and insurers bear primary responsibility for communication and individual support.
In April I will send you a report giving an overview of the progress and developments of the changes in long-term care and support up to the first quarter of 2015.
In april a.s. zal ik u een rapportage toezenden waarin ik een beeld zal geven over het verloop en de ontwikkelingen van de veranderingen in de langdurige zorg en ondersteuning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over ‘de ellende met de keukentafelgesprekken’

An MP from the SP asks the State Secretary for Health about problems with municipal kitchen-table assessment conversations under the new Wmo 2015, including cuts to home care hours, telephone handling, costs and training. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for implementation, that the state lacks national data, that legal safeguards and appeal rights apply, and that intervention is possible only for serious, systemic failures.
If a municipal executive does not carry out the legally required investigation properly, the client has the right to hold the municipality to account, if necessary through objection and appeal.

Indien een college het op basis van de Wmo 2015 verplichte onderzoek in vervolg op een melding niet zorgvuldig uitvoert, heeft de cliënt het recht de gemeente hierop aan te spreken, zo nodig in bezwaar en beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de loondump en dreigende ontslagen bij Verian

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether Verian's pressure on Nijmegen home-care staff to accept a 20% pay cut under threat of dismissal is lawful, and whether the executive pay, municipal duty of care and Verian itself should be intervened on. The State Secretary answered that employers cannot unilaterally cut pay, that a changed job offer can be refused with dismissal then reviewed by UWV under reasonableness criteria, that the WNT pay norm applies to executives, and that municipalities are responsible for continuity of care under the Wmo 2015 and Verian must comply with the rules.
An employer cannot unilaterally reduce the employee's wage.
Een werkgever kan niet eenzijdig het loon van de werknemer verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over passend onderwijs voor chronisch zieke leerlingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether the Passend Onderwijs system adequately serves chronically ill pupils who cannot follow full-time programmes, and what measures will be taken. The State Secretary rejected the premise, pointing to existing options such as leave from school attendance, spread examinations and case-by-case support by schools, the inspectorate and truancy officers, and announced no new measures.
There is no overview of the number of chronically ill pupils who cannot follow a full-time education programme.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal chronisch zieke leerlingen dat geen fulltime onderwijsprogramma kan volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de huishoudelijke hulp toelage

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport why promised job retention in home care via the huishoudelijke hulp toelage (HHT) has not materialised, and questions tariffs, eligibility for low-income clients, administrative burden and the role of gemeenten. The State Secretary answers that it is too early to quantify jobs saved, that nearly all municipalities will use the HHT, and that tariffs, co-financing and administrative requirements are matters for municipalities and providers, with VWS only monitoring effectiveness.
This means that at present there is no insight into the number of jobs in employment that could be retained up to now.
Dit betekent dat op dit moment geen inzicht bestaat in het aantal banen in loondienst dat tot op dit moment kon worden behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de begeleiding van pleegouders in de Jeugdwet

MP Siderius asked whether the Youth Act's ban on a foster-care supervisor also being a foster parent at the same agency blocks experienced foster parents from mentoring prospective foster parents, and whether foster-parent corporations are desirable. The State Secretary answered that the rule only prevents conflicts of interest for supervisors, that foster parents may mentor each other, and that he will inform Jeugdzorg Nederland to clarify the rule.
To prevent further confusion I will inform Jeugdzorg Nederland about how article 5.1, first paragraph, part b, of the Youth Act works
Om verdere onduidelijkheid te voorkomen zal ik Jeugdzorg Nederland over de werking van artikel 5.1, eerste lid, onderdeel b, van de Jeugdwet informeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over de crowdfundingsite www.geefgezondheid.nu

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that people with health needs must compete for donations on the crowdfunding site geefgezondheid.nu, whether the government will make the site unnecessary by ensuring insurers and municipalities cover needs, and whether it will analyse crowdfunding requests for wrongly denied care. The minister answered that eligibility decisions rest with insurers and municipalities, that crowdfunded items fall outside or only partly within the basic package and that the government has no duty there, and declined to analyse the requests.
These concern forms of care or provisions that are not part of the basic Zvw package or only partly fall under the Wmo
Het gaat hier om zorgvormen of voorzieningen die geen onderdeel zijn van het basispakket van de Zvw of slechts ten dele vallen onder de Wmo
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over thuiszorgorganisatie Vérian die zelfstandige thuishulpen vraagt na een massaontslag

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether thuiszorg organisation Vérian, after dismissing 127 employed home helpers, was rehiring them as self-employed alfa-helpers and whether this undermined policy against such constructions. The State Secretary said dismissals are for UWV or the courts, that Vérian reports no dismissed staff working via its subsidiary, that no broad use of such constructions is known, and that the matter has been referred to an intervention team.
I have now asked the Intervention Team for Reform of Long-Term Care, led by Doekle Terpstra, to look into this further.
Ik heb het Interventieteam Hervorming langdurige zorg onder leiding van Doekle Terpstra inmiddels gevraagd om dit verder na te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het door Thebe zelf aangevraagde faillissement van Thebe Thuiszorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy requested by Thebe of its home-care subsidiary Thebe Thuiszorg, affecting about 2,000 staff, including concerns about wage dumping, pay of executives, and continuity of care. The State Secretary regretted the situation, said the bankruptcy is a court matter and that he will not comment on the company's finances, and pointed to takeover arrangements by other providers and municipal responsibility for continuity of care.

Moreover, now that the court has ruled on the basis of all information available to it, it is not for me to make statements about the background to this bankruptcy and the financial situation of the organisation.

Het is, te meer nu de rechtbank tot een uitspraak is gekomen op basis van alle hem ter beschikking staande informatie, niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de achtergronden bij dit faillissement en de financiële situatie van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over het faillissement van Thebe

MPs asked whether Brabant municipalities stopping household help for some clients on 1 January 2015 conflicts with a court ruling and the duty of care, and whether the State Secretary would intervene in the bankruptcy of Thebe. The State Secretary answered that municipalities must assess clients individually, that a categorical termination is not allowed, that he has informed all Wmo aldermen, and that the court and curator handle the bankruptcy, so he declined to comment on Thebe's finances.
A categorical termination of an ongoing provision is not permitted under the law.
Een categoriale stopzetting van een lopende voorziening is niet toegestaan op grond van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius en Yücel over de medewerking van het kabinet aan het plan om de werkloosheid in Twente aan te pakken

MPs Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether the cabinet will cooperate with the Twente 'Twente Werkt' action plan against high unemployment, and referred to earlier motions on regional economic renewal and border regions. Minister Kamp replied that the ministries already participate in the plan, pointed to earlier letters, acknowledged a skills mismatch in Twente and said no substantial changes to government jobs in the region are foreseen, while leaving the specific contribution per action line to a later letter.
The ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and Economic Affairs are already actively participating in the 'Twente Werkt!' action plan.
De ministeries van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Economische Zaken werken al actief mee aan het Actieplan «Twente Werkt!.»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Kooiman over problemen bij Fier Friesland met de budgetten specialistische functies

MPs Siderius and Kooiman asked why specialised national services of Fier Friesland still lack funding agreements for 2015 and whether budgets, shelter for foreign trafficking victims and their children, and the transfer of AWBZ and youth mental health funds to municipalities have been properly arranged. The State Secretary answered that agreements exist through the VNG framework, that municipalities decide on purchasing, that central shelter (COSM) is extended to 2017, and that the government will monitor the transition and revisit the 2015 budget in spring with the VNG, while declining several requests such as a pilot status, a transfer to the Ministry of Security and Justice, or a trust account.
It is up to the municipalities to make agreements on the design and financing of care provision for victims of trafficking in human beings and their children.
Het is aan de gemeenten om afspraken te maken over de vormgeving en financiering van het zorgaanbod voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel en hun kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de inrichting van een adviesteam door de Raad voor de kinderbescherming

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about the Child Protection Board's new advisory team, its overlap with Veilig Thuis, privacy safeguards, medical expertise and the meldcode. The government answered that the advisory role supports municipalities without shifting responsibility, that the Board and Veilig Thuis are complementary, and that privacy and forensic medical procedures are regulated.
When a municipality consults the Board, responsibility for the report and therefore for the child's safety remains with the municipality.
Als een gemeente de Raad consulteert, blijft de verantwoordelijkheid voor de melding en dus voor de veiligheid van het kind bij de gemeente liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de Mutsaersstichting die wordt bedreigd in haar voortbestaan, waardoor er kwetsbare kinderen op straat dreigen te belanden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the Mutsaersstichting, a youth care provider threatened with collapse over a dispute with municipalities on youth care purchasing, and about the role of the Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd. The State Secretary answered that an agreement has been reached, that the TAJ mediated and advised, and that the government will remain involved after 1 January 2015 while leaving first responsibility with municipalities.
Moreover, I will not hesitate to ask municipalities for information where necessary and to inform your House upon request.
Ik zal overigens niet schromen daar waar nodig gemeenten om informatie te vragen en uw Kamer desgevraagd daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het verdeelmodel Wmo 2015 (Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning)

An SP MP asked the state secretary why the regional care-office tariffs for day care and support under the Wmo 2015 are not public, whether gemeenten with more care receive less budget under the new allocation model, and how the model accounts for socio-economic and health differences and financial risks. The state secretary refused to publish the tariffs as market-sensitive and confidential, denied that high-care gemeenten get less, described the objective model's indicators, and committed only to a phased transition and further evaluation.
Het gaat hierbij om «marktgevoelige» en vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de voorgenomen sluiting van de St. Suitbertusschool in de gemeente Montferland (Stokkum)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education about the planned closure of St. Suitbertusschool in Stokkum (Montferland), its merger with a nearby school, the effect on village liveability, and whether small schools could be kept open. The State Secretary answered that closure is the responsibility of the school board, that the merger is carefully prepared due to falling pupil numbers, that he has no means to keep the school open, and that he will propose a law easing the rules on cooperative schools.
It is not for me to give a judgment on a decision to close or merge a school.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over een besluit tot sluiting of fusie van een school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over pleegkinderen die na hun 18de verjaardag in een zwart gat vallen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how to prevent foster children and other youths from falling through the gap when youth care ends at 18, including a single help desk and legal guarantees for the transition. The State Secretary answered that the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet already require municipalities to plan continuity of care, that care can be extended to age 23, and that ZN and VNG are working on information transfer, but gave no figure on how many municipalities have concrete arrangements.
I will keep urging municipalities and health insurers to give substance to this.
Ik blijf er bij gemeenten en zorgverzekeraars op aandringen hier invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "het flitsfaillissement van Triodus Kinderopvang"

An SP MP asked the minister about the pre-pack bankruptcy and sale of childcare organisation Triodus, including its consequences for children, staff and locations, the sale conditions, and whether tougher rules are needed. The minister answered that continuity was secured for parents and children, most staff were offered permanent contracts, and that the curator will report on the sale conditions later while he sees no need for new legislation.
The curator will shortly account for the prepack period through the first public report.
De curator zal binnenkort middels het eerste openbare verslag verantwoording afleggen over de prepack periode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over scholen die ouders verplichten tot aanschaf van een iPad

SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Education whether schools may require parents to buy iPads, which can cost up to 1,000 euro, and how the 'free' versus 'cost-free' distinction and school financing are handled. The State Secretary replied that schools may not compel purchase of tablets or laptops, that voluntary parental contributions are allowed with cost-free alternatives, and that the Inspectorate has received a stable number of complaints and ordered corrections at 17 schools.
I asked the Inspectorate whether it has received signals about schools where questions have arisen about parental contributions and school costs.
Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd of zij signalen hebben ontvangen over scholen waar vragen zijn gerezen over de ouderbijdrage en schoolkosten voor ouders.
