The answers attribute delays to late adoption of EU regulations and new programming requirements, state that four Dutch ERDF, two of four INTERREG and the ESF programmes are approved, and explain that payments to beneficiaries occur after the fact via the managing authority.
The Dutch ESF programme was approved as the fourth of all European ESF programmes.
Het Nederlandse ESF-programma is als vierde van alle Europese ESF-programma's goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het bericht in het FD van 1 oktober 2014:  “Nederland blijft achter met Europese subsidies”

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the low Dutch success rate (4 of 108 applications) in the first round of the EU SME instrument, and whether Dutch SMEs can benefit more. The minister confirms the figures, explains the success rate is still early to judge, and promises to examine how to better reach the target group and keep the Chamber informed.
I will keep the Chamber informed of the further approach and the results thereof.
Ik zal de Kamer op de hoogte houden van de verdere aanpak en de resultaten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Van Veen over het artikel 'Miljoenenstrop door stoffen'

MPs Dijkstra, Ziengs and Van Veen asked about the European Commission's plan to add five substances to the RoHS II restriction list, whether the process followed REACH procedures, and what the costs and benefits would be. The Secretary of State answered that the Commission acted within the RoHS framework after consulting member states and stakeholders, that the costs are real but the benefits of phasing out hazardous substances justify them, and that the government sees no reason to intervene, while it will monitor exemption applications.
I therefore see no reason to hold the Commission to account on this.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding de Commissie hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over de voorgenomen aanpassing van het Sportbesluit

Rep. Van Veen asks whether the State Secretary of Finance signalled to sports parties a far-reaching revision of the Sportbesluit after the Bridport CJEU ruling, and about its financial and municipal consequences. The government confirms the Bridport ruling prompted reconsideration of the VAT sports exemption, says the financial impact is not yet quantified and will be assessed carefully, and promises a decision later via the Fiscale Verzamelwet 2015.
A substantiation of the amount has (for the time being) not been shared with us.
Een onderbouwing van het bedrag is (vooralsnog) niet met ons gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen zijn gesteld over het artikel ‘Geld nodig voor oorlogsgraven’

MP Van Veen asked the minister about reports that the Oorlogsgravenstichting needs more money for war graves upkeep, rising costs, its thin equity and whether government will take long-term responsibility and separate memorial centre operations. The minister said the upkeep is fully covered by subsidy, the foundation is seeking external funds, equity is being restored, and that the separation of memorial centres from grave work already exists.
For additional expenses the Oorlogsgravenstichting is looking for income other than subsidy funds.
Voor extra uitgaven is de Oorlogsgravenstichting op zoek naar andere inkomsten dan de subsidiegelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het bericht ‘Twee onnodige doden door ruzie cardiochirurgen Den Haag’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that two avoidable deaths at The Hague's HagaZiekenhuis resulted from a dispute between cardiac surgeons, and about the IGZ's handling, including why no disciplinary case was brought. The minister replied that the facts broadly match the hospital's report, that mortality is in line with the national average, that two calamities were reported and deemed adequately addressed, and that the IGZ found no individual culpable conduct warranting a disciplinary referral.
The IGZ decided not to refer the matter to the disciplinary judge because it considers there was no culpable individual conduct.
De IGZ heeft besloten om de zaak niet voor te leggen aan de tuchtrechter omdat zij van oordeel is dat er geen sprake is van verwijtbaar individueel handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het bericht ‘Eigen medisch dossier taboe voor patiënten’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that doctors obstruct patients' access to their own medical records, including blacking out parts and refusing copies. The minister acknowledged patients' right of access under the WGBO, said the IGZ received 17 complaints in 2012-2013 but does not enforce access rights, and listed complaint and civil-court routes.
Patients have the right to inspect their own medical records or receive a copy of them.
Patiënten hebben het recht om hun eigen medische dossiers in te zien dan wel een afschrift daarvan te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van Veen over een uitzending waarin aandacht wordt besteed aan het beoordelen van de wilsbekwaamheid door een notaris bij dementie

MPs Van Oosten and Van Veen asked about a broadcast on notaries assessing testamentary capacity in dementia cases, and whether notaries should be released from absolute professional secrecy to report suspected abuse. The government answered that notaries already have a duty to investigate such suspicions under professional rules and case law, can use a KNB reporting protocol, and that pilots on preventing financial exploitation of the elderly run until end 2014.
It is the notary's natural task to provide legal protection to his clients regarding the content and legal consequences of an intended legal act.
Het is de natuurlijke taak van de notaris om aan zijn cliënten rechtsbescherming te bieden ten aanzien van de inhoud en de rechtsgevolgen van een voorgenomen rechtshandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het bericht ‘Inspectie pakt ‘foute’ digitale dokters aan’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the inspectorate is targeting unreliable digital doctor apps, including complaint numbers, notified apps, a KNMG quality mark, reimbursement, and responsibility allocation. The minister answered that no complaints were received, some apps were notified via Farmatec, the KNMG mark does not yet exist, reimbursement is possible in some cases, and the producer bears primary responsibility while the inspectorate supervises compliance.
The IGZ is responsible for supervising whether such apps, registered as medical devices, meet the legal requirements
De IGZ is verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht of dergelijke apps, die geregistreerd zijn als medische hulpmiddel, voldoen aan de wettelijke eisen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Van Oosten over de aanbevelingen in de dissertatie van mr.dr. R.P. Wijne

Two VVD MPs asked the health and justice ministers about recommendations in a dissertation by R.P. Wijne on easing patients' civil claims for avoidable harm, including reversing the burden of proof and presuming consent violations. The minister replied that the pending Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg already offers a low-threshold compensation route and incident-disclosure duty, and that the government will first assess its effects before considering further changes to the patient's evidentiary position.

We first want to see what the effects of the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg bill are, before considering whether, and if so which, further improvement of the patient's evidentiary position is necessary.

Wij willen eerst bezien wat de effecten zijn van het wetsvoorstel Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg, alvorens te beschouwen of – en zo ja welke – verdere verbetering van de bewijspositie van de patiënt noodzakelijk is.

Vragen van de leden Van Veen en Duisenberg (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap inzake het artikel «Vanaf 2014 loten voor hbo-studie Verpleegkunde aa

MPs Van Veen and Duisenberg asked why the Hanze University introduced a numerus fixus for nursing studies and whether nationwide internship places match future demand. The ministers answered that the number of places is an institutional decision, that shortages are primarily regional, that funding and regional programmes support placements, and that Europe plays no role.
A university of applied sciences may make such decisions itself and is responsible for its own choices.
Een hogeschool mag dit soort beslissingen zelf maken en is verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen keuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het EO-programma “De vijfde dag” van 13 februari 2013

An MP asked the minister whether the health inspectorate (IGZ) used its powers enough to guarantee patient safety at SEIN after a repeat incident, and whether oversight of institutions under extra supervision should be made public. The government answered that the IGZ acted adequately, that the 2011 death was not comparable to 2008, and that it will increase transparency about supervised providers and reported incidents.
Secondly, greater transparency about the (alleged) calamities that a care provider reports to the IGZ.
Ten tweede grotere transparantie over de (vermeende) calamiteiten die een zorgaanbieder aan de IGZ meldt.
Vragen van het lid Van Veen (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Lijst met 1000 medische zaken uitgelekt» (ingezonden 21 februari 2013).

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about reports that a list of about 1,000 medical cases leaked to RTL and whether patient data was adequately protected at the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ). The minister answered that the IGZ mistakenly passed a list to RTL without intent, that a guarantee against recurrence cannot be given, and that the IGZ is improving safeguards within an ongoing improvement trajectory.
As I have indicated earlier, I find it unacceptable that confidential information from the IGZ has become known to RTL.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, vind ik het onacceptabel dat vertrouwelijke informatie van de IGZ bij RTL bekend is geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het artikel ‘verslavingszorg zelf ontspoord’

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about reports that newly founded addiction clinics charge high residential rates, use non-specialist staff for therapy, and admit patients without medical need, and whether these are systemic or isolated. The minister answered that data show post-2008 clinics declare mainly in the higher residential categories, that insurers can refuse or reclaim improper declarations, that a guideline on head-therapist roles is being prepared, and that a 33% bed reduction is agreed with the sector, while disputing the reported revenue figure.
If health insurers find that declarations are unlawful or inefficient, they need not reimburse those declarations.
Als zorgverzekeraars constateren dat er onrechtmatig of ondoelmatig wordt gedeclareerd, dan hoeven zij die declaraties niet te vergoeden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veen over het artikel ‘VieCuri stelt twee radiologen op non-actief’

An MP asked the minister about press reports that hospital VieCuri suspended two radiologists, and the timeline between the complaint, the investigation and the suspension. The minister answered that an independent investigation was commissioned in September 2012, the suspensions followed on 10 December 2012, and termination of the admission agreements was issued in January 2013.
I have made inquiries about this both with the Board of Directors of VieCuri and with the Inspectorate.
Ik heb hiervoor zowel bij de Raad van Bestuur van het VieCuri als bij de Inspectie navraag laten doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van Veen over de economische kosten van mislukte bedrijfsoverdrachten

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the economic costs of failed business transfers, citing a report claiming EUR 4 billion annual turnover loss and 80,000 jobs lost. The minister rejected the report's conclusions as based on a hypothetical total-inactivity assumption, pointed to existing support (KvK advice, guarantee schemes), and saw no need for additional measures.
No, I cannot endorse these conclusions, because the study assumed the hypothetical situation that all failed business transfers and closures of healthy firms lead to total inactivity.

Nee, ik kan deze conclusies niet onderschrijven, doordat in het onderzoek is uitgegaan van de hypothetische situatie dat alle mislukte bedrijfsoverdrachten en opheffingen van gezonde bedrijven leiden tot totale inactiviteit.

m: Amendement van het lid Ferrier over het geven van instemmingsrecht aan ouders bij het vaststellen van het ontwikkelingsperspectief
Replaces 'after consultation with' parents with 'in agreement with' parents when schools draw up and adjust a pupil's development perspective.
In the first paragraph, 'after consultation with' is replaced by 'in agreement with'.
In het eerste lid wordt «na overleg met» vervangen door: in overeenstemming met.
Motie Ferrier en Van der Ham over beperking van de regeldruk en bureaucratie
Asks the government to carry out a baseline measurement of teachers' time spent on care forms before special-needs partnerships start, and agree with schools to limit bureaucracy.
requests the government to carry out a baseline measurement of time spent on care forms
verzoekt de regering een nulmeting uit te voeren over de tijdsbesteding ten aanzien van zorgformulieren
Motie Ferrier c.s. over door de gemeenten gesubsidieerd leerlingenvervoer
Asks the government to consult VNG and inform the House on continued municipal subsidised pupil transport for children who cannot travel independently.
requests the government to enter into discussion with the VNG and inform the House
verzoekt de regering hierover in gesprek te gaan met de VNG en de Kamer te informeren
Motie-Ferrier/Dijkhoff over eisen aan gesubsidieerde ontwikkelingsorganisaties
Asks the government to make clear to subsidised development organisations the transparency, governance and pay requirements and the financial sanctions for non-compliance, and to inform the House.
requests the government to make clear to all subsidised development organisations which requirements are imposed on them
verzoekt de regering aan alle gesubsidieerde ontwikkelingsorganisaties duidelijk te maken welke eisen aan hen worden gesteld
Amendement van de leden Ferrier en Dijkhoff ter dekking van het amendement 32500 V nr. 55
Amendment that cuts 10 million euro from the international financial relations budget (IDA-15 contribution) to cover another amendment.
the commitment and expenditure amounts reduced by € 10,000 (x € 1,000)
het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 10 000 (x € 1 000)
Amendement van de leden Ferrier en Dijkhof over het verzachten van de bezuiniging op de bestrijding van HIV/Aids
Softens a budget cut to HIV/Aids work by moving 20 million euro within the budget statement, funded by cuts to other lines.
This amendment aims to soften the cut to HIV/Aids control by 20 million euro.
Dit amendement beoogt de bezuiniging op de bestrijding van HIV/Aids met 20 miljoen euro te verzachten.
Motie Hachchi c.s. over een Europees actieplan om resolutie 1325 te concretiseren
Asks the government to call for national action plans on UN Resolution 1325 and to push in the EU for a European action plan on it.
requests the government to work in the EU for a European action plan to give concrete form to UNSCR 1325 in policy at European level
verzoekt de regering zich in de EU in te zetten voor een Europees actieplan om op Europees niveau VNVR 1325 in beleid te concretiseren
Motie Ferrier c.s. over proactief uitvoeren van resolutie 1325 van de Veiligheidsraad
Asks the government to implement UN Resolution 1325 proactively through embassies and EU representations and to report to the Chamber annually.
Motie Ferrier over coherentie in verband met duurzame ontwikkeling
Asks the government to pursue policy coherence for sustainable development and to send parliament an annual overview of projects where coherence is actively applied.
to send the House each year an overview of projects in which coherence is actively applied
de Kamer jaarlijks een overzicht van projecten te sturen waarin coherentie actief wordt ingezet
Motie Dijkhoff en Ferrier over ontkoppeling van hiv/aids-beleid en SRGR-beleid
Asks the government to reverse the decoupling of HIV/AIDS policy from sexual and reproductive health and rights policy in development cooperation.
requests the government to reverse the decoupling of HIV/AIDS policy from SRHR policy
verzoekt de regering de ontkoppeling van het beleid op het gebied hiv/aids van het beleid omtrent SRGR
Motie Ferrier over ontwikkelen van een duurzame lokale economie
Motion asks the government to give more attention to ecological security in development policy and to bring together expertise for pilots on a sustainable local economy, informing the House.
requests the government, when developing a sustainable local economy in developing countries, to bring together sustainability expertise and to start pilots and inform the House

verzoekt de regering bij het ontwikkelen van een duurzame lokale economie in ontwikkelingslanden specifieke op duurzaamheid gerichte kennis en ervaring van bedrijfsleven en maatschappelijke organisaties samen te brengen en waar mogelijk nieuwe pilots te starten en de Kamer daarover te informeren
motie Ferrier c.s. over een onderzoek naar de ontwikkeling van de kosten bij extreme toe- of afname van het aantal leerlingen
Asks the government to study how school costs develop when pupil numbers change sharply and to inform the House in spring 2011.
requests the government to produce further research on how costs develop relative to funding when pupil numbers change sharply
verzoekt de regering te komen met een nader onderzoek naar de ontwikkeling van de kosten in relatie tot de omvang van de bekostiging
Motie Voordewind en Ferrier over oplossingen gericht op het opvangen van de gevolgen van krimp
Asks the government to study solutions for the effects of population decline on schools in shrinking regions.
requests the government to research solutions aimed at absorbing the consequences of shrinkage in education
verzoekt de regering om onderzoek te doen naar oplossingen die zich richten op het opvangen van de gevolgen van krimp in het onderwijs
Motie Voordewind c.s. over bezuinigingen op passend onderwijs laten neerslaan op terugdringen bureaucratie en management
Asks the government to do everything to keep education cuts for inclusive schooling out of classrooms and away from pupils needing extra care.
requests the government to do everything to ensure the cuts to inclusive education do not land in the classroom or with pupils needing extra care
verzoekt de regering er alles aan te doen om de bezuinigingen op passend onderwijs niet in de klas en bij de zorgleerlingen terecht te laten komen
Motie Ferrier c.s. over geïntegreerde en doelmatige zorg en ondersteuning van jeugdigen
Asks the government to align youth care and education policy across ministries and to inform the House in spring 2011 about the consequences of the cut on special education.
to inform the House in spring 2011 about what the consequences of the 300 million cut to fitting education will be
de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2011 te informeren over wat de consequenties van de korting van 300 mln. op passend onderwijs zullen zijn
Amendement van de leden Çelik en Ferrier ter vervanging van nr. 9 aangaande het invoeren van een evaluatiebepaling in deze wet
Adds an evaluation clause requiring the education minister to report to parliament within three years on how schools handle pupil data, who has access, and retention periods.
sends to the States General within three years of entry into force a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice

zendt, in overeenstemming met Onze minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk
Motie Waalkens c.s. over steun voor onderzoek naar vaccins
Asks the government to keep supporting research into vaccines and microbicides after 2010.
requests the government to continue supporting research into vaccines and microbicides also after 2010
verzoekt de regering ook na 2010 onderzoek naar vaccins en microbicides te blijven steunen
Motie Vendrik c.s. over besteding van eventuele extra middelen voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Motion asks the government to prioritise any freed-up or extra 2010 development aid for NGO peace and civic education projects in South Sudan and for environmental and deforestation work in Sudan.

requests the government, if funds are freed up or extra money is available for development cooperation in 2010, to prioritise peace dividend and civic education projects when drafting the Spring Memorandum

verzoekt de regering om, indien vrijvallend dan wel extra geld beschikbaar is in 2010 voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking, bij het opstellen van de Voorjaarsnota prioriteit te geven aan vredesdividend- en burgereducatieprojecten
Motie Ferrier over helderheid over de EKI-voorziening voor 2010
Asks the government to clarify quickly the precise composition of the 300 million euro EKI provision and when debt relief to DRC will occur, or how the funds will be spent.
requests the government to provide clarity soon on the precise composition of this 300 million provision
verzoekt de regering op korte termijn helderheid te verschaffen over de precieze samenstelling van deze voorziening van 300 mln.
Amendement van het lid Voordewind c.s. over het deels ongedaan maken van de korting op het bilaterale onderwijsprogramma van Bangladesh
Amends the foreign affairs budget to partly reverse a planned cut to Bangladesh's bilateral education programme by shifting funds between articles.
This amendment aims to partly reverse the planned cut of 13.5 million euros to Bangladesh's bilateral education programme
Dit amendement beoogt de voorziene korting van 13,5 miljoen euro van het bilaterale onderwijsprogramma van Bangladesh ten dele ongedaan te maken
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ferrier c.s. ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 10 over het verhogen van het budget voor UNAIDS
Amendment shifts 4.5 million euro from one budget article to UNAIDS funding, covering a cut to UNAIDS and halving a Global Fund cut; it concerns budget allocation, not executive checks.
This amendment aims to allocate 4.5 million euros to UNAIDS.
Dit amendement beoogt een toekenning van 4,5 miljoen euro aan UNAIDS.
Motie Ferrier over onderzoek naar de bestedingsdruk op het budget voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Asks for a study, possibly by the IOB, of budget-spending pressure on the development aid budget and scenarios for more multi-year flexibility.
requests the government to have a study carried out into spending pressure on the development cooperation budget
verzoekt de regering een onderzoek naar de bestedingsdruk op het budget voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking te laten verrichten
Amendement van het lid Ferrier c.s. over het toekennen van budget aan GFATM en UNAIDS
Reallocates 20 million euro within the foreign affairs budget to restore funding to the Global Fund (16 million) and UNAIDS (4 million).
This amendment aims to allocate 16 million euro to the Global Fund to Fight Aids, Tuberculosis and Malaria and 4 million euro to UNAIDS.
Dit amendement beoogt een toekenning van 16 miljoen euro aan het Global Fund to Fight Aids, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GFATM) en 4 miljoen euro aan UNAIDS.
Amendement van het lid Ferrier over het toekennen van budget aan Guyana Shield Initiative
Shifts €1.5 million within the foreign affairs budget from poverty reduction to the Guyana Shield Initiative under environment.
within article 6.1 Environment and Water, to allocate €1.5 million to the Guyana Shield Initiative
binnen artikel 6.1 Milieu en Water, € 1,5 miljoen toe te kennen aan het Guyana Shield Initiative
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Ferrier en Gill'ard ter vervanging van nr. 24 over financiële ondersteuning ex-asielzoekers
Shifts budget from poverty reduction to support for the return of former asylum seekers to their countries of origin.
This amendment aims to provide financial support for the return of former asylum seekers present in the Netherlands to their country of origin.
Dit amendement beoogt financiële ondersteuning te bieden aan de terugkeer van in Nederland aanwezige ex-asielzoekers naar hun land van herkomst.
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen c.s. over de daadwerkelijke besteding van de zorggelden
Asks the government to commission a detailed audit of how schools actually spend the care-related education funds, reporting to the Chamber in spring 2009.
requests the government to commission an in-depth audit in primary, secondary and vocational education of the actual spending of the care funds
verzoekt de regering een diepgaand accountantsonderzoek in te stellen in het po, het vo en het mbo naar de daadwerkelijke besteding van de zorggelden
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen/Ferrier over een formele positie van ouders in de nieuw te vormen regionale netwerken
Asks the government to give parents a formal position in the regional networks under Passend Onderwijs.
ensure that parents get a formal position in the newly formed regional networks
ervoor te zorgen dat ouders een formele positie krijgen in de nieuw te vormen regionale netwerken
Amendement van het lid Gill'ard C.S. ter vervanging van nr. 3 over de productontwikkeling van hittebestendig oxytocine
Shifts 1.5 million euro within the foreign affairs budget to heat-stable oxytocin product development, with conditions on patents and affordable pricing.
Amendement van de leden Gill'ard en Ferrier voor vrijmaken van gelden t.b.v. de productontwikkeling van hittebestendig oxytocine
Shifts 1.5 million euro within the foreign affairs budget to develop heat-stable oxytocin for postpartum haemorrhage.
This amendment aims to use 1.5 million euro within article 5.5 Reproductive health for the product development of heat-resistant oxytocin
Dit amendement beoogt de aanwending van € 1,5 miljoen binnen artikel 5.5 «Reproductieve gezondheid» ten behoeve van de productontwikkeling van hittebestendig oxytocine
Motie Ferrier c.s. over de beleidsvoornemens ten aanzien van de begrotingssteun aan Rwanda
Motion asks the government to inform the House after a visit to Rwanda about its findings and policy plans on budget support given Rwanda's role in the Eastern Congo conflict.
requests the government to inform the House directly after this visit, and at latest before 15 December 2008, about the outcomes of its findings
verzoekt de regering de Kamer direct na dit bezoek, doch uiterlijk vóór 15 december 2008, over de uitkomsten van zijn bevindingen te informeren
Motie Voordewind c.s. over een interdepartementale strategie ter bestrijding van kinderarbeid
Asks the government to develop an interdepartmental strategy against child labour and evaluate basic-education programmes.
requests the government to develop a coherent interdepartmental strategy to combat child labour
verzoekt de regering een samenhangende interdepartementale strategie te ontwikkelen voor bestrijding van kinderarbeid
Amendement van het lid Ferrier dat beoogt een financiële ondersteuning te bieden voor de terugkeer van ex-asielzoekers
Proposes shifting €4,000 within the foreign affairs budget article on Dutch citizens abroad and personal traffic to fund support for return of former asylum seekers.
This amendment aims to provide financial support for the return of former asylum seekers present in the Netherlands
Dit amendement beoogt een financiële ondersteuning te bieden aan de terugkeer van in Nederland aanwezige ex-asielzoekers
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ferrier over schending van het wapenembargo en sanctieregime door de Rwandese regering

MP Ferrier (CDA) asked the foreign minister whether the government considers the UN Group of Experts' findings that Rwanda violated the DRC arms embargo by supporting the M23 rebels to be serious, how it weighs Rwanda's denial, and what consequences and steps follow for development relations and donor pressure. The minister answered that the findings are worrying, that Rwanda's response and the final report will be weighed, that bilateral sectoral budget support has been suspended and multilateral budget support postponed, and that the Netherlands continues consultations with international partners.
The Netherlands has put on hold the decision on granting bilateral sectoral budget support to the Rwandan government.
Nederland heeft de beslissing over het verlenen van bilaterale sectorale begrotingssteun aan de Rwandese overheid aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen Ferrier over mogelijke verduistering van Nederlands ontwikkelingsgeld bij de grootste universiteit in Oeganda

MP Ferrier asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about reports that Dutch development funds were embezzled at Uganda's largest university, and how Nuffic's oversight and the Ministry's role work. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, described investigations by Ugandan police and the Auditor General, said Nuffic has paused its own inquiry pending the Auditor General's findings, and explained the audit and management-cost arrangements.
The investigation initiated by Nuffic was delayed because the Ugandan fiscal police seized all relevant documents for its own investigation.
Het door de Nuffic ingezette onderzoek is vertraagd doordat de Oegandese fiscale recherche voor haar eigen onderzoek alle relevante documenten in beslag heeft genomen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ferrier, Van der Staaij, El Fassed, De Lange, Ouwehand, Hachchi en Irrgang over het bericht dat ruim 18 miljoen mensen in de Sahel worden bedreigd door een humanitaire ramp

MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the Sahel food crisis affecting 18 million people, its urgency, past prevention efforts, Dutch funding levels, disaster risk reduction, and support for smallholders. The State Secretary answered that the situation is very serious, outlined past Dutch development projects, reported modest extra Dutch emergency contributions and planned bilateral and multilateral efforts, but gave no specific DRR funding breakdown and declined to pledge larger increases.
At present so-called aid tracking of DRR activities, labelling the DRR dimension of development cooperation activities, is not yet possible.
Op dit moment is het zogenoemde «aid tracking» van DRR activiteiten, het labellen van de DRR-dimensie van OS activiteiten, nog niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ferrier over het bericht dat de Indiase overheid 77 buitenlandse NGO's op een ‘watchlist’ heeft geplaatst

Ferrier (CDA) asked the government about reports that India placed 77 foreign NGOs on a watchlist and required detailed disclosure of their activities under the FCRA. Minister Rosenthal answered that the FCRA was tightened in 2010 to counter misuse of foreign funds, that the EU delegation reports difficulties for some NGOs, and that human rights concerns will be raised bilaterally and in the EU-India dialogue.
Both in bilateral contacts and during the upcoming EU-India human rights dialogue, attention will be given to this issue.
Zowel in bilaterale contacten als tijdens de aanstaande EU-India mensenrechtendialoog wordt aan deze kwestie aandacht gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ferrier over de conferentie ‘The Sudanese Dutch Private Investment Forum’

An MP asks whether the government knows of and endorses a private investment forum on Sudan, whether Sudanese regime members and Dutch officials attended, and how it fits the Ferrier motion on conditions for aid to Sudan. The minister says no Sudanese government members took part, two foreign ministry officials and one agriculture ministry official joined part of the programme, and the government continues to press for humanitarian access and compliance with UN resolution 2046.
Members of the Sudanese government did not take part in the Sudanese Dutch Private Investment Forum.
Aan het «Sudanese Dutch Private Investment Forum» is niet deelgenomen door leden van de Sudanese regering.
Antwoord vragen Ferrier en Biskop over de brief van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs aan VCO Heerenveen

MPs Ferrier and Biskop asked the Minister of Education why school margedagen (extra free days) at VCO Heerenveen conflict with the Leerplichtwet while the hours norm is met, and why they differ from the planned flexible-schedule experiment. The minister replied that the school abolished the margedagen after consulting the Inspectorate, so no sanctions are needed, that she is bound by existing law and will not make exceptions before the experimentation law takes effect.
Once a law has been adopted, I am bound to comply with it.
Op het moment dat een wet is aangenomen, ben ik gehouden aan de naleving ervan.
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe en Ferrier over het voornemen van verschillende universiteiten om talenstudies op te laten gaan in brede studies

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government shares concern that several universities plan to fold language degrees (e.g. Frisian, French, Portuguese) into broad bachelor programmes, and whether standalone full-time language study should be preserved for national and international interests. The State Secretary acknowledged language importance, said profiling may mean some small programmes disappear or are merged or restructured, and that broad bachelors can still offer languages, while institutions must align plans with the Implementation Plan for Humanities.
I share the view that languages are of great importance from a national cultural perspective and for the Dutch economy and exports.
Ik deel de mening dat talen van groot belang zijn vanuit nationaal cultureel belang en voor de Nederlandse economie en de export.
Antwoord vragen Ferrier over het rapport "Fond de Commerce"

The MP Ferrier asks whether the focus on victims of sexual violence in Congo leaves too little room for ordinary development cooperation and how donor spending on sexual and reproductive health is balanced across countries. The state secretary acknowledges that international aid is not always well aligned with the wider Congolese context, explains the deliberate Maniema focus under a parliamentary motion, and points to OECD and UN guidelines.
However, I share the report's conclusion that international aid efforts are not always optimally aligned with the broader Congolese context.
Ik deel echter de conclusie van het rapport dat de internationale hulpinspanningen niet altijd optimaal zijn afgestemd op de bredere Congolese context.
Antwoord vragen Smilde en Ferrier over de gevaren van totaal resistente tbc

CDA MPs Smilde and Ferrier asked about the danger of totally drug-resistant tuberculosis in India, Europe and the Netherlands, the Dutch preparedness plans, funding for new TB drugs, policy coherence and travel advice. The minister answered that resistant TB is significant but TDR-TB has not yet been found in the Netherlands, that existing plans, expert working groups and screening are in place, and that new drug development is largely the pharmaceutical industry's task, with some Dutch funding and no change to travel advice.
TDR-TB has not yet been observed in the Netherlands.
TDR-tbc is nog niet waargenomen in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen Ferrier over de positie van vrouwen en het aanpakken van discriminatie in Egypte na de verkiezingen

An MP asks the Foreign Minister how she assesses the position of women and discrimination in Egypt after the elections, given that the two largest parties do not clearly endorse these values. The minister answers that the parties' stated positions remain to be tested in practice, that women's representation is under 2 percent of parliament, and that the Netherlands funds and raises women's rights with Egyptian authorities.
The Dutch government will also assess the new Egyptian government on its actions regarding women's rights.
De Nederlandse regering zal de nieuwe Egyptische regering ook wat betreft vrouwenrechten beoordelen op haar daden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi (beiden D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks), en Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bevordering van politieke vrouwenparticipatie in

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would back a gender quota for Libya's new constitution-making body, and how it funds women's political participation in the MENA region. The minister said the Netherlands supports women's participation, will remind the NTC of its commitments, has earmarked EUR 2 million for 2011 and 2012, and will take a lead role within the EU, but did not commit to requesting a quota.

I follow developments in Libya closely and where necessary I remind the NTC and the interim government of their commitments in the draft Constitutional Charter regarding the democratic transition, including women's rights.

Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in Libië nauwgezet en waar nodig herinner ik de NTC en de interim-regering aan hun toezeggingen in the draft Constitutional Charter ten aanzien van de democratische transitie inclusief vrouwenrechten.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ferrier (CDA) en Dikkers en Vermeij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het feit dat het ABP betrokken is bij land

MPs from CDA and PvdA asked why the ABP pension fund's EUR 47 million investment in the Global Solidarity Forest Fund in Mozambique was linked to alleged land grabbing, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary said the ABP is a privatised fund at arm's length from the cabinet, that the relevant ministries would raise the matter in the employers' council and accountability body, and that pension transparency rules are planned.
ABP is a privatised fund and, like other pension funds in the Netherlands, is therefore at arm's length from the cabinet.
ABP is een geprivatiseerd fonds en staat daarmee net als andere pensioenfondsen in Nederland op afstand van het kabinet.

An MP asked the education minister about a broadcast on children with Down syndrome being refused by schools and the number of truants (thuiszitters), and whether schools are refusing pupils strategically ahead of the Passend Onderwijs law. The minister denied seeing signals confirming the picture, estimated about 2,500 truants, and pointed to regional approaches and a Gedragswerk project, while promising new truancy data by 15 March 2012.
There are now good structures for a regional approach to truant pupils.
Er zijn nu goede structuren voor een regionale aanpak van thuiszittende leerlingen.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over patenten (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretaries whether patent barriers had stalled Dutch-Indonesian agricultural cooperation, and whether ministries lack patent expertise. The government answered that the failure stemmed mainly from licensing third-party patents and costly GMO safety procedures, that knowledge exists within ministries, and promised a fuller letter before summer 2012.
I will, together with the state secretary for Foreign Affairs, inform the House further before summer 2012.
Ik zal, samen met de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken, de Tweede Kamer voor de zomer 2012 nader informeren.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het rapport van de International Land Coalition over landgrabbing (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

MP Ferrier asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the International Land Coalition report on land grabbing, including whether the government shares its conclusion that large-scale land acquisitions harm smallholders, how it will apply the investment-model recommendations, how it will improve IFC and OECD standards compliance, and how it will use the report to strengthen the enabling environment. The State Secretary agreed with the concerns, pointed to existing food-security policy, OECD due diligence instruments and partner-country support for land rights, and gave no new binding commitment.
I acknowledge that the global struggle for fertile farmland and the growing global trade in it can come at the expense of the poor local population.
Ik onderken dat de mondiale strijd om vruchtbare landbouwgrond en de groeiende wereldwijde handel daarin ten koste kan gaan van de arme lokale bevolking.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouten (ChristenUnie), Ferrier (CDA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Dijkhoff (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP), Dikkers (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Hachchi (D66)

Ten MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting one year after it was first reported, including whether enforcement is adequate, whether companies are meeting their responsibilities, and the status of various studies and working groups. The government answered that the problem lies mainly with Turkey, that the embassy raised it with Turkish authorities and funds a study, that industry bodies have adopted guidelines and a Turkish action plan exists, but that it could not confirm concrete results of the Turkish working group and could not answer in time for the scheduled debate.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue within the EU framework, including in the Council conclusions.
Het kabinet zal hier in EU-kader aandacht voor blijven vragen, ook in de Raadsconclusies.

Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanvallen en ontvoeringen door Somalische groeperingen, waaronder Al Shabaab, in de grensstreek t

The MP asks the government about Al Shabaab attacks and kidnappings near the Kenya-Somalia border, including the abduction of two Spanish MSF workers from Dadaab, the Kenyan military operation, arrests of opposition figures and journalists in Ethiopia, and EU humanitarian funding. The ministers answer that the kidnapping reduced aid at Dadaab to essential services, describe the Kenya-TFG joint communique and the AU's position, and state that the government raises concerns with Ethiopia and the AU and expects the EU funds to reach refugees.
The Netherlands conducts a dialogue with the Ethiopian authorities, bilaterally and within the EU, in which concerns on this are voiced.
Nederland voert bilateraal en in EU-verband een dialoog met de Ethiopische autoriteiten, waarin de zorgen hieromtrent worden uitgesproken.

Vragen van de leden Biskop en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over «Elke Dag een Werelddocent» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the education and foreign affairs ministers whether they endorse the added value of teacher experience abroad, what initiatives exist for primary and secondary teachers, and what their effects are. The ministers answered yes, pointed to EU Comenius, the national BIOS programme, and Learn4Work, reported participation numbers, and said a Comenius evaluation was positive and BIOS will be evaluated in 2012.
The BIOS programme will be evaluated in 2012.
Het BIOS programma zal in 2012 worden geëvalueerd.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de uitgave van The Broker is opgeschort (ingezonden 6 oktober 2011).

The MP Ferrier asks the state secretary for Foreign Affairs why the publication of The Broker was reportedly suspended and how this fits the Ferrier motion on knowledge. The state secretary replies that no subsidy was terminated, that the quoted remark concerned a board decision of The Broker, and that the ministry's contribution was transferred as agreed, while future proposals will be judged on their merits.
There is no question of the ministry's subsidy to The Broker being terminated.
Er is geen sprake van een stopzetting van de subsidie van het Ministerie aan The Broker.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over geweld tegen Nuba’s in het zuiden van Soedan (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about escalating violence against Nuba communities in South Sudan's border region, including rumours of chemical attacks, and whether the government would press for an international inquiry and protect the area in development relations. The government answered that it is concerned, has urged an end to violence and a political solution bilaterally and in the EU, UN and contact group, supports an independent international investigation, and presses for humanitarian access despite Sudanese government obstruction.
That is why the Netherlands advocates an independent international investigation into alleged human rights violations and war crimes in South Kordofan and Blue Nile.
Daarom pleit Nederland voor een onafhankelijk internationaal onderzoek naar vermeende mensenrechtenschendingen en oorlogsmisdaden in Zuid-Kordofan en Blue Nile.

Vragen van de leden Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat in Mexico twee journalistes zijn vermoord en dat er dit jaar al 10 journalisten zijn gedood (ingezonden 8 sept

The CDA MPs Ormel and Ferrier asked the Foreign Minister about the killings of two journalists in Mexico, the causes and investigation of those killings, the protection of journalists and human rights defenders, the Mexican government's protection measures, general security, and safety for Dutch travellers. The minister answered that the perpetrators and motive are unknown and under investigation by Mexican prosecutors, outlined EU and bilateral support and Mexico's announced protection mechanism, and gave a travel advisory.
The perpetrator and motive of the murders are unknown. The investigation into these murders has not yet been concluded.
Dader en motief van de moorden zijn onbekend. Het onderzoek naar deze moorden is nog niet afgerond.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het opschorten van subsidies voor mondiaal burgerschap (ingezonden 16 augustus 2011).

An MP asks whether the state secretary for Foreign Affairs has suspended subsidies for global citizenship, whether funds remain for 2011 and 2012, and how he views claims that the development-policy principle linking change abroad and change at home has ended. The secretary confirms the cut from €32m to €27m for 2011, that about €6m will be paid in 2012 on earlier commitments, disagrees that the principle has ended, and defends a renewed approach to building public support for development cooperation.
Due to the need to cut spending, I had to lower the original subsidy ceiling for the period up to the end of 2011 from €32 million to the current €27 million.
Vanwege de noodzaak tot bezuinigen heb ik het oorspronkelijke subsidieplafond voor de periode tot eind 2011 moeten verlagen van € 32 mln naar de huidige € 27 mln.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de positie van pastoralisten in de hongersnood (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

MP Ferrier (CDA) asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs how drought-hit pastoralists in Kenya's arid and semi-arid areas are protected in famine relief and what structural options exist. The state secretary answered that the government shares the concern, outlined Dutch food-security and water priorities for Kenya, and said relief is targeted to local needs with structural measures to follow in multi-year plans.
In the note on food security I will set out my policy in broad lines.
In de notitie voedselzekerheid zal ik mijn beleid in grote lijnen uiteen zetten.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over milities in Rio de Janeiro (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

MPs Ferrier and Çörüz asked the Foreign Minister how militia control in Rio de Janeiro has developed since 2009, how Brazil has responded to the Freixo report and Amnesty's findings, what the Netherlands and EU have done to raise these recommendations, and how the Dutch government views and supports human rights defenders in Brazil. The minister answered that progress is slow, that implementation of the Freixo recommendations proceeds gradually according to local authorities, that the EU raised human rights defender protection at the May 2011 dialogue and will do so again, and that Dutch support for defenders is general in nature through policy, embassy engagement and EU meetings of heads of mission.
The EU has indicated that it will again put the protection of human rights defenders on the agenda at the next dialogue with Brazil.
De EU heeft aangegeven ook in de eerstvolgende dialoog met Brazilië het onderwerp van de bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers weer te zullen agenderen.
Vragen van de leden Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het recent opgelaaide geweld in de Soedanese regio Abyei (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

MPs Ormel and Ferrier asked the foreign minister how the Netherlands views the renewed fighting in Abyei, including whether the Sudanese army's invasion is disproportionate, what role the Netherlands plays in de-escalation, how the African Union is involved, and the scale of humanitarian need. The government condemns the invasion as a violation of the 2005 peace agreement, says it is pressing the EU, UN Security Council and African Union for action, and describes humanitarian funding through the UN Common Humanitarian Fund, with a 6 million EUR contribution being prepared.
The Netherlands condemns the seizure of Abyei by the North Sudanese army and allied militias, and the dissolution of local government by presidential decree.
Nederland veroordeelt de inname van Abyei door het leger van Noord-Soedan en gelieerde milities, en de ontbinding van lokaal bestuur door presidentieel decreet.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier (CDA) en Verhoeven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie over het ODA-budget (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

The MPs ask how the 300 million euro of ODA funds earmarked for the top sectors will be spent and how much remains uncommitted through 2015, and whether civil society organisations can use these funds. The minister answers that the top-team advice is still pending, that funds rise from 200 million in 2012 to about 300 million in 2015 with a large share already committed to business programmes, and that civil society can participate through programmes such as IDH and the PPP fund.
In the business letter the cabinet sends to the House before Prinsjesdag, the allocation of funds for the top sectors will be discussed in more detail.
In de bedrijfslevenbrief die het kabinet voor Prinsjesdag naar de Kamer stuurt zal nader worden ingegaan op de verdeling van de middelen ten behoeve van de topsectoren.

Vragen van de leden Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over doden die zijn gevallen op Papoea als gevolg van ingrijpen door de lokale politie (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about deaths in Papua caused by local police intervention, including whether Indonesia had met calls for independent investigation and how the Netherlands would press for one. The minister said investigations by Indonesian police and a provincial parliament-led visit were ongoing, the embassy was monitoring them, and Dutch initiatives included raising Papua abuses at an EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
I have instructed the Dutch embassy in Jakarta to closely monitor this.
Ik heb de Nederlandse ambassade in Jakarta opdracht gegeven dit op de voet te blijven volgen.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de staatsecretaris en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de positie van vrouwen in de Arabische regio. (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

CDA MPs Ferrier and Ormel asked the foreign minister and state secretary about strengthening women's position in the Arab region, including Clinton's remarks on democratisation and Egypt's constitutional revision. The government answered that women's active participation is essential, cited UN Women-backed Egyptian conferences, and earmarked EUR 2 million for women's participation in the region.
If necessary, I will raise the follow-up to the recommendations with my Egyptian counterpart.
Indien nodig zal ik mijn Egyptische collega aanspreken op de opvolging van de aanbevelingen.
Vragen van de leden Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Nigeria (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

MPs Ormel and Ferrier asked the Foreign Minister about post-election violence in Nigeria, the assessment of the election process and Buhari's reaction, refugee numbers, the religious dimension of the violence and measures against it, and international and African Union initiatives. The minister answered that the violence has largely ended, that observers called the election credible, that Buhari did not call for calm, that 74,000 displaced persons are registered and a government commission was set up to investigate the violence.
President Jonathan has since set up a government commission to investigate what exactly happened and who should be held responsible for this violence.
President Jonathan heeft inmiddels een overheidscommissie ingesteld die moet onderzoeken wat de exacte toedracht was en wie verantwoordelijk moet worden gehouden voor deze gewelddadigheden.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Çörüz (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mishandeling van vrouwen in Irak (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

MPs Ferrier and Çörüz asked the foreign minister about violence against women in Iraq, including Article 41 of the Iraqi penal code, the arrest of youth activists, and reported pressure on the Organisation for Women's Freedom Iraq, which receives Dutch MDG3 Fund support. The minister answered that these issues are raised bilaterally and in the EU, that two detained activists were released while two remained unlocated, and that he was unaware of the raid on the OWFI office but would keep raising civil society and human rights concerns.

The Netherlands will continue to raise with the Iraqi authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU, the importance of an independently operating civil society and improving the human rights situation in general.

Nederland zal de Iraakse autoriteiten zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband blijven aanspreken op het belang van een onafhankelijk opererend maatschappelijk middenveld en het verbeteren van de mensenrechtensituatie in het algemeen.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het behoud van de EU Speciale Vertegenwoordiger voor het Grote Merengebied (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

MPs Ferrier and Ormel asked whether the EU High Representative Ashton intends not to refill the EU Special Representative for the Great Lakes Region, and whether the Netherlands would advocate keeping the post given stability goals and the aid phase-out in Congo. The ministers answered that Ashton has decided not to appoint one for now because the EEAS judges the situation improved, that the Netherlands respects this and generally favours restraint in appointing special representatives, and that EU delegations and staff will take over the tasks.
The Netherlands and the other member states respect the decision of HR Ashton to temporarily not appoint a Special Representative for the Great Lakes Region.
Nederland en de overige lidstaten respecteren het besluit van HV Ashton om voorlopig geen Speciale Vertegenwoordiger voor het Grote Merengebied aan te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, voor Asiel en Immigratie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over kinderen die hier illegaal verblijven en geen mbo-stage kunnen

An MP asks whether undocumented children entitled to education can complete mbo vocational training when they cannot do the required internships, and proposes treating internships as education. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the right to the theoretical part of schooling remains, and will ask mbo institutions to issue school certificates, while referring to the labour minister's answers on the internship question.
Since they cannot obtain a diploma without an internship, I will call on mbo institutions to issue a school certificate for the illegally resident foreigner.
Daar zij zonder stage geen diploma kunnen behalen, zal ik een beroep doen op de mbo-instellingen om een schoolverklaring ten behoeve van de illegaal verblijvende vreemdeling af te geven.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat het Fonds Economische Opbouw Uruzgan zou zijn mislukt (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about reports that the Uruzgan Economic Development Fund (FEOU) failed, covering its results, investment spent, project status, investor confidence, lessons for fragile states, and evaluation plans. The government replies that only three projects were funded (about 3.3 million euro committed), that the fund was not a failure given the difficult context, and that a final evaluation will be shared with the House after completion in late 2012.
Naturally I am willing to share the result of this with the House.
Vanzelfsprekend ben ik bereid het resultaat hiervan met de Kamer worden te delen.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de onderdrukking van de Papoea’s (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

CDA MPs Ferrier and Ormel asked the foreign minister about reported oppression of Papuans, including alleged annexation, mistreatment of human rights, and migration policy effects. The minister replied that Papua has been part of Indonesia since 1969, acknowledged slow autonomy implementation and human rights concerns, and said Netherlands raises the issue in political dialogue and supports local capacity building.
Het inwinnen van betrouwbare informatie is moeilijk.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanhouding van tegenstanders van het Cubaanse regime (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the arrest of Cuban dissidents who wanted to commemorate Zapata Tamayo's death, and how the government and EU responded. The minister called the conduct regrettable, said Nederland has not officially reacted but its embassy contacted activists, and said the EU raises human rights in its dialogue with Cuba, which the arrests may affect.
Nothing has been officially responded to from the Netherlands.
Vanuit Nederland is niet officieel gereageerd.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse zaken over het Biogas project in Afrika (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether Dutch development organisations had hijacked the Biogas for Better Life initiative, why the ministry dropped that foundation over management capacity, and how African participation and capacity would be fostered. The state secretary denied the hijacking claim, explained the ministry chose Hivos and SNV for the 30 million euro subsidy on management-risk grounds, and said African partners and local capacity-building are central to the programme.
In the ministry's judgement the management risks were too great to grant this young and small foundation a subsidy of 30 million euros.
Naar het oordeel van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken waren de beheersmatige risico's te groot om aan deze jonge en kleine stichting een subsidie van 30 miljoen Euro toe te kennen.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de staatsecretaris en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de moord op minister Shanbaz Bhatti (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

MPs Ferrier and Ormel asked about the murder of Pakistani minister Shanbaz Bhatti, Pakistan's blasphemy laws, extending the religious freedom pilot to Pakistan, raising minority rights in dialogue, and consequences for development ties. The government condemned the killing, criticised the blasphemy law, said Pakistan would be added to the religious freedom pilot, and reported Pakistan's removal from the development partner list, stating this was unrelated to the murder.
The intention is to extend the pilot afterwards to ten countries, adding Pakistan to the group of countries.
De intentie bestaat om de pilot daarna uit te breiden met tien landen, en Pakistan aan de groep landen toe te voegen.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het rapport «Development without freedom» van Human Rights Watch (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

MP Ferrier asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the Human Rights Watch report 'Development without freedom' on Ethiopia, including why the Development Assistance Group launched a follow-up study, its timing, donor coordination to prevent politicisation of aid, and risks elsewhere. The State Secretary answered that the follow-up study is in draft stage with results possibly by end 2011, that coordination runs through DAG and EU ambassadors, and that embassies assess partner-country governance annually and can adjust aid accordingly.
I am willing to share the results and conclusions of this study with the House of Representatives.
Ik ben graag bereid de resultaten en de conclusies van dit onderzoek met de Tweede Kamer te delen.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het ontbreken van christelijke feestdagen op een kalender van de Europese Commissie (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs why all Christian holidays were missing from a European Commission school calendar. The State Secretary answered that the omission was an unintended error, that the Commission would issue a rectification with official national holidays, and that he regretted the omission.
To correct this error, the Commission will send a rectification to all schools that received the agenda.
Om deze fout te herstellen zal de Commissie een rectificatie sturen aan alle scholen die de agenda hebben ontvangen.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een kinderpornozaak op een basisschool (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

CDA MPs Ferrier and Van Toorenburg asked the education minister whether privacy rules stopped the prosecutor's office from informing a primary school that its deputy head was a suspect in a child pornography case, and whether privacy should yield to children's interests. The state secretary replied that the Wjsg framework requires weighing a serious public interest against the parties' interests, that the existing framework already allows early information sharing with employers, and that the prosecution service will train prosecutors on how to inform third parties, without committing to a change in law.

Like the chair of the College of Procurators-General, I am of the view that the current legal framework offers sufficient grounds for (early) provision of information to third parties, such as employers of suspects in sensitive positions.

Ik ben evenals de voorzitter van het College van procureurs-generaal van oordeel dat het huidig wettelijk kader voldoende aanknopingspunten biedt voor (vroegtijdige) informatieverstrekking aan derden, zoals werkgevers van verdachten met gevoelige functies.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het rapport «Van vmbo naar havo: tweestrijd over tweesprong?» (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

CDA MPs asked the education minister about an ECBO report finding that vmbo students moving up to havo do worse partly because havo schools bar them from repeating year four, and whether schools' rules and the transition policy should change. The minister said schools set their own repeat and transition rules, called inconsistent treatment of former vmbo pupils objectionable, and declined to change the transition policy, which is left to schools.
The transition policy is entirely up to the school and I am leaving it that way.
Het overgangsbeleid is volledig aan de school en dat laat ik zo.

Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over kinderarbeid bij hazelnootproductie in Turkije. (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asked ministers whether child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting is known, how it will be addressed with Turkey and companies, and how children can be kept in school. The government acknowledged that child labour persists in Turkey, noted limited progress and EU pressure, and pointed to bilateral dialogue, ILO channels and Turkish school-enrolment initiatives without committing to new sanctions.
The cabinet will work to implement the EU Council conclusions on child labour, adopted on 14 June at the Netherlands' initiative.
Het kabinet zal zich inzetten voor de uitvoering van de op 14 juni jl. op Nederlands initiatief tot stand gekomen EU-Raadsconclusies kinderarbeid

Vragen van de leden Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitbuiting van Indiase textielarbeiders door C&A en H&M (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

MPs Ormel and Ferrier (CDA) asked whether Dutch retailers C&A and H&M, which sourced from Indian factories paying workers a fraction of the minimum wage, should be held to account and whether they would cancel such orders. The ministers answered that the companies say they pursue improvements, that the OECD guidelines and corporate social responsibility frame the matter, and that the government will raise human rights and child labour with India through EU channels, without committing to new sanctions.
The OECD guidelines form the framework for the Dutch government regarding the conduct of internationally operating Dutch companies.
De OESO-richtlijnen vormen voor de Nederlandse regering het kader voor het gedrag van internationaal opererende Nederlandse bedrijven.

Vragen van de leden Koopmans en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister voor Wonen Wijken en Integratie en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschappen over te weinig leerlingplekken door de economische crisis

Two CDA MPs asked whether the economic crisis has left too few apprenticeship places for construction trainees and whether the state, as a large client, should require apprenticeship places in its tenders. The minister replied that the construction sector is stabilising, that the government already requires apprenticeship places in Rijksgebouwendienst projects, and that tendering by provinces, municipalities and water boards is their own autonomous matter.
At administrative level, the issue of apprenticeship places will be raised in the bodies suited for it.
Op bestuurlijk niveau zal in de zich daarvoor lenende gremia het onderwerp leerlingplaatsen aan de orde worden gesteld.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Salaris Dales gewoon doorbetaald» (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the salary of the former InHolland board chair Dales would be paid until the end of his contract, and whether such severance constructions are acceptable and occur elsewhere. The state secretary said the contract ended on 1 January 2011 with a one-year severance payment, called such arrangements undesirable, and announced recovery of the excess cost from InHolland's supervisory board.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het rapport «Development without Freedom» (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about a Human Rights Watch report alleging that Ethiopian development aid is used to silence opposition and manipulate elections, and whether Dutch aid is affected. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns and said Dutch aid has adequate safeguards, will not change the aid relationship, and that the issue is being pursued with other donors in the DAG group and the EU.
I see no reason, based on the HRW report, to change the current development cooperation relationship with Ethiopia.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op basis van het HRW-rapport de huidige OS-relatie met Ethiopië te wijzigen.

Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de inzet van de Europese Unie bij VN-viering van 10 jaar resolutie 1325, op 31 oktober 2010 (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010)

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister and State Secretary about the EU's stance on the tenth anniversary of UN Security Council resolution 1325 on women, peace and security, including whether the Netherlands would push for implementation and a joint EU position. The minister replied that Dutch efforts continue through the National Action Plan, support to other countries, and a seminar, and that the Netherlands is pushing for a substantive EU declaration, without committing to new legislation or binding measures.
The Netherlands strongly advocated for a solid joint EU statement during the Security Council open debate on 26 October.
Nederland heeft zich sterk gemaakt voor een gedegen gemeenschappelijke EU verklaring tijdens het Open Debat in de Veiligheidsraad op 26 oktober.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het weigeren van vmbo-t-gediplomeerden bij de havo (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

MP Ferrier asks the education minister why vmbo-t graduates are being refused entry into havo despite the vmbo-t preparing pupils for havo, and whether parents should have a say in such decisions. The minister agrees pupils and parents should know admission criteria, says schools set their own criteria without a duty to publish them, and points to complaint committees and works councils as the remedies for parents and pupils.
Secondary schools have the room to set their own admission requirements for pupils entering higher year groups than the first year, but are not obliged to publish those requirements.
Vo-scholen hebben de ruimte om zelf toelatingseisen te stellen aan leerlingen die instromen in hogere leerjaren dan het eerste jaar, maar zijn niet verplicht om die eisen bekend te maken.
Vragen van de leden Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mogelijk uitstel van het te houden referendum in Zuid-Soedan (ingezonden 29 september 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about the risk of postponing South Sudan's independence referendum, EU preparations for after the CPA expires, pressure on Sudanese authorities over repression of journalists and human rights defenders, and whether the EU observation mission is in place. The minister confirmed support for holding the referendum on schedule, described Dutch and EU diplomatic and financial efforts, and said the EU observation mission will start once a memorandum of understanding is signed.
The EU observation mission will take up its work in Sudan as soon as possible after a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) is signed with the Sudanese authorities.
De EU-waarnemingsmissie zal zo spoedig mogelijk na het sluiten van een Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) met de Soedanese autoriteiten haar werkzaamheden in Soedan oppakken.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen op het volwassenenonderwijs (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Education about reports that schools may refuse adult secondary education (vavo) students and that budget cuts reduce teachers and funding for adult education. The government answered that it knows of no waiting lists, pointed to municipalities' options to spend participation-budget funds on education, and said the current framework offers enough pathways for most pupils.
I am not aware of any waiting lists for vavo.
Over wachtlijsten voor vavo is mij niets bekend.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het handelen van de inburgeringsdocent (ingezonden 30

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about a reported incident in which an integration course teacher allegedly accommodated concerns about sharing a class with gay students, and about how the course and the film 'Naar Nederland' address tolerance and respect. The minister said the incident could not be verified, saw no signs it occurs often, and explained that the exam and course materials cover tolerance toward homosexuality and mutual respect.
It has not proven possible to establish whether the situation described in the Gay Krant actually occurred in this way.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om te achterhalen of de situatie zoals beschreven in de Gay Krant zich zo heeft voorgedaan.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de 10-urennorm voor studenten van buiten de Europese Economische Ruimte (EER) (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

MPs Jadnanansing and Ferrier asked whether the 10-hour weekly work cap for non-EEA students should be relaxed, given that many cannot cover living costs. The government replied it sees no evidence of widespread shortfalls, keeps the 10-hour cap to prevent students becoming labour migrants, and will consider raising it no earlier than 2012.
It must be prevented that working becomes a main activity, whereby study migrants could effectively become labour migrants.
Voorkomen moet worden dat het verrichten van arbeid een hoofdactiviteit wordt waardoor studiemigranten feitelijk arbeidsmigranten zouden kunnen worden.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dood van een zwangere Somalische vrouw in het asielzoekerscentrum van Leersum (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Health whether emergency medical care for asylum seekers is guaranteed after care was transferred to new health centres, following the death of a pregnant Somali woman in an asylum centre, and whether an investigation will be started. The minister answers that access should match care for residents, that the Health Inspectorate is already studying the new system, and that the Inspectorate will also investigate this incident, while declining to comment on the circumstances of death pending results.
The IGZ will also launch an investigation into the present incident.
De IGZ zal ook naar het onderhavige incident een onderzoek instellen.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Justitie over uitspraken tijdens de jaarlijkse parlementaire vergadering van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerking

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether they had noted remarks by a US congressman at the OSCE parliamentary assembly claiming the Netherlands is a major source and destination of human trafficking and a top-six country for sex-trafficked women, and what action would follow. The government replied that the US TiP report classes the Netherlands as primarily origin and destination country without comparing it to others, that the cited ranking reflects CoMensha victim-origin data rather than a world ranking, and that the report gives the Netherlands a top tier ranking while listing the national taskforce and international cooperation measures already taken.
The Netherlands is described as primarily an origin and destination country and to a lesser extent a transit country (p. 248).
Nederland wordt aangeduid als primair een herkomst- en bestemmingsland en in mindere mate een doorvoerland (p. 248).

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mogelijke betrokkenheid van de Zweedse oliemaatschappij Lundin bij mensenrechtenschendingen in Soedan (ingezonden 15 juni

MPs Haverkamp and Ferrier asked the Dutch foreign minister about alleged complicity of Lundin in war crimes in Sudan's Block 5A and whether Lundin, active in the Netherlands, should face consequences. The minister replied that Sweden, Austria and Malaysia must decide on further investigation, that Lundin is only a gas-licence co-holder in the Netherlands, and that Dutch consequences await the Swedish prosecutor's inquiry.
Pending the aforementioned investigation by the Swedish Public Prosecution Service, this is not an issue at this stage.
Hangende het eerdergenoemde onderzoek van het Zweedse Openbaar Ministerie is dit in dit stadium niet aan de orde.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ferrier (beiden CDA), Timmer en Kraneveldt-van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een cluster 3 school

MPs asked whether a school in Losser for children with an IQ of 35 or lower lacks structural care funding after the AWBZ package measures and why it has no education recognition from the municipality. The minister said the school needs municipal agreement, denied a confirmed funding gap, pointed to adjusted care classes and a EUR 10 million subsidy, and promised continued consultation with the health ministry.
It is not known whether there are no or fewer structural funds as a result of the AWBZ 2009 package measure for the care activities at the school.
Het is niet bekend of er geen of minder structurele middelen zijn als gevolg van de pakketmaatregel AWBZ 2009 voor de zorgactiviteiten op de school.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verwerpen van de Indonesische speciale autonomie door de bevolking van Papua (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

MP Ferrier (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about intimidation of demonstrators in Papua after the population rejected Indonesia's special autonomy, and whether the government would press Indonesia on peaceful dialogue, access for media, humanitarian groups and observers. The minister answered that the Netherlands respects Indonesian sovereignty, works on implementing the 2001 special autonomy law and raises the right to peaceful protest and restrictive access policy in bilateral and EU dialogue, while noting some improvement.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation in Papua and raise it in its contacts with the Indonesian authorities.
Nederland zal de situatie in Papoea nauwgezet blijven volgen en bespreken in de contacten met de Indonesische autoriteiten.

Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Justitie over onduidelijkheid rondom regels voor machtiging tot voorlopig verblijf (MVV) voor Surinaamse st
