An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary and the Justice minister why the 10,000 euro guarantee required of non-EU students, including Surinamese students, was still unclear and inconsistently applied across institutions, and whether it is an IND requirement. The government answered that proof of sufficient means is required but a guarantee is only one of several options, that it is not an IND requirement, and promised a letter to institutions in June after a delayed reply.
I will inform the institutions further by letter.
Ik zal de instellingen nader per brief informeren.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het stopzetten van programma's van een christelijke niet-gouvernementele organisatie (ngo) in Afghanistan (ingezonden 8 ju

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about the suspension of Church World Service programmes in Afghanistan over proselytizing allegations, and whether this reflects wider pressure on Christian organisations. The minister confirmed the temporary suspension by Afghan authorities pending an investigation, said the Netherlands will raise concern and will inform parliament of the outcome, and reported no known general trend of pressure.
Of course I will closely follow the progress of the investigation and inform the House of its outcome once it is made public.
Uiteraard zal ik het verloop van het onderzoek nauwlettend volgen en de Kamer na bekendmaking van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek hierover informeren.

Vragen van de leden Schinkelshoek en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over geluidsoverlast door het Kerkgen

MPs Schinkelshoek and Ferrier asked whether a noise dispute over Salvation Army gatherings in Zutphen, a site with religious use since 1856, should weigh in the assessment, and how the government would safeguard religious freedom and engage churches. The minister replied that the matter is for the courts given a pending interim ruling, that the Wet geluidhinder contains no church-specific requirements, and pointed to information on the Activiteitenbesluit, declining to go into the case further.
The cabinet therefore does not go further into the content of the interim ruling.
Het kabinet gaat derhalve niet nader in op de inhoud van de voorlopige uitspraak.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de tender draagvlakactiviteiten op het gebied van internationale samenwerking (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

Ferrier (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about the timing, eligibility criteria and next steps of the new subsidy tender for public-support activities in international cooperation, including whether it follows a prior motion. Minister Verhagen confirmed the tender was published on 31 May, said the criteria are set out in the tender document and incorporate the motion's criteria, and expected a selection by summer with a first subsidy round in autumn.
The criteria named in the Voordewind/Ferrier motion have been incorporated in it.
De criteria die zijn benoemd in de motie Voordewind/Ferrier zijn in hierin verwerkt.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp, Ferrier en Ten Hoopen (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de immer verslechterende situatie in de Indiase deelstaat Manipur (ingezonden 27 mei

CDA MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the deteriorating situation in India's Manipur state, including religious tensions, Dutch economic interests, and the effect on civil society and NGOs. The foreign minister answered that Naga independence demands and an economic blockade cause the unrest, that no Dutch firms or investments are present, and that the Netherlands and EU will raise the matter with Indian authorities if needed.
The Netherlands and the EU are following this process and will, where necessary, raise the situation in contacts with the Indian authorities.
Nederland en de EU volgen dit proces en zullen zonodig de situatie aan de orde stellen in contacten met de Indiase autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Rwanda, Burundi expel Human Rights Watch workers» (ingezonden 26 mei 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether expelling Human Rights Watch staff from Burundi conflicts with human rights benchmarks for budget support, and about the outlook for fair elections. The minister said only one HRW representative's work permit was withdrawn, that Nederland raised the matter with Burundi and would raise it at the UN Human Rights Council, and that the election process was being closely monitored.
The Netherlands has therefore raised this with the Burundian authorities and will bring the matter up at the 14th session of the UN Human Rights Council in June.
Nederland heeft de Burundese autoriteiten hier dan ook op aangesproken en zal de onderhavige kwestie aankaarten in de 14 e zitting van de VN Mensenrechtenraad die in juni plaatsvindt.
Vragen van de leden Biskop en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over materialen voor de herbouw van een school in Haïti (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

CDA MPs Biskop and Ferrier asked the foreign minister about a container of building materials for a Haiti school that was reportedly blocked at the border, and whether Haiti still only needs cash. The minister replied that the container has now reached Port-au-Prince, that Haiti still has great need for emergency aid, and that the Netherlands funds relief through the UN, the Red Cross and SHO rather than the Haitian government.
This container has now nevertheless reached Port-au-Prince.
Deze container heeft Port-au-Prince inmiddels alsnog bereikt.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over betrokkenheid van vrouwen bij wederopbouw van Haïti (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

CDA MPs Ferrier and Haverkamp asked the foreign minister whether the role of women in Haiti's post-earthquake reconstruction, including in the donor conference and the Post-Disaster Needs Assessment, should be strengthened in line with UN Resolution 1325. The minister agreed women should be actively involved, said Dutch partners are pressing for this through the UN and EU, and listed concrete steps such as gender-responsive budgeting and a UNDP/UNFPA panel.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verlies aan geloofwaardigheid van het Kimberley proces inzake diamantenhandel in Zimbabwe (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

CDA MPs Ferrier and Haverkamp asked the foreign minister whether the Kimberley Process has lost credibility over Zimbabwean diamond trade, including whether Zimbabwe should be suspended if it shows no improvement by June 2010. The minister rejected the claim that the process is a sham, agreed that human rights abuses and military involvement are serious, noted an approved Zimbabwean action plan monitored by a KP observer, and said suspension is an ultimate measure to be decided by the EU at the KP meeting.
The Netherlands is represented within the KP by the EU.
Nederland wordt binnen het KP vertegenwoordigd door de EU.

Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vrijheidsbeperking van een Rwandese presidentskandidaat die na 16 jaar in Nederland gewoond te hebben teruggekeerd is naar haar vaderland (i

MP Ferrier asks the Foreign Minister about the detention and conditional release of Rwandan presidential candidate Victoire Ingabire, whether Rwanda's rights record should limit budget support, and whether she holds Dutch nationality. The minister confirms awareness, notes the charges and reporting duty, says the embassy monitors the case, states budget support is sectoral and will be reviewed after the Joint Review, and confirms she is not Dutch.
The embassy in Kigali is closely following this matter and is also in contact with the Rwandan authorities about it.
De ambassade in Kigali volgt deze kwestie op de voet en onderhoudt hierover ook contact met de Rwandese autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de massamoord in Oost-Congo (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

MP Ferrier asks the Foreign Minister about the LRA massacre in eastern Congo, urging faster MONUC investigation and EU technical help, stronger protection of civilians, and linking debt relief to security. The minister confirms the joint MONUC-OHCHR mission and pressure for publication of the interim report, supports the EU envoy's initiative and a MONUC mandate focused on civilian protection, but declines to add protection conditions to the HIPC debt relief process.
The Netherlands is working bilaterally and multilaterally to improve protection of the civilian population in the DRC against the LRA and other armed groups.
Nederland zet zich bilateraal en multilateraal in voor verbetering van de bescherming van de burgerbevolking in de DRC tegen de LRA en andere gewapende groepen.

requests the government to remove this component from the new financing system
verzoekt de regering dit onderdeel uit de nieuwe financieringssystematiek te schrappen
Motie-Langkamp over het in stand houden van gespecialiseerde verpleegkundige kinderdagverblijven
Asks the government to take measures so that specialised nursing day-care centres keep existing and to inform the House before Christmas.
requests the government to take measures so that the specialised nursing day-care centres continue to exist
verzoekt de regering met maatregelen te komen die ertoe leiden dat de gespecialiseerde verpleegkundige kinderdagverblijven blijven bestaan
Motie-Langkamp over het garanderen van de noodzakelijke zorg voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders
Asks the government to guarantee necessary care and support for children, young people and parents despite budget cuts to the AWBZ.
requests the government to guarantee the necessary care and support for children, young people and parents
verzoekt de regering de noodzakelijke zorg en begeleiding voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders te garanderen
Amendement van het lid Langkamp over subsidie voor een 50- tal nazorgtraject voor moeders en diens kind(eren) vanuit Gezin in Balans van Humanitas
Shifts 250 thousand euro within the Youth and Family budget to guarantee subsidy for aftercare trajectories for ex-detainee mothers and their children.
With this amendment the subsidy for about 50 aftercare trajectories for mothers and their children from Gezin in Balans of Humanitas is guaranteed for 2009.
Met dit amendement wordt de subsidie voor een 50-tal nazorgtraject voor moeders en diens kind(eren) vanuit Gezin in Balans van Humanitas voor het jaar 2009 gewaarborgd.
Amendement van het lid Langkamp over het in stand houden van Stabiel, een hulpaanbod vanuit het Leger des Heils
Moves 2.2 million euro within the youth budget from the Zorg en bescherming article to the Gezond opgroeien article to keep the Stabiel parenting support programme running in 2009.
With this amendment the continuation of Stabiel is guaranteed for budget year 2009.
Met dit amendement wordt het voortbestaan van Stabiel gegarandeerd voor het begrotingsjaar 2009.
Motie Leijten en Langkamp over een actieplan buurtsport
Asks the government to develop an action plan for neighbourhood sport aimed at elderly people and the chronically ill.
requests the government to develop an Action Plan Neighbourhood Sport for the elderly and chronically ill
verzoekt de regering een Actieplan Buurtsport te ontwikkelen voor ouderen en chronisch zieken
Motie Leijten en Langkamp over het lottodeel van de basisinfrastructuur van de sport
Asks the government to include the Lotto share of sports base infrastructure in the budget of the Olympic Plan 2028.
requests the government to include the Lotto share of the sports basic infrastructure in the Olympic Plan 2028 in the budget
verzoekt de regering het Lottodeel van de basisinfrastructuur van de sport in het Olympisch Plan 2028 in de begroting op te nemen
qa: Vragen van het lid Langkamp (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat een kinderdagverblijf zonder vergunning toch kinderen opvangt (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

An MP asked the education minister about reports that a childcare centre whose licence had been revoked kept caring for children, and whether fragmented municipal enforcement allowed the operator to reopen elsewhere. The minister answered that the practice was worrying, that Almere had struggled to detect the covert care, that enforcement will improve with the joint inspection register in 2011, and that parents' notification should remain the operator's duty.

With the Joint Inspection Space becoming operational in early 2011, the supervisor will be able, using the operator's Chamber of Commerce or citizen service number, to view inspection and enforcement records held by other municipalities.

Met het operationeel worden van de Gemeenschappelijke Inspectieruimte begin 2011 a.s. zal de toezichthouder op basis van het Kamer van Koophandelnummer of het Burgerservicenummer van de houder wél de gegevens kunnen inzien over inspecties en handhavingsprocedures in andere gemeenten.
Vragen van het lid Langkamp (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat een kinderdagverblijf zonder vergunning toch kinderen opvangt (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

MP Langkamp asks the minister whether a daycare centre that continues caring for children after losing its licence can be sanctioned, and whether the law should be changed to allow sanctions and municipal closure powers. The minister replies that criminal sanctions, administrative fines, and municipal enforcement under the Gemeentewet and Awb already exist, so no legislative change is proposed.
There is the possibility of a criminal sanction as well as an administrative fine.
2679 ) – de mogelijkheid van een strafrechtelijke sanctie zowel als die van de bestuurlijke boete.
Vragen van het lid Langkamp (SP) aan de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin over de bezuinigingen bij Bureau Jeugdzorg Utrecht en Trajectum te Utrecht (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

Ms Langkamp (SP) asked the Minister for Youth and Family whether Bureau Jeugdzorg Utrecht can keep serving the same number of families despite a reported 4.2 million euro cut, about staff dismissals, other bureaus' subsidies, municipal arrangements, supervision and the Deltamethod caseload. The Minister replied that the province denies any cut, that provinces are responsible for funding and oversight, that a 1:15 caseload norm is maintained pending an independent study due before summer 2010, and that the province has tightened supervision.
As I reported to you in answers to earlier parliamentary questions (dated 26 March 2010), there is no cost-cutting measure at bureau jeugdzorg.
Zoals ik u in antwoorden op eerdere kamervragen (d.d. 26 maart 2010) hierover heb gemeld, is er bij bureau jeugdzorg geen sprake van een bezuinigingsmaatregel.

m: Motie van het lid Vlottes over de btw op boodschappen op 0% zetten en dit dekken door het budget voor ontwikkelingshulp te schrappen
Asks the government to set VAT on groceries at 0% and fund it by cutting the development aid budget.
requests the government to set VAT on groceries at 0% and fund this by cutting the development aid budget
verzoekt de regering de btw op boodschappen op 0% te zetten en dit te dekken door het schrappen van het budget voor ontwikkelingshulp
Motie van het lid Vlottes over bij de aanpassing van het belastingstelsel een rechtsvergelijkend onderzoek doen per maatregel
Asks the government, when revising the tax system, to conduct comparative legal research per measure and inform the House.
requests the government, when adjusting the tax system, to conduct comparative legal research per measure and inform the House
verzoekt de regering bij de aanpassing van het belastingstelsel een rechtsvergelijkend onderzoek te doen per maatregel en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie van het lid Vlottes c.s. over in de nog te ontvangen grenseffectenrapportages nadrukkelijk ingaan op een eventuele daling van verkoopvolumes en de oorzaken hiervan
Asks the government to address any decline in national sales volumes and its causes in the forthcoming cross-border effects reports.
requests the government to explicitly address in the forthcoming cross-border effects reports any decline in sales volumes and its causes
verzoekt de regering bij de nog te ontvangen grenseffectenrapportages nadrukkelijk in te gaan op een eventuele daling van verkoopvolumes en de oorzaken hiervan
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vlottes over het bericht 'Honderden Turkse Bulgaren betrokken bij nieuwe toeslagenfraude'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports of new childcare benefit fraud involving 330 Bulgarians, the scope of possible further cases, how this relates to earlier signals, and recovery of funds from a convicted suspect. The State Secretary answered that the exact size of the group is unknown, that the signals are part of ongoing enforcement, and that recovery is handled against the benefit recipients, with difficulties noted for those abroad.
There is no insight into the precise size of this group.
Er is over de precieze omvang van deze groep geen inzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vlottes over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst sluit nieuwe vermogenstaks in 2027 uit’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the new Box 3 wealth tax based on actual returns may not take effect on 1 January 2027, when this was first communicated, and about the revenue loss and possible delays. The government answers that Tax Authority capacity is consumed by the restoration operation after the June 2024 Supreme Court rulings, that a delay could cost about 2 billion euros a year, and that alternative implementation options are still being studied with results expected by year end.
My intention is to inform the House once the study is completed and I can brief it on the dilemmas and pros and cons of the various options.
Mijn voornemen is om uw Kamer te informeren zodra het onderzoek is afgerond en ik uw Kamer kan meenemen in de dilemma’s en voor- en nadelen van de verschillende opties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst, Vlottes, Boon en Markuszower over de 'Stichting Plant een Olijfboom'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Stichting Plant een Olijfboom, whose staff allegedly praised the 7 October attack, questioning its ANBI charity status, missing financial reporting, possible funding of Hamas, and calls for an FIOD investigation or a ban. The minister condemned such statements but said the ANBI public-benefit test is neutral and non-prosecutable conduct is no ground for revocation, that financial publication gaps are usually remedied, that tax secrecy prevents comment on the individual organisation, and that dissolution/banning under Article 2:20 BW is for the Public Prosecution Service and the court.
The Tax Authority is bound by the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act and therefore cannot provide further information about individual institutions.
De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en kan daarom geen nadere informatie verstrekken over individuele instellingen.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het bericht 'Former Armed Forces personnel training foreign militaries could be prosecuted under National Security Act'

An MP (Valstar, VVD) asked the Minister of Defence whether the UK's National Security Act, which may prosecute former armed forces personnel who train foreign militaries, should inspire Dutch measures, and whether a ban on such training would ease prosecution. The minister answered that existing Dutch criminal law already suffices, that UK and Dutch offences are materially comparable, and that the government will tighten exit briefings and conduct rules for departing personnel rather than legislate further.
Limiting these risks as far as possible is of equal great importance in both countries.
Het zo veel als mogelijk beperken van de genoemde risico’s heeft in beide landen hetzelfde grote belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valize, Six Dijkstra en Rajkowski over de kabinetsbrief Gemelde kwetsbaarheid Cisco Webex vergadervoorziening

MPs Valize, Six Dijkstra and Rajkowski asked about a Cisco Webex vulnerability that exposed metadata of government meetings, whether calls could be joined by phone, and which classification levels may be discussed on Webex. The State Secretary answered that Webex may be used up to Departementaal VERTROUWELIJK, that no Dutch cases of misuse are known, and that the Cisco vulnerability disclosure process will be discussed with Cisco.
However, no cases are known in the Netherlands in which unauthorised users attended confidential video meetings of the national government.
Binnen Nederland zijn echter geen gevallen bekend waarbij ongeautoriseerde gebruikers vertrouwelijke videovergaderingen van de Rijksoverheid hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Bamenga over de verontreiniging met PFAS op Vliegbasis Gilze-Rijen en elf andere defensieterreinen

MPs Van der Werf and Bamenga asked ministers about severe PFAS contamination at Gilze-Rijen air base and eleven other defence sites, including whether soil norms are exceeded, why 2019-2020 measurements were not published earlier, what remediation and prevention steps are planned, and whether health risks exist. The government answers that the contamination is known to the competent authority, that a risk-based remediation plan was approved in 2024, that no health risks have been identified so far, and that the Chamber will be kept informed periodically.
Yes, the reporting by Pointer (KRO-NCRV) is known.
Ja, de berichtgeving van Pointer (KRO-NCRV) is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over het artikel 'Optimising Dutch Air and Space Power Policy Recommendations for Defending the Netherlands and Deterring Aggression as Part of NATO'

An MP asked the Defence Minister about an RUSI report on Dutch air and space power, including F-35 readiness, SEAD/DEAD priorities, MQ-9 Reapers, and the handling of the report and its recommendations. The Minister answered that the government agrees more investment is needed, cites the Defence White Paper 2022, defends current F-35 transition and procurement choices, and declines to commission a separate report, though several answers defer to other bodies or pending processes.
For that reason, I currently do not consider it necessary to commission a separate report on these themes.
Daarom acht ik het opstellen van een separaat rapport over deze thema's momenteel niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de berichtgeving dat Defensie een miljoenenorder overweegt bij het Israëlische bedrijf Elbit.

MP Dobbe asked the Defence Minister whether the ministry was considering a multi-million order from Elbit Systems, an Israeli firm whose weapons may be used in occupied territories, and asked about related arms imports and Israel's compliance with international law. The minister confirmed the planned Elbit self-protection system for the Embraer C-390M, said Defence needs Israeli equipment for operational reasons, stated the government has no visibility on how Israel uses its weapons, and listed past Israeli procurements.
The cabinet has no visibility on where Israel deploys these weapons.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op waar Israël deze wapens inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'Poland's capital Warsaw earmarks $30 million for bomb shelters and other security'

An MP asked the ministers whether the government is prepared for worst-case scenarios, how many bomb shelters exist in the Netherlands and whether they are distributed evenly, and whether new shelters are planned. The government answered that it prepares for various threats through crisis plans and coordinates resilience work, but that public shelters have had no role since 1990, the current state of existing shelters is unknown, and no plans for new shelters are known.
The Minister of Defence, on behalf also of the Minister of Justice and Security, has promised a letter to the House on societal resilience in relation to military threats.
De Minister van Defensie heeft, mede namens de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, een Kamerbrief toegezegd over de maatschappelijke weerbaarheid in relatie tot militaire dreiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Gabriëls over het bericht 'Vervuiling Jelsumer Feart komt van vliegbasis Leeuwarden'

Two MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Defence about reports that PFOS contamination in the Jelsumer Feart originates from Leeuwarden air base, including exceedances far above the water-framework norm, spread risks, health risks, remediation timing and other defence sites. The government confirmed the source is on the base, described containment measures, notification of the Public Prosecution Service, a remediation plan to be tendered in Q3 2024 with intent to remediate by year-end, and an ongoing source investigation and programmatic PFAS approach across defence sites.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) has therefore been instructed to remediate the soil at the former fire-training site and the sediment in the watercourses on the air base.
Het RVB heeft daarom opdracht gekregen om de grond op de voormalige oefenbrandweerplek en het baggerslib in de watergangen op de vliegbasis te saneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over samenwerking met de Palestijnse autoriteit

Stoffer (SGP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about Dutch security cooperation with the Palestinian Authority, including the Martyrs Fund, the risk of aid reaching terrorist groups, and the role of Hamas and Fatah in Gaza. The government declined to share the MOU text, said no specific budget is attached, stated Dutch budget support via PEGASE was stopped, and outlined risk-mitigation measures such as vetting under USSC and per-activity risk assessment.
International (policy) agreements are not made public, given international and diplomatic interests.
Internationale (beleids)afspraken worden, met het oog op de internationale en diplomatieke belangen, niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over luchtverdediging voor Oekraïne

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about air defence for Ukraine, including a request to deliver more systems, the implementation of a bilateral security agreement, and whether the Netherlands would take the lead again and supply further Patriot systems. The government answered that it is coordinating a Patriot coalition, provides three launchers and a radar, has funded air defence initiatives, and is still examining the consequences of NATO capability targets for its own readiness and training before deciding on further support.
The Netherlands itself makes three launchers and a radar available; the other essential core components are supplied by an ally.
Nederland stelt zelf drie lanceerinstallaties en een radar beschikbaar, de overige benodigde kerncomponenten worden door een bondgenoot geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de mogelijkheden voor aanvullende leveringen van luchtafweersystemen aan Oekraïne

Boswijk (CDA) asks whether the government will seize the room NATO's Secretary General opened to dip below stockpile floors and deliver more Patriot systems to Ukraine, and whether it will push for more joint NATO exercises. Minister Ollongren answers that the Netherlands has led a coalition assembling a full Patriot system, contributing three launchers and a radar, backs expanding stockpiles and production, and that existing joint exercises already occur without freeing capabilities.
The Netherlands has taken the lead in bringing together an international coalition for the supply of additional Patriot capacity to Ukraine.
Nederland heeft het voortouw genomen om een internationale coalitie bijeen te brengen voor de levering van aanvullende Patriot capaciteit aan Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de kernwapentaak van de F-35

MP Dobbe (SP) asked whether nuclear weapons are in the Netherlands now that the F-35 has taken over the nuclear mission from the F-16, whether the B61-12 is present, and how this fits with NPT disarmament obligations. The government declined to disclose numbers, locations and certification details for security reasons, rejected the claim that the motion Van Dijk on transparency was insufficiently implemented, and argued the B61-12 is not a new weapon.
As your House is aware, on the basis of allied and legally binding agreements no statements can be made about the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe.

Zoals uw Kamer bekend, kunnen op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het rapport 'Optimising Dutch Air and Space Power Policy Recommendations' van het Royal United Services Institute (RUSI)

MP Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister and State Secretary of Defence how the government views the RUSI report's recommendations on Dutch air and space power, including F-35 readiness, noise norms for military airbases, SEAD/DEAD capability, training, and financial implications. The government broadly endorses the need for sustained readiness, stronger SEAD/DEAD capability and growth to at least 2% of GDP, lists measures already taken, and leaves funding decisions to a future cabinet.
The financial implementation of this is a matter for a next cabinet.
Financiële invulling hiervan is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het artikel ‘Russia plotting sabotage across Europe, intelligence agencies warn’

Two CDA MPs asked the government about warnings from European intelligence services of a growing Russian threat of violent sabotage, including to North Sea infrastructure, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The government answered that it shares the concern, points to the North Sea infrastructure protection action plan and the national response framework, and says EU cooperation is being strengthened, while declining to detail the services' current knowledge of targets.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy, the working methods and current knowledge level of the services are not discussed publicly.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding wordt er in het openbaar niet ingegaan op de werkwijze dan wel het actuele kennisniveau van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Tuinman over aanbestedingsbureaucratie bij defensieaankopen

MPs Eerdmans and Tuinman asked the Defence Minister about procurement bureaucracy slowing defence acquisitions and whether Article 346 TFEU exemptions are used as promised. The state secretary acknowledged the need to reduce administrative burden, said exemptions may be invoked more often given the threat picture, declined to give frequency figures for Article 346, and promised to inform parliament before summer.
Defence makes no statements about the frequency of applying Article 346(1)(b) TFEU, because of the protection of the security interest for which that provision is applied.

Defensie doet geen uitspraken over de frequentie van het toepassen van artikel 346 lid 1 sub b VWEU, dit vanwege de bescherming van het veiligheidsbelang waar artikel 346 lid 1 sub b VWEU voor wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Erkens over de levering van Patriot-systemen en raketten aan Oekraïne

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about supplying Patriot systems and missiles to Ukraine, including use of Dutch stocks, production acceleration, interoperability and NASAMS. The minister answered that the government is actively examining options, committed funds for air defence, and is pursuing joint procurement and production efforts, though it gave no firm decisions on several points.
In weighing this, the impact on operational readiness, international obligations and the ability to keep training Dutch military personnel is critically examined.
Hierbij wordt in de afweging kritisch gekeken naar de gevolgen voor de operationele gereedheid, internationale verplichtingen en de mogelijkheid om Nederlandse militairen te blijven trainen.
Antwoorden op vraag van het lid van Houwelingen over documenten van de MIVD inzake de ‘Nord Stream-gasleiding

An MP asked the Minister of Defence for all MIVD documents from 2022 onward mentioning the Nord Stream pipeline. The minister refused, citing the statutory secrecy duties of the Intelligence and Security Services Act 2017, and pointed to the parliamentary intelligence committee (CIVD) as the channel for confidential information.
No, this given the safeguards in the Intelligence and Security Services Act 2017 concerning, among other things, the statutory duty of secrecy regarding the services' methods of working.
Nee, dit gelet op de waarborgen die de Wet op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (Wiv) 2017 bevat over onder meer de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding van de werkwijze van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat er bij een Nederlandse wapeninzet in Afghanistan in 2007 mogelijk zes burgerslachtoffers zijn gevallen

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about possible civilian deaths from a 2007 Dutch fire-support action in Afghanistan, including why they were not disclosed, and about related 2009 incidents and a 2016 Mosul investigation. The minister explained the 2007 incident was omitted from a 2009 registration, outlined what was known, and said the 2009 matter is under prosecutorial review while an internal Mosul investigation is ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het verbeteren van het bedrijfsklimaat in de defensiesector

An MP from JA21 asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Defence about banks and pension funds reluctant to finance the defence industry and about regulation hampering defence producers. The government answered that it is consulting banks, pension funds and industry on financing bottlenecks, will report in June 2024, and is pursuing EU level-playing-field measures and a sectoral defence-industry law.
In June 2024 the House will be informed about the bottlenecks in financing defence-related companies and the measures that could strengthen this financing.
In juni 2024 zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de knelpunten voor financiering van defensie gerelateerde bedrijven en de maatregelen die deze financiering kunnen versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Houwelingen over de dreiging van een nucleaire oorlog tussen Nederland en Rusland

MPs Baudet and Van Houwelingen asked the government about the risk of nuclear war with Russia, including whether troops would be sent to Ukraine, the effects of nuclear weapons, and whether Ukraine could join NATO and the EU. The ministers answered that Russia's invasion is illegal, that Nederland is not at war with Russia, that deterrence is maintained, and that no decision on troop deployment can be anticipated, while several questions were answered jointly or left to later decisions.
The cabinet cannot elaborate further on the nature of the discussions due to confidentiality.
Het kabinet kan in verband met vertrouwelijkheid niet verder op de aard van de besprekingen in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de bilaterale veiligheidsovereenkomst tussen Nederland en Oekraïne

An MP from FVD asked the Dutch government about the bilateral security agreement with Ukraine, including its similarity to other countries' agreements, the lack of parliamentary consultation, Ukraine's obligations, and the Nord Stream sabotage. The minister answered that the agreement follows the G7+ declaration, commits to ten years of support, and that Nord Stream questions are under investigation, with some answers partial and the Nord Stream question left to the investigation.

Since the signing of the G7+ declaration on 12 July 2023, the cabinet has frequently and consistently informed the House about its efforts to conclude a security arrangement for multi-year support to Ukraine.

Het kabinet heeft de Kamer sinds het ondertekenen van de G7+-verklaring van 12 juli 2023 veelvuldig en consequent geïnformeerd over de inzet van het kabinet om een veiligheidsarrangement voor meerjarige steun aan Oekraïne af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Tuinman, Boswijk, Dobbe, Van Oostenbruggen, Nordkamp en Dassen over vrouwen in de krijgsmacht

Seven MPs asked the state secretary about women's advancement, part-time service, childcare, uniforms, sexual misconduct, the frontline role of women and veterans' support in the armed forces. The answers describe incremental measures such as a new part-time leave variant, modular training, a new combat uniform system and a 2023 harassment report count, and state that operational experience is not a formal condition for promotion.
Participation in deployments is not a condition for promotion in rank.
Deelname aan uitzendingen is niet voorwaardelijk om door te groeien in rang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tuinman en Boswijk over het bericht 'Kajsa Ollongren: mooi als VDL Nedcar militaire voertuigen gaat produceren'

MPs Tuinman and Boswijk asked the Defence Minister about reports on converting the VDL Nedcar plant in Born to produce military vehicles, munitions and drones, and about related defence industry, NATO and budget questions. The minister answered that talks with VDL are ongoing but the plant is not currently suited to such production, that licence production and collaboration with industry are being explored, and that choices on force composition will be made by the next cabinet.
The cabinet will inform the House further about progress when that is possible.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang wanneer dat mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Houwelingen over de Kamerbrief betreffende de staat van de oorlog in Europa d.d. 23 februari jl

Two MPs from FVD asked the government to substantiate claims in its letter on the war in Europe, including Russian territorial ambitions, Ukraine's role in peace talks, and whether the 2022 talks failed due to Boris Johnson. The government answered that Russian officials' statements and past conduct support its assessment, that Ukraine decides when conditions for negotiations exist, that the Johnson claim is Russian disinformation, and that NATO enlargement strengthens deterrence.
Questions 3 and 4 follow on from each other, and are therefore answered together.
Vragen 3 en 4 liggen verder in het verlengde van elkaar, en zijn daarom gezamenlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het testverslag 'AcceptatieverslagMinimum Viable Product Defensie Big Data Advanced Analytics Platform'

An MP from FVD asked the Defence Minister about an acceptance test report on the Defence Big Data Advanced Analytics Platform, including who commissioned it, whether it reached the steering group, and whether it could be sent before a debate. The state secretary answered that the report was a limited snapshot shared with the steering group via integrated results on 14 February 2022, that the project was paused and re-scoped, and that the report was sent with names and operational details redacted.
In the test report, the names of defence employees and information related to operational deployment have been redacted for confidentiality.
In het testverslag zijn de namen van defensiemedewerkers en informatie gerelateerd aan operationele inzet gelakt in verband met vertrouwelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de kosten van afschalen van de steun aan Oekraïne

An MP asked the ministers whether the financial costs of withdrawing support from Ukraine, and the costs of a Russian victory, have been mapped, and whether the cabinet will communicate more actively about these risks. The ministers answered that support continues, that consequences are broader than financial, that scenario analyses are discussed with research institutes without being shared publicly, and that the cabinet already communicates about these risks.
For security reasons, the cabinet cannot publicly go into the details of these scenarios.
Het kabinet kan omwille van de veiligheid niet publiekelijk ingaan op details van deze scenario's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de inzet van Zr. Ms. Holland bij de hulpverlening aan de Gazastrook

An MP asks why the Netherlands is not acting on Israeli foreign minister Cohen's stated support for a maritime humanitarian corridor to Gaza, and why it does not itself contact Israel about deploying Zr. Ms. Holland. The government answers that full Israeli cooperation is not yet present, that land access is the priority, and that the ship will return to the Netherlands at the end of January while maritime options remain under review.
For now, this has not sufficiently crystallised in the international context.
Vooralsnog heeft zich dit in internationaal verband onvoldoende uitgekristalliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de dreigende sluiting vanhet Walaardt Sacré Kamp in Huis ter Heide

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of Defence why the Walaardt Sacré Kamp refugee reception site in Huis ter Heide is being closed despite a shortage of reception places. The government answered that Defence's support was always temporary, that a parliamentary motion led to a gradual wind-down agreed for July 2024 with the municipality, and that most residents now have refugee status and are awaiting housing.
With this, I am honouring your motion.
Hiermee doe ik uw motie gestand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Veldkamp over de Turkse militaire aanvallen in Syrië en Irak

MPs Kahraman and Veldkamp asked the Dutch ministers about Turkish air and drone strikes in Syria and Iraq in late December 2023, including civilian casualties, damage to civilian infrastructure, consistency with international law, NATO coordination, asylum effects and protection of minorities. The government acknowledged Turkey's security concerns and stressed proportionality and avoiding civilian harm, but said it could not independently verify infrastructure damage, declined to assess Turkish compliance with humanitarian law as too complex, and gave evasive answers on asylum impact.
The cabinet has not been able to independently verify whether critical civilian infrastructure was hit in the drone and air strikes.
Het kabinet heeft niet eigenstandig kunnen verifiëren of bij de drone- en luchtaanvallen kritieke civiele infrastructuur is getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over de uitspraken van de Duitse minister van Defensie

D66 MPs Paternotte and Podt asked the Defence Minister about German Defence Minister Pistorius's warnings of possible military confrontation with Russia and related Dutch scenario planning, public communication, the NATO Baltic response, and continued support for Ukraine. The minister confirmed shared concern about Russia, said scenario planning occurs within NATO and nationally but details will not be published for security reasons, and affirmed continued military support to Ukraine.
For security reasons, the details of the scenarios are not communicated publicly.
Omwille van de veiligheid wordt in het openbaar niet over de details van scenario's gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Tuinman en Diederik van Dijk over de mogelijke oprichting van een eigen tankbataljon

MPs Boswijk, Tuinman and Diederik van Dijk asked the government about reviving a national tank battalion, its cost, its links with Germany and the timing of a Leopard 2A8 procurement decision. The government says a tank battalion is not funded and that the decision on it is left to the next cabinet, while giving substantive answers on cost structure, the German cooperation and technology, and withholding only the commercially confidential cost breakdown, which it supplies in a confidential annex.
This cost specification contains commercially confidential elements.
Deze kostenspecificatie bevat commercieel vertrouwelijke elementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel ‘Extra munitie voor Oekraïne vergt enorme investeringen’

An MP asked the Defence ministers how Europe can jointly procure and expand production of ammunition and defence materiel, including tax incentives, pension and bank financing, export treaties and drones. The government answered in general terms, citing joint procurement initiatives, planned consultations and future letters to parliament, without new binding commitments on the scrutiny of the executive.
We will inform your House as soon as possible, by means of a DMP letter, about how this will be implemented and the associated consequences.
Wij zullen uw Kamer door middel van een DMP-brief zo spoedig mogelijk informeren over de invulling hiervan en de daarbij behorende consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pool en Markuszower over het nieuws dat het demissionaire kabinet onderzoekt of er asielzoekers kunnen worden opgevangen op locaties van Defensie

PVV MPs asked whether the caretaker cabinet's plans to house asylum seekers on Defence sites should be abandoned, citing security risks, incidents and the military's primary purpose. The Defence Minister answered that such requests are weighed case by case for humanitarian reasons and legal feasibility, that security measures are added after consent, and that incidents are recorded by COA.
For the number of reported incidents, I refer you to the 'COA incident registration per location' on www.coa.nl.
Voor het aantal gemelde incidenten verwijs ik u naar de «COA incidentenregistratie per locatie» op www.coa.nl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tuinman over de zorgen van Commandant der Strijdkrachten Onno Eichelsheim over de capaciteit van de Defensieindustrie

An MP from BBB asked the Defence Minister about the Chief of Defence's concerns over defence industry capacity, munitions production timelines, unmanned systems units, MQ-9 drones and the Defensievisie 2035. The Minister answered that existing European framework contracts can meet munitions needs within four years, that unmanned systems will be integrated into existing units rather than separate ones, and that the 2035 vision remains valid in analysis but is being adapted.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over kernwapenoefeningen op luchtmachtbasis Volkel

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked whether the 312 squadron at Volkel takes part in NATO nuclear sharing, whether it has trained on the B61-12 bomb since 2021, and whether the F-16 is planned to carry it, and about the timing of F-35 transition and bomb deliveries. The ministers confirmed Nederland's NATO nuclear task at Volkel but declined to give details on training, transition timing, or weapons numbers and locations, citing security and alliance arrangements.
For security reasons, no statements can be made about details relating to the Netherlands' nuclear weapons task.
Om veiligheidsredenen kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over details die verband houden met de kernwapentaak van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pool over het nieuws dat Nederlandse koopvaardijschepen worden bedreigd op de Rode Zee

The MP asks whether Dutch merchant ships have been attacked by Houthi forces in the Red Sea and whether military escorts will be provided after shipping industry requests. The Minister answers that no Dutch-flagged ships have been specifically targeted, that Dutch support continues through existing missions and a staff officer for US-led operation Prosperity Guardian, and that the government is studying a further contribution.
The cabinet is closely monitoring the situation in the Red Sea.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie rondom de Rode Zee nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de betrokkenheid van een AIVD’er bij het saboteren van het Iraanse kernwapenprogramma

MP Sneller asked the government whether the AIVD was involved in a 2007 sabotage operation against Iran's nuclear programme, who approved it, whether parliament's intelligence committee was informed, and whether the CTIVD should investigate. The minister declined to answer on the specific operation citing the statutory duty of secrecy, stated that the same rules apply abroad as at home, and said the CTIVD decides itself whether to investigate.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy regarding the methods of the services, I cannot respond substantively to the alleged involvement of the Netherlands.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding van de werkwijze van de diensten, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voortgang van het dienjaar

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the rollout of the one-year military service (dienjaar), including target numbers, selection, funding and lessons from Scandinavia. The government answered that the scale-up is on schedule, that the aim is to raise military staffing levels, and that it is exploring an enquiry for 17-year-olds and reviewing selection and training capacity.
The one-year service must be seen as a meaningful and valuable way to spend, for example, a gap year.
Het dienjaar moet gezien worden als een zinvolle en waardevolle invulling van bijvoorbeeld een tussenjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Van Oostenbruggen over de Maatschappelijke Diensttijd

Two MPs asked the Defence State Secretary about the Dutch national service year (Dienjaar Defensie), including whether 2,000 to 3,000 volunteers per year are needed and whether the government will fund that capacity. The State Secretary answered that scaling up will be gradual to about 1,000 participants in 2025, that current measures are insufficient, and that a mandatory questionnaire for 17-year-olds is being explored.
Defence will need to take additional measures to improve personnel readiness.
Defensie zal aanvullende maatregelen moeten nemen om de personele gereedheid te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Graus over de overname van Delfts chipbedrijf NOWI door Nexperia

PVV MPs De Roon and Graus asked whether the Dutch government would investigate Nexperia's takeover of chip firm NOWI, citing claims that IoT chips could be used for sabotage against countries. The minister answered that NOWI's products are not dual-use or military goods, so the transaction falls outside the retroactive scope of the investment screening law, and that Defence applies security measures in procurement generally.
NOWI's products cannot be classified as dual-use products or military goods.
De producten van Nowi zijn niet aan te merken als producten voor tweeërlei gebruik of militaire goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gang van zaken rond de Red Card Holder ten tijde van het bombardement op Hawija

MP Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about the Red Card Holder's role in the 2015 Hawija bombing, including whether the commander in Jordan held a dual role and whether the court-submitted documents would be sent to parliament. The minister explained the RCH's function and the 2020 tightening of its working method, but declined to comment on the dual-role documents because the case is before the court.
Since this case is currently before the court, I cannot make any statements on this at this time.
Aangezien deze zaak momenteel onder de rechter is kan ik hier op dit moment geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het toenemende aantal explosies, welke meestal drugsgerelateerd zijn

Van Haga asked the Justice and Defence ministers about the rising number of explosions, mostly drug-related, including how many occurred in 2023, what the government will do to stop them, whether the underworld controls some neighbourhoods, and whether the army should patrol high-risk areas given police shortages. The Minister reports an increase in incidents, gives a 2023 overview, describes prevention and international efforts, denies that authorities have lost control, and says military patrols are not currently needed.
On the basis of these figures it is not possible to establish a direct link between these explosions and drug or gang wars.
Het is op basis van deze cijfers niet mogelijk om een direct verband te leggen tussen deze explosies en drugs- of bendeoorlogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hammelburg, Piri, Van der Lee en Dassen  over ‘De Russische oorlog tegen Oekraïne is eenpraktijkexamen voor Europa – en de tijd begint te dringen’

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and Volt asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government sees risks to US military aid to Ukraine from congressional gridlock and a possible 2024 US administration cutting support, and whether Europe can cover any shortfall. The government answered that US, European and international support remains essential, that a new House speaker has been appointed, that Europe must take more responsibility, and that it will continue support in consultation with allies while F-16 transfer and munitions decisions depend on training, infrastructure, US export approval and EU criteria.
The cabinet will continue to support Ukraine for as long as necessary.
Het kabinet blijft Oekraïne steunen zolang als dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Drost over de visumverlening aan en bezoek van Taliban-vertegenwoordiger Abdul Bari Omar aan Nederland

MPs Ceder and Drost asked how a Taliban representative received a Dutch visa to attend a WHO forum in the Netherlands, who invited him, and whether the minister would share the visa files and apologise to relatives of fallen Dutch soldiers. The minister answered that the WHO invited him, that the visa was assessed under the EU Visa Code and he was not on sanctions lists, that visa files cannot be shared, and that the government will review the visa process and invitation policy, while acknowledging he should not have received a visa.
No information is shared from individual visa application files.
Van individuele visumaanvraagdossiers wordt geen informatie gedeeld.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen het lid Jasper van Dijk overintegriteitsproblemen bij de Defensie Bewaking en Beveiligingsorganisatie (DBBO)

An MP asked whether the Defence minister accepts that the investigation into an integrity complaint at DBBO-Zuid took too long and whether independent handling of such complaints is needed. The state secretary acknowledged the delay of over a year, said measures were taken to shorten it, but rejected an independent complaints body, arguing Defence must handle complaints itself.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de oproep van de Israëlische regering om 300.000 militaire reservisten deelte laten nemen aan de lopende vijandelijkheden, met name in deGazastrook

An MP asked the government whether Israel's call-up of 300,000 reservists for fighting in Gaza also reaches Dutch citizens, whether this constitutes prohibited recruitment, and about Dutch citizens in Israel and settlements. The government answered that it has no data on Dutch citizens serving in the IDF, that calling up reservists is not recruitment under Article 205 of the Criminal Code, and condemned settler violence while calling on Israel to prevent it.
The cabinet does not know how many Dutch nationals are currently active in the Israeli army, nor how many have recently been called up or travelled there.
Het is het kabinet niet bekend hoeveel Nederlanders momenteel actief zijn in het Israëlische leger noch hoeveel recentelijk zijn opgeroepen of afgereisd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Oekraïne

An MP asked the Defence Minister about remarks at the Warsaw Security Forum describing support for Ukraine as a very cheap way to keep Russia from threatening NATO, and about the phrase 'they are fighting this war, we are not fighting it'. The minister confirmed the statements, explained that Ukraine's war is vital for European security and that the Dutch contribution is modest relative to Ukraine's sacrifices, and identified 'they' as the Ukrainian armed forces and 'we' as Dutch military personnel.
The Netherlands and other allies are not a party to this war.
Nederland en andere bondgenoten zijn geen partij in deze oorlog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het artikel 'Russische familie? Dan wordt een baan bij defensie heel lastig'

MP Krul (CDA) asked the Defence Minister whether security clearances (VGB) were refused or withdrawn for Defence staff because of Russian family ties, and whether this is consistent with earlier answers and external risk assessments. The minister answered that no specific policy targets staff with Russian ties, that each clearance is case-by-case under the Security Screening Act, declined to comment on individual cases, and rejected compensation or review, pointing to the objection and appeal procedure.
I cannot make any statements about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het sturen van clustermunitie door de VS naar Oekraïne

Futselaar (SP) asked the Defence Minister whether the US consulted the Netherlands on supplying cluster munitions to Ukraine, whether restrictions apply, and whether Dutch-supplied PzH 2000 howitzers may fire them. The government answered that the Netherlands was informed but not asked to consent, that the US and Ukraine agreed use limits, that the munitions can be fired from the PzH 2000, and that the Netherlands remains bound by the Cluster Munitions Convention.
The Netherlands was not asked to consent to this supply of cluster munitions and is also not competent to do so.
Nederland is niet gevraagd in te stemmen met deze levering van clustermunitie en is hiertoe ook niet bevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Mutluer over de onterechte verdenking van aanwezigheid bij een klimaatprotest op luchthaven Schiphol

MPs Ellemeet and Mutluer asked how the Public Prosecution Service and Marechaussee identified about 400 climate protesters detained at Schiphol in November 2022, after some of the 176 warning letters went to people who were not present, and whether this was careful conduct. The minister explains that photos were matched using social media, open sources and a facial recognition program under art. 55c Sv, that eight people received apology letters, and that an internal review is ongoing with commitments to remove wrongly processed data and learn lessons.
In a number of cases it later turned out that the identification was incorrect.
Bij een aantal personen bleek achteraf sprake te zijn van een onjuiste identificatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Valstar over het rapport 'Stormbreak: Fighting through Russian defences in Ukraine’s 2023 offensive'

MPs Brekelmans and Valstar asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about the RUSI report 'Stormbreak' on Ukraine's 2023 offensive, including whether NATO/EU safety rules limit realistic training, whether training is too focused on individual tactics, and whether brigade staff training is deficient. The Minister largely rejected the report's analysis, saying training is adapted to Ukraine's needs within safety requirements and that NATO doctrine is taught where useful, while committing only to continue existing coordination efforts.
I do not recognise this picture.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Fritsma over de Nederlandse inzet bij Operation Inherent Resolve in Irak

PVV MPs De Roon and Fritsma asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the Dutch contribution to Operation Inherent Resolve in Iraq, citing a US inspector general report on limited progress in training Iraqi and Kurdish forces, and whether Dutch advisers should be withdrawn. The ministers answered that progress is incremental and security sector reform is slow, that Iraqi authorities still need the international presence, and that Dutch troops should not be withdrawn.
The cabinet considers a more stable and secure Iraq to be of undiminished strategic importance to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet acht een stabieler en veiliger Irak van onverminderd strategisch belang voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de inzet van de door Nederland geleverde F-16 gevechtsvliegtuigen

An FvD MP asked whether the Netherlands, like Denmark, restricts how Ukraine may use the F-16s it supplies, including whether attacks on Russian territory are allowed. The minister answered that delivery depends on training, infrastructure, coalition coordination and US approval, that Ukraine must respect international humanitarian law and sign end-user declarations limiting use to self-defence, and that Parliament will be informed later about the timeline.
Your House will be informed in due course about the envisaged delivery timeline.
Uw Kamer wordt op termijn nader geïnformeerd over het beoogde tijdpad van levering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Piri en Van der Lee over de levering van F-16’s aan Oekraïne

Three MPs asked the government about the timeline, conditions, pilot training and number of F-16 aircraft to be delivered to Ukraine. The Minister of Defence answered that delivery depends on completed training, infrastructure, coalition coordination and US approval, that the Netherlands expects to make 12 to 18 aircraft available for a training centre in Romania, and that the exact numbers are not yet fixed.
Your House will be informed in due course about the envisaged delivery timeline.
Uw Kamer wordt op termijn nader geïnformeerd over het beoogde tijdpad van levering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Fritsma over de gebrekkige digitalisering van de Duitse landmacht en de gevolgen daarvan voor de samenwerking met Nederland

PVV MPs De Roon and Fritsma asked the Defence Minister about digital interoperability problems in the German army, whether Dutch capabilities must be downgraded to cooperate, and whether Germany is being pressed on its NATO spending pledges. The minister denied any downgrading, said modernisation programmes are ongoing on both sides, and stressed that cooperation strengthens the Dutch armed forces.
No, the development and operation of the Dutch army is not hindered by the organisation of the German army.
Nee, de ontwikkeling en het opereren van de Nederlandse landmacht wordt niet gehinderd door de inrichting van de Duitse landmacht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk, Boswijk, Ceder, Belhaj, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Sylvana Simons, Dassen en Christine Teunissen over de evacuatie van lokale oud-medewerkers van de Nederlands

MPs from many parties asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the evacuation and resettlement of local former Afghan Security Guards and other local staff, including whether guards were excluded and why EUPOL staff were refused. The government answered that individual requests are assessed under the 2014 interpreter arrangement and special scheme, that criteria were not tightened, and that the resettlement project was folded into the ministries' standing organisations while the remaining group of about 100 people is still being pursued.
Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Valstar over het artikel ''You don’t survive that': Ukraine sappers dice with death to clear Russian mines'

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Ukrainian demining needs, Dutch deliveries of mine-clearance systems, and funding for cheap local demining innovation. The government answered that it supplies demining capabilities in line with Ukraine's requests, supports local production and humanitarian demining, and that EU instruments are not open to Ukrainian participation.
The cabinet gives as much as possible effect to Ukrainian requests for the delivery of (additional) mine-clearing systems, in line with the Brekelmans and Sjoerdsma motion.
Het kabinet geeft zo veel mogelijk gehoor aan de Oekraïense verzoeken tot de levering van (aanvullende) mijnruimsystemen, in lijn met motie Brekelmans en Sjoerdsma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over deelname van Nederlandse militairen aan een internationaal militair judotoernooi

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch military personnel competed alongside Russian personnel at an international military judo tournament, whether permission was given, whether the Netherlands sought a boycott, and whether rules for such events will change. The minister confirmed participation and that no permission was sought from the Commander or minister, said the Netherlands did not push for a boycott, and committed to revising guidelines and to examine suspension or boycott options within CISM.
Following this case, Defence will adjust the guidelines for participation in military sporting events.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus zal Defensie de richtlijnen voor deelname aan militaire sportevenementen aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Het leed in Hawija erkennen en verzachten is mislukt'

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked the Defence Minister about reports that Dutch-funded reconstruction in Hawija failed to directly compensate bombing victims, including questions on individual compensation, IOM and UNDP spending, alleged corruption, community involvement and a possible IOB evaluation. The Minister defended the 2020 decision for collective voluntary compensation, reported project outcomes, said there is no evidence of corruption in the final reports, declined an IOB study for now, and noted a possible virtual visit to Hawija.
Defence is in discussion with IOM about whether and how the financial accountability can be shared with your House.
Defensie is in gesprek met IOM of en hoe de financiële verantwoording met uw Kamer kan worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de ontwikkelingen met de schadevergoeding aan de bevolking van Hawija

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether the 2015 Hawija bombing compensation had failed, why no individual compensation was paid, whether agricultural projects were largely unrealised, and for full financial accountability from UNDP and IOM. The minister defended the collective community projects, reported six agricultural projects with more industrial repairs instead, promised a further UNDP financial report and talks with IOM, and declined individual compensation.
Defence is in discussion with IOM on whether and how the financial accountability can be shared with your House.
Defensie is in gesprek met IOM of en hoe de financiële verantwoording met uw Kamer kan worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Krul en Boswijk over de beveiliging van luchthaven Schiphol

Three CDA MPs asked ministers how Schiphol's access controls fail when former staff keep passes, uniforms and radios, and who is responsible for fixing this. The government calls the situation unacceptable, says Royal Schiphol Group and employers hold responsibility, and lists audits, sanctions and an automatic alarm as steps taken.
Royal Schiphol Group further intensifies supervision of correct implementation by carrying out random audits of employers.
Royal Schiphol Group intensiveert verder het toezicht op de correcte uitvoering door steekproefsgewijs audits uit te voeren op werkgevers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Hoe onderzoek naar nazi-uitingen binnen het leger werd gesaboteerd'

An MP from the PvdA asked the Defence Minister, after a NRC report, why an investigation into Nazi expressions within the armed forces was allegedly sabotaged, why a whistleblower was intimidated and why the COID handled reports in a non-independent way, plus whether an independent investigation will be held. The state secretary answered that such expressions are unacceptable, described existing screening and integrity measures, rejected the claim of systematic extremism and of a flawed investigation, and declined a new independent investigation while expressing regret over one withdrawn report and promising tighter handling of investigation data.
At this moment I have no reason to doubt the investigation and the conclusions attached to it.
Ik heb op dit moment geen reden om aan het onderzoek – en de daaraan verbonden conclusies – te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over mogelijke sabotage van onderzoek naar nazi-uitingen in de krijgsmacht
