MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het toekennen van het recht om het predicaat ‘Koninklijk’ te voeren aan ondernemingen

MP Simons asked whether royal predicate ('Koninklijk') status can be withdrawn from companies that no longer meet the conditions or have harmed their reputation, citing examples of fraud, corruption and environmental damage, and whether a formal appeal procedure exists. The Minister of Economic Affairs answered that the predicate can be revoked via a careful process involving the mayor, the commissioner of the King and ministry advice, that individual cases cannot be discussed, and that no separate appeal procedure is planned.
I cannot go into individual companies.
Op individuele bedrijven kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de bescherming van het koraal tegen de zandstorting van het Chogogo Dive and Beach Resort op Bonaire

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked ministers about a sand dumping project by Chogogo resort on Bonaire that allegedly lacked a permit and damaged coral, including a verbal tolerance decision and an unpaid penalty. The government answered that a natural permit was belatedly granted in January 2022 with conditions, that the island authority is responsible for enforcement and collecting the penalty, and that enforcement programmes will be strengthened, though impacts on coral are still unknown.
The public body is responsible for this.
Het openbaar lichaam is hiervoor verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het gebruik van algoritmes door decentrale overheden

An MP asks the Minister of Interior how algorithms used by local authorities must comply with rules, whether the Rotterdam welfare-fraud algorithm complies, whether similar tools are used elsewhere, who supplies them, how proportionality is tested, and about filming of benefit interviews, notification of fraud investigations, and discrimination criteria. The minister answers that the government is bound by the GDPR and equality law, that assessing Rotterdam's compliance is for the municipality, the DPA and courts, that an algorithm register and a mandatory register are being explored, and that filming is acceptable only in exceptional cases.
It is not for me to judge that.
Het is echter niet aan mij om daarover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het artikel dat de IVBN oproept de nieuwe wet Opkoopbescherming aan te passen

An MP asked the Minister about an IVBN call to amend the new Opkoopbescherming law, which he said blocks new rental housing construction in Amsterdam, and whether Amsterdam's implementation is responsible. The minister answered that the law is aimed at existing housing, that the wording does not clearly exclude new builds so he will consider clarifying it, and that municipalities can avoid the conflict, while promising to monitor implementation and evaluate.
I will consider whether it is necessary to remove this ambiguity by clarifying in the law that the purchase protection applies only to existing homes.
Ik ga bezien of het nodig is om deze onduidelijkheid weg te nemen door in de wet te verduidelijken dat de opkoopbescherming enkel ziet op bestaande woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aanbevelingen uit het rapport 'Gender Election Observation Mission The Netherlands 2021' van Gender Concerns International

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would act on recommendations from a Gender Concerns International election observation report, including gender quotas for candidate lists and media monitoring. The Minister said the report was forwarded to relevant departments, that responsibility for most proposals lies with those departments or with political parties, and declined to endorse mandatory gender parity or other systemic changes.
Forwarding such information, where it is relevant to a policy area under another department, is among the responsibilities I have as Minister of the Interior for the electoral process.

Het doorgeleiden daarvan, mits deze informatie relevant is voor een beleidsterrein dat onder een ander departement valt, behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheden die ik als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties heb voor het verkiezingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Verhuren koophuis frustreert starters'

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked about the rise of keep-to-let and buy-to-let housing, its effects on starters, and whether mortgage conditions are being breached. The minister said keep-to-let is stable at about 4% of transactions, outlined measures such as the transfer tax differentiation and a box 3 reform, and declined further research on unreported rental, citing lender estimates below 10%.
I therefore see no reason to commission additional research.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor het laten uitvoeren van aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Strolenberg over het artikel 'Een rol bij de lijkschouw'

MPs Van den Hil and Strolenberg asked whether task reallocation could let PAs and nurse specialists perform death inspections, easing shortages of elderly-care physicians and municipal inspectors. The minister replies that a careful study starting spring 2022 will assess whether such task shifting adds value, with results shared with the House around summer, and that temporary emergency solutions for municipal inspections are being discussed.
In spring 2022 the study will start, and around the summer the results will be shared with your House.
Voorjaar 2022 wordt gestart met het onderzoek en rond de zomer zullen de resultaten hiervan met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat bewoners moeten wijken voor statushouders

An MP asked the Minister about reports that current anti-squat residents of Krabbenbossen in Zundert must make way for refugee-status holders, and about information provided to them, the number of pilot projects, and whether current residents will be rehoused. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible, that residents were informed (though not all in time), that the project is for 95 units for refugee-status holders, and declined to intervene in local responsibilities.
I do not know the local situation and I do not want to intrude on the responsibilities of the municipalities.
Ik ken de lokale situatie niet en ik wil niet in de verantwoordelijkheden van de gemeenten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Mali expels Paris envoy over 'hostile and outrageous' French comments'

VVD MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about Mali's expulsion of France's envoy, the junta's postponed elections, and the effects on Dutch participation in MINUSMA and Takuba. The ministers answered that the junta is illegitimate, that Takuba will be withdrawn, and that the impact on Dutch missions and EU coordination is under close review.
The cabinet is also holding intensive consultations with partners in the UN and EU on the possible consequences of the deteriorating conditions in Mali for the UN mission MINUSMA.
Het kabinet voert daarnaast intensief overleg met partners in de VN en de EU over de mogelijke gevolgen van de verslechterende omstandigheden in Mali voor de VN-missie MINUSMA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over de situatie in Mali

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the situation in Mali, including the future of MINUSMA, the Takuba task force, French withdrawal, Russian paramilitaries, and Dutch evacuation planning. The government answered that it is very concerned, that the Dutch MINUSMA contribution is not under review for now, that Takuba is being withdrawn, and that it is monitoring developments and maintaining diplomatic contacts.
Suspending the Dutch civilian and military contribution to the UN mission MINUSMA is currently not on the table.
Het stopzetten van de Nederlandse civiele en militaire bijdrage aan de VN-missie MINUSMA is momenteel niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over waarom Nederland het Dataprotectieverdrag nog niet geratificeerd heeft

An MP asked why the Netherlands has not yet ratified the modernised data protection convention (Convention 108+), whether the caretaker cabinet plans to ratify it and when, and how the minister views the TIB and CTIVD call for prompt ratification. The minister replied that the approval procedure was paused pending an external analysis of recent ECtHR case law on bulk interception, which is now ready and will be shared, and that the procedure will now be resumed in line with the TIB and CTIVD wish.
The approval procedure will now be resumed, in line with the wish of the TIB and the CTIVD.
De goedkeuringsprocedure zal nu, in lijn met de wens van de TIB en de CTIVD, hervat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Erkens over het bericht 'Facebook vs. Zeewolde: hoe lokale politici moeten beslissen over een landelijke kwestie'

MPs Rajkowski and Erkens asked about the planned large Meta data centre in Zeewolde, its impact on grid capacity, energy use, heat reuse, national coordination and the conditions attached to the sale of state land. The minister answered that national spatial policy prefers hyperscale centres at the country's edges, set conditions for the land sale, and committed to tighten national steering and admission criteria in a joint letter this spring.
In line with the coalition agreement, this cabinet will tighten national steering and the admission criteria for (hyperscale) data centres.
In lijn met het coalitieakkoord zal dit kabinet de landelijke regie en de toelatingscriteria ten aanzien van (hyperscale) datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Het Rijk regelde onder druk van Facebook voorrang op het stroomnet'

MP Leijten (SP) asked ministers whether the government arranged priority grid access for Facebook/Meta's Zeewolde data centre, questioned the secrecy and possible blackmail by the company, and asked for timelines of contacts and a pause on the decision. The minister denies any priority was granted, says the connection follows the legal framework, and gives a detailed contact timeline while declining to disclose tax rulings and refusing to pause the spatial process.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the tax position of individual taxpayers due to the statutory tax confidentiality obligation (Article 67 AWR).
Het kabinet kan geen mededelingen doen over de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht (artikel 67 AWR).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Een jaar dakloos en dertig vakantieparken achter de rug en nu is het bijna kerst'

An SP MP asks how a family was made homeless after a housing corporation ended its tenancy over nuisance, and whether municipalities, corporations and the state have duties to prevent such eviction, including blacklists and rent allowance. The minister answers that corporations have no formal duty to offer alternatives but should consider them, that municipalities are responsible for housing policy and do not discuss individual cases, that the national plan 'Een thuis voor iedereen' will be sent to parliament, and that the blacklist use is governed by a model protocol with data-protection safeguards.

As I indicated in answers 2 and 3, it is part of the housing corporation's task to look at alternative housing when ending a tenancy agreement or to refer tenants to a place where they can go, but there is no formal duty for this.

Zoals ik in de beantwoording op vraag 2 en 3 aangaf past het bij de taak van de woningcorporatie om voor het beëindigen van de huurovereenkomst met huurders te kijken naar alternatieve woonruimte of hen te verwijzen naar een plek waar zij daar voor terecht kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de opzegging van de overeenkomsten van de standplaatsen op het Vakantiepark Meerzicht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the termination of standplaats leases at Vakantiepark Meerzicht by new owner Europarcs, including the sharp notice, compensation, nature impacts and the wider buyout of holiday parks by private equity. The minister answered that the matter is primarily a private-law contract issue, that the government has commissioned a joint study with EZK due in Q2 2022, and that other questions fall to municipalities, provinces or the courts.
It is not for me, or for the Minister of EZK, to assess whether the landlord has complied with the agreements and conditions in this case.
Het is niet aan mij, of aan de Minister van EZK, om te beoordelen of de verhuurder zich in dit geval aan de afspraken en voorwaarden heeft gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de rode loper voor datacenters

An MP asked ministers about the government's past active acquisition of hyperscale data centres, claimed industry lobbying, water and electricity use, grid congestion, and the Microsoft permit. The reply defends the former acquisition policy as now discontinued, says data centres bring limited direct jobs, notes grid scarcity is not solely caused by data centres, and promises a joint letter with stricter national criteria for data centres in spring.
In line with the coalition agreement, this cabinet will tighten national steering and the admission criteria for (hyperscale) data centres.
In lijn met het coalitieakkoord zal dit kabinet de landelijke regie en de toelatingscriteria ten aanzien van (hyperscale) datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Nijboer, Thijssen en Kröger over de rode loper voor datacenter Zeewolde

MPs asked whether ministries actively courted Facebook/Meta for a Zeewolde data centre, gave it priority on the high-voltage grid, and whether the data centre's energy, heat and diesel backup impacts were addressed. The ministers answered that NFIA was approached by Meta, that the connection was legally permissible without priority, and that many questions on energy, heat and jobs are left to the municipality or are unknown, while promising a national data centre strategy later.
There is no question of "priority" for Meta's connection to the high-voltage grid.
Er is geen sprake van «voorrang» voor aansluiting van Meta op het hoogspanningsnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de plannen voor het hyperscale datacenter van Facebookmoederbedrijf Meta in Zeewolde en andere datacenters

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch (PvdD) asked about Meta's hyperscale data centre plans in Zeewolde, the sale of state land, energy and water use, and grid tariffs. The minister answered that the state conditions the land sale on energy and water standards, and that the government will tighten national steering and licensing criteria for hyperscale data centres.
The cabinet will tighten the choices in the NOVI regarding data centres.
Het kabinet zal de keuzes in de NOVI over datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het coalitieakkoord

An SP MP asked the Minister of Housing about rent increases amid high inflation, the coalition agreement's plans for income-dependent and phased rent rises, and related affordability risks. The minister answered that the 2022 social rent increase is capped at inflation (2.3%), that details of the coalition's rent measures will be worked out in a separate affordability programme, and that a full answer could not be given before the debate.
I will consider and work out the rent measures announced in the coalition agreement together, in the affordability programme under the National Housing and Construction Agenda.
Ik zal de in het coalitieakkoord aangekondigde huurmaatregelen in onderlinge samenhang bezien en uitwerken in het programma Betaalbaarheid onder de Nationale Wonen en Bouwen Agenda (NWBA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over nep sociale huurwoningen gebouwd door private partijen

Member Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Minister about concerns that commercial developers building social rental homes may let them drift to the free sector, the differing obligations between housing corporations and private parties, and how much municipalities can steer social rental construction. The Minister said the government is studying the issue, that municipalities can use zoning and allocation rules to secure social rental homes, and that a research report will be shared before summer 2022.
Municipalities can arrange this in the land-issuance agreement (where the municipality owns the land), in the anterior agreement and/or in local regulations.
Gemeenten kunnen dit regelen in de gronduitgifte overeenkomst (wanneer de gemeente grondeigenaar is), in de anterieure overeenkomst en/of in lokale verordeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het 'quarantaine-koppel'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the forced isolation and quarantine of a couple after a COVID-19 case linked to the omicron variant, including why they were held after negative tests. The minister replied with a timeline of events, explained the legal basis for the measures under the Public Health Act, and defended the safety region chair's conduct as appropriate.
I note that the mayor of Haarlemmermeer, in her role as chair of the Kennemerland safety region, has acted adequately.
Ik constateer dat de burgemeester van Haarlemmermeer, in haar rol als voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio Kennemerland, adequaat heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘versnellende factoren van de versterkingsoperatie die tot vertraging leiden’

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the government why the Groningen reinforcement operation remains delayed despite acceleration measures, asking about batch planning, contractor payments, the building-contractor pool, the Eigen Kiest Bouwer programme and the Tuikwerd typology approach. The State Secretary answered in detail with progress figures and plans for 2022, acknowledged some delays, and stated that residents would not have to invest their own money in reinforcement.
I am aware of delays within this project.
Ik ben op de hoogte van vertraging binnen dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over digitale veiligheid

MP Leijten (SP) asked the government about the European and Dutch digital identity schemes, data storage and blockchain use, lobbying, ethics, cyber vulnerabilities and dependence on single providers. The state secretary answered at length, defending the planned EU framework and Dutch rules against data commercialisation, but gave largely general replies and deferred some matters to other bodies or future policy.
I agree with the experts that citizens' personal data are not a tradeable commodity and that providers' business models may not be based on it.
Ik ben het met de experts eens dat persoonsgegevens van burgers geen handelswaar zijn en dat verdienmodellen van aanbieders daarop ook niet gebaseerd mogen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat raadsleden gemeenschappelijke regelingen een bedreiging vinden voor de lokale democratie

An SP MP asks whether council members' concerns that joint arrangements (gemeenschappelijke regelingen) threaten local democracy are justified, and raises questions on council knowledge of arrangements, mergers, citizen control over municipal tasks, the growth of joint arrangements and the future of local government. The minister points to a Wgr amendment giving councils a stronger position, promised support products and motions, notes that joint arrangements are a form of extended local government, and declines to predict the structure of local government in 20 years, pending proposals due in 2022.
With the forthcoming amendment of the Wgr, the position of municipal councils in this assessment is strengthened through the new obligation to ask councils for an opinion on the proposed arrangement.

Met de aanstaande wijziging van de Wgr wordt de positie van gemeenteraden bij deze afweging versterkt door de nieuwe verplichting om gemeenteraden om een zienswijze te vragen over de voorgenomen regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Stoffer, Segers en Mulder over gewonde burgers als gevolg van Turkse militaire activiteiten in Noordoost-Syrië

MPs asked the government whether Turkish military attacks in northeast Syria injuring civilians, including children, were lawful, and about Turkey's strategy and humanitarian protection of minorities. The government said it lacks details to judge the legality of specific attacks, condemned the Turkish operation, and described ongoing diplomatic efforts and support programmes for religious minorities.

The cabinet states that all countries, including Turkey, must act in accordance with international law, but does not have the details of the attacks in question and therefore cannot make statements on their lawfulness.

Het kabinet stelt voorop dat alle landen en dus ook Turkije conform het internationaal recht moeten handelen, maar beschikt niet over de details van de betreffende aanvallen en kan dus ook geen uitspraken doen over de rechtmatigheid daarvan.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Kuiken en Kathmann over het veilige verloop van de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen en de gevolgen van de snelle toename van het aantal besmettingen voor de organisatie van de gemeenteraadsverkiezin

Two PvdA MPs asked how rising COVID-19 infections affect the safe organisation of the municipal elections, including adequacy of measures, mobile polling stations, polling staff and contacts with municipalities. The minister answers that the Temporary COVID-19 Elections Act provides sufficient powers, that voter turnout is not expected to fall, that municipalities decide on mobile polling stations, and that a national recruitment campaign is not needed but support materials are provided.
The Temporary COVID-19 Elections Act (Twv) provides the legal basis for taking the measures needed to keep elections safe during the coronavirus pandemic.
De Tijdelijke wet verkiezingen covid-19 (Twv) biedt de grondslag voor het nemen van maatregelen die nodig zijn om verkiezingen veilig te houden tijdens de coronapandemie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Strolenberg over het bericht 'Tekort aan lijkschouwers dreigt: ‘Weinig geneeskundestudenten kiezen ervoor’'

MPs Van den Hil and Strolenberg asked about a reported shortage of forensic doctors who perform death inspections (lijkschouw), including timelines for a new capacity forecast, a recruitment campaign, IGJ roundtable and the appointment procedure. The minister answered each question with expected timelines (forecast end 2022, campaign start Q2 2022, Wlb bill end 2022) and described regional measures including temporary emergency solutions.
To this end, a round-table meeting will be organised in spring 2022.
Hiertoe wordt in het voorjaar van 2022 een rondetafelbijeenkomst georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about arms deliveries to Ukraine, including transparency about Ukraine's request, the defensive/offensive distinction, and consistency with export criteria. The government answered that it cannot disclose Ukraine's specific needs, will inform parliament quickly if deliveries proceed above 2 million euro, and is welcoming toward supporting Ukraine's self-defence while still pursuing diplomacy.
Should the Netherlands decide to supply military goods to Ukraine, the cabinet is willing to inform the House of this in an expedited letter.
Mocht Nederland overgaan tot het leveren van militaire goederen aan Oekraïne dan is het kabinet graag bereid om de Kamer hierover versneld per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over burgers die tegen de overheid moeten procederen

MP Arib asks whether citizens who miss short appeal deadlines against government decisions should be able to correct such errors, and whether the human touch should prevail in legal disputes with the state. The minister answers that a bill amending the General Administrative Law Act is in preparation, which will examine a 'civil loop' and more room for discretion on late objections, while stating that the existing administrative loop cannot cure time-limit breaches and that the government will consult on the bill in spring.
This question will be considered in the process of the bill in preparation amending the General Administrative Law Act following the childcare benefits affair.
Deze vraag wordt betrokken in het traject van het in voorbereiding zijnde wetsvoorstel tot aanpassing van de Awb naar aanleiding van de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Kort over het artikel dat bijstandsgerechtigden in Amsterdam een halfjaar mogen samenwonen zonder gevolgen voor hun uitkering waarin beide partners hun eigen woning mogen aa

MPs Koerhuis and De Kort (VVD) asked the minister whether Amsterdam's policy letting welfare recipients cohabit for six months without benefit consequences, while keeping their own homes, is acceptable given vacancy and social housing waiting lists. The minister answered that the measure stays within the Participatiewet, is not the cost-sharing norm, avoids premature housing loss, falls within the six-month vacancy limit, and that he will be informed of the results of this and the Tilburg trial.
In our view, the municipality of Amsterdam is not conducting income policy with this measure.
De gemeente Amsterdam bedrijft naar ons oordeel met deze maatregel geen inkomenspolitiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het woonplan “Dijkzone” in Den Helder

An SP MP asked the government about the Dijkzone housing plan in Den Helder, built on a sea dike, and whether it accounts for sea-level rise and the Deltacommissaris's advice. The minister answered that the dike design assumes 3.5 m sea-level rise over 200 years, that responsibility lies with the water board, municipality and province, and that the project is still in feasibility study with no irreversible decisions taken.
It has therefore not yet been determined whether this housing plan can proceed.
Daarmee is nog niet vastgesteld of dit woonplan al dan niet doorgang kan vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Rechter: de beslissingen van de Minister zijn redelijk kort door de bocht'

An SP MP asks the Minister of Housing whether the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties may ignore tenants' interests when approving housing corporation sales to investors, and whether the authority checks residents' objections (zienswijzen) substantively. The Minister answers that tenant interests are not an approval criterion but are voiced through performance agreements and mandatory objections, that the authority only checks alignment with those agreements, and rejects a need for a new review.

It is up to local parties – municipality, housing corporations and tenant associations – to determine in consultation what the size, spread across neighbourhoods and composition of the social housing stock should be.

Het is aan lokale partijen – gemeente, woningcorporaties en huurdersverenigingen – om in overleg te bepalen wat de omvang, spreiding over wijken en buurten en samenstelling van de sociale woningvoorraad moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat vaste bewoners van Bungalowpark L’Air Pur in Baarle-Nassau hun vaste plek willen behouden

An MP asks whether residents of a bungalow park in Baarle-Nassau who face enforcement and penalty payments should be protected, and whether the minister will intervene via the expert team or reopen rules allowing permanent residence. The minister says enforcement is a municipal matter, the municipality has been informed about the expert team, and a study on permanent residence in recreational homes is ongoing with results expected in spring 2022.
It is up to the municipality and province to make this assessment.
Het is aan de gemeente en provincie om deze afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over wrakingsregels bij een hoorzitting van de huurcommissie

An MP asked why the recusal rules for rent tribunal hearings under the Uhw only allow challenges before the hearing starts, unlike court proceedings, and whether this is a gap. The minister confirmed the rule, explained it stems from the 1979 law mirroring older court rules, and said he will examine amending the law.
Yes. It is not a deliberate distinction, and therefore I intend to examine amending the law on this point.
Ja. Het gaat niet om een bewust onderscheid en daarom ben ik voornemens om een wijziging van de wet op dit punt te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Wijk bij Duurstede ruim twee keer zoveel woningen wil bouwen

An MP asked the minister whether Wijk bij Duurstede's request for 530 extra homes was blocked by provincial limits on the built-up area and whether the province should be pressed to remove such obstacles. The minister answered that the province allows expansion under conditions, capped the local site at 280 extra homes over road-network concerns, and promised monitoring and consultation without committing to reversing the restriction.
The province has indicated it will allow a maximum of 280 extra homes on this expansion site, because a higher number is expected to cause bottlenecks on the provincial road network.

De provincie heeft aangegeven op deze uitbreidingslocatie de ontwikkeling van maximaal 280 extra woningen toe te staan, omdat een hoger aantal naar verwachting leidt tot knelpunten op het provinciale wegennet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht 'Deltacommissaris: woningbouw houdt veel te weinig rekening met klimaatverandering'

An MP (Van Esch, PvdD) asked the ministers about a report that the Delta Commissioner finds housing construction takes too little account of climate change, including whether new homes are planned in flood-prone or unstable areas, and what action will be taken on climate-adaptive building, nature-inclusive building, subsidence and coastal/river development. The minister answers that a formal response to the Delta Commissioner's advice will follow in Q1 2022, that a national climate-adaptation action programme and a building-criteria framework will be produced, and that the government commits to these steps while describing many measures as ongoing or to be explored.

In the response to the Delta Commissioner's advice we will indicate how we will tackle this challenge of quickly realising affordable homes on the one hand and taking account of the consequences of climate change on the other.

In de reactie op het advies van de Deltacommissaris zullen we aangeven hoe we aan de slag gaan met deze uitdaging om enerzijds snel betaalbare woningen te realiseren en anderzijds rekening te houden met gevolgen van klimaatverandering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Koerhuis over het artikel dat de woningbouw naar nul gaat door nieuwe wet

MPs Minhas and Koerhuis (VVD) asked the minister about a newspaper report that a new noise law would bring housing construction near zero, and about the status of the Koerhuis motion on policy-neutral transfer of noise rules. The minister rejects the report's conclusions, says the impact analysis shows up to 60,000-80,000 planned homes may face cumulation assessments, and says a joint working process with the region and an implementation guide for municipalities are underway.
The ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and I are willing to draft, together with the region, a framework or guidance for municipalities that face this issue.
De bewindslieden van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en ik zijn bereid om samen met de regio een handelingskader of handreiking op te stellen voor gemeenten die daarmee te maken krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over geweld tegen anti-Zwarte Piet demonstranten in Volendam

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked why the cabinet did not condemn violence against anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators in Volendam, whether perpetrators should be prosecuted, and how the mayor and local triangle handled the unannounced demonstration. The minister condemned the violence and the attempt to block the constitutional right to demonstrate, but said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and that assessing the mayor's and local triangle's conduct is for the mayor, who answers to the municipal council.
Facilitating and properly managing demonstrations is the responsibility of the mayor, who is accountable to the municipal council.
Het faciliteren en in goede banen leiden van demonstraties is aan de burgemeester, die daarover verantwoording aflegt aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Wijngaarden en Koerhuis over de actuele veiligheidsrisico’s voor Nederlanders in Oekraïne

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Infrastructure about security risks for Dutch nationals in Ukraine, including travel advice, evacuation preparations and airspace safety. The government answered that there is no reason yet to speak of a threatening situation, kept the current travel advice, said evacuation is not being organised, and pointed to existing EU and national airspace risk assessments.
That number need not be representative of the actual number of Dutch nationals in Ukraine, because there is no registration obligation for Dutch nationals abroad (due to privacy).
Dat getal hoeft niet per se representatief te zijn voor het daadwerkelijke aantal Nederlanders in Oekraïne, omdat er geen registratieplicht is voor Nederlanders in het buitenland (vanwege privacy).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat meer tribunes in het Goffertstadion onveilig zijn en herstelmaatregelen nodig zijn voor heropening

An MP asked the minister about reports that more stadium stands at the Goffertstadion were unsafe and needed repairs before reopening, and about structural stadium safety across the Netherlands, including comparisons with Belgium and the UK. The minister answered that repairs were permitted and the municipality will decide on reopening after work is done, and that a legal periodic structural safety assessment for large public buildings is being prepared, while stating no national stadium authority is needed.
I am currently working on the necessary amendment of the Building Decree for the Living Environment, which I expect to submit to your House this spring in the pre-consultation procedure.
Ik werk thans aan de benodigde wijziging van het Besluit Bouwwerken Leefomgeving (Bbl) die ik naar verwachting in dit voorjaar aan uw Kamer zal voorleggen in het kader van de voorhangprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de regering brieven met aanwijzingen aan gemeentes stuurde zonder wettelijke grondslag

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked whether letters the government sent to municipalities instructing them to create emergency asylum reception places, called 'aanwijzingen', had any legal basis, and whether they amounted to mere requests. The government answered that the letters had no basis in Dutch law, were not legally binding, were intended as urgent requests, and that it will no longer use the term 'aanwijzing' in this way, while refusing to share some correspondence yet and not answering the criminal-law questions.
The cabinet regrets this. Therefore the cabinet no longer wishes to use the term 'aanwijzing' in a situation like this in this way.
Het kabinet betreurt dat. Daarom wil het kabinet de term «aanwijzing» in een situatie zoals deze niet meer op deze wijze gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht ‘Uitspraak in supermarktoorlog Didam bedreigt Nederlandse woningbouw’

An MP asked the minister whether the Hoge Raad's Didam ruling, requiring equal opportunity when municipalities sell land, threatens housing construction and causes delay and damage claims. The minister answered that the ruling may complicate municipal land sales but does not affect privately owned land, that delays are possible where selection processes do not comply, and that the government will publish guidance and support municipalities.
I have therefore published a first factsheet with questions and answers on the website www.woningmarktbeleid.nl following this ruling.
Ik heb daarom op de website www.woningmarktbeleid.nl een eerste factsheet 3 geplaats met Vraag en Antwoord naar aanleiding van dit arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over financiering van onderdak voor dak- en thuislozen uit coronagelden

An MP asked how much less municipalities receive for homeless shelter now that corona support is being phased out, whether funding affected street sleeping, and why it is not continued. The State Secretary replied that no phase-out has occurred, that the Covid cost-compensation scheme is extended to 31 December 2022, and that no exact data on street sleeping effects exist, while declining to provide extra funds this winter.
No exact data are available on this.
Hier zijn geen exacte gegevens over bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de gevolgen van de Hoge Raad uitspraak “overheid moet gelijke kansen bieden bij uitgifte grond”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Housing about the consequences of a Supreme Court ruling requiring fair selection when municipalities sell land, and about guidance for municipalities and the housing targets. The Minister answered that the ruling may cause delays, that a transparent selection procedure with objective criteria is now required unless there is only one serious bidder, that legal advice and a factsheet were issued, and that the Reiswijzer Gebiedsontwikkeling will be revised with VNG and Neprom.

The Supreme Court ruling of 26 November 2021 may lead to delays in housing plans where the government supplies the land and no selection procedure meeting the ruling's requirements has been conducted.

Het arrest van de Hoge Raad van 26 november 2021 zal bij woningbouwplannen waar de overheid de grond levert en er geen selectieprocedure is gevoerd die voldoet aan de eisen die het arrest stelt, tot vertraging kunnen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische basis waarmee gemeentes gedwongen worden asielzoekers op te vangen

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Secretary of State's December 2021 letters 'designating' emergency asylum reception sites for Enschede, Gorinchem and the Rotterdam region have any legal basis, and whether this amounts to an unlawful directive to municipalities. The government replied that the letters are not legal directions, have no grounding in Dutch law and no public-law effect, were a request driven by an acute shortage of about 2,000 places, and that it would not be repeated lightly; it also declined to release a decision memo, saying none was written.
The directions have no basis in Dutch statute or regulation, as I stated during the Justice and Security budget debate in the Senate on 21 December.
De aanwijzingen hebben geen grondslag in Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving, zoals ik gemeld heb bij de begrotingsbehandeling JenV in de Eerste Kamer op 21 december jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanwijzing aan gemeenten over de huisvesting van asielzoekers

An SP MP asked why the government designated five municipalities to host asylum seekers by letter instead of seeking voluntary cooperation, and on what legal basis. The State Secretary answered that the letters were urgent designations without legal basis or legal effect, justified by the risk of emergency tent shelters, and that such designations are a last resort.
It is not a designation in the legal sense, and the letters therefore have no public-law legal effect.
Het betreft geen aanwijzing in juridische zin en de brieven hebben dan ook geen publiekrechtelijk rechtsgevolg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Leijten over “de verplichting door gemeenten tot een alimentatieverzoek als al vaststaat dat dit geen kans van slagen heeft”

SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that municipalities can require welfare recipients to file hopeless alimony claims, as criticized by a court, and asked about scope, costs, cost recovery and ending such practices. The State Secretary acknowledged the court's criticism, said such obligations must be used carefully and not where a claim has no chance, declined a broad inventory as unfeasible, and committed to alerting municipalities in Gemeentenieuws.
I consider a broad inventory as you propose too far-reaching in that light, and I also consider such an inventory unfeasible.
Ik vind een brede inventarisatie zoals u voorstelt in dat licht te vergaand en ik acht een dergelijke inventarisatie ook onuitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over dat een Amerikaanse spion Booking.com heeft gehackt en dit niet is gemeld

Leijten (SP) asked whether Booking.com customers should have been notified of a reported 2016 hack by a US spy, why the AIVD did not inform the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, how often US actors hacked Dutch firms, whether the AIVD is equipped to counter such espionage, and whether Booking.com faces stricter supervision. Minister Ollongren answered that the old Wbp breach-notification rules applied, that she cannot judge the case which falls to the regulator, that she cannot discuss AIVD conduct or current knowledge in public, that the AIVD investigates suspected state hacks of Dutch firms, and that the AP has no current steps to announce.
I cannot publicly address specific questions about the conduct of the AIVD.
Ik kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op concrete vragen over het handelen van de AIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel ‘Blijvende inspanning gemeenten betaalt zich nog niet terug’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about municipalities bearing unreimbursed costs for supervising former unaccompanied minors and about the lack of reception places, as motion-Van Dijk ('no extra tasks without money') was adopted. The Minister answered that a one-off 10 million euro payment is being arranged for 2022, but that structural funding and compensation are left to a future cabinet.
Whether and how this extended care should be financed structurally is a matter a next cabinet will have to consider.
Over de vraag of en op welke wijze deze verlengde opvang op structurele wijze gefinancierd dient te worden, zal een volgend kabinet zich moeten buigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de schrijnende huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked the government about substandard housing of migrant workers, overcrowding linked to high rents, and enforcement by municipalities and employment agencies. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Goed Verhuurderschap bill, certification plans for employment agencies, housing funding and a coming Jaarrapportage, but gave mostly general commitments without new enforcement powers for the central government.
Municipalities will soon get an additional instrument with which they can act better against abuses.
Gemeenten krijgen straks een extra instrument in handen waarmee ze beter kunnen optreden tegen misstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording op de schriftelijke vragen over het artikel dat Amsterdam een opkoopbescherming wil invoeren voor de hele stad

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior whether Amsterdam's plan to apply its purchase protection to the whole city fits the law, which refers to buurten and gebieden, and whether it is well justified. The Minister replied that the law leaves municipalities free to define gebied, that a citywide designation is legally possible but must be justified by scarcity or liveability, and that assessing Amsterdam's justification is for the municipal council and, ultimately, the courts.
It is not for me as Minister to assess Amsterdam's justification.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om de onderbouwing van Amsterdam te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het integriteitsbeleid bewindspersonen

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Interior how the secretary-general would grant exemptions from the broadened post-office lobbying ban, who sits on the independent advisory committee, how GRECO recommendations are met, and whether the government wrongly informed GRECO that the lobbying ban had lapsed. The minister replied that exemptions weigh factors like duration of office and proximity of policy field, that the advisory committee role will be assigned to an existing college via future legislation, that responsibility for compliance lies primarily with former ministers, and that no organisations were misinformed because the ban was never withdrawn.
The lobbying ban applied and still applies in full.
Het lobbyverbod gold en geldt onverkort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen over het maken van landelijke prestatieafspraken met corporaties

An MP asks why national performance agreements were made with Aedes, which does not represent all housing corporations, and how non-member corporations and performance targets will be ensured, and whether regional or provincial agreements or differentiated tax relief will be pursued. The minister says non-members are bound via the priorities and local agreements, defers the regional-agreement question to the next cabinet, and rejects regionally differentiated levy relief.
With Aedes I am working out over the coming weeks how we keep good oversight of achieving the targets in the national performance agreements
Met Aedes werk ik de komende weken uit hoe we goed zicht houden op het realiseren van de doelen uit de landelijke prestatieafspraken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aangenomen motie-Van Haga c.s. over het wegnemen van obstakels voor het isoleren van monumenten

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how obstacles to insulating listed buildings would be removed, following an adopted motion. The minister replied that guidance and updated restoration guidelines already exist, and promised a study with the Cultural Heritage Agency and other bodies on knowledge gaps and whether a national guideline is useful, with findings before summer 2022.
I expect to send my findings to your House before summer 2022.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer voor de zomer van 2022 mijn bevindingen te zullen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de betrokkenheid van het mkb bij het Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet

MPs asked whether SMEs are sufficiently involved in testing the Digital Environment Act system (DSO), including whether agricultural and other sector organisations will be involved and how the promised independent SME test will be implemented. The minister replied that several SME trade organisations now take part in workshops and user tests, that the engagement has been intensified, and that a three-phase approach agreed with business organisations is underway, with further tests and communication planned.
With the business federations, including MKB-Nederland, I have made agreements on how to give effect to your request for an independent SME test of the DSO.
Met de koepels van het bedrijfsleven, waaronder MKB-Nederland, heb ik afspraken gemaakt over de wijze waarop invulling wordt gegeven aan uw verzoek om een onafhankelijke mkb-toets op het DSO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over een gemeente die gesprekken over uitkeringen filmt

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked whether filming benefit conversations in the municipality of Dronten is acceptable, whether it undermines trust, and how the municipality complies with privacy law. The minister answered that filming privacy-sensitive talks needs a legal basis and must be necessary and proportionate, that the municipality has halted filming pending a review, and that the Dutch data protection authority and courts will judge its admissibility.
At present filming has been completely halted and the municipality is carrying out a review examining which means can be used and the advantages and disadvantages of each.
Op dit moment is het filmen geheel stil gelegd en voert de gemeente een onderzoek uit waarin gekeken wordt welke middelen kunnen worden ingezet en wat per middel de voor- en nadelen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de intocht van Sinterklaas

An MP asks ministers whether they will urge mayors to allow QR-code-free Sinterklaas parades and whether they will act against municipalities that refuse Zwarte Piet via subsidy conditions. The government replies that it supports broad access to the parade, that children under 18 are exempt from the coronavirus pass, and that municipalities decide on subsidies and the parade themselves.
The arrival of Sinterklaas is a local matter.
De intocht van Sinterklaas is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het beleidsneutraal overzetten van beleidsregels

The MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about the implementation of the motion on transferring noise rules without policy change, and the status of an impact analysis on cumulation rules for housing. The minister answers that the Aanvullingswet geluid is a policy-neutral transfer of SWUNG-2 but that the revised aircraft noise cumulation rule is a policy change, that an impact analysis was completed in August 2021, and that consultations with administrative partners continue; she commits to sending the impact analyses to parliament as soon as possible.
The State Secretary of IenW, as the responsible minister for noise policy, will send the impact analyses to your House as soon as possible.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW zal, als verantwoordelijk bewindspersoon voor het geluidbeleid, de impactanalyses zo spoedig mogelijk toezenden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het weren van buitenlanders in een huurwoning

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about an online rental ad excluding foreigners under an 'anti-migrant policy', and what can be done to stop such discrimination. The minister agreed discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to planned landlord rules in the Goed Verhuurderschap bill, and announced a pilot on a reporting duty with Utrecht by summer 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat woningverhuurders met een miljardenclaim dreigen richting de staat

An MP asked whether the minister would release internal advice, Landsadvocaat advice and the Raad van State advice on property rights concerning a planned cap on WOZ points in the rent-valuation system, which landlords threaten to challenge in court for billions. The minister refused to release the internal and Landsadvocaat advice because of an anticipated court case and the advice predates the new policy line, but promised to point the House to the Raad van State advice once published.
In light of that possible procedure, I am not willing to make the internal advice on property rights public.
In het licht van die mogelijke procedure ben ik niet bereid om de interne adviezen met betrekking tot het eigendomsrecht openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over de brief van UNESCO inzake de voorgenomen gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

Three MPs asked whether UNESCO had sent a letter on protecting the Wadden Sea and possible gas extraction beneath it, and whether it could be shared with a cabinet appraisal. The State Secretary confirmed UNESCO letters of 7 May and 30 November 2021, said the Ternaard gas production is assessed under UNESCO principles with a decision expected in March 2022, and that the cabinet plans to reply to UNESCO in January 2022.
The cabinet intends to send a letter to UNESCO with a response in January 2022.
Het kabinet is voornemens om in januari 2022 een brief te sturen aan UNESCO met een reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “de zware gasbeving in Garrelsweer’’

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the ministers about the Garrelsweer gas-quake, the overrun of the seismic density threshold, schade-afhandeling delays at the IMG, the slow reinforcement operation and the Ombudsman's criticism. Minister Blok answers at length, largely defending the current approach, acknowledging delays and promising a further letter on seismic analyses and a law closing the Groningen field.
As SodM indicates, on 8 November, due to the magnitude 1.7 earthquake near Westeremden, one of the monitoring parameters, the earthquake density near Zeerijp, reached its highest level.

Zoals SodM aangeeft heeft op 8 november jl., door de aardbeving met magnitude 1,7 bij Westeremden, één van de monitoringsparameters, namelijk de aardbevingsdichtheid, nabij Zeerijp het hoogste niveau bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het artikel dat Amsterdam een opkoopbescherming wil invoeren voor de hele stad

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior about Amsterdam's plan to introduce city-wide purchase protection for homes below 512,000 euro, including contacts with the ministry, consistency with the statutory criteria of scarcity and the NHG limit, and property rights. Minister Ollongren answered that the municipality is responsible for its own scope and justification, that the ministry gave general briefings but did not review the Amsterdam proposal, and that the statute allows municipal discretion while a strong justification is required, and that the amendment route bypassed Raad van State advice.
The municipality of Amsterdam is itself responsible for the scope it has chosen in its policy proposal for the purchase protection scheme.
De gemeente Amsterdam is dus zelf verantwoordelijk voor de reikwijdte die zij heeft gekozen in haar beleidsvoorstel voor de regeling Opkoopbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de toepassing van de opkoopbescherming bij het ‘flippen’ van woningen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked whether flipping homes (buying, renovating and quickly reselling at a higher price) is undesirable, why the owner-occupancy protection does not cover flipping, and what the government will do about speculation in the housing market. Minister Ollongren answered that quick resale for profit is undesirable but not always harmful, that the protection targets rental-driven scarcity, that the raised 8% transfer tax on investors is an adequate deterrent, and that no outright ban is warranted on current data.
Banning quick resale of a home would be an additional restriction on property rights.
Het verbieden van het snel doorverkopen van een woning is een aanvullende beperking van het eigendomsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de intimidatie van MH-17-advocaten

An MP asked the government about reports that lawyers representing MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, likely by Russia, and about security measures, diplomatic responses, spying offences, a foreign agents register, and countering disinformation and cyberattacks. The government condemned all interference, said it monitors the security situation closely and takes measures where needed, but declined to discuss individual cases and said no diplomatic action is currently warranted, while noting a planned bill to extend espionage offences.
For security reasons I cannot address individual cases or comment on whether investigations are ongoing.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek en kan ik geen uitspraken doen over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Verenigingen van Eigenaren (VvE) zich grote zorgen maken over een nieuwe wet waardoor bewoners laadpunten voor elektrische auto’s in ondergrondse garages kunne

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a planned notification scheme for EV charging points in VvE-managed garages would effectively force associations to install chargers, and whether municipalities block charging on streets citing garages. The minister denied that VvEs are obliged to install chargers, said the owner-initiated notification process involves VvE board review, and declined to meet the VNG, saying municipal parking policy is for municipalities to set.
The VvE board assesses whether the conditions of the notification scheme and any additional VvE conditions are met.
Het VvE-bestuur beoordeelt of is voldaan aan de voorwaarden van de notificatieregeling en de eventuele aanvullende voorwaarden van de VvE.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en Van der Woude over het bericht 'Gerommel binnen Adviescollege Slavernijverleden: Een jaar werk is in twee maanden uitgevoerd'

MPs Van Strien and Van der Woude asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that the Slavery Past Advisory Committee functioned poorly, that some members were biased, and that its work was rushed and fragmented. The minister denied any substantive steering of the committee, said its advice was clear with 11 recommendations, and left any government response to a future cabinet.
The Advisory Committee operated fully independently in terms of substance.
Het Adviescollege heeft inhoudelijk volledig onafhankelijk geopereerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport tijdens het notaoverleg van 25 oktober 2021 over het maken van landelijke prestatieafspraken met corpora

An MP asked whether the government will make national performance agreements with housing associations via Aedes rather than individually, and how local agreements are made. The minister confirmed national agreements with Aedes on the EUR 500 million levy reduction, citing that individual agreements do not fit the Housing Act and that Aedes represents nearly all associations, and promised monitoring and involvement of non-members.
That is also not necessary, because nearly all housing associations are represented by Aedes.
Dat is ook niet nodig, omdat nagenoeg alle corporaties door Aedes vertegenwoordigd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het artikel dat de Twentse corporatie Domijn met een truc de verhuurdersheffing omzeilt

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporation Domijn's use of a tax construction to avoid the rental housing levy is acceptable, how many corporations use it, and whether the rules for the new-build tax reduction will be tightened. The Minister declined to comment on individual taxpayers, explained how the investment declaration scheme works, rejected any link between municipal and Authority approvals and the tax reduction, and said corporations are expected to follow the rules, while rule changes cannot be retroactive.
For individual taxpayers and their tax affairs, however, the duty of confidentiality applies and I cannot make any statement.
Voor individuele belastingplichtigen en hun belastingzaken geldt echter de geheimhoudingsplicht 2 en kan ik geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Asielzoekerscentra bomvol: 'We zitten tegen crisisnoodopvang aan'' en 'Afghanen de druppel'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of the Interior about the overcrowding of asylum reception centres, the causes of the shortage, and the government's plans to expand capacity and speed up the outflow of status holders. The government answers that all regular reception places are full, attributes this to rising inflow, slow housing of status holders by municipalities and reception capacity pressures, and describes efforts to add temporary places, flexible housing pilots and IND backlog measures.
With this, all regular reception places are occupied and various forms of emergency reception are now being used.
Daarmee zijn alle reguliere opvangplekken bezet en wordt nu verschillende vormen van noodopvang ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het nieuwsartikel 'Raad van Europa: Nederlandse rechter normaliseert discriminatie door marechaussee'

MP Azarkan asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of the Interior about press reports on a Council of Europe rapporteur's criticism of ethnic profiling by the Royal Marechaussee and a court ruling that ethnicity may play a role in selection for mobile security checks, asking about training, complaint routes, the use of skin colour and ethnicity in risk profiles, and whether a ban is planned. The government answered that it opposes discrimination, that the court ruling is limited to mobile security checks and is under appeal, that training and complaint procedures exist, and that a cabinet position on ethnicity and nationality in risk profiles will follow after the College voor de rechten van de mens publishes its legal framework, with no ban committed to yet.
The cabinet considers it important to provide clarity on the legal frameworks that apply and are applied in the Netherlands regarding the use of ethnicity and nationality in risk models.

Het kabinet acht het van belang helderheid te bieden over de juridische kaders die van toepassing zijn en in Nederland worden toegepast ten aanzien van het gebruik van etniciteit en nationaliteit in risicomodellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Geurts over collectieve warmtesystemen in de gebouwde omgeving

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary about heat networks: the forfaitair efficiency assumption in energy labels, the supply temperature for district heating, the size of heat districts, and local government capacity to set them. The State Secretary defended the forfaitair method and the energy label design, argued that the draft law's criteria protect optimisation and innovation, noted the Expertise Centrum Warmte and ongoing talks with VNG and IPO for support, and rejected the suggested conflict of interests.
Municipalities have by far the most knowledge of the specific characteristics of the local situation.
Gemeenten hebben bij uitstek kennis van de specifieke kenmerken van de lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht “PUR-cowboys hebben vrij spel”

MPs asked the government about reports that spray PUR insulation is applied carelessly, the number of complaints, certification, worker protection and the reliability of the GGD protocol. The minister answered that compliance with rules and certification is the responsibility of companies and supervisors, promised an evaluation of work practice with a proposal in summer 2022, and provided complaint figures and an explanation of the protocol's funding.
With the evaluation of work practice I want to gain more insight into how regulations, rules and private certification are applied in practice.
Met de evaluatie van de werkpraktijk wil ik meer inzicht krijgen hoe de regelgeving, voorschriften en private certificering in de praktijk worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over de kosten van het aardgasvrij maken van woningen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether all correspondence between the ministry and municipalities about the cost of making homes gas-free could be provided. The minister answered yes and referred to an annex containing the correspondence known to her.
Yes. In annex 2 you will find all correspondence that has taken place between the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the municipalities concerned, insofar as known to me.
Ja. In de bijlage 2 treft u alle correspondentie die er is geweest tussen het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken Koninkrijksrelaties en desbetreffende gemeenten, voor zover bij mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afwikkeling van de compensatie van gedupeerden in het Toeslagenschandaal

An SP MP asked whether the secretaries-general of two ministries prepared a memo on the compensation of victims of the childcare benefits scandal, its status, and whether it could be sent to parliament. The government answered that no such memo could be found, but that related emails on interdepartmental capacity for the restoration agency were located, and it offered to search further if the MP specifies the expected content.
Based on the information in your questions, we have not been able to find such a memo.
Op basis van de informatie in uw vragen hebben wij een dergelijke notitie niet kunnen vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Koerhuis over de brandveiligheid van zonnepanelen

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Koerhuis asked about fire safety of solar panels after a roof fire in Hoofddorp and whether building fire-safety rules for new homes are enforced. The minister answered that municipalities supervise compliance, that the Wkb quality-assurance law is planned for 1 July 2022, that NEN is reviewing standards, and that research on particle deposition from solar-panel fires is ongoing with results expected in early 2022.
It is up to the municipality as competent authority to supervise compliance with the fire-safety regulations that apply to new homes.
Het is aan de gemeente als bevoegd gezag toe te zien op de naleving van de brandveiligheidsvoorschriften die gelden voor nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese drones die gebruikt worden door de politie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether police use Chinese DJI drones, why they were chosen, whether data could reach Chinese servers, and whether a Rijksbreed policy on foreign technology is needed. The minister confirmed police use DJI drones, said procurement law gave no basis to exclude them, acknowledged the data-leak reports could not be verified, and declined to commission further investigation or a government-wide overview of such technology use.
Such an overview is not available.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van de eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het bericht dat het metropakket MRA een serieuze optie is voor financiering uit Nationaal Groeifonds

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs follow-up questions on earlier answers about the Amsterdam metropolitan package (MRA) and possible Nationaal Groeifonds financing, covering Haven-Stad housing comparisons, land revenue differences between social and owner-occupied housing, a planned harbour basin in the Houtrakpolder, and the cost of earlier harbour basins. The minister answered that the projects are not fully comparable, that land-price differences cannot be averaged, that a sensitivity analysis on housing mix is underway, that the Houtrakpolder plans are not yet elaborated, and that Havenbedrijf Amsterdam's individual project costs are not public.
The Port of Amsterdam Company N.V. is a company. Therefore information on the costs of individual works is not public and the requested amount cannot be provided.
Het Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V. is een bedrijf. Daarom is informatie over de kosten van individuele werken niet openbaar en kan het gevraagde bedrag niet worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Nijboer over overlast gevende gevelreclame

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether landlords hanging advertising scaffolding sheets on their buildings, causing light and daylight nuisance for tenants (a Rotterdam case), is acceptable, what the national rules are, and what tenants can do. The minister answered that no specific national rules apply, that municipalities regulate such advertising through permits and bylaws, that landlords must prevent nuisance to tenants, and that tenants can seek remedies via the courts, the municipality, the Huurcommissie for rent reduction, and Het Juridisch Loket.
Apart from the specific case in Rotterdam, I am not aware of any signals from tenants experiencing nuisance from advertising on scaffolding sheets during facade renovation or maintenance.
Behalve over het betreffende geval in Rotterdam zijn mij geen signalen bekend van huurders die overlast ervaren van (reclame op) steigerdoeken tijdens gevelrenovatie of onderhoud aan de gevel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Toename afsplitsingen in lokale politiek: al 150 nieuwe fracties’

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that around 46% of municipal councils have seen councillors split off to form their own factions since 2018, and whether the minister's earlier call to discourage such splits had been heeded. The minister confirmed the figures come from NRC research, said the VNG considers discouraging splits undesirable given the personal mandate of councillors, and committed to a circular encouraging municipalities to adopt reading-rule measures and to re-engaging the VNG.
In my view, including such provisions in the municipal council's rules of procedure would be a suitable way to discourage splits.
Mijns inziens zou het opnemen van dergelijke bepalingen in het reglement van orde van de gemeenteraad een geschikte wijze van het ontmoedigen van afsplitsingen zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat appartementencomplexen elektrische auto’s weigeren in hun garages uit vrees voor brand

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that apartment complexes refuse electric cars in their garages over fire fears, and about the planned notification scheme for charging points in owners' associations' (VvE) car parks. The minister answered that electric cars are not more fire-prone than combustion cars, outlined planned Bbl changes and a subsidy for VvE charging advice, and said VvEs will not be obliged to install charging points.
VvE's are not obliged to install charging points.
VvE's worden niet verplicht tot het plaatsen van oplaadpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Woude over het bericht dat de bank voortaan je studieschuld kan opzoeken

Two VVD MPs asked whether a plan letting banks look up students' study debt via DUO for mortgage applications breaks the earlier promise that study debt would not be registered for mortgages. The minister replied that the government is not introducing a BKR registration of study debt, that the data stays with citizens who choose whether to share it, and that no talks with DUO are needed.
The cabinet is not proceeding with a BKR registration of study debts.
Het kabinet gaat niet over tot een BKR-registratie voor studieschulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Nieuwe werkwijze Huurcommissie onrechtmatig, huurders de dupe’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that the Huurcommissie's new working method of issuing summary chairman's rulings without hearings is unlawful and harms tenants, with questions on case numbers, waiting times, objection rates, budget, and tenants' rights. The minister rejects the claim of unlawfulness, states the method is legally based and reduces backlogs, reports objection rates around 28%, and declines structural changes such as a rent-check for the free sector or enforceable repair rights.
Applying the manifest chairman's ruling follows from the law and is not unlawful.
Het toepassen van de kennelijke voorzittersuitspraak volgt uit de wet en is niet onrechtmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Kuiken over het bericht 'Woede om Ollongren die bevolking Caribisch Nederland maant korter te douchen: 'Wat een dedain''

MPs Van den Berg and Kuiken asked the Minister of the Interior whether her advice to Caribbean Netherlands residents to shower shorter and use air conditioning less, based on a Milieu Centraal survey, was appropriate given local poverty, and about renewable energy investment by utility WEB. The minister acknowledged the survey was non-representative and the wording unfortunate, said the municipalities decide how to use the tips, and said a renewables roadmap for Bonaire will be sent to parliament by January 2022.
I regret the commotion that arose over this initiative to promote awareness and possible savings in households together with the public body Bonaire and the involved agencies WEB and UNKOBON.

Ik betreur de ophef die is ontstaan over dit initiatief om samen met het openbaar lichaam Bonaire en betrokken instanties WEB en UNKOBON tot bewustwording en mogelijke besparing in huishoudens te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘oververhitte huurmarkt perfecte voedingsbodem voor oplichters’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about fake rental listings targeting desperate housing seekers, the lack of control over private rental, and police dismissing fraud reports. The minister condemned fraud, pointed to a forthcoming 'goed verhuurderschap' bill with a basic norm, a municipal area rental permit and a permit for migrant worker housing, and said it will go to the Raad van State soon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de storing bij Facebook en Instagram op 4 oktober 2021

MPs asked about the impact of the 4 October 2021 Facebook and Instagram outage on Dutch government operations, citizens, and future resilience, as well as EU regulation and internet routing standards. The minister replied that government operations were largely unaffected because these apps are restricted to informal use, that the outage was caused by a human error at Facebook, and that existing EU and national measures (Telecommunications Act duties, NIB2 negotiations, DMA) are being pursued.
There are currently no known signals of such messages directed at the cabinet.
Er zijn op dit moment geen signalen bekend over dergelijke aan het kabinet gerichte berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de plannen van het Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen om deel te willen nemen in een zonnepark

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether a hospital in Groningen (OZG) should take part in a solar park, given reports it would receive a EUR 20 million donation if the park is built. The government answered that the hospital does not invest in the park, is not dependent on the donation, and that hospitals should primarily provide care, though on-site renewables are acceptable; it declined to give a financial rescue guarantee and said oversight of insurers' duty of care is with the NZa.
It is not among the tasks of a hospital to be financially involved in a solar park to be developed on third-party land.
Het behoort niet tot de taken van een ziekenhuis om financieel betrokken te zijn bij een te ontwikkelen zonnepark op gronden van derden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het Rebel rapport inzake de business case van 14 de grootschalige woningbouwgebieden

The MP asks the Minister of Interior about the Rebel report on the business case of 14 large-scale housing areas, covering the unfunded public investment, social rent share, land prices, sustainable heating choices, the selection of rail-zone areas and whether other rail zones could be added. The Minister confirms the report, gives consolidated figures and land price ranges, says sensitivity analyses are still underway, and explains the selection criteria, while stating that other rail-zone projects are a municipal choice and may fall under a future WBI tranche.
Once this research is completed, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra dit onderzoek gereed is, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden sociale huurwoningen in slechte staat en soms rijp voor de sloop’

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior about reports that tens of thousands of social rental homes are in poor condition, asking what the government will do, how corporations are supervised, the Huurcommissie waiting times, and whether an APK-style periodic inspection is warranted. The Minister acknowledges differences between corporations and points to prestatieafspraken, Aw supervision, Civil Code tenant rights and the Huurcommissie, but rejects a mandatory periodic inspection and automatic rent reductions, and largely disputes the data of specific corporations.
I am not in favour of a mandatory general periodic inspection for rental homes.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een verplichte algemene periodieke keuring voor huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over disproportioneel handelen door de burgemeester van Nijmegen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Nijmegen mayor acted disproportionately and used show of force when closing a café for COVID rule violations, including threats to arrest young staff. The Minister declined to assess the mayor's decision, saying proportionality is for the courts and the mayor is accountable to the municipal council, and refused to summon the mayor.
I cannot intervene in that as Minister. Ultimately, the judgment on whether the government acted proportionately rests with the courts.
Ik kan daar als Minister niet in treden. Uiteindelijk is het oordeel over proportioneel handelen door de overheid aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Radar Checkt! Woonstichting De Key gooit studenten op straat'

An MP asked whether housing association De Key is withholding statutory relocation compensation from students in several Amsterdam and Diemen complexes, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister explained the legal conditions for the minimum relocation allowance, reported De Key's own account of each case, said assessing individual claims is for the courts, and stated she would inform parliament and had no signals about other corporations.
Whether tenants wrongly did not receive the statutory relocation allowance is a matter for the judge.
Het oordeel of huurders ten onrechte niet de wettelijke verhuiskostenvergoeding hebben ontvangen is aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bieden op huurwoningen
