MP Nijboer asks the Minister of the Interior about rental platforms like Rebid where tenants bid against each other for homes, whether paid credits and bidding breach the ban on double intermediary fees, whether the ACM should be alerted, and whether this pushes rents up and should be regulated. The Minister says bidding is undesirable but lawful in the free rental sector, refers tenants to ACM ConsuWijzer and cites ACM fines on intermediaries, and says rent regulation and bidding are being tested in 'botsproeven' without committing to a concrete regulatory decision.
I still believe this phenomenon is undesirable, because tenants may take irresponsible risks in determining their rent.
Ik ben nog steeds van mening dat dit fenomeen onwenselijk is, doordat huurders wellicht onverantwoorde risico's nemen bij het bepalen van hun huur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat de waanzin op de woningmarkt overslaat op de huursector

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of the Interior whether bidding above the asking price for rental homes is becoming common and whether rules or measures should curb it. The Minister said no figures are available, that the government has no role in agreed rents, and that she is working on rent-regulation trials and increasing supply rather than banning bidding, which falls outside the Good Landlordship bill.
A possible ban on renting out by bidding falls outside the scope of the Good Landlordship bill.
Een mogelijk verbod op verhuren per opbod valt buiten de reikwijdte van het wetsvoorstel goed verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat provincie Noord-Holland een ultimatum stelt aan gemeente Castricum om huisvesting voor statushouders te regelen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about the province of Noord-Holland's ultimatum to Castricum to arrange housing for refugee status holders, including whether the BPL landscape, grid connection delays and the BAG law hinder building, and whether the ultimatum conflicts with a national pilot. The minister answers that the province's intervention ladder is applied case by case, that sufficient building plan capacity exists, that the province is the supervisor, and that the pilot evaluation is pending.
It is up to the province, in its legal role as supervisor, to assess whether substitution is appropriate when a municipality gives no or insufficient effect to the statutory task.

Het is aan de provincie in haar wettelijke rol als toezichthouder om te beoordelen of indeplaatsstelling aan de orde is, wanneer een gemeente geen of te beperkt invulling geeft aan de wettelijke taakstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een asielgezin uit het AZC Heerlen mag worden gezet voor het weigeren van een te kleine sociale huurwoning

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that an asylum-seeker family could be evicted from a Heerlen reception centre for refusing a social rental home, and about how often status holders refuse housing. The minister answered that most refusals are accepted after their consequences become clear, that 1,598 of 1,696 refusals since 2013 were found unjustified, and that the outcome for the family is for the municipality and COA to resolve.
It is not possible to break down the above figures by household composition and region, as this is not recorded.
Het is niet mogelijk om bovenstaande cijfers op te splitsen naar gezinssamenstelling en regio, dit wordt niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het gebrek aan openheid bij de overheid

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether government openness is adequate, especially on COVID-19 information, and whether the Wob is being stretched to block disclosure. The minister agrees openness is the starting point, attributes Wob delays to volume and complexity, and points to the Woo and planned measures to improve processing.
A transparent government must be the starting point, I agree with you on that.
Een transparante overheid moet het uitgangspunt zijn, dat ben ik met u eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de toezegging die is gedaan tijdens de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen om een aantal noties over het woonbeleid op een rij te zetten

MP Omtzigt asked the government to deliver promised housing policy notes, including a concrete multi-year plan on housing construction, rent allowance, the cost-sharing norm, sale of social housing and sustainable urban development targets. Minister Ollongren answered that the notes were sent on 5 October 2021 and outlined building pathways, but declined to commit to a full plan, leaving further measures to a new cabinet and promising only a later letter on additional funding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Esch over de aanhoudende onvrede, acties en voorgenomen rechtszaken tegen ambtenaren- en lerarenpensioenfonds ABP

MPs Teunissen and Van Esch asked the ministers about public and legal pressure on pension fund ABP over fossil-fuel and animal-suffering investments, and whether public employers should tender the scheme, and whether conscientious objectors can opt out. The government answered that ABP's board independently manages investments, that ABP has decided to divest from fossil fuel producers, that tendering is not required under the Dutch statutory system, and that individual opt-out for investment objections is not possible.
The ABP board is responsible for implementing the pension scheme, including the investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur gaat over de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het in Singaporese handen vallen van de High Tech Campus Eindhoven

MP Nijboer asks whether the sale of the High Tech Campus Eindhoven to a US asset manager with Singaporean state fund GIC behind it threatens Dutch knowledge infrastructure and national interests. The minister replies that the transaction is a private real estate deal outside existing investment screening rules, that no national security risk is identified, and that the government is examining whether additional safeguards are needed.

Regarding information security and national security risks from direct access to sites where sensitive technology is used or developed, my ministry is exploring whether additional measures are necessary.

Over de informatiebeveiliging en risico's voor de nationale veiligheid bij directe toegang tot de locaties waar sensitieve technologie gebruikt of ontwikkeld wordt, verkent mijn ministerie of aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bedreigen en intimideren van een raadslid

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a mayor of Noardeast-Fryslân threatened and intimidated a councillor over a Facebook post, and whether the mayor should be called to order. The Minister answered that after an open conversation the mayor's remark about possible consequences was not intended as a threat, and that she sees no reason to call the mayor to order.
In view of this reporting, I conclude that the mayor of Noardeast-Fryslân did not threaten or intimidate a councillor.
Gelet op deze berichtgeving deel ik de conclusie dat de burgemeester van Noardeast-Fryslân een raadslid heeft bedreigd of geïntimideerd niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Markuszower en Wilders over woningweigering door statushouders

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether it is acceptable that refugee status holders (statushouders) refuse housing offers, citing reports of families expelled from a reception centre, and requested data on refusals since 2010. The minister answered that refusals are rare and mostly handled by COA's procedure, gave figures showing 1,696 refusal procedures since 2013 with 1,598 judged unjustified and 137 eviction procedures started, and rejected calls to deport such persons.
Of the total number of housing refusals, 98 were found justified and 1,598 were found unjustified.
Van het totale aantal woningweigeringen zijn er 98 terecht en 1.598 onterecht bevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel 'Wij geven passende zorg zonder dat de gemeente iets hoeft te doen'

An MP asks whether the Omgevingswet will restrict the permit-free construction of care dwellings (mantelzorgwoningen) on a relative's land, and whether municipalities will be required to allow them. The minister says the current rules are carried over unchanged, that no municipalities are known to restrict them, and that an instructieregel is not yet needed; instead local pilots on caregiver access are planned.
It is my preference to wait for developments in municipal practice and later assess whether national steering on this point is needed.
Het heeft mijn voorkeur de ontwikkelingen in de gemeentelijke praktijk af te wachten en later te bezien of er op dit punt van rijkswege sturing nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van den Hil over het bericht dat de derde ronde Woningbouwimpuls opent in september 2021

MPs Koerhuis and Van den Hil asked whether small and medium municipalities face high minimum project sizes (200 and 500 homes) under the Woningbouwimpuls and whether they may pool projects regionally. The minister answered that no such signals reached her beyond Noord- and Midden-Limburg, that joint applications are already possible if one municipality applies, and that the third round's funds are exhausted.
After the third tranche the financial resources for the Woningbouwimpuls are exhausted, so municipalities cannot submit an application for the Woningbouwimpuls after all.
Na de derde tranche zijn de financiële middelen voor de Woningbouwimpuls uitgeput, waardoor gemeenten niet alsnog een aanvraag voor de woningbouwimpuls kunnen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over de kosten van het aardgasvrij maken van woningen

MP Jansen asked the Minister of Interior about a letter from 19 municipalities that refused to provide the cost overview requested for the Aardgasvrije Wijken programme, and whether the ministry had contact with them. The minister confirmed receipt, said the ministry had not advised on the letter since it was the municipalities' own responsibility, and declined to share communications as there were none beyond being informed.
The national government has no role in this.
Het Rijk heeft hierbij geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Tegenslag voor aardgasvrij maken van woonwijken: voor¬loper Purmerend loopt vertraging op'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Purmerend gas-free neighbourhood pilot should be stopped given its delays, high costs and the lack of accountability to the central government for the subsidy. The Minister replied that the planning was not unrealistic, that costs are inherent to the experimental phase, that the Rijk will keep funding it, and that the programme's evaluation will follow in 2022.
Municipalities do not have to account to the central government for spending under this type of grant.
Gemeenten hoeven bij deze uitkeringsvorm over de uitgave geen verantwoording af te leggen aan het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over een burgemeester die een boek schreef over kritische burgerjournalisten

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked ministers about a mayor who wrote a book criticising critical citizen journalists, and about local government support for independent local journalism. The government answered that local journalism is essential, that no protocol exists for mayors, that municipalities are encouraged to develop media policy, and that the data available does not show local media budget cuts or communication spending.
No, there is no such protocol.
Nee, er is geen dergelijk protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over de interpretatie van de grondwettelijke bepalingen inzake het erfelijk koningschap, met name de artikelen 24 en 25

Two SGP MPs asked whether the government's position that a crown heir may marry a same-sex partner without renouncing the throne, and that a consent law is a sufficient route, is consistent with the constitution's closed hereditary succession and with the earlier cabinet's view that marriage implies capacity for children. The minister replied that consent is a matter for the legislature in a concrete case, that the government sees no obstacle to a consent law, and that the earlier view was less firm, without citing new advice.

It is inevitable that there is a fundamental tension with the closed system of succession in the Constitution, which precisely aims to establish on objective and unambiguous grounds who the monarchy passes to.

Het is onvermijdelijk dat er fundamenteel een spanning is met het gesloten systeem van erfopvolging in de Grondwet, dat juist beoogt om op objectieve en eenduidige gronden vast te stellen op wie het koningschap overgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over minder geld voor Texel, Bergen, Castricum, Heerhugowaard, Beemster en Den Helder uit gemeentefonds

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior why Texel, Bergen, Castricum, Heerhugowaard, Beemster and Den Helder lose Municipal Fund money under the revised distribution, citing island costs, working poverty and fears of cuts to housing and schools. The reply refers the MPs to the separate letter answering the committee's questions on the revised Municipal Fund distribution proposal, so the substance is not answered in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de nadelige gevolgen voor Groninger en Friese gemeenten van de herverdeling van het gemeentefonds

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the proposed redistribution of the municipal fund would cut funding for Groningen and Frisian municipalities, and how she would ensure fairness and avoid harming services. The answers were not included in this document; it only refers the questions to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 35 570 B, nr. 9), so the substance of the response cannot be coded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over het vasthouden van water in natuurgebieden om overstromingen te helpen voorkomen

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked about retaining water in nature areas to help prevent floods, including the role of agriculture, river space, and responsibilities across government tiers. Minister Schouten answered substantively, describing existing policy, river-widening measures and groundwater frameworks, and committing to further letters on climate adaptation for nature later this autumn.
Action lines on climate adaptation for nature will be communicated to you later this autumn.
Actielijnen klimaatadaptatie natuur u later dit najaar wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Leaseplan: alleen volledig gevaccineerden weer welkom op kantoor’

MP Bikker (ChristenUnie) asked the ministers of Health and of the Interior about a report that Leaseplan would admit only fully vaccinated staff to the office, raising concerns about coercion, bodily integrity, remote work options, transmission data and employers' legal basis for recording vaccination status. Minister De Jonge answered that vaccination is voluntary, employers may ask but not require vaccination or register status under the GDPR, and that the government is consulting sectors and will ask the OMT for advice if policy changes are warranted.
An employer may not require an employee to be vaccinated against corona.
Een werkgever mag een werknemer niet verplichten om zich te laten vaccineren tegen corona.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het loten door SNN voor het verlenen van subsidie

MP Beckerman asked whether the lottery used by SNN to order applications for the Groningen earthquake-area home improvement subsidy is acceptable and whether everyone entitled will receive it. The minister explained that lotteries are a standard way to order same-day applications, but to avoid one, sufficient budget will be made available this year for complete applications received on the cap day, with decisions by 18 November 2021, and budgets for 2022 and 2023 will be merged.
Therefore I will ensure that sufficient budget becomes available this year for those who submitted a complete application on the day the subsidy ceiling is exceeded.
Daarom zal ik ervoor zorgdragen dat er voor degenen die een volledige aanvraag hebben gedaan op de dag van overschrijding van het subsidieplafond dit jaar al voldoende budget beschikbaar komt
Antwoord vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht ‘Hoe gelijk zijn man en vrouw voor gemeenten?’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why women often lack digital access to tax records for property they co-own with men, since municipalities and water boards usually issue tax assessments in one person's name. The minister explained the legal basis and municipal discretion, said there is no legal barrier to addressing all co-owners, and committed to discussing alternatives with municipalities and water boards.
I am willing to discuss with the other tiers of government what the options are for giving all owners of a property insight into the tax records.
Ik ben bereid om met de medeoverheden te bespreken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om alle eigenaren van een eigendom inzicht te geven in de belastinggegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Peters over Europese Missie voor 100 klimaat neutrale steden tegen 2030

MPs from the CDA asked how the Dutch government will engage with the EU Cities Mission (100 climate-neutral cities by 2030), including its role in the City Climate Contract, selection criteria and funding. The State Secretary answers that BZK and EZK coordinate the mission, that the government will decide later whether to co-sign contracts, that selection is up to cities, and that about EUR 300 million is reserved at EU level without geographic earmarking.
Whether the national government should play a major role in this and how that could take shape is not yet clear at this moment.
Of de rijksoverheid hierin een grote rol moet spelen en hoe dat vorm zou kunnen krijgen, is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de interpretatie van het begrip “wettige nakomelingen” in artikel 25 en artikel 31 van de Grondwet

An MP asked the Prime Minister how the constitutional term 'wettige nakomelingen' (lawful descendants) in articles 25 and 31 should be read, including whether children from same-sex marriages, adoption, or donor/surrogacy should qualify for succession. The government answered that a successor may marry a same-sex partner without losing the throne, but declined to settle the succession status of such children now, deferring it to a future consent law and case-specific weighing.
It is not useful to anticipate such a weighing regarding succession now, in the context of a consent law.
Het is niet dienstig om nu vooruit te lopen op een dergelijke weging omtrent de erfopvolging in het kader van een toestemmingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht “Meer mensen plegen fraude om sociale huurwoning te krijgen”

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether applicants forge documents for social rental housing, whether housing corporations can verify data without access to BRP records, and whether a legal basis for data sharing should be created. The minister acknowledged the forgery problem, pointed to a digital income-check pilot and fraud-detection methods, rejected large-scale data sharing without suspicion as disproportionate, and promised an update on a related study later in the year.
Large-scale information exchange to detect fraud, where there is no suspicion, I do not consider proportionate.
Grootschalige informatie-uitwisseling om fraude op te sporen, waarbij geen sprake is van een verdenking, acht ik niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de gevolgen van de asielinstroom van Afghanistan naar Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the consequences of the Afghan asylum influx, covering monthly asylum figures, family reunification, reception in the region, housing, crime and welfare dependency. The government answered with statistics, stated it does not use quotas, declined to make some predictions, and described existing measures and planned policy steps.
The Netherlands does not work with maximums or quotas in asylum policy.
Nederland werkt in het asielbeleid niet met maxima of quota.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de woede over de bouw van een kantoorpand in de tuin van het Catshuis

Rep. Leijten (SP) asked why a new office building is being built in the Catshuis garden for temporary housing of the Ministry of General Affairs, why vacant buildings are not used, and whether the project is proportionate. The State Secretary answered that the Binnenhof renovation requires temporary housing, that other locations were explored with the Catshuis site preferred on security and cost grounds, and that the proportionality weighing (including a city council motion against it) is still ongoing and will be reported in December 2021.
This weighing is still ongoing. In the next progress report of December 2021 I will of course return to this.
Deze weging is nog steeds gaande. In de volgende voortgangsrapportage van december 2021 zal ik hier uiteraard op terugkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Nijboer en Bromet over het oplopende tekort aan studentenwoningen

MPs Nijboer and Bromet asked the Minister why the student housing shortage of about 22,000 units is growing, whether the 50 million euro allocation is enough, and why a solution is only in sight by 2028. The minister acknowledges more is needed, promises to update the national action plan with stakeholders, but says structural solutions and any separate funding scheme for student housing must await a new cabinet.
As I indicated in the committee debate of 16 September, I am going to talk with the parties to update the National Student Housing Action Plan and increase the ambition.
Zoals ik in het Commissiedebat van 16 september jl. heb aangegeven ga ik met de partijen in gesprek om het Landelijk Actieplan Studentenhuisvesting te actualiseren en de ambitie te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de enorme woningnood van internationale studenten

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of the Interior about the severe housing shortage for (international) students, including reports of students sleeping in bus shelters, and whether emergency accommodation and better warning of international students were planned. The Minister acknowledged the shortage, pointed to local responsibility and existing measures such as temporary housing in several cities, and promised to update the national housing action plan with stakeholders and to talk again with universities about information for international students.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to ensure sufficient housing at local level.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om op lokaal niveau te zorgen voor voldoende huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over studentenhuisvesting

GroenLinks MPs asked about unhoused international students sleeping in bus shelters, emergency housing, cost of emergency shelter in Groningen, the housing-benefit and cost-sharing rules for hosts, and information given to international students. The minister answers that housing is primarily a local responsibility, lists local emergency measures, explains the rules for taking in students, says the national action plan will be updated with stakeholders while structural solutions await a new cabinet, and admits the answers were not delivered within the requested five days.
It is a local responsibility to ensure there is sufficient housing.
Het is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid om te zorgen voor voldoende huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse universiteiten weer overspoeld worden door buitenlandse studenten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman (SP) asked the ministers about students sleeping in tents, emergency shelters and on couches because of the student housing shortage, and what will be done for the coming academic year. The government answered that it is working with municipalities and housers through the national student housing action plan, that universities are not primarily responsible for housing, and that it cannot easily quantify homeless students.
It is difficult to establish how many students precisely have housing problems.
Het is moeilijk na te gaan hoeveel studenten precies problemen hebben met huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gezinnen die door Vestia uit de Tweebosbuurt verdreven worden

Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Interior whether Vestia's eviction proceedings against families in the Tweebosbuurt, linked to RVV subsidy deadlines, were acceptable, and whether the UN rapporteurs' concerns and the earlier motion on resident consent were being followed. The minister answered that the matter is before the courts, that Vestia's reasons include housing, liveability and financial grounds, that a review of the RVV deadlines with Vestia will be held, and that the minister will not intervene in local consultation.
The case is now before the courts, so it is for the judge to rule on it.
Daarmee is de zaak nu onder de rechter en is het aan de rechter om een oordeel te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van ambtenaren voor een privékwestie

MP Leijten asked whether a state secretary used civil servants for advice on a private matter, whether top officials may use ministry staff for private affairs, who handles integrity enforcement, and whether the ministry should have declined. The minister answered that private matters can affect a office-holder's functioning, that the ministry supports ministers in their ministerial role, that the landsadvocaat advice cost 4,173.68 euro paid by the ministry, that integrity rules for ministers will be codified in the Blauwe Boek, and that the internal handling is described in an earlier answer.
The ministry also has the task of advising the ministers on when a matter in the private sphere affects their functioning as minister.
Het ministerie heeft mede als taak om de bewindspersonen te adviseren over de vraag wanneer een aangelegenheid in de privésfeer van invloed is op het functioneren als bewindspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Ambtenaren hielpen staatssecretaris Knops bij privékwestie'

An MP asked whether civil servants, the state's lawyer and an agency were used to handle a private matter of State Secretary Knops, including legal analyses, communication advice and a Kadaster note, and whether this was proper and should be investigated. The minister answered that private matters can affect a minister's integrity so the ministry verified facts, that the legal analysis was only background information, that the Kadaster note led to no action, that no specific rules govern this, and that no independent investigation is needed.
This subject will be included in the concrete elaboration of the code of conduct for ministers and state secretaries.
Dit onderwerp zal worden betrokken bij de concrete uitwerking van de gedragscode voor bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht dat er woede is over de handelwijze van de gemeente Den Haag inzake de aanvraag van een vergunning voor een invalidenparkeerplaats

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of the Interior whether the anger over the municipality of The Hague's handling of a disabled parking permit application was justified. The questions were withdrawn by the MP on 4 October 2021, so no substantive answers were given.

The written questions from MP Van Baarle (DENK) to the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations about the report of anger over the municipality of The Hague's handling of a permit application for a disabled parking space have been withdrawn (submitted 4 October 2021).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Baarle (DENK) aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat er woede is over de handelwijze van de gemeente Den Haag inzake de aanvraag van een vergunning voor een invalidenparkeerplaats zijn ingetrokken (ingezonden 4 oktober 2021).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Bikker over het bericht 'Geen Friese tolken meer beschikbaar vanwege 'magere vergoeding''

MPs Romke de Jong and Bikker asked about reports that Frisian interpreters are no longer available due to low fees, and how the right to use Frisian in court (Wet gebruik Friese taal art. 11) is guaranteed. The minister answered that Frisian-speaking judges and prosecutors exist, interpreters can be used, new tariff and procurement arrangements are being introduced, and a baseline survey and future bestuursafspraken are planned.
It is for my successor to give these arrangements concrete form and record them.
Het is aan mijn ambtsopvolger deze afspraken concreet vorm te geven en vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het artikel 'Bas van den Dungen toezichthouder bij Amphia'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Interior whether a top civil servant's secondary position on a hospital supervisory board was properly approved. The minister answered that the procedure under the civil service rules and integrity code was followed, with tailored conditions, and saw no obstacle to the role.
I see no obstacle to exercising this secondary position.
Ik zie geen belemmering voor het uitoefenen van deze nevenfunctie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Sjoerdsma over de pilot voor DigiD-activeringscode ontvangen via videobellen en toegankelijkheid van het Digitaal Corona Certificaat voor Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Brekelmans and Sjoerdsma asked about extending the pilot for issuing DigiD activation codes via video call to Dutch citizens abroad, its lessons, and access to the Digital Corona Certificate for citizens without BSN or DigiD. The minister said the pilot continues until structural arrangements, targeted for early 2022, are in place, reports strong demand and satisfaction, and notes the system does not record citizens' nationality or residence, so usage by group cannot be given.
The system used for the DCC does not record, for privacy reasons, to whom the DCC is issued, and therefore also not nationality or place of residence.
Het systeem dat voor DCC wordt gebruikt slaat in verband met privacy niet op aan wie het DCC wordt uitgegeven en dus ook niet de nationaliteit en woonplaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over 'opnieuw uitstel sloop en nieuwbouw in Ten Boer’

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the Interior Minister about the gemeente Groningen's refusal to build further temporary replacement homes in Ten Boer, the resulting two-year wait for residents, budget and shortages per municipality, and the slow pace of the Groningen earthquake reinforcement. Minister Ollongren answers that 35 replacement homes are available, the works are phased, the NCG has budget for temporary housing, and the Rijk targets completion of assessments by end 2023 and reinforcement by 2028.
However, arranging replacement housing themselves proves complicated for many owners.
Het zelf regelen van de wisselwoningen blijkt voor veel eigenaren echter ingewikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitkeringsafhankelijkheid en huisvesting van statushouders

An MP asks the ministers about rising benefit dependence among refugee status holders, their low education levels, the 2021 housing quota forcing municipalities to house 24,500 status holders, and whether this burdens the welfare state and housing supply. The government answers that benefit dependence falls with length of stay, that it cannot give total welfare costs, that municipalities bear housing duties under the Huisvestingswet, and lists measures to support housing and integration.
Figures are only available from the 2014 cohort onward.
Er zijn alleen cijfers beschikbaar vanaf het cohort 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de opschalingskorting op het gemeentefonds

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the municipal fund cut ('opschalingskorting'), its amounts, efficiency basis, legality under municipal finance law, and whether it will be frozen in 2022. The minister answered in full, stating the cut is not tied to new tasks, and confirmed the government decided to freeze its increase for 2022 as well.

I am of the view that the scale-up cut complies with the legal standards for deductions from the municipal fund under article 2 of the Financial Relations Act and article 108 of the Municipalities Act.
Ik ben van mening dat de opschalingskorting voldoet aan de wettelijke normen voor uitnamen uit het gemeentefonds van artikel 2 Financiële-verhoudingswet en artikel 108 Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat provincie Noord-Holland woningbouw in Callantsoog tegenhoudt

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the Noord-Holland province is blocking a 32-home housing project in Callantsoog, whether housing sites were dropped by the new environmental ordinance, and how the province handles overprogramming and small-scale building in BPL landscape areas. The minister answers that the ordinance does not drop firm municipal plans, that planning capacity is sufficient, that the 32-home project exceeds the 11-home small-scale limit, and that regional coordination and a Noord-Holland-Noord housing deal are ongoing.
No, this is not correct. The adopted environmental ordinance takes existing housing sites into account.
Nee, dit klopt niet. De vastgestelde Omgevingsverordening houdt rekening met de bestaande woningbouwlocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over brandveiligheid en overbewoning

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about fire safety and overcrowding after a fatal fire at an overcrowded house in The Hague, including whether the municipality acted adequately and whether enforcement tools against malicious landlords are sufficient. The Minister answered that municipalities hold the enforcement powers, that current instruments are generally adequate, that the repetition requirement is expected to be dropped on 1 January 2022, and that a 'goed verhuurderschap' bill is in consultation, without assessing the municipality's conduct.
It is not for me to judge whether a municipality acted adequately in a case.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen of een gemeente in een geval adequaat handelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over beleggers op de woningmarkt

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the Minister of Interior about investors buying homes, Blackstone's rent increases, data on investor purchases and rental contracts, and whether tenants in the free rental sector need stronger protection and the government should regulate rents. The Minister confirms the Kadaster figures, defends investors as needed for housing supply, describes measures taken (opkoopbescherming, transfer tax differentiation, rent caps, a planned landlord permit), says some data is unavailable, and does not commit to new rent-control or tenant-rights measures beyond ongoing studies.
I see no possibilities to reliably provide the information you requested.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden betrouwbaar in de door u gevraagde informatie te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat documentatie van woningen zeer gemakkelijk op te vragen is

An MP asked whether building drawings of homes, including those of public figures under protection, can be requested too easily and whether this enables burglaries. The minister answered that building files are public under the Wob and Archiefwet, that municipalities may restrict access via exclusion lists for risk objects, and that she will consult the VNG but sees no need for new identity checks.
Providing building drawings is a responsibility of municipalities.
Het verstrekken van bouwtekeningen is een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Koerhuis over het op straat zetten van meerderjarige weeskinderen (en/of andere medebewoners van overleden familieleden of partners)

MPs Van der Plas and Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about housing corporations evicting adult orphans and other co-residents after a family member's death, including a case in Enschede. The Minister answered that temporary tenancy contracts will be allowed via a regulation change expected around November, a code of conduct is planned by year end, further legal options are being explored, and corporations will be urged via Aedes to act humanely.

The Regulation on Admitted Housing Institutions is currently being amended so that housing corporations can offer these adult children a temporary lease, allowing them to stay longer in a social rental home.

Momenteel wordt daartoe de Regeling Toegelaten Instellingen Volkshuisvesting (RTIV) aangepast, zodat woningcorporaties deze meerderjarige kinderen een tijdelijk huurcontract aan kunnen bieden waardoor zij langer in een sociale huurwoning kunnen wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘De complotdenker bankiert maar elders, zegt de bank’

An MP asked whether banks may close accounts of clients who spread controversial messages without breaking the law, and how freedom of expression is protected against bank blocking. The government answered that banks act under AML rules, prudential integrity requirements and private contract law, that controversial views alone are insufficient grounds, and that banks must be transparent about reasons and clients can complain to Kifid or the courts, without committing to a concrete new step.
The cabinet therefore considers it important, with a view to freedom of expression, that banks are transparent when they take action based on a breach of their intention.
Het kabinet vindt het daarom, met het oog op de vrijheid van meningsuiting, van belang dat banken transparant zijn als zij actie ondernemen op basis van een overtreding van hun voornemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over malafide makelaars

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about reports from Vereniging Eigen Huis of unfair practices by estate agents (favouritism, price inflation, envelope bribes, staged 'no interest' claims) and the scale of complaints. The Minister condemned these practices, said she is working with industry bodies on binding rules for a fair, transparent and enforceable purchase process, but gave no firm timeline or legal change.
I am therefore currently working with industry associations and other relevant parties on concrete agreements on a fair, transparent and enforceable purchase process.
Ik werk daarom momenteel met brancheorganisaties en andere betrokken partijen aan concrete afspraken over een eerlijk, transparant en handhaafbaar koopproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het opkopen van vakantieparken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about buy-outs and transformation of holiday parks and campsites, including non-renewed leases, tenants' rights and municipal powers. The minister answered that data on the trend is not available, that the sector is market-driven, that parties must follow existing law, and that municipalities have planning and private-law instruments, while rejecting extending rent protection to recreational leases.
I cannot confirm that this trend exists, because the data are not available.
Ik kan niet bevestigen of er sprake is van bovengenoemde trend, omdat deze data niet voorhanden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat Vereniging Eigen Huis wordt overspoeld door klachten over makelaars

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about hundreds of complaints about estate agents reported to Vereniging Eigen Huis and whether the ministry will set rules and take further steps. The minister said she is working with the sector on binding-style rules for a fair, transparent purchase process, will report this autumn, and is not ruling out legislation, while rejecting re-regulating the profession as a quick fix.

That is why I am currently drawing up, together with the industry associations and other organisations including Vereniging Eigen Huis, clear rules for a fair, transparent and enforceable purchase process.
Daarom stel ik op dit moment samen met de brancheorganisaties en andere organisaties waaronder Vereniging Eigen Huis duidelijke regels op voor een eerlijk, transparant en handhaafbaar koopproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bespioneren van burgers door ambtenaren

An MP asks the Interior Minister about municipal officials monitoring citizens' social media, including fake accounts, whether this is illegal, whether it is a police task, and when a ministry protocol will be available. The minister answers that monitoring occurs widely under GDPR limits enforced by the privacy authority, that a monitoring guidance document is expected by year end, and that municipalities bear primary responsibility for compliance.
Enforcement is carried out by the Dutch Data Protection Authority and can lead to fines.
Handhaving vindt door de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens plaats en kan tot boetes leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over veranderingen op het gebied van woningtaxaties

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Interior Minister about rising costs and changes to mortgage valuations, including the new physical valuation report, a possible maximum price, the EBA guidelines and whether hybrid desktop valuations should be allowed. The minister replied that the sector sets its own prices, rejected a maximum price for now, pointed to cheaper hybrid valuations permitted under EBA rules, and promised to monitor costs and talk with the sector.
I will closely monitor the costs of the new model report after 1 October and where necessary engage in discussion with the sector about this.
Ik zal de kosten van het nieuwe modelrapport na 1 oktober a.s. nauw volgen en waar nodig het gesprek met de sector hierover aangaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen voor Nederland van het Pegasus-hack-schandaal

MPs Van Dijk asked whether the government knew of Pegasus spyware abuse against Dutch politicians, journalists, lawyers and human rights defenders, whether Dutch institutions use the software, and how it views the conviction of Moroccan journalist Omar Radi. The ministers said they were unaware of any list of Dutch targets, that Dutch agencies may use special powers under legal safeguards without disclosing details, that they cannot verify the basis of Radi's conviction, and that they find the surveillance unacceptable while pursuing export controls and cybersecurity norms.
In general, Dutch institutions are not permitted to hack into automated systems.
In het algemeen geldt dat het Nederlandse instellingen niet is toegestaan binnen te dringen in geautomatiseerde werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over dat er negen jaar na de aardbeving bij Huizinge een chronische ramp gaande is in Groningen

An MP asks whether the Groningen earthquake reconstruction is delivering on its promises, given delays, unequal treatment of victims, and unresolved cases; the minister defends progress (more homes in works, a reconstruction target of 2028) but acknowledges delays, a missed 1 July deadline, and that some cases remain unclear. The government answers most questions on substance, promises letters and an intervention team, and withholds nothing material.
The previously communicated date of 1 July 2021 for the reinforcement advice to these residents was unfortunately not met.
De eerder gecommuniceerde datum van 1 juli 2021 voor het versterkingsadvies aan deze bewoners is helaas niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Van Ginneken over een lek van privéadressen van volksvertegenwoordigers en politieke en maatschappelijke organisaties door de Kamer van Koophandel

MPs Simons and Van Ginneken asked ministers about a leak of private home addresses of MPs and political and civil-society organisations via the Chamber of Commerce, in which a former lawyer had unlawfully retrieved about 1,785 addresses. The government answered that the lawyer's authorisation was revoked, a criminal complaint filed, the police investigate, and that authorisations are being audited and address protections expanded.
Following the unauthorised retrieval, the Chamber of Commerce filed a criminal complaint against the lawyer.
De KVK heeft naar aanleiding van de onbevoegde opvraging aangifte gedaan tegen de advocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het lobbyverbod voor oud-bewindspersonen en de overstap van de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

An MP asked the government whether the post-office lobbying ban for former ministers still applies after the circular was withdrawn, whether officials may contact former ministers acting as lobbyists, and whether the ban should be legally anchored, including the Van Nieuwenhuizen case. The government confirmed the ban remains in force via the Gedragscode Integriteit Rijk and Handboek, noted it is still considering further measures for former ministers, and gave only partial answers on sanctions, exceptions and legal anchoring.
The cabinet is still considering whether further measures for former office-holders are desirable.
Het kabinet beraadt zich nog op de wenselijkheid van nadere maatregelen voor gewezen bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de subsidie Verduurzaming en Verbetering voor gedupeerden in Groningen, die binnen 5 dagen op is

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked why the 2021 budget for the Groningen home-improvement subsidy ran out within five days and whether all eligible owners can be reached, including the number of eligible homes and the regimes in place. The ministers answer that the subsidy is phased over three years by design, that no legal entitlement exists, and that they will raise the ceiling via a Staatscourant amendment if needed, though they do not commit to extra funding now.
This year €75 million was available, for which more than 8,100 owners submitted an application.
Dit jaar was € 75 mln. beschikbaar, waar door meer dan 8.100 eigenaren een aanvraag hebben ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Baarle over de sloop van de Tweebosbuurt en de VN brief aan Rotterdam

MPs Beckerman and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Interior about the demolition of the Tweebosbuurt in Rotterdam, the UN rapporteurs' communication alleging human rights violations, and resident participation. The minister answered that dialogue with the UN and the municipality continues, that the courts are handling the appeal on the demolition, and that housing policy is a matter for local authorities, declining to order an independent investigation or halt the demolition.
An appeal has currently been lodged in this case, so it is for the court to assess whether the residents have been sufficiently involved.
Op dit moment is in deze casus een hoger beroep ingesteld, het is daarom aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de bewoners voldoende zijn betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat criminelen een slaatje proberen te slaan uit oververhitte woningmarkt

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that criminals are exploiting the overheated housing market through fake rental sites, asking about complaint volumes, prevention, enforcement and the ACM investigation. The minister answered that fraud reports are stable, prevention campaigns were run, the ACM investigation is ongoing with results expected in spring 2022, and no additional criminal-law measures are deemed necessary now.

That is why it is very good that the national police Internet Fraud Reporting Point, the Fraud Helpdesk and the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) each act from their own role against this problem.

Het is daarom heel goed dat het Landelijk Meldpunt Internetoplichting van de politie, de Fraudehelpdesk en de Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM) ieder vanuit hun eigen rol optreden tegen deze problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Europese Handvest inzake Lokale Autonomie

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Interior whether the Netherlands recognises Article 11 of the European Charter of Local Self-Government, whether the Wet arhi complies with it, and whether municipalities can challenge a forced merger before a Dutch judge on that basis. The Minister answered yes to recognising the article, but explained that the Netherlands has a reservation excluding Article 11, so municipalities cannot invoke it and the Council of State confirmed this in 2011.
However, the Netherlands has made a reservation regarding, among other things, Article 11 of the Charter.
Nederland heeft echter bij onder andere artikel 11 van het Handvest een voorbehoud gemaakt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de handelswijze van de provincie Gelderland bij de herindeling Barneveld-Scherpenzeel

MP Leijten asks the Minister of Interior whether a merger of Barneveld and Scherpenzeel can be pushed through despite an 82% referendum majority against, whether the province approached MPs, and whether an integrity investigation is warranted. The Minister answers that a merger without broad support is permissible in exceptional cases under the Wet arhi, that the province initiated it, that the impending advice will be assessed on its merits, and that no formal integrity investigation request was received, so none is needed.
That a large majority of residents oppose the proposed solution of a merger is an important factor and must be taken into account in weighing the desirability of the merger.

Dat een ruime meerderheid van de inwoners tegen de voorgestelde oplossing van een herindeling is, is een belangrijk gegeven en dient als zodanig in de afweging over de wenselijkheid van de herindeling betrokken te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Erkens over het bericht inzake overbelasting van elektriciteitsnetten in wijken

MPs Koerhuis and Erkens asked whether electricity grids in neighbourhoods are becoming overloaded, blocking solar connections, new businesses and new homes, and what the government will do. The state secretary confirms growing transport scarcity, points to existing measures and the planned Energy Act, and says new homes may be allowed gas connections where grid capacity is lacking.
Netbeheer Nederland is still working on a national overview of scarce transport capacity for electricity offtake and expects to have it ready this autumn.
Netbeheer Nederland werkt nog aan een landelijk overzicht van schaarse transportcapaciteit voor de afname van elektriciteit en verwacht dat dit najaar gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat onafhankelijke experts grote vraagtekens zetten bij het Amsterdamse erfpachtstelsel

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Amsterdam's erfpacht (leasehold land) system gives homeowners adequate consumer protection and legal certainty, following a critical Berenschot report, and whether the ministry should intervene. The Minister answered that consumer protection is adequately secured through complaint procedures, the ombudsman, local democratic oversight and the courts, that erfpacht is a matter for the Amsterdam municipality to address, and declined to commit to national legal measures.
In general terms, I am of the view that consumer protection for leasehold is sufficiently secured.
In algemene zin ben ik van mening dat de consumentenbescherming bij erfpacht voldoende is geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat experts een bom leggen onder het Amsterdamse erfpachtstelsel

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether leasehold policy in Amsterdam is opaque, unequal and burdensome for residents, and what the government thinks of a report critical of the city. The minister answered that the matter is primarily municipal, denied that Amsterdam neglects leaseholders' interests, and pointed to the city's own transparency steps and ongoing review.
Leasehold policy is determined per municipality and in my view is first and foremost a municipal matter.
Het erfpachtbeleid wordt per gemeente bepaald en is daarmee in mijn ogen in de eerste plaats een gemeentelijke aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over de fatale brand in Arnhem en lessen voor brandveiligheid

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked about the fatal Arnhem flat fire, fire-safety supervision of existing buildings, single-escape-route flats, and fire safety of mattresses and upholstered furniture. The minister said she will respond to the Onderzoeksraad recommendations within six months, await an IFV study due in October, and promised further consultation with municipalities and building owners, but did not commit to specific new regulation.
I am going to talk with municipalities and building owners about this supervision.
Ik ga in gesprek met gemeenten en gebouweigenaren over dit toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over toenemend antisemitisme

An MP asked the government about rising antisemitism, reports of Jewish emigration and bullying of Jewish pupils, and what it would do about them. The minister described existing and planned measures (a national antisemitism coordinator, EU strategy, school safety duties and inspectorate oversight) without committing to new concrete steps.
A school must be a safe environment for everyone.
Een school moet voor iedereen een veilige omgeving zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het bericht 'Nog slag te slaan: helft Nederlandse kantoren voldoet niet aan juiste energielabel'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about a report finding half of Dutch offices fail the required energy label and about enforcement of the label C obligation for offices by 2023. The minister replied that RVO monitoring matches the Colliers figures, that owners were informed via letters and intermediaries, that government buildings are to be upgraded through portfolio routemaps, and that municipalities, as the competent authority, decide on sanctions.
The competent authority is the municipality. The municipality ultimately determines which sanction is appropriate.
Het bevoegd gezag is de gemeente. De gemeente bepaalt uiteindelijk welke sanctie passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de problemen rondom Paleis Soestdijk

An MP asked why the buyer of Paleis Soestdijk changed its plans substantially after purchase, whether the sale can be reversed, and whether public money should cover a budget gap, and asked how the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf views the sale process. The State Secretary answered that post-sale changes were approved as optimisations within the buyer's concept, the buyer bears the financial risk and the sale cannot be reversed, and the sale followed a careful, formally prescribed procedure.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf approved the proposed changes because it judged them to be elaborations/optimisations that fit within the proposed concept.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf heeft de voorgestelde wijzigingen goedgekeurd omdat het van oordeel was dat het ging om uitwerkingen/optimalisaties die binnen het voorgestelde concept pasten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de elementen dwang en draagvlak binnen het aardgasvrij maken van de gebouwde omgeving

An MP asked the minister to define 'dwang' (coercion) and 'draagvlak' (public support) in the Aardgasvrije Wijken programme and whether coercion is applied in pilot neighbourhoods and under the new collective heat law. The minister answered that residents cannot currently be forced off gas, that municipalities will later be given a not-yet-defined power to end gas supply with safeguards, that support is a municipal responsibility measured partly via satisfaction surveys, and that the draft collective heat bill contains no coercion.
I therefore cannot yet go into your specific questions.
Op uw specifieke vragen kan ik daarom nog niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de zeggenschap over veiligheidsregio’s

Two SP MPs asked how much say municipalities still have over safety regions, what happens if municipalities refuse higher contributions or cannot pay, whether funding is adequate, and about conditions and plans for merging safety regions. The minister replied that municipal mayors and councils retain governance and budget influence, that contributions are binding once adopted, that funding comes via the general municipal fund with some tension over priorities, and that no concrete merger request exists while the ministry will weigh boundary criteria and regional support if one arises.
My current policy is not to take any steps to push safety regions towards merging, but to consider any proposals from safety region boards to merge.
Mijn huidige beleid is geen activiteiten te ontplooien om veiligheidsregio’s tot fusie te bewegen, maar eventuele voorstellen van besturen van veiligheidsregio’s om te fuseren in overweging te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Utrecht krijgt Overvecht niet van het gas af en doet dringend beroep op het Rijk’

An MP asks whether the Utrecht Overvecht-Noord natural-gas-free pilot is a failure and how the government reconciles the pilot's planned forced gas disconnection with parliament's motion against dwangsom-based coercion. The minister replies that the pilot is a learning exercise, that Utrecht has committed to voluntary participation, cost neutrality for residents and no fines, and that any future coercive powers are a matter for the next cabinet.
In the December 2020 letter I informed the House, based on Utrecht's commitments, that imposing a penalty payment on residents in Utrecht Overvecht-Noord will not arise.

Antwoord 11 In de brief van december 2020 8 heb ik de Tweede Kamer op basis van de toezeggingen van de gemeente Utrecht gemeld dat het opleggen van een dwangsom aan bewoners in Utrecht Overvecht-Noord niet aan de orde zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de ceo die altijd een Minister kan bellen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior why large companies have so much contact with ministries and whether lobbying access is fair, and whether ministers should publish the number and type of meetings, citing an OECD report on lobby transparency. The Minister replied that what matters is a fair and equal access process, that ministers weigh interests themselves, that the government sees no sign Dutch lobbying is less transparent than elsewhere, and that it sees no need to publish meeting lists, though the OECD report will inform integrity policy.
The cabinet has no indications that lobbying in the Netherlands is conducted less transparently than in other countries.
Het kabinet heeft geen indicaties dat lobbyen in Nederland op minder transparante wijze verloopt dan in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Baarle en Sneller over het bericht dat Nederland met de regels voor lobbyisten ver achterop zou raken

MPs Van Baarle and Sneller asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch lobbying rules lag behind other countries, including OECD findings, UK disclosure duties, revolving-door rules and the withdrawn lobbying-ban circular. The minister disputes that Netherlands is far behind, says a lobbying register and integrity code exist, promises new rules for former ministers and a possible code of conduct for ministers, but leaves a supervisory body and some measures to a future cabinet.
The Netherlands has no official supervisory body for lobbying activities, but that does not mean lobbying activities can take place without any restriction.
Nederland kent geen officiële toezichthouder op lobbyactiviteiten, maar dat betekent niet dat lobbyactiviteiten in Nederland zonder enige restrictie kunnen plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Kops over het bericht dat er weer miljoenen worden uitgetrokken voor de huisvesting van asielzoekers

MPs Markuszower and Kops asked whether millions spent on renovating the Gilze asylum centre and on housing for asylum seekers, including a EUR 50 million housing scheme, is justified given the Dutch housing shortage. The government answered that the renovation maintains monumental COA buildings and that the EUR 50 million scheme is mostly unearmarked, serves several priority groups, and eases pressure on social housing, while refusing to end asylum reception.
Of this amount, EUR 3 million is specifically earmarked for developing so-called interim facilities.
Van dit bedrag is € 3 miljoen specifiek bestemd voor het ontwikkelen van zogeheten tussenvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Rijk belemmert gemeenten in armoedebeleid' en het niet uitvoeren van de motie over dit onderwerp

An MP asked why the government has not implemented an adopted motion to raise the asset limit for local tax waiver to the Participatiewet level, and whether it will do so before 1 July 2021. The minister confirms non-implementation, citing the demissionary cabinet's reluctance, the different purposes of tax waivers and benefits, poverty-trap and tax-burden effects, and refuses to commit to a timeline, leaving the matter to a successor cabinet.
The cabinet has not yet implemented the broadly adopted motion, because the current demissionary cabinet does not consider it opportune to decide on this now.
Het kabinet heeft de breed aangenomen motie nog niet uitgevoerd, omdat het huidige demissionaire kabinet het niet opportuun acht om hier nu over te beslissen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Markuszower over het mét subsidie huisvesten van grote statushoudersgezinnen

MPs Kops and Markuszower (PVV) asked why municipalities receive subsidies to house large refugee-status-holder families, calling it absurd and unfair to Dutch housing seekers. The State Secretary defended the scheme as necessary because large families stay too long in COA reception, and refused to end it or to have refugees find housing abroad.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Pieter Heerma over belemmeringen bij hypothecaire financiering van verduurzaming eigen woning

CDA MPs asked why few lenders use the no-advice route for extra mortgages to finance home insulation, and whether the five-year limit and taxation costs should be dropped. The minister said the route was only recently opened and systems take time, kept the five-year limit for consumer-knowledge reasons, and pointed to hybrid valuations and subsidies as cost mitigations.

I see no reason to drop the five-year limit because it cannot simply be assumed that after five years the knowledge about the financial product is still sufficient to take out an additional mortgage without advice.

Ik zie geen reden om de termijn van vijf jaar te laten vervallen omdat er niet zonder meer vanuit kan worden gegaan dat na deze periode van vijf jaar de kennis over het financieel product nog voldoende is om zonder advies een aanvullende hypotheek af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat woonwagenbewoners, gemeente Haarlem en corporaties een actieplan maken voor woonwagenbewoners

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior whether other municipalities should be urged to make action plans for caravan dwellers, and raised mortgage and fire insurance access, the shortage of standplaatsen, and the lack of regional and national action. The Minister said she will encourage municipalities through a knowledge programme and a funding scheme rather than require action plans, will talk with lenders and insurers, and will wait for results before considering further instruments.
I do not want to use the data from the repeat measurement now to approach or name individual municipalities.
Ik wil de gegevens uit de Herhaalmeting nu nog niet gebruiken om individuele gemeenten te benaderen of te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een geheime vertrekdeal van een VVD-wethouder de samenleving een kwart miljoen kan kosten

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a secret departure deal for a VVD alderman that could cost the public a quarter million euros, about the entitlement to post-service benefits, and about the state of municipal dualisation. The minister answered that the alderman's pension entitlement under the Appa is automatic and independent of the reason for leaving, declined to change the law based on one case, and described past steps to strengthen the council's position.
I therefore see no reason, based on this single case, to amend the law on this essential point.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om op basis van dit ene geval de wet op dit wezenlijke punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Smeulders over de funderingsproblematiek in Friesland en over het artikel 'Provincie Fryslân gaat huiseigenaren betrekken bij oplossen funderingsschade'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about foundation damage in Friesland caused by lowered water tables in peat meadow areas, and about the responsibility, legal framework and lack of data on affected homes. The minister explained that water boards and municipalities bear care duties, that compensation depends on whether a water-level change is lawful and natural subsidence, that no research on the specific problem exists, and that the cabinet's response to the advisory report was sent to the House.
No research is currently being carried out to map this specific problem.
Er wordt op dit moment geen onderzoek uitgevoerd om deze specifieke problematiek in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ellian over het bericht inzake vertraging woningbouw door tekort aan capaciteit in rechtspraak

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that housing construction in Rotterdam (about 1,310 homes) is stalled because Council of State court cases take too long. The minister acknowledged that durations at the Administrative Jurisdiction Division are longer than desired for some cases, explained the statutory deadlines and causes of delay, noted she cannot say how many projects are stalled, and said no extra funds were given specifically to building cases.
On the basis of the available data I cannot state how many appeal cases concerning housing projects are not decided within statutory deadlines and therefore remain too long before the judge.
Ik kan op basis van de beschikbare gegevens niet aangeven hoeveel beroepszaken over woningbouwprojecten niet binnen wettelijke termijnen worden afgedaan en derhalve te lang bij de rechter liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, Bromet en Kathmann over het bericht ‘raadsleden pleiten voor modernisering verlofregeling’

Four MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether leave arrangements for councillors should be modernised, following a letter from three municipal councils. The Minister said the current leave rules for elected representatives were a deliberate choice, that broader leave is not warranted, and that she will consult professional associations and administrative bodies on possible flexibilisation, leaving any legislative change to her successor.

I want to see whether the Dutch Association of Councillors, the Dutch Association of Provincial Members and the Association of Water Board Members support the call for a more flexible arrangement set out in the letter.

Ik wil bezien of de Nederlandse Vereniging van Raadsleden, de Nederlandse Vereniging van Statenleden en de Vereniging van algemeen bestuursleden van de Waterschappen het pleidooi voor een flexibeler regeling uit de brief ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een melding van een poging tot Russische beïnvloeding van het Nederlandse parlement in een la verdween

An MP asked whether a report of an attempted Russian influence on parliament went missing and how the parliamentary security office cooperates with the AIVD, plus questions on foreign political financing. The minister explained the standard reporting channel, said no comment on individual reports, and pointed to the pending Wfpp amendment banning donations from third countries and making EU/EEA donations fully transparent.
As a rule, no public statements are made about individual reports to the AIVD.
In de openbaarheid worden in de regel geen uitspraken gedaan over individuele meldingen aan de AIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Kort over het bericht inzake vriendjespolitiek in de Eemshaven

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether municipal councils and provincial states could approve land purchase, development and sale frameworks for the Eemshaven port company, how transparent such land deals are, and whether councillors may hold executive posts in joint regulations. The minister answered that the port was corporatised in 2013 with council and states approval, that ministerial supervision is risk-based and no longer requires approval for private law entities since 2016, that council representation in joint regulations is appropriate, and that she will ask the BBV commission to pay attention to transparency.

I will additionally ask the BBV commission whether special attention can be paid to how municipalities, provinces and joint regulations should give shape to this when land policy activities are placed with a private law entity at a distance.
Ik zal de commissie BBV aanvullend vragen of bijzondere aandacht kan worden besteed aan de manier waarop gemeenten, provincies en gemeenschappelijke regelingen hier invulling aan dienen te geven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de brief van Aedes voor Commissiedebat Wonen en Corona

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about housing association Aedes' letter on evicting orphaned children, the implementation of the Koerhuis motion, and whether housing rules or rent allowance should be changed for young adults who lost parents. The Minister said she will amend the Rtiv 2015 to allow temporary leases for adult orphans, draft a code of conduct, and that the age limit issue for rent allowance requires a future cabinet's integral assessment.
To make this possible, I intend to amend the Regulation on admitted housing institutions (Rtiv) 2015 in the short term.
Om dit mogelijk te maken wil ik op korte termijn de Regeling toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting (Rtiv) 2015 aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Alphen aan den Rijn mag in enquête kiezen tussen windmolens en windmolens’

MP Leijten asked whether municipal surveys on wind turbines using leading questions and selective targeting, as in Alphen aan den Rijn, undermine representative public support and trust, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said participation is the regions' responsibility, that manipulation would be unacceptable, that the reported survey contains factual errors, and that PBL will be asked to analyse participation in the RES plans, with no separate investigation planned.
If the results of such a survey were manipulated, I would disapprove of that.
Als de resultaten van een dergelijk onderzoek gemanipuleerd zouden worden, keur ik dat af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Beckerman over brandveiligheid van gebouwen in Nederland

MPs Koerhuis and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior why fire safety of buildings has still not been fully mapped nearly four years after Grenfell, and questioned provinces' and municipalities' handling of the inventory, including municipalities that have not reported. The Minister answers that provinces and municipalities have policy discretion, that an inventory is being completed with a follow-up survey of 80 municipalities this year, and that she will inform the House at year end.
Provinces have policy discretion over how interadministrative supervision is given shape.
Provincies hebben beleidsvrijheid hoe aan het interbestuurlijke toezicht vorm wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Ruimte voor half miljoen woningen in het groen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about an EIB report claiming 500,000 homes could be built in green areas, whether the national government should take more control of housing construction and override Utrecht's wind turbine plans at Rijnenburg, and whether closing borders to asylum seekers and immigrants from Islamic countries would ease the housing shortage. The minister replied that planned capacity is sufficient until 2030, that peripheral building is locally constrained and not feasible before 2030, that regional steering will be strengthened with the next cabinet, that the Rijnenburg case is addressed in a separate letter, and that border closure is not a realistic solution.
I share the conclusion that it will not be possible to build a million homes only within urban areas.
Ik deel de conclusie dat het niet zal lukken om een miljoen woningen alleen binnenstedelijk te bouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Tussen Zwolle, Hasselt en Kampen een stad zo groot als Lelystad? 'Er is plek voor''

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of the Interior about an EIB study suggesting a new city of Lelystad's size could be built between Zwolle, Hasselt and Kampen, and about whether wind-energy search areas should yield to housing. The minister replied that sufficient planning capacity exists to 2030, that peripheral building is locally constrained and must be weighed regionally, and that no study of scrapping wind zones is needed.
I therefore see no need for such a study.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak voor een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het buitensluiten van mensen door de digitale wereld.

An MP asked the minister whether people who are not digitally skilled can participate in society, how many lack digital skills and internet access, how the motion requiring low-threshold human contact with government is being implemented, and whether banks, insurers and housing corporations will be engaged on offline contact. The state secretary answers that digital inclusion programmes, information points and a statutory duty of appropriate assistance in a pending bill are under way, cites figures on digital skills and home internet, and says private sectors bear responsibility for their own services and the DigiHulplijn is being promoted.
Therefore the bill provides for a general duty of care for the government to offer appropriate support in communication with the government.
Daarom voorziet het wetsvoorstel in een algemene zorgplicht voor de overheid om passende ondersteuning te bieden bij communicatie met de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten niet willen stoppen met oneigenlijk informatie verzamelen over hun inwoners

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether municipalities that continue collecting personal information about residents improperly, despite privacy law, will be sanctioned and how quickly this will stop. The minister replied that municipalities are responsible for complying with privacy rules themselves, that she will raise it with the VNG and municipalities, and that she has had administrative contact with the VNG with a further letter to Parliament before the summer recess.
Where compliance and internal supervision fall short, I will raise this in my discussions with the VNG and municipalities.
Wanneer naleving en intern toezicht tekort schieten, zal ik hier in mijn gesprekken met de VNG en gemeenten aandacht voor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten mensen online in de gaten houden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether citizens monitored online by municipalities are informed and can object, and whether the central government sets a bad example in monitoring and profiling residents. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for GDPR compliance, that people can object to processing, that a Rijksbrede monitoring guideline is being developed, and that she will raise the issue with the VNG.
People can object to forms of processing at the relevant municipality or ask for rectification or modification.
Mensen kunnen bij de desbetreffende gemeente tegen vormen van verwerking bezwaar maken of vragen om rectificatie of wijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de mogelijke herindeling van de gemeente Scherpenzeel

MP Van Houwelingen asked the Minister of Interior whether the Gelderland provincial executive's lobbying for a Scherpenzeel municipal merger had been sent to or discussed with the ministry. The minister confirmed awareness of the article, said the position paper was not sent to or discussed with the ministry, and noted that ministry contact with the municipalities and province has not covered it.
No. The document referred to in the article – the position paper on the Scherpenzeel/Barneveld merger process – was not sent to me nor discussed with me.
Nee. Het document waar in het artikel aan wordt gerefereerd – position paper herindelingstraject Scherpenzeel/Barneveld – is niet naar mij gestuurd of met mij besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de nieuwe Oekaze Kok en de soepeler omgang met het contact tussen ambtenaren en Kamerleden
