MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked why the revised guidelines on external contacts of civil servants with MPs still cause uncertainty and fear among officials, and whether the rules are in fact looser than the former Oekaze Kok. The minister answers that the rules are meant to be more permissive, outlines awareness training and a planned debate, and defends the remaining limits on civil servants' contact with Parliament as flowing from ministerial responsibility.
The cabinet wishes to stress that the rules have certainly not become stricter, but that the revision has in fact created more room for contacts between civil servants and MPs.
Het kabinet wil vooropstellen dat de regels zeker niet strenger zijn geworden, maar dat er met de herziening juist méér ruimte is gekomen voor contacten tussen rijksambtenaren en Kamerleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht 'PUR-spuiter Eco Isolatie mag van Reclame Code Commissie niet claimen dat gespoten PUR-schuim milieuvriendelijk is'

An MP asks the government about advertising claims that sprayed PUR foam insulation is environmentally friendly, the health risks identified by the Health Council, and whether it will phase out or regulate the product. The minister answers that the advertising body's ruling suffices, that no new phase-out or campaign is planned, that a practice evaluation and a meeting with the sector will follow, and that the current subsidy and building rules remain in place.
I do not intend to start phasing out sprayed PUR foam.
Ik ben niet voornemens om te starten met het uitfaseren van gespoten PUR-schuim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het feit dat de provincie Noord-Holland woningbouw in Landsmeer tegenhoudt

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of the Interior why the province of Noord-Holland is blocking housing in Landsmeer, and whether the Minister has spoken only with the province and not with the municipality. The Minister answers that contact with both parties has taken place, that housing is a provincial competence in the region, that eight discussion locations were dropped in BPL landscape areas affecting only soft plans, and that a maatwerk approach for linear settlements is being developed.
Therefore this topic will soon be discussed in consultation between my ministry and the deputy minister for spatial planning and housing of Noord-Holland.
Daarom komt dit onderwerp binnenkort aan de orde tijdens overleg tussen mijn ministerie en de gedeputeerde Ruimtelijke ordening en wonen van Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over misstanden bij bouwtechnische keuringen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about abuses in building inspections for house purchases, including inspectors hired by sellers understating defects, lead fees paid by inspectors to estate agents, and weak quality and liability rules. The Minister acknowledges concerns and urges sector professionalisation and transparency, but rules out mandatory inspections or a system overhaul for now, while promising continued dialogue with the sector and possible further measures if progress is insufficient.
If insufficient progress is made, I do not rule out additional measures.
Als er onvoldoende progressie wordt gemaakt sluit ik aanvullende maatregelen niet uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het Meldpunt huurtoeslag van de Woonbond

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked about the Woonbond's housing benefit complaints line and the tax authority's handling of housing, care and child benefit cases, including wrongful intent/gross negligence labels. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, estimated about 500 affected citizens in comparable cases, and said a compensation scheme is being prepared, with acute cases able to apply for emergency support now.
These reports confirm the need for a restoration scheme.
Deze meldingen bevestigen de noodzaak van een herstelregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over antiziganisme, de National Roma Integration Strategy en stateloosheid

MP Van Baarle (DENK) asked the government about anti-Gypsyism, the EU Roma integration strategy, and statelessness among Dutch Roma. The minister answered that policy is generic anti-discrimination plus targeted Roma/Sinti measures, that no data exist on stateless Roma, and that existing law already gives Roma the same naturalisation rights as other aliens.
No data are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de kosten van taxaties

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the lack of agreement between banks and the valuation sector on hybrid property valuations, their costs, and whether the cheaper desktop valuation for small changes will remain the norm. The minister answered that two competing hybrid products will be available after 30 June, that costs are not yet known and will be monitored, and that the regulator NRVT and the ECB/DNB will assess compliance with EBA guidelines without the minister commenting on that.
It is not for me to assess whether the developed valuation products comply with the EBA guidelines.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of de ontwikkelde taxatieproducten voldoen aan de richtsnoeren van de EBA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van de vragen over het feit dat mevrouw Bunschoten met drie kinderen door corporatie Dudok feitelijk op straat wordt gezet

An MP asked whether a divorced mother of three being effectively evicted by housing corporation Dudok fits the human-scale approach, and whether Article 1.7 of the local housing ordinance allows corporations to help such tenants. The minister said individual assessment at local level is appropriate, that Article 1.7 is for existing tenants rather than applicants, and that she will inform parliament after the summer on the problem of divorced parents.
I will inform the House about this after the summer, involving the various stakeholders.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover na de zomer informeren, waarbij ik tevens de verschillende stakeholders zal betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over winsten die worden gemaakt met publiek geld voor verduurzaming

SP MPs asked the government about private profits from publicly subsidised wind and solar, electricity bills, overcompensation under the SDE+ scheme, and the Court of Audit's findings. The State Secretary maintained that overwinsten are limited by the tender design and PBL cost estimates, committed to a new evaluation and to monitoring participation, but refused to quantify private profits and rejected socialising renewable energy.
I have no direct insight into the amount of private profit made with SDE+ subsidies.
Ik heb geen direct inzicht in de hoeveelheid private winst die is gemaakt met SDE+-subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat bouwen in het oosten goedkoper is

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior about reports that building in eastern Netherlands is cheaper, whether further research into building more homes there is needed, how housing plans there are being accelerated, and the status of the Arnhem–Nijmegen housing deal, a motion on a Zwolle–Deventer–Apeldoorn deal, and a stikstof-related motion. The minister answered that planning capacity in Overijssel and Gelderland is sufficient to 2030 so additional research is unnecessary, listed acceleration programmes and agreements, reported progress on the Arnhem–Nijmegen deal, and said talks on the Zwolle–Deventer–Apeldoorn deal are ongoing with the decision left to the next cabinet.
It is up to the new cabinet to ultimately make a decision on this.
Het is aan het nieuwe kabinet om hier uiteindelijk een besluit over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen door de coronapandemie

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the government how socioeconomic health inequalities have grown due to the coronavirus pandemic, and how communication about vaccination and measures reaches people who are digitally or functionally illiterate, and how many communication staff the government employs. The minister answered that research on the widening gap is ongoing with results expected by year-end, cited existing data and studies, listed communication staff numbers (811.5 fte at department communication directorates, 15 fte on the vaccination communication team), and described outreach tools for low-literacy and digitally less skilled groups.
It is expected that in the coming months it will become clearer what the consequences of the pandemic are for socioeconomic health inequalities in the Netherlands.
Naar verwachting zal de komende maanden meer duidelijk worden wat de gevolgen zijn van de pandemie voor de sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Özütok en Westerveld over de blijvende tekorten voor jeugdzorg bij gemeenten

MPs Kuiken, Özütok and Westerveld asked whether the government should have resolved the chronic youth care funding shortfall at municipalities earlier, and why no extra money was provided now. The State Secretary replied that the government granted temporary funds (over EUR 1 billion for 2021 and EUR 1.314 billion for 2022), agreed savings with municipalities, committed to a reform agenda, and that a new cabinet must decide on structural funding taking the Commission of Wise Men's ruling as a weighty input.
The cabinet makes available an additional EUR 1.314 billion to municipalities in 2022 for the youth care shortfalls.
Het kabinet stelt in 2022 € 1,314 miljard extra beschikbaar aan gemeenten voor de tekorten vanwege de jeugdzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Plannen voor daklozenwoningen belanden te vaak in ijskast’

MPs Van den Hil and Koerhuis asked whether homelessness housing plans are stalling, how many of the 10,000 supported housing places have been realised, and whether temporary housing, prioritisation and municipal data are adequate. The State Secretary answered that municipalities report about 2,200 places realised by end 2020 (on track by their own measure), with overlapping figures from housing associations and the BZK fund, acknowledged delays due to COVID, and deferred further prioritisation and additional measures to a future cabinet.
It is up to a future cabinet to determine how the follow-up is shaped.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om te bepalen hoe het vervolg vorm wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de steeds meer voorkomende «nep-sociale huur» en over de verhoging van de maximaal toegestane verkoopprijs bij sociale koopwoningen

MPs Grinwis asked about municipalities programming temporarily affordable 'social rent' from commercial parties, its long-term effects, and raising the maximum price for social owner-occupied homes to the NHG limit. The minister answered that municipalities have discretion, that regulated rent from commercial landlords lacks corporation duties such as passend toewijzen, and that the price cap rise aims to help build affordable starter homes in tight markets.
Private landlords do not have this task.
Particuliere verhuurders hebben deze taak niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Hijink en Leijten over het afschuiven van uitbetalingen bij letselschade door verzekeraars aan gemeenten

MPs Van Nispen, Hijink and Leijten (SP) asked about insurers redirecting injury-claim victims to municipalities for costs insurers should bear, and about slow payouts and municipal recovery of costs. The minister answered that insurers may not require victims to first go to the municipality, that victims may choose, that no fixed settlement term exists, and that municipalities are responsible for recovering costs, with no direct national role beyond pointing to a convenant option.
An insurer of the liable party may not require a victim to first approach the municipality to claim support under the Social Support Act 2015.

Een verzekeraar van de aansprakelijke partij mag niet van een slachtoffer verlangen dat hij zich eerst tot de gemeente wendt voor een beroep op ondersteuning via de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte’

Rep. Van der Plas (BBB) asked the ministers of Interior and Agriculture about the PBL report 'Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte', questioning its omissions on food production, its treatment of farmland, housing targets, solar and wind land claims, and datacenter space. The ministers answered that the PBL is independent, that the report takes existing policy as its baseline, and that the housing figure derives from the National Environmental Vision and Primos projections.
The PBL report 'Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte' focuses on the spatial choices the new cabinet must make.
Het PBL-rapport «Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte» richt zich op de ruimtelijke keuzes die het nieuwe kabinet moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat huurders vaak honderden euro’s teveel betalen

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of the Interior about reports that tenants overpay hundreds of euros in the free rental sector, the shrinking supply of mid-rent homes, the rise in Rent Commission cases in 2020, and how to get more tenants to contest rents. The minister acknowledges overpayment in some urban cases, says the Rent Commission rise cannot be fully explained, outlines access measures, and promises an update on the backlog action plan soon.
As I have previously informed your House, I am keeping a close eye on the progress of the Rent Commission's action plan.
Zoals ik uw Kamer eerder heb laten weten houd ik een vinger aan de pols bij de voortgang op het actieplan van de Huurcommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Beckerman over brandveiligheid

MPs Koerhuis and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior about fire safety of buildings after the Grenfell fire, including the lack of an inventory of risky buildings, the status of municipal inventories and provincial oversight, and whether municipalities can be compelled to act. The Minister answered that most provinces and municipalities are progressing, that municipalities have policy discretion but are expected to complete the inventory, and that results will be sent to parliament by end 2021.
I asked the provinces to indicate what actions they have taken following my request.
Ik heb de provincies verzocht om aan te geven welke acties zij hebben ondernomen naar aanleiding van mijn verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over studentenwoningen niet meetellen als sociale huurwoningen

An SP MP asked whether student housing should count as social rental housing, citing Rotterdam's practice, rising waiting times and high rents in projects like Our Domain and Lee Towers. The minister answered that dwellings meeting the social rental criteria may be counted even when let to students, that monitoring them as a separate category is preferable, and that the choice of monitoring method rests with municipalities.
That is why municipalities may count student housing as social rental housing in their monitoring, including the municipality of Rotterdam.
Daarom kunnen gemeenten studentenwoningen in hun monitoring meetellen als sociale huurwoningen, ook de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een dreigende gedwongen herindeling van de gemeente Scherpenzeel

An FvD MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the proposed forced merger of Scherpenzeel lacks democratic support (over 80% of residents oppose it), whether it is unacceptable and conflicts with the European Charter of Local Self-Government, and which statutory or non-statutory tasks Scherpenzeel cannot perform. The Minister replied that she is following the case and will assess the merger advice once the provincial council decides on 7 July 2021, that municipalities can initiate mergers but remain dependent on legislation, and that she sees no conflict with the Charter if a proper process with consultation occurred, while the province must show evident capacity problems.
Only after the merger advice has been adopted by the provincial council and presented to me will I assess the advice against the substantive criteria of the Municipal Reorganisation Policy Framework.

Pas nadat het herindelingsadvies is vastgesteld door PS en aan mij is aangeboden, zal ik het advies beoordelen aan de hand van de inhoudelijke beoordelingscriteria van het Beleidskader gemeentelijk herindeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat rijksambtenaren maar weinig weten van wat zich in Twente en de Achterhoek afspeelt

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a report that national civil servants know little about Twente and the Achterhoek and take those regions' concerns less seriously, and asked for a response to the advisory council's findings and for steps to improve rijk-regio cooperation. The minister declined to comment on substance for all questions, deferring to a formal response to the advisory council's report, expected before the summer recess.
Pursuant to article 24 of the Framework Act on Advisory Bodies, I will respond within 3 months of receiving the advice.
Op grond van artikel 24 van de Kaderwet adviescolleges, zal ik binnen 3 maanden na ontvangst van het advies een reactie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Beruchte NSB’ers kochten Joodse huizen op in Arnhem’

Two PVV MPs asked ministers about reports that NSB members bought up Jewish houses in Arnhem during the war, asking how much property Arnhem seized, for a full restitution overview, for restitution of looted property, and for investigation of municipal and professional roles. The government answered that Arnhem's own investigation is ongoing, that no federal additional research or restitution is planned, and that post-war restitution was already addressed through the 2000 compensation fund.
This investigation is complex because much administration was lost, partly due to the destruction of Arnhem in the last year of the war.
Dit onderzoek is complex, omdat veel administratie verloren is gegaan, onder meer door de verwoesting van Arnhem in het laatste oorlogsjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de wachttijden voor sociale huurwoningen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of Interior about long waiting times for social rental housing, linking them to housing allocated to status holders and alleged discrimination against Dutch citizens. The Minister rejected the claim that status holders displace Dutch applicants, cited measures to accelerate construction, and said discrimination in the housing market is being tackled through awareness, information and new municipal instruments.
The approach to discrimination in the housing market is being intensified, through awareness and information provision, but also by giving municipalities new legal instruments and enforcement powers.

De aanpak tegen discriminatie op de woningmarkt wordt geïntensiveerd, door in te zetten op bewustwording en informatievoorziening, maar ook door gemeenten nieuw wettelijk instrumentarium en handhavingsmogelijkheden te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het NRC-bericht ‘Nieuwe bouwcrisis dreigt door ‘onwerkbare’ megawet’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of the Interior about press reports that the Digital Environment Act system (DSO) and the Omgevingswet risk not functioning in time for 1 January 2022, and about related municipal concerns and testing problems. The minister answered that testing found improvements needed but overall progress is positive, moved the entry-into-force date to 1 July 2022, and committed to further steps such as an Auditdienst Rijk review and a later letter, while withholding internal documents for the time being.
I will inform the House of an answer to this question as soon as possible.
Ik zal Uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk van een antwoord op deze vraag voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Koerhuis over het NRC-bericht ‘Nieuwe bouwcrisis dreigt door ‘onwerkbare’ megawet’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the Environmental and Planning Act (Omgevingswet) could delay building projects if introduced on 1 January 2022, and whether the digital system is ready. The Minister answered that the start date moves to 1 July 2022, admitted the digital system is not yet fully in order with ongoing delays, and described temporary alternative measures and transitional law.
With a view to meeting the minimum criteria for entry into force, together with the other governments it has been decided to move the entry-into-force date from 1 January 2022 to 1 July 2022.

Antwoord 2 Met het oog op het voldoen aan de minimumcriteria voor inwerkingtreding is samen met de andere overheden besloten de inwerkingtredingsdatum van 1 januari 2022 naar 1 juli 2022 te verplaatsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het NRC-bericht ‘Nieuwe bouwcrisis dreigt door ‘onwerkbare’ megawet’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about large municipalities' concerns over the Environment and Planning Act implementation, including failed tests in Amsterdam and the coherence of the DSO digital system. The minister answered that testing has found issues being addressed, cooperation runs through interbestuurlijke structures, transitional rules protect housing projects, and the start date was moved to 1 July 2022.
It has emerged that both the national DSO facility and local systems still require improvement or supplementation in parts.
Er is gebleken dat zowel de landelijk voorziening DSO als lokale systemen op onderdelen nog verbetering dan wel aanvulling behoeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de tarieven bij gemeenten voor trouwceremonies stijgen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether marriage should remain accessible to low-income people, whether rising marriage fees reflect municipal budget pressure, and whether a cap on cost-recovery should be studied. The minister answered that municipalities must offer free marriage slots, that fee-setting is a local democratic choice, and that no national maximum or study by central government is planned.
A maximum tariff for marriage fees would not do justice to locally made democratic choices and local cost differences.
Een maximumtarief voor trouwleges zou geen recht doen aan lokaal gemaakte democratische keuzes en lokale kostenverschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Amsterdam een bouwstop doorvoert in belangrijke groeigebieden

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior whether Amsterdam's reported building stop in growth areas would worsen the housing shortage, its effect on metropolitan planning capacity, land prices and Woningbouwimpuls-funded projects. The minister answered that no ongoing projects are affected, that planning capacity is ample, that land prices are set per location, and that no call with the municipality is needed.
The level of land prices is not public.
De hoogte van de grondprijzen is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat provincie Noord-Holland woningbouw in Landsmeer tegen houdt

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether a Noord-Holland provincial landscape designation (BPL) and restrictions on small-scale housing in Landsmeer had removed housing locations and undermined housing targets. The minister answered that only a limited number (about 1,200 homes across eight locations) is affected, that planning capacity is sufficient, and that cooperation with the province on housing is ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Minhas over het bericht 'Vertraging woningbouw dreigt na uitspraak Raad van State'

MPs Koerhuis and Minhas (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about a Council of State ruling that may lengthen housing project delays by letting non-objectors appeal, and about the risk of further delays and of people selling off objections. The minister answers that the ruling is not a crisis but may lengthen procedures, that a bill to amend the General Administrative Law Act is being prepared, and that a draft will go to internet consultation this summer.
The intention is to put a draft bill out for (internet) consultation this summer.
Het voornemen is om deze zomer een conceptwetsvoorstel in (internet)consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over aparte looproutes voor statushouders in Oegstgeest

The MP asks whether the government accepts a local proposal to route asylum status holders away from a park in Oegstgeest, and whether it violates the constitutional non-discrimination clause, and what tools exist to intervene. The minister answers that the municipality confirmed no obligation or ban on routes exists, that discrimination is unacceptable, and that intervention options are limited, with no existing comparable measures known.
The COA can and will never require or prohibit a route, except in situations where a restrictive measure has been imposed under the approach to nuisance behaviour.
Het COA kan en zal nooit een route verplichten dan wel verbieden, behoudens situaties waarin in het kader van de aanpak van overlastgevend gedrag een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Remco Dijkstra en Wiersma over het bericht dat het metropakket MRA een serieuze optie is voor financiering uit Nationaal Groeifonds

VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the Amsterdam metropolitan package (extending the North/South line and closing the ring line) was a serious option for Nationaal Groeifonds funding, including housing numbers, port land use, social housing shares and land revenues. The government answered in detail on the proposal, its costs, housing figures and port policy, reserving 1.5 billion euros for the North/South line extension but declining to calculate some counterfactuals and leaving the exact land-revenue effects undetermined.
For the reason given above, this calculation cannot be made.
Om de reden die hiervoor werd gegeven is deze berekening niet te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht Alkmaarse raad rebelleert tegen provinciaal verbod op woningbouw in Stompetoren

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the province of Noord-Holland's protection of the Stompetoren countryside as a Bijzonder Provinciaal Landschap blocks housing construction, and whether the province should reverse lost housing sites given the national housing shortage. The minister replied that the province has sufficient plan capacity, that the Stompetoren site no longer fits the province's urbanisation strategy, and that a Masterplan Wonen and talks with the region are under way.
For me it is important that the provinces, in consultation with municipalities, offer sufficient room for the regional need for construction.
Voor mij is het van belang dat de provincies in overleg met gemeenten voldoende ruimte bieden voor de regionale behoefte van de bouwopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over gemeenten die mogelijk discriminerende algoritmen gebruiken

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about municipalities possibly using discriminatory algorithms, following a Rotterdam audit office warning, and asked about the legal framework, use of nationality and ethnicity as indicators, supervision and transparency. The state secretary answered that existing equal-treatment law applies, that a government-wide inventory of nationality and ethnicity use in risk models is underway, that guidance and an impact assessment are being prepared, that a possible algorithm register is being explored, and that existing supervisors cover algorithms without a new body being deemed necessary.
I consider this the responsibility of the municipal council, the college of mayor and aldermen, local supervisors and audit offices.
Ik vind dit het verantwoordelijkheidsdomein van de gemeenteraad/College van burgemeester en Wethouders, lokale toezichthouders en Rekenkamers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de Belgische overheid die (gedeeltelijk) plat lag door een DDoS-aanval

An MP asked the government about a reported DDoS attack that disrupted parts of the Belgian government, including how often the Dutch government is targeted, whether it is resilient, whether it proactively scans for vulnerabilities, whether an emergency protocol exists, whether contact was made with Belgium, and lessons learned. The State Secretary answered that no complete picture of attacks exists, points to existing frameworks (NCSA, BIO, NCP-Digitaal, proactive vulnerability scanning), and reports contacts with CERT-BE and the Belgian federal government.
There is no complete picture of the number of attacks on which the Dutch government has been a target.
Er is geen volledig beeld van het aantal aanvallen waarvan de Nederlandse overheid doelwit is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Bromet over het bericht dat algoritmes van de gemeente Rotterdam kunnen leiden tot vooringenomen uitkomsten

MPs Bouchallikh and Bromet (GroenLinks) asked about reports that Rotterdam's algorithms may produce biased outcomes, including the Rekenkamer Rotterdam report, use of possibly discriminatory variables, transparency toward benefit recipients, the SyRI ruling, and the need for an algorithm register. State Secretary Knops answered that municipalities are responsible, that the government is developing guidance, an impact assessment and a national inventory of unlawful use of nationality/ethnicity in risk models, and that a register is being studied.
Ultimately, municipalities are themselves responsible for complying with the law.
Uiteindelijk zijn gemeenten zelf verantwoordelijk voor naleving van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over 'de belofte van het kabinet dat de versterking nu echt op stoom komt en de uitvoering van het bestuursakkoord'

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the government whether its promise that reinforcement of Groningen homes is finally gaining momentum is credible, whether the budget for batch 1588 is sufficient, and how the 2020 Bestuursakkoord (governance agreement) is being implemented across its blocks and categories. Minister Ollongren answers at length that implementation is progressing, that the amendment-Beckerman on restoring living space is being worked out with municipalities and NCG, and that various regulations, funds and plans are in preparation, but gives few firm figures on outcomes.
On the additional costs I am in consultation with municipalities, the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) and the housing corporations.
Over de meerkosten ben ik met gemeenten, de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) en de woningcorporaties in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het feit dat mevrouw Bunschoten met drie kinderen door corporatie Dudok feitelijk op straat wordt gezet

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about a divorced mother of three who was reportedly left without housing by housing corporation Dudok, and whether separated parents should get urgency status for social housing. The minister replies that urgency rules are set by municipal housing ordinances, that the corporation has no discretion, that the applicant can already apply for regular social housing, and that the municipality is responsible for further categories.
It is up to the municipalities themselves which further categories are added, depending on the local situation.
Het is aan gemeenten zelf welke verdere categorieën hieraan toegevoegd worden afhankelijk van de plaatselijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het niet uit huis zetten van weeskinderen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior for an update on implementing the Koerhuis motion on not evicting orphaned minor children, the age limits involved, and whether housing corporations could be forced to keep such young adults housed. The minister said the work is in its final phase with results to be sent before summer, that maatwerk and a possible code of conduct are preferred over compulsion, and gave limited direct answers on the legal options.
As previously indicated, I will inform your House of the outcomes before the summer.
Zoals eerder aangegeven zal ik uw Kamer voor de zomer over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Faith het huis uit moet na het overlijden van haar moeder

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a housing corporation may evict 20-year-old Faith after her mother's death, given the COVID-era agreement against evictions. The minister answered that a court ruled for non-rent reasons, the corporation has repeatedly offered alternative housing, and she sees no reason to intervene with the corporation.

On 25 May 2021 the court, weighing the interests of Faith and of the housing corporation, decided that Faith will not continue the lease of the social rental home and must leave the home by 1 September.

Op 25 mei 2021 heeft de rechter, onder afweging van de belangen van Faith en die van de woningcorporatie besloten dat Faith de huur van de sociale huurwoning niet voortzet en de woning per 1 september moet verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de bouw en verkoop van sociale huurwoningen

Labour MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about the supply of social rental housing, commercial developers' deals that release social units after a time, subsidy conditions, tenant consent for sales and rent protection. The Minister replied that a 150,000-unit social rental commitment is in place, that municipalities and housing corporations decide locally on sales, that tenant contracts remain intact after sale, and that existing rules already regulate sales and rents.
I have no insight into the extent to which municipalities also make agreements with commercial parties on the construction of rental housing for the regulated segment.
Ik heb geen zicht op in hoeverre gemeenten ook afspraken maken met commerciële partijen over de bouw van huurwoningen voor het gereguleerde segment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over negatieve publieke uitlatingen van een hoge ambtenaar van de NCTV over Pieter Omtzigt

Two SP MPs asked why a senior NCTV official's public tweets criticising Pieter Omtzigt were permissible and whether they breach the civil service conduct norm, and whether that official was involved in threat assessments for him. The ministers answered that the freedom of expression of officials is weighed against functioning-based criteria, that two fact-finding inquiries are ongoing so no conclusions can be pre-empted, and that the official had no direct or indirect role in threat analysis for Omtzigt.
While these investigations are ongoing, we can and will not anticipate those conclusions, given the duty of care we must observe as employer.
Lopende deze onderzoeken kunnen en willen wij niet vooruitlopen op die conclusies, mede gelet op de eisen van zorgvuldigheid die als werkgever in acht zijn te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Baarle en Azarkan over de huidige stand van zaken met betrekking tot discriminatie en racisme in Nederland

MPs Van Baarle and Azarkan asked about the current state of discrimination and racism in the Netherlands, covering complaint and prosecution figures over ten years, reporting willingness, and government measures on housing, labour, education, healthcare and spending. The minister answered with detailed statistics on antidiscrimination-service complaints, police reports, prosecutions, sentences and sanctions, and described planned measures including a National Coordinator and a State Commission on discrimination and racism.
The approach to discrimination will receive an important and substantial boost in the coming period.
De aanpak van discriminatie zal in de komende periode een belangrijke en wezenlijke impuls krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een windmolenvoorstel bouwplannen in gevaar brengt

MP Koerhuis asked whether the provincial executive of Noord-Holland's proposal to drop the 600-metre minimum distance for wind turbines endangers housing plans and health of residents. The minister answers that the provincial rule is a supplementary requirement, national noise and shadow rules still apply, the housing targets are not considered at risk, and that setting distances is primarily a municipal task.
The provincial executive has indeed decided to drop the minimum distance requirement.
Het college van gedeputeerde staten heeft inderdaad besloten de minimale afstandsgrens los te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Doelstellingen flexwoningen lang niet gehaald

MPs Boulakjar and Koerhuis asked the minister whether municipalities and housing corporations are missing flexible housing targets, what obstacles exist (locations, business case, image) and what is being done. The minister answered that it is too early to conclude targets will be missed, outlined support measures and funding, and said most woondeals already include flexible housing targets.
I therefore think it is too early to conclude that the target for placing flexible housing will not be met.
Ik vind het daarom te vroeg om te concluderen dat de doelstelling voor het plaatsen van flexwoningen niet wordt behaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over artikel over sloop in de Groningse Schildersbuurt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the loss of historic interiors and chimneys in the Groningen Schildersbuurt due to conversions of student rooms into self-contained flats and demolition, asking about protection options, extent of the problem and municipal tools. The minister answered that the area is a protected townscape where only exteriors are largely protected, that about 41 conversions and 60 demolition notifications occurred, that municipalities have some tools but no watertight solution, and that simplifying monument procedures is not needed.
The municipality of Groningen is not aware whether chimneys or stained glass specifically have been demolished in the Schildersbuurt.
Het is de gemeente Groningen niet bekend of er specifiek schoorstenen of glas-in-lood in de Schildersbuurt zijn gesloopt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de berichten dat bewoners uit het zogenaamde ´smurfendorp´ in het Groningse Kropswolde niet permanent in hun recreatiewoningen mogen wonen en dat permanent wonen op bungalowpa

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that residents of the Kropswolde holiday park De Leine may not live there permanently, including whether the municipality is acting with due regard for the human factor during the COVID crisis and whether the rapid-reuse task force could assess the park. The minister answered that the municipality has a phased enforcement policy with a six-month grace period, that the decision on the park's future rests with the municipality, and that she has already conveyed her call for the human factor to the municipality.
It is up to the municipality to weigh the future prospects of a specific park.
Het is aan de gemeente om een afweging te maken aangaande het toekomstperspectief van een specifiek park.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Woude over het opnemen van studieschulden in het BKR-register

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Woude asked whether student debts would be registered with the BKR credit register, as the AFM proposed, and whether the government would keep its promise not to do so. The minister answered that the government will not move to BKR registration of student loans, noting that lenders can already verify loans via Mijn DUO and that student loans have different social repayment terms.
Yes, the cabinet will not proceed with BKR registration for student debts.
Ja, het kabinet gaat niet over tot een BKR-registratie voor studieschulden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Agnes Mulder over de (ongewenste) (neven)effecten van de inwerkingtreding van het wettelijk stelsel voor werkzaamheden aan gasverbrandingsinstallaties(Koolmonoxide- of Gas

MPs Heerma and Mulder asked the Interior Minister about unintended side effects of the Gas Boiler Act (certification for gas appliance work), including rising maintenance subscription costs, withdrawal of installers from older appliances, and municipal enforcement capacity. The minister answered that costs are limited, certification is needed from 1 April 2022, cost developments will be monitored, and an evaluation is planned for 1 October 2023.

As I indicated in my answer to questions 10, 11 and 12, I will keep a close eye on developments before the statutory certification requirement takes effect on 1 April 2022, so that developments such as those you describe can be identified.

Zoals ik in mijn antwoord bij de vragen 10, 11 en 12 heb aangegeven zal ik voor die tijd (in aanloop naar de wettelijke certificeringsplicht per 1 april 2022) al wel de vinger aan de pols houden zodat ontwikkelingen zoals u die schetst kunnen worden gesignaleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘ICT-adviseur corporaties had financiële banden met ICT-leveranciers waarover het adviseert’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that an ICT adviser to housing corporations had financial ties to ICT suppliers it advised on, and about conflict-of-interest safeguards, procurement rules and governance codes. The Minister acknowledged the risk of conflicting roles, placed primary responsibility on the ICT firms and corporations' own procurement policies, and argued that European procurement rules would not prevent such conflicts.
Possible mixing of roles is primarily the responsibility of the entrepreneur, not of the client.
Mogelijke vermenging van rollen is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de ondernemer, en niet in die van de afnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Ellian over stemmen door Nederlanders in het buitenland

Two VVD MPs asked why only about 9-10% of the estimated one million Dutch citizens abroad registered to vote, why only 63,549 of 92,772 registered voters cast a ballot, and why proxy voting and invalid votes were so low or high, and whether surveys or evaluations would be run. The minister answered that registration barriers are mostly lack of reliable postal addresses and disengagement, that an online survey of 30 expat associations is ongoing, that a survey of registered voters will be conducted, and that the full evaluation will be sent before the summer recess.
I am willing to conduct a survey among all voters included in the permanent registration and ask them whether they voted in the last House of Representatives election and, if not, why not.

Ik ben bereid een enquête te houden onder alle kiezers die zijn opgenomen in de permanente registratie en aan hen te vragen of zij hebben gestemd bij de afgelopen Tweede Kamerverkiezing en zo nee, waarom niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over aanhoudende problemen met loden leidingen

MP Nijboer asked the Interior Minister about slow progress in finding and replacing lead pipes, the duty of landlords to disclose them, a possible lease clause, health risks to children, and whether a ban is planned. The minister answered that owners are responsible for removal, that gemeenten were asked to act, that a disclosure clause is being studied and progress will be reported annually, and that a ban will be considered if progress is insufficient.
The letter of 2 July 2020 on lead-in-drinking-water actions committed to reporting to the House annually, in a joint letter, on developments and progress in remediation.
In de brief van 2 juli 2020 over acties lood in drinkwater is toegezegd dat de Kamer jaarlijks per gezamenlijke brief wordt gerapporteerd over de ontwikkelingen en de voortgang van saneringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Kops over het bericht dat 11.000 vergunninghouders in de tweede helft van dit jaar een woning moeten krijgen

PVV MPs Markuszower and Kops asked why about 11,000 asylum permit holders should receive housing within six months when Dutch citizens wait years, and whether they should be denied housing and borders closed. The minister replied that asylum protection is required by law, that housing allocation is handled by municipalities under a half-yearly quota, that no nationality-based distinction is made, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
Er wordt in Nederland geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over de woningnood

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the housing shortage, waiting lists, first-time buyer access, housing prices, and environmental rules' effect on construction costs. The minister answered with the estimated shortage of 331 thousand homes, government construction measures for starters, and stated that environmental rules will not be relaxed.
In June 2021 I will inform the House about the shortage based on the updated CBS forecast.
In juni 2021 zal ik de Kamer informeren over het tekort op basis van de geactualiseerde CBS-prognose.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over anonieme bedreiging en intimidatie op huisadressen

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether anonymous intimidation at home addresses by groups such as Vizier op Links is punishable and how victims will be protected. The government said 51 reports and ten complaints have been filed, that the Public Prosecution Service is assessing whether criminal offences occurred, and pointed to local security measures and support for politicians.
The Public Prosecution Service is currently investigating whether the actions in question qualify as criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt momenteel of de betreffende handelingen zich kwalificeren als strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het intimideren van linkse politici

The MP Kuiken asked the ministers whether intimidating stickers and visits at private addresses targeting left-wing politicians are unacceptable, how many complaints have been filed, what the Data Protection Authority can do about doxing, and when an internet-bullying policy framework will be ready. Minister Grapperhaus answered that such intimidation is unacceptable, that ten complaints were filed with four still under investigation, that the Data Protection Authority can act against doxing, and that the framework was delivered in February 2021.
Aggression and intimidation are therefore completely unacceptable.
Agressie en intimidatie zijn daarom volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Özütok over intimidaties door Vizier op Links

MPs Van den Berge and Özütok asked whether the government considers the intimidation of public figures by the anonymous group Vizier op Links at their home addresses unacceptable, whether it is criminal, whether AIVD is aware of it, and what measures will be taken. The minister condemned the conduct as intimidating, said he cannot comment on individual cases, reported ten complaints with six closed and four pending, and described existing police and local-triangle protection mechanisms.
The Public Prosecution Service is currently examining whether the conduct in question qualifies as criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt momenteel of de betreffende handelingen zich kwalificeren als strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het oprichten van een wooncoöperatie in de Tweebosbuurt in Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why housing corporation Vestia refuses to cooperate with tenants of the Tweebosbuurt in Rotterdam who want to form a residents' cooperative to prevent demolition, and how this fits the cabinet's aim to expand cooperatives. The minister answered that the initiative does not meet the Housing Act definition (eight scattered homes, not five neighbouring units forming a unit), that corporations are not obliged to sell, and that the ministry supports cooperative initiatives via Platform31.
Although the Housing Act imposes no restrictions on initiatives wishing to set up a housing cooperative, the housing corporation is not obliged to sell the homes to the initiative.
Hoewel de Woningwet geen beperkingen oplegt aan initiatieven die een wooncoöperatie wensen op de richten is de woningcorporatie niet verplicht om de woningen aan het initiatief te verkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat bewoners van Park de Braassem de wanhoop nabij zijn door de onheilstijding van hun gemeente in de toch al moeilijke coronatijd

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the municipality of Kaag en Braassem is enforcing permanent-residence bans on people living in recreational homes during the COVID crisis, and whether the minister will urge the municipality to apply a humane approach. The minister confirmed the enforcement procedure, said she contacted the municipality which claims to apply a humane approach, and promised a quality and assessment framework around summer.
It is correct that the procedure has been started.
Het klopt dat de procedure is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Koerhuis over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten onterechte kosten betalen voor huisvesting

MPs Wiersma and Koerhuis asked why the Roemer advisory team did not examine reports that migrant workers pay unlawful extra housing costs via intermediaries, and how supervision works. The minister answered that a landlord permit scheme is being prepared, that information initiatives exist, that the Inspectorate SZW and municipalities supervise within their own remits, and that no complete data on such practices is held.
At present I am preparing a law that would allow municipalities, if they wish, to impose nationally uniform rules on landlords.
Op dit moment ben ik bezig een wet voor te bereiden waarmee gemeenten desgewenst landelijk geüniformeerde voorschriften kunnen instellen voor verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurdersbelangenorganisaties

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how tenant organisations are regulated, whether it is desirable that housing corporations can agree sales with tenant organisations that do not represent the affected tenants, and how individual tenants can have a say in sales. The minister explained the representativeness rules under the Overlegwet and Woningwet, that Woonzorg Nederland now agreed to recognise the local tenant association and give it advisory rights, and that individual tenants have no veto over sales but keep their rental rights.
I do not consider it desirable that housing corporations can make agreements with tenant organisations about the sale of homes while the tenants concerned are not represented.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat woningcorporaties afspraken kunnen maken met huurdersorganisaties over de verkoop van woningen, terwijl de betrokken huurders niet worden vertegenwoordigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de bestuurlijke situatie in Limburg

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Interior whether action was taken before the Limburg governor and deputies resigned, why a temporary commissioner (Remkes) was appointed and what his competences are, whether the scandal extends beyond the province, and whether there are other subsidy ties with ministries. The Minister answered that the ministry monitored developments, explained the appointment as necessary to restore trust and gave Remkes a mandate on administrative culture with an integrity reporting point, while stating that the province and private overseers are responsible for investigations and that she has no view of subsidy ties beyond media reports.
As you know, promoting administrative integrity and tackling administrative problems is one of the priorities of my policy.
Zoals u weet, is de bevordering van de bestuurlijke integriteit en de aanpak van bestuurlijke problemen een van de speerpunten van mijn beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over bewoners die na een verwoestende brand in een door gaswinning onveilige woning nu alles kwijt zijn

An SP MP asked the Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about a family whose Groningen house, damaged by gas-extraction earthquakes and vacated in 2017, burned down in 2020, leaving them with no compensation or replacement home, and whether the government will ensure restitution and limit prolonged legal battles. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, said liability must be assessed case by case, pointed to NCG and IMG support and meetings with affected residents, and gave no concrete new commitment.
However, we do not make statements about the details of individual situations.
Wij doen echter geen mededelingen over de details van individuele situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat 65.000 stemmen van 70-plussers niet zijn meegeteld door fouten bij briefstemmen

MP Den Haan asked why about 65,000 votes cast by voters aged 70 and over by post were not counted, whether the government would investigate, and how other countries compare. Minister Ollongren said about 95% of postal votes were valid, that uncounted votes mostly resulted from missing ballot or polling card, that the Kiesraad and Tweede Kamer, not the minister, determine the result, and that the election evaluation and campaign evaluation are underway.
I am evaluating the Tweede Kamer election.
Ik ben de Tweede Kamerverkiezing aan het evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘’belemmerende factoren voor een rechtvaardig herstel van kapotte en onveilige huizen’’

An SP MP asked the ministers about obstacles to fair repair of damaged and unsafe houses in Groningen caused by gas extraction, covering the evidential presumption, KNMI measurement errors, backlogs, foundation damage and value-loss compensation. The minister answered that the independent IMG handles claims under the statutory presumption, is working to speed up processing and refine its approach, and that the measurement errors had no effect on damage handling.
The IMG applies the statutory evidential presumption and uses the report of the expert panel the IMG commissioned in 2019.
Het IMG past het wettelijke bewijsvermoeden toe en gebruikt hierbij het rapport van het panel van deskundigen dat het IMG in 2019 heeft uitgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Dik-Faber over een werkbezoek aan de prefab-woningen in De Driesprong te Ermelo d.d. 6 maart 2021

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about defects, resident safety, the provincial subsidy rush, and oversight of the Slokker prefab homes in De Driesprong, Ermelo. The Minister answered that repairs are ongoing with the housing corporation, that residents have adequate legal protection, and that the Wkb quality-assurance reform will strengthen construction oversight.
I do not consider extending or amending legislation on this point necessary.
Ik acht uitbreiding of aanpassing van wet- en regelgeving op dit punt dan ook niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Gemeente Meppel gaat in gesprek met bewoners over uitbreiding prostitutiegebied’

An SGP MP asked the government about Meppel's plans to expand a prostitution zone and the claimed effects on neighbourhood liveability, drug problems, and whether municipalities can exclude prostitution businesses. The State Secretary replied that local matters lie with municipal councils, refused to make general claims about liveability or drugs, said a municipal 'zero option' is not yet legally possible until the Wrs takes effect, and declined further legal frameworks.
On questions about local situations, the central government exercises great restraint.
Bij vragen over lokale situaties past de rijksoverheid grote terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het voorstel van de gemeente Amsterdam tot het plaatsten van windturbines in het IJmeer, op korte afstand van de woonwijk IJburg

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the minister about Amsterdam's plan to place wind turbines 350 to 500 metres from the IJburg residential area, including health risks, participation, distance norms and enforcement. The minister answered that noise and shadow-flicker norms limit risks, that no separate distance criteria exist, that enforcement lies with local authorities, and that no national overview of complaints or violations is kept.

The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) has no national overview of violations, enforcement measures and residents' complaints regarding onshore wind turbines in the past year.

Bij de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) bestaat geen landelijk overzicht van overtredingen, handhavingsmaatregelen en klachten van omwonenden met betrekking tot windturbines op land in het afgelopen jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over ‘de compensatie van Shell en Exxon voor het verlagen van de gaswinning’

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether Shell and ExxonMobil received at least 1.5 billion euros in compensation for the Groningen gas closure, and pressed on the NAM's payments for damage and reinforcement costs, the stuwmeer scheme, the Norg storage dispute and possible taxation of the oil companies. The minister denied the 1.5 billion figure, said the profit-split change was about 1.3 billion for 2018-2023 but much lower in practice, and explained the cost recovery from NAM and the ongoing arbitration, while declining to disclose commercially confidential information and promising to inform parliament on a levy.
All agreements with Shell, ExxonMobil or the NAM are public, except for commercially confidential information.
Alle overeenkomsten met Shell, ExxonMobil of de NAM zijn, behoudens bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie, openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Groningers in bevingsgebied moeten nog langer wachten op smartengeld'

An MP asked why the Groningen compensation scheme for immaterial (emotional) damage from earthquakes is delayed, what the new timetable is, and how the Chamber was informed. The minister explains the scheme is new and complex, the IMG plans a phased start at end of Q2 2021 with 100 households, and the Chamber was informed proactively via the IMG website and regular updates.
I will also proactively inform your Chamber about developments regarding the procedure for compensation of immaterial damage.
Ik zal uw Kamer ook proactief informeren over de ontwikkelingen omtrent de werkwijze voor de vergoeding van immateriële schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat mensen op bungalowpark Eper Sprengen de telkens loerende toezichthouders zat zijn

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior whether Epe municipality's enforcement against permanent residence in holiday bungalows, including questions about residents' beliefs, was proportionate, and how this fits a motion on the human touch. The minister answered that such questioning unrelated to zoning enforcement is undesirable under the General Administrative Law Act, that the municipality denies asking about religion, and that she has re-raised her earlier call for the human touch with Epe.
I therefore consider it undesirable that questions are asked about matters that are not necessary for supervising the zoning plan.
Ik acht het daarmee onwenselijk dat vragen gesteld worden naar zaken die niet noodzakelijk zijn voor het toezicht op het bestemmingplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over voorkennis bij het bieden op woningen

MP Nijboer asks the Minister of the Interior about insider information and non-transparent bidding in the housing market, including lottery practices for new-build homes. The minister calls such practices unacceptable, points to industry codes and complaint routes, promises talks with brokers and transparency measures, but declines to ask the ACM for an investigation or to commission a study of the Norwegian bidding model.
I will discuss with property developers the methods used in allocating new-build homes.
Ik ga met de projectontwikkelaars in gesprek over de methoden die worden gehanteerd bij de toewijzing van nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de voorgenomen verkoop van het gemeentelijk recreatieoord Hoek van Holland

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the Minister of Interior about the planned sale or long lease of Rotterdam's municipal recreation park at Hoek van Holland, tenant rights, consultation, and whether the municipality should keep it in public hands. The Minister answered that the decision is the municipality's competence, that existing tenancy contracts transfer to a new landlord, and that the Rijk has no role or intention to intervene.
As Minister of BZK I have no role or competence in this matter.
Als Minister van BZK heb ik in deze kwestie geen rol of bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de provincie ingrijpt bij een datacenter in Middenmeer (Hollands Kroon)

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether the dispute between the province of Noord-Holland and the municipality of Hollands Kroon over competence for data centre permits, and the wider sprawl of large warehouses and data centres, should prompt national rules or intervention. The minister answered that the province and municipality are in consultation, that the provincial executive considers itself competent, that spatial choices lie primarily with municipalities, and that further national rules are not currently on the table, with a first step being to develop and monitor siting policy with other authorities.
It is always preferable that governments reach a shared view through good mutual consultation.
Het heeft altijd de voorkeur dat overheden in goed onderling overleg tot een gezamenlijk inzicht komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over een nep-bijeenkomst die draagvlak moest suggereren

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether staged theatre-like participation sessions that suggested public support undermine trust in democracy, and how the minister would respond to the Amsterdam case and the right to challenge. The minister said the Amsterdam matter is a local responsibility for the municipal council, that participation must be representative, and that a legislative proposal strengthening local participation is in preparation.
The issue identified in the article must however be examined by the municipal council of Amsterdam.
De in het artikel gesignaleerde kwestie moet echter bezien worden door de gemeenteraad van de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de problemen met het nieuwe energielabel

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of the Interior about problems with the new energy label, including shortages of certified advisers, rising prices, the 190 euro cost estimate, measurement quality and the consumer-facing criticism raised by Radar. The Minister rejects claims of a rushed introduction, acknowledges shortages and price rises, and says extra measures and a market consultation on digital labels are underway, with an update to parliament promised before the summer.
I therefore do not share the view of Vereniging Eigen Huis that the introduction was careless and too hasty.
Ik deel dan ook niet de mening van Vereniging Eigen Huis dat de invoering onzorgvuldig en te snel is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Studenten in de stress door tijdelijk huurcontract’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior about temporary student rental contracts, the rarity of multi-year campus contracts, data on temporary rentals, student housing shortages and prices, and Huurcommissie backlogs. The minister answered that the Wet doorstroming huurmarkt 2015 is under evaluation, that data on student-specific temporary contracts is not separately collected, reported a shortage of 22,000 units per Kences, and promised the evaluation results by end of next month.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over spionage in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked whether the government shares concerns that Chinese-owned Nuctech customs scanners at Rotterdam port could be used for espionage, and what security assessment was made at purchase. The government answered that risks exist, customs has commissioned an external audit of the scanner systems, and it gives no operational detail on intelligence service knowledge.
Customs is having an external audit carried out on the scanning and detection systems and related IT setup, to ensure the scanning and detection processes are arranged as securely as possible.
De Douane laat een externe audit uitvoeren op de scan- en detectiesystemen en daaraan gerelateerde IT-inrichting, om te verzekeren dat de scan- en detectieprocessen zo veilig mogelijk zijn ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Regterschot over het onnodig betalen van leges

MPs Lodders and Regterschot asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities such as Emmen wrongly kept charging building-permit fees under outdated zoning plans and refused refunds despite the Council of State ruling and the Ombudsman's findings. The minister said she had not received signals of such charges, that enforcing the law is primarily for councils, citizens and courts, and repeated her call for generous ex officio reductions while declining to judge the Emmen case or to ask other municipalities about compliance.
It is primarily for the municipal council, interested parties and the courts to ensure that municipalities comply with the law.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad, belanghebbenden en de rechter om erop toe te zien dat gemeenten de wet naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over aardgas als duurzame en klimaatvriendelijke brandstof

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked whether natural gas should be classed as a sustainable fuel under the EU Taxonomy, why households are being moved off gas, and whether the gas-free neighbourhood pilots should stop. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes the Commission's proposal to classify gas plants as sustainable, that the transition is voluntary and aligned with the Climate Agreement, and that the Netherlands remains committed to its climate targets.
The Netherlands therefore spoke out against the Commission's new proposal to classify private investments in gas power plants as sustainable under conditions.
Nederland heeft zich dan ook uitgesproken tegen het nieuwe Commissievoorstel om private investeringen in aardgascentrales onder voorwaarden als duurzaam aan te merken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over corruptie bij Limburgse CDA-bestuurders

Leijten (SP) asks the Interior Minister how she assesses the integrity scandal in Limburg's provincial government, whether the administration and the governor's position remain tenable, whether similar cases exist elsewhere, what external controls exist against fraud, whether complaints about subsidy handling reached the ministry, and whether she accepts that subsidy abuse harms trust in politics. The minister answers that the governor ordered an inquiry, executives resigned, a new acting commissioner (Remkes) was appointed with a restorative mandate, no signs of similar cases in other provinces were found, external controls are the responsibility of provinces, accountants and the Public Prosecution Service, and no complaints reached the ministry.
Thereupon I have nominated Mr J.W. Remkes for appointment as acting Commissioner of the King, with an explicit administrative mandate.
Daarop heb ik de heer J.W. Remkes voorgedragen voor benoeming tot waarnemend commissaris van de Koning, met een expliciete bestuurlijke opdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het verduurzamen van huurwoningen

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Interior whether the cost of making social rental homes sustainable (around 100,000 euro per home, as reported) is absurd, why costs seem to have doubled since 2018, and why the minister speaks of 'sustainability' while gas is called a sustainable fuel. The minister rejects the 100,000 figure, cites ABF research putting gas-free conversion at roughly 23,000 to 29,000 euro plus about 8,000 euro insulation, and defends scaling up and subsidies while defining sustainability as energy improvement toward gas-free homes.
I do not recognise this amount.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Huizen aardgasvrij maken is complex en kost ook meer dan verwacht'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers whether the government would stop the natural-gas-free neighbourhoods programme, citing an EIB study estimating costs of about 40,000 euro per home and doubts about affordability. The Minister of Interior answered that the EIB case is not representative, that costs will fall through innovation, that the programme is a learning exercise, and that the government will not stop the transition.
I do not share that conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Linda's zoon (13) is over een paar maanden wees: 'Ik wil hem goed achterlaten'

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of the Interior about a 13-year-old orphan who may have to sell the family home to pay inheritance tax. The State Secretary answered that the existing rules offer no sufficient relief, that the Tax Authority can grant only limited instalment payment, and that he intends to legislate an interest-free long-term payment arrangement for such hardship cases, to be included in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2023.
I therefore intend to prepare an amendment to laws and regulations so that a general solution can be offered for this and other comparable hardship situations.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om een wijziging van wet- en regelgeving voor te bereiden zodat een algemene oplossing kan worden geboden voor deze en andere vergelijkbare schrijnende situaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot en Diertens (beiden D66) over de berichten ‘Verzet tegen nieuwe vrachthaven Bonaire, aanleg zou ‘ecocide’ zijn’ en het bericht ‘conservebonaire.org opposes Hato port’

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that a proposed new cargo port on Bonaire would harm the coral reef, its financing, environmental impact assessment, and transparency. The minister answered that no decision to build a port has been taken, that feasibility studies and an MER are still pending and will be shared later, and that the island council (Bestuurscollege) is responsible for the decision.
For now, there is no decision to build a new cargo port (location).
Vooralsnog is er geen sprake van een besluit tot het bouwen van een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de bouwprojecten op Bonaire

An MP asked ministers about planned port and fuel-pier construction on Bonaire that could destroy coral and whether permits, enforcement, financing, cruise tourism and waste management were adequately handled. The government answered that no construction has begun, that existing environmental and maritime procedures apply and can be appealed, and that a feasibility and cost-benefit study and the Bonaire Brandstof Terminals company will follow.
These procedures are public, have objection and appeal possibilities and can go to the administrative court.
Deze procedures zijn openbaar, kennen bezwaar en beroepsmogelijkheden en een gang naar de bestuursrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de misstanden rondom de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe RIVM gebouw

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about vibration-sensitivity problems, cost overruns, delays and contractor withdrawals in the construction of the new RIVM/CBG headquarters in Utrecht. The government answered each question, acknowledging the vibration-requirement problems, roughly 36.5 million euro in extra costs shared with the contractor, and a delayed handover, while stating it complied with procurement rules and that the building will meet the requirements.
The House will be informed separately by letter about the new handover date.
De Kamer wordt middels een brief separaat geïnformeerd over de nieuwe opleverdatum.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Woningbouwimpuls zorgt voor bijna 45.000 nieuwbouwwoningen’ en de uitvoering van de aangenomen motie Koerhuis c.s. over de ondergrens verlagen naa

MPs Regterschot and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior about the number of woningbouwimpuls projects per province, why 48 applications were rejected (mostly for unvalidated financial shortfalls), how the Koerhuis motion on lowering the 500-home threshold was implemented, why the second-tranche budget was exceeded, and how the third tranche (about 250 million euro) will be allocated and spread. The minister answered that rejections mainly concerned the 'necessity of the contribution' criterion, that the motion could not be applied to the already-open second tranche, that the overrun was to fund all positively assessed projects, and that the spread and ranking will be addressed in an interim evaluation letter to parliament.
Question 3: How has the adopted Koerhuis et al. motion been implemented within the second tranche?
Vraag 3 Hoe is de aangenomen motie-Koerhuis c.s. 2 uitgevoerd binnen de tweede tranche?

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de klacht tegen Nederland die de Nederlandse Vereniging Omwonenden Windturbines op 9 november 2015 heeft ingediend bij het Compliance Committee van het Verdrag van Aarhus va

MP Van Gerven asks why the Aarhus Compliance Committee has still not decided, nearly five and a half years after a complaint against the Netherlands over public participation, and what the consequences of a ruling would be for citizen consultation rules in the AWB and Omgevingswet. The government says it cannot explain the delay since the committee controls its own working methods, declines to assess possible consequences before a decision, denies legal uncertainty, and sees no means to press the committee to speed up.
Unfortunately it is not possible to inform you of the reason for the absence of a decision, since the Aarhus Compliance Committee is responsible for its own work organisation and methods.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om u te informeren over de reden van het uitblijven van een beslissing, aangezien het Aarhus nalevingscomité over zijn eigen werkindeling en -methoden gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Gerven over de virtuele verkoop van groene stroom aan Amazon

MPs Beckerman and Van Gerven asked about the virtual sale of green electricity guarantees from Dutch offshore wind to Amazon, and whether this undermines climate goals, public subsidies and transparency. The minister explains that guarantees of origin are an administrative instrument, that Dutch wind power mainly serves Dutch consumers, and that overviews of certificate trade are published by CertiQ, though some data are aggregated for confidentiality.
This overview does provide aggregated volumes, due to commercially confidential information.
Dit overzicht biedt wel geaggregeerde volumes in verband met bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Otterloo over de aanpassing van de procedure omtrent het geldig verklaren en het tellen van binnengekomen briefstemmen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Interior Minister how the error rates of postal votes for voters aged 70 and over compare with those for voters abroad, whether the procedure was tested, how invalid and set-aside ballots and PostNL's chain of custody were handled, and whether the answers could be given before the final result. The minister replied that the procedure was based on the overseas one but adapted, that focus-group testing took place, that set-aside rates were estimated at roughly 4 to 6 percent against 0.29 percent invalid votes, that PostNL's detailed process is confidential though a closed briefing is offered, and that the deadline could not be met.
PostNL is however willing to give a further explanation of this process and the safeguards in a confidential meeting
PostNL is echter bereid om in een vertrouwelijke bijeenkomst een nadere toelichting te geven over dit proces en de waarborgen

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over grootschalige en onrechtmatige verzameling van data van burgers door de krijgsmacht, de politie, de Belastingdienst, de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten en andere overhei

An MP from D66 asked several ministers about large-scale and unlawful data collection on citizens by the armed forces (LIMC), police systems, UWV (SONAR), the Tax Service, and COA-police data sharing, including whether these comply with GDPR and oversight rules. The ministers acknowledged shortcomings, described remediation steps such as stopping LIMC collection pending an internal review, phasing out SONAR, and ending COA data sharing, while deferring some matters to ongoing investigations and to a future cabinet on AP funding.
If it turns out that government organisations are not or insufficiently able to do so, the cabinet will discuss this with the relevant body.
Indien blijkt dat overheidsorganisaties hier niet of onvoldoende toe in staat zijn, dan gaat het kabinet hierover met het desbetreffende onderdeel in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de digitale inkomenstoets

An MP asked why the digital income-check pilot for social housing allocation had not started, and why a legal basis for sharing BRP data had only surfaced late. The minister attributed the delay to greater technical complexity and to legal uncertainty over the BRP data basis, which has since been resolved, and expects the pilot to start in spring 2021.
This uncertainty has since been resolved and the expectation is that the pilot can start this spring.
Deze onduidelijkheid is inmiddels opgelost en de verwachting is dat de pilot dit voorjaar kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over rillen in een gasloos huis

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers about tenants in gas-free homes in Nijmegen's Meijhorst who were cold and faced rising energy bills, and whether the energy transition is affordable. Minister Ollongren said the situation is unpleasant, that Portaal is contacting tenants and will visit them, rejected the claim that the energy transition is unaffordable, and disputed the Ecorys projection of rising energy poverty.
I therefore do not get the impression that housing corporation Portaal is trying to shift the cause onto the residents.
Ik heb dan ook niet de indruk dat woningcorporatie Portaal de oorzaak op bewoners probeert af te wentelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra en Geluk-Poortvliet over de berichten 'Ronald McDonald Huis en provincie Utrecht in de clinch over nieuwe locatie logeerhuis' en 'Zelfs minister bemoeit zich met discussie over Ro
