MPs Terpstra and Geluk-Poortvliet asked why the Minister of OCW intervened in the planned relocation of the Ronald McDonald House on Utrecht Science Park, which falls within the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie heritage zone, and whether the minister could help by adjusting the nomination. The government answered that it asked the province to weigh the World Heritage aspect in its advice, that alternative sites outside the zone exist, and that the nomination boundaries cannot be changed at this stage.
In January 2021 I asked the Provincial Executive of Utrecht to properly take the World Heritage aspect into account in its advice.
In januari 2021 heb ik aan het College van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Utrecht gevraagd om in haar advies het aspect van werelderfgoed goed mee te nemen in de afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Terpstra over het bericht 'Taxatiebranche werkt samen aan kwaliteitsverbetering woningtaxaties'

An MP (Terpstra, CDA) asked the Minister of Interior about the new 2021 mortgage valuation report model for housing, its costs, the stacking of costs with energy labels and inspections, the examination pass rate of valuers and liability. The minister answered that the sector self-regulates, the new model adds risk and sustainability information without longer on-site inspection time, costs are not yet clear and will be monitored, and that the sector is urged to reuse existing data.
I have no insight into how many valuers have already passed the examination and how many still have to take it.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel taxateurs op dit moment al geslaagd zijn voor het examen en hoeveel taxateurs het examen nog moeten afleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht 'De computer mag de taxateur straks niet meer vervangen bij bepalen waarde woning'

Two MPs from the VVD asked about reports that the EBA guidelines will bar purely computer-generated valuations for mortgages, raising concerns about higher costs and longer waiting times. The Minister of Finance answered that a hybrid valuation (model checked by a valuer) will remain permitted, that cost and duration effects are expected to be limited, and that DNB and the ECB will decide how to apply the guidelines in supervision.
It is for DNB and the ECB, as independent and autonomous authorities, to determine how they will apply the guidelines in supervision.
Het is aan DNB en de ECB als zelfstandige en onafhankelijke autoriteiten om te bepalen hoe zij de richtsnoeren zullen toepassen in het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitvoering van de Wet tot samenvoeging van de gemeenten Groningen, Haren en Ten Boer

MP Krol asks the Minister of Interior about the 2019 Groningen-Haren-Ten Boer merger: whether an evaluation of another merger applies here, whether solar parks planned by Groningen breach the merger agreement, how local taxes rose for former Haren residents, and whether an investigation into official bias is warranted. The Minister answers that the evaluation does not apply, that solar park planning is a matter for regional energy planning and the municipality, that cost increases are largely not caused by the merger, and that she again declines an independent investigation.
I am therefore again not willing to start such an investigation, because I do not see its added value.
Ik ben dus wederom niet bereid een dergelijk onderzoek op te starten, omdat ik de meerwaarde ervan niet zie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Terpstra over het uit zijn huurhuis zetten van een bejaarde man door sociale woningcorporatie Stek in Lisse

MPs Peters and Terpstra asked whether housing corporation Stek should refrain from evicting a 76-year-old man from his social rental home in Lisse, given the COVID-19 agreement not to evict tenants, and what instruments the government has to enforce it. The minister replied that the case falls outside the agreement because the eviction rests on persistent nuisance rather than rent arrears, that an alternative temporary housing solution has been found, and that the eviction was postponed to 5 April.
The specific situation you ask me about falls outside the scope of the agreements in the statement.
De specifieke situatie waar u mij over bevraagt, valt daarmee buiten de reikwijdte van de afspraken in het statement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de stop van de subsidie energiebesparing eigen huis (SEEH)

An MP asked whether the SEEH energy-saving subsidy for homeowners' associations (VvE's) was closed early, why the advice-cost window closed while budget remained, and whether it would reopen with additional funds. The minister confirmed the temporary closure to free budget for already submitted applications, and committed to reopening the scheme with roughly 31 million euro in total, including about 14 million for new measures.
I informed your House of this in my letter of 1 March 2021 and in the answers to the earlier questions from the SGP faction.
Ik heb dit aan uw Kamer gemeld in mijn brief van 1 maart 2021 en in de antwoorden op de eerdere vragen van de SGP-fractie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het artikel 'Ik wil niet meer alleen maar over de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) praten'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked the ministers why a permit for replacing a damaged manure cellar in Groningen has taken eighteen months, and what can speed up gas-damage procedures. The minister explains that permitting lies with municipalities and the province, that the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen is still reviewing sector responses to its expert advice on manure-cellar damage, and points to the Versterken bill and coordination efforts to speed up procedures.
The permitting process for building a manure basin falls under the authority of the municipality and province.
Het vergunningsproces voor de bouw van een mestbassin valt onder het gezag van gemeente en provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de funderingsproblematiek

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about foundation damage in cities and rural areas, including costs to homeowners, the Fonds Duurzaam Funderingsherstel, the role of KCAF and RVO, and innovation for bacterial decay of wooden piles. The government answered that the problem is poorly quantified and complex, that the loan fund has issued only 34 loans, that KCAF declined cooperation, and that the Rijksprogramma Aanpak Funderingsproblematiek will be developed further in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het deltaplan aanpak funderingsschade

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the Deltaplan on foundation damage, including the claim that a million homes face risk, the role of groundwater management, how owners with unaffordable repair costs are helped, and whether the Rijk should take a stronger coordinating role. The Minister disputes the scale of the claim (at most 80,000 homes in the relevant damage bracket), explains the division of groundwater responsibilities among provinces, water boards and municipalities, points to the Fonds Duurzaam Funderingsherstel, and says that any new ministry question is for formation talks.

I am of course willing to hold talks with the coalition of the Deltaplan aanpak funderingsschade, together with the other responsible departments and co-governments, to see how we can jointly prevent foundation problems and solve current ones.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid om samen met de andere verantwoordelijke departementen en medeoverheden het gesprek te voeren met de coalitie van het Deltaplan aanpak funderingsschade
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat journalisten stiekem konden meekijken bij online tentamens

MPs asked the education minister about reports that journalists could covertly watch online exams at Hanzehogeschool, exposing student names and ID numbers, and what safeguards exist. The minister confirmed the breach, described remedial steps and a notification to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, said no new regulation is needed, and declined to keep a register of online exam incidents, citing institutions' own responsibility.
Higher education institutions bear responsibility under their statutory duties for ensuring the quality of (online) examinations and their components.
Hoger onderwijsinstellingen dragen vanuit hun wettelijke taak de verantwoordelijkheid om de kwaliteit van de (online) examens en de onderdelen daarvan te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kuiken over het dubbele testbeleid voor vliegreizen

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked the ministers about the double testing regime for flights into the Netherlands, including data on positive tests, crew testing, quarantine compliance, airport test availability and EU coordination. The government answered that it holds no data on positive tests before departure, said compliance and crew results are not registered or are low, and maintained that pre-departure testing is more effective, while committing to extend the rapid test validity to 24 hours.
The cabinet has no data on the number of travellers who tested positive with a PCR test before they wanted to travel to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft geen data over aantallen reizigers die positief zijn getest met een PCR-test voordat zij naar Nederland wilden afreizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over het stopzetten van huurtoeslag wegens geboorte kind

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked the ministers why a Belastingdienst benefit (huurtoeslag) was stopped because a newborn lacked legal residence status, and sought details on frequency, legal basis, and planned changes. The government answered that a birth alone is not grounds to stop the allowance, that stoppage occurs only after four months without a residence application, that the case was resolved, and that it is exploring rule changes such as raising the age threshold to 18.
I cannot go into the specific circumstances of an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Kosten nieuwbouw stijgen met 16 procent door BENG-eisen'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a report that new-build costs rise 16% due to BENG energy requirements, and about cost increases in construction generally. The minister rejected the 16% figure, citing estimates of 4-8% for BENG-related cost increases, and said cost increases are largely driven by market conditions and that the government is working with the sector on cost reduction.
There is no 16 percent cost increase for new construction due to BENG requirements.
Er is bij nieuwbouw geen sprake van 16 procent kostenstijging door BENG-eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sneller en Schonis over het bericht 'Particuliere beleggers slepen notarissen voor de rechter vanwege rol in dubieuze grondhandel'

MPs asked whether land speculation rules changed since 2019, whether notaries adequately protect private investors, and how buyers are protected against speculators. The minister replied that no relevant legislative changes occurred, that fragmentation is limited (about 0.13% of farmland), that notaries' independence rules and disciplinary oversight apply, and that consumer protection and AFM oversight exist, promising a further answer.
Since May 2019 there have been no legislative amendments aimed at bringing land positions under AFM supervision or at countering land speculation.
Sinds mei 2019 zijn geen wetswijzigingen geweest die erop gericht waren grondposities onder het AFM-toezicht te brengen of gericht waren op het tegengaan van grondspeculatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het nog altijd veel te hoge aantal afgekeurde poststemmen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the over 4 percent invalid postal votes, still high in Doetinchem after measures, would be reduced. The Minister explained that many postal votes are set aside for valid reasons (missing ballot or pass), described a procedure to open envelopes to check for passes, and said the set-aside rate would fall significantly.

As I informed the House in my letter of Tuesday 16 March, I asked all municipalities to have postal voting boards open the ballot envelope when the return envelope contains only that envelope, to check for a voter pass.

Zoals ik in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van dinsdag 16 maart jl. heb laten weten, heb ik alle gemeenten verzocht om de briefstembureaus te vragen om, wanneer de retourenvelop uitsluitend een briefstembiljetenvelop bevat, deze envelop te openen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat veel poststemmen ongeldig zijn

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether it is harmful to trust in democracy that postal votes are invalidated over minor errors, and whether ballots sent together with the voting pass in one envelope will be counted. The minister answered that such votes should count, announced a procedure letting polling staff open the envelope to check the pass and count the ballot without viewing it, and confirmed the answers would be provided on time.
That is why, upon receiving signals from the municipalities, I immediately took action and requested guidance from the Council of State and advice from the Electoral Council.
Daarom heb ik gelijk na het ontvangen van de signalen van de gemeenten actie ondernomen en voorlichting gevraagd aan de Raad van State en advies aan de Kiesraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de problemen met briefstemmen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about invalid postal votes, the expected share of invalid ballots, and whether votes with the passpass and ballot in the same envelope should still be counted despite the secrecy of the vote. The Minister said some municipal postal-vote boards found no passpass in return envelopes, outlined a procedure approved by the Electoral Council and Council of State that lets boards open the inner envelope only to check the passpass so the ballot is counted without being viewed, and sent this to municipalities.
Therefore no votes will be lost from voters who put a ballot envelope containing the passpass and ballot into their return envelope.
Daarmee gaan dus geen stemmen verloren van kiezers die in hun retourenvelop een briefstembiljetenvelop hebben gestopt met daarin de stempluspas en het briefstembiljet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over honderden bewoners van de Rotterdamse wijken Bloemhof en de Afrikaanderwijk die niet kunnen stemmen vanwege ontbrekende stempassen

MP Kuzu asked the Interior Minister about hundreds of residents in Rotterdam's Bloemhof and Afrikaanderwijk who could not vote because their polling cards were not delivered, and whether the municipality acted adequately. The minister answered that a PostNL courier withheld 195 polling cards, that 68 voters requested replacements and the remaining 127 cards were delivered, that the prosecutor dropped the case, and that the municipality has ordered an external investigation.

Following signals from politicians, residents and the Bloemhof neighbourhood council, the Rotterdam mayor instructed that people in the area where polling cards were reportedly not delivered be actively informed of the option to request a replacement polling card.

Naar aanleiding van signalen vanuit de politiek, bewoners en de wijkraad Bloemhof heeft de burgemeester van Rotterdam opdracht gegeven om in de wijk waar volgens genoemde signalen geen stempassen zijn bezorgd, mensen actief te wijzen op de mogelijkheid om een vervangende stempas aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over aanhoudende berichten over ongeldige briefstemmen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of large numbers of invalid postal votes in the March 2021 election, including how many were set aside, why, and whether they could still be counted. The minister said no national count of set-aside votes exists yet, that procedures and guidance have been issued, that the first 400,000 misdelivered envelopes were being redistributed to other municipalities, and that the House itself can open sealed ballot packages to investigate validity.
I therefore do not currently have figures on the total number of set-aside or invalid votes.
Ik beschik nu dus niet over cijfers over het totaalaantal terzijdeleggingen of ongeldige stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de onafhankelijkheid van de organisatie die de beveiliging van de verkiezingssoftware heeft onderzocht

An FvD MP asked the Interior Minister whether the independence of Hackdefense, which audited the election software OSV2020 commissioned by the Kiesraad, was compromised given its sole shareholder's alleged D66 membership and politics. The minister said the Kiesraad ran a European tender under public procurement rules, that the ministry (via UBR/HIS) only advised on the procurement process and had no role in the audits, and that the Kiesraad is responsible for commissioning security tests.
The Ministry of the Interior has had no involvement in the investigations and/or tests that the Kiesraad had carried out.
Het Ministerie van BZK heeft geen betrokkenheid gehad bij de onderzoeken en/of testen die de Kiesraad heeft laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Kerstens en Kuiken over zorgcowboys die gemeenten op kosten jagen

MPs Nijboer, Kerstens and Kuiken asked about 'zorgcowboys' moving clients across the country to the detriment of municipalities, municipal financial strain in youth care, benefits and shelter, and whether this causes social rental housing construction problems and gatekeeping of care. Minister De Jonge answered that no signals of such practices were received, pointed to COVID compensation, extra youth-care funds and the planned residence-principle reforms, and largely deferred the structural funding question to a future cabinet.
Decision-making on a structural solution in terms of adjusting the system from 2022 and the required budget will be left to a next cabinet.
Besluitvorming over een structurele oplossing in termen van aanpassing in het stelsel vanaf 2022 en benodigd budget, zal aan een volgend kabinet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het artikel van mr. dr. F.H. Kistenkas 'Door het invoeren van één milieuwet zullen waarden als natuur en biodiversiteit als eerste sneuvelen'

MP Van Gerven asked the Minister of Interior whether the Omgevingswet (Environment and Planning Act) relies on policy rather than binding instruments, how national and local interests are reconciled, and why the Fryske Marren sand-extraction island was blocked despite national policy. The Minister replied that regional cooperation is supported by policy instruments backed where needed by binding instructions and projectbesluiten, that the Rijk can intervene through instructie- and inpassingsprocedures, and that the Fryske Marren case reflects a working policy cycle; she declined to reintroduce a Planologische kernbeslissing.
The Omgevingswet requires administrative bodies, when exercising their tasks and powers, to take into account the tasks and powers of other authorities and to coordinate where necessary.

In de Omgevingswet is geregeld dat bestuursorganen verplicht zijn om bij het uitoefenen van hun taken en bevoegdheden rekening te houden met de taken en bevoegdheden van andere overheden en zo nodig afstemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over ongeregeldheden in Urk

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about riots and arson in Urk linked to COVID-19 measures, whether the violence was unacceptable, why it escalated despite police reinforcements, and whether the mayor was supported and enough enforcement was in place. The minister condemned the violence, said enforcement is the mayor's responsibility under the municipal council, described contacts with the mayor and support networks, and said the situation had calmed.
The mayor is responsible for maintaining public order and is accountable to the municipal council for this.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving van de openbare orde en legt daarover verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Snoeren en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Wethouder voor twee maanden kost Meerssen bijna drie ton!'

MPs Snoeren and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the Minister of Interior about a Meerssen alderman whose two-month tenure triggers a large wachtgeld (severance) payment, and whether the costs and BBV provisioning rules create perverse incentives for small municipalities. The minister defended the career principle in the APPA pension law, said the Meerssen case is exceptional, and rejected amending the law.
I am not considering any amendment of the Appa on this point.
Ik overweeg op dit punt geen aanpassing van de Appa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat gemeente Midden-Groningen er een potje van maakt met recreatiepark De Leine

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that Midden-Groningen municipality is enforcing against permanent residence in holiday bungalows at De Leine, and whether this fits with earlier motions on proportionate enforcement and a transformation task force. The minister said the municipality is aware of the human-scale principle, residents get time to find housing, the task force is to be operational around summer 2021, and she has contacted the municipality and will deliver an assessment framework around summer.
Following your questions, I contacted the municipality of Midden-Groningen and brought my call to apply the human scale in enforcement on permanent residence to its attention.

Naar aanleiding van uw vragen heb ik contact opgenomen met de gemeente Midden-Groningen en mijn oproep om de menselijke maat te hanteren in de handhaving op permanente bewoning onder de aandacht gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Wonen op een vakantiepark? Meeste Veluwse gemeenten willen daar niets van weten’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about permanent residence on holiday parks, including enforcement, criminality, housing supply and capturing land-value gains. The Minister answered that decisions belong at local level, pointed to an action agenda on undermining crime, admitted unknown effects on housing supply, and said land-value gains cannot in principle be taxed although cost recovery is under study.
In principle it is not possible to claw back land-value gains.
Het is in principe niet mogelijk om bestemmingswinsten af te romen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over eventuele voornemens het demonstratierecht te beperken

MP Van Raak (SP) asked whether the government planned extra conditions on demonstrations, including caps on participant numbers and time slots, and whether municipalities had received information the Chamber had not. Minister Ollongren answered that the normal Wom procedure applies, that bans or limits must be assessed case by case by mayors, that a Veiligheidsberaad handreiking allows participant caps for health reasons, and that the questions were answered as soon as possible.
A demonstration may only be restricted by the mayor or, in extreme cases, banned, if necessary to protect health, in the interest of traffic, or to combat or prevent public disorder.

Een demonstratie kan door de burgemeester alleen worden beperkt of, in het uiterste geval, worden verboden, als dat noodzakelijk is ter bescherming van de gezondheid, in het belang van het verkeer of ter bestrijding of voorkoming van wanordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er in Dronten vijf stembureaus minder komen

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether Dronten's polling stations are being reduced despite a motion requiring more, and whether the government will intervene. The minister confirms the reduction in polling locations (18 to 13 stemlokalen, but 18 to 20 stembureaus), says the government urges municipalities to maintain polling locations, and states that Dronten's choice is its own responsibility.
I have previously pointed municipalities to the importance of maintaining the number of polling locations at the level of the 2017 Tweede Kamer election
Ik heb gemeenten eerder gewezen op het belang van het op peil houden van de stemlokalen/locaties ten opzichte van de Tweede Kamerverkiezing in 2017
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over woningeigenaren die huren bij een woningcorporatie

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about social tenants who own several homes, including a Súdwest-Fryslân tenant owning 59 properties, and whether ownership should be checked before allocating social housing. The minister said the Kadaster found 1055 social tenants also owning two or more homes, that such situations are undesirable, that corporations can include clauses in leases and terminate contracts, and that further research is planned.
Research by the Kadaster found that 1055 people rent a home from a housing corporation while also owning two or more owner-occupied homes.
Uit onderzoek van het Kadaster is naar voren gekomen dat 1055 personen een woning bij een woningcorporatie huren en tegelijk twee of meer koopwoningen in eigendom hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra over het bericht ‘Huren van de corporatie terwijl je 59 panden bezit’

MPs Koerhuis and Terpstra asked the minister about reports that some social rental tenants also own one or more homes, including owners of many properties. The minister answered that such occupancy is undesirable, cited Kadaster data showing 1,055 tenants with two or more owned homes, and promised further research and talks with Aedes and the VNG on remedies.
It is undesirable if a tenant 'occupies' a social rental home from the housing corporation when he is not entitled to it to meet his housing needs because he owns one or more owner-occupied homes.

Het is ongewenst als een huurder een sociale huurwoning van de woningcorporatie «bezet houdt», als hij niet op die woning is aangewezen om te voorzien in zijn woonbehoefte vanwege het bezit van één of meer koopwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het verloop van het verkiezingsproces inzake de komende Tweede Kamerverkiezing

Baudet (FvD) asked the Interior Minister about fraud risks, storage and counting of postal ballots, the handling of ballots lacking signatures on voting passes, the suspension of counting, screening of election officials, and mask rules for the March 2021 Tweede Kamer election. Minister Ollongren answered every question in substance, explaining the safeguards in the Temporary COVID-19 elections law and its regulations while acknowledging some residual risks.
I will assess during the evaluation of the election to what extent it has occurred that no signature was placed on the voting pass.
Ik zal bij de evaluatie van de verkiezing bezien in welke mate het is voorgekomen dat er geen handtekening is gezet op de stempluspas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Otterloo over het artikel ‘Klein experiment met poststemmen in Den Haag’

The MP asks the Minister of Interior about a small trial in The Hague in which several people made errors filling in the postal ballot form, and about voter guidance, error rates and usability testing for voters aged 70 and over. The Minister points to earlier focus-group testing and adjustments, explains which errors lead to rejection of a postal vote, and lists communication measures and helplines.
The explanation voters aged 70 and over receive with their postal ballot documents is aimed at ensuring the voter follows all steps so they cast their postal vote correctly.
De uitleg die de kiezers van 70 jaar en ouder krijgen bij hun briefstembescheiden is erop gericht dat de kiezer alle stappen volgt, zodat zij hun briefstem op de correcte wijze uit brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten 'Dronter gezin al jaren bedreigd vanwege geografische coördinaten' en 'Hoe boze demonstranten door Google en CIA bij deze onschuldige familie in Dronten terechtkom

An MP asks the Justice and Security minister about reports that a Dronten family has been repeatedly threatened because online maps link their IP address to the geographic centre of the Netherlands, and what the government will do. The minister says police are already acting on criminal threats, commits to facilitating contacts with US bodies and Google at the municipality's request, and points to broader online-harm measures, while noting that linking an IP address to coordinates is not a crime.
The municipality of Dronten has sent me a letter requesting support to restore normality to the situation.
Vanuit de gemeente Dronten heb ik inmiddels per brief het verzoek gekregen om ondersteuning te bieden om de ontstane situatie weer te normaliseren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Otterloo over de artikelen ‘Frankrijk stelt regionale verkiezingen drie maanden uit’ en ‘Spaansgezinde socialisten groeien flink maar separatisten behouden meerderheid

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that French regional elections were postponed by three months due to COVID-19 and about lower turnout in Catalonia, and asked which criteria determine whether Dutch elections can safely proceed. The minister answered that countries make their own assessments, that the Dutch election is being organised safely with no fixed infection threshold, and that surveys show over 80% of voters intend to vote, while declining to set an acceptable turnout drop or a deadline for postponement.
There is no reason at all to think the House of Representatives election cannot go ahead in March.
Er is geen enkele reden om te denken dat de Tweede Kamerverkiezing niet kan doorgaan in maart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat studenten van de Erasmus Universiteit een tweede camera moeten gebruiken bij tentamens

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether the Erasmus University's requirement for a second camera during proctored exams is proportionate and privacy-compliant, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that institutions decide their own measures after a risk analysis with the data protection officer, that she calls on institutions to use second cameras only when strictly necessary, and that alternatives to proctoring should be offered where possible.
I call on educational institutions to be restrained in using a second camera for online examinations and to adopt this measure only where it is deemed strictly necessary.
Ik roep onderwijsinstellingen op om terughoudend te zijn met de inzet van een tweede camera bij online tentaminering en alleen over te gaan op deze maatregel als het strikt noodzakelijk wordt geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het sluiten van de subsidieregeling energiebesparing eigen huis (SEEH)

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why the SEEH subsidy for homeowners' associations (VvE's) was closed early, whether all 2020 applications can be honoured, and how the government will support VvE sustainability. Minister Ollongren answers that EUR 70 million will be made available so all valid 2020 applications are paid and the scheme reopens, while acknowledging that early closure may harm trust and promising an evaluation in 2021.
I make EUR 70 million in budget available on the BZK budget for the SEEH.
Ik stel 70 miljoen euro aan budget op de BZK begroting ter beschikking voor de SEEH.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de grote afstand naar stembureaus

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether voting should be accessible and whether long distances to polling stations, such as those for elderly residents in Eindhoven, are undesirable, and whether all municipalities should be reminded to spread polling stations well. The minister answered that voting stations should stay accessible, that Eindhoven spread its locations carefully with mobile polling at care homes, and that she sees no need to repeat the reminder because municipalities already understand the importance of spread.
I have previously pointed municipalities to the importance of keeping polling locations at the level of the 2017 Lower House election and of spreading them and making them accessible.
Ik heb gemeenten eerder gewezen op het belang van het op peil houden van de stemlocaties ten opzichte van de Tweede Kamerverkiezing in 2017 en op het belang van spreiding en toegankelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over mensen die hun woning moeten verlaten respectievelijk kwijtraken als ze hun zorgindicatie verliezen of worden opgenomen in een GGZ-instelling

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the government about people losing their homes when care indications end or when they are admitted to mental health institutions, and about the gaps in housing and support, the reduction of support hours, the household-sharing norm, and municipal responsibilities. The state secretary answered that no central figures exist on homelessness caused by expiring care indications, pointed to municipal responsibility, planned expert support and the Wvggz/Participatiewet frameworks, and said action is being taken through working agreements and a new plan.
At central level there is no insight into the amount of support that municipalities provide under the Wmo 2015.
Op centraal niveau bestaat geen inzicht in de omvang van de begeleiding die gemeenten op basis van de Wmo 2015 verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Slechts voor genodigden, liefst anoniem: fondsenwerving bij de VVD’

An MP asked whether private sponsorship of VVD party events and advertising, reported as anonymous fundraising, constitutes a reportable in-kind donation under the Wfpp and what the consequences of non-compliance are. The minister said the rules treat in-kind gifts like cash gifts, that she cannot judge the cases from the article alone and has asked the VVD for information, and that sanctions range from an audit review to a fine of up to 25,000 euro per violation.

Whether the cases mentioned in the article must be classified as in-kind contributions I cannot assess based solely on the information in this article. I have therefore asked the VVD to inform me about this.

Of de in het artikel genoemde casussen als bijdrage in natura moeten worden aangemerkt kan ik op basis van enkel de informatie in dit artikel niet beoordelen. Ik heb daarom de VVD verzocht mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Klein experiment met poststemmen in Den Haag’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of the Interior about a small Den Haag postal-voting experiment that revealed problems for over-70 voters, including invalid ballots from incorrect forms or envelopes. The minister answered that the instructions are sent with the postal ballot documents, explained how the secrecy of the vote is safeguarded, stated she knows of no earlier experiments, and shared the instructions on request.
It is essential that voters put their voting pass and the postal ballot in the return envelope when voting by post.
Essentieel is dat de kiezers hun stempluspas en het briefstembiljet in de retour- envelop doen als ze per brief stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Aartsen over het bericht 'gemeente als huurbaas geen pretje'

MPs Koerhuis and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether it is true that businesses cannot negotiate lower rent with the municipality of Amsterdam, whether other large municipalities have similar policies, and whether municipalities should be urged to give tenants tailored relief during COVID. The state secretary replied that Amsterdam offers rent deferral, interest-free repayment and cancellation for bankrupt tenants, and announced a 10 million euro fund for rent discounts, but gave no overview of other municipalities and said municipalities must decide their own role.
No overview is available of the rent discount policy for businesses during the coronavirus period of all municipalities with more than 100,000 inhabitants.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van het beleid inzake huurkorting voor ondernemers in coronatijd van alle gemeenten met meer dan 100.000 inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Bouwen met hout? Dat is niet duurzaam, zegt de norm'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the MPG building-environment norm discourages timber construction because it does not credit stored CO2, and asked about a French 50% biobased materials rule and the motion on sustainable timber. The minister agreed the norm does not credit CO2 storage in biobased materials, agreed to examine how to include it and to explore a French-style rule, and described existing and planned actions.
In my answer to questions from MP van Eijs I committed to determine how the environmental impact of CO2 storage in biobased materials, including timber, can be included in our national system.

In mijn antwoord op vragen van lid van Eijs heb ik toegezegd te bepalen hoe de waardering van de milieueffecten van de opslag van CO 2 in biobased materialen, waaronder hout, kan worden opgenomen in onze nationale systematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de machtsstrijd bij de nieuwe Milieudatabase

MP Van Eijs (D66) asked the Minister of Interior whether the transfer of management of the national environmental database (NMD) to the Stichting NMD raised concerns about governance, objectivity and stakeholder representation. The minister answered that the ministry's responsibility is the same as for other norms, that the foundation's governance adequately represents stakeholders and science, and that communication was adequate.
The ministry provides a financial contribution to the Stichting NMD.
Het ministerie geeft een financiële bijdrage aan de stichting NMD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het rapport van Gronings Perspectief over Voortgang en voetangels in het gaswinningsdossiers, Professionals over een complex systeem

An MP asked the ministers about a Groningen Perspectief report finding that officials and professionals in the gas-extraction file are overburdened by a fragmented, complex system. The minister reports that NAM has no role in damage handling or reinforcement, outlines existing channels, the reinforcement bill and communication measures, and largely states that existing processes are sufficient without committing to a structural change.

It is of great importance that the central government, the region, experts, the House and civil society organisations remain in constant contact to reach the best possible solutions for the situation in Groningen.

Het is van groot belang dat Rijk, regio, experts, Kamer en maatschappelijke organisaties voortdurend met elkaar in contact blijven om tot de best mogelijke oplossingen voor de situatie in Groningen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Verhoeven, Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat er tientallen communistische partijcomités binnen Nederlandse bedrijven in China bestaan

MPs from D66 and CDA asked the government whether it knew of Chinese Communist Party committees in Dutch companies in China, what economic or strategic effects this has, whether the government has agreements with these firms, and whether intellectual property is being stolen. The minister answers that the government is aware of such committees and offers general advice to firms, cites an EU Chamber survey suggesting limited influence, says precise numbers of party-linked board members are not held, and declines to comment on intelligence investigations.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on specific investigations by the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over specifieke onderzoeken van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over problemen met software die bij verkiezingen wordt gebruikt

An MP from the PVV asks the Interior Minister about reports that vote iT, linked to a German firm whose counting system was faulted, is connected to the Dutch election counting software OSV2020, and why risky software is used when counting is possible by hand, plus its costs and safeguards. The minister answers that the German software is different, that the Kiesraad owns OSV and tests it through independent audits and open source code, and that the software speeds counting while manual paper counts remain the basis.
To determine whether the software is suitable for use, the Kiesraad has the software examined by independent bodies.
Om te bepalen of de programmatuur geschikt is voor gebruik laat de Kiesraad de programmatuur onderzoeken door onafhankelijke instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over extra (financiële) steun voor de Waddeneilanden

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would provide extra financial support for the Wadden islands, including after the rejection of their regional deal and the impact of COVID-19 on tourism. The Minister answered that existing corona compensation and support schemes apply, that no additional islands-specific measures or funds are planned, and that no budget remains for new Regio Deals this cabinet period.
The cabinet currently sees no reason to take specific additional measures for the Wadden islands on top of this package.
Het kabinet ziet op dit moment geen aanleiding om bovenop dit pakket specifiek voor de Waddeneilanden extra maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurders die na sloop/nieuwbouw niet terug kunnen naar hun oude plek

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether tenants in the Groningen gas-field area who must be rehoused after demolition can return to their old neighbourhood at the same size, and why some are being offered smaller homes or homes elsewhere. The minister answered that corporations talk individually with each tenant, aim for a suitable home and same-street return where possible, but cannot always rebuild exactly what stood before, and that all corporations follow the same approach.
It is not always possible to rebuild exactly what stood there.
Het is niet altijd mogelijk exact terug te bouwen wat er stond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het groeiende aanbod van verhuurhypotheken

An MP asks the ministers about the growing supply of buy-to-let mortgages and their effects on starters and house prices. The minister answers that there are about 15 providers, that the government sees no problem with more providers but requires responsible lending, that it differentiated transfer tax to favour starters, and that it will introduce purchase protection and cap rent increases, while rejecting a numeric threshold for treating landlords as entrepreneurs.
In addition, I will cap the annual rent increase in the free sector, so that tenants in the free sector are also protected against unexpected excessive rent increases.
Daarnaast zal ik de jaarlijkse huurprijsstijging in de vrije sector maximeren, waardoor ook de huurders in de vrije sector worden beschermd tegen onverwachte excessieve huurverhogingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Particuliere woningverhuur groeit ondanks alles gestaag door’

MP Smeulders (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Interior about a report that private rental housing keeps growing, including investor purchases, by-to-let mortgages, the transfer tax increase for investors, and possible bans or municipal self-occupancy requirements. The minister answered in detail with Kadaster data, but declined to give a full count of by-to-let mortgages and argued a ban would likely fail EU law tests, while pointing to the transfer tax differentiation and an evaluation planned for 2024-2025.
I have no insight into how often rental mortgages are granted.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoe vaak verhuurhypotheken verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Particuliere woningverhuur groeit ondanks alles gestaag door’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that private landlords and investors account for around 40% of home purchases, and about definitions, transaction shares, buy-to-let trends and comparisons with other countries. The minister explained the broad investor definition used by the Kadaster, provided tables on transactions, buy-to-let shares, first-time buyer shares and ownership shares, and argued that investors are needed for a stable housing market while outlining measures on transfer tax and rent caps.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over fysieke woningbezichtigingen ten tijde van de coronapandemie

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about physical versus digital home viewings during the pandemic, the rules for physical viewings, and whether the number of viewings should be capped. The minister said no such figures exist, digital viewings are meant to reduce physical ones rather than replace them, and the industry associations' agreed protocols govern viewings, with the government staying in contact with them.
Such figures are not known to me.
Dergelijke cijfers zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Harbers over het bericht dat bewoners in Transvaal al dagen in de kou zitten

MPs Koerhuis and Harbers asked about residents of Transvaal in The Hague left without heating for days, a shortfall on the Energiek 2 district heating network owned by housing corporation Staedion, and whether corporations may run heat networks and why they are exempt from the Warmtewet licensing requirement. The minister answered that outages affected about 50 then about 20 homes, that tenants' protection lies with tenancy law and courts or the Huurcommissie, that ACM may enforce for non-tenants, and that no revision of the exemption is planned.
For tenants, disputes can be brought before the court or the Huurcommissie.
Bij geschillen ligt voor huurders de weg naar de rechter of Huurcommissie open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het achterblijven van de bouwambitie in Almere

Labour MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior why Almere's housing ambition lags behind the 60,000-home target agreed with the national government, and what consequences and steps follow. The minister replied that the agreements remain in force, that about 12,000 homes have been built since 2010, that a 25,000-home plan for 2020-2030 is a substantial acceleration, and that further steps are being explored in ongoing MIRT and regional processes.
Currently a programme is being developed in Almere to realise this acceleration task.
Momenteel wordt in Almere gewerkt aan een programma om deze versnellingsopgave te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de subsidieregeling Specifieke uitkering ventilatie in scholen

An MP asks the Dutch government about the SIVUS subsidy scheme for school ventilation, including whether school boards or municipalities bear primary responsibility for funding building ventilation and whether the investment ban for school boards is compatible with the required substantial works. The minister replies that school boards and municipalities share responsibility, that a bill to ease investment rules and an interdepartmental review are underway, and that funds have already been made available.
As communicated earlier before the summer, a bill is being prepared to improve the planning of housing investments.
Zoals eerder voor de zomer gecommuniceerd, is een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding om de planvorming voor investeringen in huisvesting te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de sociale woningbouw in Noord-Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about housing corporations' warning on social housing in Northern Netherlands, including support for replacing homes and liveability investments in sparsely populated areas. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing schemes (RVV, Woningbouwimpuls, Volkshuisvestingsfonds) and planned legislative changes, while leaving structural solutions to the next cabinet.
It is up to the next cabinet to make choices about structural solutions for the imbalance between the resources and tasks of corporations.
Het is aan het volgende kabinet om keuzes te maken over structurele oplossingsrichtingen voor de disbalans tussen de middelen en opgaven van corporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat het overgrote deel van de gemeenten grote tekorten heeft

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipal deficits caused by the corona crisis are unsustainable and whether hidden costs will be compensated without complicated procedures. The government acknowledges the financial strain, points to measures already taken and a February study on municipal finances, but refuses to commit to compensating all costs, leaving the amount to political-administrative weighing and deferring structural solutions to a next cabinet.

The amount and scope of real compensation requires a political-administrative weighing, with the starting point that the sub-national governments will not be worse off as a result of the corona approach than before.

De hoogte en omvang van de reële compensatie vraagt een politiek bestuurlijke afweging, waarbij het uitgangspunt is dat de medeoverheden er als gevolg van de corona-aanpak niet slechter voor komen te staan dan daarvoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht 'burgemeester Sjors Fröhlich over schadevergoeding Niemans: Dit is een mokerslag'?

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the practical and legal consequences for the municipality of Vijfheerenlanden of a €90 million damages ruling tied to a 40-year-old case involving a predecessor municipality, and whether the government would support it. The minister answered that the municipality must pay from its own funds, that supervision and the Article 12 safety net exist but are not expected to be needed, and that BZK and the province will help map the consequences.

The conversation led to the agreement that the municipality of Vijfheerenlanden, with support from BZK and the province of Utrecht, will map out the consequences of the ruling for Vijfheerenlanden's ambitions in relation to its financial position.

Het gesprek heeft geleid tot de afspraak dat de gemeente Vijfheerenlanden met ondersteuning van BZK en de provincie Utrecht de gevolgen van de uitspraak voor de ambities van Vijfheerenlanden in relatie tot de financiële positie in kaart gaat brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht "Bouwers in opstand tegen norm duurzaam bouwen: Hout dupe van oneerlijke rekensom"

MP Van Eijs (D66) asked the Minister of Interior whether CO2 storage in biobased materials such as wood should count in the MPG environmental calculations, given the 2050 climate-neutral ambition. The minister confirmed storage is not credited because the EN 15804 method, which follows EU norms, counts end-of-life emissions, but committed to examine how CO2 storage in biobased materials could be included within EU frameworks and to evaluate the calculation method with the NMD.
I therefore undertake to determine how the valuation of the environmental effects of CO2 storage in biobased materials, including wood, can be incorporated into our national system.
Ik zeg u daarom toe te bepalen hoe de waardering van de milieueffecten van de opslag van CO 2 in biobased materialen, waaronder hout, kan worden opgenomen in onze nationale systematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snoeren, Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht 'Woonbelasting weer omhoog: uitschieters tot +27%!'

VVD MPs asked the government about reported large rises in local property and waste charges for 2021, the effect of abolishing the macro norm and introducing the local-cost benchmark, and possible caps and measures against rising fees. The minister answered that the national picture awaits the COELO atlas, that the benchmark is too recent to evaluate (evaluation planned for 2025), that local councils decide on charges, and that the rise in the import-waste tax is unlikely to raise local waste fees.
It is still too early to determine the effects of introducing the local-cost benchmark, because the benchmark was only introduced in 2020.
Het is nog te vroeg om te kunnen constateren wat de gevolgen van de invoering van de benchmark lokale lasten zijn, omdat de benchmark pas in 2020 is ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over de Gasopslag in Norg

MPs Dik-Faber and Mulder asked about seismic risk, ground movement and damage compensation linked to the Norg gas storage, including the IMG's suspension of damage claim decisions in Drenthe. The minister answers that risks are low, that monitoring and the IMG's compensation process are adequate, and that the IMG is independent and is awaiting TU Delft and TNO advice.
The IMG is independent in its working method as a zbo. I attach great value to this independence; the IMG itself decides how it handles the aforementioned damage claims.
Het IMG is als zbo onafhankelijk in haar werkwijze. Ik hecht grote waarde aan deze onafhankelijkheid, het IMG bepaalt zelf hoe het omgaat met bovengenoemde schade-afhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Vestia wil jaren na derivatendrama opnieuw hulp van andere corporaties'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that Vestia, a housing corporation, again wants help from other corporations, questioning its financial results, planned sanering requests, settlements with banks, repayment of the 675 million euro rescue loan and a tax exemption. The Minister largely answered that the sanering period runs to 2022, that any new request will be judged then, that no new state support is given, and that structural solutions and tax measures are as described.
Assessment of a possible application will take place in due course, based on the application and the situation at that time.
Beoordeling van een eventuele aanvraag geschiedt te zijner tijd op basis van aanvraag en de situatie op dat moment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over koolmonoxide vergiftigingen door onveilige cv-ketel

MP Beckerman asked the government about a carbon monoxide poisoning incident in Amsterdam-Oost and the safety of AGPO Ferroli boilers, including recall warnings, certification, and enforcement. The minister answered that the incident was not caused by a defective Ferroli boiler but by improper reinstallation of a flue after maintenance, that Ferroli had issued warnings, and that new certification rules apply from 2022.
The carbon monoxide poisoning turns out not to have been caused by a defective boiler, but by the flue duct not being carefully reinstalled after maintenance.
De koolmonoxidevergiftiging blijkt niet veroorzaakt te zijn door een defecte cv-ketel, maar doordat het rookgasafvoerkanaal na onderhoud niet zorgvuldig werd teruggeplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over constructies om huurprijsregulering te ontduiken bij Kamerverhuur

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the legal construction of 'contractuele medehuur' (contractual co-tenancy) is used to evade rent regulation in room rentals, and what protections tenants have, including whether municipalities could require individual contracts. The minister answered that such practices are undesirable, that she is examining legal instruments for municipalities such as a landlord licence, and that the decision is left to the next cabinet.
I want to further map out which legal changes are needed to give municipalities more instruments to prevent these constructions and what the possible consequences of this would be.
Ik wil verder in beeld brengen welke wettelijke wijzigingen nodig zijn om gemeenten meer instrumenten te bieden om deze constructies te voorkomen en wat de mogelijke consequenties hiervan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat tien procent van de mensen overweegt niet te gaan stemmen in verband met het coronavirus

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether she is concerned that about ten percent of voters may stay home from the election because of the coronavirus, and whether covid-proof 'stemstraten' (voting lanes) should be mandated for all municipalities. The minister replied that a BZK survey shows 81% are certain to vote and 5% (waarschijnlijk) not, with 22% of those citing corona; she sees no need for separate voting lanes for symptomatic voters and declined to mandate them, noting the number of polling stations is broadly on par with 2017.
I am not in favour of obliging all municipalities to set up a voting lane.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van alle gemeenten te verplichten een stemstraat in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over stemmen per brief

An MP asked whether rising coronavirus risk at polling stations justifies widening postal voting beyond voters aged 70 and over. The minister replied that postal voting for all voters is undesirable because secrecy and freedom of the vote cannot be guaranteed as at a polling station, and that the timeline of the Electoral Act makes it unfeasible.
Postal voting for everyone is, in the government's view, undesirable.
Briefstemmen voor iedereen is naar de overtuiging van de regering onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht 'Rapport van Vrije Ondernemers Noordwijk (VON): GOM blijkt zelf de grootste onttrekker van 1e klas bollengrond'

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that the Greenport Ontwikkelingsmaatschappij is itself the largest taker of first-class bulb land, that councils are enforcing against gardens and pastures to keep bulb acreage, and whether this fits the National Spatial Strategy. The minister answered that land-use and enforcement decisions are a matter for the municipalities, that the national interest concerns agricultural land and open landscape only in general terms, and that she would not intervene in local powers.
It is not for me to intervene in the application of local powers where no national interest is at stake.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de toepassing van lokale bevoegdheden als daarmee geen nationaal belang gemoeid is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Brandbom bij Syrisch gezin in Heerlen: burenruzie of racisme’

The MP Kuzu asks the ministers about a Syrian family in Heerlen subjected to months of threats, intimidation and violence, including a reported firebomb, and about the roles of the municipality, police, housing corporation Vincio Wonen and its past discrimination record. The minister answers that investigations are ongoing and declines to discuss the specific incidents, states that local authorities are primarily responsible for safety and housing, and says the corporation's discrimination matter was previously prosecuted and dismissed while a new review of social media is underway.
While this investigation is ongoing, I do not wish to go into the substance of this specific case and the possible incidents.
Lopende dit onderzoek wil ik niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze specifieke casus en de eventuele incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over gevraagd losgeld om gehackte gemeentedata terug te krijgen

An SP MP asked whether the government agrees with a mayor refusing to pay ransom for hacked municipal data, whether public bodies have paid ransoms, how other municipalities are protected, and how many ransomware extortionists have been convicted. The government agreed that paying ransom is undesirable, said it does not register public-body cases separately and that there is no full picture of ransom payments, described existing cyber-resilience measures and a 2021 exercise on ransomware, and said ransomware is not a separate offence so convictions cannot be counted directly.
There is no complete picture of cases in which public institutions have paid ransom.
Er is geen volledig beeld van gevallen waarbij er door publieke instellingen losgeld is betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en het informeren van de Kamer

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked about delayed Wob freedom-of-information requests, the government's answers on the childcare benefit scandal, and the adequacy of earlier answers to parliament. The government denies deliberate delay for political reasons, says it knows of no such cases, admits some earlier answers were incomplete and promises to keep providing relevant information.
I will ask my colleagues to be more transparent going forward about the handling of a Wob request when handling it has taken a long time.
Ik zal mijn collega’s verzoeken in het vervolg transparanter te zijn over de afhandeling van een Wob-verzoek wanneer met de afhandeling van een Wob-verzoek veel tijd gemoeid is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het artikel van mr dr F.H. Kistenkas 'Door het invoeren van één milieuwet zullen waarden als natuur en biodiversiteit als eerste sneuvelen'

The SP's Van Gerven asked the minister whether the Omgevingswet's integrated approach, state steering and sustainability safeguards protect health, nature and environmental quality, drawing on a critical Volkskrant article and New Zealand's experience. The minister replies that the Act keeps sector-specific, EU-derived norms and mandatory assessment rules, that the national vision and instruments give the state steering power, and answers each question in turn.
The protection level that national regulation under the Omgevingswet provides is equivalent to the protection level of the current regulation.
Het beschermingsniveau dat de rijksregelgeving onder de Omgevingswet biedt, is gelijkwaardig aan het beschermingsniveau van de huidige regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van Eijs over het bericht ´Hoogleraren: stop de strijd tegen permanente bewoning van vakantiehuizen´

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are still enforcing against permanent residence in holiday homes and how this fits with the adopted motion on applying the human touch. The minister answered that municipalities should apply the human touch, that a quality and weighing framework is coming, and that municipalities should be cautious with enforcement and penalty payments during the second COVID wave.
Later this year I will come with a quality and weighing framework for municipalities.
Later dit jaar kom ik met een kwaliteits- en afwegingskader voor gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het ophalen van ondersteuningsverklaringen voor nieuwe partijen

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities that failed to let voters sign support declarations for new parties without an appointment should be re-instructed, and whether the collection period should be extended. The minister says she has reminded all mayors, contacted the municipalities concerned, and sees no need to extend the period because the covid-era extension already applies and the candidacy deadline is fixed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over het bericht 'Belgen krabbelen terug: eis negatieve test alleen voor wie langer dan 48 uur in België blijft'

MPs Schonis and Paternotte (D66) asked ministers about Belgium's COVID-19 negative-test requirement for travellers staying over 48 hours, its consultation with the Netherlands and border municipalities, and whether the Netherlands could impose a similar test requirement. The minister answered that consultation with Belgian and Dutch authorities took place, that the 48-hour rule benefits cross-border workers, that the Netherlands extended negative-test requirements to certain high-risk arrivals from 29 December, and that extending it to car traffic would require legislative change.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over arbeidsmigranten in verloederde huizen

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Interior about a landlord repeatedly linked to exploiting migrant workers and letting dilapidated housing, and about how municipalities and the government can prevent such landlords moving between municipalities. The Minister answered that enforcement lies mainly with municipalities, pointed to a regional pilot, knowledge sharing, planned tools such as a landlord permit and a blacklist review, and promised further letters including a government response to the migrant worker task force.
Enforcement of these abuses lies with the municipalities concerned themselves.
De handhaving van deze misstanden ligt bij de betrokken gemeenten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Van Aalst en Wilders over nieuwe rekenregels voor geluid die de woningbouw lam dreigen te leggen

PVV MPs asked whether new noise calculation rules for cumulative noise would stall housing construction, and whether windmill noise would be counted less strictly. The government answered that it is aware of the housing shortage, that the updated aviation noise rule is still under joint impact analysis with local partners and an interim transitional provision keeps the current formula, and that separate noise norms for windmills remain and their noise is included in cumulative assessment without being weakened.
Together with the administrative partners it has been agreed to jointly carry out a further impact analysis of the possible consequences of updating the aviation noise calculation rule.
Met de bestuurlijke partners is afgesproken gezamenlijk een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren naar de mogelijke consequenties van de actualisering van de rekenregel voor luchtvaartgeluid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht 'Vergoeding lekke mestkelder ‘lachertje’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about reports that compensation for leaking manure cellars damaged by Groningen earthquakes would be based on economic rather than actual damage, and about timelines and the IMG's approach. The government answered that the IMG will publish its method for manure cellar damage in early 2021, that the expert panel advised repair costs unless they exceed 1.25 times capitalised business damage, and that the IMG's independence limits pre-empting its decision.
It is not appropriate for me to anticipate this, also given the independence of the IMG.
Het past mij niet, ook gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van IMG, hier nu al op vooruit te lopen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Zoektocht naar 70 duizend extra stembureau leden: veel meer mensen nodig dan normaal' in de uitzending van WNL op maandag 30 november 2020

MPs Smals and Van Gent asked the ministers how they would address a shortage of about 70,000 polling station workers for the March 2021 elections, including whether vocational (mbo) students could fill roles, as an alternative to internships. The minister confirmed the proposals are being explored with the MBO council, VNG and other partners, and promised a January survey of municipalities and a possible regional or national reserve pool.
To get a good picture of the situation regarding the number of required polling station members, I will hold a survey among municipalities in early January.
Om een goed beeld te krijgen van de stand van zaken rond het aantal benodigde stembureauleden houd ik begin januari een peiling onder de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de vergoedingen van leden van adviescommissies

An MP asked why the 2005 promise to publish all advisory committee member fees was not kept, and about fees, anti-cumulation enforcement and total costs of advisory and task-force bodies. The Staatssecretaris said he has no powers over individual fees, that publication lies with line ministers, stopped central cumulative publication after 2016, and does not hold the requested data, citing the effort required and the lack of a clear definition for many bodies.
I do not have the requested information.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Terpstra de berichten ‘Over dingen die blijven’ en ‘Laat ons bouwen’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about provincial Noord-Holland spatial rules (protected landscapes, 11-home limit, overprogramming, corporation financing, aviation noise) that may block housing construction. The Minister answers that the province makes its own choices, that housing plan capacity is sufficient, that the aviation noise issue is under impact analysis, and that corporations face financing gaps requiring a future cabinet decision.
The province has indicated that for the Alkmaar region, in cooperation with the municipalities, it will start an exploratory trajectory to make an integrated assessment.
De provincie heeft aangegeven voor de regio Alkmaar in samenwerking met de gemeenten te starten met een verkenningstraject om een integrale afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Over dingen die blijven'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Noord-Holland's new environmental regulation, which designates 32 protected provincial landscapes, removed housing sites in Alkmaar and the BUCH municipalities, and whether this is due to provincial or national/EU rules. The Minister answers that some soft housing plans are constrained but mostly were already blocked, that the designations rest on existing protection regimes, that sufficient housing capacity exists, and promises to inform parliament in early 2021 on a regional follow-up.
The Environmental Regulation offers room to reach sufficient housing sites in line with this.
De Omgevingsverordening biedt ruimte om in lijn hiermee tot voldoende woningbouwlocaties te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Over dingen die blijven'

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked whether the new provincial environmental regulation designates all of Wijdemeren as protected landscape, removing housing sites, barn conversions and marina renovations, and asked the minister to pressure the province to reverse this. The minister confirmed a large part of the municipality is designated BPL, that only two housing locations fall away, that barn conversion rules were restored, and that the province will run a review of BPL boundaries, while declining to commit to a direct intervention.
I consider it important that sufficient housing is built that matches the need.
Ik vind het van belang dat voldoende woningen worden gerealiseerd die aansluiten bij de behoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over de beperkte dekking van asbestdaken

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Linde asked whether insurers such as Centraal Beheer and Achmea are limiting coverage of asbestos roof damage, leaving homeowners uninsured or underpaid, and whether the government will press insurers to reverse this. The minister (Finance) answered that he has no overview of insurers' conditions, that Achmea phases out coverage of asbestos roofing by 5% a year, that policy terms govern payouts, and that the government is asking the asbestos programme office to talk with insurers.
I have no insight into insurers' conditions.
Ik heb geen zicht op voorwaarden van verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra en Koerhuis over de bouwopgave in Noord-Holland in relatie tot het bericht ‘Nieuwe omgevingsverordening beschermt 32 bijzondere landschappen’

MPs Terpstra and Koerhuis asked whether the new Noord-Holland environmental regulation, including Bijzonder Provinciaal Landschap designations and extra sustainability requirements, makes outer-urban building nearly impossible and undermines the national housing target. The minister answered that the province still has ample housing plan capacity (127% outside the MRA, above 130% in the MRA), that the legal basis exists, and that she sees no evidence that plans will be blocked, while the enquiry was answered late due to consultation with the province.
For me it is paramount that provinces provide ample space for the realisation of building plans to meet the regional housing task.
Voor mij staat voorop dat provincies ruim voldoende ruimte bieden aan de realisatie van bouwplannen om invulling te geven aan de regionale bouwopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het drama voor de huizenkopers in Helmond

MP Nijboer asks the Minister of Interior about the Helmond housing project where buyers face unfinished homes after developer Earth & Eternity and contractor Gemert Bouw dispute payment, and about the Betaal Garant guarantee fund and how buyers can be protected. The minister answers that the municipality is supporting buyers, that court proceedings against the fund's director are pending, that existing market guarantee schemes and the Wet kwaliteitsborging information duty are relied on, and that a national guarantee fund is not considered necessary.
Court proceedings against the director of Betaal Garant Nederland are currently ongoing.
Momenteel loopt een gerechtelijke procedure tegen de bestuurder van Betaal Garant Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het afluisteren van o.a. de politie en marechaussee door de National Security Agency (NSA)

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister, on behalf of the Justice and Defence ministers, whether the Dutch police and military police were spied on by the US NSA through backdoored equipment, when the government learned of it, whether the US was asked for clarification, and which Dutch services still use US-origin equipment. The government declined to discuss specific equipment, the US contacts, or the services' methods publicly, noting CTIVD oversight and that it cannot guarantee equipment not developed under its own control, pointing to the National Crypto Strategy.
Publicly I cannot make statements about the equipment these services use, because this would give insight into their working methods.
In het openbaar kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de apparatuur die deze diensten gebruiken, omdat dit inzicht zou geven in hun werkwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over onwenselijke sloopplannen van de Peperstraat in Zaandam

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about plans to demolish the Peperstraat in Zaandam, including resident participation, relocation of tenants, the consideration of renovation, and whether the project falls under the woningbouwimpuls subsidy. The minister answered that the redevelopment is part of a wider area plan with participation via information meetings and a klankbordgroep, that a social plan covers relocation, and that the subsidy assessment followed the standard procedure, while leaving assessment of participation and communication largely to the municipality.
Giving a judgment on this is not for me. The municipality makes its own choice that suits the specific situation.
Een oordeel hierover geven is niet aan mij. De gemeente maakt daarin de eigen keuze die past bij de specifieke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Steen door de ruit en dreigbrief Molukse wijk in Elst'

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about reports of a stone through a window and a threatening letter in a Moluccan neighbourhood in Elst, and about the allocation policy giving Moluccans priority for housing in such neighbourhoods. The government explained the historical basis of the arrangements, said they exist in about 45 municipalities, denied that tensions are a recurring pattern, and said it sees no reason to revisit the agreement.
Apart from the incidents reported by the Gelderlander and the NOS, I am not aware of any signals so far that give cause to revisit this agreement.
Buiten de incidenten waarvan de Gelderlander en de NOS melding hebben gemaakt, zijn mij vooralsnog geen signalen bekend die aanleiding geven tot een herijking van deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Kröger over het mogelijk instellen van een (regionale) avondklok-maatregel

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government would use the Coordination Act on states of emergency or the Act on extraordinary powers of civil authority to impose a (regional) evening curfew during the COVID-19 pandemic, and why it now considered this after earlier saying a state of emergency was not necessary. Minister Grapperhaus answered that a curfew is not currently on the table, that it would be based on article 8 of the Wbbbg without declaring a state of emergency, that parliament would be informed in advance by royal decree, and that no substantive weighing of curfew measures has yet been made.
Of an intention to do so, notice will be given to the States General, so that views can be exchanged between government and States General if desired, unless urgency prevents it.

Van een voornemen daartoe zal mededeling worden gedaan aan de Staten-Generaal, zodat daarover desgewenst tussen regering en Staten-Generaal van gedachten kan worden gewisseld, tenzij de vereiste spoed zich daartegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Gijs van Dijk en Ploumen over het recente onderzoek van het College voor de Rechten van de mens over zwangerschapsdiscriminatie

Two PvdA MPs asked the government how it will respond to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens study finding that 43% of working women who gave birth 2016-2019 experienced pregnancy discrimination, and what enforcement, sanctions and reporting measures it will take. The State Secretary answers that a Labour Market Discrimination Action Plan, a bill giving the Inspectie SZW enforcement powers over recruitment, awareness campaigns and a planned meeting with stakeholders are underway, but gives no figures on fines issued and does not commit to new binding measures.
I consider it very important that women are aware that they can turn to someone if they suspect discrimination and that they can proceed to report it.
Ik acht het van groot belang aan dat vrouwen zich ervan bewust zijn dat zij bij een vermoeden van discriminatie ergens terecht kunnen en dat zij over kunnen gaan tot melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat in Groningen minder stemlokalen worden ingericht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Groningen plans fewer polling stations for the 2021 Tweede Kamer election and whether the government will press the municipality to add stations. The minister answers that a survey shows 51 municipalities, including Groningen, currently expect fewer polling stations, that she wants numbers kept at least stable, and that she has written to all municipalities and offered support.
As stated in your House, I have the ambition that the number of polling stations for the upcoming Tweede Kamer election remains at least at the same level.
Zoals uitgesproken in uw Kamer, heb ik de ambitie dat het aantal stemlokalen voor de aankomende Tweede Kamerverkiezing minimaal op peil blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Yassini over het bericht ‘Verhalenboek moet Achterhoeks stimuleren’

MPs El Yassini asked the ministers whether the regional dialect Achterhoeks, a Nedersaksisch variety, is supported, including private initiatives such as a dialect storybook and the 2018 convenant on Nedersaksisch recognition.
