Minister Ollongren answered that the government values regional languages, describes the convenant, the EUR 25,000 funding in 2019 and provincial support via ECAL, and says regional governments take the lead.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, as coordinating department, is in contact with the local governments involved in the recognised regional languages of the Netherlands.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties heeft als coördinerend departement contact met de lokale overheden betrokken bij de erkende streektalen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Otterloo over de artikelen 'Leidse burgemeester wil geen 70-plussers als lid van stemlokalen' en '70-plussers geweerd uit stembureaus'

The MP asks the Minister of Interior whether a Leiden mayor's policy of excluding over-70s from polling station work, and related COVID-19 risk concerns, is ageist and whether a voluntary or mandatory test should be offered. The Minister replies that people in risk groups may choose for themselves to serve, that exclusion of over-70s could raise age discrimination questions for courts or the Human Rights Commission, that testing cannot be mandatory, and that a recruitment campaign for poll workers is underway.
I see no reason to not let persons who fall within a risk group make the decision for themselves whether they wish to sign up as a polling station member.
Ik zie geen reden om personen die vallen in een risicogroep niet zelf de afweging te laten maken of zij zich willen aanmelden als stembureaulid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht 'Lenferink weert 70-plussers uit Leidse stembureaus, oud-wethouders woedend over leeftijdsdiscriminatie'

MPs Van der Molen and Geluk-Poortvliet (CDA) asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Leiden mayor excludes over-70s from polling station work for the March 2021 election, how that exclusion is assessed, and whether covid-19 health-check rules apply regardless of age. The minister confirmed that the covid-19 election act bars staff who answer yes to health-check questions or develop symptoms, referred to earlier answers on the mayor's decision, and said no reason exists to bar over-70s from volunteering, since they can decide for themselves.
I see no reason to deny persons aged 70 and over the choice themselves to register as polling station members.
Ik zie geen reden om personen van 70 jaar en ouder niet zelf de afweging te laten maken om zich aan te melden als stembureaulid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Ollongren wil verkiezingen uitsmeren over 15, 16 en 17 maart’.

An MP asked whether volunteer shortages for polling stations will worsen for the 2021 general election, how many extra staff are needed if polls open over several days, and how students can be recruited. The minister answers that at least 70,000 polling staff are needed nationally (over 10,000 extra if polls open on 15 and 16 March), that a national recruitment campaign started on 30 November and includes outreach to students.
It must be taken into account that at least 70,000 polling station members will nationally need to be deployed, including counters.
Er moet rekening mee worden gehouden dat er landelijk minimaal 70.000 stembureauleden ingezet zullen moeten worden, inclusief tellers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de berichten ‘Microwoning: een ‘echt’ huis voor minder dan 2 ton’ en ‘Flexwoningen, wel te huur niet te koop’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of the Interior about micro and flexible housing: how many projects exist, whether they can be financed with mortgages (including on leased land and for 15-year permits), infrastructure costs, and whether to meet with banks. The minister answered that no national monitor exists yet, explained mortgage conditions and NHG limits, and declined to meet lenders since some already offer such mortgages.
Although Statistics Netherlands is working on it, there is as yet no national registration or monitor of micro or flexible homes.
Hoewel het CBS daaraan werkt, is er nog geen landelijke registratie of monitor van micro- of flexwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de huisuitzetting van mantelzorger meneer Zilverentant

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporation WoonOpMaat was evicting a carer after his partner entered care, and whether this breached the COVID-era agreement against evictions. The minister answered that this was a voluntary termination co-signed by the tenant, not an eviction, and that the corporation agreed to extend his stay until 4 January 2021.
Following your questions, the housing corporation concerned has informed me upon request that in this case there is no question of an eviction or forced vacation of the dwelling.
Naar aanleiding van uw vragen laat de betreffende woningcorporatie mij desgevraagd weten dat er in het geval van de betrokkene geen sprake is van een huisuitzetting of ontruiming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘27.000 statushouders moeten volgend jaar huis krijgen’

MPs Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that 27,000 refugee status holders must be housed next year, the impact on social rental waiting lists, temporary housing pilots, and faster permit procedures. The minister acknowledged the heavy burden on municipalities, announced an extra 3 million euros for flexible housing pilots and a planning-procedure change via the Crisis- en herstelwet, but did not answer all questions due to time constraints.
Given the limited time span, that has not been possible.
Gegeven de beperkte tijdspanne is dat niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra, Peters, Agnes Mulder, Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de betaalbaarheid van duurzaamheidsinvesteringen en de leningen die hiervoor moeten worden afgesloten

MPs asked the Minister how homeowners lacking funds for sustainability investments can be protected from being forced into loans, following a NIBUD study showing at least two million owners cannot afford them. The minister agreed that people without borrowing capacity should not be compelled to borrow, pointed to the energy-saving mortgage with income-based repayment and debt forgiveness, and promised to ask the Warmtefonds to monitor financial stress among vulnerable groups.
Daar ben ik het mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de dreigende sluiting van de bibliotheek in Almelo

An MP asked ministers whether the Almelo public library faced closure due to a municipal subsidy cut and whether they would intervene. The minister acknowledged the importance of library access, said organising it is the municipality's responsibility, and noted the council reduced the cut from 200,000 to 100,000 euros so closure no longer applies.
Given the decentralised character of the library system, the way this is shaped is the responsibility of the municipality.
Gezien het decentrale karakter van het bibliotheekstelsel is de wijze waarop dit wordt vormgegeven de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de verkiezingssoftware hackbaar is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the election process should be made safer, whether a manual count should be added as a check if the vote-counting software proves hackable, and whether these questions would be answered before any legislative debate. The Minister answered only by referring to her separate reaction to a report by the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen, sent to parliament at the same time.
To answer these questions I refer to my response to the report of the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn reactie op het rapport van de stichting Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent, Middendorp en Van der Molen over het nieuws dat de uitslag van de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen kwetsbaar is voor hackers

MPs Van Gent, Middendorp and Van der Molen asked the Minister of the Interior whether election results are vulnerable to hacking through the counting software, whether manual checks exist, and whether publication of polling station reports is timely. The minister answered only by referring to a separate reaction to a report from the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen, so none of the seven questions were answered on substance.
For answering these questions I refer to my response to the report of the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn reactie op het rapport van de stichting Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Gent over Demonstratie tegen omstreden pedopartij

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Gent asked whether the Dutch party PVND, seen as a successor to the banned Martijn association, should be banned, whether it violates children's rights, and whether convicted offenders could be stripped of passive voting rights. The Minister of Justice answered that the OM is investigating and will not comment on ongoing inquiries, that deprivation of voting rights is only possible as a court-imposed sanction for serious offences against the state, and that a Political Parties Act is in preparation.
The Public Prosecution Service is conducting an investigation. No statements are made about ongoing investigations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) doet onderzoek. Over lopende onderzoeken worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Krotbeleggen: ‘triest’ spel van een beursfonds drijft gemeentes tot wanhoop’

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether the government would act against a listed fund that lets listed monuments decay to gain land positions, and whether exchange listings could be refused. The minister answered that municipalities already have enforcement powers under the Wabo and Woningwet, that Wassenaar has taken action, and that exchange exclusion and new general coercive measures are too far-reaching, so no further steps are planned.
For that reason we see no reason for follow-up steps.
Om die reden zien wij geen aanleiding voor vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de bestaande mogelijkheden om de overwaarde op een huis uit te laten betalen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about products that let homeowners cash out home equity, the AFM's oversight of them, and whether mandatory repayment rules push people to build equity. The minister answered that no total count exists, that the AFM supervises these products (with some sale-and-lease-back constructions falling under ACM), and that equity can arise from repayment, price rises or savings, with the government emphasising good advice and clear conditions.
Therefore there is no overall picture of the number of homeowners who annually use these financial products for that reason.
Daarom is er geen totaaloverzicht van het aantal huiseigenaren dat jaarlijks om die reden gebruikmaakt van deze financiële producten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de mogelijkheid voor raadsleden in Boxmeer om in coronatijd te kunnen stemmen

An SP MP asked whether councillors in Boxmeer should be able to vote during the COVID-19 period, and whether all councillors can exercise their voting rights given health risks. The Minister replied that participation is an essential right, that the municipal council chooses its meeting format under local autonomy, and that councillors can take part in deliberation digitally but not formally vote in a physical meeting.
Taking part in deliberation and in voting are essential rights of a councillor.
Het deelnemen aan een beraadslaging en aan een stemming zijn essentiële rechten van een raadslid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over Vestia en de huurverlaging

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior about Vestia's rent policy, its WSW sanitation constraints, the Social Rent Accord rent cut, and the transfer tax increase for housing corporations. The minister answered that Vestia may freeze or lower rents within the sanitation framework, that a mandatory rent reduction applies to Vestia tenants from 1 January 2021, and that a structural solution will be reported before year-end, while declining to offer specific compensation.
As promised in the committee meeting of 9 November 2020, I will inform the House before the end of the year about the steps I am taking to ensure a solution is on the table next year.

Zoals toegezegd in het WGO Wonen en Ruimte van 9 november 2020, informeer ik uw Kamer voor het einde van het jaar over de stappen die ik neem om te zorgen dat er volgend jaar een oplossing op tafel komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over herindelingsverkiezing Eemsdelta

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked why proxy votes, postal and early voting were not made possible for the Eemsdelta by-election in time, and what further measures could be taken. The minister answered that the Covid-19 election law provides a basis, that increasing proxy votes from two to three was dropped in consultation with municipalities as unworkable in time, and that postal and early voting are planned only for the March 2021 national election.
In the evaluation I will pay attention to the number of proxy votes cast.
In de evaluatie zal ik aandacht schenken aan het aantal uitgebrachte volmachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Terpstra over het bericht 'Migranten in Westland wonen in tenten en hutjes door gebrek aan huisvesting'

MPs Palland and Terpstra (CDA) asked ministers about reports that migrant workers in Westland live in tents and shacks due to lack of housing, including agreed bed-space targets and national support instruments. Minister Koolmees answered that the municipality reports about 4,500 people housed rather than 'barely any', that Den Haag is responsible for the tent images, and that the government will act on the Aanjaagteam advice and inform parliament by 16 December.
The cabinet is working on this and hopes to inform the House of Representatives about it by 16 December.
Het kabinet is hiermee aan de slag en hoopt voor 16 december daarover de TK te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Huurder moet langer wachten en is duurder uit'

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of the Interior whether the decline in social rental stock, longer waiting times, rent rises and priority allocation of social housing to status holders were acceptable, and whether rents would be cut. The minister rejected the criticism, citing growing corporation output, planned rent measures and CBS data showing rent increases below inflation, and refused to accept that priority for status holders is unfair.
I consider it important that housing corporations build more social rental homes.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat corporaties meer sociale huurwoningen gaan bouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de huurtoeslag en de uitwerking van het Sociaal Huurakkoord

An MP asked about implementing the Social Rental Agreement (Sociaal Huurakkoord), commercial landlords' obligations, and the reinstatement of rent allowance (huurtoeslag) for a case where the rent exceeded the threshold. The minister answered that the measures are being legislated or are in progress, outlined the rules on reinstated entitlement and a new hardship clause, and declined to take a position requiring commercial landlords to cut rents.
Expected later this year to inform the House of Representatives about possible adjustments to rental policy and regulations.
Naar verwachting later dit jaar informatie aan de Tweede Kamer over eventuele aanpassingen in huurbeleid- en regelgeving
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het agressief incassobeleid bij woningcorporatie De Key

The SP MP Beckerman asks the Minister of the Interior about De Key housing corporation's automated letters threatening bailiffs over disputed 2020 rent increases, and about tenants' rights to object. The Minister says objecting tenants should not receive payment reminders while proceedings run, describes the rappel procedure and cooperation with municipalities, and refers to ongoing work and information websites, without giving data on objections or on sector-wide practice.
I do not have an overview of the extent to which the over 2.2 million households in the social rental sector have objected to the rent increase effective 1 July.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht in hoeverre de ruim 2,2 miljoen huishoudens in de sociale huursector bezwaar hebben aangetekend tegen de huurverhoging per 1 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over 1 miljoen verzakkende huizen door bodemdaling

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Interior and of Infrastructure about the risk that up to a million homes sink due to land subsidence, the costs, who bears them, and what policy exists. The government answered that owners bear foundation repair costs, that municipalities and water boards manage groundwater with limited ability to prevent further sinking, and listed existing funding and support programmes without committing to new measures.
Enquiries with the provincial, water board and municipal associations show that it is not possible to provide this overview in full detail within the set deadline.
Uit navraag bij de koepels van provincies, waterschappen en gemeenten blijkt dat het niet mogelijk is om dit overzicht op de gestelde termijn «en detail» te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het ‘Hoe bewoners van het Wijnhaveneiland zich voor veel geld laten afkopen door projectontwikkelaars’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether residents of Rotterdam's Wijnhaveneiland are obstructing construction projects by holding out for payments from developers, and asks for data on objection and appeal procedures for zoning plans. The minister says compensation settlements are legitimate, that the government has no statistics on objections or settlements, that existing law already addresses abuse of procedure, and that the Council of State has sped up appeal rulings.
No statistics are kept on objections or appeal procedures against zoning plans or on how these procedures unfold.
Er worden geen statistieken bijgehouden van bezwaren of beroepsprocedures tegen bestemmingsplannen en/of hoe het verloop is van deze bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Terpstra over het bericht «Protest kost bouwers handenvol geld: Bezwaar maken voor financieel gewin gaat over rug woningzoekenden»

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether residents who file objections against housing projects for financial gain, often leading to secret settlements with developers, should be stopped and whether the rules should change. The minister said such financially motivated objections are undesirable but that existing law already allows declaring them inadmissible for abuse of rights, while refusing further legal changes and not intervening in contractual freedom of the settlements.
With further amendment, I consider the risk too great that legal protection of parties standing up for their legitimate interests would be undermined.
Bij verdere aanpassing vind ik het risico te groot dat rechtsbescherming van partijen die voor hun gerechtvaardigde belangen opkomen wordt aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en De Groot over het bericht ‘Fundering van 1 miljoen huizen bedreigd door laag grondwaterpeil’

MPs Van Eijs and De Groot (D66) asked about a report that about 1 million homes risk foundation damage from low groundwater, and about the responsibilities of water boards, farmers, municipalities and the state. The Minister answered that the damage estimate is per owner and largely modest, that government supports owners through viewers, funding funds and knowledge centres, and that owners are responsible for their foundations, while referring several questions to other levels and ministries.
This problem does not primarily lie with the water boards.
Deze problematiek ligt niet primair bij de waterschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Deurnese twintigers willen bouwen in villawijk: ‘Maar de buurt wil ons er niet bij hebben’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a news report on young people in Deurne whose housing plan in a villa neighbourhood was blocked by residents, and about how to promote mixed neighbourhoods, starter housing and municipal land availability. The minister answered that housing supply is mainly a local and regional matter, outlined general measures such as the Omgevingswet, the Expertteam Woningbouw and the woningbouwimpuls, and gave no specific commitment on the Deurne case.
Unfortunately I do not have factual information on the extent to which resistance from residents plays a delaying role in housing projects.
Helaas beschik ik niet over feitelijke informatie over de mate waarin weerstand van bewoners een vertragende rol speelt in woningbouwprojecten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Van den Bosch en Veldman over het toestaan en mogelijk maken van winterterrassen als reddingsboei voor horecaondernemers

VVD MPs asked whether winter terraces with covers and heaters could serve as a lifeline for hospitality businesses, whether municipalities should be encouraged to allow them, and what rules apply to tents and canopies under Covid measures. The government agreed terraces help and that municipalities should weigh allowing them, said it is a local decision, and explained that open-sided terraces count as outdoor locations, though it keeps no overview of municipal decisions.
Such an overview is not kept.
Een dergelijk overzicht wordt niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de kosten van WOZ-bezwaren voor gemeenten

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether no-cure-no-pay agencies profit from WOZ property-valuation objections while citizens gain little, and about the costs to municipalities. The minister says a WODC study is expected by end 2020, cites over EUR 12 million in cost reimbursements paid by municipalities in 2019, and states that objection procedures are already easy for citizens, with no further access measures planned for now.
The WODC study is expected to be delivered by the end of 2020.
Het onderzoek van het WODC wordt naar verwachting voor het eind van 2020 opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over aanpassing van de rente door hypotheekverstrekkers na wijziging van de WOZ-waarde

An MP asked whether mortgage lenders should actively inform borrowers when a rise in WOZ property value makes them eligible for a lower interest rate. The minister explained that lenders adjust risk surcharges based on loan-to-value, that borrowers may need to provide proof of higher value, and that lenders should inform clients, but declined to impose a specific new obligation, pointing to AFM supervision and sector initiatives.
I find it desirable that mortgage lenders actively lower the interest rate within the fixed-rate period when the debt decreases.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat hypotheekverstrekkers binnen de rentevastperiode de rente actief verlagen wanneer de schuld afneemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over hoe de samenleving in het gaswinningsgebied Groningen door de overheid wordt verscheurd 2.0

An SP MP asked the Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about residents of Groningen gas-field villages facing demolition and rebuilding of houses with limited choice, unfair treatment of owners who lost upgrades, and the fairness of differing 'regie' under the Bouwakkoord. The minister defended the process, admitted that individual wishes and upgrades cannot be fully guaranteed under current building rules, and promised to explore agreements to speed up reinforcement.
I am aware that residents of the earthquake region may experience stress and uncertainty as a result of gas extraction.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat bewoners van de aardbevingsregio door de gevolgen van de gaswinning stress en onzekerheid kunnen ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “hoe de samenleving in het gaswinningsgebied Groningen door de overheid wordt verscheurd”

An SP MP asks the Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about unequal treatment of residents of Overschild (Groningen) across three reinforcement batches, including differing subsidies, delays, and damage handling. The minister confirms the statements and admits some unexplainable differences are unavoidable, promising talks with the region and a clarifying update soon.
Although I agree with you that it is important to prevent differences where possible, especially at neighbourhood level, this is unfortunately unavoidable.
Hoewel ik met u deel dat het van belang is om waar mogelijk verschillen te voorkomen, zeker op wijkniveau, is dit helaas onvermijdelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Gerven over de aanhoudende klachten rond laagfrequent geluid bij windturbines

SP MPs asked why, despite RIVM findings on low-frequency wind turbine noise, no additional noise or distance norms exist, and whether health studies and a community-inclusive knowledge platform will follow. The government answered that current Dutch noise norms are adequate, that no distance norm or separate low-frequency norm is needed, that a health study will be explored with RIVM, and that existing platforms already represent residents.
Yes, the current norm assumes a serious nuisance rate of about 9% at the maximum permissible noise load.
Ja, de huidige normering gaat uit van een percentage ernstige hinder van ongeveer 9% bij de maximaal toelaatbare geluidbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over de toegankelijkheid van gemeentelijke websites voor slechtzienden en slechthorenden

MPs Kerstens and Kuiken asked why many Dutch municipal websites still fail accessibility rules for visually and hearing-impaired users, despite earlier promises, and what enforcement the government will use. State Secretary Knops answered that the legal duty took effect on 23 September 2020, that obstacles such as lack of knowledge and resources explain non-compliance, that dedicated accessibility teams will be deployed, and that formal supervision will follow the Wet digitale overheid, which is still before the Senate.

To have all government organisations publish an accessibility statement as quickly as possible, all municipalities, water boards, provinces and national government organisations without a valid statement will be approached in the coming months by government accessibility teams and the Digitoegankelijk expertise centre.

Om zo snel mogelijk alsnog alle overheidsorganisaties een toegankelijkheids-verklaring te laten publiceren, worden in elk geval de komende maanden alle gemeenten, waterschappen, provincies en rijksoverheidsorganisaties zonder een (geldige) verklaring benaderd door toegankelijkheidsteams van de overheid en het expertisecentrum Digitoegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Proefproject 'van gas af' stilgelegd'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about reports that the Purmerend gas-free neighbourhood pilot in Overwhere-Zuid was halted, probing communication, the causes of problems, and ministry responsibility. The minister answers that the project was not stopped but slowed for evaluation, that the municipality is responsible for execution with the ministry overseeing the national programme, and that no specific new measures are planned.
The conclusion that the pilot project has been halted is therefore not correct, but the pilot will be delayed compared to the original planning.
De conclusie dat de proeftuin is stilgelegd is dus niet correct, wel zal de proeftuin vertraging oplopen ten opzichte van de oorspronkelijke planning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Proefproject 'van gas af' stilgelegd'

PVV MPs asked whether the Purmerend Overwhere-Zuid gas-free pilot, a Programma Aardgasvrije Wijken project, was halted, questioning costs, the EUR 6.9 million allocation and the EUR 100 million second round. The minister replied that the pilot was not stopped but delayed for evaluation, that the funds are a municipal decentralisation grant rather than a subsidy, and that she stands by the programme's learning goal.
An overview of progress at the pilot sites will be sent to your House in the first quarter of 2021 through the annual progress report of the PAW.
Een overzicht van de voortgang bij de proeftuinen zal ik aan uw Kamer sturen in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 middels de jaarlijkse voortgangsrapportage van het PAW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten werken samen met omstreden techgigant Huawei’.

MPs asked why Huawei is partly excluded from critical 5G infrastructure in the Netherlands but not from university research cooperation with UvA and VU, and what framework governs cooperation with foreign-state-influenced companies. The government replied that universities are autonomous under the WHW and that the cooperation falls outside vital infrastructure, that authorities advised universities on risks, and that an investment screening and export-control framework is being developed, without committing to new binding rules on university cooperation.

Under their autonomy pursuant to the WHW, the universities themselves are responsible for deciding whether or not to enter a particular (international) research cooperation, within the frameworks of existing laws and regulations.

De universiteiten zijn vanuit hun autonomie op grond van de WHW zelf verantwoordelijk voor het besluit om – binnen de kaders van bestaande wet- en regelgeving – al dan niet een bepaalde (internationale) onderzoekssamenwerking aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Nederlandse digitale veiligheid en de ontmoeting met de Chinese minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the government about the Dutch digital security implications of university research cooperation with Huawei and about the PM's and Foreign Minister Blok's meeting with Chinese FM Wang Yi. The government answered that the research is civilian (multilingual search), results are open access, universities are responsible for their own partner choices, and a neutral framework for telecom suppliers applies.

The cabinet will inform the House this autumn in more detail about the state of affairs in the process toward additional measures to counter unwanted knowledge and technology transfer through education and research.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer dit najaar nader informeren over de stand van zaken bij het proces om te komen tot aanvullende maatregelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Amsterdamse universiteiten gaan samenwerken met Huawei'

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg (CDA) asked ministers about reports that Amsterdam universities would collaborate with Huawei on AI research, including the role of security services, dual-use concerns, and the need for national-security frameworks. The government answered that universities are autonomous and responsible for their own partnership decisions, that AIVD and NCTV advised on risks without formal approval power, and that the government is developing additional knowledge-security measures.
The Dutch intelligence and security services have no role in approving or disapproving such collaborations.
De Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten hebben geen rol in het goed- of afkeuren van dergelijke samenwerkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over haperende warmtepompen en stijgende energierekeningen

An MP from the PVV asked ministers why residents of Spoorwijk in The Hague have had faulty heat pumps and rising energy bills, and questioned the energy transition's affordability and claims of lower bills. The minister replied that the Warmtewet protects heat consumers, the government cannot guarantee total energy bills, and the Ecorys and PBL findings are disputed, while a related question was answered separately.
It is therefore not the role of the Minister to assess these individual cases.
Het is dan ook niet de rol van de Minister om deze individuele gevallen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Ook radiatoren onder toezicht’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether homeowners are obliged to hydraulically balance radiators and install per-room temperature control when replacing their boiler, and whether this unduly burdens them with high costs. The minister answered that these obligations follow from EPBD III, with exemptions, a 3-4 year payback for balancing and about seven years for thermostatic valves, and that municipalities enforce them; the answer to the final question on the AO was not provided.
I assume that through the FAQ, the knowledge base and the customer contact centre, any unclarities can be removed.
Ik ga ervanuit dat door de FAQ, de kennisbank en het klantcontactcentrum eventuele onduidelijkheden kunnen worden weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over een WOB-verzoek met betrekking tot de correspondentie herindeling Groningen, Haren en Ten Boer

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether she knew that a Wob request for correspondence behind written answers on the Groningen, Haren and Ten Boer municipal merger had been delayed beyond the promised decision date, and why. The minister confirmed the facts, said the decision was issued on 6 October 2020 after a third party objected and internal coordination caused further delay, and agreed to answer quickly.
Due to the summer recess, the request could not be handled within the usual period.
In verband met het zomerreces kon het verzoek niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn behandeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over “stijgende energierekeningen en vaste lasten door warmtepompen”

An MP (PVV) asks the ministers whether the energy transition to gas-free homes, including heat pumps, has raised energy bills and created energy poverty, and whether they will reverse course. The government replies that the transition must stay affordable, cites subsidies and the Warmtefonds, declines to comment on the Transvaal case (referred to the complaints committee), disputes the Ecorys projections as outdated, and rejects reversing the connection obligation removal.
I cannot go into this specific case, as the matter is being referred to the complaints committee.
Ik kan niet ingaan op dit specifieke geval, aangezien de kwestie wordt voorgelegd aan de geschillencommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een huisuitzetting van een huurder die herstellend is van corona

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a planned eviction of a corona-recovering tenant on 15 September 2020, the court's appeal timing, and how this fits the sector's pledge to avoid evictions during the pandemic. The minister answered that the eviction was suspended after a summary proceeding, that the pledge covered only arrears-based evictions and this case stemmed from a pre-corona ruling, and that she remains in talks with landlord organisations on preventing evictions.
It is up to the judge to rule on individual cases.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen over individuele casussen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Smeulders en Nijboer over huisuitzettingen in de tweede coronagolf

MPs Beckerman, Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior about evictions of antikraak residents during the second COVID wave, a possible ban on evictions, a rehousing guarantee, and renewed agreements with landlords. The Minister said a general eviction ban is not desirable, that courts should weigh individual cases, that a case was resolved by alternative housing, and that the earlier agreements remain in force with some landlord associations and municipalities.
A general ban on evictions is not considered desirable by the cabinet.
Een algeheel verbod op huisuitzettingen acht het kabinet niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over mogelijke integriteitsschendingen bij de verkoop van het pand Noordeinde 64/64a te Den Haag

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about possible integrity violations in the sale of Noordeinde 64/64a in The Hague, including former Rijksvastgoedbedrijf staff involvement, a former senior official starting a commercial firm, and whether the ADR audit was delayed. The Staatssecretaris answered that no involvement of former staff was observed, that no known cases of breached confidentiality exist, that the sale was not a tender so the Scheiding van belang rules do not apply, and that the ADR report is expected in November with a government response.
Furthermore, I am awaiting the final ADR report; see the answer to question 7.
Verder wacht ik het definitieve rapport van de ADR af; zie het antwoord op vraag 7.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over digitaal vergaderen voor raadsleden mogelijk maken als dat nodig is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether all councillors should be enabled to take part in council meetings, including digitally when they cannot attend physically for health reasons, and whether the Minister would press municipalities such as Boxmeer that refuse digital participation. The Minister replied that councils decide for themselves whether to meet physically or digitally under local autonomy, that hybrid meetings are legally impossible under the temporary law, and that she sees no point in urging municipalities.
Because hybrid meetings are legally not possible, I do not consider such a call meaningful.
Omdat hybride vergaderingen juridisch niet mogelijk zijn, acht ik een dergelijke oproep niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over NEMA (National Emission Model for Agriculture) en AERIUS Calculator

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers how they will ease the ecology-economy tension in nitrogen policy, whether the AERIUS Calculator's methods (SRM-2 for roads with a 5 km cut-off versus OPS for other sources) are defensible, and about monitoring, permit numbers and building-phase exemptions. The minister replied that the calculator remains the best available tool, that the government is studying a scientifically based distance or deposition threshold with RIVM, that the meter network will be expanded, and that exact permit and housing figures are not centrally recorded or depend on future emissions.
I consider it important that competent authorities base their permit decisions on the best available method, and that is the AERIUS Calculator.
Ik vind het van belang dat bevoegde gezagen bij hun vergunningverlening uitgaan van de best beschikbare methode en dat is AERIUS Calculator.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over vriendjespolitiek bij het toewijzen van nieuwbouwwoningen

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether developers allocate new-build homes to friends and family and to people based on discrimination, and what measures the government will take. The minister answers that anti-discrimination rules apply, that the extent of discrimination is unclear so the government will investigate it, and that it sees no reason for measures against favouritism, while outlining future steps on affordable ownership and municipal allocation powers.
At present it is unclear to what extent discrimination occurs in the allocation of new-build homes.
Op dit moment is het onduidelijk in welke mate discriminatie voorkomt bij het toewijzen van nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Stadskanaal geeft sleutel aan provincie: ‘Je kunt alles wel kapotbezuinigen’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about Stadskanaal's council warning that severe budget cuts endanger local amenities, and whether the government shares concern that municipal finances force closures. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to extra funds and compensation measures and a study into the effects of financial strain on local services, and said long-term options will be discussed with municipalities.
Anticipating the results of this research, the series of temporary additional funds for youth care of €300 million has been extended to 2022.
Vooruitlopend op de resultaten van dit onderzoek is de reeks van de tijdelijke extra middelen voor jeugdzorg ad € 300 mln. verlengd naar 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het gebruik van data door middel van de Leefbaarheidseffectrapportage, bewonersparticipatie en de Omgevingswet

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the Leefbaarheidseffectrapportage (LER) tool, its role in citizen participation under the Omgevingswet, and whether it should be improved or made more widely used. The Minister answered that the LER is a useful participation tool, that existing open-data platforms already support it, and that no specific review of this commercial instrument is planned.
I see no reason to investigate this specific (commercial) instrument for possible improvements.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om dit specifieke (commerciële) instrument op mogelijke verbeteringen te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp Van Eijs, Beckerman, Laan-Geselschap, Dik-Faber, Nijboer Geluk-Poortvliet en Terpstra over de noodzaak tot investeren in wonen voor senioren

MPs from several parties asked whether a 80,000-unit shortage of senior housing exists, what the government is doing with the taskforce on housing and care, and whether municipalities should be obliged to build senior homes. The minister answered that the shortage figure's source is unclear, that a senior housing monitor will be sent by year-end, that no binding national targets will be imposed, and that the government is supporting local action through taskforces, agreements and subsidy schemes.
Even after inquiry, it is not clear to us what the source of this figure is.
Het is ons, ook na navraag, niet duidelijk wat de bron is van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht ‘Verontwaardiging over voorkeur minister Ollongren voor windmolens op zee’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether her reported preference for offshore rather than onshore wind and solar was at odds with the Climate Agreement, which requires at least 35 TWh of onshore renewables. The minister denied contradicting the Climate Agreement, affirmed onshore wind and solar are needed, and stressed regional RES planning and public support.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht dat China wereldwijd 2,4 miljoen sleutelfiguren volgt

CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that China's Zhenhua Data tracks 2.4 million key figures worldwide, including whether Dutch people are in the database and whether the government will act. The government confirmed it was informed, said Dutch persons with special roles in the democratic order were notified, saw no indications of Chinese security service orders or a link to a social credit system, and pointed to existing resilience measures and telecom security rules.
I have been informed about the database.
Ik ben geïnformeerd over de databank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over de subsidiering van zogenaamd ‘antiracisme’

The MP asked how many organisations receive subsidies from national, provincial and municipal government to combat (alleged) racism, the amounts, and detailed information per recipient. The minister answered that the requested per-organisation information is not available, pointing to the municipal anti-discrimination facilities funded at 6 million euro per year and the College voor de rechten van de mens budget of 7.01 million euro, and apologised for the late reply.
It is not possible to answer this question in its entirety, because the requested information is not available.
Het is niet mogelijk om deze vraag in zijn geheel te beantwoorden, omdat de gevraagde informatie niet voorhanden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat een lezer de ‘dakloze’ Annica (19) aan een huis helpt na overlijden van haar ouders

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporation De Alliantie intends to evict a 19-year-old woman, Annica (Sammy-Jo), within thirty days after being publicly reported as homeless, and asked for a prompt answer. The minister confirmed the report, said the corporation has been involved in seeking a solution, and that the young woman can move into a home in Hilversum from 1 October for a year while using the Woningnet emergency scheme.
I acknowledge the urgency of Sammy-Jo's situation and therefore answered your earlier questions on 24 September.
Ik onderken de urgentie van de situatie van Sammy-Jo en heb uw eerdere vragen daarom op 24 september jl. beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de korting op de verhuurderheffing voor extra nieuwbouwwoningen

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of the Interior whether the rent-tax (verhuurderheffing) reduction for new social housing really adds new homes, whether the total cost may exceed 1 billion euros, and how eligibility is assessed. The minister answers that applications cover about 150,000 homes, that realisation cannot be precisely measured, that the scheme is now closed, and that a joint taskforce with housing associations and municipalities will monitor construction.
This cannot be established. Applications are not checked on whether the building plans are existing or new.
Dit is niet vast te stellen. Aanvragen worden niet getoetst op het feit of het bestaande of nieuwe nieuwbouwplannen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Gerven over de financiële consequenties van het Besluit activiteiten leefomgeving en het Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving voor waterspeeltuinen

MPs Laçin and Van Gerven asked whether the Omgevingswet and its AMvB's (Bkl and Bal) would impose disproportionate financial burdens on volunteer-run water playgrounds, and whether the government would investigate and remedy any such effects. The minister confirmed the rules apply, placed monitoring and safety duties on the operator, said costs are not expected to be disproportionate, and declined to commission a study, saying it will monitor implementation and discuss with the sector if problems arise.
I of course monitor the implementation of the new rules and my ministry is in contact with organisations in the field about it.
Ik volg de uitvoering van de nieuwe regels uiteraard en mijn ministerie heeft daarover ook contact met organisaties in het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Absurditeit op Amsterdamse huizenmarkt: mini-hotelkamer te huur als woning'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a 6 m2 'long stay' hotel room offered as housing for 799 euro a month falls under tenancy protection, whether it meets the Building Decree, and what will be done to protect students. The minister answered that hotel use is a separate legal category, that tenancy protection applies only to housing and courts decide, that the Amsterdam municipality must check the Building Decree, and that the government opposes hotel housing as the norm while working on a national student housing plan.
Ultimately it is up to the judge to determine whether there is regular rent.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van reguliere huur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verhuurders die huurders dwingen een dure parkeerplaats te huren

An MP asked the Minister whether landlords may force tenants to rent a parking space with social housing, and whether this should be banned. The Minister answered that bundled parking rent is in principle lawful, that courts usually find it reasonable but may annul it if it gives the landlord an unreasonable advantage, and that she will investigate a possible ban and report in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Hotel biedt longstay aan: 799 euro voor 6 vierkante meter’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a hotel marketing 6 m2 'longstay' rooms for 799 euro should be treated as housing, which rules apply, and whether tenant protection should be extended to such offers. The Minister answered that these are hotel rooms for short stays outside rental law, that Amsterdam regards such arrangements as not the norm, and promised a transparency convenant on rent setting, possibly to be made binding by legislation.
In this case it does not concern rental of a dwelling but of a hotel room for short-term use.
In deze casus betreft het geen verhuur van een woning maar van een hotelkamer voor kortstondig gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de bewoonbaarheid van verhitte woningen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether overheated homes can count as a defect the landlord must fix, whether landlords can be forced to cool them, and what is done for vulnerable residents and climate adaptation. The minister said there are no legal temperature norms for existing homes, so courts or the Huurcommissie decide case by case, while new homes get an overheating standard from 2021 and several climate adaptation programmes are underway.
Where indoor temperatures are concerned, there are no statutory norms for existing homes.
Waar het gaat om binnentemperaturen bestaan er voor bestaande woningen geen wettelijke normen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de Huurcommissie

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about long processing times at the Rent Commission (Huurcommissie), the share of tenants winning cases, and whether landlords can raise rents while disputes are pending. The Minister gave statutory deadlines, case volumes and win rates, attributed delays to a 2018 inflow surge and COVID-19 hearing suspensions, and announced capacity measures and an action plan to be sent to Parliament.
For the Commission's rulings, a statutory deadline of four months applies after the four-week fee payment period has expired.
Voor het doen van commissie-uitspraken geldt een wettelijke termijn van vier maanden na het verstrijken van de legesbetalingstermijn van vier weken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Terpstra over het bericht ‘Vergunningsvrij bouwen gaat tijd opleveren’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior about the Rotterdam 'Architect aan Zet' experiment with permit-free building, its possible adverse effects, and measures to speed up housing construction. The Minister defended the experiment and the planned expansion of permit-free building under the Omgevingswet and Wkb, while acknowledging a risk that buildings may deviate from rules without prior municipal review.
The municipality does not review the plans and there is no permit, but unlike permit-free building there is control over the execution.
De gemeente toetst de plannen niet en er is ook geen sprake van een vergunning, maar er is in tegenstelling tot vergunningvrij bouwen wel controle op de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat woningcorporatie De Alliantie Sammy-Jo uit huis zet na het overlijden van haar vader

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether housing corporation De Alliantie acted improperly by ending the tenancy of a young woman after her father died, despite the agreement not to evict during the COVID-19 crisis. The minister answered that the contract ended automatically on death, that the corporation looked for a solution with her and she has been offered alternative housing, and that she may stay in the parental home until then.
I have understood from De Alliantie that it has searched together with Sammy-Jo for a suitable solution and that replacement housing has now been found with housing corporation Dudok Wonen.
Van De Alliantie heb ik begrepen dat zij samen met Sammy-Jo naar een passende oplossing heeft gezocht en dat er inmiddels vervangende woonruimte is gevonden bij woningcorporatie Dudok Wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht dat huizenbezitters honderden euro’s extra kwijt zijn aan taxaties

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Interior ministers about reports that homeowners pay hundreds of euros more for valuations, and whether an EBA guideline banning computer-generated valuations was legally binding. The minister answered that the guidelines follow a comply-or-explain principle, that DNB and the ECB will apply them from 30 June 2021, and that a working group is exploring hybrid valuations and reforms to the appraisal process.
For the guidelines the comply-or-explain principle applies, whereby national authorities have room to deviate from the guidelines with reasons.
Voor de richtsnoeren geldt het «pas toe of leg uit» principe, waarbij nationale autoriteiten de ruimte hebben om gemotiveerd af te wijken van de richtsnoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de werkwijze van taxateurs

An MP asks the Interior and Finance Ministers about the independence and quality of mortgage valuations (taxaties), the DNB finding of systematic overvaluation, EU rules on model-based valuation, and costs to consumers. The minister acknowledges quality and independence concerns, points to a working group, sector self-regulation and new hybrid valuation options, but does not commit to a regulatory fix beyond further reporting later in the year.
I will inform you further about the outcomes of this process later this year.
Over de uitkomsten van dit traject zal ik u later dit jaar nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht: 'Minister die niet reageert op omstreden vertrekpremie directeur woningcorporatie Woonbron'

MPs Beckerman asked the minister why she had not responded to reports that housing corporation Woonbron's 2019 annual report still defended a severance payment to its former director as lawful. The minister replied that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties had already reacted to Woonbron, that Woonbron has since disavowed the wording and committed to the government's policy, and that a separate letter from the minister was unnecessary.
Woonbron indeed placed the following statement on its website on 3 September, after the Aw's reaction referred to in the answer to question 1.
Woonbron heeft namelijk na de in het antwoord op vraag 1 aangehaalde reactie van de Aw op 3 september het volgende bericht op haar website geplaatst
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Emiel van Dijk en Kops over het aan hun lot overlaten van kwetsbare Nederlanders ten gunste van statushouders in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that Amsterdam gives housing priority to refugee status holders over Dutch residents with medical problems, and whether subsidies to Amsterdam should be cut. The minister replied that there is no discrimination by nationality, that municipalities set their own urgency categories and must meet the statutory quota, and that she will not withhold support but is funding pilots and housing projects.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van den Bosch over de problemen in de kermisbranche en dat er ondanks de versoepelingen veel kermissen niet doorgaan

Two VVD MPs asked why many fairground events were not going ahead after the July 2020 easing of COVID rules, asking about economic damage, municipal reasoning, safe 'corona-proof' organisation and central support. The government answered that roughly half of fairs could proceed, that permitting is a municipal matter in consultation with safety regions, and that the national government and VNG provide handreikingen and platform support without taking over the decision.
Granting permits for a fair is a local matter, and the evaluation is that initially it is as well.
De vergunningverlening van een kermis is een lokale aangelegenheid en de evaluatie is dat in eerste instantie ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over berichtgeving van mogelijke fraude bij Vestia

The MP asks about reports of alleged multi-million fraud at housing corporation Vestia, how it went undetected by the board, supervisory board, accountant and the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties, and whether fraud is structural. The minister replies that the case dates from 2018, a criminal and forensic investigation is ongoing so the amount cannot be disclosed, the Aw does not supervise individual transactions, fraud is not considered structural, and the saneringsproces will not be postponed.
Because this is an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot inform you about the scale of the alleged fraud.
Omdat het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft kan ik u niet informeren over de omvang van de vermeende fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over genoegdoening voor atoomklokkenluider Frits Veerman

An SP MP asked whether the government will investigate how state bodies treated nuclear whistleblower Frits Veerman, and whether it will meet him to discuss redress. The minister says the Huis voor Klokkenluiders report concerned his former employer, not the state, but offers a conversation with Veerman to see whether specific government conduct warrants new examination.

I am willing to arrange a conversation with Mr Veerman to examine whether there have been concrete acts by government organisations towards him that harmed him and that have not yet been investigated.
Ik ben bereid een gesprek te arrangeren met de heer Veerman om te bezien of er in dit kader concrete gedragingen zijn geweest van overheidsorganisaties jegens zijn persoon die hem hebben benadeeld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de grote opgave voor Vestia

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the Vestia housing corporation, its divestment of stock to regional corporations, shortfalls in investment capacity in the Haaglanden region, and the impact on tenants including rent reductions under the Social Rental Agreement. The Minister acknowledges the regional shortfall and the transfer effects, but defends Vestia's sanering plan and declines to force rent cuts or compensate Vestia, pointing to ongoing regional talks and a regional regisseur.
I see no need or possibility to specifically enforce rent reductions at Vestia and compensate the corporation for them.
Ik zie geen noodzaak en mogelijkheid om specifiek bij Vestia huurverlaging af te dwingen en de corporatie daarvoor te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de opkomende criminaliteit en toenemende kansenongelijkheid in achterstandswijken

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about rising crime and inequality of opportunity in deprived neighbourhoods, including Zaandam, and whether an integrated approach like Rotterdam-Zuid would be extended. The government acknowledged the problems, pointed to prevention programmes and the Interbestuurlijk Programma Leefbaarheid en Veiligheid, but gave no new budget and said the approach is still being explored with municipalities.
In this cabinet period, as I indicated in my letter of 18 June 2020, the further development of the preventive approach to undermining crime will be linked to this exploration.

In deze kabinetsperiode zal, zoals ik aangaf in mijn brief d.d. 18 juni 2020, voor de verdere uitwerking van de preventieve aanpak van ondermijnende criminaliteit bij deze verkenning worden aangesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Ploumen over een wegverzakking in Kerkrade

Two MPs asked about a road collapse in Kerkrade caused by a historic mine shaft, including how it happened, safety measures, and compensation. The minister answered that the shaft is being located and sealed under an existing programme, that a worker was injured when a drilling rig slid into the collapse, and that residents' financial damage will be settled between authorities.
With the municipality of Kerkrade it has been agreed to consult the parties involved after the sealing of shaft DOM-37 on whether this event gives cause for adjustments to the programme.
Met de gemeente Kerkrade is afgesproken om na de sanering van de DOM-37-schacht met de betrokken partijen te overleggen of deze gebeurtenis aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Hoe beveiligers van Thierry Baudet met geweld een demonstrant onschadelijk maken’

MPs Özütok and Buitenweg asked whether private security guards of Thierry Baudet used physical force to stop a lone demonstrator, whether demonstration freedom may only be restricted by authorities under the Wom, and whether measures would be taken against repeat offending security firms. The Minister replied that private guards have no force powers beyond any citizen, that the complainant filed a police report, that such incidents are not separately registered, and that the Wpbr allows fines and licence withdrawal.
Private security guards, like any other citizen, have no authority to use force.
Particuliere beveiligers hebben, net als iedere andere burger, geen bevoegdheid tot het aanwenden van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de gang van zaken rondom de demonstratie d.d. 21 juni 2020 op het Malieveld tegen de anderhalvemetersamenleving

MP Baudet asked the Interior and Justice ministers about the handling of the 21 June 2020 Malieveld demonstration against the 1.5-metre society, including the ban, police conduct and differential treatment of protests. Minister Ollongren answered that the local authority (the safety region chair) is responsible for demonstration decisions and must account to the municipal council, so ministers decline substantive answers, while stating the 1.5m rule is not a restriction of the right to demonstrate.
The local authority is accountable for that decision to the municipal council and, where appropriate, to the courts.
Het lokale gezag legt over die beslissing verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad en eventueel aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de nieuwe vertragingen van de versterking

An SP MP asked the Interior and Health ministers about new delays in the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation, payment and negotiation problems with contractors, and health and trust impacts on residents. The Interior Minister acknowledges delays partly caused by COVID-19 measures, says the policy itself is unchanged, and gives partial answers, withholding commercial details and deferring some matters to the NCG and municipalities.
NCG makes no statement on the content of these negotiations because of commercially sensitive information and because a statement could affect the negotiations.
Over de inhoud van deze onderhandelingen doet NCG geen uitspraak in verband met bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en het feit dat een uitspraak hierover de onderhandelingen kan beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Sneller over de gevaarlijke situaties als gevolg van ‘boerenprotesten’

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Sneller asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Interior about dangerous situations caused by farmers' tractor blockades of motorways and airports, including whether police acted and what risk assessments applied. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no counts of tractors are available, that protest rights are primarily assessed by local authorities, that police prioritised ending the blockade, and that the government does not see unequal treatment compared with climate protests.
No figures are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de gevolgen voor huurders tijdens en na gedwongen verhuizing

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about who is eligible for moving-cost compensation when tenants must relocate for reinforcement works, the timeline, the handling of disputes that force residents to court, and the health complaints about indoor climate in upgraded homes. The Minister answered that new arrangements to equalise compensation for tenants and owners and a one-off allowance for tenants are planned to take effect on 1 October 2020, that the aim is to prevent court cases, and that the GGD Groningen has not started the research referred to, while the Health Council advice will be answered in autumn.

The intention is to bring into effect on 1 October the arrangements aimed at equalising, as far as possible, compensation for owners and tenants in the reinforcement programme, as well as the allowance scheme.

Het voornemen is om de afspraken die toezien op het zoveel als mogelijk gelijktrekken van vergoedingen voor eigenaren en huurders in de versterkingsopgave alsmede de tegemoetkomingsregeling per 1 oktober aanstaande in te laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verhuurwebsites die illegale kosten rekenen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about rental websites that mislead consumers and charge prohibited intermediary fees to tenants. The minister answered that such practices are prohibited, pointed tenants to reclaim unlawful fees and report misleading practices to the consumer authority ACM, which can investigate systematic violations.
Tenants can reclaim wrongly charged intermediary fees from rental agents.
Huurders kunnen ten onrechte in rekening gebrachte bemiddelingskosten van verhuurbemiddelaars terugvorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over wooncoöperaties

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about housing cooperatives abroad (Germany, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland), including their legal form, funding, tenant participation and whether Sweden's public housing complies with EU law, and asked what lessons can be learned. The Minister answered that the information requires external research, which will be sent to parliament with a letter, and gave a short account of Sweden's system.
I will commission such research, while noting, as in my earlier answer, that a comparison is subject to limitations.
Ik zal een dergelijk onderzoek laten doen, waarbij ik net als in mijn eerdere beantwoording aanteken dat een vergelijking aan beperkingen onderhevig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de verergering van de situatie in Groningen

Labour MP Nijboer asked about slow progress on house reinforcement in Groningen, inspection reports not being shared, delays and uncertainty for residents, foundation research and compensation disputes, and why these problems persist compared with the speed of the COVID response. The minister answers that inspection reports are available on request, that prioritisation and capacity limits cause delays, that a few specific cases will be discussed or have advice sent, and that a versnellingspakket is intended to speed up reinforcement.
Residents can ask their assigned NCG resident supporter or the municipality's area director whether and when their address is included in the municipal action plans.
Bewoners kunnen bij de hun toegewezen bewonersbegeleider van NCG of gebiedsregisseur van de eigen gemeente informeren of en wanneer hun adres is opgenomen in de gemeentelijke plannen van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over ‘het dienen van twee heren’ bij woningmakelaars

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether estate agents may charge both landlords and tenants, how the rule against charging tenants is enforced, and what victims can do. The minister answered that enforcement is partly through civil courts and partly through ACM, which has fined or ordered rental agents to stop charging fees, with an ongoing check and no answer on timing within three weeks.
In 2019 the ACM addressed four intermediaries for wrongly charging brokerage fees to tenants.
De ACM heeft in 2019 4 bemiddelaars aangesproken op het ten onrechte in rekening brengen van bemiddelingskosten aan huurders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de Woondeal regio Arnhem-Nijmegen

MP Koerhuis asked whether a theoretical 50% social rental share would satisfy the Woondeal Arnhem-Nijmegen agreement, whether the government would clarify this to the region, and how it would ensure free-market homes are built. Minister Ollongren answered no, said she is willing to raise a clarifying letter at the next consultation, and pointed to a regional monitoring system and the Versnellingstafel.
I am in principle certainly willing to do so, but according to my information there appear to be no misunderstandings about this agreement in the region.
Daartoe ben ik in principe zeker bereid, maar naar mijn informatie blijken er over deze afspraak geen misverstanden te bestaan in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘woningbouwrel met Ouderkerk’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether Amsterdam, as landowner, may impose its housing policy on Ouder-Amstel's 'De Nieuwe Kern' project and whether this undermines local democracy, and raised state aid and competition concerns. The Minister answered that Amsterdam acts only as a private-style landowner bound by the zoning plan set by Ouder-Amstel's council, sees no undue encroachment, gives no data on other municipalities, and sees no reason to act.
There is no question of Amsterdam imposing its own housing policy on the municipality of Ouder-Amstel.
Er is geen sprake van het opdringen van eigen woningbouwbeleid aan de gemeente Ouder-Amstel door de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP asks the government to justify continued COVID-19 restrictions, their proportionality, effects on mental health, economy and poverty, and the scientific basis for distancing and ventilation advice. The ministers respond that restrictions remain necessary to control the virus, describe the OMT and BAO advisory process and support measures, and state that herd immunity was never a goal.
The decision whether the measures proposed by the OMT are implemented is then up to the cabinet.
De afweging of de maatregelen die het OMT voorstelt worden uitgevoerd, is vervolgens aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP from FvD asked the ministers of health, interior and justice about second-wave preparedness, IC capacity, AstraZeneca conflict-of-interest concerns, hydroxychloroquine research, social media censorship, face-mask experiments and a minister's holiday in Sweden. The government answered that capacity expansion and PPE stockpiles are underway, denied any conflict of interest, and defended the local face-mask experiments as proportionate.
I see no risks in the fact that we have entered into a deal with AstraZeneca.
Ik zie geen risico's in het feit dat we met AstraZeneca in zee zijn gegaan.

Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over “het bericht dat vier van de vijf gemeenten niet weten of ‘tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog Joods vastgoed is onteigend en doorverkocht terwijl dat

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked ministers whether the government will map all looted Jewish property during WWII, return unlawfully collected taxes and fees, and open the Nederlands Beheersinstituut archives. The government replied that the Kordes commission and the 2000 settlement already addressed postwar restitution, that no new investigation or restitution is planned, and that most Verkaufsbücher archive material is already digitised and open.
In view of the outcomes of this research and the government's response, there is no reason to conduct new research into looted real estate.
Gezien de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en de reactie van het kabinet is er geen aanleiding om opnieuw onderzoek te doen naar geroofd onroerend goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Krakers bij Lunetten hebben vrij spel’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that squatters occupying a municipal site in Utrecht were free to act, asking who bears damage costs, whether squatting is a crime, and whether the minister would press the Utrecht council to evict. The minister confirmed squatting is the crime of trespass, that victims must sue for damages, and that eviction decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service and the municipality, so he would not intervene.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide whether eviction takes place under the given circumstances. It is not for me to judge this.
Het is aan het OM om te besluiten of in de gegeven omstandigheden ontruimd wordt. Het is niet aan mij om hierover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van Helvert, Van Dam inzake het bericht ‘Activist Zarza neergestoken in Leeuwarden, familie vermoedt politiek motief’

Three CDA MPs asked whether the stabbing of Iranian activist Sadegh Zarza in Leeuwarden had a political motive, whether Iranian academics should face broader screening, and what steps the government had taken regarding Iranian involvement in liquidations in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service leads the investigation and no substantive statements can be made yet, that screening is limited to sensitive technical research areas under sanctions rules, and that no further action is currently planned.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to lead the criminal investigation into the offence and any possible motive.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om leiding te geven aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar het strafbare feit en het eventuele motief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de status en rol van de IHRA-definitie bij de strafrechtelijke beoordeling of uitlatingen discriminatoir zijn

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Interior about the legal status of the IHRA antisemitism working definition in criminal assessment of discriminatory speech, and whether it is used by prosecutors and judges. The Minister answered that the definition is non-binding, that the government does not treat its illustrative examples as part of the definition, that it only helps police and prosecutors be alert to indicators, and that criminal assessment remains governed by the Criminal Code and case law.
Agreement with the list of expressions and conduct will never automatically lead to the conclusion that a punishable discriminatory/antisemitic expression or conduct exists.
Overeenkomst met de lijst met uitingen en gedragingen zal nimmer automatisch leiden tot de conclusie dat sprake is van een strafbare discriminatoire/antisemitische uiting of gedraging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Terpstra over de terugkeer van het ministerie van VROM

MPs Nijboer and Terpstra asked whether the government would restore a separate Minister for Housing, Spatial Planning and Environment (VROM), prepare for it, and re-establish a Rijksplanologische Dienst. Minister Ollongren answered that a ministerial portfolio is a political choice for the next cabinet formation, that housing and spatial tasks are handled integrally, and that re-creating a planning service is not considered appropriate.
Whether the next cabinet should have a Minister for Housing, Spatial Planning and Environment is a political choice and consideration for the parties involved in a future cabinet formation.

Of er in het volgend kabinet een Minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer moet komen, is een politieke keuze en afweging die aan politieke partijen betrokken bij een volgende kabinetsformatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over loodvergiftging van kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of childhood lead poisoning in the Netherlands, its causes, the role of lead pipes, and whether a binding ban on lead pipes and a timeline for safe tap water would be introduced. The minister disputed the 7,600 figure, said recent Dutch measurements show a declining trend, referred to the Gezondheidsraad advice and the July 2020 letter, and said a pipe ban would be reconsidered depending on the annual sanitation progress report.
Until the pipes are replaced, the Health Council advises residents to use bottled water for pregnant women, bottle-fed infants and young children up to about seven years old.
Zolang de leidingen niet zijn vervangen adviseert de Gezondheidsraad aan bewoners om voor zwangeren, flesgevoede kinderen en jonge kinderen tot een jaar of zeven flessenwater te gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de drie aardbevingen in Groningen de afgelopen week

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about three earthquakes in Groningen, the response to affected residents, damage claims backlogs at the IMG, COVID-related delays, reinforcement operations and a new norm. The minister replied that gas extraction will end around 2022, that damage handling and reinforcement are ongoing with a six-month target, that a new norm will be applied from 1 September 2020, and that the government is consulting the region, but he declined to answer the questions in the one-week timeframe requested.
The IMG is an independent administrative body and determines its own working method for handling damage claims.
Het IMG is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan en bepaalt zijn eigen werkwijze voor de afhandeling van schademeldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over de oproep van de Burgemeester van Loppersum voor een andere aanpak voor de versterkingsoperatie in Groningen

MPs asked whether the government will act on the Loppersum mayor's call for a crisis team and an emergency law to speed up the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation. The minister says the government is pursuing faster implementation, is in talks with the mayor and regional administrators, and will inform parliament on outcomes, while the reinforcement bill is still being revised after the Council of State's advice.
In line with our commitment in the General Consultation on Mining/Groningen of 24 June, we will inform the House of the outcomes as soon as possible.
Conform onze toezegging in het Algemeen Overleg Mijnbouw/Groningen van 24 juni jl. informeren wij uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huisbazen die weigeren loden leidingen te vervangen

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether landlords refusing to replace lead pipes should be held to account, whether tenants must go to court to enforce safe water, and whether a lead-pipe ban and warnings will follow.
