The minister says landlords are responsible and tenants can use the Huurcommissie or courts, that a lead-pipe ban was not chosen for now but will be reconsidered after annual monitoring, and that municipalities and GGDs will be encouraged to act.
If the landlord refuses to take measures, the tenant can bring the matter before the Huurcommissie or, if necessary, the court.
Indien de verhuurder weigert maatregelen te nemen kan de huurder zijn zaak voorleggen aan de Huurcommissie of zo nodig de rechter
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat veel gemeenten de regels met betrekking tot de mogelijkheid om gratis huwelijken aan te bieden, overtreden

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are breaching the rules requiring free weekly wedding slots, and whether she knows which ones do and how she will ensure compliance. The Minister says she sees no supporting evidence in the news report, that the law sets a minimum number of free slots without income distinction, that she sees no reason to actively identify non-compliant municipalities, and that municipalities must follow the law, with no grounds for intervention.

Although I am aware of the news reports on this in the past, I see no reason at this time to actively look for municipalities that do not or insufficiently offer the possibility of a free wedding ceremony.

Hoewel ik bekend ben met de nieuwsberichten die hierover in het verleden zijn verschenen, zie ik op dit moment geen reden nadrukkelijk op zoek te gaan naar gemeenten die de mogelijkheid van een gratis huwelijksvoltrekking niet of onvoldoende bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Terpstra over de vraag naar woningen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about housing demand, including whether PBL's claims about apartment demand, willingness to pay, and housing preferences should guide construction programmes. The Minister answers that housing needs vary by municipality, that municipalities decide on housing types using various studies, and that the existing WoON and Staat van de Woningmarkt provide sufficient insight, so no additional PBL study is requested.
For now these two studies provide sufficient insight into the matter and I am currently not intending to ask the PBL to carry out additional research.
Vooralsnog bieden deze twee studies voldoende inzicht in het genoemde vraagstuk en ben ik op dit moment niet voornemens om het PBL te vragen aanvullend onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over een gemeentelijk onderscheiding voor Jack Bogers

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a municipal honour for Jack Bogers, who allegedly helped Volkert van der Graaf destroy evidence, is consistent with the dignity of government and whether the municipality of Wageningen should be addressed. The Minister replied that municipal honours are set by municipalities under their own criteria, falling outside the national decoration system, and saw no reason to address Wageningen.
Municipalities also determine their own criteria for awarding an honour.
Gemeenten bepalen ook zelf de eigen criteria voor het verlenen van een onderscheiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de projecten ‘Heft in Eigen Hand’ en ‘Eigen Initiatief’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the Heft in Eigen Hand and Eigen Initiatief programmes, where Groningen residents organise their own earthquake-strengthening work, and reports of stalled projects, pressure from building supervisors, budget cuts and unclear rules. The Minister denied that projects are widely stuck, said 26 addresses are complete, acknowledged some interpretation differences and a reduced temporary housing allowance, and committed to talks with residents and to informing parliament on a motion.
I will inform your House as soon as possible about the implementation of this motion.
Ik informeer uw Kamer zo snel mogelijk over de uitvoering van deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Mondkapjesplicht in grote steden

Three D66 MPs asked whether local mask-wearing requirements in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, imposed via emergency ordinances, are compatible with Article 10 of the Constitution, their enforceability and sanctions, and why voluntary wearing was not chosen. The ministers answered that the experiments are a temporary, proportionate, locally motivated response to non-compliance with the 1.5-metre rule, that violations are punishable with a 95-euro fine, and that courts remain available for objections, while acknowledging the legal uncertainty and offering a temporary bill to shorten the emergency situation.
It is not for the government to intervene in any assessment of the sanction by the court.
Het is niet aan de regering om te treden in de eventuele beoordeling van de sanctie door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht 'Landelijk coördinator nodig om discriminatie aan te pakken'

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Interior about calls from the College voor de Rechten van de Mens for a national discrimination coordinator, and whether such a coordinator, sector-specific policy and more resources would be pursued. The Minister confirmed awareness, referred to motions adopted in the plenary debate on institutional racism and a promised letter this autumn on a Staatscommissie and a national coordinator, and pointed to existing sector-specific measures.

During the debate, in response to these motions, I indicated that a letter will appear this autumn in which I will address the state commission and the requests for a national discrimination coordinator.

Tijdens het debat heb ik in reactie op deze moties aangegeven dat er dit najaar een brief zal verschijnen waarin ik zal ingaan op de staatscommissie en de verzoeken om een nationaal coördinator discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over De (woning)bouw ten tijde van de Coronacrisis

An MP asked the minister how COVID-19 affects housing construction order intake, the housing shortage, anti-cyclical building measures, and related permitting, tax and mortgage issues. The minister answered that the government is taking a range of measures (a 'keep building' package, reprioritised funds, flexible municipal staffing pools) and promised to monitor the situation and report back to parliament if further measures are needed.
I am therefore in close consultation with the sector to monitor the extent to which home purchases decline and which measures may need to be taken to ensure building continues.

Ik ben daarom nauw met de sector in overleg om te monitoren in hoeverre de aankoop van woningen terugloopt en welke maatregelen eventueel genomen moeten worden om ervoor te zorgen dat er doorgebouwd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over wooncoöperaties

An MP asks the minister about housing cooperatives: their number, their potential to deliver affordable housing, obstacles they face, and whether government will support pilots, a revolving fund and foreign models. The minister answers that the cooperative sector is small, that a full overview is not available, that a financing study and pilots via Platform31 are underway, and that she will inform parliament after the summer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Özütok over het bericht ‘Parlement, maak een einde aan deze uitzonderingstoestand’

Two MPs asked the government to clarify how many people gathering at 1.5 metres constitutes a breach of the emergency ordinances, and why the Prime Minister's statements on group size, and the definition of an event, seemed inconsistent with fines and enforcement practice. The minister explained the successive rules for public spaces and gatherings, said the definition of event and the distinction with gatherings is clarified in an ordinance, and noted that a bill in preparation will address gathering norms.
In general, an emergency ordinance must contain sufficiently precise provisions to be complied with and enforced.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat een noodverordening voldoende bepaalde voorschriften moet bevatten om te kunnen worden nageleefd en gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over onterechte huurverhogingen door foutieve huishoudverklaringen door de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked how 932 household statements with a wrong AOW age led to unlawful higher rent increases, and what happens if landlords do not reverse them. The government answered that the error stemmed from an outdated parameter in software, that the Tax Authority informed landlords and tenants by letter and phone, and that reversing increases is the landlord's responsibility under civil rental law.
The Tax Authority is not leaving it to the tenants.
De Belastingdienst laat het niet over aan de huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over eeuwige grafrust

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about 'eternal grave rest' and perpetual grave rights in municipal and special cemeteries, and whether municipalities may offer them. The Minister answered that the Burial Act does not explicitly regulate eternal grave rest but leaves room for it, that cemetery managers may offer it, and that she supports the decentralised system while being willing to talk with municipalities about religious burial needs.
I am willing to speak with municipalities about this and am already in discussion with representatives of religious organisations about the legal provisions needed.
Ik ben bereid om met gemeenten hierover te spreken en ben met vertegenwoordigers van religieuze organisaties al in gesprek over de wettelijke voorzieningen die nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de schommelingen in het gemeentefonds

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government agrees that municipalities need at least 2 billion euros extra, whether the surcharge for scaling up should be dropped, how large the social-domain deficits are, what the balanced-budget picture is and how COVID costs are being compensated. The minister acknowledged the pressures, pointed to additional funds and ongoing studies and deferred the surcharge decision to a new cabinet.
That is why the cabinet is having research done on youth care and is monitoring the Wmo subscription tariff.
Daarom laat het kabinet onderzoek doen naar de jeugdzorg en monitort het kabinet het Wmo-abonnementstarief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over maatwerk voor huurders bij Vestia in onder meer Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about Vestia's limited investment in tenant housing (mould, maintenance), rent increases, maximum rent hikes and the non-use of rent relief, and whether the government would act on tenant hardship and the 2014 rescue support. The Minister answered that Vestia is not barred from investing, that a 10-year programme of EUR 886 million for existing stock is planned, that remedial duties apply under good landlordship, and that monitoring of rent increases is possible but a full administration is not warranted.
It is incorrect that Vestia may no longer make any investments.
Het is onjuist dat Vestia geen investeringen meer mag doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over grote problemen bij de firma die de Nederlandse staatsgeheimen beveiligt

An MP asked the Interior Minister about problems at Fox-IT, the firm securing Dutch state secrets, including its takeover by NCC, weak financial results and the suspension of most of its board, and whether secrets were leaked and if Fox-IT can still be trusted. The minister answered that clear continuity and security agreements exist, that oversight is applied, that no leak or interception of state secrets has been found, and that a broader national cryptostrategy is being developed.
As long as these conditions are met, we see no reason why the encryption of state secrets using Fox-Crypto products would be endangered.
Zolang aan deze voorwaarden wordt voldaan, zien wij geen reden dat de versleuteling van staatsgeheimen, gebruikmakend van producten van Fox-Crypto, in gevaar komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over herindelingen in het algemeen en de herindeling Groningen, Haren, Ten Boer in het bijzonder

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the procedural rules and assessment frameworks for a province-initiated municipal merger (Groningen, Haren, Ten Boer) bind the province and protect municipalities, and whether the ministry adequately supervised the process. The Minister answers that the procedural rules give clarity, the framework binds the Minister rather than provinces, the Minister judges whether the process was careful when the advice is received, and that the process was assessed as careful, though support in Haren was more limited.
Only I therefore account for their conduct.
Alleen ik leg dan ook over hun handelen verantwoording af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Otterloo over Chinese censuur op niet-Chinese video’s en commentaren op YouTube

An MP asked the minister whether reports of YouTube automatically deleting comments containing Chinese political terms were known, and whether the government would act against YouTube's parent company and the Chinese government. The minister confirmed the reports, said YouTube called it a software error under investigation and denied outside influence, saw no reason for action, and reaffirmed Dutch support for a free internet via the Freedom Online Coalition.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to take action.
Het kabinet ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht 'Eindhoven gaat windhinder bij nieuwe woontorens te lijf'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about wind nuisance from high-rise buildings, whether national rules exist, and whether Eindhoven's pre-testing approach and the lessons from Rijksvastgoedbedrijf incidents should be applied more broadly. The Minister answered that municipalities may regulate wind nuisance through their own rules and the NEN 8100 standard, that no national instruction rules exist for this aspect, and that the building-code wind-load requirements cover structural safety.
It is up to municipalities to include the prevention of wind nuisance in their municipal regulations.
Het is aan gemeenten om in hun gemeentelijke regelgeving het tegengaan van windhinder mee te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra over het bericht 'Nieuwe geluidsregels zetten streep door bouw 380.000 huizen'

MPs Koerhuis and Terpstra asked whether new noise rules for aviation and rail would block construction of 380,000 homes around Amsterdam, whether WHO noise guidelines are legally binding and how they factor in, and whether the province and municipalities were involved. The minister answered that the rules leave room for development, that WHO advice is not legally binding and its impact will be reported to parliament by end 2020, and that consultations with the province and municipalities are ongoing with possible regulatory adjustment.
The WHO advice on noise was not taken into account in shaping the noise rules as they will apply after the Environment and Planning Act enters into force (Supplementary noise track).
Het advies van de WHO over geluid is niet betrokken bij het vormgeven van de geluidregels, zoals die na inwerkingtreding van de Omgevingswet gaan luiden (Aanvullingsspoor geluid).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Özütok over het bericht van EenVandaag ‘Verbod streekmarkten drijft boeren tot wanhoop: Onbegrijpelijk, omdat weekmarkten wél open mogen'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why regional farmers' markets were banned under COVID-19 emergency rules while weekly markets stayed open, and whether municipalities could re-permit them. The minister explained that markets are excluded from the event ban only when they are ordinary markets, that whether a regional market counts as an event is decided case by case by the safety region chair, and that organising markets remains a municipal matter, while stating sympathy for short supply chains.
Whether a regional market falls within this definition depends on the concrete circumstances and organisation of that market and is for the chair of the safety region to assess.
Of een streekmarkt binnen deze definitie valt, zal afhankelijk zijn van de concrete omstandigheden en inrichting van die markt en is ter beoordeling van de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over beperkingen begrafenissen en kerkdiensten in het licht van de Grondwettelijke vrijheden

An SGP MP asked the ministers whether COVID-19 caps on attendance at church services and funerals (30 persons) fit the constitutional freedom of religion, and whether emergency decrees are a suitable instrument for such restrictions. The minister answered that worship exemptions, streaming and a 'reasonable interpretation' of article 6 justify the temporary limits, that church bodies set their own protocols, and that a bill on fundamental-rights restrictions is in preparation.

A reasonable interpretation of freedom of religion means that this right does not extend so far that, under current circumstances, it covers an unlimited number of participants in religious gatherings.

Een redelijke uitleg van de vrijheid van godsdienst brengt dan met zich dat dit recht niet zó ver reikt dat het onder de huidige omstandigheden een onbeperkt aantal deelnemers aan religieuze bijeenkomsten omvat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Van Gent over het stemmen per volmacht

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior about proxy voting, including reports of vote fraud linked to paid proxy cards, higher proxy shares in some polling stations, and OSCE criticism. The Minister answered that in-person voting is preferred, that early voting experiments are currently not affordable, that the Public Prosecution Service investigates signals of canvassing, and that the government plans to restrict the proxy scheme in the Caribbean Netherlands before 2023.

In the evaluation of the 2019 elections I informed the House that, due to recurring objections from executive boards, island councils and international observers, I will prepare a bill ahead of the 2023 island council elections restricting the proxy voting scheme in the Caribbean Netherlands.

In de evaluatie van de verkiezingen van 2019 heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat ik, vanwege terugkerende bezwaren van bestuurscolleges, eilandsraden en internationale waarnemers, een wetsvoorstel ga voorbereiden in aanloop naar de eilandsraadsverkiezingen in 2023, waarmee de volmachtregeling in Caribisch Nederland wordt beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de persvrijheid op Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about reported press-freedom restrictions on Curaçao during the COVID-19 crisis, whether a free press matters especially in crises, and whether financial aid could be conditioned on press freedom. The State Secretary answered that independent journalism is vital in crises and applies to all Kingdom countries, that aid conditions focus on the financial sector but may extend beyond it, and that the answer was delayed for care and coordination.
Without judging the specific cases, I believe there must also be room during the crisis for the informing and controlling role of journalists.
Zonder over de casuïstiek te oordelen, vind ik dat er ook tijdens de crisis ruimte moet zijn voor de informerende en controlerende rol van journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over kortingen aan verhuurders op de verhuurderheffing in onder meer Rotterdam

An SP MP asks the Minister of the Interior why the discount on the rental levy does not check rent development after first tenant turnover, despite the aim of keeping social rentals affordable long-term, and why a 10-year commitment was used for the Rotterdam Parlando project. The minister replies that the subsidy is checked at the starting rent, that turnover is rare and liberalisation limited, that random post-completion rent checks by RVO are planned with possible withdrawal of the discount, and that the Ministry was not party to the 10-year agreement.
In addition, random checks will soon be started on the rents of homes realised with the help of a levy reduction.
Daarnaast zal er binnenkort ook gestart worden met het steekproefsgewijs opvragen van de huren van woningen die zijn gerealiseerd met behulp van een heffingsvermindering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over gemeenten die in geldnood dreigen te komen

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether municipalities face financial distress from COVID-19 revenue losses and how they could absorb it, and whether the government would help. State Secretary Knops replied that compensation measures were agreed with local governments, no liquidity problems are known, a regiegroep is assessing the costs, and the accres is frozen for 2020-2021.
The number of municipalities under preventive enhanced supervision in 2020 is still limited and does not deviate strongly from the figures of the past ten years.
Het aantal gemeenten dat in 2020 onder verscherpt toezicht staat (preventief) is nog beperkt en wijkt niet sterk af van de aantallen van de afgelopen tien jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de versterking in Groningen

An MP asks the Interior Minister about slow and inconsistent handling of earthquake reinforcement (versterking) in Groningen, including rejected inspection requests, homeowners in the programme unaware of it, unreported inspections, and delayed P50 advice. The minister answers that 330 of 523 on-request inspections were granted, explains the procedures and capacity targets, and says full assessments of all buildings by end 2020 are not feasible.
As soon as a resident-friendly reinforcement advice is available, the owner concerned will be contacted about it.
Zodra een bewonersvriendelijk versterkingsadvies beschikbaar is, wordt daarover contact opgenomen met de betreffende eigenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Ollongren wekte te hoge verwachtingen met aardgasvrije wijken’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior about the Algemene Rekenkamer's criticism of the Aardgasvrije Wijken programme: few homes made gas-free, unclear goals and monitoring, and no evaluation until 2022. The Minister replied that the goal is learning rather than a home count, that monitoring and evaluation plans are being finalised, that the funding and business-case weaknesses are being addressed, and that the evaluation will go ahead in 2022 without delaying the second tranche.
I will inform the House of Representatives about this through the second progress report at the start of 2021.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer hierover informeren middels de tweede voortgangsrapportage begin 2021.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Peters, Van der Molen en Slootweg over de uitgestelde invoering van het nieuwe woonplaatsbeginsel

Three CDA MPs asked why the new woonplaatsbeginsel (residence principle for youth care funding) was postponed and whether municipalities such as Goirle are financially harmed. The minister answered that the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ care is extended by a year and raised to 30 million euros, and that postponement to 2022 was chosen to ensure careful implementation given the COVID-19 workload on municipalities.
Now that the introduction of the youth residence principle has been postponed by one year, the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ is extended by one year.
Nu de invoering van het woonplaatsbeginsel jeugd met een jaar is uitgesteld, wordt de compensatieregeling voogdij en 18+ met een jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het ontbreken van overeenstemming tussen winkeliers en vastgoedeigenaren

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked whether landlords and retail tenants are reaching rent-relief agreements, whether the Steunakkoord agreements are binding and could be declared generally binding, and whether legislation is needed. The State Secretary replied that most tenants and landlords have made case-by-case agreements, that a legal basis for generally binding private agreements does not exist, and that no legislative proposal is planned.
To declare private agreements generally binding, a legal basis is required. That does not currently exist.
Om private afspraken algemeen verbindend te verklaren, is een wettelijke grondslag nodig. Die bestaat nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over discriminatie en etnisch profileren in alle lagen van de overheid

MP Azarkan (DENK) asked the Minister of the Interior about discrimination and ethnic profiling across all levels of government, following a report by the National Ombudsman, and asked about the police complaints procedure, the scope of the Ombudsman's investigation, and possible legal changes. The Minister answered that training, integrity policy and complaints handling address bias, that the Ombudsman's investigation will focus on complaints handling and report in autumn 2020, that the police complaints procedure uses an independent advisory commission but is aimed at restoring trust rather than sanctions, and that current law already covers nationality and language under the existing discrimination grounds.
The National Ombudsman expects to complete the investigation in autumn 2020.
De Nationale ombudsman verwacht het onderzoek in het najaar van 2020 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Smeulders en Beckerman over het tijdelijk bevriezen van huurprijzen

MPs Nijboer, Smeulders and Beckerman asked how the minister will implement the Senate motion to temporarily freeze rents in both the free and social sectors, and whether housing corporations should be compensated for lost rent. The minister answered that a general freeze is not proportionate or timely, relies on case-by-case maatwerk, a complaints desk at the Huurcommissie, monitoring, and a decision in August, and will table a separate bill on temporary rent reductions.
Capping or generally postponing the rent increases customarily applied on 1 July does not reflect proper governance, for two reasons.
Het nu maximeren of generiek uitstellen van de huurverhogingen die gebruikelijk plaats vindt op 1 juli getuigt niet van behoorlijk bestuur, vanwege twee redenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale straf voor woningcorporaties

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of the Interior whether the corporate tax treatment of housing corporations (depreciation limits, ban on write-downs, earningsstripping under ATAD1, reserves) unfairly penalises them compared with commercial landlords and restricts their investment capacity. The government answers that equal treatment requires no special regime, that the rules apply generically, that corporations cannot be carved out under ATAD1, and that the investment capacity and withholding of a broader review will be sent to parliament before summer.
The cabinet is examining whether housing corporations will also have sufficient room for the necessary investments in the medium and long term.
Het kabinet onderzoekt of woningcorporaties ook op middellange en lange termijn voldoende ruimte hebben voor de benodigde investeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Özütok over het bericht ‘Parlement, maak een einde aan deze uitzonderingstoestand’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Justice and Interior Ministers about legal objections that COVID-19 emergency ordinances (noodverordeningen) based on the Public Health Act lack basis, bypass the constitutional state-of-emergency regime, restrict constitutional rights without grounds, and lack democratic control. The government defended the ordinances as lawful, pointed to Ministerial instructions as subject to parliamentary oversight and to council information duties, and announced temporary specific legislation with consultation of local bodies.
The cabinet nonetheless considers it desirable that the measures to be taken after the acute crisis phase be developed in consultation with parliament.
Wel acht het kabinet het gewenst dat de maatregelen die moeten worden getroffen na de fase van acute crisisbeheersing in samenspraak met het parlement tot stand worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Kops en Wilders over de achterstelling van Nederlandse woningzoekenden

PVV MPs asked whether the municipality of Vlaardingen giving refugees priority on social rental housing is discrimination against Dutch citizens, whether municipalities should be barred from such priority, and whether temporary asylum permits should be withdrawn so social housing goes only to Dutch nationals. The minister rejected the discrimination framing, explained that municipalities set their own urgency categories and that housing refugees serves integration, and refused to withdraw asylum permits.

After the mandatory urgency status of status holders was removed from the Housing Act on 1 July 2017, municipalities can themselves decide which categories of housing seekers they wish to include as urgency categories in the housing ordinance.

Nadat de verplichte urgentiestatus van statushouders per 1 juli 2017 uit de Huisvestingswet is gehaald kunnen gemeenten zelf bepalen welke categorieën woningzoekenden ze als urgentiecategorie in de huisvestingsverordening wensen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de evaluatie van de verhuurderheffing

An MP asks the government about the rental levy (verhuurderheffing) on housing corporations, whether it has halved social rental construction, and whether it should be lowered to stimulate building affordable homes. The minister disputes that the levy alone caused the investment drop, notes corporations have investment room, and points to a planned study under the Ronnes motion and measures to keep building.
Before the summer I will send the results of this to the House.
Voor de zomer zal ik de resultaten hiervan aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over 100 miljoen euro subsidie voor de versnelde verduurzaming van huurwoningen

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior why EUR 100 million is being spent on accelerating energy renovation of rental homes during the corona and housing crises, and whether this raises rents. The minister defends the Renovatieversneller as part of the Climate Agreement that lowers renovation costs and keeps tenants' energy-bill savings in line with rent increases, but gives no per-home cost figures.
Landlords and tenants agreed in the social rental accord that rents will not rise more than the saving on the energy bill.
Verhuurders en huurders hebben in het sociaal huurakkoord afgesproken dat de huren niet meer zullen stijgen dan de besparing op de energierekening.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van den Bosch over opstartproblemen bij gemeentes betreffende de ‘Tijdelijke wet digitale beraadslaging en besluitvorming provincies, gemeenten, waterschappen en de openbare

MPs Middendorp and Van den Bosch asked the Minister of the Interior about start-up problems and technical failures in municipalities using the temporary digital deliberation law, and whether this threatens local democracy. The Minister answered that most councils have held digital or physical decision meetings, technical incidents are limited and mostly teething problems, mayors bear democratic responsibility, and an independent evaluation committee will report further.
The number of technical incidents that seriously disrupted digital council meetings is limited.
Het aantal technische incidenten wat zich heeft voorgedaan die de digitaal raadsvergadering ernstig hebben verstoord, is beperkt te noemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat een op de drie Amsterdamse makelaars bereid is om te discrimineren

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Interior whether she knows of the report that one in three Amsterdam estate agents would discriminate, and what measures will be taken against discrimination in the housing market, including monitoring, complaint procedures and sanctions. The minister answers that a broader anti-discrimination approach is under way, with mystery-guest and practice-test research due in early 2021, that agents' associations are cooperating but no disciplinary cases are known, and that she is considering how to pursue discriminating landlords and agents while promoting reporting and pilots in cities.
In the interest of results that are as realistic as possible, I cannot currently share any further details about this research.
In het belang van zo reëel mogelijke resultaten van dit onderzoek, kan ik er nu geen verdere mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over veelvuldig discriminerende makelaars en verhuurders

MP Nijboer asked whether the government finds it unacceptable that agents and landlords discriminate against housing seekers, whether offenders will be prosecuted, and whether licensing for agents and landlords will be introduced. The Minister replied that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide and no complaint is known, that awareness-based and screening measures plus a new study are underway, and that a quality mark and landlord licensing are being piloted without firm dates.
It is not for me but for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether a criminal offence has occurred and to decide whether to prosecute.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of sprake is van een strafbaar feit en te beslissen of tot strafrechtelijke vervolging wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de Regeling Vermindering Verhuurderheffing (RVV) nieuwbouw 2020

An MP asked how much of the €1 billion nieuwbouw heffingsvermindering budget was already claimed, whether the scheme should be expanded, and whether the rental levy should be cut structurally instead of through targeted schemes. The minister replied that applications already exceed the budget, the scheme will be closed from 1 July 2020 while pending applications are honoured, and that a targeted scheme was chosen over a generic levy cut for reasons of focus, while acknowledging a generic cut would be simpler.
Because of the many applications, I have had to decide to close the application option for the nieuwbouw levy reduction as of 1 July.
Vanwege de vele aanvragen heb ik moeten besluiten om per 1 juli de aanvraagmogelijkheid van de heffingsvermindering voor nieuwbouw te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten met hun baan ook hun bed kwijt raken

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the ministers whether the government would prevent employers from evicting migrant workers who lose their jobs and charge excessive rent for housing. The minister answered that the NOW scheme encourages keeping staff employed, that housing charges are capped by law, that a task force on migrant worker protection has been set up, and that no data exists on how many workers lost housing.
There is currently no data available on the basis of which I can make concrete statements about the number of migrant workers affected by the crisis.
Er zijn echter op dit moment geen data beschikbaar op basis waarvan ik concrete uitspraken kan doen over de aantallen arbeidsmigranten die zijn getroffen door de crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf en een pand dat voor een spotprijs is verkocht aan een malafide ondernemer

The SP MP Van Raak asked whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf sold Noordeinde 64 to the municipality of The Hague, which resold it a day later for a bargain price to a dubious entrepreneur, and asked about sale price, reasons, knowledge of resale, whether such sales should be banned, anti-resale clauses, and how often similar constructions occur. The Staatssecretaris answered that the sale followed the reallocation procedure at a notarised price of EUR 1,735,000 based on an independent valuation, that an ADR investigation is ongoing, that the reallocation procedure will be changed with a policy decision in autumn, that a 10-year surcharge clause applies instead of an anti-resale clause, and provided an overview of sales since 2003.
Furthermore, I wish to inform you that I am currently having an ADR investigation carried out into the sale of this property, the results of which I expect before the summer.
Verder wil ik u in dit verband melden dat ik momenteel een ADR-onderzoek laat uitvoeren naar de verkoop van dit pand, waarvan ik voor de zomer de resultaten verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over kortingen aan verhuurders op de verhuurderheffing

Labour MP Beckerman asked whether housing-association rent reductions on the landlord levy (RVV) produced permanent affordable homes, how long rents must stay regulated, whether Vestia's Tweebosbuurt project abuses the scheme, and whether the levy should be abolished. Minister Knops gave detailed counts of applications and realised investments, said there is no fixed holding period and rejected a 20-year term as too burdensome, and promised a study of corporations' finances before summer 2020.
If there is evidence and RVO receives signals that the rent has risen excessively shortly after the dwelling is realised, RVO has the option to withdraw the definitive levy reduction.

Indien er wel bewijs is en RVO signalen ontvangt dat de huur op korte termijn na realisatie van de woning excessief is gestegen, heeft RVO de mogelijkheid over te gaan tot intrekking van de definitieve heffingsvermindering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'NCG levert in afgelopen drie maanden elf versterkte huizen op'

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of the Interior why only eleven houses were reinforced in Groningen in three months, questioning the pace, causes and COVID-19 impact. The minister confirmed the figure, attributed delays to complex projects and the pandemic, and listed measures such as alternative inspections and extra resident support, while declining to give a multi-year reinforcement planning.
To say anything about the number of buildings that will need reinforcing, it must first become clear from an assessment whether a building meets the safety standard.
Om iets te kunnen zeggen over het aantal gebouwen dat zal moeten worden versterkt zal uit een beoordeling duidelijk moeten worden of een gebouw aan de veiligheidsnorm voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het vergeten hoekje van Opwierde

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister why residents of several streets in Appingedam's Opwierde neighbourhood still lack clarity on Groningen earthquake reinforcement, why a district-based approach was not chosen, and how compensation will be provided. The minister answered that these homes are already registered, will be assessed this year, and that the risk-based prioritisation sets their lower-risk status, while committing to continued communication and capacity expansion.
The homes in the named streets in Appingedam have already been registered and will be assessed this year so that residents of these homes also have clarity.
De woningen in de genoemde straten in Appingedam zijn reeds opgenomen en zullen dit jaar beoordeeld worden zodat ook de bewoners van deze woningen duidelijkheid hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over aardgasvrije woningen (Startmotorkader Warmtenetten)

An MP from the PVV asked about the Startmotorkader Warmtenetten, which uses a EUR 200 million subsidy so housing associations can disconnect homes from gas and connect them to heat networks while keeping tenants' housing costs neutral, and questioned whether heat-network costs can really stay below gas bills and who ultimately pays. The Minister for Home Affairs defended the framework and the cost-neutrality goal, noting it is not guaranteed for every household, that the Warmtewet caps tariffs at the gas-reference level, that costs are shared between companies, landlords, society and residents, and that the government will not halt the gas-free transition.
I will inform the House after the summer about the results of this study.
Ik informeer uw Kamer na de zomer over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Europees Parlement pleit voor een noodfonds voor overzeese gebieden’

An MP asked the ministers whether the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom have applied for, and how they would access, a possible EU emergency fund for overseas territories adopted in a European Parliament resolution. The government replied that no such fund exists yet since the Commission has not acted on the call, but that the Commission has redirected existing funds (about EUR 10 million via RESEMBID and access to the B-envelope), and that the Kingdom is working to facilitate access.
The European Commission has so far not acted on this call.
De Europese Commissie (de Commissie) heeft tot op heden geen gevolg gegeven aan deze oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over digitaal beraadslagen

An MP asked whether live-stream glitches at supplier NotuBiz, which disrupted some digital council meetings, were understood, how many bodies were affected, and how public access can be guaranteed. The minister confirmed the glitches, said about 25 meetings were affected and some suspended, explained the capacity cause, stated that meetings must be public and suspended during faults, and said ICT responsibility lies primarily with local authorities.
Meetings of decentralised representative bodies under the Temporary digital deliberation and decision-making act are by definition public.
Vergaderingen van decentrale volksvertegenwoordigende organen op grond van de Tijdelijke wet digitale beraadslaging en besluitvorming zijn per definitie openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gedwongen verhuizingen in Leiden

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about forced evictions of temporary (antikraak) tenants in Leiden during the coronavirus crisis, including whether the owner's termination and asbestos work justify the move. The Minister says the housing corporation and vacancy manager are helping tenants without alternative housing, that most already have it, and that the works and relocations proceed under RIVM guidance.
The housing corporation and vacancy manager say they are jointly doing everything possible, in consultation with residents, to find timely alternative housing for residents who do not yet have it.

De betrokken woningcorporatie en leegstandbeheerder zetten naar eigen zeggen gezamenlijk en in overleg met de bewoners alles op alles om voor de bewoners die nog niet over alternatieve woonruimte beschikken tijdig andere woonruimte te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van Nederland bij spionageoperatie ‘Rubicon’ en afluistergenootschap ‘Maximator’

Van Raak (SP) asked the Interior Minister, answered by Defence Minister Bijleveld-Schouten, about the Dutch role in the alleged 'Rubicon' espionage operation and the 'Maximator' eavesdropping alliance, including timing of knowledge and decisions, which companies were involved, and whether agents were deployed without company staff knowing. The government declined to discuss the knowledge level and methods of the intelligence services, saying only that cooperation with foreign services is necessary and that the CTIVD oversees lawful use of powers.
Publicly, no statements are made about the knowledge level and working methods of the intelligence and security services.
In het openbaar worden geen uitspraken gedaan over het kennisniveau en de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over woonruimte voor (economisch) daklozen

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Housing about homelessness among economically displaced people, including its link to housing shortages, the Ombudsman's recommendations, the kostendelersnorm exception, and housing solutions. The minister answered at length, describing existing measures (Flexwonen, Crisis- en herstelwet changes, CBS data), noting no categorical exception to the kostendelersnorm, and promising a broader national plan later.
To gain more insight into the regional task of reducing the number of homeless people, the cabinet has asked the centre municipalities to map it.
Om meer zicht te krijgen op de regionale opgave om specifiek het aantal dak- en thuislozen terug te dringen heeft het kabinet de centrumgemeenten gevraagd deze in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat er extra huurwoningen nodig zijn voor asielzoekers in Westland

An MP asked the Minister about press reports that Westland needs extra rental housing for asylum seekers and whether temporary housing could ease pressure on reception centres and the housing market. The minister agreed flexible temporary solutions can help, said municipalities are primarily responsible, and pointed to existing flex-housing measures and a planned accelerator programme for Westland.
Municipalities are primarily responsible for taking the necessary measures to counter pressure on the housing market as far as possible.
Gemeenten zijn namelijk primair verantwoordelijk om de nodige maatregelen te treffen om de druk op de woningmarkt zoveel mogelijk tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de aflevering van het programma Radar over de installatie van warmtepompen

An MP asked the ministers about consumer complaints over heat pump installations, calling for stricter government oversight, accreditation of installers and guarantee schemes. The minister answered that the market and sector should first address the problems, saw no role for the government in intensified supervision or mandatory accreditation, but committed to consulting the installation sector on better quality assurance.
I currently see no role for the government in supervising more intensively or imposing direct regulation in the form of accreditation.
Ik zie vooralsnog geen rol voor de overheid om intensiever toe te zien of directe regulering in de vorm van accreditatie op te leggen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over de berichten ‘Trein stilgezet vanwege vrouw met nikab, politie geeft weer geen boete’ en ‘Conducteur aan schandpaal door nikabfans'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers how the NS and police handled a train stopped for a woman wearing a niqab who was not fined, whether the conductor was supported, and whether action was taken against online harassment of the conductor. The government defended the professionals' discretion, said the police acted in line with agreed procedures, condemned the social media campaign against the conductor, and noted that the NS reported no other incidents since the ban took effect.
It is for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to decide what criminal follow-up is given to a violation.
Het is aan politie en Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen welk strafrechtelijk vervolg aan een overtreding wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht dat een dubieuze afbouwverzekeraar het project in Brielle niet af bouwt

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Linde asked whether a dubious completion insurer leaving a Brielle housing project unfinished leaves buyers unprotected, how often the AFM receives signals about such insurance, how many providers operate, when providers must account, and what specific rules apply. The minister says the insurer lacked a licence and used unusual terms, that buyers may be unable to claim, that the AFM has received very few signals which led to no follow-up, that DNB regulates prudential supervision of 18 insurers offering the branch, and that no specific rules for completion insurance are known beyond general insurance law.
The Minister for Environment and Housing will therefore work with the supervisor to map how the risk of such situations can be further limited in the future.
De Minister voor Milieu en Wonen gaat daarom met de toezichthouder in kaart brengen hoe het risico op dergelijke situaties in de toekomst verder kan beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat 23 ouderen hun huis kwijtraken vanwege een commerciële overname

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked the ministers of Health and Interior about reports that 23 elderly residents of De Keizershof must leave after a commercial takeover, and whether this is acceptable, legally sound, and comparable to the Careyn case. The minister answered that the building was never a care location, the care provider and property owner disputed who pays for adaptations, the rent stopped and the lease was dissolved by court, and that the ministers have contacted the parties to help residents find new housing, committing to no formal structural change.
I find it very unfortunate that these elderly residents have ended up in this situation.
Ik vind het heel vervelend dat deze ouderen in deze situatie terecht zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht 'België houdt grens dicht voor directeur Confucius-instituut'

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government was informed that Chinese professor Xinning Song was barred from Belgium and the Schengen area, and about screening, Chinese intelligence obligations and Confucius Institutes in the Netherlands. The minister replied that Belgium did not actively inform the Netherlands, that no security screening applies to Confucius Institute staff, that Chinese law cannot be ruled out as requiring cooperation with intelligence services, and that knowledge-security measures and a broader study are underway.
When relevant developments arise on this, I will inform the House further.
Bij relevante ontwikkelingen hieromtrent zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het feit dat de Belastingdienst het recht op huurtoeslag heeft afgewezen, terwijl een burger het wel had doordat er sprake was van verworven rechten

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked why the tax authority refused housing benefit that a citizen received under acquired rights, and how the Council of State ruling of July 2019 is being applied. The government says the authority changed its practice from 24 July 2019, lapsed acquired rights can be revived until 1 September 2020, and past final decisions will not be reopened.
Decisions that are final will not be reopened with retroactive effect.
Besluiten die wel onherroepelijk vaststaan, worden niet met terugwerkende kracht heropend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het persbericht van Divosa van 1 oktober jl., over de Budgetten gebundelde uitkeringen 2019 en 2020 en over de middelen voor re-integratie en minimabeleid

Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks the state secretary about Divosa's warnings on the BUIG welfare budget, recurring municipal deficits and budget fluctuations, the shrinking re-integration budget, and the adequacy of minimum-income funding. The secretary rejects the claim that structural deficits dominate, says the budget model is sound and under review, and promises further research and talks with the VNG without committing to new funding.
I do not share Divosa's concerns.
Ik deel de zorgen van Divosa niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Van Eijs en Schonis over het artikel ‘Duurzaamheid blijft ondergeschoven kind bij aanbestedingen in de bouw’

D66 MPs asked whether sustainability plays too small a role in public construction tenders and whether this jeopardises the 2050 climate goals. The government answers that sustainability can be included in many tender criteria, outlines Rijksoverheid purchasing strategy, Klimaatakkoord measures, CO2-Prestatieladder and MKI/MPG instruments, and the status of motion Schonis on smart maintenance pilots.
For central government this has led to drafting a new procurement strategy for Rijk purchasing, aimed at sustainable, social and innovative purchasing.
Voor de rijksoverheid is dit aanleiding geweest voor het opstellen van een nieuwe inkoopstrategie voor de inkoop van het Rijk, gericht op duurzaam, sociaal en innovatief inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de stilgevallen woningbouw

An MP from the PVV asks the minister why housing construction is stalling despite stated acceleration goals, why building permits have fallen, what the government will do about nitrogen (PAS) rules and its gas-free building policy, and whether it will allow more building on the urban periphery. The minister answers that the government has prioritised housing, cites record construction figures and a EUR 2 billion housing impulse, attributes the permit decline to nitrogen rulings, labour shortages and cost overruns, and refuses to reverse the gas-connection obligation removal while committing to continue talks with regions.
I am not willing to reverse this.
Ik ben niet bereid dit terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Noodkreet bouwers – ‘Ruimte zat in Nederland’'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister why housing construction is lagging despite promised acceleration, and presses for more greenfield sites, reversal of the gas-connection requirement for new builds, relief from nitrogen rules, and priority for native Dutch citizens over status holders in social housing. The Minister answers that housing policy is a priority with new programmes and deals, that regions must find sites, that the gas connection obligation will not be restored, that nitrogen rules are EU-based with local mitigation options, and that no nationality-based allocation is possible.
I am not willing to reverse this.
Ik ben niet bereid dit terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de onaangekondigde korting van 3 miljoen op de begroting van Emmen

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked why Emmen was not informed in time of a surprise cut of about 3 million euro to its social assistance budget, and whether the change in allocation key is justified. The state secretary replied that the budget shift reflects annual model updates and labour market changes, that no improper administration occurred, that the municipality can use the safety-net scheme if a shortfall arises, and that no reason to revise the budget is seen.
Of course, the ministry is willing to explain the budget change.
Uiteraard is het ministerie bereid om de budgetmutatie toe te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de aangekondigde ontslagen bij Tata steel

An MP asked the economics minister whether the announced Tata Steel layoffs stem from global overcapacity, the aborted Thyssenkrupp merger, EU anti-dumping policy, and whether the EU should have conditioned merger approval on greener steel, and if consolidation is needed. The minister answered that overcapacity and auto demand are causes, that EU trade defence measures are effective but unilateral restrictions are not a long-term solution, that merger review rules do not normally allow green conditions, and that consolidation is primarily a matter for market parties.
It is primarily up to market parties themselves to decide whether they want to consolidate and to look for suitable partner(s).
Het is primair aan marktpartijen zelf om te bepalen of zij willen consolideren en daarvoor geschikte partner(s) te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerde huizenkopers in Brielle

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior whether home buyers in Brielle can rely on the guarantee insurer, how they can enforce claims, whether they are adequately informed, and whether a national construction guarantee fund should be created. The Minister explained supervision by DNB and the bankruptcy-claim route, pointed to the upcoming Wet kwaliteitsborging for better information, and declined to set up a mandatory national fund.
Given the duty of confidentiality, DNB does not give insight into possible steps in specific cases while the investigation lasts.
Gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht geeft DNB zolang het onderzoek duurt geen inzicht in mogelijke stappen in specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het protest van de eilandraadsleden van Saba

Parliamentarian Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior about the walkout of Saba's island council members protesting insufficient structural funding for policy, and whether Saba should have more freely spendable budget. The Minister answered that Saba has substantial structural funds, agreed in principle that structural tasks should be financed structurally, and committed to review Saba's budget autonomy and to continued contact with the island council.

Yes. In the governance agreement 2019–2022 (the 'Saba Package') that I concluded, it was agreed that the Public Body of Saba and the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will strive to cover structural tasks with structural funds.

Ja. In het door mij afgesloten bestuursakkoord 2019–2022 (de «Saba Package») is afgesproken dat het Openbaar Lichaam Saba en het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zich zullen inspannen om structurele taken ook met structurele middelen te dekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over de primaire energiefactor (PEF) voor elektriciteit

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked whether a primary energy factor (PEF) of 1.45 for electricity is still realistic, given 2018 renewable shares of 7.4% and the need to align with the KEV forecast, and whether a low PEF misleads home buyers. The minister maintains 1.45 is realistic because renewable growth and coal reduction will bring the outcome in line, rejects revising the PEF to the KEV because it would delay near-zero-energy buildings, and says the PEF change was requested by the heat pump sector and the NEN committee.
No, that is not my intention.
Nee, dat is niet mijn voornemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er duizenden nieuwe opvangplekken nodig zijn voor asielzoekers

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary and Minister about reports that thousands of new asylum reception places were needed, questioning the earlier closure of reception centres, the absence of reserve capacity, waiting times and municipal responsibility. The government replied that capacity planning is under consultation with municipalities and provinces, that flexible reception forms are being developed, and that the IND is recruiting staff, while giving only partial data on waiting times and housing.
At this moment the IND is (still) not able to extract the waiting times from the systems.
Op dit moment is de IND (nog) niet in staat om de wachttijden uit de systemen te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over gevaarlijke AGPO Ferroli CV-ketels

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked about dangerous AGPO Ferroli central heating boilers, including NVWA findings on poor maintenance, disagreement among maintenance firms, housing corporations' replacement decisions, and whether a 0800 helpline should be opened. The Minister answered that maintenance is the owner's responsibility, the NVWA has imposed corrective actions on the manufacturer under its supervision, corporations decide replacement themselves, and the NVWA's existing number suffices, while promising a progress update before summer 2020.
I will inform you before summer 2020 about the progress of the corrective actions the NVWA imposed on Ferroli.
Ik zal u voor de zomer van 2020 informeren over de voortgang van de door de NVWA aan Ferroli opgelegde corrigerende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de schadelijke gezondheidseffecten van klimaatbeleid

An MP asked ministers whether municipal health service (GGD) warnings that climate policy such as wind turbines, biomass plants and home insulation may harm health, and claims of noise and biomass harms, are accepted. The minister says the GGD concerns are taken seriously, promises a letter in a few months on health and safety risks of the energy transition, and rejects claims that climate policy is harmful or that the government does not weigh health effects.
Therefore I will send your House a letter in a few months with a further response to those reports.
Daarom zal ik over enkele maanden uw Kamer een brief sturen met een nadere reactie op die rapporten
Antwoord op vragen van de het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Perverse verhuurder stopt met hoogste bieder methode’

An MP asks whether the government considers the bidding-based rental of homes (highest bidder method) by a landlord in The Hague undesirable, whether it is legal, whether it will be banned, and whether similar cases occur. The minister answers that the method is not prohibited under freedom of contract but is undesirable as poor landlordship, notes both landlords have stopped, and says malicious landlords' excessive rents will be addressed with municipal instruments.
The method chosen here to have tenants bid against each other is not prohibited.
De methode die hier gekozen is om huurders tegen elkaar op te laten bieden is niet verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van der Molen over “de ANW-hiaatverzekering”

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether insurer Loyalis actively marketed ANW gap insurance, supplementary survivors' pension and IPAP disability cover to public-sector employees, whether their end dates tied to age 65 or the AOW age were disclosed, and whether the Pensioenkamer and the minister should act on policyholders left uninsured after the AOW-age increase. The minister answered that Loyalis responded to client requests and employer requests, informed affected policyholders and offered choices, and that the ministers have no responsibility for a private insurer, so they decline to convene the Pensioenkamer.
The Ministers of SZW and BZK have no responsibility for a private insurer.
De Ministers van SZW en BZK hebben geen verantwoordelijkheid voor een private verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over het bericht dat de SSH& voortaan haar kamers zal verhuren door middel van loting

SP MPs asked whether a housing association's switch to a lottery for student rooms breached the national student housing action plan and whether students were properly consulted. The minister answered that local parties are responsible for the consultation, that the housing association consulted its tenants' organisation as the law requires, and that the government will monitor whether student unions are included.
From central government we will keep a close eye on this.
Vanuit het Rijk zullen we vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de gedwongen verhuizing van bewoners van Vakantiepark Arnhem

An SP MP asked the Minister about residents of Vakantiepark Arnhem being forced to move chalets on short notice, living conditions, legality, compensation, municipal action and the pilot programme for holiday parks. The minister answered that the municipality disapproves of the owner's conduct, that the legal assessment is for courts case by case, and that pilots and further information will follow.
The municipality of Arnhem informed me that the College sent a letter to the owner disapproving of the owner's handling of the relocations on the park.
De gemeente Arnhem liet mij weten dat het College een brief aan de eigenaar heeft gestuurd waarin zij de handelwijze van de eigenaar omtrent de verhuizingen op het park afkeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Actiegroep Niet Te Koop een sociale huurwoning bezet in Oud-West’

An MP asked whether squatting a social rental home is a crime, whether housing corporation Stadgenoot delayed filing a complaint against squatters, and whether corporations should always file immediately. The minister confirmed squatting is punishable, said Stadgenoot delayed its complaint by two days, and declined to require corporations to file immediately, leaving it to the owner's discretion.
It is up to the owner (Stadgenoot) to decide what it does with its property.
Het is aan de eigenaar (Stadgenoot) om te bepalen wat deze met zijn pand doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ronnes over consequenties PFAS (poly- en perfluoralkylstoffen)

MPs Von Martels and Ronnes (CDA) asked about the consequences of the PFAS temporary framework for construction and dredging, including project delays, housing construction, jobs and comparison with other countries. The minister says she is in talks with the sector, has organised information meetings and regional working conferences, and is taking measures to unblock projects while noting the national framework is needed for health reasons.
I do not have independent figures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Een derde kinderen leeft in ongezond huis’

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior about a report finding that a third of children live in unhealthy homes, including whether landlords should be obliged to keep homes healthy, whether building rules will change, and why tenants report more mould. The Minister acknowledged the concern, described the existing landlord-tenant division of repair duties and tenant remedies (rent reduction, court orders, municipal enforcement), pointed to existing health rules in the Building Decree, and promised a faster local mould approach and more information on healthy living.
I want to accelerate the approach and I am focusing on the local approach in those G4 and G40 municipalities where tenants say mould occurs most often.
Ik wil een versnelling in de aanpak en richt mij daarbij op de lokale aanpak in die G4 en G40 gemeenten waar vocht en schimmel volgens huurders het vaakst voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het rapport 'Politiek en Sociale Media Manipulatie'

An FvD MP asks the Interior Minister whether the government endorses a commissioned report that labels news sites as junk versus mainstream and calls a commenter suspicious, and whether it will refrain from interfering with media, algorithms and Russian election interference claims. The minister replies that the report is independent academic research, that the government does not qualify media and will not restrict press freedom, and that no evidence of state-sponsored disinformation in recent elections was found, while still citing ongoing Russian influence activity and noting ongoing transparency efforts.
It is not for the government to determine which media reporting is true or false.
Het is niet aan de overheid om te bepalen welke berichtgeving door media waar of niet waar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de beantwoording van het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Binnenlandse Zaken om een reactie op de twee rondetafelgesprekken over woonfraude

An MP asks the Minister of BZK about the timing of the digital income check pilot against housing fraud, which depends on Logius prioritising it through a vote among government organisations, and how to secure capacity and a national rollout. The minister answers that the pilot started this autumn, that a new voting round produced enough votes to start the pilot, that it will run with a limited number of housing corporations, and that a national rollout will be decided later based on the pilot results.
De pilot is dit najaar gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het schrappen van gemeentelijke hondenbelasting

MP Krol asked the Minister of Interior whether dog tax, a relic originally aimed at rabies and stray dogs, should be abolished and whether the Minister would consider scrapping the legal basis in the Gemeentewet. The Minister answered that municipalities may freely decide on dog tax, that the Rfv advised abolition, and that abolition is being examined in an interdepartmental working group whose final report is expected in early 2020.
Under the chairmanship of BZK an interdepartmental working group has been set up to examine the revision of the municipal tax area.
Onder het voorzitterschap van BZK is een ambtelijke werkgroep ingericht waarin de herziening van het gemeentelijk belastinggebied wordt onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de toename van het aantal kinderen dat in een crisisopvang woont

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked the government about the rising number of children living in crisis shelters, including whether gezinnen should get priority for housing and whether the issue will be addressed in an upcoming homelessness action plan. The minister answered that children should not grow up in shelters, that no recent data exists so a study will be commissioned, that housing allocation is a municipal responsibility, and that a homelessness action plan is being prepared.
There are no recent substantiated figures on the number of children currently living in women's or social shelters.
Er zijn geen recente onderbouwde cijfers bekend over het aantal kinderen dat momenteel in de vrouwen- of maatschappelijke opvang woont.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over vervuild drinkwater door loden waterleidingen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether lead water pipes in homes, which can harm unborn and young children, will be replaced, and what measures and cost coverage are planned. The minister answered that numbers are unknown, that owners are responsible for removal, that a mandatory disclosure at rental or purchase and information campaigns are being considered, and that a ban on renting such homes is not needed because the Huurcommissie and courts can enforce repair.
I will also look at how an active disclosure of possible lead pipes when entering a rental or purchase agreement can be made mandatory.
Ik ga ook kijken hoe een actieve melding over de eventuele aanwezigheid van loden leidingen bij het aangaan van een huur- of koopovereenkomst verplicht gesteld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Laurens Wonen in opspraak is

An MP asks the minister about reports that housing corporation Laurens Wonen is in trouble, including recovery of damages from its former supervisory board chair, a dual personal union that the regulator should have caught, and an inaccurate oordeelsbrief. The minister answers that the corporation's board decides on recovery, that the regulator Aw is monitoring the case and will publish findings, and that the regulator has admitted missing the dual union and not updating the letter, with procedures tightened.
The Aw has informed me that following this case it will provide an overview of personal unions before the end of the year.
De Aw heeft mij laten weten dat zij naar aanleiding van deze casus voor het einde van het jaar een beeld zal geven inzake personele unies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een uitvaartverzekeraar mensen met een psychische aandoening weigert

An SP MP asked whether funeral insurers may refuse people with psychiatric conditions and whether this discriminatory practice should be banned. The minister answered that insurers are free to set acceptance policy, that the Equal Treatment Act already bars direct discrimination on disability or chronic illness, and that individuals can turn to the College voor de rechten van de mens or the courts.
If consumers believe that the acceptance policy of funeral insurers is in individual cases contrary to the law, they can submit this to the College voor de rechten van de mens or the judge.

Indien consumenten van mening zijn dat het acceptatiebeleid van uitvaartverzekeraars in individuele gevallen strijdig is met de wet, dan kunnen zij dit voorleggen aan het College voor de rechten van de mens of de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een uitvaartverzekeraar mensen met een psychische aandoening weigert

MP Van Raak asks whether funeral insurers refuse or surcharge people with psychiatric or other health conditions, and whether such grounds should be banned. The minister acknowledges the practice, says insurers may set their own acceptance policy within anti-discrimination law, and refers consumers to the College voor de rechten van de mens or the courts.
I am aware that funeral insurers apply criteria on the basis of which people with an increased mortality risk are refused or charged a higher premium.
Het is mij bekend dat uitvaartverzekeraars criteria hanteren op basis waarvan mensen met een verhoogd sterfterisico worden geweigerd of een hogere premie krijgen opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Raak over het bericht dat het CETA verdrag lokaal beleid bedreigt

MPs Alkaya and Van Raak asked whether CETA's investor-state arbitration could expose municipalities and Dutch residents to damages claims over local policy, and whether the government would protect them. The minister answered that no CETA claims are foreseen, that the treaty affirms governments' right to regulate and that damages are capped at actual loss, and declined to guarantee full protection beyond stating the existing legal position.
Individual municipalities cannot be directly sued under the CETA treaty.
Individuele gemeenten kunnen niet rechtstreeks worden aangesproken onder het CETA verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Emiel van Dijk over extra druk op de woningmarkt door nieuwe vluchtelingenstroom

Two PVV MPs asked whether the arrival of refugees adds pressure on the housing market and whether statushouders should be denied housing that Dutch citizens need. The minister answered that housing is allocated without nationality distinctions, that municipalities set urgency categories locally, and that pilots with flexible housing solutions are being funded.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over de rol van pensioenfondsen bij dierenwelzijn

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked whether pension funds such as ABP, which invests in food companies allegedly failing animal welfare standards, should change their investment policy and how the government would respond. The minister replied that ABP invests about 1.7 billion euro in 17 such companies, found no known law violations, and that the government relies on the voluntary but monitored IMVB covenant and exploring greater member control over investments.
The IMVB covenant focuses on embedding the OECD guidelines and UN Guiding Principles in pension funds' policy.
Het IMVB-convenant richt zich op de inbedding van de OESO-richtlijnen en United Nations Guiding Principles (UNGP's) in het beleid van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over de berichten dat studenten op camping neerstrijken

Two SP MPs asked how many students sleep in tents, hostels or bungalow parks due to housing shortages, how they are supported, and what rent protections exist. The minister said the situation is more nuanced than media reports, described municipal and institutional emergency housing arrangements, pointed to monitoring, the Huurcommissie campaigns and the Goed Verhuurderschap pilots, and promised to continue talks with partners without specifying enforceable consequences.

Regarding your questions on numbers of students in temporary emergency accommodation (campsites, hostels and holiday bungalows) and the costs for students, I made inquiries with various municipalities and educational institutions.

Wat betreft uw vragen over aantallen studenten in tijdelijke noodvoorzieningen (campings, hostels en vakantiebungalows) en de kosten voor de student, heb ik bij verschillende gemeenten en onderwijsinstellingen navraag gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over grote misstanden in de uitvaartzorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether reported abuses in funeral services (bodies kept at high temperatures, swapped coffins, cremations abroad at cheaper rates) violate the Burial Act, whether the trade association is powerless, whether regulation is lacking, and what will be done. The minister answered that the Burial Act does not explicitly regulate storage conditions, that the reported case concerned one entrepreneur, and that she is in talks with the sector and will return to parliament in November.
I am already in discussion with the sector about this and will soon also come back to your House on it.
Daarover ben ik reeds met de branche in gesprek en zal ik binnenkort ook met uw Kamer over komen te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het toenemend aantal economisch daklozen in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the rising number of economically homeless people in the Netherlands, whether the state will act, and whether the state is failing its constitutional duty to provide housing. The minister answered that the number is not tracked, cited a CBS figure of 39,300 homeless in 2018, pointed to existing housing measures and municipal responsibility, and said a plan to reduce homelessness would come in autumn.
The number of economically homeless people in the Netherlands is not tracked.
Het aantal economisch daklozen in Nederland wordt niet in kaart gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over de verdubbeling van het aantal daklozen

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about the reported doubling of the number of homeless people in the Netherlands, including the state's duty to provide housing, the causes, the adequacy of social assistance, shelter capacity and broader societal effects. The state secretary answered that housing and health are constitutional social rights shared with municipalities and housing corporations, that the government will present an additional plan this autumn, and that CBS research on the rise is pending.
That is why the Cabinet, together with other (local) parties, will come this autumn with an additional plan to significantly reduce the number of homeless people in the coming years.
Daarom komt het Kabinet dit najaar samen met andere (lokale) partijen met een aanvullend plan om het aantal dak- en thuislozen de komende jaren fors terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ‘de app Nextdoor’

An MP asked the ministers whether the neighbourhood app Nextdoor leaks data, whether the Data Protection Authority has started an investigation, whether police complaints were filed, and whether government should refrain from promoting such apps. The ministers acknowledged leak risks, declined to comment on the AP investigation and individual complaints, said government should be restrained in recommending privately developed apps, and declined to commission research into safer alternatives.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority has informed me that in principle it does not make statements about possible and ongoing investigations.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) heeft mij bericht in beginsel geen uitspraken over mogelijke en lopende onderzoeken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Bergkamp over de onbereikbaarheid van aangepaste rolstoelwoningen

Two D66 MPs asked why a patient was refused an accessible wheelchair home due to age, and about accessibility policy under the UN disability convention and related housing rules.
