The minister said the patient has since been offered a suitable home, that corporations may label dwellings for specific groups on objective grounds, and that no further signals of wrongful refusals were received, while promising to discuss any such cases with Aedes and stating that no national definition of a wheelchair home exists.
I have not received any further signals.
Er hebben mij niet meer signalen bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Schonis over het bericht 'Mogelijk 14 miljard minder aan woningbouw en wegen door stikstofuitspraak'

MPs Van Eijs and Schonis asked about reports that the Council of State's PAS ruling could cost the construction sector billions, including whether provinces paused nature permits, how many homes are affected, and how the ADC test applies to housing. The minister answers that permitting has resumed step by step, that roughly 25,000 homes are affected though projects are not halted, and that an overview of affected infrastructure projects will follow.
The Minister of IenW will inform the House before the MIRT consultation about the consequences of the PAS ruling for national infrastructure projects.
De Minister van IenW zal de Kamer voorafgaand aan het Nota-overleg MIRT informeren over de gevolgen van de PAS-uitspraak voor de nationale infrastructuur projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Jasper van Dijk over de vermogenstoets voor kwijtschelding van lokale belastingen

MPs Van Raak and Van Dijk asked whether the asset limit for remission of local taxes should be raised to reduce debt problems and the poverty trap. The minister answered that the limits mirror national rules, acknowledged an earlier letter wrongly suggested a single figure, and declined to raise the limit because a higher threshold would worsen the poverty trap.
However, if the remission limit were raised to be closer to or equal to the social assistance norm, this would increase the poverty trap.
Echter, indien de kwijtscheldingsnorm zou worden opgehoogd om dichter of gelijk aan de bijstandsnorm te staan, zou dit de armoedeval vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het stagnerende aantal vrouwen in adviescolleges van het Rijk

An MP asked the ministers why the number of women and people with a migration background in government advisory councils is stagnating, why the statutory goal of balanced representation has not been reached since 1997, and whether a binding quota should be introduced. The State Secretary answered that the government will respond substantively to the Court of Audit report on diversity in advisory councils, taking these questions into account, likely only after the cabinet response to the SER advice on diversity at the top.

As the Minister of the Interior promised your House during the committee meeting of 3 July on the functioning of the civil service, I, as the minister responsible for the Framework Act on advisory councils, will respond substantively on behalf of the cabinet to that report.

Zoals de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties tijdens het algemeen overleg van 3 juli jl. over het functioneren van de Rijksdienst aan uw Kamer heeft toegezegd, zal ik, als verantwoordelijke voor de Kaderwet adviescolleges, namens het kabinet inhoudelijk reageren op dat rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over aan allochtonen toe te rekenen kosten op het gebied van woning/huisvesting (sociale huurwoningen, huurtoeslag, subsidies etc.)

PVV MPs Wilders, Fritsma and Van Dijk asked the government to quantify housing-related costs (social rentals, rent allowance, subsidies) attributable to non-Western immigrants, compare them with the group's share of the population and its housing-market effects, and break them down by year. The minister answered that no data exist on costs attributable to people with a migration background, that no central administration tracks this, and that no realistic estimate can be made given the many organisations involved.
I have no insight into what share of all housing-related costs can be attributed to Dutch nationals with a Western or non-Western migration background, and I cannot calculate this either.

Ik heb geen inzicht in welk deel van alle aan wonen/huisvesting gerelateerde kosten toe te rekenen zijn aan Nederlanders met een (westerse of niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond en kan dit ook niet berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over kosten, die voortvloeien uit de aanwezigheid van (niet-westerse) allochtonen in Nederland

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify costs arising from the presence of (non-Western) immigrants in the Netherlands, including police, intelligence, BZK programmes, provincial and municipal funds. The minister answered that most of these costs cannot be broken down by ethnic background because such data are not kept or not permitted, pointing to other responsible ministries and municipalities.
Data on the costs of police deployment for citizens with a (non-Western) migration background are not available.
Gegevens over de kosten van de inzet van politie ten aanzien van burgers met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond, zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het weren van zwangerschappen en baby’s in huurwoningen

An SP MP asked whether landlords excluding pregnant women, babies and families from certain Amsterdam rental homes amounts to discrimination, and what can be done for tenants and applicants. The minister answered that the landlord's clause limiting occupancy to two people is not aimed at excluding children, that such clauses are void if they disadvantage tenants, and pointed to Amsterdam housing-supply measures and legal aid for tenants.
A clause in a lease stating that no children may live in the dwelling is therefore contrary to that right.
Een beding in een huurcontract dat in de woning geen kinderen mogen wonen, is daarmee in strijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over beleggers die het onmogelijk maken voor starters om een huis te kopen

MPs Asscher and Nijboer asked whether investors pushing up house prices make it impossible for first-time buyers to buy, and what the government will do about buy-to-let investors, owner-occupancy obligations and rent increases. The minister answered that a price effect is suggested but causality is not shown, that the government is exploring a differentiated transfer tax and box 3 changes, and that rent measures will be decided later in the autumn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Ldders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de Basisregistratie Persoon (BRP)

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether residents can register at any address in the BRP without the consent of existing occupants, and about the checks municipalities must perform, in cases where people are registered without the main resident knowing and suffer financial harm. The state secretary answered that registration depends on actual residence rather than consent, that municipalities control registrations under the BRP law and the adres onderzoek circular, that consent-based registration would undermine the BRP, and that the ministry is discussing solutions with municipal and implementing bodies.
Registration in the BRP at an address in the municipality is therefore not dependent on the consent of the resident already registered at that address.
Inschrijving in de BRP op een adres in de gemeente is derhalve niet afhankelijk van de instemming van de reeds op dat adres ingeschreven bewoner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij een cyberaanval tegen Iran

MP Karabulut asked the ministers whether the Netherlands was involved in the Stuxnet cyberattack on Iran, how decisions were made, whether parliament was informed, and how the operation relates to international law. The minister neither confirmed nor denied Dutch involvement, citing the duty to protect sources and secrecy, and declined to give substantive answers to most questions while stating the IAEA supervised Natanz in 2007.
Given the nature of the AIVD's work and its methods, and because of the statutory duty to protect sources, I cannot respond substantively to alleged Dutch involvement.
Gezien de aard van het werk en de werkwijze van de AIVD en vanwege de wettelijke plicht tot bescherming van bronnen, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerde huizenkopers in Brielle

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about home buyers in Brielle who face costs of construction defects after the builder went bankrupt, and asked what rights, remedies and guarantee schemes exist. The minister said the municipality supports buyers with an interest-free loan and urges collective action, outlined existing rights and guarantees, and said the upcoming Wet kwaliteitsborging will strengthen consumer protection, while stating that no separate guarantee fund is planned.
Precise figures are not known to me because I am not a party involved in this.
Precieze aantallen zijn mij niet bekend omdat ik hierbij geen betrokken partij ben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over gasvrij wonen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers about SCP findings that public support for gas-free homes is narrow and that households feel imposed upon, and whether the policy should be abandoned. Minister Ollongren answered that support is important and taken seriously, that the policy will not be scrapped, that co-decision with residents is planned via neighbourhood pilots, and that nuclear energy is not excluded.
It is essential that measures in the built environment are implemented with good involvement of residents and building owners.
Het is essentieel dat de uitvoering van maatregelen in de gebouwde omgeving plaatsvindt met een goede betrokkenheid van bewoners en eigenaren van gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het onterecht stoppen van huurtoeslag aan statushouders

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked why housing allowance is stopped and reclaimed for statushouder families when a baby is born, and asked for compensation and a fix. The government answers that the allowance is restored retroactively once the child's residence permit is granted, that the problem stems from legal eligibility requirements rather than automatic database linking, and promises to examine options with other ministers and report in spring 2020.
Even in the case of an initially late application for a residence permit, there is ultimately no loss of housing allowance.
Zelfs bij een in eerste instantie te late aanvraag van een verblijfstitel is er dus uiteindelijk geen verlies aan huurtoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de hoge prijs die huurders betalen voor de verkoop van sociale huurhuizen aan beleggers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether social rental homes sold to investors leave tenants paying high rents, whether the Social Rental Accord rent cap should apply to private landlords, and about the status of studies, a self-occupancy requirement and transfer tax measures. The Minister replied that private landlords face the same per-dwelling rent caps, that the government does not stimulate sales (local parties decide), that studies and a transfer tax differentiation are underway with results expected by year end, and that a website for foreign investors will be merged into another.
It is up to local parties to determine how many social rental dwellings are needed.
Het is aan lokale partijen om te bepalen hoeveel sociale huurwoningen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het recht op huurtoeslag van cliënten in een beschermde woonvorm

An MP asked whether residents of supported housing cannot claim rent allowance when their building is owned by a commercial landlord, and whether this worsens the shortage of housing from non-profit landlords. The minister confirmed the rule, said local authorities and housing corporations are responsible for housing supply, and pointed to recent government plans without committing to amend the rule.
I share your concern about realising sufficiently affordable housing with appropriate support for this group of vulnerable citizens.
Ik deel uw zorg om voldoende betaalbare huisvesting met passende ondersteuning te realiseren voor deze groep kwetsbare burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht: ‘Deelautoproject botst op taaie Woningwet’

An MP asked whether the Housing Act blocks a shared electric car project with housing corporations and whether rules should be changed to let corporations send surplus solar power to shared cars. The minister said the Act already allows corporations to lease roofs to third parties, but will not widen corporations' remit to energy production, while promising to examine further cooperation options.
However, I am willing, when elaborating the policy intention, to examine how the options for corporations to cooperate with such initiatives can be further expanded.
Wel ben ik bereid om bij de uitwerking van het beleidsvoornemen te bezien hoe de mogelijkheden voor corporaties om met dergelijk initiatieven samen te werken verder kunnen worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het Democratiefestival in Nijmegen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the cost and visitor numbers of the Democracy Festival in Nijmegen, whether the minister supports binding referendums, and what steps are taken to renew democracy. The minister reported a ministry subsidy of about €767,000 to the VNG plus smaller contributions, roughly 6,417 participants and about €158 per person, and said the binding corrective referendum is being studied carefully in a phased approach without anticipating a final decision.
The cabinet attaches importance to not anticipating the definitive policy position for now.
Het kabinet hecht eraan nu niet vooruit te lopen op de definitieve standpuntbepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de stijgende kosten van taxaties

An MP asked the Interior and Finance Ministers whether draft EBA guidelines requiring physical appraisals, and rising appraisal costs, are acceptable given house prices. The Minister answered that quality appraisals matter, that model valuations (about 30 euro versus 400-500 euro for physical ones) are a good alternative when used responsibly, and that it is too early to judge consumer cost effects.
I previously informed the House that I see model-based valuation, when used responsibly, as a good alternative to a physical appraisal.
Ik heb eerder aan uw Kamer gemeld dat ik modelmatig waarderen bij verantwoord gebruik zie als een goed alternatief voor een fysieke taxatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Özütok over het bericht ‘Wildgroei flexmakelaars baart zzp'ers zorgen’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that flex intermediaries are multiplying and may be used to shift risk and cut rates, and about the central government's own use of such intermediaries. The minister acknowledges misuse risks, says procurement emphasises quality over price, and says the government does not track how many people work via intermediaries, while promising further research into triangular relationships.
How many people per year work via flex intermediaries at the ministries cannot therefore be derived from these figures.
Hoeveel mensen per jaar via flexbemiddelaars bij de ministeries werken is derhalve niet uit deze cijfers af te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Middendorp over leeftijdsontslag in het licht van het pensioenakkoord

MPs Van der Linde and Middendorp asked how the slower rise of the AOW age under the pension agreement affects civil servants' forced retirement at the AOW age, pension accrual, ABP communication, and whether discretion or exceptions should apply. The ministers answered that early retirement numbers and pension effects were calculated, that employers and employees decide on working on, and that the government stays politically restrained on collective agreement content.
Whether or not to keep working after the AOW age is a decision for the employer and the employee.
Het wel of niet langer doorwerken na de AOW-leeftijd is een beslissing van werkgever en werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht dat het COC veel Friese scholen niet meer binnenkomt

An MP asked the ministers whether the reduction in COC guest lessons on LHBTI acceptance in Friesland, and the shift of LHBTI policy from province to municipalities, was of concern and what the government would do to keep attention on LHBTI acceptance nationwide. The minister answered that schools are free to choose how to address sexual diversity, that the government supports municipalities through the Regenboogsteden programme, and that the sexuality core objectives are being revised.
I am not aware of agreements on the transfer of LHBTI policy from provinces to municipalities.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van afspraken over de overdracht van lhbti-beleid van provincies naar gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de voortgang van het behoud van het dossier 'Sanders'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the 'Sanders' file transferred to the National Archives in 2001 had been digitised as promised in 2017, and if not, how it would be made accessible. The minister answered that the film reels were digitised between April and July 2018 and are now accessible, though a privacy restriction on the BNV archive applies until 1 January 2025 and access requests go to the Chief National Archivist.
For the BNV archive, of which the 'Sanders' file is part, a restriction on public access applies out of respect for the privacy of living persons.
Voor het BNV-archief, waarvan het dossier «Sanders» onderdeel is, geldt een beperking op de openbaarheid vanwege de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van nog levende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de stijgende lasten voor woningcorporaties

An MP asked the Interior and Finance ministers whether the rising levy on housing associations (verhuurderheffing) and the ATAD tax rules are shrinking their investment capacity and new affordable construction, and whether the government will compensate them. The minister answered that the levy rise is mainly from WOZ-value growth and an earlier higher revenue estimate, that the 100 million euro rate cut offsets the burden, that associations' planned investments have risen, and that a 100 million euro annual reduction for building in shortage areas was announced.
There is no reason to assume that the lower new-build figures were caused by a shortage of investment capacity in the short and medium term as a result of the landlord levy.
Er is geen reden om aan te nemen dat de lagere nieuwbouwcijfers zijn ingegeven door een tekort aan investeringskracht op de korte en middellange termijn als gevolg van de verhuurderheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over huurders met financiële problemen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that 800,000 tenants are in financial trouble, and whether rents should be lowered and social tenants protected. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to existing rent support, the rent-increase bill, planned tenant discount measures, and said integral rent reduction is not appropriate, while noting landlords may give individual or temporary discounts.
Integral rent reduction is not a solution for this and is therefore not appropriate.
Integrale huurverlaging is daarvoor geen oplossing en is dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kuiken over het bericht 'Limburg absolute koploper in verstrekken betaalde klussen aan oud-politici'

MPs Özütok and Kuiken asked the Interior Minister about reports that Limburg province awarded paid assignments to former politicians more than all other provinces combined, and about procurement, integrity and transparency concerns. The minister answered that the province reports no violation of EU or internal procurement rules beyond one 2017 internal-rule deviation, that the commissioner of the King's ambtsbericht was requested, and that the minister will review integrity rules for former office-holders with the provincial associations and advise more careful procurement practice.
I will inform the college of provincial executive of this finding in a letter.
Ik zal het college van gedeputeerde staten van deze bevinding in een brief op de hoogte stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het afbranden van monument Haarendael

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about a fire that destroyed the listed Haarendael estate, including its cause, whether the owner failed to protect it, and whether long-term neglect of maintenance is acceptable. The minister answered that the cause is still under investigation, that the owner had no effective protective measures and the building was left vacant, and that she agrees long-term neglect of monuments is undesirable and promotes regular maintenance.
Technical investigation into the cause of the fire is still being carried out.
Technisch onderzoek naar de oorzaak van de brand wordt nog uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs

An MP asked the government about sexual abuse by tantra massage practitioners, including the status of a victim-reporting campaign, numbers of reports and prosecutions, whether tantra massage should be licensed or regulated, and the handling of a reported case at The New Tantra. The minister answered that tantra massage is not a protected profession, the health inspectorate found no jurisdiction, licensing is only required for commercial sexual services, and no further regulation is planned, while a victim-reporting campaign starts in November 2019.
I currently see no reason to regulate the profession of tantra massage practitioner by law.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding om het beroep van tantramasseur wettelijk te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Emoties lopen hoog op bij ontruiming recreatiewoning’

The PVV MP Kops asked the Minister of the Interior about the municipality of Zeewolde's enforcement against permanent residence in holiday bungalows, including fines, seizure of pensions, forced eviction, lock changes, and inspection methods, and asked about residents' remedies and about Polish migrant workers living there. The Minister replied that land-use and enforcement are decentralised, that residents can object, appeal to the courts or complain about conduct, and that the municipality sets its own enforcement priorities.
If the municipality enforces wrongly, the resident can object to the municipality or challenge the enforcement decision in court.
Indien de gemeente onterecht handhavend optreedt kan de bewoner bezwaar maken bij de gemeente of het handhavingsbesluit aanvechten bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Raemakers over het bericht “Het raadsel rond de val van burgemeester Peter de Koning: Dit is een stille coup”.

MPs Den Boer and Raemakers asked about the unexplained forced resignation of Gennep mayor Peter de Koning and whether the procedure followed the Municipalities Act, and called for more transparency on mayoral departures. The minister said the breakdown was regrettable, that the commissaris van de Koning reported on the background, that no formal dismissal procedure under article 61b applied, and that she saw no reason for further research but would discuss the theme with the commissioners.
I see no reason for further investigation. However, following the Gennep case I will discuss the theme with the commissioners of the King.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek. Wel zal ik naar aanleiding van de casus Gennep de thematiek met de commissarissen van de Koning bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de wanhoop van huurders in Middelstum

An MP asked ministers about tenants in Middelstum, Groningen, who face forced double relocation due to earthquake reinforcement and asked about compensation, sloop/rebuild numbers, and support. The minister acknowledged the burden, cited legal relocation allowances and an extra payment of €609.50 for the double move, said corporations and tenants must resolve the dispute with a mediator, and committed to consulting NCG and housing corporations.
Because this is a recurring problem, I will take the initiative to consult with NCG and housing corporations.
Omdat dit een terugkerend probleem is zal ik het initiatief nemen om in overleg te treden met NCG en woningcorporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verboden bemiddelingskosten die Utrechtse pandjesbazen reken

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior why Utrecht rental intermediaries keep charging prohibited brokerage fees, whether fines should apply to repeat offending landlords, and what legal barriers prevent municipalities from introducing landlord licensing. The minister says the ban is clear, cooperates with the ACM against malicious intermediaries without guaranteeing an end to such fees, points to Groningen's existing municipal powers, and commits to report on a motion on licensing risks this autumn.
However, I cannot guarantee that intermediaries will never again charge unjustified brokerage fees.
Ik kan echter niet garanderen dat bemiddelaars nooit meer onterechte bemiddelingskosten in rekening (blijven) brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerde huurders in Honselersdijk

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about tenants of Vestia in Honselersdijk affected by renovation works, including communication, temporary housing, permits, safety and compensation. The minister explained the tenants' rights and duties under tenancy law and the Overlegwet, declined to act on the ongoing case, and pointed to the Huurcommissie and courts for rent reduction.
It therefore does not fit my role as system steward to address the municipality of Westland or Vestia about an ongoing case concerning the treatment of tenants.
Het past derhalve niet in mijn rol van stelselverantwoordelijke om de gemeente Westland of Vestia aan te spreken op een lopende zaak omtrent de behandeling van huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het wegpesten van een transgenderstel in Heerlen

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the government whether local authorities and police have enough tools to stop harassment of LGBTI people, as in the Heerlen case of a transgender couple who moved out, and whether further action or consultation is planned. The minister answered that existing tools are sufficient, that Heerlen used a range of measures including an area ban, and that no additional instruments or consultation are needed, while pointing to the existing Action Plan.
Yes, local administrators and police have sufficient powers to address and tackle persons who harass LGBTI people to the point of driving them out.
Ja, de lokale bestuurders en politie beschikken over voldoende mogelijkheden om personen, die LHBTI's lastig vallen tot wegpesten aan toe, aan te spreken en aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de mogelijkheden tot verruiming van de inkomensgrens voor sociale huur

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the Dutch government itself proposed the EUR 33,000 income limit for social rental housing, and whether the income limit could be raised or the single-person limit lowered in line with EU state-aid rules. The minister answered that the Netherlands could propose but the Commission had to approve, that the EUR 33,000 cap was agreed with the Commission in 2009, and announced plans for a bill raising the limit for larger households and lowering it for single-person households.
This measure was discussed with the EC and agreed in consultation with your House.
Deze maatregel is met de EC besproken en in overleg met uw Kamer overeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het optreden van KMar- en douanemedewerkers op Schiphol, Eindhoven Airport en Rotterdam The Hague Airport

An MP asks ministers about alleged ethnic profiling and discriminatory treatment by Customs and the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee at Schiphol and Eindhoven airports, including an Ombudsman finding on Customs cash checks. The government denies systematic profiling, acknowledges shortcomings in information provision and one inappropriate remark, cites ongoing complaint procedures, and declines a separate investigation while awaiting the Ombudsman's own inquiry.
Yes, Customs acknowledges that at the time of the complaint the provision of information at Eindhoven Airport was insufficient
Ja, de Douane erkent dat ten tijde van de klacht de informatieverstrekking op Eindhoven Airport onvoldoende was
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Laan-Geselschap, Ziengs en Nijkerken-De Haan over de berichtgeving over gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

VVD MPs asked the government whether it supports a bus driver who refused to continue with a niqab-wearing passenger, whether the face-covering ban is being applied consistently in public transport, hospitals and other institutions, and what steps will be taken to clarify enforcement with police and operators. The minister answered that operators and staff should first ask the person to remove the covering or leave, that police should be called if needed, that the practice is being clarified with sector bodies, and that the government will keep monitoring implementation.

The cabinet supports compliance with the law by institutions, paying attention to how the procedure is designed so that it takes account of safeguarding a safe public task and the roles that employer and employee have in compliance with this law.

Het kabinet ondersteunt de naleving van de wet door de instellingen, met aandacht voor de invulling van de werkwijze die rekening houdt met het zorgen voor een veilige publieke taak en de rol die de werkgever en werknemer bij deze wet met betrekking tot de naleving hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de verkoop van hofjeswoningen door corporaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the sale of 29 almshouse dwellings and a chapel by housing corporation Lefier could be stopped despite opposition from tenants, the municipality and the church, and what role the Autoriteit woningcorporaties plays. The minister answered that the sale was approved under the BTIV rules, that the municipality's objection is still pending, and that she sees no reason for new regulation, while answering the remaining questions largely by restating existing rules and municipal responsibilities.
The Aw issued a positive decision on the proposed sale.
De Aw heeft een positief besluit afgegeven op de voorgenomen verkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over het advies van de AIVD over de nationale veiligheid en veiling 5G

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the AIVD advice on 5G and national security of 4 February 2019 was not sent to parliament earlier or attached to the 1 July letter, and whether the government will adopt the AIVD recommendations on phasing out high-risk suppliers and on open source software. The government answered that the advice was weighed in the Taskforce risk analysis and shared confidentially with parliament, that its 5G approach is country-neutral, that it adopts the AIVD advice for C2000 with a verification study, and that open source software is a long-term option to be pursued at European level.
Because the AIVD and MIVD letter is one part of the Taskforce's analytical process, it was decided not to send the letter separately and outside the context of the report to the House.
Omdat de brief van de AIVD en de MIVD één onderdeel is van het analyseproces van de Taskforce is er voor gekozen de brief niet los en buiten de context van de rapportage aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Dam over de berichten ‘Verkeerde afslag politie’ en ‘OV-bedrijven gaan boerkaverbod niet handhaven’

CDA MPs Van der Molen and Van Dam asked the ministers how enforcement of the face-covering ban in public transport and public buildings is working after police statements suggested reluctance to prioritise it. The minister replied that the ban must be enforced, that police have aligned their communication with the law, that police can be called in via escalation, and that the law will be evaluated three years after entry into force.
De wet dient te worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht “Bij provincie heeft integriteit geen prioriteit”

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether provinces must publish an annual integrity report, why only Noord-Holland did so, and what the Minister will do about integrity in Limburg. The Minister replies that the law requires accountability to provincial states but not a separate integrity report, that the form is agreed with each provincial council, that integrity is not a neglected priority, and that an ambtsbericht on Limburg was received and will be sent to parliament later.
I will inform your House about the content of the official report in the answer to the parliamentary questions from members Özütok (GroenLinks) and Kuiken (PvdA).
Ik zal uw Kamer over de inhoud van het ambtsbericht informeren in de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van de leden Özütok (GroenLinks) en Kuiken (PvdA)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het niet handhaven van het boerkaverbod in het openbaar vervoer

An MP asked the government why police do not always enforce the partial burqa ban on public transport, whether fines are issued, what agreements exist between police, prosecutors and transport operators, and what role transport staff have. The minister answered that police first ask offenders to stop and only then draw up a report, that transport staff can address offenders but have no enforcement power, and that the government is monitoring implementation while no separate police-operator fining agreement exists.
The partial ban on face-covering clothing makes no distinction by type of clothing.
Het gedeeltelijk verbod gezichtsbedekkende kleding maakt geen onderscheid naar soort kleding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Van der Molen over het niet handhaven van het verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

MPs De Pater-Postma and Van der Molen asked why a bus driver in Limburg was reprimanded and police and employer did not support him after enforcing the partial ban on face-covering clothing in public transport, and how enforcement would be made effective. The minister replied that enforcement under the law rests with police and the Public Prosecution Service, that transport staff only address passengers and escalate, that the driver and police acted per the law, and that police response times and a conduct guideline have been agreed.
In the incident on a bus in Stein, both the bus driver and the police officer acted in accordance with the law.
Bij het voorval in een bus in Stein hebben zowel de buschauffeur als de politiemedewerker conform de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen door de leden Van Aalst, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat Arriva haar personeel afvalt als zij het boerkaverbod in de bus handhaven

PVV MPs asked whether the government would condemn Arriva for dismissing a bus driver who enforced the face-covering ban, and whether they would act against transport operators refusing to enforce it. The minister answered that both driver and police acted lawfully, that enforcement is a police and prosecutor task, that operators must only ask riders to remove face coverings, and that no operator currently refuses to comply, so no action is planned yet.
Contacts with public transport companies currently do not show that they refuse to comply with the law.
Uit de contacten met de openbaar vervoer bedrijven blijkt op dit moment niet dat zij de wet weigeren na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Sms’jes en WhatsApp berichten op zakelijke én privé telefoons zijn te ‘wobben’’

MPs Middendorp and Van den Bosch asked the Minister of Interior whether work-related WhatsApp and SMS messages on official and private phones fall under the Dutch Freedom of Information Act (Wob) following a Council of State ruling, and what consequences follow. The Minister confirmed such messages can be requested under the Wob, saw no immediate need to amend the Act, and pointed to a government-wide guideline and archiving instruction while stating existing refusal grounds fully apply.
This means that such messages can be requested by invoking the Wob.
Dit betekent dat dergelijke berichten kunnen worden opgevraagd met een beroep op de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over intimidatie van huurders door huisbazen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports of intimidation of tenants by landlords in cities with housing shortages, and about what the government is doing, including licensing and criminalising such conduct. The Minister answered that the government is working through woondeals, the Aanpak Goed Verhuurderschap and five city pilots, rejects a national licensing scheme as disproportionate, and considers intimidation already criminal so no separate economic offence is needed.
It is not known how many complaints tenants have filed against landlords, because the police do not record them in that way.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel aangiftes zijn gedaan door huurders tegen verhuurders, omdat die aangiftes niet op die manier door de politie worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het verdwijnen van kleine woningcorporaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about rising audit costs and the disappearance of small housing associations, including the effects of the OOB status threshold at 5,000 units. The minister answered that controls were reduced, the market share of smaller audit firms has grown, the OOB threshold was kept, and fusion decisions are left to the regulator, Autoriteit woningcorporaties.
As far as I am aware, the study is not carried out annually.
Voor zover mij bekend wordt het onderzoek niet jaarlijks uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over huurverhogingen in aardbevingsgebied 2.0

Two MPs asked whether a housing corporation's rent increases for tenants in a Groningen earthquake-risk complex, which was flagged as elevated risk, were justified, and what tenants could do. The minister answered that the increase was regular, that reinforcement assessments are handled by the National Coordinator Groningen, that tenants can object to the Rent Tribunal, and that she is not party to the dispute and will not reverse it.
I am not a party to this matter and it is not for me to reverse the rent increase.
Ik ben geen partij in deze kwestie en het is niet aan mij om de huurverhoging ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het energielabel voor woningen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the reliability of the home energy label and the research behind a proposed change to a kWh/m2 indicator, including whether a simplified self-assessment version can be as accurate as the current one. The minister answered that a simplified version would be less accurate due to home geometry and required inputs, that the EU directive requires a numeric kWh/m2 indicator, and that work on affordability and a digital home file is ongoing.
The energy label gives homeowners insight into the energy performance and also informs them about measures they can take to improve energy performance.
Het energielabel geeft woningeigenaren inzicht in de energieprestatie en informeert hen bovendien over maatregelen die zij kunnen nemen om de energieprestatie te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over dat er mogelijk meer versterkingen nodig zijn door onnauwkeurige metingen

An MP asked ministers whether inaccurate seismic measurements mean more Groningen homes need reinforcement, the timing of NAM risk calculations, interim support for residents, and clarity on KNMI and NAM roles. The government says the reinforcement is not halted or delayed, the SodM audit takes 12 to 18 months, the KNMI/NAM roles await an evaluation, and tenants' safety and compensation are covered through corporation agreements.
As promised in the letter of 10 July, we adopt this SodM advice.
Zoals in de brief van 10 juli jl. (Kamerstuk 2019Z14913 ) toegezegd nemen wij dit advies van SodM over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht Hoofdpijn in je milieuhuis

PVV MPs asked whether residents of gas-free renovated homes in Zoetermeer's Palenstein district, who reported headaches and poor air, show that the energy transition harms health, and whether the gas-connection obligation and the gas-free programme should be reversed. The minister acknowledged ventilation problems that have been fixed, rejected reversing the gas-free policy and the pilot neighbourhoods, and defended the climate case while promising monitoring by GGD Haaglanden.
Based on these measurements, GGD Haaglanden classifies the ventilation (CO2 values) in the measured homes as good.
Op basis van deze metingen classificeert GGD Haaglanden de ventilatie (CO 2 -waarden) in de gemeten woningen als goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht Paula (79) en Wiggert (82) in stress door ‘gedwongen’ verduur

A PVV MP asked the Minister of the Interior about elderly tenants in The Hague facing forced gas disconnection and renovation by housing corporation Vestia, with rent increases, no replacement housing and health concerns. The minister acknowledged the stress, described compensation and support measures, rejected the claim that Vestia should be called to order, and said no other similar cases are known.
I have no data on the number of these.
Over het aantal daarvan heb ik geen gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘De mobiele lokdoos werkt niet met 5G’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that IMSI-catchers (mobile 'lokdoos' interception devices) do not work with 5G, and about Europol's concerns over identifying and locating suspects on 5G networks. The government answered that a working group is adapting investigative procedures and rules for 5G, that it is in contact with telecom providers and foreign counterparts, and that private possession of IMSI-catchers remains prohibited.

At present, the interdepartmental working group '5G and investigation', chaired by the police and including the Public Prosecution Service, Agentschap Telecom and the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Justice and Security, is working out which changes in procedure are needed to enable identification and localisation of persons on the 5G network.

Op dit moment wordt in de ambtelijke werkgroep «5G en opsporing» onder voorzitterschap van de politie met daarin het Openbaar Ministerie, Agentschap Telecom en de Ministeries van Economische Zaken en Klimaat en van Justitie en Veiligheid uitgewerkt welke aanpassingen in werkwijze noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het gebrekkige toezicht op de data van patiënten

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked how patient data is protected, whether a US company had access to anonymised data, whether patients are informed about research use, and about monopoly risks in digital care. The minister answered that responsibility lies mainly with care providers, that the software in question is not used in the Netherlands, that anonymised or consented research is the rule, and promised further letters and debate.
Hospitals themselves bear responsibility for their patient management software and what they agree with suppliers in their contracts.
Ziekenhuizen dragen zelf de verantwoordelijkheid voor hun software voor patiëntenbeheer en hetgeen ze afspreken met de leveranciers in hun contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over bodemwende

MP Van Eijs (D66) asked whether the government finds the bodemwende erfpacht-based financing model acceptable, whether the erfpacht canon should be tax-deductible when used for home improvement, and when clarity on this would be given. The minister said the Klimaatakkoord research into erfpacht financing will be reported to parliament in autumn, and declined to comment on the tax treatment of an individual provider's product, which lies with the Belastingdienst.

This factual assessment is reserved for the Belastingdienst and, under the duty of confidentiality, I cannot comment on or anticipate the outcome of the assessment of the position on an individual provider's product.
Deze feitelijke beoordeling is voorbehouden aan de Belastingdienst en in het kader van de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet ingaan of vooruitlopen op de uitkomst van de beoordeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Brenk over de grenseffecten van de Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren (Wnra)

MPs Krol and Van Brenk asked about cross-border social security effects of the Wnra civil service law reform, including how many civil servants would switch social security regimes, sick-pay obligations, Article 16 agreements, and notification of Belgian and German authorities. The minister answered that effects depend on individual circumstances, estimated 450 to 550 university staff might face a switch, explained the applicable rules, and said the SVB will handle Article 16 requests under existing policy and foreign authorities will be informed via the Administrative Commission.
The Minister of Education, Culture and Science is in contact with the employers' organisations and will follow developments.
De Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap is in contact met de werkgeversorganisaties en zal de ontwikkelingen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Westerveld over het bericht 'Vijf stenen door de ramen bij journalist Willem Groeneveld van stadsblog Sikkom'

MPs Smeulders and Westerveld asked about the stone-throwing attack on journalist Willem Groeneveld, whether a landlord could be barred from the housing market if linked to it, what is being done to protect journalists, and how malicious landlords are targeted. The minister condemned threats against journalists, deferred on the landlord question until police and prosecutors finish, listed press-freedom and journalist-protection measures, and described pilots and ongoing work against bad landlords without committing to a keurmerk or mystery-guest checks.
Once the investigation is complete, I will consider whether further action on my part is desirable.
Na afronding van het onderzoek zal ik bekijken of verdere actie van mijn kant gewenst is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra en Koerhuis over de berichten ‘Havengebied dreigt een warzone te worden’, ‘Wordt ruimte straks de grote uitdaging voor Amsterdam?’ en ‘Kock wil verzelfstandiging havenbedrijf

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports on tensions between the Amsterdam port and housing plans, and about the municipality's 100% ownership of the port company. The minister answered that the port is of national importance, that the municipality as sole shareholder is responsible for its ownership, and that Rijk and region coordinate on infrastructure and housing without committing to a concrete new step.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam, as 100% shareholder, to give proper form to its ownership of Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam als 100% aandeelhouder om op een goede manier invulling te geven aan haar eigenaarschap van het Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Vestia schikt met Deutsche Bank voor € 175 miljoen

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about Vestia's settlement of 175 million euros with Deutsche Bank over toxic derivatives, the status of claims against other banks, the 675 million euros in rescue aid from other housing corporations and its repayment, and Vestia's 2017 and 2018 results. The minister answers that the Aw found Vestia made sufficient efforts to recover damages, declines to report on pending claims against other banks, explains that repayment of the aid is assessed by 2022 under the rescue decision, and notes that the large results were mainly unrealised revaluations.
Since this would not benefit the course of proceedings with these parties, the Aw cannot provide any information about this.
Aangezien dit het verloop met deze partijen niet ten goede komt, kan de Aw hier geen mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de faciliteiten van jongerenorganisaties

An MP asked the education, health and interior ministers about whether youth organisations deserve facilities, how youth are consulted on policy, which subsidies exist and how board grants (bestuursbeurzen) are allocated. The government answered that youth participation matters, outlined existing consultation channels and subsidies, and defended the current allocation criteria limited to higher-education-relevant organisations.
No, there is no separate overview of youth organisations that receive facilities or subsidies from the national government.
Nee, er is geen afzonderlijk overzicht van jongerenorganisaties die faciliteiten of subsidie krijgen van de landelijke overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Den Boer over berichten op Twitter dat mensen een sms kregen van Forum voor Democratie zonder dat zij zich hebben ingeschreven bij de partij

MPs Verhoeven and Den Boer asked how Forum voor Democratie could text people who had not joined the party, whether the Data Protection Authority would investigate, how people can check and delete their data, what sanctions apply, and whether party membership is verified for state funding. The ministers answered that the phone numbers may have been obtained lawfully with consent or were a processing error, that complaints were already with the AP and ACM, that data access and erasure requests are available, and that membership is checked through a declaration of intent and audit.
Inquiries with the AP show that complaints about this situation have indeed been filed.
Navraag bij de AP leert dat er inderdaad klachten over deze situatie zijn ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over brandveiligheid in seniorenwoningen

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about fire safety in senior housing complexes after a news report on evacuation risks, asking about past signals, measures on smoke spread and escape route length, and whether existing rules fall short. The minister answered that stricter fire safety requirements for residential buildings are planned, with TNO research and a draft amendment to the Besluit bouwwerken leefomgeving to follow, and that municipalities can already impose new-build standards on existing complexes but the minister is still considering how to encourage this.
In this letter I report that I intend to tighten the fire safety requirements for residential buildings.
Ik meld in deze brief dat ik voornemens ben om de brandveiligheidseisen voor woongebouwen aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat Yarden klanten toch laat bijbetalen voor hun uitvaart

MP Van Raak asked whether funeral costs have risen significantly, whether insurer Yarden can pass extra costs to policyholders through an en-bloc clause, whether such unilateral changes undermine insurance reliability, and what the government will do about funerals becoming unaffordable. The minister answered that costs rose about 30% from 2006 to 2018, largely due to inflation, that a package policy downgrade from 2020 affects about 380,000 policies under an en-bloc clause with a cancellation right, and that there is no indication a dignified funeral has become unaffordable for many people.
I have no indications that a dignified funeral has become unaffordable for many people as a result of Yarden's financial problems.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat voor veel mensen een waardige uitvaart als gevolg van de financiële problemen bij Yarden onbetaalbaar is geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over beantwoording van het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Binnenlandse Zaken om een reactie op de twee rondetafelgesprekken over woonfraude

An MP asks whether a digital income check for social housing allocation, and direct access by landlords to income data without consent, are sound ways to prevent housing fraud. The minister supports a pilot of a digital income check with consent, rejects landlord access without consent as contrary to the GDPR, and describes the pilot's data sources and timeline.
No, because consulting income data (a processing under the GDPR) without the consent of the prospective tenant is contrary to the GDPR.
Nee, want het raadplegen van de inkomensgegevens (een verwerking onder de AVG) zonder toestemming van de potentiële huurder is in strijd met de AVG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over stijgende nieuwbouwprijzen door klimaatregeltjes.

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior why new-build home prices rose 17% in a year, whether climate rules such as the removal of the gas connection obligation add unnecessary costs, which regional climate rules raise prices, and whether the minister will reverse these rules. The minister acknowledged the rising prices and the cost estimates for gas-free construction, promised further research and results by early 2020, but refused to reverse the abolition of the gas connection obligation.
I am not willing to reverse this.
Ik ben niet bereid dit terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sienot over het bericht ‘Huizenkopers haken af, omdat nieuwbouw te duur wordt’

MPs Van Eijs and Sienot asked the Minister of Interior about rising new-build home prices, the role of sustainability measures such as heat pumps, land prices, municipal incentives for housing sites, and support for gas-free homes. The minister answered that causes are still unclear, promised research on costs and benefits of gas-free new build by early 2020, and outlined housing deals, a climate-agreement innovation programme, and a public campaign.
In doing so, I also want to have the costs and benefits of gas-free new construction mapped out.
Daarbij wil ik ook de kosten en baten van aardgasvrije nieuwbouw in kaart laten brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het deels instorten van het dak van het stadion van AZ in Alkmaar

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked the government about the partial collapse of the AZ stadium roof in Alkmaar, including whether budget cuts, municipal oversight, pressure on the municipality, and solar panels contributed. Minister Ollongren answered that the municipality found no evidence the roof was underbuilt, that investigations by Haskoning and the Onderzoeksraad are pending, and that she will inform parliament once outcomes are known.
The municipality of Alkmaar will inform me of the outcomes of this investigation. Once that has happened, I am willing to inform your House.
Over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal de gemeente Alkmaar mij informeren. Nadat dit is gebeurd, ben ik bereid uw Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat AZ aan een ramp is ontsnapt

MPs Koerhuis and Rudmer Heerema asked the Minister of Interior about the roof collapse at the AZ stadium, including inspection of stadium roofs, expertise support for municipalities and the sequencing of the Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen. The minister answered that the cause is still unknown pending investigations, that building owners and municipalities bear inspection duties, and that pilot projects for higher consequence classes are being explored.
At this moment it is still unclear what caused the roof of the AZ stadium to collapse.
Op dit moment is nog onduidelijk wat de oorzaak is geweest van het instorten van het dak van het AZ-stadion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over een onderzoek naar de veiligheid van constructies in publieke gebouwen

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked whether public buildings are regularly checked for structural safety, why wind loads are not studied, and how the findings of the 2016 football stadium safety audit were followed up. The minister replied that building owners and municipalities are responsible, that no mandatory periodic inspection exists, that targeted inspection duties are used for specific building types, and that the stadium audit was discussed with clubs and municipalities without new specific standards.
At this moment it is still unclear what caused the collapse of the roof of the AZ stadium.
Op dit moment is nog onduidelijk wat de oorzaak is geweest van het instorten van het dak van het AZ-stadion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over het bericht ‘Inlichtingendiensten: stop je intimiderende bezoekjes’

MPs Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether intelligence and police informant recruitment targeting climate activists was intimidating, disproportionate and lawful, and how citizens can hold the state to account on climate and rights. Minister Grapperhaus replied that individual cases cannot be discussed for confidentiality reasons, that police must act within legal frameworks and handle complaints, and that the government shares concern about climate policy pace.
As I stated in my letter of 18 June (Kamerstuk 29 628, no. 885), given the confidentiality, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Zoals ik gemeld heb in mijn brief van 18 juni jl. (Kamerstuk 29 628, nr. 885 ), kan er gelet op de vertrouwelijkheid niet worden ingegaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Friezin onterecht ingeschreven in Groningen: “Ik ben een Fries in hart en nieren”’

An MP asked how a Frisian woman from Dokkum came to be wrongly registered in Groningen's population register, and whether residents can be registered elsewhere without consent or notice. The State Secretary confirmed the error was corrected retroactively, explained that a legally authorised household member's change-of-address notification can trigger registration, and said no new measures are planned as cases are not shown to be widespread.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak  over het bericht dat partijen open staan voor illegale donaties

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether parties willing to accept anonymous large donations had acted illegally and how the law on party financing would be tightened, including closing the route of donations via foundations. The minister said no actual transaction took place so no violation occurred, will address parties in writing and in talks rather than amend the law now, and will propose transparency measures on the natural persons behind donating legal entities later.
I will also urge them to take measures to prevent the impression from arising again in the future that they are willing to cooperate in constructions that run counter to the legislature's intent.

Ik zal er hierbij ook op aandringen dat zij maatregelen gaan treffen om te voorkomen dat in de toekomst wederom het beeld kan ontstaan dat zij bereid zijn om mee te werken aan constructies die ingaan tegen de intentie van de wetgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de middenklasse die geen huis meer kan kopen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the middle-income group can still afford a home, the consequences of housing scarcity, and measures to stabilise rents and prices. The Minister denied that middle-income housing costs have risen (WoOn2018 shows stable quotes), acknowledged regional shortages, and listed building targets, allocation measures and promised follow-up letters and studies.
I will examine together with municipalities and market parties whether there is room to better target the design of the emergency lever toward the problems experienced.
Ik zal samen met gemeenten en marktpartijen onderzoeken of er ruimte is om de uitwerking van de noodknop nog beter te richten op de ervaren problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat de uitvaartpolis vaak zoek is

Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Interior whether a comprehensive insurance overview for heirs is technically feasible, whether the pension portal and BRP data could show funeral policies, and whether the GDPR and insurers' communication are obstacles or need action. The State Secretary answered that the Verbond van Verzekeraars says a full overview is currently not feasible, that the BRP legal framework does not allow automatic death signals to insurers, that the GDPR is no obstacle, and that a publicity campaign is unnecessary as the insurers already promote their search service.
I am willing to enter into discussion about that.
Ik ben bereid daarover in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het verdwijnen van de website statengeneraaldigitaal.nl

An MP from the CDA asked why the Staten-Generaal Digitaal website disappeared, why historical parliamentary documents now have fewer search options and PDF-only access, and who maintains the collection. The State Secretary confirmed the move to officielebekendmakingen.nl, explained the management arrangement with the Tweede Kamer's DIA and KOOP, and referred the functionality questions to the Kamer's Presidium.
It is up to the Presidium of the House to answer questions in this area.
Het ligt op de weg van het presidium van de Kamer om vragen op dit gebied te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over mogelijkheden tot verruiming van de inkomensgrenzen voor sociale huur

An MP asks whether income limits for social housing should be widened, how many people fall between social and private rental, and how other EU states define social housing targets under EU state-aid rules. The minister answers that the EU Commission only checks for manifest errors, that the Dutch income limit was agreed with Brussels, and that a differentiated income limit is being explored while the government commits to a broader housing package and a later overview of other member states.
On how these member states have shaped this demarcation, I will inform you further.
Over de wijze hoe deze lidstaten deze afbakening hebben vormgegeven zal ik u nader informeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over Europese dreiging van de Eternal Blue exploit

A D66 MP asked the Interior Minister about the Eternal Blue exploit, the Baltimore ransomware attack, Dutch exposure to SMBv1 vulnerabilities and whether patch policy for government should change. The State Secretary answered that the NCSC advisory remains in force, the BIO patch rules are considered sufficient, and that existing cooperation structures are being strengthened.
For this one specific vulnerability I see no reason to change the government-wide patch policy as set out in the Baseline Information Security Government.
Ik zie vanwege deze ene specifieke kwetsbaarheid geen reden het overheidsbrede patchbeleid aan te passen, zoals dat is opgesteld in de Baseline Informatiebeveiliging Overheid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Overheidsalmanak staat bol van de fouten'

An MP asked about press reports that the government's online almanac contains many errors and omissions in data on councillors and provincial members, and whether it should be freely accessible and accurate. The State Secretary acknowledged the reports, attributed the errors to data supplied by the VNG and provinces, agreed that the almanac must be complete and accurate, and promised to contact those bodies and add editorial capacity.
I will contact the VNG and the provinces concerned about improving the supply of data.
Ik zal contact opnemen met de VNG en met de betrokken provincies over een verbetering van de aanlevering van gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over onbeantwoorde vragen over artikel 68 van de grondwet, de inlichtingenplicht van de regering

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked the government about delayed answers to parliamentary questions on the duty to provide information (article 68 of the Constitution), including state secrecy, deliberately delayed FOI requests and withheld information. The minister answered that questions were grouped for clarity, that the government does not track the requested statistics, that state-interest refusals are rare and pre-tested in cabinet, and that Parliament's information right is broader than the FOI law.
Parliament's right to information is in several respects also broader than the right to public access under the FOI law.
Het recht op inlichtingen van de Kamer is in een aantal opzichten ook breder dan het recht op openbaarheid onder de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Gevaarlijke gasleidingen in Nederland versneld vervangen na explosie Den Haag’

MPs Sienot and Van Eijs asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of the Interior about the accelerated replacement of risky grey cast-iron gas pipes after an explosion in The Hague, why some network operators acted slowly, and whether gas-free housing could help. Minister Wiebes answered that SodM supervises an accelerated plan, that the cause of the third incident is not yet explained, that safety is leading, and that he will support network operators where needed.
Now that the precise underlying cause of the third incident, a crack in the gas pipe in The Hague, cannot be explained, it is (still) not possible to establish a link with the earlier incidents.

Nu de precieze achterliggende oorzaak van het derde incident, een scheur in de gasleiding in Den Haag, niet kan worden verklaard, is het (nog) niet mogelijk een relatie te leggen met de eerdere incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de uitzending van Radar over drugsdumpingen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about drug waste dumpings on private land, including whether owners should be expected to take preventive measures, whether full compensation for clean-up costs is warranted, and whether convicted dumpers could fund a victims' fund. The government answered that owners need not take preventive measures, that full compensation for direct clean-up costs for private owners will be provided through provincial schemes and structural funding, and that a victims' fund and separate co-financing arrangements are still being explored by the intergovernmental working group.
In connection with drug dumpings, citizens who have committed no offence are not obliged to take measures to prevent the dumping of drug waste, nor to clean up dumped drug waste.

In samenhang met drugsdumpingen zijn burgers die geen overtreding hebben begaan, niet verplicht om maatregelen te nemen om dumping van drugsafval tegen te gaan en ook niet om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked how much of the earlier co-financing budget for drug waste clean-up remained unspent, whether private owners should be compensated for clean-up costs, and what the government will do to provide structural funding. The government answered that EUR 1.2 million remained unspent and is available to provinces, that EUR 1 million per year is now structurally reserved for 2019-2024, and that responsibility for clean-up lies with regional and local authorities, with private owners to be compensated where they bear no fault.
The cabinet now makes available structurally another EUR 1 million per year for 2019 to 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked whether innocent private landowners should not have to pay for clearing drug waste dumped on their land, following a Council of State ruling, and what consequences the government draws. The Staatssecretaris replied that regional and local authorities are primarily responsible, notes provincial subsidy schemes, and announces a structural 1 million euro per year from 2019 to 2024 so that private owners are fully compensated for direct clean-up costs and municipalities partly compensated.

The cabinet now makes available structurally another 1 million euro per year for 2019 through 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Vestia verkoopt 10.000 huizen in onder meer Westland en Pijnacker-Nootdorp’

An MP asks the Minister whether the planned sale of about 10,000 Vestia social rental homes in six municipalities should go only to other housing associations or sitting tenants, and whether approval can be withheld to protect rental stock. The Minister replies that the sale is planned to other housing associations under an approved sanation plan, that no buyer or approval request exists yet, that the Aw as supervisor would review any future sale, and provides 2017 sales figures by region.
Should this case change in the future, it will be assessed under the sales rules of the BTIV by the Aw, as independent supervisor.
Mocht deze casus in de toekomst wijzigen, dan zal deze conform de verkoopregels uit het BTIV worden beoordeeld door de Aw, als onafhankelijk toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Mitros bouwafspraken niet nakomt

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Mitros, a housing corporation, should halt sales of social rental homes after failing to meet agreed construction targets, and why its sale prices and conditions are above WOZ value. The minister replied that local parties set performance agreements and judge their implementation, that sales rules apply (offer first to sitting tenants for regulated homes), and that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties checks compliance.
It is a matter for those parties how they assess the implementation of mutually agreed performance agreements.
Het is een aangelegenheid van die partijen hoe zij de uitvoering van onderling gemaakte prestatieafspraken beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de voortgang van het Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet en de Aanvullingswet Grondeigendom

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the progress of the Digital Environment Act system (DSO), the BIT advice and follow-up, the exception to the offer obligation for self-realisation, and powers to compel land owners to build or be expropriated. The Minister replied that the DSO basic level is due end 2019, that BIT advice has been fully followed and a further BIT update will be requested end 2019, that a building obligation is legally limited and a study is pending, and that a residence obligation study has been commissioned.
I expect the results of this study at the end of August and will of course inform your House after the summer recess.
Ik verwacht eind augustus de resultaten van dit onderzoek en zal uw Kamer daarover uiteraard informeren na het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Twitter blokkeert Wilders’

MPs Middendorp and Van Gent asked the government about reports that Twitter had blocked MP Wilders' account and whether this affects freedom of expression and the EU disinformation action plan. The Minister replied that Twitter found Wilders violated its hateful conduct policy and asked him to remove a tweet, that Twitter is a private contractual matter outside ministerial control, and that the government will push platforms for more transparency, but could not answer all questions in time.
As Minister, I do not decide on the terms of use of social media platforms such as Twitter.
Als Minister ga ik niet over de gebruiksregels van sociale media als Twitter.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het misbruikschandaal bij ProDemos

An MP asked the ministers of Interior and Justice about a sexual misconduct scandal at the ProDemos foundation, including whether an independent investigation is warranted, aftercare for staff, and how staff are supported in filing complaints. The minister answered that the investigation by the Joustra committee was delayed and will be completed as soon as possible after the summer recess.
He will complete his investigation as soon as possible after the summer recess.
Hij zal zijn onderzoek zo snel mogelijk na het zomerreces afronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over lange rijen bij de Roemeense stembureaus in Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked whether too few voting locations were provided for Romanian citizens in the Netherlands, causing long queues and a disturbance at the Hague embassy during the 2019 EP and referendum votes, and whether the government would raise this with Romania. The minister answered that Romanian authorities are responsible, that the Netherlands raised its dissatisfaction with the ambassador and Romanian counterpart, and that Romania promised improvements, so no EU-level agenda item is needed.
The Romanian authorities must in future ensure sufficient capacity, polling stations and staff so that every citizen who wishes to vote can do so.
De Roemeense autoriteiten dienen in het vervolg te zorgen voor voldoende capaciteit, stemlocaties en personeel, zodat iedere burger die dat wil kan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bosman over de Arctische Raad

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about the failure of the Arctic Council ministerial meeting in Rovaniemi, the US Secretary of State's speech on Chinese and Russian activity in the Arctic, and Russian plans for the Northern Sea Route. The government confirmed no Ministerial Declaration was adopted, said Dutch Arctic policy would be addressed in a forthcoming letter, and gave only general or deferred answers on the substantive questions.
You will receive this letter next summer.
Deze brief zult u komende zomer ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Beleggers kopen Groningen op’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about reports that investors are buying up Groningen, squeezing starters and social renters, and proposes measures such as higher transfer tax for investors and rent caps. The Minister acknowledges housing shortages and the rise of private rentals, promises further research on investor price effects, a 'noodknop' for middle-segment rents, and a review of transfer tax differentiation, but rejects the proposed rent freeze and cap as impractical.
Before the summer I will inform the House about the further elaboration of the emergency button.
Voor de zomer informeer ik uw Kamer over de verdere uitwerking van de noodknop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het opkopen van huizen om duur te verhuren in studentensteden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about investors buying homes in university cities to rent out at high prices, squeezing starters and social tenants, and proposed a maximum number of properties, a residence obligation, higher transfer tax for investors, and action on banks promoting such investment. The Minister acknowledged the concern, rejected a property cap and a broader ground-level restriction as disproportionate, said studies on price effects and a differentiated transfer tax are underway, and pointed to existing municipal powers and a planned rent-abuse measure.
I therefore have reservations about the proportionality of this instrument.
Ik heb dan ook bedenkingen bij de proportionaliteit van dit instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Mitroshuurders vrezen extreme huurverhoging'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that Mitros tenants fear extreme rent increases after 21 social rental homes in Utrecht were sold to a commercial buyer, and about the adequacy of tenant information, the Autoriteit woningcorporaties' approval, and local agreements. The minister answered that the Aw approved the sale under the legal procedure after positive opinions from the municipality and tenant organisation, that tenants were informed in time, and that housing allocation and distribution are a matter for local parties.
The Aw states that both the municipality of Utrecht and the tenant organisation gave a positive opinion on the proposed sales.
De Aw geeft aan dat zowel de gemeente Utrecht als de huurdersorganisatie een positieve zienswijze op de voorgenomen verkopen hebben gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat woningcorporaties hoge tarieven rekenen voor inschrijvingen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about housing corporations charging high registration fees for social rental housing, and whether waiting-time portability and a national search system could help. The minister acknowledged rising waiting times, defended registration fees as cost recovery, provided a fee table per region, and said that portability and a unified system are for corporations and municipalities to pursue, with the government supporting exploration.
I do not have information on waiting times per housing corporation.
Ik beschik niet over informatie van wachttijden per corporatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over te dure huurwoningen voor zorgcliënten in Zwolle

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked whether the government knows of care clients forced to move because their rent is too high for their income in Zwolle, and whether rent for care housing is monitored. The minister replied that she had no such signals, explained the tenancy protection rules for care housing, said rent is not monitored against client income, and will await the municipality's study before considering further steps.
No, rent is not supervised in relation to the income of tenants (who may also be care clients).
Nee, op huurprijzen wordt geen toezicht gehouden in relatie tot het inkomen van huurders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Huurders betalen hoge prijs in overspannen vrije sector’

An MP asks whether landlords in the liberalised rental sector exploit scarcity through neglected maintenance, high rents and service charges, and whether tenants should get Huurcommissie access and better protection. The minister says landlords may not charge maintenance costs, describes Goed Verhuurderschap and woondeals, and says the Huurcommissie advice route is being promoted but full access for liberalised tenants is not granted.
