Regarding rent protection there is a distinction. Whereas for regulated tenancies all procedures under the Rent Price Implementation Act are possible before the Huurcommissie, this is not the case for liberalised tenancies.

Ten aanzien van de huurprijsbescherming is er wel een onderscheid. Daar waar bij de gereguleerde huurovereenkomsten alle procedures op basis van de Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte bij de Huurcommissie mogelijk zijn, is dit bij de geliberaliseerde huurovereenkomsten niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het selectief toepassen van Nederlandse grondrechten

MP Martin Bosma (PVV) asks the Interior Minister how the right to demonstrate can be reconciled with the bans and restrictions on demonstrations after counter-protests, and why such bans are applied to some groups but not others, citing Articles 1 and 9 of the Constitution. The minister answers that mayors decide case by case, that a ban is a last resort and content can never be the reason, that mayors account to the council and courts, and that criminal law applies equally to all demonstrators.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daar in te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost, Voordewind en Segers over de berichten 'Iraans anti-Israëlprotest bereikt ook westerse steden' en 'CIDI: Stop haatdemonstraties Iraans regime in Nederland'

MPs Drost, Voordewind and Segers asked whether calls to destroy Israel and the United States at a demonstration in The Hague were incitement to hatred, whether police should have ended it, whether an interpreter was present, and whether Iran was behind it. The minister answered that the demonstration right allows offensive speech, police found no criminal offences, an interpreter was present, and the cabinet has no concrete indication of Iranian involvement.
The right to demonstrate also includes publicly expressing opinions or statements that may be experienced as annoying, offensive or shocking.
Het demonstratierecht omvat ook het publiekelijk uiten van meningen of uitlatingen die als hinderlijk, aanstootgevend of choquerend kunnen worden ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Nu al record aan woningbeleggingen in 2019'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a report that housing investment reached a record in 2019, including the rising share of international investors, their effect on prices and affordability, and why housing corporations invest less in new construction. The minister acknowledged the trend, noted risks from excessive rents, said she is developing an emergency brake on excessive rents and studying price effects, and outlined measures such as simplified market testing and differentiated income limits for corporation housing.
I am therefore working hard to counter investors who behave excessively.
Ik werk er dan ook hard aan om de beleggers die zich excessief gedragen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huizen met gebreken, zoals schimmel, vooral huurhuizen zijn en niet elke huurder ermee naar de huurcommissie kan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that many homes have serious defects such as mould and that tenants, especially in the private free sector, cannot always turn to the Huurcommissie, and asked about action timelines, Huurcommissie backlogs and rights for free-sector tenants. The minister answered that an integrated local approach is being pursued, outlined the tenant and landlord responsibilities and Huurcommissie procedures, explained the backlog increase as a trend break rather than a budget cut, and said she will encourage landlords to allow Huurcommissie advice in free-sector leases.
I do not have the exact information on the number of persons living in a home with mould and damp problems.
Ik beschik niet over de exacte informatie van het aantal personen dat woont in een woning met schimmel- en vochtproblemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over het bericht dat de doorstroming vanuit de vrouwenopvang naar huurwoningen problematisch verloopt

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked about reports that women leaving shelters struggle to move into rental housing, and about the Ombudsman's findings on shelter bottlenecks and clawed-back rent allowance. The Minister acknowledges local housing shortages, points to existing priority rules for shelter residents and to ongoing working groups and a commitment to inform parliament, while stating there is no national picture of shelter place shortages and that municipalities are responsible.
There is no national picture of the (possible) shortages of shelter places in women's shelters.
Er is geen landelijk beeld van de (eventuele) tekorten aan opvangplekken in de vrouwenopvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Laurens Wonen in opspraak is

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that housing corporation Laurens Wonen was in trouble, including whether its supervisory board chair was unlawfully reappointed and paid, and whether a joint management arrangement with care provider Laurens Zorg creates financial risks like those at Humanitas. The Minister, relaying the Aw's findings, confirmed the unlawful reappointment, said the Aw has agreed supervisory arrangements with the corporation, and said the joint arrangement is being ended and the financial ties unwound.
The Aw, as supervisor of housing corporations, cannot rule on the remuneration for work for Laurens Zorg.
De Aw kan als toezichthouder op woningcorporaties geen uitspraak doen over de vergoeding voor werkzaamheden voor Laurens Zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het bericht dat er fors minder vergunningen voor nieuwbouwwoningen zijn afgegeven

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior Affairs why building permits for new homes fell 27 percent in early 2019 and whether the ban on gas connections in new construction, the rising costs and scarce building locations are to blame. The minister acknowledged concern, linked the drop plausibly but not certainly to the gas-free new build rule and lagged application declines, said permits have since recovered, and committed only to continued monitoring.
I will continue to closely monitor the development.
Ik blijf de ontwikkeling nauwlettend monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Burgemeester moet slapende rekenkamer wekken’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether dormant municipal audit committees (slapende rekenkamers) violate the Municipalities Act, how many exist, and what sanctions or powers apply. The minister confirmed that a dormant audit committee breaches the law, named no municipalities, said there is currently no power to intervene, and pointed to a planned bill and a working group's recommendations.
There is currently no possibility to intervene when municipal councils fail to perform a task that the Municipalities Act requires of them.
Er is op dit moment geen mogelijkheid om in te grijpen als gemeenteraden een taak niet uitvoeren die op grond van de Gemeentewet van gemeenteraden wordt gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het bericht dat Facebook toch in de fout gaat met politieke advertenties uit het buitenland

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked whether Facebook still lets foreign actors place political ads targeting other countries despite its transparency pledges, and whether self-regulation should give way to legislation. The minister acknowledged the gaps, said the government lacks power to enforce full ad transparency, and promised an inventory of existing rules and expert consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Meenen en Kwint over de uitvoering van de motie Van den Hul c.s. (35 000 VIII, nr. 173) inzake het inzichtelijk maken van de ruimtebrief

Four MPs asked the government why it will only 'point to' a Parliament motion asking education employers to make the 'ruimtebrief' (budget space letter) public at collective bargaining tables, and why the letter's name is changing. The minister replied that the government cannot oblige employers to disclose the letter's contents, that collective bargaining freedom precludes forced disclosure, and that it will send employers a cover note pointing to the motion while noting it conflicts with confidentiality and negotiating freedom.
The cabinet cannot and will not oblige education employers to make the contents of the letters transparent at the negotiating table.
Het kabinet kan en wil de onderwijswerkgevers niet verplichten om de inhoud van de brieven inzichtelijk te maken aan de onderhandelingstafel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht dat dorpen leeglopen omdat de bouwprojecten niet loskomen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of the Interior whether the housing plan supply is sufficient to close the housing shortage, citing EIB and ABF studies, and questioned provincial planning, the binnenstedelijk bouwen rule and plan data quality. The minister answered that there are enough plans (155% of projected need to 2025), outlined woondeals, the expertteam woningbouw and planning monitoring, and committed to further updates and the AO Bouwopgave.
The inventory shows that there are currently sufficient plans to meet the increase in demand and close the shortfall by 2030.
Uit de inventarisatie komt naar voren dat er op dit moment voldoende plannen zijn om te voorzien in de toename van de behoefte en het inlopen van het tekort tot 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Tony van Dijck over hypotheken voor ‘duurhuurders’

PVV MPs Kops and Tony van Dijck asked whether tenants paying high rents should be able to get mortgages based on actual monthly costs, and whether stricter income rules should be relaxed given lost wealth-building. The minister defended current income-based mortgage rules, saying individual case-by-case exceptions (the explain option) are possible and that the pilot by BLG Wonen is being monitored, while refusing a general loosening of income requirements.
I am not in favour of generally relaxing the income requirements for mortgage credit, because this would increase the risk of over-lending to consumers.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het generiek versoepelen van de inkomenseisen voor hypothecair krediet, omdat dit het risico van overkreditering van consumenten doet toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht ‘Gratis wonen. Als je mee laat kijken in je bed’

An MP asked the ministers whether a Helmond smart-district initiative offering rent reductions in exchange for personal data, and sensor-based monitoring, is acceptable, and how it fits with privacy and oversight. The minister answered that the project is a citizen-involved experiment bound by the GDPR, that no concrete data agreements exist yet, that the rent-for-data plan is still in feasibility, and that the Ethics Commission and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens remain relevant, with no commitment to halt the initiative.
Nothing has been decided yet. Should the experiment go ahead, I will closely monitor its design and implementation.
Er staat op dit moment nog niets vast. Mocht het experiment wel worden uitgevoerd, dan ga ik de uitwerking en de uitvoering daarvan nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Dik-Faber over de berichten ‘NBA bezorgd over daling aantal oob-kantoren’ en ‘Woningcorporaties worden al streng genoeg gecontroleerd’

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Finance and Interior ministers about NBA concerns that the number of accountancy firms licensed to audit public-interest entities (oob) is falling, and about extending that status to large housing corporations. The minister answers that the decline is regrettable but not yet a shortage, rejects tailored rules for small oob firms, and says the oob status for housing corporations above 5,000 units will go ahead, while promising to await the CTA recommendations on the audit market.
Applying tailored treatment for smaller oob accountancy organisations does not seem desirable to me from that point of view.
Het toepassen van maatwerk voor kleinere oob-accountantsorganisaties lijkt mij vanuit dat oogpunt niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Buitenweg over de mogelijke verhuizing van interceptieschotels uit Burum

MPs Diks and Buitenweg asked the ministers of Defence and the Interior whether the government is frustrated with the intelligence services over relocating the Burum interception dishes because of 5G, and what consultation, analysis and parliamentary involvement there would be before any relocation decision. The minister denied the frustration, said a TNO study concluded coexistence is not possible, and promised an alternative by September 2022 via international cooperation, while withholding details of that cooperation for confidentiality reasons.
Because of the confidentiality required in this context, I cannot say anything further about the precise shape of this international cooperation.
Ik kan vanwege de in dit verband vereiste vertrouwelijkheid verder geen uitspraken doen over de precieze invulling van deze internationale samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de registratie van stemgerechtigde EU-burgers in Nederland

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the low registration (12%) of non-Dutch EU citizens to vote in the 2019 European Parliament elections and whether municipalities, such as Haarlem, Gouda, Heerlen, Roermond and Amersfoort, properly informed them of the 9 April registration deadline. The minister replied that municipalities were required and instructed to inform EU citizens, described what each named municipality did, and said an evaluation survey would be held with a view to possible further action for 2024.

I will inform the House of Representatives about the answers municipalities gave to these questions and will then indicate whether I see reason for further action for the next European Parliament election in 2024.

Ik zal de Tweede Kamer informeren over de antwoorden die de gemeenten op deze vragen hebben gegeven en dan ook aangeven of ik reden zie voor nadere actie voor de volgende verkiezing van de leden van het Europees parlement in 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het laten verkrotten van panden

An SP MP asked the minister how a property speculator can repeatedly avoid paying penalties while letting listed buildings and plots decay in several municipalities, and what the state can do to stop such patterns. The minister answered that enforcement is primarily a municipal competence, listed the available instruments (penalties, enforced repair, takeover, expropriation, criminal enforcement), and said existing law is sufficient, without providing the requested cost and penalty figures.
I do not have the data you requested.
Over de door u gevraagde gegevens beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat bouwers moeten bijdragen aan de toekomst van de stad Eindhoven

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Eindhoven municipality's plan to recover costs for supra-local facilities from developers (a 'new-build levy') was known beforehand, whether it complies with the law, and whether it threatens the housing deal targets, and asked the minister to intervene. The minister answered that the municipality uses a lawful cost-recovery option under the Wro, that it does not affect the 3,000 homes per year target, and that she sees no reason to intervene for now, promising to talk to Eindhoven if monitoring data give cause.
I see no reason at this moment to intervene.
Ik zie dan op dit moment geen aanleiding om te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat gemeenten bouwplannen frustreren

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are frustrating housing construction, whether a shortage of building officials explains lagging output, and what measures will reach the 75,000 homes per year target and protect affordable rental housing. The minister acknowledged capacity constraints at municipalities, pointed to the expert team and Crisis- and herstelwet, said 2018 output came close to the target, and promised to inform parliament before summer about an emergency measure on excessive rent increases.
That is why I am working on developing an emergency measure to curb excessive rent increases. I will inform you about this before the summer.
Daarom ben ik bezig met de uitwerking van de noodknop om excessieve huurstijgingen tegen te gaan. Hierover zal ik u voor de zomer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het bericht 'Ambtenaar belt voor € 211.000 maar krijgt geen ontslag'

An MP asked why officials ran up large mobile data bills without being dismissed or prosecuted, and whether the government would file charges, recover costs and change contracts. The minister said a flawed reporting system caused the costs, a conditional dismissal was imposed on the main case, no fraud was found so no charges would be filed, costs would not be recovered, and contract caps were introduced.
Following the ADR report, I have taken measures to prevent excessive data use in the future.
Naar aanleiding van het ADR-rapport heb ik maatregelen getroffen om excessief dataverbruik in de toekomst te voorkomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over arbeidsmigranten die een goudmijn zijn voor verhuurders

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked about reports that holiday bungalows in Ewijk are used to house migrant workers as a profitable model, the adequacy of oversight of exploitation and housing conditions, and what legal tools exist against exploitative landlords. The minister called such use undesirable in principle, said the Inspectorate SZW cannot judge exploitation from press reports, described lokal housing inspection and inter-agency cooperation, and pointed to pilots against bad landlords and forthcoming measures.
I cannot assess from the press reports whether there is exploitation or judge the specific housing conditions, partly because the expertise to assess this is assigned to other organisations.

Ik kan op basis van de berichtgeving niet beoordelen of er sprake is van uitbuiting of oordelen over de specifieke woonomstandigheden, mede omdat de expertise om te beoordelen of hier sprake van is bij andere organisaties is belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een gesponsorde reis van een Arnhemse topambtenaar naar Saoedi-Arabië

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether a senior Arnhem civil servant's trip to Saudi Arabia, reportedly paid for by third parties including Ernst & Young, breached the municipal code of conduct, and how the trip was assessed. The minister declined to judge the individual municipal case, saying it is for the mayor, college and council of Arnhem, and said she did not know who paid, while noting the municipality has a legal code of conduct and may clarify it.
I consider this an internal matter for the municipality of Arnhem and leave it to the mayor, the college and the council of Arnhem to give a judgment on this from their respective responsibilities.

Ik acht dit een interne gelegenheid van de gemeente Arnhem en laat het aan de burgemeester, het college en de raad van Arnhem om hierover vanuit hun respectievelijke verantwoordelijkheden een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Koerhuis en Lodders over het  bericht ‘Leidse  steuntrekker mag  kamer verhuren aan student om bij te verdienen’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Leiden plan to let welfare recipients sublet rooms and keep part of the income was lawful, and what the government would do. The government answered that the plan contravened the Participatiewet, that it was a serious shortcoming in lawful implementation, and that Leiden withdrew the pilot after contact with the ministry, so no formal sanction was needed.

Given its scale (both the target group and the monthly amount to be exempted) and its possible spillover effect, implementing the plan would in my view lead to a serious shortcoming in the lawful implementation of the law.

Gelet op de omvang daarvan (zowel qua doelgroep als het vrij te laten maandbedrag) en het mogelijke uitstralingseffect, zou de uitvoering van het plan naar mijn mening leiden tot een ernstige tekortkoming in de rechtmatige uitvoering van de wet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over woonvormen voor dementerenden

An MP asked the ministers about shortages of suitable housing for seniors and people with dementia, whether government will stimulate initiatives like those in the Aedes agenda, and whether lessons from Germany will be applied. The minister answered that existing programmes (Woonagenda, Langer thuis) support housing and care for older people, that support is available, and that the government does not itself initiate such housing forms, without committing to new binding agreements.
Municipalities are encouraged to map the challenge of housing and care for older people and to make a plan to ensure people do not end up living unsuitably.
Gemeenten worden gestimuleerd om de opgave met betrekking tot wonen en zorg voor ouderen in beeld te brengen en een plan te maken
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kops over achterblijvende woningbouwplannen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether housing construction plans are sufficient to reduce the housing shortage, why the National Housing Agenda has not met its target, and whether local sustainability requirements should be scrapped. The Minister acknowledges regional gaps and risks, says local and provincial authorities bear primary responsibility, and defends their sustainability standards as legally limited and acceptable.
Soon I will send the most recent figures on available planning capacity to the House with the State of Housing report.
Binnenkort zend ik met de Staat van de Volkshuisvesting de meest recente cijfers over de beschikbare plancapaciteit aan de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Bruins Slot over de algemene ledenvergadering van de Koninklijke Bond van Oranjeverenigingen en het manifest ‘Versterk vrijwilligerswerk’

MPs Bruins Slot and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers about the Koninklijke Bond van Oranjeverenigingen's manifesto on volunteering, including regulatory burden, asylum-seeker volunteering, training, municipal subsidy rules and event bureaucracy. The government supports the goals and the activities of Oranjeverenigingen, declines to abolish the volunteer declaration or change several rules, promises to examine further reductions in event regulation, and answered the final question (on Koningsdag 2019) as not answered in time.
The cabinet is also exploring other options to further reduce the regulatory burden of organising events.
Het kabinet onderzoekt daarnaast andere mogelijkheden om de regeldruk bij het organiseren van evenementen verder te verminderen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Segers over het bericht ‘Ombudsman slaat alarm: 'Het centrum van Amsterdam is 's nachts een wetteloze jungle’ en daarbij het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman van Amsterdam

MPs Drost and Segers asked ministers about the Amsterdam Ombudsman's draft report on lawlessness, nightlife, ATMs, prostitution and tourism in the city centre. The government replied that these are mainly local matters, outlined police capacity increases, RIEC cooperation, ATM oversight limits, and exit programmes, while declining to take a national lead on most suggested measures.
The draft report of the Ombudsman metropolitan Amsterdam concerns a local matter.
Het conceptrapport van de Ombudsman metropool Amsterdam betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het bericht ‘Gemeente Enschede voorkomt faillissement BVO FC Twente met miljoenensteun’

MPs Westerveld and Özütok asked whether Enschede's multi-million euro rescue of FC Twente, a commercial football club, complies with state aid rules, whether it fits the austerity in the social domain, and whether such clubs should receive aid when paying staff above WNT pay norms. The minister answered that municipal autonomy governs the choice, that the municipality itself judges no state aid is involved, that WNT does not apply to FC Twente, and pointed to a national reference framework and factsheet on football state aid.
In this case, the municipality takes the position that there is no state aid involved.
In dit geval stelt de gemeente zich op het standpunt dat er geen sprake is van staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Smeulders over gevolgen van de saneringsopdracht van corporatie Vestia voor huurders in Bergeijk

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about negative effects of Vestia's remediation plan on tenants in Bergeijk, including maintenance backlogs, poor communication, reduction of social rental stock, and the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties' approval of commercial-branch separation. The Minister answered that operational maintenance is the corporation's responsibility with complaints to the Huurcommissie, that monitoring by WSW and the Aw finds no large-scale backlog, that sale of Vestia homes must be at market value, that a bestuurlijk regisseur has been appointed with advice expected mid-2019, and that financial recovery is weighed alongside housing interests.
The operational activities of a housing corporation fall under the responsibility of the corporation itself.
De operationele activiteiten van een corporatie vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de corporatie zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over aardgasvrij bouwen na 1 juli 2018

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked the Minister of the Interior about homes built after 1 July 2018 that are exempted from the gas-free building rule, including how many were connected to gas, the grounds used, alternatives, and future heating options. The minister answered that no precise registration exists, about 1,200 homes in 24 municipalities received exemptions, the choice of exemption rests with municipal councils, and municipalities must present heat transition plans by end 2021.
It is up to the municipal council concerned to exercise control over this.
Het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraad om hier controle op uit te oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de provincie Utrecht meebetaalt aan campagnes

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether the province of Utrecht subsidises individual European Parliament candidates' campaigns and whether this is permitted. The minister replied that the NOS corrected its report (the €750 went to the Utrecht CDA branch, not a candidate), and that the Political Parties Financing Act covers only national parties' receipts, not donations to candidates on party lists.
In general, for the financing of political parties and candidates, the Political Parties Financing Act applies only to national political parties and not to local or regional parties.

In het algemeen geldt voor de financiering van politieke partijen en kandidaten dat de Wet financiering politieke partijen zich alleen richt op landelijke politieke partijen en niet op lokale of regionale partijen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Özdil over het bericht ‘Cafédeur blijft dicht voor expat in Eindhoven: 'Ik ben hier nu vijf maanden en dat is lang genoeg om te weten dat ik nooit hier ga wonen'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a report of a bar in Eindhoven refusing entry to an expat, and about discriminatory door policy in hospitality generally, including the existing legal framework, enforcement and sanctions. The minister answered that discrimination is unacceptable, cited 2017 and 2018 complaint and police incident figures, and described the legal framework, municipal tools, complaint bodies and sanctions while leaving enforcement largely to municipalities.

It is not compatible with the prohibition of discrimination and the principle of equality as enshrined in our Constitution and as further elaborated in the Criminal Code and the General Equal Treatment Act (Awgb).

Het is niet verenigbaar met het discriminatieverbod en gelijkheidsbeginsel zoals neergelegd in onze Grondwet en zoals onder meer nader uitgewerkt in het wetboek van Strafrecht en de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling (Awgb).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Kops over het bericht dat een bejaard Nieuwegeins stel dat al vanwege huisuitzetting uit het leven wilde stappen vrijdag opnieuw op straat staat

MPs Agema and Kops asked about an elderly Nieuwegein couple facing eviction and homelessness, questioning priority for status holders in social housing and the closure of care home places. The minister rejected the link to status holders, stated that no one should have to live on the street, and said the couple had found temporary housing.
The couple has thus not ended up on the street.
Het echtpaar is daarmee niet op straat komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over Amersfoort dat reeds in 2030 geheel van het gas af wil zijn

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether Amersfoort's plan to be fully off gas by 2030 is unrealistic, how municipalities can legally force homeowners off gas, and whether citizens should be protected. The minister rejects the criticism, explains that municipalities currently lack a legal basis to force disconnection but that the Rijk is considering one with legal safeguards and appeal routes, and refuses to withdraw the climate plans.
Municipalities currently have no statutory basis to force homeowners to disconnect from natural gas.
Gemeenten hebben nu geen wettelijke grondslag om huiseigenaren te dwingen van het aardgas af te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Bunker van nazikopstuk uit foute handen houden’

CDA MPs asked whether the government would halt the sale of Seyss-Inquart's former Nazi command bunker in Wassenaar, which is a rijksmonument, and whether specific conditions should apply given its wartime heritage character. The state secretary confirmed awareness and the rijksmonument status, and said a Nota van Uitgangspunten setting planning conditions and a pre-selection of qualified buyers would govern the sale, without halting it.
The outcome of close cooperation with the municipality of Wassenaar, the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is a Nota van Uitgangspunten to be drawn up.
Uitvloeisel van de nauwe samenwerking met de gemeente Wassenaar, de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed en het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is een op te stellen Nota van Uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Domper voor wethouder Kurvers: corporaties zien niets in plan voor duurdere huurhuizen'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Rotterdam's plan for more middle-income rental housing, which housing corporations rejected, was a setback, and whether corporations and municipalities can be compelled to implement local housing agreements. The minister replied that a binding ruling was issued in the dispute, that corporations can still contribute to district renewal within the Housing Act, and that existing instruments, including court action and the minister's binding ruling power, are sufficient.
There is no hierarchical relationship between a municipality and a housing corporation when making performance agreements.
Er geldt bij het maken van prestatieafspraken geen hiërarchische relatie tussen een gemeente en een woningcorporatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het woningtekort

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior about the projected housing shortage in 2030, disputed building permit trends, and whether municipalities and status holders' priority access are to blame. The minister rejects the ABN-AMRO pessimism, argues the shortage will narrow to about 2.4% by 2030 with 76,000 homes a year, points to woondeals and instruments with regional partners, and rejects ending priority for status holders.
I see it as our shared challenge to meet the need for housing, with due regard for all other spatial interests.
Ik zie het als onze gezamenlijke uitdaging om te voorzien in de behoefte aan woningen, met voldoende oog voor alle andere ruimtelijke belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over gasloze sociale huurwoningen

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether tenants of social rental housing really want gas-free renovation, questioning its costs of over 100,000 euro per dwelling and the burden on tenants, plus the use of energy coaches. Minister Ollongren rejects the premise, argues tenants can refuse renovation proposals, says the cost figures overstate the case, and defends energy coaching as awareness-raising.
Tenants have the option to reject a renovation proposal from their landlord.
Huurders hebben hierbij de mogelijkheid een renovatievoorstel van hun verhuurder af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Van der Molen over het dubbeldorp Spaarndam

MPs Van den Bosch and Van der Molen asked the Minister of the Interior why the government only asked the province in March 2019 to facilitate talks on a border correction for the twin village Spaarndam, and why the Chamber would only be informed by end 2019. The Minister answered that the new Haarlemmermeer municipality only existed from 1 January 2019, that talks by the province have started, and that the Chamber will be informed by end 2019 or earlier if there is clarity.
In line with the Chamber's request, and aware that a careful procedure also takes some time, I will therefore inform it further no later than the end of 2019.
In lijn met het verzoek van de Kamer en in de wetenschap dat een zorgvuldige procedure ook enige doorlooptijd vergt, zal ik haar daarom uiterlijk eind 2019 nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Verplicht sparen voor onderhoud appartement’

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether VvE mandatory maintenance savings held in reserve funds should be taxed in box 3 and whether this creates unequal treatment and double taxation. The minister answered that the reserve is a taxable property right under Supreme Court case law, that there is no unequal treatment, and that no additional exemption or new measures are planned beyond reviewing the eigenwoningrente ruling.
The cabinet sees no injustice in this.
Het kabinet ziet hier geen onrechtvaardigheid in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Utrechtse ambtenaren moeten op multiculti-les’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of the Interior whether it is a municipal task to impose multicultural training on Utrecht civil servants, whether the costs of the municipality's diversity action plan affect Rijk funding for the social domain, and what the Rijk will do to stop such projects. The Minister replied that training and the action plan are municipal choices paid from general funds, that municipalities account to their own council rather than the Rijk, and that she sees no role for herself.
The action plan is paid from the general funds of the municipality of Utrecht. Municipalities account for the spending of general funds to the municipal council, not to the central government.
Het actieplan wordt betaald uit de algemene middelen van de gemeente Utrecht. Gemeenten leggen over de besteding van algemene middelen verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad, niet aan het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Martin Bosma over de ereplaats voor wetsovertreders bij de viering van Koningsdag

An MP asked the Minister of Interior why Extinction Rebellion was given a prominent place at the national King's Day celebration in Amersfoort, despite unlawful actions in Amsterdam the day before, and about the municipality's contacts, the NOS, and funding. The minister answered that demonstration regulation is a mayoral responsibility under the Wom, that the Amsterdam demonstration caused traffic offences but no public order disturbances, that police and municipality had routine contacts with the group, that the broadcaster is editorially autonomous, and that she has no information on funding beyond public sources.
In light of the above, I am not in a position to account for the manner in which the mayor handles demonstrations by Extinction Rebellion.
Gelet op het bovenstaande ben ik niet in de positie om verantwoording af te leggen over de wijze waarop de burgemeester met demonstraties van Extinction Rebellion omgaat.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de opvatting van het financieel stabiliteitscomité over het Klimaatakkoord en over de niet gepubliceerde achtergronddocumenten van het Klimaatakkoord

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the Financial Stability Committee's warnings about mortgage lending norms and green building-linked finance conflict with the draft Climate Agreement, and why the PBL analysis's background documents and reviewer access were incomplete. The ministers replied that AFM and DNB concerns are being taken into account in designing new financing options, that the PBL published three of five background documents, and that the government holds no unpublished background documents.
It is up to the PBL to make the background documents public.
Het is aan PBL om de achtergronddocumenten openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Koopmans over het niet tijdig ontvangen van stemdocumenten door Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Van Gent and Koopmans asked the ministers why Dutch citizens abroad had not received their voting documents on time for the 2019 European Parliament election, and how many ballots arrived on time. The minister answered that The Hague municipality organises the vote, that most voters received ballots by email, that postal ballots were delayed until 25 April 2019 pending Council of State rulings, and that the government aims to ease voting abroad.
The Ministry of the Interior evaluates every election and, for elections in which Dutch citizens abroad may vote, receives data from The Hague municipality on abroad-voter participation.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) evalueert elke verkiezing en ontvangt daarvoor, als het om verkiezingen gaat waarvoor Nederlanders in het buitenland kunnen stemmen, van de gemeente Den Haag gegevens over de deelname van kiezers in het buitenland aan de betreffende verkiezing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over tijdelijke huurcontracten

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior whether landlords who evict tenants at the end of temporary leases to avoid permanent tenancy rights should be condemned, whether the Housing Market Flow Act failed, and whether rents should be lowered. The Minister answered that temporary leases are known to tenants in advance, promised to report on their use before summer, defended the temporary lease options as serving real needs, and rejected a general rent reduction citing contractual freedom.
On this basis I will inform your House before the summer about the use of these temporary tenancy agreements by landlords.
Ik zal uw Kamer op basis hiervan vóór de zomer informeren over het gebruik van deze tijdelijke huurovereenkomsten door verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Tijdelijk huurcontract zit steeds meer huurder dwars’

An MP asks whether temporary rental contracts leave tenants vulnerable to landlords who avoid converting them to open-ended contracts, and whether rent regulation or more tenant protection is warranted. The minister defends the temporary-lease option for specific groups, says she doubts rent regulation would help, and promises a monitoring report on the use of temporary contracts before summer.
I will inform you before the summer, on the basis of this, about the use of these temporary rental agreements by landlords.
Ik zal u op basis hiervan vóór de zomer informeren over het gebruik van deze tijdelijke huurovereenkomsten door verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over misbruik van de landelijke regeling huisvesting statushouders om uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers te huisvesten

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether a subsidised social housing experiment in Almere for refugee status holders was misused to house rejected asylum seekers, and how many were housed and how the subsidy was checked. The minister answers that the subsidy was checked against the BRP registration criteria, that four undocumented persons were found temporarily staying there and referred to Ter Apel, and that no subsidy went to housing rejected asylum seekers, while verification of the five-year requirement occurs at the end of the period.
Every subsidy application is assessed by RVO against the criteria set out in the scheme.
Iedere subsidieaanvraag wordt door RVO getoetst aan de in de regeling gestelde criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het 'anders toewijzen' van huurwoningen in Utrecht

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether housing corporation Portaal may select tenants in Utrecht's Overvecht who commit to being good neighbours, and what the limits are. The minister said such additional conditions are legal within the Woningwet and housing rules provided no discriminatory criteria are used, cited other examples, and noted that liveability measures are governed by municipal performance agreements.
Within the allocation rules of the Housing Act there is room for additional conditions when allocating rental homes.
Binnen de toewijzingsregels van de Woningwet is ruimte voor additionele voorwaarden bij toewijzing van huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurprijzen die de pan uit rijzen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the minister whether she would freeze or cap rent increases in the free rental sector after reports of sharp rises, and why earlier amendments were rejected. The minister agreed rents are a concern but said freezing existing contracts is unworkable and that she is developing a targeted 'noodknop' for the middle-rent segment, to be presented before summer.
I am working on developing the emergency button to tackle excesses and am focusing on the middle-rent segment.
Ik ben bezig met de uitwerking van de noodknop om excessen aan te pakken en richt mij daarop op het middenhuursegment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raak over het bericht dat buitenlandse bedrijven Europese partijen sponsoren

MPs Leijten and Van Raak asked whether buying influence over parties through foreign corporate donations and Dutch shell companies is undesirable, and what the government will do to make European party financing more transparent and block corporate funding. The minister agrees buying influence is undesirable, announces a bill banning non-EU donations to Dutch parties, and says EU-level changes to Regulation 1141/2014 can only come via the scheduled 2021 review.

Given the increased risk of foreign influence, the cabinet will, in addition to the existing transparency rules in the Wfpp, prohibit donations from outside the EU (except from Dutch voters residing abroad) and require full transparency for donations from other EU countries.
Gelet op het toegenomen risico van buitenlandse beïnvloeding zal het kabinet in aanvulling op de bestaande transparantieregels in de Wfpp giften van buiten de EU verbieden

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sneller over de berichten ‘Grondspeculant belemmert bouwplannen van gemeenten’, ‘Dubieuze handel in kavels veel omvangrijker dan gedacht en ‘Niemand wil bouwen op versnipperde

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Finance and of the Interior about reports that land speculation obstructs municipal building plans, that land trading in plots is more extensive than thought, and that fragmented land is hard to build on, asking about municipal pre-emption rights, the reach of the Wvg after the Omgevingswet, and AFM supervision of speculative land offerings. The minister acknowledged speculation can delay projects but could not assess how many municipalities are affected, said the pre-emption right is an effective tool and that she had received no signals of municipal unawareness, and explained that land offerings structured as leases or self-managed fall outside AFM supervision, with a bill on investment objects planned for late 2019.
However, I cannot assess to what extent and in how many municipalities concrete (firm) building plans are actually obstructed by land speculation.
Ik kan echter niet beoordelen in hoeverre en in hoeveel gemeenten daadwerkelijk door grondspeculatie concrete (harde) bouwplannen worden bemoeilijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Koerhuis over het bericht 'ABN-AMRO-economen: bouw is miljarden kwijt door fouten'

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked the minister how the government will reduce the high failure costs in Dutch construction, citing an ABN-AMRO report. The minister answers that the Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen bill, along with stricter contractor liability and the Bouwagenda, is the main route, and commits to answering the questions within the time frame.
The bill on quality assurance for construction aims at such a system, which may also contribute to the necessary cultural change in the sector.
Het wetsvoorstel Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen beoogt zo'n stelsel, dat tevens kan bijdragen aan de noodzakelijke cultuuromslag in de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de AIVD niet langer gegevens met Oostenrijk deelt

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of the Interior whether Austria's BVT had left the Club de Berne, whether the AIVD's cooperation with Austria was affected, whether Dutch government composition or Russian ties should limit intelligence sharing, and whether the Netherlands lobbied against BVT cooperation. The Minister repeatedly answered by citing the statutory risk-weighing procedure under the Wiv 2017 and declined to discuss the specific arrangements with foreign services publicly.
The AIVD and MIVD do not make public statements about the precise arrangement of cooperation with intelligence or security services.
De AIVD en MIVD doen in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de precieze invulling van de samenwerking met inlichtingen- of veiligheidsdiensten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg, Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht 'AIVD en MI5 gestopt met samenwerking met Oostenrijkse diensten'

MPs Buitenweg, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about reports that the AIVD and MI5 stopped cooperating with Austrian intelligence services, including effects on the Club van Bern, CTG, PESCO and the Burum satellite station. The minister declined to comment publicly on the specifics of intelligence cooperation, citing legal risk-weighing procedures, and otherwise answered that bilateral and EU relations with Austria remain good.
The AIVD and MIVD make no public statements about the precise nature of cooperation with intelligence or security services.
De AIVD en MIVD doen in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de precieze invulling van de samenwerking met inlichtingen- of veiligheidsdiensten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Koerhuis over het bericht dat Amstelveen vasthoudt aan 2500 nieuwe studentenwoningen

MPs Dijkstra and Koerhuis asked whether Amstelveen's plan for 2,500 student dwellings under Schiphol flight paths risks residents' safety and health and circumvents Schiphol airspace rules. The minister answered that the plan is only a non-binding area vision, that the LIB rules restrict housing near flight paths and that consultation with the province and ministries will follow, but declined to judge the plan before a binding zoning plan exists.

In the short term, consultation will take place between representatives of the municipality, the province of Noord-Holland and the ministries of BZK and IenW to discuss how the area vision and the zoning plan still to be drawn up relate to the LIB rules.

Op korte termijn vindt nader overleg plaats tussen vertegenwoordigers van de gemeente, de provincie Noord-Holland en de ministeries van BZK en IenW om te bespreken hoe de Gebiedsvisie en het nog op te stellen bestemmingsplan zich verhouden tot de regels van het LIB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over drempels bij het gebruik van de blijverslening

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked why the Blijverslening, a municipal loan for home adaptations for older residents, has been granted only 75 times since 2015, and what conditions and awareness exist. The minister confirmed the figure, attributed low uptake to limited awareness and reluctance to plan future housing needs, and said municipalities decide whether to offer the loan and on what terms, promising continued support and awareness campaigns without a new binding step.
It is up to municipalities and provinces themselves to determine to what extent the set conditions sufficiently match local needs and policy objectives.
Het is aan gemeenten en provincies zelf om te bepalen in hoeverre de gestelde voorwaarden voldoende aansluiten op de lokale behoefte en beleidsdoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent, Van den Bosch en Lodders over de afgelopen provinciale statenverkiezingen

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Interior Affairs who pays for recounts of votes in provincial elections, whether municipalities are funded for this, and whether electronic vote counting could reduce recount costs and frequency. The minister answered that municipalities organise elections and recounts are part of that task funded via the municipal fund, and that electronic counting would require a new ballot paper being tested first, without clearly reducing recount risk in the Flevoland case.
Carrying out any recount (and therefore also its funding) is part of organising the election.
Het uitvoeren van een eventuele hertelling (en dus ook de bekostiging daarvan) is onderdeel van de organisatie van de verkiezing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht dat er vraagtekens zijn bij de fundering van de parkeergarage in Eindhoven

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked whether the foundation of the Eindhoven parking garage played a role in its collapse, citing doubts raised by Terken and Plass, and asked about the independence of the Hageman report and the OvV findings. Minister Ollongren answered that the foundation is not considered a cause, citing Hageman, the Safety Board (OvV) and TNO, and that the municipality found no material deviations in its inspections, but did not claim absolute certainty.

In carrying out its investigations, the Safety Board is bound by a duty of confidentiality and therefore does not state with whom it spoke, what information it collected and how it handled it, except as set out in its report.

Bij het uitvoeren van haar onderzoeken is de Onderzoeksraad gehouden aan een geheimhoudingsplicht en doet daarom geen uitspraken met wie er gesproken is, welke informatie verzameld is en hoe daarmee is omgegaan, behoudens wat in het rapport is weergegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het misbruikschandaal bij ProDemos

An MP asked the ministers about a sexual abuse scandal at ProDemos, a publicly funded democracy-education foundation, including whether the organisation had taken proper steps, whether an independent inquiry was warranted, and how former staff were supported and protected in deciding whether to file complaints. The minister reported the dismissal of a leader, internal and external investigations, aftercare offers, and an independent committee under Tjibbe Joustra to report before the summer recess.
I am of the view that everyone should feel free to file a complaint, without fear of repercussions.
Ik ben van mening dat eenieder zich vrij moet voelen om aangifte te doen, zonder angst voor repercussies.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van der Linde en Koerhuis over de brief van de Ombudsman aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het opnieuw aandacht vragen voor de korte aanvraagtermi

VVD MPs asked why the Dutch Ombudsman's concerns about low awareness of the 'special situations' rent/benefit scheme and its six-week application deadline were not addressed, and what the government would change. The State Secretary answered that the Belastingdienst had expanded website information and would raise awareness via intermediaries, that the six-week term is set in regulation and sufficient in practice, and that changes await an IBO review due end 2019, while declining a coulance scheme.
From an implementation perspective, the six-week term is sufficient.
Vanuit de uitvoering gezien is de zeswekentermijn voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gevaarlijke typen Ferroli-cv- ketels

An SP MP asked the ministers about dangerous Ferroli central heating boilers, including conflicting maintenance advice, complaints received, corporation Vestia's handling, and whether the boilers should be replaced. The minister answered that an NVWA investigation is ongoing, that no outcome can be anticipated, that Vestia is taking interim measures such as biennial maintenance, and that the government is working on a certification system for gas installation work.

I cannot anticipate the outcome of this investigation. As promised in the General Consultation on the NVWA of 23 April 2019, I will inform the House before summer about the progress of the investigation.

Op de uitkomst van dit onderzoek kan ik niet vooruitlopen. Zoals toegezegd in het Algemeen Overleg NVWA d.d. 23 april 2019 zal ik de Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de voortgang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over hinderlijke regelgeving voor de uitrol van zonnepanelen door woningbouwcorporaties

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Woningwet rules that restrict housing corporations from installing solar panels and feeding surplus energy into the grid hinder sustainability goals, and whether corporations should get SDE+ subsidy. The minister confirmed the current limits, said corporations are eligible for SDE+ if they meet conditions, and committed to amend the Woningwet after the evaluation to allow more sustainability measures.
I intend to include these adjustments in the legislative amendments following the evaluation of the revised Housing Act.
Ik ben voornemens om deze aanpassingen mee te nemen in de wetswijzigingen naar aanleiding van de evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de doorrekening van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL)

MPs Mulder, Ronnes and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the ministers about the PBL cost calculation of the draft Climate Agreement's building-sector measures, including the costs per tonne of CO2 and transparency of assumptions. The minister answered that the calculations use standard insulation assumptions, that PBL has explained its models, and that the Climate and Energy Outlook may incorporate new insights.
PBL strives for full transparency about its calculations.
PBL streeft naar volledige transparantie over zijn berekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het grote tekort aan sociale huurhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the shortage of social rental housing, including flexible and temporary contracts, housing for vulnerable groups, sales of social housing to investors, waiting times, and the burden of the landlord levy. The minister answered that she is pursuing many housing measures, that social housing sales are governed by local performance agreements, that waiting-time data are published in separate reports, and that a study on corporations' financial capacity will follow by end 2019.
By the end of 2019 I expect to be able to present the results of these studies to the House.
Eind 2019 verwacht ik de Kamer de resultaten van deze onderzoeken te kunnen presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht zonnevelden en windmolens in Rijnenburg en Reijerscop wil plaatsen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Rijnenburg, a large Utrecht development area, should be kept for housing rather than solar and wind, given the regional housing shortage and province-wide shortfall of firm plans. The Minister replies that Rijnenburg is not a location for large-scale housing in the short term, that the choice of specific sites lies with the province and municipalities, and that she will press regions to secure enough building locations.
Rijnenburg is not a location where large-scale housing construction is possible in the short term.
Rijnenburg is geen locatie waar grootschalige woningbouw op korte termijn mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over woningbouw bij Utrecht

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the Rijnenburg and Reijerscop polders near Utrecht, planned for housing, should be reconsidered as a 'pauzelandschap' given Utrecht's housing shortage, and why housing plans were postponed. The Minister said housing there is a longer-term option after 2030, that spatial trade-offs are for provinces and municipalities, and that she is discussing housing capacity with the region through MIRT and a housing deal.
I share your view that Utrecht, within the MIRT/UNED mobility agreements, must make clear at which housing locations the expected growth in residents will concretely be accommodated.

Ik deel met u de visie dat Utrecht in het kader van de MIRT/UNED-afspraken over mobiliteit rond Utrecht duidelijk moet maken op welke woningbouwlocaties de verwachte groei van het aantal inwoners concreet geaccommodeerd gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de vastgelopen woningmarkt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about the cooling housing market, rising construction, buy-to-let competition, city housing deals, border closure, and priority for refugees in social housing. The Minister answered that prices are normalising, that she is investigating buy-to-let effects and will inform parliament before summer, that housing deals are a long-term Rijk-regio partnership, and that she will not close borders or prioritise nationals exclusively.
I am currently having this investigated and intend to inform your House about it before the summer.
Ik laat dit momenteel onderzoeken en ben voornemens uw Kamer hier voor de zomer over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet opnemen van een bouwtechnische keuring in het koopcontract

An MP asked why a building inspection clause was absent from most home purchase contracts despite a standard model clause introduced in 2018, and whether buyers are discouraged from inspections in the overheated housing market. The minister replied that the model clause makes disclosure mandatory but not inspection itself, that research found no evidence buyers forgo inspections under market pressure, and that no further measures are planned.
That research showed no evidence that buyers in a tight housing market more often forgo a contingency clause in the purchase contract.
Daaruit is niet gebleken dat kopers in een gespannen woningmarkt vaker afzien van een voorbehoud in het koopcontract.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over discriminatie op bestelling door verhuurmakelaars

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked the minister about landlord agents who agree to discriminate on request and charge illegal intermediary fees. The minister called the findings unacceptable, pointed to the Goed Verhuurderschap project, self-regulation, a research study and a Rotterdam pilot, and said prosecution is not feasible because willingness to discriminate is not yet actual discrimination.
I find these figures very disappointing and unacceptable.
Ik vind deze cijfers zeer teleurstellend en onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de gemeente Groningen een cursus gemeentepolitiek aanbiedt

Labour MP Van Raak asked whether subsidised ProDemos 'Politiek Actief' civic courses, which train citizens in local politics, undermine party-based recruitment and political diversity, and whether they should be stopped or subsidy conditions changed. The minister answered that the course costs about 131,000 euro per year, is neutral and aims to raise civic knowledge, and declined to stop or change the subsidy.
No. The ProDemos courses contribute to a vital local democracy.
Nee. De cursussen van ProDemos dragen bij aan een vitale lokale democratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van den Bosch over de beantwoording op vragen inzake het bericht ‘Verval in de gymzaal: kapotte trampolines en turnbruggen’

MPs Heerema and Van den Bosch asked whether municipalities are responsible for financing and maintaining gym facilities and equipment, how often schools have held them to account, whether an investigation into slow replacement of defective gym equipment is planned, and whether municipal Gemeentefonds funds should be cut for non-replacement. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for accommodation financing while school boards are responsible for safety, that objection and appeal routes exist, that no investigation is planned given horizontal supervision, and that cutting Gemeentefonds funds is undesirable and lacks a legal basis.
I have no insight into how often schools have held their municipality to account on this responsibility.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoe vaak het is voorgekomen dat scholen hun gemeente op deze verantwoordelijkheid aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een betalingsherinnering door overheden

MP Van Raak asked why government bodies, unlike businesses, are not required to send a payment reminder before charging fees, and whether a uniform norm should be set. The minister replied that the Awb leaves the decision to charge a fixed reminder fee to each administrative body, that differences between bodies are acceptable, and that a noodstopprocedure for people in debt is being developed.
Thus the government, just like businesses, has an obligation to first send a reminder (payment reminder).
Zo heeft de overheid net als bedrijven een verplichting om eerst een aanmaning (betalingsherinnering) te sturen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over betere richtlijnen voor een lager maatschappelijk OZB-tarief voor bij voorbeeld sportverenigingen en buurthuizen

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked whether the government will help municipalities set a lower property tax (OZB) rate for sports clubs, community centres and similar non-profit organisations, and whether they agree such organisations should be taxed differently from businesses. The minister answered that talks with the VNG are ongoing, that OZB taxation follows the property rather than the owner so a lower rate for organisations does not fit its objective character, and that the government will consider the problems the VNG identifies.
Introducing the lower OZB rate for sports clubs and similar organisations does not fit the objective nature of this levy.
De invoering van het lagere ozb-tarief voor sportverenigingen e.a. sluit niet aan bij het objectieve karakter van deze heffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over problemen met prefab-huizen

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about defects in Slokker prefab homes (moisture, draughts, subsidence, cracking, shaking floors, skewed frames), whether other builders are affected, how complaints are handled, and whether the building supervision and regulation are adequate. The minister replied that the defects are being addressed by the builder, that the municipality found and is enforcing a missing energy-performance requirement, that no wider national problem exists so no independent inquiry is planned, and pointed to a pending quality-assurance bill.
No, carrying out such an investigation myself is not appropriate because there are no signals of nationwide problems with prefab homes.
Nee, het uitvoeren van zo’n onderzoek door mij ligt niet in de rede omdat er geen signalen zijn dat er landelijke problemen zijn met prefab-woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het oordeel van de VN dat mensenrechten worden aangetast door beleggers

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a UN finding that investors such as Blackstone violate tenants' rights through housing purchases and tenant treatment, and about Blackstone's acquisitions in Amsterdam and Rotterdam. The minister answered that Dutch tenant protection prevents such practices, announced studies and a possible 'emergency button' on rents, and answered the questions in a numbered but partly clustered manner.
Little is yet known about this specific case.
Er is nog weinig bekend over deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Nijboer en Ronnes over de huurcommissie

MPs Smeulders, Nijboer and Ronnes asked the Minister of the Interior about the Huurcommissie's backlog, including its budget, causes of longer processing times, regional complaint volumes, staffing, and when the backlog will be cleared. The minister answered that about EUR 4 million is reserved for 2019 and staffing is being expanded by about 10 FTE, that the 7,500-case target for 2019 carries risks, and that the backlog is expected to be cleared only in the course of 2021.
The Huurcommissie and I consider it important to clear the increased workload as quickly as possible and to normalise processing times.
De Huurcommissie en ik vinden het belangrijk om de toegenomen werkvoorraad zo snel mogelijk in te halen en de doorlooptijden te normaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht 'Corporaties laten vergoeding NOM-woning links liggen'

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked why the government sent the Energy Performance Allowance evaluation to parliament without a policy response, why only about 6,000 zero-on-the-meter homes were built against a target of 100,000, and whether the costs and rules can be reduced. The minister said the evaluation was sent on 5 April 2019, that she will consult stakeholders and expects to report to parliament by year-end, and that she sees no reason to doubt CE Delft's cost findings but has not yet sketched alternatives.
I expect to be able to inform your House of the outcome at the end of this year.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer eind dit jaar over de uitkomst te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Negen jaar Crisis- en Herstelwet: de (dis)balans'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether lengthy objection and appeal procedures, allegedly abused by querulous stakeholders, delay housing projects and whether settlement payments to objectors should be curbed, and whether legal rules could be changed to speed up procedures. The Minister answered that existing law already allows abuse to be countered, that settlements are private and not monitored, and that further restriction of appeal rights is not desirable, though further acceleration measures in the Crisis- and Herstelwet are being pursued.
I am aware that project developers and other clients sometimes reach a settlement with a party that has lodged an objection or appeal. These settlements are not made public.

Ik ben er van op de hoogte dat projectontwikkelaars en andere opdrachtgevers soms een schikking treffen met een partij die in bezwaar of beroep is gegaan. Deze schikkingen worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Bedrijfshal in een weiland is voor belegger bijna net zo mooi als een kantoor in Londen’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the proliferation of large logistics warehouses in open landscape, requesting building statistics, zoning data, a possible open-space levy, and government action to concentrate development. The minister answered that spatial planning is decentralised, pointed to the ladder for sustainable urbanisation, the NOVI framework and a forthcoming landscape policy letter, and said data on warehouse construction is not currently monitored and a levy is under study.
Spatial planning of business parks is a decentralised task.
Ruimtelijke planning van bedrijventerreinen is een decentrale taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over integriteitskwesties bij de waterschappen

Member Den Boer (D66) asked ministers about 103 integrity cases across the 21 Dutch water boards over four years, why water boards show more cases than provinces and municipalities, and what steps are taken to strengthen integrity, including model codes of conduct and the basic integrity scan for new board members. The minister answers that integrity is primarily the responsibility of officials and board members themselves, points to existing toolboxes, handbooks and codes, explains the high count at Waternet by its size, and promises an evaluation of the integrity scan in 2019.
In 2019 the handbook will be evaluated, after which a next (digital) version will be published.
In 2019 zal de handleiding overigens worden geëvalueerd waarna (digitaal) een volgende versie zal verschijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een Zweedse belegger die huurhuizen opkoopt

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the sale of nearly 10,000 Dutch rental homes from Round Hill Capital to Swedish investor Heimstaden, including tenant impacts, tax revenue, and past sales by housing corporations. The Minister said investors may buy and sell freely, explained that existing rental contracts continue and tenant protections apply, declined to comment on individual tax positions, and said the 2015 sale exemption was granted by an independent regulator.
The assessment of proposed sales of homes by housing corporations is carried out on behalf of the Minister by a supervisor, who reaches an independent judgment.
De beoordeling van voorgenomen verkopen van woningen door woningcorporaties wordt namens de Minister door een toezichthouder uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Ploumen en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Westerveld hoopt op snelle publicatie van RIVM rapport’

MPs Moorlag, Ploumen and Nijboer asked about a news report on Westerveld hoping for quick publication of a RIVM report on pesticide exposure, when it was completed, and what legal tools municipalities have to protect residents from pesticide exposure via zoning. The minister answered that the RIVM reports were sent to the House on 10 April, and that municipalities can use zoning plans and the precautionary principle to set buffer zones, with about 50 metres a commonly accepted rule of thumb, while the exposure study shows no unacceptable risk at that distance.
Yes, this is possible and is already happening.
Ja, dit kan en vindt ook al plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de trouwkosten per gemeente fors verschillen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior why wedding fees differ across municipalities, why Friday weddings cost more, whether a wedding should be affordable for everyone, whether income can be considered, and why there is no maximum fee. The minister replied that fees are a matter of local autonomy and cost-based, that free weddings must be offered by law, that income cannot be taxed by municipalities, and that councils can lower fees if they are seen as too high.
A maximum tariff for wedding fees would not do justice to locally made democratic choices and local cost differences.
Een maximumtarief voor trouwleges zou geen recht doen aan lokaal gemaakte democratische keuzes en lokale kostenverschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over problemen met en leren van pilots aardgasvrije wijken voor de toekomstige wijkaanpak

CDA MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked about problems in the Nijmegen Meijhorst zero-natural-gas renovation pilot, what central information is collected on neighbourhood pilots, costs, and planning for regional heat plans. The Minister of Interior answered that residents report renovation and comfort problems being addressed, that a Knowledge and Learning Programme and monitoring are being set up, and that further details will follow in later letters.
Your House will be informed about this in the autumn of 2019.
Uw Kamer zal hierover in het najaar van 2019 worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over wederom onveilige CV-ketels

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior whether about 150,000 older Agpo Ferroli central heating boilers are dangerous, why earlier answers omitted problems with these models, and what the NVWA knew and did. The minister says the NVWA opened an investigation after a Kassa broadcast, did not keep figures on boiler incidents, received no earlier complaints since the 2008-2009 corrective actions, and promises to act if the investigation warrants it.
Following the Kassa broadcast of 16 March 2019, the NVWA started an investigation at the producer.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Kassa van 16 maart 2019 is de NVWA een onderzoek bij de producent gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Rijk verdeelt wmo-gelden anders: Gelderse gemeenten krijgen miljoenen minder’

MP Kerstens asked the ministers whether the proposed new allocation model for protected housing (beschermd wonen) funds under the Wmo, which reportedly cuts funds for Gelderland municipalities, is unjust, could discourage municipalities from hosting providers, threatens access to care, and whether the government will talk with municipalities, revise the model, add money, or assign a role to provinces. The minister replied that the model follows the Toekomst Beschermd Wonen commission advice, that regional implementation agreements and consultations with the VNG are underway, that the model will be reviewed in 2019 with a final decision in spring 2020 and introduction planned for 2021 via a phased transition, and that municipalities are responsible so no provincial role is foreseen.
In spring 2020 the definitive decision on the allocation model and the timing of its introduction will be taken.
In het voorjaar van 2020 vindt definitieve besluitvorming plaats over het verdeelmodel en het moment van invoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat zeker 1 miljoen huizen in Nederland dreigen te verzakken

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the ministry knows about foundation subsidence threatening up to one million homes, how many reports it has received, and what it will do about groundwater levels, affected municipalities, and homeowners' financial support. The minister answered that the ministry is aware, that owners are primarily responsible with a shared loan fund for those unable to pay, that a broader survey of affected municipalities will be considered and reported to parliament, and that a public-private viewer helps buyers identify risk.
I will look into how this can be given shape and inform your House of the outcomes.
Ik zal bezien op welke wijze dit vorm kan worden gegeven en uw Kamer over de uitkomsten hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van Meenen over het bericht 'VO-raad: middelbare scholen verdwijnen in krimpregio's’

MPs Schonis and Van Meenen asked about reports that secondary schools are disappearing in shrinking regions and what the government will do to keep access reasonable. The minister acknowledges concern, says school boards are primarily responsible, points to accountmanagers and a process facilitator, and commits to working with the Interior Ministry and provinces on an integrated regional approach.
The problem of pupil decline in such regions is much broader than education alone and also concerns the liveability of the region.
Het probleem van leerlingendaling in zulke regio's is veel breder dan alleen het onderwijs, en gaat ook over de leefbaarheid van de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over zich ADO-supporters noemende personen die onder ander het monument De Dokwerker in Amsterdam hebben beklad

MPs Kuiken, Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about ADO Den Haag supporters who defaced the De Dokwerker monument in Amsterdam, including criminal investigation, camera footage, administrative measures, stadium bans and antisemitism in sport. The government answered that a report was filed and is with the Public Prosecution Service, declined to discuss the investigation or evidence, pointed to the mayor's powers and the KNVB's private-law stadium bans, and described existing anti-discrimination policy in football.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Vaststelling WOZ door gemeenten rammelt’

MPs Lodders and Van den Bosch asked about a report that 17 municipalities scored insufficiently on WOZ property valuation, and about oversight, sanctions, and the Waarderingskamer's role. The State Secretary replied that low-scoring municipalities are placed under intensified supervision with agreed improvement deadlines, that the Waarderingskamer approved publication of WOZ values for all municipalities, and that the government sees the supervisory framework as adequate.
Municipalities that score insufficiently are placed under intensified supervision and must achieve agreed improvements within a set period.
Gemeenten die een onvoldoende scoren worden onder verscherpt toezicht geplaatst en dienen binnen een bepaalde termijn afgesproken verbeteringen te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Rog over het onderwijs in het Fries

MPs Van der Molen and Rog asked about the quality of Frisian-language education, the Inspectorate's thematic research, school exemptions and oversight powers. The minister replied that exemptions are provincially granted, earlier recommendations have been largely implemented, a new inspectorate study is planned, but transferring supervision to the province is not on the agenda.
Transferring supervision to the province of Fryslân is not on the table.
Overdracht van het toezicht aan de provincie Fryslân is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat 70 procent van de huurbemiddelaars illegale bemiddelingskosten rekent

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares concern that 70 percent of rental agents charge illegal intermediary fees, what action will be taken, whether tenants can recover fees, and whether a Groningen-style landlord licence should be introduced nationally. The minister answers that ACM will enforce more strictly, that tenants can reclaim fees via ConsuWijzer and other guidance, and that a national landlord licence is disproportionate while the Groningen pilot is monitored.
I am therefore pleased with the announcement by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) that it will act more intensively against rental agents who charge tenants unjustified costs.
Ik ben dan ook verheugd over de aankondiging 2 van de Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM), die intensiever op gaat treden tegen huurbemiddelaars die onterechte kosten in rekening brengen aan huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Van Eijs over de Nationale Landschap Enquête van Natuurmonumenten
