MPs Smeulders and Van Eijs asked the minister about Natuurmonumenten's National Landscape Survey, its concerns over landscape protection amid spatial pressures, biodiversity loss, and the role of government as landscape steward. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to provinces as primarily responsible, referred to the NOVI principles and the LNV vision, and committed to informing the House on the motion about quantifying soft values.
Yes, I will inform the House about this in writing.
Ja, ik zal de Kamer hierover schriftelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht dat Friese gezinnen op straat zijn gezet om een wietplantje

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether families evicted over a single cannabis plant in Friesland were disproportionately treated and whether a zero-tolerance policy could exempt small home growers. The minister said proportionality is for the courts (kantonrechter) to judge in individual cases and that local housing corporations and municipalities decide on zero-tolerance policies, so no new national change was committed.
Prior to any eviction from a home, it is always up to the sub-district court judge to assess whether a landlord may proceed.
Het is voorafgaand aan een woningontruiming altijd aan de kantonrechter om te beoordelen of een verhuurder hiertoe kan overgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over klachten van bewoners van de Lijnbaanflat in Rotterdam over een ingrijpende renovatie

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about residents of the Lijnbaanflat in Rotterdam complaining of extreme nuisance from a major renovation, the rules for remaining in homes during works, compensation, tenants' right to temporary housing, the reported Vestia media ban, and whether tenant rights should be strengthened for upcoming sustainability works. The minister answered that existing Civil Code and Overlegwet rules are sufficient, that tenants can go to court for compensation or stopping works, that Vestia denies imposing a media ban (which only a court can impose), and that the cabinet will discuss tenant protection in the Klimaatakkoord follow-up.

The cabinet will also discuss with parties such as Aedes, the Woonbond and the VNG, as part of the follow-up to the Klimaatakkoord, how the position and quiet enjoyment of tenants during sustainability works can be sufficiently safeguarded.

Het kabinet zal de uitwerking van nieuwe maatregelen op grond van het Klimaatakkoord met partijen zoals Aedes, de Woonbond en de VNG ook bespreken hoe de positie en woongenot van huurders bij verduurzamingswerkzaamheden in voldoende mate geborgd kan blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat er een vliegshow is georganiseerd boven Amsterdam

An MP asked the ministers whether the aerial display over Amsterdam followed safety procedures, stayed above the minimum altitude, and why residents were not informed in advance, along with emissions, noise, and climate questions. The minister replied that the permit and safety rules were followed, the minimum altitude was respected, the event was not secret but deliberately not widely advertised to avoid crowds, and emissions will be offset while the government is pursuing aviation sustainability.
There is no question of secrecy regarding the aerial display.
Er is geen sprake van geheimhouding van de luchtvaartvertoning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Van Eijs en Ronnes over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het tracé van buizen voor ondergronds transport van gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Smeulders, Van Eijs and Ronnes asked for the current status of the indicative pipeline route Laarbeek-Echt/Susteren, why it remains in the Structuurvisie Buisleidingen, and whether it should be removed or subjected to a cost-benefit analysis. Minister Ollongren answered that the definitive route procedure is being stopped because insufficient information exists, that the indicative route will stay in the structure vision, that no MKBA will be made, and that the Chamber will be informed through the upcoming Nationaal Programma Energiesysteem.
An indicative route cannot be established as a definitive route without consultation with the Chamber about it.
Een indicatief tracé kan niet als definitief tracé worden vastgesteld zonder overleg daarover met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Ronnes en Smeulders over het bericht 'Huurcommissie kan stroom aan klachten niet aan'

MPs asked why complaints to the Huurcommissie (rent tribunal) surged to about 10,000 in 2018, how long cases take, and what the effect of the modernisation bill and long waits is. The minister attributes the rise to no single cause, says durations range from two months to a year, and says she cannot say how many disputes moved to the courts.
The Huurcommissie does not receive data on court proceedings before the judge.
De Huurcommissie ontvangt geen gegevens over gerechtelijke procedures bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over problemen bij de Huurcommissie

MP Beckerman asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the Huurcommissie's inability to handle a flood of tenant complaints, what is needed to meet statutory deadlines, and whether halving government funding caused the backlog. The Minister acknowledges the need to balance careful work with reasonable timeframes, points to measures taken and planned in a separate letter, and denies that the backlog is linked to the 2018 funding change.
The Huurcommissie does its utmost to keep processing times as short as possible.
De Huurcommissie doet haar uiterste best om de doorlooptijden zo kort mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over inschrijfkosten bij woningcorporaties voor woonruimteverdeelsystemen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether registration and renewal fees for regional housing allocation systems should be made free or uniform, and asked for an updated overview of fees and what the government has done to make fees cost-based. The minister agreed fees should be lower and more uniform but opposed making them free, supported a joint national system led by housing associations and municipalities, and provided a fee table for 2019 versus 2016.
I too would like to see registration and renewal fees lowered and made uniform for all tenants.
Ook ik zie graag dat de inschrijvings- en verlengingskosten zouden worden verlaagd en tevens voor alle huurders eenduidig worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Eijs over het bericht dat bedrijven websites als MijnBelastingdienst hebben ontdekt als jachtgrond voor persoonlijke gegevens

MPs Verhoeven and Van Eijs asked about reports that companies harvest personal data from government portals such as MijnBelastingdienst, and about data requirements for rental applicants. The State Secretary answered that the GDPR applies and that he is concerned about tenants' dependence on landlords, is exploring further legal frameworks for citizen control over personal data, and sees a government portal as not necessarily required.
I am currently examining whether further (legal) frameworks are needed for this.
Ik onderzoek momenteel of hiervoor nadere (juridische) kaders nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Slootweg over Nederlandstalige informatie over de staatsschuld

MPs Van der Molen and Slootweg asked why the annual Outlook on state debt financing is published only in English, whether this obscures the per-capita debt burden, and whether essential information should also be available in Dutch. The minister answered that the Outlook is in English since 2008 because its audience is English-speaking, that the essential content is available in Dutch elsewhere, and that Dutch press releases and publications on debt are issued, while rejecting the suggestion of deliberate obscuring.
Only information on turnover in the so-called secondary market regarding maturity, type of investor and geographic location of trading activity is not separately published in Dutch.
Alleen informatie over omzet op de zogenaamde secundaire markt inzake de looptijd, type investeerder en geografische locatie van de handelsactiviteit wordt niet apart in het Nederlands gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Corporaties laten vele miljoenen euro’s voor nieuwbouw ongebruikt liggen'

MPs Van Eijs and Koerhuis asked whether housing corporations leave large unused investment capacity for new social rental homes and sustainability, and whether they should be pressed to use it. The minister confirmed the indicative investment capacity figures, said local parties decide how it is deployed, and promised to report on the sector in the annual Staat van de Volkshuisvesting.
It is therefore up to tenant organisations, housing corporations and municipalities to make local agreements on the deployment of the available housing resources.
Het is dan ook aan huurdersorganisaties, corporaties en gemeenten om lokaal afspraken te maken over de inzet van de beschikbare volkshuisvestelijke middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het opkopen van Zeeuwse woningen voor vakantieverhuur

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether holiday-rental buy-to-let in Zeeland coastal villages (Cadzand, Groede, Breskens) harms liveability, drives up house prices and displaces local residents, and what the government will do about commercial rental in breach of local rules. The Minister answered that municipalities can set and enforce rules on holiday rental, that she encourages them to use existing powers, pointed to a handreiking and a planned one-time registration obligation, but attributed price rises to many factors and left most concrete choices to municipalities.
I encourage municipalities to make use of these possibilities.
Ik moedig gemeenten aan om gebruik te maken van deze mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Bedrijven vrezen heksenjacht op vermeende discriminatie’

VVD MPs asked the government about press reports that businesses fear witch-hunts over alleged discrimination after Amsterdam's local approach using fake applicants, and whether municipalities should intervene in labour-market discrimination alongside official bodies like the Inspectie SZW and the College voor de Rechten van de Mens. The state secretary affirmed that enforcement is for national bodies, said municipalities are responsible for their own local approach within legal frameworks, and committed to raising the issue with the G4 mayors.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for their local approach to discrimination.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun lokale aanpak van discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huren in Hellevoetsluis

MPs Beckerman and Van Dijk (SP) asked about rising rents in Hellevoetsluis, housing conditions and possible exploitation of migrant workers, waiting times for social housing and data on migrant workers. Minister Ollongren answered that housing shortages drive up rents, that municipalities and the province are responsible for local supply, that exploitation questions fall to other bodies, and that updated migrant worker figures will follow later in the year.
I cannot judge from the reporting whether there is exploitation or assess the specific housing conditions, partly because the expertise to assess this lies with other organisations.

Ik kan op basis van de berichtgeving niet beoordelen of er sprake is van uitbuiting of oordelen over de specifieke woonomstandigheden, mede omdat de expertise om te beoordelen of hier sprake van is bij andere organisaties is belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het discrimineren door banken van klanten met een spaarhypotheek

An MP asked whether banks such as ING and Rabobank unfairly charge a rate surcharge to customers renewing an expiring savings mortgage, how much tax deduction is involved, and what the government will do to make banks prioritise customer interests. The Minister of Finance answered that rate differences between mortgage types are permitted, that the surcharge reflects higher interest and refinancing risk and is treated as ordinary deductible interest, that the amount of deduction involved is unknown, and that the sector should itself show more regard for customers.
I am of the view that it is primarily up to the sector to show that they have more regard for the interests of the customer.
Ik ben van mening dat het primair aan de sector is om te laten zien dat zij meer oog hebben voor het belang van de klant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de opening van een gemeenteraadsvergadering met een gebed

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about municipal council meetings opened with a prayer, including municipalities whose rules seem to make the prayer mandatory. The Minister says the prayer is not compulsory in practice, will send municipalities a letter clarifying church-state separation and asking them to state explicitly in their rules rules of procedure that participation is not obligatory.

I will therefore ask municipalities, through the letter announced in my answer to question 2, to make explicit in their rules of procedure, where the official prayer is included, that there is no obligation to deliver the official prayer or to take part in it.

Ik zal daarom gemeenten via de in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 aangekondigde brief verzoeken om indien het ambtsgebed is opgenomen in het reglement van orde te expliciteren dat geen sprake is van een verplichting om het ambtsgebed uit te spreken dan wel er aan deel te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de VNG onderneemt met belastinggeld

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the VNG's commercial activities funded by municipal money are improper, how its decision-making and representativeness work, and whether its model regulations give it undue influence. The minister answered that member municipalities decide on the VNG's services and fees, that internal governance is primarily the VNG's responsibility, and that municipalities freely choose whether to use model regulations.
The VNG is a members' association and it is up to the members, the municipalities, to decide on the type of services they offer and the costs charged for them.
De VNG is een ledenvereniging en het is aan de leden, de gemeenten, om besluiten te nemen over het type dienstverlenging dat ze aanbieden en de te berekenen kosten daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over investeringen door woningcorporaties

An SP MP asks the Interior Minister about housing corporations leaving investment capacity unused, the rising landlord levy, liberalisation and sale of rental homes, and rising construction costs. The minister answers that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties' views are its own, that indicative investment room exists, that the WOZ-based levy is being studied under a motion, and that sector capacity limits drive construction costs.
I do not have information on how many of the potentially liberalisable homes were actually liberalised after sale.
Ik beschik niet over informatie hoeveel van de potentieel te liberaliseren woningen daadwerkelijk geliberaliseerd zijn na verkoop
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Burgemeesters onbekend met regels demonstraties'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that mayors were unfamiliar with demonstration rules, including unlawful bans of Kick out Zwarte Piet protests, the imposition of self-funded security on demonstrators, police support, prosecutions and public support for the right to demonstrate. The Minister answered that mayors are responsible under the Wom, that bans must be well-motivated and only used as a last resort, that evaluation and legal proceedings are underway, and that a handbook and a meeting before the summer recess will improve knowledge.
Local authorities must make every reasonable effort to allow such (risky) demonstrations to go ahead.
Het lokale gezag moet zich zoveel als redelijkerwijs mogelijk inspannen om dergelijke (risicovolle) demonstraties doorgang te laten vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Omtzigt over de coreper-vergaderingen

Two CDA MPs asked the Interior Minister whether the Netherlands consistently argued in EU negotiations on the whistleblower directive that whistleblowers may always use the external channel directly, and for an overview of meetings and votes. The minister answered that Dutch practice allows direct external reporting where internal reporting cannot reasonably be expected, that the Netherlands actively promoted this flexible system at EU level, and that it acted consistently in all negotiating meetings.
During the negotiations the Netherlands actively and prominently worked to introduce this flexible system at European level as well.
Gedurende de onderhandelingen heeft Nederland zich actief en prominent ingezet om dit flexibele systeem ook op Europees niveau te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over de berichten dat verschillende buitenlandse steden een klimaatnoodtoestand hebben uitgeroepen

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked whether the government would explain the effects of cities such as Basel, Vancouver and London declaring a climate emergency on local and national powers, and whether Dutch municipalities and provinces could declare one too. The minister answered that such declarations are symbolic with no transfer or widening of powers, that Dutch law has no rules for them, and that a climate emergency declaration would not affect the forthcoming package of CO2 measures.
In none of the cities does declaring the climate emergency widen or transfer powers of local or national governments.
In geen van de steden worden door het uitroepen van de klimaatnoodtoestand bevoegdheden van de lokale of nationale overheden verruimd of overgeheveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van der Molen over het bestaan van zogenaamde “spookburgers.”

MPs Peters and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers about homeless people being refused registration and mail addresses by municipalities despite a 2016 agreement, and whether the government would compel municipalities to register them. The government acknowledged the problem and the duty to register, said it is pursuing guidance, workshops and a legislative clarification making registration on a mail address mandatory, but declined to name the refusing municipalities or to use direct enforcement powers for now.
Antwoord op vragen va het lid Jasper van Dijk over spookburgers en gemeenten die een briefadres weigeren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Interior about municipalities refusing mail addresses (briefadres) to homeless and 'ghost' citizens, leaving them without access to insurance, benefits and passports. The government acknowledged the problem, said it was contacting municipalities and the Nationale ombudsman, and announced a legislative amendment to make municipalities register people at a mail address ex officio.

The Ministry of BZK organised and facilitated national workshops for municipalities in early 2017 and in September and October 2018 to draw attention to the topics in the circular on the BRP and mail addresses.
Zo heeft het Ministerie van BZK begin 2017, en in september en oktober 2018, landelijke workshops voor gemeenten georganiseerd en begeleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over de concrete aanpak van bedreigingen van boeren

MPs Buitenweg and Bromet asked the Justice, Interior and Agriculture ministers how threats against farmers by violent animal activists are being tackled, including the scale, reporting and prosecution figures and the AIVD's assessment. The minister condemned the intimidation, said such threats are not separately registered, stressed reporting and existing police and prosecution responses, and did not commit to new measures.
Threats against farmers or vandalism of barns motivated by animal activism are not as such registered by the Public Prosecution Service and the police.
Bedreiging van boeren of vernieling van stallen vanuit dieren-activistische motieven, wordt niet als zodanig door het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over illegale bewoning op vakantieparken

MPs Koerhuis and Laan-Geselschap asked the government about illegal residence on holiday parks, including ZKA findings that a third of parks lack a tourist future and about ten percent face serious safety problems. Minister Ollongren answered that an action agenda 2018-2020 is being implemented, pilots will report by end 2020, an information base with the Kadaster will help municipalities, and conversion to housing is possible locally.
I will inform you about the results after the pilots are completed.
Ik zal u na afronding van de pilots over de resultaten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Lodders over het bericht ‘Klokkenluiders kunnen bij misstanden aanbestedingen nergens terecht’

Two VVD MPs asked whether whistleblowers can report misconduct in public procurement, since the competition authority ACM can only act against firms under the cartel ban and not against government bodies or state companies. The state secretary answered that ACM can act against state companies acting as undertakings, that internal checks, the Huis voor Klokkenluiders and the FIOD/OM are the available routes, that no change to the rules is needed, and that research on legal protection in procurement is ongoing with results to parliament before summer.
I am of the view that it is not necessary to expand the current possibilities.
Ik ben van mening dat het niet nodig is om de huidige mogelijkheden uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het woningtekort

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a study by Capital Value and ABF Research showing a larger housing shortage, the discrepancy with the government's shortage figures, the share of social rental housing in the shortage, and how the 75,000 homes-per-year target and the 2030 forecast relate to it. The minister acknowledged the study, defended her shortage projections and the 75,000 target as sufficient, noted that the shortage is not broken down by dwelling type, and listed measures to speed up construction.
I am therefore not aware of any shortage figures for rental housing in general or for social rental housing.
Er zijn mij dan ook geen tekortcijfers bekend over huurwoningen in het algemeen of over sociale huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Aartsen en Laan-Geselschap over het kraken van het Fort bij Velsen in de gemeente Beverwijk door oud-ADM-krakers

VVD MPs asked whether the government will act against squatters who occupied the listed Fort bij Velsen, whether the owner filed a complaint, and whether monumental buildings should get priority for eviction and damage recovery. Minister Grapperhaus said squatting is illegal, the owner filed a report, a court allowed eviction, and no change to prosecutorial priorities for monuments is planned, while withholding details on individual cases.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over een item in het programma Kanniewaarzijn

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether the government shares concern that older people and people on benefits struggle to get small mortgages, and whether lenders' duty of care and a 'no-fuss' rule for mortgages under 20-30% of WOZ value should be added. Minister Hoekstra answered that lenders choose their target groups, that a bagatelle rule is not responsible because home value does not reveal income, and that the government will raise remaining bottlenecks at the next Platform hypotheken meeting.
From the Platform hypotheken I currently have no signals that people with modest incomes lack mortgage options while this would be responsible.
Vanuit het Platform hypotheken heb ik op dit moment geen signalen dat mensen met een bescheiden inkomen geen hypotheekmogelijkheden hebben terwijl dit wel verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat sommige gemeenten liever geen geld uitgeven aan verkiezingsborden

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities are reducing election billboards, and whether the government will act on this and earmark municipal fund money for elections. The minister replied she has no overview, supports turnout measures, reminded municipalities by circular and will do so again, but said municipal funds cannot be earmarked.
I have no overview of municipalities that have decided to place fewer election billboards for the upcoming elections.
Ik heb geen overzicht van gemeenten die hebben besloten minder verkiezingsborden te plaatsen voor de aankomende verkiezingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bewijs dat door Airbnb de huizenprijzen stijgen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about research claiming Airbnb raises house prices, the status of motions on enforcing illegal short-term rentals, and monitoring of housing prices. The minister said the Los Angeles findings cannot be transferred directly to Amsterdam, announced a registration obligation bill for consultation, and said a study with Kadaster, DNB and UvA on investor price effects will be reported later this year.
The bill is meant to change this through a registration obligation.
Het wetsvoorstel moet daar verandering in gaan brengen door middel van een registratieplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat 1400 huizen in Amsterdam verhuurd worden op Airbnb door mensen die buiten Amsterdam staan ingeschreven

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior whether about 1,400 Amsterdam homes rented on Airbnb by people registered outside Amsterdam create vacancy and housing fraud, and about progress on the Koerhuis/Beckerman motion to make housing fraud an economic offence. The minister said she does not know these figures, pointed to a planned registration duty for hosts and a permit/notification regime for tourist rental, and noted that illegal room rental can already be enforced under the Housing Act and the Spatial Planning Act.
Precisely to gain insight into these numbers, the bill proposes a registration duty for hosts.
Juist om inzicht te krijgen in deze aantallen wordt in het wetsvoorstel een registratieplicht voor verhuurders ( hosts ) voorgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over illegale verhuur op Airbnb

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior whether Spain's registration approach to holiday rentals could be applied in the Netherlands, whether Airbnb could be designated a tourist intermediary and required to show KvK numbers, and whether this could be included in the forthcoming holiday rental law. The Minister replied that a mandatory single registration with a number to be displayed on each listing will be introduced via a Huisvestingswet amendment, but declined to classify rental providers as entrepreneurs under the Housing Act, citing the housing-market link and proportionality, and noted KvK registration would not reveal property addresses.
In this context, the Housing Act will be amended.
In dit verband zal de Huisvestingswet worden gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

MP Ouwehand asked the government about its role in the Week zonder vlees (meat-free week), including promotion via ministry Twitter, whether canteens and dinners should be made meat-free by default, the external costs of meat production, and Canadian dietary advice. The government answered by referring to the earlier written answers (Aanhangsel Handelingen 1896) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03362, on a week without meat, have been answered by way of Parliamentary Papers, session 2018–2019, no. 1896.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03362 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over fraude met inkomensverklaringen door wanhopige woningzoekenden

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporations' fraud with fake income declarations by desperate applicants is acceptable, whether the money is recovered, whether fraudsters are prosecuted, and what action is taken. The minister says prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, notes no national fraud figures are kept, and announces a digital income-verification pilot with corporations, the Tax Office and Aedes.
No national figures are kept on the number of deregistrations by housing corporations due to fraud.
Over het aantal uitschrijvingen bij woningcorporaties vanwege fraude worden geen landelijke cijfers bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over flatbewoners die actie eisen tegen ‘onderwaterkelders’ in Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about residents of the Slingeflat in Rotterdam whose cellars have been flooded for months, with mould, and about the landlord Vestia's response, possible rent reduction and sanctions. The minister replied that the cause turned out to be defective rainwater drain connections rather than groundwater, that Vestia will repair them and start a planned maintenance approach, that Vestia is examining compensation, and that tenants can go to the Huurcommissie, but did not commit to a two-month timeline.
Vestia is examining the possibilities of compensation for residents who have been unable to use their storage space for a longer period due to the water nuisance.
Vestia onderzoekt de mogelijkheden van een compensatie voor bewoners die gedurende een langere periode geen gebruik hebben kunnen maken van hun berging als gevolg van de wateroverlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over slecht geïsoleerde particuliere huurwoningen

MP Beckerman (SP) asked ministers about poorly insulated private rental homes, high energy-label shares, rent freezes, and subsidies for private and corporate rentals above the liberalisation limit. Minister Ollongren answered that tenants already have legal routes (courts, rent commission, right of initiative under art. 7:243 BW), that data on maintenance and insulation are not yet available, and that subsidy options await the integrated Klimaatakkoord package.
Once the research results are available, the Chamber will be informed about them.
Zodra de onderzoeksresultaten beschikbaar zijn wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de externe inhuur bij provincies soms meer dan 30 procent is

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister for figures on external staff hiring (externe inhuur) per province, after a report that it sometimes exceeds 30 percent. The minister replied that provinces are autonomous and accountable to their own elected councils, so the central government keeps no such figures and sets no targets, and apologised for the late answer.
For this reason, the central government neither keeps figures on external staff hiring at provinces nor has targets in relation to external staff hiring at provinces.
Om deze reden houdt het Rijk noch cijfers bij over externe inhuur bij provincies, noch heeft het Rijk doelstellingen in relatie tot externe inhuur bij provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het voorkomen van onveilige balkons

Beckerman (SP) asks the minister whether galleries and balconies are being adequately inspected for safety, whether a mandatory inspection duty should be extended to balconies, and whether municipalities should have sanctioning powers and owners' associations should be supported. The minister says the gallery inspection duty stays limited to galleries, that municipalities bear the burden of proof for Bouwbesluit violations, that she will commission a study with VvE Belang on owners' associations' readiness to assess building condition, and that she opposes a general mandatory periodic inspection regime.
I therefore see no reason at present to extend this inspection duty.
Ik zie daarom thans geen aanleiding om deze onderzoeksplicht uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het onderzoek van de gemeente Maastricht naar eigen ambtenaren

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether a municipality may monitor employees' email, what remedies staff have if monitored or wrongly accused, whether union and works council members have extra protection, and whether breach of confidentiality is criminal. The minister answers that monitoring is allowed under GDPR conditions with prior notice (or retrospective notice for covert checks), points to internal complaints, ombudsman, Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and courts, and says the municipality is responsible for deciding on investigations and reports.
The Court based this judgment among other things on the fact that the employer had failed to inform the employee in advance of the nature and extent of the monitoring to be carried out.
Het Hof baseerde dit oordeel onder meer op het feit dat de werkgever in gebreke was gebleven de werknemer vooraf in te lichten over de aard en de omvang van de uit te voeren controle
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht 'Ontslag topambtenaar achtervolgt Dijkgraaf Klip'

An MP asked ministers about reports that a senior water board official's dismissal affected the dijkgraaf, including whether the general board was properly informed and whether confidentiality rules were followed. The minister answered that the general board itself must judge its conduct, that the province is the primary supervisor, and that the minister has no direct supervisory role over water boards.
Whether the right course was taken is up to the general board (AB) of the water board itself to assess.
Of er juist is gehandeld, is ter beoordeling van het algemeen bestuur (AB) van het waterschap zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de gevolgen voor provincies bij het ontbreken van een goedkeurde jaarrekening

An SGP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the consequences for the province of Utrecht of lacking an approved 2017 annual account, which followed a possible overpayment to a contractor on the Uithoflijn project. The minister answered that she suspended 60% of Provinciefonds advances, declined for now to impose preventive financial supervision for 2019, and noted no other recent provincial cases are known.
On 15 July 2018 the province of Utrecht should have submitted the annual account and the auditor's statement as well as the auditor's report of findings.
Op 15 juli 2018 had de provincie Utrecht de jaarrekening en de controleverklaring alsmede het verslag van bevindingen van de accountant moeten inleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat de inkomensgrens voor sociale huur omhoog kan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the CJEU ruling allowing the social rental income limit to be raised should lead to a broader target group, whether earlier interpretations of EU rules were wrong, and whether the ATAD earnings-stripping rule should exempt housing associations. The Minister rejected the claim that the income limit can be raised, said the Commission decision binds the government, and found no reason to revisit ATAD or seek exemption for housing associations.
I do not share your conclusion that the income limit for social rental housing can be raised.
Ik deel niet uw conclusie dat de inkomensgrens voor de sociale huur omhoog kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over een Arrest van het Gerecht

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the income ceiling for social housing eligibility can be changed independently, given a General Court ruling and the European Commission's role. The minister answered that the ceiling was part of an approved EC decision that Nigeria... the government is bound to implement, that the EC had to approve it, and that a review of the ceiling and household-size differentiation will be reported at the Woningwet evaluation.
I will inform you about this at the evaluation of the revised Housing Act.
Ik zal u hierover informeren bij de evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Raan over de online omgevingsanalyse die is opgesteld in opdracht van de Omgevingsraad Schiphol (ORS)

MPs Laçin and Van Raan asked about an online environmental analysis commissioned by the Schiphol Environmental Council, its purpose, cost, and GDPR safeguards. The minister explains it was part of a broad public consultation on Schiphol's future, costing €45,375, and states that the ORS as a foundation must comply with the GDPR under supervision of the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
The Schiphol Environmental Council is a foundation and as such, like any other natural or legal person, must comply with the rules and obligations of the GDPR.
De Omgevingsraad Schiphol is een stichting en moet als zodanig net als iedere andere natuurlijke of rechtspersoon voldoen aan de regels en verplichtingen van de AVG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huiseigenaren die arbeidsmigranten in kamertjes proppen

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked ministers about homeowners housing migrant workers in overcrowded rooms, the shortage of adequate housing, Hilvarenbeek's housing target, and the government's role. The minister answers that housing is a regional and local responsibility, points to the SNF quality mark and a forthcoming guide for municipalities, but declines to give a count of migrant workers without adequate housing and offers no national lead role.
How housing for migrant workers is best distributed within a region and in which forms it can be provided must be determined at regional and local level.
Hoe de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten binnen een regio het beste past qua verdeling en in welke woonvormen deze kan worden gerealiseerd, moet op regionaal en lokaal niveau worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Einde subsidieregeling jongeren voor gemeenten’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the end of the youth employment subsidy for municipalities, its effects on hiring young civil servants, and whether talks with sector partners would follow. The minister answered that the A&O fund decides on subsidies, expects little effect from ending the scheme, provided the requested figures, and declined a dedicated consultation as a matter for the sector's own collective bargaining.
Permanent employment was not a condition of the youth scheme. Therefore figures on this are not known to the A&O fund Gemeenten.
Het in vaste dienst aannemen was geen voorwaarde voor de jongerenregeling. Daardoor zijn cijfers hierover niet bekend bij het A&O fonds Gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het artikel ‘Sturen op economische groei’ van secretaris-generaal Camps van het ministerie van Economische zaken en klimaat

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Interior about a New Year article by the Secretary-General of the Ministry of Economic Affairs on cyclicality in the housing market, including the procyclical effects of the landlord levy, a possible construction fund, phasing out mortgage interest deduction, and ring-fencing land profits. The minister acknowledges the cyclicality, notes existing and planned measures (Woondeals, Omgevingswet, middle-rent bill, landlord levy evaluation in 2020), and says the ideas need further analysis, with CPB research commissioned.
I agree that the Dutch housing market is a cyclical market in which both house prices and housing construction fluctuate.
Ik onderschrijf dat de Nederlandse woningmarkt een cyclische markt is waar zowel de huizenprijzen als de woningbouwproductie fluctueert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Lodders over de stijging van de woonlasten

Two VVD MPs asked whether rising local housing costs (lokale lasten) in many municipalities, including large increases in Amsterdam, are acceptable and whether the government will act or discuss this with municipalities. The Minister answered that municipalities set local taxes democratically, that a national macronorm only limits total ozb revenues, that the Wet HOF does not restrict local tax increases, and that no further measures or talks with municipalities are planned.
For a picture of the other municipalities, one will have to wait for the 2019 edition of the COELO atlas of local taxes to appear.
Voor een beeld van de andere gemeenten zal gewacht moeten worden op het verschijnen van de 2019 editie van de COELO atlas van de lokale lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de stijgende prijzen van nieuwbouwwoningen

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of the Interior about rising new-build house prices, the gas-connection requirement, housing targets, and whether statushouders should give way to Dutch housing seekers. The minister responds that prices rose because of a shift to higher price segments, defends the sustainability policy, reports regional housing-acceleration efforts, and rejects nationality-based allocation.
In the Netherlands no distinction is made on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de politiebonden woedend zijn over verbod politieactie

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether it is wrong that the Hague mayor partly banned a police union pension protest without giving reasons, and whether she would contact the mayor. The minister replied that the demonstration will go ahead as announced, so the assumed situation does not apply, and that restrictions must always be reasoned by the competent mayor, with no reason currently to contact the mayor.
In general, restrictions on or a ban of a demonstration must always be motivated by the competent authority (the mayor).
In algemene zin geldt dat het stellen van beperkingen aan of het verbieden van een demonstratie altijd zal moeten worden gemotiveerd door het bevoegde gezag (de burgemeester).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Van den Bosch en Lodders over het bericht 'Bestuurslid luidt noodklok: 'Waterschap Rivierenland heeft straks een half miljard schuld'

MPs of the VVD asked the government about a report that water board Rivierenland faces a debt of half a billion euros, asking how financial positions of water boards are monitored, whether rising dike-reinforcement costs and interest rates threaten investment plans, and whether water boards keep to their core tasks. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answered that each water board is responsible for its own finances under oversight by its general board and the provinces (including the Wet FIDO interest-risk norm), that the cost trends are not yet a established trend and are being monitored, that dike safety planning is not in jeopardy, and that water boards' core tasks are legally limited with provinces supervising them.
Each water board is itself responsible for its own financial position.
Ieder waterschap is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de eigen financiële positie.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Van Raak over het inhuren van KPMG door de Rijksoverheid

The MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior Affairs which ministries hired KPMG over 2009-2018 for advice, audits or assignments and at what cost per case and in total. The minister declined to give the detailed information, citing commercial confidentiality and procurement rules, but offered Rijksbrede spend data for 2010-2017 to the Chamber confidentially.
The requested information cannot be provided publicly and in detail.
De gevraagde informatie kan ik niet openbaar en in detail verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Kerstens en Den Boer over politiek verlof voor militairen om uitzending mogelijk te maken

MPs Belhaj, Kerstens and Den Boer asked whether soldiers can get political leave to attend council or assembly meetings, and whether elected councillors can temporarily transfer their seat to enable deployment abroad. The government answered that soldiers can get extraordinary leave for council duties, but that the Kieswet and Constitution allow temporary seat replacement only for pregnancy, childbirth and illness, so a constitutional amendment would be needed and it is not convinced this is necessary.
An extension of the replacement option for military deployments abroad therefore requires an amendment of the Constitution.
Een uitbreiding van de vervangingsmogelijkheid bij buitenlandse missies van militairen vereist dus een wijziging van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Gent over de mogelijkheid tot ‘politiek verlof’ voor militairen

Two VVD MPs asked whether soldiers deployed abroad can temporarily give up their municipal council seat via 'political leave', and whether the law should allow this. The government answers that the Constitution offers no basis for replacing councillors deployed abroad, the only substitution being for pregnancy, childbirth or long-term illness, and it sees no need to introduce a replacement option.
The Constitution provides no basis for replacing councillors who are sent abroad for their profession, whether voluntarily or not.
De Grondwet biedt geen grondslag voor vervanging van raadsleden die voor hun beroep al dan niet vrijwillig worden uitgezonden naar het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Fraudeverdachte verdient aan villa' en het bericht 'Beslag gelegd op huizen Erik Staal om miljoenenfraude'

An MP asked whether renting out real estate under attachment (beslag) by fraud suspect Erik Staal on Bonaire is lawful, whether this situation is undesirable, and whether the villa's rental requires a permit or enforcement. The Minister answered that renting attached property is in principle allowed, that the attachment creditor's rights remain protected, that no permit is required for rental and thus no enforcement is possible, and that the villa is no longer listed.
Renting out a property under attachment is in principle permitted.
De verhuur van een in beslag genomen onroerende zaak is in beginsel toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het graaigedrag rondom een Nederlandse topambtenaar op Curaçao

An SP MP asked why a senior Dutch civil servant received a foreign-posting allowance of 2,319 euro per day present for 18 days of work over nine months despite living in the Netherlands, and whether the excess will be recovered. The government answered only by referring to an earlier letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII and IV, nr. 89), without addressing the questions on substance.

The written questions from MP Van Raak (SP), question number 2018Z21681, were answered by means of the letter 'The profiteering around a Dutch senior civil servant on Curaçao' (Parliamentary paper 35 000 VII and 35 000 IV, no. 89).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raak(SP), vraagnummer 2018Z21681 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Het graaigedrag rondom een Nederlandse topambtenaar op Curaçao» (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII en 35 000 IV, nr. 89 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Topambtenaar kreeg ruim 40.000 euro voor achttien dagen Curaçao’

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary and Minister of Internal Affairs about a press report that a senior civil servant received over 40,000 euro in allowances for eighteen days on Curaçao, asking about the contracts, legality, tax treatment, and whether the Auditdienst Rijk should investigate. The government answered that all questions were addressed in a separate letter (Kamerstuk 35 000 VII and 35 000 IV, nr. 89), so this document itself gives no substantive answers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Sjoerdsma over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Karabulut and Sjoerdsma asked why a person born in East Jerusalem is registered in the Basisregistratie Personen as born in Israel, and whether the government will change the system. The Staatssecretaris explains that the Landentabel only allows recognised states and territories, that the government will amend the table to add 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' for births from 15 May 1948 onward, and admits the earlier 2014 option of 'Onbekend' was a policy choice.

I intend to amend the Landentabel (table 34) and include the designation 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' for persons born in those areas from 15 May 1948 onward.

Ik ben voornemens de Landentabel (tabel 34) te wijzigen en de benaming «Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem» daarin op te nemen voor personen die vanaf 15 mei 1948 in die gebieden zijn geboren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht '369.334 euro voor een rapport van honderd pagina's dat in een la ligt'

An MP asked ministers about a press report that a health-sector foundation paid about 369,000 euro for a 100-page report, allegedly as a disguised golden handshake for a former executive via a WNT-evading construction. The minister disputes the press framing, says the WNT does not apply to this private foundation, and states the cabinet sees no reason to add an anti-abuse clause to the WNT.
It is up to the commissioning party of the research, in this case Espria, to judge that.
Het is aan de opdrachtgever van het onderzoek, in dit geval Espria, om daarover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat duizenden mensen illegaal op een vakantiepark wonen

Two VVD MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that thousands of people live illegally on Veluwe holiday parks, including whether the government will prevent criminal groups from exploiting them and whether it will publish quantitative and per-park overviews. The minister answered that no national data exists on permanent occupancy and deferred enforcement to municipalities, while promising support, a learning network, pilots and better data.
No quantitative overview is available at national level of holiday parks where permanent residence takes place.
Op landelijk niveau is geen kwantitatief overzicht beschikbaar van vakantieparken waar permanente bewoning plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de achterblijvende woningbouw

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the government will deliver on its target of one million new homes by 2030, given industry warnings that only half will be finished on time, and why municipalities that resist building are not held to account. The minister answers that housing construction is a priority, cites regional housing deals and the Transformation Facility, notes that construction output rose to nearly 74,000 homes in 2018, and says the responsibility for acceleration lies with regional and local levels.
Accelerating housing construction has the highest priority for me.
Het versnellen van de woningbouw heeft voor mij de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het bericht dat 270 containers overboord geslagen zijn bij de Waddeneilanden

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked ministers about the MSC Zoe container loss off the Wadden islands, including causes, health and environmental risks, liability of the shipowner, cooperation, lashing rules, container tracking and crisis coordination. The minister answered that causes are under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service and foreign authorities, that the shipowner has been held liable and must clean up, that regional safety authorities coordinate the response, and that container chipping would need international agreement.
The cause of the containers going overboard is not yet known and is the subject of investigation by, among others, the Public Prosecution Service.
De oorzaak van het overboord slaan van de containers is nog niet bekend en onderwerp van onderzoek door o.a. het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de opening van een gemeenteraadsvergadering met een gebed

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a Tholen council rule requiring the chair to say a prayer at the opening of meetings breaches church-state separation, and whether it should be annulled. The minister agreed the mandatory wording conflicts with that principle, noted the council has since changed the rule to a prayer before the opening, and saw no reason to annul it.
I share the views of my predecessor on the relationship between the official prayer and the principle of separation of church and state
Ik deel de opvattingen van mijn ambtsvoorganger over de verhouding tussen het ambtsgebed en het beginsel van de scheiding van kerk en staat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over de aanpak van nepnieuws

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Minister of the Interior about the EU disinformation site EUvsDisinfo no longer covering Dutch media, the reported Facebook approval of fake political ads, dialogue with Facebook and other platforms, measures against foreign state-driven political ads, and sanctions for fake ads. The minister replied that the site's approach was adjusted, that Facebook and other firms have committed to the Code of Practice on disinformation which the government will monitor, that research on social media effects will report around summer 2019, and that sanctions exist only where Dutch law is broken since free expression is constitutionally protected.
No minutes were made of the conversations.
Van de gesprekken zijn geen verslagen gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Aartsen over het bericht 'Geen Nederlandse media meer op Europese nepnieuwslijst'

MPs Kwint and Aartsen asked whether Dutch media had been excluded from EU East StratCom's EUvsDisinfo list, whether the Dutch government would send a letter on it, whether Dutch journalists would stop appearing on the list, and who funds EUvsDisinfo. The minister replied that no Dutch sources remain on the website after assurances from the EEAS, that she assumes no future Dutch press articles will appear, and that the taskforce is funded from the EEAS communication budget within the general EU budget, without a copy of the agreement being provided.
There is no copy of that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het met nepnieuws beïnvloeden van verkiezingen

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Interior Minister about EU and Dutch efforts against fake news influencing elections, including platform accountability after a case of a cameraman running a fake news operation on Facebook. The minister said the threat is real but no concrete signals exist for the Netherlands, and that the government relies on the EU Code of Practice on disinformation and monitoring, rejecting binding regulation for now.
The cabinet will critically monitor the implementation of the code of conduct.
Het kabinet zal de uitvoering van de gedragscode kritisch volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kröger over het gemeentelijk beleid ten aanzien van de circulaire economie

MPs Özütok and Kröger asked the ministers about a StartCirculair/SUBtracers study finding many municipalities state circular economy ambitions without concrete implementation, and about knowledge gaps, support measures, regulatory obstacles and procurement progress. The government answered that it has noted the study, supports municipalities through workshops, networks, procurement programmes, the Versnellingshuis and the Omgevingswet, is reviewing regulatory obstacles via a taskforce, and will report on procurement progress in the first half of 2019.

Regarding the first two recommendations, which call for raising awareness, creating knowledge and facilitating networks of entrepreneurs and organisations, the cabinet supports municipalities, provinces and water boards by organising a series of workshops

Ten aanzien van de eerste twee aanbevelingen, die oproepen om bewustzijn te vergroten, kennis te creëren en netwerken van ondernemers en organisaties te faciliteren ondersteunt het kabinet gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen door middel van het organiseren van een reeks workshops
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over misstanden bij woningcorporatie Mijande

An MP asked the minister about misconduct at housing corporation Mijande, including whether the buyer will cooperate in reversing below-value sales, whether the corporation's assets are at risk, whether the former board member should contribute financially, and whether the interim director's pay will be disclosed. The minister answered that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties is handling the buyer's objection, that the corporation must limit and recover damage, that the regulator will act if needed, and that pay details will appear in the 2018 annual accounts.
If the House wishes, I can send information about the interim board member's remuneration to the House.
Antwoord 4 Indien de Kamer daar prijs op stelt, kan ik informatie over de bezoldiging van de interim--bestuurder naar de Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Bouwen in het groen? Wel doen’

MPs Koerhuis and Laan-Geselschap (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the Chief Government Architect's public stance against building in green areas and its implications for housing policy and decentralised housing responsibility. The minister answered that the advisory views are non-binding, that the government must prioritise accelerating housing construction, that regions should first use inner-city space but some may need greenfield sites, and that the National Environmental Vision will set the direction for a national vision.
The advice of the College of State Advisers and the Chief Government Architect is not binding and aims to promote spatial, and therefore integrated, thinking.
De adviezen van het College van Rijksadviseurs c.q. de Rijksbouwmeester hebben geen bindend karakter en hebben als doel het denken vanuit een ruimtelijke, dus integrale, invalshoek te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Leraren vinden moeilijk een woning op plekken waar werk is'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Ministers of Interior and Education whether teachers can realistically find affordable homes in big cities, and what the government will do about it. The minister says housing supply is a municipal responsibility, describes existing national and municipal instruments and initiatives, and states the government is stimulating housing construction without committing to specific new measures for middle-income teachers.
Data on the size of the shortage in these cities is not available to central government.
De gegevens over de omvang van het tekort in deze steden zijn niet bij het Rijk beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asked the government, in 21 questions, whether ministers are accountable for climate policy and whether they will respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including on economic growth, intergenerational justice and changing the system. The answer, given on behalf of several ministers, was not included in the document, which contains only the question list and a reference to the answer in a separate parliamentary appendix.
The written questions of MP Teunissen (PvdD), question number 2018Z24288, have been answered by way of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Teunissen (PvdD) vraagnummer 2018Z24288 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de veiligheid van escaperooms in Nederland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior whether escape rooms in the Netherlands are safe after a fire in Poland, including whether they meet building code rules, whether municipalities inspect them, and whether additional rules such as an emergency exit button are needed. The Minister answered that municipalities supervise compliance, that many municipalities have now decided to inspect all escape rooms, and that a specific emergency button should not be prescribed in the building code.
I am not aware whether these locations meet the requirements of the Building Decree or whether municipalities have granted permits for these locations.
Mij is niet bekend of deze locaties aan de eisen van het Bouwbesluit voldoen en of voor deze locaties door gemeenten vergunningen zijn verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Kopers in de kou – Lang wachten op energieaansluiting in nieuwbouwwoning'

An MP (PVV) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about buyers of new homes waiting weeks or months for energy connections, the 18-week legal deadline being missed, compensation, and the shortage of installers amid the energy transition. The minister acknowledged the problem, attributed delays to network operators, capacity shortages and complex projects, said compensation depends on the buyer-builder contract, and promised ongoing work with sector parties and the ACM without committing to a specific new measure.
The statutory 18-week period for connecting customers to electricity is regularly exceeded in practice.
De wettelijke termijn van 18 weken voor het aansluiten van klanten voor elektriciteit wordt in de praktijk regelmatig wordt overschreden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over een mogelijk ICT-fiasco bij het Rijk

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of a failing government intranet (Rijksportaal), its rising costs, a 2016 quick scan suggesting non-market-conform costs, abandoned releases, and duplicate internal document systems across ministries. The minister denied that the intranet is failing, acknowledged the unexecuted follow-up study, withheld detailed cost breakdowns citing confidentiality, and described replacement plans and reuse of old hardware.

I cannot share a breakdown of costs at the level of detail you request in a public answer, because part of the data available to me is confidential, relating to information from external parties outside the civil service.
Een uitsplitsing van kosten op het door u gevraagde detailniveau kan ik u vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van een deel van de mij beschikbare gegevens, niet in openbare beantwoording met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis relaties over gestuntel bij bouw parkeergarage Wormerveer

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about building-safety lapses in the Wormerveer car park and in Eindhoven, including whether municipalities can structurally provide adequate construction supervision and whether the Kwaliteitsborging bill would help. The minister answered that municipalities supervise under their own policy and that the bill adds an independent quality assurer, while stating she has no power to intervene in individual municipalities and that a motion is being implemented.
I have no authority to intervene in the municipality of Zaanstad.
Ik heb geen bevoegdheid om bij de gemeente Zaanstad in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Bodem zakt meer dan verwacht door droogte’

Two MPs asked the ministers about a report that Dutch soil is subsiding faster than expected because of drought, its causes, the expected costs, and who is liable for damage. The minister answered that drought and groundwater management cause the subsidence, that owners bear their own responsibility, that municipalities and water boards have a duty to weigh interests, and that insurers' coverage depends on policy terms.
If the damage is caused by unlawful action by the government, the injured party can hold the relevant government body liable through civil law.
Als de schade wordt veroorzaakt door onrechtmatig handelen door de overheid, dan kan de benadeelde het betreffende overheidsorgaan aansprakelijk stellen via de civielrechtelijke weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het RST op Curaçao

An MP asks whether internal management problems at the RST recherche team in the Caribbean Netherlands delayed or affected investigations, including the murder of politician Helmin Wiels, and why signals from whistleblowers were not acted on sooner. The minister replies that cooperation with partners is in order, that the police chief says the Wiels investigation was not frustrated, that signals were followed up with talks, a team coach and harmonised labour rules, and that an interim team leader has been appointed while the RST's future positioning is to be decided.
I will of course continue to keep your House informed about relevant developments regarding the functioning of the RST.
Over relevante ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot het functioneren van het RST zal ik uw Kamer uiteraard blijven informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat de provincie Noord-Holland woningbouw in Alkmaar tegenhoudt

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the province of Noord-Holland is blocking housing construction in the Alkmaar region, and whether the Metropoolregio Amsterdam should be extended to include those municipalities and others such as Hoorn. The Minister answered that the national target is on track to be discussed further, that the Alkmaar region can build without joining the MRA, that she has not yet talked with the province but will do so and report by the end of Q1 2019, and that delays stem mainly from implementation capacity and the province has earmarked EUR 15 million for bottlenecks.
I have committed to your chamber to enter into talks with the province of Noord-Holland soon and to inform you of the outcomes.
Ik heb uw kamer toegezegd spoedig met de provincie Noord-Holland in gesprek te gaan en u over de uitkomsten te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over onderzoek naar fraude bij Vestia

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior when the forensic investigation into fraud at housing corporation Vestia started and when it will finish, and whether its outcome will be sent to parliament. The minister replied that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties reports a start on 19 November 2018 with an uncertain duration, and that the report will not be published given its confidential content, though the main findings will be shared with parliament in time.
Given its confidential nature, it is not customary for the Aw to make public the reports arising from forensic investigations it receives.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijk karakter daarvan is het niet gebruikelijk dat de Aw rapportages naar aanleiding van forensisch onderzoek waarover zij komt te beschikken openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht 'Experts boos over soepeler BENG-eisen'

GroenLinks MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked why the proposed BENG energy performance requirements for nearly zero-energy buildings were softened, who lobbied for it, and what it means for the energy transition and household bills. The minister replied that the higher numerical value reflects a new calculation method rather than a weakening, listed the consulted parties and denied any lobbying, and said the figures are not comparable and that a tighter renewable-energy requirement could hurt cost-optimality.

That the numerical value is higher than in the previously proposed requirements does not mean that the BENG requirements about to be submitted for consultation are much more lenient than the previously proposed requirements.
Dat de getalswaarde hoger is dan in de eerder voorgenomen eisen betekent niet dat de BENG-eisen die binnenkort voor consultatie worden voorgelegd veel soepeler zijn dan de eerder voorgenomen eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over privacy schending van woningzoekenden

The SP MP Beckerman asked the Minister of the Interior whether housing allocation systems such as Woonnet Haaglanden breach the GDPR by requesting income declarations at registration, how many corporations do so, and whether applicants refused for earning too much or for withholding income data are compensated. The Minister answered that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is competent to judge GDPR compliance, that Woonnet says it only requests income data once a allocation is imminent, and that she has no figures on refusals or compensation, while asking Aedes to communicate the AP's view if one is issued.
The judgement whether these corporations or cooperation bodies act in breach of the GDPR falls to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP).
Het oordeel of deze – samenwerkingsverbanden van – corporaties in strijd handelen met de AVG komt toe aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over frauduleuze bemiddelingsbureaus

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that fraudulent intermediary agencies duped desperate housing seekers, including how widespread the fraud is, whether statushouders' priority is unfair, and what will be done. The minister confirms criminal investigations into two suspects with several hundred files, but says it is unknown how many obtained homes, points to weak income verification, rejects the priority objection as a local matter, and promises digitisation exploration and further information in 2019.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation into the suspects and therefore the appropriate criminal measures will be taken.
Er is sprake van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de verdachten en er zal derhalve sprake zijn van de geëigende strafrechtelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Roon, Bosma en Fritsma over het bericht dat het Chinese leger massaal onderzoekers stuurt naar westerse universiteiten

PVV MPs asked whether Chinese military-linked researchers are entering Dutch universities such as TU Delft to develop dual-use technologies, and how immigration screening and a possible ban would work. The government answered that the intelligence services do not comment on their knowledge, that universities bear primary responsibility for screening students, and that a review of the policy framework is ongoing, with no statutory ban beyond the North Korea rule.
The intelligence and security services make no statements about their current level of knowledge.
De inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doen geen uitspraken over hun actuele kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel 'Minister Ollongren is wél voor Europees leger'

MP Bosman asked the Interior Minister whether her remarks in Denmark supporting a European army contradict the cabinet position against one, and whether she informed colleagues or the ministry publicly announced her speech. The minister answered that her remarks on strengthened European defence cooperation match the cabinet line, that there is no plan to amend article 100 of the Constitution, and that she did not inform colleagues or publicly announce the speech.
This is in line with the cabinet position, which I share, as stated by the Prime Minister and the Minister of Defence.
Dit sluit aan op het kabinetsstandpunt, dat ik deel, zoals verwoord door de Minister-President en de Minister van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Vergunning in strijd tegen criminaliteit’

Two VVD MPs asked whether a licensing requirement with financial checks for certain branches or streets, as used in Rotterdam, could help fight undermining crime, and whether mayors have a factsheet of administrative tools. The minister answered that municipalities may introduce such licensing within the limits of higher law and that existing information for mayors is sufficient, so no factsheet or new guidance is planned.
No, there is already sufficient information available for municipalities.
Nee, er is voor gemeenten al voldoende informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het benoemen van een “burgerlid” in een commissie van een gemeenteraad

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities may impose extra requirements on citizen members of council committees, whether a council vote can block such an appointment, and how this fits the VNG model and the Bodegraven-Reeuwijk regulation. The minister answered that the Gemeentewet sets no requirements for non-councillors, councils may set their own, a vote may block a candidate, the Crown cannot annul such an internal appointment, and the council itself must judge consistency with its regulations.
It is an autonomous competence of the council to decide, by regulation, whether or not to formulate appointment requirements for non-councillors.
Het is een autonome bevoegdheid van de raad om bij verordening al dan niet benoemingsvereisten te formuleren voor niet-raadsleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over woningcorporaties die het moeilijk wordt gemaakt om te verduurzamen

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked whether the minister agrees with the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties' rejection of Groninger Huis joining a solar park, and how sustainability goals can be met if such initiatives are blocked. The minister declined to comment on the individual case (under court review), said the Woningwet's proximity rule is assessed case by case, and promised an evaluation of the Woningwet in early 2019 that will examine obstacles to housing-corporation sustainability.
As legislator, it is not for BZK to respond to individual cases.
Als wetgever is het niet aan BZK om te reageren op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over inwoners die in de kou zitten door torenhoge stookkosten in Delft

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Interior about residents in Delft facing very high heating costs, including a housing corporation's metering system and tenants' demands. The Minister explained the general billing system, pointed tenants to the Huurcommissie and their legal remedies, and said the government does not register which metering systems corporations use or where complaints arise.
It is not registered which system landlords use to measure heating costs.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd welk systeem verhuurders toepassen voor het meten van de stookkosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over de primaire energiefactor (PEF) voor elektriciteit

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders question the government's change of the primary energy factor (PEF) for electricity to 1.45, based on the NEV 2017 forecast for 2020 rather than realised performance, arguing it implies an unrealistic 69% generation efficiency and could encourage low-efficiency electric systems. Minister Wiebes defends the change as aligning the standard with the BENG requirements from 2020, rejects the claim that low-efficiency systems will be favoured, and says the PBL uses the same data in its climate agreement calculations.
The revised PEF of 1.45 has been set on the basis of realistic expectations regarding the share of renewable electricity in 2020.
De herziene PEF van 1,45 is vastgesteld op basis van realistische verwachtingen ten aanzien van het aandeel hernieuwbare elektriciteit in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over vluchtelingen die eigen woonunits bouwen

An MP asks about a reported plan by refugees to build their own housing units and whether the province can take over housing of status holders from municipalities that miss their quota, and how that process works. The minister explains a six-step intervention ladder ending in substitute placement at municipal cost, says temporary housing can help ease pressure, and announces pilots for flexible housing.
When the quota is not met, an intervention ladder is applied, in which substitute placement can be reached in six steps.
Bij het niet halen van de taakstelling wordt een interventieladder gehanteerd, waarbij in 6 stappen tot indeplaatsstelling gekomen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het minder in dienst nemen door de Rijksoverheid van oudere werknemers

An MP asked the ministers whether the central government spent 68 million euro in 2016 to encourage employers to hire older workers, and why its own hiring of workers aged 50 and over has allegedly fallen relatively. The ministers confirmed the 68 million for the action plan 'Perspectief voor vijftigplussers', gave hiring figures showing that the number of hires aged 50+ rose from 298 in 2013 to 877 in 2017, and said the evaluation will be sent to parliament in early 2020 while the government aims for a balanced workforce.
The evaluation of the action plan will be completed at the end of 2019. The results will be sent to your House in early 2020.
Eind 2019 wordt de evaluatie van het actieplan afgerond. De resultaten worden begin 2020 naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het niet handhaven van het woningwaarderingsstelsel

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about widespread non-compliance with the rent-scoring system, landlord intimidation, rent-policing, registers of bad landlords, higher fines, and faster tribunal procedures. The Minister said high rents are not illegal under contractual freedom, pointed to information campaigns, the Huurcommissie tools, new landlord fees and the Goed Verhuurderschap measures, and explained that short procedures are rarely suitable but that the 2019 reform gives enough options for faster cases.
The Huurcommissie is also currently examining the possibilities to make the register of rulings more searchable.
Ook onderzoekt de Huurcommissie momenteel de mogelijkheden om de doorzoekbaarheid van het register van uitspraken te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over het bericht dat de nieuwbouw van een school in de problemen komt door stijgende bouwkosten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman (SP) asked ministers whether rising construction costs delaying a school building in De Bilt reflect a national problem, whether budgets are sufficient, and how mould and damp in schools are addressed. The ministers replied that rising costs are a market trend with no specific school-building data kept, that existing budgets for maintenance are adequate, and that they see no further options to curb cost increases beyond a pilot programme.
Beyond that, I see no options for curbing the rising costs of school construction resulting from market developments.
Verder zie ik geen mogelijkheden om de stijgende kosten van scholenbouw als gevolg van marktontwikkelingen in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over onderzoek naar fraude bij Vestia

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reported fraud by Vestia staff, whether the new Housing Act prevents it, the FIOD's and Aw's oversight of such cases, and whether the problem is structural.
