The Minister declined substantive comment while the case is with the Public Prosecution Service, described the Aw's integrity reporting point and interventions, and said Vestia has launched an independent forensic investigation and remains under intensified supervision.
I cannot respond substantively to the report at this time, because the case is still with the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik kan op dit moment niet inhoudelijk op het bericht reageren, omdat de zaak nog bij het Openbaar Ministerie ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over misstanden bij woningcorporatie Mijande

MP Koerhuis asked the minister about misconduct at housing corporation Mijande, including whether the new Woningwet can prevent it, how the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties (Aw) handles integrity reports, whether whistleblowers are protected, whether the former director must pay damages, and whether the interim director's pay complies with the rules. The minister answered that the Aw intervened, the sales were voided, the former director was dismissed without severance, the Aw has sufficient instruments, and pay will be verified via the 2018 annual accounts audit.
The Aw therefore cannot yet provide insight into the remuneration of directors for 2018.
De Aw kan daarom nu nog geen inzage geven over bezoldiging van bestuurders over 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huurders slechter af zijn dan huizenbezitters

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that tenants are worse off than homeowners, including their housing-cost burden, purchasing power, rent reduction and satisfaction with housing. The minister rejects the notion of a housing divide, argues that tenant and owner groups are hard to compare, and says a general rent reduction is not appropriate while rent affordability keeps her attention.
I do not share your view that there is a divide in the housing market.
Ik deel uw mening niet dat er sprake is van een tweedeling op de woningmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het beëindigen van buitenlandse financiering van politieke partijen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether foreign financing of Dutch political parties will be restricted, given earlier promises and a 2016 motion, and how this compares with EU countries. The minister answered that measures will be announced in the cabinet response to the Veling committee report, with a bill to follow, and that the lack of agreement among parties is not the cause of the delay.
In the cabinet response to the report of the Veling committee I will address these measures.
In de kabinetsreactie op het rapport van de commissie-Veling zal ik op deze maatregelen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de voortgangsbrief van de TIB

An MP asked the ministers of Interior and Defence about the TIB's progress letter, including why the number of authorisation requests to the TIB is withheld, why this differs from publishing AIVD/MIVD wiretap statistics, the TIB's view on the hacking power, and the vulnerability of its membership. The ministers said they object only to publishing absolute figures now but accept an aggregated total in the TIB's annual report, and promised a supplementary-member provision in the law amendment.
The Minister of Defence and I are of the view that the absolute figures in the TIB's progress letter, given the short period it covers, give too much insight into this method of working.

De Minister van Defensie en ik zijn van oordeel dat de absolute getallen in de voortgangsbrief van de TIB, mede gelet op de korte periode waarop de voortgangsbrief betrekking heeft, teveel inzicht geeft in deze werkwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘De diensten zijn regelmatig niet blij met ons’

An MP asked the Interior and Defence Ministers whether the law governing intelligence services should be amended to allow appointment of a deputy member of the TIB oversight committee, which the TIB chair says is a flaw in the law. The ministers answered that they consider the TIB's continued functioning important, were informing the TIB of plans to provide for deputy members in the law, but gave no firm commitment on the specific wording.
We consider it of great importance that the TIB can continue to carry out its work properly and we endorse the concern raised by the TIB.
Wij vinden het van groot belang dat de TIB haar werk goed kan blijven uitvoeren en onderschrijven de door de TIB naar voren gebrachte zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het 'uitrusten' van werknemers met microchips

An SP MP asked ministers whether employers may require or request workers to have microchips implanted, citing a UK case, and how such practices relate to GDPR, bodily integrity and the role of supervisors. The minister said such practices must respect privacy and bodily integrity, that the case is hypothetical for the Netherlands, that implanting microchips would likely be unlawful given the employer-employee relationship and biometric data rules, and that workers can complain to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie SZW.
Privacy, human dignity and protection of bodily integrity are fundamental rights that must also be protected in a rapidly digitalising work environment.
Privacy, menselijke waardigheid en de bescherming van de lichamelijke integriteit zijn fundamentele rechten die ook in een snel digitaliserende werkomgeving beschermd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Nieuwe belasting op attracties voor dagjesmensen’

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked about Amsterdam's plan for a new levy on attractions aimed at day-trippers, and the limits central government sets on municipal tax autonomy. Minister Ollongren answered that municipalities can set tourist and recreation levies autonomously within legal limits, that the effects on businesses and subsidised institutions are not yet known, and that the Amsterdam alderman will first consult residents.
At this stage there is insufficient knowledge of the measure Amsterdam wishes to introduce to say anything about its potential effects on entrepreneurs or their turnover.
In dit stadium is onvoldoende bekend over de door de gemeente Amsterdam gewenste maatregel om iets te kunnen zeggen over de potentiële effecten ervan op ondernemers of hun omzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van den Bosch over de aftakeling van vakantieparken

VVD MPs Van Oosten and Van den Bosch asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about crime and decline on small holiday parks, including the action agenda, enforcement powers, anonymous reporting, owner responsibility and registration of addresses. The minister acknowledged the problem, described the 2018-2020 action agenda and coordination role, said existing laws are in principle sufficient, and pointed to a legal framework to be drafted and address-quality work.
There is no national picture available of the total number of holiday parks undermined by crime and their geographic spread.
Er is geen landelijk beeld beschikbaar van het totale aantal vakantieparken dat door criminaliteit wordt ondermijnd en de geografische spreiding daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over ‘nepadvertenties op Facebook die onze democratie ondermijnen’

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Interior Minister about fake political ads on Facebook that could undermine democracy, following a Brandpunt report. The minister said she knows of no specific examples, pointed to Facebook's ad review, transparency tools and planned political ad archive, and noted she cannot guarantee such ads will not recur.
Facebook has committed to me to create an archive for political advertisements, which will also contain all removed political advertisements and advertisements that were only briefly visible.
Facebook heeft mij toegezegd een archief voor politieke advertenties te maken, dat ook alle verwijderde politieke advertenties zal bevatten en de advertenties die maar kort zichtbaar zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat oud-minister Opstelten het ‘minder Marokkanen-proces’ zou hebben beïnvloed

PVV MP Wilders asked whether former minister Opstelten influenced the decision to prosecute him for his 2014 remarks about Moroccans, and why RTL Nieuws's information requests and FOIA request received incomplete answers. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the Public Prosecution Service took an independent prosecution decision, that searches found no formal instruction or request from the minister, that the minister's communications with the College are confidential ambtsberichten not disclosed, and that no notes or minutes showing ministerial involvement were found.
I will therefore not provide a copy of this official report.
Ik zal daarom geen afschrift doen van dit ambtsbericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over verblijf op vakantieparken

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about permanent residence in holiday parks, including enforcement, the legal definitions of living versus recreating, and a case at Buitenplaats Horsterwold. The minister replied that these matters are decentralised to municipalities, which set zoning and enforcement, and declined to comment on the private contract or the alderman's statements.
Policy on spatial planning and the use of recreational homes has been decentralised.
Het beleid ten aanzien van ruimtelijke ordening en gebruik van recreatiewoningen is gedecentraliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Den Boer over het bericht ‘DELA gebruikt vingerafdruk overledenen voor commerciële doeleinden’

MPs Van Dam and Den Boer asked whether funeral company DELA's use of deceased persons' fingerprints for commercial products was acceptable, and about legal protection of the dead and the remedies available to relatives. The minister answered that fingerprints taken with consent are a personal choice and part of business operations, that taking them without consent is unacceptable, and that relatives can complain to the company, the funeral complaints institute, the police or a civil court.
That a funeral organisation, such as DELA, sells products bearing the fingerprint of a deceased person for whom consent was given falls within the business operations of that organisation.

Dat een uitvaartorganisatie, zoals DELA, producten verkoopt met daarop de vingerafdruk van een overledene waarvoor toestemming is gegeven, behoort tot de bedrijfsvoering van de betreffende organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het dreigement van accountants dat zij geen controle willen uitoefenen op topinkomens

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the accountants' association's (NBA) threat not to carry out WNT pay-cap controls and asked about their involvement in simplifying the rules. The minister says the NBA's concerns about complexity will be discussed within the second statutory evaluation, that the NBA helped draft the 2018 control protocol, and that politicians, not accountants, should set pay norms.
I want to conduct the further discussion on this on the basis of facts within the framework of the second statutory evaluation.
De nadere discussie daarover wil ik voeren op basis van feiten in het kader van de tweede wetsevaluatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht 'Woningwet blokkeert subsidie voor zonnepanelen voor woningcorporaties'

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked whether the Woningwet blocks housing corporations from claiming SDE+ subsidy for solar panels because the electricity flows to an energy company, and whether they should amend article 45(2)(c). The minister answered that the Woningwet does not exclude SDE+ subsidy, that corporations may generate electricity only when it is directly linked to housing, and that the Woningwet evaluation including the Autoriteit woningcorporaties will examine possible obstacles by year end.
The evaluation of the revised Woningwet is currently being completed. I expect to send it to your House before the end of this year.
De evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet wordt op dit moment afgerond. Ik verwacht deze voor het eind van dit jaar naar uw Kamer te versturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat woningcorporaties geen energiesubsidies mogen aanvragen

An MP asked whether housing associations are barred from applying for SDE+ renewable energy subsidies, and why some could while others could not, and whether the rules can be harmonised. The minister replied that the Woningwet does not exclude associations from SDE+ subsidy, that electricity sold to third parties falls outside their core work, that the Aw supervises individual cases, and that the issue will be considered in the upcoming Woningwet evaluation.
Housing associations are not excluded from applying for SDE subsidy under the Housing Act, and the subsidy scheme also contains no exclusion of associations from receiving SDE subsidy.

Woningcorporaties zijn op grond van de Woningwet niet uitgesloten van het aanvragen van SDE-subsidie en ook de subsidieregeling kent ook geen uitsluiting voor verlening van SDE-subsidie aan corporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het bericht 'Privacyregels bedreigen duizenden pensioenen'

MP Van Rooijen asks whether GDPR privacy rules hinder pension funds from tracing former members with 'forgotten' pensions and whether legal changes are needed. The minister agrees finding these pensions is good, stresses privacy protection must be balanced, promises talks with the sector and says a legal change may be proposed in 2019 if necessary.
I will shortly enter into discussions with the sector to find a suitable solution for the bottlenecks experienced.
Ik zal op korte termijn in gesprek gaan met de sector om een passende oplossing te vinden voor de knelpunten die worden ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over het bericht dat Shell kinderen wurgcontracten zou hebben laten ondertekenen

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked ministers about reports that Shell had children sign contracts with broad rights waivers, English-law jurisdiction and confidentiality clauses for Generation Discover 2018, and about related questions on the Hogeschool Leiden and the festival. The government answered that the forms were sent in error, were replaced, and that affected children were not photographed, declined to answer questions 3 to 25 because Shell will destroy the contracts, and did not consider the other issues reason for action beyond general comments.
Because Shell will destroy the agreements you refer to and will therefore not rely on them, I will not address questions 3 through 25, as you yourself suggest.
Omdat Shell de overeenkomsten waar u naar verwijst, zal vernietigen en daar dus geen beroep op zal doen ga ik, zoals u zelf voorstelt, niet in op de vragen 3 tot en met 25.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over tankers die elke dag illegaal kankerverwekkend gas lozen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about tankers that vent benzene and other carcinogenic vapours on the Waal and Rhine, including near inhabited areas, and about enforcement gaps between provinces and the state. The minister answered that venting is banned only for petrol, that a national ban on venting other dangerous substances will take effect around 2020 under a revised Rhine convention, that enforcement lies with the ILT and Rijkswateren authorities, and that no change in provincial responsibility is warranted.
Nevertheless, my aim is to ban venting of all dangerous substances while sailing as quickly as possible.
Niettemin is mijn streven gericht op het zo snel mogelijk verbieden van het varend ontgassen van alle gevaarlijke stoffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verwijdering van het schilderij Regelrecht uit de rechtbank in Almelo

MP Bergkamp asked ministers about the removal of a nude-breasted painting from the Almelo court building, whether it undermines the court's independence, and whether the samenleving seeks to influence art more. The government answered that the court board is responsible for the building's interior, that the removal was weighed against a complaint from a sex-crime victim, and that artistic freedom remains the starting point, with no general policy on art in public buildings.

In this case it is therefore up to the court board of the Overijssel district court to assess to what extent the complaints received about the painting give cause to move it from the public to the non-public area of the Almelo courthouse.

Het is in dit geval dus aan het gerechtsbestuur van de rechtbank Overijssel om te beoordelen in hoeverre er in de ontvangen klachten over het schilderij een aanleiding moet worden gezien om het schilderij van de publieke naar de niet-publieke ruimte van het gerechtsgebouw in Almelo te verplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat er ruim € 1 mln. aan boetes is uitgedeeld aan huiseigenaren die geen energielabel hebben aangevraagd

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior about reports that over 1 million euro in fines were issued to homeowners who did not obtain an energy label, questioning the label's necessity and reliability. The Minister defended the mandatory energy label as an EU-based obligation with high compliance, declined to compensate affected buyers, and rejected abolition.
I do not consider it possible or desirable to abolish the energy label, which is mandatory upon the transfer of a home.
Ik acht het niet mogelijk en niet wenselijk om het energielabel, dat verplicht is bij de overdracht van een woning, af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over gesjoemel met energie-indexen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about manipulated energy indices in Groningen rentals, how tenants can challenge them, and how certifiers and EPA advisers are controlled and sanctioned. The minister explained the Huurcommissie and court routes, the certification oversight chain (certificate holders, certification bodies, Raad voor Accreditatie, KvINL), and that the BENG system will tighten quality control, but gave no figures on prosecutions and did not commit to new measures beyond the planned system change.
I am not aware whether parties have been prosecuted for issuing or committing fraud with incorrect energy indices.
Het is mij niet bekend of partijen zijn aangeklaagd voor het afgeven van of fraude met onjuiste energie-indexen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Nijboer over het definitieve energielabel voor woningen

MPs Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the reliability of home energy labels, the oversight of certified assessors, liability for incorrect labels, and the energy-label system's performance. The minister answered that the government registers rather than issues labels, cited inspection results and fines, acknowledged the need for better communication and a review of the simplified label, and promised further steps.
The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport carries out random checks on the files handled by certified experts.
De Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport voert steekproefsgewijs controles uit op de dossiers die door de erkend deskundigen zijn behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Nijboer over gesjoemel met energielabels en energie-indexen

MPs Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about alleged manipulation of energy indices in Groningen rental housing, how tenants can recover overpayments, how certifiers are checked and sanctioned, and whether action will be taken. The minister acknowledged the article, explained the rent-points effect (often limited in practice), said only suspected cases by one certificate holder are known, pointed tenants to the Huurcommissie and courts, outlined a suspension and withdrawal process for certificate holders, and saw no need for further measures.
Given the options tenants have with the Rent Tribunal and the courts in cases of fraud and manipulation, I currently see insufficient reason for additional measures.
Gezien de mogelijkheden van huurders bij de Huurcommissie en de rechter in gevallen van fraude en sjoemelen, zie ik op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding voor aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de achteruitgang van leefbaarheid in wijken

Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of the Interior about the deterioration of neighbourhood liveability, the options for municipalities and housing corporations, and whether the income limit for social housing and the passend toewijzen rules should be changed. The Minister acknowledged the survey and Leefbarometer findings, pointed to existing instruments for mixing neighbourhoods, said the Woningwet evaluation will report by year end, and declined to commit to raising the income limit or changing passend toewijzen now.
I am of the view that this set of instruments gives local parties sufficient opportunities to address keeping neighbourhoods liveable and safe.
Ik ben van mening dat dit instrumentarium lokale partijen voldoende mogelijkheden biedt om zorg en invulling te geven aan het leefbaar en veilig houden van wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over het bericht ‘Ecologen: zonneparken zijn funest voor de natuur’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether they share experts' concern that large solar parks harm nature and soil life, and about rooftop priority, land competition, the number of solar parks under construction, the government's role, and innovative placement such as noise barriers. The ministers answered that ecological effects depend on site and design, that spatial planning is primarily a responsibility of municipalities and provinces, that rooftops should be prioritised per the draft NOVI, and that they will inform parliament in early 2019 on a national assessment framework.
I will inform you early in 2019 about the implementation of this motion and also involve it in drafting the draft NOVI.
Ik zal u begin 2019 informeren over de uitvoering van deze motie en deze ook betrekken bij het opstellen van de ontwerpNOVI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Met sociale koopwoningen gaat veel mis’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of the Interior whether the social-purchase housing rules (sociale koop) can be easily misused, whether municipalities have the legal expertise to make watertight agreements, and how many social-purchase homes were added or lost over five years. The Minister pointed to municipal instruments such as zoning categories and housing vision agreements, said no data exist on social-purchase stock changes, referred to the Expertteam Woningbouw for support, and committed to informing parliament next year on a commissioned Platform 31 study.
I do not have data showing how many social-purchase homes based on the zoning category were added or disappeared over the past five years.
Ik beschik niet over data waaruit blijkt hoeveel sociale koopwoningen er op basis van de bestemmingscategorie de afgelopen vijf jaar zijn bijgekomen en verdwenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Beckerman over de brandveiligheid van gebouwen

MPs Koerhuis and Beckerman asked about fire-safety of buildings, including combustible facade panels, the reported Nijmegen plan to loosen fire-safety enforcement, and what the minister can do to intervene in municipalities. The minister said an inventory of risky buildings is being prepared with the VBWTN and fire service, with a letter expected end of November, that municipalities have policy freedom in enforcement and are accountable to their councils, and that she has no power to intervene since interbestuurlijk toezicht lies with the provinces.
Although it is therefore not for me to have an opinion on this, I made inquiries with the municipality as part of the right of reply.
Hoewel het dus niet aan mij is om hierover een mening te hebben, heb ik in het kader van wederhoor navraag gedaan bij de gemeente.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de conclusie van EenVandaag dat de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid de huidige landelijke inventarisatie van breedplaat- ofwel bubblevloeren in twijfel trekt

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior whether the national inventory of hollow-core (bubble) floors is doubted by the Dutch Safety Board, whether a new inventory will be started, and whether municipalities are informed quickly. The Minister said she is having Prof. Wijte examine the consequences of the Safety Board's findings for the inventory and will report by end of November, but did not know whether complete building files lie with municipalities.
I have asked Prof. Wijte to examine this and to consult with the OvV and all other experts he considers relevant.
Ik heb prof. Wijte gevraagd om dit te onderzoeken en hiervoor in overleg te treden met de OvV en met alle andere deskundigen die hij van belang acht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de gevolgen van de WOZ-waarde in het huurpuntenstelsel en de verhuurderheffing

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the effects of WOZ property values in the rent-points system and the landlord levy on social rents, liberalisation thresholds and municipal property tax. The Minister answered that the WOZ-based model was deliberate, that its effects are being evaluated, that the levy revenues have not exceeded the original projections, and that she will not divert levy gains to tenants but will report on local options.

How many social rental homes have crossed the liberalisation threshold since the rent-points system, in which the WOZ value determines a large part of the rent, was introduced will emerge from the evaluation of the WWS.

Hoeveel sociale huurwoningen de liberalisatiegrens zijn overgegaan sinds het ingaan van het huurpuntenstelsel waarin de WOZ-waarde een groot deel van de huurprijs bepaalt, zal naar voren komen bij de evaluatie van het WWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over erfpacht

An MP from D66 asked for a full history of the leasehold (erfpacht) situation on the Wadden islands, including the Groothuis, Van der Werf and RVB valuation reports, the commitments made to parliament and leaseholders, the scientific-integrity assessment of the RVB valuation method, and the legal protection of leaseholders. The State Secretary answered that Staatsbosbeheer has offered most leaseholders a sale or continued lease, that the LOWI complaints were declared unfounded so the RVB method is not in question for the government, and that leaseholders' interests are protected by civil law and general principles of good governance.

There is now a court case brought by a number of leaseholders in which the valuation method used by the RVB is being challenged. I am awaiting the outcome of this procedure and will inform you about it in due course.

Thans is sprake van een door een aantal erfpachters aangespannen gerechtelijke procedure waarin de door het RVB gebruikte taxatiemethode ter discussie wordt gesteld. Ik wacht de uitkomsten van deze procedure af en zal u er te zijner tijd over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat in de vier grote steden 1 op de 5 huizen wordt verkocht aan beleggers

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the public sale of social rental flats in Groningen to investors, and the growing share of investor purchases in big cities, will drive up rents and house prices. The Minister answered that the corporation and municipality acted lawfully, that municipal and tenant consultation rules apply, that the government is monitoring investor effects and will report next year, and that local solutions for starters are the responsibility of municipalities.
I do not have figures on how often a social rental home is sold through a comparable tender.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers hoe vaak een sociale huurwoning via een vergelijkbare aanbesteding wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Lodders over het bericht 'Tientallen gemeenten hebben geen goed beeld van WOZ-waarde huizen'

MPs Van den Bosch and Lodders (VVD) asked about news reports that dozens of municipalities have poor WOZ property valuations, including causes, overvaluation corrections, tax consequences, the meaning of Waarderingskamer star ratings, and whether sanctions will follow. Minister Ollongren answered that 95 municipalities received a negative rating at some point, mostly due to data registration and backlog problems, that the regulator decides on sanctions, and that she sees no reason for extra measures now.
The precise number of cases is not known to me or to the Waarderingskamer.
Het precieze aantal gevallen is mij of de Waarderingskamer niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de vastgelopen woningmarkt

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the housing market is a mess under her watch, whether the national housing agenda is empty, why municipalities are slow to build, and whether social rental homes should go to Dutch applicants rather than refugees with status. The minister rejected the critique, pointed to new measures and regional agreements, and said local allocation choices and the equal-treatment principle apply.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs

MPs Kuiken and Buitenweg asked whether sexual abuse by tantra massage practitioners persists and what authorities are doing about it, including reports, prosecutions, municipal permit requirements and enforcement. Minister Grapperhaus answered that sexual abuse is unacceptable, municipalities can enforce permit rules, a victim awareness campaign is planned, and provided limited figures while stating that specific data on prosecutions for tantra abuse is not registered.
Furthermore, I do not have information on the number of prosecutions or criminal sanctions, as cases of sexual abuse by tantra masseurs are not specifically registered.

Verder beschik ik niet over informatie ten aanzien van het aantal gevallen van vervolging of strafrechtelijke sancties aangezien er niet specifiek wordt geregistreerd op gevallen van seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over illegale boetes door huisbazen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked whether a Nijmegen landlord may impose fines of 50 to 100 euro for misplaced bicycles or forgotten keys, and whether this is common and how the government will act against abuse of tenants' dependent position. The minister answers that fines are permitted if agreed in the lease and reasonable, that a landlord may only charge a cost-based reimbursement absent such terms, that unlawful brokerage fees are banned, and that she is working to improve enforcement as requested in a motion.
Landlords are permitted to include penalty clauses in their lease contracts or general terms for cases where the tenant does not comply with certain agreements on house rules.

Het is verhuurders toegestaan om in hun huurcontracten dan wel in de algemene voorwaarden bij de huurcontracten boetebepalingen op te nemen voor gevallen de huurder bepaalde afspraken omtrent «huisregels» niet nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het tracé van buizen voor ondergronds transport van gevaarlijke stoffen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the route of a pipeline for hazardous substances running under or near a residential area in Helmond, including its history, legal basis, public participation and alternatives. The minister confirmed awareness of concerns, explained the indicative status of the route and that a new public consultation will follow in the first half of 2019, but gave only partial answers, withheld the environmental study until it is final, and committed to involving Helmond and affected parties.
The route of the Laarbeek-Echt-Susteren pipeline strip has a provisional character in the current Structuurvisie, as the still-to-follow objection procedure may lead to adjustments of the route.

Het tracé van de buisleidingenstrook Laarbeek-Echt-Susteren heeft in de vigerende Structuurvisie een voorlopig karakter aangezien de nog te volgen zienswijzeprocedure kan leiden tot aanpassingen van het tracé van de strook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over ongewenste druk van de overheid en het bedrijfsleven op onderzoekers

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked about undue pressure from government and business on researchers, including the KNAW code on external funding, the new research integrity code, and Rijksvoorwaarden. The ministers answered that the new Dutch research integrity code covers all researchers, that universities must protect their researchers, and that the government will review the Rijksvoorwaarden and model contract to ensure they fit the integrity code.

I will, together with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the drafting committee that prepared the new code, take another careful look at the Rijksvoorwaarden in combination with the model agreement for (policy-oriented) research.

Daarom ga ik samen met de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de schrijfcommissie, die de nieuwe gedragscode heeft opgesteld, nog eens goed naar de Rijksvoorwaarden in combinatie met de modelovereenkomst voor (beleidsgericht) onderzoek kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over verhuurder Camelot

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the Interior and Education Ministers about the letting company Camelot and its treatment of student tenants at the University of Twente, including deposits, mandatory services, referrals and whether rules need tightening. Minister Ollongren answered that companies may choose their business, that Camelot has reduced its deposit to 1,000 euro after university consultation, that tenants can seek legal advice and rulings, and that the issues feed into the student housing action plan and a 'Goed verhuurderschap' approach, with a follow-up letter promised after a sector meeting.
I will meet the sector on 1 November about the Goed verhuurderschap approach.
Ik spreek op 1 november met de sector over de aanpak Goed verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over woningen van Vestia aan de Trekweg te Den Haag

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she would engage housing corporation Vestia to fix structural maintenance failures in Trekweg and Stuwstraat homes in The Hague, and whether she would force action and address poor complaint handling. The Minister answered that maintenance is a core task of corporations, that Vestia's remediation plan covers it, and listed existing tenant routes (complaints, Huurcommissie, municipal orders, court injunctions) while noting a complaints line, weekly surgery and an upcoming visit by the alderman and a Vestia board member.
Tenants must be able to assume at all times that their home is maintained in a decent way.
Huurders moeten er te allen tijde vanuit kunnen gaan dat hun woning op een degelijke manier onderhouden wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over huurders die gedwongen worden tot werk (en statushouders niet)

An MP asked whether housing corporation Portaal forces tenants of its 'mixed living' homes to work four hours a week, while statushouders are exempt, and whether the Minister would stop this. The Minister answered that the activities are voluntary, carry no consequences for the lease, bring no rent reduction or payment, and that she sees no reason to ask the housing regulator to investigate.
There is no question of mandatory activities.
Er is geen sprake van verplichte werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de NVWA en vervolgonderzoeken naar onveilige cv-ketels

An MP asks how the NVWA handled the safety of Nefit gas boilers (B3L and B3M) from 2009 to 2018, including the handling of heat exchanger problems, oversight design, certification plans, registration of appliances and periodic inspection. The government answers that the NVWA acted in line with its powers, that a certification regime and related bill are being prepared, and it declines to introduce central serial-number registration or mandatory periodic inspection of home installations.
The NVWA was informed about this by the German authorities.
De NVWA is daarover door de Duitse autoriteiten geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het gebrek aan toezicht op legionella afkomstig van afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallaties

An MP asks ministers why wastewater treatment plants linked to legionella outbreaks at Vion and Rendac face no legionella controls, whether oversight is adequate and what will be done. The minister answers that the link was previously unknown, that local authorities acted correctly and that temporary measures are in place while permanent rules and further research are being prepared.
In addition, I will have the possibilities examined for including requirements on legionella for wastewater treatment as well.
Daarnaast laat ik in kaart brengen welke mogelijkheden er zijn om ook voor afvalwaterzuivering eisen op te nemen met betrekking tot Legionella.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Koerhuis over de tekortkoming bij de aansluitingsplicht van nutsbedrijf Liander bij het nieuwbouwproject 'Oostweide' in Heiloo

MPs Rudmer Heerema and Koerhuis asked the minister about grid operator Liander's failure to connect the Oostweide new-build project in Heiloo on time, including household hardship, financial liability, compensation, and whether such cases occur elsewhere. The minister answered that financial consequences are private-law matters outside his involvement, that Liander and the builders reached constructive agreement to finish work quickly, and that he is consulting network operators and the regulator ACM on the wider problem of missed 18-week connection deadlines.
Any financial consequences result from private-law relationships between the parties, in which I am not involved.
Eventuele financiële consequenties zijn het gevolg van privaatrechtelijke verhoudingen tussen de partijen, waarbij ik niet ben betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Kraakactie in Mill tegen uitsterfbeleid woonwagens’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of the Interior whether the squatting of a caravan site in Mill by travellers from another municipality, in protest at a municipal phase-out policy, is illegal, and what enforcement options exist, and whether the 2018 policy framework on caravan sites causes confusion. The minister answered that squatting without permits is illegal, that municipalities may enforce against it and mayors may intervene under the Public Manifestations Act, that she will discuss the framework with municipalities and traveller organisations, and that municipalities may reduce standplaatsen where there is no longer demand.
The policy framework does not give individual caravan dwellers the right to illegally occupy, appropriate or carry out illegal activities on a standplaats.
Het beleidskader geeft individuele woonwagenbewoners geen recht om illegaal een standplaats in gebruik te nemen, toe te eigenen of illegale activiteiten te ontplooien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over studenten die naar de rechter moeten voor onterecht betaalde bemiddelingskosten

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why students must go to court to recover improperly charged brokerage fees, and what the ACM and government will do about it. The minister answered that courts judge individual cases, that the ACM acts only on systematic violations, that a Huurcommissie role and a 'Goed verhuurderschap' approach are being explored, and that data on the number of affected tenants and municipal support are not available.
I do not have figures on the number of brokers who wrongly charge disguised brokerage fees or on how many tenants have been wrongly charged.

Ik beschik niet over cijfers van de aantallen bemiddelaars die ten onrechte verkapte bemiddelingskosten in rekening brengen en aan hoeveel huurders ten onrechte bemiddelingskosten in rekening is gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het instorten van een parkeergarage in Wormerveer

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about the partial collapse of a parking garage in Wormerveer, whether prefab floors were implicated, and what is being done about similar garages and building supervision. The minister answered that the collapse was caused by a failed steel beam connection rather than the floors, that other garages are being reviewed, and that the forthcoming Wet Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen is intended to tighten supervision, while the investigation is still ongoing.

The investigation into the partial collapse of the parking garage in Wormerveer is not yet complete. Once this investigation is finished, I will consider whether national measures are needed for similar parking garages or buildings.

Het onderzoek naar de gedeeltelijke instorting van de parkeergarage in Wormerveer is nog niet afgerond. Als dit onderzoek is afgerond, bezie ik of landelijke maatregelen nodig zijn bij soortgelijke parkeergarages of gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Den Boer over het uitzonderen van Nederlanders in het buitenland bij het kiezen van de Eerste Kamer

MPs Sjoerdsma and Den Boer asked why Dutch citizens living abroad have no say in electing the Eerste Kamer, given the coalition agreement's commitment to easier voting rights including for the Eerste Kamer. The minister replied that options for giving overseas Dutch citizens influence will be mapped and presented to parliament in spring 2019, and that the BES islands will vote for their own electoral college on 20 March 2019.
In my letter of 15 October 2018 I informed your House that in the coming months I will map out the options for giving Dutch citizens living abroad influence over the composition of the Eerste Kamer.

In mijn brief van 15 oktober 2018 heb ik uw Kamer meegedeeld dat ik in de komende maanden de opties in kaart ga brengen om Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen invloed te geven op de samenstelling van de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurtoeslag voor mensen die beschermd wonen of huren via een instelling

The SP's Beckerman asked why the Tax Administration's website dropped the statement that residents of temporary housing, such as shelters, receive no housing allowance, and whether this followed a 2015 Council of State ruling; he also asked about clawbacks, the number of affected tenants, and how the government will improve move-on from shelters. The minister answered that the ruling and a 2016 law on fixed-term contracts reduced such exclusions, that clawbacks continue where contracts are for short-term use, and that the government is exploring a model contract and a target-group contract with the sector, with results to Parliament by end 2018.
Precise figures on how many people currently rent a home through a social or care institution are not known, because they are not registered nationally.
Over het aantal mensen dat op dit moment een woning via een maatschappelijke of zorginstelling huurt zijn geen precieze cijfers bekend, omdat deze niet landelijk worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Opmars No Cure, No Pay bureaus bij WOZ-bezwaren’

MPs asked about the growing share of WOZ property-valuation objections filed by no-cure-no-pay agencies, including calls for independent research, consumer protection, association sponsorship practices, municipal valuation quality, and an OZB inspection counter under the Omgevingswet. The ministers say they will commission research into the volume of such objections and related cost reimbursements before deciding on solutions, but decline to intervene in agency-association arrangements and point to existing Waarderingskamer oversight and the WOZ waardeloket.
My colleagues and I will have the development of the number of objections by no cure no pay companies and the related cost reimbursements examined.
Mijn ambtgenoten en ik zullen de ontwikkeling van de aantallen bezwaren door no cure no pay bedrijven en de in verband daarmee toegekende kostenvergoedingen laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat Shell-directeur Marjan van Loon de stad Den Haag gaat adviseren over duurzaamheid

An MP asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that Shell's director advises The Hague on sustainability, whether Shell's advice is credible, and what steps government will take regarding local advice and Shell's role. The minister answered that local advisory appointments are for the municipality and its council to oversee, that Shell is one of many parties in the energy transition, and that it is up to local governments to disclose their advisory bodies.
It is not for the national government to direct decentralised authorities, in this case the Hague municipal executive, on their hiring of advisers.
Het is niet aan het Rijk om decentrale overheden, en in dit geval het college van B&W van Den Haag, aan te sturen op hun inhuur van adviseurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over het artikel 'Twitter, Facebook en Google gaan nepnieuws aanpakken'

MP Middendorp asked the Interior Minister about reports that tech companies such as Twitter, Facebook and Google may influence elections and whether Dutch or EU rules govern their role in elections. The minister answered that tech firms can affect elections both positively and negatively, that no Dutch studies exist on their effects, that GDPR and an EU voluntary code of practice on disinformation apply, and that the Staatscommissie Parlementair Stelsel and an evaluation of the Wfpp will address campaign rules.
I do not rule out that personal data could also be misused in the Netherlands to influence elections.
Ik sluit niet uit dat ook in Nederland misbruik gemaakt zou kunnen worden van persoonsgegevens om verkiezingen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over signalen dat mensen lang niet kunnen verhuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether older people wanting to downsize are stuck for many years due to scarce affordable housing, and how common this is. The minister said such waits are undesirable, cited RIGO and WoON data showing long registration times varying by region, and pointed to the Actielijn Wonen en Zorg and NHG changes as measures to improve downsizing.
I consider it undesirable if people cannot move to a home that suits their housing wishes.
Ik vind het onwenselijk als mensen niet kunnen verhuizen naar een woning die past bij hun woonwens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het bericht dat ex-studenten geen hypotheek krijgen bij een studieschuld

MPs Ronnes and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers whether banks wrongly count the original rather than remaining student debt when assessing mortgage applications, and whether DUO should improve information to students. The government answered that annuity repayment makes the monthly burden constant so the original debt is weighted via fixed factors, that the explain exception exists, that information will be improved, and that excluding student debt would raise over-indebtedness risk.

At the next Platform Hypotheken in 2019, where the sector and the supervisor discuss possible bottlenecks in mortgage lending, it will be inventoried how providers use this explain possibility and whether bottlenecks are encountered.

Tijdens het volgende Platform Hypotheken in 2019, waar met de sector en de toezichthouder wordt gesproken over mogelijke knelpunten in de hypotheekverstrekking, zal worden geïnventariseerd op welke wijze aanbieders gebruik maken van deze explain-mogelijkheid en of hier knelpunten worden ondervonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het bericht 'Opvang op Griekse eilanden kraakt'

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked about reports that reception conditions on Greek islands are inhumane, including child suicide attempts, and about EU monitoring and asylum procedure reform. The Dutch state secretary acknowledged the concerns, attributed problems mainly to overcrowding and slow asylum procedures, described EU and Dutch support and new Greek asylum law, but said no exact figures on child suicide attempts were available and opposed transfers to the mainland as a long-term solution.
Inquiries have revealed that no exact figures on suicide attempts can be obtained.
Navraag heeft geleerd dat geen exacte cijfers over pogingen tot zelfmoord zijn te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Jetten over het bericht dat Hardenberg in alle nieuwbouwwijken gasaansluitingen toelaat

Two MPs from D66 asked ministers whether Hardenberg's blanket exemption from the gas connection obligation for all new-build neighbourhoods was lawful and in line with the law's intent. The minister answered that the municipal exemption power is limited to specific projects or locations, that he cannot judge whether Hardenberg complied with the rules, and that objection and appeal are open to affected parties.
Whether the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Hardenberg took this decision in accordance with the provisions of the law, I cannot assess.
Of het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Hardenberg dit besluit conform de bepalingen in de wet heeft genomen, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ronnes over het potentiële gebruik van slimme meters voor energiebesparing

MPs Mulder and Ronnes asked the ministers about the evaluation of the energy-saving covenant, weak uptake of smart-meter energy-saving services, and smart thermostats. Minister Wiebes answered that the evaluation is expected by end 2018, that the covenant is expected to be complied with, and that policy measures are limited to voluntary sector commitments and subsidies.
I assume that the Covenant will be complied with.
Ik ga er vanuit dat het Convenant zal worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over scheuren in pilaren in een parkeergarage in Almere

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether cracked pillars closing an Almere parking garage pose collapse risk, whether they are linked to the 2017 Eindhoven collapse, and whether municipal building supervision and the planned quality-assurance law address the failure. The minister answered that the municipal investigation into the cause is not finished, that there is no link to Eindhoven, and that the municipality holds the permit file while the planned Wkb would supervise building quality through private quality assurers.
The investigation into the cause has not yet been completed.
Het onderzoek naar de oorzaak is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over de situatie van de gesloten parkeergarage in Almere

MPs Smeulders asked the Minister of Interior about the closed parking garage in Almere: investigation status, whether its concrete matches other buildings, the inventory of unsafe concrete floors promised last year, municipal inspection capacity, the privatisation of building inspection under the Wkb, and liability. The minister answered that the Almere investigation is not finished, pointed to her May 2018 letter, said municipalities are responsible for inspection and that no national register is kept, and noted private quality guarantors would still be supervised by a public accreditation body with municipalities retaining enforcement powers.
I have made inquiries with the municipality of Almere. It has informed me that the investigation has not yet been completed.
Ik heb hierover navraag gedaan bij de gemeente Almere. Deze heeft mij laten weten dat het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes en Beckerman over PUR-schuim in Vriezenveen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior about a family in Vriezenveen left facing a large claim after no contractor would remove demolition rubble containing PUR foam, and about PUR recycling, Bouwbesluit rules and comparisons with Germany and Belgium. The minister acknowledged the case, said the rubble was dumped as non-reusable, committed to amending the Bouwbesluit by mid-2019, and declined an independent inquiry.
However, I see no reason to commission further independent research in addition to the announced amendment of building regulations and the planned Health Council study.
Ik zie echter geen aanleiding om naast de door mij aangekondigde wijziging van de bouwregelgeving en het nog geplande onderzoek door de Gezondheidsraad nader onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het achterhouden van een rapport van de CTIVD

MP Kuiken asks Minister Ollongren whether the CTIVD report on intelligence oversight was deliberately held back until after the advisory referendum on the Wiv, and whether foreign-service consultation was the only reason for the delay. The minister denies any link to the referendum, says the delay was caused by the time needed to consult foreign services on full publication, and states that the report mainly concerns the old Wiv 2002.

The decision to make the report fully public, against the wishes of foreign services, and the careful consultation that this required, was for me the only reason not to send the report to the House before the advisory referendum.

Het besluit om het rapport, tegen de wens van buitenlandse diensten in, integraal openbaar te maken en de zorgvuldige afstemming die daarvoor nodig was, was voor mij de enige reden om het rapport niet voorafgaand aan het raadgevend referendum aan de Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de lessen die Nederland heeft getrokken ruim een jaar na de brand in de Londense Grenfell Tower

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior what lessons the Netherlands has drawn from the 2017 Grenfell Tower fire, including fire safety of buildings, insulation materials, and EPBD implications. The minister replied that the UK inquiry report is delayed, so lessons await it, an advisory body has been tasked, and municipalities will be asked to inventory high-risk buildings and consider stricter regulation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over de inventarisatie van brandgevaarlijke gevelplaten

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked whether more information exists on the extent of fire-hazardous facade panels in the Netherlands, whether suppliers were approached, whether municipalities are asked to inventory affected buildings, and whether Nijmegen's self-inspection by housing corporations is problematic. The Minister says all municipalities will be asked to inventory the most risky buildings and check Bouwbesluit compliance, with the approach still being discussed with VBWTN and the fire service, and that building owners bear primary responsibility while municipalities have policy freedom in building supervision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de toegenomen populariteit van gasgestookte ketels, met name in nieuwbouw

MP Wassenberg asks whether the rising popularity of gas boilers, especially in new-build homes, undermines Dutch climate targets, the Groningen gas phase-out and the 2050 gas-free goal, and whether government policy and gas connections should be changed. The minister replies that gas-boiler demand has not risen sharply, that heat pumps are gaining share, that the gas connection obligation for new homes was abolished from 1 July 2018, and that municipalities will set neighbourhood plans and the Klimaatakkoord will support the transition.
I have asked RVO to explain these figures.
Ik heb RVO gevraagd om deze cijfers toe te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat Russische trollen ook actief zijn in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether Russian troll activity in the Netherlands is a concern, whether it is criminal, and whether the government will act with platforms and at EU level against foreign influence on public opinion. The government says foreign interference is serious, points to an interdepartmental approach and EU work on online disinformation, and says whether speech is criminal is for the prosecutor to decide, while keeping talks with platforms ongoing.

The cabinet considers unwanted foreign interference very objectionable as it can undermine the political and social system and touches the foundation of the Dutch democratic legal order and open society.

Het kabinet vindt ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging zeer kwalijk aangezien dit het politieke en maatschappelijke systeem kan ondergraven en raakt aan het fundament van de Nederlandse democratische rechtsorde en open samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Özdil over het bericht ‘Gemiddelde prijs studentenkamer voor het eerst boven de 400 euro’

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about rising student rents, the causes of the housing shortage, and whether the woningwaarderingsstelsel should be mandatory for student housing. The government said it lacks exact shortage figures per city, pointed to the Landelijke monitor and a new action plan, and considered existing rent-control and Huurcommissie routes sufficient consumer protection.

As I indicated earlier in answers to parliamentary questions from MPs Van Meenen and Van Eijs (D66) and MPs Voortman and Özdil (GroenLinks), no exact figures per city can be given on student housing demand and supply.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven in antwoorden de Kamervragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Eijs (D66) (kenmerk 2017Z12177 ) en de leden Voortman en Özdil (GroenLinks) (kenmerk 2017Z15653 ) zijn er geen exacte standen per stad te geven als het gaat om de vraag naar en het aanbod van studentenhuisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het tekort aan studentenkamers

Two CDA MPs asked about the shortage of student rooms, rising rents, housing options for starters, arrangements for international students, and whether the housing situation affects study choices. The minister disputed the figure of 40,000 unhoused students, pointed to monitor data and the rent-check route via the Huurcommissie, and said no trend yet shows housing affecting study choice.
I have not yet observed a trend showing that the housing market situation influences students' study choices.
Ik heb nog geen trend waargenomen waaruit blijkt dat de situatie op de woningmarkt de studiekeuze van studenten beïnvloedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over de website www.investingindutchhousing.nl

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why a government website encourages foreign investors to invest in Dutch housing, how it is funded, and how buy-to-let excesses, tenant conflicts, social housing sales and rising rents are addressed. The Minister answered that the website informs about the housing market, costs about 12,500 euro in editorial work, that foreign investors are a small share and must follow Dutch rules, and that municipalities and the Huurcommissie provide tools for tenant protection, while promising to update the website on social housing sales.
The website will be updated on this point.
De website zal op dit punt geactualiseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Amsterdam boos: 'Kabinet lokt foute vastgoedbeleggers'”

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior why the government promotes Dutch rental housing to foreign investors, whether social rental homes should be liberalised and sold to foreign investors, and why pension funds rather than housing corporations are targeted. The minister answers that the campaign informs investors about the housing market, that corporations may sell or liberalise stock under sale rules involving tenants, municipalities and a possible independent committee, and that foreign investment is under 5 percent and supports housing finance.
For the potentially liberalisable homes the offer sequence does not apply. However, for these homes a municipal opinion is also mandatory.
Voor de potentieel te liberaliseren woningen geldt de aanbiedingsvolgorde niet. Wel geldt dat voor deze woningen ook een zienswijze van de gemeente verplicht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het aantrekken van buitenlandse investeerders voor sociale woningbouw

MP Ronnes (CDA) asks whether the government endorses a website promoting foreign investment in Dutch housing, including social rental stock sold by housing corporations, and whether it will stop directing foreign investors to the regulated sector. The minister answers that the site informs about the housing market, that foreign investors are a small share, that corporation sales are subject to tenant, municipal and dispute rules, and that the site will be updated.
The website will be updated on this point.
De website zal op dit punt geactualiseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het verpatsen van sociale huurhuizen aan buitenlandse beleggers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a government website promoting Dutch social rental housing to foreign investors, trade missions to London and Southeast Asia, and the liberalisation and sale of social housing to foreign investors were justified, and what they cost. The Minister answered that the website only informs investors about the Dutch housing market, reported modest costs, said further trips were not planned, and pointed to sale rules and local authority roles while declining to ban foreign buyers as New Zealand did.
Question 4: How much public money did the foreign trips and the website cost?
Vraag 4 Hoeveel gemeenschapsgeld hebben de buitenlandse reizen en de website gekost?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het massaal vragen van teveel huur voor studentenkamers

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about a student-union report finding that about 70 percent of students pay rent above the legal maximum, and whether the rent-protection system works, and urges penalties, blacklisting of landlords and action against double brokerage fees. The minister refers to a letter on the representativeness and reform, says she will monitor affordability via a national student housing monitor, is willing to talk to housing corporations with concrete signals, plans higher fees for repeat-offending landlords and good-landlordship talks with the sector, and notes municipalities can intervene on overcrowding and safety.

In cases of overcrowding, poor fire safety, unlawful subdivision and the like, the municipality can intervene under administrative law based on the Housing Act, the zoning plan or the Building Decree.

Bij overbewoning, slechte brandveiligheid, ongeoorloofde verkamering en dergelijke kan de gemeente bestuursrechtelijk ingrijpen op grond van de huisvestingswet, het bestemmingsplan of het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Meenen over (buitenlandse) studenten die geen onderdak hebben

MPs Van Eijs and Van Meenen (D66) asked whether foreign students lacking housing at the start of their studies could be quantified, whether a permanent solution is foreseen, how universities consider housing capacity in recruitment, and about tent accommodation in Groningen and municipal-university coordination. The minister replied that no exact figures per city exist, pointed to the national student housing monitor and a new action plan with local production agreements, and said she will inventory local cooperation and concrete housing actions with the monitor.
No data are available on the number of students who cannot find accommodation before the start of their studies.
Over het aantal studenten dat voor de start van hun studie geen woning kan vinden zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Veldman over het bericht 'Veel bewoners van sociale huurwoningen verdienen te veel'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about a newspaper report on high-income social housing tenants in the Rivierenland and Maasland regions, and about the effects of monitoring data, rent rules, selling dear social rentals and possible action. The Minister answered in detail with regional statistics, explained the income-based rent rules, and said she will assess the expected rent agreement and report to parliament, if it is not reached she will consider whether current policy suffices.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over onveilige balkons en galerijen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about a collapsed balcony in Groningen, why 312 balconies were closed despite recent renovation, prior warnings, whether all gallery flats were inspected, inspection results nationally, and balcony safety outside gallery flats. The Minister answered that corporations and the municipality investigated and took measures, that the national inspection duty lies with owners and municipalities with provincial oversight, and that the Minister holds no results data and will await the ongoing investigation.

Supervision of compliance with the gallery flat inspection duty lies with the municipality. Inter-governmental supervision of this municipal task lies with the province. I have no role in this supervision.

Het toezicht op de naleving van de onderzoeksplicht van galerijflats ligt bij de gemeente. Het interbestuurlijke toezicht op deze gemeentelijke taak ligt bij de provincie. Ik heb geen rol bij dit toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Klagen over ongelijke behandeling kan niet in Caribisch Nederland'

MPs Özütok and Van Tongeren asked whether complaints about unequal treatment can be lodged in Caribbean Netherlands, given that equal-treatment law does not apply there, and which rights protections are missing. Minister Ollongren answered that residents can still go to court under the Constitution, international treaties and the BWBES, that the government considers legislative restraint necessary, and that an exploration of extending equal-treatment legislation to the islands will be carried out.

I intend, partly in response to the College's recommendation in its report 'Five years College for Human Rights', to have an exploration carried out into the possibility of introducing equal-treatment legislation in Caribbean Netherlands.

Ik ben, mede naar aanleiding van de aanbeveling van het College in zijn rapport «Vijf jaar College voor de Rechten van de Mens», voornemens om een verkenning te laten uitvoeren naar de mogelijkheid om de gelijkebehandelingswetgeving in te voeren in Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over wijken die kunnen veranderen in getto’s

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether housing policy such as passend toewijzen is causing neighbourhoods to become one-sided 'ghettos', and asked for a new multi-year neighbourhood policy. The Minister rejected the ghetto framing, said local actors bear primary responsibility and listed tools they have, and declined to introduce a new neighbourhood policy or to change the Woningwet ahead of its 2018 evaluation.
Given these possibilities, I do not consider the introduction of a new multi-year neighbourhood policy to be necessary.
Gegeven deze mogelijkheden acht ik de introductie van een nieuw meerjarig wijkenbeleid niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat het aantal huurwoningen in handen van particulieren de afgelopen tien jaar met 40% is gestegen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the rise in privately owned rental homes and buy-to-let investment threatens first-time buyers and warrants national measures. The minister disputes the 40% rise figure as a data artefact, argues private renting is a welcome supply addition best handled locally, and rejects general restrictions while promising a later letter on good landlordship and regional measures.
I do not see private renting in itself as a problem, but as an opportunity for more mid-market rental homes.
Particuliere verhuur zie ik op zichzelf niet als probleem, maar als een kans voor meer middenhuurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de inspectie van gevaarlijk roestvrijstaal (RVS) in zwembaden

MP Van Eijs asked the Minister of Interior whether the inspection regime for dangerous stainless steel fixtures in swimming pools is adequate, including the number of compliant pools, whether provinces acted on a request to remind municipalities of their duties, and whether the Bouwbesluit and NPR 9200 are aligned. The minister answered that municipal first-line and provincial interbestuurlijk supervision are sufficient, that all provinces have followed up, that the two rule sets cover different scopes, and that pool owners bear primary responsibility.

As I reported in my letter of 5 January 2018, I consider supervision of the remaining work to complete the inspection duty sufficiently secured through first-line supervision by municipalities and additional interbestuurlijk supervision by provinces.

Zoals ik mijn brief van 5 januari 2018 heb gemeld, acht ik het toezicht op de nog resterende werkzaamheden met betrekking tot het afronden van de onderzoeksplicht voldoende geborgd met het eerstelijns toezicht door gemeenten en het aanvullend interbestuurlijke toezicht door provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Lange over het bericht ‘het overmaken van de huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties’

Two MPs (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about whether moving debt-burdened tenants to the cheapest social rental housing could reduce housing costs and debt, and what other countries and corporations do. The minister gave rent-burden data, said debt cases require customised municipal solutions with no national data on relocations, and rejected extra consultation as unnecessary since corporations already work to prevent evictions.
The information you requested is not available because debt handling is customised work for which no national figures are kept.
De door u gevraagde informatie is niet beschikbaar omdat de aanpak van de schulden maatwerk is waarvan landelijk geen cijfers worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de stagnerende woningproductie

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about stagnating housing production, falling building permits by municipalities, shortages of construction workers, and whether the 1 July 2018 gas connection ban delays projects. The minister disputes stagnation, cites rising CBS output and a long-term rise in permits, says there is no sign of municipalities obstructing, and outlines the national housing agenda, regional talks and the Crisis- en Herstelwet changes, while declining to reverse the Gaswet change.
I have no indications that there are municipalities that are obstructing.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat er gemeenten zijn die «dwarsliggen».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Krol over de berichten: 'Discriminatie ouderen in vacatureteksten' en 'vacature sluit ouderen uit'

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked the government about reports that job advertisements still exclude older workers through age-related wording, and about enforcement, sanctions and possible criminal law. The State Secretary answered that age-related wording can be direct or indirect discrimination, pointed to the Inspectie SZW review, the 2018-2021 action plan and voluntary tools, and declined to commit to criminal prosecution or to a separate letter before Prinsjesdag.

As announced in my letter on tackling labour market discrimination in the temporary employment sector of 1 May 2018 and in the outline letter on the 2018-2021 Action Plan of 19 July 2018, among other effective alternatives, the possibilities to strengthen the enforcement role of the Inspectorate SZW in supervising discrimination in recruitment and selection are being explored.

Zoals is aangekondigd in mijn brief «Aanpak arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie in uitzendsector» 7 van 1 mei 2018 en in de «Hoofdlijnenbrief Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie 2018–2021» 8 van 19 juli 2018, wordt, naast andere effectieve alternatieven, verkernt wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de handhavende rol van de Inspectie SZW met betrekking tot toezicht op discriminatie bij werving en selectie te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de stijging van externe inhuur bij gemeenten

An SP MP asks the Interior Minister why municipal reliance on external hired staff rose again after falling, especially in large cities, and whether a Roemer-style 10 percent cap should apply to municipalities. The minister replies that municipalities are autonomous and accountable to their councils, that external hiring can be necessary for projects, notes ministries' near-stable external hiring against the cap, and declines to extend the cap to municipalities.
Subnational governments are autonomous tiers of government that are themselves responsible for their operations and the spending of their funds, and therefore also for external hiring.
Medeoverheden zijn autonome bestuurslagen die zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering en besteding van hun middelen, en daarmee ook de externe inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de uitvoering van de moties ingediend tijdens het VAO WNT

MPs asked the Minister of Interior how she will substantiate the next WNT annual report with figures on labour mobility and public-private pay gaps, as demanded by motions from the VAO WNT debate. The Minister replied that the next report will add information on enforcement, exemption requests and stakeholder experiences, while systematic effect data will come through a sub-study programme feeding the 2020 evaluation, with results sent to Parliament as they become available.

In response to the various motions in the VAO WNT of 17 May 2018, I am meeting you and have repeatedly promised that from the next WNT annual report onward I will enrich it with more information on the effects of the WNT.

Naar aanleiding van de diverse moties in het VAO WNT van 17 mei 2018 kom ik u tegemoet en heb ik bij herhaling toegezegd dat ik vanaf de eerstvolgende WNT-jaarrapportage deze zal verrijken met meer informatie over de effecten WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het bericht dat meer dan 100 Nederlandse studenten hun kamer moeten verlaten voor internationale studenten

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that over 100 Dutch students must leave their rooms in the former Bijlmerbajes to make way for international students, and whether this is undesirable and what will be done. The ministers answered that the temporary housing is additional capacity once converted, that the affected students were told their stay was temporary, that they will be asked to help find alternatives, and that they know of no other similar cases.
Only once this location has been made suitable for international students do the rooms count as extra capacity on top of the existing supply.
Pas op het moment dat deze locatie geschikt is gemaakt voor internationale studenten, tellen de kamers als extra capaciteit op het bestaande aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Rijke huurder krijgt geld terug’

MP Nijboer asked the ministers about a report that the Tax Authority wrongly supplied tenants' income data to landlords before 2016, and whether rent increases based on that data must be reversed or compensated. The minister answered that the legal basis dates from 2013, that the Finance Minister is appealing a court ruling on the pre-2016 data, that she does not consider the Council of State ruling to invalidate those rent increases, and that individual civil cases are pending.

I am of the view that the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State does not mean that it must be concluded that the income-dependent (higher) rent increases of 2013 through 2015 were not validly agreed.

Ik ben van mening dat de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State niet tot gevolg heeft dat geconcludeerd moet worden dat de inkomensafhankelijke (hogere) huurverhogingen van de jaren 2013 tot en met 2015 niet rechtsgeldig overeengekomen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de schadevergoeding van Belastingdienst in verband met inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked about the consequences of a court ruling that the Tax Authority must pay damages to a tenant for wrongly disclosing income data to a landlord for income-dependent rent increases, and whether affected rents should be reversed. The minister answered that the government disagrees with the ruling and has appealed, does not believe rents should be reduced to 2012 levels, and sees no reason to start talks with those affected and the Woonbond.

How many households actually received a higher income-dependent rent increase is not known to me, because it is up to landlords whether or not to use the option of an income-dependent (higher) rent increase.

Voor hoeveel huishoudens daadwerkelijk een inkomensafhankelijke hogere huurverhoging is toegepast is mij niet bekend, omdat het aan verhuurders is om al dan niet gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheid tot inkomensafhankelijke (hogere) huurverhoging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat statushouders nog altijd met voorrang een woning krijgen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior whether it is unacceptable that refugees with status still receive priority for social housing, and whether this can be stopped given that Dutch citizens wait years. The Minister answered that since 2017 municipalities decide locally whether to treat status holders as a priority category, that it reflects local housing conditions and the municipal housing obligation, and that everyone is treated equally regardless of nationality.

After the mandatory urgency status of status holders was removed from the Housing Act on 1 July 2017, municipalities can themselves determine which categories of housing seekers they wish to include as an urgency category in the housing ordinance.

Nadat de verplichte urgentiestatus van statushouders per 1 juli 2017 uit de Huisvestingswet is gehaald kunnen gemeenten zelf bepalen welke categorieën woningzoekenden ze als urgentiecategorie in de huisvestingsverordening wensen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat president Erdogan de Turkse Nederlanders per brief oproept om op zijn partij te stemmen

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether Erdogan's letter urging Turkish Dutch citizens to vote for his party was acceptable, how Turkish parties obtained voter data, and what the government would do about it. The minister said the letter is inappropriate as an implicit voting recommendation but legal, that voter lists were lawfully obtained from Turkish authorities, and that the government would raise the matter with Turkey if diaspora politics crossed legal limits.
The cabinet considers it inappropriate that Dutch citizens receive a letter from the Turkish president calling on them to vote in the Turkish parliamentary and presidential elections.
