Het kabinet vindt het ongepast dat Nederlandse burgers een brief ontvangen van de Turkse president met een oproep om te gaan stemmen voor de Turkse parlements-en presidentsverkiezing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Koopmans over de brief van de Turkse president Erdogan inzake de Turkse verkiezingen

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Koopmans asked the government about a letter from Turkish President Erdogan to Turkish voters in the Netherlands before the 2018 Turkish elections, including who supplied the address data, whether the Dutch data protection authority investigated, and whether Turkish election signs on Dutch motorways were justified. The government answered that the letter was not a literal voting instruction but was inappropriate, that address lists can be obtained in Turkey under Turkish law, that the data protection authority acted independently and the GDPR does not apply, and that local authorities handled the signs and no disclaimer will be added.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority is an independent supervisory body that itself determines which investigations it carries out.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf bepaalt welk onderzoek zij uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Limburg waarin staat dat ook ‘geslacht is niet kunnen worden vastgesteld’ in de geboorteakte mag komen te staan?

An MP asked the ministers whether, following a Limburg court ruling, a birth record may state that a child's sex could not be determined, and whether people should be able to register as gender-neutral. The minister said the question is on the agenda of the advisory commission on civil status, will consider next steps after the commission's findings and legal, financial and ICT implications, and gave no commitment to a legislative change yet.
The findings of the Commission will be taken into account when considering, together with my fellow ministers, possible further steps.
De bevindingen van de Commissie zullen worden betrokken bij het bezien, samen met mijn collega bewindspersonen, van mogelijke nader te zetten stappen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Ronnes over aansluiting en planning van duurzame energie projecten met betrekking tot elektriciteitsnetwerken en beschermen natuur, landschap en vruchtbare landbouw

MPs from the CDA asked the Economic Affairs minister about grid connection delays for renewable energy projects, the statutory connection deadlines and sanctions, planning coordination with regional governments, and protecting nature, landscape and farmland from solar parks. The minister answered that the 18-week deadline is increasingly exceeded for some connections, that no sanctions have been imposed to date, and that regional energy strategies and the national environment vision will address spatial coordination.
For connections to the low and medium voltage grid there is no uniform recording of exceedances of the deadlines.
Voor aansluitingen op het laagspannings- en middenspanningsnet is er geen uniforme vastlegging van overschrijdingen van de termijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat er een zwarte lijst komt voor frauduleuze aanbieders van bedevaarten naar Mekka

An MP asked the government about reports of a blacklist for fraudulent Hajj travel providers, whether consumers are adequately protected, and whether the regulator and prosecutor should be alerted. The state secretary said existing consumer protection rules are sufficient, that organising the market is not a government task, and that the signal was passed to the ACM, which is independent in setting its enforcement priorities.
I have meanwhile passed this signal on.
Ik heb inmiddels dit signaal doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gratis zonnepanelen voor huurders

Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporations should install solar panels on rented homes without rent increases, how many social rental homes have panels, whether corporate reserves could fund over a million panels, and why panel costs can be passed on through service charges. The minister answered that such choices are local matters for corporations, tenants and municipalities, gave Aedes figures for 67,900 corporation homes with panels, estimated capacity from non-DAEB reserves with caveats, and explained the legal tenant-consent rules (70% for complexes) without committing to change the rules.
I see no reason to actively steer the agreements made locally on this.
Ik zie geen reden om actief te gaan sturen op de afspraken die hierover lokaal gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het pleidooi van gemeenten voor een landelijk vuurwerkverbod

The MP asks whether the government will adopt a nationwide fireworks ban as urged by municipalities and the Safety Board, whether the VVD blocked it, and how it views local measures and the 'waterbed effect'. The ministers answer by referring to their 8 June letter explaining why they chose not to implement the Safety Board's ban now, say they are consulting the VNG on local regulation, and state that a ban on certain fireworks is not excluded if the measures prove ineffective after evaluation.
Should it turn out that these measures do not lead to the desired result, a ban on certain types of fireworks is not ruled out.
Mocht blijken dat deze maatregelen niet tot het gewenste resultaat leiden, dan is een verbod op bepaalde typen vuurwerk niet uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het gebruik van de dienstauto, in relatie tot transparantie en verantwoording afleggen aan de Kamer

The MP Öztürk asked the Minister of Interior about the use of the Speaker's official car, including who may ride along, requests for travel logs, cost per kilometre and the rules, linking this to transparency toward parliament. The Minister answered that the Tweede Kamer itself is responsible for correct use under the relevant law and tax rules, so the requested information is not held by her ministry.
The Tweede Kamer is responsible for the correct use of the official car under the stated legal as well as fiscal frameworks.
De Tweede Kamer is verantwoordelijk voor het correct gebruik van de dienstauto vanuit de genoemde wettelijke maar ook de fiscale kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over geluid van warmtepompen en airco’s voor omwonenden

MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked the ministers about noise from heat pumps and air conditioners affecting neighbours, including existing national rules and possible measures. The government answered that the Bouwbesluit 2012 currently sets no neighbour-protection noise rules, that it intends to add them later in 2018, and that municipalities can use APV noise provisions in the meantime.
No rules are set in the Bouwbesluit 2012 on the noise of heat pumps and air conditioners to protect neighbours.
Aan het geluid van warmtepompen en airco’s worden in het Bouwbesluit 2012 geen regels gesteld ter bescherming van omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het wethoudersbestand dat niet representatief blijkt te zijn

Parliamentary member Öztürk asked whether the low share of wethouders (aldermen) with a migration background reflects a structural problem and what the government will do about representativeness in local and mayoral appointments. The minister answered that college formation is a local matter, that she has no figures on targets, will not anticipate a study on barriers for other groups beyond disability, and describes existing diversity initiatives for mayors without committing to concrete new measures.
Coalition negotiations are a local matter. I therefore have no figures on what is being aimed for, nor insight into the considerations made locally when forming the colleges.

Collegeonderhandelingen zijn een lokale aangelegenheid. Ik heb dan ook geen cijfers over waarop wordt aangekoerst of inzicht in de afwegingen die lokaal worden gemaakt bij samenstelling van de colleges.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Nieuwbouw gebrekkig opgeleverd’

Rep. Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that new-build homes are delivered with defects, the causes, and how buyers and the housing market are protected. The Minister acknowledges rising defects, points to the Kwaliteitsborging bill strengthening buyer protection and contractor liability, and says a letter to the Eerste Kamer on resuming that bill is coming before the summer recess.
With the Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen bill I want to give a boost to improving construction quality by strengthening the position of construction consumers.
Met het wetsvoorstel Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen wil ik een impuls geven aan de verbetering van de bouwkwaliteit door de positie van bouwconsumenten te versterken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het ‘Evaluatieadvies van de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen 2018’ door de Kiesraad van 17 mei 2018

MPs Bergkamp and Den Boer asked the Minister of the Interior about the Kiesraad's 2018 evaluation advice, which again recommends letting voters with intellectual disabilities receive help from polling-station members inside the voting booth, and about the risks raised in the earlier amendment debate. The Minister answered that the ministry will examine with organisations how such help could be provided, hold a round-table in early September, and inform parliament before the end of the year.
I expect to inform the House about the outcomes of those talks before the end of this year.
Ik verwacht de Kamer voor het einde van dit jaar over de uitkomsten van die gesprekken te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Zorgtop verdient aanzienlijk minder dan vijf jaar geleden’

An MP asked whether the government will ensure the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) is applied in spirit, not just letter, after hospital Nij Smellinghe reportedly gave two directors large severance payments without disclosure because they were not formally 'topfunctionarissen'. The minister replied that WNT compliance is good, that the disclosure duty for non-top-officials' severance was removed in 2017, and that institutions decide what transparency is appropriate, without committing to new action.
Within the limits the law sets, it is up to the institutions themselves to determine what an appropriate degree of disclosure is.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet stelt, is het aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen wat een passende mate van openbaarmaking is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over regeldruk voor kleine evenementen en festivals zoals de Lauwersland Fietsvierdaagse

CDA MPs asked the government about red tape for small events and festivals, including the Lauwersland Fietsvierdaagse needing municipal permits, cost burdens, temporary structure rules, event classification and safety handbooks. The minister answered that the rules are municipal, that the cycling event goes ahead in 2018, and that the government and VNG will keep monitoring, without committing to new national rules.
I endorse the social importance of volunteer organisations and associations, such as Oranje, scouting, carnival, sports and other associations.
Ik onderschrijf het maatschappelijk belang van vrijwilligersorganisaties en verenigingen, zoals Oranje-, scouting-, carnavals-, sport- en andere verenigingen.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het ABP

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Interior Minister about the end of the ANW-compensation scheme at the ABP pension fund and what had been done since earlier postponement and promises to help affected participants. The minister answered that the scheme was extended and broadened for those uninsurable, that sectors took initiatives like ANW supplementary insurance, and declined further action because pension rules are a matter for social partners.
Are you willing to take additional action toward the ABP to still force tangible results for the affected participants?
Bent u bereid aanvullende actie te ondernemen richting het ABP om alsnog tastbare resultaten af te dwingen voor de getroffen deelnemers?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurverhogingen in aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asked ministers about rent increases imposed by housing corporations in the Groningen earthquake area on tenants whose homes are unsafe and not yet reinforced, and about compensation and reinforcement timelines. The ministers said corporations decide rent increases, tenants can seek reductions via the Huurcommissie, reinforcement plans await advisory reports, and value-loss compensation is being studied.
Rental regulations provide that tenants can go to the Rent Tribunal and that the Rent Tribunal can judge a rent increase as unreasonable
De huurregelgeving regelt dat huurders naar de Huurcommissie kunnen stappen en dat de Huurcommissie een huurverhoging als onredelijk kan beoordelen
Antwoord op vragen van lid Leijten over het bezoek van de Eurocommissaris Cretu in het kader van het cohesiebeleid en de volgende meerjarenbegroting

MP Leijten asked why the Chamber was not informed about the April 2018 meeting between Commissioner Crețu and the Dutch ministers on cohesion policy and the next MFF, whether a meeting report exists, and whether the Chamber will be informed of such meetings in future. The ministers answered that such consultations are routine, that their outcomes flow into the regular EU information channels, and that minutes will not be provided, while stating the cabinet coordinates MFF positions closely.
The cabinet does not consider it expedient or desirable to inform the Chamber of every conversation that ministers have with members of the European Commission.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun noch wenselijk om van elk gesprek dat bewindspersonen met leden van de Europese Commissie voeren, de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Utrecht stemt in met verkoop monumentale woningen door Stadsherstel Midden Nederland’ (Herdruk)

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the sale of monumental housing by Stadsherstel Midden Nederland in Utrecht, including conditions, DAEB status, loss of social rental stock and tenant protection. The minister answered that local conditions bind the sale (no sale for 10 years, rent segments set), that the Housing Act does not require such sales, that tenants keep their contracts, and that the sale is a local judgment.
The decision whether the housing corporation will sell specific monumental dwellings is made by the corporation in consultation with local parties.
De afweging of de woningcorporatie specifieke monumentale woningen zal verkopen wordt door de corporatie gemaakt in afstemming met lokale partijen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Koerhuis over crimineel geld in de Amsterdamse huizenmarkt

MPs Beckerman and Koerhuis asked whether criminal money is entering the Amsterdam housing market, how large it is, what measures exist to keep it out, and whether police have enough capacity. The Minister replied that the reports describe risks rather than established facts, pointed to an upcoming WODC study, and listed existing anti-money-laundering and RIEC cooperation measures while acknowledging police capacity is scarce.
The article, like the police unit's 'Trends and developments' report, speaks of risks rather than established facts.
Het artikel spreekt, net als het rapport «Trends en ontwikkelingen» van de politie-eenheid Amsterdam over risico’s, niet over vastgestelde feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Bosch over vergoedingen van volksvertegenwoordigers die nog altijd worden overgemaakt naar de partijkas

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether she knows of the court ruling on the Noordoostpolder SP payment arrangement and the ministry's letter urging municipalities to stop routing councillors' allowances to party coffers, and whether she will investigate and inform parliament which municipalities and provinces still follow the arrangement. The minister confirmed awareness, said the ruling binds only the parties involved and that other bodies must decide whether to follow it, and declined to investigate or send a new letter.
I have not examined which municipalities and provinces cooperate in the assignment of the allowances of elected representatives and officials to a political party's account.
Ik heb niet onderzocht welke gemeenten en provincies meewerken aan de cessie van de vergoeding van volksvertegenwoordigers en bestuurders naar de rekening van een politieke partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht ‘Gemeenten neigen nog naar monisme’

MP Den Boer asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about a study finding that about 20% of municipalities lack the prescribed council group support, that fewer than 40% have the mandated secretary instruction, the evaluation history of the dualisation act, and the government's response to Hessels' recommendations. The minister largely accepts the findings, outlines existing and planned instruments (learning environment, action programme, research into council instruments, draft law strengthening local audit offices, consultation with VNG), and commits to further consultation on the recommendations.
It is of great importance that the municipal council has sufficient support to be able to carry out its agenda-setting, supervisory and representative tasks.
Het is van groot belang dat de gemeenteraad beschikt over voldoende ondersteuning om zijn kaderstellende, controlerende en volksvertegenwoordigende taken waar te kunnen maken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Streep door 2500 studentenwoningen na ‘verraad’ ministerie’

An MP asked whether the national ministries had co-developed and then rejected a plan for 2,500 student dwellings at Uilenstede near Schiphol despite safety and health concerns, and whether the state was a reliable partner. The ministers answered that the plan was assessed under the airport zoning rules, the inspectorate refused the exemption on external safety and noise grounds, and the local objection is pending.
Because of the appeal to special circumstances, and recognising that this is a complex task, the ILT made a broader balancing of interests.
Vanwege het beroep op bijzondere omstandigheden, en het besef dat het een complexe opgave betreft, heeft de ILT een bredere belangenafweging gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat voor het eerst in haar geschiedenis de Universiteit van Amsterdam meer aanmeldingen heeft van studenten met een buitenlandse vooropleiding dan m

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether the University of Amsterdam receiving more applications from foreign-educated than Dutch-educated students raises student housing shortages, and asked about housing policy, corporation finances and a planned cap on international student housing. The minister answered that applications are not enrolments, that a joint action plan on student housing is being prepared, and that the government will not limit international student intake or housing, though the answers are largely general.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het energiezuiniger maken van woningen wat huurders meer kost

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why tenants of very energy-efficient homes sometimes pay more rather than less, and how many energy performance fees (EPV) have been agreed and at what level. The minister answered that individual cases are not tracked, that a quickscan found most tenants pay nothing or less at annual settlement, that tenants can go to the rental committee, and that she will not reconsider the EPV or introduce the promised woonlastenwaarborg yet.
In the evaluation of the law, which I am carrying out this year, I will therefore pay attention to tenants' housing costs.
In de evaluatie van de wet, welke ik dit jaar uitvoer, zal ik daarom aandacht houden voor de woonlasten van de huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Kops en Fritsma over het bericht “Miljardairsfamilie Van der Vorm koopt huizen voor Syriërs (en jij betaalt mee)”

PVV MPs asked why a Rotterdam housing initiative by the SNTR foundation reserves 200 homes for Syrian status holders, calling it discrimination against Dutch citizens, and whether such schemes should be stopped. The minister answered that the scheme responds to housing needs of status holders, that whether it constitutes discrimination is for a court to judge, and that no comparable initiatives are known; he rejected the call to restrict social housing to Dutch nationals.
Whether in this case there is also discrimination is not for the cabinet but for a judge to assess.
Of in het onderhavige geval ook sprake is van discriminatie is niet aan het kabinet, maar aan een rechter om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geluk-Poortvliet over de gang van zaken rondom het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het ABP

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Geluk-Poortvliet, CDA) asked why the government and ABP accepted that the ANW-compensation scheme's abolition was poorly communicated, with no consequences, and whether supervisors, the ABP board and pension rules were adequate. The minister answered that supervision lies with independent regulators (DNB and AFM), that the ABP board knows its scheme, that no fine was imposed and no supervisor contacted, and that a 5-year coulance scheme and a 2019 evaluation will follow, with some commitments to evaluate.
The ABP board is currently carrying out an evaluation, in which the social partners are also involved.
Het ABP-bestuur is momenteel bezig met een evaluatie, waarbij ook de sociale partners worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Özütok over “het verzoek van Friesland en Zeeland aan jongeren stemrecht vanaf 16 jaar te gunnen”

MPs Jetten and Özütok asked whether the minister would support a request from Friesland and Zeeland to trial voting at 16 in the 2019 provincial elections, and on the criteria and research behind voting age. The minister replied that no formal request was received, that the Constitution does not allow lowering the voting age even as an experiment, and that she sees no current demand for lowering it, offering instead other forms of youth participation.
The Constitution does not permit granting the right to vote to younger persons, not even by way of an experiment.
De Grondwet staat niet toe het kiesrecht toe te kennen aan jongere personen, ook niet bij wijze van experiment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Groeiend aantal gemeenten weigert contant geld aan balie’

MPs asked whether the government knows of the growing number of municipalities refusing cash at service counters, for a list of those municipalities, and how people who cannot pay by card can still pay. The minister confirmed awareness, gave a 2016 list of 21 pin-only municipalities noting others have since adopted it, and said exceptions are made in practice, such as bank transfers, authorisations or home visits, while affirming access to cash must be preserved.
There is no complete and conclusive overview of all municipalities that apply a pin-only policy at municipal public counters.
Er is geen compleet en sluitend overzicht van alle gemeenten die een pin-only beleid hanteren bij gemeentelijke publieksbalies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Ook gemeenten doen contant geld in de ban’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities refusing cash payments at counters exclude citizens, and whether she would act with the VNG and MOB. The minister confirmed about 21 municipalities went pin-only in 2016 with more since, acknowledged vulnerable groups need exceptions, and agreed to further consultation with the VNG and MOB.
Yes, I am willing to hold further consultation with the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) and the MOB on municipalities' acceptance of cash.
Ja, ik ben bereid tot nader overleg met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en het MOB over de acceptatie van contant geld door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Acht gemeenten accepteren alleen nog pinbetalingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities that accept only card payments are acceptable, given that cash is legal tender, and what citizens can do if they can only pay in cash. The minister said cash restrictions can be lawful, that exceptions must remain possible for citizens who can only pay cash, that citizens can file a complaint under the General Administrative Law Act, and that she is willing to discuss the matter with the VNG and municipalities.
I consider it important that exceptions to the pin-only policy must remain possible for citizens who can only pay with cash.
Ik acht het van belang dat uitzonderingen op het pin-only beleid mogelijk moeten blijven voor burgers die alleen met contant geld kunnen betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Arno Rutte en Beckerman over het gijzelen van een huurster in Groningen

Three MPs asked the ministers about a Groningen landlord who allegedly locked a tenant in her room by screwing the door shut, and whether such practices occur more widely. The minister declined to comment on the specific case pending investigation, called such confinement unacceptable, outlined planned action against bad landlords including sector agreements and possible legal changes, and noted that exact figures on such offences are not registered.
As long as not all the facts are known, I refrain from commenting on this specific case.
Zolang niet alle feiten bekend zijn onthoud ik mij van een reactie over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Huizenkoper bij bank duizenden euro’s duurder uit dan bij onafhankelijk adviseur’

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether a report showing bank-channel mortgage buyers pay more than those using independent advisers reflects reality, and what the government will do about competition and transparency. The minister said he cannot confirm the survey's findings, sees no signals of insufficient competition or transparency, and will examine how the advisory-cost disclosure document (dienstverleningsdocument) can be improved, with a follow-up letter to Parliament.
I cannot confirm the results of this study.
Ik kan de resultaten van dit onderzoek niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over Cambridge Analytica

An MP (Verhoeven, D66) asked ministers about Cambridge Analytica's methods, the number of Dutch Facebook users affected (up to 90,000), and whether Dutch parties use similar microtargeting. The minister answered that up to 89,373 Dutch people may have been affected, that no Dutch cases of Cambridge Analytica-style influence are known, that Dutch party microtargeting is not comparable and is subject to stricter privacy rules, and that the Raad voor het Openbaar Bestuur was asked to advise on digitalisation and democracy.
I am not aware of the exact methods of these companies, which data they had access to, or which social media platforms that personal data came from.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de exacte methodes van deze bedrijven, over welke gegevens zij de beschikking hadden, dan wel van welke sociale media platforms die persoonsgegevens afkomstig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het feit dat AOW-gerechtigden vanaf 1 juli 2017 geen extra huurverhoging meer betalen

Voortman (GroenLinks) asked why AOW recipients are exempt from the income-dependent higher rent increase and whether IVA recipients could be too. Minister Ollongren replied that the exemption reflects reduced mortgage access for older people, notes improved access since then, and declines to extend the exemption to IVA recipients, citing existing exemptions and their income.
I do not have data on how many households object to the income-dependent higher rent increase on the ground that they belong to the designated group of chronically ill and disabled persons.

Ik beschik niet over gegevens over hoeveel huishoudens bezwaar maken tegen een inkomensafhankelijke (hogere) huurverhoging op de grond dat zij deel uit maken van de aangewezen groep chronisch zieken en gehandicapten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over documentatieverplichtingen voor huurwoningen met een huur rondom de liberalisatiegrens

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Minister of Interior whether landlords may obtain tenants' income data for income-dependent rent increases when rents are above the liberalisation threshold, what protects tenants' privacy, and whether the rent tribunal could play a role. The Minister explained that landlords of regulated tenancies may request household declarations from the Tax Authority regardless of the threshold as long as the maximum rent is not exceeded, that the Tax Authority will act on complaints and may refuse repeat offenders, and that the rent tribunal has no role in this but handles rent-increase disputes.

Landlords may propose an income-dependent rent increase for all regulated tenancies, including dwellings whose current rent is around or above the current liberalisation threshold, as long as they do not exceed the dwelling's maximum rent limit.

Verhuurders mogen voor alle met een gereguleerde huurcontract verhuurde woningen, dus ook voor woningen waarvan de huidige huurprijs rond of boven de huidige liberalisatiegrens (€ 710,68 p.m.) ligt, een inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging voorstellen zolang zij daarmee de maximale huurprijsgrens van de woning niet overschrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Lange over het overmaken van de huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties

MPs Koerhuis and De Lange asked about the proposal to pay housing benefit (huurtoeslag) directly to housing corporations, its effect on debt-restructuring tenants, and the size and cost of social rental housing. The minister answered that talks with Aedes and the Tax Administration are ongoing, that direct payment is currently not used, and that outcomes cannot yet be anticipated.
I do not want to anticipate the outcome of those talks.
Op de uitkomst van die gesprekken wil ik niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht ‘Slachtoffer discriminatie woningmarkt: Het is vernederend’

MP Azarkan asked the Minister of Interior about reports of ethnic discrimination on the housing market and what the government would do, including spot-checks and enforcement. Minister Ollongren acknowledged the problem as unacceptable, pointed to complaint routes and preventive measures, and promised talks with industry bodies on good landlordship and possible regulatory changes, but declined to launch a new investigation or stronger enforcement.
I have announced that I will enter into discussion with the industry organisations to make agreements on good landlordship.
Ik heb aangekondigd het gesprek aan te zullen gaan met de brancheorganisaties om afspraken te maken over goed verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over ‘groene leningen’ voor het energieneutraal maken van woningen

An MP from the PVV asked the ministers about proposed green loans to make homes energy-neutral, including repayment terms, ownership of installations, and affordability. The government answered that a pilot in Heerhugowaard is voluntary, that details such as interest rates, terms and repayment consequences are still being studied, and that it rejects the claim that its climate policy has failed.
Details are still being worked out by the parties involved. I therefore have no insight at this stage into the interest rates, terms and other conditions.
Details worden door de betrokken partijen nog uitgewerkt. Ik heb derhalve in dit stadium geen inzicht in de rentepercentages, termijnen en andere voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over de hertelling in de gemeente Zaanstad

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Interior Minister about the recount of votes in Zaanstad, including delayed announcement of results, whether a second recount was lawful, the role of the Kiesraad representative, and possible irregularities. The minister answers that the council ordered a single recount, the results were announced a day later due to an extra check, no second recount took place, and no legal changes were required, while announcing a bill to clarify recount procedures.

I am currently preparing a proposal to amend the Electoral Act that regulates that in a case like this, where the representative body decides on a recount, the municipal polling station carries out the recount under the supervision of the representative body.

Ik bereid momenteel een voorstel tot wijziging van de Kieswet voor, dat regelt dat in een geval als dit, waarin het vertegenwoordigend orgaan tot een hertelling besluit, het gemeentelijk stembureau van de gemeente waar de hertelling aan de orde is, deze hertelling uitvoert onder toezicht van het vertegenwoordigend orgaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huurders duizenden euro’s meer moeten betalen door blokverwarming

The SP MP Beckerman asked whether tenants of a Staedion apartment complex facing large heating bills after the installation of heat meters could be helped, whether independent research into the meters and bills was warranted, and what measures would prevent such cases. The minister replied that the change to metered billing explains the higher costs, that no independent research is planned because tenants can turn to the rent tribunal and courts, and that the landlord has offered consultations and any overcharge would be refunded.
If there are indeed excessive charges, that amount will of course have to be refunded.
Mocht er overigens sprake zijn van teveel in rekening gebrachte kosten, dan zal dit bedrag vanzelfsprekend moeten worden terug betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verduurzaming van woningen

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether builders place marginal solar panels merely to meet energy norms, and whether the minister would engage the sector, municipalities, or change building rules to improve rooftop solar use. The minister said builders comply legally with permits and contracts, pointed to forthcoming BENG nearly-zero-energy requirements as the solution, and declined to add specific rules or start talks with the sector.
I will therefore not include specific requirements in the building regulations.
Ik zal daarom geen specifieke eisen opnemen in de bouwregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over de hoge OZB-rekeningen voor sportverenigingen en andere Sociaal Belang Behartigende Instellingen (SBBI)

CDA MPs asked whether municipalities charging sports clubs property tax (OZB) and then refunding it via subsidy is bureaucratic, whether non-residential OZB burdens on SBBI's are excessive, and whether the Municipalities Act should be amended to allow equal rates or an exemption. The minister answered that OZB rates and subsidies are a local democratic choice, declined to amend the law or grant a blanket exemption, and said no general judgement on burdens is possible.
An amendment of the Municipalities Act is not necessary in my view at this moment.
Een aanpassing van de Gemeentewet vind ik op dit moment niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Gemeenten misbruiken Crisis- en herstelwet’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities are misusing the Crisis and Recovery Act by adding sustainability requirements to housing projects that delay construction, and what the government will do about it. The minister rejects the claim of misuse, says sustainability and housing speed are compatible, and says she is in discussion with municipalities and provinces on speeding up housing production.
I do not share NEPROM's view that the Crisis and Recovery Act is being misused.
Ik deel de mening van de NEPROM niet dat de Crisis- en herstelwet misbruikt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het rapport inzake kernenbeleid

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior whether she would address the costs of community-level policy (kernenbeleid) after municipal mergers, including a per-village increase in the municipal fund. The Minister said the policy falls under municipal autonomy, that it is too early to change the fund distribution based on a single-municipality report, and that the issue will be considered in the periodic maintenance report and the review of financial relations.
On the basis of the report, which concerns one municipality, it is currently too early to proceed to an adjustment of the distribution.
Op basis van het rapport, dat betrekking heeft op één gemeente, is het op dit moment te vroeg om over te gaan tot een aanpassing van de verdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het vervolg van de aanpak van schimmelhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the answers to 37 sets of written questions on mould and damp housing would be forwarded to the municipalities concerned, and whether they could be answered before a committee meeting. The minister replied that the relevant answer letter and questions would be brought to the attention of the municipalities shortly, but that timing did not allow answering before the meeting.
I will bring the content of the relevant answer letter of 12 April, as well as the questions underlying it, to the attention of the municipalities concerned shortly.
Ik zal de inhoud van de betreffende antwoordbrief van 12 april jl., alsmede van de daaraan ten grondslag liggende vragen, op korte termijn onder de aandacht van de betrokken gemeenten brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Bizarre oproep: ’Maak lawaai tijdens dodenherdenking’

MPs Van der Molen and Van Dam asked whether a online call to make noise during the Dutch national Remembrance Day two-minute silence should be prevented, and whether the minister would engage Amsterdam. The minister condemned the call as disrespectful but said the local security triangle has full attention and is responsible for deciding how to respond.
It is up to them to decide how to deal with this call.
Het is aan hen om te beslissen hoe met deze oproep moet worden omgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de mogelijkheid van een Airbnb-hypotheek

MP Beckerman asked whether co-financed mortgages tied to Airbnb rental (Loftium) exist in the Netherlands, whether they should be banned, whether the government will use its tourist-rental instrument to ban them, why a platform agreement to collect tourist tax is not possible, and how platforms can be prosecuted for website violations. The minister answered that no such products are known in the Netherlands, that they are undesirable but no ban is warranted, that a platform tourist-tax agreement is not feasible, and that platforms can be prosecuted under criminal or administrative law.
Since I am not aware that such products are currently offered in the Netherlands, I see no reason for a ban.
Aangezien mij niet bekend is dat dergelijke producten op dit moment in Nederland aangeboden worden, zie ik echter geen aanleiding voor een verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Amsterdam: laat krakende asielzoekers zitten'

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asks about reports that Amsterdam is leaving squatting asylum seekers in social housing alone, and whether the government will intervene. The minister agrees squatting is illegal, says the case is left to Amsterdam authorities and the public prosecutor, and states he has no direct means to order eviction.

I take the position that the further course of the procedure toward eviction should be left to the authorities in Amsterdam, and I see no reason to enter into discussion with those authorities about it.

Ik stel mij op het standpunt het verdere verloop van de procedure tot ontruiming aan de autoriteiten in Amsterdam over te laten en zie dan ook geen aanleiding om hierover met deze autoriteiten in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Kops over het bericht dat Amsterdam krakende asielzoekers laat zitten

Two PVV MPs asked why undocumented asylum seekers in Amsterdam ('we are here') have been able to squat buildings for years, why the municipality does not enforce the squatting ban, and why they are not detained and deported. The State Secretary answered that the group is under a departure obligation, that forced return is not always possible due to missing travel documents and lack of cooperation by countries of origin, and that courts have largely upheld eviction orders, while referring to a separate letter for the specific case.
For more information on the case the news report concerns, I refer you to the letter the Minister of Justice and Security will send to your House alongside these questions.
Voor meer informatie over de casus waarop het nieuwsbericht van de Telegraaf betrekking heeft, verwijs ik u naar de brief die de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het kraken van sociale huurwoningen in Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister about squatting of social rental homes in Amsterdam, including its costs, the number and outcomes of squatting cases, state accommodation of squatters, and owners' options. The Minister gave substantive figures on Ymere's costs and prosecution statistics, rejected the idea that squatters are accommodated, and declined to collect some data or comment on foreign law.
I do not have the other requested data from the above questions.
Over de overige gevraagde gegevens van bovenstaande vragen heb ik geen beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Kuik over sugardating

MPs Van der Staaij and Kuik asked whether sugardating platforms that connect young women with wealthy men for sex amount to illegal prostitution or trafficking, whether they should be regulated or investigated, and whether municipalities can act against their advertising. The state secretary answered that no specific permit is needed, existing criminal law (art. 273f) suffices against exploitation, consultations with site operators are constructive, no indications of exploitation are known to the prosecution service, and no further investigation or new municipal powers are planned.
I currently see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hier verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over woningbouwplannen in grote stedelijke regio’s

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about housing plans in large urban regions, including the claim of a chronic shortage of plans, the choice of regions for talks, whether built-up areas can absorb future demand, and pre-financing for brownfield transformation. The minister said the claim is unsourced, explained the regional selection based on scale and spatial complexity, noted studies showing inner-city potential but limits in the long term, and said a pre-financing fund is under review.
Currently I am examining how pre-financing can accelerate the transformation of these profitable inner-city locations and how private parties can contribute to a fund for such projects.
Momenteel bezie ik hoe voorfinanciering de transformatie van deze rendabele binnenstedelijke locaties kan versnellen en hoe private partijen kunnen bijdragen aan een fonds voor dergelijke projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht 'Hoe mooi zou het zijn, een chip bij de geboorte'

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a news report on a 'digital identity chip at birth' and the VNG's Taskforce Samen Organiseren, including its membership, funding, pilots and privacy safeguards. The state secretary said the VNG had corrected the article, denied any plan to implant chips, described the Taskforce and its pilots, and stated the BRP modernisation is not directly linked to the Taskforce.
The article does not speak of implanting a chip at birth, but of assigning a digital identity at birth.
In het artikel wordt niet gesproken van het implanteren van een chip bij geboorte, maar van het toekennen van een digitale identiteit bij geboorte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht

An MP from the CDA asked ministers about leasehold (erfpacht) disputes in Amsterdam, including court costs, the legal status of the Amsterdam switch scheme to perpetual leasehold, whether it amounts to an insurance product requiring AFM oversight, and the financial burden on homeowners. The minister answered that courts remain open at manageable cost, that the scheme is a contractual arrangement not an insurance product so the AFM has no role, and that the municipality offered a calculator tool and a financial safety net.
It is up to the leaseholder, possibly after obtaining legal advice on his case, to decide whether he wants to bring proceedings against the municipality.
Het is aan de erfpachter om – eventueel na het inwinnen van juridisch advies over zijn zaak – te beslissen of hij een procedure tegen de gemeente wil voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Omtzigt en Lodders over het btw-nummer van zzp’ers dat het burgerservicenummer bevat

MPs Van der Molen, Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether the VAT number of sole traders contains the citizen service number (BSN) and whether this is lawful under privacy rules, and asked the government to stop including the BSN in new VAT numbers. The State Secretary of Finance answered that the BSN is part of the VAT number for natural persons for historical and EU-specification reasons, that a legal basis exists under the Wabb and Wet op de omzetbelasting, and that he is open to a different VAT number format, with information to the House before summer 2018 but declined to report on the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
I cannot make any statement about the status of the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de beveiliging van mevrouw El-Rhazoui

An MP asked the Minister whether the Dutch state should have provided protective security for Zineb el-Rhazoui, who was threatened and speaking at De Balie, and why the NCTV and police judged Dutch protection unnecessary. The government answered that the local authority took appropriate measures based on threat assessments, that the NCTV advised negatively on the bodyguards' firearm permits, and that the state will protect people's free speech when threats warrant it.
The local competent authority decided to take appropriate measures.
Het lokaal bevoegd gezag heeft besloten tot het treffen van passende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geluk-Poortvliet over het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het ABP

MPs Omtzigt and Geluk-Poortvliet asked about the abolition of the ANW compensation scheme at the ABP pension fund, including communication failures, the five-year limit on the hardship arrangement, and whether a duty of care applies to risk coverage. The minister acknowledged communication was unfortunate and insufficient, defended the five-year limit and the abolition as a joint social-partner decision, and declined to ask the AFM for an investigation.
I am also not willing to ask the ABP to remove this five-year term.
Ik ben ook niet bereid het ABP te verzoeken deze vijfjaarstermijn te schrappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over corporatiedirecteuren die boven de norm verdienen

MPs Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about housing corporation directors earning above the statutory pay norm (WNT), including why transitional rules permit overruns, whether seven top officials repaid excess pay, whether transitional rules will be shortened, and whether corporation directors should fall under the collective labour agreement. The minister answered that transitional rules protect property rights under the ECHR, that five of seven officials have repaid excess pay with the other two still pending and monitored by the supervisor, that no early phase-out is planned, and that the CAO question is for social partners, not the cabinet.
The WNT offers the possibility to impose an order subject to a penalty payment on the corporation.
De WNT biedt de mogelijkheid aan de corporatie een last onder dwangsom op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over voorbehoud van financiering en bouwkundige keuring bij de aankoop van woningen

MP Ronnes asked the Minister of the Interior about the use of financing and structural survey contingencies in house purchases, especially in Amsterdam where notaries draft purchase agreements and the survey clause is reportedly not used. The Minister said the ongoing study does not examine who drafts the contract, that talks with the notarial body are underway with an update promised, and that there are no statutory quality requirements for building surveyors while encouraging sector initiatives.
I will inform you about this.
Antwoord op meerdere vragensets van het lid Beckerman over schimmelhuizen in diverse gemeenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about mould-affected rented homes at two addresses in Middelstum, the housing corporation's response, tenants' remedies, and whether the ministry should conduct nationwide research and a national action plan. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, described the existing tenant remedies (complaints committee, Huurcommissie rent reduction, municipal building supervision, kantonrechter) and corporation-sector initiatives, and said the WoON 2018 survey will count mould-affected dwellings with results to be sent to parliament in early 2019.
As Minister I do not intervene in individual cases, as also indicated in answers to earlier parliamentary questions.
Als Minister treed ik niet in individuele casuïstiek, zoals ook in antwoorden op eerdere Kamervragen is aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het woningtekort onder senioren

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about a reported shortage of around 100,000 suitable homes for seniors, safety risks for elderly people stuck in unsuitable homes, and government responsibility for the housing shortage. The minister disputes the 100,000 figure as unquantifiable, points to municipal duties under the Wmo and to planned national housing and care programmes, and rejects the claim that statushouders receive favoured treatment.
I do not recognise the figure of 100,000 homes.
Het getal van 100.000 woningen herken ik dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Hypotheekkeurslijf nekt starters en senioren’

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the minister about a report that the mortgage rules leave starters and seniors without loans and about a Vereniging Eigen Huis study finding lenders underuse the room for tailored mortgages (maatwerk). The minister acknowledged the differences between lenders, said the platform on maatwerk found clarity had improved after the AFM's clarification, and that evaluation results will be sent to parliament before summer.
The outcomes of the platform are currently being evaluated. The House will be informed about the outcomes before the summer.
De uitkomsten van het platform worden momenteel geëvalueerd. De Kamer zal voor de zomer over de uitkomsten worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Tony van Dijck over het bericht ‘Hypotheekkeurslijf nekt starters en senioren’

MPs Kops and Tony van Dijck asked whether mortgage lenders deliberately refuse maatwerk (tailored) mortgages to starters and seniors, whether strict rules deter lenders, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that lenders choose whether to offer maatwerk for commercial reasons, that the platform maatwerk has improved clarity, that about 43% of lenders now offer it, and promised to inform parliament before the summer after evaluating the outcomes with the sector.
I will inform you about this before the summer.
Ik zal u voor de zomer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het rapport van de CTIVD over de AIVD en het gebrek aan privacy bij informatie-uitwisseling

An MP asked why the minister did not inform parliament or the public about a CTIVD report on the AIVD's unlawful sharing of information with other services before the referendum on the new intelligence act, and whether the report changes views on that law. The minister replied that the report was sent within the statutory six-week period, that it concerns the current law, and that it does not cast the new Wiv2017 in a different light.
The report, including the policy response, was sent to the House shortly after the deadline on Wednesday 28 March.
Het rapport, inclusief beleidsreactie, heb ik kort na de deadline op woensdag 28 maart naar de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Utrecht geeft Qatar 23 miljoen euro cadeau'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that Utrecht gave 23 million euros to Qatar and Credit Suisse via the sale of social rental homes in Kanaleneiland, including whether the sales of homes for 0 euro were acceptable and whether the Aw should investigate Mitros and Portaal. The Minister rejected the characterization of a 23 million euro gift, said the Aw found the sales served housing interests with no sale at 0 euro, and left further conditions and judgment of the municipal council's conduct to Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over asbest bij onderhoud en renovatie van huurwoningen

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked about tenants' rights during renovations of rental housing, including asbestos removal, relocation housing, and whether asbestos removal in Utrecht Overvecht was done without adequate protection. The government answered that tenants have a strong legal position, that landlords must ensure safety and assess asbestos, that disputes can go to court, and that it declines to share inspection reports, which the municipalities or housing corporation control.
It is up to the municipalities or housing corporation Portaal to share the reports with third parties.
Het is aan de gemeenten of woningbouwcorporatie Portaal om de rapporten met derden te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over de gevolgen voor bewoners tijdens renovaties

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the minister about tenant rights and living conditions during housing renovations, including temporary housing, compensation for damage, nuisance duration, asbestos, toilet facilities, and tenant participation. The minister answered that tenants have legal rights to compensation and temporary housing where relocation is objectively necessary, that disputes can go to court, and that existing rules suffice, while encouraging agreements between landlords and tenants.
There is therefore an independent procedure for disputes over temporary replacement housing during renovation work.
Er bestaat dus een onafhankelijke procedure voor geschillen over tijdelijke vervangende woon- of verblijfruimte tijdens renovatiewerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het rapport "Demonstratierecht onder druk"

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Minister of Interior about the Ombudsman's report on the right to demonstrate, including municipal bans on demonstrations, the Wom's adequacy for spontaneous disorder, and the effect of local political colour. The Minister broadly endorses protecting the right to demonstrate, promises a letter before the summer recess after talks with mayors, but declines to investigate municipal ban practices, saying responsibility lies with local authorities.
Respecting freedom of demonstration must take priority for local authorities, even when facilitating or banning a demonstration is politically sensitive.
Het respecteren van de demonstratievrijheid dient voor het lokale gezag voorop te staan, ook als het faciliteren of juist verbieden van een demonstratie politiek gevoelig ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Gemeenten: laat ons discrimineren op leeftijd'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary about municipalities wanting exemption from the ban on age-based rejection of applicants, the legal basis for youth-unemployment age measures, generatiepact limits, and preferential hiring rules. The state secretary answered that age distinctions were permitted only under a legally anchored labour-market policy, that municipalities could target the 18-27 age group in vacancy texts until 1 January 2018, and that the government would invest in attracting young employees.
Selecting on age is, however, as I already indicated in my answer to question 2, only possible where there is statutorily anchored employment or labour-market policy.
Selecteren op leeftijd is evenwel, zoals ik reeds heb aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 – alleen mogelijk als sprake is van wettelijk verankerd werkgelegenheids- of arbeidsmarktbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Raak over “het gebrek aan informatie van gemeenten aan burgers door ondoorzichtige bestuurlijke constructies als Zeestad in Den Helder”

An MP asked why citizens of Den Helder must go to court to obtain information about the Zeestad theatre company, and whether such private-law vehicles escape freedom-of-information and council oversight. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, explained the Wob applies only to public bodies or private bodies under decisive municipal influence, and pointed to the council's audit committee and existing guidance while saying no overview of comparable constructions exists.
The Zeestad case is currently before the court. For that reason I do not consider it appropriate to make statements about it now.
De casus-Zeestad is momenteel onder de rechter. Ik acht het om die reden niet opportuun daar nu uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over het objectieve verdeelmodel Wmo en Jeugd in relatie tot doelmatig medicijngebruik

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked whether the medicine-use distribution criterion in the Wmo and Youth social domain fund penalises municipalities like Asten that prescribe medicines efficiently, and what will be done about it, including timing of the evaluation and compensation. The minister answered that the criterion fits average municipal costs, that individual compensation does not fit the integrated approach, that a qualitative evaluation is complete with a quantitative follow-up to be decided, and that best-practice sharing is encouraged.
Once this research is completed, I will present the research report to your House.
Zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond, zal ik het onderzoeksrapport aan uw Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het wantrouwen van gemeenten in beleggers van middenhuurwoningen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about municipalities' distrust of investors in mid-rent housing, the 40% fear of quick resale, use of land allocation and zoning tools, liveability and debt-relief goals, and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the housing shortage, pointed to private agreements, the Expertteam Woningbouw and local round tables, and said the policy is a local responsibility with support offered.
Housing and land policy is a local matter.
Het woon- en grondbeleid is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Leijten over nepnieuwsbestrijders van de EU die Nederlands nieuws beoordelen maar geen Nederlands spreken

SP MPs asked why the EU's EUvsdisinfo fake-news unit, which has no Dutch-speaking staff, rates Dutch news, how its volunteer numbers and €1 million budget add up, and whether the government would distance itself from it. The minister answers that the unit's Dutch-language articles were wrongly published and rectified, that the government opposes its method and has raised it with the EEAS, and that the EU Commission is not responsible for it.
No, the cabinet will therefore carry out the motion submitted by MPs Kwint and Yesilgöz-Zegerius (Parliamentary paper 21 501-34, no. 290).
Nee, het kabinet zal daarom de motie van de leden Kwint en Yesilgöz-Zegerius (Kamerstuk 21 501–34, nr. 290 ) uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over legionella in een wooncomplex is Amsterdam Zuidoost

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of the Interior about Legionella contamination in a housing complex in Amsterdam Zuidoost, its health risks, the timing of disinfection, and temporary sanitation for residents. The Minister replied that the housing corporation Rochdale had installed legionella filter showerheads, disinfection was scheduled for 29 March with temporary toilets provided, and no further action by the government was currently warranted.
The GG&GD saw no reason for further action on its part.
De GG&GD zag geen reden voor verdere actie van haar kant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het feit dat een mantelzorger opdraait voor de kosten van een begrafenis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a caregiver paying for a deceased care recipient's funeral was intended under the Burial Act, whether municipalities could have acted differently, and whether the law should be revised. The minister said such cases are regrettable, explained that the burgomaster bears funeral costs only when no heirs or surviving relatives exist, noted municipalities have discretion to cover costs, and committed to discussing with municipalities how to make the rules better known.
The law does leave municipalities room to make their own assessment and still take the costs on their account.
De wet biedt overigens ruimte voor gemeenten om een eigen afweging te maken om alsnog de kosten voor haar rekening te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat bewoners in het aardbevingsgebied problemen ondervinden met hun hypotheek

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they would investigate and provide a remedy for Groningen homeowners facing falling home values and unsaleable homes due to earthquake risk, and whether banks are supporting them. The minister answered that banks will talk with affected owners, that CBS monitors the housing market, and that existing schemes such as the Koopinstrument, NAM value-loss scheme and Commissie Bijzondere Situaties apply, with the issue part of ongoing talks with the region.
Following the report, banks, through the Dutch Banking Association, have stated they are willing to talk with Groningen homeowners experiencing mortgage problems.

Naar aanleiding van het rapport hebben banken bij monde van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken te kennen gegeven dat zij graag in gesprek gaan met Groningse huiseigenaren die problemen met hun hypotheek ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht 'De Rotterdamse buurten knappen niet op door armen te weren'

MP Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Interior whether the Rotterdam law (Wbmgp) on selective housing allocation should be extended given evaluations showing limited or negative effects, a possible waterbed effect, stigmatisation of low-income groups and rights concerns. The Minister defended the evaluation's conclusions, judged applications on necessity, suitability, subsidiarity and proportionality, rejected suspending the measure pending further research, and pointed to the next five-yearly evaluation in 2020.
I assess the applications against the four criteria in the law, namely necessity, suitability, subsidiarity and proportionality.
Ik beoordeel de aanvragen aan de hand van de vier criteria in de wet, te weten noodzakelijkheid, geschiktheid, subsidiariteit en proportionaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat een Turks-Nederlandse vereniging in Rotterdam is besmeurd met PKK-leuzen door sympathisanten van de terroristische beweging PKK

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about the graffiti of PKK slogans on a Turkish-Dutch association building in Rotterdam, measures to protect members, and PKK demonstrations with flags. Minister Grapperhaus replied that local authorities and police are handling protection, a criminal investigation has no suspects yet, the PKK is monitored and on the terrorism sanctions list, and flag displays are regulated under the right to demonstrate.
I have viewed the defacement with abhorrence.
Ik heb met afkeer kennisgenomen van de bekladding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het artikel ‘3,7 ton voor krakers’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about reports that Amsterdam spends about 370,000 euros preparing a temporary site for ADM squatters, questioning the duration, scale, and secrecy of the decision. The minister confirms squatting is illegal, explains the civil and administrative proceedings and the Raad van State injunction, notes no comparable cases are known, and attributes the secrecy to the Amsterdam municipality.
The Amsterdam municipal executive imposed secrecy until residents near the sludge fields in North had been informed about the possible arrival of the current ADM site residents.
Het college van de gemeente Amsterdam heeft geheimhouding opgelegd tot het moment dat omwonenden van de slibvelden in Noord geïnformeerd waren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de oprichting van een dochteronderneming door woningcorporatie De Key

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about tenant opposition to housing corporation De Key creating a commercial subsidiary to take over property, questioning the exemption, the internal loan rate, consultation and tenant protection. The Minister declined to answer substantively because objections under the General Administrative Law Act are pending before the Authority for Housing Corporations, referred most questions there, and stated that the Minister does not intervene in supervisory casework.
Answering some of the questions would anticipate these legal procedures, which is undesirable.
Met het geven van antwoord op een deel van de gestelde vragen zou vooruitgelopen worden op deze juridische procedures, hetgeen onwenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het schorsen van verdachte lokale bestuurders

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether suspected local politicians in Roermond and Brunssum harm local government, whether the minister should be able to suspend them during criminal proceedings, and what legal tools exist to annul such appointments. The minister acknowledged the damage to trust, explained that councils can dismiss aldermen and that the minister is studying broader grounds for suspension and disqualification, and noted annulment of an alderman's appointment has never occurred, promising a letter on integrity measures.

I will, as also announced in my letter, examine in consultation with the Minister of Justice and Security what the possibilities are to broaden the grounds for disenfranchisement and the ban on exercising an administrative function.

Ik zal, zoals eveneens in mijn brief aangekondigd, mede in overleg met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, nagaan wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de grondslagen voor ontzetting uit het kiesrecht en het verbod op het uitoefenen van een bestuurlijke functie te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het bericht 'Gasloos vergt nieuwe regelgeving'

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether existing regulation hinders municipalities in the energy transition, whether the Omgevingswet delay and the Motion Vos-Van Veldhoven on CO2-neutral land-use strategies are being acted on, and whether the Bro and Bouwbesluit should be amended. The minister answers that legislation will be adapted (Wet voortgang energietransitie, Warmtewet, Bouwbesluit change), that municipalities can already act via the Chw experiment, but declines to amend the Bro or Bouwbesluit in the proposed way.
I therefore currently see insufficient possibilities to amend the Bro in the proposed way.
Ik zie op dit moment dan ook niet voldoende mogelijkheden om het Bro op de voorgestelde wijze aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over de risico’s van gespoten purschuim

MPs Beckerman and Van Kent asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that workers and a family became ill from sprayed PUR foam, and how responsibility and damages should be handled. The minister answered that employers and the installing firm are primarily responsible, victims can pursue civil claims, and the diagnostic protocol was co-funded by the sector, but declined to recognise damage and did not answer the question on the sector's influence in full detail, and refused to answer within 48 hours.
It is not for me to recognise damage.
Het is niet aan mij om schade te erkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over het bericht dat blindend en slechtzienden in Den Haag kunnen stemmen voor de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen

Two D66 MPs asked whether blind and visually impaired voters in The Hague can vote independently in the 2018 municipal elections using a template and audio support, and whether every municipality should offer this, including talks with the VNG. The minister confirmed the template is permitted for municipalities but declined to press for national rollout before The Hague's pilot is evaluated, promising to inform parliament on accessibility measures soon.
I therefore consider it still too early to discuss with the VNG before the 21 March council elections whether this approach can also be followed in other municipalities.
Ik vind het daarom nog te vroeg om al vóór de raadsverkiezingen van 21 maart met de VNG te bespreken of deze werkwijze ook in andere gemeenten kan worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Kops over statushouders die sociale huurwoningen bezet houden

PVV MPs Fritsma and Kops asked how many social rental homes are occupied by status holders, whether the minister withheld this information, and whether that undermines MPs' right to ask questions. Minister Ollongren answered that the number is not centrally registered, offered only a theoretical estimate of about 38,000 homes for Syrian status holders, and said she has no exact figure.
I have no insight into how many social rental homes are currently occupied by status holders, not even after consultation with Aedes and COA.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel sociale huurwoningen momenteel worden bewoond door statushouders, ook niet na afstemming met Aedes en COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de positie van woongroepen voor ouderen

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior about the position of senior co-housing groups, including whether housing corporations selling such properties should be required to protect their continuity and whether the government will act on this. The Minister acknowledged their social value but said existing local agreement and consultation rules are sufficient and declined a national role, while promising no concrete new action.
At present I see no role for the national government to steer in such local matters.
Daarbij zie ik op dit moment geen rol voor de rijksoverheid om in dergelijke lokale aangelegenheden sturend op te treden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over nepnieuws

MPs Baudet asked the Minister of Interior about the EU East StratCom Task Force's labelling of Dutch articles as fake news, its membership, funding, criteria, and the planned NU.nl/Facebook fake-news cooperation. The Minister answered that the government does not assess article content, that it targets state-sponsored disinformation rather than 'fake news', that the Task Force's budget is EU-funded, and that there is no legal agreement or register, while declining to judge specific media outlets.
Legal proceedings have been brought regarding three of the articles in this database. I do not wish to comment on those.
Ten aanzien van drie van de berichten uit deze database is een rechtszaak aangespannen. Daar wil ik niet in treden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat de voorzitter van de Ulu moskee in Utrecht aangifte heeft gedaan tegen de PVV-lijsttrekker in Utrecht over zijn angstwekkende uitspraak over het afbr

MPs from DENK asked about a PVV lijsttrekker's remark that the Ulu mosque could burn, which made worshippers fearful, and about his employment as a municipal employee. The minister distanced himself from the remark, pointed to existing mosque security guidance and local contacts, and said the municipality of Nieuwegein must judge whether the employee's conduct breached the rules.

It is up to the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Nieuwegein, as employer and competent authority, to assess whether the political statements made by Mr Van Deún lead to the conclusion that the so-called performance norm has been exceeded.

Het is aan het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Nieuwegein als werkgever en bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of de door de heer Deún gedane (politieke) uitlatingen leiden tot de conclusie dat de zogenaamde functioneringsnorm is overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat deelde vertrouwelijke informatie van 'weggepeste' vuurtorenwachter met haar collega's’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reports that Rijkswaterstaat shared confidential, medical information about a lighthouse keeper allegedly bullied by colleagues, and about the independence of the investigating body, the role of the Labour Inspectorate, and measures against workplace bullying. The minister answered that the report was wrongly shared and excuses were given, defended ECO&P's independence, explained the Inspectorate's existing role, and described general prevention efforts and ongoing studies.
That the data on the health condition of the person concerned became known in this way should not have happened.
Dat de gegevens over de gezondheidstoestand van betrokkene hierbij bekend zijn geworden, had niet mogen gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de stijging van de lokale lasten en het COELO-rapport

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the macronorm for property tax (OZB), its history since 2008, overshoots, the role of COELO, the VNG and the Tax Administration, and the 2014 evaluation. The minister answered that municipalities decide democratically on OZB, that overshoots are offset in later years, that COELO collects only aggregate data, and that the norm will be reconsidered only when the local tax base is revised.

Based on the currently available data, aimed at applying the macronorm to the total revenues of all municipalities together, COELO does not have the data to determine the OZB revenue of individual municipalities.

Op basis van de huidige beschikbare gegevens, met als doel de toepassing van de macronorm op de totale opbrengsten van alle gemeenten tezamen, beschikt het COELO niet over de gegevens om de ozb-opbrengst van individuele gemeenten vast te stellen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van den Bosch over het bericht "Dit gaan ze niet leuk vinden, Rik’’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a newspaper report on a website built from open government pesticide data, and whether it is the ministry's role to prevent or resolve such conflicts over open-data reuse in the digitalisation strategy. The minister answered that open data should be freely reusable by anyone, with or without profit, that the state remains responsible for its own use of data, and that the policy will not be changed.
Open data are made available without imposing requirements on their use by third parties.
Open data worden beschikbaar gesteld zonder eisen te stellen aan de toepassing door derden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Kuzu over het bericht dat vier Marokkaanse Nederlanders onderwerp van een arrestatiebevel zijn van het Marokkaanse openbaar ministerie

DENK MPs asked whether four Dutch-Moroccans are subject to arrest warrants from Morocco's prosecutor over Rif protests, what contact the Netherlands had with Moroccan authorities, and how the Netherlands would refuse unjustified extradition or legal-assistance requests. The government replied that Morocco said these were witness summonses rather than arrest warrants, that it cannot say more than it knows, that each request is assessed case by case under Dutch law and the ECHR including free expression, and that it raised the treatment of detained demonstrators with Moroccan ministers.
Legal assistance and extradition requests are always assessed case by case and in compliance with Dutch law and international treaties.
Rechtshulp- en uitleveringsverzoeken worden altijd per geval en met inachtneming van de Nederlandse wet en internationale verdragen beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over onveilige cv-ketels

An SP MP asked why the government's answers on faulty Nefit cv-boilers (types B3L and B3M) did not address heat-exchanger problems, when NVWA was informed, and whether boilers meet safety rules, among other questions about a carbon monoxide study and OvV recommendations. The minister answered that the NVWA was informed of B3L heat-exchanger problems from 2012 and of B3M issues in 2016, issued a formal order to Nefit to report all incidents, and that the independent CO study and RTL-commissioned research will be shared before summer, but gave evasive or referral answers on legislation, installer training and the OvV recommendations.
The NVWA then decided to demand all information about incidents involving the B3M type.
Daarop besloot de NVWA alle informatie over incidenten met het type B3M te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over gemeentelijke herindeling in de Leidse regio

An MP asks whether the province of Zuid-Holland may impose a consistent regional end-state and grant itself power to force municipal mergers in the Leiden region, and what legal basis and remedies municipalities would have. The minister answers that the province only offers help and that a forced merger under the Arhi law is a last resort, with no objection or appeal possible against such a procedure.
No objection or appeal is possible against a merger procedure by the province under article 8 of the General Rules for Municipal Mergers Act.
Tegen een herindelingsprocedure door de provincie conform artikel 8 van de Wet algemene regels herindeling is geen bezwaar of beroep mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over voorbehoud van financiering en bouwkundige keuring bij de aankoop van woningen

The MP asks whether sellers are pressuring buyers to waive financing and structural-inspection conditions, whether a new model contract is applied, and whether buyers should always be able to demand an inspection. The minister answers that research is ongoing, contract freedom is preserved, the new model contract now includes these conditions by default, and the brokers' use of it will be checked.
