I am willing to enter into discussion with the brokers' trade organisations to ask whether they have these figures or whether they wish to investigate this differently.
Ik ben bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de brancheorganisaties van makelaars om hen te vragen of zij deze cijfers hebben of dit anders te willen onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘voorbereiding kernramp kan beter’

MPs Ploumen and Van Dijk asked whether the government accepts the Safety Board's findings that the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany are inadequately prepared for a nuclear disaster, and how it will improve information to the public and cross-border cooperation. The state secretary accepts the Board's recommendations, promises a cabinet response with specific measures, says the ANVS will make incident information more accessible, and says cross-border issues will be raised in bilateral talks.
I endorse the recommendations of the OVV.
Ik onderschrijf de aanbevelingen van de OVV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het aanstellen van dhr. M. Franco als regeringscommissaris op St. Eustatius

An MP asked the State Secretary why a Curaçao-born candidate was appointed government commissioner on St. Eustatius rather than a Dutch-based administrator, and whether a Dutch commissioner should be appointed. The State Secretary answered that the appointee holds Dutch nationality, that the functions were filled with people from both the Caribbean and European Netherlands, and that administrative experience was a key requirement.
Mr. Marcolino (Mike) Franco holds Dutch nationality and originates from Curaçao.
Dhr. Marcolino (Mike) Franco heeft de Nederlandse nationaliteit en is afkomstig uit Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Middendorp en Özütok over het bericht 'Je uitvaart kan een stuk duurzamer maar het mag nog niet'

Three MPs (Den Boer, Middendorp, Özütok) asked the Minister of Interior whether citizens should have more freedom in funeral methods, such as resomation, given environmental benefits and public support, and whether an impact assessment would be conducted. The Minister answered that careful study of ethics, environment and worker safety is needed first, referred to a completed TU Delft report, and promised to inform parliament in the second half of 2018 on policy proposals.
I expect to be able to inform your House further in the second half of 2018 about policy proposals regarding funeral practices in the Netherlands.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in de tweede helft van 2018 nader te kunnen informeren over beleidsvoorstellen met betrekking tot de lijkbezorging in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over schimmel in huurhuizen in Haarlem

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about mould and neglected maintenance in around 200 social rental homes in Haarlem owned by Ymere, and whether tenants should keep paying full rent. The minister acknowledged Ymere delayed renovation for about thirteen years, noted that tenants can take complaints to the Huurcommissie, and said she will raise mould problems with the housing association body Aedes and include the issue in the WoON 2018 survey.
Ymere subsequently chose, for various reasons including financial ones, to postpone the renovation.
Ymere heeft daarna echter om verschillende redenen, waaronder financiële, de keuze gemaakt om de renovatie uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitzending ‘2Doc: liever dood dan vermist’

MP Van Haga asks ministers about a documentary on unrecovered WWII aircraft wrecks, including the municipal discretion over salvage, cost sharing, and calls for harmonisation. The government acknowledges the emotional concerns, defends municipal discretion on safety and public order grounds, notes a 70% Rijk contribution and a working group on a decision framework, but does not change the rules.
The national government is willing to contribute to harmonising municipal policy.
Het Rijk is bereid een bijdrage te leveren aan het harmoniseren van het gemeentelijk beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over de televisie-uitzending ‘Liever dood dan vermist’

MPs Van der Molen and Van der Graaf asked ministers about a TV documentary on missing WWII airmen and whether municipalities can be induced to recover aircraft wrecks. The government answers that recovery is a local decision, that it lacks an overview of refused requests, that it will help harmonise municipal policy via a framework being developed, and that the framework is delayed by complexity and many parties.
The central government has no overview of that.
Daar heeft de rijksoverheid geen overzicht van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het door ‘EU vs Disinfo’ bestempelen van journalistieke verslaggeving tot nepnieuws

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister why the EU's EU vs Disinfo unit labelled a journalist's report on a political event as fake news, and whether this endangers press freedom. The minister replied that the unit's task is to identify and rebut disinformation without targeting journalists, that journalists are responsible for how they report, not for what is said at events, and refused to ask the EU to stop funding the unit.

It is important, however, that these actions focus on identifying, naming and factually refuting disinformative (elements of) reporting, and not on identifying and naming journalists and their journalistic reporting as disinformation.

2 Het is hierbij wel zaak dat deze acties zich richten op het identificeren, benoemen en feitelijk weerleggen van desinformerende (elementen van) berichtgeving en niet op het identificeren en benoemen van journalisten en hun journalistieke verslaglegging als zijnde desinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over doorstroming en drukte bij maatschappelijke opvang

MPs Beckerman and Kooiman asked about shortages and slow move-on in women's shelters and emergency homelessness shelters, including Groningen's reduced capacity and the lack of affordable housing for shelter residents. The minister responded that a working group with several ministries and municipal follow-up will address bottlenecks from the Ombudsman's report, municipalities will carry local responsibility for housing and capacity agreements, and a multi-year agenda on sheltered housing is being developed.
Currently, work is underway to set up this working group.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan het opzetten van deze werkgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over de risico’s voor de volksgezondheid van gespoten purschuim

Two SP members asked the Ministers of Interior and of Social Affairs about health risks of sprayed polyurethane foam insulation, including whether residents are protected, whether certified firms follow the 2013 guidelines, and whether isocyanates are listed as substances of very high concern. The Minister replied that TNO and RPS studies did not establish causality but precautions were taken, that the Bouwbesluit 2012 will be amended to require residents to leave and forced ventilation, that a diagnostic protocol exists, and that the REACH restriction proposal is pending.
I therefore want to include this as a requirement in the Bouwbesluit 2012.
Ik wil dit daarom als eis opnemen in het Bouwbesluit 2012.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gevaar van rechts-extremisme

An MP asked the Ministers of Interior and Justice whether the prosecutor had pursued an Erkenbrand visitor's statements under criminal provisions on group insult and incitement, whether a complaint had been filed, and whether AIVD informs political parties about candidates posing a threat to the democratic legal order. The Minister replied that a complaint is not known to the OM, that further investigation is for the prosecutor to decide independently, and that AIVD can inform a party chair via an official report, without commenting on individual cases.
The OM is, however, not aware of a complaint, so further (investigative) research is in principle not called for.
Het OM is echter niet bekend met een aangifte, zodat nader (opsporings)onderzoek in beginsel niet in de rede ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de nasleep van de brand in de Grenfell Tower in Londen

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the Hogeschool Rotterdam building closure over cladding fire risk, lessons from the Grenfell Tower inquiry, and how building material fire safety and quality are ensured in the Netherlands. The minister answered that municipalities and builders are responsible under the Bouwbesluit 2012, that no large-scale deviations in fire-safety cladding are known, and pointed to the pending Kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen bill.
However, I have no indications that this occurs on a large scale when it comes to the fire safety of facades.
Ik heb echter geen aanwijzingen dat dit op grote schaal plaatsvindt als gaat om de brandveiligheid van gevels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Lodders over het bericht ‘Kans op onnodig betalen van leges steeds groter’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities may charge permit fees under outdated, unextended zoning plans, which the Wro prohibits after ten years, and how overcharged businesses can be compensated. The Minister says such fees are unlawful and disapproves of them, but places the duty to ensure valid grounds and to remedy overcharging mainly on municipalities and provinces, without estimating the scale.
Article 3.1, fourth paragraph of the Wro clearly provides that it is not permitted to collect leges when the zoning plan is more than ten years old.
In artikel 3.1, vierde lid van de Wro is duidelijk bepaald dat het niet is toegestaan om leges in te vorderen wanneer het bestemmingsplan meer dan tien jaar oud is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat ook in Nederland gebouwen staan die, net als de afgebrande Grenfell-toren in Londen, zijn bekleed met brandonveilige gevelpanelen

An MP from the SP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about whether fire-unsafe cladding panels like those on Grenfell Tower are used in Dutch buildings, how municipal inspection of cladding works, and whether rules should be tightened. The Minister answered that such panels are mainly used in non-residential buildings, that the Building Decree 2012 already regulates fire safety, that municipal inspection is sample-based and builders bear primary responsibility, and that the Kwaliteitsborging bill is the planned improvement.
The English investigation report into the Grenfell fire is not yet available.
Het Engelse onderzoeksrapport naar de Grenfell brand is nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over gebouwen met brandgevaarlijke gevelpanelen in Nederland

MP Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Interior Minister about buildings with fire-hazardous facade panels across the Netherlands and the government's role in addressing it, including whether municipal building files and the Quality Assurance Act would fix oversight gaps. Minister Ollongren said primary responsibility lies with builders and owners, municipalities enforce, and she will await the Grenfell inquiry before considering measures, while pointing to the pending Quality Assurance Act and promising to send a separate letter on its status.
Because the problem is national in scope, there is also a role for me as systems-responsible minister for building regulation.
Omdat er sprake is van een landelijke problematiek, ligt er ook een rol voor mij als stelselverantwoordelijke voor de bouwregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over gebouwen met brandgevaarlijke panelen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch buildings have fire-hazardous facade panels like those in Grenfell Tower, and whether the government will identify such buildings and hold municipalities accountable. The minister answered that ACM panels are mainly used in non-residential buildings, that about five existing buildings have non-compliant facades owned by building owners who are investigating, and that she will await the Grenfell inquiry before deciding on further measures, without publicly naming buildings.
The municipal competent authority itself decides whether it is opportune to communicate externally about the signals it has received or observed itself.
Het gemeentelijk bevoegd gezag bepaalt zelf of het opportuun is om extern te communiceren over de signalen die zij heeft ontvangen of zelf heeft opgemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Lage straf door trage rechtsgang'

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that sentences were reduced because criminal cases took too long, and what causes the delays and what will be done. The ministers acknowledged that reasonable-term breaches can reduce sentences, cited capacity shortages and reported measures such as ZSM, the Verkeerstoren and extra judges in the north, while stating that no registration of such overruns exists.
The court and the Public Prosecution Service do not keep records of exceedances of the reasonable time limit and the consequences attached to them.
De rechtbank en het OM houden geen registratie bij van overschrijdingen van de redelijke termijn en welke gevolgen daaraan zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat aardbevingsdemonstranten politiebezoek kregen voorafgaand aan een geplande protestactie

Beckerman (SP) asked whether police visited earthquake-protest demonstrators at home before a planned action against NAM, based on a Facebook event list, and whether this was proportionate and a breach of the right to demonstrate. Minister Grapperhaus replied that home visits to gather information on possible public-order risks are normal police work under the mayor's responsibility, that the Groningen mayor said the method could have been less intrusive, and that the police chief spoke with the citizens concerned.
Actively contacting the persons involved following such signals by the police is one of the options for this and forms part of normal police work.
Het actief contact opnemen door de politie met betrokkene(n) naar aanleiding van dergelijke signalen is daartoe een van de mogelijkheden en maakt deel uit van het normale politiewerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Meer gemeenten ruilen e-mail om voor online formulier’

An MP asked whether municipalities replacing email with online contact forms weakens accessibility, whether such forms deter citizens, whether excessive personal data (including gender) is requested, and how those without DigiD can reach government. The State Secretary answered that well-designed forms can preserve or improve accessibility, that municipalities must justify data requests under privacy law, that everyone should be able to contact government digitally and a right to digital communication will be added to the General Administrative Law Act, and that he is willing to discuss the topic with municipal, provincial and water board associations.
I am of the view that everyone must be able to contact the government digitally.
Ik ben van mening dat iedereen de overheid digitaal moet kunnen benaderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het onder verscherpt toezicht plaatsen van Woonstichting Vooruitgang uit Sassenheim

An MP asks the Minister whether housing association Vooruitgang in Sassenheim was placed under enhanced supervision by the Autoriteit woningcorporaties after governance failures, the resignation of the entire supervisory board, and disputes with the director-manager, and asks about information to tenants and the municipality. The Minister confirms the enhanced supervision, explains the 2017 inspection and intervention, the board's resignation, the appointment of temporary internal supervisors, and states that financial position gives no cause for concern while the association must produce a governance recovery plan.
The Aw will also press the corporation on this and act where necessary.
De Aw zal hier ook op aandringen bij de corporatie en waar nodig handelend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman en Van Kent over het bericht dat de bouw zich niets aantrekt van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether the construction sector ignores recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) and how recurring recommendations on coordination, responsibility, safety awareness and risk assessment will be implemented. The minister acknowledges the problem, lists steps taken (guidelines, a Kwaliteitsborging bill, Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit changes, a study on a central party for site safety) and commits to further follow-up, though some recommendations remain unaddressed.
It is currently being examined how a single central party can be made responsible for safeguarding site safety at construction sites.
Er wordt momenteel nagegaan hoe één centrale partij verantwoordelijk kan worden gemaakt voor de borging van de omgevingsveiligheid bij bouwplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het door de bouwsector stelselmatig negeren van adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid

MP Van Eijs (D66) asked whether construction firms systematically ignore Dutch Safety Board (OvV) recommendations after fatal accidents, about accident registration, use of lead structural engineers, and whether the minister will consult the sector and OvV. The minister denies systematic neglect, explains existing reporting duties and the Storybuilder tool, notes that a lead engineer role is recommended but implementation is unknown, and declines a separate consultation with OvV as unnecessary.
From my previous answers you can conclude that the OvV's recommendations are being followed up and that consultation with the construction sector is taking place in this context.
Uit mijn voorgaande antwoorden kunt u opmaken dat de aanbevelingen van de OvV worden opgevolgd en dat er in dat kader met de bouwsector overleg plaatsvindt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Kwetsbaarheid voor omkoping een reëel risico’

MPs Van Oosten and Van den Bosch asked whether municipalities can adequately screen risk-sensitive officials for criminal antecedents, given reports of vulnerability to bribery and infiltration. The minister answered that VOG screening exists with a ten-year lookback for political office holders, that a study and a Netwerk Weerbaar Bestuur are underway, and that a bill extending VOG refusals to police data is in preparation, while the Bibob bureau's role would require further study.

As known to your House, I am preparing a bill under which, for certain vulnerable functions in the security domain, a VOG can be refused not only on the basis of judicial documentation but also on the basis of police data.

Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, bereid ik een wetsvoorstel voor waarbij voor bepaalde kwetsbare functies binnen het veiligheidsdomein de VOG niet alleen kan worden geweigerd op basis van justitiële documentatie, maar ook op basis van politiegegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat mensen vanaf Fort Oranje op een andere camping geplaatst worden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about residents of Fort Oranje being moved to other campsites, including whether rehousing is solved or merely displaced. The minister said municipality Zundert provides case managers and that camp placements are undesirable but tolerated temporarily for about 10 people, with national support and an evaluation to follow.

I consider it in principle undesirable that residents of Fort Oranje are rehoused on a campsite, because that housing may not meet the minimum housing requirements and residents may lose sight of care and support.

Ik acht het in principe niet wenselijk dat bewoners van Fort Oranje opnieuw op een camping worden gehuisvest, omdat daarbij de kans bestaat dat die huisvesting niet voldoet aan de minimumeisen die we aan woonruimte stellen en bewoners uit zicht kunnen raken van zorg en hulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over onveilige cv-ketels

An MP asked the government about reports that Nefit concealed defects in its boiler (TopLine/B3M) from the food and product safety regulator NVWA, and about fire and carbon monoxide risks, and whether periodic inspections should be introduced. The government denied knowledge of concealment, reported 180 incidents and 10 fires linked to the boiler, described the NVWA's oversight and corrective action, and said it would not introduce an APK inspection but would implement an installer certification scheme recommended by the Safety Board.
In 2016 the NVWA received a report from a former Nefit employee about both boiler types (B3L and B3M) indicating that the problems were more serious than previously assumed.

In 2016 werd bij de NVWA een melding ontvangen van een ex-werknemer van Nefit met betrekking tot beide typen cv-ketels (B3L en B3M) waarin werd aangegeven dat de problemen ernstiger waren dan eerder aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over (partij-) politieke propaganda in en rond het stembureau

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about party-political propaganda such as foreign flags and nationalist posters in or near polling stations, and whether election rules are adequate. The minister answered that municipalities must prevent campaigning at polling stations, the current law is adequate, and voters may attend vote counts subject to the chair's order-keeping authority, without a registration procedure.
I consider the current legislation adequate.
Ik acht de huidige wetgeving toereikend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Fritsma, De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht dat Nederlanders langer op de wachtlijst voor een sociale huurwoning moeten staan doordat statushouders en buitenlandse arbeidskrachten

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch social-rent applicants face longer waiting lists because statushouders, foreign workers and students get priority, and whether social housing should go only to Dutch nationals. The Minister said housing supply drives waiting times, that the automatic urgency status for statushouders was removed, that she has no data on how many social rentals statushouders occupy, and that allocation by nationality is ruled out under equal treatment.
I have no insight into how many social rental homes are currently occupied by statushouders.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel sociale huurwoningen momenteel worden bewoond door statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Molen en Slootweg over overfinanciering bij agentschappen en ZBO’s

MPs Van der Molen and Slootweg (CDA) asked whether agencies and zbo's are over-financed, citing a November 2017 article, and whether the government will reclaim the surplus funds. Minister Hoekstra denies the over-financing picture, citing audited 2016 annual reports showing fixed assets exceed long-term debt and reserves, and points to existing supervisory instruments, while rejecting any need to recover funds.
I do not recognise the picture that unnecessary funds go to agencies and zbo's and therefore see no need for this.
Ik herken me niet in het beeld dat er onnodige middelen naar agentschappen en zbo's gaan en zie hiervoor daarom geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurders in Groningen die in de steek worden gelaten

MP Nijboer asks whether it is acceptable that Groningen housing corporations and tenants face prolonged uncertainty over earthquake reinforcement procedures and standards, and whether the government will provide clarity and hold corporations accountable for neglected maintenance. Minister Ollongren answers that clarity is a priority, that the norm changes only when NEN makes significant improvements, that tenants can pressure corporations through existing channels, and that she is in talks with corporations, though the minister's role on specific maintenance complaints is limited to setting the framework.
The central government is therefore making every effort to remove the resulting uncertainties, for housing corporations and other stakeholders, as quickly as possible.
Het Rijk spant zich dan ook in om de ontstane onduidelijkheden, voor woningcorporaties en andere betrokkenen, zo snel mogelijk weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het opinieartikel ‘Wordt het niet tijd om Nederland iets ruimer te zien dan de Randstad? Kabinet, ik bied u Zuid Limburg’

PvdA MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about an opinion piece urging a broader view of the Netherlands beyond the Randstad, with Zuid-Limburg as a TriState growth region. The minister responds that the government will look beyond the Randstad, that regions bear primary responsibility for spatial development, and that cross-border action and the National Environmental Vision will be pursued, with an update to parliament promised in spring 2018.
The State Secretary of BZK will inform the House of Representatives in more detail on progress in spring 2018.
De Staatssecretaris van BZK zal in het voorjaar van 2018 de Tweede Kamer over de voortgang hieromtrent nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geluk-Poortvliet over de afschaffing van de ANW-compensatie door het ABP

MPs Omtzigt and Geluk-Poortvliet asked why the ABP pension fund abruptly ended ANW-compensation for survivors, whether members were informed in time, and whether the AFM should investigate the information provided. Minister Ollongren answered that the change was agreed by social partners, that members were notified and the coulance scheme was extended to 1 May 2018, but declined to commit to an AFM investigation, leaving that to the independent regulator.
This was also noted by the social partners. They asked the ABP to adjust this information.
Dit is ook geconstateerd door sociale partners. Zij hebben het ABP verzocht deze informatie aan te passen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het vervallen van de Anw-compensatieregeling bij het Algemeen Burgerlijk pensioenfonds (ABP)

Van Rooijen (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Interior whether the government supports ABP's call for social partners to create a collective insurance replacing the abolished Anw-compensation scheme, and whether ABP should postpone the change by a year. The minister answered that social partners asked ABP to extend the transitional coulance arrangement by three months to 1 May 2018, which ABP accepted, and that pension content is for employers and employees to decide.
No. Employees and employers decide on the content of the pension scheme.
Nee. Werknemers en werkgevers gaan over de inhoud van de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het bericht dat een huiseigenaar alleen wil verhuren aan ‘mensen van Nederlandse afkomst'

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether a landlord refusing to rent to people not of Dutch origin is discrimination, what victims can do, and what measures will prevent it, including whether estate agents should refuse such requests and whether the sector will be engaged. The minister answered that discrimination is prohibited, pointed to the Equal Treatment Act, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and local anti-discrimination services, noted the brokerage associations' codes of conduct, and said the issue will be raised in upcoming consultations with the sector.

In the upcoming consultations with the brokerage associations and the umbrella organisations of private landlords I will discuss whether enough attention is being paid in practice to preventing discrimination.

In de eerstvolgende overleggen met de brancheverenigingen voor makelaars en de koepelorganisaties van particuliere verhuurders zal ik in gesprek gaan over of er in de praktijk voldoende aandacht is om discriminatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Wiersma en El Yassini over het bericht 'Ernstig tekort aan bouwvakkers dreigt nu de economie weer bloeit'

MPs Koerhuis, Wiersma and El Yassini asked the ministers whether the projected shortage of 70,000 construction workers threatens the housing target and quality, and what the government will do about training, innovation and secure building pipelines. The minister answered that employers bear primary responsibility, pointed to existing measures (tax cuts on labour, Matchen op Werk, Techniekpact, UWV retraining budget, BBL subsidies), and said she would talk with stakeholders and regional parties without giving firm commitments.
The responsibility to attract sufficient qualified personnel lies primarily with the employers themselves.
De verantwoordelijkheid om voldoende gekwalificeerd personeel aan te trekken ligt primair bij de werkgevers zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over verlagen van administratieve lasten en overhead bij woningcorporaties

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether housing corporation administrative costs, overhead, personnel, maintenance and IT costs exceed those of private landlords and how they could be reduced. The minister answered that comparison data are lacking, that corporations have statutory tasks justifying certain costs, that costs have been falling since 2013, and that the sector and the Autoriteit woningcorporaties will be monitored, with a commitment to work with the sector on reducing administrative burdens.
Due to the lack of figures from private landlords and property managers, such a comparison is not possible.
Door het ontbreken van cijfers van private verhuurders en vastgoedbeheerders is een dergelijke vergelijking niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat de huurtoeslag de komende jaren flink zal dalen

PVV MPs Kops and Mulder asked whether the government knows how many of the 1.4 million rent-allowance households are in debt and how many will fall into financial trouble from cuts to the allowance, and how it can claim households will be better off. The minister answered that the allowance is not being cut but rising slightly less, that debt has multiple causes, that removing the hard income limit and tax cuts leave households better off overall, and that statushouders are treated equally.
It is not known how many of these households receive rent allowance.
Niet bekend is hoeveel van deze huishoudens een huurtoeslag ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de kosten van een lege buizen- en laadpaalnorm

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the number of parking spaces covered by the empty-conduit rule for EV charging, the estimated costs per space, the definition of major renovation, and whether the norms should apply to owner-occupied renovations. The minister said the EU trilogue deal was not yet detailed enough to answer the first question, gave cost estimates and the renovation definition, and argued the norm should apply only where parking or electrical infrastructure is part of the renovation.
Because the provisional agreement is still being worked out, I unfortunately cannot yet provide clarity on the provisions for EV charging infrastructure.
Omdat het voorlopige akkoord nog nader uitgewerkt wordt, kan ik op dit moment helaas nog geen duidelijkheid verschaffen over de bepalingen voor laadinfrastructuur voor elektrisch vervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de AIVD en het kabinet burgers misleiden

MP Van Raak asks whether the AIVD may already intercept cable communications when targeted, and why its website says the new law lets it investigate cable communication that it could not previously reach, and whether the website should be changed. The minister answers that interception of identified persons via cable is already allowed under the old law, that the new law adds power to intercept cable traffic without a specific identified target, and that the website text is accurate but has been clarified.
Because your question shows that parts of the passage may be open to multiple interpretations, the text has been further clarified.
Omdat uit uw vraag blijkt dat delen van de passage voor meerdere interpretaties mogelijk zijn, is de tekst verder verduidelijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over het bericht “Raadsleden samenwerkende gemeenten ontevreden: clubs van wethouders bepalen alles”

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a survey showing council members want more influence over inter-municipal bodies, and about democratic oversight of such bodies, including mergers and reform of the Wgr. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the Wgr would be amended to improve political accountability, and committed to a policy letter in spring 2018 and an action plan in summer 2018.
Decision-making in a joint arrangement must be transparent and the councils involved must be able to better carry out their supervisory role and intervene where necessary.
Besluitvorming in een gemeenschappelijke regeling moet transparant zijn en betrokken gemeenteraden moeten hun controlerende rol beter kunnen uitvoeren en zo nodig kunnen ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat raadsleden zich buitenspel voelen gezet

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether it is concerning that many council members do not know which inter-municipal cooperation bodies their municipality belongs to, and whether the proliferation of such bodies creates a democratic deficit that training or higher allowances cannot solve; he also asked about the benefits of municipal mergers. The Minister acknowledged the concerns, said the Wgr will be amended to improve political accountability and councils' controlling role, promised a policy letter in spring 2018 and an action plan on local democracy in summer 2018, and said the question on mergers concerns cooperation research rather than mergers and refers to an earlier reply.
Decision-making in a joint arrangement must be transparent and the councils involved must be better able to carry out their controlling role and, if necessary, intervene.
Besluitvorming in een gemeenschappelijke regeling moet transparant zijn en betrokken gemeenteraden moeten hun controlerende rol beter kunnen uitvoeren en zo nodig kunnen ingrijpen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gevaar van rechts-extremisme

An MP from the Labour party asked the Interior Minister about the threat posed by the far-right group Erkenbrand, its aim of a white ethnostate, possible criminality of racist remarks by its visitors, and infiltration of political parties. The minister answered that Erkenbrand fits the AIVD definition of far-right extremism, that existing radicalisation policy suffices, that the remarks may be punishable but no complaint has been filed, and that individual party membership is a matter for the parties.
I do not make any statements about possible individual cases.
Over eventuele individuele gevallen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘32 woonunits voor vluchtelingen in Veldhoven geplaatst’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of 32 housing units for refugees in Veldhoven, the typical wait for status holders to move from COA shelter to regular housing, and whether status holders should lose automatic priority for social housing. The minister answered that status holders wait on average five to six months, that the automatic urgency status was abolished in July 2017 leaving municipalities to decide, and that she would inform parliament on the effect if data become available.
It is currently not known to me in how many municipalities status holders are still considered a priority category.
Het is mij op dit moment nog niet bekend in hoeveel gemeenten statushouders nog als een voorrangscategorie worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het toenemend aantal gemeenten dat de permanente bewoning van vakantiehuisjes wil uitbannen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about municipalities cracking down on permanent residence in holiday homes, including high penalty payments and the risk of homelessness for residents. The minister answered that data on the number of municipalities and residents affected is not available, that enforcement is a municipal matter, and that the courts judge disputes while residents must find housing themselves.
It is not known how many municipalities permit or prohibit permanent residence in holiday homes.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten permanente bewoning van vakantiewoningen toestaan of juist niet toestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over beschimmelde huizen in Bedum en Groningen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about long-term residents in mouldy, poorly ventilated social rental homes in Bedum and Groningen, and how long this is acceptable. The minister answered that landlords are responsible for repairs, pointed tenants to the complaints committee, Huurcommissie, courts and building supervision, and said the corporations are acting with tenants, without intervening in the individual case.

In general terms the Minister's role is to set the framework, and it is not appropriate to intervene in such a case in advance, given the various legal options and obligations that exist to remedy the problem.

In algemene zin is de rol van de Minister kaderstellend en past het op voorhand niet om te interveniëren in een dergelijke casus, gelet op de diverse wettelijke mogelijkheden en verplichtingen die er zijn om de problematiek te verhelpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over de blokkade van een demonstratie

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Minister of the Interior about a blockade that prevented a permitted demonstration against Zwarte Piet in Dokkum from proceeding, and whether ministers had signalled understanding for it. The minister replied that the mayor is the competent authority under the Wom, that no cabinet member judged the mayor's decisions, that the prosecution investigation is ongoing, and that she would consult mayors and the VNG on the public-order criterion.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is still ongoing, and nothing further can be reported on this at present.
Het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie loopt nog, daarover kan op dit moment verder niets worden gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van Raak over het onderzoek ‘Verkenning Meldprocedures en Integriteitsvoorzieningen 2017’

MPs asked about a 2017 Huis voor klokkenluiders survey finding only 48% of employers have whistleblowing procedures meeting the Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders, and about weak reporting culture, especially in semi-public sector and firms without works councils. The minister acknowledged the gaps, said work remains, and pointed to ministry activities in 2018 and recommendations to works councils and branch organisations, without new binding measures.
The Ministry of SZW will also devote attention in 2018 to the importance of a safe work culture, including by organising meetings and drawing attention to developed instruments.

Het Ministerie van SZW zal ook in 2018 aandacht besteden aan het belang van een veilige werkcultuur, onder meer door het organiseren van bijeenkomsten en door het extra onder de aandacht brengen van ontwikkelde instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Rijk in stenen, arm in geld’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether seniors should be able to unlock home equity and whether the mortgage-access issue blocks housing mobility, and why a motion on senior mortgages had not yet produced action. The minister responded that a platform on tailored mortgage lending identified constraints from the income-based annuity test in the RHK, that the AFM clarified when exceptions are permissible, and that a yearly mortgage platform will revisit equity release, possibly involving the NHG if warranted.
I have decided to give substance to this by organising a mortgage platform every year.
Ik heb besloten hier invulling aan te geven door jaarlijks een platform hypotheken te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat overwaarde moeilijk te gelde te maken is

MP Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that home equity is hard to access for older homeowners with low incomes, including whether they must move, why few providers offer equity-release mortgages, and the effect of phasing out the Hillen scheme. The minister answered that equity can be released through interest-only mortgages, individual affordability assessments and other options, that competition is sufficient though equity-release providers are few, and that the Hillen phase-out is unlikely to force sales.
I consider it important that seniors have sufficient options to release equity from their homes.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat senioren voldoende mogelijkheden hebben om overwaarde vrij te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Coalitie-Overeenkomst NPRZ tussen marktpartijen, de gemeente Rotterdam en woningcorporaties voor de aanpak van de particuliere woningvoorraad in Rotterdam-Zuid

The MP asked the minister about the NPRZ coalition agreement between market parties, Rotterdam and housing corporations to tackle 2,000 private homes in Rotterdam-South, why this differs from the earlier 10,000-home target, and whether corporation-bought homes funded by tenants would be resold. The minister sent the agreement, said the 10,000-home ambition stands and 2,000 homes are a first phase, and said local details and funding arrangements will be set in a programme committee and performance agreements.
The agreements on this are made at local level and form part of the programme committee mentioned in the answer to question 2.
De afspraken hierover worden op lokaal niveau gemaakt en maken deel uit van de in het antwoord op vraag 2 genoemde programmacommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Den Boer en Van Raak over zwangere volksvertegenwoordigers

MPs Özütok, Den Boer and Van Raak asked whether a Nijmegen councillor's resignation, forced by the rule barring temporary replacement in the last 16 weeks of a term, amounts to pregnancy discrimination and whether adoption leave can be covered. Minister Ollongren said there is no discrimination, but she will prepare a bill to allow temporary replacement throughout the term, while refusing a constitutional amendment for adoption.
I am willing to prepare a separate bill for this purpose and will aim to present the bill to your House shortly.
Ik ben bereid daartoe een separaat wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding te nemen en zal ernaar streven het wetsvoorstel op korte termijn aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Den Boer en Sneller over de beïnvloeding door buitenlandse entiteiten van democratische verkiezingen

Three D66 MPs asked the Interior Minister about foreign influence on elections via social media, including Russian political ads on Facebook, data protection against microtargeting, and advertiser transparency. The government replied by referring to a separate letter on covert influence of public opinion by state actors, without answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MPs Verhoeven, Den Boer and Sneller (all D66), question number 2017Z15194, have been answered by means of the letter 'Covert influence on public opinion by state actors'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de van de leden Verhoeven, Den Boer en Sneller (allen D66), vraagnummer 2017Z15194 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Heimelijke beïnvloeding van de publieke opinie door statelijke actoren»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kröger over het bericht ‘Driekwart gemeenten koopt nog vervuilend vervoer’

MPs Özütok and Kröger asked whether municipalities have the expertise and priority to buy sustainable vehicles, after a Natuur & Milieu benchmark found most municipalities lag behind national procurement criteria. The State Secretary attributes gaps to limited knowledge, priority and divided responsibility, points to existing MVI support tools, and says she will discuss stimulating municipalities with the VNG and PIANOo without making binding commitments.
I am happy to discuss with the VNG and PIANOo how we can further encourage municipalities to improve this.
Ik ben er graag toe bereid om met de VNG en PIANOo te bespreken hoe we gemeenten nog meer kunnen stimuleren om dit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat steeds minder starters een huis kunnen kopen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior about reports that fewer starters can obtain a mortgage, asking how many starters are excluded from both buying and renting and whether the LTV limit should be kept from falling further. The Minister replied that the government lacks data on starters who abstain from the market, reaffirmed that LTV will not be cut below 100 percent, and pointed to municipal planning and a mid-rent segment initiative.
Unfortunately I cannot make statements about people who, for various reasons, decide not to start on the housing market as a renter or buyer, as I do not have the relevant data.
Helaas kan ik geen uitspraken doen over mensen die vanwege diverse redenen besluiten om niet te starten op de woningmarkt als huurder dan wel koper, ik beschik niet over de relevante data.
Antwoord op van het lid Koerhuis over het huurbeleid van woningcorporaties

Rep. Koerhuis (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior about a CPB report finding that housing corporations give larger rent discounts on luxury homes, and about options to align rents with quality, including a norm rent in rent allowance, selling and liberalising high-point homes, and stimulating such sales. The Minister replied that rent policy is constrained by existing rules, that a norm rent would be a major change with income effects, that sales rules were loosened and that the middle-rent table's findings will be sent in early 2018.
Early in 2018, following the outcomes and recommendations of the middle-rent working table chaired by Mr van Gijzel, I will inform you further on this point.
Begin 2018 zal ik naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten en aanbevelingen van de samenwerkingstafel middenhuur o.l.v. de heer van Gijzel u op dit punt nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat de woningbouwproductie steeds verder achteroploopt door onderbezetting bij gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipal understaffing delays housing construction, how many projects the Crisis and Recovery Act and expert teams had helped, and whether those teams should proactively visit municipalities. The minister acknowledged delays and capacity problems but said exact figures are lacking, pointed to ongoing regional talks and continued use of the expert teams, but did not commit to proactive outreach.
At this moment I do not have exact figures that could give more insight into this.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over exacte cijfers die hier meer inzicht in kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over integriteit van het lokaal bestuur in Limburg

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked the Minister of Interior whether the appointment of a controversial alderman in Brunssum, which the mayor and the Limburg commissioner of the King considered a threat to governability, was acceptable and what tools mayors and commissioners have when integrity is at stake. The Minister said she had requested an official report, appointed an acting mayor with a mandate to restore relations, and promised to report by Q1 2018 on whether the legal toolkit should be expanded.
I aim to inform your House further on this in the first quarter of 2018.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hierover in het eerste kwartaal van 2018 nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Özdil over het bericht ‘Studentensteden sturen brandbrief over huisjesmelkers’

MPs Voortman and Özdil asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that student cities want more powers against landlords exploiting the student housing shortage, including whether students can resist excessive rents and what municipalities can do. The minister answered that tenants can use rent regulation and the Huurcommissie, launched a targeted student campaign, gave an overview of housing supply figures without per-city data, and said she is willing to discuss additional municipal powers with the aldermen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huurwoningen vaak onbetaalbaar zijn voor mensen met een middeninkomen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that many middle-income households cannot afford rents above €700, and why they are labelled 'scheefwoners', and whether rent protection should be extended to middle-rent homes. The minister disputes the 28% figure as a theoretical calculation, argues middle incomes have ample housing options, refuses to extend the social-rent regime, and points to municipal instruments and a working group on middle-rent housing.
I do not share that view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de consument nog steeds ten onrechte kosten betaalt aan verhuurmakelaars

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether letting agents still charge tenants illegal intermediary fees, why enforcement is lacking, and what tenants can do. The minister confirmed the legal ban, said tenants can reclaim fees within five years, and noted the ACM supervises compliance and has acted against agents in the past.
I do not have figures on the number of intermediaries who wrongly charge, whether or not disguised, intermediary fees.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van de aantallen bemiddelaars die ten onrechte al dan niet verkapte bemiddelingskosten in rekening brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Beckerman over het bericht dat steeds meer woningen worden opgekocht door particuliere beleggers om duur te verhuren (buy to let)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about buy-to-let investors buying homes to rent out at high rents, including rent levels, displacement of first-time buyers, corporation home sales and possible tax or contractual limits. The Minister answered that buy-to-let can add to the rental supply, that displacement of starters seems limited to Amsterdam so no national measures are planned, and that corporation sales are already controlled via the Autoriteit woningcorporaties and prestatieafspraken.
Displacement of first-time buyers so far only seems to occur in Amsterdam, so I do not consider it appropriate to take national measures to curb buy-to-let.
Verdringing van koopstarters lijkt zich vooralsnog alleen voor te doen in Amsterdam, waardoor ik het nemen van landelijke maatregelen om buy to let af te remmen niet passend acht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over administratieve lasten bij woningcorporaties

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether housing associations' administrative burden had risen sharply under the revised Housing Act, as Aedes claimed, and what could be done to cut costs. The minister acknowledged the burden rose more than expected, estimated the structural increase at about 60 million euros, and committed to consulting sector parties on reducing burdens, pointing to existing supervision and reporting streamlining initiatives.
I agree with Aedes that it must be examined how, within the goals of the law, the administrative burden for corporations is not higher than necessary.
Ik ben het met Aedes eens dat gekeken moet worden hoe binnen de doelen van de wet de administratieve lasten voor corporaties niet hoger zijn dan nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Özütok over de afhandeling van de zaak Artez

Two MPs asked the ministers about the costs and lessons of the ArtEZ top-salary (WNT) case, the first enforcement of its kind, which involved a penalty order by the Education Inspectorate. The government estimates about €350,000 in public costs, says lessons are shared among WNT supervisors, promises evaluation of supervision and enforcement in 2019, and points to the annual WNT report for other cases.
In the next evaluation of the WNT, planned for 2019, supervision and enforcement will be specifically evaluated, among other things.
In de volgende evaluatie van de WNT, voorzien in 2019, zullen onder meer het toezicht en de handhaving gericht worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de almaar stijgende huizenprijzen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about rising house prices, Moody's forecast of continued increases, and whether insufficient construction and regulation are to blame. The minister answered that price rises are concentrated in cities for structural reasons, declined to forecast prices, and outlined measures to boost construction and regional housing policy.
For that reason I make no statements about price developments over the next three years.
Daarom doe ik geen uitspraken over de prijsontwikkeling in de komende drie jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een zakenprins illegale activiteiten onderneemt

The SP MP Van Raak asked the ministers about a report that a prince of the royal family, Bernhard, runs illegal rental practices such as charging key money, possibly unregistered tenants, and asked whether royals must obey the law. The minister answered that rental law applies to everyone, that the ACM supervises the rental market and municipalities can fine unregistered occupancy, and declined to comment on the specific case.
Laws and regulations, such as those on rental, apply to everyone. I see no reason to address this specific situation.
Wet en regelgeving, zoals ten aanzien van verhuur geldt voor iedereen. Ik zie geen aanleiding om op deze specifieke situatie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “verloedering van de bouwwereld”

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the construction sector is deteriorating, whether municipal building supervision failed in cases of unsafe concrete floors, who is liable for damage, and how to prevent the sector from being left to self-supervision. The minister disagreed that the sector is deteriorating, stated that municipalities supervise compliance but builders bear responsibility for quality, and said the inventory of affected buildings is ongoing.
As far as can currently be estimated, hundreds of buildings will actually need to be examined.
Voor zover nu wordt ingeschat, zullen honderden gebouwen daadwerkelijk moeten worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, De Graaf en Agema over het bericht dat senioren in Apeldoorn overdonderd zijn door de komst van Turkse leeftijdsgenoten

MPs from the PVV asked ministers whether it is acceptable that a housing corporation in Apeldoorn plans to let vacated flats in a senior complex to Turkish elderly receiving home care, without consulting current residents, and asked for the plans to be stopped. The minister replied that corporations are free to set allocation policy within the Housing and Tenancy Acts, that the corporation appears to have followed the legal consultation procedure, and that residents can complain to the independent complaints committee or the courts, but that the minister has no role in individual allocation policy.
As far as I can tell, the housing corporation has acted within the framework of the law.
Voor zover ik kan nagaan heeft de woningcorporatie binnen de kaders van de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over grotere vermogensongelijkheid door het volkshuisvestingsbeleid

Member Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister whether the government's promotion of home ownership, the housing market rules and planned measures would reduce wealth inequality and improve access to housing for lower-income households. The Minister answered that the effects of specific measures cannot be generalised, that many factors affect wealth inequality, and that the government expects to strengthen middle-rent supply and housing construction without predicting effects on wealth distribution.
It is not possible to say in general what effect a change in the rules on the mortgage market or the free rental sector has on wealth differences and access to the housing market.

Het is niet mogelijk om in zijn algemeenheid te zeggen welk effect een verandering van de regels op de hypotheekmarkt of de vrije huursector heeft op de vermogensverschillen en de toegang tot de woningmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een belofte van vice-premier De Jonge

The MP asks when the minister will deliver on the Deputy PM's promise to quickly provide concrete examples of Russian-spread fake news in the Netherlands, and whether the answer will be sent by a set deadline. The minister points to earlier letters with examples of state influence on public opinion, promises a further letter before the Christmas recess, and agrees to send the answer on time.
In the debate on my ministry's budget last week I indicated that I will inform your House further before the Christmas recess.
Ik heb in het debat over de begrotingsbehandeling van mijn ministerie vorige week aangegeven dat ik uw Kamer voor het Kerstreces nader informeer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het artikel ‘Onderwijs raakt in de knel door complexe regelgeving’

An MP asked about complex regulation burdening education, including identical annual reporting rules for small and large institutions, high administrative costs of the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT), its complex transitional rules, and enforcement gaps. The minister answered that rules apply regardless of size for transparency, that administrative costs are being reduced via simplifications and a new audit protocol, and that sanctions such as orders with penalty payments exist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het raadplegen van de informatie over de formatie op rijksoverheid.nl

An MP asked why the archive of the Rutte-III coalition formation was not available on rijksoverheid.nl despite a promise of access, and asked about transparency of lobbying. The minister replied that about 1,500 formation documents were published on kabinetsformatie2017.nl on 15 November 2017 with personal data made unreadable, and that the government supports greater openness and will consult on the Open Overheid initiative.
